  • stick to, Mukupa wamuntoowa wakabbaamina acikanda cangu. = The sap of the muntoowa tree adhered to my skin.
  • subside naturally as a blister without lancing, Itwizya lyakali akuboko kwangu lyakabbaamina. = The blister which was on my arm subsided by itself.
stand stiffly, as on guard. Ulabajana bamasilikani kababbaa nyana kugatela nanda yacisi. = You find soldiers standing guarding State House.

be dressed in smart and stiff uniform, Nkujana nguyuulya mupaale wiide kubbaanyene mumakkaki mwanaa musimbi kwamukomena tyambo mucibuno. = There was a smart girl standing in starched khaki uniform with a large belt around her waist.
catch unawares, Ijilo mubbi bakamubbaatikizya basilikani nkabela bakamwaanga nsimbi. = Yesterday the police caught the thief unawares and handcuffed him. Also: -bbaatizya.
pounce on, Ndamuka kuyuba limwi bandiyandaula bandibbaatizya. I was slow to hide until finally the people who were looking for me pounced on me. Also: -bbaatikizya
stagger, Bana bakaunka kwiita bausyi kumwi bayaku-bbabbalika akaambo karjonzi. = The children went to call their father while staggering because of sleepiness.

stutter, Uulya muntu ulabbabbalisya kukanana. That person stutters when she speaks. Mulaka wakwe ulaangenye ncabbabbalisya kwaambaula. = His tongue is tied that is why he stutters when speaking. (1.-bbabbalisigwa, 2.-bbabbalisyide, 4.-bbabbalisyila, 5.-bbabbalisyilalyo, 6.-bbabbalisyisya,-7.-bbabbalisyabbabbalisya.) Also: -kankatila.

wrestling with one another, Basimbi bobilo nibakakolwa bakali kubbabbalisyanya pesi kunyina wakatingwa. = When the two girls were drunk they were wrestling with one another, but no one was thrown down. Also: -gagalisyanya, -gigilisyanya, -jijilisyanya.
be stuck or glued together, -bbabbatila, Zikoye zyakwe zili bbabbamide mantongwe. = His eyelids are stuck together with mucous.

become glued together, as eyelids, Mukupa walusu nindakuusiya bwakaindi, wakabbabbamina munkomeki akaambo kamudumu. = When I had left the powdered milk for a long time in the cup, it became coagulated because of the dampness. Also: -gagatila, -bbabbatila.

be peeled off as a scabs or leaves sticking to another, Zikwa zyamusamu ooyu zyakabbabbanuka. = The bark of this tree has peeled off. Lwakabbabbanuka lukanda nicakapona cilonda. = The scab peeled off when the wound healed. Yalikwama nzoka, alabbabbanuka makwa. = When the snake moults, the scales are sloughed. Also: -babanuka.

sever, peel off, as bark from a tree or scab from a wound, Mutinta, kobbabbanuna makwa amusamu. = Mutinta, peel off the bark of the tree. Bakalya nsima ndala njibakali kuyoka amakala amulilo kutegwa ikasaale. Niyakakasaala bakaibbabbanuna makwa akutalika kwiibuya. = They were eating left-over nsima which they were roasting on the embers of the fire so that it would become warm. When it was warm they peeled off the skin and began to eat it without relish. Also: -babanuna.
Ihacci yakatalika kubbabbata niyakaumwa kasako andelo. = The horse started to gallop when it was struck on the shoulder with a stick.
be glued together, Eeci cisamu mociyaabukomenena cilabbabbatila kuceenzinyina. = This tree as it grows sticks to its neighbouring tree. Also: -bbabbamina.
unglue, Kobbabbatula bulongo obu kukaanda kampongo. = Remove this clay from the wall of the goats shelter.
peeling in sections of skin as a result of being beaten, Musankwa naakamana kuumwa, wakabbabbauka cikanda. = After the boy was beaten, the skin peeled off.

remove section by section, Mumazuba masyoonto nanda njibakabbabbaula basimukowa wakaivwumba amasenke eeni alubulo. = In a few days the roof of the house, which the relatives of the husband had stripped, he replaced with real sheets of iron.

fall of as plaster, peel off as trunk of tree, be abraded as skin, Cikanda camunwe cakabbabbuka nindakalinontola. = The skin of my toe came off when I tripped. Bakazyuuma ndeye zyamyuumba akubbabbuka antobo. = They beat the bundles of spears against the shields so that they fell off. Also: -matula

burn small patches of grass, Kamubbabbula syokwe eli. = Burn this patch of the bush. Also: -babula, -babwida.
  • lacerate, strip off skin, Bamubbabbula cikanda kucibbadela. = They removed his skin at the hospital. Also: -papula
remove skin carefully, Kamubbabbulula zikanda zyajejemuka. = Remove the skin which has become loose.
unglue, separate, Bakazibbabbununa zipepa kutegwa zyaandaane. = They unglued the papers so that they could be separated. Also: -bbabbatula.
tear off for someone, Kamundibbabbwida nyama ndye. = Tear off the meat for me so that I eat.
burn grass around houses as a precaution against bush fires.
cause to pay, charge, Musankwa umwi wakali kuzabusya akubbadalisya basinyendo acito. = A cetain boy was ferrying travellers across and charging them at the bridge. Also: -bbadelesya.

pay, Bana bacikolo babakasya kulya nkaambo tiibakabbadela. = They have not allowed the school children to eat because they did not pay. Uuyanda kusilikwa nkubbadela mali. = The one who wants to be healed has to pay money. (1.-bbadelwa, 2.-bbadede, or -bbadele, 3.-bbadezya, 4.-bbadelela, 5.-bbadelelalyo, 6.-bbadelesya, 7.-bbadela-bbadela, 8.-bbadelana.)
shoot, Nguni wabbaila ntobolo? = Who fired the gun? Also: -dubula.
be shot with a gun, rt. bbaila, Cheelo wakabbailwa ntobolo naakatiinjile munanda. = Cheelo was shot with a gun as he was about to enter the house. Also: -dubulwa.
search, Nobasankwa, kamulibbaka-bbaka mumakomo tuule tumbuwa. = Boys, search your pockets so that we buy some buns.
rouse oneself, Nokakaba kaindi kabacili mukasinze kali boobu, Mainza wakalibbakamuna. = = After a while when they were still in darkness, Mainza roused himself and opened his mouth and began to talk.
kick with leg, Mbongolo niyakamubbakela, wakawa ansi. = When the donkey kicked him, he fell down.

carry on back, Mutinta, komubbala mwana aleke kulila. = Mutinta, carry the child on your back so that it stops crying. (1.-bbalwa, 2.-bbalide, 3.-bbazya, 4.-bbalila, 5.-bbalilalyo, 7.-bbala-bbala, 8.-bbalana)
  • bear fruit, as bananas, cobs etc., Mapopwe akabbala mumuunda wangu. = The maize in my field has brought forth some good cobs.
run over to, Moombe mubutu wakabbalamukila kuli banyina. = The unweaned calf ran over to its mother.

take turns in herding or carrying one another, as on a bicycle, Tunooyaabucincana kubbalana ali namutendele. = We will be taking turns in carrying one another on the bicycle.
  • be connected, Ino twakozyanya buti? Antela tuli luzubo lomwe nkolu-bbalana. = How are we so much alike? Perhaps we are connected in clan relationships.
struggle against, Tusune twakabbalangana. = The oxen were difficult to handle. Also: -pilingana.

be interweaved, be overlapped, Ooyu musankwa menyo akwe alibbalenye. = This boy's teeth have grown over one another.
  • act of carrying one another, Basimbi balibbalenye ancinga nibali kuya kucibbadela. = The girls were carrying one another on the bicycle when they were going to the hospital.

escape, Musune mweenzu wabbalika. = The newly acquired ox has escaped. Bazike baali kubbalika kuzwa kuli basimalelo babo. = The slaves were escaping from their masters. Also: -loboka.
  • easily carried, Mwana ooyu wakabbalika kale nkaambo lukombo-kombo Iwakawa kale. = It was already possible to carry the child on the back because the umbilical cord had already dropped off.
escape to, rt. -bbalika, Mukaintu naakaumwa, wakabbalikila kumunyinandumi wakwe. = When the woman was beaten, she escaped to her brother.

open an ox all along the stomach, Nibakamana kufwunda musune okwesu, bakamubbalula. = After skinning our ox, they opened it along its stomach. Also: -bbwalula. (1.-bbalulwa, 2.-bbalukide, 3.-bbalulisya, 4.-bbalwida, 5.-bbalwidalyo, 6.-bbalulisya, 7.-bbalula-bbalula)
  • remove baby from back, rt. -bbala Kobbalula mwana. = Put the child down from your back.

transfer inherited name from one person to another, Muzimo wakabbalulwa naakaumwaya wakaangidwe. The spirit was transferred when (by bad behaviour) the one to whom it had been given, drove it off.
  • taken down from the back, Mwana wakabbalulwa nobakasika kumunzi banyina. The child was taken down form the back when the mother arrived home.
split wood, Choolwe wakabbaluula nkuni. = Choolwe chopped up the firewood. Also: -pandaula, -kwamaula, -kwamauna.
be in a state of terror, Fwulwe wabbambasana akufwooteka. = The tortoise was terrified and could not breathe properly.

crush, Muzovwu wamubbambasanya elyo muya oonse wazwida amwi. = The elephant crushed him and all his breath came out in a gasp. -bbambasele Nyika yaku Nakambala ilibambasele. The land at Namabala is flat.
hobble, Cheelo ubbampa buya kweenda. Cheelo just hobbles as he walks. Also: -bampa, -dyabatila.
patch, Buluke bulizapukide, cifwumo ndeelede kububbampika. = My pair of trousers is torn, to-morrow I should patch them. Also: gambilila
hobble along, Muntu uciswa zinowe, ulabbampila kweenda. = A person with corns, hobbles along when walking. Also: -bampila, -sunkuta.
cause to scatter, Ncinzi cakabbamukizya bantu bakali kunywa bukoko? = What caused the people to scatter who were drinking beer?

scatter from one another, Niyakalila ntobolo, boonse bakali kunywa bukoko bakabbamukizyanya kuya musyokwe. When the gun was fired, all those who were drinking beer scattered off into the bush. Mukopa a Musulumba bakabbamukizyanya mbuli kuti tabacizyi cicitika. Mukopa and Musulumba scattered from one another as if they did not know what had happened. Also: -mwaikizyanya.

open, Wakabbamuna gabba lisiya lyaananikidwe wailo. = He opened the black tin which had been smeared with oil. Koleta cibbamuna mulomo. = Bring what opens the mouth. (i.e. a bribe) (1.-bbamunwa, 2.-bbamunidwe, 3.-bbamunisya, 4.-bbamunina/-bbamwida, 5.-bbamuninalyo, /bbamwidalyo, 6.-bbamunisya, 7.-bbamuna-bbamuna)

lie down with face downwards, Mwana, kobbandama, tubone cuute amatako aako. Child, lie face down so that we see the abcess on your buttock. Wakabbandama wakavwalama ansi. She lay face downwards, crouching on the ground. (2.-bbandamide, 3.-bbandamisya, 4.-bbandamika) Also: -bandama.
put one lying down, Bayi bakabbandamika sicikolo akumuuma tusako totatwe. The teacher put the pupil lying face downwards and gave him three strokes.
lie down secretely near, Ooyu mwana wakabbandamina abantu beenzu kuteelela nzyobakali kwaamba. This child lay down secretely near the visitors to hear what they were saying.
tuck cloth between legs, *Kamumubbangila mwana kutegwa atamubisyi aambuka.* Tuck the cloth in between the child's legs so that it does not soil you when it defecates. Also: -bingila.

be peeled or pulled off, as skin, *Wakalumwa syuumbwa aboobo wakabbankauka mubili.* = He was attacked by a lion and so had his skin was pulled off from the body.
  • be very thin, *Akaambo kabulwazi Masowe wakabbankauka citaambiki.* = Because of illness Masowe has become unspeakably thin.
beat hard and fast, *Musankwa wakali kwiibbankaula ngoma.* = The boy was beating the drum hard and fast.
break into many pieces, *Kamubbansaula looye twaanzye misunta yabwizu.* = Cut the cord into many pieces so that we tie the bundles of grass. Also: -kosoola, -dunsaula, -zutaula.

break as a rope into two parts, *Kamubbansula lukole oolo muzibeela zyobilo.* = Cut that rope into two pieces. Also: -kosola
  • beat severely, *Ndakubbansula mbayi kuti koile kulila.* = I will give you a good slap if you continue to cry. *Wakamubbansula kabayi kumatako.* = She gave him a good slap on the bottom. Also: -bbansaula.

try to find means of solving a problem, *Nindakafwidwa bataata, ndakabbantauka nkaambo ndakabula cakucita.* When my father died, I was searching for a way to solve my problems, as I did not know what to do. *Nobakamubuzya musimbi, kakunyina akubbantauka, wakabaambila kuti masimpe wakalaa da.* When they questioned the girl she said, without searching for an excuse, that she was indeed pregnant.
slap repeatedly, *Munene wakababbantaula bana bakalisya nombe mumuunda wakwe.* The old man slapped the children repeatedly who let the cattle graze in his field. Also: -bantaula
be caught unexpectedly, *Muka Sicibende wakabbantilwa buya, wakabula ambwasisa.* The wife of Sicibende was caught unexpectedly, she had no way of hiding.

move house or village a short distance, *Bakabbantukila mumalundu akwa Mulundika nobakamvwa manunununu niyakanjila ntomba mucisi.* = They moved away to the hills of Mulundika when they heard rumours that smallpox had entered the land.
slap again and again, *Bantu bakamubbantula sicinguni.* = The people repeatedly beat the stubbourn one. Also: -bbantaula.
open, *Nikakaba kaindi wakabbanuna mulomo kuti akanane.* = After a short time he opened his mouth to speak. *Wakabbanuna meso aakwe.* = She opened her eyes. Also: -banuna.
look after carefully, *Mainza aubbasope kabotu musamu, ulayandika mumulimo wakukusilika.* = Let Mainza look after the medicine carefully, it is needed for treating you.
stick with force, *Wakamubbata ceele kumeso mweenzinyina.*= He plastered his friend's face with porridge. *Kozwa ulakubbata mankanda.* = Move away he will paste you with mud.
(the movement of running), *Syaampeyo kaciti bbata-bbata wakabona muntu ufwuma kweenda kazya.* = Syaampeyo, while running, saw a man coming quickly.
stick on by force, *Wakabbataika tusinsyo twamabbodela.* = He stuck on the tops of the bottles using force.
be awakened, Ndakabbatamuka uuzyana naakanjila munanda. = I awoke when the dancer entered the house.
awaken suddenly, Mmubwa wakandibbatamuna naakanjila munanda mwindakalede. = It was a dog which suddenly awakened me when it entered the house where I was lying. Also: -patamuna.

come out, Inanda njibakali kusyingulula yakabbatauka. = The plaster came off the house which they were plastering.
  • hurry, Kamubbatauka kweenda. = Hurry along. Also: -batauka, -bindaana, -nyangauka.
make come off, Wakatalika kubbataula tusinsyo twaavwunisizye mabbodela. = He started removing the caps covering the bottles.

stick, Kobbatika citampa alugwalo kotanalutumizya. = Stick a stamp on the letter before you post it. Wakabbatika lugwalo ndwaakali kulemba acitendele cananda. = He stuck the letter he had written on the door-post of the house. Also: -bantika.
be fixed on, Munanda mwakabbatikidwe zifwanikiso zinji kubwaanda. = In the house there were many pictures fixed on the wall.
squeeze, Kolibbatikizya, ndiza uleela. = Squeeze yourself in, maybe you will fit. Also: -patikizya, -syanikizya.
peel off, Bataata nobamuuma cimboko mwana, cikanda cabbatuka. = When my father beat the child with a whip, the skin came off.

take a step, Mwana wiiya kweenda, usoka kwiima naya kubbatula. = A child who is learning to walk, first tries to stand and then it takes a step. Naatiikati abbatule kuulu ayende, wakamvwa buyo jwi kunze lyakwe. = When he was about to lift his leg to move away, he heard a voice behind him.
  • open, Kokaka kubbatula mulomo baakukubuzya. = Refuse to open your mouth when they ask you. Also: -mamuna.
  • remove, uncover, open up, Kobbatula civwunisyo cakagabba kajisi nswi. = Take the lid off the tinned fish. Also: -batula
unstick, Nokwakamana kuvwoota, zipepa zyoonse bakazibbatulula. = When the voting was over, they removed all the posters. Also: - babatula.
carry with or in, rt. -bbala, Eeyi ngubo njakubbazya mwana. = This cloth is for carrying the child.
carry with, Mali ndakaakwaawuzya mulembo wacitenge eci ncebbazizye mwana. = I used the money for buying citenge material with which I carry the baby.

be fierce, intense, Nkondo ya Balozi yakabbebba. = The Lozi war was fierce. Mulilo wankuni zyamubanga ulabbebba kapati. = Fire made from firewood of hard trees, flames furiously. Kaambo kakacili kubbebba ncobeni. = The matter was at boiling point.
  • travel at high speed = Kootokala kakabbebba. = The small car went quickly.
be in a state of fury, Wakajoka ulibbebbede. = He returned in an furious state.
burn fiercely in (with, at), Mulilo wabbebbela mumbaula. = The fire burned fiercly in the fire container.

pout, as a spoilt child, make an ugly face, Banyina nibakamukwabbaula muluso mwana, wakabbebbenyana akulila. = When the mother caned the child, it pouted and cried. Also: -bbebbula, -debbula, -piinyika milomo, -pipinyana, -memenyana.

make ugly, Bacembele bakacibbebbenyeka caali cibiya. = The old lady deliberately made the pot unattractive.
  • be ugly, Cibbebbenyeka kumeso ulati ncilozi. = He is ugly in the face, you would say he is a witch.

be ugly, be distorted, Bakati 'camunanda tacisalwi', tee kufwumbwa cijika nsima nocibbebbenyene nkubweza buyo. = They say you do not choose what is for the house (i.e. a permanent wife) according to her beauty, but whoever can cook, no matter how ugly she is, just take her. Ciindi eeci tiibakali kulangwa kumeso nkaambo bakalibbebbenyene citaambiki akaambo kabukali bwakabalutizizye. = At that time you could not look at their faces as they were unspeakably distorted because of the anger which filled them with so much hatred.
pout, Mwana wakabbebbula mulomo naakaumwa kuli banyina pesi taakalila. = The child pouted when it was beaten by its mother but it did not cry. Also: -debbula, -bbebbenyana.

state of carrying a baby, rt. bbala, Umwi mukaintu tanaakamubbede kabotu mwana. = One woman was not carrying her baby properly. Maboko twakali kupindulwa nkwaangilwa kusyule, nobbede mwana kusyule tokonzyi kumwaangulula kuti anyonke. Banji bana bakali kufwa kusyule lyamanyina balibbedwe. = The arms were tied behind the back, when you carried a child on the back you were not able to untie the child so that it could suck. Many children died when carried on the backs of their mothers (who were taken as slaves).
swing around, Kacembele kakabbeeleluka nikakali kutandwa munyati. = The old woman was swerving around when she was being chased by a buffalo. Also: -beeluka, -bbeluka
swing around, e.g Cisani cilabbeeluka akaambo kamuwo wavwula. = The cloth is swinging around because there is plenty of wind. Also: -bbeeleluka.
cause to swing around, Koleka kubbeelelusya zisani munsi acakulya. = Stop swinging your clothes around near the food.

open partly, pull back, Kamukabbeesula kalembo tubone ncasisa munanda. = Pull back the curtain so that we see what she is hiding in the house. Also: -beeluka.
  • drag along, Ncibi kubbeesula mulembo watombe munsi acakulya. = It is bad to drag a dirty cloth along beside the food.
drag through, rt. -bbeesula, Ndabbeeswida dembo lyangu muli cakulya. = I have dragged my long coat along through where the food is.
winnow, Kamutwa! Kamubbeeta! Kamuseba! Kamuziya! = Pound! Winnow! Sift! Grind! Also: -pupulula.
agree to a bet in contesting, Bakabbejelana musinzo wakutijaana akusiyana. = They placed a bet in competing in a race.
flash, as lightning, Cijazyo cako cilabbekema muzuba. = Your door is shining in the sun. Also: -naima, -njelema.
swing around, Bantu nobazyana ciņande balabbeluka. = People swing around when they dance the cinande. Also: -beeluka.
curve, bend, (ety.Eng.) Cabbenda cibulo nicaumpwa mucikko. = The metal bent when it was burnt in the fireplace. Also: -diimana
toss up, when winnowing, Kamubbeta musozya ooyu mwamana musibike. = Winnow the pounded maize and when you have finished put it on the fire. Also: -pupulula, -bbeeta, -kwaapula.
overturn, Bbala lyakabbeuka akusowela ansi mutumba wamusankwa. = The wheelbarrow overturned and threw the body of the boy on to the ground.
be overturned, Ndakalibbeukide mumootokala. = I overturned in a car.
be repulsive, Cintu nocibbibbinkenye buti kubija, mpaali amwi mpocili mafwuta. No matter how unattractive a thing may be, a part of it has juice.
steal from, Musilisi bakamubbida misamu yoonse. = They stole all the medicines from the doctor. Wakandibbida moyo wangu oonse. You have stolen my whole heart.

gone deep into, rt. -bbila, Bakalibbide musyokwe kuyandaula nguwe. = They had gone deep into the bush searching for her. =
  • Moyo wakwe wakabbide kale mubulowa. Her heart had already sunk into blood. (i.e. she was totally distresssed)

cause to take a secret look, have hidden affection for, Koonse kulanga bakali kwiide kubbidikizya. They did all their looking in a hidden way. Musimbi ooyu tanaakali kulitondezya kuti kuli musankwa wakali kubbidikizya kuli nguwe. This girl was not giving any sign that there was a boy who was stealing a look at her.
be stolen, rt. -bba, Mwaka wakainda bantu banji bakabbidwa nombe zyabo. = Last year many people had their cattle stolen.

• remove barreness, Moonde ulicizyi kubbika bantu batazyali. = Moonde knows how to make fertile people who are barren or impotent.
  • easily stolen, rt. -bba, Nkuku zyacikuwa zilabbika nkaambo tazilili. = Broilers are easily stolen because they don't cry out.
have hope in, Ndali kulibbikka-bbikka kuti sunu ndavwola mali manji, ani pe. I had hoped that I would earn a lot of money today, but it is not so. cf. -bikka-bikka, -peekezya

investigate, Kuti kakuli kaambo nkotazyi, ncibotu kubbikita-bbikita kuli bamadaala kutegwa bakubule maanu. = If there is something which you do not know, it is good to seek information from the older men so that they supply you with knowledge. Nekuba kuti wabbikitabbikita muli basimabbuku, boonse bamanene inga bakwaambila kuti tabanacibwene cakuti musimbi watizigwa waakujoka. No matter how much you investigate among the headmen, all the old men will tell you that they have never seen a girl who was illegally taken away for marriage returning to the village. Also: -vwuntauzya, sepa-sépa

gore, toss with horns, Ooli kumpela abasune kocenjela, balakubbikula. Be careful as you are in front of the pair of oxen, they will gore you.
  • raise up with a lever, Kamubbikula azisamu kutegwa ibbwe lidaduke. = Use poles as levers so that the stone is raised.

disappear, Basankwa a basimbi bamazubaano beelede maanda alukwatano, bakabbila. The boys and girls of today, who are fit to have proper homes, have disappeared. (1.-bbilwa, 2.-bbide, 3.-bbizya, 4.-bbilila, 5.-bbililalyo, 7.-bbila-bbila.)
  • set, as sun, Izuba lyakabbila katutanasika ku Monze. The sun sank before we reached Monze.
  • sink, as in water, Bazubi bakali kubbila kuyandaula muntu wakanyikila mumulonga. = The fishermen were diving down in the water searching for the person who had drowned in the river. *Wakabbila kunsi ameenda.* = He was submerged under the water.
dive repeatedly into, *Cibawe wakabbilauka mazyiba oonse.* = The otter dived repeatedly into all the pools.

dive for, *Bamwi bantu balicizyi kubbilila nswi.* = Some people know how to dive for fish.
  • disappear, *nombe zyabbilila kunze amulundu.* = The cows have disappeared behind the hill.

disappear from one another, *Nobakaandaana buyo, tabanaenda kasinzo kabbililanwa, Mainza wakaita, wamwiimika mweenzinyina.* = When they had just separated, before they had gone a short distance without disappearing from each other's view, Mainza called, he stopped his friend. *Wakazwa kabotukabotu, bantu banji kabaliwo, akubweza twakwe, wabbilila kunze aņanda.* = He came out carefully, many people were there, and he took his belongings, he disappeared behind the house.
disappear, *Naakabbililila Ntiinga, mweenzinyina wakatalika kuseka.* = When Ntiinga has disappeared from view, her friend started to laugh.

work hard without a break, *Kuti kobbilingana amulimo mazuba oonse, inga ulanetuka.* = If you work hard for many days without a break, you will faint. *Musimbi wakali kubbilingana kubamanina milimo banyina.* = The girl was working hard to finish the work for her mother. Also: -bilingana, -gwilingana, -gwitingana.

be deep, *Sena cuumbwe eci cilabbilwa bakwesu?* = My friends, is this grave deep enough?
  • be robbed of, (Ila) *Jilo ndakabbilwa mulenga wangu.* = Yesterday I was robbed of my radio. Also: -bbidwa

be furious, as a river, . *Kuti mulonga wabbimba, inga wakutola.* = If the river is furious, it can take you.
  • (used as a noun) jealousy, *Muka Haatontola tayandi musimbi uusika munsi a mulumaakwe, ulaa bbimba.* = Haatontola's wife does not like a girl who comes near her husband, she is full of jealousy. Also: buzuba, bufwi.

be turned upside down, be overturned, *Cimbaya-mbaya cakabbindamuka jilo nkaambo wakalikweenzya wakalikoledwe.* = The lorry overturned yesterday because the one driving it was drunk. Also: -sandamuka, -vwuntamuka. (2.-bbindamukide, 3.-bbindamusya, 4.-bbindamukila, 5.-bbidamukilalyo, 6.-bbindamukisya, 7. bbindamukabbindamuka)

turn upside down, turn around, *Kobbindamuna nyama ilaida mumpoto.* = Turn the meat upside down as you fry otherwise in will burn in the pot. *Wakamubbindamuna mutwe kuti amulange kumeso nkaambo waamujisi amakosi.* = He turned her head around so that he could look at her face because he held her by the neck. (1.-bbindamunwa, 2.-bindamwide, 3.-bbindamusya, 4.-bbindamukila, 5.-bbindamukilalyo, 6.-bbindamukisya, 7.-bbindamukabbindamuka, 8.-bbindamunana.)

pass the loin cloth between the legs, *Kolibbindila musa inga katuyakubona zitabonwi.* = Gather your clothes around you properly or we will see what should not be seen. *Naakavwuluma munjile, babwa bakabbindila micila.* = When the warthog snorted, the dogs put their tails between their legs (in fear). (1.-bbindilwa, 2.-bbindide, 3.-bbindizya, 4.-bbindilila, 5.-bindililalyo, 6.-bbindilisya, 7.-bbindila-bbindila, 8.-bbindilana.)

have tail between legs, rt. bingila, *Babwa bakalilede kumwi ka babbingide *micila cakuyoowa akutakkomana.* = The dogs were lying down with their tails between their legs in fear and uneasiness. (1.-bbingidwe, 3.-bbingizya, 6.-bbingizyisya)

put tail between legs, Mubwa wa Mweetwa wakaka kubbingila mucila nkaambo kabukali bwakwe. = Mweetwa's dog, because it was fierce, would not put its tail between its legs. (1.-bbingilwa, 2.-bbingide, 3.-bbingizya, 4.-bbingizyizya, 5.-bbingizyizyalyo, 6.-bbingilisya) Also: -bbindila.

cover, Zisamu zipati zyamana kulundikwa, balatalika kubbitila makomwe aamavwu ngobagagula amaamba. = When the log are piled up they start covering them with clods of earth which they have dug out with hoes.

immerse, cause to go down, rt. -bbila, Ba Nsabata kupapatisya balo babbizya mumeenda. = The members of the Seventh Day Adventist Church baptize people by immersing them in the water. Kokwisula kalobo, *nswi yabbizya mbilibili.* = Pull the hook, the fish has made the float sink. Kaindi bamadaala tiibakali kubbizya zuba kunywa bukoko. = In the past old men did not drink beer until sunset. Ndakalibbizya mazuba manji mumasaka abantu akaambo aka. = I spent many days in different lands concerning that affair. (1.-bbizyigwa, 2.-bbizyide, 4.-bizyizya, 5.-bbizyizyalyo, 6.-bbizyisya, 8.-bbizyanya)
be crushed Cibulo cameenda cabbobana nicalyatwa acimbayambaya. = The bucket of water was crushed when it was run over by a lorry. Also: -ombenkana, -bbobela.

be crushed, Mootokala wabbobanya niwapwaya abwaanda. The vehicle was crushed when it smashed into a wall. Also: -poonkana, -pobana, -bbobana. = (2.-bbobenye, 3.-bbobanizya, 4.-bbobanina, -5.-bbobaninalyo)

sound like a plane or waterfall, Tweende tukabone mulonga uubbobboma ooku. = Let us go and see the river which roars over there. cf. -pompoma, -boboma. (2.-bbobbomede, 3.-bbobbomezya, 4.-bbobbomweda, 6.-bbobbomesya, 7.-bbobboma-bbobboma)
give up unwillingly, surrender, Mutinta wakabbobela mapopwe. = Mutinta gave up the maize unwillingly.

fall inwards, Inanda yakabboboka. The house fell inwards. Cuumbwe caba Sigola cakabboboka. = The grave of Sigola fell inwards. (2.-bbobokede, 3.-bbobozya, 4.-bobweda, 5.-bbobokelalyo)
  • gush out, as water when discovered, Meenda akabboboka mucikala. = Water gushed out of the well.
  • be in abundance, Mazubaano nsipa zyakabboboka. Nowadays soaps are in abundance. Mapopwe akabboboka uno mwaka, kunyina nzala. The maize is plentiful this year, there is no hunger.

sink down, cave in, Muntu wabbobokela kuulu mucisanza nibwatyoka bwalo. = The person's leg sunk down in the maize granary when the poles cracked. Musune wangu wabbobokela mubwina naalikucela atala acuulu. = My ox sank into a hole when it was grazing on top of an anthill. Also: -dyobokela, bbolokela, -golokela. (2.-bbobokede, 3.-bbobokezya)

pierce, Basankwa balibbobola bbola nibalikusola kubamba. = The boys burst the ball when they were trying to fix it. (1.-bbobolwa, 2.-bbobwede, 3.-bobbozya, 4.-bbobweda, 5.-bbobwedalyo, 6.-bbobolesya, 8.-bbobolana.) cf. -donkola, -bbosyola, -bobola.
  • make plentiful, Mfwulumende mpya yakabbobola camutunzya. = The new government has made fertilizer available. Balimi baibbobola mpilibili uno mwaka. = The farmers have harvested plenty of hot-pepper this year.

press down out of shape as a tin, Basimusika balabbobya zipimyo zyabo nzyobasambalila mapopwe. = Marketeers press down the tins out of shape with which they use to sell their maize. Also: -poonkanya, -bbobanyas, -bbokezya, -bbookezya.

speak to someone in a rough manner, Bamwi bana balabbodola kubapati. = Some children speak impolitely to the elders. Mukaintu naakabbodola kuvwiila mudaala wakamuuma lubayi lomwe. = When the woman answered in a rough manner, he gave her one slap. (2.-bbodwede, 3.-bbodozya, 4.-bbodweda, 5.-bbodwedalyo, 6.-bbodolesya, 8.-bbodweedana) Also: -dandaula.
boil, Izitende zyatalika kale kubbodoma mucibiya. = The pumpkins have already started to bubble in the pot. Also: -bila, -bodoma (2.-bbodomede, 3.-bbodomezya)

insult, Ncecikolo ncaakali kwiiya! Wakali kwiiya kubbodweeda bapati. = That is the school at which he was learning! He was learning to insult the elders. Wakatalika kubabbodweeda akubaswida mate. = He began to insult them and spit at them.
be scolded, rt. -bbodola, Nsyeyandi kuunka kuli bataata kuya kubbodweedwa. = I don't want to go to my father to be scolded.

sit as tired or very hungry, Ulibonya buya kubbogomana kuti wakatala. You show that you are exhausted by the lifeless way in which you are sitting. Ulibonya buya kubbogomana kuti ulinyemede. = Looking at the tired state you are in, one can tell you are angry. Also: -bongomana, -pokomanas, -pompomana.
eat the intestines inside by using means of witchcraft Tuyowela twabacembele twakamubbokaula cakumaninina. The spirits of the old woman have eaten his intestines completely.
dress in a nice way, Mubuzuba oobu Nabulongo wakalibbolede kusama. On this day Nabulonga had dressed with style.

explode, Vwili lyanamutendele lyakabboloka nindakainda abbwe. The wheel of the bicycle burst when I passed over a stone. Also: -bbolooka (2.-bbolokede, 3.-bbolosya, 4.-bbolokela, 5.-bbolokelalyo, 6.-bbolokesya)
  • burst out laughing, Boonse bakabboloka magwegweegwe kuseka. = All burst out laughing.
burst on, explode on, Yandibbolokela ncinga munzila. = The tyre of my bicycle burst on the way. (1.-bbolokelwa, 2.-bbolokede, 3.-bbolosya, 4.-bbolokela, 5.-bbolokelalyo, 6.-bbolokesya)
lose power, Bantu boonse bakaliko bakaide kubbolomana buyo fwee-ee, babula amate mukanwa. = All the people who were present just lost power, the spittle dried up in their mouths.

burst, "Swiilila! Zyabbolooka nsinsini nzindatenta mumulilo.. = Listen! The bedbugs are bursting which I burnt in the fire. Also: -bboloka (2.-bbolookede, 3.-bboloosya, 4.-bbolookela, 5.-bbolookelalyo, 6.-bbolookesya)
burst into song, Banyina kabaide kubboloola twiimbo twakukondwa. Her mother just happily burst into song.

search through the undergrowth, Mukaintu wakalazika mwana ansi akutalika kubbolyooka kuyandaula zyungu-zyungu. The woman laid her child on the ground and began to search through the undergrowth seeking the pumpkins. (2.-bbolyookede, 3.-bbolyookezya, 4.-bbolyookela, 6.-bbolyookesya)

cause to open Wakasangila tombwe wakwe umusubizya meso lyoonse, mpoonya ngooyu nkutalika kubboloosya makoto busaleme. He prepared his tobacco which reddens the eyes always, thereupon his eyes began to open wide and he slept on his back.

relax, take one's ease, sit lazily, Bamwi beenzuma babbombola nkaambo bakkede kabotu. Some of my friends can relax because they are well off. Mweenzu wabbombola mumunzi wesu nkaambo wakasika ino. A visitor is relaxing in our village because he has just arrived. Also: -pombola, -kwaya.

bump, (ety. Eng.) Sosoloka awa ndakubbompa musengele! Move away from here or I'll hammer you with a kick! Also: -uma mulazyi. (1.-bbompwa, 2.-bbompede, 3.-bbompezya, 4.-bbompela, 6.-bbompesya, 8.-bbompana)
speak in a rough manner, Wakababbongawida. He spoke to them in a rough manner. Also: -bbodweeda, -bbodola.
bend head down, Tiki naambaula boobu, oku kumwi wakalibbongwede. When Tiki was talking like this, he was bending his head down.

smash leaving a hole, Kuti ciyanga eeci catalika ndime mbociyandisya kulwana, inga ndacibbonkola liso lyaco. If this fool provokes me as he longs for a fight, then I will smash his eye. Bakabwalala babbonkola bwaanda masiku nibali kuyanda kubba mucintoolo. The thieves smashed through the wall at night when they wanted to rob the store. (1.-bbonkolwa, 2.-bbonkwede 3.-bbonkozya, 4.-bbonkweda, 5.-bbonkwedalyo, 6.-bbonkolesya, 8.-bbonkolana) Also: -donkola

be preferable, Ulya buti yebo? Asyaanza ulabbonsyeka nkaambo inga kafwuwa biyo wasiya mpaali kulida. In what way do you eat? Even a lion is preferable because he will at least leave a little bone where he has been eating. (1.-bbonsyekwa, 8.-bbonsyekana)

strike with fist or stick, Ndajana musankwa ubbonta mubwa acisako. I found a boy beating a dog wih a stick. Musana wangu wakadukumana nkaambo kamasako mapati ngundakali kubbontwa amubili wangu. My back became bent because of the big sticks with which my body was beaten. Kuti wati ndume, nobbonta musako, noyasa keembe mumutwe talekezyi ncalumide. When you say, 'let me beat it', then when you strike it with a stick, when you wound it in the head with an axe, it will not let go of what it has bitten. (1.-bbontwa, 2.-bbontede, 3.-bbontya, 4.-bbontweda, 5-bbontelalyo, 6.-bbontesya, 7.-bbonta-bbonta, 8.-bbontana)
strike one another with stick or fist, Basankwa nibakali kulwana bakabbontana citaambiki. When they were fighting they hammered one another in an undescribable way. (1.-bontanide, 2.-bbontanina)

make sound, Zimwi zintu zyakali kwiile kubbonteka munanda, ayasya kalambe nkujana kunyina ciliko. Some things were making a noise in the house, when she lit a lamp there was nothing. (1.-bontekwa, 3.-bbontokede, 4.-bbontokela)
fall heavily, as from a tree, Mwaaba wakabbontoka akuzikugansya mutwe ansi. The grey jackal fell heavily and smashed its head on the ground. (2.-bbontokede, 3.- bbontokesya)

beat continually, rt. bbonta, Tacili cibotu kubbontoola basune notulima mumuunda. It is not good to beat the oxen continually when we are ploughing in the field. (1.-bbontoolwa, 2.-bbontoolede, 3.-bbontoozya, 4.-bbontweeda, 5.-bbontweedalyo, 6.-bboontolesya, 8.-bbontoolana.) Also: -gobbola.

beat with, Bakali kweenda lyoonse azimboko azitobolo zyakubbontya kufwumbwa kulubizya bakaili. = They were always moving with whips and guns to hit the prisoners if ever they made a mistake. (3.-bbontoozya)

yield under pressure, sink down, Zibeela zyamyuungu zyabizwa zilabbookela watyanka amunwe. of pumpkins when they are cooked become indented when you press them with a finger. Bana baniini bamwi balabbookela antuntilo. Some little children have an indent on the top of the head. Masaya akwe alabbookela wanoosekaseka. Her cheeks go into dimples when she smiles. Also: -bobela. (2.-bbookede, 3.-bbookezya, 4.-bbookezyezya, -5.bbookelalyo, 6.-bbookelesya, 8.-bbookezyanya) Slices

indent, Mwana naakawa, wakawida abbwe nkabela ibbwe lyakamubbookezya mutwe. When the child fell, it fell on a stone and the stone made an indent on it's head. Also: -bbobya. (3.-bbookezya)
  • make a fool of, Nkundakali kumusekela lyoonse wakatalika kundibbookezya. Since I was always laughing with him, (i.e. becoming too familiar) he started making a fool of me. Wakagaminina = kuya kukaanda kamusimbi ngwaakali kubbookezya kuzwa ciindi naakamita. = He went directly over to the little house where the girl was whom he had been making a fool of since the time she became pregnant. Sena ugeme kubbookezya na? Mwati ulaa mulemyo biya webo? = Do you want to behave foolishly? Have you any respect? Also: -fwubaazya.

cry as a spoilt child, Mazuba ano Moonga wakaleka kubboomona kulila nkaambo wakomena. Nowadays Moonga has stopped crying as a spoilt child because she has grown up. Also: -boomona. (4.-bboomweda, 6.-bboomonesya)

explode, Kana kankuku kabbosoka bula nikalyatwa ajombe. = The chick's stomach burst when it was stepped upon by a cow. Also: -bbosyoka (2.-bbosokede, 3.-bbosozya, 4.-bbosokela, 5.-bbosokelalyo, 6.-bbosokesya)
cause to be patient, Kaindi kusela lyakalibbosya moyo. = Long ago negotiating for marriage was a matter of patience. Bbosya moyo, kunsi ndidozi. = Cool down your heart, beneath lies witchcraft.

prefer to, Inga ndabbosyeka kuya kuli bina Mutinta kuleka kuya kuli Muka Mweene kuya kubbodweedwa. I would prefer to go to Mutinta's mother than to the wife of Mweene where I would be scolded. Also: -mbosyeka (1.-bbosyekwa)

burst, as tumour, as football, Mavwili aacimbaya-mbaya abbosyoka munzila. The tyres of the lorry burst on the way. (2.-bbosyokede, 3.-bbosyozya, 4.-bbosweda/-bbosyokela, 5.-bbosyokelalyo, 6.-bbosyokesya, 8.-bbosyolana.) cf. -bbosoka, -bbotoka
burst, dissolve, melt, rt. bbosyoka, Nkujana mbulukutu ziide kulibbosyokela mukanwa tanaakutafwuna. = You find that sweets just melt in the mouth before chewing them.

cause to burst, Ndayanda kwiile kubbosyola myungu eeyi. = I just want to burst these pumpkins. (1.-bbosyolwa, 2.-bbosyolede, 3.-bbosyozya, 4.-bbosyoda, 5.-bbosyolelalyo, 6.-bbosyolesya, 8.-bbosyolana.) Also: -bbosoka.
crack a whip, Wakali kubbotaula mukkwilo naakali kubinga nombe. = He was cracking the whip when he was driving the cattle. (1.-bbotaulwa, 2.bbotaulide, 3.-bbotausya, 4.-bbotaulila, 6.-bbotaulisya)

burst, Iji lyankuku lyabbotoka nkaambo lilibolede. = The chicken's egg burst because it is rotten. Oonse mapopwe aayokwa mucikko, kuti waligusya kumulilo lilabbotoka. As regards all the maize which was roasting in the fireplace. if you took out one it would burst. Also: -bbosoka. (2.-bbotokede, 3.-bbotozya, 5.-bbotokelalyo, 6.-bbotokesya) bbotokela burst in, Ipopwe lyamubbotokela mumatansyi. The maize cob burst in the hands.
toss the head, Mwana wali kulila, wali kupazaya, wali kubbubauka. The child was weeping and struggling and tossing the head. (2.-bbubaukide, 3.-bbubausya, 5.-bbubaukilalyo, 6.-bbubaukisya)

panic, become excited, Bantu bamumunzi bakabbubba nibakamvwa lufwu Iwasibbuku. = The people of the village were filled with panic when they heard about the death of the headman. (2.-bbubbide, 3.-bbubbya, 4.-bbubbila, 5.-bbubbilalyo, 6.-bbubbisya, 7.-bbubbabbubba, 8.-bbubbilana, or -bbubbizyanya)
  • flap wings, Nkuku yakabbubba niyakakosolwa mutwe. The chicken flapped its wings when its head was cut off. Ncinzi cipa kuti moyo wangu kuubbubba boobu, ukoya muyuni uli mucisekwe? = What makes my heart flap like this, like a bird in a nest?

blow, as a wind Muzikombelo takweelede kuba luwo lubi lubbubbula. In the churches there should not be an evil wind blowing. (1.-bbubbulwa, 2.-bbubbwide, 3.-bbubbuzya, 6.-bbubbulisya, 8.-bbubbulana)
  • flap wings, Nkuku yamubbubbula mubwa naalikuyanda kuluma kana kayo. = The hen flapped its wings at the dog who wanted to bite it's chick.
show distain, Wabbubbulala kumeso. She turned away her face distainfully.

• blow strongly, rt. bbubbula, Ooyu muwo ulabbubbulisya sunu kwiinda lyoonse. This wind today is blowing more strongly than usual.
  • flap wings, Wali kutyani, Milambo, nkuku nkuzyabbubbulisya boobu munanda. Milambo, what were you doing to make the hens flap their wings in the house?
rush off, Nkaanga Nzila takwe anokakasola kubbubbuma abanamunji. Little Nzila never tried to rush off with all the others.
rush off to in a crowd, Boonse bakabbubbumina kudilwe masiku ngamunya alya. All rushed off to the funeral that same night. (2.-bbubbumide)

rush off, Nkaambo nzi ncalisampula boobu kubbubbumuka musyokwe kutija bantunyina? = Why does she dishonour herself in this way by rushing off into the bush and running away from other human beings? (2.-bbubbumukide, 3. -bbubbumusya, 4.-bbubbumukila, 6.-bbubbumukisya)

disturb, Ndakababbubbunganya nindakasika nkaambo akali masiku. I disturbed them when I arrived because it was night-time. (2.-bbubbunganide, 4. -bbubbunganina, 6.-bbubbunganisya, 8. -bbubbunganizyanya)

hide one's feelings, Nokuba kuti cakali kucisa, ndakali kubbubbunyana kutegwa batandiseki bamakwe. = Although it was paining I was suppressing my feelings so that the in-laws would not laugh at me. (2.-bbubbunyene, 4.-bbubbunyanina, 6.-bbubbunyanisya.) Also: -bbubbunyika.

suppress one's feelings, Tacili cibotu kulibbubbunyika nokuli kumakwe kuti cintu cakucisa kapati, weelede kulyaambilila. = It is not good to hide your feelings if something is hurting you when at the in-laws. You should speak out for yourself. Basimbi balalibbubbunyika kulya akati kabasankwa. Girls control their manner of eating when they are with boys.
fight with one another, Nkuku zyakali kubbubbusyanya nkozyakali kugoma-goma mitiba. = The hens were fighting with one an-other when they were pecking in the dish.

heap, Ncibotu kubbubila masamu akuumpa malasha bulongo nobucili butete. It is good to heap the pieces of wood for burning the charcoal while the soil is still soft (for plastering the mound.) Also: -bubila. (1.-bbubilwa, 2.-bbubwide, 3.-bbubizya, 4.-bbubilila, 5.-bbubililalyo. 6.-bbubilisya)
blow as wind, Muwo ulabbubula kapati. The wind is blowing strongly.(2.-bbubude, 4.-bubwida, 5.-bbubulilayo, 6.-bbubulisya.) Also: -bbubbula.
be busy, Ucibbubuuka kacembele kakasika. When she was still busy, the old woman arrived. (2.-bbubuukide, 3.-bbubuusya, 6.-bbubuukisya.)

appear in view, surface, Twakalindila buyo aasyoonto acalo citima cakabbuka. We had only waited a little time and then the train itself arrived. BuIwazi bwasikalileke bwabbuka bubi mazubaano. AIDS had appeared in a terrible way these days. (1.-bbukwa, 2.-bbukide, 3.-bbusya, 4.-bbukila, 5.-bbukilalyo, 6.-bbukisya, 7. -bbuka-bbuka, 8.-bbukizyanya)
  • perspire, Nkasaalo yakamubbuka kaindi kaniini. = Drops of sweat quickly arose on him.
  • scramble for, Bantu bakabbuka ndongwe zyalwiindi. The people were scrambling for groundnuts for the Lwiindi ceremony.

scramble together for something, rt. -bbuka, Bana bakali kubbukana, Malilwe naakawaala nswiiti ansi. = When Malilwe threw sweets on the ground, the children were scrambling with one another for them. (1.-bbukanwa, 2.-bbukanide, 3.-bbukuzya, 4.-bbukanina, 5.-bbukaninalyo, 7.-bbukana-bbukana) Also: -nyaana, -bbukula.
scramble for, Wababona bantu aaba mbubaibbukanina nyama. = Did you see how these people are scrambling for the meat?

pass by, Nindakali kuya ku Monze, ndakaakwiile kubbukila ananda yamucembele wakacisidwe kapati. When I was going to Monze, I just happened to pass by the house of the old lady who was extremely ill. Mbwaakabbukila kunzaa nanda wakajana dombwana lyakasunsumenye. = When he passed by the house he found a big man squatting. (1.-bbukilwa, 2.-bbukide, 3.-bbukizya)

be caught committing adultery, Wakandisampaula mubantu kaamba kuti ndakabbukilwa kumukaintu wakwe. = *He disgraced me before the people saying that I was caught committing adultery with his wife.* Kuti mukaintu wabbukilwa ulapenzegwa kumuluimi wakwe, pesi kuti kwabbukilwa mulombwana, mukaintu wakwe tazumizigwi kukanana. = *If a wife commits adultery she is punished by her husband, but if a husband commits adultery, his wife is not permitted to speak.* Bamatatakulu abamamakulu bakali kubbukilwa malale abalo, pesi tiibakali kulekana. = *Our grandfathers and our grandmothers were committing adulteries, but they did not leave one another.* (2.-bbukide)
  • be infected by a disease, Bantu babbukilwa bulwazi bwantuntumaanzi. = *People have been infected by an outbreak of malaria.*

discover, come across, Ndakazikukabbukizya kakuku akati kamuunda. = *I came across a chicken in the middle of the field.* Ndakazikwiide kumubbukizya mpeetakali kumuyeeyela. = *I just came across him where I least expected him to be.* Mukubaa coolwe wakazibbukizya zyoonse munsi acuulu. = *Luckily he discovered all beside an anthill.* Mukutobezya mukondo waņombe yakwe, Muleya wakazikwiibbukizya muciba camweenizyina. = *Following the track of his cow, Muleya came across it in the kraal of his friend.* (1.-bbukizigwa, 2.-bbukizyide, 4.-bbukizyizya, 5.-bbukizyizyalyo, 7.-bbukizya-bbukizya, 8.-bbukizyanya.)

scramble for, Bana bakali kubbukula ndongwe. = *The children were scrambling for the groundnuts.* (1.-bbukulwa, 2.-bbukulide, 3.-bbukuzya, 4.-bbukulila, 6.-bbukulisya, 7. -bbukulabbulula, 8.-bbukulana) Also: -bbukana, -nyaana.

shake, as clothes or blankets, Kamubbukumuna mapayi aayo kutegwa kasuko kazwe. = *Shake those blankets so that the dust comes out.* Ncibi kulibbukumuna ali cakulya. = *It is bad to shake the dust off oneself near food.* Nkuku zyakali kulibbukumuna mumavwu. = *The chickens were rolling themselves in the soil.* (kulibbukumuna bbuku-bbuku = to shake oneself) Also: -pukumuna (1.-bbukumunwa, 2.-bbukumwide, 3.-bbukumuzya, 4.-bbukumwida, 5.-bbukumwidalyo, 6.-bbukumunisya, 7.-bbukumuna-bbukumuna)

be covered with sweat, Balombe bakabbukwa nkasaalo nibakabeleka kapati mumuunda wabo. = *The boys were covered with sweat when they worked hard in their field.* Wakabbukwa mitukuta. = *He was covered with drops of sweat.* (2.-bbukide, 3.-bbusya, 4.-bbukila, 5.-bbukilalyo, 6.-bbukisya)
  • be sought after hastily, Indongwe zyakabbukwa abantu banji. = *Many people scrambled after the groundnuts.* Also: -nyaanwa.
  • enter an important place, Ino kubbukwa buti kumunzi wa Mwami Moonze? = *How do you approach the village of Chief Moonze.*

take hold of by force, Musimbi wakajatwa kwabo akwaambilwa kuti, "Kolila wakwatwa kuli Sicibende." Nobakamana kumujata bakamubbula akutalika kwiimba. = *The girl was caught at her home and told, "You should cry because you are married to Sicibende." After taking hold of her they dragged her out by force and began to sing.* (1.-bbulwa)
loose shape or colour, Cisani ncaakaula cakafwambaana kubbuluka. = *The shirt which he bought faded quickly.* (2.-bbulukide, 3.-bbulusya, 4.-bbulukila, 5.-bbulukilalyo, 6.-bbulukisya) Also: -jujuka.

discover, diagnose, *Basondi bakakakilwa kubbulula bulwazi bwa Chimbwali.* = The diviners failed to find out what Chimbwali's disease was. *Cakamwaalila kubbulula kuti mweenzi-nyina nguwakamubbida.* = He failed to discover that it was his/her friend who stole from him/her. Also: -bbununa (1.-bbululwa, 2.-bbulukide, 3.-bbulusya 4.-bbulukila, 5.-bbulukilalyo, 6.-bbulukisya)
  • weaken, *Aabo batumbu batajati musamu ooyu nkaambo baluubbulula.* = That nursing mother should not touch this medicine, she will weaken it.

fly away together, as little birds, *Tuyuni twakabbululuka kuzwa mucisamu.* = The little birds flew away together from the tree. Also: -pululuka (2.-bbululukide, 3.-bbululusya, 4.-bbululukila, 5.-bbululukilalyo 6.-bbululukisya)
blow on, *Wakabbulu-lwida kubantu akubatesya kapati abo bakali munsi lyakwe.* = He blew on the people wetting those who were nearest to him.

run away without giving notice, *Mwana ngwelela wiide kubbulumuka uya kwabo kakunyina akaambo.* = The child I am looking after just runs back to her home without a reason. *Mpongo zyali kubbulumuka nozyakongwa suntwe.* = The goats just took off when they were frightened by the hyena. *Mutinta taakali kubeleka kabotu, wakali kwiile kubbulumuka.* = Mutinta wasn't working properly she would just take leave when she wanted. (2.-bbulumukide, 3.-bbulumusya 4.-bbulumukila, 5.-bbulumukilalyo, 6.-bbulumukisya, 8. -bbulumusyanya)

be tossing about, Bamacembele nibakali kusola kumujatilila musimbi, wakali kubbulungana mumaanza abo. When the old women were trying to catch the girl, she was struggling in their hands. (2.-bbulunganide, 3.-bbulunganya, 4.-bbulunganina, 5. -bulunganinalyo, 6.-bbulunganisya, 8.-bbulunganizyanya) cf. -syolomba, -bulungana.
  • be unkempt, *Kamulikamuna kutegwa masusu aleke kubbulungana.* = Comb yourself so that your hair may no longer be tossed. Also: -pulungana -pupungana, -undungana, -zazangana

cause to roll on the ground, *Bamacembele bakalibbulunganya ansi lyadilwe limwi baakutuba buu.* At the time of the funeral the old women were rolling themselves on the ground until they were completely white. *Bantu bakatalika kuuma mupovwo kuti aleke kudunka akubbulunganya mudaala.* = he people began to beat the bull so that he would stop prodding and rolling the old man about on the ground. (2.-bbulunganide, 4.-bbulunganina, 5.-bbulunganinalyo, 6.-bbulunganisya, 8.-bbulunganizyanya)

cause to become powerless, rt. -bbuluka, *Cakabbulusya musamu ngwaakaleta kucibbadela nimvula yakamuwa.* It was the rain which fell on him which made the medicine useless which he brought from the hospital. (1.-bbulusyigwa, 2.-bbulusyide, 4.-bbulusyila, 5.-bbulusyilalyo)

wander about, *Ncibi kubbulyauka mbuli sincinko.* = It is bad to wander about like a mad one. *Umwi mutumbu wakali kubbulyauka mumuunda naakali kuyandaula myuungu.* A certain woman was wandering about in the field in search of pumpkins. (2.-bbulyaukide, 3.-bbulyausya, 4.-bbulyaukila, 5.-bbulyaukilalyo, 6.-bbulyaukisya)

discourage, Tacili cibotu kumubbumpaika mwana kuti kakanana. = It is not good to discourage a child if it talks. Wakabbumpaika kuvwuwa. = He was dissuaded from answering. (1.-bbumpaikwa, 2.-bbumpaukide, 3.-bbumpaisya, 4.-bbumpaikila, 5.-bbumpaikilalyo, 6.-bbumpaikisya 7.-bbumpaika-bbumpaika, 8.-bbumpaikana.) Also: -bbumpiika, -tyompeeka, -tyompya.

discourage, Ndatiibaambile kaambo kabotu mumuswaangano pesi bandibbumpiika. = I tried to tell them something good at the meeting but they discouraged me. (1.-bbumpiikwa, 2.-bbumpiikide, 3.-bbumpiizya, 4.-bbumpiizyizya, 5.-bbumpiizyizyalyo, 6.-bbumpiikisya, 7.-bbumpiika-bbumpiika, 8.-bbumpiikana.) Also: -bbumpaika, -tyompeeka, tyompya.

wait, delay for a long time, Twakabbunduka kusikila lyakainda dilwe. = We waited for a long time until the funeral had passed. (2.-bbundukide, 3.-bbunduzya, 4.-bbundukila, 5.-bbundukilalyo, 6.-bbundukisya)

wrap up, Musimbi naakamana kutumbuka, wakabbungaila mwanaakwe muzisani zisalala. = When the girl had given birth, she wrapped her child up in clean clothes. Also: -bbutaila. (1.-bbungailwa, 2.-bbungailide, 3.-bbungaizya, 4.-bbungailila, 5.-bbungaililalyo, 6.-bbungailisya, 7.-bbungaila-bbungaila, 8. -bbungailana.)

defy, Tacili cibotu kubbungwida muntu wakali kukugwasya kubbadela mali aacikolo. = It is not good to revolt against someone who helped you to pay school fees. Also: -bungwida. (1.-bbungwidwa, 2.-bbungwide, 3.-bbunguzya, 4.-bbungulila, 5.-bbungwidalyo, 6.-bbungulisya, 8.-bbungwidana.)

limp, Simuzyaabo wamusankwa ulya wiide kubbunkutila kweenda, akamusamike nzi? = The uncle of that boy just limps, what will he clothe him with? (2.-bbunkutide, 3.-bbunkutizya, 4.-bbunkutilila, 5.-bbunkutililalyo, 6.-bbunkutisya, 7.-bbunkutila-bbunkutila)

throw down, Mwana wakabbunta nyama mumamvwu. = The child threw the meat down on the soil. (1.-bbuntwa, 2.-bbuntide, 3.-bbuntya 4.-bbuntila, 5.-bbuntilalyo, 6.-bbuntilisya, 8.-bbuntana.)
  • cover in white ash, Wakatalika kulibbunta mutwe. He began to cover his head with ashes. Also: -bunta.
play about, Wakabona basulwe bobile balabbuntauka. = He saw two rabbits playing about. (2.-buntaukide, 3.-bbuntausya, 4.-bbuntaukila, 5. -bbuntaukilalyo, 6.-bbuntaukisya, 7.-bbuntauka-bbuntauka)

emerge, come to surface, appear, Ndakaakubbunuka munsi aamupati wangu mumeenda. = I surfaced in the water near my elder brother. Ooyo mwami mupati wa Batonga, Kazyalanzubo, naakabbunuka, naa wakazyila anzi, naa wakaloka kujulu wakakkala eneeni a Gundu mpolili akati-kati. When that great chief of the Batonga, Kazyalanzubo, appeared, it was not known where he had come from, or whether he dropped down from above, and dwelt right in the middle of the land. Also: -yutuka. (2.-bbunukide, 3.-bbunusya, 4.-bbunukila, 5.-bunukilalyo, 6.-bbunukisya, 8.-bbunusyanya)

emerge at a point, Wakabbunukila munsi ankomwe yamulonga. He emerged near the bank of the river. (1.-bbunukilwa, 2.-bbunukide, 3.-bbunusya, 4.-bbunukila, 5. bbunukilalyo, 6.-bbunukisya, 8.-bbunusyanya)
  • be caught, have one's secret revealed, *Bwamubbunukila bulale katayeeyede.* = The fact of his adultery came to light when he was not thinking about it.

cause to be known, *Lwiindi wakabbununa bulale bwamupati wakwe kuli muka Chisowa.* = Lwiindi caused the adultery of his elder brother to Mrs. Chisowa to be known. Also: -bbulula. (1-bbununwa, 2.-bbunukide, 3.-bbunusya, 4.-bbunukila, 5.-bbunukilalyo, 6.-bbunukisya, 8.-bbunusyanya.)

bring to the surface, *Intale niiluma muntu tiiyandi kumubbusya, ilamusisa munkomwe, masiku ilamulya naabola.* = When a crocodile catches a person, it does not want to bring him to the surface, but hides him in the river bank and eats him at night after he has decomposed. (1.-bbusyigwa, 2.-bbusyide, 4.-bbusyizya, 5.-bbusyizyalyo, 7.-bbusya-bbusya.)

wrap, *Mutumbu wakabbutaila mwana muzisani zibotu.* = The mother wrapped up the child in clean clothes. (1.-bbutailwa, 2.-bbutailide, 3.-bbutaizya, 4.-bbutailila, 5. -bbutaililalyo, 6.-bbutailisya, 7.-bbutaila-bbutaila, 8.-bbutailana.) Also: -bbutila, -bbungaila, -vwungaila.

turn about restlessly, *Sunu masiku bana balikubbutauka nkaambo kuli nsinsini zinji mubulo bwabo.* = Last night the children were restless because there are many bugs in their bed. Also: -sandauka, -pilimuka, -pilauka. (2.-bbutaukide, 3.-bbutausya, 4.-bbutaukila, 5.-bbutaukilalyo, 6.-bbutaukisya, 7.-bbutauka-bbutauka.)

cover a stack of logs with clods in preparation for the making of charcoal, *Kamubbutila zisamu zyamalasha zyuumpwe kabotu.* = Cover the logs for charcoal so that they are well burnt. (1.-bbutilwa, 2.-bbutilide, 3.-bbutizya, 4.-bbutilila, 5.-bbutilalyo, 6.-bbutilisya, 8.-bbutilana.)
  • wrap up in, *Kamubbutila nyama mumatu mubweze kabotu.* = Rap up the meat in leaves so that you carry it properly.

be restless, *Masowe naakamvwa lufwu lwabanyina, taakoona masiku oonse wakali kubbutuka.* = When Masowe heard about the death of her mother, she did not sleep the whole night, she was just restless. Also: -bbutauka, -sandauka, -pilimuka. (2.-bbutukide, 3.-bbutusya, 4.-bbutukila, 5. -bbutukilalyo, 6. -bbutukisya, 7.-bbutuka-bbutuka)

diagnose, discover cause, *Basondi bakakakilwa kububbutula bulwazi bwakwe muzisondyo zyabo.* = The witch-doctors failed to diagnose his disease in their objects of divination. (1.-bbutulwa, 2.-bbutwide, 3. -bbutuzya, 4.-bbutuzyizya, 5.-bbutuzyizyalyo, 6.-bbutulisya, 7.-bbutula-bbutula) Also: -bununa.
  • meet accidentaly after a long time, *Mukaintu wakamubbutula mulumi wakwe wakamusiide kaindi.* = The wife came across her husband who had left her a long time ago.

rush out, *Ndakaile kubbutumuka kakunyina akulibambila kuya ku Monze.* = I hastily set out for Monze without preparing myself. *Wakabbutumuka kuzwa abulo cakufwambaana niyakamweendeenda nzoka.* = He fled from the bed when the snake moved across him. *Sulwe wakabbutumuka, mubwa naakainda munsi ambuta.* = The hare suddenly rushed out when the dog passed near the burrow. cf.-vwandamuka (2.-bbutumukide, 3.-bbutumusya, 4.-bbutumukila, 5.-bbutumukilalyo, 7.-bbutumuka-bbutumuka.)

make something or someone rush away, Ndime ndamubbutumuna Choolwe nindamukonga nzoka. = It is me who has caused Choolwe to rush away when I frightened him with a snake. (1.-bbutumunwa, 2.-bbutumwide, 3.-bbutumusya, 4.-bbutumwida, 5.-bbutumwidalyo, 7.-bbutumunabbutumuna, 8.-bbutumunana.)
find, come across, rt. -bbutula, Taakatola mazuba manji pe, wakazibbutuzya zigwebenge. = It did not take many days, he discovered the thieves.

raise the head with eyes looking shamelessly or fearlessly, Musimbi utalomenyi wiile kubbuulala, tayandi kulemeka bapati. An unruly girl raises her head looking shamelessly, she does not want to respect the elders. Syuumbwa wakabbuulala walanga kujwe kucibanda eeco, cikosi cakwe wakalanzya kwakali kuletezya muwo. The lion raised his head looking fearlessly to the east to that plain, his neck looking to where the wind was coming from. Also: -buulala. (2.-bbuulete, 4.-bbuulalila, 5.-bbuulalilalyo, 6. -bbuulalisya, 7.-bbuulala-bbuulala)

swarm out like bees, Ciindi cakulyookezya bana bacikolo bakabbuumuka mbuli nzuki kuzwa anze. = At breaktime the school childen poured out like bees swarming out. Also: -soomoka. (2.-bbumukide, 3.-bbumusya, 4.-bbuumukila, 5.-bbuumukilalyo, 6.-bbuumukisya)
blurt out, Umwi mulombwna wakacinkukide wakaide kubbwa twaambo tunyina maanu. = One mad man was just blurting out statements which had no meaning.

hop, as in playing, Bana balayanda kubbwaantuka noba-so bana munkomwe yamulonga. = Child-ren like to jump off the bank into the river when they are playing. Also: -dwaantuka (1.-bbwaantukwa, 2.-bbwaantukide, 3.-bbwaantusya, 4.-bbwaantukila, 5.-bwaantukilalyo, 6.-bbwaantukisya 8.-bbwantukana.)

run excitedly jumping about, Basune batalika kutijaana kababbwalamuka. The oxen began to run jumping about excitedly. (2.-bbwalamukide, 3.-bbwalamusya, 4.-bbwalamukila, 5.-bbwalamukilalyo, 6.-bbwalamukisya.)
pierce, Ngulube bakazimana kuzibbwalaula amasumo nkaambo zyakali kulya zimbwali. = They finished off. the pigs by piercing them with spears because they were eating the sweet potatoes.

beat as heart when startled, Ngooyu waboola makoto, kuya kubbwalankana moyo ulati wali kutandwa suntwe. = Here comes the big fellow, going with his heart pumping as if being chased by a hyena. (2.-bbwalankanide, 3.-bbwalankanya 7.-bbwalankana-bbwalankana)
be pierced, Nkuku tiiyaali kubona, meso ayo oonse akalibbwalawidwe. = The hen could not see, it's eyes had been pierced.

jump suddenly, as heart in fear, Moyo wangu wakabbwaluka nindakamvwa kuti mwami wakafwa. = My heart beat in fear when I heard that the chief had died. (2.-bbwalukide)
  • be holed, Kagabba kabbwaluka bana nobali kukasobanya. = The tin got holed when the children were playing with it. Ngoma yakabbwaluka lubambo. = The drum-head has been holed.

bore a hole, pierce, Basankwa babbwalula cilayi cakususizya mapopwe. = The boys made holes in the sledge for drawing the maize. *Kobbwalula* kagabba kakwiidizya. = Make holes in the can for watering. *Webo wandibbwalula* moyo noondaambila kaambo kayoosya kaya. = You pierced my heart when you told me of that terrible affair. Also: -donkola, -bobola, -bbobola (1.-bbwalulwa, 2.-bbwalwide, 3.-bbwalusya, 4.-bbwalwida, 5.-bbwalwidalyo, 6.-bbwalulisya, 7.-bbwalula-bbwalula.)

cause to jump, rt. *-bbwaluka*, Bubotu bwamukaintu oyu bwakali kwiide kumubbwalusya moyo. = The beauty of this woman was causing his heart to jump. (1.-bbwalusyigwa, 2.-bbwalusyide, 3.-bbwalusya, 4.-bbwalukila, 5.-bbwalukilalyo, 7.-bbwalusya-bbwalusya)

be flat, as top of head, Mutwe wamunanga wakali mupati wamana kaubbwambwasele mbuli ciyuni citegwa ncelelebula. = The head of the witchdoctor was large and flat resembling the bird called the smaller locust bird.

stab, Bakamubbwankula asumo naakatiitije. = They stabbed him with a spear when he was about to run away. (1.-bbwankulwa, 2.-bbwankwide, 3.-bwankuzya, 4.-bbwankwida, 5.- bbwankwidalyo, 6.-bbwankulisya, 8.-bbwankulana.)

jump down, as from a vehicle, Bantu bakabbwantuka mootokala niwakatiibbindamuke. = The people jumped down from the vehicle when it was about to overturn. Also: -dwantuka, -dwaantuka. (1.-bbwantukwa, 2.-bbwantukide, 3.-bbwantusya, 4.-bbwantukila, 5.-bbwantukilalyo, 6.-bbwantukisya. 8.-bbwantukilana)
  • jump up and down, Bana balayandisya kubbwantuka nobasobana. = Children like to jump up and down when they are playing.
fall heavily, as rain, Imvwula yakabbwatamuka kapati jilo. = The rain fell heavily yesterday. (2.-bbwatamwide, 3.-bwatamusya 4.-bbwatamukila, 5. -bbwatamukilalyo, 6.-bbwatamukisya)

loan, Chibize, mweenzuma, ndibbweleke cibaki cako cayeengo mibotu ncosamide. = Zebra, my friend, lend me your garment with the nice stripes which you are wearing. (1.-bbwelekwa, 2.-bbwelekede, 3.-bbwelesya, 4.-bbwelekela, 7.-bbwelekabbweleka, 8.-bbwelekana)

stand with surprise, be shocked, Nibaamba kuti musimbi wangu wamita, ndaile kubbwelemana mbuli ciyanga. = When they said that my girlfriend was pregnant, I stood shocked like a fool. (3.-bbwelemeka, 4.-bbwelemanina)

suddenly turn around with fear, Ndakabbwenyuka nindakamvwa uundiita. = I suddenly turned around with fear when I heard someone calling me. Bakabbunuka biya kusyule lyakwe, walo wakabbwenyuka akuyoowa kapati. = They suddenly appeared behind him, and he turned in panic and feared greatly. (2.-bbwenyukide, 3.-bbwenyusya, 4.-bbwenyukila, 6.-bbwenyukisya.)

ooze out, percolate, Cilonda camwana cibbwibbwa busina. = The child's wound is oozing pus. Meenda alabbwibbwa mukasensa. = Water oozes forth from the spring. Mudenda naakacili mwana, wakali kunga alya ceele cikasaala wabbwibbwa nkasaalo ampemo. = When Mudenda was a child, whenever he ate warm porridge, he would just ooze sweat on the nose. Musankwa ooyu naakali kusobana bbola wakali kubbwibbwa mitukuta. = When this boy was playing football he was pouring drops of sweat. Mamina akali kuzwa mumuntu usondokede taakali kwaasindula naabbwibbwa buti. = The mad man did not wipe away the mucous which was coming out no matter how it poured out.
be shocked, Ibakaintu bakaile kubbwilimana nibakamvwa dilwe. The women were shocked when they heard about the funeral. (2.-bbwilimene, 3.-bbwilimusya, 4.-bbwwilimanina, 6. -bbwilimanisya)

belch, Nindakamana kulya mayi, ndakali kwiile kubbya zinunka nsu. = When I had finished eating the eggs I was just emitting stinking belches. Bakaintu bakatalika kubbya nobakabona kankuli kamunanga kasalazya meso. = The women started to belch when they saw the calabash of the witchdoctor with the bright eyes. (belching is sometimes a physical reaction when contact is made with the spirit world.) Also: -byola.

get tired, as when running much, Basimbi bakabeba nibakalunduka musinzo mulamfwu. = The girls got tired when they had run for a long distance. Bana babeba kusobana tiinde. = The children get tired from playing the running game of tiinde. Also: -katala, -lema. (1.-bebezegwa, 2.-bebede, 3.-bebya, 5.-bebelalyo, 6.-bebesya, 7.-beba-beba, 8.-bebesyanya.)
jabber, Wiile kubebeezya kukanana, tomvwiki kabotu. = You are just jabbering when you speak, you are not clearly understood. Also: -bwelebwezya.

cover partly on one side only, cover inadequately as child on back, Kasani nkakulibebeka buyo. = The cloth is only for covering partially. (1.-bebekwa, 2.-bebekede, 3.-bebesya, 4.-bebekela, 6.-bebekesya, 8.-bebekana.)
lay poison for, Bakamubebekela musamu wa 'kalobola'. = They bewitched her by laying poison for her to cause the disease of continuous bleeding. Also: -teela. (rt. -teya)
persuade, Mudaala wakatalika kubebesya sicikolo musimbi kuti amuyande. The old man tried to persuade the school-girl to love him. (1.-bebesegwa, 2.-bebesyede, 4.-bebesyezya, 8.-bebezyanya.)

draw out, as a little or small amount, Kobebula tuccuka tuniini tubikke mukakondo. Take a little sugar so that we put it in the porridge. Also: -nenuna, -sontola, -zomona tuniini. (1.-bebulwa, 2,-bebulide, 3. -bebuluzya, 4. -bebulila.)
cause to be tired, Kukanana kwamudaala kwakandibebya. = The talking of the old man made me tired. (3.-bebya, 8.-bebezyanya)
become, rt. -ba, Cakababeda cintu cisesya nkwindakalumwa. = Where I was bitten became for them a thing to be laughed at. (1.-bedwa, 2.-bede)
have become, Ndilaa mbwebede. I have become pregnant. (1.-bedwe)
seem, Mwana kukoka, ubee talyi nalya. The child is thin, it seems it does not really eat when it eats.

come first or in front of, preceed, Mebo ndakubeelela kusika. = I came earlier before you. Ndakamubeelela. I beat him in a race. Mebo ndakalibeelela kutegwa mbe kunembo. = I went ahead of them so that I could be in front. Eeyi nombe iitegwa Kaluwa ilineneede nkaambo njiilibeelela kucela bwizu bubotu. = This cow called Kaluwa is fat because it is first to graze the good grass. Also: -indila, -taangunina. (1.-beelelwa, 8.-beelelana.)
be overtaken, rt. -beelela Ndakabeelezegwa nindakali kale ku nembo kulunduka. = When I was already ahead I was overtaken. Also: -indilwa. (2.-beelezede, 3. beelezya, 8.-belezyanya.)

surpass, Ndakamubeelezya mumaanu mucikolo. = I surpassed him in intelligence at school. Uubeelezya kusika, the one who reaches first.
  • send ahead, Ndabeelezya mwana kuya kuzyibya baama kuti mbajane kunanda yabo ndaunka. = I sent a child ahead of me to let my mother know that I should find her at her house when I go.
compete, Twakabeelezyanya kuti tubone uutiiyindwe. = We competed to see who would be overtaken. Also: -zundana, beelezyana.

swing around, drag about, Kacembele kakasamide kasani kazapaukide kakali kubeeluka mutanga lyabantu. The old woman who was dressed in rags was swinging herself around in the crowd of people. Kacembele kakabeeluka ciyoosya nikakali kutija munyati. = The old woman was dodging around in a frantic way when she was running from the buffalo. Chinyama naali kuzyana cisani cali kwiile kubeeluka. When Chinyama was dancing her dress was just swinging about. Also: -bbeesula. (2.beelukide, 3.-beelusya, 4.-beelukila, 5.-beelukilalyo, 6.-beelukisya, 7.-beelukabeeluka.)
winnow, shake as basket in winnowing Kamubeeta mapopwe aaya. = Winnow this maize. (1.-beetwa, 2.-beetide, 3.-beetya, 4.-beetela, 6.-beetesya, 8.-beetelana.) Also: -pupulula, -kwaapula.
lie, pretend, Koleka kubeja, ulakubona Leza. Stop lying, God will see you. (1.-bejelwa, 2.-bejede, 3.-bejezya, 4.-bejela, 5.-bejelalyo, 6.-bejesya, 7.-bejabeja, 8.-bejelana.)
tell a lie to somebody, Ndamubejela kuti ndali ku Monze, ani mebo ndali ku Chisekese. = I lied to him that I was in Monze while I was in Chisekese. cf.
(1.-bejelwa, 2. bejede, 3.-bejezya, 4.-bejela, 5.-bejelalyo, 6.-bejesya, 7.-bejabeja, 8.-bejelana)
deceive one another, Twali kubejelana aumwi ulati ndijisi cili boobu nocitako. = We were deceiving one another saying that we had such and such a thing when it was not there.
lie or deceive for another, Wakandibejelela kucikolo kuti ndakali kuciswa. She lied for me at school say-ing that I was sick. Also: -cengela, -uninina. (1.-bejelelwa, 8.-bejelelana.)

report, Ndakamubejelezya kuli bamasilikani kuti wabba. = I reported him to the police that he had stolen. Ciindi eeco kwakali muntu wakandibona nkabela wakaakundibejelezya kuli simalelo wangu. = At that time there was a person who saw me and then reported me to my boss. (1.-bejelezyegwa, 3.-bejelezya, 8.-bejelezyanya.)
  • slander, Moonde bakamubejelezya kubba nombe. They falsely accused Moonde of stealing the cattle. Also: -tamikizya.
tell lies about one another, Twakali kubejelezyanya kubunii-i kuti kwaba casoweka. = We were telling lies about one another when we were young when something was missing. Also: -taminana.
pretend, Bunji bwabana bakali kulibejezya kuti bakkuta. = Many of the children pretended that they were full. (2.-bejezede)
be bright, shine, Mapopwe alabeka mumuunda nilyabala zuba. = The maize glistens beautifully when the sun shines. Also: -mweka-mweka. (2.-bekede, 4.-bekela, 5.-bekelalyo, 6.-bekesya, 7.-beka-beka.)

move about by wind, *Mapopwe abasibbuku alabeka-beka amuwo mumuunda.* = The maize of the headman is blown about by the wind. Also: -pekema.
  • spoil a child, *Mwana ngomubeka-beka boobo takabaa milimo waakukomena.* = The child whom you spoil in this way will not be industrious when it grows up.
be shining, *Mapopwe angu alabekema kabotu mumuunda.* = My maize is shining nicely in the field. (2.-bekamide, 4.-bekemena, 6.-bekemisya, 7.-bekema-bekema.)

be cared for in an excessive way, *Babanyina tiibakali ku-muzumizya kuti kabeleka milimo yausyi. Wakali kubekwa-bekwa lyoonse.* = The mother was not allowing him to do the father's jobs. He was always being spoilt.
become, *Nsenacibwene cili boobu kuzwa mbwendakabela muntu!* = I have never seen such a thing as this since I became a human person. Also: -beda. (2.-bede.)

move stealthily, *Musimbi wakabela-bela musyokwe ku-anga kuti naa kuli uzya.* = The girl moved stealthily through the bush to see whether someone was coming. Also: -sobelela, -nwabila. (1.-belwa-belwa.)
  • show symptoms, *Bulwazi bulabela-bela mumubili wangu.* = The disease is showing the symptoms in my body.

entice, *Koleka kubela-usya mwana musyoonto, ulaliletela milandu.* = Stop enticing the young child, you will bring yourself troubles. (1.-belausyigwa, 2.-belausyide, 3.-belausya, 4.-belausyizya, 6.-belausyisya, 7.-belausya-belausya, 8.-belausyanya.)
conceal together a love affair, *Ba Mwiinga a Masowe bakabelausyanya ciindi cilamfwu kusikila nibakajatwa.* = Mwiinga and Masowe were secret lovers for a long time before they were caught.
let go in front, *Banyina bakabeelezya mwana kweenda.* = The mother let the child go in front. (1.-beelezyegwa, 2.-beelezyede, 8.-beelezyanya)
swing around, *Naali kutijaana mudaala, zisani zyakwe zyali kubeeluka.* = When the old man was running, his clothes were swinging about. (1.-beelukwa, 2.-beelukide, 3.-beelusya, 4.-beelukila.)

work, *Kamubeleka, mwamana ndamupa namunyo.* = Work, when you are finished I will give you a water melon. (1.-belekwa, 2.-belekede, 3.-belesya, 4.-belekela, 5.-belekelalyo, 6.-belekesya, 7.-beleka-beleka.) Also: -sebenza.
work for someone, *Moomba wakali kubelekela mwami.* = Moomba was working for the chief
work hard, rt. -beleka, *Twamuka kubuka nkaambo twakabelekesya jilo.* = We were late getting up because we worked very hard yesterday. Also: -fwundumana.
slip away from, sneak away, *Wakaile kubeleleka kweenda, tiitwakamubona.* = He just slipped away, we did not see him. Also: -zeluluka -beluluka, -weleluka. (4.-belelekela.)

go stealthily, sneak in, *Naakali kunjilila basimbi, wakabelelela buya mukunjila munanda.* = When he was entering the girls house, he went in stealthily. (1.-belelelwa.)
  • stalk an animal, go carefully, *Kobebelela kabotu-kabotu kutegwa ukajate* kambaambi. = Go carefullly so that you can catch the duiker. Also: -bela-bela, -sobelela.

= cause to work, use, rt. -beleka, *Kamubelesya cimboko kumu-uma atakaindululi.* = Use a sjambok when you are beating him so that he does not repeat it. (1.-belekwa, 2.-belekede, 3.-belesya, 4.-belekela, 5.-belekelalyo, 8.-belesyanya.
bear a child prematurely, *Mutinta wakabelula mwana akumusowa mucoonde.* = Mutinta bore the baby prematurely and threw it away in a thicket. (1.-belulwa, 2.-belwide, 4.-belulila)

disappear, slip away unnoticed, *Naakamana kubba, wakabeluluka kuya mubwizu kuti ataboneki.* = After stealing, he disappeared into the grass so that he could not be seen. Also: -beleleka, -zeluluka, -weleluka. (2.-belulukide, 3.-belulusya, 4.-belukila.)
be born prematurely, *Ooyu mwana wakabelulwa buya, ncali muniini.* = This child was born prematurely, that is why s/he is small. (2.-beludwe)

move without rushing, *Katulibemba buyo kweenda, afwiimpa mpotuya.* = Let us not rush, where we are going is nearby. *Mudyaka wakali kulibemba buyo ambele akakoli kakwe kumwi wakali kuyabutongookela mukaintu kuti tayendesyi.* = Mudyaka was moving along with ease in front with his stick while complaining to his wife that she wasn't going fast enough.

walk along the edge or side, walk carefully, as on thorns *Tuyakubembeleka mulonga Lufwuwa kuya kunkolola.* = We will walk along beside the river Lufwuwa going to the initiation ceremony. *Mwana wakali kubinga koombe wakali kukabembeleka mumbali.* = The boy who was driving the calf, was walking along beside it. (1.-bembelekwa, 2.-bembelekede, 3.-bembelesya, 4.-bembelekela, 8.-bembelekana.)
  • beat about the bush when speaking, hint at, *Koleka kubembeleka kukanana nobetekwa, kocigama ncowamba.* = Stop beating about the bush when you are being tried, speak straight. *Sena mwayeeya kuti ndilimitide? Sena nciceeco ncomubembeleka?* = Do you think I have conceived? Is that what you are hinting at. *Wakabona kuti wakeelede kwaamba kaambo kayasa kutegwa batasowi ciindi kuya bubembeleka.* = He saw that he ought to say something to the point so that they would not waste time hinting at things.

cut off, cut off a slice of bread, *Kamubenda cinkwa tulye.* = Cut the bread so that we can eat. Also: -tenda.
  • follow game, stalk, creep up after, approach stealthily, *Muvwimi ubenda banyama mumulundu.* = The hunter is stalking animals on the hill. (1.-bendwa, 2.-bendede, 3.-bendya, 4.-bendela, 5.-bendelalyo, 6.-bendesya, 7.-benda-benda,) Also: -sobelela

cut into pieces, *Mufwambaane kwiibendaula nyama eyi kutegwa iyanikwe nolicibala zuba.* = Quickly cut the meat up into pieces so that it can be hung up in the sun while it is still shining. Also: -benduula, -tendaula, -sama. (1.-bendaulwa, 2.-bendaulide, 3.-bendauzya, 4.-bendaulila, 5.-bendesya, 6.-bendelana.)

plan to do, *Ooyu ubendelela kubba, ncaindainda awa.* = This one is planning to steal, that is why he frequently passes here. (1.-bendelelwa, 2.-bendelekede, 5.-bendelelalyo, 8.-bendelelana)
  • follow stealthily after, Wakamubendelela wakamujata munsingo, wakamusina. = He crept up on him, he caught him by the neck, he strangled him.

be chipped or cracked, Keembe kangu kakabenduka nikakauma abbwe. = My axe was cracked when it struck a stone. Also: -komoka (1.-bendulwa, 2.-bendukide, 3.-benduzya, 4.-bendukila, 5.-bendukilalyo, 6.-bendukisya, 8.-bendulana.)

cut, indent, chip, Kamulibendula senke eli kutegwa linjile kabotu. = Cut this sheet of zinc so that it fits. Kanyama kakakubendula kutwi. = The animal cut your ear. Also: -lendula. (1.-bendulwa, 2.-bendwide, 3.-benduzya, 4.-bendulila, 6.-bendulisya, 8.-bendulilana.)

cut at the edge, Kobendulula kapepa kasyoonto wamana ukanamatike acijazyo. Cut the paper along the edge and when you have done so stick it on the door. Also: - tendulula (1.-bendululwa, 2.-bendulwide, 3.-bendulusya.)
cut in bits, Kamubenduula senke mutubeela tusyoontosyoonto. = Cut up the sheet of zinc into small pieces. Also: -tendaula, -bendaula. (1.-benduulwa, 2.-bendwiide, 3.-benduuzya, 4.-bendwiida)
volunteer, Kwakainda buyo myaka iili kkumi kwakalibenga umbi. = Just ten years past and another volunteered. (2.-bengede, 3.-bengezya, 4.-bengela, 6.-bengesya.) Also: -sanga

dive to catch fish, Wakabengelela musankwa kusikila waijata nswi mumeenda. The boy was diving into the water until he caught a fish. (lubengelele, a noun, the hammer-headed stork, a bird which dives for fish)
inherit, Ndakabentaka jamba lyarnombe kuli baacisya nibakafwa. = I inherited a plough from my uncle when he died. Also: -kona.

lose power, about to loose consiousness Mulwazi naakakkala kwakaindi kalamfwu muzuba, wakatalika kubenzauka. When the patient was sitting for a long time in the sun he began to lose consiousness. Also: -dizyauka, -vwenzauka, -benzuka. (2.-benzaukide, 3.-benzausya, 4.-benzaukila, 6.-benzaukisya.)
cut up meat into strips for drying, Kobenzenga nyama yakuyanika. Cut the meat into strips for drying in the sun. Also: -sama.

collapse, faint, lose power, Naakakkala kwakaindi muzuba, wakabenzuka akunetuka kwakaindi kasyoonto. = When she sat for a long time in the sun she lost power and fainted for a short time. Also: - benzauka. (2.-benzukide, 3.-benzusya, 4.-benzukila, 6.-benzukisya.)

collapse, lose power, Naakaciswa wakabenzuuka kwaciindi cisyoonto alimwi wakaba kabotu. = When he was sick he became very weak for a short time, but then he recovered. cf.-benzauka. (2.-benzuukide, 3.-benzuusya, 4.-benzuukila, 6.-benzuukisya.)

swing, Inombe yalikuyabubesaula mucila niyali kweenda munzila. = The cow was swinging its tail while walking along the path. Also: -kwisaula, -fwisaula. (1.-besaulwa, 2.-besaulide, 3.-besausya, 4.-besaulila, 6.-besaulisya.)

become fixed in one's position, Taata kacili muzumi bakali kuyanda kale kuzumina, baati muzumizye kuti mukwate mwanaabo, ono mbwaafwa basanduka tabacindiyandi ategwa ndabesya mucete. When my father was still alive, they (i.e. the girl's parents) were about to allow me to marry their daughter, but when he died they changed and no longer liked me, saying I had become a poor man.

try a case, Moonde ngomubetesi ukonzya kubeteka kaambo aaka. = Moonde is the judge who can try this matter. Mmufwubafwuba, zinya lyamuntu, utakwe maanu, utayeeyi, utalibeteki utalibuzyi. = He is a foolish person, an idiot, without wisdom who does not think, who does not test himself or question himself. Bantu banji balikubetekwa mumankuta nkaambo kakujaya banyama musyokwe. = Many people were judged in the courts because of killing animals in the bush. (1.-betekwa, 2.-betekede, 3.-betesya, 4.-betekela, 5.-betekelalyo, 6.-betekesya, 7.-beteka-beteka, 8.-betekana)
nail, *Kobetela cifwanikiso eeco kubwaanda.* = Nail that picture on the wall. Also: -gagaila, -kankamina. (1.-betelwa, 3.-betezya, 6.-betekesya.)

carve, *Sena ulicizyi kubeza ngoma?* = Do you know how to carve a drum? (1.-bezwa, 2.-bezede, 3.-bezya, 4.-bezela, 5. bezelalyo, 6.-bezesya, 7.-beza-beza, 8.-bezelana.)
  • file the teeth, *Bakamubeza meno.* = They filed his teeth. *Musilisi wakatalika kubeza menyo amusimbi.* = The dentist started to file the girl's teeth. Also: -fwala.
continue to carve, Wakalikubezaula nkwandi limwi yaakubota. = He was working on the wooden dish until it was perfectly carved. (1.-bezaulwa.)
be carved, rt. -beza, *Atalaa zisalu waangilila cintu cakabezegwa.* = Above the animal skins he tied an object which was carved. (2.-bezedwe)
carve for someone, Kamundibezela nkwandi. = Carve a wooden plate for me. (1.-bezelwa)
carve with a tool, Munguza wakabezezya mbezo kubamba nkwandi. = Munguza used an adze to carve a wooden plate. (1.-bezezyegwa, 2.-bezezyedwe.)
recarve, *Eeyi nkwandi iyandika kubezululwa.* = This wooden plate needs to be re-carved. (1.-bezululwa, 2.-bezulwidwe, 3. -bezuluzya.)

heap branches together, *Cibibi ncobabibika bacembele, tacinaumpwa pe.* = The heap of branches which the old woman has piled up, is not yet burnt. (1.-bibikwa, 2.-bibikide, 3.-bibizya, 4.-bibikila, 6.-bibikisya, 8.-bibikilana.)

call repeatedly, *Kobibita kusikila Nchimunya avwuwe.* = Call repeatedly until Nchimunya answers. (1.-bibitwa, 2.-bibitide, 3.-bibitizya, 4.-bibitila, 5.-bibitilalyo, 6.-bibitisya 8.-bibitana.)
  • fill up, *Nacintu kwakabibita misozi mumeso akwe.* = Tears filled Nacintu's eyes. Also: -iba-iba

fill a pipe or roll a cigarette, *Munene ubiika musanga walubanje.* = The old man is rolling a marijuana cigarette. (1.-biikwa, 2.-biikide, 3.-biisya, 4.-biikila, 5.-biikilalyo, 6.-biikisya, 8.-biikilana.)
fill a pipe for someone to smoke, *Mulembwe wakalitumide mujwa wakwe kuti amubiikile mfwuko.* = Mulembwe sent his nephew to fill a pipe for him. (1.-biikilwa, 2.-biikilidwe.)
ooze, as like blood, or from a witch's charm *Lumwi lusengo ilwakali kumbali kwakakkede Sicibende Iwakali kubiisyika.* = One charm next to where Sicibende was sitting was oozing a liquid.
weep silently, sob, Bacembele balabiizika kulila kuti bayeeya mwanaabo wakafwa mwakali. = The old woman sobs when she remembers her child who died last year.

become bad, *Cilainda kubija kuti mubbi kataleki kubba.* = It will be worse if the thief does not stop stealing. Eeyi nyama yabija nkaambo yaida. = This meat is bad because it is burnt. (2-bijide, 3.-bisya, 4.-bijila, 5.-bijilalyo, 6.-bijisya, 7.-bija-bija or -biabi.)
be bad for, frustrate, Cakamubijila Mainza, musimbi naakamuleka. = It was bad for Mainza, when the girl left him. (1.-bijilwa, 2.-bijide, 3.-bisya.)
be frustrated, Balimi banji bakabijilwa nibakabula kwakusambala nzyobalima. Many farmers were frustrated when they had nowhere to sell their produce. (2.-bijidwe)
