be in a state of disorder, Munanda ya Nchimunya mulidobenkenye. In the house of Nchimunya there is disorder.

shoot, crack, Ulabinga nombe kuya kumacelelo kayaabudobola mukkwilo wakwe. He is driving the cattle to the grazing pastures going along while cracking his whip. (1.-dobolwa, 2.-dobwede, 3.-dobozya, 4.-dobweda, 8.-dobolana)

speak with a deep voice, Mudaala wadodoma abukali sunu. = Today the old man spoke with a deep angry voice. (2.-dodomede, 3.-dodomezya, 4.-dodomena)
  • sound with deep resonance, Mucembele naakali kufweba ndobondo yakalimvwinsya kudodoma. When the old woman was smoking a bubble pipe a deep rumble was heard.
poke out, Kodokanona masilila mumfwuko. Poke out the burnt remains of tobacco in the pipe. (1.-dokanonwa, 2.-dokanwede, 3.-dokanozya, 4.-dokanweda) Also: -dokomona, -dokonona.

scratch, Munene wakali kudokaula-dokaula ansi alwala lulamfwu Iwacalananda. The old man was scratching about on the ground with the long nail of his thumb. (1.-dokaulwa, 2.-dokaulide, 3.-dokauzya, 4.-dokauda, 8.-dokaulana)

pine for something, desire food at the sight of someone eating, Mwana wakadokelelwa naakabona balya. The child longed for food when s/he saw some people eating. (2.-dokolwede) Also: -nyomenenwa, -menenwa.

touch someone to attract attention, Ndakamudokola, kumane wandilanga cabukali. I touched him to attract his attention, whereupon he looked at me angrily. Ndakamudokola mwiiyi wakali kwiile kulangilila bantu nkobapupana kutanta mootokala. I touched a teacher who was just watching the people as they scrambled to get on to the truck. (1.-dokolwa, 2.-dokolede, 3.-dokozya, 4.-dokweda, 6.-dokolesya, 8.-dokolana)
  • scratch out, Bakwale badokola minsonje yamapopwe. The partridges scratch out the seedlings of the maize. Also: -dokoola
poke out, as out of a hole, Ndakazidokomona ndongwe kuzwa musaka. I poked the groundnuts out of the sack. (1.-dokomonwa, 2.-dokomwede, 3.-dokomozya, 4.-dokomweda) Also: -dokonona.

clean teeth with a toothpick, Bamacembele nobakamana kulya nyama, bakatalika kulidokonona mumenyo atusamu. When the old women had finished eating the meat, they began to clean their teeth with tooth picks. (1.-dokononwa,2.-dokonwede, 3.-dokonozya, 4.-dokonweda, 8.-dokononana.) Also: -dokomona.

be vaccinated, Nkondo yakudokotwa kukasya cifwumu kubana balaa myaka itanasika yosanwe, yakatalika mazuba masyoonto ainda. = The vaccination campaign to prevent measels for under-five children, began a few days ago. (2.-dokotedwe, 4.-dokotelwa)
move in a line, Inombe zyakadolola kuya kumulonga kukunywa meenda. = The cattle moved in a line going to the river to drink water. (2.-dolwede, 4.-dololela)
touch, as with one finger, Kodomba kasanga mumafwuta undibikke mujanza. = Dip a blade of grass in the vaseline and put it on my hand. Also: -tomba, -tompa

light, as a candle, Kamudomeka lambe kusalale munanda. = Light a lamp so that there is light in the house. Wakadomeka kasanga katombwe akutalika kufweba. = He lit a cigarette and began to smoke. Also: -doneka. (1.-domekwa, 2.-domekede, 3.-domesya, 4.-domekela, 5.-domekelalyo, 6.-domekesya, 7.-domeka-domeka, 8.-domekana)
be stained, Eezi zyakusama zyaide kudombela tombe. = These clothes were just stained with dirt. Also: -dobela. (2.-dombede, 3.-dombezya, 4.-dombelela)

fill oneself, Wakayeeya kucita cimwi cintu cibi kutegwa bamwi batakate walo kalya alikke kakkuta kalidomenena. = He thought of doing something bad so that others would turn away so that he could eat alone and satisfy himself alone. (1.-domenenwa, 2.-domenede, 3.-domenenena, 8.-domenenana)

mention, Ndakatiibamvwe kabadomooka kukutumizya kumanyika abantu. = I thought I heard some mentioning about sending you to foreign countries. Coonse ciindi musimbi ulya wakali kudomookwa kubisizya bantu. = All the time it was said that that girl was doing bad things to people. (1.-domookwa, 2.-domookede, 4.-domookela, 8.-domookana)
select, pick, Ndakamudomoona akati aabeenzinyina. = I selected him from among his friends. Also: -nomona. (1.-domoonwa, 2.-domoonede, 3.-domoonya, 4.-domoonena, 8.-domoonana)

name as particular person to be chosen or to do something, rt. -domoona, Bali kudomoonsya Nangoma kuti ulavwundikwa kono. = They were thinking of Nangoma as one to be initiated this year. (1.-domoonsyegwa, 2.-domoonsyede, 4.-domoonsyela)
be selected, Zina lya Katungamasaka alimwi alyokwa Chuugwa ngamazina obile akadomwa. = The name of Katungamasaka and again of Chuugwa were the two names which were chosen.

quick snatching of anything bit by bit, Chibinga wakali kudomwena buya kubweza ndongwe zyakali kupya. = Chibinga was patiently snatching the groundnuts which were very warm. (2.-domwenede, 3.-domwenezya, 4.-domwenena)
doubt, Twali kudonaika kuti naa ulaboola. = We were doubting as to whether you were coming. (1.-donaikwa, 2.-donaikide, 3.-donaizya, 4.-donaikila, 8.-donaikana.) Also: -doneeka.
explain exactly, Wadondolola buya mbucakacitika. = He explained exactly how it had happened.

articulate clearly, Bazyali nibasaanguna kumuyiisya mwanaabo mazina azintu, tabayandi kudondomeka kwaamba. Kuti badondomeka takooamba kabotu. Kuti kabamuyiisya zina lyansima, balati "Koti nciya" - inyama balati "inyana" = When parents are initially teaching their child the names of things they do not want to articulate in speaking. If they articulate correctly the child will not speak easily. If they are teaching the word nsima they say, "Say nciya," - for nyama they say nyana. (1.-dondomekwa, 2.-dondomekede)
doubt, Basilisi bakabudoneeka bulwazi bwakwe. = The doctors doubted what his illness was. (1.-doneekwa, 2.-doneekede, 3. -doneekela, 8.-doneekana.) Also: -donaika.

light up, Kamudoneka nka-ndela kwasiya munanda oomu. = Light a candle, it is dark here in the house. Kataningaona wakadoneka musanga kuti afwebe. = Before he slept he lit up a cigarette so that he could have a smoke. (1.-donekwa, 2.-donekede, 3.-donesya, 4.-donekela, 5.-donekelalyo, 6.-donekesya, 7.-doneka-doneka, 8.-donekana.) Also: -domeka, -yasya, -munika.
dip, as a bucket into water, Dongola cibulo eeci mumeenda oomu. = Dip this bucket into the water. Also: -dimpukizya.
make holes in, Katwaadonkela mapepa aya oonse. = Let us perforate all these papers. Also: -donkoola, -bbwalaula.

be holed, Cigabba eci cakadonkoka, tacikonzyi kubelesegwa. = This tin is holed, it cannot be used. (2.-donkokede, 6.-donkokesya)
  • abate, as a swelling, burst as an abcess, Cuute nicakabomba cakadonkoka, busina bwakazwa. = When the boil had come to a head, it burst and the pus came out.

be in a torn state, Ndiinga Mudyaka lyaide kuvwabama mumubbudula mupati acibaki cipati cidonkokede andelo. = Big Mudyaka was just weighed down in big shorts and a big shirt which was torn at the shoulders.

pierce, bore a hole, Kamudonkola awa kutegwa mweembo katusibila mpawo. = Bore a hole here so that we can blow the horn at the very spot. (1.-donkolwa, 2.-donkwede, 3.-donkozya, 4.-donkweda, 5.-donkwedalyo, 6.-donkolesya, 7.-donkola-donkola, 8.-donkolana) Also: -bbwalula.
  • strike water when digging, Bakaadonkola meenda mumugonti wabataata. = They struck water in the well of my father.
make a hole for someone, rt. -donkola, Undidonkwede kalyango mubbokesi eliya. = Make an opening in that box for me.

pull with force, Bakamudonsa kwaanza wakali kulwana kuti aleke kulwana. = They pulled away the hand of the one who was fighting to stop him fighting. (1.-donswa, 2.-donsede, 3.-donsezya, 4.-donsweda, 5.-donswedalyo, 6.-donsolesya, 7.-donsa-donsa, 8.-donsana.)

poke, Kodonta amunsi kutegwa citina cilokele ansi. = Poke with a pestle so that the brick falls to the ground. (1.-dontwa, 2.-dontede, 3.-dontya, 4.-dontela, 5.-dontelalyo, 6.-dontesya, 7.-donta-donta, 8.-dontana.)
  • hit the point, Kabakazyanya ciindi cilamfwu, bakaleka umwi naakadonta kaambo. = Having argued for a long time, they stopped when someone hit the nail on the head.

pour out, Kamudoolola mapopwe, apupululwe oonse. = Pour out the maize so that it is all winnowed. (1.-doololwa, 2.-doolwede, 3.-doolosya, 4.-doolweda, 6.-doololesya.)
  • give detailed explanation, Wakadoolola coonse cakacitika. = He gave a detailed explanation of all that had happened.
pour out, Indongwe zyadoomoka musaka. The groundnuts are pouring out of the sack. (2.-doomokede, 4.-doomokela, 6.-doomokesya)
spill out, Cisaka caide kuyauka, mapopwe aamuwa oonse aide kudoomokela ansi. = The sack just spilt, the shelled maize grain just poured out on the ground.

pour out like grain, Kamudoomona mapopwe musaka lizule bbekete. Pour out some grain from the sack to fill the bucket. Haanampakila wakali kudoomona mali kumakwe. = Haanampakila was pouring out money to his inlaws. (1.-doomonwa, 2.-doomwede, 3.-doomozya, 4.-doomweda, 6.-doomonesya.)

doubt, Kamuleka kudooneka bakwesu, Moonga uyakupiluka zoona. Stop doubting my friends, Moonga will return the day after to-morrow. (1.-doonekwa, 2.-doonekede, 4.-doonekela, 6.-doonekesya, 8.-doonekana.)
  • suspect, Kasima antela tubwantu tulanyugwa abantu badoonekwa bulozi. = A little nsima or sweet beer (administered by the witchdoctor) are taken by people who are suspected of witchcraft (to end their practice.)

dive and swim, Bana bakali kudubba muzyiba lyakali munsi-munsi amunzi. The children were diving and swimming in the pool which is near the village. (1.-dubbwa, 2.-dubbide, 3.-dubbya, 4.-dubbila, 6.-dubbisya.) Also: -dubbuda.
fall into unintentionaly, Kana kasyoonto kadubbikila muzyiba. = A little child fell into the pool accidentally. (1.-dubbilkilwa, 2.-dubbikilide, 3.-dubbikizya) Also: -dyumpukila, -dubbukila.
swim, Wakaya mudambwa kukudubbuda. She went to the dam to swim.
shift residence as a group to a considerable distance, Bakadubbuka kuzwa ku Chiyobola kuya kwa Chaamuka. = They shifted their residence from Chiyobola to Chaamuka. Also: -pola

(2.-dubbukide, 4.-dubbukila)
  • repeat action, Kwakali mango manji mumisamu iilya bantu bakakatala kudubbuka kucela. There were many mangoes on those trees, the people grew tired as they continued to gather them.
drop into accidentaly, Mwana wadubbukila mucikala. = The child dropped accidentally into the well. Also: -dubbikila
swim, Mwakali kudubbwa kuli nywebo, basa? = Where were you swimming, friends? (2.-dubbide, 3.-dubbya, 4.-dubbila, 6.-dubbisya) Also: -dubba

walk while stooping, Ino eeco ciindi kamwale ncadubilika_ampande yakwe kumutwe acikonde cakwe cacisambo munsingo utegwa nkubota! = At that time when the female initiate walks while stooping with a cowry shell on her head and a necklace of grass around her neck, it is a beautiful sight! (2.-dubilikide, 3.-dubilizya, 4.-dubikilila)
walk while stooping, Ulatobela munsi kadubilila, ulati nkabwa katobela simalelaako. He walks behind stooping, you would say like a puppy following its master.
explode, as dynamite, be discharged as gun, Intobolo yadubuka yajaya bantu bobilo. = The gun which was discharged killed two people. (1.-dubulwa, 2.-dubukide, 3.-dubuzya, 4.-dubukila, 6.-dubukisya.

shoot, discharge, Kodubula munyati nataningakuluma. = Shoot the buffalo before it attacks. Cigwasya nzi kudubula nokunyina munyama? = What good is it to shoot when there is no animal? (1.-dubulwa, 2.-dubwide, 3.-dubuzya, 4.-dubulila, 5.-dubulilalyo, 6.-dubulisya, 7.-dubuladubula, 8.-dubulana.)
bathe, swim, Twajana bana baladubwa muzyiba lyameenda = We found the children swimming in the pond. Also: -dubbwa

pull, drag, Kamududa looye olu. Pull this string. Wakatalika kulududa lubanje kabiibi. He began to smoke marijuana a lot. (1.-dudwa, 2.-dudide, 3.-dudya, 4.-dudila, 5.-dudilalyo, 6.-dudisya, 7.-duda-duda, 8.-dudana)
drag off to or for, Eezi zilombwana zyakamuvwampila Mutinta akumududila musyokwe. These wretched boys grabbed Mutinta and dragged her off into the bush

hide, go off into hiding, shrink away, play hide and seek, try to hide when there is nothing to hide you. Sulwe wakadudubala muciteyo nibakainda munsi babwa. The hare was hiding in a bush when the dogs past by. (2.-dudubede, 4.-dudubila, 6.-dudubalisya.)
take a hiding position, Nobamuyandaula walo wakali kwiile kududubede kunze acuulu. = As they were searching for him, he was just hiding behind an ant-hill.

move with short steps to avoid being detected, Basimpongo nobatobela nsolo mumasamu baladudu lika. When the goatherds follow the honey birds among the trees, they move with short steps. Wakatiiti asozye kududulika cakufwambaana kuya kuzyuli kutegwa akayube. He tried with short steps to go quickly to the bedroom to hide. (2.-dudulikide, 4.-dudulikila, 6.-dudulikisya)
sound of an engine, Cigayo ciladuduma. = The engine of the grinding mill is throbbing. Also: -didima. (2.-dudumide, 3.-dudumya, 4.-dudumina, 6.-dudumisya.)
gush out, as sour milk when shaken out of bottle, Kuti kotacenjeli, mabisi aladudumuka. If you are not carefull, the milk will spill out. (2.-dudumukide, 3.-dudumuzya, 4.-dudumukila, 6.-dudumukisya)
pour out, Mabisi adudumukila ansi. = The sour milk gushed out onto the grond. Also: -tuntumukila

poke out, Wakatalika kududumuna mfwuko yakajisi tukali. = He began to poke out his pipe which had a strong mixture. Kodudumuna mabisi aali munsuwa isanzigwe. Empty out the milk-gourd so that it can be cleaned. (1.-dudumunwa, 2.-dudumwide, 3.-dudumunizya, 4.-dudumwida, 6.-dudumunisya)
pour out on to, Wakacibweza cigumbuli akubududumwida ansi bukoko boonse. = He took the container and poured out all the beer on the ground.
rot as corpse or carcass, Balombwana botatwe bakabweza mutunta wakali kududunyikidwe. = The three strong men carried the corpse which was rotting.

be famous, Sibbuku wakaduka akaambo kakulela kabotu bantu bakwe. The headman was renowned for ruling his people well. Also: -duma. (2.-dukide, 3.-dusya, 4.-dukila)
  • be broken, Oolu lukalo Iwakaduka lili? = When was this fibre rope broken? Also: -dunsuka, -zutuka, -kosoka, muntuka.

move from one place to another, Ono meso alo mbwaakali kucikonzya kwaandaanya cibi a cibotu, tiibakasowa ciindi cilamfwu pe, nkubona mbaabo badukaila kuya ambi. As their eyes were able to distinguish the bad from the good, they did not waste a long time, but moved on to the next place.
move in womb, Mwana mwida uladukaula, ndimumvwide. = The child in the womb is moving, I can feel it. (2.-dukaulide, 4.-dukaulila.) Also: -dukunya.

make a big fire, Basankwa badukula mulilo anze bayanda kuyoka mapopwe. = The boys have made a big fire outside because they want to roast some maize. (1. -dukulwa, 2.-dukwide, 3.-dukuzya, 4.-dukulila, 5.-dukulilalyo, 6.-dukulisya, 7.-dukuladukula.) Also: -kunka, -kutula
  • turn one's back on another, Wakaile kudukula kweenda nibakamwiima nsima. He turned his back on them when they refused to give him nsima. Sena mwana wakasola kuccilila ndime jilo nindakadukula? = Did the child try to follow me yesterday when I turned away?

incline the shoulders forward, Musana wakadukumana akaambo kakuciswa kapati. He was bent forward because he was very sick for a long time. (1.-dukumanwa, 2.-dukumene, 3.-dumukisya, 4.-dukumina.)
  • act in pompous or boastful fashion, Kaladukumana kweenda mbuli bavwubide. = He walks in a pompous fashion as though he is rich. Naakamvwa kuti wazwidilila mumusunko, wakeenda kuya kumunzi cakudukumana. = When he heard that he had passed the exam he went home walking proudly. Also: -tukumuna
be bent forward, Kaluso kamulombwana kakadukumenye kulanga-langa mapepa atebule. = A tall and smart-looking young man was bent forward looking at the papers on the table.

be bent out of shape, Sena mwati nkucembaala kwakandidukumika musana? = Would you say it was old age that cause my back to be bent? Ino cimudukumika andelo uulya ncinzi? = What causes that one to be bent at the shoulders?
  • make haughty, Lubono Iwakukona ludukumika bamwi. = The wealth of inheritance makes some people proud. (1.-dukumikwa, 2.-dukumikidwe, 4.-dukumikila)
be powerless, be fatigued or exhausted, Ndakadukuminwa ciindi nindakaugwa mvwula. = I was numb with the cold when I got soaked. Also: -dikiminwa.
gush out, Mabisi akadukumuka kuzwa munsuwa. = The sour milk gushed out of the gourd. (2.-dukuminidwe, 3.-dukumizya, 4.-dukumininwa) Also: -dudumuka, -tuntumuka.
move inside or under cover, move as a calf in the womb, Kuli cidukunya mukuulu kwangu. = There is something moving about under the skin of my leg. (2.-dukunyizyide, 4.-dukunyina.) Also: -dukaula.

protrude from beneath, Cikoto cidukuzya agwezyo cilacisa kapati. The lump which is protruding from my shoulder is very painful. (2.-dukuzyide, 4.-dukuzyizya.)
  • be in process of germinating, Bana babona bowa bucidukuzya. = The children saw the mushrooms in the process of germinating.

light a fire for someone, rt. -dukula, Ndaciswa. Kondidukwida mulilo, undijikile kasima. = I am sick. Light a fire for me so that you can cook a little nsima for me. (1.-dukwidwa, 2.-dukwidide, 3.-dukwidizya, 4.-dukwidila, 8.-dukwidana) Also: -kutula.
  • turn one's back on another, rt. -dukula, Mukaintu naakanyema wakadukwida mulumi wakwe. = When the wife became angry, she turned her back on her husband. Aakalikulida banalumi mulilo wakaliko, bamwi bakadukwide cikko, zilyo bakaziteenkene biya. = There was a fire where the men ate, some turned away from the fire and just surrounded the food.

be expensive, Eezi zintu ziladula aboobo nsekonzyi kuzyuula. = These things are expensive and so I cannot buy them. (1.-dulwa, 2.-dulide, 3.-duzya, 4.-dulila, 5.-dulilalyo, 6.-dulisya, 7.-dula-dula, 8.-dulana or -dulisyanya)
  • shuffle, or play cards, Bataata baligwa mali manji nibali kudula njuka. = My father had a lot of his money eaten up when he was gambling with cards.
  • throw in wrestling, Ba Chilundu bakali kubadula beenzinyina mukamando kaindi. = Chilundu used to throw his friends in wrestling long ago. Also: -tinga.
  • be unusual or rare, Kaindi lufwu Iwakali kudula kapati, tiilwakali kuboola maboola-boola mbuli sunu. = In the past death was rare, it was not coming frequently as today.
be expensive for, Tiicakamudulila mbuli mbwaakali kuyeeyela. = It was not as expensive for him as he had thought.

be famous/infamous, wellknown, Wakaduma kulowa. = He was infamous for bewitching others. Sibbuku Kachabe wakaduma akaambo kakubeteka kabotu milandu. Headman Kachabe was famous for judging crimes fairly. Also:

(2.-dumide, 3.-dumya, 4.-dumina)
  • be dominant, Ijwi lyanswi lyakaba ndeliduma. The topic about fish became the one which dominated. Kwaduma kuti swebo twakazyila kumusanza. = It was well-known that we came from the south.
  • be moist, be damp, Indongwe zyaduma nkaambo zyaugwa mvwula. = The groundnuts are damp because they were soaked by the rains.

boast, Mulombwana umwi watiisweekelwe buumi nkaambo kakulidumba kuti ulicizyi kusamba milonga izwide. One youth almost lost his life because of pride, saying that he knew how to swim a full river. Nomulidumba buvwubi, bulamana. When you boast of riches, they will end. (2.-dumbide, 3.-dumbya, 4.-dumbila.) Also: -dunda.

carry heavy load with much difficulty, Mukaintu wakadumbaizya cituli canyama kutola munanda yakwe. The woman carried with difficulty the piece of meat to her house. Munene wakadumbaizya nongo yabukoko kuleta anze. The old man carried the pot of beer with difficulty out of the house. (1.-dumbaizyigwa, 2.-dumbaizyide, 3.-dumbya, 4-dumbaizyizya, 8.-dumbaizyanya)
carry something heavy, Ndakamubona Choombe kadumbya-dumbya nongo yabukoko kutola kukaanda kaniini. I saw Choombe carrying a heavy pot of beer taking it to the little hut. Also: -cuncumya.
drop into, Mali naakaloka, akadumpikila mucibulo cameenda. = When the money fell, it dropped into the bucket of water. (2.-dumpikide, 3.-dumpikizya) Also: -dumpukila, -dumpwikila.

drop into, Bacidumpikizya kale basankwa cibulo mumu godi. = The boys have already dropped the bucket into the well. (1.-dumpikizyigwa, 2.-dumpikizyide, 3.-dumpikizyizya, 8.-dumpikizyanya.) Also: -dyumpukizya, -golokezya, -nyikizya.

dip, as a bucket into water, plunge, dive, fall into hole, Inombe yadumpukila mucilindi, yatyoka. = The cow which fell into the hole, has broken its legs. (2.-dumpukilide, 3.-dumpukizya, 4.-dumpukizyizya, 8.-dumpikizyanya.) Also: -dumpikila, -tumpwikila, -dubbukila.

drop, Ooyu mwana wadumpukizya malaangu mumugodi nindali kusamba. This child dropped my money into the well when I was washing myself. (1.-dumpukizyigwa, 2.-dumpukizyide, 4.-dumpukizyizya, 8.-dumpikizyanya.)

make famous, rt. -duma, Kamumudumya sibbuku ulela kabotu. = Spread the good name of the headman who rules well. Tuyanda kudumya mazina eesu munyika. We want to have our names renowned world-wide. (1.-dumizyigwa, 2.-dumizyidwe, 3.-dumizyizya)
  • moisten, rt. -duma, Kamuzidumya ndongwe tuyupe zyakusyanga. = Wet the groundnuts so that we can easily shell them for planting.
  • be intent on, Bakaunka kuzyana ciņande kusekelela nankolola. Tiicakaloma akuloma nkaambo basimbi bakadumya kuzyana cikambekambe. They went to dance the cinande to celebrate the initiated girl. It was not good at all because the girls were fixed on dancing the cikambekambe. Akaambo kakuyanda lubono, buzumi bwabantunyina tababubali akububala, badumya buyo buvwubi. . = Because of love of wealth they don't care about the lives of their fellow humans, they are only interested in wealth.

move carefully looking around so as to be undetected, Inombe zyesu zilya mapopwe mumuunda ookwa Japi, ino koyaabudunaama atakuboni ulaa muunda ukazigusye. = Our cattle are eating maize in Japi's field, so you go carefully so that the owner of the field does not see you and take them out. (2.-dunaamide, 3.-dunaamya, 4.-dunaamina.) Also: -dunta.
stare, look at carefully, Dunama ubone cili mujungusi atebule. = Look carefully and see what is under the table. (1.-dunaminwa, 2.-duneme, 3.-dunaamya, 4.-dunamina.) Also: -sinama
bend down and look carefully, Wakadunamina buyo kuti azwe kabotu amulyango. He just bent down looking carefully so that he would come out easily at the doorway.

be proud, have a swelled. head, Ooyu muntu ulalidunda azintu nzyajisi. This person is proud of things s/he has. (2.-dundide, 3.-dundya, 4.-dundila, 5.-dundilalyo, 6.-dundisya.)
  • raise the dust, Mbomubede mu Lusaka moodunda lusuko. = That is how it is in Lusaka where dust rises. Also: -lunda.
make more of yourself than what is real, exaggerate, Nkaambo nzi ncolidundaika kutali mbobede. = Why do you pretend to be what you are not? (2.-dundaikide, 3.-dundaizya, 4.-dundaikila)

praise oneself, Nabulongo wakuntumana, wamwanguka, watambala, wasyiima, walibanda akulidundaizya. Nabulongo stood up, she kicked for joy, she danced happily, she showed her energy, she praised herself with names.

praise, flatter, Syankumai mucembele wakamudundiizya muka mwanaakwe kumacembelenyina. The old woman Syankumai was praising the wife of her son to the parents of her daughter-in-law. *Basikweebelezya boonse bakadundiizya ngoma ya Syaanasulwe.* = All the spectators were praising the drum of Mr. Hare. Also: *-lumbaizya, -dundizya.*
praise, *Mucembele uladundizya kapati kumilimo yabasimbi.* = The old woman is full of praise for the activities of the girls. Also: *-dundiizya.*
bounce, *Cisako calikwiile kudundubuka nindali kuuma nzoka.* = The stick was just bouncing as I beat the snake. (2.-dundubukide) Also: *-dindibuka.*
bulge, *Cida cakwe cakadundumana akaambo kakulya kapati.* = His stomach protruded because of excessive eating. (2.-dundumene, 3.-dundumana, 4.-dundumanina)
to prod, poke, butt, *Impongo zidunka kapongo keenzu.* = The goats are butting a new goat in the herd. (1.-dunkwa, 2.-dunkide, 3.-dunkizya, 4.-dunkila, 6.-dunkisya, 7.-dunka-dunka, 8.-dunkana.)

repeat prodding, *Mucende udunka-dunka mpwizyi.* = The bull keeps prodding the heifer.
  • palpitate as heart, *Moyo wangu wakaile kudunka-dunka.* = My heart was just throbing. Also: -dunta, -duntauka.

break in many pieces, *Mubwa wakaludunsaula lutambo ndubakamwaangide munsingo* = The dog tore the rope up into pieces with which they had tied him. (1.-dunsaulwa, 2.-dunsaulide, 3.-dunsauzya, 4.-dunsawida, 6.-dunsaulisya, 8.-dunsaulana.) Also: *-bbansaula*
be broken, *Kakole kakadunsuka.* = The rope got broke. (2.-dunsukide) Also: *-kosoka, -zutuka.*

break rope or wire by pulling, break loose from, e.g Bakalu *dunsula looye basune ijilo.* = The oxen broke loose from the rope yesterday. 1.-dunsulwa, 2.-dunsulide or -dunswide, 3.-dunsuzya, 4.-dunswida, 8.-dunsulana)
  • pluck, as fruit, *Kamudunsula mango obile tweende.* = Pluck two mangoes so that we go. Also: *-cela.*
cut off for someone, rt. dunsula, *Kondidunswida kooye kafwiifwi.* = Cut off a short piece of string for me.

cut with, *Lunyoolo ndoIwakali kudunsya, kunyoolwa cakali kucisa nkaambo kwakali kubaanga nkumonswa.* = It is the blade which was used for shaving, being shaved was painful because it was like being plucked like a chicken. (1.-dunsyigwa)

push over, *Ngulube yakadunta mibundu yacimbwali.* = The pig knocked over the mounds of sweet potatoes.
  • beat as heart, *Moyo wangu uladunta.* = My heart is palpitating. (1.-duntwa, 2.-duntide, 3.-duntya, 4.-duntila, 5.-duntilalyo, 6.-duntisya, 7.-dunta-dunta. 8.-duntana.)
  • move in a hidden way, stoop down, *Bakwale baladunta muzitewo.* = Partridges are moving secretively in the bush. Also: *-dunaama, -duda*
  • be bent, *Mudaala wakalicembeede cakuti wakali kweenzya kafwunko, wakali kwiide kudunta naenda.* = The old man was so old that he walked with a stick, he was bent as he walked.
pulsate as heart, *Moyo wangu uladunta-dunta akaambo kakuyoowa.* = My heart is pounding with fear.
be evasive, *Ino tumvwe kakunyina akuduntaika kukanana.* = Now let us hear without being evasive. (1.-duntaikwa, 2.-duntaikide, 3.-duntaikizya, 4.-duntaikila)

walk bent down carrying a load, Wainjila nzila iya kumunzi uyaabuduntaila kweenda akaambo kakuti nkata yaloozi njaakayumwide yakali kulema kapati. He entered the path going to the village bent down as he walked because of the bundle of fibres which he carried which was very heavy. Also: -anzula. (1.-duntailide, 2.-duntaizya, 4.-duntaukila)
beat, pulsate, throb, rt. dunta, Moyo wangu wiile kuduntauka akaambo kakuyoowa. = My heart is beating because of fear. (2.-duntaukide, 3.-duntausya, 4.-duntaukila) Also: -zelengana, -zwa.
cut down, Balimi baleelede kuduntaula mateyo mumyuunda yabo mumwezi wa Ivwivwi. = The farmers ought to cut bushes in their fields in November. (1.-duntaulwa, 2.-duntaude, 3.-duntauzya, 4.-duntawida)
make to beat, Ncindabona ciduntausya moyo. What I have seen makes the heart pound. (2.-duntausya, 4.-duntausyila, 8.-duntausyanya) Also: -gulunganya.
be furtive, be in hiding for, rt. dunta, Bakwale bali kuduntila mapopwe akati kamuunda. The partridges were hiding in the middle of the maize. (2.-duntilide, 4.-duntilila)

be ineffective in acting, like cutting with a blunt axe, Keembe katabosyi kaladuntubula nogonka. = A blunt axe bounces when you are cutting. (1.-duntubulwa, 2.-duntubwide, 3.-duntubuzya, 4.duntubulila, 8.-duntubulana)
  • throw something which rebounds, bounce, Nguni uduntubula bbola lyangu anze aawo? = Who is bouncing my ball outside there?

graze the surface, Bbule mmunyama ufwumbwa kuti nomuyasa masumo aduntula buyo atala. = A honey badger is the animal which whenever you spear it, the spears just graze the surface. (1.-duntulwa, 2.-duntwide, 3.-duntuzya, 4.-duntulwida, 8.-duntulana)
bounce, pulsate, Eeli bbola ndyacisani, pesi liladuntuuka. = This ball is made of cloth, yet it bounces. (2.-duntuukide, 3.-duntuuzya, 4.-duntuukila) Also: dindibuka, -dundubuka.

come into view, Naakadunuka mumunzi wakabona mukaintu wakayumwide nsima mucisuwo. = When he appeared in the village he saw a woman carrying nsima in a basket. Bakazikwiile kudunuka bataata nketayeeyede. = My father just appeared when I was not thinking of him. Mulukaye mwakali kantu kakali kuputa, kakali kudunuka a kubbila. = In the potsherd there was a thing moving, it was appearing and sinking. Also: -bbuka, -bbunuka.

spot, glimpse, Mwaaba wakaudunukila musamu. = The jackal spotted a tree. Mali wakaadunukila munsi acisanda mumamvwu. = He spotted the money beside the leg of the bed in the soil. Sicibende bakadunukilana asimuzyaabo mwinakwe. = Sicibende and the uncle of his wife spotted one another. Ooyu mwana wakazidunukila nombe akuzileta kwakwe. This boy accidentally found the cattle and brought them to his own village. (1.-dunukilwa, 2.-dunukilide, 3.-dunukizya, 4.-dunukizyizya, 8.-dunukilana)
chop up, cut, Inombe kucela mani, zidusula buya. = When the cattle are grazing, they just cut the grass. Also: -dunsula 1.-dusulwa, 2.-dusulide, 3.-dusuzya, 4.-duswida, 6.-dusulisya, 8.-dusulana)
make famous, rt. -duma Bakadusya makani aaya mbantu basika laka-laka. = The people who spread this news are those who are gossipers. (2.-dusyide, 3.-dusyizya. 4.- dusyila, 8.-dusyanya)
expand, extend Kukomena kwalo cakaile *kuduumana* bula. = Growth was confined to the expansion of the stomach. (2.-duumene, 3.-duumika, 4.-duumanina)

putrefy, Luunga wakabona mubili wamukombwe *uliduumene* antangalala. = Luunga saw the (dead) body of a cock putrefying in the open. Ndajana nombe yakaumwa mootokala *iliduumene* mumugwagwa. = I found the cow which had been hit by a vehicle putrefying on the road. Also: *-tunta*

go frequently, Twali *kuduumuka* kucibbadela kukulanga baciswa. = We used to go frequently to see the patients at the hospital. Also: *-duunkana* (1.-duumukwa, 2.-duumukide, 3.-duumusya, 4.-duumukila)
go frequently to, Michelo wakatalika *kuduumukila* kwabo Mainza. = Michelo began to frequently visit the home of Mainza.
become damp, Kuti wabikka cisani anze inga *caduungana* caugwa mvwula. = If you put the cloth outside it becomes damp when the rain falls.
be in a damp state, Eeci cibaki *ciliduungene*, utacisami, cilakujazya mpeyo. = This blouse is damp, don't wear it, it will make you feel the cold.

go to a place repeatedly, Uladuunkana abuzuba kumuunda. = She persists in going to the field daily. Musankwa wakali *kuduunkana* kususa zitina zyakuyasya nanda. = The boy was repeatedly going back and forth carrying bricks to build a house. Kaindi bazyali bamusankwa bakali kupenga *kuduunkana* kuya kukusela musimbi ngobasala kuti mwanaabo atwale. = Long ago the parents of the boy suffered a lot in going repeatedly to make marriage negotiations about the girl whom they had chosen for their son to marry. Also: *-duumuka* (1.-duunkanwa, 2.-duunkanide, 3.-duunkanya, 4.-duunkanina)
be frequent in occurance, Ino musa *uduunkanina* kuli ooku? = My friend where do you go so frequently over there? (1.-duunkaninwa, 2.-duunkanide)

pull vigourously, Nitwakabikka musenga munji mucikkocci basune bakatalika *kuduunyana*. = When we put a lot of sand in the scotch-cart, the oxen began to pull it strenuously together. (2.-duunyene, 3.-duunyika, 4.-duunyanina) Also: -daanyana, -kakanyana, -mamanyana.
be swollen as a dead body, Nitwali kweenda mumugwagwa twajana nombe *iliduunyene* mumbali aamugwagwa. = When we were going along the path we found a dead swollen cow beside the road.
knock hard, as with fist, Kukonkomona walo *uduvwula* buya. = When he is knocking he just hammers with his fist. (1.-duvwulwa, 2.-duvwide, 3.-duvwizya, 4.-duvwulila)

jump down from a place or vehicle, Bana bakadwaantuka kuzwa ankomwe yamulonga = The children jumped down from the river bank. cf. -bbwaantuka. (1.-dwaantukwa, 2.-dwaantukide, 3.-dwaantusya, 4.-dwaantukila, 8.-dwaantukana)
go or do repeatedly, Mutinta mmuyumu kudwaba kusesa kuli basizikwelete. = Mutinta is continually asking to be repaid by her debtors. (2.-dwebede, 3.-dwabya, 4.-dwabila, 8.-dwabilana)

go repeatedly to, Akalo kacele kaya kakali kundilembela magwalo aaluyando, ani kandivwumba kumeso kadwabila kkoce. = And this bush-cat was writing me love letters, but in reality was just deceiving me, going behind my back.
  • run towards before flying, Muyuni jule wakatalika kudwabila, nkujana mababa aima mbuli kuti wakali kuyanda kuuluka. = The secretary bird began to run to take flight, and the wings were standing up as if it was about to fly.
pierce, lance, Wakamudwalula musune asumo. = He pierced the ox with a spear. (1.-dwalulwa, 2.-dwaIwide, 3.-dwaluzya, 4.-dwalwida, 8.-dwalulana) Also: -bbwalula

stand on guard, Akati kabantu aba basikufwenezya umwi utegwa nguudwanama amulyango, mbwaasika amulyango nkudwanama, ulangide munanda akukasya bantu kwiinda amulyango. Among those people who go to take the girl for marriage, as soon as one of them, known as sikudwanama, 'theone-who-stands-at-the-doorway', takes up his position at the door, he looks inside forbidding the people to pass through the doorway. (1.-dwanaminwa, 2.-dwaneme, 3.-dwanamizya, 4.-dwanamina, 8.-dwanaminana.)
hop along, Jule usaanguna kudwanka-dwanka katanauluka. The secretary bird hops along before it takes off in flight. Also: -junka-junka
hop, skip, Basa, katudwanta mbuli bacula. Friends, let us hop like frogs. Cula udwanta buya kweenda. A frog hops as it goes along.

hop about, Igande nilyakazwa anze, lyakadwantauka. When the big frog came out it hopped about. Kaya kana kakali kudwantauka buya kweenda. That child was walking in a hopping fashion. (2.-dwantaukide, 3.-dwantausya, 4.-dwantaukila, 8.-dwantaukana.)

jump down, Mootokala nuwakapya, twakafwambaana kudwantuka kutegwa tutapyi. When the vehicle caught fire, we quickly jumped down. (1.-dwantukwa, 2.-dwantukide, 3.-dwantusya, 4.-dwantukila, 8.-dwantukana.) Also: -bbwantuka

hop about from one place to another, Munguza tasitikizyi kubeleka, wiile kudwantuuka awa awaawa. = Munguza is not stable in doing his work, he just moves about here and there. (1.-dwantuukwa, 2.-dwantuukide, 3.-dwantuusya, 4.-dwantuukila, 8.-dwantuukana) Also: -dwatuuka
go from one job to another leaving each unfinished. Also: -dwantuuka
swim, Katudwaya mumulonga basa. Let us swim in the river, friends. Also: -yamba, -dubbwa, -dubba
run under duress, Mubbi wakali kudweba kumbele lyamusilikani. = The thief was being forced to trot in front of the policeman. (2.-dwebede, 3.-dwebya, 4.-dwebela)
running to, Masiku oonse wakali kudwebela kucimbuzi akaambo kakusoomona. Because of diahorrea he was running to the toilet all night. (1.-dwebelwa, 2.-dwebelede, 3.-dwebya, 8.-dwebelana)
exhale, Wakadweemuna kati ma, busi buya bwiide kuunduluka bwamunyonosya kapati. = He exhaled, the smoke was just flowing out making him very happy.

send to take one's turn, order, command, Kapapa, ndakudwiila, koya ukanyone nombe ino. Kapapa, I send you for your turn, go and bring back the cattle now. Niyakaumuna ngoma ya Syaa= nasulwe, wakadwiila ngoma ya Chibila. = When the drum of Syaanasulwe went silent, Chibila with his drum took his turn. (1.-dwiilwa, 2.-dwiilide, 3.-dwiizya, 4.-dwiilila, 8.-dwiilana) Also: -pyolola.

take turns at herding, Basankwa bakali kudwiilana nobakali kweembela mpongo musyokwe = The goat herds were taking turns in bringing back the goats from the bush. Tweelede kudwiilana buyo kweembela kutegwa katupumuna. We should take turns in herding so that we rest. (2.-dwiilanide, 3.-dwiilizyizya, 4.-dwiilanina) Also: -balizyanya.

tie a tourniquet, Mwana naakalumwa nzoka, bausyi bakafwambaana kumudwinika loozi kutegwa busaki butayi kumoyo. When the child was bitten by a snake, the father tied a tourniquet so that the poison would not go to the heart.

be bent in pain, Suntwe wakali kudyaabala kweenda akaambo kakuumwa amusana. The hyena was bent with pain because he was beaten across the back. (2.-dyaabele, 3.-dyaabazya, 4.-dyaabalila) Also: -nialala, -niabala.

make back hollow or concave, Koleka kudyaamana noyenda inga koya kulemanina lyo. = Stop making your back hollow when you walk perhaps you will be left as a cripple. (2.-dyaamene, 3.-dyaamika, 4.-dyaamanina) Also: -dimpuka.

be in a bent state, Eeci cisamu cilidyaamene. This tree is bent. Musana wamudaala ulidyaamene akaambo kantenda yamumugwagwa. = The back of the old man is bent because of a road accident. Also: -dimpukide.

press inwards, make concave, Cakamudyaamika musana musune nkuumwa kapati. = What made the back of the ox concave was being beaten a lot. (2.-dyaamikide, 3.-dyaamika, 4.-dyaamikila, 8.-dyaamikana) Also: -tyaamika.
press on, Wamudyaamina acamba. He pressed on his chest. (1.-dyaaminwa, 2.-dyaaminide, 3.-dyaamizya, 4.-dyaaminina, 8.-dyaaminana)

press down, Kamudyaaminina nsimbi kutegwa caando ciboneke kabotu. Press hard with the cattle-brand so that the brand mark may be seen clearly. (1.-dyaamininwa, 2.-dyaaminide, 3.-dyaaminizya, 8.-dyaamininana)
  • oppress, inflict hardship, Kudyaaminina mucaala ncibi nkaambo bumwi buzuba ndiza ayebo bana bako bayakucaala. Oppressing an orphan is bad because one day perhaps your children will be orphans as well.
hobble along, Munene udyabatila buya kweenda. = The old man just hobbles along. (2.-dyabatilide, 3.-dyabatizya, 4.-dyabatilila) Also: -dyabila, -sunkuta, -bbampila.

walk unsteadily as on wet land, Banabulwe bakali kudyabbalika kunjila mutusensa twamaanzi. = The iguanas were walking unsteadily as they entered the swampy places. (2.-dyabbalikide, 3.-dyabbalizya, 4.-dyabbalikila)

trample on, Bantu bamwi balayanda kudyabbauka mizeezo yabeenzinyina. Some people like to trample on the ideas of their friends. Munyati wakadyabbauka muvwimi akumujaya. = The buffalo trampled on the hunter and killed him. (1.-dyabbaukwa, 2.-dyabbaukide, 3.-dyabbauzya, 4.-dyabbaukila, 8.-dyaabaukana)

walk unsteadily, Uladyabila kweenda nkaambo ulilemenye. = He walks unsteadily because he is lame. Mwami wakali azinowe atulolomi tunji aboobo wakali kwiide kudyabila. = The chief had corns on many toes and so he was just hobbling along. (2.-dyabilide, 3.-dyabizya, 4.-dyabilila) Also: -sunkuta, -kangaila.

soak the end in some liquid, Wakaleta pepe lyankuku akulidyaka-dyaka mumafwuta. He brought the feather of the hen and soaked the tip in oil. (1.-dyakwa-dywakwa, 3.-dyakizyadyakizya, 4.-dyakilila-dyakilila, 8.-dyakanadyakana)

oppress, Toonse tobamakaintu abalombwana tuleelene, kunyina ulaatala. Taceelede kudyakaizya umwi pe. = All of us, we women and men, are equal, no one is on top. One should not dominate the other. (1.-dyakaizyigwa, 2.-dyakaizyide, 4.-dyakaizyizya, 8.-dyakaizyanya)
  • correct, Ndalumba mwiiyi wangu akaambo kakundidyakaizya ciindi nindakali kulemba bbuku eeli. = I thank my teacher for correcting me during the time I was writing this book.
delay deliberately, Aaba bana tababeleki, baile kudyalauka. = These childen are not working, they are just delaying deliberately. (2.-dyalaukide, 4.-dyalaukila)

delay deliberately for a reason, Tozyi kuti ncobadyalaukiladyalaukila boobu bayanda kubona naa tuli bafwubafwuba. = Do you not know that the reason why they are delaying deliberately is that they want to see whether we are foolish. (2.-dyalaukide, 3.-dyalaukizya, 4.-dyalaukilila)

be rough in speech or action, Mudyaka wakali kwiile kudyakaula kuvwiila ciindi naakali kubetekwa. = Mudyaka was just answering in a rough manner when he was being tried. (1.-dyakaulwa, 2.-dyakaulide, 3.-dyakauzya, dyakaulila, 8.-dyakaulana.)
mock, Wakamvwa muntu umuseka kumwi oku kamudyakizya. = He heard someone laughing at him while mocking him.

push hard or stuff into or under, Kagwalo wakadyambilila kabwe kumbali munselelo amusamu. = He stuffed the note under a stone down beside the tree. (1.-dyambililwa, 2.-dyambilide, 3.-dyambilizya, 4.-dyambililila, 8.-dyambililana)

eat slowly or shyly, Uladyanka kulya nkaambo ubwenye musimbi. = He is eating slowly because he has seen a girl.
  • eat carelessly, Koleka kudyanka nolya, ulabasesemya bapati. = Stop being careless as you eat, you will disgust the elders.

press, as with finger, Kodyauminina kapati kutegwa cijate. = Press hard so that it sticks. Cheelo, dyauminina jamba eeli linjile mubulimo. = Cheelo, press hard on this plough so that it ploughs deeply. (1.-dyaumininwa, 2.-dyauminide, 3.-dyauminisya, 4.-dyauminina, 8.-dyaumininana) Also: -dyaaminina.
get mixed up in, Mainza ulidyobengene mumaali. = Mainza is caught up in polygamy.

mix with one another, Aaba bantu bamalombwana abamatumbu bakadyobenkana kwaanzyanya nibakazwa mucikombelo. = These people, men and women, mixed together to greet one another when they came out of the church. (2.-dyobenkene, 3.-dyobenkanya, 4.-dyobenkanina)

fall over a precipice or into a hole, Ndakadyobokela mucilindi ciniini nkaambo tiicakali kulibonya kabotu. = I fell into a small hole because it was not clearly seen. Kangulube kakadyobo kela muntimba jilo. = The piglet got stuck in the mud yesterday. Mootokala wakali kwiide kusotauka akudyobokela muzilindi. = The car was just jumping about and running down into holes. (2.-dyobokede, 3.-dyobokezya, 4.-dyobokelela)

insert, as a stick into porridge, Kodyobola muungo muceele, wamana ukope. = Insert the cooking-stick into the porridge, and when you have done that stir it. (1.-dyobolwa, 2.-dyobolede, 3.-dyobozya, 4.-dyobozyezya)
poke into, Wandidyokola muliso. = He poked me in the eye. (1.-dyokolwa, 2.-dyokwede, 3.-dyokozya, 4.-dyokozyezya, 8.-dyokolana)

sitting foolishly, Eeci cana cilidyokomene munanda pele kumyankuta muungo wacisyu limwi caakubaa njilikitwa. = The stupid child just sits foolishly in the house, the only thing it does is to lick the stick used for stirring relish and because of that its teeth grow over one another. (traditional belief if a child misbehaves) (4.-dyokomanina)

poke, dip into, Munene wadyomba munwe mubuci. = The old man has dipped his finger in the honey. Wakatalika kumudyomba-dyomba mwida. = He started poking him in the stomach. (1.-dyombwa, 2.-dyombede, 3.-dyombya, 4.-dyombela, 5.-dyombelalyo, 6.-dyombesya, 8.-dyombana.)
insert Also: -sekka, -dyoomeka
immerse in water, Wakamujata akumudyondyomezya mumeenda. = He caught him and immersed him in water. (1.-dyondyomezyegwa, 2.-dyondyomezyede, 4.-dyondyomezyezya)
utter incorrectly, Webo kwiimba tocizyi inga uladyongola. = You don't know how to sing, you are distorting the song. (1.-dyongolwa, 2.-dyongwede, 3.-dyongozya, 4.-dyongweda)
insert as stick into porridge Also: -dyomba

drop into, Kapongo kadyumukila mucikala. The goat has dropped into a well. Cikwama camali cadyumukila mucimbuzi. The purse of money has dropped into the latrine. (2.-dyumukide, 3.-dyumukizya, 4.-dyumukizyizya) Also: dubbikila, -dubbukila.

drop into, Ijilo mwana musimbi wakadyumpukila mumugodi ciindi cacifwumofwumo. = Yesterday morning a little girl dropped into the well. (2.-dyumpukide, 3.-dyumpukizya, 4.-dyumpukilila, 5.-dyumpukilalyo)

drop into, Mbubakasikila buyo kumulonga, sulwe wakadyumpukizya nondo mumeenda. = As soon as they reached the river, the hare dropped the tortoise into the water. (1.-dyumpukizyigwa, 2.-dyumpukizyide, 4.-dyumpukilila) Also: -dumpukizya, -tumpukizya.
poke, stab, prick, Kamumudyunga sumo mubwa ulaa cinsuungwe. = Stab the mad dog with a spear. (1.-dyungwa, 2.-dyungide, 3.-dyungizya, 4.-dyungila, 6.-dyungisya, 8.-dyungana) Also: -dunka, -yasa.
continually provoke or poke at, Kamuleka kumudyungadyunga caali nkaambo mulamunyemya. = Don't be continually poking at him, you will annoy him. Also: -cokosa.

stab, Ino muтиdyungila nzi ooyu? = Why are you stabbing this one? (1.-dyungilwa, 2.dyungilide, 3.-dyungilizya)
  • insert for, Kondidyungila cisamu kumpemo yamoombe ooyo kutegwa aleke kunyonka. Please insert for me a plug of wood through the nose of that calf to prevent it from sucking.

stab with spear, Kamumudyunka buyo natiicileke kusunda akubba. Just stab him with a spear, that is when he will stop misbehaving and stealing. (1.-dyunkwa, 2.-dyunkide, 3.-dyunkizya, 4.-dyunkila, 8.-dyunkana)

be foolish, Coonse ncomucita nobeenzuma tamukonzyi kundicenga, kucengwa uudyuuma. In all you are doing my friends you cannot deceive me, only the foolish can be deceived. Ino udyuuma buti usyi Mutinta mwana mbwali musongo buya acileke cikolo? = How foolish can you be, father of Mutinta, to allow a child who is so intelligent to leave school? Hadyuuma, dyuuma kumbele ulaa mpindu. Foolish one, be foolish, afterwards you will find the benefit. Also: -zilaika, -ziima, -zinzilika. (2.-dyuumide, 3.-dyuumya, 4.-dyuumina)

negotiate marriage through parents, Baleeba kumwana waba Michelo. They are negotiating for marriage (on behalf of the boy) to the daughter of Michelo. Ndakalemba lugwalo kuli Nkausu kuti atalike kundeebela. = I wrote a letter to my uncle Nkausu that he should begin to make the marriage negotiations for me. (1.-ebwa, 2.-ebedwe, 3.ebezya, 4.-ebela, 5.-ebelalyo, 6.-ebesya, 7.-eba-eba, 8.-ebana.)
  • look at, admire, Katueba mbobasobana basimbi aaba. = Let us watch how these girls play. Muntu nacembaala taoni kapati pe, bulaca nkweeba busiku. = A person does not sleep very well when old, until the dawn it is a matter of watching the darkness. Bana baleeba ndeke = The children are admiring the plane.
be worth admiring, Oyu musimbi uleebeka kwiinda bamwi. = This girl is more attractive than others. (2.-ebekede, 3.-ebekesya, 4.-ebekela, 8.-ebekana)

negotiate for someone in marriage, rt. -eba, Bataata bakatalika kundeebela musimbi jilo. My father started making marriage negotiations for me yesterday. Nchimunya bamweebela musimbi wakukwata. They are negotiating for a wife for Nchimunya. (1.-ebelwa, 2.-ebelede, 4.-ebeleda, 8.-ebelana). Also: -sela.
  • admire, look at, study, Ebela bubumbe bwakwe musimbi ooyu. = Admire the structure of this girl. Bantu banji balayanda kweebela musobano wabbola. = Many people like to watch a football match. (1.ebelwa, 2.-ebelede, 3.-ebezya, 4.-ebelela, 5.-ebelelalyo, 6.-ebelesya, 7.-ebela-ebela.)
watch, Ndakagunwa nindakajana kuti kuli bali kundeebelela. = I was embarrased when I found there was someone watching me. (1.-ebelelwa, 2.-ebelede, 4.-ebelelela, 8.-ebelelana)

watch an event, rt. -ebela, Ndajana bana beebelezya musobano wabbola. I found the children watching the football match. Mabende wakali kwiide kweebelezya namacaaca. = Mabende was just watching television. (2.-ebelezyede, 4.-ebelezyezya, 8.-ebelezyanya)

keep an eye on, Kobeebezya buyo kutegwa ubone nkobatiigame. Just keep an eye on them so that you see where they are about to go. (1.-ebezyegwa, 2. -ebezyede, 3.-ebezyesya, 4.-ebezyela, 8.-ebezyanya)
  • exhibit, Balimi bakaleta zisyango zyakweebezya kumaebe-ebe. = The farmers brought their produce to be exhibited at the showgrounds.

become flat, Kuti basune tabaceli, inga baeka mwida. = If the oxen do not graze, they become flat-stomach ed. Musune _uleekede_. = The ox is flatstomached. (1.-ekwa, 2.-ekede, 3.-ekezya, 4.-ekela, 8.-ekana)
  • give with compassion, grant favour, _Wandeeka sunu_. = He favoured me today. _Ndeeke tombwe_. = Grant me some tobacco please. _Koya ukasole kulomba antela inga bayakukweeka tusu notuceya kutegwa ujikile bana keele_. = Go and try to ask, perhaps they will kindly give you a little maize flour, however small, so that you can cook a little porridge for the children. _Inga anywebo kamumweeka mweenzinyoko_. = Please you should have pity on your friend.

be in a flat state, as stomach with hunger, _Uliekede mwida mbuli kuti tanalide kuzwa jilo_. = S/he has a flat stomach as if s/he has had no food since yesterday. _Weetezegwa kubona nkweekede akaambo kakubula zyakulya kwamazuba manji_. = He was sad to see how emaciated I was because of lacking food for many days. _Wakasintama kumujatauka wajana mwida muleekede kapati pesi mubili ucikasaala_. = He bend down to touch him he found her stomach was flat (from lack of food) but his body was still warm.

measure, fit into, _Sena wakeela mubuluke buya?_ = Did you fit into that pair of trousers? _Notanalanduka mulonga uyelede kwaayela meenda_. = Before you cross a river you should measure the depth of the water.
  • catch up, _Nokuba kuti wasaanguna kulunduka, uyakweela nkaambo ntaamu zyakwe nzifwiifwi_. = Even though he is first to run, you will catch up because he has short strides. (1.-elwa / -enzyegwa, 2.-elede, 3.-ezya, 4.-elela, 5.-elelalyo. 6.-elanizya, 7.-ela-ela, 8.-elana)

be equal, _Haamainza bakeelana a Himunzya kulampa_. = Haamainza and Himunzya are equal in height. Basi mbi bobilo bakeelana mumusunko. = The two girls got equal marks in the exam. Nokuba kuti Chinkuli wakamuka kusyanga mapopwe akwe, *akeelana* abakasaanguna nkaambo wakaabikkila bufwumba. = Even though Chinkuli was late in planting, his maize is of equal size with the first ones because he used manure. (1.elanwa, 2.-elanide, 3,-elanya, 4.-elanina, 5.-elaninalyo, 6.-elanisya, 7.-elaneelana.) Also: -ezana.
make equal, Mali akaitwa akali manji kapati nkaambo balo
nombe zyotatwe. = The money asked for was a lot because they made it equal to three cattle. Kamube

bana kwiima kutegwa basiyane kabotu. = Set the children up equally in line so that they compete properly.
  • make level, *Elanya* masusu. = Clip the hair so that it is level.

avoid, *Kweeleba* cilindi eeco. = Avoid that hole. *Kweeleba* bubi ncintu cibotu. = It is a good thing to avoid evil. Basicikolo *bakeeleba* nobakajana nzoka ililede munzila. = The pupils avoided the snake which was lying on the path. (1.-elebwa, 2.-elebede, 3.-elebya, 4.-elebela, 5.-ebelelayo, 6.-elebesya, 7.-eleba-eleba, 8.-elebana.) Also: -enguluka.
cause to avoid, Kamwe
basune acuumbwe cabaneene. = Make the oxen avoid the grave of my grandmother.
ought, should, *Uleelede* kulaigwa kutegwa ukomene kabotu. = You need to be instructed so that you grow up properly. (1.-eledwe, 2.-elede, 3.-elezya, 4.-elezyela)

be frustrated, *Ndeeleela*, kwabula kwakugama. = I am frustrated, I don't know where to go. Bana baleeleela kusika kumunzi nkaambo baliyoowede. = The children are put off from going home because they are afraid. (2.-eleelede, 4.-eleelela)

compare, measure, *Mutinta a Chimuka baleeleka nguzu nzyo-bajisi.* = Mutinta and Chimuka are comparing their physical powers. *Koeleka zyakulya.* = Measure out the food (1.-elekwa, 2. -elekede, 3. -elanizya, 4. -elanizyizya, 5. -elekelalyo, 6. -elekesya, 7.-eleka-eleka, 8. -elekana)
  • threaten or aim at, as with a spear, *Ndakayoowa munene naakandeeleka sumo.* = I was afraid when the old man aimed a spear at me. *Cilatondwa kwe-eleka sumo nokaba keembe kumuntu.* = It is taboo to aim a spear or an axe at a person.

correctly measured, *Ku-kuboko kwalulyo wakajisi lufwulu Iwaa-yelekedwe meendaa cula kumwi kaba-ndauka mazina a mizimo.* = In his right hand he had a cup which was suitably filled with water while he called on the names of the spirits.

fit, measure for, be suitable, deserve, rt.-ela, *Eeci cisani cilamwe-elela mwana amucizyi wangu.* = This garment suits my niece (sister's child). *Bulungu mbwasamide mucibuno mbubotu bulamweelela.* = The beads which she wears on the waist are beautiful, they suit her. *Bina Mutinta bakandeelela busu bwamwana.* = The mother of Mutinta measured for me a little mealie-meal for the baby. *Mali ngavwola ayelela mulimo ngwacita.* = The work which he does deserves the money he earns. *Bafwa baa-cisya! Aa ino inga ndaakweelela kwani mebo nendinyina mukowa?* = My uncle has died! Now whom can I depend on as I have no clan? (1.-elelwa, 2.-elede, 3.-elezya, 4.-elelela, 5.-elelelalyo, 6.-elelesya, 7.-elela-elela, 8. -elelana)

be dressed well, *Webo lyoonse uleelelwa, naa uli buti mubili wako.* = You are always well dressed no matter how your body is. *Nabwiinga wa-keelelwa naakasama zisani zyabwiinga.* = The bride was well dressed when she wore the wedding garments. (2. -eledwe, 3.-elezya)
  • be measured out for, *Kaindi musi-mbi wakali kupegwa milimo yakucita koo-nyinazyala: wakali kweelelwa lusuwo Iwa-maila kuti aziye.* = Long ago a girl was given jobs by her mother-in-law: a big basket of millet was measured out for her to grind.
flood, *kweelenkana kwamulonga* = the flooding of the river. Also: *-fwasuka.*
be equal, rt. -elana *Mule-elenye kulampa nobasankwa nywebo.* = You boys you are of the same height.

take care of, *Mpongo a nombe bakazyeelesa mumuunda nibakali kuzitola kukucela.* = They took care of the goats and the cattle so as to make them avoid the field when they were taking them out to graze. *Koelesa nombe zita-indi mumyuunda yabantu, balatupa mulandu.* = Guide the cattle so that they do not enter people's fields, they will give us a case. Also: -elebya, -leesya. (8. -elesana)

be last, *Muusa weelezya kulya.* = Muusa was the last one to eat. *Syuumbwa wakaluma nombe yeelezya.* = The lion attacked the last cow. (1. -ezyegwa, 2. -elezyede)
  • plan or think of doing something, *Wakeelezya mbwanga ulabasunga kabotu banyina.* = He planned as to how he would keep his mother.
  • beautify, *Musune wangu Bbantomu nguuelezya ciba cangu.* = My ox Bbanto-mu is the one who makes my kraal look nice.

be taken down, as roof by wind, Ciluli cananda cakeeluka nkaambo kwakali muwo munji. = The roof of the house was blown off because of the heavy wind. (1.-elulwa, 2.-elukide, 3.-elusya, 4.-elukila, 5.-elukilalyo, 6.-elukisya, 7.-eluka-eluka) Also: -vwumbuka, -yabuka, -vwunuka.
  • come up, Jamba lyakeeluka nilyakasika acuulu mumuunda. = The plough ploughed shallowly when it reached the anthill. Also: -iluka.

pull as oxen, Basune bangu bakaelula cilayi nocakapatide mane limwi cakadaduka. = My oxen pulled the sledge when it was stuck until it finally was released. (1.-elulwa, 4.-elulila, 8.-elulana)
  • take down a roof, Kamuelula ciluli kutegwa tugusye ndongwe. = Take down the roof so that we take out the groundnuts. Also: -yabula, -vwununa
be measured, Amuboole mweelwe. = Come and be measured.

sing sad songs, Mwana walikweema muciimbo cakwe ciindi naali kuyeeya banyina bakafwa. = The child was singing a sorrowful song when he recalled the death of his mother. Chitonga ncaakatusiila sikale, asunu ncencico nco-tweema notuzingidwe antela notuli mumapenzi. = Traditional Tonga culture which the ancestors left us, is even today the one which we use to lament when we are troubled or when we are in sufferings. (1.-emwa, 2.-emede, 3.-emya, 4.-emena, 5.-emenalyo, 6.-emesya, 7.-ema-ema, 8.-emana)
  • become oily and soft, Ndongwe zyatugwa ciindi cilamfwu muncili inga zilaema. = When groundnuts are pounded for long time in the mortar, they become oily and soft.
be oily, Ulaema-ema kumulomo nkaambo walikulya nyama V - 126 yamafwuta. = He was oily at the mouth because he was eating meat with fat. Also: -ena-ena.
take a little shyly, Nabwi-inga ulaliemaika kulya naakwatwa-kwatwa. = A newly wed woman takes a little food shyly. (4. -emaikila, 6.-emaikisya)

mock, provoke, make furious, Ncibi kweemba mweenzinyoko. = It is bad to mockingly provoke your friend. Mucende kuti komweemba ulakuluma ncobeni. = A bull will indeed attack you if you provoke it. Bakamuuma kutegwa asubuke atakaembi kabili. = They beat him so that he would repent and no longer provoke people. Also: -fwubaazya, -nyemya. (1.-embya, 2.-embede, 8.-embana)
  • arouse sexually = -emba nkwela, (Ila) Also: -empuzya.

complain, Twakali kwe-embauka mumwezi wa Nalupale imvwula niyakaunkide. = We were grumbling in the month of December when the rain went. Banabunji batakali kujata myoyo yabo bakatalikide kale kweembauka akwiima-ima anze mbubuli cilengwa ca Batonga muntu naaciswa kapati. = Many who were unable to control their hearts had started already to complain and stand outside as is the custom of the Batonga when a person is seriously ill. (1.-embaukwa, 2.-embaukide, 3.-embaukizya, 4.-embaukila, 5.-embaukilalyo, 6-embaukisya, or -embausya, 7.-embauka-embauka, 8. -embaukana) Also: -tongooka, -lilauka

complain about to, "Aa tobamakaintu twakasinganizigwa buti kaka? Mmulandu buya kuba mukaintu!" Wakalyeembaukila Saliya. = "Ah! How have we women been cursed? It is a crime to be a woman!" Saliya complained to herself.

herd, Kamweembela nombe, nobana, zitalyi mapopwe. = Children, take care of the cattle so that they don't graze in other people's fields. (1.embelwa, 2.-embede, 3.-embezya, 4.-embelela, 5.-embelelalyo, 6.-embelesya, 7.-embela-embela, 8. -embelana)
  • watch over, Kamumweembela mweenzu ataloboki. = Watch over the stranger so that he does not escape.

look for chance to attack one another, Kagele a Michelo bakatalika kweembelana, Michelo naakabbukilwa kuli muka Kagele. = Kagele and Michelo began to look for a chance to attack one another, when Michelo had a love affair with the wife of Kagele.
cause to herd, . Mwakeembezezya mumaila esu! = You have allowed your cattle graze in our maize!

help to herd, cause to herd, rt. -embela, Chilala wakalikubeembezya bana bakwe ciindi cilamfwu. = Chilala was making his children herd for a long time. (1.-embezyegwa, 2.-embezyede, 8.-embezyanya)
  • cause someone to take care of something for you, Ndakamweembezya nkuku zyobilo Michelo. = I asked Michelo to take care of two chickens for me.

complaining unhappily, Ncibi kweembauka lyoonse-lyoonse mbuli kuti tamukwe maanu. = It is bad to be always complaining as if you had no sense. Bantu banji bakatalikide kale kweembauka akwiima-ima anze mbubuli cilengwa ca Batonga muntu naaciswa kapati. Many people had already begun to murmur and stand around outside according to the custom of the Batonga when a person is seriously sick.

repent, feel remorse or pain, Ndakeempa alimwi nsyicikaindululi kwa-amba twaambo twakubeja. = I have repented and I will not repeat making false statements. Mubbi wakeempa wakati, "Ndeempa sunu! Nsekabbi limbi mubuumi bwangu pe." = The thief said remorsefully, "I have repented today! I will never steal again in my life." Ciimo cako citondezya kuti tonasubuka akweempa akusanduka kuzwa mubuumi bwako bwakaindi. Your behaviour shows that you have not yet regretted nor repented nor changed your life from what it has been in the past. (1.-empwa, 2.-empede, 3.-empya, / empezya, 4.-empela, 5.-empelalyo, 6.-empesya, 7.-empeempa.)
cause to repent, Wakamweempanzya mwana naakamwaambila majwi aakumulaya. He helped the child to repent when he spoke words of advice to him/her. Also: -empenzya, -empya

float, Amubone makunka alaempauka atala ameenda. = Look at the coconuts, they are floating on the water. Ndakajana muntu ufwide weempauka mumeenda. = I found a dead body floating in the water. Also: -impauka, -ibauka. (1.-empauzigwa)
  • be immoral, Basimbi a basankwa batalilemeki baile kweempauka mumadolopo. Boys and girls who do not respect themselves just move immorally through the towns.
be in a state of pain or stress, Nkondo yakatweempya, twakaliempede. = The war punished us, we were afflicted.
repent, rt. -empa, Bana bakeempela nibakaumwa. = The children repented when they were beaten.

erect head as person or beast, Munyati wakeempemana lyakalila ntobolo. The buffalo raised its head when the gun was fired. Also: -zulumana, -jilimana. (2.-empemene)
  • be perplexed, *Ndakaile kweempemana kacibulide cakucita.* = I was just confused not knowing what to do. Also: -zingwa.

be anxious in search of something, *Baama beempenkana kuyandaula mwana.* = My mother was in a state of panic searching for the child. Also: -sempenkana. (1.-empenkanwa, 2.-empenkene, 3.-empenkanya, 4.-empenkanina, 6.-empenkanisya)
agitate people, *Basikalumamba bakabeempenkanya bantu.* = The soldiers agitated the people.

ill treat, *Bazyali baleka kundiyanda nendeempenzya bana babo.* = The parents no longer like me, because I ill-treat their children. (1.-empezyegwa, 2.-emepezyede, 8.-empenzyanya)
  • cause to repent, rt. -empa, *Munene wakabeempenzya bana beembela nkaambo wakabauma kapati nibakalisya.* = The old man made the children who were herding repent because he beat them soundly for allowing their cattle to graze in someone's field.

hunt without seeing game, *Ndali kweempeta musyokwe kuvwima kakunyina ncejaya.* = I went scouting for animals in the bush without killing any. (1.-empetwa, 2.-empetede, 3.-empetezya, 4.-empetela)
  • roam about, *Bantu batolo baile kweempeta, tabajisi minzi isumbula.* = Lazy people who are just roaming about, do not have developed villages. *Banyama bakali kweempeta ooku akooku kuyandaula cakulya.* = The animals were searching here and there for food. Also: -fwabauka, -impita.

make one suffer, repent, *Cakandeempezya kukwata-kwata nkubula cakulya akudula kwazintu.* = What made me repent in having many marriage partners was the scarcity of food and the high cost of living. *Mweendelezi wakabeempezya basibbola naakabapa cisubulo cakulunduka musinzo mulamfwu.* = The coach chastized the footballers when he gave them the punishment of running a long distance. *Nkondo zinji zyaka-tweempezya.* = Many wars afflicted us. (1.-empezyegwa, 2.-empezyede, 8.-empezyanya)

become profligate, lustfull or lecherous. *Bamwi baalumi cibapa kweempuka nkufwidwa kwabamakaintu.* = The reason why some men become profligate is because of the deaths of their wives. (2.-empukide, 3.-empusya, 4.-empukila, 8.-empuzyanya)

be promiscuous, *Uulya mwana uleempukide kuli bamuka bantu.* = That boy behaves immorally towards the wives of others. *Sunu basankwa abasimbi baleempukide, tabakwe mpuwo yabusankwa abusimbi.* = Today boys and girls are promiscuous, they have no honour of boyhood or girlhood.
have sexual desires, try to arrouse another sexually, *Nobakaintuma, kweempukila ciwa camulumi wamweenzinyoko ncibi.* = You women, looking at the husband of your friend lustfully is bad.

give a love potion or a love charm to cause a woman to love someone who is not her husband, excite thoughts of lust, *Mulumi wangu nguwakandeempula nkaambo tandibambi kabotu.* = My husband caused me to take another lover because he does not look after me properly. *Mulumi wakwe nguwakamweempula nkaambo wakamuyiisya kunywa bukoko.* = Her husband made her promiscuous because he taught her how to drink beer. *Jolezya taakali kuzikkomanina zilengwa zimwi zibee zileempula, mbuli cilengwa cakusalazya kwiinda mukunjila mucibiya caumwi. = Jolezya was not happy with certain sexual habits, like the custom of being purified by having sex with another. (1.-empulwa, 2.-empukide, 3.-empuzya, 4.-empulanina, 8.-empulana)
love one another sexually, Twakeempulana a Muka Katombwe. = Mrs. Katombwe and I were attracted to each other sexually.

look right and left, Ciindi noyanda kukosola mugwagwa uleelede kweempuuka. = When you want to cross the road, you should look right and left. Also: -zibauka, -cebauka. (2.-empuukide, 4.empuukila)
  • move about looking for sex, Basankwa abasimbi baempuuka munjanji mbabaleta malwazi aatasilikiki. = The men and women who wander along the railway-line looking for sex are the ones who bring incurable diseases.
cause to be lustful or lecherous, Munene oyu wakeempuzya kana kasimbi nkayanda. = This old man has caused the little girl he loves to become promiscuous. (1.-empuzyigwa, 2.-empuzyide, 8. -empuzyanya)

make one repent, afflict, Bantu batolo kubeleka yakabeempya nzala. = The hunger has taught lazy people to work. Bamasilikani bakamweempya mubbi nkaambo kakubba. = The policemen punished the thief because of stealing. Nkondo yakatweempya nobana. = The war afflicted us, my children. Also: -subula. (1.-empezyegwa, 2.-empede, 3.-empya, 4.-empela)

be melted partially, dissolve, be greasy, shine as polished boots, rt. -ema, Indongwe zileemuka kuti zyatugwa kwaciindi cilamfwu. = Groundnuts become oily when pounded for a long time. Bulongo bulakomooka, bulayeemuka, bulaunka amulonga. = The soil is broken up, it dissolves, it goes with the river. Also: -yaaya, -yeemuka, -enzemuka (2.-emukide)
desire, Balombe banji bakamweemunzya mwana wamwami akumukombelezya kumukwata. = Many boys desired the daughter of the chief and proposed marriage to her. Also: -lombozya, -nyomenenwa, -emuzya.

covet, desire what is not your own, Teensi cibotu kweemuzya cintu cijisi muntu nkaambo kweemuzya ngamatalikilo akubba. = It is bad to desire what belongs to another because coveting is the origin of stealing. Also: -lombozya, -emunzya.

deceive, Ba Michelo bandisyomenzya kundipa zisani, pesi balikundeena buyo. = Mr. Michelo promised he would give me clothes, but he was just deceiving me. Azikutweene musamu wakambuma. = He is coming to deceive us with the medicine of making one rich. Also: -cenga, -unina. (1.-enwa, 2.-enede, 7.-ena-ena, 8.-enana)

be oily, Cibiya ncimwali kujikila mundyoli cileena-ena. = The pot in which you prepared pounded dry pumpkin leaves mixed with groundnuts is oily. Also: -ema-ema
  • deceive, Musimbi wali kundeenaena buyo, taandizumina pe. = The girl was just deceiving me, she did not agree to my proposal.
look down with embarrassment or shame, Ndakaile kuenama, nibakandijana nsebba mapopwe. = I just looked down with shame, when they found me stealing the maize.
face, Basibinda bakaunka kuya kukuvwima beenamina cikali acitali cikali. = The hunters went to hunt facing what was dangerous and what was not. (1.-enaminwa, 2.-enamide, 3.-enamizya, 8.-enaminana)

move, walk, go, Kweenda kuno, musa, nkupe popwe. = Come here, friend, so that I give you a cob of maize. Musankwa mufwubafwuba uleenda amukaintu mupati kule-kule kuli nguwe. = A foolish boy goes about with a woman who is too old for him. (1.-endwa, 2.-endede, 3.-enzya, 4.-endela, 5.-ende-lalyo, 6.-endesya, 7.-endeenda.) Also: -kwansa (-enda gubi-gubi = walk quickly)
  • cry pitifully, Mwana tanaakaivwuwa mibuzyo yoonse eeyi, wakalitungumene ulangide ansi kumwi kayeenda yacizike. = The child did not answer all the questions, he bowed his head looking down while the tears flowed.

go about trading, Simakwebo wakeendauka koonse-koonse, pele kunyina ncaakasambala pe. The trader went everywhere but did not sell a thing. (1.-endaukwa, 2.-endaukide, 3.-endausya, 4.-endaukila) Also: -enduka.

wander about, travelling about visiting, Jolezya wakaunka ku Lusaka kukweendeenda. Jolezya went visiting to Lusaka. Also: -zunga-zunga, -zulungana, -indana. (1.-endeendwa, 2.-erideendede, 3.-endeendya, 4.-endeendela, 5.-endeendelalyo, 8.-endeendana)

go along, Chimuka wakandeendela biya akuzoonduuma ananda yangu. Chimuka just came for the purpose of beating me at my house. Nsilibi ziyendela mumbali amulonga. = The black ants go along by the riverside. Twakali kweendela musyokwe buzubo obo mbotwakaloboka. We were going along through the bush on that day when we escaped. Malwazi atombe zyeendela antoomwe. Diseases and dirt go along together. (1.-endelwa, 2.-endelede, 5.-endelalyo, 6.-endesya, 8.-endelana)
  • be free, Ndalyeendela. = I am free. Ulaleendela. = He walks freely.
  • progress, Ino sunu aendela ali makani anu? = How far today has your case progressed?
  • seek charms to bewitch, Kuti kosundila bamuka bantu, bayakukweendela. = If you play with other men's wives, they will seek to bewitch you.

go along with, agree, rt. enda Miyeeyo yangu ileendelana ayako. My thoughts agree with yours. Bana kucikolo balaiya zintu zinji, pesi Iwiiyo Iwabo talweendelani abuumi bwamuminzi. Children learn many things at school but their learning does not correspond to life in the villages. (1.-endelanwa, 2.-endelanide, 3.-endelanya, 4.-endelanina)
go along with, rt. -enda, Ncimunya wakeendelela abanyina nibakaunka ku Lusaka. Ncimunya went along with her mother when she went to Lusaka. (2.-endelede)
govern, administer, Wakali kweendelezya cibbadela ku Monze.
She was administering the hospital of Monze. (1.-endelezyegwa, 2.-endelezyede, 8.-endelezyanya)

go backwards and forwards in search of something, Twakatala kweendengana kuyandaula nombe. = We are tired of going to and fro searching for the cattle. Bantu bakali kweendengana kuyandaula micelo musyokwe. = The people were roving about looking for fruits in the bush. Also: -sempenkana, -empenkana
travel fast, rt. -enda, Kweendesya, balatusiya bantu baya. = Hurry up, those people will leave us behind.

rule, Choombe nguuyendezya cilikiti eeci. Choombe is the one ruling this district. Also: -endelezya.
  • become arbitrator, Mwami nguwakauyendezya mulandu. = It was the chief who was the arbitrator of the case.
  • travel by or on, rt. -enda, Weendezya nzi kuya kucikolo? = By what means do you travel to school?

go about trading, Musambazi wakeenduka ooko akooku kusambala zintu zyakwe. = A trader went about selling his wares. Also: -endauka, -pindauka. (1.-endukwa, 2.-endukide, 3.-enduzya, 4.-endukila, 5.-endukilalyo, 6.-endukisya)

trade, Bantu bakaindi bakajana cakulya ciindi canzala kwiinda mukweenduuka kuuzya bana babacizyi babo. = The people of long ago found food at a time of hunger by trading in the sale of their nephews or nieces. (1.-enduukwa, 2.-enduukide, 3.-enduuzya, 4.-enduukila, 5.enduukilalyo, 6.-enduukisya)

discover, rt. -ena, Beembezi beenena nziba. = The herders spied a dove (discovered the dove's place for laying eggs). Kokkala kabotu, omusimbi, balakweenena busimbi. = Sit properly, girl, or else they will see your private parts. Musimbi wakeenena nzuki kumulonga jilo. = A girl saw honey-bees at the river yesterday. (1.-enenwa, 2.-enede, 3.-enesya, 4.-enenena, 8.-enenana)
  • lay poison for, Kamweenena tujaye kansimba kalya nkuku zyesu masiku. = Lay some poison so that we kill the wildcat which kills our chickens at night. Also: -teya ncefwu.

heat cream or butter, Musimbi uleenga mafwuta akunana amubili. = The girl is heating the oil for smearing on her body. (1.-engwa, 2.-engede, 3.-engezya 4.-engela, 5.-engelalyo, 6.-engesya, 7.-engeenga, 8.-engana) Also: -zenga.
  • cook first food after a girl is married, Mutinta nguwakaenga musa naakakwatwa mweeninyina. = Mutinta was the one who cooked the first meal when the daughter of her uncle got married. (When a girl is married she goes to live at the village of her husband. She cooks food in her mother-in-law's house. After some time a relative of the girl comes and makes a new fire in new kitchen of the bride and cooks the first meal in the house of the newly wed which allows the bride herself to cook after that.)
  • trace a sign, draw a circle around, mark out, Kamwaayenga mayi kutegwa kaalizyibya. = Mark the eggs so that they can be recognized. Bantu bakaunka kuya kweenga munzi mupya. = The people went to mark out a new village. Bayanda kweenga lulindi. = They want to mark out the foundations for a house.
  • boil powdered castor oil beans, Kamweenga mafwuta kwiinda mukujika nseke zyamabbona zyatugwa. = Make some oil by cooking pounded castor oil seeds. Also: -zenga
  • wear a tuft of hair on the crown of the head (Ila), Koenga cisumpa = Wear a tuft of hair.

draw rough lines, Bakamweengaula kumeso atwe lyadilwe. = They drew lines with ash on his face during the funeral. Kamuzyeengaula zibiya nzimwabumba atwe. = Draw lines with ash on the pots which you have moulded. Also: -cekaula, -zekaula (1.-engaulwa, 2.-engalide, 3.-engaulizya, 4.-engaulida, 5.-engaulidalyo, 6.-engaulisya, 8.-engaulana)
  • stab many times, Mukaintu ngobakabbida bakamweengaula azipeni. = They stabbed with knives many times the woman whom they robbed.
make small fire beside the main one, Wakeengekezya kujika. = She made a small fire beside the big one for cooking.

be laid out, measured out, Chipwetenge a Dyabbula nobakaunka kumunzi bakajana nsima zyeengela kale. = When Chipwetenge and Dyabbula went home they found the food already laid out. (1.-engelwa, 2.-engede, 3.-engezya, 4.-engelela)

surround, encircle, Meso aa Sicibende akali ansengo zyali kweengelede lukaye. The eyes of Sicibende were on the magic horns which encircled the potsherd. Mwami Kanongesha ngomwami mupati wa Balunda. Walo Iwakwe mbalela, ibamweengelede, bategwa mba Lunda-Ndembo. Chief Kanongesha is the paramount chief of the Lunda people. He is the one who rules those who surround him called the Lunda-Ndembo. (1.-engeledwe, 3.-engezya, 4.-engelela)

have mercy, e.g Bakamweengelela wakabbide zisani. = They showed mercy on the one who stole the clothes. (1.-engelelwa, 2-engelede, 3-engelezya, 4.-engelela, 5.-engelelalyo, 6.-engelelesya 7.-engelela-engelela, 8.-engelelana)
  • fill eyes with tears, Kubusyu bwakwe kwakeengelela misozi. = The eyes filled with tears without falling. Also: -ibaiba

put out food to eat, rt. engela, Bamakaintu beengezya kale cakulya atebule. The women have already put out the food on the table. (1.-engezyegwa, 2.-engezyede, 4.-engezyezya, 5.-engezyezyalyo, 8.-engezyanya) Also: -sengezya.
  • draw a line with, rt. -enga, Kweengezya apensele. = Draw a line with a pencil.

graze, as thorns on the skin, Akandeengula mamvwa nindakali kweenda musyokwe. = I was grazed by the thorns when I was in the bush. (1.-engulwa, 2.-engwide, 3.-enguzya, 4.-engulwida, 8.-engulana)
  • skim off (skim off oil after boiling castor oil beans) Kamweengula mafwuta mwamana mwaabikke munsazi. = (After boiling it), skim off the oil and put it in an oil container.
  • cry pitifully, Kuti mucembele wafwidwa muzyukulu, uleengula kulila. = If an old woman looses the grandchild, she cries pitifully. Also: -lengula.

avoid, Wakeenguluka mulindi ngwaakateedwe mukazila. = He avoided the hole which had been set on the path to trap him. Bana bakeenguluka nibakajana muntu ufwide mumugwagwa. = The children avoided the dead person whom they found on the road. Nobakabbila banji-banji mubutinti, bakabona kuti awa akali abi, eelyo bakeenguluka. = When very many sank into the mud, they saw that this was a bad place, so they avoided it. Also: -eleba. (1.-engulukwa, 2.-engulukide, 3.-engulusya, 4.-engulukila, 5.-engulukilalyo, 6.-engulukisya, 7.-enguluka-enguluka, 8.-engulukana)

hesitate in acting, withdraw, Wakeenkela kufwusa nibakatiilwane a muntu ulya. He hesitated in throwing a blow when they were about to fight. Muciindi cakugagaila mpikili, Mainza wakeenkela. At the moment of hammering the nail, Mainza hesitated. (1.-enkelwa, 2.-enkede, 3.-enkezya, 4.-enkela, 5.-enkelelalyo, 6.-enkelesya, 7.-enkela-enkela, 8.-enkelana) Also: -saya.

wander about in search of something, Muntu wakaensenkana kwamazuba manji kuyandaula nombe. = The man wandered about for many days searching for the cattle. Also: entenkana. (1.-ensenkanwa, 2.-ensenkene, 3.-ensenkanya, 4.-ensenkanina, 5.-ensenkaninalyo, 6.-ensenkanisya)
graze as a bullet, Wakandeensya nkulu. = He grazed me with a bullet. Also: -kwensya (1.-ensyegwa, 2.-ensyede, 3.-ensyezya, 4.-ensyela, 8.-ensyana)

twist, move in different directions, Inzoka yanikweenda ileentengana. = When a snake moves it twists itself about. (1.-entenkanwa, 2.-entenkanide 3.-entenkanya, 4.-entenkanina, 5.-entenkaninalyo, 6.-entenkanisya)

looking for something going here and there, move in a confused way, Bakatalika kweetenkana kuyandaula mwana. = They began to look here and there in search of the child. Bantu bakeentenkana lyakasika makani aalufwu. = The people milled around in confusion when they received news of the death. Also: -ensenkana, -empenkana, -endengana.

be melted, be fused, Bunzuka bwangu bweenyuka akaambo kazuba. = My wax has melted because of the sun. Nkandela niyadomekwa yeenyuka. = When the candle was lit, it melted. Also: -enzemuka, -yaaya. (1.-enyulwa, 2.-enyukide, 3.-enyuzya, 4.-enyukila, 5.-enyukilalyo, 6.-enyukisya)
  • lift with full power, Musune naakaumwa kapati, wakeenyuka kukwela. = When the ox was beaten hard, it pulled with strength. Also: -inyuka.

be convicted, Wakalimvwa mbuli mubbi weenzegwa amulawo wacisi. = He felt that he was like a thief convicted by the law of the country.
  • be caught up on, Sulwe wakaenzegwa kumubwa ijilo. = The hare was caught up by the dog yesterday.

be melted, Mafwuta eenzemukila ansi. = The fat is melted on the ground. Ciindi cakabala zuba mu buzuba bwakaccilila nicakatalika kweenzemuka civwula-mabwe. = The time when the sun shone on the following day is when the hail-stones began to melt. Also: -yeemuka, -emuka, -yaaya. (1.-enzemunwa, 2.-enzemukide, 3.-enzemuzya, 4.-enzemukila, 5.-enzemukilalyo)

melt, fuse, dissolve, Kweenzemuna mafwuta aya mweelede kwaabikka azuba. = To melt this fat you have to put it in the sun. Zitima zisusa lubulo Iwamukuba Iwazwa akusigwa kulutola kooko nkolweenzemuninwa kuzwa kumabwe buyo. = The trains carry the copper ore from the place where it is dug out to the place where it is refined. (1.-enzemunwa, 2.-enzemwide, 3.-enzemuzya, 4.-enzemwida, 5.-enzemwidalyo, 6. -enzemunisya)
dissolve, Baaenzemusya kale mafwuta. = They have already caused the fat to melt. (1.-enzemusyigwa, 2.-enzemusyide, 4. -enzemusyila, 6, -enzemusyisya)

collapse, faint, lose consciousness, Mulwazi wakaenzuka izuba nilyakamubala kapati. = The patient collapsed, when the sun shone on him for a long time. (2.-enzukide, 3.-enzusya, 4.-enzukila, 5.-enzukilalyo, 6.-enzukisya) Also: -ezuka, -benzauka, netuka.

cause to go, drive, rt. -enda, Mutinta nguuenzya cimbayambaya eeci. = It is Mutinta who is driving this vehicle. (1.-enzyegwa, 2.-enzyede, 3.-enzyesya, 4.-enzyela, 5.-enzyelalyo, 6.-enzyesya, 8.-enzyanya)
  • go with the aid of, Mutinta wakacembaala, uenzya kafwunko. = Mutinta has become old, she walks with the aid of a stick.
  • overtake, Wakamweenzya mweenzinyina amulundu wa Munali. = He overtook his friend at Munali Hills.
  • get through to, Muciindi cisyoonto wakaenzya meenda mumugodi. = In a short time he got through to water in the well.
  • catch out, Wee, wagunwa sunu, twakweenzya, omumpelenge. = Today you are shamed, we have caught you out, cunning one.

come close to one another, Beenzyanya basizimbayambaya munzila nibali kuya ku Monze. = When they were going to Monze the drivers came close to one another.
  • compare, Kamweezyanya zibiya zyanu tubone cibumbidwe kabotu. = Compare your clay pots so that we see which one is better moulded. Also: -ezyanisya.
  • get on well together, Mebo amupati wangu twakali kweenzyanya kabotu. = I was getting on well with my brother.

show someone around, Kamumweenzyeenzya mweenzu kutegwa akuzyibe kabotu kuno. = Show the visitor around so that he gets to know this place well. (1.-enzyeenzyegwa, 2.-enzyeezyede, 4.-enzyeenzyela, 8.-enzyeenzyanya)
  • be deeply moved, Cakali kundeenzyeenzya mubili kuti ndazikuyeeya cakacita mukaintu ngundakaleka. = I was deeply moved whenever I thought of what my wife whom I had left had done.

clear away grass, hoe the ground, Kamweepa kabuwa aka mpatiikkale mwami. = Clear away the grass from this spot where the chief will sit. (1.-epwa, 2.-epede, 3.-epya, 4.-epela, 5.-epelalyo, 6.-epesya, 7.-epeepa, 8.-epana.)

disrespect, Mukaintu wakamweepula mulumaakwe akaambo kakutamusamika kabotu. = The wife disrespected her husband because he did not dress her properly. Also: -ubaula. (1.-epulwa, 2-epwide, 4. -epwida, 5.-epwidalyo, 6.-epulisya, 7.-epula-epula, 8.-epulana.)
  • graze, Naakali kulima, jamba lyakamweepula acituta. = As he was ploughing, the plough grazed his foot. Also: -syepula.
be shy, Ncibi kuliesaula kulya kuti kofwide nzala. = It is bad to be shy in eating if you are hungry. (1.-esaulwa, 2.-esaulide, 3.-esauzya, 4.-esawida, 6.-esaulisya)

sneeze, Kweesemuka ncitondezyo cakuciswa syini. = Sneezing is a sign of suffering from a cold. Also: -esyemuka, -ezyemuka. (1.-esyemukwa, 2.-esyemukide, 3.-esemusya, 4.-esemukila, 5.-esemukilalyo, 6.-esemukisya)

sneeze, Weesyemuka naafweba tombwe wamumрето. = He sneezed when he took snuff. Mundijatile omunene, ndilaa cisyini aboobo ndali kweesyemuka. Please excuse me, old man, I have a cold and so I am sneezing. (1.-esyemukwa, 2. -esyemukide, 3.-esyemusya, 4.-esyemukila 5.-esyemukilalyo, 6.-esyemukisya, 7.-esyemuka-esyemuka.) Also: sesemuka.
to cause sneezing, Cimweesyemusya nkasuko kanji kali munanda yakwe. It is the pile of dust in his house which has caused him to sneeze.

bring, Eta kasaka kuno. = Bring the sack here. Also: -leta (1.-etwa, 2.-etede, 3.-etezya, 4.-etela, 5.-etelalyo, 6.-etesya, 8.-etelana.)
  • bend when overloaded, curve, Dasilibbumu wacikkocci wakeeta nkaambo wakabikkwa kacili mutete. = The pole which links the cattle with the scotch-cart curved downwards because it was still soft and new. (1.-etwa, 2.-etede, 3.-etya, 4.-etela, 5.-etelalyo, 6.-etesya, 7.-eteeta.)
