feel sorry for, Wakaboola kwangu kalyeteeka. = He came to my place feeling sorry for himself.

bring for, Komweetela cisani mwana asame. = Bring the dress for the child to wear. Wakabalwiida zintu zyeetela misozi. = She told them things which brings tears. (1.-etelwa, 2.-etelede, 3.-etezya, 5.-etelalyo, 6.-etesya, 8.-etelelana)
  • be sympathetic, Ndakeetela Moomba naakaumwa ababbi. = I felt pity for Moomba when he was beaten by thieves.

bring along, Kamunga kamumweetelela mweenzinyoko kutegwa abazyibe bakamuyiisya. = Come with your friend so that he may know who taught him. Kondeetelela mulembo munanda oomu. = Bring me along a cloth from the house. (1.-etelelwa, 2.-etelede, 3.-etelezya, 4.-etelezyela, 5.-etelezyelalyo, 8.-etelelana)

be sympathetic, rt. -eta, Bantu banji balaetezegwa nobabona balwazi mbobapenga muzibbadela. = Many people are sympathetic when they see patients suffering in the hospitals. Konga kweetezegwa mweenzinyoko nalimukuciswa. = You should have compassion on your friend when he is sick. (2.-etezyede, 8.-etezyanya)

be a cause for sorrow, Cileetezya kapati kubona mbobapenga bantu baciswa bulwazi bwasikalileke. = It is very sad to see how people suffer who are sick with AIDS. Zyaamba Naakkoyo zileetezya moyo. = What Naakkoyo said saddens the heart. (1.-etezyegwa, 2.-etezyedwe, 4.-etezyezya)
  • bend, as a wire, as a spring, bend by means of, Koleta cisamu cakweetezya kabulo nokacipya. = Bring a piece of wood for bending the wire while it is still hot.
be all equal, Basune aaba baleezana kukwela cilayi. = These oxen pull the sledge with equal power. Also: -elana. (2.-ezanide, 3.-ezanisya, 4.-ezanina)

reckon, guess, Weezeezya buya kuti naa uyakulanduka mubbuku lyafwuka. = He is wondering whether he will pass Grade 9 examinations. (1.-ezeezyegwa, 2.-ezeezyede, 4.-ezeezyezya, 8.-ezeezyanya)
  • examine conscience, evaluate, Noyanda kuzekela muntu musongo kunkuta, nkusaanguna kweezyeezya ncoyanda kwaamba. = If you wish to sue an intelligent person in court, first reflect as to what you will say.

foretell, announce, Naa kwacitika cintu cibee cilanyandya, caambwa kuti ncisubulo kuzwa kumuntu umwi ulaa munyono, nokuba kuzwa kumizimo, nokuba kweezeqwa alufwu lwamntu lucizya. = If something occurs which causes amazement, it is said it is a punishment coming from a person who is envious, or it is from the spirits, or it fortells the death of a person.
try on, Nizyakaboola zisani eezi, bana boonse bakakkomana akutalika kulyeezeka. = When these clothes arrived all the children were happy and began to try them on.

be agile, Balayanda kumutuma nkaambo kakuti uleezemuka kweenda. = They like to send him because he is agile in moving. Also: -nantauka, -nyangauka, -nyanyaala, -nyansauka. (2.-ezemukide)
  • melt, Mafwuta alafwambaana kweezemuka zuba nolipya kapati. = The butter quickly melts in the sun when it is very hot. Also: -enzemuka.

think before making a decision, Uceezezya buya kuunka ku Monze. = She is still thinking about going to Monze. Also: -ezeezya, -ezyeezya. (2.-ezezyede)
  • penetrate the heart with sadness or joy, Lufwu Iwabaama Iwakandeezezya moyo. = The death of my mother penetrated my heart. Yakandeezezya moyo nindakaangululwa mulandu wakujaya muntu. = I was overjoyed when I was freed from the charge of killing a person.

faint, Basimbi bakeezuka anyota nkaambo zuba lyakali kupya kapati. = The girls fainted due to thirst because the sun was very hot. (2.-ezukide, 3.-ezuzya, 4.-ezukila, 8.-ezulana) Also: -enzuka, -benzauka, -netuka.

overtake, Takonzyi kundeezya mebo pe nkaambo ntaamu zyakwe nzifwiifwi. = She cannot overtake me because she has short steps. Kufwumbwa nkonditiitijile, uyakundeezya sinkondoma. = To wherever I try to run, my enemy can overtake me. Ngaaya masiku naatakeezya koona mudaala. = That night sleep did not overtake the old man. (1.-ezyegwa, 2.-ezyede, 4.-ezyezya, 8.-ezyanya) Also: -enzya
  • cause to fit, measure, try on, compare, Ndilyeezya cisani ncindakaula jilo. = I am trying on a dress which I bought yesterday. Kosaanguna kuleezya cisani eco, antela ncisyoonto kuli nduwe. = First try on that dress, perhaps it is too small for you. Ndaceezya nzi? = What can I compare it to. Mukabbuku aka ndasoleka kuleezya bukkale bwamatata mbobwakabede. = In this small book I have tried to evaluate how the life of my ancestors was. (in relation to my own).
  • threaten with Cilatondwa kweezya mabwe kubeenzinyoko, inga koya kufwusila lyo. = It is dangerous to threaten your friend with stones because you might accidentally throw one. Also: -eleka.
  • wish evil to, Cilatondwa kumweezya kufwa muntunyoko. = It is forbidden to wish death to happen to your fellow human being.

copy, compare with, rt, ezyanya, Kamubeezyanisya aba tubone mulamfwu. = Compare those to see who is taller. Kweezyanisya twaambo ncibotu nkaambo inga mwapa bukosozi buluzi. = Comparing cases is good because you can give a good verdict. (1.-ezyanisyigwa, 2.-ezyanisyide, 3.-ezyanizya, 4.-ezyanisyizya, 8.-ezyanisyanya) Also: -enzyanya.

equal in behaviour, Bakeezyanya kaambo kamicito. = They equalled one another in their deeds. (1.-ezyanyizyigwa, 2. -ezyanyisyide, 3.-ezyanyisya, 4.-ezyanyisyizya)
  • compare, Basimbi beezyanya zisani. = The girls are comparing their dresses
be compared with, Mapenzi mpaali, pesi taaceezyanizigwi amapenzi ayakutusikila. = Sufferings are present, but it is not to be compared with the sufferings which will reach us.

ponder, evaluate, think deeply about, Mainza taakaizyi kabotu nombe yakwe naakanjila muciba wakali kweezyeezya biya. = Mainza did not know his cow well, when he entered the kraal he was just guessing that it was the one. Nokuba kuti usyi wakafwa kaindi, pesi notulanga mwanaakwe tulakonzya kweezyeezya kuti usyi wakali boobu. = Even though his father died long ago, but when we look at the child we can imagine how the father was. (1.-ezyeezyegwa, 2.-ezyeezyede, 8.-ezyeezyanya) Also: -ezeezya, -ezezya.

measure the depth of a river, Kamweezyeka akasamu tubone meenda mbwaalampa. = Measure with a stick to see how deep the water is. (1.-ezyekwa, 2.-ezyekede, 3.-ezyesya, 4.-ezyekela)
  • try on, Wakaka kulyeezyeka cisani nkaambo tiicamukonda. = She refused to try on the dress because it did not please her.
  • compare with, Munyama mmupati cakunga kunyina cimbi aano ncotukonzya kumweezyeka. = Munyama is great to the extent that there is no other thing here with which we can compare him.
sneeze, Cisyini candipa kweezyemuka. The common cold has caused me to sneeze. (1.-ezyemukwa, 2.-ezyemukide, 3.-ezyemusya, 4.-ezyemukila) Also: -esemuka, -esyemuka

die, Mudaala wakafwa jilo. = The old man died yesterday. Also: -zaya, -zimina.
  • lose consciousness, Muntu ulaa maafwa, ulafwa ziindi zinji. = A person with epilepsy can pass out several times.
  • be worn out, be broken, Oobu buluke bwangu bwafwa. My pair of trousers is worn out.
  • -fwa ceempa, be suffering from extreme exhaustion.
  • -fwa cikkalizi, be tired of sitting and waiting, Twafwa cikkalizi nitwalikulindila beembela. We were tired of waiting for the herders.
  • -fwa cimenya mate = desire something making one's mouth water. (fwa luunyaluunya)
  • -fwa cisubu = experience beyond endurance; have enough of it
  • -fwa lutu = starve;
  • -fwa bukata = be lonely;
  • -fwa mibe = perspire;
  • -fwa mpeyo = be cold;
  • -fwa mudokodoko = desire food at the sight of someone eating; Also: nyomenenwa, -dokelelwa
  • -fwa muula = be drenched;
  • -fwa nyota = be thirsty;
  • -fwa nzala = be hungry;
  • -fwa nsusi = gasp when near to death, unable to talk, Nitwakasika kucibbadela twakajana mudaala ufwa nsusi. = When we arrived at the hospital we found the old man gasping.
  • -fwa bunyeele, feel tingling sensation; (1-fwidwa/-fwilwa, 2-fwide, 3.-fwizya, 4.-fwida, 5.-fwidalyo, 6.-fwisya, 7.-fwaafwa.)

breathe uncomfortably, as when one is sick, Mwana wali kufwaama masiku oonse nkokuti talimvwide kabotu. The child was breathing heavily throughout the night which means she is not feeling well. (1.-fwaamwa, 2.-fwaamide, 3.-fwaamya 4.-fwaamina, 5.-fwaaminalyo, 6.-fwaamisya, 7.-fwaama-fwaama)
desire, Kufwumbwa ciindi naabona umbi musimbi naa mukaintu ulamufwaamina. Any time he saw another girl or woman he would desire her. (1.-fwaaminwa, 2.-fwaamide, 3.-fwaamizya, 8.-fwaaminana)

split open, as water, Ntale niyasotoka mumulonga kufwambaana, meenda afwaamuka. = When the crocodile quickly dived into the river, the water split open. (1.-fwaamunwa, 2.-fwaamukide 3.-fwaamuzya, 4.-fwaamukila)

suffer from lack of, Uno mwaka bantu baya kufwaba nzala. = This year people will suffer from hunger. Notuli mumunzi tatweelede kufwaba nsipa pe, tweelede kubakombelezya kabotu kuti batutondezye bapati. = When we are in a village we should not suffer from lack of soap, we ought to ask the elders to show it to us. Bakafwaba bwaawo. = They lacked relish. Mutinta coonse ciindi kusama kwakwe nkwakufwaba. = Mutinta is always poorly dressed. (1.-fwabwa, 2.-fwabide, 3.-fwabya, 4.-fwabila)
  • approach stealthily and closely, *Naakayanda kujata kayuni wakafwaba buya.* = When he wanted to catch a bird he approached close to it stealthily. Also: -swabaila, -sobelela.

hunt without seeing anything, *Ndakafwabauka musyokwe mane kubucedo.* = I hunted in the bush until dawn without seeing anything. (-fwabaukwa, 2.-fwabaukide, 3.-fwabauzya, 4.-fwabaukila, 8.-fwabaukana)
  • be destitute, *Niwakamana mulimo, wakafwabauka mane kulufwu.* = When he retired, he became destitute until death. Also: -cetaala.
  • attempt in many ways to achieve a plan, *Balafwabauka kusola kuti bajane cakulya abana babo.* = They and their children attempt in many ways to find food. *Kutegwa ndijane mali aansipa, ndifwabauka buya.* = In order to find money for soap, I have to try in many ways.
desire earnestly certain goods, *Wakali kufwabila biya kujana lubono.* = He was longing to acquire wealth. (1.-fwabilwa, 2.-fwabilide, 3.-fwabauzya, 4.-fwabilila, 8.-fwabilana)

desire, rt. -fwabila, *Chigwenya ufwabilila kukwata mwanaa Kanoma.* = Chigwenya desires to marry the daughter of Kanoma. (1.-fwabililwa, 2.-fwabilide, 3.-fwabilizya, 4.-fwabililila, 5.-fwabilililalyo, 6.-fwabilizya, 7.-fwabilila-fwabilila, 8.-fwabililana)
  • break out as a disease, rt. -fwaba, *Oyu mwana tasobani kabotu mazuba ano, nkokuti kuli bulwazi bumufwabilila.* = This child does not play well these days, perhaps there is a disease which is attacking him.

search continually, *Bamakaintu balafwabuula kuti bajane mapopwe aakuulisya.* = The women are searching to find maize for re-selling. Also: -yanduula, -fwabauka. (1.-fwabuulwa, 2.-fwabuulide, 3.-fwabuuzya, 4.-fwabuulila, 5.-fwabuulilalyo, 6.-fwabuulisya 7.-fwabuula-fwabuula, 8.-fwabuulana.)

strike with fist, *Joni waka-mufwainda ankumo mweenzinyina.* = John struck his friend on the forehead. (as noun, *Ndakamuuma fwaindi yomwe wakawa ansi.* = I gave him one blow and he fell down.) *Ndamufwainda kafwaindila maanu.* = I struck him a little blow as if in jest, but it was meant to hurt him. (idiomatic) (1.-fwaindwa, 2.-fwaindide, 3.-fwaindya, 4.-fwaindila, 5.-fwaindilalyo, 6.-fwaindisya, 7.-fwainda-fwainda, 8.-fwaindana)

plane as wood, pare as a pensil, *Misamu mibotu kufwala minsi njeeyi: mwaani naa mupani, mugooni, muleya-mbezyo, musekese, mufwundabaalu naa mutwa-maila.* = Good trees for making pestles are: mwaani or mupani, mugooni, musekese, mugooni, muleya-mbezyo, mufwundabaalu or mutwa-maila. *Amukufwala miini yatweembe misamu njobavwula kufwala njeeyi: musekese, mugooni, mukamba, mutobo, mumbankoli a mufwundabaalu.* = And for making the handles of axes, the trees they are fond of using are: musekese, mugooni, mukamba, mutobo, mumbankoli and mufwundabaalu. (1.-fwalwa, 2.-fwalide, 3.-fwazya, 4.-fwalila, 5.-fwalilalyo, 6.-fwalisya, 7.-fwala-fwala. 8.-fwalana.) Also: -beza.
  • sharpen, as teeth, *Kaindi Bama-Lubale bakalicizyi kufwala menyo.* = Long ago the Baluvale people knew the art of filing teeth. Also: -beza, -kampula
  • tease, as cotton. Also: -yabununa
rasp, plane, *Kofwala-fwala cuuno eci, njanda kucuula.* = Hurry up carving this stool, I want to buy it.

scratch one another, Bakaile kwaampana tubayi akufwalana mala. They were just patting one another and playfully scratching one another (1.-fwalwa, 2.-fwalide, 3.-fwazya, 4.-fwalila, 5.-fwalilalyo, 6.-fwalisya, 7.-fwala-fwala, 8. -fwalana)

cut into slices, Kamwaafwalula magwili aayo. Cut up those potatoes into slices. (1.-fwalulwa, 2.-fwalulide, 3.-fwalulisya, 4.-fwalulwida, 5.-fwalulwidalyo, 6.-fwalulisya, 7.-fwalulafwalula, 8.-fwalulana)
  • cultivate, Mudaala wakafwalula kaunda kasyoonto biyo kuti ajane cakulya. = The old man cultivated a small piece of land so that he would get maize to eat.

grasp, understand, Cheelo ulafwama kabotu kuli coonse ncayiisigwa. = Cheelo grasps well whatever he has learnt. Also: -mvwa (1.-fwamwa, 2.-fwamide, 3.-fwamya, 4.-fwamina, 5. -fwaminalyo, 6.-fwamisya, 7.-fwama-fwama, 8.-fwamana)
dispute, protest, Wakafwama-fwama kuti nguwabba. = He protested that he had not stolen. Also: -ziza-ziza, -kazya-kazya.
hurry, Kofwamba kuboola kuti watumwa. = Come quickly if you are sent. (2.-fwambide, 3.-fwambya, 4.-fwambila, 5.-fwambilalyo, 6.-fwambisya, 7.-fwamba-fwamba.)

hurry, Fwambaana Munsanje, kweenda tulye. Hurry up Munsanje, come so that we eat. (1.-fwambaanwa, 2.-fwambaanide, 3.-fwambaanya, 4.-fwambaanina, 5.-fwambaaninalyo, 6.-fwambaanisya, 7.-fwambaana-fwambaana.)
attempt to seize, Wakasoleka kufwampanya zintu zyamufwu pele cakaala. = He attempted to seize the property of the deceased for himself, Also: - vwampila, but he failed.
(2.-fwampanyide)

flap, Muzovwu ulafwampauka matwi nayenda. The elephant flaps its ears as it walks. Sikwaze ulafwampauka mababa nauluka. = The eagle flaps its wings when it is flying. (1.-fwampaukwa, 2.-fwampaukide, 3.-fwampauzya, 4.-fwampaukila, 5.-fwampaukilalyo, 6.-fwampaukisya, 8.-fwampaukana) Also: -vwupaula.

flap, as wings, Cuungwe ufwampaula biyo mababa nauluka. = A vulture flaps its wings when flying. (1.-fwampaulwa, 2.-fwampaulide, 3.-fwampaulisya, 4.-fwampaulila, 5.-fwampaulilalyo, 6.-fwampaulisya, 8.-fwampaulana.)

apply too much, Ncibi kufwampila munyo munji mucisyu nkaambo bamwi tabayandi cisyu cilula. = It is bad to put a lot of salt in the relish because some do not want salty relish. (1.-fwampilwa, 2.-fwampilide, 3.-fwampizya, 4.-fwampilila, 5.-fwampililalyo, 6.-fwampilisya, 7.-fwampila-fwampila, 8.-fwampilana)
  • throw, Wandifwampila musenga mumeso. = He threw sand in my eyes. Also: -fwankila.

draw a line on the ground, Kofwamuna mweengo mpoyanda kuti ndisimpe cisamu. = Draw a line on the ground where you want me to plant the tree. (1.-fwamunwa,2.-fwamudwe, 3.-fwamuzya, 4.-fwamwida, 5.-fwamwidalyo, 6.-fwamunisya, 7.-fwamuna-fwamuna, 8.-fwamunana.)
  • cut off thin slice, Kamufwamuna kakwa kamululwe tunywinsye mwana uuciswa ntuntumaanzi. = Would you please cut me off a thin piece of mululwe bark so that we give to the child to drink who is suffering from malaria.

do things hurriedly, cause to hurry, *Kamufwamvwaanya kubikka zintu munanda kutegwa tujale akuunka nkobatwiita.* = Quickly put these things in the house so that we close and go to where they are calling us. *Mudaala wakalibindide, wakafwamvwaanya Bina Choolwe.* = The old man was rushing, he made Bina Choolwe hurry up. (1.-*fwamvwaanyizigwa*, 2.-*fwamvweenye*, 3.-*fwamvwaanizya*, 4.- *fwamvwaanyina*, 5.-*fwamvwaanyinalyo*) Also: -*vvavwaanya*.

strip off bark string from rough bark, *Ndabasiya kabafwandulula loozi musyokwe.* = I left them stripping fibres in the bush. Also: -*fwundulula*. (1.-*fwandululwa*, 2.-*fwandulwide*, 3.-*fwanduluzya*, 4.-*fwandulwida*, 5.-*fwandulwidalyo*, 6.-*fwandululisya*, 7.-*fwandulula-fwaundulula*)
draw a picture, *Ko-fwanikizya muntu ulya.* = Make a sketch of that person. (1.-*fwanikizyigwa*, 2.-*fwanikizyide*, 4.-*fwanikizyigwa*, 8.-*fwanikizyanya*) Also: -*fwanikisya*

take something to excess, as mealie-meal or salt, *Wacifwankila munyo cisyu cakuti tacicilikkiki.* = He put so much salt in the relish that it is no longer edible. *Nkupotana buyo bongo, kayi mmabanje ngobaide kufwankila.* = The brain is just confused, it is the marijuana which they use excessively. (1.-*fwankilwa*, 2.-*fwankilidwe*, 3.-*fwankizya*, 4.-*fwankilila*, 5.-*fwankililalyo*, 6.-*fwankilisya*, 7.-*fwankila-fwankila*, 8.-*fwankilana*)
  • throw at, *Sulwe wakabafwankila musenga mumeso akutija.* = The hare threw sand into the eyes and ran away. Also: -*fwampila*.
*Nciinga Bulanda ciide kufwankula mabanje akutila manongo.* =

fall as fine rain, *Twakasika mvwula niyakatalika kufwanta-fwanta.* = We arrived when the rain was falling finely. 1.-*fwantwa-fwantwa*, 2.-*fwantide-fwantide*, 3.-*fwantya-fwantya*, 4.-*fwantila-fwantila*.) Also: -*sunkumuka*, -*sunsumuna*.

develop a severe rash on the body, *Mwana wafwantuka cifwumu mubili oonse.* = The child has developed measles all over his body. Also: -*fwanyuka*, -*fwayuka*. (1.-*fwantukwa*, 2.-*fwantukide*, 3.-*fwantuzya*, 4.-*fwantukila*, 5.-*fwantukilalyo*, 6.-*fwantukisya* 7.-*fwantuka-fwantuka*)
  • germinate in great numbers, *Cafwantuka cisyu cangu mumbewu* = The vegetable seeds have germinated in abundance in my garden. *Mapopwe akali kunga amena cifwantukila limwi myuunda yoonse fwantu!* Also: -*fwanyuka*

draw out fibre from bark, *Kofwanununa loozi.* = Extract the fibre from the bark. Also: -*fwundulula*, -*fwandulula* (1.-*fwanununwa*, 2.-*fwanunwide*, 3.-*fwanunuzya*, 4.-*fwanunwida*, 5.-*fwanunwidalyo*, 6.-*fwanununusya*)
  • split into small pieces, *Fwanununa nkuni eezi tujisye.* = Split these pieces of firewood so that we get fuel for cooking. Also: -*papaula*
  • scratch out a line, make a crease, *Wakandifwanununa mala akwe kumeso.* = She scratched a line on my face with her nails. Also: -*kwambaula*.

become visible, as a disease, *Mwanaangu wakafwanyuka bukotokoto amubili.* = Rashes appeared on my child's body. Also: -*fwayuka* (1.-*fwanyukwa*, 2.-*fwanyukide*, 3.-*fwanyuzya*, 4.-*fwanyukila*, 5.-*fwanyukilalyo*, 6.-*fwanyukisya*)
  • appear or germinate as a plant, Nsangu nzindakasyanga izoona tazina*fwanyuka*. = The seeds which I planted the day before yesterday have not yet germinated. Also: -fwantuka, -fwayuka.

open as an ox, Nibakamana kwiifwunda *nombe*, *bakaifwanzaula* = They opened the ox after skinning it. Also: -azaula. (1.-*fwanzaulwa*, 2.-*fwanzawide*, 3.-*fwanzauzya*, 4.-*fwanzaulila*, 5.-*fwanzaulilalyo*, 6.-*fwanzaulisya*, 8.-*fwanzaulana*)

burst open, *Iji lyafwa-* *nzuka nilyaloka ansi*. = The egg burst when it fell to the ground. (2.-*fwanzukide*, 3.-*fwanzuzya*, 4.-*fwanzukila*, 5.-*fwanzukilalyo*, 6.-*fwanzukisya*) Also: -*fwunzuka*.
hasten to complete work, *Kamufwanzya kulima, nyika niicili* *ntete*. = Be quick in plouging while the earth is still wet. Also: -fwambaana, -binda (1.-*fwanzyaanizigwa*, 2.-*fwanyeenya*)
cause to quicken, *Kamufwanzyaanya kujika tuunke kudilwe*. = Cook quickly so that we go to the funeral. (1.-*fwanyaanyizigwa*, 2.-*fwanzyeenya*)

be split, *Cisamu caka-* *fwapauka naakaciyasa akeembe*. = The wood split when he axed it. *Musamu* *wakafwapauka nowakaandwa mvwula*. = The tree was split when it was struck by lightning. (1.-*fwapaukwa*, 2.-*fwapaukide*, 3.-*fwapauzya*, 4.-*fwapaukila*, 5.-*fwapaukilalyo*, 6.*fwapaukisya* 7.-*fwapauka-fwapauka*, 8.-*fwapaukana*)

chip, pare to a point, *Koleta mbezo, ndiyanda kufwapaula mwii-* *ni wakeembe*. = Bring the adze, I want to chip the handle of the axe. (1.-*fwapaulwa*, 2.-*fwapaulide*, 3.-*fwapaulizya*, 4.-*fwapaulwida*, 5.-*fwapaulwidalyo*, 6.-*fwapaulisya*, 7.-*fwapaula-fwapaula*, 8.-*fwapaulana*)

shoot upwards, gush, *Sikalumamba wakafwapula ntobolo yakwe* *kukonga babbi*. = The soldier shot his gun into the air to frighten the thieves. *Notwa-* *kali kulima, cisamu cakandifwapula amwi-* *indi*. = When we were ploughing, the stick sprang up and caught me on my shin. (1.-*fwapulwa*, 2.-*fwapulide*, 3.-*fwapuzya*, 4.-*fwapwida*, 5.-*fwapwidalyo*, 6.-*fwapulisya*, 8.-*fwapulana*)
  • cut in small pieces, *Kamufwapula* *nkuni tusikke*. = Cut up the firewood into small pieces so that we stick them in the fire. *Kamufwapula makowa ayo*. = Cut those cucumbers into slices.
be overcrowded, *Ino baa-* *ma kuti mizeezo wakufwasila inga otyani*? = Now mother, if thoughts are flooding your mind what can you do? Also: -vwulila
explode, burst, *Naakali* *kuccovwa ncinga yakwe, yakafwasuka* *vwili lyamunsi*. = When he was cycling the rear tyre burst. Also: -bboloka. (2.-*fwasukide*, 3.-*fwasuzya*, 4.-*fwasukila*)

overflow, spill out, rt. -*fwa-* *suka*, *Meenda naalikubila afwasukila* *ansi*. = When the water was boiling it overflowed onto the ground. *Sicibende* *naakalitambula buyo bbwatu, lyakafwa-* *sukila ansi*. = When Sicibende received the sweet-beer, it spilled out onto the ground. (5.-*fwasukilalyo*)

make loose, unblock, *Kofwasununa citolopu camudina musune*. = Release the strap, the ox is choking. Also: -fwefwenuna, -tebununa, -fwevwenuna, -tebezya, -kobya-kobya. (1.-*fwasununwa*, 2.-*fwasunwide*, 3.-*fwasunuzya*, 4.-*fwasunwida*, 8.-*fwasununana*)
strike with the fist Also: -bbonta

develop a rash, *Mweemba wafwayuka 'kabbokesi' mubili* oonse. = Mweemba has developed chicken-pox over the whole body. (1.-fwayukwa, 2.-fwayukide, 3.-fwayusya, 4.-fwayukila, 5.-fwayukilalyo, 6.-fwayukisya)
  • germinate, Lusyanga Iwafwayuka mumapopwe. = Weed has germinated among the maize. Also: -fwantuka.

smoke, Bamwi bana bamazubaano balaciyanda kufweba lubanje. = Nowadays some children still like to smoke dagga. Nomufweba ndalomba kuti mucileke nkaambo tacimugwasyi pe. = I ask you who smoke to stop because it does not help you at all. Ooyu munene taakali muntu ufweba cifwebe-fwebe pe. = This old man was not one who smoked often. (1.-fwebwa, 2.-fwebede, 3.-fwebya, 4.-fwebela, 5.-fwebelalyo, 6.-fwebesya, 7.-fweba-fweba, 8.-fwebelana)
  • snuff, Bacembele balikufweba tombwe wamumpemo. = The old women are snuffing. Also: - fwinkila
  • suck through a reed, Mudaala wakali kufweba buci munongo ivwukkidwe mamvwu. = The old man was sucking honey from a pot which was covered with clay.

suck through, Nindali kunywa meenda ndali kufwebela mulutete. = When I was drinking water I was sucking it through a reed. (1.fwebelwa, 2.-fwebeledwe, 3.-fwebya, 4.-fwebela, 5.-fwebelalyo, 6.-fwebesya, 7.-fweba-fweba, 8.-fwebelana)
charm the affections by smoking a certain mixture, smoke for, Kaindi basankwa bakali kufwebelela basimbi kutegwa babayande. = Long ago the men were smoking charms to attract women.
smoke traditional charms for one another, Bamwi bantu luyando lwabo ndwakufwebelelana. = Some people's love is a matter of smoking charms for one another.

give a little tobacco, Ooyu ndime emufwebya abuzuba. = It is I who give this one some tobacco to smoke daily. Also: -fwezya.
  • make one smoke, Naluntaambwe wafwa bana nobamufwebya tombwe. = The chameleon died when the children made him smoke tobacco.
cut up, chew, Suntwe mupati uyandisya kulya nyama yakabola, yafwefwema utolela bana bakwe. = An adult hyena likes to eat rotten meat, when it is chewed she takes it to her young.

loosen, Sena wamufwefwenuna citolopo musune? = Have you loosened the strap around (the neck of) the ox? Also: -fwezununa, -fwasununa. (1.-fwefwenunwa, 2.-fwefwenwide, 3.-fwefwenuzya, 4.-fwefwenwida, 5.-fwefwenwidalyo, 8.-fwefwenunana)

continually excrete as a new born infant, Kuti mwana muvwanda kafwekaula, banyina balakkomana. If an infant excretes continually, the mother is happy. (1.-fwekaulwa, 2.-fwekaulide, 3.-fwekauzya, 4.-fwekaulila, 5.-fwekawidalyo, 6.-fwekaulisya 7.-fwekaula-fwekaula)
  • upset one's stomach, Cibwantu cisaside ncicandifwekaula mwida. = The sour beer is what has upset my stomach.

pant, Mubwa naamana kutanda sulwe, wapiluka kafwekemba. = After the dog had chased the hare, it returned panting. Babwa bakali kufwekemba muzimvwule. The dogs were panting in shady places. Ooyu munene wakayoowa cakuti naakabuzigwa kuti wabaa nzi kunyina naakaingula, wakali kwiile kufwekemba. This old man feared to the extent that when he was asked as to what was wrong with him, he was not able to reply, he was just panting. _Bakatalika kufwekemba kulila._ = They began to sigh as they cried. Also: -fweta, -fwooteka. 1.-fwekembwa, 2.-fwekembede, 3.-fwekembya, 4.-fwekembela, 5.-fwekembelalyo, 6.-fwekembesya, 7.-fwekemba-fwekemba)

poke coals as in fire, e.g _Kofwekemuna itwe kutegwa mulilo uyake._ = Poke out the ashes so that the fire lights up. (1.-fwekemunwa, 2.-fwekemwide, 3. -fwekemuzya, 4. -fwekemwida, 5.-fwekemwidalyo, 6.-fwekemunisya.) Also: -tokolola, -yokolola, -fwekulas, -fwukuma.

expand, Kuti mukaintu wamita, da lyakwe lilafwekula. = When a woman is pregnant her stomach expands. (1.-fwekulwa, 2.-fwekwide)
  • poke out, _Kofwekula itwe lipya zibizwe ndongwe._ = Poke out the hot ash so that the groundnuts are roasted. Also: -fwekemuna.
be expanded, Niyakasika mezi yosanwe, ida. lyakwe lyakatalika kufwekuka. When the fifth month arrived, her womb began to expand.
fail an exam, (ety. Eng.) Sena uyeeya kuti _twafweela ncobeni biya._ = Do you think that we really failed? (1.-fweelwa, 2.-fweelede, 3.-fweezya, 4.-fweelela, 5.-fweelelalyo, 6.-fweelesya)

feel a quivering sensation in the stomach, Ndakamvwa bunyeele, amwida kufwelauka ndeke niyakali kunyamuka kuya mujulu. = I felt a tingling sensation and quivering in the stomach when the plane took off into the air. Bakateelela mwida mwafwelauka amitwe yazinguluka. They felt their stomachs quivering and there heads dizzy. Also: -fweluka (2.-fwelaukide, 3.-fwelauzya, 4.-fwelaukila)
disappear, slip away, _Inzoka niyakazwa munanda yakafwelemuka akunjila mubwizu._ = When the snake came out of the house, it disappeared going into the grass. Also: - welemuka.
whistle as a reedbuck Also: -fwooteka

receive initial marriage gifts (relatives of bride, through their representatives, receive presents of money or goods from parents of bridegroom when bride is taken to the bridegroom), Akati kabantu aaba basikufwenenzya, kuli bantu bobilo bazyibidwe kapati kwiinda baabo bana-munji. Umwi utegwa nguudwanama amulyango ulangide munanda akukasya bantu kwiinda amulyango; uwabili utegwa nguuzima mulilo, mbwaasika nkufwukuma mulilo aawo mpobajikila. Ucita kuti batiisosele walo nkusokoma mucikko limwi baakuzingwa buya bajika. Kufwumbwa buyo kuti babapa eezi zyeelede kupegwa ndilyona inga beenda. = Among these people involved in the marriage security, there are two people who are recognized to be more important than the others. One is called 'the one who guards the doorway and looks into the house preventing people from passing beyond the entrance'; the second is the 'one who douses the fire, as soon as he arrives he pokes out the fire there where they are cooking'. When they try to make the fire grow he continues to poke out the fire at the fire-place until the cooks become fed up. If it happens that they are given what they want, they will go. Also: -fwenezya. (1.-fwenezyegwa, 2.-fwenezyezya, 4.-fwenzyezya, 8.-fwenenzyanya)

be dissolved in water or ashes or smoke, Ibbwe ndindakabikka mumeenda jilo, lyafwengauka. = The stone which I put in water yesterday has been dissolved. Bbwe Iyameenda Iyaka fwengauka nilyakabikkwa azuba. = An iceblock dissolved when it was put in the sun. (2.-fwengaukide, 3.-fwengauzya, 4.-fwengaukila, 5.-fwengaukilalyo) Also: -seemuka

dissolve or resolve into particles or vapour, disintegrate, Kamufwengaula bbwe lyameenda kwiinda mukulibikka azuba. Melt the block of ice by placing it in the sun. (1.-fwengaulwa, 2.-fwengaulide, 3.-fwengauzya, 4.-fwengaulila, 5.-fwengaulisya) Also: -yaaya, -enzemuna.
  • break up, Ijamba lyakabufwengaula bulimo. = The plough broke up the soil. Also: -fwenkaula.

break up, as clods of earth, Nitwakali kulima jamba lyangu yakabufwenkaula bulimo nkaambo basune bakalaa nguzu. = When we were ploughing my plough broke up the earth because my oxen were powerful. Also: -fwengaula. (1.-fwenkaulwa, 2.-fwenkawide, 3.-fwenkauzya, 4.-fwenkawida, 5.-fwenkaulisya)

take much to excess, Mwafwenkula cipaanzi cipati kwiinda boonse. You have taken the biggest share. Mukaintu mubaya wakafwenkula munyo munji akufwankila mucisyu, calo calula. = A careless woman took a large amount of salt and added it to the relish, hence it became too salty. Also: -fwonkola. (1.-fwenkulwa, 2.-fwenkwide, 3.-fwenkuzya, 4.-fwenkulila/-fwenkwida, 6.-fwenkulisya)
mark a line, Kamufwenununa kankwenene aawa kalibonye. = Mark a clear line so that this place can be seen. (1.-fwenununwa, 2.-fwenunwide, 3.-fwenunuzya, 4.-fwenunwida, 6.-fwenununisya) Also: -enga.

speak softly, Wakatalika kukanana musimbi cakufwenya-fwenya mbuli kuti kuli mbatayandi kuti bamvwe alimwi kaluwide kutegwa meso ataswaani aabasilisi. The girl began to speak softly as if she did not want everybody to hear and again turning her head aside so that she would not have eye-contact with the doctor. (1.-fwenyegwa-fwenyegwa, 2.-fwenyedefwenyede, 4.-fwenyena-fwenyena)
vanish in grass, Munyama wakaile kufwenyunyuka kutegwa atabonwi. = The animal just disappeared so that it could not be seen. Also: -fwelemuka. (2.-fwenyunyukide, 4.-fwenyunyukila)

draw as breath, Wakali kufwepa kutondezya kuti tafwide. = He drew his breath showing that he was not dead. (1.-fwepwa, 2.-fwepede, 3.-fwepya, 4.-fwepela, 5. -fwepelalyo, 6.-fwepesya, 7.-fwepa-fwepa) Also: -yoya.
  • smoke, Nomufwepa ndalomba kuti mucileke nkaambo tacimugwasyi. = Smokers, I request you to stop smoking because it does not help you. Also: -fweba

progress speedily, Mapopwe aaya alafwesa kukomena. = This maize is growing rapidly. Naakamvwa kuti mulumi wakwe wafwa, wakali kufwesa kuya kucibbadela. = When she heard that her husband had died, she hurried to the hospital. (1.-fweswa, 2.-fwesede, 3.-fwesya, 4.-fwesela, 5.-fwe-selalyo, 6.-fwesesya, 7.-fwesa-fwesa)
  • be in a panic, pant in fear, Wazya wiile kufwesa kulunduka akaambo kasyuumbwa ngwaabona musyokwe. = He came running in a panic because of the lion he saw in the bush. Naakamana kulota boobu Mutinta wakasinsimuka wacaazya kufwesa mbuli muntu walikutijaana. After Mutinta dreamt in this way she awoke and remained panting like a person who had been running.
travel at high speed, Uulya muntu ulifwesede kweenda. = That person is travelling quickly.
pant, as dog, or person after exertion, Mubwa ulafweta naamana kutanda sulwe. = The dog pants after having chased the hare. (2.-fwetede, 3.-fwetya, 4.-fwetela, 6.-fwetesya) Also: -fwekemba.
pant, rt.-fweta, Bakapiluka kumunzi kabazya bufwetaila akaambo kakukatala. = They returned to the village panting as they came because of tiredness.
gasp, Ooyu mwana ulafwetuka calufwu. = This child is gasping in his last breath. (2.-fwetukide, 3.-fwetusya, 4.-fwetukila)

loosen, Bataata bakafwambaana kufwevwenuna citolopo musune naakasinwa. = My father quickly released the strap when the ox was choking. Also: -fwefwenuna, -fwasununa. (1.-fwevwenuna, 2.-fwevwenwide, 3.-fwevwenuzya, 4.-fwevwenukila, 8.-fwevwenunana.)

loosen, Naakayaangisya nombe bausyi bakafwambaana kwii-fwezununa. = When he tied the oxen tightly his father came to loosen it. (1.-fwezununwa, 2.-fwezunwide, 3.-fwezunuzya, 4.-fwezunwida, 8.-fwezununana) Also: -fwevwenuna.
share tobacco, Kamundifwezya tombwe omunene. = Old man, share some tobacco with me. (1.-fwezyegwa, 2.-fwezyezye, 3.-fwenzya, 4.-fwezyezya, 8.-fwezyanya) Also: -fwebya.
share tobacco with one another, Ndakajana bamadaala bafwezyanya tombwe ijilo. = I found the old men sharing tobacco yesterday.

die for, rt. -fwa, Jesu wakatufwida. = Jesus died for us. (1.-fwidwa, 2.-fwide, 5.-fwidalyo)
  • die to the detriment or misfortune of another, Wakamufwida mwana munzila kamutola kucibbadela. = The child died on the way as she was taking her to the hospital.
  • show pity, Tweelede kubafwida lubomba bantu baciswa bulwazi bwasikalileke. = We ought to show compassion to those who are suffering from AIDS.

die without hope of survival, Uulya wakafwidilila tacikajoki kabili. = That one has really died and will not come back to life.
  • reduce to complete silence, Ndakali kuyanda kwaambaula pesi ndakafwidilila nkaambo babetesi bakandikasya. = I wanted to speak but I remained silent because the magistrate stopped me. Nibakandikasya kukanana munkuta, ndakaile kufwidilila mumoyo wangu. = When they refused me to speak in court, I remained silent.

breathing through the mouth with closed nose, Naakacili kufwiima koona mwana, walo Mutinta nkulya. = When the child was breathing through the mouth while sleeping, Mutinta was eating. Munene kuyoya koonse wakali kwiide kufwiima mbuli kuti wali kutanta kalundu. = All the breathing of the old man was like panting as if he was climbing a hill. (1.-fwiimwa, 2.-fwiimide, 3.-fwiimya, 4.-fwiimina, 6.-fwiimisya)

be short, Kufwiimpa uli mbuli banasimpiningile. = You are as short as the bushmen. Nitwali kubandika twajana kuti ciindi cafwiimpa nkaambo musalo wali kunoneezya. = When we were talking we found that the time was short because the conversation was nice. (2.-fwiimpide, 3.-fwiinsya, 4.-fwiimpila, 5.-fwiimpilalyo, 6.-fwiimpisya)
abbreviate, *Kofwiimpya*
Shorten your report, my friend. Also: *-fwiinsya, -kosoola.*

make short, *Twakakafwiinsya kasamu kutegwa milongo iceyeceye.* We shortened the stick so that the lines would be lessened. *Waufwiinsya musinzo munenema, twalumba.* = You have shortened the distance my old friend, we thank you. *Ulacibona cakafwiinsya nondo maulu.* You will see what shortened the legs of the tortoise. (i.e. You will pay for your crime.)
  • make oneself humble, *Ncibotu kulifwiinsya kuti wasangana mubapati.* = It is good to behave humbly if you are mixing with the elders. Also: *kulibonzya.*
sob, *Nobabamba cakulya misozi ileenda, wakafwikima kulila caansaansi.* = When she was preparing the food the tears were flowing, she was sobbing quietly.

go fast and straight, *Kalembe kazwa mubuta kalafwilimuka kuya mumunyama.* An arrow from the bow goes out at a very high speed straight into the animal. (2.-fwilimukide, 3.-fwilimusya, 4.-fwilimukila, 6.-fwilimukisya)
draw near, *Kakufwimpa nkobede kutegwa umvwe ncaamba.* = Shorten the distance where you are so that you catch what he is saying. Also: *fwiimpa.* (1.-fwimpwa, 2.-fwimpide, 3.-fwimpya)
ooze, *Meenda alafwininika mucikala.* = The water is oozing into the well. Also: *-mimita, -zinza* (2.-fwininikide, 3.-fwininizya, 4.-fwininikila, 6.-fwininikisya)

sniffle, sigh, *Kofwinkila mamina ayo mwana.* Sniff up that mucous from your nose child. Zimwi zyana wakali kumvwa ziti, "Ndaumuna kale, ndaumuna kale," kumwi nkufwinkila, misozi iti mbulu-mbulu-mbulu. You would hear some poor children saying, "I am quiet, I am quiet," while sobbing, the tears rolling down. (1.-fwinkilwa, 2.-fwinkilide, 3.-fwinkizya, 4.-fwinkilila, 5.-fwinkililalyo, 6.-fwinkilisya)
  • sniff as snuff Also: *-sipa, -fweba*

close the eyes voluntarily, *Kamufwinya kutegwa mutatoogwi mamvwu.* Close your eyes so that you are not blinded by the dust. *Mwiingile wakafwinya meso mukunyeela insyu.* = The warthog closed its eyes as it chewed the grass. (insyu = insyuto, = bulbs of grass) (2.-fwinyide, 3.-fwinyizya, 6.-fwinyisya, 7.-fwinya-fwinya, 8. -fwinyana.)
  • bundle up as a body, *Cheelo ulalifwinya naona abulo.* Cheelo bundles up his body when he is sleeping. Also: *-gonya*
  • fasten noose, *Kofwinya lukole tuce koombe.* Fasten the noose of the rope so that we catch the calf.
contract nose and eyes, wink, *Kamufwinya-fwinya kulanga inga kamuya kunjilwa tuuka mumeso.* Blink your eyes otherwise small insects will get into them.

. wrinkle, *Cisani tiicasumwa kabotu, cafwinyana.* = The cloth is not sewn properly, it has wrinkled. *Cisani caligwa ngulube, cafwinyana-fwinyana.* = The dress which has been eaten by a pig is all wrinkled up. Also: *-vwungana, -kokonyana, -onyana.*

focus the eyes, *Twakalikufwinyikizya biya meso kutegwa tubone cakali mukati.* We were just focusing our eyes with difficulty so that we could see what was inside. Also: *-dinikizya, -mwinikizya.* (1.-fwinyikizyigwa, 2.-fwinyikizyide, 4.-fwinyikizyizya, 8.-fwinyinana)

signal with eyes, *Wamufwinyina mwana kutegwa ataambi camasimpe.* = She signaled with her eyes to the child not to tell the truth. *Wakandi-fwinyina kutegwa nditavwuwi kufwambaana.* = He winked at me (in warning) so that I would not answer quickly. (1.-fwinyinwa, 2.-fwinyinide)
  • despise by facial expression, *Ndamuuma nkaambo walikundifwinyina.* = I beat him because he made a face at me.

wave away with, as flies, wag the tail, *Kamufwisaula cisani kutegwa nzinini zitakkali ali cakulya.* = Drive off the flies with a cloth so that they do not light where there is food. *Inombe nozicela zilafwisaula micila.* = When cattle graze they shake their tails. Also: -besaula, -kwisaula,-vwupaula, -vwupuula. (1.-fwisaulwa, 2.-fwisaulide, 3.-fwisauzya, 4.-fwisawida, 6.-fwisaulisya, 8.-fwisaulana.)
tie a slip-knot Also: -kwibika, fwizika.

shoot upwards, *Moyo wangu wafwisuka nindabona nzoka iilya mpati.* = My heart suddenly leaped when I saw that big snake. *Muce wangu naatukila bausyi, moyo wangu wafwisuka aboobo ndamuuma cabukali.* = When my young brother spoke so insolently to his father, my heart leaped and I beat him in anger. (2.-fwisukide, 3.-fwisuzya, 4.-fwisukila, 6.-fwisukisya)
  • recoil as a noose, *Kooye nika-fwisuka, kaca namusya.* = When the snare recoiled, it caught a duiker.
  • be short-tempered, *Moyo wa Mutinta ulafwisuka lyoonse.* = Mutinta's heart is ever quick to anger. Also: -nyetauka.

swish tail, *Musune wangu ulafwisula mucila kutanda nziniini.* = My ox is swishing it's tail to drive off the flies. Also: -fwisaula, -kwisula.
  • pull out, as fish with hook, *Calikunonezya kufwisula tutaka nitwali kuloba.* = It was nice to pull out the small fish when we were fishing.
  • reveal a matter, *Umwi musankwa wakafwisula kaambo, wapozomoka kupandulula makani aakabandikwa abapati kumangolezya.* = One boy revealed the matter, he loudly explained the matter which the leaders had been talking about in the evening.
use to swat, *Mucila wasyaanza ngwenjakulifwisula nzinini.* = I will swat the flies with the tail of a lion.
pretend to be dead, rt. -fwa, *Kolifwisya-fwisya kutegwa bayoowe batakakuumi kabili.* = Pretend to be dead so that they will fear and will not beat you again.
tie a slip-knot, *Kokafwizika kooye aako kumpela ooko.* = Tie a slip knot further on. (1.-fwizikwa, 2.-fwizikide, 3.-fwizikizya, 4.-fwizikila, 8.-fwizikilana)
loosen a knot, *Kokafwizulula kutegwa waangile aambi.* = Loosen it so that you tie a knot at another place. (1.-fwizululwa, 2.-fwizulwide, 3.-fwizuluzya, 4.-fwizululila, 8.-fwizululilana)

loosen, *Kukafwizununa kooye cilagwasya nkaambo kalaidina mpongo.* = To loosen the rope is helpful otherwise it can choke the goat. (1.-fwizununwa, 2.-fwizunwide, 3.-fwizunuzya, 4.-fwizununina, 8.-fwizununana) Also: -fwevwenuna.

remove a stopper from a bottle, *Wakafwogola cisinsyo cabbodela kutegwa amupe bukoko buli mukati.* = He removed the stopper of the bottle so that he could give him the beer inside. (1.-fwogolwa, 2.-fwogwede, 3.-fwogozya, 4.-fwogweda, 5.-fwogwedalyo, 6.-fwogolesya) Also: -sinkula.

put off, cancel, *Lweendo Iwakwe Iwakuya kukunywa Iwafwo-* *kela.* = His journey to go and drink has been put off.
  • unable to bear children, *O mu-cembele, wakafwokela kale.* = O old woman, you are no longer able to bear children.

take a large share, *Musimbi wakafwonkola buya kubuula ndongwe.* = The girl took a large share of groundnuts to shell. Also: *-fwenkula.* (1.-fwonkolwa, 2.-fwonkwede, 3.-fwonkozya, 4.-fwonkweda, 5.-fwonkwedalyo, 6.-fwokolesya)
cause to march or parade, *Ooyu mwiiyi ulicizyi kufwoola basicikolo.* = This teacher knows how to parade the pupils. (1.-fwoolwa, 2.-fwoolede, 3.-fwoozya, 4.-fwoolela, 6.-fwoolesya, 8.-fwoolana)
cause to march, rt. *-fwoola,* *Mupati wabasilumamba wakabafwoolede kale basilumamba naakadubulwa ntobolo.* = The commander had already marched the troops when he was shot.
march as soldiers, *Basicikolo balafwoolwa.* = The pupils are marching.

pant, gasp, hiss as snake, *Ndakafwooma kapati nindakali kutanta mulundu wa Nacisekwe.* = I panted heavily when I was climbing Nacisekwe hill. Wakaide kuwa muzinga ansi. Notwakaunka kumugwasya, wakaiide kufwooma. = He fell heavily to the ground. When we went to help him he was just gasping. (2.-fwoomede, 3.-fwoomya, 4.-fwoomena, 6.-fwoomesya, 8.-fwoomana.)
hiss, rt. *-fwooma,* *Nindakainda a mulyango wananda, nzoka yakalifwoomede kale.* = When I passed by the door of the house, a snake had already started hissing.
hiss, *Mwana wayoowa niyamufwoomena nzoka.* = The child was frightened when the snake hissed at him. Also: *-ccemena.*
take a handful, *Kamufwoonkola nyemu nkaambo nzinji* = Take a handful because there are plenty. (1.-fwoonkolwa, 2.-fwoonkwede, 3.-fwoonkozya, 4.-fwoonkweda, 6.-fwoonkolesya)
rustle, hiss, *Inzoka ilafwoota mubwizu.* = The snake rustles in the grass. Also: *-sokonya.* (2.-fwootede, 6.-fwootesya)

gasp, pant in fear, whistle as a reedbuck, *Wakafwooteka naakatandwa mulala.* = He panted in fear when he was chased by a black mamba. Also: *-fwekemba.* (2.-fwootekede)
  • die from extreme exertion, *Wakafwooteka kufwa.* = He died of extreme exhaustion.

photograph, (ety. Eng.), *Baya badaala balafwotola.* = That old man is taking a photograph. (1.-fwotolwa, 2.-fwotwede, 3.-fwotozya, 4.-fwotweda, 8.-fwotolana)
  • act foolishly when bewitched, *Ooyu mwana talilemeki, micito yakwe njamuntu wakafwotolwa.* = This child does not respect himself/herself, s/he does things like a person who is bewitched.

be spoilt, uncooked or raw, *Cafwuba cisyu, tiicabizwa nkaambo mulilo waceya.* = The relish is spoilt, it is uncooked because the fire wasn't hot enough. (1.-fwubizyigwa, 2.-fwubide, 3.-fwubya, 4.-fwubila, 6.-fwubisya.)
  • be choked as by weeds, *Mapopwe akafwuba nkaambo taakaliminwa.* = The maize was choked because it was not weeded. Also: -dobela, -omfwokelwa.

act foolishly, *Moonde naakali kubetekwa wakali kukazya, pesi naakasika kamboni wakazoofwubaala.* = When Moonde was being tried he was denying (his guilt), but when a witness appeared he became foolish. (1.-fwubaazyigwa, 2.-fwubeede, 3.-fwubaazya, 4.-fwubaalila, 5.-fwubaalilalyo, 6.-fwubaalisya, 7.-fwubaala-fwubaala, 8.-fwubaazyanya.)
fool, Bakamufwubaazya mweenzinyina limwi wanyema. = They kept fooling their friend until he became angry. Also: -bbokezya, -bbookezya.

treat as a fool, Bakamufwubaazika naakacita cintu ncaatakeelede kucita. = They treated him as a fool when he did something which he ought not to have done.
  • play the fool, Koleka kulifwubaazika akati kabeenzinyoko. = Stop making a fool of yourself among your friends. Also: -fwubaazya.

pop, as a cork from a wine bottle, come off, Nibali kusola kujula idolomu lyabukoko, civwunisyo cadolomu cafwubbuka. = When they were trying to open the drum of beer, the lid popped out. Lwafwubbuka Iwala ciindi naalinontola. The toe nail came off when he tripped. (1.-fwubbulwa, 2.-fwubbukide, 3.-fwubbuzya, 4.-fwubbukila, 6.-fwubbukisya.)

pull the bark off, Baifwubbula cikwa nondo ciindi nibailyata basimootokala. = The motorist tore the shell off the tortoise when he ran over it. Ciwena wakalicisa kusyule akufwubbuka cikanda. The crocodile damaged itself behind and tore the skin off. (1.-fwubbulwa, 2.-fwubbulide, 3.-fwubbuzya, 4.-fwubbulila, 6.-fwubbulisya, 8.-fwubbulana)
  • lift off a mould, as in brick making, Kamufwubbula kabotu cikombole mutajayi zitina. Lift the mould off carefully so that you do not break the bricks. Also: -fwumuna.
  • hurt oneself against a stone, Walifwubbula abbwe naali kweenda. = He hurt himself against a stone when he was walking.

spoil, rt. -fwuba, Kuyobayoba kwabana kufwubya nonzi zyabamacembele. The shouting of the children spoiled the sleep of the old women. Baifwubya nkolola bantu bali kulwana. The people who were fighting spoiled the initiation ceremony. Waufwubya mulilo kautanajatilila kunkuni. He spoiled the fire before the firewood lit up. Kuwuula kwababwa kwakafwubya nonzi. = The howling of the dogs spoiled the sleep. (1.-fwubizyigwa, 2.-fwubide, 3.-fwubya, 4.-fwubila, 6.-fwubisya)

take out fermenting maize to dry, Bacembele bafwudulula mimena kutegwa iyanikwe. The old women took out the fermenting maize to dry. (1.-fwudululwa, 2.-fwudulwide, 3.-fwuduluzya, 4.-fwudulwida.)
  • clean out intestines, Bana bafwudulula mala ankuku yajaigwa. = The children are cleaning out the intestines of the chicken which was killed. Also: -fwundulula.

make one inhale fumes of medicine. Munanga wakafwufwudika mulwazi amusamu mukali. = The witchdoctor caused the patient to inhale strong medicine. Kamumufwufwudika ndiza syini lilaceya-ceya. = Make him inhale the medicine, maybe his cold will lessen. Musilisi wakamuvwumba ngubo, kafwufwudika dongo lyanyama lipya. = The healer covered him with a blanket causing him to inhale the fumes of the big pot of hot meat. Also: -fwukutila (1.-fwufwudikwa, 2.-fwufwudwidwe)
boil over as milk, ferment as beer, Kofwambaana kugusya mukupa acikko wabona kuti wafwufwuma. = Remove the milk from the fire quickly when you see it boiling over.

be feeble without energy and looking downcast, Aka kakuku ncokafwufwumana nkokuti kaciswa. = The reason why this chicken is powerless is that it is sick. *Ufwufwumana nzi mbuli kuti waciswa?* = Why are you looking so weak and downcast as if you were sick? (2.-fwufwumene, 3.-fwufwumika, 4.-fwufwumanina, 6.-fwufwumanisya.)

be laid up with sickness, rt. -fwufwumana, Ndajana kakuku kangu *kalifwufwumene* munsaa mulilo. = I found my chicken in a sick state beside the fire. (3.-fwufwumika, 4.-fwufwumanina 6.-fwufwumanisya.)

grow quickly, be stout, Bana bamwi basunu akaambo kakukkala kabotu mubuvwubi, *balafwu-fwumuka kukomena.* = Some children nowadays grow quickly because of living in prosperity. Also: -pupumuka,-fwutumuka (2.-fwufwumukide, 3.-fwufwumusya, 4.-fwufwumukila, 6.-fwufwumukisya.)
  • ferment or rise as yeast, Bukoko *bwafwufwumuka* akuvwula kapati nka-ambo bwabikkwa mimena yamapopwe aakono. = The beer has fermented and risen well because there was yeast inserted from this year's maize. (which is still wet) Also: -tutumuka.
track the scent, Babwa *bafwufwuzya* mukondo wakasulwe. = The dogs are tracking the scent of the hare. Also: -numfwida. (1.-fwufwuzyigwa, 2.-fwufwuzyide, 4.-fwufwuzyizya)

kneel before, Nobana inga kamufwugama nomupa bapati zintu kutondezya bulemu. = Children you should kneel down to show respect to the elders when you are giving them things. *Musimbi wakafwugama munkombe amu-cembele akwaamba kuti, 'Mucembele ndalilya kuli nduwe. Nduwe banene.'* = The girl knelt before the old woman saying, "Old woman, I have submitted myself to you. You are my grandmother." (1.-fwugamwa, 2.-fwugeme, 3.-fwuga-mya, 4.-fwugamina, 5. fwugaminalyo, 6.-fwugaminsya, 7.-fwugama-fwugama, 8.-fwugaminana)
  • having monthly period, Ooyu musimbi ulifwugeme, tayelede kusangana mubantu bamwi. = This girl is having her monthly period, she ought not to mix with other people.

kneel down, rt. -fwugama, Bakaintu abalo mbubona bakalijisi zyuuno pesi bana-bana abamooye baka-*fwugeme* biya kabakkede atusindi no-bakali kulya. = The women also sat in the same way, but the little children and the girls knelt, sitting on their heels when they were eating.

dig out, as monkeys do with nuts, Nkuku zyazifwuka ndongwe. = The hens have dug up the groundnuts. *Njakufwuka mayi aaciwena mumusenga.* = I will dig out the eggs of a crocodile from the sand. (1.-fwukwa, 2.-fwukide, 3.-fwukisya, 4.-fwukwida, 6.-fwukisya, 7.-fwuka-fwuka, 8.-fwukilana.)
dig out here and there, Wali kufwuka-fwuka ooku akooku mundongwe. = She was digging up the groundnuts here and there.

kneel, *Kofwukama amabwe awa.* = Kneel on these stones. (1.-fwukamwa, 2.-fwukeme, 3.-fwukamya, 4.-fwukamina, 5.-fwukamninalyo, 6.-fwukamisya, 7.-fwukama-fwukama, 8.-fwukaminana.)
  • have monthly period, Mukaintu ulaa da kunyina nafwukama. = A woman who is pregnant does not have a monthly period.

kneel on, *Kofwu-kamina acisani eci kutegwa utabiji kasuko.* = Kneel on this cloth so that you don't get dirty with the dust.
  • kneel to, worship Ncibotu ku

Leza alikke. = It is good to worship God alone.
  • put one's mind on, Webo iya-kukukola nzala nkaambo wafwukamina kunywa bukoko ciindi cakulima. = You will experience starvation because you have focused on beer-drinking at the time of ploughing. Also: *-vwukamina, -sukamina.*
rise from a kneeling position, Kamufwukamuka mula-minwa. = Rise from your knees, you will be tired. (1.-fwukamukwa, 2.-fwukamukide, 3.-fwukamuzya, 4.-fwukamukila)

cover up, Ooyu musimbi ulaciyanda *kulifwukata* ankolo amaanza obile nkaambo tayandi kubonwa nkolo. = This girl still likes covering her breasts with both hands because she does not want her breasts to be seen. Also: -fwumbata.

enfold to protect, grasp with both hands, Idada lyafwukatila bana. = The duck is protecting her ducklings under her wings. Also: -sukatila. (1.-fwukatilwa, 2.-fwukatilide, 3.-fwukatizya, 4.-fwukatilila, 6.-fwukatilisya, 8.-fwukatilana)
  • act as bodyguard, Basankwa bamwi basalwa kufwukatila muleli wacisi. = Some men are chosen to act as bodyguards to the president. Also: kwabilila.

drink or eat slowly, Ngulube yafwukaula kwaciindi cilamfwu mumuunda. = The pig has been eating in the field for a long time. Badaala bafwukaula tukoko kwa Mandevu. = The old man is sipping a little beer at Mandevu's. (1.-fwukaulwa, 2.-fwukawide, 3.-fwukauzya, 4.-fwukaulila, 6.-fwukaulisya.)

put more soil around plant, Baama baunka kukulimina akufwukila ndongwe. = My mother has gone to weed and put more soil around the groundnut plants. (1.-fwukilwa, 2.-fwukilide, 3.-fwukizya, 4.-fwukililila, 6.-fwukilisya, 8.-fwukilana.)

be treated by inhaling fumes from steaming pot of medicine while seated under a blanket. Bulwazi nibwakalema, bakasoleka micelo yakufweba ayakufwukizigwa. = When the illness worsened, they tried medicines for smoking and for inhaling. Also: -umpizigwa (2.-fwukizidwe, 3.-fwukizizya, 4.-fwukizigilwa)

doze, Koleka kufwukula tokwe kumvwa caambwa. = Stop dozing, you will not hear what is being said. Bunji bwabana bakali kufwukula Syaakasonda-nsima naakali kukanana. = Many of the children were dozing when Syaakasonda-nsima was talking. Musankwa wakatalika kufwukula limwi yaa, mfwoomfwoo woonena limwi. = The boy began to doze until finally he fell asleep. (1.-fwukulwa, 2.-fwukwide, 3.-fwukuzya, 4.-fwukwida, 5.-fwukwi-dalyo, 6.-fwukulisya, 7.-fwukula-fwukula.) Also: -uzila, -uvwila, -gunka.
  • scratch out, uproot, as nuts from the ground with hands, Bacembele bafwukula nyemumbwiila. = The old woman is scratching the ground-peas out of the ground with her hands.
  • replenish, Sinjuka naakamanina mali, wakaunka kuŋanda kuya kufwukula mali. = When the card player had finished off his money he went away wanting to replenish his funds.

dig out a second time, as when groundnuts have already been dug up, Twali kukufwukulula nyemumbwiila. = We had gone to dig up the groundpeas for the second time. (1.-fwukululwa, 2.-fwukulwide, 3.-fwukuluzya, 4.-fwukulwida, 8.-fwukulwidana.) Also: -vwunkulula.

push in hot ash, *Kofwukuma cimbwali mucikko.* = Push the sweet potatoe into the fire (hot ash). *Sicibende wakafwukuma lusala ndwaakapegwa.* = Sicibende pushed the edible tuber which he had been given into the hot ashes. (1.-fwukumwa, 2.-fwukumide, 3.-fwukumya, 4.-fwukumina, 8.-fwukuminana.) Also: -syundila.
  • stir coals in a fire, rake out a fire, *Bantu bafwukuma mulilo ciindi cakufwenezya nobajika zyakulya zyabwiinga bayanda mali.* = People who stir up the fire where the food for the bride is being cooked, want money. (This custom is known as *kufwukuma muzuba*.) Also: -fwekemuna, -tokolola, -yokololas, -cokoma.
become cold when sitting, *Bana bakafwukumana muwo niwakali kuunga.* = The children became cold when the wind was blowing. (1.-fwukumanwa, 2.-fwukumene, 3.-fwukumika, 4.-fwukumanina)
sit in a frozen state, rt. -fwugumama, *Moomba zyakamutola nonzi aawo mpaakafwukumenye.* = Moomba was taken away by sleep where he was sitting stiff in the cold.

lift off mould, *Kamufwukumuna kabotu cikombole kutegwa citina citafwi.* = Lift the mould off care-fully so that you do not break the brick. Also: -fwubbula, -sukumuna. (1.-fwukumunwa, 2.-fwukumwide, 3.-fwukumuzya, 4.-fwukumunina)
  • shake out, *Kofwukumuna payi kazwe kasuko.* = Shake the blanket so that dust comes out. Also: -vwukumuna

fumigate to expel evil spirits, *Bapati bafwukutila mwana wanjilwa zyeelo.* = The elders are fumigating a child ritually who has been possessed by an evil spirit. (1.-fwukutilwa, 2.-fwukutide, 3.-fwukutizya, 4.-fwukutizyizya, 8.-fwukutilana.) Also: -fwufwudika, -umpilila.
  • pack, *Kamufwukutila bwizu bunji kucibalu kutegwa kasuko katanjili mubusu.* = Pack more grass into the windfence so that the dust does not enter the mealie-meal. Also: -kutila.

forge, mould as bullets, beat as blades, *Kamufwula maamba akulimya.* = Forge the hoes for weeding. *Muzeli uyanda kufwula tulobyo.* = The fisherman wants to forge hooks for fishing. (1.-fwulwa, 2.-fwulide, 3.-fwuzya, 4.-fwulila, 5.-fwulilalyo, 6.-fwulisya, 7. -fwula-fwula, 8.-fwulana)
  • blow into eye, *Kamundifwula, ndatoogwa kauka muliso.* = Blow into my eye, it has been blocked by an insect.
  • take precautions, *Buumi bwamudolopo bwakaba bwakulifwula kumala.* = Life in the city has become a matter of blowing on your finger nails (i.e. being aware of danger)
become lop-sided *Mudaala ooyu wafwulaika buya kukweenda.* = This old man is lopsided when he is walking.
move at great speed, *Wakafwulamuna kabulo kuya kunkuta kukuula saimoni.* = He moved the bike with great speed going to the court to buy a summons. (1.-fwulamunwa)
be afraid, *Wakali kulifwulakumala.* = He was afraid.

puff and blow as one angry, *Munene wiile kufwulauka nkubamunyemya bana.* = The old man was puffing and blowing because the children angered him. *Lipakweenda uyuminina buyo kuseka nobafwulauka Bina Simweete.* = Lipakweenda just starts laughing when Bina Simweete gets worked up. Also: -syundauka (1.-fwulaukwa, 2.-fwulaukide, 3.-fwulausya, 4.-fwulaukila,

blow air on or into, rt. -fwula, *Kamufwulida mulilo uyake cibizwe cakulya.* = Blow on the fire so that it lights up and enables the food to be cooked. (1.-fwulidwa, 2.-fwulide, 3.-fwulidya, 4.-fwulidila, 5.-fwulidilalyo, 6.-fwulidisya, 7.-fwulida-fwulida, 8.-fwulidilana) Also: *-vwutila*

blow gently, *Ndaliku-fwulidila kuti uyake, pesi walo tauyaki.* = I was blowing gently for it to catch fire but it didn't. *Notwakali kulida nzuki, twaka-fwulidila busi bwatombwe kutegwa nzuki zitatulumi.* = When we were trying to take honey from the bees, we were blowing in tobacco smoke so that the bees would not sting us.
  • be unstable, unhealthy, *Buumi bwa Mweetwa bwakali bwakufwulidila biya.* = The life of Mweetwa was unstable.

possible to forge, rt. -fwula, *Lubulo olu lulafwulika.* = This metal is forgeable. *Oolu lubulo lulafwulika ku-tweembe nkaambo talukomoki.* = It is possible to use this metal for making axes because it is unbreakable.
blow strongly, *Mumwezi wa Gandapati mpeyo ilafwulisya.* = In the month of June a cold wind blows strongly. (1.-fwulwa, 2.-fwulide, 3.-fwulizya, 4.-fwulila, 6.-fwulisya, 8.-fwulana)

become thin, *Waka-fwuluka akaambo kamizeezo.* = He became thin because of thoughts. *Cibila wakanyema kapati naakaambwa kufwu-luka.* = The rock-rabbit was very angry when it was told it was thin. (1.-fwulukwa, 2.-fwulukide, 3.-fwulusya, 4.- fwulukila, 6.-fwulukisya.)

dilapidated, thin *Nkobali bamwi banga bamanyina boona mucaanda cifwulukide, pesi balo boona mumaanda mabotu.* = There are some whose mothers sleep in a delapidated house, while they sleep in beautiful houses. *Mazuba ayo kunyina nikwakali-kujanika nombe ifwulukide oomu mucisi.* = In those days a thin cow was never found here in the country.

bud, shoot out as a mealie cob, blossom, *Maluba akafwulula kale mbuli sunu!* = The flowers are blossoming so early! *Kufwumbwa kuti ndongwe zyatalika kufwulula taziyandiki kunya-nyaansya antela kuputausya kapati.* = Whenever groundnuts begin to flower they do not need to be shaken about or disturbed. (1.-fwululwa, 2.-fwulwide, 3.-fwuluzya, 4.-fwuluzyizya)
  • overflow, as a river, *Wakajana kalonga kalafwulula.* = He found the little river overflowing.

complete forging, reforge, resharpen, *Chifwala wali kufwululula cipeni cafwumpa.* = Chifwala was resharp-ening the knife which was blunt. (1.fwulululwa, 2.-fwululwide 3.-fwululuzya, 4.-fwululwida) Also: -sensemuna.
take without permission, as a thing hidden, *Nguni wafwulu-mana nyemu zyali mucisaka?* = Who has taken the groundnuts that were in the bag without permission? Also: -fwulumuna.

move in secret, *Bacembele nibakali kudilwe bakaakufwu-lumuka.* = When the old woman was at the funeral she left in secret. *Ndaakusika ku Monze ndiyakufwulumuka nkabone muzyukulu wangu kunanda yakwe.* = When I reach Monze I will go in secret to see my grandchild at his house. (1.-fwulumukwa, 2.-fwulumukide, 3.-fwulumuzya, 4.-fwulumukila, 6.-fwulumukisya.) cf. -fwelemuka

go secretly to a place, *Mudaala wafwulumukila ku Monze ncibatamujana bali kumuyanda.* = The old man went away secretly to Monze, that is why those who wanted him could not find him. Also: -fwelemukila
take without permission. Bataata bandinyemena nindafwulumuna ndongwe zyabacembele. = My father was angry when I took the groundnuts of the old woman without permission. Also: -fwulumana.

look about, search, Ufwulunga nzi murņanda oomo mbuli muntu mubbi? Why are you casting your eyes about in that house like a thief? Bana nobakafwa nzala, bakafwulunga munanda moonse pesi kwakanyina cakulya. = When the children were dying from hunger, they looked everywhere in the house but there was no food. Also: -nona-nona, -vwulungula, -vwunyungula, -gulunga, -fwunuka. (1.-fwulungwa, 2.-fwulungene, 3.-fwulungizya, 4.-fwulugula, 6.-fwulunganisya, 8.-fwulunganya.)
be angry, (2.-fwulungene)

cause to become thin, rt. fwuluka, Joni mbulwazi bwamufwulusya. It is the disease which has made John so emaciated. Ooyu mwana wakomena, komulesya, ibiyo ulakufwulusya. = This baby has grown big, wean him, otherwise he will make you thin. Kubeleka kapati kulafwulusya. Working too hard makes one thin. Mutinta wakaleka kulya zyamafwuta nkaambo uyanda kulifwulusya. Mutinta stopped eating fatty food because she wants to lose weight. (1.-fwulusyigwa, 2.-fwulukide, 3.-fwulusya, 4.-fwulusyizya, 8.-fwulusyanya) Also: -syulusya.

be forged, Ino cipeni eeci cakafwulwa lili? = When was this knife forged? (2.-fwulide, 3.-fwuzya, 4.-fwulila, 6.-fwulisya, 8.-fwulilana)
  • be removed (i.e. blown out) for a person, Koboola mwanaangu, wee lede kufwulwa kauka kakunjila mumeso. = Come my child so that the insect which has entered your eye may be blown out from you.
  • receive advice, Mwanaangu sunu ulangika kuti maanu ayaabuceya, ino weelede kufwulwa maanu. = My child nowadays you seem to be deteriorating in intelligence, now you ought to be sharpened up. Also: -sinkula. Also: -bulwa

start early, Bafwuma kweenda kuya kumuunda. They set out early to go to the field. (1.-fwumwa, 2.-fwumide, 3.-fwumya, 4.-fwumina, 5.-fwuminalyo, 6.-fwumisya, 7.-fwumafwuma, 8.-fwuminana)
  • achieve quickly, Kufwuma kuvwuba ncibi, inga lubono Iwaakukumanina. = To become rich quickly is bad, your wealth will vanish in the future.

scratch as ground with hands, dig up, burrow, excavate, Katufwumba malaala kukalonga kutegwa tukalobye. Let us dig up worms at the river so that we can fish. Also: -vwitila. (1.-fwumbwa, 2.-fwumbide, 3.-fwumbya, 4.-fwumbila, 6.-fwumbisya, 8.-fwumbilana.)
  • smear a cow's udder with dung, Kofwumba cibele caņombe koombe katanyonki. = Smear the cow's udder with dung so that the calf does not suck.
  • make a cake of, Fwumba cilundu catombwe. Make a cake of tobacco.
  • cover the mouth, Mwana wakali kukaka kumena musamu pesi banyina bakamufwumba mulomo kutegwa amene. = The child was refusing to swallow the medicine, but the mother covered its mouth so that it would swallow. Also: -vwumba mulomo
  • be sick for a long time, Choobe taningapona asunu, ucifwumba bulamfwu. = Choobe is not yet healed, he is still on the sick list.
  • dug from, Basankwa bafwumide kukufwumba meenda. = The boys went early to dig for water.

enfold, Mukaintu wafwumbata mwana kuti atafwi mpeyo. = The mother embraced the child so that it would not be cold. (1.-fwumbatwa, 2.-fumbete, 3.-fwumbatya, 4.-fwumbatila, 6.-fwumbatisya, 8.-fwumbatana)
enfold as a chicken under hens wings, Inkuku ifwumbatide twana. = The chicken has enfolded the chicks in her wings. (1.-fwumbatidwe, 3.-fwumbatizyizye, 4.-fwumbatizyizya)

give a tool into the hand, Ciindi bazyali nebayanda mwana wabo kweenda amaulu, balamwiimbila akumufwumbatika akafwunko. = When the parents want their baby to walk, they sing for him and give him a walking-stick in the hand. (1.-fwumbatikwa, 2.-fwumbatikide, 3.-fwumbatizya, 4.-fwumbatizyizya, 6.-fwumbatikisya, 8.-fwumbatikana)
  • make hold tightly, Komufwumbatika iji mumaanza kutegwa atalilosyi ansi. = Make him hold the egg tightly in his hands so that he does not drop it.

grasp, Wali kufwumbatila bwizu. = He was holding grass tightly with both hands. Bazyali balamuyiisyia mwana kufwumbatila zilyo mumaanza akwe. = The parents teach the child how to hold food in its hands. Basicikolo balalifwumbatila nobaya kucikolo akaambo kakutontola. = The pupils hold themselves tightly when going to school because of the cold. Also: -fwukatila, -sukatila, -tumbatila (1.-fwumbatilwa, 2.-fwumbatilide, 3.-fwumbatizya, 4.-fwumbatilila, 6.-fwumbatilisya, 8.-fwumbatilana)

open out, Mwana naakafwumbatide iji mujanza, banyina bakamufwumbatula kutegwa balibone. = When the child was holding an egg, the mother opened its hands to see it. Also: -tumbatula, -vwunga ntuku. (1.-fwumbatulwa, 2.-fwumbatwide, 3.-fwumbatulizya, 4.-fwumbatwida, 6.-fwumbatulisya)

root up, Mwiingile (munjile) wakali kufwumbaula nyika ampemo. = The warthog was rooting up the ground with its nose. Also: -fwumbuula. (1.-fwumbaulwa, 2.-fwumbawide, 3.-fwumbauzya, 4.-fwumbawida, 6.-fwumbaulisya.)
be in calf, rt. -fwumbata, Inombe ilifwumbete. = The cow is in calf. or Inombe ilaa cibele. (1.-fwumbetwe, 2.-fwumbetede)
be eroded, Kazila kalakatazya kwiinda nkaambo kakafwumbika. = The path is difficult to pass along because it has been eroded.
appear suddenly, Towwiigwi! Wafwumbuka ino nitwali kukwaamba. = You are not to be gossiped about! You just appear now when we are talking about you. Also: -vwumbuka.

scavange, scratch as ground with paws, rt. -fwumba, Babwa balikufwumbula bwina mwanjila kasulwe. = The dogs were scratching at a hole in which the hare entered. (1.-fwumbulwa, 2.-fwumbulwide, 3. -fwumbuzya)
  • make a ball of dung, Haafwumbula ulafwumbula ibbola kuzwa kumafwumba anombe kutegwa atulile iji mukati. = The dung-beetle is making a ball from the dung of the cattle so that it could lay it's egg inside it.

arise as a cloud, Makumbi mbwaakafwumbunuka jilo cakali kuyoosya. = It was frightening the way clouds arose yesterday. (2.-fwumbunukide, 3.-fwumbunuzya)
  • re-excavate, Cilindi ncibaka-fwumbide cakali cisyoonto, pesi niyakaboola mvwula cakafwumbunuka akukomena. = The hole which they had dug was small, but when the rain came it was made deeper and became bigger.
tear up ground as bull, Mucende ulafwumbuula ansi nalikalauka. The bull is tearing up the ground when he is angry. Also: -fwumbaula (1.-fwumbuulwa, 2.-fwumbwiide, 3.-fwumbuuzya, 4.-fwumbwiida)

dig out, Meenda afwumbwa ansi kuti apenzya. = If water is a problem it is extracted from the earth. Oobu bwina bwakafwumbwa amunyama utegwa galaba. This hole was dug out by an animal called an antbear. (2.-fwumbidwe)
  • be in the habit of doing, happen to do, Mwaalumi taakaleka kalengwa kakwe. Wakali kufwumbwa kwainda biyo mazuba maniini wakaindulula kucita kalengwa kakwe. Her husband did not stop his habit. When just a few days had passed he already repeated his habit. Obu buzuba twakafwumbwa kuti twakazwisya nombe abana mbutwakali kweembela limwi. = One day we happened to take out the cattle with the children with whom we were herding.

sniff, Babwa bafwumfwula mwainda sulwe. = The dogs are sniffing where the hare passed. Also: -numfwida
  • blow, of cold wind, Impeyo yakafwumfwula jilo cakuti tukuku tobilo twakaandwa. A cold wind blew yesterday and two chicks were frozen.
cover with wings to protect, Mukombwe wakafwumfwukilwa amababa akwe niyakamwaanda mpeyo. The cock was hidden by being covered by wings when it was cold.

stoop to pass under, Mudenda wakalikufwumfwulika mucisaka naakali kweembela mpongo. = Mudenda was bending down to pass through a thick forest when he was herding the goats. (2.-fwumfwulikide)
  • be doubled up with the cold, Bacembele bafwumfwulika buya kweenda akaambo kampeyo. = The old woman is doubled up as she walks because of the cold. Also: -tuntulika.
be bunched up with the cold, Nkuku zyaile kufwumfwumana nizyamvwa mpeyo. = The chickens were just bunches up when they felt cold. (1.-fwumfwumanwa, 2.-fwumfwumene, 3.-fwumfwumanya, 4.-fwumfwumanina.)

get up early for a purpose, Ncibafwambaanina kubuka, balikufwumina kuya kucigayo. = The reason for waking up early is because they were setting out early to go to the grinding mill. (1.-fwuminwa, 2.-fwumide, 3.-fwumya, 4.-fwuminina)

take captive, Bamwi bakafwumpwa akutolwa buzike. = Some were captured and taken into slavery. Fwumpa mwana ooyo, ndiyanda kumugela. Get hold of that child, I want to cut his hair. Cibunga cababbi cakafwumpa mwana ku Chisekese jilo. A group of thieves kidnapped a child in Chisekesi yesterday.
  • attack as bees, swarm around, Nzuki zyakamufwumpa mwana akumuluma kapati. = The bees swarmed around the child and stung him severely. Also: -pumpa, -vwumpa.
  • be blunt, Eeli jamba lyakafwumpa ncolitalimi kabotu. = This hoe is blunt that is why it is not digging well. Kuti keembe kafwumpa uleelede kukafwuzya. = If the axe is blunt you ought to sharpen it.
  • throw energetically, Wakaile kulifwumpa muciteyo naakabona basikalumamba. = She just threw herself in the bush when she saw the soldiers. Nakaala wakafwumpa bukowa mumulilo akwaamba kuti, "Swiilila! Zyabbolooka nsiinsini nzindatenta mumulilo." = Nakaala hurled the cucumber-seeds into the fire and spoke saying, "Listen! to the bedbugs bursting which I have burnt in the fire."
  • shake out, Musozya ngubakaleka bana, banyina bakaufwumpa kuzwa mumutiba mupati. = The samp which the children left, was shaken out from the big dish by the mother.

come out, Cifwumpu cafwumpuka kuzwa mumeenda. = The stump of a tree has emerged from the water. Lwala Iwangu Iwafwumpuka nindalinontola. My nail came out when I hit myself against something. (2.-fwumpukide)

force someone to act wrongly, Tacili cibotu kufwumpula muntu nkaambo inga kaenda mubulubizi lyoonse. It is not good to make a person do something wrong because s/he may act that way habitually. (1.-fwumpulwa, 2.-fwimpulide, 3.-fwumpuzya, 4.-fwumpulila)
  • hurt oneself against a stone, Ndalifwumpula nindali kweenda munzila. = I banged myself against a stone when I was walking along the path. Also: -nontola, -umpula.
  • do something wrong unintentionally, Mwiiyi wakalomba kulekelelwa ciindi naakalifwumpula kuuma sicikolo. = The teacher asked to be forgiven when he beat the pupil unintentionally.

become detached, Keembe kafwumuka kuzwa mumwiini. = The axe-blade came out of the handle. Also: -fwubbuka, -somoka, -kukkuka. (1.-fwumunwa, 2.-fwumukide, 3.-fwumuzya, 4.-fwumukila, 6.-fwumukisya)
  • come out as feathers, burst out, as boils, Kwafwumuka cuumba cipati acuute. A big maggot came out of the abcess when it burst.
  • break out, as a disease like small-pox, Mwanaangu wakafwumuka mubili oonse. My child broke out in a rash all over the body.

pull out, as feathers or grass from roof, unsheathe, take out from a container, Kamufwumuna bwizu aciluli tuyoke ndongwe. = Pull out some grass from the roof so that we roast some groundnuts. Mucembele naakali kupandaula nkuni, wakaalilwa kufwumuna keembe. When the old woman was splitting firewood, she was unable to pull the axe out. (which was stuck) Wakafwumuna cipanga cakwe. He unsheathed his machete. Wakasinda misozi kumeso akatambala nkaakafwumuna mubbeeke ndyaakajisi. = She wiped the tears from her eyes with a handkerchief which she pulled out from her bag. (1.-fwumunwa, 2.-fwumwide, 3.-fwumuzya, 4.-fwumwida, 5.-fwumwidalyo, 6.-fwumunisya, 7.-fwumuna-fwumuna, 8.-fwumunana.) Also: -sakamuna, -sokomuna, -sankamuna.

looking for, Ndajana kabwa katumbu kalafwunauka kuyandaula cakulya. I found a little dog with pups searching about for food. (1.-fwunaukwa, 2.-fwunaukide, 3.-fwunausya, 4.-fwunaukila, 5.-fwunaukilalyo, 6.-fwunaukisya, 7.-fwunauka-fwunauka, 8.-fwunaukana.)

skin a beast, Basankwa bakafwunda nombe kunze ananda. = Men skined the cow behind the house.
  • learn, study, Bana aba balafwunda kabotu. These pupils learn well. Also: -iya
  • learn by heart, Mazuba akaindi bana bakali kufwunda mumutwe manamba. = In past days the children were learning maths off by heart. (1.-fwundwa, 2.-fwundide, 3.-fwundya, 4.-fwundila, 5.-fwundilalyo, 6.-fwundisya, 7.-fwundafwunda) Also: - peta.
  • strip off, as fibres, Basankwa baunka kukufwunda loozi lwacaanda campongo. = The boys have gone to strip off fibres from trees for the goat shelter.
defile or stir up, as water, Ngulube zyafwundanya meenda muzyiba. The pigs have made the water dirty in the pond. (1.-fwundanyizigwa, 2.-fwundenye) Also: -kondoola, -vwundaanya, -vwundanya.

prepare yeast from maize grains, Bacembele bafwundika mimena yankolola. = The old woman is preparing maize-grain yeast for the initiation ceremony.
  • prevent, Bakafwundika mweenzinyina kukaambo nkaakatiiyambe. = They prevented their friend from saying what he was about to say. (1.-fwundikwa, 2.-fwundikide, 3.-fwundisya, 4.-fwundikila, 5.-fwundikilalyo, 6.-fwundikisya, 7.-fwundika-fwundika)

cause to suffocate, gag, rt. -fwundilila, Kwakaba kumufwundikizya kumubikka akati. = Putting her in the middle was just causing her to suffocate. (1.-fwundikizigwa, 2.-fwundikizyizye, 4.-fwundikizyizya, 8.-fwundikizyanya.)

be left speechless, Ndakafwundilila naakaamba kuti baama tabayandi. I was left speechless when he said that he disliked my mother.
  • choke, breathe with difficulty or asthmatically, Mebo nsyekonzyi kulunduka, ndafwundilila. = I cannot run, I am asthmatic. (1.-fwundilizigwa, 2.-fwundilide, 3.-fwundilizya, 4.-fwundilizyizya, 5.-fwundilililalyo, 6.-fwundililisya, 7.-fwundilila-fwundilila, 8.-fwundilizyanya)

hinder one from speaking out, Bamufwundilisya cakuti takonzyi kukanana kabotu. They hindered her in such a way that she could not speak properly. Also: -fwundilizya
  • gag, Mwana bamufwundilisya beenzinyina ncaafwa. The friends were gaging the child, that is why it died. Also: -fwundilizya

stifle, Bana nobatufwundilizya akaambo kalwiiyo lwabo, bayakucibona akale mbocibija kutateelela bapati. When the children overcome us because of their learning, they will see later on how it is bad not to listen to the elders.

teach, cause to learn, rt. -fwunda, Twamujana mucikolo kafwundisya bana. We found him in the class teaching the children.
  • break in or tame oxen, Cheelo wali kufwundisya basune. = Cheelo was taming the young oxen. Also: - tambisya. (1.-fwundisyigwa, 2.-fwundisyizye, 4.-fwundisyizya, 5.-fwndisyizyalyo, 6.-fwundisyisya, 7.-fwundisya-fwundisya, 8.-fwundisyanya.)

have goose pimples on the body because of the cold, Ndafwunduka amubili nkaambo kampeyo. = I have goose pimples on the body because of the cold. Also: -mfwunduka
  • become incensed, aroused, agitated Munene wakafwunduka kapati nibakamutukila bana. = Munene was highly incensed when the children insulted him. Sunu basimbi mbobasama, inga nuutontola mubili wako, ulafwunduka. Today the way girls dress, even if your body is cool, it becomes aroused. Abalo ndakabona bafwunduka, akabayoosya makani aya. = I saw that they also were agitated, that news had frightened them. (1.-fwundukwa, 2.-fwundukide, 3.-fwundusya, 4.-fwundukila, 5.-fwundukilalyo, 6.-fwundukisya, 7.-fwunduka-fwunduka)

cut open a beast already skinned, open, clean out a fowl, Kusanzya mala ankuku, nkusoka kwaafwundula naanga asalala. To wash a chicken's intestines you first of all open them up, that is when they can be cleaned out. (1.-fwundulwa, 2.-fwundwide, 3.-fwunduzya, 4.-fwundwida, 5.-fwudwidalyo, 6.-fwundulisya, 7.-fwundula-fwundula) Also: -danuna, -tanuna.

draw out fibre from the bark of a tree, Kamufwundulula loozi tuyasye nanda. = Draw out fibre from the bark so that we use it for building a house. (1.-fwundululwa, 2.-fwundulwide, 3.-fwunduluzya, 4.-fwundulwida, 5.-fwundulwidalyo, 6.-fwundululisya, 7.-fwundulula-fwundulula) Also: -fwandulula,-fwunda, -fwanununas, -yapula.

work hard, Muleelede kufwundumana nomwiiya kutegwa mukacikonzye kulanduka mubbuku lyafwuka. You need to work very hard to pass Grade 9. Also: -belekesya. (1.-fwundumanwa, 2.-fwundumene, 3.-fwundumanya, 4.-fwundumanina, 5.-fwundumaninalyo, 6.-fwundumanisya, 7.-fwundumana-fwundumana)

develop physically, Ooyu mwana ulafwambaana kufwunga. = This child is quick to develop bodily. Bamwi bana tabafwambaani kufwunga nkaambo kakutanyonki kabotu. = Some children do not develop well because they do not breast-feed enough. (1.-fwungwa, 2.-fwungide, 3.-fwunzya, 4-fwungila, 5.-fwungilalyo, 6.-fwungisya, 7.- fwungafwunga.) Also: -fwutumuka, -babana.

become foolish, Muntu mulozi nanywa tubwantu antela kulya kasima kamucape, ulafwunguka ulabula maanu. A witch when she drinks sweetbeer or eats a little nsima given by the witch-finder becomes stupid and loses normality. (1.-fwungulwa, 2.-fwungukide, 3.-fwunguzya, 4.-fwungukila, 5. -fwungukilalyo, 6. -fwungukisya, 7.-fwungukafwunguka)

change oneself into something else, Muzyaano zimwi bantu bamwi balifwungula kuba basuntwe. In some stories some people change themselves into hyenas. (1.-fwungulwa 2.-fwungwide, 3.-fwunguzya, 4.-fwungulila, 5.-fwungulilalyo, 6.-fwungulisya, 7.-fwungula-fwungula, 8.-fwungulana.) Also: -pungula, -sandula.
  • change through witchcraft, Munene wakafwunqula mwanaakwe kuba domba. = The old man changed his child into a half-human, half-animal, creature. Ba Chimuka bakaide kwaankamana mbuli bantu bafwunqulwa. = Chimuka was dumbfounded like people who are bewitched.

adopt as an infant, Basazinyina bakafwungusya bana ciindi bazyali nibakafwa. The relatives adopted the children when their parents died. (1.-fwungusyigwa, 2.-fwungusyizye, 3.-fwunguzya, 4.-fwungusyizya, 5.-fwungusyizyalyo, 6.-fwungusyisya, 7.-fwungusya-fwungusya, 8.-fwungusyanya.)
  • cause to grow, Mukupa wamunkolo ufwunqusya kabotu bana. = Breast milk causes the children to grow well.

plough a field, Sena nywebo mwakafwunka kale myuunda yanu? = You people, have you already ploughed your fields? Cimwi ciindi businde bulaona kusikila mwaka uboola nobuya *kufwunkwa.* = Sometimes the tilled land is left for a year when it is ploughed. Also: -lima. (1.-fwunkwa, 2.-fwunkide, 3.-fwunkizya, 4.-fwunkila, 5.-fwunkilalyo, 6.-fwunkisya, 7.-fwunka-fwunka, 8.-fwunkilana.)
  • make into a cake, Basimbi balafwunka zibunge zyambula zyakulya nobalima. Masuku balakanda mumukupa, amwi balafwunkunya. = The girls make cakes of mbula fruit to eat when they are ploughing. They knead masuku fruit into the milk, some they use for making cakes.

plough quickly, *Kamufwunka-fwunka noitanaboola mvwula.* = Plough quickly before the rains come.
  • float as a preying crocodile, *Ciwena wali kwiile kufwunka-fwunka naalikubendelela kuluma bantu bali mubwato.* = The crocodile was just floating along stalking the people to attack them in the boat.

replough a field, break up as lumps of earth, *Kufwunkulula kuleelede kucitwa naa mapopwe taazwa kabotu.* = It is better to replough the field if the maize did not germinate properly. Also: -limununa. (1.-fwunkululwa, 2.-fwunkulwide, 3.-fwunkuluzya, 4.-fwunkulwida, 5.-fwunkulwidalyo, 8.-fwunkulwidana.)

replough a field, re-dig, *Chilala wakafwambaana kufwunkununa muunda wakwe.* = Chilala was quick to replough his field. Also: -fwunkulula (1.-fwunkununwa, 2.-fwunkunwide, 3.-fwnkunuzya, 4.-fwunkunwida, 5.-fwunkunwidalyo, 6.-fwunkunisya.)

pour out, as food from a pot, *Ceele kamucifwunta mumutiba mupati.* = Pour out the porridge into a big dish. Also: -fwumpa, -sukumuna. (1.-fwuntwa, 2.-fwuntide, 3.-fwuntya, 4.-fwuntila, 5.-fwuntilalyo, 6.-fwuntisya, 7.-fwunta-fwunta, 8.-fwuntana.)
  • blow vigourously, *Kofwunta mulilo uzime ulaumpa cibalu.* = Blow the fire well to extinguish it lest it burns the fence.
  • blow into, inflate with air, *Naakanetuka, beenzinyina bakamufwunta muya mukanwa kutegwa acikonzye kuyoya.* = When he fainted, his friends blew air into his mouth so that he could be able to breathe.
  • cool, by waving over, *Kamuci-fwunta-fwunta cinkomba citaunkili ansi.* = Wave cool air over the boiling cinkomba so that it does not flow over onto the ground. Also: -omba-omba.
be in a deep sleep, *Naakazyila kubukoko, wakafwuntuka koona.* = When he came from drinking beer, he fell into a deep sleep.

become fat, *Mainza wakalikokede pesi naakatalika kulya kabotu wakafwuntumuka.*= Mainza was thin but when he started to eat well he became fat. (1.-fwuntumukwa, 2.-fwuntumukide, 3.-fwuntumuzya, 4.-fwuntumukila 5.-fwuntumukilalyo, 6.-fwuntumukisya, 7.-fwuntumuka-fwuntumuka) Also: -fwutumuka
be in a bulging state, *Milambi yakwe yakalifwuntumukide akaambo kamilimo miyumu njaakali kucita-cita.* = His biceps were bulging because of the hard work which he continually did.
be in deep sleep, *Musimbi wakalifwuntwide.* = The girl was in a deep sleep. Also: -suntuka koona
be silent and introverted, *Ciindi coonse wakakkala ngwakufwuntyumana.* = All the time he sat silent and introverted.

be downcast, *Akaambo kakutazwidilila mukusalwa kwakali mu mwezi wa Nalupale, Chimuka wakaile ku-* fwunuka. = Because of not been chosen in the December elections, Chimuka was disappointed. (1.-fwunukwa, 2.-fwunukide, 3.-fwunuzya, 4.-fwunukila, 5.-fwunukilalyo, 6.-fwunukisya, 7.-fwunuka-fwunuka) Also: -tunuka.
perform, Notutuba buya buu, inga aswebo ma twalifwunungula mbotucizyi. = Even though we are poor, we can act in the way we know.
cause water to ripple, Naakalosya bbwe pati mumeenda, meenda akafwununika. = When he dropped a big stone in water, the water rippled.

remain soft and fresh, Maaya akali kunanikwa mafwuta amukula kutegwa lyoonse loozi kalufwununuka, kalutayumi. = The traditional stringed skirts were smeared with ochre so that the strings would remain soft and fresh and not become dry. (1.-fwununikwa, 2.-fwununikide, 3.-fwununikizya, 4.-fwununikila, 5.-fwununikilalyo, 6.-fwununikisya, 7.-fwununuka-fwununuka.)

look about as if wanting to steal, investigate, Naakayanda kubba wakafwunuuka ooku akooku kubona kuti kunyina uliko. = When he wanted to steal he looked here and there to see that there was nobody around. Also: -fwunauka.

close eyes voluntarily, Kamufwunya kuli nceyanda kucita. = Close your eyes there is something I want to do. Kabatanafwunya kuti bapaile, bakaide kutyokezya nkaambo mweenzu wakasika anze. = Before they closed their eyes to pray, they broke off as a visitor arrived outside. Also: -fwinya. (1.-fwunyigwa, 2.-fwunyide, 3.-fwunyizya, 4.-fwunyina, 5.-fwunyinalyo, 6.-fwunyisya, 7.-fwunya-fwunya, 8.-fwunyinana.)
  • fold, Kamundisumina cisani akucifwunya muminganja mipati-pati. = Sow this dress for me and fold it into large pleats.
  • curl as hair, Koafwunya masusu aako kutegwa abote. = Curl your hair so that it becomes beautiful.
