close eyes repeatedly, Ino inga mufwunya-fwunya nzi nywebo? = Why are you closing and opening your eyes so repeatedly?

become wrinkled, shrink, Nindamana kusanzya cisani cangu cafwunyana. = My dress shrank after I washed it. Also: -fwinyana, -zambanas, -nyana-nyana, -onyana, -dadankana. (1.-fwunyanizigwa, 2.-fwunyanide, 4.-fwunyanina, 5.-fwunyaninalyo, 6.-fwunyanisya)
wink knowingly, connive, Musankwa wali kufwunyina musimbi kutegwa atakanani. = The boy was winking telling the girl not to speak. Also: -fwinyina.

brake off or cut down, Chingwala wakafwunyuka kasolo naakaloka kuzwa mucisamu. = Chingwala dislocated his hip when he fell out of a tree. Mitabi yamisamu yobilo yakafwunyuka kambizyi nikakabbubbula. = The branches of two trees broke off when the whirlwind blew. (1.-fwunyukwa, 2.-fwunyukide, 3.-fwunyuzya, 4.-fwunyukila, 5.-fwunyukilalyo, 6.-fwunyukisya, 7.-fwunyuka-fwunyuka, 8.-fwunyukana)

break with force a stone or stick, Ndakacifwunyula cisamu ciya canguzu. = I energetically broke that stick. (1.-fwunyulwa, 2.-fwunyulide, 4.-fwunyulila, 5.-fwunyulilalyo, 6. -fwunyulisya, 8.-fwunyulana.) Also: -kwezyula.

cut down, Nguni wakafwunyuna cisamu ciya alya? = Who cut down that tree over there? (1.-fwunyunwa, 2.-fwunyunide, 3.-fwunyuzya, 4.-fwunyunina, 5.-fwunyuninalyo, 6.-fwunyunisya, 7.-fwunyuna-fwunyuna, 8.-fwunyunana.) cf. -fwunyula, -kwezyula.
break up, *Sicibende wakafwunyungula mombo akwiipa Bina Chibbamu.* = Sicibende broke up the dove and gave it to the mother of Chibbamu.
be curled, as the hair in cone, rt. -fwunya, *Masusu aakwe akafwunywa ncaalangika kabotu.* = Her hair is curled that is why it looks well.

be smashed, *Kuti wabikka bowa musaka, boonse bula-fwunzauka.* = If you put mushrooms in a sack, they will all be smashed. *Wafwunzauka mootokala niwaumputa mucisamu.* = The vehicle was smashed when it crashed into a tree. Also: -pozauka, -pwasyauka. (1.-fwunzaukwa, 2.-fwunzaukide, 3.-fwunzauzya, 4.-fwunzaukila, 5.-fwunzaukilalyo, 6.-fwunzaukisya)

grow hair (bwefweefwi), as in green maize, *Mapopwe angu atalika kale kufwunzaula ngalaala.* = My maize has already begun to grow hair on the cob. (1.-fwunzaulwa, 2.-fwunzaulide, 3.-fwunzauzya, 4.-fwunzaulila, 5.-fwunzaulilalyo, 6.-fwunzaulisya, 7.-fwunzaula-fwunzaula, 8.-fwunzaulana.)
  • smash, *Baufwunzaula mutwe wanombe kutegwa utendaulwe kabotu.* = They have smashed the head of the cow so that they could cut it up into pieces.

be ripped apart, *Basu-Iwe bajaigwa amadiba balafwunzuka.* = The hares which are killed in the stone-trap are ripped apart. (1.-fwunzukwa, 2.-fwunzukide, 3.-fwunzuzya, 4.-fwunzukila, 5.-fwunzukilalyo, 6.-fwunzukisya, 7.-fwunzuka-fwunzuka) Also: -fwanzuka.
open as an ox so that intestines slip out, *Wakamuyasa mu-* sune mwida kumane bula bwafwunzukila anze. = He pierced the ox in the stomach so that the intestines slipped out.

crush something so that contents come out. *Mbaani bafwunzula citende eci?* = Who crushed this pumpkin? (1.-fwunzulwa, 2.-fwunzwide, 3.-fwunzuzya, 4.-fwunzwida, 5.-fwunzwidalyo, 6.-fwunzulisya, 7.-fwunzula-fwunzula, 8.-fwunzulana.)

tassel, *Uno mwaka mvwula yakaunka mapopwe naakatalika kufwunzuula ngalaala.* = This year the rain stopped when the maize began to tassel. Also: -fwunzaula. (1.-fwunzuulwa, 2.-fwunzwiide, 3.-fwunzuuzya, 4.-fwunzwiida, 5.-fwunzwiidalyo, 6.-fwunzuulisya)
  • crush into pieces, *Moota wafwunzuula mubwa mumugwagwa.* = The vehicle crushed the dog on the road.

detach something, *Izyaanza zimwi zyaņombe bakazifwupula akuzibikka acuumbwe.* = They detached some of the horned heads and put them on the grave. (1.-fwupulwa, 2.-fwupulide, 3.-fwupuzya, 4.-fwupulila, 5.-fwupulilalyo, 6.-fwupulisya, 7.-fwupula-fwupula, 8.-fwupulana)

throw, shoot at, *Kamuleka kufwusa mabwe aciluli mulajaya mpulungwido zyananda.* = Stop throwing stones on the roof you will break the windows of the house. (1.-fwuswa, 2.-fwuside 3.-fwusya, 4.-fwusila, 5.-fwusilalyo, 6.-fwusisya, 7.-fwusa-fwusa, 8.-fwusilana.) Also: -waala.

throw at one another, rt. -fwusa, *Bana bafwusana mabwe balacisana, kamubalesya.* = Stop the children from throwing stones at each other, they will hurt one another. (1.-fwusanwa, 2.-fwusanide, 3.-fwusanizya, 4.-fwusanina, 5.-fwusaninalyo, 6.-fwusanisya 7.-fwusana-fwusana, 8.-fwusana.)

rise as a river, overflow as yeast fizzing out of bottle, spill over, *Nsima yabila kapati, niyamana yatalika kufwusuka.* = The nsima boiled for a long time, eventually it began to spill over. (1.-fwusukwa, 2.-fwusukide, 3.-fwususya, 4.-fwusukila, 5.-fwusukilalyo, 6.-fwusukisya, 7.-fwusuka-fwusuka.) Also: -fwasuka, -unka *(Kobikka nkwasizyo kutegwa ileke kuunka nsima.* = Put more mealie-meal so that the nsima dos not flow over.)
  • gather in large numbers, *Twalikuyeeya kuti bantu tabakwe kuvwula kucikombelo, pele bafwusuka muciindi cisyoonto.* = We thought that the people would not be many at the church, but they gathered in large numbers in a short time.

grow hair on mealies when the young cob is beginning to ripen, *Mapopwe aamumbewu yangu atalika kufwususa.* = The maize cobs in my garden have begun to grow hair. (1.-fwususwa, 2.-fwususide, 3.-fwususya, 4.-fwususila, 5.-fwususilalyo, 6.-fwususisya, 7.-fwususa-fwususa) Also: -fwunzaula, -fwunzuula.
  • rise as steam or vapour, *Wakabona meenda muzyiba mbwaakafwususa busi ulati mmufwundundu wasikunku.* = He saw the water in the pool how it rose as a vapour, you would say it was the mist of a dense fog.

be grief-stricken, show illhumour, sulk, *Ooyu mwana atumwa lyoonse ulitondezya kufwuta kubusyu citondezya kunyansya.* = When this child is sent to carry a message somewhere, it makes a sulky face always showing it's revulsion. (2.-fwutide, 3.-fwutya, 4.-fwutila, 5.-fwutilalyo, 6.-fwutisya, 7.-fwuta-fwuta, 8.-fwutilana)
  • ferment as bread, swell, rise as a river, *Wiile kufwuta kuneneya mbuli cinkwa cabikkwa bumena.* = He has just become fat like bread mixed with yeast. *Munzi wakwe uyakuzula meenda kuti meenda amuzyiba lya Kariba akatalike kufwuta.* = His home will be filled with water if the water from Kariba lake begins to rise. Also: -fwututa, -fwusuka.

turn one's back, *Kuti Leza wafwutata inga taiwi mvwula.* = If God turns his back on us, the rain will surely not fall. *Mubekwabekwa muciindi cakuti amulange Nacintu wakafwutata cabuusu walanga kubwaanda.* = Mubekwabekwa instead of looking at Nacintu he turned his back in shame and looked at the wall. Also: -takata. (1.-fwutatwa, 2.-fwutatide, 3.-fwutatya, 4.-fwutatila, 5.-fwutatilalyo, 6.-fwutatisya, 7.-fwutata-fwutata, 8.-fwutatilana)

turn one's back on someone, *Bazyali besu batufwutatila.* = Our parents have turned away from us. *Ncibi kumufwutatila mwanaako kumapenzi ngajisi.* = It is bad to turn away from your child in the sufferings which s/he has. *Bana aba baakukomena baya kundifwutatila akusukamina bamukowa wabo.* = When these children grow up they will turn their backs on me and concentrate on the matrilineal side. *Ino basazima nkaambo nzi ncibandifwutatila boobu?* = Why have my relatives turned their backs on me?
turn with ones backs to one another, *Murjanga wakabaambila kuti bakkale cakufwutatilana.* = The witchdoctor said that they should sit with their backs turned against one another.

swell, *Wiile kufwutauka mubalikumuuma.* = She is swelling where they have beaten her. (1.-fwutaukwa, 2.-fwutaukide, 3.-fwutaukizya, 4.-fwutaukila, 5.-fwutaukilalyo, 6.-fwutaukisya, 7.-fwutauka-fwutauka) Also: -fwutumuka.
  • move about in search of food, Atwalo tumbaambi twakali kufwutaukafwutauka mazuba alya. = Even small duikers were moving about here and there looking for food those days.
  • be busily engaged in doing something, Mulembwe wakamulya coolwe simeenzu akwe nkaambo wakajana ula-fwutauka ambali aananda yakwe. = Mulembwe was lucky to find his host because he found him occupied doing different jobs near his home. Misozi walo wakali kufwutauka mucaanda cakazwide tumpangaliko twakwe, kapati nsengo. = Misozi also was busy doing something in the house which was full of his divining instruments, especially horns.

work freely, Sicibende naakaunka kuyoolanga banyina bamwi, mwinakwe wakajana ciindi cakulifwutaukila. = When Sicibende went to see his stepmother, his wife found time to work freely. (1.-fwutaukilwa, 2.-fwutaukide, 3. -fwutausya, 4.-fwutaukila, 5.-fwutaukilalyo, 6.-fwutaukisya, 7.-fwutaukila-fwutaukila, 8.-fwutaukilana) Also: -kutauka

hide food or money already received, Wakafwutika nsima kuti alye aakale. He hid the nsima so that he could eat it later on. Bamwi bantu bayandisya kunywa mali aabeenzinyina pesi abo balafwutika. Some people take much delight in using up the money of their friends while they put away their own. (1.-fwutikwa, 2.-fwutikide, 3.-fwutizya, 4.-fwutikila, 5.-fwutikilalyo, 6.-fwutikisya, 7.-fwutika-fwutika, 8.-fwutikilana.)

turn away from, Beenzinyina boonse bakamufwutila nkaambo wakabaima mapopwe matete. All his friends turned away from him because he refused them fresh maize. (1.-fwutilwa, 2.-fwutide, 3.-fwutya, 4.-fwutilila, 5.-fwutililalyo, 6.-fwutisya, 7.- fwutila-fwutila, 8.-fwutilana.)

eat to excess, Mubuzuba bwakusekelela wakafwutilwa zinkwa. = On the day of celebration he ate bread to excess. Also: -zembelwa, -zimbilwa. (2.-fwutilidwe, 3.-fwutilizya, 4.-fwutililwa, 5.-fwutililwalyo, 6.-fwutisigwa)
  • be rejected, Mwana wafwutilwa kubeenzinyina. = The child has been rejected by its friends.

be saved, Ndakafwutuka acoolwe kunzala yakali mwakali. = I was fortunate to be saved from last year's hunger. Kwakafwutuka buyo omwe. = Only one was saved. (1.-fwutukwa, 2.-fwutukide, 3.-fwutusya, 4.-fwutukila, 5.-fwutukilalyo, 6.-fwutukisya, 7.-fwutuka-fwutuka)
  • be pulled inside out, Kufwutuka kwankomo zyangu kutondezya kuti nsejisi mali. The turning out of my pockets shows that I have no money.

save, Twakabafwutula bana kuzwa munanda yakali kuyaka mulilo. = We saved the children by getting them out from the burning house. (1.-fwutulwa, 2.-fwutwide, 3.-fwutusya, 4.-fwutwida, 5.-fwutwidalyo, 6.-fwutulisya, 7.-fwutula-fwutula, 8.-fwutulana)
  • turn inside-out, turn backwards, Kamucifwutula cigogo kutegwa ciyanikwe kabotu. Turn the dress inside-out so that it dries properly. Kamufwutula nkomo zyanu zyoonse kutegwa tubone wabba mali. Turn all your pockets inside out so that we see who stole the money. Maboko aakacembele akafwutulwa akwaangilwa kusyule mwaali mutukokola. = The arms of the old woman were turned backwards and tied behind by the elbows. Also: -pindula.

be swoolen, be stout, *Kufwutumuka* da akaambo kakwiindilizya kulya ncibi. = To have a swollen stomach due to excessive eating is bad. (1.-fwutumukwa, 2.-fwutumukide, 3.-fwutumusya, 4.-fwutumukila, 5. fwutumukilalyo, 6.-fwutumukisya, 7.-fwutumuka-fwutumuka) cf. -tantamuka, -tatamuka.
  • rise as yeast, Ceele cacinkwa ca-*fwutumuka* kale. = The dough is already rising. Also: -tukumuna, -fwufwumuka.
  • puff oneself up, Igande lyakabboloka nilyakafwutumuka kuti beelane kukomena amusune. = The bull-frog burst when it puffed itself up trying to be equal in size to an ox.

open out, as a bag, *Kofwutumuna* coola eeci ndaake zisani. = Open out the bag so that I pack the clothes.
  • make something grow, Muntu ucizyi kulela bamucaala ulabafwutumuna kufwambaana. = A person who knows how to keep orphans makes them grow fast. (1.-fwutumunwa, 2.-fwutumwide, 3.-fwutumunizya, 4.-fwutumunina, 5.-fwutumuninalyo, 6.fwutumunisya, 7.-fwutumuna-fwutumuna, 8.-fwutumunana.)

save, rt. -fwutula, Ndime ndakabafwutusya kunzala mwakali kwiinda mukubapa zyakulya. = It is me who saved them from hunger last year by giving them food supplies. (1.-fwutusyigwa, 2.-fwutusyide, 3.-fwutusyizya, 4.-fwutuzyizya, 5.-fwutuzyizyalyo, 6.-fwutusyisya, 7.-fwutusya-fwutusya, 8.-fwutusyanya.)
ferment, Bukoko bula-*fwututa* kubila. = The beer is fermenting. (1.-fwututwa, 2.-fwututide, 3.-fwututya, 4.-fwututila, 5.-fwututilalyo, 6.-fwututisya, 7.-fwututa-fwututa) Also: -vwututa.

swoop down as a bird catching a chicken, Kainga kaka-*fwuulika* kuzya ansi kubenda nkuku. = The hawk swooped down to take the chicken. (2.-fwuulikide, 3.-fwuulisya, 4.-fwuulikila, 5.-fwuulikilalyo, 6.-fwuulikisya, 7.-fwuulika-fwuulika)

glide a bird, swoop down, Wakafwuuma mbuli kainga kuya kukuuma mwana. = She swooped down like a falcon to strike the child. (2.-fwuumide, 3.-fwuumya, 4.-fwuumukila, 5.-fwuumukilalyo, 6.-fwuumisya, 7.-fwuuma-fwuuma)

rush down, Sikakooze naakafwuumuka kujata kakuku, musankwa wakamuuma malekani. = When the hawk swooped down, a boy struck it with a catapult. (2.-fwuumukide, 3.-fwuumukizya, 4.-fwuumukila, 5.-fwuumukilalyo, 6.-fwuumukisya, 7.-fwuumuka-fwuumuka, 8.-fwuumukilana.)

rush to a place, Bakafwuumukila kuya kudilwe bantu boonse. = All the people rushed to the funeral. Meso akwe akali kukonzya kubona bucita musika nafwuumukila kana kankuku. = His eyes were able to see like an eagle's when it swoops down to snatch a chick.

be narrow, Nkolobeki njindakaula jilo ilakaka ku-*fwuundana*. = The cultivator which I bought yesterday refuses to become narrow. (1.-fwuundanwa, 2.-fwuundenye, 3.-fwuundanya, 4.-fwuundanina, 5.-fwuundaninalyo, 6.-fwuundanisya, 7.-fwuundana-fwuundana)
  • squeeze together, Kamuleka kufwuundana ciindi cakulemba nkaambo tamukwe kulemba kabotu. = Stop squeezing together when you are writing because you will not write properly. Also: -sisinkana.

make narrow, rt. -fwuundana, *Kobufwuundanya* bulo kutegwa bunjile kabotu munanda. = Make the bed narrow so that it can enter the house easily. *Musumi wakaifwuundanya* nkomo tainjiliki. = The tailor made the pocket narrow so that you cannot push your hand inside.
be narrow in shape, *Eeci cibiya cilifwuundene* kapati kumulomo. = This pot is very narrow at the mouth.

press against, *Baka-mufwuundika* mweenzinyina. = They pressed against their friend. (1.-fwuundikwa, 2.-fwuundikide, 3.-fwuundikizya, 4.-fwuundikizyizya, 5.-fwuundikizizyalyo, 6.-fwuundikisya, 7.-fwuundika-fwuundika, 8.-fwuundikizyanya)
  • cause to narrow, *Waifwuundika* kapati nongo kumulomo, koibambulula. = You have narrowed the mouth of the pot too much, remould it. *Mweelede kufwuundika* nkolobeki ciindi nomukolobekela nyabo. = Make the cultivator narrow when you are cultivating the beans.

stoop as going through low doorway, *Kofwuuntila* buya kunjila munanda, mulyango mmufwiifwi. = Bend down when you are entering the house, the doorway is low. *Wakali kufwuuntila* biya kweenda nkaambo wakalikusoomona kapati. = He was stooping down because he was suffering from severe purging. *Fwulwe* wakaya *bufwuuntila*. = The tortoise went along bowing down. (1.-fwuuntilwa, 2.-fwuuntilide, 3.-fwuuntizya, 4.-fwuuntilila, 5.-fwuuntililalyo, 6.-fwuuntilisya, 7.-fwuuntila-fwuuntila.)

cause to narrow, *Candifwuunyika* busyu. = It has caused my face to narrow. (1.-fwuunyikwa, 2.-fwuunyikide, 3.-fwuunyikizya, 4.-fwuunyikizizya, 5.-fwuunyikizizyalyo, 6.-fwuunyikisya, 7.-fwuunyika-fwuunyika)

cause to go fast, rt. -fwuuta, *Kamufwuusya* ŋombe nkaambo mvwula ilaafwiifwi. = Speed up the cattle because the rain is near. Also: -binzya. (1.-fwuusyigwa, 2.-fwuusyide, 3.-fwuusizya, 4.-fwuusizya, 5.-fwuusizyalyo, 6.-fwuusyisya, 7.-fwuusya-fwuusya, 8.-fwuusyanya.)

produce or accumulate wealth, *Atuyeeye* bantu bakaindi *mbobakafwuwa* lubono. = Let us think of how the people of the past produced wealth. (1.-fwuwigwa, 2.-fwuwide, 3.-fwuwizya, 4.-fwuwila, 5.-fwuwilalyo, 6.-fwuwisya, 7.-fwuwa-fwuwa, 8.-fwuwana.)
  • bring up, rear, *Bataata bakafwuwa* mucende. = My father reared a bull. Also: - *suwa*.

sprain oneself, *Ndakafwuyuka* nindakali kusotoka jilo. = I sprained myself when I was jumping yesterday. *Ndakadyobokela* mudindi aku-*fwuyuka* kasolo. = I stepped into a hole and damaged my hip. *Mukaintu umwi wakafwuyuka* musana ciindi naakali ku-Iwana amweenzinyina. = A certain woman strained her back when she was fighting with her friend. Also: -syikuka. (1.-fwuyukwa, 2.-fwuyukide, 3.-fwuyuzya, 4.-fwuyukila, 5.-fwuyukilalyo, 6.-fwuyukisya, 7.-fwuyuka-fwuyuka, 8.-fwuyukana.)

cause to sprain, *Bakamufwuyula* bana Chipembele nibakali kuuma bbola. = The Chipembele team injured him when they were playing football. (1.-fwuyulwa, 2.-fwuyulide, 3.-fwuyuzya, 4.-fwuyulila, 5.-fwuyulilalyo, 6.-fwuyulisya, 7.-fwuyula-fwuyula, 8.-fwuyulana.)

cause to forge, rt. -fwula, *Ndakafwuzya* ijamba kutegwa nkalime kabotu. = I had the plough forged so that I plough well. (1.-fwuzyigwa, 2.-fwuzyide, 3.-fwuzyizya, 4.-fwuzyila, 5.-fwuzyilalyo, 6.-fwuzyisya, 7.-fwuzya-fwuzya, 8.-fwuzyizyanya)

be or become lean, Cheelo wagaangila nkaambo kakufwidwa mwana. = Cheelo has become lean because she has lost a child. (2.-gaangide, 3.-gaangizya, 4.-gaangilila, 5.-gaangililalyo, 6.-gaangisya, 7.-gaangila-gaangila) Also: -kangila.
  • hinder development, Mapopwe akagaangila nkaambo akabalwa kapati izuba. = The maize did not develop because it was heated for a long time by the sun.

point out directly, Cilatondwa kugaanta muntu kucintu ncotali masimpe. = It is taboo to point directly accusing someone of a thing which you are not sure is true. Sena inga baboola kumunzi bazikumugaanta kuti we nduwe olowa watumana? = When they come to the village they will they be able to point the finger at him saying, "You who bewitch are destroying us?" Also: -gala (1.-gaantwa, 2.-gaantide, 3.-gaantya, 4.-gaantila, 5.-gaantilalyo, 6.-gaantisya, 7.-gaanta-gaanta, 8.-gaantana)
rebel, mutiny, Nchimunya wagaanya kusanzya mitiba. = Nchimunya has rebelled against washing the dishes. (2.-gaanyide, 3.-gaanyizya, 4.-gaanyanina, 5.-gaanyaninalyo, 6.-gaanyisya) Also: -zanga, -kaka.

divide, Banyina bakagaba nsima akubapa bana babo. = The mother divided the nsima and gave it to her children. (1.-gabwa, 2.-gabide, 3.-gabya, 4.-gabila, 5.-gabilalyo, 6.-gabisya, 7.-gaba-gaba, 8.-gabana) Also: -abanya.
  • be stuck, Ijamba lyagaba acisamu. = The plough is stuck in a tree. Ga! Wakagaba musimbi. Taakakonzya kuvwiila. = Ga! The girl was stuck. She could not answer. Also: -njomba

divide into portions among yourselves, Kamugabana gwaba. = Divide the guava among yourselves. Also: -abana.
  • collide, Umwi mukaintu a musankwa bakagabana amancinga akati kabbiliki. = One woman and a man collided on their bicycles in the middle of the bridge.
gobble, eat ravenously, Syuumbwa wali kugaba-gaba mafwuwa. = The lion was gobbling up the bones. Also: -gabba-gabba
gulp down food, Mbwaakamanina buyo kugabaula-gabaula, wakabayiila zyoonse nzyaakaakubona akumvwa. When he had gulped down the food he related to them all that he had seen and heard.
eat ravenously, Kulya kugabba-gabba mbuli mubwa tacili cibotu pe. Eating ravenously like a dog is not good. Also: -gaba-gaba, -gabwila.

plough with hoe, Amane kubamba cibelesyo cakwe, wakatalika kugabula kulima abusena oobo mbwaakapegwa. When she had finished making her tool, she started with a hoe to plough the place which she had been given. (1.-gabulwa, 2.-gabulide, 3.-gabuzya, 4.-gabulila, 5.-gabulilalyo, 6.-gabulisya, 7.-gabula-gabula, 8.-gabulana.) Also: -kabwila

lie on back, lean backwards, Mutinta wagadama mumusenga naakolwa. Mutinta lay on his back on the sand when he was drunk. (1.-gadamwa, 2.-gademe, 3.-gadamya, 4.-gadamina, 5.-gadaminalyo, 6.-gadamanisya, 7.-gadama-gadama) Also: -gandama, -salama, -ngandama
be astounded or flabbergasted Bakagagabala kulanga nguwe. = They were amazed looking at him.

hammer, Ulaboola kugagaila ciluli. = He will come to nail the roof. (1.gagailwa, 2.-gagailide/-gagaide, 3.-gagaizya, 4.-gagailila, 5.-gagailalyo, 6.-gagailisya, 7.-gagaila-gagaila, 8.-gagailana) Also: -betela, -kankamina.

stagger, Chimuka wakali kugagalika naakakolwa bukoko. = Chimuka used to stagger when he was drunk with beer. (1.-gagalikwa, 2.-gagalikide, 3.-gagalisya, 4.-gagalikila, 5.-gagalikilalyo, 6.-gagalikisya, 7.-gagalika-gagalika)

struggle with, Wakatalika kugagalisya bbwe eliya kutegwa alange buci mukati. = He started struggling with that stone (to remove it) so that he could see the honey inside. (1.-gagalisyigwa, 2.-gagalisyide 3.-gagalisyizya, 5.-gagalisyizyalyo, 6.-gagalizyisya, 7.-gagalisya-gagalisya, 8.-gagalisyanya)

struggle with one another, rt. -gagalika, Bakagagalisyanya basankwa kusikila limwi umwi watingwa mukamando. = The boys struggled with one another until one was thrown down in the contest. Also: -gigilisyanyas, -jijilisyanya, -bbabbalisyanya.

harden, Makololo aansima agagamina mumupika. = The leavings of the nsima had hardened in the pot. (1.-gagaminwa, 2.-gagamide, 3.-gagamizya, 4.-gagaminina, 5.-gagaminalyo, 6.-gagaminisya, 7.-gagaminagagamina) Also: -gagatila
  • stretch a skin with pegs, Cikutu cakagagamina abwaanda. = The hide was stretched on the wall.

roar with laughter, laugh loudly, Wakagagamuka kuseka mbuli muntu usondokede. = He howled laughing like a madman. (1.-gagamukwa, 2.-gagamukide, 3.-gagamusya, 4.-gagamukila, 5.-gagamukilalyo, 6.-gagamukisya, 7.-gagamuka-gagamuka, 8.-gagamukana.) Also: -gwagwamuka, -kwangana.

roar with laughter, Ncinzi cakabapa kugagamuna kuseka naakamana kukanana munene? = What made them roar with laughter when the old man had finished talking? (1.-gagamunwa, 2.-gagamunide, 3.-gagamuzya, 4.-gagamunina, 5.-gagamuninalyo, 6.-gagamunisya, 7.-gagamuna-gagamuna, 8.-gagamunana.)

become fixed to, remain in same position, Makololo aamundyoli akagagatila mucibiya. = The hardened scraps of the pumpkin-stew were stuck to the pot. Wagagatila, tayandi kuunka nkobamwaambila bapati. = He stays where he is, he does not want to go to where the elders tell him. (1.-gagatilwa, 2.-gagatide, 3.-gagatizya, 4.-gagatilila, 5.-gagatililalyo, 6.-gagatililisya, 7.-gagatila-gagatila, 8.-gagatilana) Also: -zyazyatila, -gagamina, -bbabbamina.

overturn clods of earth, Eliya jamba lyanombe lilagagula nyika akaambo kamulomo uubosya kapati. = That plough turns over the earth because the blade is very sharp. Also: -dadula. (1.-gagulwa, 2.-gagwide, 3.-gaguzya, 4.-gagwida, 5.-gagwidalyo, 6.-gagulisya, 7.-gagula-gagula)
be digested, rt. -gaya, Cakulya ceelede kugaigwa kabotu mwida. = Food ought to be well digested in the stomach. (2.-gaidwe, 3.-gaizya, 5.-gailwalyo)

fight one another, Mukaintu wakali kubbede mwana. Nobakagaizyanya, mukaintu wakatola sule naakawa nkujana walimbilila mwana. = The woman was carrying a child on her back. When they were fighting she fell on her back only to press down on the child. (2.-gaizyenye, 4.-gaizyanyizyizya)

accuse of a crime (sometimes unjustly or without evidence,) Basibbuku bakaile kumugala musankwa. = The headman just accused the boy of the crime unjustly. Mwakaile kumugala Muunta, taasi ngwaakali kwaamba munanga. = You have just mistakenly accused Muunta, he is not the one the witchdoctor was talking about. (1.-galwa) Also: -tama, -ganda.

stand with chest out, Wakabuka Mutinta wakkala kulungumana syuumbwa mpaakagalamene. = Mutinta woke up and sat looking up at the lion who stood with chest out. (ready to attack.) (3.-galamika, 4.-galamanina, 5.-galaminalyo, 6.-galamanisya)

be in position of standing with chest out, in Ucilanga buyo atalaa cuulu, wakajana kuti kwakaimvwi munyama ugalamenyi, mmunyati. When he just looked on top of the termite hill he found an animal standing with chest out, it was a buffalo. (3.-galamenyika, 4.-galamenyina)

kick for joy, as cattle, Boombe nibakamana kunyonka bakagalamuka. When the calves had finished sucking they kicked for joy. Also: -gatuuka. (2.-galamukide, 3.-galamusya, 4.-galamukila, 5.-galamukilalyo, 6.-galamukisya)

become too hard, Busu bwaindilila kuvwula, aboobo nsima yaile kugalangana kuyuma. = There is too much mealie-meal and so the nsima has hardened in drying up. (When used as a noun, Eeyi nsima yayuma mugalanganga. This food has dried into hard lumps.) (2.-galanganide, 3.-galanganya, 4.-galanganina, 5.-galanganinalyo, 6.-galanganisya)
  • be ugly, Sunu Mutinta wakaile kugalangana kumeso akaambo kakutalya kabotu. Mutinta has now an ugly face because she has not been eating well. Also: -kolobbana.

punctuate sentences of a tale with interjections, Kamugalangatisya kuti muntu watalika kwaana. = You should be responding with the interjection, "galangati' at sentence intervals, when someone has started telling a story. (1.-galangatisyigwa, 2,.-galangatisyide, 3.-galangatizya, 4.-galangatisyila, 6.-galangatisyisya, 8.-galangatizyanya)
be in an ugly state, rt. galangana, Eeci cintu cakabezegwa cakali kwiide kugalangene. This thing which was carved was just very ugly. (2.-galanganide)

run hard, Basankwa nibagaluka kulunduka boonse bakazwa nkasaalo. When the boys ran hard they were all sweating. (1.-galukwa, 2.-galwide, 3.-galuzya, 4.-galukila, 5.-galukilalyo, 6.-galukisya, 7.-galuka-galuka)

run hard, Bamwi nokuba kuti bagalula, tiibazwa mitukuta. = Even though some have run hard, they have not perspired. (1.-galulwa, 2.-galulide, 4.-galulila, 5.-galwidalyo, 6.-galulisya)
  • dig hard when earth is dry, Bakali kugalula nyika noiyuma. = They were digging the earth even though it was hard.

refer to, take a direction, Baama bagama nzila iiya kwa Munguza kumbo. My mother took the path westwards leading to Munguza. Syuumbwa naakali kutanda baweza, wakamugama mudaala wakajisi ntobolo. When the lion was chasing the hunters, it went towards the old man who had a gun. (1.-gamwa, 2.-gamide, 3.-gamya, 4.-gamina, 5.-gaminalyo, 6.-gamisya, 7.-gama-gama, 8.-gamana.)
  • speak straight-forwardly, Mutani kwaambi masendelela, kamugama biyo. = *Don't speak indirectly, just speak directly.*

throb with pain, Cikopo cilagamauka. = I have a splitting headache. Mutwe wiile kugamauka akaambo kamunzuwe wabukoko bwajilo. = The head is throbbing because of the hangover from yesterday's beer. (2.-gamaukide, 3.-gamusya, 4.-gamaukila, 5.-gamaukilalyo 6.-gamaukisya, 7.-gamauka-gamauka)

stick on, Kamugambika cigamba ciyumu. = Stick on a strong patch. (1.-gambikwa, 2.-gambikide, 3.-gambya or gambikizya or gambizya, 4.-gambikila, 5.-gambikilalyo, 6.-gambikisya, 7.-gambika-gambika, 8.-gambikana) Also: -lamika.

sew patches on, Lyoonse nkugambilila biya zisani. = It was always a matter of putting patches on the clothes. (1.-gambililwa, 2.-gambilide, 3.-gambilizya, 4.-gambililila, 5.-gambilililalyo, 6.-gambililisya, 7.-gambilila-gambilila, 8.-gambililana)

be surprised, Tatweelede kugambwa kuti muntu ulemenede walubizya nkaambo awalo mmuntu mbuli ndiswe. = We ought not be surprised if an important person makes a mistake, because s/he is also a human being like us. (2.-gambidwe, 3.-gambizyigwa, 7.-gambwa-gambwa) Also: -nyandwa, kankamana, -ankamana.
cause astonishment, Cilagambya kubona mwami katukila bantu. = It is shocking to see the chief insulting people.

refers to, belongs to, Nokuba kuti mwana wakusaanguna teesi wakwe, inga wazyala akale kumpela amazuba bamugamide. = Even though the first child was not his, but she gave birth later on in the passing of days, the children who were his. (3.-gamika, 4.-gamya)

lead in the direction of, Babbi bakazigamika kumugwagwa mupati mpongo kutegwa mano atalibonyi. = The thieves took the goats to the main road so that their footprints would not be visible. (1.-gamikwa, 2.-gamikide)

refer directly to, rt. -gama, Ndali kugaminina kwaambila basicikolo. = I was very direct in speaking to the pupils. Eeyi nombe njiyangu njacigaminina. = This cow is my own personal property. (1.-gamininwa, 2.-gaminide, 3.-gaminizya, 7.-gaminina-gaminina, 8.-gamininana.)

laugh loudly, Wakagamuka kuseka nindakamwaambila makani asesya. = He roared laughing when I told him the amusing news. (1.-gamukwa, 2.-gamukide, 3.-gamuzya, 4.-gamukila, 5.-gamukilalyo, 6.-gamukisya, 7.-gamuka-gamuka, 8.-gamukana)
  • do with force, Kusya nyika njumu nkugamuka nkaambo nciyumu. = To dig hard earth is to use force because it is hard.
  • throb with pain, Mutwe wakali kwiile kugamuka busiku boonse. = My head was throbbing throughout the night. Also: -gamauka.

direct towards, rt. -gama, Kozigamya kujwe nombe nkozitiikakkute kabotu. = Take the cattle to the east where they will have enough to eat. (1.-gamizyigwa, 2.-gamizyide, 7.-gamyagamya, 8.-gamizyanya.) Also: -gamika.

pound hard grains to produce flour, Nobasimbi, kamuganda mapopwe aayo aali mucisuwo. = Girls, pound those maize grains which are in the basket. (1.-gandwa, 2.-gandide, 3.-gandya, 4.-gandila, 5.-gandilalyo, 6.-gandisya, 7.-ganda-ganda, 8.-gandana.)
  • accuse, Waile kundiganda akati kabeenzuma nokuba kuti tiindakacicita. = He just accused me among my friends even though I did not do it. Also: -tama, -gala.

lie on back, lean backwards, Twajana cakolwa wagandama akati kamugwagwa. = We found the drunkard lying flat on the road. (1.-gandamwa, 2.-gandeme, 3.-gandamya, 4.-gandamina, 5.-gandaminalyo, 6.-gandamisya, 7.-gandama-gandama) Also: -gadama, -salama, -ngandama.

make holes, Tiimwali kulimina pe, mwali kuya kugangaika buyo. = You were not weeding properly at all, you were just making holes. (1.-gangaikwa, 2.-gangaikide, 3.-gangaikizya, 4.-gangaikila, 5.-gangaikilalyo, 6.-gangaikisya, 7.-gangaika-gangaika)

quarrel vehemently, Nitwakali ku Lusaka twakajana basimbi bobilo balagangana mumugwagwa. = When we were in Lusaka we found two women quarreling on the road. (1.-ganganwa, 2.-ganganide, 3.-ganga-nya, 4.-ganganina, 5.-ganganinalyo, 6.-ganganisya, 7-gangana-gangana, 8.-gangana.) Also: -kangana, -zwangana.

make holes for sowing, Kamusyanga mapopwe muzilindi nzimwali kuganka. Plant the maize in the holes you were making. (1.-gankwa, 2.-gankide, 3.-gankizya, 4.-gankila, 5.-gankilalyo, 6.-gankisya, 7.-ganka-ganka, 8.-gankana)
  • break off in middle of speech, Ncibotu kumanizya twaambo kwiinda kuganka buyo. It is good to complete what you are saying rather than breaking off.
  • eat porridge without relish, Nseyandi kuganka nsima. = I don't want to eat nsima without relish. Also: -buya nsima.
  • hobble, Walikuganka buyo kweenda nkaambo gondo lilizimbide. = He was just hobbling because his knee is swoolen.
  • strike with elbow, Chiimba watolwa kucibbadela nkaambo mweenzinyina wa-muganka kakokola amulomo. Chiimba was taken to hospital because his friend had elbowed him in the mouth.
break off, Wagankaika kuyeeya. He broke off thinking.

hop on one leg, hobble with a stick, rt. -ganka, Wakaligankila kweenda akasako nkaambo kuulu kwakwe kwakalityokede. He was helping himself along with a stick because his leg was broken. Also: -gantila. (1.-gankilwa, 2.-gankilide, 3.-gankizya, 4.-gankilila, 5.-gankililalyo, 6.-gankilisya, 7.-gankila-gankila, 8.-gankilana.)
  • dig as you plant, Kamugankila kusyanga nyemu. Use a hoe when planting groundnuts. Bakali kugankila mumwezi wa Itwi. They were planting (by making holes) in the month of August. (i.e. before the rains).

help with, Mudaala wakatobela mbongolo munsi kayaabuli-gankizya akasako. The old man followed the donkey behind helping himself along with a stick. Amane kulya, wakajokezya maboko aakwe, waligankizya atukokozwi, wabuka, wakkala. When she had finished eating, the power returned to her arms, she helped herself up with her elbows, she rose, she sat. Mucembele oyu takonzyi kweenda natajisi kafwunko kakuligankizya naenda. This old woman is unable to walk without having a stick to help her along as she walks. (1.-gankizigwa, 2.-gankizyizye, 4.-gankizyizya)

resow, Katugankulula muya mwaatakazwa mapopwe. = Let us go and resow the maize there where it did not germinate. (1.-gankululwa, 2.-gankulwide, 3.-gankuluzya, 4.-gankulwida, 5.-gankulwidalyo, 6.-gankululisya, 7.-gankulula-gankulula, 8.-gankulwidana.) Also: -syangulula.

be planted in holes, Mvwula yacivwuna-nombe yakamenesya mbuto zyakasyangwa muzilindi zyakali kugankwa mucivwu ciyumu. = The first rains caused the seed to germinate which had been planted in the holes made in dry soil.

strike, Munanga wakaganta mulwazi amutwe akumuvwupuula amubili ajingo. = The witchdoctor struck the patient on the head and sprinkled him with the long tail of a gnu. Wakanyamuna jamba akuti agante ansi. = He raised the hoe to strike the ground. (1.-gantwa, 2.-gantide, 3.-gantya, 4.-gantila, 5.-gantilalyo, 6.-gantisya, 7.-ganta-ganta, 8.-gantana)
  • tramp along, Moonga naakabula ncinga yakutanta, wakaganta buyo amaulu kuya ku Monze. When Moonga had no bicycle to ride, he just tramped along going to Monze. Also: -janda.
  • state or question another with remarks which you are not sure of, Nacintu wakaide kuganta-ganta kubuzya Masowe = Nacintu was just questioning Masowe with uncertain questions.

shake the ground with footsteps, Nyika yalikuzungaana naali kugantaila kweenda. = The ground shook because he was pounding along heavily as he walked. (1.-gantailwa, 2.-gantailide, 3.-gantaizya, 4.-gantailila, 5.-gantaililalyo, 6.-gantailisya, 7.-gantaila-gantaila)

hobble, Munene ulaligantila akasako nkaambo wacembaala. = The old man is hobbling along with a stick because he is old. (2.-gantilide, 3.-ganti lizya, 4.-gantilila, 5.-gantililalyo, 6.-gantilisya, 7.-gantila-gantila) Also: -gankila, -jintaila.
be struck, rt.-ganta, MuIwazi wakagantwa amutwe akuvwupuulwa amubili ajingo. = The patient was struck on the head and sprinkled with the long tail of a gnu.

dig hard ground, with hoe or mattock, Basankwa bobilo bakalikuganyuna nyika njumu. The two boys were digging the hard ground energetically. (1.-ganyunwa, 2.-ganywide, 3.-ganyuzya, 4.-ganyunina, 5.-ganywidalyo, 6.-ganyunisya, 7.-ganyunaganyuna, 8.-ganyunana.) Also: manyuna.

guard, act as sentry, (ety. English), Nobakali kulila bantu, bamwi bakali kwiide kugatela bina Jesi amwanaabo. When the people were mourning, some were just guarding the mother of Jesi and her child. (1.-gatelwa, 2.-gatelede, 3.-gatelezya, 4.-gatelela, 5.-gatelelalyo, 6. -gatelesya, 7.-gatela-gatela, 8.-gatelana.)

kick for joy as cattle, Babutu balagatuuka nobasobana. = The calves kick for joy when they play. (1.-gatuukwa, 2.-gatuukide, 3.-gatuuzya, 4.-gatuukila, 5.-gatuukilalyo, 6.-gatuukisya, 7.-gatuuka-gatuuka) Also: -galamuka, -tambala, -mwansauka

become mad, wail, Mubwa wakagauka jilo. = A dog went mad yesterday. Wakasoka wagauka kulila mukaintu wakwe. He began to wail for his wife. (1.-gaukwa, 2.-gaukide, 3.-gausya, 4.-gaukila, 5.-gaukilalyo, 6.-gaukisya. 7.-gauka-gauka, 8.-gauzyanya) Also: -cinkuka, sondoka.
make mad, wail, Cakamugaula ndubanje ndubaamufwebya. What made her mad was the dagga which they made her smoke.
make mad, Lubanje lulagausya kuti waindilizya kulufweba. = Dagga will make one go mad if one smokes it a lot.
arouse, rt. -gaula, Chikwamaala wakasiba mweembo akugawida basikuzemba. = Chikwamaala blew the horn and aroused the mourners. (1.-gawidwa, 2.-gawidide, 8.-gawidana)

grind grain, mince, Baya kukugaya busu basimbi. = The girls are going to grind the mealie-meal. Kamugaya masembe kutegwa tukumbe cibwantu. = Grind the grains of meal so that we make light beer. (1.-gayigwa, 2.-gayide, 3.-gayizya, 4.-gayila, 5.-gayilalyo, 6.-gayisya, 7.-gaya-gaya, 8.-gayilana.)
  • fit on anklets, Kamwale wakali kugaya malanda. = The initiate was fitting on anklets.
  • chew, Kogaya kabotu mangamwe aya mukanwa kutegwa atakumyongi. = Chew these grains of maize properly in your mouth so that they do not upset your stomach.
hold tightly, Wakaligazizya naakali kutanta malele. = He held tightly when he was climbing the ladder.

cut hair with scissors, shear, Ndiyanda kumugela mukulu mwana ooyu. = I want to shave this child bald. (1.-gelwa, 2.-gelede, 3.-gezya, 4.-gelela, 5.-gelelalyo, 6.-gelesya, 7.-gela-gela, 8.-gelana.)
  • cheat, (idiomatic use) Kuti tamucenjeli, oyu simuula nombe ulamugela kumakosi. = If you are not careful this cattle dealer will shave the back of your head. i.e. will cheat you. Also: -nyengelela.
dislocate Also: -jejeuka

be shaved, Bantu boonse bakajatwa bulozi bakagelwa minkulu akuyasaulwa nsimbo mitwe yoonse. = All those who were convicted of witchcraft were shaven bald and were cut with tattoes all over their heads. (1.-geledwe, 3.-gezyedwe, 4.-gelelwa, 5.-gelelwalyo, 6.-gelesyegwa, 7.-gelwa-gelwa)
refers to, rt. -gama, Eyi nyama njiyangu. Ili ndigeme. This meat is mine, it belongs to me. (1.-gemwe, 8.-gemene)

wrestle, Bana bobilo bakali kugigilisyanya kwaciindi cilamfwu = The two children were wrestling with one another for a long time. (1.-gigilsyigwa, 2.-gigilisyenye, 4.-gigilisyanyizizya) Also: -gagalisyanya, jijilisyanya, -bbabbalisyanya.

hook, as on a barbed wire, Lwakandigoba luwaile nitwakali kutija njombe iiluma. = The barbed wire caught me when we were running away from the cow which attacks. (1.-gobwa, 2.-gobede, 3.-gobezya, 4.-gobezyezya, 5.-gobekelalyo, 6.-gobekesya, 7.-goba-goba, 8.-gobana) Also: -oba.

walk with slow steps, Ncagobaila kweenda talimvwide kabotu. = The reason that he is walking slowly is that he is not feeling well. (1.-gobailwa, 2.-gobailide, 3.-gobaizya, 4.-gobailila, 5.-gobaililalyo, 6.-gobailisya, 7.-gobailagobaila.)

hit as with stick, Bakazigobbola njombe mumuunda nobakali kulima. = They hit the oxen with sticks when they were ploughing in the field. (1.-gobbolwa, 2.-gobbolede, 3.-gobbozya, 4.-gobbweda, 5.-gobbwedalyo, 6.-gobbolosya, 7.-gobbola-gobbola, 8.-gobbolana.) Also: -bbontoola.
  • peck, strike with beak, Inkuku zigobbola maambukwa amwana. = The chickens are pecking where the baby defecated. Sikakoze nguugobbola nkuku njaakwempa. = It is a jackal buzzard which strikes the hen which it snatches with its beak.
  • clear field, Wakagobbola muunda mupati. = He cleared a big field. Also: -panda, -kobola.
  • pull out as an eye, e.g Cungwe waka-agobbola meso amubwa ufwide. The vulture pulled out the eyes of the dead dog. Also: -labula

hang as cloth on hook, Kamucigobeka cisani kucisamu ooko. = Hang the dress on the tree over there. Also: -anzika. (1.-gobekwa, 2.-gobekede, 3.-gobekezya, 4.-gobekela, 5.-gobekelalyo, 6.-gobekesya, 7.-gobeka-gobeka, 8.-gobekana.)

get stuck in or on, rt. -goba, Mweembezi walila naamugobelela kukutwi mamvwa = The shepherd cried when the thorns hooked him by the ear. (1.-gobelelwa, 2.-gobelede, 3.-gobelezya, 4.-gobelezyezya, 5.-gobelelalyo, 6.-gobelelesya, 7.-gobelela-gobelela, 8.-gobelelana.)

peck, Twamubona jule naali kugobola nzoka. = We saw a secretary bird when it was pecking at a snake. (1.-gobolwa, 2.-gobolede, 3.-gobozya, 4.-gobolela, 5.-gobolelalyo, 6.-gobolesya, 7.-gobola-gobola, 8.-gobolana.) Also: -njomona, -jomona, -goma, -jobola, -goma, -domona, -domwena, -zomona.
undo by pulling, Kofwa-mbaana kundigobolola kalobo kandigobelela. Quickly undo the hook which has hooked me. Also: -gobonona

unhook rt. -goba, Cazauka cisani naali kugobonona kuzwisya mucisamu. = The dress was torn when she was pulling it off the tree. (1.-gobononwa, 2.-gobonwede, 3.-gobonozya, 4.-gobononena, 5.-gobonwedalyo, 6.-gobononesya, 7.-gobonona-gobonona, 8.-gobononana.) Also: -obolola.

strike with beak repeatedly, Kayuni, nkaanga simugomagoma, kali kugoboola mucisamu. = The little bird, the woodpecker, was repeatedly striking with its beak in the tree. Also: -goma-goma. (1.-goboolwa, 2.-gobweede, 3.-goboozya, 4.-gobweeda, 5.-gobweedalyo, 6.-goboolesya, 7.-goboola-goboola, 8.-goboolana.)

sound of train as it struggles to pull a heavy load, Citima akalundu noceenda cilagoccoka. The train puffs and heaves as it goes. Akalundu noceenda citima cilalila cilati, "Ndakatala! Ndazitola! Ndabatola! Ndagoccoka! Ndasukuluka! When the train is going up the hill it cries, it says, "I am tired! I am taking goods! I am taking people! I am struggling! I am exhausted! (2.-goccwede, 3.-goccozya, 4.-goccokela, 5.-goccokelalyo, 6.-goccokesya, 7.-goccoka-goccoka)

look without respect, (ety. Sindebele?) Ooyu mwana ulagodola kulanga bapati, talemeki. This child looks at the elders disrespectfully, he has bad manners. (2.-godolede, 3.-godozya, 4.-godolela, 5.-godolelalyo, 6.-godolesya, 7.-godola-godola, 8.-godolana) Also: -nyansya.

sit with satifaction, Naakamana kubauma boonse munanda, wakaakwiide kugodomana acuuno cipati. = When he had finished beating all in the house, he just sat with satisfaction in a big chair. (1.-godomanwa, 2.-godomenye, 3.-godomanya, 4.-godomanina, 5.-godomaninalyo, 6.-godomanisya, 7.-godomana-godomana)
be in a contented state, Naakasika kuzwa kubukoko wakaligodomene munsaa mulilo. When he arrived from the beer he sat contentedly beside the fire. Also: -gogomene

bow the head in shame, Naazulwa kaambo, wagodyaama buyo. When he was found to be guilty, he just bowed his head in shame. (1.-godyaamwa, 2.-godyaamide, 3.-godyaamya, 4.-godyaamina, 5.-godyaaminalyo, 6.-godyaamisya, 7.-godyaama-godyaama)
bend down towards, Wakagodyomanina kumutumbu ooku kumwi kapetekezya majwi amwi. = He bent down towards his wife while whispering a few words.
be in a state of guilt, Ndiinga Mudyaka liide kugodyomene lyagunwa mpolikkede. Big Mudyaka was just in a state of guilt, ashamed where he sat.

clothe oneself, Kogoga buluke busubila mboyelelwa kabotu. = Put on your red pair of trousers which suits you. (as a noun, cigogo = a garment) Also: -sama (1.-gogwa, 2.-gogwede, 4.-gogela 5.-gogelalyo, 6.-gogesya, 7.-goga-goga)

be twisted out of shape, Cimbayambaya cakagogama nicakanjila muntenda yamumugwagwa. The vehicle was twisted out of shape when it was involved in a traffic accident. (2.-gogamide, 3.-gogamya, 4.-gogamina, 5.-gogaminalyo, 6.-gogamisya, 7.-gogama-gogama) Also: -ongama, -zyondongana.

go with head inclined in shame, Wagogola kumpela abantu walibonya bufwubafwuba. Going with your head bent in shame before people shows that you are foolish. Also: -godya(a)ma, -godama (1.-gogolwa, 2.-gogwede, 3.-gogozya, 4.-gogweda, 5.-gogwedalyo, 6.-gogolesya, 7.-gogola-gogola)

undress, Komugogolola cibaki Mwiinga ulacibisya tombe. = Take off the blouse from Mwiinga's body, she will make it dirty. Kamugogolola musambe amundolomena. Undress so that you wash with the mundolomena root. (Instruction given during the smallpox epidemic.) (1.-gogololwa, 2.-gogolwede, 3.-gogolozya, 4.-gogolweda, 5.-gogolwedalyo, 6.-gogololesya, 7.-gogolola-gogolola, 8.-gogololana.) Also: -samununa.

bow head, have head inclined, Kamugogomana mitwe mbuli mbotucita mucikombelo. = Bow your heads down just as we do in the church. Naakajatwa mwanalumi, wakaide kugogomana. = When the husband was caught, he just bowed his head in shame. (1.-gogomekwa, 2.-gogomenye, 3.-gogomeka, 4.-gogomanina, 5.-gogomaninalyo, 6.-gogomanisya, 7.-gogomana-gogomana, 8.-gogomekana) Also: -sintama, -tukumana.
bend, Kamugogomeka kawayile tucezye mafwuleenke = Bend the wire so that we hook the oranges.

be in a bent or curved state, rt. -gogomana, Kasamu aaka kaligogomene. = This stick is bent. Basimbi bamwi basama maluke atondezya mubili moonse mougogomene. = Some girls wear trousers which show how the body is curved.

peck with beak, Nkuku zyali kugogomona amulyango nizyayanda kulya. The chickens were pecking at the door when they wanted to eat. (1.-gogomonwa, 2.-gogomode, 3.-gogomozya, 4.-gogomweda, 5.-gogomwedalyo, 6.-gogomonesya, 7.-gogomona-gogomona, 8.-gogomonana.) Also: -goma-goma.

tap gently, Wakagogomwena atafwule naakayanda kwa ambaula kubeenzinyina. = He tapped gently on the table when he wanted to talk to his friends. Also: -gunkunya, -goma-goma. (1.-gogomwenwa, 2.-gogomwede, 3.-gogomwezya, 4.-gogomweda, 5.-gogomwedalyo, 6.-gogomwesya, 7.-gogomwena-gogomwena)

become stiff, Wagogonyana kukkala mbwaali kulivwunga. = He became stiff from sitting in a crouched position. Also: -kokonyana. (1.-gogonyanwa, 2.-gogonyanide, 3.-gogonyeka, 4.-gogonyanina, 5.-gogonyaninalyo, 6.-gogonyanisya, 7.-gogonyana-gogonyana)
  • be shriveled up, Mapopwe akaile kugogonyana akaambo kaciyuma-yuma, taakamena kabotu. = The maize shriveled up because of the drought, it did not germinate well. Also: -kokonyana.

move with difficulty, due to age, illness etc. Ooyu musankwa ugogoteka mbuli mucembele akaambo kakuciswa. = This boy walks like an old woman because of sickness. Also: -konkoteka. (2.-gogotekede, 3.-gogotesya, 4.-gogotekela, 5.-gogotekelalyo, 6.-gogotekesya, 7.-gogoteka-gogoteka)

flatter, praise with false words, rt. -gogola, Musankwa ugogweda musimbi mutwaambo twaku-beja. = The boy is flattering the girl with lies. (1.-gogwedwa, 2.-gogwede, 3.-gogwezya, 4.-gogwedela, 5.-gogwedelalyo, 6.-gogwedesya, 7.-gogweda-gogweda, 8.-gogwedana.)
bow in acceptance, rt. gogola, Awalo musimbi wali kwiile kugogwede nabejelwa. = And the girl was bowing in agreement when she was being flattered.
bow head, Haatubwantu nobamulanga wakaligogwele kumwi ka sansamuna nkasaalo kumeso. = As they looked at Haatubwantu he was just looking down while wiping the sweat from his face.

end, Cagola caano. = The story has finished. Bwina bwambeba bwakagola. = The hole of the rat came to an end. Ndagola. = I am finished (devastated). Mazuba naagola, myaka niigola, ciindi camunzi wakwa Leza tacigoli, cili atalaa zeezi zyoonse. = When the days finish, when the years finish, the time of God's dwelling does not finish, it is above all these things. (2.-golede, 3.-gozya, 4.-golela, 5.-golelalyo, 6.-golesya, 7.-golagola, 8.-gozyanya) Also: -simpa
finish or end up, Tiiyakali kulibonya nzoka nkoyakali kugolela. = It was not seen where the snake ended. (i.e. it was so long that you could not see the tail of it.)

eat first crops, Agoloka, mpaamanina nzala. = When people eat the first crops, that is when the hunger ends. (1.-golokwa, 2.-golokede, 3.-golosya, 4.-golokela, 5.-golokelalyo, 6.-golokesya, 7.-goloka-goloka).

fall into a hole or over a cliff, Mupati wangu wagolokela mucilindi nitwali kuvwima. = My elder brother fell into a hole when we were hunting. (1.-golokelwa, 2.-golokede, 3.-golokezya, 4.-golokelela, 5.-golokelelalyo, 6.-golokelesya, 7.-golokela-golokela)

drop something into, Mwana wagolokezya bbodela mumugoti. = The child has dropped a bottle into the well. Also: -dumpikizya, -dyumpukizya. (1.-golokezyegwa, 2.-golokezyede, 3.-golokezyezya, 4.-golokezyela, 5.-golokezyelalyo, 6.-golokezyesya, 7.-golokezya-golokezya, 8.-golokezyanya.)

break up earth, make to crumble, Nkomwe yamulonga yakagolomoka lyakawa mvwula mpati. = The v-177 river bank collapsed during the heavy rains. (2.-golomokede, 3.-golomozya, 4.-golomokela, 5.-golomokelalyo, 6.-golomokesya, 7.-golomoka-golomoka)

mix up languages, Mubbi nibamuuma kapati basilikani, *wacigolonga cisyobo citamvwugwi.* = When the thief was beaten by the police, he spoke a language which was not understood. Munanga wakatalika kugolonga mucisyobo cakwe *citamvwugwi.* = The witchdoctor began to make utterances in his unintelligible language. (1.-golongwa, 2.-golongede, 3.-golongesya, 4.-golonganizigwa, 5.-golonganizigwalyo, 7.-golonga-golonga.)

making noise by moving things around, *Nguni uugolonganya tugabba munanda oomu?* = Who is making noise by banging the tins together in the house? Basimbi bakali kugolonganya mitiba munanda. = The girls were arranging the dishes noisily in the house. Also: -gwelenganya. (1.-golonganyizigwa, 2.-golongenye, 4.-golonganizyizya, 6.-golonganyisya)
  • mix up languages, Ooyu muntu ulagolonganya kwaamba nkaambo uzyi milaka minji. = This person is mixing up language as s/he speaks because s/he knows many languages. *Nsecimvwi eco ncomugolonganya.* = I do not understand that mixed-up langauge of yours.

peck with the beak, bite, *Inkuku igoma mapopwe.* = The chicken is pecking at the maize. *Inzoka yagoma mwana walikusobana.* = The snake bit the child who was playing. Also: -tongola, -gobola, -jomona. (1.-gomwa, 2.-gomede, 3.-gomya, 4.-gomena, 5.-gomenalyo, 6.-gomesya, 7.-goma-goma, 8.-gomana.)
peck, tap gently, *Nkuku zilagoma-goma ansi aalikuwida busenga.* = The chickens are pecking at the ground where the dregs were falling. Also: -goboola.

pick up by luck, Ndagomena mali mukazila kaya kwa Haamalambo. = Luckily I picked up some money on the path which goes to Haamalambo. (1.-gomenwa, 2.-gomenede 3.-gomya, 4.-gomeneda, 5.-gomenedalyo, 6.-gomenesya, 7.-gomena-gomena, 8.-gomenana.) Also: -bwezela.
  • speak confidentially, *Ncekwaambila ncigomena mulomo.* = What I am telling you is confidential.

take what is not yours, depend on other people, *Sena ncibotu lili kunikugomenena twabantu?* = When is it ever good to be always taking the things of other people? (1.-gomenenwa, 2.-gomenede, 3.-gomya, 4.-gomeneda, 5.-gomenedalyo, 6.-gomenesya, 7.-gomenena-gomenena, 8.-gomenenana.)

fall off, as plaster, *Cakagomooka cintoolo nkocili kunze.* = The plaster at the back of the shop fell off. (2.-gomookede, 3.-gomoozya, 4.-gomookela, 5.-gomookelalyo, 6.-gomookesya, 7.-gomooka-gomooka)

strike with beak, *Ijuni lyakamugomoona mukaintu akumukwambula.* = The big bird struck the woman with its beak and scratched her. (1.-gomoonwa, 2.-gomoonede, 3.-gomoonesya, 4.-gomoonena, 5.-gomoonenalyo, 6.-gomoonesya. 7.-gomoona-gomoona, 8.-gomoonana.)
  • break in pieces, *Basankwa bagomoona nkomwe yamulonga kutegwa babambe cito.* = The boys are breaking the bank of the river so that they make a ford. (or drift).

peck with beak, *Inkuku zigomwena mapopwe aatika.* = The hens are eating maize grains which spilled over. (1.-gomwenwa, 3.-gomwezya, 4.-gomwenena, 5.-gomwenenalyo, 6.-gomwenesya, 7.-gomwena-gowena, 8.-gomwenana.) Also: -goma-goma.
*nanda yagongola* = the ridge of a house.

cut a tree, *Ndiya kukugonka zisamu zyacaanda cangulube.* = I am going to cut timber for the piggery. (1.gonkwa, 2.-gonkede, 3.-gonkezya, / gonsya, 4.-gonkela, 5.-gonkelalyo, 6.-gonkesya, 7.-gonka-gonka, 8.-gonkana.)
  • amputate, *Basilisi bakagonka maulu abantu banji ciindi cankondo.* = The doctors amputated the legs of many people during the war. Also: -kosola.
  • endanger a child who is still suckling by becoming pregnant again, *Kuti mukaintu wamita kacinyonsya inga wamugonka mwana.* = If a woman conceives while she is still suckling a child, she endangers the child.

help to walk, *Ndajana mulwazi ulaligonkaila akasako.* = I found the patient helping himself to walk with a stick. (1.-gonkailwa, 2.-gonkailide, 3.-gonkailizya, 4.-gonkailila, 5.-gonkaililalyo, 6.-gonkailisya, 7.-gonkaila-gonkaila)

help oneself to walk, as with a stick or crutches, *Ulaligonkaizya.* = He walks by himself using crutches. (1.-gonkaizigwa, 2.-gonkaizyide, 4.-gonkaizizya, 5.-gonkaizizyalyo, 6.-gonkaizisya, 7.-gonkaizya-gonkaizya, 8.-gonkaizyanya.) Also: -gankizya

be in a state of weakness, *Uligonkedwe mumazwi akaambo kanzala.* = He is in a state of weakness at the knees because of the hunger. *Uligonkedwe nkaambo kakwiile kulya miteezi lyoonse.* = She is in a state of weakness because of always eating okra. (3.-gonkezya, 4.-gonkelelwa, 5.-gonkelelwalyo, 6.-gonkezyesya, 7.-gonkezya-gonkezya, 8.-gonkezyanya)
drag along, drag along, *Mudaala wakali kwiile kuligonkeezya kweenda.* = The old man was just dragging himself along. Also: -gonkelya.
plod, drag, *Mutinta wakalicisidwe cakunga wakali kwiile kuligonkelya.* = Mutinta was so ill that she was just dragging herself along. Also: -gonkeezya.

become very weak and stiff with hunger, *Akaambo kakutalya, Cheelo wagonkelwa.* = Because of not eating, Cheelo has become weak. *Inga wagonkelwa kuti koide kulya lunkomba.* = You will be weak if you just eat okra. (2.- gonkedwe) Also: -konkelwa.
  • cut for, *Bacembele bagonkelwa ziyako kuti bayakilwe nanda.* = Poles have beem cut for the construction of the old woman's house.

sap energy, *Inzala ilagonkezya.* = Hunger saps ones energy. *Banyina wakalanga mwanaabo mbuli kuti wabaambila agonkezya mumafwuwa.* = The mother looked at her daughter as if she (the daughter) had told her something which took away her (mother's) energy.

hit with knuckles or stick, *Bacigonkola cisankwa cakali kusabila kapati mucikolo.* = They struck the brat with the knuckles who was making a lot of noise in the class. *Bayi bamugonkola mwana mumutwe.* = The teacher struck the child with a stick on the head. Also: -konkola. (1.-gonkolwa, 2.-gonkwede, 3.-gonkozya, 4.-gonkweda, 5.-gonkwedalyo, 6.-gonkolesya, 7.-gonkola-gonkola, 8.-gonkolana.)

hack, chop off, trim off, cut wood *Kamucigonkolola ciluli cabutala kutegwa bwizu bweelane.* = Trim the grass on the granary so that it is even. (1.-gonkololwa, 2.-gonkolwede, 3.-gonkolozya, 4.-gonkolweda, 5.-gonkolwedalyo, 6.-gonkololesya, 7.-gonkolola-gonkolola, 8.-gonkololana)

cut up as meat, cut off branch, Bana bagonkoola nyama. = The children are cutting up the meat. (1.-gonkoolwa, 2.-gonkweede, 3.-gonkoozya, 4.-gonkweeda, 5.-gonkweedalyo, 6.-gonkoolesya, 7.-gonkoola-gonkoola, 8.-gonkweedana.) Also: -yasaula.

be cut, as wood, Ziyako zyagonkololwa kuti zyeelane. = The poles have been cut to equal sizes. Nkuni zyagonkoolwa kale. = The firewood has been cut already. Ayalo nyama yamafwuwa yagonkoolwa kale. = Even the bone-meat has been cut up already. (2.-gonkolwedwe)
be amputated, Ciindi cankondo bantu banji bakagonkwa maulu. = During the war, many people had their legs amputated. (2.-gonkwedwe)
cut for someone, rt. gonka, Ndaciswa, ndabula undigonkweeda nkuni. = I am sick, I have no one to cut firewood for me. (1.-gonkweedwa, 2.-gonkweedwe.)

hit energetically, Mulavwu wakagonta cijazyo akutonta nanda kutegwa suntwe amukwasyi wakwe bawanyuke. = The lion hammered on the door and pushed the house to make the hyena and family jump in fear. (1.-gontwa, 2.-gontede, 3.-gontya, 4.-gontela, 5.-gontelalyo, 6.-gontesya, 7.-gonta-gonta, 8.-gontana.) Also: -gunta.

bundle up as a body, curve up the knees, Mazuba ampeyo bantu banji balaligonya noboona. = During the cold days many people gather their legs up together when they are sleeping. (1.-gonyegwe, 2.-gonyede, 3.-gonyezya, 4.-gonyezyezya, 5.-gonyezyezyalyo, 6.-gonyesya, 7.-gonya-gonya) Also: -fwinya.
  • die, Wakacita kabotu kwaagonya. = He did good to die.

rush off together, Bantu boonse bagoomoka kuya kumalende sunu. = All the people rushed off in a body to the rain-shrine. (1.-goomokwa, 2.-goomokede, 3.-goomozya, 4.-goomokela, 5.-goomokelalyo, 6.-goomokesya, 7.-goomoka-goomoka)

pour out plentifully, Bacembele bakagoomona meenda manji mucisyu. = The old woman poured a lot of water in the relish. (1.-goomonwa, 2.-goomwede, 3.-goomozya, 4.-goomokela, 5.-goomokelalyo, 6.-goomokesya, 7.-goomoka-goomoka)

come from opposite sides, collide, Citima nicakagoontana acimbaya-mbaya cakali cintu ciyoosya kulanga. = When the train collided with the truck it was a terrible thing to see. Bantu banji bakagoontana kumuswaangano watwaambo twacisi. = Many people came together at a political meeting. Also: -guntana. (1.-goontanwa, 2.-goontanide, 3.-goontanina, 5.-goontaninalyo, 6.-goontanisya, 7.-goontana-goontana)

cause to end, rt. -gola, Ndabugozya bwina nindali kusya mbeba. = I came to the end of the hole when I was digging for rats. (1.-gozyegwa, 2.-gozyede, 3.-gozyezya, 4.-gozyela, 5.-gozyelalyo, 7.-gozya-gozya, 8.-gozyanya.)
cheat, Joni waguba ncamweta-mweta. = John has cheated that is why he is smiling. Bamwi bana tabayoowi kuguba bapati. = Some children do not fear to cheat the elders. Also: -unina.
urge on, Basimbi bali kugubaizya basankwa kuti balwane. = The girls were urging on the boys to fight. (1.-gubaizyigwa, 2.-gubaizyide, 4.-gubaizyizya, 8.-gubaizyanya.) Also: -sibilizya.
dive into, Bana bakagubba mucizyiba. = The children were diving into the pond. (1.-gubbwa, 2.-gubbide, 3.-gubbya, 4.-gubbila, 5.-gubbilalyo, 6.-gubbisya, 7.-gubba-gubba)
be in a hurry, Ndakagubila ncindakaluba mali. = I was rushing that is why I forgot the money. (2.-gubilide, 3.-gubizya, 4.-gubilila, 5.-gubililalyo, 6.-gubilisya, 7.-gubila-gubila) Also: -binda.

be busy, make or do a lot of things without resting, Sunu kunyina kupumuna, ndaile kugubingana. = Today there is no rest, I am just too busy. (1.-gubinganwa, 2.-gubingene, 3.-gubinganya, 4.-gubinganina, 5.-gubinganinalyo, 6.-gubinganisya, 7.-gubingana-gubinana) Also: -jata bubi.
confuse, excite, Langa musa mebo ndaluba kubuzya nkaambo waide kundigubinganya = Look my friend I forgot to ask because you just have me excited. (1.-gubinganizyigwa)

be confused, shocked by a sudden happening, Bacembele bauluba mulembo wabo nkaambo bagubinkana nibamvwa lufwu lwamuzyukulu wabo. The old woman forgot her shawl because she was confused when she heard about the death of her grandchild. (2.-gubinkanide, 4.-gubinkanina, 5.-gubinkaninalyo, 6.-gubinkanisya, 7.-gubinkana-gubinkana, 8.-gubinkanizyanya) Also: -intila

cause to be confused, excited, upset, disturbed, Cindigubinkanya ndufwu Iwa Mutinta nkaambo wakacili mwana. The thing that upset me is the death of Mutinta because she was still young. Also: -nyonganya,-gubinganya. (1.-gubinkanyizyigwa, 2.-gubinkenye)

confuse, rt. -guba, Dyabbula taakayanda kugubizya mweenzinyina mukukanana kwakwe. = Dyabbula did not want to confuse his friend in his talking. Wakagubizya Kavwili mubukandu. = Kavwili was confused by cowardice. (1.-gubizyigwa, 2.-gubizyide, 4.-gubizyizya, 5.-gubizyizyalyo, 6.-gubizyisya, 7.-gubizya-gubizya, 8.-gubizyanya.)
stimulate, excite, Candigubunganya nkubona bantu banji baya bulila mumugwagwa. = What agitated me was to see many people going to weep on the road. Also: -gubinganya.

thunder, Imvwula ilaguduma kujulu, iyanda kuboola. = The It is thundering above, the rain is about to come. (2.-gudumide, 3.-gudumya, 4.-gudumina, 5.-guduminalyo, 6.-gudumisya, 7.-guduma-guduma) Also: -zuma.

mistreat, Cheelo ulayanda kugudyuuza bana kuti bazyali kabatako. Cheelo is fond of mistreating the children when the parents are away. (1.-gudyuuzigwa, 2.-gudyuuzide, 3.-gudyuuzia, 4.-gudyuuzizya 5.-gudyuuzizyalyo, 6.-gudyuuzisya, 7.-gudyuuza-gudyuuza, 8.-gudyuuzianya) Also: -gutauzya, -gutaika.

rumble within, Mwida mulaguguma nkaambo ndalya nsima yamakoto alimwi mmukonde. = My stomach is rumbling because I ate lumpy and halfcooked nsima. (1.-gugumwa, 2.-gugumide, 3.-gugumya, 4.-gugumina. 5.-guguminalyo, 6.-gugumisya, 7.-guguma-guguma)

bump into, Jilo masiku Moonde wakamugukula mweenzinyina nkaambo taakamubwenye. Last night Moonde bumped into his friend because he did not see him. Also: -gunkula. (1.-gugulwa, 2.-gukulide, 3.-gukuzya, 4.-gukuzyizya, 5.-gugulilayo, 6.-gukulisya, 7.-gukula-gukula, 8.-gukulana.)
bump heads, Basankwa bakagukulana mitwe nobakali kulunduka. = The boys knocked their heads against one another as they were running. Also: -guntana.

graze, hit without penetrating, as a bullet, Naakadubulwa yakamugululunta nkulu. = When he was shot, the bullet did not penetrate. (1.-gululuntwa, 2.- gululuntide, 3.-gululuntya, 4.-gululuntila, 5.-gululuntilalyo, 6.-gululuntisya, 7.-gululunta-gululunta, 8.-gululuntana.) Also: -cuzula, -kwensya, -cubbula.
rumble, Mwida lyamunene mulaguluma. The old man's stomach rumbles within. Also: -guuma (1.-gulumwa, 2.-gulumide, 3.-gulumya, 4.-gulumina, 5.-guluminalyo, 6.-gulumisya, 7.-guluma-guluma.)

go around looking for something, Mucembele wakali kugulunga kuyandaula ngoma yatombwe = The old woman is going around searching for the box of snuff. (1.-gulungwa, 2.-gulungide, 3.-gulunganya, 4.-gulunganina, 5.-gulunganinalyo, 6.-gulunganisya, 7.-gulunga-gulunga.) Also: -fwulunga.

be disturbed, Moyo wakwe wakali kuzuzuma akugulungana. = His heart was trembling and disturbed. (1.-gulunganwa, 2.-gulunganide, 3.-gulunganya, 4.-gulunganyizyizya, 5.-gulunganinalyo, 6.-gulunganisya, 7.-gulungana-gulungana.)

make a disturbing noise, Basikoswe bakali kugulunganya muzigwedegwede moonse. = The rats were making noise among all the goods. Also: -gwetenganya, -gwelenganya.
  • disturb, make beat fast, Icaamba bataata candigulunganya moyo. = What my father has said has disturbed my heart. Also: -duntausya.

bruise one another, e.g Basankwa bobilo nibakali kusobana bbola bakaguluntana. = When the two boys were playing football they bruised one another. Also: -cuzulana. (1.-guluntwa, 2-guluntide, 4.-guluntya, 5.-guluntilalyo, 6.-guluntisya)
touch, Kuguma muntu ufwide ndayoowa. I am afraid to touch a person who is dead. (1.-gumwa, 2.-gumide, 3.-gumya, 4.-gumina, 5.-guminalyo, 6.-guminsya, 7.-guma-guma, 8.-gumana.)
touch repeatedly, Wali kundiguma-guma amutwe nitwali kupaila. He was repeatedly touching me on the head when we were praying.

touch one another, meet, Kamugumana kukkala basa nkaambo busena mbusyoonto. Sit close to each other my friends because the space is small.
  • be fulfilled, carried out, Mazubaano ziyaabugumana zyaalemba basinsimi mu Bbaibbele. These days the things which were written by the prophets in the Bible have come to pass. Also: - zuzikizigwa.

put in contact, Kogumika mulomo wamwana alukolo kuti atalike kunyonka. Bring the mouth of the child to touch the breast so that it can begin to suck. Kuti watugumika buteelede tuwaile twamagesi, inga akukwela magesi. = If you connect the electrical wires wrongly, you can have an electrical shock. (1.-gumikwa, 2.-gumikide, 3.-gumikizya, 4.-gumikizyizya, 5.-gumikizyalyo, 6.-gumikisya, 7.-gumika-gumika, 8.-gumikana.)

be connected with, Wakacenjezya kuti bantu beelede kufwambaana kwaambilizya kubasilikani kufwumbwa kaambo kaguminizya bakapika. = He warned them that the people ought to be quick in reporting to the police any matter that was connected with thieves.
touch with something, rt. - *guma*, Tamweelede kugumya minwe kuli moola wantobolo nkaambo inga yadubuka. = You should not touch the trigger of the gun with your fingers because it might fire.

nod, Guna mutwe, tubone naa wazumina. = Nod your head so that we may see if you have agreed. Also: -gunka. (1.-gunwa, 2.-gunide, 3.-gunya, 4.-gunina, 5.-guninalyo, 6.-guninsya, 7.-guna-guna, 8.-gunizyanya.)
  • be ashamed, Mudaala wakaguna naakajanika ulasamba mumulonga. = The old man was ashamed when he was found bathing naked in the river. Also: -nyana, -gunwa.
  • tilt downwards, as a scale when loaded Cikkelo cakaguna nibaabikka mapopwe manji. = The scales tilted downwards when they put a lot of maize on it.

nod up and down, Wakaguna-guna mutwe kutondezya kuti wazumina. = He nodded his head to show that he agreed. Kana kamwi kakali kuguna-guna buyo. = One child was nodding (as sleep came on).
  • move up and down, Nitwali kuloba mbilibili yali kuguna-guna. = When we were fishing the float was moving up and down. Also: -gunauka.

move up and down, Akaambo kamayuwe bwato tiibwali kweenda kabotu, bwali kugunauka. = Because of the waves the boat was not moving well, it was going up and down. Inga muli Nakapaya balilukila bana moota nkoigunauka. = On the Nakapaya hill the children were just vomitting as the vehicle was moving up and down. Also: -gunuuka, -tengaana, -guna-guna. (1.-gunaukwa, 2.-gunaukide, 3.-gunausya, 4.-gunaukila, 5.-gunaukilalyo, 6.-gunaukisya, 7.-gunauka-gunauka, 8.-gunausyanya.)

overcome, Wakamugundula mweenzinyina nibakali kulwana. = He overpowered his friend when they were fighting. Also: -koma, -zunda. (1.-gundulwa, 2.-gundulide, 3.-gunduzya, 4.-gundulila, 5.-gundulilalyo, 6.-gundulisya, 7.-gundula-gundula, 8.-gundulana.)
carry from one place to another, Akamugundumya mabulo kumutola kudolopo mpati. = The train took him from one place to the big city.

moult, Nkuku yakagundyuuka mapepe. = The chicken moulted its feathers. (1.-gundyuukwa, 2.-gundyuukide, 3.-gundyuuzya, 4.-gundyuukila, 5.-gundyuukilalyo, 6.-gundyuukisya, 7.-gundyuuka-gundyuuka.) Also: -jundauka.

gulp down, Mudyaka wakacigungumwina cibwantu coonse. = Mudyaka gulped down all the sweet beer. (1.-gungumwinwa, 2.-gungumwide, 3.-gungumwizya, 4.-gungumwida, 5.-gungumwidalyo, 6.-gungumwisya, 7.-gungumwina-gungumwina)
be ashamed, Aano mpondilemba lugwalo, ndiligunidwe kapati. = Now as I write a letter, I am deeply ashamed.

be ashamed, rt. -guna, Cheelo wagunigwa naazundwa kulunduka. = Cheelo was ashamed when he was beaten in the race. Mainza wagunigwa naawumwa kumukaintu. = Mainza was ashamed when he was beaten by his wife. Also: -gunwa.

nod when sleepy, Ufwide nonzi, aboobo wiile kugunka mutwe. = He is feeling sleepy and so he is nodding. Mudaala wakali kugunka koona, mpoona wakatalika kufwukula. = The old man was nodding with sleepiness, thereupon he began to doze.
  • hit, *Naakalikuyanda kunywisya bbola, mweenzinyina wakamugunka kakokola acamba.* = When he wanted to score a goal his friend hit him on the chest with an elbow. (1.-gunkwa, 2.-gunkide, 4.-gunkila, 5.-gunkilalyo, 6.-gunkisya, 7.-gunka-gunka.) Also: -gunta, -ganka, -donta.

cutting shrubs and bushes in the fields, *Bamwi bantu bakatalikide kale kugunkaula akumwaya bufwumba mumyuunda kulibambila kulima.* = Some people began already to cut bushes and shrubs and to spread manure in the fields preparing for ploughing. (1.-gunkaulwa, 2.-gunkawide, 3.-gunkauzya, 4.-gunkawida, 5.-gunkawidalyo, 6.-gunkaulisya, 7.-gunakula-gunkaula, 8.-gunkaulana.) Also: -duntaula, -sanzula.
tap, *Naali kwaambaula walikugunka-gunka atafwule aboobo tiitwamvwa ncaali kwaamba.* = He kept on tapping the table as he talked, as a result we could not hear what he was saying. Also: -gunta-gunta.

nod the head as when dozing, rt. -gunka, *Ugunkila nzi sunu webo kakutanaakutalika kupya.* Why are you dozing before it becomes hot? Also: -guna. (2.-gunkilide, 3.-gunkizya, 4.-gunkilila, 5.-gunkililalyo, 6.-gunkilisya, 7.-gunkila-gunkila)

hurt, knock against, *Ndaligunkula nindali kweenda kuya kumunzi.* I knocked against something when I was going home. *Zina lyamusamu indyabuluba yakaliluba niyakaligunkula munzila.* The giraffe forgot the name of the tree when it knocked itself against something on the way. (from a story) Also: -nontola, -gukula. (2.-gunkulide, 3.-gunkuzya, 4.-gunkulila, 5.-gunkulilalyo, 6.-gunkulisya, 7.-gunkula-gunkula, 8.-gunkulana.)
bump into one another, *Basimbi bakagunkulana nibakali kweenda mumudima.* = The girls bumped into one another when they were moving in the dark. Also: -guntaana, -guntana.
knock, as at a door, *Nguni wali kugunkunya amulyango?* = Who was knocking at the door? (1.-gunkunyizigwa, 2.-gunkunyide, 3.-gunkunyizya, 4.-gunkunyizyigwa, 6.-gunkunyisya.) Also: -konkomona.

hit against, run into, *Cimbayambaya cakaakugunta mucisamu nicakazwa munzila nkaambo namutekenya wakali koona.* The lorry hit against a tree when it swayed off the road because the driver was sleeping. Also: -guntula. (1.-guntwa, 2.-guntide, 3.-guntya, 4.-guntila, 5.-guntilalyo, 6.-guntisya, 7.-gunta-gunta, 8.-guntana.)

collide, *Nitwali kusobana bbola twaguntaana mitwe mpoona twawa toonse.* When we were playing football we hit each others heads and we both fell down. (2.-guntaanide, 3.-guntaanya, 4.-guntaanina, 5.-guntaaninalyo, 6.-guntaanisya, 7.-guntaana-guntaana, 8.-guntaana.) Also: gukulana, -gunkulala.
hit continuously, *Michelo naakakolwa bukoko wakali kuligunta-gunta abwaanda.* When Michelo was drunk he kept hitting himself against a wall.

ill-treat, *Ncibi kuguntaika bamucaala.* It is bad to ill-treat orphans. (1.-guntaikwa, 2.-guntaikide, 3.-guntaizya, 4.-guntaikizyizya, 5.-guntaikilalyo, 6.-guntaikisya, 7.-guntaika-guntaika, 8.-guntaikana.) Also: -gutaika.

collide, rt. -gunta, *Zyaguntana zimbayambaya zyobilo sunu* munzila. = Today two vehicles collided. Mutinta bakaguntana mitwe abanyina nibakali kubbalula muzimo wabakaapanyina. = Mutinta and her mother knocked their heads together when they were transferring the spirit of her grandmother. (Symbolizing the transfer of the spirit from the mother to the daughter.) (1.-guntwa, 2.-guntide, 3.-guntanya, 4.-guntila, 5.-guntilalyo, 6.-guntisya, 7.-guntana-guntana, 8.-guntana)

cause people to knock heads against one another, rt. -gunta, Ndabaguntanya mitwe bana baalilwa mulimo ngundabapede. = I knocked the heads of the children together who were unable to do the work I had given them. (1.-guntanyizigwa, 2.-guntanizidwe, 3.-guntanyika, 4.-guntanyizyizya, 5.-guntanyizyizyalyo, 8.-guntanyikana.)

cause to clash, Mutinta waaguntanyika bana kuti batalike kulwana. = Mutinta caused the children to start fighting. Also: -guntiika, -guntanya. (1.-guntanyizigwa, 3.-guntanyikide, 4.-guntanyizyizya, 5.-guntanyizyizyalyo, 8.-guntanyikana.)

summarize, fill one in briefly about a matter, Kanditaningamwaanina caano cangu, andimuguntaudeguntaude ncitwakaandaanina abakaintu bakusaanguna. = Before I tell you my story, let me tell you briefly why my first wife and I separated. Mweemba wakayeeya kuti ncibotu kuti awalo mweenzinyina Mainza amuguntaude zintu mbuzyakali kweenda. = Mweemba thought it would be good if he filled in his friend Mainza about how things were going. (1.-guntaudwe, 3.-guntauzya, 8.-guntauzyanya)

knock, rt. -gunta, Ndamuguntaula amutwe nindanyema. = I knocked him on the head when I was angry. (1.-guntaulwa, 2.-guntaulide, V - 184 3.-guntauzya, 4.-guntaulila, 5.-guntaulilalyo, 6.-guntaulisya 7.-guntaula-guntaula, 8.-guntaulana.)
  • cut short, summarize, Ijilo mwakaamba kuti muyakundaambila juunza zyoonse zijatikizya kusumpulwa kwanu amulimo. Nkooko kamuguntaula tumvwe. = Yesterday you told me that you would tell me today all that happened as regards the promotion in your work. Now lets hear it in brief. Muzimo wakaguntaula caano cakwe coonse. = Muzimo told his whole story briefly.

find out, Batutumide buyo kuzikuguntauzya. = They sent us just to find out. (1.-gutauzyigwa, 2.-guntauwide, 4.-guntauzyizya, 5.-guntauzyizyalyo, 6.-guntauzyisya, 7.-guntauzyaguntauzya, 8.-guntauzyanya.)

find out something for, Twaboola kuguntawida Michelo kaambo nkayanda kuzyiba. = We have come to find out for Michelo concerning a matter he wants to know about. (1.-guntawidwa, 2.-guntawide, 3.-guntawizya, 4.-guntawidila, 5.-guntawidalyo, 8.-guntawidana.)

harass, Bacembele baguntiika bana babeleka. = The old woman is harassing the children who are working. (1.-guntiikwa, 2.-guntiikide, 3.-guntiikizya, 4.-guntiikila, 5.-guntiikilalyo, 6.-guntiikisya, 7.-guntiika-guntiika, 8.-guntiikana.) Also: gutiika, -gutaika.

knock against, rt. -gunta, Bacembele nibalikweenda masiku baliguntula acuuno. = When the old woman was moving about at night she knocked against the stool. (1.-guntulwa, 2.-guntwide, 3.-guntuzya, 4.-guntwida, 5.-guntwidalyo, 6.-guntulisya, 7.-guntulaguntula, 8.-guntulana) Also: -gunkula.

knock against, Ndaliguntuzya kubwaanda nindali kuyanda kuwa. = I knocked myself against the wall when I was about to fall. Nindali kweenda ndaliguntuzya abbwe. = When I was walking I knocked myself against a stone. (1.-guntuzyigwa, 2.-guntuzyizye, 3.-guntuzya, 4.-guntuzyizya, 5.-guntuzyizyalyo, 6.-guntuzyisya, 7.-guntuzya-guntuzya, 8.-guntuzyanya.) Also: -gutuzya.
knock against one another, Twaguntuzyanya mitwe nitwali kunjila munanda nkaambo kwali kusiya. We knocked our heads against one another when we were entering the house because it was dark.

go sloping downwards, Nobakamana kutanta mulundu, bakagunukila kumulonga. When they had climbed the mountain, they went downwards to the river. (1.-gunukilwa, 2.-gunukide, 3.-gunukizya, 4.-gunukilila, 5.-gunukililalyo, 6.-gunukilisya, 7.-gunukila-gunukila) Also: -selela

overturn, Kocigununa citaanga cijisi maila muceme aabolede kutegwa atike. = Overturn the basket which has the rotten millet so that it pours out. (1.-gununwa, 2.-gunwide, 3.-gunuzya, 4.-gununina, 5.-gununinalyo, 6.-gununisya, 7.-gununa-gununa) Also: -vwuntamuna, -tingamuna, -suntula.

shake up and down, Bwato bulagunuuka mumayuwe akaambo kamuwo munji. = The boat is rolling up and down on the waves due to the gale. (1.-gunuukwa, 2.-gunuukide, 3.-gunuuzya, 4.-gunuukila, 5.-gunuukilalyo, 6.-gunuukisya, 7.-gunuuka-gunuuka) Also: -guna-guna, -gunauka.

be ashamed, Ndakagunwa nitwakazundwa kukakolo kasyoonto mumusobano wabbola. I was ashamed when we were defeated by a small school in the football competition. (2.-gunide, 3.-gunya, 4.-guninwa, 5.-guninwalyo, 6.-gunisyigwa, 7.-gunwa-gunwa, 8.-gunizyanya) Also: -nyana, -usa, -gunigwa.
make ashamed, make feel defeated, rt. -guna, Ndamugunya nindamuzunda kukanana musankwa uulya. = I made that boy ashamed when I overcame him in a debate.
Also: -gunya.

light a match, Kogunyuna kancisi komwe tuyasye kalambe. = Strike a match so that we light the lamp. (1.-gunyunwa, 2.-gunyudwe, 3.-gunyuzya, 4.-gunywida, 5.-gunywidalyo, 6.-gunyunyusya) Also: -kkwenyuna, -gwenyuna.

drive off, as flies, Kamugusa nzinini zitanjili mumabisi. Drive off the flies so that they do not go into the sour milk. (1.-guswa, 2.-guswide, 3.-gusuzya, 4.-guswida, 5.-guswidalyo, 6.-guswisyisya) Also: -kusaula, -vwupaula.

take away, remove, Kamugusya tombe eli aawa, kuboola beenzu = Remove this dirt there, visitors are coming. (1.-gusyigwa, 2.-gusyizye, 3.-gusyizya, 4.-gusyizya, 5.-gusyizyalyo, 6.-gusyisya, 7.-gusya-gusya, 8.-gusyanya.)

afflict, be rough to another in word or deed, Koleka kumugutaika mwana ulamukatazya. Do not be rough to the child, you will trouble him. Ncibi kugutaika bana bamucaala. = It is bad to ill-treat orphans. (1.-gutaikwa, 2.-gutaikide, 3.-gutaizya, 4.-gutaikila, 5.-gutaikilalyo, 6.-gutaikisya, 7.gutaika-gutaika, 8.-gutaikana) Also: -guntaika, -gutauzya, gudyuuza.
-guntaika, -guntiika, -tonta

mistreat, Basankwa bapati balabagutauzya bana nobeembela mpongo. Big boys mistreat the children when they are herding goats. (1.-gutauzyigwa, 2.-gutauzyizye, 4.-gutauzyizya, 5.-gutauzyizyalyo, 6.-gutauzyisya, 7.-gutauzya-gutauzya, 8.-gutauzyanya.) Also: -gudyuuza.

mistreat one another, Chilala a mukaintu wakwe tabakkali kabotu munanda yabo, lyoonse balagutauzyanya. = Chilala and his wife do not live well in their house, they are always mistreating one another. Also: gutuzyanya.

push around, dominate, Bantu bamwi balayanda kugutiika beenzu. = Some people like pushing visitors around. (1.-gutiikwa, 2.-gutiikide, 3.-gutiikizya, 4.-gitiikila, 5.-gutiikilalyo, 6.-gutiikisya, 7.-gutiika-gutiika, 8.-gutiikana.) Also: -guntiika, -guntaika, -gutika.
bleat, Mbelele ilagutuka. = The sheep bleats. (2.-gutukide)

knock against, Naakaligutula kubwaanda, wakalicisa mumutwe. = When he knocked against the wall, he hurt his head. (1.-gutulwa, 2.-gutulide, 3.-gutuzya, 4.-gutulila, 5.-gutulilalyo, 6.-gutulisya, 7.-gutula-gutula, 8.-gutulana.)

+ be spoilt, as old eggs (known by shaking them), Mayi aaya alagutuma taakakonkonwi. = These eggs are spoilt, they will not produce chicks. (1.-gutumwa, 2.-gutumide, 3.-gutumya, 4.-gutumina, 5.-gutuminalyo, 6.-gutumisya, 7.-gutuma-gutuma.)
  • make noise, Mbeba zyakali kugutuma munanda masiku. = The rats were making noise at night in the house. Also: -gwelenganya.

make flatulent, rt. -gutuma, Nzala njiindigutumya mwida. = It is hunger which causes my stomach to rumble. Kogutumya mayi kuti uzyibe naa mmabotu. = Shake the eggs to see if they are good. Also: -jukuma.

knock against, Nindatiiwume kabwa, ndaligutuzya kubwaanda. = When I was about to beat the pup, I knocked myself against the wall. (1.-gutuzyigwa, 3.-gutuzyizye, 4.-gutuzyizya, 5.-gutuzyizyalyo, 6.-gutuzyisya, 7.-gutuzya-gutuzya, 8.-gutuzyanya.) Also: -guzula, -gutuzya.
be in conflict with another, Balagutuzyanya murjanda yabo. = They are quarreling with one another in their house. Also: -bwentelanas, -bwensyanya, -zwangana, -gutauzyanya.

sound, as stomach rumbling, Mwida mwangu mulaguuma nkaambo ndaanywa cibwantu cisaside = My stomach is rumbling because I drank sour sweet-beer. (1.-guumwa, 2.-guumide, 3.-guumya, 4.-guumina, 5.-guuminalyo, 6.-guumisya, 7. -guuma-guuma)

go in a crowd, Bantu boonse baguumuka kuya kunkolola. = All the people went off in a crowd to the initiation ceremony. (1.-guumukwa, 2.-guumukide, 3.-guumusya, 4.-guumukila, 5.-guumukilalyo, 6.-guumukisya, 7.-guumuka-guumuka) Also: -uumuka, -wuumuka.
rub against a tree as a cow, Munyama ulaliquya acisamu. = An animal is rubbing itself against a tree. Also: kulicuusya

+ scrape the surface, Nobakali kulimina bakali kuguyaula buyo atala. When they were weeding they were just scraping the surface. Aumwi mwaalu mainza inga ulaguyaula-guyaula mukalimo kakwe kutegwa atakasunzi biya twakuti bana bakwe bakooloke. = Each man scratches his plot so that he does not have to beg and so that his children can eat the first maize. (1.-guyaulwa, 2.-guyawide, 3.-guyauzya, 4.-guyauwida, 5.-guyauwidalyo, 6.-guyaulisya, 7.-guyaula-guyaula, 8.-guyaulana.)
  • summarize story, Kwaaguyaula makani tumvwe mbucakacitika. = Summa rize the matter so that we hear how it happened.

stand upright, Basankwa nibakali kufwoolwa bakali kugwaalala kutegwa baende kabotu. = When the boys were marching they stood upright so that they move properly. (2.-gwaalele, 3.-gwaalizya, 4.-gwaalila, 5.-gwaalilalyo, 6.-gwaalalisya, 7.-gwaalala-gwaalala) Also: -gwalala.

be opened wide, Nibakamana muswaangano milyango yoonse yakagwaamuka. = When they finished the meeting all the doors were opened wide. (1.-gwaamunwa, 2.-gwaamukide, 3.-gwaamuzya, 4.-gwaamukila, 5.-gwaamukilalyo, 6.-gwaamukisya, 7.-gwaamuka-gwaamuka.)

open wide, Wagwaamuna kujula mulyango. = She has opened the door widely. Also: -gweemuna. (1.-gwaamunwa, 2.-gwaamwide, 3.-gwaamuzya, 4.-gwaamukila, 5.-gwaamukilalyo, 6.-gwaamunisya, 7.-gwaamuna-gwaamuna.)

grab, Bantu boonse zyaba nkamba, baba bagwaanana, bamulota kuvwuba cintu nocitako balo ncobayanda nkulisina buya kukapaula. = The people have become bitter, they have become grabbers, they dream of wealth which is not there and will kill themselves in trying to find it.
quarrel, Bakatalika kugwaankwana. = They began to quarrel. Also: -kwankwana

remain hung up as cloth thrown over line, stick as in a tree, Kasamu kagwaba mucisamu camango. = The stick has got stuck in the mango tree. (1.-gwabwa, 2.-gwabikide, 3.-gwabya, 4.-gwabikila, 5.-gwabilikalyo, 6.-gwabikisya, 7.-gwaba-gwaba, 8.-gwabana.)
stick in, Kayuni nindakauma amalekani, kagwabama mumitabi yamusamu. = When I hit the bird with a catapult, it got stuck in the branches of the tree. Also: -angila, -patila

strike one another, Basune bakagwabana citaambiki kusikila limwi umwi wakakomwa. = The oxen fought furiously until one was defeated. (1.-gwabanwa, 2.-gwabanide, 3.-gwabanizya, 4.-gwabanina, 5.-gwabaninalyo, 6.-gwabanisya, 7.-gwabana-gwabana, 8.-gwabana)

hang up, Kogwabika cisani eeci amulenga awo. = Hang up this cloth on the line there. Kaindi basimbi bakali kusama tukuze. Tumwi tukuze bakali kugwabika munsingo. = Long ago girls used to wear strings of beads. Some beads were hung around their necks. (1.-gwabikwa, 2.-gwabikide, 3.-gwabikizya, 4.-gwabikila, 5.-gwabikilalyo, 6.-gwabikisya, 7.-gwabika-gwbika, 8.-gwabikana.) Also: -kobeka, -anzika.
be hung up, Nkausu taiko awa acisanda mpundakaigwabikide jilo. = The vest is not on the pole where I had hung it yesterday.

write carelessly, scribble, Kolemba kabotu, ncibi kugwagwala buya. = Write well, do not be scribbling. (1.-gwagwalwa, 2.-gwagwalide, 3.-gwagwalizya, 4.-gwagwalila, 5.-gwagwalilalyo, 6.-gwagwalisya) cf. -kwala-kwala, -gwalaula.
be busily occupied, Mainza ulagwagwalika kuyandaula nzila yakujana cakulya cabana bakwe. = Mainza is running around searching for a way to find food for his children.

laugh loudly, Bantu bakali kumuswaangano bakagwagwamuka kuseka sicuuno naakawa. = The people at the meeting laughed loudly when the chairperson fell off the chair. (1.-gwagwamukwa, 2.-gwagwamukide, 3.-gwagwamusya, 4.-gwagwamukila, 5.-gwagwamukilalyo, 6.-gwagwamukisya, 7.-gwagwamuka-gwagwamuka)

laugh loudly, Tanaakali kusisikizya kuseka pe, nkugwagwamuna biya kuseka walo. = He was not laughing in a hidden way, he was laughing openly. (1.-gwagwamunwa, 2.-gwagwamunina, 3.-gwagwamuzya, 4.-gwagwamunina, 5.-gwagwamuninalyo, 6.-gwagwamunisya, 7.-gwagwamuna-gwagwamuna, 8.-gwagwamunana.)

persist, Mudaala ulagwagwatila kutwaambo tuniini. = The old man persists in dragging out insignificant matters. (1.-gwagwatilwa, 2.-gwagwatide, 3.-gwagwatizya, 4.-gwagwatilila, 5.-gwagwatilalyo, 6.-gwagwatilisya, 7.-gwagwatilagwagwatila, 8.-gwagwatilana) Also: -gwegwetela, -zumanana.

write, Kogwala lugwalo kumupati wako ulombe mali. = Write a letter to your elder sister and ask for money. Also: -lemba. (1.-gwalwa, 2.-gwalide, 3.-gwalizya, 4.-gwalila, 5.-gwalilalyo, 6.-gwalisya, 7.-gwalala-gwalala, 8.-gwalilana.)
