shake the ground with footsteps, Wali *kujintaila* kweenda. = He was shaking the ground as he walked. Kulimvwisya buya kuti kuli weenda nkwa*jintaila*. = It could be clearly heard that there was someone walking because of the heavy footsteps. Also: -gantaila. (1.-jintailwa, 2.-jitailide, 3.-jintaizya, 4.-jintailila, 5.- jintaililalyo, 6.-jintailisya, 7.-jintaila-jintaila)

stamp the feet, Bantu bali *kujintauka* kuzyana acuumbwe. = The people were stamping the feet when dancing on the grave. Bantu bamumunzi mwa Haakwale bakaluujisi *kujintauka* kuzyana nkolola. = The people of the village of Haakwale were busy stamping the feet when dancing at the initiation ceremony. Also: -gwataila, -dinta. (1.-jintaukwa, 2.-jintaukide, 3.-jintauzya, 4.-jintaukila, 5.-jintaukilalyo, 6.-jintaukisya, 7.-jintauka-jintauka)
dance, Syaazyana ula
amulyango. = The witch-dancer is dancing at the doorway. (1.-jintukwa, 2.-jintukide, 3.-jintuzya, 4.-jintukila, 5.-jintukilana, 6.-jintukisya, 7.-jintukajintuka)

hold each other, rt. -jata, Basimbi *bajisene* maanza nibali kweendeenda. The girls were holding each other's hands as they were walking. (uujisene minwe = a web-footed or webfingered person). Also: -jatene.

hold, contain, rt. -jata, Haamunji ujisi lubono lunji. = Haamunji possesses great wealth. Ino ujisi nzi mucoola oomo? = What do you have in that bag? (1.-jisigwi)
  • be occupied with much activity, Mucende wakaluujisi kunyita mutalaa mulonga. The bull was busy bellowing across the river.
be held, rt. -jata, Mvwiki eeyo tiiyakali kweenda, mbuli kuti *ijisigwi* buya amuntu. = The week did not pass quickly, as if it was been held up by someone.
cook with, rt. -jika, Mucembele wakali kuyandaula mafwuta aku*jisya*. The old woman was searching for cooking oil to cook with.
fall out, Mbaakaciputununa buyo ciputu, kwakajitika fwulwe aansi. = As soon as he unwrapped the bundle, the tortoise fell out on the ground.
peck, Inkuku *zijobola* mapopwe. The hens are pecking at the maize. Also: -goma. (1.-jobolwa, 2.-jobolede, 3.-jobozya, 4.-jobweda, 5.-jobwedalyo, 6.-jobolesya, 7.-jobola-jobola. 8.-jobolana)
return, come back, Kojoka, utaunki ku Monze. = Return, don't go to Monze. (1.-jokwa, 2.-jokede, 3.-josya, 4.-jokela, 5.-jokelalyo, 6.-jokesya, 7.-jokajoka, 8.-jokelana) Also: -bweeda, -piluka.
return to, rt. joka, Waka
kucikolo, taakoona kuno. = He/She returned to school, he/she did not spend the night here. Jokela nkoozyila. = Go back to where you came from.
reconcile, as a marriage, rt. -joka, Mutinta a Chityamba baka*jokelelana*. Mutinta and Chityamba were reconciled with one another.

cause to return, restore, rt. -joka, Kamujokezya musune ngumwakalombede. Return the ox which you asked for. (1.-jokezyegwa, 2.-jokezyede, 3.-jokezyesya, 4.-jokezyezya, 5.-jokezyezyalyo, 8.-jokezyanya)
  • take revenge, avenge, rt. -joka, *Kujokezya cibi inga takupi luumuno.* = Taking revenge does not bring peace.

return, *Chimamu wakafwambaana kujokoloka kuzyila ku dolopo.* = Chimamu quickly returned from the city.
  • repent, *Moyo wakwe wakajokoloka naakapegwa cisubulo cipati.* = He repented when he was given a severe punishment. Also: -empa, -subuka, -pubuka

cool the heart, *Ncibotu kujokolola moyo kuti wanyema.* = It is good to cool the heart if you are angry. (1.-jokololwa, 2.-jokolwede, 3.-jokolosya, 4.-jokololela, 5.-jokololelalyo, 6.-jokololesya, 7.-jokolola-jokolola, 8.-jokololana)

be restored, *Ndakajana kunyina ncicakali kunga cilandigwasya kuyeeya cintu citakonzyi kujokolosegwa.* = I found that it was not helping me to think about something which cannot be restored. (2.-jokolosedwe)

round up, turn back *Mutafwambaani kuzijola nombe nkaambo tazinakkuta.* = Don't be quick to bring the cattle back because they are not yet satisfied. Also: -nyona. (1.-jolwa, 2.-jolede, 3.-jolezya, 4.-jolela, 5.-jolelalyo, 6.-jolesya, 7.-jola-jola, 8.-jolana)
  • bring back, *Kojola busu munanda Cheelo.* = Cheelo, bring the meal back into the house. *Mwana yebo kojola mpoto kuli balaayo.* = Child, return the pot to the owner. Also: -josya, -jokezya.
  • quench thirst, *Amundigwasye meenda njanda kujola nyota.* = Help me with water so that I quench my thirst.
  • get married to your dead relative's wife, *Himweene nguwaajola muka muce wakwe.* = Himweene is the one who got married to the wife of his diseased younger brother.
  • be infected, *Naakaunka ku Bulozi wakajola bulwazi bwacifwumu.* = When he went to Loziland he was infected with the measles.

peck, *Ciindi camainza nkobo zilayandisya kujomona nzengene kunombe.* = During the rainy season the cattle-egrets love to peck at the ticks on the cattle. *Ndime jomwi-jomwi mulomo uujomona bakali.* = I am the pecker, the one who pecks the hard ones. (1.-jomonwa, 2.-jomonede, 3.-jomwesya 4.-jomonena, 5.-jomonenalyo, 6.-jomonesya, 7.-jomona-jomona, 8.-jomonana) Also: -njomona.

dip something into the gravy, *Kamujompeka munwe mumusinza mulabile naa kuli munyo.* = Dip your finger into the sauce and taste if there is enough salt. *Bana tabacizyi kujompeka nsima mumusinza.* = Children do not know how to dip the nsima into the gravy. (1.-jompekwa, 2.-jompekede, 3.-jompezya, 4.-jompekela, 5.-jompekelalyo, 6.-jompekesya, 7.-jompeka-jompeka, 8.-jompekana) Also: -sunsa.

stick out, *Menyo akwe akajoncomana bbola nilyamuuma ku-mulomo.* = His teeth stuck out when the ball struck him on the mouth. (1.-joncomanwa, 2.-joncomanide/-joncomene, 3.-joncomanya, 4.-joncomanina, 5.-joncomaninalyo, 6.-joncomanisya, 7.-joncomana-joncomana) Also: -konkomena, -konkomana, -jonkomana

be not well fixed *Keembe nkaabikka mumwiini wakajoncomeka ncokatagonki kabotu.* = The axeblade which he inserted in the handle was not well attached, that is why it does not cut well. (1.-joncomekwa, 2.-joncomekede, 3.-joncomekezya, 4.-joncomekela, 5.-joncomekelalyo, 6.-joncomekesya, 7.-joncomeka-joncomeka, 8.-joncomekana)
protrude, rt. -joncomana, Meja abasune alijoncomene. = The horns of the oxen are sticking out. (1.-joncomenwe)
stand in amazement Also: -cenceleka, -angamana, -concomana.

take back, cause to return, rt. -joka, Mweenzu walonda kujosya mali ngaakakweletede. A visitor came to return the money which s/he borrowed. Also: -boozya, -pilusya. (1.-josyegwa, 2.-josyede, 3.-josyezya, 4.-josyela, 5.-josyelalyo, 6.-josyesya, 7.-josya-josya, 8.-josyanya)
  • practice custom of returning the bride, (-josya matende,) Bana koomusimbi bakamulembela musankwa kuti mukaintu wakwe wakeelede kujosya matende. = The relatives of the bride wrote to the boy saying that his wife ought to go back to her home following the footprints she made in coming. Bazyali ba Mundunda bakamuka kujosya musimbi ngwaakatizya. = The parents of Mundunda were late in returning the girl with whom he had eloped.

lessen, cut off Bakajuba mazuba amuntolongo kwamyezi yone. = They shortened the days in jail by four months. Buluke bwangu bwalampisya njanda kubujuba. My trousers are too long, I want to shorten them. (1.-jubwa, 2.-jubide, 3.-jubya, 4.-jubila, 5.-jubilalyo, 6.-jubisya, 7.-juba-juba, 8.-jubana)

lessen, rt. -juba, Basimalelo bako beelede kukujubila mali amwi mwezi amwezi nkaambo tiimwakali kubeleka kabotu. Your boss should deduct some money from month to month because you have not been working properly.

be taken out, rt. -jwa, Wakajugwa linyo lyakali kumupenzya. = S/He had the tooth taken out which was paining her/him. Bwizu bwakajugwa aba makaintu banji. = The grass was cut by many women. Nseyandi kujugwa kasusu amutwe. = I don't want a little hair of my head to be plucked out. (i.e. I don't want to be fooled.) (2.-jwide, 3.-jwisya, 4.jwida, 5.-jwidalyo, 6.-jwisya, 7.-jugwajugwa)

loose value, fade, Chuma wakali musimbi mubotu, sunu wajujuka. = Chuma was a beautiful woman, today her beauty has faded. (1.-jujukwa, 2.-jujukide, 3.-jujuzya, 4.-jujukila, 5.-jujukilalyo, 6.-jujukisya, 7.-jujuka-jujuka, 8.-jujulana) Also: -bbuluka, -sipala, -tubuluka, -unduka.

intrude, push oneself forward when unwanted, Basimbi bobilo bakali kulijujutizya kubasankwa nokuba kuti basankwa tiibakali kubayanda. = Two girls were pushing themselves forward to the boys even though the boys did not like them. (1.-jujutizyigwa, 2.-jujutizyide, 3.-jujutizyisya, 4.-jujutizyizya, 5.-jujutizyizyalyo, 7.-jujutizya-jujutizya, 8.-jujutizyanya) Also: -cucutizya.
come out as feathers or hair, Mapepe aankuku akajuka. The feathers of the chicken came out. Also: -fwumuka (2.-jukide, 3.-jwisya, 4.-jukila, 5.-jukilalyo, 6.-jukisya, 7.-juka-juka, 8.-jwana)

shake old eggs, Koajukuma mayi aakalekwa kulindwa. = Shake the eggs which were left over after incubating. (to see if they are fresh) (1.-jukumwa, 2.-jukumide, 3.-jukumya, 4.-jukumina, 5.-jukuminalyo, 6.-jukumisya, 7.-jukuma-jukuma) Also: -gutumya.

open, Kamujula kumulyango, kuli bakonkomona. Open the door, there is someone knocking. Kujula meso mucikolo ncibotu nkaambo inga kobona ncobacita bayi. To open your eyes in school is good because you can see what the teacher is doing. (1.-julwa, 2.-julide, 3.-juzya, 4.-julila, 5.-julilalyo, 6.-julisya, 7.-jula-jula, 8.-julana.) Also: -yula, -jalula.
  • take pot off from fire, *Kamujula*, musozya wabizwa. = Take the pot off the fire, the stew is cooked.

prolong stay in a place, live or work a long time in one place, *Bamaama bakaakujuluka ku Ntambo nkobakaunka, tabajoki ino.* = My mother has stayed too long at Ntambo where she went, she does not come now.
  • return to one's senses, *Ndalilubide kwaciindi cilamfwu, ono ndajuluka ndakuzyiba nkondiya.* = I was confused for a long time, now I returned to my senses and know where I am going.
  • come to end of season, *Amufwambaane kususa bufwumba kutola kumuunda, mwaka wajuluka* = Be quick to transport the manure to the field, the year is coming to the end. (1.-julukwa, 2.-jukulide, 3.-juluzya, 4.-julukila, 5.-julukilalyo, 6.-julukisya, 7.-juluka-juluka, 8.-julukana)
be slow in acting Also: -beleleka

be opened, *Cijazyo cajulwa kale inga banjila ino.* = The door is already open, they can enter now.
  • be taken off the fire, as cooking pot, *Kamulindila mulalya musozya wajulwa.* = Wait, you will eat when the samp will be taken off the fire.
dry, *Buluke tabuningajuma*, *bucili butete.* = The trousers are not yet dry, they are still wet. (1.-jumwa, 2.-jumide, 3.-jumya, 4.-jumina, 5.-juminalyo, 6.-jumisya, 7.-juma-juma) Also: -yuma.

moult, *Kamufwambaana kujata nkuku yakajundauka mapepe.* = Be quick and catch the chicken which has lost its feathers. *Matimba wakajundauka masusu mumutwe akaambo kabulwazi bwakanswende.* = Matimba lost the hair on his head because of the disease of gonorrhoea. Also: -gundyuuka, -monsaukas, -nyonkooka, -kuluka, -monkooka. (1.-jundaukwa, 2.-jundaukide, 3.-jundauzya, 4.-jundaukila, 5.-jundaukilalyo, 6.-jundaukisya 7.-jundauka-jundauka, 8.-jundaulana)
come off, as hair, *Masusu aamusimbi wakafwa jilo akalijundaukide* = The hair of the girl who died yesterday had come off.
Also: -jundaukide.

trot, *Mubbi wakali kujunka-junka kumbele lyancinga yamusilikani.* = The thief was trotting in front of the policeman's bicycle. (1.-junkwajunkwa, 2.-junkide-junkide, 3.-junzyajunzya, 4.-juusyila-juusyila, 5.-juusyilalyojuusyilalyo, 6.-junkisya-junkisya) Also: -zeba-zeba, -dwanka-dwanka, cunka-cunka.

wipe or rub spear or rifle, *Muvwimi wakali kujuusya ntobolo kugusya kasuko.* = The hunter was wiping the gun to take off the dust. *Kolijuusya kubwaanda kutegwa kauka kalamatide kaloke.* = Rub yourself against the wall so that the insect which is stuck will fall off. *Ndakajana munyati ulalijuusya acisamu.* = I found the buffalo rubbing himself against the tree. Also: -pukuta, -cuusya, -sansamuna, -syobola. (1.-juusyigwa, 2.-juusyide, 3.-juuzya, 4.-juusyila, 5.-juusyilalyo, 6.-juusyisya, 7.-juusya-juusya, 8.-juusyanya)

greet, *Bakujuzya kale sena?* = Have they already greeted you? *Basibbuku, amubajuzye bazwa kukusonda.* = Headmen, greet those who have come from divining. (1.-juzyigwa, 2.-juzyide, 3.-juzyisya, 4.-juzyizya, 5.-juzyizyalyo, 6.-juzyisya, 7.-juzya-juzya, 8.-juzyanya)
  • open with, rt. -jula, *Sena mulijisi cakujuzya kagabba ako?* = Have you got an opener for that tin? Cijazyo nicakaala kujula amakkii, twakajuzya keembe. = When the door failed to open with a key, we opened it with an axe.
  • cause to take pot off the fire, rt. -jula, Ciindi buyo cisyoonto yakaboola yakajuzya kacembele. = Just in a short time there came the rain which caused the old woman to take the pot off the fire. (i.e. as severe storm was imminent)
greet one another, rt. -juzya, Bakapegwa zyuuno akutalika kujuzyanya. They were given chairs and began to greet one another.

pull out feathers, grass, teeth, peg, Baya kukujwa bwizu bwacaanda cankwilimba. They are going to cut grass for the pidgeon house. Ayaswa mamvwa muntu, aima kulijwa mamvwa, Haamilimo nkubwenta akutukana. = When a person was pierced by thorns, when he stopped to remove it, Haamilimo would complain and scold. (1.-jugwa, 2.-jwide, 3.-jwisya, 4.-jwida, 5.-jwidalyo, 6.-jwisya, 7.-jwa-jwa, 8.-jwana) Also: -nonkola, -mwa, -monsa.
  • pout, Ncibi kujwa mulomo kubapati nobakulaya. It is bad to pout to the elders when they are correcting you.

insult, ridicule, Kujwana nkokuti kutukila, kapati kusabauzyanya. = Kujwana means to insult and especially to ridicule. Bakajwana tususu. = They plucked out each others hairs (a metaphor used to say they did not respect one another but treated one another as cousins.)

cry as a baboon, Ujwema buya kulila mwana wabapati bangu mbuli cipombo. The child of my elder sister cries like a baboon. Nibakakongwa bana bakajwema mbuli basokwe. = When the children were frightened they cried like monkeys. (1.-jwemwa, 2.-jwemede, 3.-jwemya, 4.-jwemena, 5.-jwemenalyo, 6.-jwemesya, 7.-jwema-jwema) Also: -cwema, -kwiila.

cut grass for, rt. -jwa, Basimbi bakaunka musyokwe kuya kumujwida bwizu mucembele. = The girls went into the bush to cut grass for the old woman. (1.-jugwa, 2.-jwide, 3.-jwisya, 5.-jwidalyo, 6.-jwisya, 7.-jwa-jwa, 8.-jwana)

make piercing or deafening noise, scream, squeak, Kakazikujwima kulila nibakakauma nkaanga Nchimunya. When they beat Ncimunya she screamed. Majuni aatuba alasabila cakuti muntu takonzyi kuzibona nonzi atalika kujwima. The big white birds make so much of a din that when they start to squall a person cannot sleep. Also: -kwiila, -cwemba, -kwemba, -cwema. (1.-jwimwa, 2.-jwimide, 3.-jwimya, 4.-jwimina, 5.-jwiminalyo, 6.-jwimisya, 7.-jwima-jwima)

speak with very weak voice, Bakajana nguzu zyabacembele zyamana, akukanana bacaazya buyo kukaama. They found the strength of the old woman was finished and in speaking her voice was just a whisper. (1.-kaamwa, 2.-kaamede, 3.-kaamya, 4.-kaamina, 5.-kaaminalyo, 6.-kaamisya, 7.-kaama-kaama) Also: -kakama.

strike repeatedly, Bakamujaya akumukabaula akeembe. They killed him and struck him repeatedly with an axe. Keembe nkakamukabaula syaanza ankumo kumusaulula. It was an axe which struck the lion on the forehead which finished him off. (1.-kabaulwa, 2.-kabaulide, 3.-kabauzya, 4.-kabaulila, 5.-kabaulilalyo, 6.-kabaulisya, 7.-kabaula-kabaula, 8.-kabaulana)
kwaamba speak with a lisp, Mutinta uyayausya kwaamba. = Mutinta speaks with a lisp

lap water with tongue, *Mubwa waukabbwaila mukupa oonse ngobayobwede basankwa.* = The dog lapped up all the milk which the boys had kept. *Mulwazi wali kukabbwaila buya kunywa meenda.* = The patient was just lapping the water with the tongue. (1.-kabbwailwa, 2.-kabbwailide, 3.-kabbwaizya, 4.-kabbwailila, 5.-kabbwaililalyo, 6.-kabbwailisya, 7. -kabbwaila-kabbwaila) Also: -kabwila.

lap up, as a dog, *Mubwa waukabwila mukupa wali mumupika.* = The dog lapped up the milk which was in the pot. Also: -kabbwaila, -mwankila, -kapa (1.-kabwila, 2.-kabwilide, 3.-kabwizya 4.-kabwizyizya, 5.-kabwizyizyalyo, 6.-kabwilisya, 7.-kabwila-kabwila)
See kabwila

refuse, *Wakakaka kuya kubeetela meenda bacembele.* = He refused to bring water for the old woman. (1.-kakwa, 2.-kakide, 3.-kasya/-kakisya, 4.-kakila, 5.-kakilalyo, 6.-kakisya, 7.-kakakaka, 8.-kakana)

be hoarse, *Ijwi lyakwe lilakakama, ncataimbi kabotu.* = His voice is hoarse, that is why he does not sing well. (1.-kakamwa, 2.-kakamide, 3.-kakamya, 4.-kakamina, 5.-kakaminalyo, 6.-kakamisya, 7.-kakama-kakama)

find difficulty in doing something, *Ndakali kukakamuka kuuka nindakacisidwe.* = I was finding it difficult to vomit when I was sick. *Mulwazi wakali kukakamuka biya kuzwa mubulo.* = The patient was finding it difficult to get out of bed. Also: -kakazuka, -takamuka (1.-kakamukwa, 2.-kakamukide, 3.-kakamuzya, 4.-kakamukila, 5.-kakamukilalyo, 6.-kakamukisya, 7.-kakamuka-kakamuka)
  • set out, *Basimalungu nibakamvwa makani aaya, bakakakamuka akuccilila.* = When the bead-traders heard the news, they set out and followed. Also: -yumuka, katamuka.

be contracted, as skin, *Cikanda cakakanyana.* = The skin is withered up. (1.-kakanyanwa, 2.-kakanyene, 3.-kakanyika, 4.-kakanyanina, 5.-kakanyaninalyo, 6.-kakanyanisya, 7.-kakanyana-kakanyana, 8.-kakanyaninana)
  • persist, *Kuti muntu wazulwa mukaambo nabetekwa, taelede kukakanyana kukazya pe.* = If a person is convicted when his case has been tried, he ought not to persist in denying his guilt. Also: -kankanyana, -dadanyana, -papanyana, -tutunyana.
be hard and rough, rt. kakanyana *Cikanda camuzovwu cilikakanyene.* = The skin of an elephant is hard and rough.

cause to contract, *Nguni wacikakanyika boobu cisani cangu?* = Who has wrinkled up my dress like this?
  • persist adamantly, *Cakandikakanyika kukazya kaambo, nkuyoowa ntolongo.* = The reason why I persisted in denying the charge was the fear of jail.

persist, be determined, *Toonse tuleelede kukakatila kwiiya kabotu.* = All of us are supposed to persevere in learning well. *Ukakatila kujaya sinkondonyina.* = She is determined to kill her enemy. (1.-kakatilwa, 2.-kakatilide, 3.-kakatizya, 4.-kakatilila, 5.-kakatililalyo, 6.-kakatilisya, 7.-kakatila-kakatila, 8.-kakatilana)

compel, force, *Bakamukakatizya kusikila wazumina kubapa mali.* = They forced him until he agreed to give them money. (1.-kakatizyigwa, 2.-kakatizyide, 4.-kakatilila, 5.-kakatililalyo, 6.-kakatizyisya, 7.-kakatizya-kakatizya, 8.-kakatizyanya)

do things reluctantly, *Ndali kukakazuka buya kubuka akaambo* kamunzuwe. = I was reluctant to get up because of a hangover. (1.-kakazukwa, 2.-kakazukide, 3.-kakazuzya, 4.-kakazukila, 5.-kakazukilalyo, 6.-kakazukisya, 7.-kakazuka-kakazuka)

exert oneself, as to get out of bed, Ndalikulikakazula buya kubuka. It was just with a mighty effort that I rose from bed. Also: -kakazyula. (1.-kakazulwa, 2.-kakazulide, 3.-kakazuzya, 4.-kakazulila, 5.-kakazulilalyo, 6.-kakazulisya, 7.-kakazula-kakazula)

strife for, endeavour, make effort, Ndakalikulikakazyula buya kuzwa mumankandya. I tried hard to get out of the mud. Ndakajana mulwazi ulalikakazyula kuseluka abulo. = I found the patient trying his best to get out of bed.

deny, rt. -kaka Wakatiindipe mulandu, pesi ndakamukakila munkuta. He wanted to accuse me of a crime, but I denied the charge in court. (1.-kakilwa, 2.-kakide, 3.-kakilizya, 4.-kakilila, 5.-kakilalyo, 6.-kakisya, 7.-kakila-kakila, 8.-kakilana) Also: -alila.
  • be impossible, unable to do, Candikakila. = It is impossible for me.

fail to do something, Mubetesi wakakakilwa kundijanina mulandu. The judge failed to find me guilty. Nobakaboola banyina mwana bakajana kuti nzoka eeyi yamena mwana wabo yakakilwa akweenda. = When the mother of the child came she found that this snake which had swallowed her child was unable to move. Also: -alilwa.
refuse completely, rt. -kaka, Kokakisya kutegwa aleke kukuzumanana muntu ooyo. Refuse completely so that that person will stop pestering you.
prevent, Inzala yakandikakizya kubinga mpongo. The hunger prevented me from driving the goats.

uproot, Twakalikakula bbwe lyakabaalila bapati. = We uprooted the stone which the elders failed to do. (1.-kakulwa, 2.-kakwide, 3.-kakuzya, 4.-kakwida, 5.-kakwidalyo, 6.kakulisya, 7.-kakula-kakula) Also: -dadula.
crawl, as a baby, Mwana muvwanda tacikonzyi kukalaba. = An infant cannot crawl. (1.-kalabwa, 2.-kalabede, 3.-kalabya, 4.-kalabila, 5.-kalabilalyo, 6.-kalabisya, 7.-kalaba-kalaba) Also: -yavwula.

be angry, Wakakalala musankwa nibakamubbida ndyasyo zyakwe. = The boy was annoyed when they stole his sandals. Also: -nyema, -bilila. (1.-kalalwa, 2.-kalalide, 3.-kalazya, 4.-kalalila, 5.-kalalilalyo, 6.-kalalisya, 7.-kalala-kalala, 8.-kalalilana)

be angry with, reprimand, rt. -kalala, Bakamukalalila baama nkaambo wakanyansya. = Mother was angry with him because he showed disrespect. Uleelede kumukalalila kutegwa acileke kuuma bana = You ought to reprimand him so that he stops beating the children. (1.-kalalilwa) Also: -lemanina, -nyemena.

answer in an angry tone, Bali kwiide kukalamuka kukanana bacembele. = The old woman was just answering in an angry voice. Also: -syoleka, -celemuka (1.-kalamukwa, 2.-kalamukide, 3.-kalamuzya, 4.-kalamukila, 5.-kalamukilalyo, 6.-kalamukisya, 7.-kalamuka-kalamuka, 8.-kalamukilana)
  • rush in, e.g Syuumbwa wakakalamuka akusotokela muciba mwakali moombe. = The lion rushed in and jumped into the kraal where the calf was.

go at high speed as animal, gallop, Mbizyi yakakalanta citaambiki kuya ku Monze. = The horse was galloping at an astonishing speed going to Monze. (1.-kalantwa, 2.-kalantide, 3.-kalatizya, 4.-kalantila, 5.-kalantilalyo, 6.-kalantisya, 7.-kalanta-kalanta)

sing one's own name with pride, Wakaimba akulikalauka cakabotu-kabotu. She sung her name slowly with pride. Chuugwa wakajisi bubi kulikalauka kuti wakalibambilide kunjila munanda yokwa simunzyaabo. = Chuugwa was busy praising himself saying that he was ready to take over the house of his uncle. Also: kulibanda. (1.-kalaukwa, 2.-kalaukide, 3.-kalauzya, 4.-kalaukila, 5.-kalaukilalyo, 6.-kalaukisya, 7.-kalauka-kalauka)
  • sound repeatedly, as drumming or gunfire, Ingoma yakakalauka. = A drum sounded repeatedly.
  • react angrily, Wali kulikalauka nibamunyemya basankwa. = He reacted angrily when the boys annoyed him.
make angry, annoy, rt. kalala, Michelo jilo ndakamukalazya. = I annoyed Michelo yesterday. (1.-kalazyigwa, 2.-kalazyide, 3.-kalazya, 5.-kalazyizyalyo, 6.-kalalisya, 7.-kalazya-kalazya, 8.-kalazyanya)

cough Naakabuka wakakasaazya tweenda, wakalikupula kumeso, wakabiika mfwuko, wakafweba nkabela wakalikaluka kukola. When he got up he heated a little water, he washed his face, he filled his pipe, he smoked and coughed. (2.-kalukide, 3.-kaluzya, 4.-kalukila, 5.-kalukilalyo, 6.-kalukisya, 7.-kaluka-kaluka)

milk, Bana, kamubweza milewu, mukakame = Children, bring a milking pot, go and milk. (1.-kamwa, 2.-kamide, 3.-kamya, 4.-kamina, 5.-kaminalyo, 6.-kamisya, 7.-kama-kama)
  • milk someone, i.e. drain their wealth from them, Basicikolo balayanda kukama bazyali nobaunka kucikolo. = School children want to take all their parents' wealth when they go to school.
  • eat food without relish, Twali kwiile kukama nsima = We were just squeezing the porridge. (Without relish.)

clap, Bamacembele balakamba nobaimba kumalende. = The old women clap when they are singing at the rain-shrine. Kwakamba nkwasi kkwakkwa-kkwa kkwa-kkwa. There was clapping 'kkwa-kkwa-kkwa kkwa-kkwa' (1.-kambwa, 2.-kambide, 3.-kambya, 4.-kambila, 5.-kambilalyo, 6.-kambisya, 7.-kamba-kamba, 8.-kambilana.)
  • be empty, as groundnuts, Ndongwe zyabacembele zilakamba nkaambo bakamuka kuzisyanga. = The groundnuts of the old woman were empty because she was late in planting them.
clap repeatedly, Bamalozi balakamba-kamba nobaanzyanya. = The Balozi clap repeatedly when greeting each other.

come to top, as dead fish, Inswi zyaile kukambama nizyakolwa ntimba. The fish were just floating on the top when they imbibed the mud. (1.-kambamwa, 2.-kambene, 3.-kambamya, 4.-kambamina, 5.-kambaminalyo, 6.-kambamisya, 7.-kambama-kambama) Also: - kapama.
go without carrying anything, Muvwimi wakali kwiile kukambasa naakapiluka kuzwa kukuweza. = The hunter was empty-handed when he returned from hunting.

preach, Mufwundisi wakakambauka kwaciindi cilamfwu. = The priest preached for a long time. (1.-kambaukwa, 2.-kambaukide, 3.-kambauzya, 4.-kambaukila, 5.-kambaukilalyo, 6.-kambaukisya, 7.-kambauka-kambauka, 8.-kambaukilana) Also: -ccumaila, -ccumayila

preach for, Bakamukambaukila kabotu mu Nsondo. = They preached well for you on Sunday.
  • lecture, Bapati bakakambaukila mwana utamvwi lyoonse. = The elders lectured a child who never listens.

clapping hands to thank or make petition, rt. -kamba. Bakamukambila kuti mvwula iboole. = They clapped for him asking for rain. Twakabakambila kale Bina Syaadene. = We already clapped for the mother of Syaadene. (1.-kambilwa, 2.-kambilide, 3.-kambya, 4.-kambila, 5.-kambilalyo, 6.-kambilisya, 7.-kambila-kambila, 8.-kambilana)
  • clap with open palm against one's hip to show sincere gratitude, Bacembele nibakatambula mali, bakakambila akasolo. = When the old woman received the money, she clapped herself on the hip.

show admiration, honour, appreciation, Bakamukambilila nkaambo wakaambaula kabotu. = They honoured him because he spoke well. (1.-kambililwa, 2.-kambilide, 3.-kambya, 4.-kambilila, 5.-kambililalyo, 6.-kambililisya, 7.-kambilila-kambilila, 8.-kambililana)
  • clap for rain, Bacipaila mizimo akukambilila mvwula. = They still offer sacrifice to the spirits and pray for rain.

be clapped for, be petitioned, rt. -kamba, Bakaamba kuti bakali kuya kwa Chibwe kumukaintu wakali musinsimi alimwi wakali kukambilwa mvwula. = They said they were going to Chibwe to a woman who was a prophetess who was a famous rain-maker. (1.-kambilwa, 2.-kambilidwe, 3.-kambilizya, 4.-kambililwa, 5.-kambililwalyo)

become tired of, Twakambuka kulya musyobo wacisyu omwe mazuba manji. = We are tired of eating one type of relish for many days. (1.-kambukwa, 2.-kambukide, 3.-kambuzya, 4.-kambukila, 5.-kambukilalyo, 6.-kambukisya, 7.-kambuka-kambuka)

make one tired of, Nyama ilakambula. The eating of meat becomes tiresome. Candikambula. = I am tired of it. Mukamwana abajikile ceeci, balo ategwa eeci cakulya cabakambula, ncobalya akumunzi. = When her son's wife cooked her something she would say that she was tired of this food, that is what they eat even at home. (1.-kambulwa, 2.-kambulide, 3.-kambuzya, 4.-kambulida, 5.-kambulidalyo, 6.-kambulisya, 7.-kambula-kambula)

make one tired of eating or drinking the same thing, rt. -kambula, Candikambusya kunywa mabisi alula mazuba oonse = Drinking bitter sour milk every day makes me fed up. (1.-kambusyigwa, 2.-kambusyide, 3.-kambusya, 4.-kambusyizya, 5.-kambusyizyalyo, 6.-kambulisya, 7.-kambusya-kambusya) Also: -nunkuzya.

slap hard, Musilikani wamukampa lubayi musankwa mpoona wawa. The policeman struck the boy with a hard slap, whereupon he fell. (1.-kampwa, 2.-kampide, 3.-kampya, 4.-kampila, 5.-kampilalyo, 6.-kampisya, 7.-kampa-kampa, 8.-kampana) also -anzamuna, -kamba

travel quickly, Bacembele bakakampaana kuya kukulila muzyukulu. = The old woman travelled quickly to go and weep for her grandchild. (2.-kampaanide, 3.-kampaanya, 4.-kampaanina, 5.-kampaaninalyo, 6.-kampaanisya, 7.-kampaana-kampaana)

slap hard with both hands, Wakandikampaika mbayi akundidibaula makkofi. = He slapped me hard and hammered me with his fists. (1.-kampaikwa, 2.-kampaikide, 3.-kampaizya, 4.-kampaikila, 5.-kampaikilalyo, 6.-kampaikisya, 7.-kampaika-kampaika, 8.-kampaikana)

overflow, flood, *Mulonga wakakampaila atala niwakawula.* = The river overflowed when it was full. (2.-kampailide, 3.-kampaizya, 4.-kampa-ilila, 5.-kampaililalyo, 6.-kampailisya, 7.-kampaila-kampaila)
  • walk with heavy steps, *Mupaizi wakali kukampaila kweenda nkaambo wakakatala kapati.* = The priest was walking with heavy steps because he was very tired.

massacre, *Bamalozi bakakampaula bantu boonse akutola nombe.* = The Balozi massacred all the people and took the cattle. (1.-kampaulwa, 2.-kampaulide, 3.-kampauzya, 4.-kampaulila, 5.-kampaulilalyo, 6.-kampaulisya, 7.-kampaula-kampaula, 8.-kampaulana)

overflow, *Notwali kuya kucikolo twajana mulonga ukampila atala.* = When we were going to school we found the river overflowing. (2.-kampilide, 3.-kampizya, 4.-kampila, 5.-kampilalyo, 7.-kampila-kampila,) Also: -kampaila
suck at short intervals as a calf. *Tacili cibotu kukampulula kukama nkaambo inga moombe wafwuluka.* = It is not good to take the milk frequently because the calf will become thin.

hit with or against, rt. *kampa*, *Mubwa wakamukampya cisako, mpoona wakafwa.* = He hit the dog with a stick, thereupon it died. *Naakali kutija nkondo, wakabbalula mwana akumukampya kucisamu kuti atijaane kabotu.* = When she was running away from the war, she removed the child from her back and hit the child against the tree (i.e. killing it) so that she could run faster. Also: -umputya. (1.-kampwa, 2.-kampide, 3.-kampya, 4.-kampila, 5.-kampilalyo, 6.-kampisya, 7.-kampa-kampa, 8. -kampana)
  • make travel fast, *Imvwula njiyakakampya mulonga ooyu.* = It was the rain which turned this river into a torrent.
set off in a crowd, *Bantu banji bakakamuka kuya kudilwe.* = The people set off in a crowd going to the funeral. (2.-kamukide, 3.-kamuzya, 4.-kamukila, 5.-kamukilalyo, 7.-kamukakamuka)

be combed, rt. -kamuna, *Masusu aakwe wakaliakamude kabotukabotu.* = She had combed her hair carefully. (1.-kamunwa, 3.-kamuzya, 4.-kamwida, 5.-kamwidalyo, 6.-kamunisya, 7.-kamude-kamude, 8.-kamunana)

comb, *Sunu ndaluba kulikamuna.* = I forgot to comb myself today. *Wakalikamuna masusu akwe akucita mukkekkezu.* = He was combing his hair amd making a parting. Also: -sakula. (1.-kamunwa, 2.-kamude, 3.-kamuzya, 4.-kamwida, 5.-kamwidalyo, 6.-kamunisya, 7.-kamuna-kamuna, 8.kamunana)
  • take a lot, *Ibabbi bakakamuna butanga bwajombe.* = The thieves took many cattle from the herd.

remilk, rt. -kama, *Kamukamununa nombe kutegwa mukupa uvwule.* = Remilk the cows so that the milk will be enough. 1.-kamununwa, 2.-kamunwide, 3.-kamunuzya, 4.-kamunwida, 5.-kamunywidalyo, 6.-kamununisya, 7.-kamununa-kamununa)

push, *Mukaintu naayanda kutumbuka ulalikana.* = When a woman wants to give birth she pushes the child out. (1.-kanwa, 2.-kanide, 3.-kanizya, 4.-kanina, 5.-kaninalyo, 6.-kanisya, 7.-kana-kana) Also: -tonka.

speak, converse, e.g *Kamukanana basa tumvwe camuleta kokuno.* = Speak friends so that we hear what has brought you here. *Ndali kuyanda kuti tu-* kanane biya mulomo mpande. = I desired that we speak directly to one another. (1.-kananwa, 2.-kananide, 3.-kanazya, 4.-kananina, 5.-kananinalyo, 6.-kananisya, 7.-kanana-kanana, 8.-kananinana)

talk to, rt. -kanana, Twaambo otu ntumwakali kundikananina twakandinonezya. These topics you were talking to me about delighted me.
  • talk quietly, Nobakali kulya kunyina mwana wakali kukanana pe, abalo bapati bakali buyo kukananina ansi. = When they were eating no child was talking and also the elders would just speak quietly.

speak having a cold, Bakali kukanazya mumpemo. = They were talking through the nose (i.e. because of having a common cold).
  • encourage to talk, Kamumukanazya mweenzu asangabalilwe. = Encourage the visitor to talk so that he feels at home.
trample as clay, Bamutuma kuya kukanda bulongo kukalonga. = They sent him to trample clay at the river. (1.-kandwa, 2.-kandide, 3.-kandya

4.-kandila, 5.-kandilalyo, 6.-kandisya, 7.-kanda-kanda, 8.-kandana.)
  • knead as dough, Kamukanda busu tujike tumbuwa. Knead the dough so that we make buns. Weendeenda kaniini wakkala. Wakanda busu kuti cibe ceele walya. He travelled a little distance, he sat down. He kneaded maize flour so that it became porridge, he ate.
  • bathe with hot water as a wound, Kamumukanda kabotu kutegwa kuulu kupone. Bathe him with hot water so that the leg gets better. Kolikanda ameenda apya gondo lyako lyafwuyuka. = Massage your sprained knee with hot water. Bamacembele mbabakali kumukanda mutumbu akumujikila Iweele. The midwives were the ones who were bathing the mother with hot water and cooking her light porridge.

beat repeatedly with a cane, Bakamukandaula Chinyakama banyina. The mother beat Chinyakama repeatedly with a cane. Koya unditemene muluso, njanda kumukandaula. = Go and cut me a cane, I want to beat him. (1.-kandaulwa, 2.-kandawide, 3.-kandauzya, 4.-kandawida, 5.-kandawidalyo, 6.-kandaulisya, 7.-kandaula-kandaula, 8.-kandaulana)

fear, be startled, express surprise, Ndakanduka nindamvwa cali kusokonya musyokwe. = I was startled when I heard a rustling noise in the bush. Aaba bantu balakomwa kufwumbwa kuti tutakanduki. These people will be overcome provided that we are not cowards. Also: -kankamana (2.-kandukide, 3.-kandusya, 4.-kandukila, 5.-kandukilalyo, 6.-kandukisya, 7.-kanduka-kanduka, 8.-kandukana)

repeat, Ulakandulula kwaamba. You repeat saying. (1.-kandululwa, 2.-kandulwide, 3.-kanduluzya, 4.-kandululwida, 5.-kandululwidalyo, 6.-kanduluzya, 7.-kandulula-kandulula, 8.-kandululana)
  • mix well, Basankwa bakandulula bulongo kutegwa baume kabotu zitina. = The boys mixed the clay well so that they could make good bricks.

make one afraid, rt. kanduka, Nguni wakukandusya? = Who terrified you? Also: -konga, -yoosya. (1.-kandusyigwa, 2.-kandusyide, 3.-kandusya, 4.-kandusyizya, 5.-kandusyizyalyo, 6.-kandusya, 7.-kandusya-kandusya, 8.-kandusyanya)

fry, Bakanga nyama yacilalilo. They fried the meat for supper. (1.-kangwa, 2.-kangide, 3.-kangizya, /-kanzya, 4.-kangila, 5.-kangilalyo, 6.-kangisya, 7.-kanga-kanga, 8. -kangana)
  • burn patterns, as on a spear-shaft, *Kolikanga sumo.* = Burn designs on the spear-shaft.
  • become hoarse, *Wakalikwiimba masiku oonse nkabela ijwi lyakwe lyakakanga.* = He was singing all night and so his voice became hoarse.

sleep in a helpless state, *Mwati ooyu abuke oobu mbwaakangabala?* = Will this one wake up as he lies in such a helpless state? (1.-kangabalwa, 2.-kangabete, 3.-kangabazya, 4.-kangabalila, 5.-kangabalilalyo. 6.-kangabalisya, 7.-kangabala-kangabala)

fry quickly, *Kamu-kanga-kanga tuswi balye beenzu.* = Fry the little fish quickly so that the visitors eat.
  • terrify, *Wandikanga-kanga munyama.* = The animal terrified me. Also: -konga.

handle carelessly, *Cibi-ya tacili mbuli mpoto nzyobajikila mazuba ano zinga noikangalisya taipwaiki.* = A traditional earthen pot is not like those with which they cook nowadays which do not break even when you handle them carelessly. (1.-kangalisyigwa, 2.-kangalisyide, 3.-kangalizya, 4.-kangalisyizya, 5.-kangalisyizyalyo, 7.-kangalisya-kangalisya)

quarrel, *Tacili cibotu kubantu bakwetene kukangana akati kabantu.* = It is not good for married people to quarrel in public. (1.-kanganwa, 2.-kanganide, 3.-kanganya, 4.-kanganina, 5.-kanganinalyo, 6.-kanganisya, 7.-kangana-kangana) Also: -gangana, -zwangana.

walk with a limp, *Kweenda ulakangaila akaambo kacilonda cili amwiindi.* When he walks he moves with a limp because of the sore on the calf of his leg. (1.-kangailwa, 2.-kangailide, 3.-kangaizya, 4.-kangailila, 5.-kangailalyo, 6.-kangailisya, 7.-kangaila-kangaila) Also: -sunkuta, -dyabila.

speak or act in a rough manner, *Kukangauka taciboneki kabotu lili beenzu.* It does not seem right to behave impolitely when visitors are present. (1.-kangaukwa, 2.-kangaukide, 3.-kangausya, 4.-kangaukila, 5.-kangaukilalyo, 6.-kangaukisya, 7.-kangauka-kangauka, 8.-kangausyanya)
  • struggle, *Kuti kamuyanda kukama kabotu kamwiiyanga kumaulu nombe kutegwa ileke kukangauka.* If you want to milk a cow properly you should tie its hind legs so that it does not struggle. Also: -pabauka

be spoiled, retarded, *Matobo akakangila, taakabizwa kabotu akaambo kampeyo.* The matobo fruits were spoiled, they were not properly ripened because of the cold. Also: -gaangila. (1.-kangilwa, 2.-kangilide, 3.-kangizya, 4.-kangilila, 5.-kangilalyo, 6.-kangilisya, 7.-kangila-kangila)
  • become enured, *Babbi bakakangila akaambo kakuumwa ciindi coonse.* = Thieves became enured because of being beaten continuously.
  • fry for, rt. -kanga, *Ndiyanda kukangila mayi beenzu kuti balye.* = I want to fry eggs for the visitors to eat.

fry with, rt. -kanga, *Baama bakangizya mafwuta angulube zinkwa.* = Mother uses lard to fry buns.
  • spoil, *Mukaintu utacizyi kusanzya zisani, ulazikangizya.* A woman who does not know how to wash clothes, spoils them. *Izuba lyakakangizya mango, ncaatalweeli kabotu.* The sun spoiled the mangoes, that is why they are not sweet.

be uprooted, *Iguwo lyakali kunga lyaamba lyabbubbula, masamu amwi akali kwiile kukanguka ku-* zyuka akutyoka. = It used to happen that when a strong wind blew, some trees were uprooted and were broken apart. (1.-kangukwa, 2.-kangukide, 3.-kanguzya, 4.-kangukila, 5.-kangukilalyo, 6.-kangukisya, 7.-kanguka-kanguka, 8.-kangulana)
  • throw one's leg over, Nchimunya wakakanguka ncinga kutija babbi. = Nchimunya mounted the bicycle to run away from thieves. Also: -panguka.

begin, Sena bakanka kale kuzikka muntu? = Have they already begun to bury the deceased? Also: -talika. (1.-kankwa, 2.-kankide, 3.-kankizya, 4.-kankila, 5.-kankilalyo, 6.-kankisya, 7.-kanka-kanka, 8.-kankana)
  • name a person, Bakamukanka zina Iya Cheelo. = They named him Cheelo. Also: -ulika
  • rush off, Wakalukanka lubilo kuya munanda kutija bataata akaambo kabulubizi bwakwe. = He rushed off into the house running away from my father because of his mistake.
marvel, be amazed.
boast, Ucimana kulikankaizya boobu, wakaunka. When he had finished boasting, he went off.

tremble, Koleka kukankama, ulailosya nkomeki yabulongo. = Stop shivering, you will drop the clay cup. Mpeyo yabukandu yamupa kukankama mbuli kwale. The coldness of cowardice made him tremble like a partridge. Wakatalika kukankama kutondezya kuti wakali kuciswa ntuntumaanzi. = He began to shiver showing that he was suffering from malaria. Also: -bimba, -dedelas, -zyangama, -tutuma, -ndendema. (1.-kankamwa, 2.-kankamide, 3.-kankamya, 4.-kankamina, 5.-kankaminalyo, 6.-kankamisya, 7.-kankama-kankama)

be astonished, Ciletela kukankamana kumvwa makani ayoosya ali boobu. It brings trembling to hear such terrifying news as this. (1.-kankamanwa, 2.-kankamanide, 3.-kanka-musya, 4.-kankamanina, 5.-kankamaninalyo, 6.-kankamanisya, 7.-kankamana-kankamana, 8.-kankamaninana)
be utterly amazed, rt. -kankamana, Makani aaya alakankamanisya. = This news is astounding. Also: -nyandya, -gambya.
cause amazement, Ndabakankamika akaambo kakuti ali masiku nindakasika. = I startled them because when I arrived it was night.

nail, Kokankamina cijazyo eeco. = Nail that door. (1.-kankaminwa, 2.-kankamide, 3.-kankamizya, 4.-kankaminina, 5.-kankamininalyo, 6.-kankaminisya, 7.-kankamina-kankamina, 8.-kankaminana) Also: -gagaila.

cry out as a hen that has just laid an egg, cackle. Inkuku yali kukankamuka niyamana kutula ji. = The hen gave a loud cackle when she had laid the egg. Also: -kokoleka (1.-kankamukwa, 2.-kankamukide, 3.-kankamusya, 4.-kankamukila, 5.-kankamukilalyo, 6.-kankamukisya, 7.-kankamuka-kankamuka, 8.-kankamukana)
  • express surprise, Bantu banji bakakankamuka kubona mwana wakazyalwa a maulu otatwe. = The people were amazed to see a child born with three legs.

cry out, Wakalyuuma akasolo kumwi ooko kalikankamukila kati, "Maawe! Ndaluba kujala ndemu caangu. She beat herself on the hip while crying out, "Dear me, I forgot to lock up, poor me." Also: -kokoleka, -kokoloka.
  • be surprised, Basimbi bakakankamuka nibakabona mbeba zinji. = The girls were startled when they saw many rats.

roar with laughter, Munene naakawa ansi, Moonde wakakankamuna kuseka. = When the old man fell down, Moonde roared laughing. (1.-kankamunwa, 2.-kankamunide, 3.-kankamuzya, 4.-kankamunina, 5.-kankamuninalyo, 6.-kankamunisya, 7.-kankamuna-kankamuna, 8.-kankamunana) Also: -gagamuna, -cincimuna.

make to shiver, rt. -kankama, Mudaala yamukankamya mpeyo. = The cold made the old man tremble. (1.-kankamizyigwa, 2.-kankamide, 3.-kankamya, 4.-kankamizyizya 5.-kankamizyizyalyo, 6.-kankamizyisya, 7.-kankamya-kankamya, 8.-kankamizyanya)
make an effort, Kamukankanyana nywebo kucita mulimo oyu. = You, make an effort to do this work. Also: -kakanyana, -zuunyana.
cause to make an effort, rt. -kankanyana, Nindakabakankanyika, mulimo wakeenda kabotu. = When I forced them to make an effort, the work went well.

smash, cut down, Koukankata mutwe wasulwe uteteete. = Smash the head of the hare to soften it. (1.-kankatwa, 2.-kankatide, 3.-kankatya, 4.-kankatila, 5.-kankatilalyo, 6.-kankatisya, 7.-kankata-kankata, 8.-kankatana)

move in a halting fashion, Naluntaambwe ulakankatika kweenda. = The chamaleon moves in a halting fashion. (1.-kankatikwa, 2.-kankatikide 3.-kankatisya, 4.-kankatikila, 5.-kankatikilalyo, 6.-kankatikisya, 7.-kankatika-kankatika) Also: -kokobela, -sunkuta.

speak in a slow, drawn out manner, Bantu bakankatila bamusya muswaangano. = People who talk slowly and endlessly prolong the meeting. (1.-kankatilwa, 2.-kankatide, 3.-kankatya, 4.-kankatilila, 5.-kankatilalyo, 6.-kankatilisya, 7.-kankatila-kankatila, 8.-kankatilana)
  • smash on, Kamukankatila acisaka zitende. = Smash the pumpkins on a sack.

make cuts, chop bone, Kamufwambaana kukankaula zifwuwa kutegwa zyajikwa zibizwe. = Be quick to chop the bones so that they are cooked and become ready. Kubaanga basidilwe bakali kusangabalilwa kubona myeendo yaņombe yakankaulwa azikanda. = It seems that the mourners were happy to see that the legs of the cows were being chopped up with the skins on. Also: -sabaula (1.-kankaulwa, 2.-kankaulide, 3.-kankauzya, 4.-kankawida, 5.-kankawidalyo, 6.-kankaulisya, 7.-kankaula-kankaula, 8.-kankaulana)
chop up for or on, rt. kankaula, Kamumukankawida nyama. = Chop up the meat into pieces for her/him.

begin from, rt. -kanka, Mulonga Makoye ukankila kwa Moyo. = The river Magoye has its source at Moyo. (1.-kankwa, 2.-kankide, 3.-kankizya, 4.-kankila, 5.-kankilalyo, 6.-kankisya, 7.-kanka-kanka, 8.-kankana) cf. -talikila.

hit with fist, Bausyi bamukanta mweenzuma naanditukila. = My friend's father beat him (i.e. his son) with his fist when he insulted me. (1.-kantwa, 2.-kantide, 3.-kantya, 4.-kantila, 5.-kantilalyo, 6.-kantisya, 7.-kanta-kanta, 8.-kantana)
  • crush fermented maize, Basimbi batalika kale kukanta mimena yabukoko. = The girls have already begin to pound the fermented maize for brewing beer.
pound, hammer, Kamukanta-kanta mapopwe acili matete kutegwa mujane cakulya. = Pound the maize which is still fresh so that you may have some food.

move with satisfaction or pride, Wali kukantaila buya kweenda naajaya sulwe. = He was walking proudly having killed a hare. (1.-kantailwa, 2.-kantailide, 3.-kantaizya, 4.-kantailila, 5.-kantaililalyo, 6.-kantailisya, 7.-kantailakantaila)

be careful, Kokantama kutegwa babbi batakubbidi lubono Iwako. = Be careful that the thieves do not steal from you your goods. Also: -cenjela. (1.-kantamwa, 2.-kantamide, 3.-kantamya, 4.-kantamina, 5.-kantaminalyo, 6.-kantamisya, 7.-kantama-kantama, 8.-kantaminana)
be careful, Ulakantamika mulimo wakwe. He is careful in doing his work. (1.-kantamikwa, 2.-kantamikide, 4.-kantamikila, 5.-kantamikilalyo, 6.-kantamikisya, 7.-kantamika-kantamika, 8.-kantamikana)
travel quickly, Choombe wakali kukantaila kweenda naamvwa kutimba kwasyuumbwa. = Choombe moved quickly when he heard the roar of the lion. Also: -kampaana.

show signs of respect repeatedly or habitually Malende balaakantuka bantu. People always show signs of respect towards the rain-shrine. (1.-kantukwa, 2.-kantukide, 3.-kantusya, 4.-kantukila, 5.-kantukilalyo, 6.-kantukisya, 7.-kantuka-kantuka) Also: -lemeka.
  • be covered with a rash, Mubili oonse wakantuka bukoto-koto. = The whole body is covered with a rash.

speak out energetically, Naakamana kukantuluka boobo mucembele, wakaumuna kumwi kayoya mbuli muntu wakali kufwundilila mucamba cakwe. When the old lady had finished speaking vehemently, she was silent while breathing like a person who has asthma.

repeat saying something, or say something with emphasis, Mulakantulula cintu comwe mbumwali kutalika. = You are saying the same thing since you started. Basibbuku bakali kukantulula kwaambilizya muswaangano. = The headman was vigourously announcing the meeting. (1.-kantululwa, 2.-kantulwide, 3.-kantuluzya, 4.-kantulwida, 5.-kantuIwidalyo, 6.-kantululisya, 7.-kantululakantulula, 8.-kantulwidana)

hit with, rt. kanta, Ninga zyakumaboko aabasimbi zyakali zyakukantya balombe amitwe. = The rings of the girls arms were for hitting boys on the head. (used as a noun, Ooyu muntu ulaa kantya. This person is foolish.) (1.-kantwa, 2.-kantide, 3.-kantya, 4.-kantila, 5.-kantilalyo, 6.-kantisya, 7.-kanta-kanta, 8.-kantana)

squeeze, compress, knead, Kamukanya zisani eezyo kutegwa muziyanike. Wring out the clothes so that you can hang them up to dry. (1.-kanywa/kanyigwa, 2.-kanyide, 3.-kanyizya, 4.-kanyina, 5.-kanyinalyo, 6.-kanyisya, 7.-kanya-kanya, 8.-kanyana) Also: -konya, -nyona, -tyanka, -sina.
mould with fingers as clay or putty, Mwana wali kukanyakanya bulongo naabija mumaanza. = It was when the child was moulding clay that the hands became dirty.

eat quickly in large mouthfuls, Wakaikanyauna nsima ciindi cisyoonto nkaambo wakalaa nzala. = He gobbled up the nsima in a short time because he was hungry. (1.-kanyaunwa, 2.-kanyaunide, 3.-kanyauzya, 4.-kanyaunina, 5.-kanyauninalyo, 6.-kanyaunisya, 7.-kanyauna-kanyauna)
stuff ones mouth with food, Sena wamana kukanyuna makusu aansima? = Have you finished filling yourself with lumps of nsima?

plan, Bantu bakanza kuzyoondijaya. = The people are planing to kill me. Bamwi bantu bakanza biyo. = Some people just plan. (i.e. they don't implement their plans.) (1.-kanzwa, 2.-kanzide, 3.-kanzia, / kanzizya, 4.-kanzanina, 5.-kanzaninalyo, 6.-kanzisya, 7.-kanza-kanza, 8.-kanzana)
  • set out on journey Sunu nkanza kuya kumusanza kukusunza zilyo. = Today I will set off to the south to ask for food.

make frightening threats, Bamwi bakali kumusibilizya nkaambo nalikanzaya boobu kukanana bakali kumulanga bagunya-gunya mitwe yabo. = Some were urging him on to fight because when he spoke so vehemently they were looking at him nodding their heads. Busiku wakali kulikanzaya akukwangala mbuli mucende uyanda kulwana. Busiku was threatening and itching for a fight like a bull who wants to attack. (2.-kanzayide, 3.-kanzazya, 4.-kanzayila, 5.-kanzayilalyo, 6.-kanzayisya, 7.-kanzayakanzaya, 8.-kanzayilana)

change one's purpose or intention, rt. -kanza, Nibakamwa kwaambilwa kuli bamwi, bakakanzuluka alimwi. When they heard what other people were saying, they changed their minds again. Also: -sandula mizeezo. (1.-kanzulukwa, 2.-kanzulukide, 3.-kanzuluzya, 4.-kanzulukila, 5.-kazulukilalyo, 6.-kanzulukisya, 7.-kanzuluka-kanzuluka, 8.-kanzulukana)
lap like a dog, Mubwa ulakapa meenda amulaka. The dog is lapping water with its tongue. (1.-kapwa, 2.-kapide, 3.-kapya, 4.-kapila, 5.-kapilalyo, 6.-kapisya, 7.-kapa-kapa) Also: -kabwila, -kabbwaila.

overflow onto, Mabisi akakapaikila ansi niyakavwula nsuwa. = The sour milk spilt onto the ground when the milk gourd was full. (1.-kapaikilwa, 2.-kapaikide, 3.-kapaizya, 4.-kapaikilila, 5.-kapaikilalyo, 6.-kapaikisya, 7.-kapaikila-kapaikila)
overflow, Mulewu niwakazula mukupa, wakali kwiile kukapaila ansi. = When the milking pot was full, the milk was just pouring out.

come to top as dead fish, Inswi zyakapama atala ameenda. = The fish were coming on to the surface of the water. Also: -ibuka, -ibama, -kambama. (1.-kapamwa, 2.-kapamide, 3.-kapamya, 4.-kapamina, 5.-kapaminalyo, 6.-kapamisya, 7.-kapama-kapama)

strip bark from tree, Kamukapaula makwa acisamu eeco. = Strip the bark off that tree. Also: -kwama. (1.-kapaulwa, 2.-kapaulide, 3.-kapauzya, 4.-kapaulida, 5.-kapaulidalyo, 6.-kapaulisya, 7.-kapaula-kapaula, 8. -kapaulana)
  • look for something, Munene ukapaula nombe zyone. The old man is looking for four cattle. Tumbaambi twakali kubafwutauka-fwutauka bavwimi mazuba aya, pele bakatujana nobakakapaulakapaula. The small antelopes were running away from the hunters those days, but they found them when they searched about. Also: - yandaula.

seek out, search for, Lyoonse muntu wafwa, nomuba muntenda, bazyali bakali kukapula muntu wamulowa. When a person died, even in an accident, the parents were seeking out the one who bewitched him/her. (1.-kapulwa, 2.-kapwide, 3.-kapuzya, 4.-kapwida, 5.-kapwidalyo, 6.-kapulisya, 7.-kapula-kapula, 8.-kapulana)

be warm, Aaya meenda alakasaala ngaayandika kusamba. = This water which is warm is what is needed to wash. (2.-kasaalide, 3.-kasaazya, 4.-kasaalila, 5.-kasaalilalyo, 6.-kasaalisya, 7.-kasaala-kasaala, 8.-kasaazyanya)

heat for, rt. -kasaala, _Balombe bakasamba maanzi akasaala akabakasaazizya basimbi babo masiku._ = At night the men washed in warm water which their girl-friends had heated for them. (1.-kasaazyigwa, 2.-kasaazyide, 3.-kasaazya, 4.-kasaazyizya, 5.-kasaazyizyalyo, 6.-kasaazyisya, 7.-kasaazya-kasaazya, 8.-kasaazyanya) Also: -kazazizya.

cause to become warm, heat, rt. -kasaala, _Kamukasaazya meenda bayanda kusamba bataata._ = Warm the water, father wants to wash. _Mpoona aalya aselukila nkuku, alekela bamintengwe kulila, banene mpobakunkila mulilo kucibalu, bamane nkukasaazya tweenda._ = The time when the hens came down and the swallows stopped crying, that is when the old man lit a fire at the fence-shelter, having done that he warmed a little water. (1.-kasaazyigwa, 2.-kasaazyide, 3.-kasaazya, 4.-kasaazyizya, 5.-kasaazyizyalyo, 6.-kasaazyisya, 7.-kasaazya-kasaazya, 8.-kasaazyanya)
heat for, _Nindakabuka, ndakajana bandikasaazyila meenda akusamba amubili._ = When I woke I found they had heated water for me to wash.

be hot in body, _Mwana wali kukasuka mubili masiku oonse._ = The child was hot in the body all night. (1.-kasukwa, 2.-kasukide, 3.-kasukizya, 4.-kasukila, 5.-kasukilalyo, 6.-kasukisya, 7.-kasuka-kasuka) Also: -pya.

refuse, rt. -kaka, _Musimbi wakwe ngwaakali kuyanda kukwata bamukasya balaawe._ = The relatives of the girl whom he wanted to marry refused him. _Makani aya andikasya koona._ = That matter keeps me from sleeping. _Wakatalika kulikasya kulya._ = He began to fast. (1.-kasyigwa, 2.-kasyide, 3.-kasyizya, 4.-kasyila, 5.-kasyilalyo, 6.-kasyisya, 7.-kasya-kasya, 8.-kasyanya)
be bitter as a lemon, _Bamwi bantu tabayandi kunywa mabisi akasyamuka._ = Some people do not like to drink sour milk which is acidic. Also: -papa, -nyemuka.

refuse a person, _Nkaambo nzi ncobatukasyila kujaya banyama?_ = Why do they not allow us to kill animals? (1.-kasyilwa, 2.-kasyilide, 3.-kasyizya, 4.-kasyila, 5.-kasyilalyo, 6.-kasyisya, 7.-kasya-kasya, 8.-kasyilana)

become tired, _Ndakatala kubeleka mumuunda sunu._ = I am tired working in the field today. (1.-katalwa, 2.-katede/-katalide, 3.-katazya, 4.-katalila, 5.-katalilalyo, 6.-katalisya, 7.-katala-katala.) Also: -beba, -lema.
become tired of, _Mbwaakakatalila buyo kusobana cisolo, ngooyu nkunyamuka nkutozya kucibaka cimbi._ = When he became tired of playing cisolo, he got up and went off to another place.

be refreshed, _Nindapumuna akusamba, ndalimvwa kukatalukwa._ = When I rested and washed, I felt refreshed. (2.-katalukide, 3.-katalusya, 4.-katalukila, 5.-katalukilalyo, 6.-katalukisya, 7.-katalukwa-katalukwa, 8.-katalukana)

rise from a sitting position, as when many start off together, _Basicikolo bakatamuka kuzwa mubakkede nikwanjila babbi muzyooneno zyabo._ = The pupils rose up from where they were resting when the thieves entered their dormitory. _Nindakadubula intobolo, buyuni bwakakatamuka kuuluka._ = When I fired the gun, the flock of birds rose up togther into the air. Also: -nyandukila amwi, -nyamukila antoomwe. (1.-katamukwa, 2.-katamukide, 3.-katamuzya, 4.-katamukila, 5.-katamukilalyo, 6.-katamukisya, 7.-katamuka-katamuka)

make tired, annoy, trouble, be difficult, Mulimo ngwecita ulakatazya. The work which I am doing is difficult. (1.-katazyigwa, 2.-katazyide, 3.-katazyisya, 4.-katazyizya, 5.-katazyizyalyo, 6.-katazyisya, 7.-katazya-katazya, 8.-katazyanya)
  • be mysterious, be related to spirit world, Ooyu mulundu wakali kukatazya kutanta nsiku. This mountain was difficult to climb in the past.
cause trouble to, rt. -katazya, Ino umukatazizyanzi mukaintu wako? = Now why are you troubling your wife?

lift up something heavy, Ndakacikatula cituli canyama kuzwa munkwandi. I lifted up the piece of meat from a wooden plate. (1.-katulwa, 2.-katwide, 3.-katuzya, 4.-katwida, 5.-katwidalyo, 6.-katulisya, 7.-katula-katula, 8.-katulana)

be rested, Ndalikoona, ndakatulukwa kale. I was sleeping, I have already rested. Also: -katalukwa. (2.-katulukide, 3.-katulusya, 4.-katulukila, 5.-katulukilalyo, 6.-katulukisya, 7.-katulukwa-katulukwa, 8.-katulukana)

be cheeky, Ooyu mwana ulakaya ncatafwambaani kucita ncatumwa. = This child is cheeky that is why he does not hurry to do what he is sent for. (Ulaa gayu. = He is full of cheek.) (2.-kayide, 3.-kayizya, 4.-kayila, 5.-kaayilalyo, 6.-kayisya, 7,-kaya-kaya, 8.-kayana)
  • protect, Bamwi bananga balicizyi kukaya maanda amisamu yabo. = Some witchdoctors know how to protect houses with their charms. Also: -vwuma.

hold oneself from, rt. kaka, Walikazizya kuti atawi. = He was stopping himself from falling. (2.-kazizyide, 3.-kazizya, 4.-kazizyizya, 5.-kazizyizyalyo, 6.-kazizyisya, 7.-kazizyakazizya, 8.-kazizyanya)
  • deny for, rt. -kaka, Wakali kukazizya mwanaakwe kuti tali nguwakabbide. = He was denying on behalf of his child saying that he/she (i.e. the child) had not stolen.

oppose, refuse, rt. kaka, Muzeezo umwi waamba kuti nkwate, uumwi ulakazya. One thought says I should marry, the other is against it. Ncibi kuzumanana kucita cintu kuti kumwi kolikazya omwini. It is bad to persist in doing a thing which you yourself oppose. (1.-kazyigwa, 2.-kazyide, 3.-kazizya, 4.-kazyizya, 5.-kazyizyalyo, 6.-kazyisya, 7.-kazya-kazya, 8.-kazyanya

deny, Mutinta wakasaanguna kukazya-kazya naakali ku betekwa, pesi kumamanino wakauzumina mulandu. Mutinta was initially denying her crime when she was being tried, but in the end she admitted the offence. Also: -fwama-fwama, -ziza-ziza.

oppose one another, contradict one another, rt. -kaka, Eeyi mizeezo ilakazyanya muli ndime. = These thoughts are conflicting within me.
  • argue, Bantu bacikazyanya, tabaningakuzuminana. The people are still arguing, they have not yet agreed with one another. Also: -tengauzyanya.
cluck, cackle, Inkuku nseke ilakekela. = The hen is clucking. (1.-kekelwa, 2.-kekelede, 3.-kekelezya, 4.-kekelekela, 5.-kekelekelalyo, 6.-kekelesya, 7.-kekela-kekela) Also: -kwekela.
represent, Ndali kukezya bataata kumuswaangano. = I was representing my father at the meeting. (1.-kezyegwa, 2.-kezyide) Also: -iminina.
purr, Nindamubuwa-buwa mangoye, watalika kukiima. When I stroked the cat it began to purr. (1.-kiimwa, 2.-kiimide, 3.-kiimya, 4.-kiimina, 5.-kiiminalyo, 6.-kiimisya, 7.-kiima-kiima) Also: -guluma.

sit, Kokkala kabotu nkaambo cuuno cilityokede. Sit properly because the stool is broken. (1.-kkalwa, 2.-kkede, 3.-kkazya, 4.-kkalila, 5.-kkalilalyo,6.-kkalisya, 7.-kkala-kkala, 8.kkalana.)
  • live, Ndakakkala kwa Chikankata myaka minji. I lived at Chikankata for many years.

be settled, be at peace, Malambo wakakkalikana naakamana kupika ntolongo. = Malambo settled down after serving a jail sentence. Kolindila baama, ndakkalikana ndakugwasya. = Woman wait, when I get settled I will help you. (1.-kkalikanwa, 2.-kkalikenye, 3.-kkalikizya, 4.-kkalikanina, 5.-kkalikainalyo, 6.-kkalikanisya, 7.-kkalikanakkalikana, 8.-kkalikanizyanya)

be in a state of peace, Kuti nibali banji bananga mbuli yuuya mucisi, cisi nicakalikkalikene. If there were many witchdoctors like that one in the country, the country would be in a state of peace. Also: -sitikana.

become quiet, rt. -kkala, Bana, kamukkalikila, mwabakatazya bacembele. Children, be quiet, you are troubling the old woman. Bana, kamukkalikila, ncibi kunyonganizyanya. Children, be at peace, it is bad to be disturbing one another. (1.-kkalikilwa, 2.-kkalikenye, 3.-kkalikizya, 4.-kkalikilila, 5.-kkalikililalyo, 6.-kkalikilisya, 7.-kkalikilakkalikila, 8.-kkalikilana)

appease, keep one quiet, rt. -kkala, Majwi ngindakamwaambila ngaakamukkalikizya. The words which I told him made him quieten down. Waka kkalikizya moyo. He calmed his heart. (1.-kkalikizyigwa, 2.-kkalikizyide, 3.-kkalikizyizya, 4.-kkalikizyila, 5.-kkalikizyilalyo, 6.-kkalikizyisya, 7.-kkalikizya-kkalikizya, 8.-kkalikizyanya)

take care of a sick person, Mbaani baya kumukkalilila kucibbadela oyu? Who is going to take care of this one at the hospital? (1.-kkalililwa, 2.-kkalilide, 3.-kkalilizya, 4.-kkalililila, 5.-kkalilililalyo, 6.-kkalililisya, 7.-kkalililakkalilila, 8.-kkalililana)
  • sit and wait for, Simavwupu ukkalilila bana bankuku. The big vulture is sitting waiting for the chicks.

stay a long time, rt. -kkala, Eeci cisani cakkalisya awa. This cloth is here for a long time. (1.-kkalisyigwa, 2.-kkalisyide, 3.-kkalisyizya, 4.-kkalisyila, 5.-kkaisyilalyo, 6.-kkalisyisya, 7.-kkalisya-kkalisya)

throb, Wakamvwa mutwe watalika kukkasa kucisa akaambo kamizeezo. He felt his head begin to throb with the pain because of the thoughts. Also: -pasauka, -gamauka. (2.-kkaside, 3.-kkasizya, 4.-kkasila, 5.-kkasilalyo, 6.-kkasisya, 7.-kkasa-kkasa)
  • creak, Batija basankwa nicakkasa cisamu ncibalikugonka. The boys moved away quickly when the tree creaked which they were cutting. Also: -tonga

walk with heavy steps, Wakatalika kweenda kukkasyaila kutobelezya kulubazu olo ndowakaletezya mumvwi. He began to go with heavy steps following that side from where the arrow had come. (1.-kkasyailwa, 2.-kkasyailide, 3.-kkasyaizya, 4.-kkasyailila, 5.-kkasyaililalyo, 6.-kkasyailisya, 7.-kkasyailakkasyaila) Also: -kkansyaila

put sitting or to rest, Bakamukkazika acuuno kuti apumune. They put him sitting on a chair to rest. Nobakamana kujika batumbu, baka fwambaana kukkazyika cakulya atafwule. = When the mother had finished cooking, she quickly set it on the table. Babwa tabeelede kukkazikwa anzala. = Dogs should not be left in hunger. (1.-kkazikwa, 2.-kkazikide, 3.-kkazikizya, 4.-kkazikizyizya, 5.-kkazikizyizyalyo, 6.-kkazikizyisya, 7.-kkazika-kkazika, 8.-kkazikana)
  • quieten the heart, Cibwantu ncindanywa cifwumofwumo candikkazika moyo = The sweet-beer which I drank this morning has cooled my heart. Also: -bombesya, -obezya moyo.

unlock, unhitch, Cijazyo camootokala nicakakkiiluka twakayoowa. = When the door of the car was opened we feared. (1.-kkiilukwa, 2.-kkiilukide, 3.-kiiluzya, 4.-kkiilukila, 5.-kkiilukilalyo, 6.-kkiilukisya, 7.-kiiluka-kiiluka, 8.-kiilukana) Also: -kkomonoka, -jaluka.
unlock, (ety. Eng.) Kamukkiilula munanda mugusye busu mulijikile nsima. = Unlock the house so that you take out the mealie meal and cook for yourselves.

lock, (ety. Eng.) Kamukkiya murjanda omo inga kakuyoonjila babbi. = Lock that house lest thieves enter. (1.-kkiigwa, 2.-kkiide, 3,-kkiizya, 4.-kkiila, 5.-kkiilalyo, 6.-kiisya, 7.-kkiya-kkiya, 8.-kkiyana) Also: -kkoma, -inga

obtain in a cunning way, Banywa kapati bukoko balayanda kukkolovwela mali kubeenzinyina. = Those who drink beer a lot like to get money from others in a cunning way. "Njakukupa mali manji kuti wazumina," wakaamba Kachila cakukkolovwela mu-simbi. "I will give you a lot of money if you agree," said Kachila in a cunning way to the girl. (1.-kkolovwelwa, 2.-kkolovwede, 3.-kkolovwesya, 4.-kkolovwelela, 5.-kkolovwelelalyo, 6.-kkolovwesyesya, 7.-kkolovwela-kkolovwela, 8.-kkolovwelana) Also: -nyengelela.

be convinced, Bunji bwabantu bana Zinywidaamwi bakakkolwa ncobeni kuti Munali wakali muntu nobakamubona ulalya. Many of the people of Zinywidaamwi were really convinced that Livingstone was a human being when they saw him eating. Twakakkolwa akumanizya kuzyiba kuti munanga ooyu ulabona ncobeni. We were convinced and fully satisfied in our inquiry that this witchdoctor really sees (when he divines). Kuti bantu bakkolwa ncobeni kuti oonse malengwa-lengwa ngobabona ansi ali mumaanzaa Leza, bayakutanda bulozi. = If the people are really convinced that all creatures which they see are in the hands of God, they will drive out witchcraft. (2.-kkolwede, 3.-kkolwezya, 4.-kkolwela, 5.-kkolwelalyo, 6.-kkolwesya, 7.-kkolwakkolwa)

put up wooden structure of roof, Basankwa bakkoma ciluli cananda yabacembele. The boys are putting up the wooden structure for the house of the old woman. Also: -gagayila (1.-kkomwa, 2.-kkomede, 3.-kkomya, 4.-kkomena, 5.-kkomenalyo, 6.-kkomesya, 7.-kkoma-kkoma, 8.-kkomana)
  • hitch up, Kokkoma kabotu jamba litakkomonoki twatalika kulima. = Hitch up the plough properly so that it does not become detached when we begin to plough. Also: -kkiya.

be happy, Ndakakkomana nindakasalwa kuya kwiiminina cikolo cesu mukusotoka. = I was happy when I was chosen to represent our school in jumping. (1.-kkomanisyigwa, 2.-kkomenye, 3.-kkomanisya, 4.-kkomanina, 5.-kkomaninalyo, 6.-kkomanisya, 7.-kkomana-kkomana, 8.-kkomaninana.)
make very happy, Kaimbo aka kakamukkomanisya kapati. = This little tune made her very happy.
be in a happy state, Nibakasika mumyuunda bakatalika kusya mbeba kabakkomenyi boonse. = When they reached the fields they all happily began to dig for rodents.
be surprised, Ndakkomokwa kumvwa kuti nguwakabba. = I was surprised to hear that he was the one who had stolen. Also: -nyandwa, -gambwa.

unhitch, Yakkomonoka nketani nitwali kulima mumuunda wabacembele. The chain became = unhitched when we were ploughing in the old woman's field. Also: -kkiiluka, -vwakunuka. (1.-kkomonokwa, 2.-kkomonokede, 3.-kkomonozya, 4.-kkomonokela, 5.-kkomonokelalyo, 6.-kkomonokesya, 7.-kkomonoka-kkomonoka)

push, Ndajana bana bakkuba wilibbala lizwide cimbwali = I found the children pushing a wheelbarrow full of sweet-potatoes. Twakatalika kukkuba macinga kunjila mumunzi. We began to push the bicycles entering the village. (1.-kkubwa, 2.-kkubide, 3.-kkubya, 4.-kkkubila, 5.-kkubilalyo, 6.-kkubisya, 7.-kkuba-kkuba, 8.-kkubana) Also: -kuba.
depart, Amukkuke kuli ndime. = Depart from me. Also: -zwa

unyoke, release, Mufwambaane kubakkulula basune nkaambo bwizu tabuli bunji. Be quick to unyoke the oxen because the grass is scarce. Waka-fwambaana kukkulula naakabona kuti umwi musune waciswa. He was quick to unyoke the oxen when he saw that one was sick. Also: -popolola. (1.-kkululwa, 2.-kkulwide, 3.-kkuluzya, 4.-kkulwida, 5.-kkulwidalyo, 6.-kkululisya, 7.-kkulula-kkulula, 8.-kkululana)

cause to be satisfied or filled, rt. -kkuta, Icipa nombe kweenda nkokuti ziyandaula mweemvwe mubotu ukonzya kuzikkusya. = What makes the cattle move is that they want fresh grass which can satisfy them. (1.-kkusyigwa, 2.-kkusyide, 3.-kkusyizya, 4.-kkusyila, 5.-kkusyilalyo, 6.-kkusyisya, 7.-kkusya-kkusya, 8.-kkusyanya)
  • take out, Kamukkusya mabwe mumugwagwa. Remove the stones from the road. Also: -gusya.
be filled, Ndakakkuta nindakamana kulya nsima. = I was full when I had finished eating nsima. (1.-kkutwa, 2.-kkutide, 3.-kkutya, 4.-kkutila, 5.-kkutilalyo, 6.-kkutisya, 7.-kkuta-kkuta, 8.-kkutana.)
be satisfactory, Makani ngaakaamba jilo munkuta alakkutwa. = The statement that he made in court yesterday is satisfactory.

equal, Wakandaambila kuti wakakkwanya myaka makumi one amyaka yobilo. He told me he had reached forty two years. (1.-kkwanigwa, 2.-kkwenye, 3.-kkwanya, 4.-kkwanina, 5.-kwaaninalyo, 6.-kkwanisya, 7.-kkwanya-kkwanya, 8.-kkwanana)

strike a match, Kamukkwenyuna mancisi tuyasye mulilo. = Strike matches so that we light a fire. (1.-kkweenyunwa, 2.-kkwenyude, 3.-kkwenyuzya, 4.-kkwenywida, 5.-kkwenywidalyo, 6.-kkwenyunisya, 7.-kkwenyuna-kkwenyuna) Also: -gunyuna, -gwetula.
  • tick off, Bayi bakkwenyuna mapepa aabasicikolo. The teacher is ticking off the papers of the pupils.

tick off for, mark for, Kondikkwenywida ibbuku ndindasiya atafwule. Mark the book for me which I left on the table.
  • strike a match, Kondikkwenywida mancisi undidonekele musanga. = Strike a match for me and light the cigarette for me.
board a train with, rt. kwela, Wakandipa amali akukkwezya citima akulya munzila. He gave me money to board a train and for food on the way. Also: -tanta

board a train, Nsejisi amali akukwezyėka citima pe. = I have no money for getting on the train. (1.-kkwezyekwa, 2.-kkwezyekede, 4.-kkwezyekela, 5.-kkwezyekelalyo, 7.-kkwezyeka-kkwezyeka, 8.-kkwezyekana)

bring back, Bana baya kukukoba nombe. The children have gone to bring back the cattle. Kokoba nombe zitanjili mumyuunda yabantu. = Go and bring back the cattle so that they do not enter into people's fields. (1.-kobwa, 2.-kobede, 3.-kobya, 4.-kobela, 5.-kobelalyo, 6.-kobesya, 7.-koba-koba, kobana) Also: -nyona, -yobolola
  • become loose, Looye Iwaanzya mubwa Iwakoba. The rope with which the dog is tied is loose..
loosen, Kacikoba-koba citolopu kutegwa citamusini musune. = Let the strap become loose so that the ox is not choked. Also: -tebeka.

hang many things, Wakalikobaika malungu-malungu munsingo. She hung many strings of beads around her neck. Kamukobaika mitendu yanyama amulenga. = Hang the pieces of meat on the rack. (1.-kobaikwa, 2.-kobaikide, 3.-kobaizya, 4.-kobaikila, 5.-kobaikilalyo, 6.-kobaikisya, 7.-kobaikakobaika, 8.-kobaikana)

hook, hang, wire to, Zisani kozikobeka amulenga. Hang the clothes on the line. (1.-kobekwa, 2.-kobekede, 3.-kobezya, 4.-kobekela, 5.-kobekelalyo, 6.-kobekesya, 7.-kobeka-kobeka, 8.-kobekana)
  • handcuff, Nobakamujata mubbi bakamukobeka nsimbi kutegwa atatiji. = When they caught the thief they handcuffed him so that he would not escape.
be hung up, Cakakobekwa mvwiki yakamana cisani eci. = This cloth was hung up last week.

protect from/against, Usyi ukobelela mwanaakwe alubeta. = The father was protecting his child from being sentenced. Mfwulumende tiidyaaminini muntu pe, ilakobelela. = The government does not oppress a person, it protects. (1.-kobelelwa, 2.-kobelede, 3.-kobelezya, 4.-kobelelela, 5.-kobelelelalyo, 6.-kobelelesya, 7.-kobelela-kobelela, 8.-kobelelana)
  • restrain, Kamukobelela mpongo kutegwa zitanjili mumuunda wabantu. Prevent the goats from entering someone's field. Also: -kwabilila.

be restricted, Tayandi kukobelelwa akaniini. = He does not want to be restricted in any way. (2.-kobelede, 3.-kobelezya, 4.-kobelelela, 5.-kobelelelalyo, 6.-kobelelesya, 7.-kobelelwa-kobelelwa, 8.-kobelelana)
  • be secure, Milawo yakamukkomanisya akulimvwa kukobelelwa. = She was pleased with the rules and felt secure.

loosen, Kolukobezya looye ndwaangidwe musune. Loosen the rope holding the ox. Also: -tebezya. (1.-kobezyegwa, 2.-kobezyede, 3.-kobezyesya, 4.-kobezyezya, 5.-kobezyezyalyo, 6.-kobezyesya, 7.-kobezya-kobezya, 8.-kobezyanya)
take midday meal, Bakapiluka kumunzi kuzikukoboka. returned home to take the midday meal. (1.-kobokwa, 2.-kobokede, 3.-kobozya, 4.-kobweda, 5.-kobwedalyo, 6.-kobokesya, 7.-koboka-koboka) They
take midday meal at, Kulya cikoboko, ndakaakukobokela ku Kapiri Mposhi. = To eat the midday meal, I took it at Kapiri Mposhi.

stub or root out shrubs, Bataata bakobola muunda mupya. = My father is stubbing the shrubs in the new field. Also: -gobbola, -panda. (1.-kobolwa, 2.-kobolede, 3.-kobozya, 4.-kobolela, 5.-kobolelalyo, 6.-kobolesya, 7,-kobola-kobola)
  • stamp half-ripe grain or tobacco leaves etc., Bamaama balikukobola makowa matete muncili. = My mother was pounding fresh cucumbers in a mortar.

bring people or cattle together, e.g Mutinta wakasola kukobolola beenzinyina boonse kutegwa beendele antoomwe kunkolola. = Mutinta tried to bring all her friends together so that they would go together to the initiation ceremony. Basankwa baunka kukukobolola nombe musyokwe. = The boys have gone to bring cattle together in the bush. Also: -yobolola. (1.-kobololwa, 2.-kobolwede, 3.-kobolozya, 4.-kobolweda, 5.-kobolwedalyo, 6.-kobozyesya, 7.-kobolola-kobolola, 8.-kobololana)

bring in cattle at mid-day for milking, Swebo kwesu twakatalika kale kukobosya. At our home we have already started bringing in the cows for milking at midday. (1.-kobosyegwa, 2.-kobosyede, 3.-kobozyezya, 4.-kobozyela, 5.-kobozyelalyo 6.-kobozyesya, 7.-kobosya-kobosya)

make loose, Kokobya-kobya citolopu kutegwa citamusini musune. = Loosen the strap so that the ox is not choked. (1.-kobezyegwa-kobezyegwa, 2.-kobede-kobede, 3.-kobyakobya, 4.-kobela-kobela, 5.-kobelalyokobelalyo, 6.-kobelesya-kobelesya, 7.-kobezya-kobezya, 8.-kobezyanyakobezyanya)
kukodoola meso roll the eyes.

keep the head inclined to one side and have a strange look, Muntu unyansya inga ulakodyomana mutwe akulanga. A person who shows disrespect inclines the head to one side when s/he looks at you. (1.-kodyomanwa, 2.-kodyomene, 3.-kodyomanya, 4.-kodyomanina, 5.-kodyomaninalyo, 6.-kodyomanisya, 7.-kodyomanakodyomana)
  • be deformed with bent head, Akaambo kamulilo wakaumuumpa munsingo wakakodyomana. Because of the fire which burnt his neck, his head was bent down on his chest.

cultivate, Bamwi bakaunka kukukofwola, bamwi kukulimina alimwi bamwi kukusinda. = Some went to cultivate, some to weed and some to till. (without planting). (1.-kofwolwa, 2.-kofwede, 3.-kofwozya, 4.-kofweda, 5.-kofwedalyo, 6.-kofwolesya, 7.-kofwolakofwola.)
become thin, Babwa batalyi kabotu balakoka. = Dogs who do not eat well become thin. (1.-kokwa, 2.-kokede, 3.-kosya, 4.-kokela, 5.-kokelalyo, 6.-kokesya, 7.-koka-koka.) Also: -nankana.

shrink back in pain, Musankwa wakakokobala naakakwabbuIwa cimboko. = The boy writhed in pain when he had been beaten with a sjambok. (1.-kokobalwa, 2.-kokobalide, 3.-kokobesya, 4.-kokobalila, 5.-kokobalilalyo, 6.-kokobalisya 7.-kokobala-kokobala) Also: -kukubala.

act slowly, Koleka kukokobela kweenda ulakuluma musune. = Do not walk slowly, the ox will toss you. Naakacili kukokobela kugusya mali mu silikani wakamujata. = When he was moving slowly to take out the money, a policeman caught him. Also: -ima-ima, -noneleka, -tombaila. (1.-kokobelwa, 2.-kokobede, 3.-kokobezya, 4.-kokobelalila, 5.-kokobelalilalyo, 6.-kokobesya, 7.-kokobela-kokobela)

break by twisting, Mucembele wakacikokocola cisamu ciyumu cankuni. = The old woman broke the dry stick for firewood. (1.-kokocolwa, 2.-kokocwede, 3.-kokocozya, 4.-kokocweda, 5.-kokocwedalyo, 6.-kokocolesya, 7.-kokocola-kokocola, 8.-kokocolana)

pluck flowers, trim grass, cull, lap off, prune, extract, Moonga ukokola cisamu camango. = Moonga is pruning a mango tree. Bakaintu balakokola nyemu. = The women are extracting the nuts from the shells. Also: -nentula, -sonzola, -sonsolas, -kokoola, -konka. (1.-kokolwa, 2.-kokwede, 3.-kokozya, 4.-kokweda, 5.-kokwedalyo, 6.-kokolesya, 7.-kokola-kokola, 8.-kokolana)
  • cough to attract attention, Naakasika munsi ananda wakalikokola kutegwa bafwambaane kumubona. = When he arrived near the house he coughed so that they would quickly see him.
  • influence a woman to accept marriage for a man who is absent, Malimba nguwakali kukokola kuli Maliya kuti azumine kuli Kachabe. = Malimba is the one who was proposing to Maliya for Kachabe that she would accept him (Kachabe). Also: -kokweda.
  • take girl away for marriage after the preliminary marriage payments have been made, Kwainda mazuba otatwe nombe yamalyansima amusune wamuyumusyo kazyuunkile kwabo musimbi, basikutwala inga baunka kuti bakakokole musimbi wabo. = When three days have passed, the ox for the father and the beast for the girl having gone to the girl's home, the boy's claimants go to take away their girl.

cry out as hen which has just laid an egg, Eeyi nkuku yatalika kale kukokoleka. = This hen has already started clucking. Also: -kankamuka. (1.-kokolekwa, 2.-kokolede, 3.-kokolezya, 4.-kokolekela, 5.-kokolekelalyo, 6.-kokolekesya, 7.-kokoleka-kokoleka)

crow, croak, Mukombwe ulakokoloka masiku amasikati. = The cock crows at night and during the day. Bacula bakali kukokoloka kunselelo akalonga. = The frogs were croaking down by the stream. (1.-kokolokwa, 2.-kokolokede, 3.-kokolozya, 4.-kokolokela, 5.-kokolokelalyo, 6.-kokolokesya, 7.-kokoloka-kokoloka, 8.-kokolokana)
  • speak arrogantly, Kukokoloka akati kabapati cilatondwa. = To speak without respect before the elders is taboo.

resemble completely, Ooyu mwana wakakokolola bausyi. = This child resembled the father exactly. (1.-kokololwa, 2.-kokolwede, 3.-kokolozya, 4.-kokolweda, 5.-kokolwedalyo, 6.-kokololesya, 7.-kokolola-kokolola, 8.-kokololana)
  • clear away or clean out, scoop out, Kamulikokolola tombe lili mulubuwa. = Clear away the dirt from the yard. Kamukokolola makololo akokoloke oonse. = Clean out the burnt food so that it is cleaned out completely. Masowe wamana kale kukokolola ncili. = Masowe has already finished scooping out the mortar.

argue with one another, Mainza bakacili kukokolosyanya abamasilikani. = Mainza was still arguing with the police. (1.-kokolosyegwa, 2.-kokolosyede, 3.-kokolosyezya, 4.-kokolosyanizyizya, 5.-kokolosyanizyizyalyo, 6.-kokolosyesya, 7.-kokolosyanya-kokolosyanya, 8.-kokolosyanya)

be plucked, rt. -kokola, Ndongwe zyakakokolwa kale. = The groundnuts have been plucked already. (1.-kokolwa, 2.-kokwede, 3.-kokozya, 4.-kokweda, 5.-kokwedalyo, 6.-kokolesya, 7.-kokolwa-kokolwa, 8.-kokolana)

be paralized, withered, be shrunk, Kuulu kwakakokonyana. = The leg is paralized. Also: -gogonyana, -konkonyana. (1.-kokonyanwa, 2.-kokonyene, 3.-kokonyeka, 4.-kokonyanina, 5.-kokonyaninalyo, 6.-kokonyanisya, 7.-kokonyana-kokonyana) Ooyo mutendu wanyama ngwaakasiya wakakokonyana akuyuma lumpampaninga amulenga. That piece of meat which he left has shrunk and has stuck to the rack. Also: -fwinyana, -onyana.
make to shrink, Kupya kwazuba kulakokonyeka zikutu zyabanyama. The heat of the sun will make the hides of the animals shrink.

propose marriage for someone, rt. -kokola, Malimba nguwakakokweda Kachabe musimbi wakukwata. = Malimba is the one who proposed marriage to a girl for Kachabe. (1.-kokolwa, 2.-kokwede, 3.-kokozya, 4.-kokweda, 5.-kokwedalyo, 6.-kokolesya, 7.-kolweda-kokweda, 8.-kokwedana)

make drunk, Bukoko bukola bantu. = Beer intoxicates people. (1.-kolwa, 2.-kolede, 3.-kozya, 4.-kolela, 5.-kolelalyo, 6.-kolesya, 7.-kola-kola. 8.-kolana)
  • cause illness, poison, Muchelo wakakola mubwa wangu. The medicine poisoned my dog.
  • be exhausted, as with hunger, Nzala yakamukola. The hunger finished him.
  • cough, Ulakola mwana oyu citaambiki. = This child coughs terribly.
  • grow old, mature, Ndongwe zyabacembele zyakasigwa kazitanakola. = The groundnuts of the old lady were dug before they were fully mature. (As noun, Ooyu mubwa Kaluumwaya mmukola. = This dog Kaluumwaya has grown old.)
  • be powerless, Ooyu mukaintu ngowakali kweendelezya zyamurjanda zyoonse, musankwa tanaakali kukola pe. = The wife was the one who controlled everything in the house, the husband had no power.

cough often or continually, Uciswa nzi ncotaleki kukolakola? = What sickness have you that you do not stop coughing continually?
  • be ripe, Okuya kumuunda wakali kusala mapopwe aakajisi misuku mipati yakali kulangika kuti nseke zyakakolakola. Over there in the field he was selecting maize stalks which had big cobs with grains that seemed to be ripe.

cough, Wiile kukolauka kutalikila jilo kumazuba. He has just been coughing, starting from yesterday evening. (1.-kolaukwa, 2.-kolaukide, 3.-kolauzya, 4.-kolaukila, 5.-kolaukilalyo, 6.-kolaukisya, 7.-kolauka-kolauka)

cough towards, Tacili cibotu pe kukolela kubusyu bwamuntu. = It is not proper to cough facing a person. (1.-kolelwa, 2.-kolede, 3.-kolezya, 4.-kolela, 5.-kolelalyo, 6.-kolesya, 7.-kolela-kolela, 8.-kolelana) =

make oneself strong, Nokuba kuti wakatala kale, kolikolelezya buyo, uyakusika ku Monze. Even though you are already tired, keep it up, you will reach Monze. Also: -yumya-yumya (1.-kolelezya, 2.-kolelezyegwa, 3.-kolelezyede, 4.-kolelezyela, 5.-kolelezyelalyo, 6.-kolelezyesya, 7.-kolelezya-kolelezya, 8.-kolelezyanya)

become ugly, Ooyu munene wakakolobbana kubusyu naakapya mulilo. The old man became disfigured when he was burnt by the fire. (1.-kolobbanwa, 2.-kolobbenye, 3.-kolobbanya, 4.-kolobbanina, 5.-kolobbaninalyo, 6.-kolobbanisya, 7.-kolobbana-kolobbana) Also: -galangana.
cause to become ugly, Cakamukolobbanya kumeso nkupya mulilo. It was fire which caused him to be ugly in the face.
be ugly, Basimbi banji tabayandi basankwa bakolobbenye. = Many girls do not like ugly men.

dig into the side of a grave below, Bakakoloboka kuti bacite nkumbwi oku kwakali kubikkwa mutunta. = They dug into the side to make a compartment where the corpse was put. (1.-kolobokwa, 2.-kolobokede, 3.-kolobokezya, 4.-kolobokela, 5.-kolobokelalyo, 6.-kolobokesya, 7.-koloboka-koloboka)

show signs of on-coming ing heavy rain, Kamutola ŋombe ku-munzi, imvwula yakoloka. Take the cattle to the village, the heavy rain is about to start. (1.-kolokwa, 2.-kolokede, 3.-kolozya, 4.-kolokela, 5.-kolokelalyo, 6.-kolokesya, 7.-koloka-koloka)

become sober, Wakakololokwa kumazuba, kumane wakacaala mbuli muntu watakakoledwe. = She was sober by the evening, until eventually she was left like a person who had not been drunk. Also: -kwempula. (2.-kololokede, 3.-kololozya, 4.-kololokela, 5.-kololokelalyo, 6.-kololokesya, 7.-kololoka-kololoka)

cover one's face, Ino ukolomana nzi? = Why are you covering your face? (1.-kolomanwa, 2.-kolomenye, 3.-kolomanya, 4.-kolomanina, 5.-kolomaninalyo, 6.-kolomanisya, 7.-kolomana-kolomana)
  • be furious, Naakanyema wakakolomana mbuli mujembwe ulwana. = When he was angry he was as furious as a buck-goat fighting. Also: -bolomana.

reprimand, scold, Mudaala wali kukolomena bana basowa ŋombe. The old man was reprimanding the children who had lost the cattle. (1.-kolomenwa, 2.-kolomenye, 3.-kolomenya, 4.-kolomenina, 5.-kolomeninalyo, 6.-kolomenisya, 7.-kolomena-kolomena)

tumble down, Zyakolomoka zitina zyaŋanda kuzwa kujulu. = The bricks of the house fell down from above. Mwana oyu wakakolomoka munsi ajeleele. The child fell over near the cliff. Kwakali kwiile kubee makumbi ayanda kukolomoka avwumbe nyika yoonse. It was just as if the clouds wanted to roll down and cover the whole land. Nkondo yakakolomoka yacivwula mabwe. = The war descended like hailstones. (1.-kolomokwa, 2.-kolomokede 3.-kolomozya, 4.-kolomokela, 5.-kolomokelalyo, 6.-kolomokesya, 7.-kolomokakolomoka) Also: -dilimuka,-oleka.

demolish, Bakaikolomona ŋanda. They demolished the house. Kamukolomona ŋanda yakaindi kuyakwe imbi. Knock down the old house so that a new one can be built. (1.-kolomonwa, 2.-kolomwede, 3.-kolomozya, 4.-kolomonena, 5.-kolomonenalyo, 6.-kolomonesya, 7.-kolomona-kolomona)

cough continuously, Muzyukulu wangu wali kukolooka masiku oonse. My grandchild was coughing continually the whole night. (1.-kolookwa, 2.-kolookede, 3.-koloozya, 4.-kolookela, 5.-kolookelalyo, 6.-kolookesya, 7.-kolooka-kolooka)

be impending, threaten (as rain), rt. -koloka, Kamutola boombe muciba, imvwula yakolozya kumbo. = Take the calves to the kraal, the dark rain clouds are threathing from the west. (2.-kolozyede, 3.-kolozya, 4.-kolozyela, 5.-kolozyelalyo, 6.-kolozyesya, 7.-kolozyakolozya)
be drunk, rt. -kola, Mukaintu ukolwa bukoko mmubi. = A woman who gets drunk with beer is a bad one. (2.-kolede, 3.-kozya, 4.-kolelwa, 5.-koleIwalyo, 6.-kolesyegwa, 7.-kolwa-kolwa, 8.-kolana)

look hurriedly or furtively, Boonse buyo bakali kwiide kukolyaula buyo meso awo aumwi mpaakakkede kubee tabamubwene. = All were just taking a hurried look, each one where he was sitting, as if they had not seen him.

overcome, Twakabakoma mbotwakali kuzundana limwi. = We defeated those with whom we were competing. Also: -gundula, -zunda, -nyombola. (1.-komwa, 2.-komede, 3.-komya, 4.-komena, 5.-komenalyo, 6.-komesya, 7.-koma-koma, 8.-komana)
implore, pray, Bayakukukomba kumalende. = They have gone to pray at the rain-shrine. (1.-kombwa, 2.-kombede, 3.-kombya, 4.-kombela, 5.-kombelalyo, 6.-kombesya, 7.-komba-komba, 8.-kombana.)
