  • cast off skin, Nzoka nozilikwama cikanda caatala cilacaala munsi. = When snakes slough they leave their skins behind. Cikanda cakatalika kulikwama. = The skin began to peel off by itself.
  • strike, Nkaanga sulwe kakamukwama suntwe kumakosi. = The hare struck the hyena on the back of the neck.
  • insult, Mutinta wakamukwama musankwa akwe, mpoona cisyabo cakamaninalyo. = Mutinta insulted her boyfriend, thereupon the friendship was completely ended. Also: -sampaula.

strip off, Twatuma basankwa bobilo kuya kukwamanya loozi. = We sent two boys to strip off fibres. (1.-kwamanyizigwa, 2.-kwamanyide, 3.-kwamanyigwa. 4.-kwamanyizyizya. 5.-kwakanyizyizyalyo, 6.-kwamanyizyisya, 7.-kwamanya-kwamanya, 8.-kwamanyanana) Also: -kapaula,-fwunda

be split, Nitwakamana kuuma zitina zyakakwamauka nkaambo bwakaceya bwizu bwakuvwumbya. When we had finished moulding the bricks, they split because there was insufficient grass to cover them. (1.-kwamaukwa, 2.-kwamaukide 3.-kwamauzya, 4.-kwamaukila, 5.-kwamaukilalyo, 6.-kwamaukisya, 7.-kwamauka-kwamauka) =

dissect, cut in small pieces, Bacikwamaula muciindi cisyoonto cisamu ciya. = They cut up that tree into pieces in a short time. Also: - kwamauna. (1.-kwamaulwa, 2.-kwamaulide, 3.-kwamauzya, 4.-kwamaulila, 5.-kwamaulilalyo, 6.-kwamaulisya, 7.-kwamaula-kwamaula, 8.-kwamaulana)

tear, cut up into pieces, Kamukwamauna cisamu eeci muzipandu-pandu. Cut up this wood into pieces. Also: -pandaula, -kwamaulas, -kwamauna, -bbaluula. (1.-kwamaunwa, 2.-kwamaunide, 3.-kwamauzya, 4.-kwamaunina, 5.-kwamauninalyo, 6.-kwamaunisya, 7.-kwamaunakwamauna, 8.-kwamaunana)

scratch, Muvwimi umwi kakamukwamba kaluwe naakakajana kacegwa kukakole. = A certain hunter was scratched by a leopard when he found it caught in a trap. Sena mamvwa nkundikwamba! Didn't the thorns scratch me! Ulalikwamba amubili. He is scratching himself on the body. Also: kulikwenya, kulikwezya (1.-kwambwa, 2.-kwambide, 3.-kwambya, 4.-kwambila, 5.-kwambilalyo, 6.-kwambisya, 7.-kwamba-kwamba, 8.-kwambana.)

scratch as on ground with paws, Babwa bali kukwamba-kwamba abwina bwambeba. = The dogs were scratching at the hole of the rats. Also: -swapula.
  • rub beak/nose. Walikwamba ampemo. She was rubbing herself on the nose.

tear up, Baikwambaula nyika nibali kusobana bbola. = They tore up the ground when they were playing football. Ijuni lyakamugomoona mukaintu akumukwambaula. The big bird pecked the woman with its beak and tore her. (with claws). Also: -kwamauna, -fwudulula. (1.-kwambaulwa, 2.-kwambawide, 3.-kwambauzya, 4.-kwambawida, 5.-kwambawidalyo, 6.-kwambaulisya, 7.-kwambaula-kwambaula, 8.-kwambaulana)

extract for, rt. -kwama, Bamakaintu bamazubaano tabacizyi ku kwamina bana babo mpondo zyakulya. = The women of today do not know how to extract mpondo seeds for their children to eat. (1.-kwaminwa, 2.-kwaminide, 3.-kwaminizya, 4.-kwaminina, 5.-kwamininalyo, 6.-kwamininisya, 7.-kwamina-kwamina, 8.-kwamininana)

be splintered as wood, be torn off, *Nindakatantide mujulu, mutabi wakakwamuka nkabela ndakawida ansi.* = When I had climbed up into the tree, a branch broke off and I fell to the ground. *Wakalijisi kahempe katuba kakakwamukide kusule.* = He had a white shirt which was torn behind. Also: -kwamauka, -papauka. (1.-kwamukwa, 2.-kwamukide, 3.-kwamuzya, 4.-kwamukila, 5.-kwamukilalyo, 6.-kwamukisya, 7-kwamuka-kwamuka)
  • burst out, *Kufwumbwa abbabbalisya kubala, walo Maanya nkukwamuka kuseka.* = Whenever he stuttered in reading, Maanya would burst out laughing.
have a torn piece, *Cisani cilaa kabeela kakwamukide.* = The cloth has a piece which is torn. Also: kakwamu

break into pieces, *Kamukwamuna makwa amusamu, tunyike anywinsigwe mwana.* Break off the bark from the tree, let us soak it so that the child may drink it. (the medicine). (1.-kwamunwa, 2.-kwamwide, 3.-kwamuzya, 4.-kwamwida, 5.-kamwidalyo, 6.-kwamunisya, 7.-kwamuna-kwamuna, 8.-kwamunana)
remove covering with, *Bamaama nibakali kukwama makwa mayumu, bakali kukwamya jamba.* = When my mother was removing the hard bark, she was using a hoe.

eat raw, *Aaba balizyibide kukwanga ndongwe.* = They are used to eating uncooked groundnuts. *Omulumi* *wangu, kumunzi toona anzala abana bako ncobeni, yebo ukwanga mapopwe kumuunda.* My husband, we at home sleep with your children in real hunger, while you eat fresh maize in the field. (1.-kwangwa, 2.-kwangide, 3.-kwangizya, 4.-kwangila, 5.-kwangilalyo, 6.-kwangisya, 7.-kwanga-kwanga, 8.-kwangana) Also: -lya bubisi.

long for a fight, *Busiku wakali kulikanzaya akukwangala mbuli mucende uyanda kulwana.* = Busiku was worked up and itching for a fight like a bull who wants to attack. (1.-kwangalwa, 2.-kwaangalide, 3.-kwangalizya, 4.-kwangalila, 5.-kwangalilalyo, 6.-kwangalisya, 7.-kwangala-kwangala, 8.-kwangalana)

contradict one another, *Basibunjaka bakwangana kale.* = The trouble-makers are already contradicting one another. Also: -gwangana, -zwangana. (see extensions for -kwanga)/
  • make noise when laughing much, *Aaba basimbi bali kukwangana.* = These girls were making noise as they were laughing a lot. Also: -gwagwamuka.

clean out all remaining contents, *Bana bakwangula musozya.* = The children cleaned out the rest of the samp. *Kamukwangula ncindaleka.* Finish off what I have left. *Bana tiibakali kuyanda kukwangula Iweele Iwamutumbu nkaambo bakali kuyoowa kuti balasalala masusu.* The children did not want to clean out the dish of light porridge of the mother who had just given birth because they feared their hair would go red. (1.-kwangulwa,2.-kwangwide, 3.-kwanguzya, 4.-kwangwida, 5.-kwangwidalyo, 6.-kwangulsya, 7.-kwangula-kwangla, 8.-kwangwidana)

take out every bit of food left, clean out pot completely, Wa jana twakwangulula cibwantu, utujatile. = You have found we have completely finished off the sweet beer, forgive us. (1.kwangululwa, 2.-kwangulwide, 3.-kwanguluzya, 4.-kwangulwida, 5.-kwangulwidalyo, 6.-kwangululisya, 7.-kwangulula-kwangulula, 8.kwangulwidana)

widen, Nadonkola mpako uliikwankwamuna kuti buci butapwasyuuki nagwisya. When she was making a hole in the tree she widened it so that the honey-comb would not be broken as she removed it. (1.-kwankwamunwa, 2.-kwankwamwide, 3.-kwankwamuzya, 4.-kwankwamwida, 5.-kwankwamwidalyo, 6.-kwankwamunisya, 7.-kwankwamunakwankwamuna) Also: -ngwangwamuna.

quarrel with, Bamakwaako bakwaambila kuti ubayakile butala takukakwa, kulatondwa, takutegwa mwakwankwana munanda wagama kutukana bamakwaako. = When your inlaws tell you to build a maize-bin you should not refuse, it is taboo, you should not quarrel with or insult your in-laws.

walk without carrying any kit, Wali kukwansa buyo, kunyina ncaajisi. He was just walking emptyhanded, he had nothing. Also: -enda cinkwamaanza. (1.-kwanswa, 2.-kwanside, 3.-kwansizya, 4.-kwansila, 5.-kwansilalyo, 6.-kwansisya, 7.-kwansa-kwansa)

slap, Bataata bakandikwapa lubayi nindakamuka kujalwida nombe. = My father slapped me when I was late in letting the cattle out. (1.-kwapwa, 2.-kwapide, 3.-kwapya, 4.-kwapila, 5.-kwapilalyo, 6.-kwapisya, 7.-kwapa-kwapa, 8.-kwapana)
be whipped, Zisamu anze azyalo zyakali kulimvwisya kukwa pauka. The trees also outside were heard being whipped (by the wind).

cane, scourge, Bayi bakali kukwapaula basicikolo bakaccelwa. = The teacher was caning the school children who were late. (1.-kwapaulwa, 2.-kwapawide, 3.-kwapauzya, 4.-kwapaulila, 5.-kwapaulilalyo 6.-kwapaulisya, 7.-kwapaula-kwapaula, 8.-kwapaulana) Also: -kwipaula

strike once with, Mubbi bakamukwapula akasako. They struck the thief with a stick. (1.-kwapulwa, 2.-kwapwide, 3.-kwapuzya, 4.-kwapwida, 5.-kwapwidalyo, 6.-kwapulisya, 7.-kwapula-kwapula, 8.-kwapulana)

whip continually, flail, flog, Bayi bakakwapuula bana bakaccelwa. = The teacher beat the children who were late several times. (1.-kwapuulwa, 2.-kwapuulide, 3.-kwapuuzya, 4.-kwapwiida, 5.-kwapwiidalyo, 6.-kwapuulisya, 7.-kwapuula-kwapuula, 8.-kwapuulana) Also: -kwapaula.

bubble, boil meal lightly before stirring, Insima ilakwasa mucibiya. = The nsima is bubbling in the pot. Kacitalika kukwasa ceele, kwakabbuka mweenzu. As the porridge began to boil, a visitor appeared. (2.-kwaside, 3.-kwasizya, 4.-kwasila, 5.-kwasilalyo, 6.-kwasisya, 7.-kwasa-kwasa)

put one's legs apart, stand astride, Ooyu tacizyi kukkala, ukwasamana buya. This one does not know how to sit properly, she just sits with legs apart. Also: -kwazamana, -kwazama. (1.-kwasamanwa, 2.-kwasamide, 3.-kwasamuzya, 4.-kwasamanina, 5.-kwasamaninalyo, kwasamanisya, 7.-kwasamana-kwasamana)

clap, Bantu boonse bakatalika kukwasila mbuli mulawo wa Chitonga. = All the people started to clap according to the Tonga traditional custom. Cakali ciindi abalo bakwasi nobalisanga kapati kukwasila. = It was the time when the clappers were delighted to clap.

row, Kuti wakwasula bwato ciindi cilamfwu inga wakatala. = If you row a boat for a long time you will surely get tired. Nciyumu kukwasula bwato kuti muwo kauli munji. = It is hard to row a boat if the wind is strong. (1.-kwasulwa, 2.-kwaswide, 3.-kwasuzya, 4.-kwaswida, 5.-kwaswidalyo, 6.-kwasulisya, 7.-kwasula-kwasula, 8.-kwasulana)
be slapped or beaten in the face, Okuya kukkamba mbubakasikila ati taasyi nkokukwaswa mbayi kubasilikani. = There at the police station they were beaten by the police.

give away a daughter in marriage, rt. -kwata, Ndakamukwasya kwa Hamapande mwanaangu. = I arranged for my daughter to marry at Hamapande. Kaindi tiibakali kuyanda kukwasya mwanaabo kumusankwa mutolo. = Long ago they did not want to give their daughter in marriage to a lazy boy. (1.-kwasyigwa, 2.-kwasyide, 3.-kwasizya, 4.-kwasyila, 5.-kwasyizyalyo, 6.-kwasyisyisya, 7.-kwasya-kwasya, 8.-kwasyanya)
  • help one marry by giving part of the lobola, Ndakamupa lubono Iwakukwasya mujwa wangu. = I contributed to the lobola to help my nephew to marry.

marry a wife, Wakaakumujana kuli wakukwata? = Where did you find a girl to marry. (1.-kwatwa, 2.-kwete, 3.-kwatya, 4.-kwatila, 5.-kwatilalyo, 6.-kwatisya, 7. -kwata-kwata, 8.-kwatana.)
  • catch, (Ila) Muvwimi wakakwata syuumbwa kumucila akumuyasa sumo. = The hunter held the lion by the tail and then struck it with a spear. Also: -jata.

marry one another, Kumantoombwa basimbi bakali kwiiya kukwatana muli cabo beni. = At the mantoombwa traditional game, the girls learnt about marriage by pretending to marry amongst themselves. (see -kwata for extensions)

hold fast for someone, Kondikwatilila ndaange malekani. = Hold it tightly for me while I tie my catapult. (1.-kwatililwa, 2.-kwatilide, 3.-kwatilizya, 4.-kwatililila, 5.-kwatilililialyo, 6.-kwatilililisya, 7.-kwatilila-kwatilila, 8.kwatililana) Also: -jatilila.
  • pay bride-wealth for someone's marriage. Bataata bakaka kundikwatilila nkaambo balizi kuti musimbi talomenye. = My father refused to pay the lobola because he knows that the girl is not honest.

pull as mealie cob off stalk, Mbaani bakwaula mapopwe mumuunda wesu. = Who are pulling maize cobs in our field? (1.-kwaulwa, 2.-kwawide, 3.-kwauzya, 4.-kwawida, 5.-kwawidalyo, 6.-kwaulisya, 7.-kwaula-kwaula, 8.-kwaulana) Also: -kwayula, -koola

enjoy, Tiindakali kukuyeeyela kuti inga kolikwaya ayebo. = I never thought that you would enjoy yourself. (1.-kwayigwa, 2.-kwayide, 3.-kwayizya, 4.-kwayila, 5.-kwayilalyo, 6.-kwayilisya, 7.-kwaya-kwaya) Also: -bbombola, -liiba.

pull off, Baceta baakwayula mapopwe aamucembele. = The monkeys pull off the cobs of maize of the old woman. (1.-kwayulwa, 2.-kwayude, 3.-kwayuzya, 4.-kwayuda, 5.-kwayudalyo, 6.-kwayulisya, 7. kwayula-kwayula, 8.-kwayulana.) Also: -kwaula, -koola.

scold, give out, Wakamvwa Mwanaasikufwa nkwaakali kukwayulula. = You heard how Mwanaasikufwa was giving out. (1.-kwayululwa, 2.-kwayulwide, 3.-kwayuluzya, 4.-kwayuIwida, 5.-kwaulwidalyo, 6.-kwayululisya, 7.-kwayulula-kwayulula, 8.-kwayululana.)

*be wide*, *Eci cijazyo cakwazama nkocili kunselelo*. = *This door is wide at the bottom*. (1.-kwazamwa, 2.-kwazeme, 3.-kwazamya, 4.-kwazamina, 5.-kwazaminalyo, 6.-kwazamisya, 7.-kwazama-kwazama, 8.-kwazaminana)
  • stand or sit with legs wide apart, *Kokkala kabotu, koleka kukwazama buya*. = *Sit properly, stop just spreading your legs*.

stretch the legs apart or in front or behind, *Basicikolo nobaima mumulongo inga maulu abo alakwazamana*. = *When the pupils are standing in line they put their legs apart*. (1.-kwazamanwa, 2.-kwazamanide, 3.-kwazamika, 4.-kwazamanina, 5.-kwazamaninalyo, 6.-kwazamanisya, 7.-kwazamanakwazamana, 8.-kwazaminalyo) Also: kwasamana, -tazamana.

widen, *Ndaakwazamika cisani camusyoonto wangu*. = *I widened my young sister's dress*. (1.-kwazamikwa, 2.-kwazamikide, 3.-kwazamizya, 4.-kwazamikila, 5.-kwazamikilalyo, 6.-kwazamikisya, 7.-kwazamika-kwazamika, 8.-kwazamikana)

be wide, *Namalwa ulikwazamukide mabazu onse*. = *The friction drum is wide right down its length. (i.e. it does not taper at the bottom.) Bakatandaana akuyoonjizyanya mumpako lyatanda lyakakwazamukide kumanjililo akumanikila kumazwido, kumpwaido*. = *They continued chasing each other until they made each other come to the entrance of the trunk which was wide, right through to the narrow outlet*. (1.-kwazamukidwe, 2.-kwazamu-kide, 4.-kwazamukila, 5.-kwazamukilalyo, 6.-kwazamukisya, 7.-kwazamukidekwazamukide)
be wide open, rt. -kwazama, *Eeci cijazyo cilikwazeme*. = *This door is wide open*. (2.-kwazemene)

become slack or lose, *Lutambo ndwaalyaangide mucibuno Iwali kukweba-kweba*. = *The belt which he tied to his waist had become slack*. (2.-kwebede-kwebede, 3.-kwebya-kwebya, 4.-kwebezyezya-kwebezyezya, 5.-kwebezyezyalyo-kwebezyezyalyo 6.-kwebezyesya-kwebezyesya, 7.-kweba-kweba) Also: -gweba-gweba, -koba-koba.

payment made as part of ritual, rt. -kukwa, *Sikuswa meenda wakakwegwa jamba lyomwe, silufwulu walo wakakwegwa bulungu*. = *The father of the girl who sprays water on her was given one hoe, the holder of the drinking gourd was also given beads. Mulawo wakaliwo wakuti mukaintu ngootwala weelede kukwegwa, pesi kwakanyina mweeIwe waanzanene*. = *There was a law saying that the woman whom you marry ought to be given something, but the amount was not determined*. (2. kwegedwe)

cluck, cackle, *Eeyi nkuku ilakwekela, iyanda kutula mayi*. = *This hen is clucking, it is about to lay eggs*. Also: -kekela. (2.-kwekelede, 3.-kwekelezya, 4.-kwekelela, 5.-kwekelelalyo, 6.-kwekelesya, 7.-kwekela-kwekela)

cry out, as a woman does when pleased, *Bamakaintu bakakwekweleka nibakatambula zisani zipya*. = *The women cried out with joy when they received the new dresses*. Also: -welela. (2.-kwekwelekede, 3.-kwekwelezya, 4.-kwekwelekela, 5.-kwekwelekelalyo, 6.-kwekwelekesya, 7.kwekweleka-kwekweleka)

pull, Kamumukwela kusikila mumunune kuzwa mumukala. = Pull until you save him from the well. (1.-kwelwa, 2.-kwelede, 3.-kwezya, 4.-kwelela, 5.-kwelelalyo, 6.-kwelesya, 7.-kwela-kwela, 8.-kwelana)
  • bring a bride for the first time, Tuya kukukwela musimbi ookwa Nchenga. We are bringing a bride for Nchenga for the first time. (traditional custom)
  • -kwela kanta/kata = pull as the string of a bow.
  • -kwela matomo = muzzel a horse, Kamukwela matomo (nsefwa) twaange basune bayakukukolobeka. = Bring the muzzels so that we muzzle the oxen that are going to cultivate.
  • suck, Wakasola kukwela buci akabu kakwe. Alimwi wakasola kukwelesya. He tried to suck the honey through his reed. Again he tried to suck strongly.
  • board a train, Eyi yakali njemizeezo yakamupa kukwela citima kuya ku Bulawayo. = These were the thoughts which made him board a train going to Bulawayo. Also: -kkwela, -tanta. kwelaanya drag, Wakali kwiile kukwelaanya maulu naakakolwa. He was just dragging his legs when he was drunk.

be easily stretched out as a rope, rt. -kwela, Oolu looye lulakweleka. = This rope is easily stretched. (1.-kwelekwa, 2.-kwelekede, 3.-kwelekezya, 4.-kwelekela, 5.-kwelekelalyo, 6.-kwelekesya, 7.-kweleka-kweleka, 8.-kwelekana)

pull over or entice to a place, Komukwelela okuya mubwa. = Lure that dog over to that place. (1.-kwelelwa, 2.-kwelelede, 3.-kwelelezya, 4.-kwelelela, 5,-kwelelelalyo, 6.-kwelelesya, 7.-kwelela-kwelela, 8.-kwelelana)
  • bring a wife to, Chimuka tabanamukwelela musimbi wakwe nkaambo tanabikka lubono. They have not yet brought Chimuka's girl to the bridegroom's home because he has not yet paid the lobola.
  • pull a torch along as when setting fire to the bush, Kamukwelela muzenge tucingilile mbewu kutegwa itakapyi. = Pull the burning brand around the garden (to make a firebreak) so that it is not burnt.
  • speak slowly, Ulakwelela kwaambaula. He talks slowly.
  • when something becomes too much, grow tired like an ox when the yoke passes over it's hump so that it can choke if it pulls, Wakali kuyandaula mulimo koonse-koonse pesi cakasika ciindi ncaakakwelela antunda. He was looking for work everywhere but the time came when he found difficulties.

cause to persuade, Mikozyanyo ilatondezegwa mukusola kukwelelezya babali kuti balisalile nzila zyabuumi bubotu. = Examples are given to try and persuade the readers to choose the paths of a good life for themselves.

borrow money, Ndakakweleta mali kumweenzuma nsondo yamana. I borrowed money from my friend last week. (1.-kweletwa, 2.-kweletede, 3.-kweletya, 4.-kweletela, 5.-kweletelalyo, 6.-kweletesya, 7.-kweleta-kweleta, 8.-kweletana)

lend, Ndakamukweletesya Chimuka kusyoonto buyo. = I lent Chimuka just a little. (1.-kweletesyegwa, 2.-kweletesyede, 3.-kweletezya, 4.-kweletesyezya, 5.-kweletesyezyalyo, 6.-kweletesyesya, 7.-kweletesya-kweletesya, 8.-kweletesyanya)

sound piercingly, Wakakwemba kulila mwana kubee waumpwa mulilo. = The child screamed as if he was burnt by fire. (1.-kwembezyegwa, 2.-kwembede, 3.-kwembya, 4.-kwembela, 5.-kwembelalyo, 6.-kwembesya, 7.-kwemba-kwemba, 8.-kwembezyanya) Also: -kwiila, -cwema, -cwemba.
  • whistle, as a train, Citima nicakakwemba, bana bakali munsi bakayoowa. = When the train whistled, the children who were near got frightened.
  • be irritated in the throat, Akaambo kakubeleka mukasuko, amoyo atalika kukwemba. = Because of working in the dust, the throat began to be irritated.

snatch from, take by force, Sokwe wakandikwempa munsale ngwindakali kulya. = The monkey snatched the sugar-cane from me which I was eating. Also: -kwinta, -kwisula, -vwupulas, -wukula, -kwempula, -nyanga, -nyanzyas, -wumpila. (1.-kwempwa, 2.-kwempede, 3.-kwempya, 4.-kwempela, 5.-kwempelalyo, 6.-kwempesya, 7.-kwempa-kwempa, 8.-kwempana)
snatch for, rt. -kwempa, Wakandikwempela mali kuli wakandinyangide. She snatched the money for me from the one who had taken it from me. (for extensions see -kwempa)

snatch, Kansale wakakakwempula mbuli kainga. = He snatched the stick of sugar-cane like an eagle. (1.-kwempulwa, 2.-kwempulide, 3.-kwempuzya, 4.-kwempulila, 5.-kwempulilalyo, 6.-kwempulisya, 7.-kwempula-kwempula, 8.-kwempulana)
fail to understand, Ndali kukwempya buya nobali kukanana mu Chikuwa. = I just failed to understand when they were talking in English.

jeer, ridicule, Basankwanyina bakali kumukwena akumuseka. = His companions were jeering him and laughing at him. (1.-kwenwa, 2.-kwenede, 3.-kwenezya, 4.-kwenena, 5.-kwenenalyo, 6.-kwenesya, 7.-kwena-kwena, 8.-kwenana)

sharpen by grinding, whet, Kamukwenga tweembe tukagonke zisamu. Sharpen the axes so that we cut down trees. (1.-kwengwa, 2.-kwengede, 3.-kwengezya, 4.-kwengela, 5.-kwengelalyo, 6.-kwengesya, 7.-kwenga-kwenga) Also: -nona.
  • anticipate a good meal, Kwakali kukwenga menyo kutaambiki bataata nibakajaya ngulube. There was a mighty sharpening of the teeth (i.e. increase of the appetite), when my father killed a pig.
  • dry throat, Nyota yakali kumukwenga-kwenga amoyo. The thirst was making his throat dry.
  • clean beak on ground, Nkuku yali kukwenga-kwenga mulomo wayo ansi. = The hen was rubbing its beak on the ground to clean it.
clash together, Nibakali kuzyana, tubulo twakakwengana kulila. When they were dancing, the metal pieces were clashing together.

rt. -kwenga, ibbwe likwengela = a whetstone for sharpening. Kuli walibweza ibbwe likwengela tweembe. Some one took the whetstone for sharpening axes.
  • sharpen for, Kofwambaana kundikwengela keembe, ndiyanda kuya kugonka zisamu. Quickly sharpen the axe for me, I want to go and cut trees.

dawn, Notwakali kuya ku Lusaka, twakatalika Iweendo kakutaningakwenkuka. When we were going to Lusaka, we began the journey before it dawned. (1.-kwenkukwa, 2.-kwenkukide, 3.-kwenkuzya, 4.-kwenkukila, 5.-kwenkukilalyo, 6.-kwenkukisya, 7.-kwenkuka-kwenkuka) Also: -kwenkwemuka.

feel uneasy, Nindakabona kuti balaa munzi tabandikanazyi, ndakalikwenkula akupilukila kunanda yangu. When I saw that the owners of the village did not speak to me, I felt uneasy and returned home. (1.-kwenkulwa, 2.-kwenkulide, 3.-kwenkuzya, 4.-kwenkulila, 5.-kwenkulilalyo, 6.-kwenkulisya, 7.-kwenkula-kwenkula, 8.-kwenkulana)

move about, Mbolyakasundukila bbaasi, aswebo twakakwenkweleka kujoka. As soon as the bus left, we also moved to return. Ndakaimvwa ncinga niyakali kuya bukwenkweleka kuya kunselelo. I heard the bicycle as it moved down the slope. (1.-kwenkwelesyegwa, 2.-kwenkwelekede, 3.-kwenkwelesya, 4.-kwenkwelekela, 5.-kwenkwelekelalyo, 6.-kwenkwelekesya, 7.-kwankweleka-kwenkweleka, 8.-kwenkwelesyanya)

move together in secrecy, Mazuba ano mucita kuti fwumbwa ngooyaanya, fwumbwa kuti katatondwi, mpaawo abatondwa boonse basazinyoko, nkukwenkwelesyanya nkwaambauzyanya, mwamana nkutolana nkukwatana. These days what you do, provided she is not taboo to you, sometimes even your relatives, you go aside together and talk about love, after which you take each other for marriage.

make smooth, Simpande ulabeza inkwa, uliikwenkwezya kuti buci butacaalili. Simpande is carving a wooden plate and makes it smooth so that the honey does not stick. (1.-kwenkwezegwa, 2.-kwenkwezede, 3.-kwenkwezya, 4.-kwenkwezezya, 5.-kwenkwezyezyalyo, 6.-kwenkwezyesya, 7.-kwenkwezya-kwenkwezya) Also: -kwizinga, -kunguba.

be snatched, Syuumbwa wakamufwuumukila Syaanasulwe kutegwa akwenswe kuulu akupwailwa amfwuno yamwaani. = The lion rushed to grab the hare's leg and smash it against the heart of the *mwaani* tree. (2.-kwensede, 3.-kwensezya, 4.-kwensela, 5.-kwenselalyo, 6.-kwensesya, 7.-kwenswa-kwenswa, 8.-kwensana)

column1: kwensya** graze surface without penetrating, <p-eg> Moonde naakanyema wakafwusa sumo kumweenzinyina pesi tiilyakamuyasa, lyakamukwensya biyo. When Moonde was angry he threw a spear at his friend, but it did not pierce him, it only grazed him. </p-eg><p-c>(1.-kwensyegwa, 2.-kwensyede, 3.-kwensyezya, 4.-kwensyela, 5.-kwensyelalyo, 6.-kwensyesya, 7.-knwensya-kwensya, 8.-kwensyanya) <p-n>Also: -gululunta.
column2: kwensya**kwenya** scratch, rub, Musimbi wakalikuciswa bweele wakalikulikwenya masiku oonse. When the girl was suffering from scabies, she was scratching herself all night. Also: -kwezya
be married to, Banyina bakalikwetwe kuli Syaampongo. His mother was married to Syaampongo. (1.-kwatwa, 2.-kwetwe, 3.-kwatizigwa, 4.-kwatilwa, 5.-kwatilwalyo, 6.-kwatisigwa, 7.-kwetwe-kwetwe)

detatch, Mitabi yacisamu yakwezuka kale. The branches of the tree are already detached. (1.-kwezukwa, 2.-kwezukide, 3.-kwezuzya, 4.-kwezukila, 5.-kwezukilalyo, 6.-kwezukisya, 7.-kwezuka-kwezuka, 8.-kwezukana) Also: -kwezyuka
pull out, Kokwezula muluso aumwe mwana wabba mayi. Pull out a stick for beating the child who stole eggs. Also: -kwezyula.

scratch, Watalika buyo kulikwezya mumutwe. He just began to scratch his head. Naakatiisole kulikwezyakwezya ampemo kuti antela lilandiindilila ndiinga simalungu. I tried to scratch myself on the nose (i.e. a belief that if you do so, you avoid danger) so that perhaps the trader would pass me by. Mangoye wakasotokela amazwi akumu

*ajanza.* = A cat jumped on his lap and scratched him on the hand. *Mucila wasokwe nkasamu kakulikwezyezya.* = The tail of a monkey is a stick for helping you to scratch. (1-*kwezyegwa*, 2.-*kwezyede*, 3.-*kwezyesya*, 4.-*kwezyela*, 5.-*kwezyelalyo*, 6.*kwezyesya*, 7.-*kwezya-kwezya*, 8.-*kwezyanya*.)

cut off, *Kokwezyaula* tutabi tusyoonto-syoonto kucisamu ncotwagonka mafwumofwumo. = Cut off small branches from the tree which we cut down this morning. Also: -sonsola, -sunzaula. (1.-*kwezyaulwa*, 2.-*kwezyawide*, 3.-*kwezyauzya*, 4.-*kwezyawida*, 5.-*kwezyawidalyo*, 6.-*kwezyaulisya*, 7.-*kwezyaula-kwezyaula*, 8.-*kwezyaulana*)

fall off, be pulled off, *Cakwezyuka cisamu cali kuleleenga.* = The branch which was hanging was fell off. (1.-*kwezyukwa*, 2.-*kwezyukide*, 3.-*kwezyukizya*, 4.-*kwezyukila*, 5.-*kwezukilalyo*, 6.-*kwezyukilisya*, 7.-*kwezyuka-kwezyuka*, 8.-*kwezyukilana*) Also: -fwunyuka.

break off, pull off, *Kokwezyula muluso tuumye kabwa.* = Break off a flexible stick so that we whip the dog. (1.-*kwezulwa*, 2.-*kwezyude*, 3.-*kwezyuzya*, 4.-*kwezyulida*, 5.-*kwezyulidalyo*, 6.-*kwezyulisya*, 7.-*kwezyula-kwezyula*, 8.-*kwezyulana*) Also: -*kwezula*, -*fwunyula*.

beat severely, Musankwa naakapwaya nsuwa, bausyi bakamukwibbaula. = When the boy broke the milk-gourd, his father whipped him. (1.-*kwibbaulwa*, 2.-*kwibbawide*, 3.-*kwibbauzya*, 4.-*kwibbawida*, 5.-*kwibbawidalyo*, 6.-*kwibbaulisya*, 7.-*kwibbaula-kwibbaula*, 8.-*kwibbaulana*) Also: -*wimbuula*, -*kwabbaula*.

whip once with lexible stick, Jakopo wakabweza muluso waka *kwibbula Jolezya.* = Jakopo took a flexible stick and whipped Jolezya. (1.-*kwibbulwa*, 2.-*kwibbwide*, 3.-*kwibbuzya*, 4.-*kwibbwida*, 5.-*kwibbwidalyo*, 6.-*kwibbulisya*, 7.-*kwibbula-kwibbula*, 8.-*kwibbulana*)

lock by placing a pole across it, *Wakanjila munanda akukwida ankwidizyo.* = He entered the house and secured it with a pole. (1.-*kwidwa*, 2.-*kwidide*, 3.-*kwidizya*, 4.-*kwidila*, 5.-*kwidilalyo*, 6.-*kwidilisya*, 7.-*kwida-kwida*, 8.-*kwidana*)

cry loudly, as when kin or relative is dying, *Baama bakakwiila kulila ciindi lyakafwa mucizyi wabo.* = Mother wailed when her sister died. *Tokonzyi kukwiila kumakwe pe, cilatuna.* = You do not yell when at your in-laws, it is improper. (1.-*kwiilwa*, 2.-*kwiilide*, 3.-*kwiizya*, 4.-*kwiilila*, 5.-*kwiililalyo*, 6.-*kwiilisya*, 7.-*kwiila-kwiila*, 8.-*kwiililana*)
be grounded, rt. -*kwiya*, *Mukula wakakwiigwa kale.* = The ochre is ground already. (2.-*kwiide*, 3.-*kwiizya*, 4.-*kwiila*, 5.-*kwiilalyo*, 6.-*kwiisya*, 7.-*kwiigwa-kwiigwa*, 8.-*kwiyana*)

take turns to, *Bana bajuni bakali kufwooma akukwiizyanya kutambula banyina.* = The young of the big bird were crying and taking turns to receive food from the mother. *Uyakuteelela bamwaaba nkobati bakwiizyanye kulila.* = You will hear the jackals as they cry out in turn. (1.-*kwiizyanisyigwa*, 2.-*kwiizyenye*, 3.-*kwiizyanizya*, 4.-*kwiizyanizyigwa*, 5.-*kwaiizyanizyizyalyo*, 6.-*kwiizyanisya*, 7.-*kwiizyanya-kwiizyanya*, 8.-*kwiizyanya*)

screw into, put an axeblade into the handle, *Kumazuba simpongo ulakwikka tuumba atusumo munsako.* = In the evening the goatherd inserts blades into spear handles. Also: -sekka, -sakila. (2.-*kwikkwa*, 3.-*kwikkide*, 3.-*kwikkizya*, 4.-kwikkila, 5.-kwikkilalyo, 6.-kwikkisya, 7.-kwikka-kwikka, 8.-kwikkilana)
  • produce a kernel, form a tuber, Eezi ndongwe zyamuka kukwikka nkaambo zyakamuka kusyangwa. = These groundnuts are late in producing kernels inside as they were planted late.

contain kernels, rt. -kwikka, Eezi ndongwe nzibotu, zilikwikkide. = These groundnuts are good, they have produced nuts inside. Amwi mapopwe taakwikkide. = Some mealie cobs are empty.
  • push blade into handle, Keembe kamalengwa kakakwikkidwe muciini cifwaafwi. The ritual axe-blade was pushed into a short handle.
insert for, rt. -kwikka, Nguni uya kundikwikkila keembe kangu? = Who is going to insert the axe blade into the handle for me?

be brightly coloured, Cisani camukaintu ooyu, cilakwimakwima. The dress of this woman shines brightly. (2.-kwimide-kwimide, 3.-kwimya-kwimya, 4.-kwimina-kwimina, 5.-kwiminakwiminalyo, 6.-kwimisya-kwimisya) Also: -kwizima-kwizima.
roll ones eyes, Wakaide kukwindaula meso akulidunda kati mmulombwana. = He was just rolling his eyes and boasting that he is a real man. Also: - vwundaula

jerk, snatch, pullstring of bow, Bana tabacizyi kukwinta nobaloba, ncobatajayi nswi. = Children do not know how to jerk the line when they are fishing, that is why they do not catch fish. Nindakabona nakasya kalunduka, ndakafwambaana kukwinta buta bwangu. = When I saw the duiker running, I quickly pulled the string of my bow to shoot the arrow. Also: -gwinta, -kwempa, -kwisula. (1.-kwintwa, 2.-kwintide, 3.-kwintya, 4.-kwintila, 5.-kwintilalyo, 6.-kwintisya, 7.-kwinta-kwinta, 8.-kwintana)

whip repeatedly, Bamukwipa-kwipa mwana wasowa nombe. They whipped the child repeatedly who lost the cattle. (1.-kwipwakwipwa, 2.-kwipide-kwipide, 3.-kwipyakwipya, 4.-kwipila-kwipila, 5.-kwipilalyokwipilalyo, 6.-kwipisya-kwipisya, 8.-kwipana-kwipana) Also: - kwipaula.

continually strike with stick, Bamukwipaula mwana abo ciindi naalisubila mucisani. They beat their child continually with a stick after it had urinated on the clothing. Also: -zwipaulas, -kwipa-kwipa, -kwapaula, -uula (1.-kwipaulwa, 2.-kwipawide, 3.-kwipauzya, 4.-kwipaulila, 5.-kwipaulilalyo, 6.-kwapaulisya, 7.-kwipaula-kwipaula, 8.-kwaipaulana)

do something quickly, Inga mbwaakacengeezya kubee uyanda kwiima, ma wakwipuka ngooyu mu Lumumba Road. When he pretended he was going to stop, he quickly turned into Lumumba Road. (2.-kwipukide, 3.-kwipuzya, 4.-kwipukila, 5.-kwipukilalyo, 6.-kwipukisya, 7.-kwipuka-kwipuka)

whip once, Komukwipula, natiileke kusunda. Beat, that is when it will stop misbehaving. (1.-kwipulwa, 2.-kwipwide, 3.-kwipuzya, 4.-kwipwida, 5.-kwipwidalyo, 6.-kwipulisya, 7.-kwipula-kwipula, 8.-kwipulana) Also: - zwipula.

whip many times, scourge, Ani mwana ngokwipuula wacita nzi? = Now what has the child done that you beat her so much? (1.-kwipuulwa, 2.-kwipuulide, 3.-kwipuuzya, 4.-kwipuuda, 5.-kwipuudalyo, 6.-kwipuulisya, 7.-kwipuula-kwipuula, 8.-kwipuulana)

swing tail, like cattle, Nindatakababona basune kuti nibatakali kukwisaula micila. = I wouldn't have seen the oxen if they were not swinging their tails. (1.-kwisaulwa, 2.-kwisaulide, 3.-kwisauzya, 4.-kwisaulila, 5.-kwisaulilalyo, 6.-kwisaulisya, 7.-kwisaula-kwisaula, 8.-kwasaulana) Also: -besaula, -fwisaula.

look well and healthy, Mbwacita munyama ooyo mboobu, uyakusaninwa kutaanguna kutegwa mubili wako ukabote-bote. Ono aakubona kuti wakwisima, uyakuba bulilu bwakwe. = This is what the animal (of the fable) does. You will be fed first so that your body is nice. Now when he sees that you are good and healthy, you will become its food. (2.-kwisimide, 3.-kwisimya, 4.-kwisimina 5.-kwisiminalyo, 6.-kwisimisya, 7.-kwisima-kwisima)

recoil as a trap, Kooye kakwisuka-kwisuka kalafwambaana kuca. = The trap which springs easily is quick to catch the prey. (2.-kwisukide, 3.-kwisusya, 4.-kwisukila, 5.-kwisukilalyo, 6.-kwisukisya, 7.-kwisuka-kwisuka)
  • flare up with temper, Ndakamuuma nkaambo moyo wangu wakakwisuka naakanditukila. I beat him because my heart flared up when he verbally abused me.

pull out, like when fishing with a rod, Tacizi kukwisula, ncatajaili nswi. He does not know how to pull out, that is why he does not catch fish. (1.-kwisulwa, 2.-kwiswide, 3.-kwisuzya, 4.-kwisulila, 5.-kwisulilalyo, 6.-kwisulisya, 7.-kwisula-kwisula, 8.-kwisulana) Also: -kusula, -fwisula, -kwinta, -kwisula.

grind to powder, Baneene bafwuma kukwiya tombwe mukakaye. My grandmother rose early to grind tobacco in a potsherd. Bamwi basimbi bakatumidwe kuya kuyandaula cisila cakukwiya mukula. Some girls were sent to go and look for hard red clay to grind into ochre. (1.-kwiigwa, 2.-kwiyide, 3.-kwiizya, 4.-kwiyila, 5.-kwiyilalyo, 6.-kwiyisya, 7.-kwiya-kwiya, 8.-kwiyana)
  • wear the heart away, Choobe takkomani kabotu mazuba ano pe, nkokuti kuli kaambo kamukwiya mumoyo lyoonse. Choobe is not happy these days, there is something which is wearing his heart away. Nzala ilatukwiya lyoonse. Hunger is always troubling us.

be bright, shine, Boya bwabanyama bamwi bulakwizima cibotelezya. The fur of some animals shines beautifully. (2.-kwizimide, 3.-kwizimya, 4.-kwizima, 5.-kwiziminalyo, 6.-kwizimisya, 7.-kwizima-kwizima) Mazuba oonse cibuye carŋanda cakali kwiide kukwizima. Every day the floor of the house was shining. Also: -kwizyima
be brightly coloured, Boya bwakaluwe bulakwizimakwizima. The fur of a leopard is brightly coloured. Also: -kwima-kwima, -mweka-mweka.

take by force, Wakaukwizimuna mumaanza angu mucila. = She took the tail out of my hands by force. (1.-kwizimunwa, 2.-kwizimunide, 3.-kwizimuzya, 4.-kwiizimunina, 5.-kwizimuninalyo, 6.-kwizimunisya, 7.-kwizimuna-kwizimuna, 8.-kwizimunana) Also: -kwempa.

polish, make smooth, draw designs on unburnt pots, Bamakaintu tabaningazikwizinga zibiya. The women have not yet polished (designed) the clay pots. Also: -kwenkweza, -kunguba. (1.-kwizingwa, 2.-kwizingide, 3.-kwizingizya, 4.-kwizingila, 5.-kwizingilalyo, 6.-kwizingisya, 7.-kwizinga-kwizinga, 8.-kwizingana)
be in a polished state, Kamuzisumika zibiya zyakwizingana ono. = Burn the pots which have been polished. Also: -umbusana.
= be smooth, Mainza mmukaintu wamiindi ikwizingene = Mainza is a woman with smooth calves.
= glisten, shine. Also: -kwizima
= burnish, polish by rubbing, Also: -kwizinga.

= blink, flash Muwo waboola upa kuti kandilaba. = When the wind comes it causes me to blink my eyes.. Kaciba kaindi kasyoonto mbuli kulaba kwaliso, usyi wakasika. = When a moment passed like the blinking of an eye, his father arrived. Bana banji bamuka kusika kucikolo nkaambo mvwula yalikulaba akuzuma kapati. = Many children were late in arriving at school because the rain was producing a lot of lightning and thunder. Walaba Leza = God has flashed, i.e. There has been a flash of lightning. (1.-labwa, 2.-labide, 3.-labya, 4.-labila, 5.-labilalyo, 6.-labisya, 7.-laba-laba)

= close the eyes repeatedly, Nkwelaba-laba nokuli muwo, bamwi bayeeya kuti ncita caali. = When I blink repeatedly when there is wind, some think I am doing it deliberately. (1.-labwa-labwa, 2.-labide-labide, 3.-labya-labya, 4.-labila-labila, 5.-labila-labilalyo, 6.-labilisya-labilisya, 7.-laba-laba)

= be delirious, rave, talk rubbish, Bantu bayanda kusondoka a basondokede inga balalabalika. = People who are about to go mad and those already mad, talk in a confused way. Langa Nakooma, utani kwaambi twakulabalika. = Look, Nakooma, don't be talking rubbish. (1.-labalikwa, 2.-labalikide, 3.-labalisya, 4.-labalikila, 5.-labakilalyo, 6.-labalikisya, 7.-labalika-labalika)
= make one rave, Nzala a nyota yakamulabalisya. = The hunger and the thirst made him talk in a foolish way.

= talk nonsense, Kwaambaula wali kwiile kulabankanya, taacizyi cakwaamba. = When talking she was just talking nonsense, not knowing what she was saying. (1.-labanakanyizyigwa, 2.-labankanide. 4.-labankanina, 5.-labankaninalyo, 6.-labankanisya, 7.-labankanya-labankanya)
= grumble, Wakanyema mudaala cakuti koonse kulya cakamwaalila pele kulabanta kwalo. = The old man was so angry that he was unable for any food but only grumbled.

= be talkative, Kulabauka kwaambaula cipa kulitaya. = To be talkative in speech can get you into trouble. (1.-labaukwa, 2.-labaukide, 3.-labaukizya, 4.-labaukila, 5.-labaukilalyo, 6.-labaukisya, 7.-labauka-labauka, 8.-labaukana).

= devour, Twakailabbaula nsima kunkolola yokwa Mutinta. = We packed ourselves with nsima at the initiation ceremony of Mutinta. (1.-labbaulwa, 2.-labbawide, 3.-labbauzya, 4.-labbawida, 5.-labbawidalyo, 6.-labbaulisya, 7.-labbaula-labbaula)

= strike with Kayuni ndakalabbula malekani. = I hit a bird with a shot from a catapult. (1.-labbulwa, 2.-labbwide, 3.-labbuzya, 4.-labbwida, 5.-labbwidalyo, 6.-labbulisya, 7.-labbula-labbula, 8.-labbulana)

= taste, Kulabila cisyu kacicili aamulilo, omusankwa, taciyandiki. = Young man, tasting relish when it is still on the fire is not wanted. Also: -swiilila. Kwainda mazuba obile katalabili kantu. = Two days passed without him tasting anything. Buzuba bwakutaanguna masiku asikati kunyina ncaakalabila naaba meenda. = During the first day he tasted nothing day or night not even water. (1.-labilwa, 2.-labilide, 3.-labilizya, 4.-labilila, 5.-labililalyo, 6.-labilisya, 7.-labila-labila, 8.-labilana) Also: -toma, -swiilila, -sola (-yaka-yaka = taste hot as pepper)
have tasted, Kunyina *nindakalabilide bukoko.* = I had never tasted beer.

taste for someone, Mwana *komulabilila cisyu naa cabizwa.* = Taste the relish for the child to see if it is cooked. *Mucembelema, konditondezya akundilabilila micelo iligwa akati kayeeyi njindaleta.* = My age-mate, show and taste for me the edible fruits from among these which I have brought. (1.-labililwa, 2.-labilide, 3.-labililizya, 4.-labililila, 5.-labilililalyo, 6.-labililisya, 7.-labililalabilila, 8.-labililana) Also: -pungila, -talikila

flash intensively, Masiku *kuti muntu uulede abulo amukaintu wakwe, kuti mvwula kiilabisya kapati, ncibotu kuti umwi wabuka abulo.* = At night if a man is sleeping with his wife, if the lighting flashes strongly, it is good for one to get out of bed.

give to taste, *Kobalabizya cisyu baama bamvwe naa cabizwa.* = Give mother the relish to taste so that she approves that it is cooked. (1.-labizyigwa, 2.-labizyide, 3.-labizyisya, 4.-labizyizya, 5.-labizyizyalyo, 6.-labizyisya, 7.-labizyalabizya, 8.-labizyanya)
  • be evasive, *Babbi balalabankanya kwaambaula kusisa bubi bwabo.* = Thieves are evasive in talking to hide their evil.

accuse falsely of witchcraft, *Mbapa mulandu wakundilabula bulozi kuti ndime ndakalowa mweenzuma.* = I give them a case for accusing me of witchcraft in that I had bewitched by friend. (1.-labulwa, 2.-labwide, 3.-labuzya, 4.-labwida, 5.-labwidalyo, 6.-labulisya, 7.-labula-labula, 8.-labulana) Also: -tanta bulozi.
  • reveal witchcraft, *Bantu bakanyema akubasesemwa balozi aba bobile nobakatalika kulilabula bulozi.* = People were annoyed and disgusted with these two witches when they began to reveal their witchcraft.

give the correct answer to a riddle, *Bana basunu cilabakatazya kulabulula tulabi.* = The children of today find it difficult to solve a riddle. (1.-labululwa, 2.-labulwide, 3.-labuluzya, 4.-labulwida, 5.-labulwidalyo, 6.-labululisya, 7.-labulula-labulula, 8.-labululana) Also: -lubulula.
be confused, *Wakasalama mukkoce lyananda kageme kulabwantika mumizeezo.* = He lay on the verandah of the house focusing on the confusion in his thoughts.

reveal the activity of a witch, rt. -labula, *Balaa munzi mbabamulonda kuti akabalabwide balozi.* = The owners of the village were the ones who searched for him so that he might reveal the witchcraft of the witches. (1.-labwidwa, 2.-labwide, 3.-labwizya, 4.-labwida, 5.-labwidalyo, 6.-labwidisya, 7.-labwida-labwida, 8.-labwidana)

be stretched like elastic, *Malekani angu alaladamuka kabotu.* = My catapult stretches out well. (1.-ladamunwa, 2.-ladamukide, 3.-ladamuzya, 4.-ladamwida, 5.-ladamwidalyo, 6.-ladamukisya, 7.-ladamuka-ladamuka, 8.-ladamunana) Also: -talamuka, -landamuka.

sit with neck stretched, *Ndakalagama nicakanditinga cimbwali.* = I sat with my neck stretched out when the sweet potatoe got stuck in my throat. (1.-lagamuna, 2.-lageme, 3.-lagamuzya, 4.-lagamina, 5.-lagaminalyo, 6.-lagaminisya, 7.-lagama-lagama) Also: -lakama.

sit erect with neck stretched out, *Wakalagamana kukkala amu-* laka anze. = She was sitting up straight with her neck stretched out and tongue hanging out. Also: -lakamana. (2.-lagamene, 3.-lagamanizya, 4.-lagamanina, 5.-lagamaninalyo, 6. -lagamanisya, 7.-lagamana-lagamana)

give instructions, rt. -lailila, Mooba katanaunka wakalailide mutwanga wakwe kuti amupe cakulya mweenzu. = Mooba instructed his servant before he left that he should give the visitor food. (1.-lailidwe, 3.-lailizya, 4.-lailizyizya, 5.-lailizyizyalyo, 6.-laililisya, 7.-lailidwelailidwe, 8.-laililana)

instruct, advise, rt.-laya, Moonga wakalailila makani mabotu kubana bakwe naakacili kupona. = Moonga gave good advice to his children when he was still alive. (1.-laililwa, 2.-lailide, 3.-lailizya, 4.-laililila, 5.-lailililalyo, 6. -laililisya, 7.-lailila-lailila, 8.-laililana) Also: -lubukizya, -konkomwena, -layilila.

load, Wakali kubeleka kulaisya masaka amapopwe muzimbayambaya. = He was working to load the sacks of maize on the trucks. (1.-laisyigwa, 2.-laisyide, 3.-laisizya, 4.-laisyila, 5.-laisyilalyo, 6.-laisyisya 7.-laisya-laisya, 8.-laisyanya) Also: -longela, -aka.

desire, Myoyo yesu ilalaka-laka kucita zinyonyoono. = Our hearts desire to do evil things. (1.-lakwalakwa, 2.-lakide-lakide, 3.-lakizya-lakizya, 4.-lakalila-lakalila, 5.-lakalila-lakalilalyo, 6.-lakalisya-lakalisya, 7.-laka-laka) Also: - lombozya

open the mouth widely, have tongue out, Mubwa naakakatala kutanda banyama, wakalakama buyo. = When the dog grew tired from chasing the animals, he just had his mouth open and tongue out. Bantu bakalakama cakunyandwa. = The people opened their mouths in astonishment. (1.-lakamwa, 2.-lakamide, 3.-lakamya, 4.-lakamina, 5.-lakaminalyo, 6.-lakamisya, 7.-lakamalakama, 8.-lakaminana)
open mouth, (1.-lakamanwa, 2.-lakamenye, 3.-lakamanizya, 4.-lakamanina, 5.-lakama-ninalyo, 6.-lakamanisya, 7.-lakamana-lakamana, 8.- lakamaninana) Also: -lagamana

stick one's tongue out at someone, rt. -lakama, Nseli muntu wakulakamina. = I am not a person at whom you can stick your tongue out. (1.-lakaminwa, 2.-lakamide, 3.-lakamizya, 4.-lakamina, 5.-lakaminalyo, 6.-lakamisya, 7.-lakamina-lakamina, 8.-lakaminana)

make one open the mouth, Komulakamuna mwana anywisigwe musamu. = Open the child's mouth so that it drinks the medicine. (1.-lakamunwa, 2.-lakamwide, 3.-lakamuzya, 4.-lakamwida, 5.-lakamwidalyo, 6.-lakamunisya, 7.-lakamuna-lakamuna, 8.-lakamunana)
  • open a gun, Koilakamuna ntobolo twiisalazye. = Open the gun so that we clean it.

open mouth wide, Kolakana mulomo unywe musamu. = Open your mouth wide so that you drink some medicine. (1.-lakanwa, 2.-lakanide, 3.-lakanizya, 4.-lakanina, 5.-lakaninalyo, 6.-lakanisya, 7.-lakana-lakana) Also: -asama, -lakama.

argue about a matter, Kamuleka kulakanina kaambo katalibonyi. = Stop arguing about a matter of which there is no evidence. Also: -zwangana. (1.-lakaninwa, 2.-lakanide, 3.-lakanizya, 4.-lakanina, 5.-lakaninalyo 6.-lakanisya, 7.-lakanina-lakanina)

talk incessantly, Ulalakata kukanana mbwaalikutalika limwi catucima. = She has been talking without a pause since she began until it annoys us. (1.-lakatwa, 2.-lakatide, 3.-lakatizya, 4.-lakatila, 5.-lakatilalyo, 6.-lakatisya, 7.-lakata-lakata) Also: -lakaza, -lokota. (namulakata = a person who talks incessantly)

overflow, as grain poured into a container already full, Ndongwe zyalikulakatika munzila. = The packed groundnuts were dropping on the way. (2.-lakatikide, 3.-lakatizya, 4.-lakatikila, 5.-lakatikilalyo, 6.-lakatikisya, 7.-lakatalakata) Also: -swininika.

overflow and flow down Wali kutila mapopwe mucisuwo limwi alakatikila ansi. = She was filling the basket with maize until it overflowed on to the ground. (1.-lakatikilwa, 2.-laka-tikide, 3.-lakatizya, 4.-lakatikila, 5.-lakatikilalyo, 6.-lakatikisya, 7.-lakatikila-lakatikila)

talk for a long time, rt. lakata, Ulalakatisya kukanana kwaciindi cilamfwu. = She talks on and on for a long time. (1.-lakatikisyigwa, 2.-lakatisyide, 3.-lakatizya, 4.-lakatisyila, 5.-lakatisyilalyo, 6.-lakatisyisya, 7.-lakatisya-lakatisya)
  • cause to overflow, Mutinta waalakatisya mapopwe ansi kuzwa mucisuwo. = Muntinta let the maize fall on the ground out of the basket.

speak in a drunken fashion or speak too much so as to weary people, Kuti wakolwa inga ulalakaula kukanana. When he is drunk he speaks too much. (1.-lakaulwa, 2.-lakaulide, 3.-lakauzya, 4.-lakaulila, 5.-lakaulilalyo, 6.-lakaulisya, 7.-lakaula-lakaula, 8.-lakaulana)

talk excessively, Chizela naakakolwa bukoko, wakakkala munsaa cikko akutalika kulakaza. = When Chizela was drunk with beer, he sat beside the fireplace and talked non-stop. (2.-lakazide, 3.-lakazya, 4.-lakazila, 5.-lakazilalyo, 6.-lakazisya, 7.-lakazalakaza) Also: -lakata

be open-mouthed, rt. -lakama, Asike kumunzi, wakajana bana balakeme biyo nzala. When he arrived at the village, he found the children just with open mouths from hunger. (1.-lakamwa, 2.-lakeme, 3.-lakamwa, 4.-lakamina. 5.-lakaminalyo, 6.-lakamisya, 7.-lakemelakeme, 8.-lakaminana)

lie down, Walala kale nkaambo walikatede naaboola. = He has already laid down because he was tired out when he came. Ncibi kulala omuno musyokwe, muli banyama balatuluma masiku. It is bad to lie down here in the bush, there are animals which will attack us at night. Inombe yalala niyamana kucela kutegwa ilyookezye. = The cow lay down to rest after grazing. Also: -ona. (1.-lalwa, 2.-lede/-lalide, 3.-lalizya, 4.-lalila, 5.-lalilalyo, 6.-lalisya, 7.-lala-lala, 8.-lalana.)
  • have sex with, Cilatondwa kulala ciliya. It is taboo to have sex with an uninitiated girl.
  • experience cold, Mwaka uno mpeyo yakalala kapati ku Libingi. = This year the cold is extreme in Livingstone.
  • experience hunger, Nzala yakaliko, bantu bakacili kwiilala, nkwiide koona vwu. = The hunger was there, the people were still suffering from it, just sleeping without any food.

put lying down, rt. -lala, Komulalika abulo mwana kutegwa afwambaane koona. Put the child down on the bed so that she quickly goes to sleep. Also: -lazika. (1.-lalikwa, 2.-lalikide, 3.-lalizya, 4.-lalikila, 5.-lalikilalyo, 6.-lalikisya, 7.-lalika-lalika, 8.-lalikana)
  • have illicit sex, Kulalika nkoona a mukamuntu naa kucita nkwela. = To have unlawful sex is to sleep with someone's wife or to indulge in lustful practices.

take evening meal, Sena mwalalila kale bana bangu? = My children, have you already had your supper? (1.-lalilwa, 2.-lalilide, 3.-lalizya, 4.-lalilila, 5.-lalililalyo, 6.-lalilisya. 7.-lalila-lalila, 8.-lalilana)

make someone angry, Ndakamulalula nindakamwiita zina lyakuzalikizigwa. = I made him angry when I called him by a nickname. Utamulaluli mweenzinyoko. = Do not annoy your friend. Also: -nyemya, -kalazya. (1.-lalulwa, 2.-lalwide, 3.-laluzya, 4.-lalwida, 5.-lalwidalyo, 6.-lalulisya, 7.-lalula-lalula, 8.-lalulana)

invent, as a story, Mucembele wakali kwaana, a kulabika a kulama a kusendelezya. = The old lady was telling stories and telling riddles, and inventing tales and speaking indirectly. (1.-lamwa, 2.-lamide, 3.-lamya, 4.-lamina, 5.-laminalyo, 6.-lamisya, 7.-lama-lama, 8.-lamana)

stick as glue, Kamulamatika cifwanikiso eeco. = Stick that picture. Wakalubikka lugwalo mumvwulupu akululamatika. = He put the letter in an envelope and sealed it. (1.-lamatikwa, 2.-lamatikide, 3.-lamatisya, 4.-lamatikila, 5.-lamatikilalyo, 6.-lamatikisya,7.-lamatika-lamatika, 8.-lamatikana)
  • accuse falsely, Joojo wakandilamatika mulandu ngonditazyi. = Joojo accused me of a crime which I did not know about. Also: -tamikizya, -lambaika.

be sticky as mud, be stuck in, Bunzuka bwandilamatila mumaanza. = The wax made my hands sticky. Maanza angu alalamatila akaambo kabuci mbwendajisi. = My hands are sticky because of the honey which I had handled. Kuulu kwakalamatila, taakakonzya kukugusya. = The leg stuck, he could not pull it out. Also: -bbatauka (1.-lamatilwa, 2.-lamatilide, 3.-lamatizya, 4.-lamatilila, 5.-lamatililayo, 6.-lamatilisya, 7.-lamatila-lamatila, 8.-lamatilana)

detach, unstick, become unglued, Sulwe wakazyana-zyana kuti alamatuke. Lyakamubala zuba buzuba boonse kalamatide kuli fwulwe. Nibakasika banyama boonse bakamulamatula. = The hare danced and danced to become unstuck. The sun shone on him the whole day as he remained stuck to the tortoise. When the animals arrived they detached him. (1.-lamatukwa, 2.-lamatukide, 3.-lamatuzya, 4.-lamatu-kila, 5.-lamatukilalyo, 6.-lamatukisya, 7.-lamatukalamatuka, 8.-lamatukana)

unglue, peel off, detach, Kamucilamatula cifwanikiso cili kubwaanda. = Unglue that picture which is on the wall. (1.-lamatulwa, 2.-lamatwide, 3.-lamatuzya, 4.-lamatwida, 5.-lamatwidalyo, 6.-lamatulisya, 7.-lamatulalamatula, 8.-lamatulana) Also: -namatula, -yabulula, -batululas, -bbatauka, -bbabba-nuka, -bbabbulas, -babatula

daub body with white clay at funerals, Mukamufwu bamulamba bulongo amubili. = They daubed the body of the widow with clay. Nibakafwa banyina, wakalamba. = When her mother died, she smeared clay on her body. (1.-lambwa, 2.-lambide, 3.-lambya, 4.-lambila, 5.-lambilalyo, 6.-lambisya, 7.-lamba-lamba, 8.-lambana.)
  • jam as gun, Ntobolo yakalamba naakayanda kwiidubula. = The gun jammed when he wanted to fire it.

slander, Nindakali kubetekwa munkuta, mubbi wakandilambaika kaambo nketazyi. = When I was been tried in court, a thief brought false accusations against me of which I knew nothing about. Also: -lamatika, -tamikizya. (1.-lambaikwa, 2.-lambaikide, 3.-lambaizya, 4.-lambaikila, 5,-lambaikilalyo, 6.-lambaikisya 7.-lambaika-lambaika, 8.-lambaikana)
  • spread (as butter), Kamulambaika mafwuta masyoonto acinkwa kutegwa mulye kabotu. = Spread a little butter on your bread so that you eat well

add a little to, Kamulambaila mafwuta acinkwa kutegwa citeteete. Put a little butter on the bread to make it soft. Also: -nambaila. (1.-lambailwa, 2.-lambailide, 3.-lambaizya, 4.-lambaikila, 5.-lambaikilalyo, 6.-lambaikisya, 7.-lambaila-lambaila, 8.-lambailana)
  • wind, Kolambaila bunweba acinkonti kutegwa ukasumye kunanda yako. Wind the thread around the maize cob so that you use it to sew at your home.

sit up majestically, Waile kulambamana kukkala naakkuta kapati. He was just sitting majestically when he was very full. (1.-lambamanwa, 2.-lambamene, 3.-lambamanya, 4. lambamanina, 5.-lambamaninalyo, 6.-lambamanisya, 7.-lambamana-lambamana)

slander, Sulwe wakalambauzya mwaaba kaambo kakubeja. The hare wrongly accused the fox of a false happening. (1.-lambauzigwa, 2.-lambauzyide, 4.-lambauzyizya, 5.-lambauzyizyalyo, 6.-lambauzyisya, 7.-lambauzya-lambauzya, 8.-lambauzyanya) Also: -obekezyas, -tamikizya, -lambikila, -lambaika.

accuse falsely, Mutinta wakali kuyanda kundilambika da litali lyangu. Mutinta wanted to accuse me of a pregnancy which was not mine. (1.-lambikwa, 2.-lambikide, 3.-lambizya, 4.-lambikila, 5.-lambikilalyo, 6.-lambikisya, 7.-lambika-lambika, 8.-lambikana)
accuse falsely, Musimbi walambikila musankwa mulandu ngwata bwene. The girl has falsely accused the boy of a crime of which he is innocent. Also: -lamatika, -tamikizya.

wind around, Choolwe wakalambila cigati cakwe kuti citasowi ciindi. = Choolwe wound his watch so that it could not lose time. Wakamvwa cimulambila munsingo. He felt something winding around his neck. Also: -zingaila (1.-lambilwa, 2.-lambilide, 3.-lambya, 4.-lambilila, 5.-lambililalyo, 6.-lambilisya, 7.-lambila-lambila, 8.-lambilana)
  • daub for, Mufwu bakamulambila mbwaakazikkilwa. The people daubed themselves for the deceased as soon as he was buried.

eat insufficiently, Mukamufwu wakalambula buyo kulya nkaambo wakali kudilwe. The widow did not eat enough because she was at the funeral. (1.-lambulwa, 2.-lambulide, 3.-lambuzya, 4.-lambukila, 5.-lambukilalyo, 6.-lambulisya, 7.-lambula-lambula, 8.-lambuzyanya)

uncoil, Iguwo nilyakabbubbula, cipepa cakazambaidwe acisamu cakalambuluka. When a mighty wind blew, the paper which was wrapped around the tree was uncoiled. (2.-lambulukide, 3. -lambuluzya, 4.-lambulukila, 5.-lambulukilalyo, 6.-lambulukisya, 7.-lambuluka-lambuluka, 8.-lambulukana) Also: -nambunuka.

unknit, Kamulambulula cisani camwana. Undo the child's dress. (1.-lambululwa, 2.-lambulwide, 3.-lambuluzya, 4.-lambulwida, 5.-lambulwidalyo, 6.-lambulukisya, 7.-lambulula-lambulula, 8.-lambululana) Also: -zambulula

unstitch, Bamaama bacilambununa cisani catakasumidwe kabotu. Mother undid the stitching of the cloth which was not properly sewn. (1.-lambununwa, 2.-lambunwide, 3.-lambunuzya, 4.-lambunwida, 5.-lambunwidalyo, 6.-lambununisya, 7.-lambununa-lambununa, 8.-lambununana) Also: -zambulula.

patch, *Kocilamika cisani camwana cipya.* Put a patch on the child's new dress. (1.-lamikwa, 2.-lamikide, 3.-lamizya, 4.-lamikila, 5.-lamikilalyo, 6.-lamikisya, 7.-lamika-lamika, 8.-lamikana) Also: -gambika, -mamika, mama, -bampika.

claim illegally as one's own, *Ncibi kulaminina cintu citali cako.* = It is bad to claim what is not yours. *Bwami bwakulaminina tabuli kabotu.* = Chieftainship claimed (illegally) is not good. (1.-lamininwa, 2.-laminide, 3.-laminizya, 4.-lamininina, 5.-lamanininalyo, 6.-lamininisya, 7.-laminina-laminina, 8.-lamininana) Also: -taminina, -angila.

be deep, long, tall, far, high, prolonged, *Mwana ooyu ulalampa kapati.* = This child grows very tall. (1.-lampwa/-lampizigwa, 2.-lampide, 3.-lampya, 4.-lampila, 5.-lampilalyo, 6.-lampisya, 7.-lampa-lampa.)
be very long, *Mulembo biya walampisya.* = The cloth is just too long.

be worn out, emaciated, exhausted, *Wakaide kulampuluka mulombwana mbuli kuti tanaakali kulya.* = The man was emaciated as if he had not been eating. *Mapopwe akaide kulampuluka.* = The maize just withered. (1.-lampulukwa, 2.-lampulukide, 3.-lampulusya, 4.-lampulukila, 5.-lampulukilalyo, 6.-lampulukisya, 7.-lampuluka-lampuluka)

lengthen, extend, *Kolulampya looye lusike kucisamu eco.* = Extend the rope so that it stretches to that tree. (1.-lampizyigwa, 2.-lampide, 3.-lampya, 4.-lampila, 5.-lampilalyo, 6.-lampisya, 7.-lampa-lampa)
be ground fine, *Buya busu bwaalamuka kabotu.* = That mealiemeal was finely ground. (2.-lamukide, 3.-kamukizya, 4.-lamukila, 5.-lamukilalyo, 6.-lamukisya, 7.-lamuka-lamuka) Also: -seta
grind fine, *Ciya cigayo cilalamuna kabotu busu.* = That grinding mill grinds fine mealie-meal. (1.-lamunwa, 2.-lamunide, 3.-lamunizya, 4.-lamunina, 5.-lamuninalyo, 6.-lamunisya, 7.-lamunalamuna)

be astounded, *Basibbola bakalamwa nibakazundwa kubana baniini.* = The footballers were amazed when they were beaten by small children. (1.lamizyigwa, 2.-lamwide, 3.-lamya, 4.-lamwida, 5.-lamwidalyo, 6.-lamwisya, 7.-lamwa-lamwa, 8.-lamwizyanya) Also: -nyandwa, -yabwa, -gambwa.
astonish, *Eeci cakamulamya akumuyoosya kapati.* = This astonished him and made him fear greatly

stretch while lying flat, *Mudaala naakazyila kumilimo, wakalandabala mucimvwule.* = The old man stretched himself out lying down in the shade when he came from work. *Nsinga zyakwe zyalandabala, moyo uladunta.* = His veins are stretched, the heart is pounding. (1.-landabalwa, 2.-landabete, 3.-landabizya, 4.-landabalila, 5.-landabalilalyo, 6.-landabalisya, 7.-landabala-landabala)
stretch oneself out flat to rest, *Kamulandabalila mucimvwule.* = Stretch out flat in the shade.
be stretched out, *Wakabona mwanaakwe kalandabede kakusweka malowa mumpemo amukanwa.* = He saw his child stretched out losing blood from nose and mouth.
be stretched out flat, *Bakaintu bamudaala bakajana ulilanda-* *bete abulo.* = The wife found her husband stretched flat out on the bed.

stretch out, *Wakalandabika kakole akati kananda.* = He stretched out the rope in the middle of the house. (1.-landabikwa, 2.-landabikide, 3.-landabizya, 4.-landabizyizya, 5.-landabizyizyalyo, 6.-landabikisya, 7.-landabika-landabika, 8.-landabikana)

stay for a long time, *Mipika njindaatola kuti ikabambwe, yalandala.* = The pots which I took to be repaired have stayed for a long time. (2.-landalide, 3.-landazya, 4.-landalila, 5,-landalilalyo, 6.-landalisya, 7.-landala-landala)

be stretched, as rubber or cloth, *Cisani cangu cilalandamuka mocili mucibuno.* = My dress stretches at the waist. (2.-landamukide, 3.-landamuzya, 4.-landamukila, 5.-landamukilalyo, 6.-landamukisya, 7.-landamuka-landamuka)

stretch catapult or rubber, lengthen, *Kolandamuna malekani aako tubone mbwaalampa.* = Stretch out your catapult so that we see how long it is. *Wakatijaana cakuti tusindi twakwe twakali kuuma kumusana naakali kulandamuna maulu kuzuzaana.* = He was running in such a way that his heels were striking his back when he was stretching his legs to flee. *Izuba nolyakatalika kulandamuna zinzimweemwe, twakanyamuka.* = When the sun began to lengthen the shadows, we set out. Also: -lozomona. (1.-landamunwa, 2.-landamwide, 3.-landamuzya, 4.-landamwida, 5.-landamwidalyo, 6.-landamunisya, 7.-landamuna-landamuna, 8.-landamunana)

cross over, *Twakaulanduka mulonga Magoye nkaambo tiiwakazwide kapati.* = We crossed the river Magoye because it was not very full. (1.-landukwa, 2.-landukide, 3.-landusya, 4.-landukila, 5.-landukilalyo, 6.-landukisya, 7.-landuka-landuka, 8.-landukana) Also: -zabuka.

take out, *Kamusamununa zisani zyenu nomutiilanduke kabotu.* = Take off your clothes so that you cross more easily. (1.-landulwa, 2.-landwide, 3.-landuzya, 4.-landizyizya, 5.-landizyizyalyo, 6.-landulisya, 7.-landula-landula, 8.-landulana)
  • pick pieces of meat to eat, *Mwana tayelede kulandula nyama mupati kataninga.* A child should not pick meat before an elder. Also: -owa, -zubula

cause to ferry, make to cross over, rt. -landuka, *Nguni wamulandusya mumulonga kuti musike kuno.* Who ferried you across the river to enable you to reach here? *Ndakakilwa kuzabuka mulonga, kondilandusya.* = I am unable to cross the river, take me across. (1.-landisyigwa, 2.-landusyizye, 3.-landuzya, 4.-landusyizya, 5.-landusyizyalyo, 6.-landusyisya, 7.-landusya-landusya, 8.-landisyanya)
  • help to make progress, *Bamayibakalandusya bana banji kuya mubbuku lyakkumi.* The teachers helped many pupils pass on to Grade 10.

look, *Langa bantu baya ncobacita kunze aamwami uulemekwa.* = Look at what those people are doing behind the honourable chief. (1.-langwa, 2.-langide, 3.-lanzya/langizya, 4.-langila, 5.langilalyo, 6.-langisya, 7.-langa-langa, 8.-langana.)
  • take care of, *Kwaalanga kabotu mabbuku aayo bataabbi.* Take care of those books so that they do not steal them.
  • inspect, *Langa zimbuzi eezyo naa zyasalala.* Check those toilets to see if they are clean.
  • be alive, *Muntu ucisidwe ucilanga.* = The critically ill person is still alive.

be fond of, *Ulalangala kulya mango abizwide.* = He is fond of eating ripe mangoes. (2.-langalide, 3.-langazya, 4.-langalila, 5.-langalilalyo, 6.-langalisya, 7.-langala-langala)
  • form tassels (maize), *Mapopwe okwesu atalika kulangala.* = Our maize has started to form tassels. Also: *-sonsa, -vwunga ngala.*

look about, *Nda-mubona alya kalanga-langa naa ulanga nzi?* = I saw him over there looking about, I don't know what he is looking for.
  • hurry in looking, *Kamulanga-langa ncomuyanda kuula tweende.* = Hurry up in looking for what you want to buy so that we can go.

face one another, *Twakalangana buya kukkala mucitima.* = We sat facing one another in the train.
  • looking at one another, *Twakaide kulangana ciindi naakatujana katumwaamba.* = We just looked at each other when he found us talking about him.
  • disagree with one another, *Atulonge nkaambo kulangana kumulomo lyoonse ncibi.* = Let us move to another place because picking quarrels with one another is bad.

cause to face, rt. *-langa*, *Mwayaka nanda yangu weelede kwiilanganya ayanu.* = When you build my house you ought to face it opposite yours. (1.-langanyizyigwa, 2.-langizyide, 4.-langanyizyizya, 5.-langanyizyizyalyo, 6.-langanyizyisya, 7.-langanya-langanya, 8.-langanyizyanya)
  • take care, rt. *-langa*, *Mukabalanganye bana bangu ndaakufwa.* = Take care of my children when I am dead. Also: *-bamba.*

look around everywhere, rt. *-langa*, *Ndilangaula kwakujana camutunzya wamapopwe.* = I am looking for a place where to find fertilizer. (1.-langaulwa, 2.-langawide, 3.-langauzya, 4.-langawida, 5.-langawidalyo, 6.-langaulisya, 7.-langaula-langaula, 8.-langaulana) Also: *-nyenguula.*

begin to produce grain, as in growing sorgum, *Maila muceme akatalika kale kulangazya. Kamubatuma bana kukuyamina.* = The sorgum has already begun to produce grain. Send the children to scare the birds away. 1.-langazyigwa, 2.-langazyide, 4.-langazyizya, 5.-langazyizyalyo, 6.-langazyisya, 7.-langazya-langazya)

await, rt. *-langa*, *Ndilangila mweenzu kuzwa ku Lusaka sunu.* = I am expecting a visitor from Lusaka today. (1.-langilwa, 2.-langide, 3.-langizya, 4.-langizyizya, 5.-langizyizyalyo, 6.-langilisya, 7.-langila-langila, 8.-langililana)
  • check, *Muzolani wauso tawo, wafwumina kukulangila makole aakwe musyokwe.* = Your father's friend is not there, he has set out early to check his traps in the bush. Also: *-yunza.*
  • look at (in envy), *Ncibi kuyiisya bana banu kuya kulangila zyakulya mumaanda abantu bamwi.* = It is bad to teach your children to go and stare at the food in other homes.

watch, rt. *-langa*, *Nobalwana bana, ndali kulangilila.* = When the children fought, I was watching. (1.-langililwa, 2.-langilide, 3.-langilizya, 4.-langililila, 5.-langilililayo, 6.-langililisya, 7.-langilila-langilila, 8.-langililana)

observe carefully *Nibali kulwana bana, ndali kulangilizya.* = When the children were fighting, I was watching intently. (1.-langilizyigwa, 2.-langilizyide, 3.-langilizyizya, 4.-langilizyila, 5.-langilizyilalyo, 6.-langilizyisya, 7.-langilizya-langilizya, 8.-langilizyanya)

look at intently, Chilwalo naakali kwiimba, bantu boonse bakamu*langisya*. When Chilwalo was singing, all the people were looking at him with full attention. (1.-langwa, 2.-langide, 3.-lanzya, 4.-langila, 5.-langilalyo, 6.-langisya, 7.-langa-langa, 8.-langana)

stare at someone, rt. -langa, Ndamulangula nkaambo kakuti wasamide kabotu. = I stared at him because he was smartly dressed. (1.-langulwa, 2.-langude, 3.-languzya, 4.-langulila, 5.-langulilalyo, 6.-langulisya, 7.-langula-langula, 8.-langulana)
revise, look again, rt. langa, Ndakalanga ndimane ndaka

alimwi nkaambo ncaakali kucita cakali kunyandya kapati. I looked and then looked again at what she was doing because it was astounding. (1.-langululwa, 2.-langululide, 3.-languluzya, 4.-langululila, 5.-langululilalyo, 6.-langululisya, 7.-langulula-langulula, 8.-langululana)

look out for continually, Ndali *kulanguula* nombe zyazimide. I was continually looking for the cattle which had been lost. (1.-languulwa, 2.-languulide, 3.-languuzya, 4.-languulila, 5.-languulilalyo, 6.-languulisya, 7.-languula-languula, 8.-languulana) Also: -langaula, -yandaula.

extend in length, prolong, Kamulansya-lansya musalo kutegwa tukkomane Prolong the conversation so that we enjoy ourselves. Muunda wakwe wakatalika *kuulansya* kwiinda mukunjila mumuunda wangu mwaka-amwaka. He began to lengthen his field by entering into my field year by year. (1.-lansyigwa, 2.-lansyide, 4.-lansyila, 5.-lansyilalyo, 6.-lansyisya, 7.-lansya-lansya, 8.-lansyanya) Also: -lampisya, -olola

be looked at carefully, Pele walo Nabulongo zyoonse ezi zyakali kucitika, kuli nguwe zyakalanzizye kunio yaliso. As regards all these things which were happening, they were just looked at by Nabulongo carefully out of the corner of her eye.

look with, look at, Aaba bantu tiibakali *kulanzya* buyo meso nsiki ezi, bakali kusola koonse mbobakali kukonzya kuziyandawida micelo. These people were not just looking at these diseases with their eyes, they were trying in whatever way they could to search for medicines. Bantu banji bamumunzi bakaboola kumulanzya pesi kunyina wakali kukonzya kugwasya. Many people of the village came to look at her but no one was able to help. Basune balikulanzya kumunzi mitwe. The oxen were headed facing homewards. (1.-langwa, 2.-langide, 4.-langila, 5.-langilalyo, 6.-langisya, 7.-lanzya-lanzya, 8.-langana)

place in an untidy or rough way, Kamubungika buya musenga oyo mutani kwiile *kulapaila*. Gather up the sand and don't just leave it untidily. Basankwa bali kwiile *kulapaila* bulongo nibali kusya cuumbwe. The boys where just scattering the soil carelessly when they were digging the grave. Kamulapaila mavwu cizule cilindi. Throw the soil roughly to fill the hole. (1.-lapailwa, 2.-lapailide, 3.-lapauzya, 4.-lapailila, 5.-lapaililalyo, 6.-lapailisya, 7.-lapailalapaila, 8.-lapailana)
put in an untidy way, (1.-lapiilwa, 2.-lapiilide, 3.-lapiizya, 4.-lapiilila, 5.-lapiililalyo, 6.-lapiilisya, 7.-lapiila-lapiila, 8.-lapiilana) Also: -lapaila

spread about, Ndakaalapila makololo kuti zilye nkuku. I spread the left-overs so that the chickens could eat. Mukaintu naakanyema, wakamulapila bu longo butete mulumi wakwe. = When the woman was angry, she splattered the wet clay over her husband. (1.-lapilwa, 2.-lapilide, 3.-lapizya, 4.-lapilila, 5.-lapilililalyo, 6.-lapilisya 7.-lapila-lapila, 8.-lapilana)

spring, as a lion, be released, jump suddenly, run quickly, Wakalapuka syuumbwa kuzwa mucoonde kuti alume kanamunsya. The lion sprang out of the thicket to attack the duiker. Mbulwaalila buyo ludweba, wakalapuka kuzuza a kusiya beenzinyina boonse. = As soon as the whistle blew, he ran as quickly as he could and left all his friends behind. Moyo wakwe wakaile kulapuka. = His heart just jumped. (1.-lapukwa, 2.-lapukide, 3.-lapuzya, 4.-lapukila, 5.-lapukilalyo, 6.-lapukisya, 7.-lapuka-lapuka, 8.-lapukilana)
spring out, rt. -lapuka, Mukuyoowa kupati Mainza wakalapukila anze. In great fear Mainza sprang outside.

release, discharge, Ndakaalapula malekani ciindi nindakabona kayuni. = I released the catapult instantly when I saw a bird. Also: -denuna, -lesula (1.-lapulwa, 2.-lapulide, 3.-lapuzya, 4.-lapulila, 5.-lupilalyo, 6.-lapulisya, 7.-lapula-lapula, 8.-lapulana)
  • transfer quickly, as coals from one fire to another, Kamulapula makala amulilo mulete kuno tupange uumbi. = Transfer the coals quickly from that fire so that we make another.

wag, Inombe zilapuula micila kutanda mbuwo. = Cattle shake their tails continually to drive away the flies. Also: -kwisaula. (1.-lapuulwa, 2.-lapuulide, 3.-lapuuzya, 4.-lapuulila, 5.-lapuulilalyo, 6.-lapuulisya, 7.-lapuula-lapuula, 8.-lapuulana)

fly about as sparks, Insasi zyamulilo zyali kulapuuka muwo niwali kubbubbula. The sparks were flying from the embers of the fire when the wind was blowing. (2.-lapuukide, 3.-lapuukizya, 4.-lapuukila, 5.-lapuukilalyo, 6.-lapuukisya, 7.-lapuuka-lapuuka) Also: -tapuuka.
  • escape quickly, as rats, Mbeba zyakalapuuka kuzwa mubwina nizyakatilwa meenda apya. = The rats rushed out quickly from the hole when some hot water was poured on them.

tell stories for fun, say interesting things, Basankwa a basimbi balalasa. = The boys and girls are holding an interesting conversation. (1.-lasilwa, 2.-laside, 3.-lasizya, 4.-lasila, 5.-lasilalyo, 6.-lasisya, 7. -lasa-lasa, 8.-lasisyanya)
be told stories of, rt.-lasa, Bakali kukkomana nibakali kulasilwa Munali kuli bausyi. = They were happy when their father was telling them stories about Dr. David Livingstone.

ignore, pay no attention, Banyina bakaambila bana babo kuti, "Ulataila nceamba, uya kupenga kumbele amazuba." = The mother told her children saying, "The one who pays no attention to what I say, will suffer in future." (1.-latailwa, 2.-latailide, 3.-lataizya, 4.-latailila, 5.-lataililalyo, 6.-latailisya, 7.-lataila-lataila, 8.-latailana) Also: - wiika.
complain, Munene wakalilauka. The old man was complaining.

remove from a full container into an empty one, Kamwaalaula mapopwe mucibulo omu avwulisya. = Remove the maize from the bucket which has more than enough. Also: -toosya. (rt. -tooka) (1.-laulwa, 2.-laulide, 3.-lauluzya, 4.-lauwida, 5.-lauwidalyo, 6.-laululisya, 7.-laula-laula, 8.-laulana)
  • proclaim a law, Kamulaula mulawo oyu umvwugwe kubantu. = Proclaim this law so that it is clear to the people.
  • chose, select, Bamayi bakalaula basicikolo bayumu kuya kuzundana. = The teachers selected strong pupils to compete. Also: -nomona, -sala.

unload, Kamulaulula mapopwe kuzwa munola. = Unload the maize from the wagon. Also: -lausyula. (1.-laululwa, 2.-laulwide, 3.-lauluzya, 4.-laulwida, 5.-laulwidalyo, 6.-laululisya, 7.-laula-laula, 8.-laululana)
unload, (1.-lausyulwa, 2.-lausyude, 3.-lausyuzya, 4.-lausyuda, 5.-lausyudalyo, 6.-lausyulisya, 7.-lausyulalausyula, 8.-lausyulana) Also: -laulula.

give advice, instruct, Mazuba ano bazyali nobalaya, bana tabateeleli. Nowadays when the parents give advice, the children pay no heed. Sautu, mwanaangu oyu mebo wandaalila kulaya, ino ndati antela undilaile nduwe biya. Sautu, this child of mine I am unable to instruct, now I say perhaps you can please instruct him for me. Bakali kutulaya mugobelo kaindi tobasankwa. They used to instruct us, we boys, at the men's shelter long ago. (1.-layigwa, 2.-layide, 3.-layizya, 4.-layila, 5.-layilalyo, 6.-layisya, 7-laya-laya, 8.-layana.) Also: -konkomwena.
  • say goodbye, Wakaile kuunka kakunyina kundilaya. He just went without biding me farewell.

advise for, rt. -laya, Kamundilayila mwana, wandikatazya. = Advise the child for me, he is difficult.
  • say good-bye for someone, Kamundilayila kubacembele kuti ndaunka. = Say good-bye for me to the old woman that I am going.

instruct, counsel, warn, rt. laya, Ndamulayilila mbwaali kunga uyakusika kwabo. = I instructed her how to reach her home. (1.-layililwa, 2.-layilide, 3.-layilizya, 4.-layilizyizya, 5.-layilizyizyalyo, 6.-layilizyisya, 7.-layilila-layilila, 8.-layililana)

load on, Kamulayisya zintu ezi mubwato,, ziya mumanyika ambi. = Load these goods on boats going to foreign lands. Basankwa balayisya mapopwe munkalaki. The boys were loading the maize on to the cart. Also: -longela. (1.-layisyigwa, 2.-layisyide, 3.-layisyizya, 4.-layisyila, 5.-layisyilalyo, 6.-layisyisya, 7.-layisya-layisya, 8.-layisyanya)
  • instruct, advise, Kamumulayisya mwanaanu kutegwa aleke kulwana abananyina. Instruct your child so that he stops fighting with his fellow children.

place in a lying position, rt. lala, Kamumulazika uuciswa ansi aawa mucimvwule. = Make the patient lie down here in the shade. (1.-lazikwa, 2.-lazikide, 3.-lazisya, 4.-lazikila, 5.-lazikilalyo, 6.-lazikisya, 7.-lazika-lazika, 8.-lazikana)
  • smooth or flatten hair, Kamulazika masusu aboneke kabotu. = Smoothen out the hair so that it looks nice. Also: -lalika
  • leave unfinished or to lie fallow, Mwaka uno bantu banji bakalazika myuunda yabo akaambo kasyokwe linji a nzala mumaanda abo. This year many people left their fields unattended because of the abundance of weeds and hunger in their homes. Uno mwaka bataata bakaulazika muunda nkaambo yavwula myaka kaulimwa. This year my father has left the field lying fallow because it has been ploughed for many years.

put in lying position, rt. -lazika, Bamuka Michelo bakakkede ambali azyuli kumwi balazikide mwana amagondo uwakali koona. = The wife of Michelo was sitting beside the bedroom while laying the child who was asleep on her knees. (1.-lazikidwe)

put lying down for, rt. lazika, Kamundilazikila mwana abulo. = Lay the child down on the bed for me.
  • delay, Bakamulazikila milimo yakwe. = They delayed him in his works.

cause to commit a crime, Bakamuleba mweenzinyina, mpoona wakajana mulandu. = They caused their friend to commit a crime, thereupon he was charged. (1.-lebwa, 2.-lebede, 3.-lebya, 4.-lebela, 5.-lebelalyo, 6.-lebesya, 7.-leba-leba, -lebana) Also: -yunga.
  • trip, Kamumuleba kutegwa atanywinsyi bbola ooyu. = Trip that one so that he does not score a goal.
  • kill an animal for an initiation ceremony = Chimuka nguwakaleba nkolola yamwanaangu. = It was Chimuka who had an animal killed for my daughter's initiation ceremony.

plant following after the plough, Kaindi bantu banji bakali kulebela biya kusyanga mapopwe. = Long ago many people used to follow the ploughs when they were planting maize. (1.-lebelwa, 2.-lebelede, 3.-lebezya, 4.-lebelela, 5.-lebelelalyo, 6.-lebelesya, 7.-lebela-lebela, 8.-lebelelana)
plant for someone, rt. lebela, Wakalebeledwa ndongwe kubana bakwe naakali kuciswa. = She had her children sow groundnuts for her when she was sick. Also: -syangililwa.

be levelled, Mapopwe ali mucisuwo alebeledwe biya. = The maize which is in the basket is full to the brim. (1.-lebelelwa, 2.-lebeledwe, 3.-lebelezya, 4.-lebelezyezya, 5.-lebelezyezyalyo, 6.-lebelezyesya, 7.-lebeledwe-lebeledwe, 8.-lebelezyanya)

move as a crowd, Nkamu yabantu mpati yalebeleka kunjila mumuswaangano. = A big group of people moved into the meeting. Also: -longomoka (1.-lebelekwa, 2.-lebelekede, 3.-lebelesya, 4.-lebelekela, 5.-lebelekelalyo, 6.-lebelekesya, 7.-lebeleka-lebeleka)

be free and contented, Kuti ndijane umbi mulala, mizeezo mbiyalutila kale, ndamujata buyo andilume nkaambo ndaazyiba ansi taalebelelwa. = If I find another black mamba, since thoughts are already so depressing, I will just catch it so that it bites me because I have known that on this earth there is no freedom. (2.-lebeledwe, 3.-lebelezya, 4.-lebelezyela, 5.-lebelezyelalyo, 6.-lebelezyesya, 7.-lebelekwa-lebelekwa)

act as a group act in unison, Babelesi bakalebelesya majwi kwaamba matongoosi abo kumfwulumende. = The workers poured out their common grievances to the government. (1.-lebelesyegwa, 2.-lebelesyede, 3.-lebelezyesya, 4.-lebelesyela, 5.-lebelesyelalyo, 6.-lebelesyesya, 7.-lebelesya-lebelesya, 8.-lebelesyanya) Also: -longomona.

cease to function, be paralysed, Ndakalebuka maulu nindakali kuciswa. = I was paralysed in the legs when I was sick. Kuli kasinga kalebuka mumubili wangu omu. = There is a vein in my body which has ceased to work. (1.-lebukwa, 2.-lebukide, 3.-lebuzya, 4.-lebukila, 5.-lebukilalyo, 6.-lebukisya, 7.-lebuka-lebuka)
  • drop as fall-trap, go off as a fire-arm or alarm, Kooye kalebuka tiikajaya. = The trap dropped but it did not kill. Also: -daduka, -inyuka, -lebwa, -tifwuka, dadalika.
  • sink, as the sun, Mutaunki nkomuya nkaambo izuba lyalebuka kale. = Do not go where you are going because the sun has already declined.

release a trap, pull a trigger, Wakailebula ntobolo naakasika adilwe. = He fired a gun when he arrived at the funeral. Also: -denuna. (1.-lebulwa, 2.-lebwide, 3.-lebuzya, 4.-lebwida, 5.-lebwidalyo, 6.-lebulisya, 7.-lebula-lebula, 8.-lebulana)
See -lebuka

fire a gun, rt. -lebula, Sa mbwaakati ndalebwida, yaakuuma akatikati ameso, mpoona luswee, kwakamana kaindi syaanza. = As soon as he fired a gun, the bullet hit just between the eyes, thereupon the lion was thrown flat, it was already dead.

use something to trip, rt.leba, Wakamulebya cisamu mweenzinyina ncaakawida mumulonga. = He tripped his friend with a stick, that is why he fell into the river. (1.-lebwa, 2.-lebede, 3.-lebya, 4.-lebela, 5.-lebelalyo, 6.-lebesya, 7.-lebya-lebya, 8.-lebana)
  • cause one to fall, Cilalebya kweenda abantu babbi. = To go with thieves causes one to fall.
divert to, Sicibende wakamuleela mwana akuya kumuuта трааkakkede. = Sicibende went aside to beat the child where he was sitting.
hide one's real feelings or emotions, Nabwiinga naakakwatwakwatwa wakali kulileemaika. = When the bride was newly married she was shy.

begin to settle, Cibwantu ncobakumba batumbu bangu caleengula kale. = The sweet beer which my wife has brewed has aleady settled. (1.-leengulwa, 2.-leengwide, 3.-leenguzya, 4.-leengwida, 5.-leengwidalyo, 6.-leengulisya, 7.-leengula-leengula) Also: -leenza, -batama

become separate, as water from sour milk, Mabisi atalika kuleenza. = The sour milk has begun to separate itself from the water. (2.-leenzide, 4.-leenzela, 5.-leenzelalyo, 6.-leenzesya, 7.-leenza-leenza)

cause to deviate, rt. -leya, Ndakabaleesya kuti babone balwazi kwesu. = I made them go aside to see the patient at our home. Michelo waka leesya mootokala musyokwe kuti apumune. = Michelo drove the car aside into the bush so that he would rest. (1.-leesyegwa, 2.-leesyede, 3.-leesyezya, 4.-leesyela, 5.-leesyelalyo, 6.-leesyesya, 7.-leesya-leesya, 8.-leesyanya)

stop, Kamuleka kubaambila zintu zibi bana. = Stop saying bad things to the children. (1.-lekwa, 2.-lekede, 3.-lekezya, / -leesya, 4.-lekela, 5.-lekelalyo, 6-lekesya, 7-lekaleka, 8.-lekana.)
  • disappoint, Lyakandileka nindakabona mbwaakacisidwe sibbuku wesu. = It disappointed me when I saw how sick our headman was.
  • become weak (idiomatic), Ncibi kulileka mbuli mulomo wakunsi. = It is bad to be lazy like your lower lip.
be worn out, Bakaintu bakwe bakalilekede kale kulila akulipwaya. = His wife was already worn out with crying and throwing herself on the ground.

leave off, rt. -leka, Mumazuba akaindi mukupa wakali wakulilekela. = In past days the milk was so plentiful that you needed only to stop when you had taken as much as you wanted. (1.-lekelwa)
  • leave for, Komulekela ceele mwana, takwe kukkuta. = Leave the porridge for the child, it will not be satisfied.

forgive, Kamumulekelela buyo nkaambo tacizyi ncacita. = Just forgive him because he does not realize what he is doing. (1.-lekelelwa, 2.-lekelede, 3.-lekelezya, 4.-lekelelela, / lekezyela, 5.-lekelelelalyo, 6.-lekelelesya, 7.-lekelela-lekelela, 8.-lekelelana.)
  • give in, give up, surrender, Ncibi kulilekelela nokuba muciindi ncojana buyumuyumu mukati kabuumi bwako. = It is bad to give up even at a time when you find difficulties in your life.

betray, desert, Bakamulekelezya mulimo nkaambo tiibakali kutambula bulumbu. = They deserted him in the work because they were not receiving any reward. (1.-lekelezyegwa, 2.-lekelezyede, 4.-lekelezyela, 5.-lekelezyelalyo, 6.-lekelezyesya, 7.-lekelezyalekelezya, 8.-lekelezyanya)

be wrinkled as an old person, Nkanda zyabacembele zyakaleketana. The skin of the old woman has wrinkled. (1.-leketanwa, 2.-leketanide, 3.-leketanya, 4.-leketanina, 5.-leketaninalyo, 6.-leketanisya, 7.-leketana-leketana)

let go, stop doing something, Ndizyi kuti muyanda kuti mbeleke kakunyina kulekezya nsetanamana. I know that you want me to work without stopping until I finish. Mukaintu wakalekezya kukopa cakulya ncaakali kujikila mulwazi. = The woman stopped stirring the food which she was cooking for the patient. (1.-lekezyegwa, 2.-lekezyede, 4.-lekezyezya, 5.-lekezyezyalyo, 6.-lekezyesya, 7.-lekezya-lekezya, 8.-lekezyanya)
  • set the dogs on, Bandiluma babwa nibabalekezya cifwumofwumo. = The dogs attacked me when they released them this morning.
be spoilt, Aba bana baide kulekwa-lekwa. = These children are just spoilt. (2.-lekede-lekede, 3.-lesyalesya, 4.-lekela-lekela, 5.-lekelalyolekelalyo, 6.-lekesya-lekesya, 7.-lekwa-lekwa)

rule, Tacili cuubauba kulela bantu bamisyobo yaandeene mucisi. = It is not easy to rule people of different ethnic groups in a country. (1.-lelwa, 2.-lelede, 3.-lezya, 4. lelela, 5.-lelelalyo, 6.-lelesya, 7.-lela-lela, 8.-lelana.)
  • fail to achieve, lose energy, Ndali kuyanda kwaanzula cisani kumane ndalela. I wanted to take down the dress from where it was hung, but I failed. Ooyu mwana takasiki ku Pemba, uyakulela nkaambo musinzo mmulamfwu. = This child will not reach Pemba, he will fail because the journey is long. Bamwi balakwatwa mbapati kale, pesi kumilimo bacilela, bacili kule. Some who are married are already adults, but as regards acitivities they are failing, they are still far off. Nibazyila kukuvwima basankwa, balela munzila akaambo kanzala. = When the men came back from hunting, they became weak on the way because of the hunger. Naakabeleka kwamyaka makumi otatwe mumugodi wa Nkana, nguzu zyakatalika kulela. When he had worked for thirty years at Nkana mine, his energy began to fail. Moyo wangu walela. = My heart has lost energy.

care for each other, Banabukwetene baleelede kulelana kabotu. = Married people ought to look after each other well.
  • be insufficient for, Mali aaya alelana kuuzya payi. This money is insufficent for buying a blanket. Also: -ceya.

be in position of ruling, rt. -lela, Sibbuku wakalelede bantu banji mumunzi wakwe. = The headman ruled many people in his village.
  • be ineffective, Bamwi balakwata mbapati kale, pesi kumilimo inga bacilelede, bacili kule. Some marry while they are already physically mature, but as regards works they are ineffective, they are still a long way off.

hang upon, be suspended, Kuli cileleenga amulenga, kubee ncisani. There is something hanging on the rack, it seems to be a cloth. (1.-leleengwa, 2.-leleengede, 3.-leleenzya, 4. leleengela, 5.-leleengelalyo, 6.-leleengesya, 7.-leleenga-leleenga) Also: -lenga-lenga, -lengelela. V - 293
