bless, Mupaizi wakamuleleka mwana. = The priest blessed the child. Also: -lumbilila. (1.-lelekwa, 2.-lelekede, 3.-lelekezya, 4.-lelekela, 5.-lelekelalyo, 6.-lelekesya, 7.-leleka-leleka, 8.-lekekana.)
take care for, rt. -lela, Kamundilelela mwana. Take care of the child for me. (1.-lelelwa, 2.-lelede, 3.-lelezya, 4.-lelelela, 5.-lelelelayo, 6.-lelelesya, 7.-lelela-lelela, 8.-lelelana)

walk majestically, go with short steps, Ciindi capobwe lyakukwatana, banabwiinga balalelema kweenda. During the wedding, the bride and groom walk slowly with short steps. (1.-lelemwa, 2.-lelemede, 3.-lelemya, 4.-lelemena, 5.-lelemenalyo, 6.-lelemesya, 7.-lelema-lelema) Also: -cankaila.

adhere as okra or honey, be sticky or viscous, Cinkomba tacileki kulelemuka nocijikwa ciindi cilamfwu. = Okra does not stop being slippery even when it is cooked for a long time. Also: -lendemuka, -lozomoka, -loloteka. (1.-lelemukwa, 2.-lelemukide, 3.-lelemuzya, 4.-lelemukila, 5.-lelemukilalyo, 6.-lelemukisya 7.-lelemuke-lelemuka)

draw up, as okra with fingers, Kolelemuna cinkomba tubone kuti cabizwa. = Draw up the okra to see if it is cooked. (1.-lelemunwa, 2.-lelemwide, 4.-lelemwida/-lelemunina, 5.-lelemwidalyo /-lelemuninalyo, 6.-lelemunisya, 7.-lelemuna-lelemuna)
  • drag out in speaking, be long-winded, Koleka kulelemuna kwaambaula, nkaambo bantu inga baleka kuswiilila. = Stop being tediously lengthy when speaking because people may stop listening. Also: -kokobela.

act without enthusiasm, Wakaunka uyaabulelenkana mbuli mwana watali kuyanda kutumwa. = He went without interest or desire like a child who does not want to be sent on an errand. (1.-lelenkanwa, 2.-lelenkene, 3.-lelekanya, 4.-lelekanina, 5.-lelekaninalyo, 6.-lelekanisya, 7.-lelenkanalelenkana)

become weak, Kunyina ncekonzya kubeleka, mubili oonse waile kuleluka. There is nothing which I can do, the whole body is weak. (1.-lelukwa, 2.-lelukide, 3.-leluzya, 4.-lelukila, 5.-lelukilalyo, 6.-lelukisya, 7.-leluka-leluka) Also: -teteeta

be tiring, Kuyumuna mapopwe amutwe kuya kucigayo cilalema. = It is tiring to carry maize on the head to the grinding mill. Ndalema kubeleka, bwaca kaindi. I am tired working, it dawned long ago. Also: -katala, -beba. (1.-lemwa, 2.-lemede, 3.-lemya, 4.-lemena, 5.-lemenalyo, 6.-lemesya, 7.-lema-lema.)
  • be dignified, Basololi bamwi balalema mumeso abantu. = Some leaders are dignified in the eyes of the people.
  • make straight, Bataata bakalicizyi kulema nsumpi zyakuyasya matala. = My father knew how to straighten the poles for building maize-bins. Umwi munene wakali kulema ciyako. A certain old man was straightening a pole (to be used in the wall of a house.)
  • be thick, Bulowa bulalema kwiinda meenda. Blood is thicker than water. Musinza ulalema. The gravy is thick.

be crippled, Wakalemana kuzwa ciindi naakatyoka mubbola. = He has been crippled since the time he broke a leg at football. (2.-lemenye, 3.-lemeka, 4.-lemanina, 5.-lemaninalyo, 6.lemanisyà, 7.-lemana-lemana.)
  • be angry, Bataata balemana, ndasowa mpongo. Father is angry, I have lost the goats. Also: -kalalila, -nyemena.
  • be addicted, Bataata bakalemana buya kunywa bukoko, kuti tiibanywa balangika kuciswa. = My father is addicted to drinking beer, if he does not drink he looks sick.
  • become pregnant, Tiicakaba ciindi wakalemana. = It was not long before she became pregnant.

become crippled at, Haajunka wakali kunkondo nkwakaakulemanina nobakaakumuyasa ntobolo yaakasolo. = It was when Haajunka was at war that he became crippled when they shot him in the hip with a gun.
  • be angry with, Baneene bakandilemanina nindakauma mwana. = My grandmother was angry with me when I beat the child.

write, Mutinta walikulemba lugwalo luya kumweenzinyina. = Mutinta was writing a letter going to her friend. (1.-lembwa, 2.-lembede, 3.-lembya, 4.-lembela, 5.-lembelalyo, 6.-lembesya, 7.-lemba-lemba, 8.-lembana)
  • make cuts on a sick person to draw blood, Munanga wamulemba nsimbo mulwazi mubili woonse. = The witchdoctor is making cuts on the whole body of the patient.
  • make lines with hot metal on wood, notch a stick, Kolemba mwiini wakeembe kangu. = Make lines with fire on the handle of my axe. Bamadaala balicizyi kulemba nzyobafwala kuti zilangike kabotu. The old men know how to make designs on what they carve so that it kooks nice. Also: -cekaula.
  • scrawl, scribble, Kana kaile kulemba mafwasa abwaanda. = The baby is just scrawling on the wall.

drag feet, be unenergetic, Ino nolembaila buya kweenda, uyakusika lili? = Now if you just drag your feet as you walk, when will you arrive? Also: -lembwaila. (1.-lembailwa, 2.-lembailide, 3.-lembaizya, 4.-lembailila, 5.-lembaililalyo, 6.-lembailisya, 7.-lembaila-lembaila)

make cuts many times, Kuulu kwa Sicibende kwakazimba masiku. Nibwakaca bakamulembaula akumuzila musamu. = The leg of Sicibende became swollen at night. When it dawned they made many cuts and applied medicine to the cuts. (1.-lembaulwa, 2.-lembaulide, 3.-lembauzya, 4.-lembaulila, 5.-lembaulilalyo, 6.-lembaulisya, 7.-lembaulalembaula, 8.-lembaulana)
have cuts made many times, Mucelo wakasilisigwa Sicibende tuuwakali wakulembaulwa pe. = The medicine which was used to heal Sicibende was not used to rub imto cuts at all.

apply for, Twakalembela kubwiiyi toonse. = We all applied for teaching. (1.-lembelwa, 2.-lembelede, 3.-lembezya, 4.-lembelela, 5.-lembelelalyo, 6.-lembelesya, 7.-lembela-lembela, 8.-lembelelana.)
  • engrave, write on, Ndakalembela abbwe zina lyangu. = I wrote my name on a stone.

draw near to, approach, Izuba Iyalembelela. The sun is about to set. (1.-lembelelwa, 2.-lembelelede, 3.-lembelezya, 4.-lembelelela, 5.-lembelelelalyo, 6.-lembelelesya, 7.-lembelela-lembelela, 8.-lembelelana)

be in abundance, rt. -lembetela, Kuti twabona mutabi uulembetede micelo ipide, tulawoobola mutabi kutegwa tucele micelo ili ali nguwo. = If we see a branch on which there is abundant fruit, we pull it down so that we can gather the fruit which is on it.

be prolific, Uuno mwaka masuku alembetela kapati kuzyala. This year the masuku fruits are abundant. (1.-lembetelwa, 2.-lembetede, 3.-lembetezya, 4.-lembetelela, 5.-lembetelalyo, 6.-lembetelesya, 7.-lembetela-lembetela)
  • suspend oneself by one's hands, cling, Mwana walembetela akuboko kwabanyina naalikuyoowa beenzu. = The child clung to its mothers arm when it was afraid of the visitors.

droop, wilt, Kubucedo munene naalembuka kufwa. = It was at dawn that the old man faded and passed away. (1.-lembukwa, 2.-lembukide, 3.-lembukizya, 4.-lembukila, 5.-lembukilalyo, 6.-lembukisya, 7.-lembuka-lembuka) Also: -neta

be devastated, rt. lembuka, Basicikolo bakalembukilwa nibakamvwa kuti mwiiyi wabo wafwa. = The children were devastated when they heard that their teacher had died.
  • be dried up, Inga waakulembukilwa mate a kumana mukanwa mwayuma nta. = The spittle would be dried up and finish in your mouth.
finish off, rt. -lembuka, Majwi aaya ayoosya akamulembukizya musimbi. = These frightening words finished off the girl.

rewrite, copy, Naakaalilwa kulanduka mubbuku lyafwuka, wakaambilwa kulembulula kutegwa alanduke. = When he failed to pass Grade 9, he was told to rewrite so that he would pass to Grade 10. (1.-lembululwa, 2.-lembulwide, 3.-lembuluzya, 4.-lembulwida, 5.-lebulwidalyo, 6.-lembululisya, 7.-lembulula-lembulula)

be written, be registered, Sena walembwa kale zina mubbuku eeli. = Is your name already written in this book? Sena mwana walembwa kale kucikolo? = Did the child already get registered at school?
  • have cuts made, Sena mulwazi walembwa kale nsimbo kumunanga? = Has the witchdoctor already made incisions on the patient?

walk slowly or lazily, Ooyu ncalembwaila kweenda waciswa. = This one is sick, that is why he walks without energy. (1.-lembwailwa, 2.-lembwailide, 3.-lembwaizya, 4.-lembwailila, 5.-lembwaililalyo, 6.-lembwailisya, 7.-lembwaila-lembwaila) Also: -lembaila.
fall in large numbers, Twakajana masuku manji alembweteka kale ansi. = We found a large number of masuku fruit already fallen on the ground. Also: -mbwela
become weak, Nkujana waide kulembwetekana lembwetee, wabula amanga. = It was to find that he just became very weak, he had no power.

respect, Bana nywebo kamunga kamundilemeka ndimupati. = You children you should be respecting me, I am an elder. (1.-lemekwa, 2.-lemekede, 3.-lemya, 4.-lemekela, 5.-lemekelalyo, 6.-lemekesya, 7.-lemeka-lemeka, 8. -lemekana)
  • make lame, Intobolo yakamulemeka niyakamuuma kumaulu. = The gun made him lame when it struck his legs.
  • make heavy, make pregnant, Ndakamwaambila kuti taku umbi waali kukonzya kundilemeka kunze lyakwe. = I told him that no other could have made me pregnant but himself.

honour, respect, Weelede kubalemekezya bazyali bako nkaambo mbabaakubonya nyika. = You ought to honour your parents because they caused you to see the world. (1.lemekezyegwa, 2.-lemekezyede, 4.-lemekezyezya, 5.-lemekezyezyalyo, 6.-lemekezyesya, 7.-lemekezya-lemekezya, 8.-lemekezyanya)

be a burden, weigh down, Candilemena kubbadelela bana aba bobilo kuzikolo. It is hard for me to pay for these two children at school. Bbeeke eli lyamulemena kapati mwana oyu. = This bag has weighed down heavily on this child. Bwakabalemena buumi. = Life had become difficult for them. (1.-lemenwa, 2.-lemenede, 3.-lemezya, 4.-lemenena, 5.-lemene-nalyo, 6.-lemesya, 7.-lemena-lemena, 8.-lemezyanya)

be dignified, rt. -lema, Kwakafwa umwi muntu ulemenede. = There died a certain honourable person. (1.-lemenedwe, 3.-lemenezya, 4.-lemenezyezya, 5.-lemenezyezyalyo, 6.-lemenezyesya, 7.-lemenede-lemenede)
respect, Kutalemenezya bapati ncibi. Not to respect the elders is bad. (1.-lemenezyegwa, 2.-lemenezyede, 3.-lemenezyezya, 4.-lemenezyela, 5.lemenezyelalyo, 6.-lemenezyesya, 7.-lemenezya-lemenezya.)
be overburdened, Mudaala walemenwa masamu ngaayumwide. = The old man was overburdened with the poles he was carrying. Also: -minwa-minwa

burden, Mwandilemezya kusanina bana banu mbomusiya. = You have burdened me heavily in feeding your children whom you leave behind. (1.-lemezyegwa, 2.-lemezyede, 4.-lemezyezya, 5.-lemezyezyalyo, 6.-lemezyesya, 7.-lemezya-lemezya, 8.-lemezyanya)

be relieved, Ndakalemunuka bana naakabatola mupati wabo. I was relieved when their elder brother (or sister) took the children. (1.-lemunukwa, 2.-lemunukide, 3.-lemunuzya, 4.-lemunuzyizya, 5.-lemunuzyizyalyo, 6.-lemunukisya, 7.-lemunuka, 8.-lemununana)

relieve a person when loaded, Kamundilemununa mukuli wameenda, andilemena. Help me to lighten the weight of water, it is heavy for me. (1.-lemununwa, 2.-lemunwide, 3.-lemunuzya, 4.-lemunwida, 5.-lemunwidalyo, 6.-lemununisya, 7.-lemununalemununa, 8.-lemununana)

honour, Kamunga kamulilemya, nobasimbi, nobanakumukwata basankwa. Show respect for yourselves, girls, if boys are to marry you. (1.-lemekwa, 2.-lemekede, 4.-lemekela, 5.-lemekelalyo, 6.-lemekesya, 7.-lemyalemya, 8.-lemekana)
  • speak with low voice, Nindakasika masiku, ndakalilemya jwi kutegwa batandizyibi. When I arrived at night, I lowered my voice so that they would not know me.
  • wear oneself out, Candilemya kwaambila bantu bamwi. Talking to some people wears me out.

become thick as milk, become viscous or gummy, Mukupa walenda nkaambo kansima yalikupya. = The milk has become thick because of the nsima which was hot. (2.-lendede, 3.-lendezya, 4.-lendela, 5.-lendelalyo, 6.-lendesya, 7.-lenda-lenda)

retard mature growth, Ooyu mwana bakamulendegezya bakaapanyina nkaambo tiibakali kumulaya kabotu kubwana. The child did not grow in a mature way because the grandmother did not instruct him properly in childhood. Also: -lendekezya. (1.-lendegezyegwa, 2.-lendegezyede, 4.-lendegezyezya, 5.-lendegezyezyalyo, 6.-lendegezyesya, 7.-lendegezyalendegezya, 8.-lendegezyanya)

fail to impart discipline, be too lenient with someone to their detriment, Ooyu mwana balamulendekezya banyina ncanyina milimo iisumbula. The mother of this child is too lenient with it, that is why he has no proper job. Ooyu mwiiyi cilaala akubalela basicikolo, wiide kubalendekezya. = This teacher is unable to control the pupils, he just lets them run wild. (1.-lendekezyegwa, 2.-lendekezyede, 3.-lendekezyesya, 4.-lendekezyezya, 5.-lendekezyezyalyo, 6.-lendekezyesya, 7.-lendekezya-lendekezya, 8.-lendekezyanya)

be lonely, Kamukkala amweenzu, ulalendelelwa. = Remain with the visitor, otherwise she will become lonely. Also: -umbilwa, -umbaalilwa. (2.-lendeledwe, 3.-lendelezya, 4.-lendelelelwa, 5.-lendelelwalyo, 6.-lendelelesya, 7.-lendelelwa-lendelelwa, 8.-lendelezyanya)
be silent, leave one in solitude, Cilalendelezya kufwidwa bazyali. = The death of parents causes loneliness.

be hoarse, Ijwi lyangu sunu lyakatalika kulendema. = My voice has begun to become hoarse today. Mudaala naakafwa, mwanaakwe wakaliwaalila ansi mpoona awo ngooyu ulalendema uloomba ulalila. = When the old man died, his son threw himself on the ground. Thereupon he became hoarse crying out and weeping. Also: -dedema. (2.-lendemede, 3.-lendemya, 4.-lendemena, 5.-lendemenalyo, 6.-lendemesya, 7.-lendema-lendema)

grow tall and lean, Bamwi basimbi bayanda basankwa balendemana. Some girls want boys who are tall and lean. (1.-lendemanwa, 2.-lendemede, 3.-lendemanya, 4.-lendemanina, 5.-lendemaninalyo, 6.-lendemanisya, 7.-lendemanalendemana)
be tall and narrow, Mukasamu *kalendemene* mwenja kusompela mabanda. From a tall narrow tree I will spy out over the plains.

be sticky, Cinkomba cavwelwa muncile inga caleka kulendemuka. Okra which has been mixed with pumpkin leaves stops being tensile. (1.-lendemukwa, 2.-lendemukide, 3.-lendemuzya, 4.-lendemukila, 5.-lendemukilalyo, 6.-lendemukisya, 7.-lendemukalendemuka) Also: -lelemuka

notch, chip or splinter a pot, Mwana wacilendula cibiya casumikwa kale. The child chipped the clay pot which was already fired and burnished. Also: -bendula (1.-lendulwa, 2.-lendwide, 3.-lenduzya, 4.-lendwida, 5.-lendwidalyo, 6.-lendulisya, 7.-lendula-lendula, 8.-lendulana)

create, Nguni wakamulenga nobantu munyika muno? = Who created you people within this world? (1.-lengwa, 2.-lengede, 3.-lengezya, 4.-lengela, 5.-lengelalyo, 6.-lengesya, 7.-lenga-lenga, 8.-lengana)
  • commit an offence, Kujaya nkulenga kaambo kayumu nta. Killing a person is to commit a serious crime.
  • Nenzala ntwiilenga cilengwa cakubbida bantu = It is hunger which gives us the habit of stealing other people's goods.
  • hang or swing loose, Izisani zilalenga amulenga. = The clothes are hanging on the line.

be reluctant, uninterested, Mweene ulalengaana kubeleka. = Mweene is unenergetic in working. Nobasimbi, ncibi kulengaana kubumba zilongo zyabulongo kumaanda anu. = You girls, it is bad to be half-hearted in making clay pots at your houses. Also: -togwala, -uzyema, -waya-waya. (1.-lengaanwa, 2.-lengaanide, 3.-lengaanya, 4.-lengaanina, 5.-lengaaninalyo, 6.-lengaanisya, 7.-lengaana-lengaana)

hang loose, Cisani cilalenga-lenga mucisamu. = The cloth is hanging freely on the tree.
  • be shaking because of weakness, Moyo ulalenga-lenga nkaambo ndimvwide nzala. My heart is shaking because of the hunger.

become weak, Walengauka akaambo kanzala mwana. = The child has become weak with the hunger. (1.-lengaukwa, 2.-lengaukide, 3.-lengauzya, 4.-lengaukila, 5.-lengaukilalyo, 6.-lengaukisya, 7.-lengaukalengauka)

find excuses continually for shirking work, Ooyu mwana ulaa makakilo aakutumwa ncalengaula kwaamba. This child is reluctant in being sent to do something, that is why he is always finding excuses to avoid it. (1.-lengawida, 2.-lengaulide, 3.-lengauzya, 4.-lengawida, 5.-lengawidalyo, 6.-lengaulisya, 7.-lengaula-lengaula, 8.-lengawidana)
dishearten, discourage, rt.lengaula, Ooyu musimbi bakamulengawida kuti atakwatwi kumusankwa ulya. They discouraged this girl from marrying that boy. Also: -tyungilila.

drive oneself into crime, rt. lenga, Eeci ncocita ulilengela mulandu. This thing that you are doing is making yourself a criminal. (1.-lengelwa, 2.-lengelede, 3.-lengezya, 4.-lengezyezya, 5.lengezyezyalyo, 6.-lengelesya, 7.-lengela-lengela, 8.-lengelana)

keep people interested by stories, Baama balalengelela zyaano zibotu. Mother keeps people interested with good stories. Bantu balateelela kapati mukambausi ulengelela. = People pay great attention to a preacher who uses imagination. (1.-lengelelwa, 2.-lengelede, 3.-lengelezya, 4.-lengele-zyezya, 5.-lengelezyezyalyo, 6.-lengele-lesya, 7.-lengelela-lengelela, 8.-lengelelana)
  • swing or hang loose, be suspended, Cisani cangu cilalengelela mucisamu. = My dress is hanging on the tree. Kukaswi kananda kwakali kulengelela mucila wacibize. The tail of a zebra was hanging in the corner of the house. Also: -leleenga.

invent stories, Moomba ulayandisya kulengelezya twaano. Moomba likes to create stories. (1.-lengelezyegwa, 2.-lengelezyede, 3.-lengelezyesya, 4.-lengelezyela, 5.-lengelezyelalyo, 6.-lengelezyesya, 7.-lengelezya-lengelezya, 8.-lengelezyanya)
  • be inventive, Nenzala ntwiilengelezya kuyandaula cakulya. = It is the hunger which makes us use our intelligence to take the initiative to find food.
  • swing or hang, Ciindi nobakali kweenda, basune aba bakali kulengelezya mitwe yabo. During the time when they were moving, the oxen were swinging their heads.

be hungry, starve, Bacembele balenguka nzala. The old woman is starving with hunger. (1.-lengukwa, 2.-lengukide, 3.-lenguzya, 4.-lengukila, 5.-lengukilalyo, 6.-lengukisya, 7.-lenguka-lenguka) Also: -kompoka
  • fall down, Mwana walenguka kuzwa mucisamu. = The child has fallen down from the tree. Also: -anguka.

cry in grief, Baama bakalengula kulila nibakamvwa lufwu Iwabausyi. Mother cried in grief when she heard of the death of her father. (1.-lengulwa, 2.-lengwide, 3.-lenguzya, 4.-lengwida, 5.-lengwidalyo, 6.-lengulisya. 7.-lengula-lengula) Also: -langula
  • frustrate, depress, Inzala ilengula myoyo yabantu. = The hunger is depressing the hearts of the people.

renew, Cibiya eeci cabija, kocilengulula. This pot is bad, redo it. (1.-lengululwa, 2.-lengulwide, 3.-lenguluzya, 4.-lengulwida, 5.-lengulwidalyo, 6.-lengululisya, 7.-lengululalengulula, 8.-lengululana)

oppose, Ulalenguula kutegwa bantu batokwaale kubeleka. = She puts up opposition continually so that the people become reluctant to work. (1.-lenguulwa, 2.-lenguulide, 3.-lenguuzya, 4.-lengwiida, 5.-lengwiidalyo, 6.-lenguulisya, 7.-lenguula-lenguula, 8.-lenguulana) Also: - lengaula.
be created, rt. -lenga Bantu bakalengwa kaindi. People were created long ago. (2.-lengedwe, 3.-lengezyedwe, 4.-lengelwa, 5.-lengelwalyo, 6.-lengesyegwa, 7.-lengwa-lengwa)

hang back, be reluctant, Ncibi kulengwana kweenda nomuya kumulimo. It is bad to be reluctant when you are going to work. (1.-lengwanwa, 2.-lengwanide, 3.-lengwanya, 4.-lengwanina, 5.-lengwaninalyo, 6.-lengwanisya, 7.-lengwana-lengwana) Also: -lengaana.

smash, Naakanyema wakaalenketa mabbodela abukoko onse. = When he got angry he smashed all the bottles of beer. Also: -denketa. (1.-lenketwa, 2.-lenketede, 3.-lenketya, 4.-lenketela, 5.-lenketelalyo, 6.-lenketesya, 7.-lenketa-lenketa, 8.-lenketana)

nibble, Mbeba zyakazilentenya ndongwe zyoonse nzindakasiside. = The rats had nibbled all the groundnuts which I had hidden. Also: -papamuna. (1.-lentenyegwa, 2.-lentenyede, 3.-lentenyezya, 4.-lentenyela, 5.-lentenyelalyo, 6.-lentenyesya, 7.-lentenya-lentenya, 8.-lentenyana)

cause to swell the lip, Baulepula mulomo bali kumuuma musankwa. = The people who were beating the boy gave him a swollen lip. Also: -debbula. (1.-lepulwa, 2.-lepwide, 3.-lepuzya, 4.-lepwida, 5.-lepwidalyo, 6.-lepulisya, 7.-lepula-lepula)

be stopped, rt. -leka, Bapati nobakamvwa kuti amwi majwi aleka kuba majwi akwiimba antela kuseka kwakukondwa, bakazyiba kuti ono bana bakatala baleelede kulesegwa. = When the elders heard that the words stopped being the words of singing or laughing in joy, they knew that the children were tired and should be stopped. (2.-lesyedwe, 4.-lesyelwa, 5.-lesyelwalyo, 8.-lesyanya)

drop as a fall-trap, Kooye kangu kalesuka. My fall-trap has dropped. (1.-lesukwa, 2.-lesukide, 3.-lesuzya, 4.-lesukila, 5.-lesukilalyo, 6.-lesukisya, 7.-lesula-lesula, 8.-lesulana) Also: -lebuka.
  • go down as sun, Izuba lyalesuka. = The sun has gone down. Also: - lebula.

discharge as gun, release as trap, Kolesula kooye nkooteya cilemba. Release the string which you have set enabling it to spring. (1.-lesulwa, 2.-leswide, 3.-lesuzya, 4.-leswida, 5.-leswidalyo, 6.-lesulisya, 7.-lesula-lesula, 8.-lesulana) Also: -lebula.

stop something, rt. -leka, Nguni wabalesya kubeleka bana aba? = Who stopped these children from working? Muntu wakali kundilesya kulila ngu Jolezya alikke. The person who was able to stop me crying was Jolezya alone. (1.-lesyegwa, 2.-lesyede, 3.-lesya, 4.-lesyezya, 5.-lesyezyalyo, 6.-lesyesya, 7.-lesya-lesya, 8.-lesyanya)

bring, Koleta kuno, tuyanda kumulya namunyo. = Bring the water-melon here, we want to eat it. (1.-letwa, 2.-letede, 3.-letya | -letezya, 4.-letela, 5.-letelalyo, 6.-letesya, 7.-letaleta, 8.-letana)
  • put on weight, Mazuba akainda ndakajana mulwazi ulifwulukide, sunu wauleta mubili. = In past days I found the patient had become thin, today he has put on weight.
  • come running, Musankwa wakaleta kabilo-bilo. = The boy came running.
make weak, Nzala yakalimuletede kapati. The hunger greatly weakened him.

bring along, Koletelela kasako kakuumya mubwa wanjila muli cakulya. Bring along a stick for beating the dog who has gone into the food. (1.-letelelwa, 2.-letelede, 3.-letelezya, 4.-letelezyezya, 5.-letelezyezyalyo, 6.-letelelesya, 7.-letelela-letelela, 8.-letelelana)

bring along with, Mudaala wakayeeya kuyoka popwe ndyaakaletelezya kuzwa kumuunda. = The old man thought of roasting the maize cob which he had brought along from the field.
  • betray, Basyuumbwa bakali bobilo. Alo kuti kana kakola, nkukanyemena, *"Sena webo uyanda kutuletelezya?"* = The lions were two. If a child coughed, would one not be angry with it, "Do you want to reveal us?"

come from the direction, Wakalomba kuti ajokele kumunzi mumukondo wakwe ngwaakaletezya. = He asked if he could return home using the same path from which he had come. Ndaletezya ku Chiyobola. = I have come from the direction of Chiyobola. (1.-letezyegwa, 2.-letezyede, 4.-letezyezya, 7.-letezya-letezya, 8.-letezyanya)

go aside, deviate, Mwana wakaleya kufwambaana naakabona sicinsuungwe kumpela lyakwe. The child went quickly to one side when he saw the mad dog in front of him. Ayende musinzo mulamfwu wakafwa nzala, nkabela wakayeeya kuti aleye amwi amunzi wabantu alange cakulya. = When he had gone a long distance he felt hungry, so he thought that he should go aside to some village and look for food. (Lufwu ndibbwe litaleeki. Death is a rock which cannot be avoided.) Also: -onga, -pinya. (1.-leyegwa, 2.-leyede, 3.-leyezya, 4.-leyela, 5.-leelalyo, 6.-leesya, 7.-leyaleya, 8.-leyana)
  • trip, Nkasamu kakamuleya, ncaakawa. It was a stick which tripped him, that is why he fell. Also: -leba
deviate continually, Mubwa nayenda ulayanda kuleya-leya. = When a dog is moving it likes to deviate here and there.

pass one another, Kamuleyana mutaswaani, mulacisana abanamutendele. = Pass one another without colliding, you will hurt one another with the bicycles. Myootokala tiiyakaleyana kabotu, bantu ncibakayoowa nkaambo yakatiipwayane. = The vehicles did not pass one another properly, that is why the people feared because they almost collided. Also: -impana.

decline as sun westwards, Izuba lyaleyama Iwaambo. = The sun declined to the west. Also: -cengama.
  • lean aside, Koleyama nditakuuminizyi bbwe. = Lean to the side, so that I do not strike you with a stone.

deviate repeatedly, Notuunka ku Lusaka tatweelede kuleyaukaleyauka. When we go to Lusaka we should not deviate. Kuleyauka ncilengwa cababwa banji. = Deviating is the habit of many dogs. (1.-leyauka, 2.-leyaukide, 3.-leyausya, 4.-leyaukila, 5.-leyaukilalyo, 6.-leyaukisya, 7.-leyauka-leyauka, 8.-leyaukana)

cause to lose energy, rt.-lela, Yandilezeka nzala nindataninganywa cibwantu. The hunger was sapping my energy before I drank the sweet beer. (1.-lezekwa, 2.-lezekede, 3.-lezesya, 4.-lezekela, 5.-lezekelalyo, 6.-lezekesya, 7.-lezeka-lezeka, 8.-lezekana)
make weak, rt. -lela, Nzala yalindilezekede kapati = The hunger has made me very weak.
be, Bazyukulu bakwe bamwi bakacili baniini lyakafwa banyina babo. = Some of her grandchilden were still small when their mother died.

eat what is another's, rt. -lya, Wandilida nsima yangu. = You have eaten my nsima. (1.-lidwa, 2.-lidide, 3-lidizya, 4.-lidila, 5.-lidilalyo, 6.-lidisya, 7.-lida-lida, 8.-lidilana / -lidana)
  • extract honey from a bee-hive, Basankwa baunka kukulida buci/nzuki. = The boys have gone to forage for honey.
  • take bait, Inswi zyakaleka kulida nkaambo kulatontola mumazyiba. = The fish have stopped taking the bait because the water is too cold in the pond.
  • work in an underhand way, Boonse balozi balipa kuloma kakuli balida kunsi. = All witches pretend to be upright while they eat in a hidden way. (idiomatic)
  • benefit from someones power, Aaba bana bakali kulida biyo masuku atalaa mitwe yabeenzinyina. = These children who were just Ives from others work. eating masuku fruit were benefiting themse

be eaten, rt.-lya, Mainza ono wakali kuyeeya bulyolyo mbwaakalide koonyinakulu. = Mainza was now thinking of the food which he had eaten at his grandmother's. (1.-lidwe, 2.-lide, 3.-lidizya, 4.-lidila, 5.-lidilalyo, 6.-lidilisya, 7.-lida-lida, 8. -lidana)

eat along with, rt. -lya, Basankwa kabacilya buci, umwi mulombwana wakalidikizya anzuki mpoonya yakamuluma akameneno. = When the boys were still eating honey, one boy ate a bee along with the honey, thereupon it stung him inside the throat. (1.-lidizyigwa, 2.-lidikizyide, 4.-lidikizyizya, 5.-lidikizyizyalyo, 6.-lidikizyisya, 7.-lidikizya-lidikizya, 8.-lidikizyanya)

eat peacefully, Kulya kwakulilidilila tiitwakali kukubona. = We never had a peacful time for taking food for ourselves. (1.-lidililwa, 2.-lidilide, 3.-lidililizya, 4.-lidililila, 5.-lidilililalyo, 6.-lidililisya, 7.-lidilila-lidilila, 8.-lidililana)

be eaten, rt. -lya, Koonse ooku nkulidwa masuku amutwe. = All this was eating fruits on our head. i.e. All this is the way of our being exploited. (1.-ligwa, 2.-lidwe, 3.-lisyigwa, 4.-lidwa, 5.-lidwalyo, 7.-lidwa-lidwa)
be edible, Nswa zilaligika. = Flying ants are edible. Also: -likkika. (2.-ligikide, 7.-ligika-ligika)

be edible, rt. -lya, Sena mucelo oyu ulaligwa? = Is this fruit edible? (2.-lide, 3.-lisya, 4.-lida, 5.-lidalyo, 6.-lisya, 7. ligwa-ligwa, 8.-lyana)
  • be eaten up, be deprived of, Ngoma wakaligwa mali manji nobakali kusobana njuka. = Ngoma lost a lot of money when they were playing cards.
be free, Wakati muminzi amwalo bantu tabaciliibi. He said that in the villages also the people were no longer free.
sound, as a drum, Zilalikima ngoma. The drums are sounding.

strike all over, Bakamulikita kumuuma kubee tali mwanaabo. = In beating her he struck her all over as if she was not his child. Also: -linkita. (1.-likitwa, 2.-likitide, 3.-likitya, 4.-likitila, 5.-likitilalyo, 6.-likitisya, 7.-likita-likita. 8.-likitana)
be edible, rt. -lya, Eeci cisyu cilalikkika. = This relish is edible. (1.-likkikwa, 2.-likkikide, 3.-likkikizya, 4.-likkikila, 5.-likkikilalyo, 6.-likkikisya, 7.-likkika-likkika) Also: - ligika.

weep, cry, Ino nkuli nkobalila? Now where are they crying? Mwana wakali kooloma kulila. = The child was roaring crying. (1.-lilwa, 2.-lilide, 3.-lizya, 4.-lilila, 5.-lililalyo,-6.lilisya, 7.-lila-lila, 8.-lilana)
  • wail at funeral, Bamacembele bakali kulila mubila. = The old women were crying aloud at the funeral.
  • ooze out, as juice, water, blood, Cilonda cangu cilila meenda. = My wound is oozing water.

bewail, lament, Mudaala ulilauka mapenzi aamujisi. = The old man is bewailing the sufferings he has. Bacembele *balilauka* kubula payi lyakulivwumba. The old woman is bewailing the lack of a blanket for covering herself. (1.-lilaukwa, 2.-lilaukide, 3.-lilausya, 4.-lilaukila, 5.-lilaukilalyo, 6.-lilaukisya, 7.-lilauka-lilauka, 8.-lilaukana)

cry to get something, rt. -lila, Mwana ulilila cisani cakwe cisubila. = The child is crying for her red dress. (1.-lililwa, 2.-lililide, 3.-lilizyizya, 4.-lililila, 5.-lilililalyo, 6.-lililisya, 7.-lilila-lilila, 8.-lililana)
  • mourn at, Naakafwa munene, bantu bakaakulilila kumujwa wakwe. = When the old man died, the people mourned him at his nephew's home.

stampede, rush to, e.g Lyakalilimuka bbunga lyabantu nobakamvwa nkwiilila ngoma yabukali. = The crowd of people rushed to where they heard the funeral drum beating. (1.-lilimukwa, 2.-lilimukide, 3.-lilimusya, 4.-lilimukila, 5.-lilimukilalyo, 6.-lilimukisya, 7.-lilimuka-lilimuka) *-lima* plant, Mumbewu oomu tuyanda kulima cisyu. = We want to plant vegetables in this garden. (1.-limwa, 2.-limide, 3.-limya, 4.-limina, 5.-liminalyo, 6.-limisya, 7.-lima-lima.) Also: -syanga, -fwunka.
  • plough, Ncibotu kufwambaana kulima njiyona mvwula yakusaanguna. = It is good to plough right during the time of the first rains.
  • harvest, Uno mwaka bantu banji tiibalima kabotu. = This year many people did not harvest well.

fall upon, press on, lie heavily on, Sena kuti samu lipati lyakulimba, inga ulakonzya kulipasulula? = If a big tree falls on you, can you get yourself out? (1.-limbwa, 2.-limbide, 3.-limbya, 4.-limbila, 5.-limbilalyo, 6.-limbisya, 7.-limba-limba, 8.-limbana)
  • go to a distant place, Mukaintu naakabuka wakajana mbuta, wamusiya abulo mulombwana wakwe *waalimba* masaka. When the woman woke up she found the bed empty, her husband had left her in bed and gone far away. Nobwakaca munene wakaalimba mantoolo. = When it was dawn the old man was already looking for something in the shops. Wakamvwa moyo wacisa eelyo wakaalimba masaka abeni. = He felt his heart paining and so he went far away in his thoughts.

fall on one another, Basimacinga balimbana akaambo kakuti tiibabwenene nibali kweenda. = The cyclists fell on top of one another because they did not see one another as they went.
  • copulate, be sexually linked, Banyama balalimbana kakunyina mulawo. = Animals copulate without any law.

fall upon, attack, Ncuuba-uba kubatanda nkaambo tulakonzya kubalimbaula masiku nobalede. = It is easy to drive them out because we can attack them at night when they are asleep. (1.-limbaulwa, 2.-limbaulide, / limbawide, 3.-limbauzya, 4.-limbaulila or limbawida, 5.-limbaulilalyo or -limbawidalyo, 6.-limbaulisya, 7.-limbaulalimbaula, 8.-limbaulana) Also: -lelemuka

pile on top, Kamuleka kulilimbika mapayi nkaambo kulapya. = Stop piling blankets on top of yourselves because it is hot. (1.-limbikwa, 2.-limbikide, 3.-limbikizya, 4.-limbikila, 5.-limbikilalyo, 6.-limbikisya, 7.-limbikalimbika, 8.-limbikana)

press down on, rt. limba, Musune utaboni wamulimbikizya mwana. The blind ox has crushed the child. (1.-limbikizyigwa, 2.-limbikizyide, 4.-limbikizyizya, 5.-limbikizyizyalyo, 6.-limbikizyisya, 7.-limbikizya-limbikizya, 8.-limbikizyanya) Also: -ilikila
  • involve in a case, Mudaala bakamulimbikizya mulandu akaambo kakuyoowa kukanana. = They involved the old man in a crime because he feared to speak out. Wanyina amulandu pesi kumamanino bamulimbikizya kaambo. = He had no crime but in the end they implicated him.

pile together, Balalimbilika zisani limwi waba mulwi. = They pile the clothes together until they become a heap. (1.-limbilikwa, 2.-limbilikide, 3.-limbilikizya, 4.-limbilikizyizya, 5.-limbilikizyizyalyo, 6.-limbilikisya, 7.-limbilika-limbilika, 8.-limbilikana)

escape from pressure, Wakaba wakulimbulula buya naya kulimbuluka kuzwa atalaa mweenzinyina. = She was taken off by force that is when she was removed from on top of her friend. Mutumbu wamulimbuluka mwana ngwaalimbilide naali koona. = The mother has moved her weight off the child upon whom she had lain heavily when she was fast asleep. Ngulube ntumbu yakalimbuluka kana nikakwiila. The sow moved off the piglet when it squealed. (1.-limbulukwa, 2.-limbulukide, 3.-limbulusya, 4.-limbulukila, 5.limbulukilalyo, 6. limbulukisya, 7.-limbuluka-limbuluka, 8.-limbulukana)

remove weight or pressure from, Musankwa uneneede wakali kulimbulula amweenzinyina. The fat boy was removing his weight off his friend. (1.-limbululwa, 2.-limbulwide, 3.-limbuluzya, 4.-limbulwida, 5. limbulwidalyo, 6.limbululisya, 7.-limbulula-limbulula, 8.-limbululana)

arable, easily ploughed, rt. lima, Muunda uujisi bulongo bubotu ulalimika. A field which has good soil is arable. (1.-limikwa, 2.-limikide, 3.-limikizya, 4.-limikila, 5.-limikilalyo, 6.-limikisya, 7.-limika-limika)

weed, Katulimina mumuunda, nsaku yaindilila. = Let us weed in the field, the weeds have increased. Lucimena biyo lungu, bakatalika kulimina. = When the pumpkins germinated, they began to weed. Also: -londweda. (rt. londola = keep field clean) (1.-liminwa, 2.-liminide, 3.-limizya, 4.-liminina, 5.-limininalyo, 6.-liminisya, 7.-limina-limina, 8.-liminana)
  • plough for, Basankwa baunka kukulimina bacembele. The boys have gone to plough for the old woman.

weed so as to get reward, Babelesi baliminina busu kuli Haankoli mudaala. The workers are working for mealie-meal at the old man Haankoli's place. (1.-limininwa, 2.-liminide, 3.-limininizya, 4.-limininina, 5.-liminininalyo, 6.-limininisya, 7.-liminina-liminina, 8.-limininana)

reap, Uuno mwaka bantu bakalimuna nkaambo mvwula yakawa kabotu. = *This year the people harvested because there was good rain.* Mweesyo takwe niwakasibikwa mane bantu nobakamana kulimuna maila. = *The funeral beer was never brewed until when the people finished harvesting millet.* Also: -tebula. (1.-limunwa, 2.-limwide, 3.-limuzya, 4.-limunina, 5.-limuninalyo, 6.-limunisya, 7.-limuna-limuna)

celebrate a festival, Baya kukulinda nkolola bantu sunu. = *They have gone to celebrate the final stage of the initiation ceremony.* (1.-lindwa, 2.-lindide, 3.-lindizya-/-linzya, 4.-lindila, 5.-lindilalyo, 6.-lindisya, 7.-linda-linda, 8.-lindana.)
  • guard, Bataata tiibaboola kudilwe nkaambo balinda munzi kuyoowa babba. = *My father has not come to the funeral because he is guarding the home for fear of thieves.* Banyina balamuuma mwana nakaka kukulinda muunda kusoola bakwale a basokwe = *The mother beats the child when it refuses to go and guard the field by driving away partridges and monkeys.*
  • incubate as a hen, Nkuku yangu ilalinda pesi mayi aligwa babwa. = *My hen is incubating but the eggs have been eaten by the dogs.*

expect, wait for, Kolindila baboole baama nobatiikupe cakulya. = *Wait, let my mother come, it is then that she will give you food.* (1.-lindilwa, 2.-lindilide, 3.-lindya/-lindilizya, 4.-lindilila, 5.-lindililalyo, 6.-lindilisya, 7.-lindila-lindila, 8.-lindilana)

attend to, Banyina bakali kumulindilila mwanaakwe kucibbadela. = *The mother was looking after her* child at the hospital. Bulwazi bwamukaintu wakwe bwakalema cakuti wakatalika kulindililwa buya. = *The illness of his wife became so serious that she had to be looked after.* (1.-lindililwa, 2.-lindilide, 3.-lindilizya, 4.-lindililila, 5.-lindililalyo, 6.-lindililisya. 7.-lindilila-lindilila, 8.-lindililana)
  • look forward to having one as wife, Choobe ulamulindilila musimbi ngwayanda kukwata kutegwa amanizye cikolo. = *Choobe is waiting for the girl he wants to marry so that she finishes school.* Also: -bindika.

beat, Nindamujana nindamulindula musako. = *If I had found him, I would have beaten him with a big stick.* (1.-lindulwa, 2.-lindwide, 3.-linduzya, 4.-lindwida, 5.-lindwidalyo, 6.-lindulisya 7.-lindula-lindula, 8.-lindulana)

look for food, ask for, beg, Bamakaintu balinga cakulya. = *The women are asking for food.* Muvwimi wakaya kukulinga tombwe kumweenzi-nyina. = *The hunter went off to ask for tobacco from his friend.* (1.-lingwa, 2.-lingide, 3.-linzya, 4.-lingila, 5.-lingilalyo, 6.-lingisya, 7.-linga-linga, 8.-lingana) Also: -lomba, -sunza.

search for, Cakamutolela ciindi cilamfwu kulingaula cakulya cabana bakwe. = *It took him a long time to search for food for his children.* Also: -yandaula. (1.-lingaulwa, 2.-langaulide, 3.-langauzya, 4.-lingawida, 5.-lingawidalyo, 6.-lingaulisya, 7.-lingaula-lingaula, 8.-lingaulana)

check here and there, assess continually, Bataata balalingaula-lingaula kumuunda kuti babone naa mwamana kulima. = *My father will inspect the field every now and then to see if you have finished ploughing.*

inspect work, check, Baya kukulingula kumuunda, ncobatako baama a bataata. My father and mother went to inspect the field, that is why they are absent. Kumazuba wakaya kukulingula cilili cakwe. In the evening he went to check his irrigated plot. Wakaswaana cibila naakali kuya kukulingula cilili cakwe. = He met a rock rabbit as he was going to inspect his garden. Basikalumamba bakaunka kulingula munyinza wacisi ca Zambia nkocili kumbo. The soldiers went to check the border which was to the west of the country of Zambia. (1.-lingulwa, 2.-lingwide, 3.-linguzya, 4.-lingwida, 5.-lingwidalyo, 6.-lingulisya, 7.-lingula-lingula, 8.-lingulana)
  • examine oneself, Ncibotu kulilingula buzuba abuzuba. It is good to examine oneself daily.

strike heavily with a club, Basankwa balinkita sicinsuungwe. The boys are beating the mad dog. Also: -likita. (1.-linkitwa, 2.-linkitide, 3.-linkitya, 4.-linkitila, 5.-linkitilalyo, 6.-linkitisya, 7.-linkita-linkita, 8.-linkitana)

try to dance a little, Kuti beenzinyoko kabazyana inga a yebo notacizyi nkucilinta-linta. = If your friends are dancing you also have to dance a bit even though you do not know it. (1.-lintwa-lintwa, 2.-lintide-lintide, 3.-lintya-lintya, 4.-lintila-lintila, 5.-lintilalyo-lintilalyo, 6.-lintisya-lintisya, 7.-lintalinta-lintalinta)

give what one asks for, rt. linga, Umwi musankwa wakaya kukusunza maila kumukowa wakwe, nkabela bakamulinzya masyoonto biyo mukasuwo. = A certain man went to ask for food to his relatives, thereupon they just gave him a little in a small basket. (1.-linzyigwa, 2.-linzyide, 4.-linzyizya, 5.-linzyizyalyo, 6.-linzyisya, 7.-linzyalinzya, 8.-linzyanya)

cause to eat, eat with, rt. -lya, Kamumulisya mulwazi nakaka. = Feed the patient even though she refuses. Beembela nizyabazimina nombe, baakulisya kuli ba Joojo. When the herders lost the cows they caused Joojo's maize to be eaten. (1.-lisyigwa, 2.-lisyide, 4.-lisyizya, 5.-lisyizya-lyo, 6.-lisyisya, 7.-lisya-lisya, 8.-lisyanya)

make one another eat, rt. -lya, Banabwiinga bakalya cakutangala nkujana abona bakali kulisyanya buya. = The newly wed couple ate happily so much that sometimes they were just feeding one another. Also: -lisyanya.

make restitution, pay, atone, compensate, Wakaambilwa kumuliya mwana ngwaakajaya liso. She was told to make restitution to the child whose eye she destroyed. Wakamuliya cikoloto cakwe mulongwaakwe. He paid his friend the debt. (1.-liyigwa, 2.-liyide, 4.-liyila, 5.-liyilalyo, 6.-liyisya, 7.-liya-liya, 8.-liyana) Also: - lungila.

snore, Wakoona kabotu akulizya mankonono. S/he slept well while snoring. Also: -vwuluma. (1.-lizyigwa, 2.-lizyide, 4.-lizyizya, 5.-lizyizyalyo, 6.-lizyisya, 7.-lizya-lizya, 8.-lizyanya)
  • cause to cry or make sound, Bayi bamulizya sicikolo nibamuuma. = The teacher made the pupil cry when s/he beat her/him. Basimbi bakali kulizya ngoloolo. The girls were ululating. Basankwa bakali kulizya budima bwabo. = The boys were beating their budima drums.
  • be in mourning, Kwakali zilengwa zyakulizya: basidilwe bakali kuliwaala mutwe akulamba mulambo amibili alimwi akusama zyakulizya. There were customs connected with mourning: the mourners were throwing themselves in ashes and smearing their bodies all over and wearing mourning dress.

catch fish with hook, _Katuloba nswi mumulonga._ = Let us fish in the river. _Batwa baloba nswi muli Kafwuwe atulobyo._ = The Batwa people fish at the Kafuwe river with hooks. (1.-lobwa, 2.-lobede, 3.-lobya, 4.-lobela, 5.-lobelalyo, 6.-lobesya, 7.-loba-loba.) Also: -oba, -goba.
  • mix, _Bacembele bakamuka kuloba bukoko._ = The old lady was late in mixing the gruel with beer.
  • be lost, die, disappear, _Kuti mvwula yawa kapati inga nyika mumwi mumasena yatalika kuloba._ = When the rain falls heavily some of the land in some vleis becomes submerged. _Noyakawa ndeke mulwaanje boonse bakali mukati bakaloba, kunyina wakafwutuka pe._ = When the plane fell into the sea all those inside were lost, no one was saved.
  • draw water, _Bamakaintu bakatalika kuloba meenda azigabba._ = The women began to draw water with open tins. Also: -teka

apply excessively, _Ndakajana mwana ulilobbeka mafwuta mumutwe._ = I found a child plastering ointment on his head. Also: -lopa. (1.-lobbekwa, 2.-lobbekede, 4.-lobbekela, 5.-lobbekelalyo, 6.-lobbekesya, 7.-lobbeka-lobbeka, 8.-lobbekana)

mix with, join, rt. -loba, _Nseke zyamapopwe zyakalilobede buyo._ = The grains of maize were just mixed. (i.e. with something else which was more plentiful.) _Lipakweenda, mujwanyina, wakalibalobede basimukowa amulyango mpobakakkede._ = Lipakweenda, who had a joking-relationship with them, joined the clan members at the doorway where they were sitting. (1.-lobedwe, 3.-lobezya, 4.-lobezyezya, 5.-lobezyezyalyo, 6.-lobezyesya, 7.-lobede-lobede, 8.-lobekana)
  • be grey-haired, _Mumutwe kwakanyina akasusu kasiya, akalilobede._ = On his head there was not a single hair which was black, they were grey.

mix as different colours, rt. loba, _Kamulobeeka mibala amitaanga njomuluka._ = Mix different colours in the baskets you are weaving. (1.-lobeekwa, 2.-lobeekede, 3.-lobeezya, 4.-lobeekela, 5.-lobeekelalyo, 6.-lobeekesya, 7.-lobeeka-lobeeka, 8.-lobeekana)

disappear, rt. -loba, _Nibakalila ciindi cilamfwu, majwi aabo akatalika kuyaabulobelela._ = When they cried for a long time their voices began to die out. (1.-lobelelwa, 2.-lobelede, 3.-lobelezya, 4.-lobelela, 5.-lobelelalyo, 6.-lobelelesya, 7.-lobelela-lobelela)

escape, run away, depart without saying goodbye, die, _Wakaide kuloboka kakunyina akaambo._ = He just ran away for no reason. _Musa, atuloboke, tuzwe mumunzi akati kamasiku._ = My friend, let us escape, let use leave the village in the middle of the night. _Ngoma zyakalila zyakuzyibya cooko coonse kuti kuli waloboka mumunzi._ = The drums sounded informing people throughout the territory that someone had died at the village. (1.-lobokwa, 2.-lobokede, 3.-lobosya, 4.-lobokela, 5.-lobokelalyo, 6.-lobokesya, 7.-loboka-loboka, 8.-lobokana) Also: -bbalika.

take time in doing something, _Mutinta ulobokezya buya kusika kuno._ = Mutinta takes time to visit here. (1.-lobokezyegwa, 2.-lobokezyede, 3.-lobokezyesya, 4.-lobokezyela, 5.-lobokezyelalyo, 6.-lobokezyesya 7.-lobokezya-lobokezya, 8.-lobokezyanya)
  • escape with someone, _Mutinta naakaloboka, wakalobokezya amwana utali wakwe._ = When Mutinta fled, she escaped with a child who was not her own.
  • bring load after load to one place, *Babelesi bakali kulobokezya kususa zitina nciyakamuka kuyakwa nanda.* = The workers were delivering the bricks bit by bit that is why they were late in building the house.

fish with a hook, rt. -loba, *Baku Kalomo abalo balalobola nswi mumulonga.* = The Kalomo people also fish with hooks in the river. (1.-lobolwa, 2.-lobwede, 3.-lobozya, 4.-lobweda, 5.-lobwedalyo, 6.-lobolesya, 7.-lobola-lobola, 8.-lobolana)

hook out, rescue, recover, rt. -loba, *Bazeli balobolola muntu wanyikide.* = The fishermen are recovering the body of the one who was drowned. (1.-lobololwa, 2.-lobolwede, 3.-lobolozya, 4.-lobolweda, 5.-lobolwedalyo, 6.-lobololesya, 7.-lobolola-lobolola, 8.-lobololana)

cause to escape, abduct, rt. -loboka, *Camulobosya mwana ulya ninzala.* = It is the hunger which made the child run away. (1.-lobosyegwa, 2.-lobosyede, 3.-lobosyezya, 4.-lobozyezya, 5.-lobozyezyalyo, 6.-lobosyesya, 7.-lobosya-lobosya, 8.-lobosyanya)

take into slavery, rt. -loba, *Bamulobya mwana beenzinyina kuli basimalungu.* = The friends of the child sold him into slavery to the bead-traders. (1.-lobesyegwa, 2.-lobezyede, 4.-lobelela, 5.-lobelelalyo, 6.-lobesya, 7.-lobya-lobya, 8.-lobezyanya)
  • push into mud, rt. -loba, *Bakamulobya mumankandya.* = They pushed him into the mud. Also: -bbizya.
  • kill, wipe out, rt. -loba, *Bulwazi bwantomba bwakalobya bantu banji.* = Smallpox wiped out many people. *Bakayoboloka boonse akumweebela mulozi wakabalobya bantu.* = They all gathered and looked at the witch who had wiped out people.
  • hook with, rt. -loba, *Kuti koyanda cakulobya, ukaule kalobyo kucintoolo.* = If you want something to hook fish with, you should buy a hook at the shop. (*cakulobya* = bait for fishing)

wither, *Matuvwu aacisyu aile kulodoka nkaambo kabuuka.* = The leaves of the vegetables have just withered because of insects. Also: -neta (1.-lodokwa, 2.-lodokede, 3.-lodozya, 4.lodokela, 5.-lodokelalyo, 6.-lodokesya, 7.-lodoka-lodoka)

miss a day, play truant, (ety. Eng. to loaf about) e.g *Kumi-swaangano mulalofwa kapati ncomutamvwi zyaambwa.* = You miss many meetings that is why you do not understand what is said. Also: -lovwa. (2.-lofwede, 3.-lofwezya, 4.-lofwela, 5.-lofwelalyo, 6.-lofwesya, 7.-lofwa-lofwa)

stretch out head, *Mukombwe ulalogomana nalila.* = The cock stretches it's head when it crows. 1.-logomanwa, 2.-logomene, 3.-logomanya, 4.-logomanina, 5.-logomaninalyo, 6.-logomanisya, 7.-logomana-logomana, 8.-logomaninana.) Also: -lokomana, -lagamana.

fall off, as fruit from tree, fall from height, *Wakaloka buya kuzwa mujulu, ncaakalicisila mwana uulya.* = That child fell from a height, that is why she hurt herself. *Moyo waloka.* = The heart sank. *Wakayoowa kapati, mubili wakwe oonse wakaloka watontola siko, masusu aima nci.* = He feared greatly, his whole body lost power and became very cold, his hair stood up. *Coolwe camubwa nkuloka kwansima.* The good luck of the dog is when the food falls down. (1.-lokwa, 2.-lokede, 3.-losya, 4.-lokela, 5.-lokelalyo, 6.-lokesya, 7.-loka-loka.)
  • reach destination, Mbubakoonena buyo bantu boonse, Chuungabuluba wakaloka akuloka. = As soon as all the people were fast asleep, Chuungabuluba arrived at his destination. Also: -anguka
  • shed tears, Tiicakali kwiindulukwa kulangwa nkaambo inga kayiile kuloka yacizike. = It was not a thing to be looked at a second time because you would just weep.
  • drop lower lip, rt. -loka, Balombwana aba yakalibalokede milomo yakunsi. = The lower lips of these boys dropped. (i.e. they were disappointed.)

drop as seeds bit by bit, Nsangu zyalikwiile kuloka-loka munzila. = The seeds were just dropping off on the path.
  • drop as liquid, Meenda alaloka-loka nkaambo mupika ulazwizya. = The water is dropping because the pot is leaking.

lift up head, Mwana waingwa kafwuwa kanswi ncuulokomana mukosi. The child has been choked by a fish bone that is why it raises its neck. (1.-lokomanwa, 2.-lokomanide, 3.-lokomeka, 4.-lokomanina, 5.-lokomaninalyo, 6.-lokomanisya, 7.-lokomana-lokomana, 8.-lokomaninana) Also: -logomana.

speak continuously with invective, continue to complain, Mukanazi ulalokota. = The speaker is speaking in a prolonged and offensive way. Moonga wakali kulokota ciindi cilamfwu naakajana mpongo zilya mapopwe. = Moonga continued complaining for a long time when he found the goats eating the maize. (1.-lokotwa, 2.-lokotede, 3.-lokotya, 4.-lokotela, 5.-lokotelalyo, 6.-lokotesya, 7.-lokota-lokota, 8.-lokotelana)

have something drop from one's hands, rt. -loka, Mwana walokwa nyama, kamumupa imbi. = Give another piece of meat to the child whose meat has dropped. (2.-lokede, 3.-losya, 4.-lokela, 5.-lokelalyo, 6.-lokesya, 7.-lokaloka)

be given a piece of game by a hunting partner, be given freely, Ndakalolela buya aka kayuni, nkaambo mebo tiindajaya sunu. Because I did not kill today, I have been given this bird (by my hunting partner). Buzuba bufwa baacisya ndikalolele bwami mbwendatakabelekela. The day my uncle dies I will be freely given riches for which I did not work. Wakalolela kulubomba Iwamulongwe wakwe. = He had been given a gift through the kindness of his friend. (1.-lolelwa, 2.-lolede, 3.-lolezya, 4.-lolelela, 5.-lolelelalyo, 6.-lolelesya, 7.-lolela-lolela, 8.-lolezyanya)

give a share of the hunt, rt. lolela, Fwulwe wakamulolezya mweenzinyina mweendo wamunyati. = The tortoise gave his friend a leg of the buffalo. Nibakali mukuweza bakali kunga kuti umwi wabulila balamulolezya. When they were hunting they used to share the meat with the one who caught nothing.
share meat with one another, Bakali kulolezyanya nyama kakunyina aucengwa. They were sharing the meat without anyone being deceived. =

flow, as water or honey, Cisomo caciluli cakalidadula liso lyakwe lyakululyo, kwakaide kulolomoka meenda. = The roof pole plucked out his right eye, there was just watery liquid flowing out. Bantu bakali kwaazanganya muntu wakali kooloma kapati kumwi kalolomoka mamina mumpemo. = The people were trying to control a man who was shouting while the phlegm was flowing from his nose.
  • drop spittle, Sicinsuungwe ulazyibwa kufwambaana nkaambo kaku lolomoka mate. = A mad dog is quickly known because of dribbling spittle. (1.-lolomokwa, 2.-lolomokede, 3.-lolomosya, 4.-lolomokela, 5.-lolomokelalyo, 6.-lolomokesya, 7.-lolomoka-lolomoka.) Also: -loloteka.

draw up as honey with fingers, Bali kwiile kulolomona buci kuzwa mumpako. They were just drawing out the honey from the hole with their fingers. (1.-lolomonwa, 2.-lolomwede, 4.-lolomozya, 5.-lolomweda, 6.-lolomwedalyo, 7.-lolomona-lolomona, 8.-lolomwedana)
follow closely, Walolonyana kale munsi-munsi kubee ubenda nanja ku Butwa. = He was already following closely as if he was hunting a lechwe cob in the valley.

flow out, Buci bwiile kuloloteka, tabumani. = The honey is just flowing, it does not finish. Bulowa bwakali kuloloteka koonse-koonse. = The blood was flowing out everywhere. Also: -lolomoka. (1.-lolotekwa, 2.-lolotekede, 3.-lolotesya, 4.-lolotekela, 5.-lolotekelalyo, 6.-lolotekesya, 7.-loloteka-loloteka)

be honest, correct, well-behaved, polite, Mucizyi wakwe ulainda kuloma. His sister is exceptionaly honest. (1.-lomwa, 2.-lomede, 3.-lomya, 4.-lomena, 5.-lomenalyo, 6.-lomesya, 7.-loma-loma) Also: -setekana.

pray, ask for, Waka-lomba kuti aangununwe kuzwa muntolongo. He asked to be released from prison. Bantu mucikombelo bakali kulomba Leza kuti abape mvwula. = The people in church were asking God to give them rain. (1.-lombwa, 2.-lombede, 3.-lombya, 4.-lombela, 5.-lombelalyo, 6.-lombesya, 7.-lomba-lomba, 8.-lombana.)
  • (idiom) Mbobakasika aciindi zuba nolilomba moombe, tiicakaba ciindi, cilalilo cakabizwa. = Just as they arrived at sunset, it was not long before the supper was ready.
something to be asked for, rt. -lomba, Munyo a busu zyakali kulombanwa. People could ask for salt and maize-flour from one another.
ask, Cakali ciindi cakumazuba, alya zuba mpolilombela moombe. = It was evening time when the sun was 'asking the calf to come home'.

be admirable, rt. -lombozya, Mukwiinda kwamyaka Mutinta ulaba mucembele akutalombozeka. = In the passage of years Mutinta will become an old woman and will no longer be admired. (1.-lombozekwa, 2.-lombozekede, 3.-lombozekezya, 4.-lombozekela, 5.-lombozekelalyo, 6.-lombozekesya, 7.-lombozeka-lombozeka, 8.-lombozekana)

approve, admire, prefer, Ndalikulombozya kuti tukakwatane anduwe. I admire you so much that I want to marry you. Basankwa banji bakamulombozya mwanaa mwami akumukombelezya kumukwata. Many young men admired the daughter of the chief and asked to marry her. Batonga bamwi batalika kulombozya kukwata mulumbu kuleka Mutonganyina. = Some Tonga have begun to prefer to marry a non-Tonga rather than another Tonga. (1.-lombozyegwa, 2.-lombozyede, 3.-lombozyesya, 4.-lombozyezya, 5.-lombozyezyalyo, 6.-lombozyesya, 7.-lombozya-lombozya, 8.-lombozyanya)
  • expect, Twali kulombozya kumalende kuti mbotutiinyamuke italike kuwa. We were expecting to receive rain at the rainshrine so that as soon as we arose it would begin to rain.

be of honest or upright character, rt. -loma, Uulya muntu *ulilomene*. That person is of upright character. Bantu bakulangila kuti kolomene alimwi koli amaanu kwiinda mbookabede kumatalikilo. The people are now looking to you to be of good character and have wisdom beyond what you had at the beginning. (1.-lomezegwa, 2.-lomene, 3.-lomezya, 4.-lomezyelwa, 5.-lomenalyo, 6.-lomesya, 7.-lomenelomene)

turn as oxen, Basune ba Joojo bakalomoka kumalomu aamuunda. = Joojo's oxen turned back at the end of the field. (1.-lomokwa, 2.-lomokede, 3.-lomosya, 4.-lomokela, 5.-lomokelalyo, 6.-lomokesya, 7.-lomoka-lomoka, 8.-lomokana)
turn back, Basune bakalomokela munsi acuulu. = The oxen turned back near the ant-hill.

break law, Antela kuli imbi milawo njobakabikka waakwiide kulomona omweenzu alimwi bakupa kaambo. Perhaps there are other laws which they laid down which you, a stranger, would break and they would convict you. (1.-lomonwa, 2.-lomwede, 3.-lomonzya, 4.-lomweda, 5.-lomwedalyo, 6.-lomonesya, 7.-lomona-lomona, 8.-lomonana)
  • cause to turn oxen around, Kamulomona basune, wasimpa muunda. = Turn the oxen around, you have come to the end of the field. Also: -nyona

bring oxen back to start another furrow when ploughing, expand area of ploughing, Eeci cakulomonena mumuunda wakwe Kalusa tiicakamukkomanisya akasyoonto pe. This habit of encroaching into his field did not please Kalusa at all. (1.-lomonenwa, 2.-lomonede, 3.-lomonenezya, 4.-lomononeda, 5.-lomononedalyo, 6.lomononesya, 7.-lomonenalomonena, 8.-lomonenana)

protest, "Ino nywebo baama muli bakowa nzi nomuvwiila boobu bantu mbomutazyi?" Wakalomotoka Choonda. = "Now you woman, to which clan do you belong that you answer in such a way the people whom you do not know?" Choonda complained. (1.-lomotokwa, 2.-lomotokede, 3.-lomotozya, 4.-lomotokela, 5.-lomotokelalyo, 6.-lomotokesya, 7.-lomotoka-lomotoka)

become thin, Mapopwe angu akalompoka nkaambo syokwe lyakavwula kapati. My maize has become thin because of the abundance of weeds. Mweemba wakalijisi mubili mubotu, sunu wakaile kulompoka. Mweemba had a healthy body, today he has become thin. (1.-lompokwa, 2.-lompokede, 3.-lomposya, 4.-lompokela, 5.-lompokelalyo, 6.-lompokesya 7.-lompoka-lompoka) Also: -swempuka.

be careful to do something in the proper way, rt.-loma, Wakalomya kujala a mulyango kutegwa nombe zitazwi. = He was careful to shut the gate properly so that the cattle would not get out. (1.-lomezyegwa, 2.-lomede, 3.-lomya, 4.-lomena, 5.-lomenalyo, 6.-lomesya, 7.-loma-loma, 8.-lomezyanya)

come for, come to fetch, Bakamulonda bamasilikani baku Gwembe akumutola kuti akabetekwe. The Gwembe police came to fetch him and took him to be tried. Sena ino walonda kwiizya? Did you come to chat? Taata Nanjoomwa, tayandi koonse akundilonda. = My father Nanjoomwa, never wants to fetch me. (1.-londwa, 2.-londede, 3.-londya/-londezya, 4.-londela, 5.-londelalyo, 6.-londesya, 7.-londa-londa, 8.-londana.)
  • guard, Kanoma wakali kulonda masiku oonse kakunyina kukatala. = Kanoma was guarding all through the night without becoming tired.

guard continually, Ciindi camasiku tweelede kujana musankwa ulonda-londa nkaambo babbi balakatazya mazuba ano. = We ought to find a man who will continually guard because the thieves are troublesome these days.

come near, Naakalondelela mazuba akuti azyalwe mwana, bakaintu bakaunka kwabo nkaambo kakali kakusaanguna kutumbuka. = When the days approached for the child to be born, the woman went to her home because it was her first child. Izuba lyakali kulondelela acilangankumo. = The sun was near to 13.00 hrs. Mainza a Mutinta nobakalondelela kusika kumunzi, Mainza wakajoka, tanaakasika amunzi eeni. = When Mainza and Mutinta came near the village, Mainza returned, he did not reach the village itself. (1.-londelelwa, 2.-londelede, 3.-londelezya, 4.-londelelela, 5.-londelelelalyo, 6.-londelelesya, 7.-londelela-londelela, 8.-londelelana)

be neatly done, Bakali kuyanda kuti babone naa ulakonzya kubeleka milimo ilondokede. = They wanted to see whether he could do jobs efficiently. (1.-londokedwe, 3.-londokezya, 4.-londokezyezya, 5.-londokezye-zyalyo, 6.-londokesya, 7.-londokede-londokede)

polish up, make neat and tidy, Kamulilondola nkaambo kuboola beenzu sunu. = Make yourselves clean and neat because visitors are coming today. Lyoonse simpongo talubi kulondola nanda yakwe natanaya kukweembela. The herdboy never forgets to clean his house before he goes herding. (1.-londolwa, 2.-londolwede /-londwede. 3.-londozya, 4.-londweda/-londozyezya, 5.-londwedalyo/-londozyezyalyo, 6.-londolozya/-londolesya, 7.-londolalondola, 8.-londolana.)

explain, Bakalondolola kwaamba kuti bantu bamvwisye. = They explained carefully so that the people would understand clearly. Also: -pandulula. (1.-londololwa, 2.-londolwede, 3.-londolozya, 4.-londolweda, 5.-londolwedalyo, 6.-londololesya, 7.-londolola-londolola, 8.-londololana)

be clean, Beenzu bayakubona kaanda kasimpongo kalondolwa anze amukati. = The visitors will see that the hut of the goatherd is clean outside and inside. (2. -londwede, 3.-londozya 4.-londożyezya, 5.-londozyezyalyo, 6.-londolesya, 7.-londolwa-londolwa, 8.-londolana)

sit up straight, erect, Kulondomana kupa kuti ubone ciboola. = To sit upright helps you to see what is coming. (1.-londomanwa, 2.-londomene, 3.-londomanya, 4.-londomanina, 5.-londomaninalyo, 6.-londomanisya, 7.-londomana-londomana) Also: -lonzola, -nongomana.

store in, rt. -londola, Mucigombwa mwakali zibumbwa nzyaakali kulondweda zipopwe a nzembwe. In the store there were bottle-granaries for storing maize and millet. (1.-londolwa, 2.-londwede, 3.-londozya, 4.-londweda, 5.-londwedalyo, 6.-londolesya, 7.-londweda-londweda, 8.-londolana) Also: -yobweda
  • clean, tidy up, Kulondweda mapopwe ncibotu nkaambo inga akomena kabotu. = Cleaning the maize-field is good because it makes the maize grow well. Also: -limina.
  • clean for someone, *Kamundilon-dweda nanda yangu.* = Keep the house clean for me.

move residence, *Naakasika wakajana bokwabo bakalonga.* = When he arrived he found his people had moved residence. (1.-lonzegwa, 2.-longede, 3.-lonzya, 4.-longela, 5.-longelalyo, 6.-longesya, 7.-longa-longa, 8.-longezyanya) Also: -pola.

move to, rt. -longa, *Wakabuzya cibaka nkobakalongela kutegwa abatobele.* = She asked where they had moved to, so that she could follow them.
  • store, pack, load, transfer into, *Kamwaalongela mapopwe mubutala, mwamana mujale kutegwa babbi batanjili.* = Pack the maize in the granary, when finished close it so that thieves do not enter. *Basimbi bakali kulongela micelo munsangwa.* = The girls were packing fruits in baskets. Also: -layisya, -laisya.
  • move into, *Basicikolo nibakamvwa ntobolo nkozilila bakalilongela mucikolo.* = When the pupils heard the gun-shots they all moved into the school.

store or pack for, *Joojo wakamulongelela zintu zyakwe mukaintu wakwe akumutanda.* = Joojo packed his wife's belongings and drove her out. (1.-longelelwa, 2.-longelede, 3.-longezya, 4.-longelelela, 5.-longelelelalyo, 6.-longelelesya, 7.-longelela-longelela, 8.-longelelana)
be packed, rt. -longela *Mapopwe akalongelwa kale mubutala.* = The maize is already stored in the gran-ary.
bless, *Sunu watulongezezya limwi Chilenganzubo.* = Creator of people you have blessed us well to-day.

unpack, unload, *Nitwakasika twakalongolola zintu zyoonse* *a kuzibikka munanda mpya.* = When we arrived we unpacked everything and put them in the new house. *Bamukowa wa Kasindi tiicakabakondede kuti Kasindi kaujisi musankwa ooyu kaide kulongolola cabana kumuntu watakali kuyanda kumanizya kukwata.* = The clan of Kasindi were not happy that Kasindi was de-livering children for a man who had not fully paid for the marriage. (1.-longololwa, 2.-longolwede, 3.-longolozya, 4.-longo-lweda, 5.-longolwedalyo, 6.-longololesya, 7.-logolola-longolola, 8.-longolwedana) Also: -tutulula,- tuntulula.

move in a long line, *nombe zyakali muciba zyakalongomoka mweembezi naakazijalwida.* = The cattle which were in the kraal came out in a long line when the herder opened for them. (1.-longomokwa, 2.-longomokede, 3.-longomosya, 4.-longomokela, 5.-longomokelalyo, 6.-longomokesya, 7.-longomoka-longomoka)
  • come out in great numbers, *nombe a mpongo zyakalongomoka antoomwe.* = The cattle and goats came out together. *Nocakaima citima, bantu bakatalika kulongomoka kuzwa.* = When the train stopped, the people began to come out in crowds. Also: -lebeleka.
come out in a line, *Naakamana kusonda, bakalongomokela anze aakali kulindilila bantu.* = When he had finished divining, they come outside in a line to where the people were waiting.

cause to come out in a long line, *Bakalongomona nombe zyoonse ciindi cakukona.* = They brought out all the cattle at the time of inheriting. (1.-longomonwa, 2.-longomwede, 3.-longomozya, 4.-longomweda, 5.-longomwedalyo, 6.-longomonesya, 7.-longomona-longomona) Also: -longolola, -tutulula, -tuntulula.

unpack, to transfer into something else, Ciya cipwaza wakacilonzezya mucivwulumuto kuti maanzi oonse angwenge, ciyume. = She transferred this cheese into another container made of leaves so that all the water would evaporate and it would become hard. (1.-lonzezyegwa, 2.-lonzezyede, 3.-lonzezyezya, 4.-lonzezyeda, 5.-lonzezyedalyo, 6.-lonzezyesya, 7.-lonzezyalonzezya, 8.-lonzezyanya)

sit in a higher position, Ncibi kulonzola mbuli kuti ndonduwe mupati. = It is bad to sit in a higher position as if it was you who were the important one. (1.-lonzolwa, 2.-lonzwede, 3.-lonzozya, 4.-lonzweda, 5.-lonzwedalyo, 6.-lonzolesya, 7.-lonzola-lonzola) Also: -nongomana, -londomana.

fall heavily, Ba Mudenda bakalonzomoka kuzwa aciluli cananda. = Mr. Mudenda fell down heavily from the roof of the house. (1.-lonzomokwa, 2.-lonzomokede 3.-lonzomozya, 4.-lonzomokela, 5.-lonzomokelalyo, 6.-lonzomokesya, 7.-lonzomoka-lonzomoka)

remove, as furniture, rt. longa, Bantu bakalonzya zintu zyamwiiyi ngobatakali kuyanda akuzibikka mucaanda buyo. = The people removed the possessions of the teacher whom they did not want and just put them into a hut. (1.-lonzyegwa, 2.-lonzyede, 3.-lonzyezya, 4.-lonzyezya, 5.-lonzyezyalyo, 6.-lonzyesya, 7.-lonzya-lonzya, 8.-lonzyanya) Also: -pozya.
  • move off, Basibbuku bakali kuyanda kulonzya bantu bamwi. = The headman wanted to move some people away. Atutalike kuteya tooze kayuni inga kakaya kulonzya. = Let us prepare traps before the little bird moves off to another place

repeat again and again, Wakaloolola kukanana mbucaali ncecilengwa cakwe. = He repeated himself again and again as it was his habit. Bamwi bakali kuyeeya kuti alunge pele baka-mwaambila biyo kuti ataciloololi pe. = Some thought that he should be fined but they just told him not to repeat it again. Also: -indulula (1.-loololwa, 2.-loolwede, 3.-loolozya, 4.-loolweda, 5.-loolwedalyo, 6.-loololesya, 7.-loolola-loolola, 8.-loololana)

rain lightly and continuously, Imvwula yali kuloontela, yaamuka. = The light rain which has been falling continuouosly, has eased off. (1.-loontelwa, 2.-loontede, 3.-loontezya, 4.-loontelela, 5.-loontelelalyo, 6.-loontelesya, 7.-loontela-loontela)
bewitch by means of, rt. -lowa, Ooyu mulozi uloozya domba. = This witch bewitches through a medium. (1.-loogwa, 2.-lowede, 3.-loozya, 4.-lowela, 5.-lowelalyo, 6.-lowesya, 7.-loozya-loozya, 8.-lowana)

become wet, Beembela yabalopa mvwula musyokwe. = The rain drenches the herders in the bush. (1.-lopwa, 2.-lopede, 3.-lopya, 4.-lopela, 5.-lopelalyo, 6.-lopesya, 7.-lopa-lopa, 8.-lopana)
  • saturate, cover to excess, Bana baniini balayanda kulopa mafwuta kumeso. = Little children are fond of covering their faces excessively with vaseline. Also: - lobbeka.

apply oil or ointment to excess, rt. -lopa, Banyina bakajana mwana walilopeka mafwuta kubusyu. = The mother found the child applying cream liberally on the face. (1.-lopekwa, 2.-lopekede, 3.-lopya, 4.-lopekela, 5.-lopekelalyo, 6.-lopekesya, 7.-lopeka-lopeka, 8.-lopekana) Also: -lobbeka, -lovweka.

cause to drop on or into, rt.-loka, Igande lyakabwezelela tubwe tuniini a kutulosezya munongo. = The bull frog gathered up pebbles and dropped them into the clay pot. Muyuni wakamamuna mulomo akulosezya nweenwe mumeenda. = The bird opened its mouth and dropped the ring into the water. Ntwana twatuyuni twiide kulakama, balosezya cakulya mbambi. = The offspring of little birds just open their beaks, it is for the others to drop the food inside. (1.-loselwa, 2.-losyede, 4.-losezya, 5.-losezyalyo, 7.-losezya-losezya, 8.-losezyanya)

cause to dream, rt. -lota, Munyama ngundabona sunu ulandilosya. = The animal I saw today will cause me to dream. (1.-losyegwa, 2.-losyede, 3.-losya, 4.-losyela, 5.-losye-lalyo, 6.-losyesye, 7.-losya-losya, 8.-losyanya) Also: -lotesya.
  • let drop, rt. -loka, Ndalosya mali nindalikweenda munzila. = I dropped the money when I was going along the path. Utailosyi nweenwe. = Don't drop the ring. Wakalosya mutwe wakafwa. = He dropped his head and died.
drop something belonging to another, rt. -loka, Kamucengela baama, mulatulosyela mwaneesu. = Take care mother, you will let our child fall.

dream, Sunu ndali kulota kuti ndali ku Monze. = Today I dreamt that I was in Monze. (1.-lotwa, 2.-lotede, 3-lotya/lotezya, 4.-lotela, 5.-lotelalyo, 6.-lotesya, 7.-lota-lota.)
  • be incinerated, Niyakapya nanda, zintu zyoonse zyakali mukati zyakalota. = When the house caught fire, everything which was inside was burnt to ashes.

dream every now and then, Buzuba oobu Mainza wakalotauka kapati cakunga cimwi ciindi wakali kusinsimuka nkwayabauka. = That day Mainza frequently and intermittently dreamed so that sometimes he was wakening as he struggled. (1.-lotaukwa, 2.-lotaukide, 3.-lotaukizya, 4.-lotaukila, 5.-lotaukilalyo, 6.-lotaukisya, 7.-lotauka-lotauka, 8.-lotaukana)

cause to dream, rt. -lota, Candilotesya nkulya kapati jilo. = What made me dream is eating too much yesterday. Also: -losya.
  • cause to be incinerated, rt. -lota, Bwizu nibwakapya bwakalotesya tuuka toonse. = When the grass was burnt, it caused all the insects to be incinerated.
be imagined, rt. -lota, Bayakunyamuka okuya kalitaningalotwa kutegwa okuno bazikusike acikasaalizi. = They will set out before it can be imagined so that they can arrive here early morning.
cause to dream, rt. -lota, Also: -losya.

stay away from work, (ety. Eng.), Bantu balovwa tabavwoli mali manji pe. = People who loaf do not earn much money. (1.-lovwa, 2.-lovwegwa, 3.-lovwesya, 4.-lovwela, 5.-lovwelalyo, 6.-lovwesya, 7.-lovwa-lovwa) Also: -lofwa.

smear abundantly oil or ointment, Bana balalilovweka mafwuta manji nokuba kuti kulapya kapati. = The children smear themselves abundantly with oil even though it is hot. Mubili a maaya akamweka akaambo kakulovweka acisila. = The body and the stringed skirt were shining because they were smeared with ochre. Also: -nanika, -lopeka (rt. -lopa) (1.-lovweka, 2.-lovwekede, 3.-lovwezya, 4.-lovwekela, 5.-lovwekelalyo, 6.-lovwekesya, 7.-lovweka-lovweka, 8.-lovwekana)
bewitch, Baya badaala balalowa. = That old man bewitches.

bewitch one another, flower, Indongwe zyangu zyakaAkaambo kamunyono bantu banji baka- talika kuluba. = My groundnuts have lowana. = Because of envy many people started flowering.

eat ravenously, Wakai-lowela bewitch for someone or for a lubbaula nyama cakulikwaya abeenzireason, rt. -lowa, Njakuunka ku- nyina. = He ate ravenously and freely munanga azikundilowele mulozi wajaya with his friends. mwanaangu. = I will go to the witch- (1.-lubbaulwa, 2.-lubbaulide, 3.-lubbaudoctor so that he will bewitch for me the zya, 4.-lubbaulila, 5.-lubbaulilalyo, witch who has killed my child. Ulabaamba 6.-lubbaulisya, 7.-lubbaula-lubbaula, bantu boonse mbaakalowa ancaakaba- 8.-lubbaulana)

column1: lowela. = He will mention all the people -lubide
column2: be in a state of abnormality, rt. he had bewitched and why he had -luba, Muntu usondokede, bapati bewitched them. baamba kuti kuli cilubide mumutwe
bewitch with, Muntu wakwe. = As regards a mad person, the wakamulowezya mucelo wanaluntaam- elders say that there is something which bwe. = A person bewitched him with the has gone wrong in his head.

go astray, Ndalubila nkaa-lozomoka slither, Inzoka mbo ndabelesya nzila iteesyi. = I went yalozomoka kuzwa mubwina. = The astray because I used the wrong path. snake slithers out of the hole. (1.-lubilwa, 2.-lubilide, 3.-lubilizya, (1.-lozomoka, 2.-lozomokede, 4.-lubilila, 5.-lubililalyo, 6.-lubilisya, 3.-lozomosya, 4.-lozokokela, 7.-lubila-lubila)

be in a hurry, Sici7.-lozomoka-lozomoka, 8.-lozomokana) bende wakatija cakulubinkana. = Sici
  • adhere as honey, Cinkomba bende ran away in a hurry. cilalozomoka kuminwe bantu nobasunsa. (1.-lubinkanwa, 2.-lubinkenye/-lubinkanide = Okra adheres to the fingers when 3.-lubinkanya, 4.-kubinkanina, people draw it up. Also: -lelemuka. 5.-lubinkaninalyo, 6.-lubinkanisya-lozomona pull up or pull back, 7.-lubinkana-lubinkana, 8.-lubinkaninana)

cause to offend, Undibasankwa. = The boys pulled the snake tondezye bantu mbondakalubizizya. = out of the hole. Kolozomona lekani Show me the people I hve offended. kutegwa mukuli ujate. = Pull back the (1.-lubizigwa, 2.-lubizyide, 3.-lubizizya, rubber so that it holds the load. 4.-lubizyizya, 5.-lubizyizyalyo, (1.-lozomonwa, 2.-lozomwede, 6.-lubizisyisya, 7.-lubizizya-lubizizya, 3.-lozomozya, 4.-lozomonena, 8.-lubizizyanya)

cause to err, lead astray, rt. 7.-lozomona-lozomona, 8.-lozomonana) luba, Ndakabalubizya kubala bana. = Also: -landamuna I erred in counting the children. (1.-lubizyigwa, 2.-lubizyide, 3.-lubizyizya, 4.-lubizyila, 5.-lubizyilalyo, 6.-lubizyisya, 7.-lubizya-lubizya, 8.-lubizyanya.)

instruct, give a sign, remind, *Komulubukizya nkwaya.* = Give him directions as to how he is to go. Oku nkulumba Leza munzila iyelede yakabikkwa, nkotwakaboolela kuti tuzookumulubukizye nywe. = This praying to God in the right way, the way that was ordained, is the reason we came so that we might direct you. (1.-lubukizyigwa, 2.-lubukizyide, 3.-lubukizya, 4.-lubukizyizya, 5.-lubukizyizyalyo, 6.-lubukizyisya, 7.-lubukizya-lubukizya, 8.-lubukizyanya) Also: -naanizya, -lailila.

accuse falsely of being a witch, *Mujwa wangu wandilubula kulowa kutako.* = My nephew has accused me of witchcraft which does not exist. (1.-lubulwa, 2.-lubwide, 3.-lubuzya, 4.-lubulila, 5.-lubulilalyo, 6.-lubulisya, 7.-lubula-lubula, 8.-lubulana) Also: -taya.
  • pull out, *Mubbi bakamulubula meno obilo nibakamujata kabba nombe.* = They pulled out two of the thief's teeth when they found him stealing cattle. Also: -lukula.

run away or escape after an unpleasant experience, *Nitwakalubuluka, twakayeeya kwesu.* = When we had endured so much, we thought of home. *Musankwa, wakali kuyandisya kuIwana, wakalubuluka nobakamujaya liso mukulwana.* = The boy, who was fond of fighting, ran away after he lost one of his eyes in a fight. *Nokwakamana myaka yone, bakalubuluka akuunka kucisi cabo.* = When four years passed, they ran away and returned to their own country. (1.-lubulukwa, 2.-lubulukide, 3.-lubulusya 4.-lubulukila, 5.-lubulukilalyo, 6.-lubulukisya, 7.-lubuluka-lubuluka, 8.-lubulukana)
  • give up permanently a habit, like drinking beer or working for someone, *Ndalubuluka, nsekanywi kabili bukoko.* = I have given up the habit, I will not drink any more. Also: -subuka

make one think of escaping, *Nzala yakatulubulula kwamyaka minji.* = For many years the famine made us think of escaping. *Zyoonse nzendaamba ndakali kuzibona ameso angu. Nciceeci cakandilubulula.* = All I have spoken about I have seen with my own eyes. That is what made me think of escaping. (1.-lubululwa, 2.-lubulwide, 3.-lubuluzya, 4.-lubulukila, 5.-lubulukilalyo, 6.-lubulukisya, 7.-lubulula-lubulula, 8.-lubululana)
  • disgust, *Sunu bukoko bwakamulubulula.* = Today beer disgusts him.
  • guess the correct answer to a riddle, *Kamwaalila kulubulula kalabiko kauba-uba.* = She has failed to guess the right answer to an easy riddle. *Mwana wakalubulula kalabiko kakatazya.* = The child solved the difficult riddle. Also: -labulula.

be reminded of, *Bakalubulwa kuti baunke kucibbadela.* = They were reminded to go to the hospital. (2.-lubwide, 3.-lubuzya, 4.-lubulila, 5.-lubulilalyo, 6.-lubulisya, 7.-lubulwalubulwa, 8.-lubulana) Also: -ibalulwa.

cause to forget, rt. -luba, *Wakasama kabotu kutegwa alilubye-lubye mapenzi akwe.* She dressed well to make herself forget her troubles. (1.-lubizyigwa, 2.-lubide, 3.-lubya, 4.-lubila, 5.-lubilalyo, 6.-lubisya, 7.-lubyalubya, 8.-lubaana, / -lubizyanya)
forget deliberately, rt.luba, *Tiindakali kuyanda kuunka kumuswaangano, aboobo ndakalilubyalubya.* = I did not want to go to the meeting, therefore I forgot deliberately.

vomit, Wakaluka naakazikunywa musamu kucibbadela. = She vomited when she drank the medicine at the hospital. (1.-lukwa, 2.-lukide, 3.-lusya, 4.-lukila, 5.-lukilalyo, 6.-lukisya, 7.-lukaluka, 8.-lukana)
  • weave, knit, Baama balicizyi kuluka mitaanga. Mother knows how to weave baskets.
  • plait, Sunu Muzembo tayandi kuuka masusu nkaambo ulikatede. = Muzembo does not want to plait hair today because she is tired. (-lukisigwa)
= be plaited into, -lukulula = plait anew.) Also: -osa, -pesa.
plait one another's hair, Basimbi balayandisya kulukana masusu. = Girls like very much to plait each other's hair.

come out of fixed position, Mwana wakalukuka linyo lyomwe jilo. = One of the child's teeth became loose yesterday. (1.-lukukwa, 2.-lukukide, 3.-lukuzya, 4.-lukukila, 5.-lukukilalyo, 6.-lukukisya, 7.-lukuka-lukuka) Also: -kuka.

extract, Nimfwaindi yakamulukula menyo obilo. It is a blow which knocked out two of his teeth. (1.-lukulwa, 2.-lukwide, 3.-lukuzya, 4.-lukwida, 5.-lukwidalyo, 6.-lukulisya, 7.-lukula-lukula, 8.-lukulana) Also: -lubula.
chew anything hard, Ndakacilukuta cifwuwa caņombe kusikila camana. I chewed the bone of a cow until it was finished.

gnaw, Syuumbwa wakali kulukuvwula zifwuwa mucoonde. = The lion was gnawing bones in the thicket. Also: -kukuzyula, -kunya, -lukuta, pulukuta. (1.-lukuvwulwa, 2.-lukuvwide, 3.-lukuvwisya, 4.-lukuvwila, 5.-lukuvwilalyo, 6.-lukuvwulisya 7.-lukuvwula-lukuvwula, 8.-lukuvwulana)

be bitter, be pungent, Imwi misamu njobapa kucibbadela ilalula. = Some medicines which they give at the hospital are bitter. (1.-lulwa, 2.-lulide, 3.-luzya, 4.-lulila, 5.-lulilalyo, 6.-lulisya, 7.-lula-lula, 8.-luzyanya.)
  • turn sour, Mabisi aya alalula. = That sour milk is bitter.
  • be oversalted, Cisyu ncotwakalya jilo cakali kulula munyo. The relish which we ate yesterday was oversalted.

be straightened, Cakalilubide, ino calulama. It was in a mess, now it is fixed up. (1.-lulamikwa, 2.-lulamide, 3.-lulamizya, 4.-lulamina, 5.-lulaminalyo, 6.-lulamisya, 7.-lulama-lulama, 8.-lulamikana)
straighten, Ino nguni wacilulamika cintu eeci? = Now who fixed this thing?

straighten things for, sort out for, Basyaaneene nobakasika kunkuta, bakandilulamikila makani angu. = When my grandfather arrived at the court he looked after my case. Kamundilulamikila cisamu cicengeme. = Straighten the bent stick for me. Chimuka nobwakaca wakamanizya mulimo wakwe wakupupulula kucapa akululamika munzi. = When it dawned Chimuka finished his work of cleansing and restoring the village to normality.

refuse by shaking the head, Mwana walulauka kukaka. = The child shook her head in refusal. Ndabona nkobaile kululauka kundilanga ani kuti tabaciyandi buya ncebaambila. = I saw how they were just looking at me shaking their heads as they did not like at all what I told them. Bantu bakali kululauka nibakamvwa cinunka munsaa mugwagwa. = The people were holding their noses when they smelt something stinking near the road. Also: -nuntauka, -tikinya, -gwenauka
be honourable, be just, *Sibbuku waliluleme.* = The headman was an upright person.

move to a place, *Ulaluluma ulaya nkumunya nkobamukasya.* = She persists in going to the very place where they forbid her to go. Also: -enda.
  • move in slow motion together, *Bantu bakali kululuma kweenda nobakali kuya kukuzikka mwami.* = The people were moving in slow motion together when they were going to bury the chief.
move quickly, *Bantu boonse bakalulumukila anze.* = All the people moved outside.

bite, sting, *Inzuki zilaluma, tazili zyakusobanya.* = Bees sting, they are not to be played with. *Mulwazi wangu wakapona naakapegwa musamu uluma* (idiomatic). = My patient was healed after s/he was given medicine which bites. i.e. which is powerful. *Ulaide kulilumaa mwiindi.* = He was just biting himself on the leg. (i.e. He was hurting himself to no avail.) (1.-lumwa, 2.-lumide, 3.-lumya, 4.-lumina, 5.-luminalyo, 6.-luminsya, 7.-luma-luma.)
  • eat the first mealies of the season, *Sena bana bakaluma kale mapopwe matete.* = Have the children already eaten the first maize?
  • gnash the teeth, -kuluma ntwino

be in danger, *Basimbi bakatumwa mumyuunda kuti bakaambile bantu boonse kuti nyika yalumaana.* = Girls were sent to the fields to tell all the people that the territory was under attack. *Nyika yalumaana, yamena meja.* = The world has become dangerous, it has grown horns. (1.-lumaanwa, 2.-lumeenye, 3.-lumaanzya, 4.-lumaanina, 5.-lumaaninalyo, 6.-lumaanisya 7.-lumaana-lumaana)

be uncertain in speech, *Naali kubetekwa wali kwiile kulilumaluma kukanana.* = When she was being tried she was just hesitating in her speech.
  • persuade, *Kuli umbi musankwa ngwindabona undiluma-luma kumatwi.* = There was another boy whom I saw who was persuading me. (idiomatic)
  • eat first maize, *Aabo balima kampelya balafwambaana kuluma-luma nkaambo kampelya takatani kubizwa.* = Those who plant an early species of maize are quick to eat the early maize because it does not take long to ripen.

bite one another, *Babwa balalumana nobalwana.* = Dogs bite one another when they fight. (1.-lumanwa, 2.-lumanide, 3.-lumanya, 4.-lumanina, 5.-lumaninalyo, 6.-lumanisya, 7.-lumana-lumana)
  • cluster together, as bananas in a bunch, *Babondo balalumana kumyeeye nobazwa muzyiba niyamana kuwa mvwula.* = Barble fish follow one another by the tail when they come out of a pond after the rain.

thank, *Ndakalumba cipego ncomwakanditumina.* = I thank you for the present you sent to me. (1.-lumbwa, 2.-lumbide, 3.-lumbya, 4.-lumbila, 5.-lumbilalyo, 6.-lumbisya, 7.-lumba-lumba, 8.-lumbana)
  • pray, *Bantu banji bakafwuma kucikombelo kuya kulumba.* = Many people set out early for the church going to pray.
  • soften twittering, *Insolo niisika mucisamu muli nzuki ilalumba, elyo basimpongo balazyiba kuti nzuki zilaafwiifwi.* = When the honey bird reaches a tree where there is honey it softens its twittering, and so the goatherds know there is honey near.

extol, Katunga katulilumbaizya aswebo mu Butonga bwesu kuleka kuti katwiile kulumbaizya misyobo iimwi yabantu. = We Batonga should praise ourselves in our Tonga way of life rather than just be praising other tribes. (*kulilumbaizya* = be proud, praising oneself) (1.-lumbaizyigwa, 2.-lumbaizyide, 3.-lumbaizyizya, 4.-lumbaizyila, 5.-lumbaizyilalyo, 6.-lumbaizyisya, 7.-lumbaizya-lumbaizya, 8.-lumbaizyanya)

swear an oath, Langa buya ndalumbila uulya ciya kwaala kulanduka. = For sure I swear that that one will be unable to cross. (1.-lumbilwa, 2.-lumbilide, 3.-lumbizya, 4.-lumbilila, 5.-lumbililalyo, 6.-lumbilisya, 7.-lumbilalumbila, 8.-lumbilana) Also: -konka
cakubeja* = perjure oneself

bless, Mwana musimbi naakwatwa usyi ulamulumbilila ameenda kutegwa akwatwe kabotu. = When a daughter gets married her father blesses her with water so that she will be married well. Jesu wakaalumbilila meenda kutegwa asanduke abe wayini. = He blessed the water so that it should become wine. (1.-lumbililwa, 2.-lumbilide, 3.-lumbilizya, 4.-lumbilila, 5.-lumbilililalyo, 6.-lumbililisya, 7.-lumbilila-lumbilila, 8.-lumbililana) Also: -leleka.
