bless with, Meenda akalumbililwa ngotulumbilizya balwazi. = It is with blessed water that we bless the sick. (1.-lumbilizyigwa, 2.-kumbilizyide, 3.-lumbilizya, 4.-lumbilizyizya, 5.-lumbilizyizyalyo, 6.-lumbilizyisya, 7.-lumbilizya-lumbilizya, 8.-lumbilizyanya)

adjure, swear by, Wakalumbizya bausyi kutondezya kuti waamba masimpe. = She swore by her father to show that she was telling the truth. Muntu nalilumbizya, ulilumbizya kumukowa kwakazyalwa usyi. = When a person swears, he swears by the clan which bore his father. Also: -konka.
pass by, Mazuba alimwi amvwiki zyakalumbuka, mulimo kautajaniki. = Days and again weeks passed, work was not found.

reward, Bakamulumbula kumupa nkuku ampongo akaambo kamulimo ngwaakali kucita. = They rewarded him by giving him a hen and a goat for the work he was doing. Lweendo Iwakwe Iwalumbulwa, waakucijana ncaakali kuyanda. = Her journey rewarded her, she found what she wanted. Ndumbule bamwi. = Let me reward some. Kondilumbula. = Reward me. (1.-lumbulwa, 2.-lumbwide, 3.-lumbuzya, 4.-lumbwida, 5.-lumbwidalyo, 6.-lumbulisya, 7.-lumbula-lumbula, 8.-lumbulana)
  • loose or miss something valuable, Masotoka wakasondoka. Beenzinyina boonse bakausa nkaambo bakamulumbula. = Masotoka went mad. All his friends were sad because they lost him.

raise the face while keeping the eyes down, Koleka kulumbulala mbuli muntu uciswa meso. = Stop looking upwards like a person who has sore eyes. (1.-lumbulalwa, 2.-lumbulwide, 3.-lumbuluzya, 4.-lumbulalila, 5.lumbulalilayo, 6.-lumbulalisya 7.-lumbulala-lumbulala) Also: -bbuulula

be smooth and round, Kabwe kakwiizya tombwe kakalumbusana akaambo kameenda akunka mumulonga. = The stone used for grinding snuff is smooth because of the water flowing in the river. (2.-lumbusene, 3.-lumbusika, 4.-lumbusanina, 5.-lumbusaninalyo, 6.-lumbusanisya, 7.-lumbusanalumbusana) Also: -bumbusana
be in a smooth and round state, Wakaleta ibbwe lilumbu *senye.* = He brought a stone which was in a smooth and round state.

be in a state of conflict, rt. - lumaana, *Cisi cakalilumeene akaambo kakuyoowana.* = The country was not at peace because people feared one another. (2.-lumeene, 3.-lumaanya, 4.-lumaanina, 5.-lumaaninalyo, 6.-lumaanisya, 7.-lumeene-lumeene)

bleed, cup, *Nkwali munene ulumika nsinga.* = There is an old man who makes the blood flow to relieve a nerve pain. *Oyu, muce wangu, nguwakalumikwa kuli Naceta.* = This one, my brother, is the one who was bled by Naceta. (1.-lumikwa, 2.-lumikidwe, 3.-lumikizya, 4.-lumikila, 5.-lumikilalyo, 6.-lumikisya, 7.-lumika-lumika, 8.-lumikana)
stuck, *Ciindi eeci musanga wakalumikidwe kukutwi.* = At this time the cigarette was stuck behind the ear.

be mixed with sand as porridge containing earth, *Nsima ya-lumina.* = The nsima is mixed with sand. *Kakondo kabana kalumina mavwu.* = The porridge of the children is mixed with soil. (1.-luminwa, 2.-lumide, 3.-lumizya, 4.-lumizyizya, 5.-lumizyizyalyo, 6.-lumizyisya, 7.-lumina-lumina, 8.-luminana)
  • be predatory, attack on its own volition, *Syuumbwa mmunyama uli-lumina.* = The lion is an animal which is predatory.

put on, *Kumutwe yakalilumine ngowani yamalala kumwi ooku kulubazu kiisyomekedwe minimba yalukumba.* = On his head he was wearing a straw hat while on its side were inserted the feathers of a nightjar.
catch without help, *Mubwa wangu wakaliluminina kasulwe* kakunyina bambi babwa bakamugwasya. My dog caught a little rabbit without the help of other dogs.
be caught up in, *Munwe wangu waluminizigwa munketani yancinga.* = My finger got caught in the bicycle chain.

eat the staple food without soup, *Ndalikuluminizya nsima anyama.* = I was seasoning the nsima with meat. (without soup) Also: -luminina.
  • bite along with, *Syuumbwa naakaluma mpongo, wakaluminizya ankuku zyobilo.* = When the lion attacked the goats, he also went on to bite two chickens.

put sand/soil in food, rt. - lumina, *Kuli wacilumizya ceele cabana.* = There is someone who put sand in the children's porridge. (1.-lumizyigwa, 2.-lumizyide, 3.-lumizyisya, 4.-lumizyizya, 5.-lumizyizyalyo, 6.-lumizyisya, 7.-lumizya-lumizya, 8.-lumizyanya)
destroy carelessly, *Muya kumuzunda mubbi oyu wakalumpanya buvwubi bwacisi canu.* = You will conquer this thief who has destroyed the wealth of your country carelessly.
cause to bite, rt. -luma, *Takanakaba kaindi bamulumya sulwe.* = It wasnt very long before they caused the dog to catch the hare.

raise the dust, *Kalunda kasuko ciindi lyazwa mulundo.* = The dust was raised when they performed the mulundo funeral ritual. *Kalikulunda kasuko nibali kunyaana mapopwe acivwolevwole.* = The dust was raised when they were scrambling for free maize. (1.-lundwa, 2.-lundide, 3.-lundya, 4.-lundila, 5.-lundilalyo, 6.-lundisya, 7.-lunda-lunda)
  • move towards something in a group, *Mbobakamvwa kwakacitika ntenda,* bantu boonse lyakalunda kuya kucibaka ooko. = As soon as they heard of the accident, all the people rushed to that place.
  • carry out the *mulundo* mourning ceremony, *Kulila dilwe litalundwi* = A traditional funeral has no ending.

heap on one after another, *Ino nywebo ncomulipenzya kundilundaika mibuzyo yoonse eyo candizimina.* = Now I am baffled why you trouble yourselves in piling me with all those questions. *Tacili cibotu kulundaika zisani amwana nokupya.* = It is not good to clothe a child with many clothes when it is hot. (1.-lundaikwa, 2.-lundaikide, 3.-lundaikizya, 4.-lundaikila, 5.-lundaikilalyo, 6.-lundaikisya, 7.-lundaika-lundaika, 8.-lundaikana)
fall as fine rain, *Imvwula yatalika kale kulunda-lunda.* = The rain has already started to drizzle. Also: *-sunkumuka, sunsumuna.*

assemble, *Bantu bakalundana kautanatalika muswaangano.* = The people gathered before the meeting began. (1.-lundanwa, 2.-lundanide, 3.-lundanya, 4.-lundanina, 5.-lundaninalyo, 6.-lundanisya, 7.-lundana-lundana, 8.-lundana)

be gathered, rt. *-lundana*, *Bantu ibakalundene bakanyandwa kubona mucembele oyu uwatakali kuyoowa.* = The people who were gathered were surprised to see this old woman who was not fearing. *Kabacilundene aba bantu cintu cakutaanguna ncibakayeeya nkuti bayandaule lufwu Iwasikwaazwa.* = When these were still gathered the first thing they thought of was to find out the reason for the death of the deceased. (1.-lundenwe, 2.-lundene)

heap up, pile up, *Katulundika mabwe aawa kutegwa kutabi mulonga.* = Let us pile up the stones here to stop a river from forming. *Wakacela matanga akwaalundika.* = She collected melons and piled them up. *Kofwambaana koya ukazyuume nombe zyaamana mapopwe a cilwi mputwalundika sunu.* = Hurry up and go and beat the cattle, they have finished the maize at the heap we gathered today. Also: *-bungika.* (1.-lundikwa, 2.-lundikide, 3.-lundisya, 4.-lundikila, 5.-lundikilalyo, 6.-lundikisya, 7.-lundika-lundika, 8.-lundikana)
  • weld, *Niyakatyoka nkolobeki yangu, ndakaitola kumufwuzi awalo wakailundika.* = When my cultivator broke, I took it to the blacksmith and he welded it.

be piled together, *Yakalundikilwa malwi-malwi aamabwe.* = Heaps of stones were piled together. (2.-lundikidwe, 3.-lundikizya, 4.-lundikila, 5.-lundikillalyo, 6.-lundikisya, 7.-lundikalundika, 8.-lundikana)

run, *Mwami naakasika toonse twakanyamuka akulunduka kuya kumucinga.* = When the chief arrived we all arose and ran to meet him. Also: *-mata, -balika, -tijaana, -zuza.* (1.-lundukwa, 2.-lundukide, 3.-lundusya, 4.-lundukila, 5.-lundikilalyo, 6.-lundukisya, 7.-lunduka-lunduka)
ran very hard, rt. *-lunduka*, *Nabulwe wakalundukisya kuyoowa babwa bakali kumutanda.* = The iguana ran very hard fearing the dogs who were chasing it.

cause dust to be raised, *Basankwa bali kulundula kasuko nibali kusobana bbola.* = The boys were raising the dust when they were playing football. (1.-lundulwa, 2.-lundwide, 3.-lundya, 4.-lundwida, 5.-lundwidalyo, 6.-lundulisya, 7.-lundula-lundula)
walk all together in a crowd, *Boonse bazyali bakalunduma kuya kukubona mwami mupya.* = All the parents went together to see the new chief.

be raised above a standard level, Nitwali kuyaka bwaanda, zitina zyobilo zyalundumana nkaambo bulongo bwavwulisya. = When we were building the wall, two bricks were raised above the level because there was too much mortar. (1.-lundumanwa, 2.-lundumanide, 3.-lundumanya, 4.-lundumanina, 5.-lundumaninalyo, 6.-lundumanisya, 7.-lundumanalundumana, 8.-lundumaninana)
  • protrude the lips, Kuti Mainza wanyema inga mulomo walundumana. = When Mainza is angry s/he pouts.

go in a crowd, rise like dust, Bantu boonse balundumuka kuya kudilwe. = All the people went off in a crowd going to the funeral. Inswa zyalikulundumuka sunu kumangolezya. = The flying ants were flying in large numbers in the evening. Muwo wakali kubbubbula alusuko Iwakali kulundumuka. = The wind was blowing and the dust was rising. (1.-lundumukwa, 2.-lundumukide, 3.-lundumuzya, 4.-lundumukila, 5.-lundumukilalyo, 6.-lundumukisya, 7.lundumuka-lundumuka)

throw up dust or ashes, raise dust, Bana balundumuna kasuko nibali kusobana. The children raised the dust when they were playing. Munanga wakalundumuna lusu Iwamusamu. The witchdoctor sprinkled the powdered medicine. (1.-lundumunwa, 2.-lundumwide, 3.-lundumuzya, 4.-lundumwida, 5.-lundumwidalyo, 6.-lundumunisya, 7.-lundumunalundumuna)

pay a fine, Wakalunga mali ongaye kubazyali bamusimbi ngookamisya? How much money did you pay the parents of the girl whom you made pregnant? (1.-lungwa, 2.-lungide, 3.-lunzya, 4.-lungila, 5.-lungilalyo, 6.-lungisya, 7.-lunga-lunga, 8.-lunzyanya)
  • salt, flavour, season Banyina bamutuma kuya kulunga munyo mucisyu. = Her mother sent her to salt the relish.

raise the head and eyes upwards, Mwana kalungama, ilamufwundilizya ngubo. Raise the child's head, the shawl will suffocate it. (1.-lungamwa, 2.-lungamide, 3.-lungamya, 4.-lungamina, 5.-lungaminalyo, 6.-lungamisya, 7.-lungama-lungama) Also: -lungumana.
be united, Banji bantu bakali kulungana ciindi nobakali kunjililwa mapenzi. Many people were united when they were involved in sufferings. also -yaana

unite, unify, Lukwatano lulunganya bantu bobilo kuti babe bomwe. Marriage unites two people so that they become one. (1.-lunganizyigwa, 2.-lunganyide 3.-lunganya, 4.-lunganyizyizya, 5.-lunganyizyizyalyo, 6.-lunganyisya, 7.-lunganya-lunganya) Also: -nunganya, -lungilila, -jatanya.
  • join pieces together, Kamulunganya tooye tobile kutegwa kalampe tukasyange kabotu. = Join the two pieces of rope so that it becomes longer and we can go and sow more easily.

looking upwards, rt. -lungama, Bakajana mulombwana ulilungeme mubbodela lyabukoko. = They found the man looking up into the bottle of beer. 2.-lungeme, 3.-lungumika, 4.-lungumikila, 5.-lungumikilalyo, 6.lungumukisya, 7.-lungeme-lungeme, 8.-lungumikana)

pay on one's behalf, Ndakamulungila mulandu wakusaanguna. = I paid for his first offence. (1.-lungilwa, 2.-lungide, 3.-lunzya, 4.-lungilila, 5.-lungililalyo, 6.-lungilisya, 7.-lungila-lungila, 8.-lungilana)
  • pay to, compensate, *Ndakamulungila* muntu ngwindakatyolela nombe ciindi nindakayuumputa acimbayambaya. = I compensated the man whose cow I crashed into with the truck. Also: -liya.

join, knot, bind, set a bone, *Lungilila* looye kutegwa lulampe lusike mumeenda mucikala. = Join the rope with another piece so that it becomes long and reaches the water in the well. (1.-lungililwa, 2.-lungilide, 3.-lungilizya, 4.-lungililila, 5.-lungilililalyo, 6.-lungililisya, 7.-lungilila-lungilila, 8.-lungililana)
  • set a bone, Cifwuwa cakatyokede bakacilungilila kucibbadela. = They set the bone at the hospital which was broken. Also: -nungilila.

impose a fine, *Bamulungizya*, nokuba kuti taali kuyanda. = They imposed a fine on her, even though she was unwilling. (1.-lungizyigwa, 2,-lungizyide, 3.-lungizyizya, 4.-lungizyizya, 5.-lungizyizyalyo, 6.-lungizyisya, 7.-lungizya-lungizya, 8.-lungizyanya) Also: -lunzya.

be burnt, as food, *Eeci cisyu calungula*. This relish is burnt. Also: -ida. (1.-lunguzyigwa, 2.-lungwide, 3.-lunguzya, 4.-lungwida, 5.-lungwidalyo, 6.-lungulisya, 7.-lungula-lungula, 8.-lungululana)
  • lose property, Niyakapya nanda, lubono loonse Iwakalungula. = When the house was burnt down, all the property was destroyed.

be oversalted, *Cisyu calungulala*, tacilikkiki. The relish is oversalted, it is inedible. Also: -lungumana. 1.-lungulalwa, 2.-lungulede, 3.-lunguluzya, 4.-lungulalila, 5.-lungulalilalyo, 6.-lungulalisya, 7.-lungulala-lungulala, 8.-lungulwidana)

relate, Makani aya onse ngondilungulula, akacitika mwakali. = All these matters that I am relating, happened last year. (1.-lungululwa, 2.-lungulwide, 3.-lunguluzya, 4.-lungulwida, 5.-lungulwidalyo, 6.-lungululisya, 7.-lungulula-lungulula, 8.-lungulwidana)
  • interpret a dream, Basinsimi bakaindi bakali *kulunqulula* maloto. = The prophets of long ago were interpreting dreams.

relate events to, rt. lungulula, Mucembele wakali kubalungulwida buumi bwansiku mbwaakamvwa kuli banyinakulu. The old lady was telling them about the life long ago which she had heard from her grandmother. Also: -pandulwida.

look upwards, Mutinta ulungumana kayuni mucisamu muya. Mutinta is looking up at the bird in that tree there. Bunji bwabamakaintu batanjide milimo baide kulungumana kubaalumi babo kutegwa bapegwe zyakujikila akulida. = Many women who do not work just look to their husbands so that they be given things to cook with and eat from. (1.-lungumanwa, 2.-lungumanide, 3.-lungumanya, 4.-lungumanina, 5.-lungu-maninalyo, 6.-lungumanisya, 7.-lungumana-ungumana, 8.-lungumaninana)
  • be oversalted, *Cisyu calungumana* nicabikkwa munyo munji. The relish was oversalted when much salt was put in it. Also: -lula, -lungalala.
erode, Ivwu lyalungutuka = The soil is eroding.

make one suffer, rt. lungula, Babbi balalunguzya. Thieves make others suffer by taking their property. *Maali alalunguzya*. (proverb) = Polygamy brings misery. (1.-lunguzyigwa, 2.-lunguzyide, 4.-lunguzyila, 5.-lunguzyilalyo, 6.-lunguzyisya, 7.-lunguzyalunguzya, 8.-lunguzyanya) =

be fined, rt. -lunga, Musankwa wakali kwiitilwa kulunzigwa nkaambo ngusikubba. = The boy was called to be fined because he was a thief. (2.-lunzide, 3.-lunzizya, 4.-lunzyila, 5.-lunzyilalyo, 6.-lunzyisya, 7.-lunzigwa, 8.-lunzyanya)

raise as clouds of dust, Inombe nizyalikuya kumulonga kukunywa meenda, zyali kulunzya kasuko. = When the cattle were going to the river to drink, they were raising the dust. (1.-lunzyigwa, 2.-kunzyide, 4.-lunzyila, 5.-lunzyilalyo, 6.-lunzyisya, 7.-kunzyalunzya, 8.-lunzyanya)
  • cause to pay a fine, Ndakamulunzya nombe zyobilo wakajaya musune wangu. = I made him pay a fine of two cattle for killing my ox. Also: -lungizya.

energize, Naakamana kulya mweenzu wakati, "Ndalifwide nzala, ino mwalupa maulu. = When he had finished eating the visitor said, "I was hungry, but now you have given strength to my legs to walk." (1.-lupwa, 2.-lupide, 3.-lupya, 4.-lupila, 5.-lupilalyo, 6.-lupisya, 7.-lupa-lupa, 8.-lupana)
  • be attracted, Zyakamulupa nswi ku Namalyo nkwaakaya, ncatajoki ino. = The fish attracted him at Namalyo where he went, that is why he does not return now.

run away in haste, Makala wakalupepenyeka wakagama kuIwizi mane wakaakuluzubuka. = Makala quickly ran away heading for the lake and finally crossed it. (2.-lupepenyekede, 3.-lupepenyesya, 4.-lupepenyekela, 5.-lupepenyekelalyo, 6.-lupepenyekesya, 7.-lupepenyeka-lupepenyeka)
be captivated, Dyabbula wakalupidwe akukanana kwamweenzinyina. Dyabbula was captivated by the talk of his friend.

be addicted to, be infatuated, be drawn to, be pleased with, Bana bobile aaba bakalupwa, mbubona mbuli bwakalupwa muntu wakali kulida buci musyokwe. These two young ones were attracted to one another just as a man is drawn to the honey he has been gathering in the bush. Wakalupwa kweenda amusimbi waasika ino-ino kuli ba Munsaka. He was fond of walking with the girl who had just arrived at Munsaka's. Mubwa walupwa kubba nyama murnanda. A dog is fond of stealing meat in the house. Bantu banji balupwa kunywa kaccassu mazubaano. = Many people are addicted to drinking kaccasu nowadays.

cause to vomit, rt. -luka, Cakulya citajikwi kabotu cilalusya. = Food which is not cooked well, causes one to vomit. (1.-lusyigwa, 2.-lusyide, 3.-lusya, 4.-lusyila, 5.-lusyilalyo, 6.-lusyisya, 7.-lusya-lusya, 8.-lusyanya)
  • weave with, Eeci cisuwo ncibotu nkaambo bacembele bakalusya lutende lubotu. = This basket is beautiful because the old woman weaved it with a good lutende plant.

be in a frenzy, Wiide kulutauka nkwayanda kulwana. = He is in a frenzy wanting to fight. (1.-lutaukwa, 2.-lutaukide, 3.-lutauzya, 4.-lutaukila. 5.-lutaukilalyo, 6.-lutaukisya, 7.-lutaukalutauka, 8.-lutukana) Also: -lulauka, -lutungana.
be in an angry state, Mooya wakalilutide kumeso. = Mooya had an angry face.

become angry, Wakalutila akaambo kakuti bausyi tiibakaula ncaakali kuyanda. She was angry as her father didn't buy her what she wanted. Tiindakali kuyanda kuti tuswaane meso nkaambo naakandibona ndakalilutide. = I did not want our eyes to meet because then he would see that I was full of anger. (1.-lutilwa, 2.-lutide, 3.-lutizya, 4.-lutilila, 5.-lutililalyo, 6.-lutilisya, 7.-lutila-lutila Also: -nyema, -kalala, -bilila.
  • be vigourous, Naakabona mapopwe akomena kabotu mumuunda wakwe, wakalutila kwaalimina. = When he saw how well the maize was growing in his field, he weeded it vigourously.
make energetic, be worked up, Ingoma yabukali yakamulutizya. = The war drum worked him up.
make mad, Mbukali bwakabalutizizye. It is anger which made them mad.

tell, rt. -luula, Ndakajana bataata basika kale baluuda bamaama makani. I found my father telling my mother the news. Also: -Iwiida (1.-luudwa, 2.-Iwiide, 3.-luuzya, 4.-Iwiida, 5.-Iwiidalyo, 6.-luulisya, 7.-luuda-luuda, 8.-luudana)

relate the facts, report an event, Wakazikuluula naakazyila kumuswaangano nkwaakatumidwe. = She reported the facts when she came from the meeting to which she had been sent. (1.-luulwa, etc. as with -luuda)
  • kuliluula = be proud in what you have done, Tacili cibotu kuliluula ncocita. = It is not good to boast about what you do. Also: -dunda.

shake the head, Kuli bakaliko acilawo, asunu baluuzya biyo mitwe. = For those who were present at that place, even now they just shake their heads. Myuunda yaminsale mmipati cakuti waibona inga waide kuluuzya mutwe. = The fields of sugar-cane are so big that whoever sees them just shakes his/her head.

eat ravenously, Ina Simweete, saa kuluvwula kwalo nyama nkokukwaambya boobu. Mother of Simweete, is it because you have devoured meat that makes you talk like that. (1.-luvwulwa, 2.-luvwide, 3.-luvwuzya, 4.-luvwida, 5.-luvwidalyo, 6.luvwulisya, 7.-luvwula-luvwula, 8.-luvwulana)

turn or jerk head to side, Waluwa naamvwa cinunka. = She turned her head aside when she smelt the stink. Naatiinduume lubayi, ndalomya buya kuluwa. When he was about to slap me, I cleverly dodged aside. (1.-luwigwa, 2.-luwide, 3.-luwizya, 4.-luwila, 5.-luwilalyo, 6.-luwisya, 7.-luwa-luwa, 8.-luwana) Also: -puwa, -puwama, -luwama, -zibuka.

oversalt, Waciluzya cisyu naabikka munyo munji. You have oversalted the relish by putting too much salt. (1.-luzyigwa, 2.-luzyide, 3.-luzyisya, 4.-luzyila, 5.-luzilalyo, 6.-luzyisya, 7.-luzya-luzya, 8.-luzyanya) Also: -sunsa, -bwenga, -luminizya.
break out, as a fight, Yalwa nkondo mumunzi mwa Hanapakila. = A fight broke out in the village of Hanapakila. (2.-Iwide, 3.-Iwanya, 4.-Iwanina, 5.-Iwaninalyo, 6.-Iwanisya, 7.-Iwa-Iwa, 8.-Iwana)

be sick, Bacembele baamba kuti ulalwala mwana wabo. = The old woman said that her child was sick. Bantu banji bakajaigwa antomba. Pele munene walo taakalwala akulwala pe. = Many died from the smallpox, but the old man himself did not become sick at all. Mwaalumi ulalwala nkaambo kacizimo ncanjidwe. The husband is sick because of the spirits which possess him. Also: -ciswa. (2-Iwalide, 4.-Iwalila, 5.-Iwalilayo, 6.-Iwalisya, 7.-Iwala-lwala)

fight among one another, Kamuleka kulwana mulacisana nywebo. = Stop fighting among one another, you will hurt each other. (1.-Iwanwa, 2.-Iwanide, 3.-Iwanya, 4.-Iwanina, 5.-Iwaninalyo, 6.-Iwanisya, 7.-Iwana-Iwana, 8.-Iwana.)
fight over or for, Basimbi bobilo bakali kulwanina musankwa. = Two girls were fighting over a boy. *Twakali kulwanina cisi cesu.* = We were fighting for our country.

take care of a sick person, *Baama bali kukulwazya mwana uuciswa kucibbadela.* = Mother is taking care of the child who is sick in the hospital. (1.-*Iwazyigwa*, 2.-*Iwazyide*, 3.-*Iwazyizya*, 4.-*Iwazyila*, 5.-*Iwazyilalyo*, 6.-*Iwazyisya*, 7.-*Iwazya-Iwazya*, 8.-*Iwazyanya*)

be sweet, *Ccuka lila-Iweela kapati.* = Sugar is very sweet. *Kunyina cilweela mbuli busololi.* = Nothing is as sweet as leadership. (1.-*Iweezyegwa*, 2.-*Iweelede*, 3.-*Iweezya*, 4.-*Iweelela*, 5.-*Iweelelalyo*, 6.-*Iweelesya*, 7.-*Iweela-Iweela*) Also: *-nona, -ina* be tasty, *Kamubikka munyo mucisyu, ndiyanda cintu cilweela.* = Put salt in the relish, I want something tasty.
  • be seasoned, *Inyama yalweela munyo ilasamuna.* = Meat seasoned with salt fills one's appetite
make sweet, rt. *-Iweela*, *Wacilweezya cibwantu naabikka ccuka limbi.* = She made the sweet-beer sweet when she put more sugar.
cause stomach to be agitated, *Kulila kwasyuumbwa kwakamu-Iwelula mwida.* = The roaring of the lion upset his stomach.

be torn, *Musinsi wangu walwenduka kusikila amoombe.* = My skirt is torn right down to the hem. (1.-*Iwendukwa*, 2.-*Iwendukide*, 3.-*Iwenduzya*, 4.-*Iwendukila*, 5.-*Iwendukilalyo*, 6.-*Iwendukisya*, 7.-*Iwenduka -Iwenduka*) Also: *-ndeluka, -ndeuka.*

tear a piece off, tear length-ways, *Kolwendula kasani kasyoonto kuzwa kucitenge.* = Tear off a small piece of cloth from the citenge. Also: *-nwezula* (1.-*Iwendulwa*, 2.-*Iwendwide*, 3.-*Iwenduzya*, 4.-*Iwendwida*, 5.-*Iwendwidalyo*, 6.-*Iwendulisya* 7.-*Iwendula-Iwendula*, 8.-*Iwendulana*)

curse, bring down evil upon, *Wandilweza mwana naanditukila kakunyina kaambo.* = The child cursed me when it insulted me without reason. (i.e. the cursing of the child brings future evil, as a child is not supposed to curse an elder.) *Mazuba akaindi Batonga bakalijisi zintu nzyobakali kuti zilalweza pesi mazubaano kunyina citondwa kuli bamwi.* = In past days the Batonga regarded certain things or deeds as bringing evil, but nowadays nothing is taboo for some. *Syabufwuma bulalweza, buyusukila mbobwami.* = The one who rushes brings down evil, the one starts late finds prosperity. (1.-*Iwezegwa*, 2.-*Iwezyede*, 3.-*Iwezyesya*, 4.-*Iwezela*, 5.-*Iwezelalyo*, 6.-*Iwezesya*, 7.-*Iweza-Iweza*, 8.-*Iwazyanya*)
be cursed, *Mapenzi angu avwulisya, antela ndalwezegwa.* = I have had so much troubles, perhaps I have been cursed. Also: *-Iwezwa.*

be cursed, *Wakafwusa masumo onse, nkabela akawida munkombe lyakwe. Wakalwezwa!* = He threw all the spears, but they fell in front of him (missing the target). He (the thrower) was cursed! (2.-*Iwezyede*, 3.-*Iwezyezyegwa*, 4.-*Iwezyelwa*, 5.-*Iwezyelwalyo*, 6.-*Iwezesya*, 7.-*Iwezwa-lwezwa*, 8.-*Iwezyezyanya*)
be an evil omen, *Wandi-Iwezya jule naandiingila mulweendo Iwangu.* = The secretary bird became an evil omen for me when it crossed the path in front of me.

become involved in a serious fight, rt. *-Iwa*, *Yakamulwida nkondo njombe zyakwe nizyakalya mapopwe okwa Haacisamu.* = He became involved in a fight, when his cattle ate Haacisamu's maize. (1.-*Iwidwa*, 2.-*Iwidide*, 3.-*Iwizya*, 4.-*Iwidila*, 5.-*Iwidilalyo*, 6.-*Iwidisya*, 7.-*Iwida-Iwida*, 8.-*Iwidanya*)

explain to, rt. -*luula*, *Ndakamujana kalwiida mweenzinyina zyanduwe.* = I found him talking to his friend about your affairs. (1.-*Iwiidwa*, 2.-*Iwiide*, 3.-*Iwiizya*, 4.-*Iwiidila*, 5.-*Iwiidilalyo*, 6.-*Iwiidisya*, 7.-*Iwiida-Iwiida*, 8.-*Iwiidana*)

be angry, *Inzoka yakalwiila niyakaumwa bbwe.* = The snake became angry when it was struck by a stone. (1.-*Iwiilwa*, 2.-*Iwiilide*, 3.-*Iwiizya*, 4.-*Iwiilila*, 5.-*Iwiililalyo*, 6.-*Iwiilisya*, 7.-*Iwiila-Iwiila*, 8.-*Iwiilana*) Also: -nyema.

give birth for first time, *Naakalondelela mazuba akuti azyalwe mwana, bakaintu bakaunka kwabo nkaambo kwakali kwalwiiya.* = When the time drew near to give birth, the wife went to her home because that was her first time to give birth. (2.-*Iwiide*)

embitter, make angry, rt. *Iwiila*, *Bavwimi bakamulwiizya munyati ngubakatobola ntobolo.* = The hunters made the buffalo angry which they wounded it with a gun. Also: -nyemya, -kalazya. (1.-*Iwiizyigwa*, 2.-*Iwiizyide*, 3.-*Iwiizyisya*, 4.-*Iwiizyizya*, 5.-*Iwiizyizyalyo*, 6.-*Iwiizyisya*, 7.-*Iwiizya-lwiizya*, 8.-*Iwiizyanya*)

fight against, rt. -*lwa*, *Katumulwisya sinkondoma.* = Let us fight against our enemy. (1.-*Iwisyigwa*, 2.-*Iwisyide*, 3.-*Iwisyizya*, 4.-*Iwisyila*, 5.-*Iwisyilalyo*, 6.-*Iwisyisya*, 7.-*IwisyaIwisya*, 8.-*Iwisyanya*)
  • carry out hard work, *Twakazumanana kulwisya mulimo wakuuma zitina kusikila twakaumana.* = We persevered in the work of making bricks until we finished it.

eat, *Twakalya kabotu twakakkuta.* = We ate well, we were satisfied. *Twakalya ndala.* = We ate the food prepared the night before. (1.-*ligwa*, 2.-*lide*, 3.-*lisya* 4.-*lida* 5.-*lidalyo*, 6.-*lisya*, 7.-*lyaalya*.)
  • eat the name, i.e. inherit the spirit, *Bakasala bantu botatwe kuti umwi abe nguusalazya akulya zina.* = They selected three people out of which one would purify the widow and inherit the name of the dead person.
  • discuss, *Chimuka bakanjila munanda amunene Luumajombe kuya kulya makani.* = Chimuka entered the house with the old man Luumarjombe to discuss the matter.
  • take from, deprive, *Wakajoka kulonda ambi mali nkaambo oonse ngaakatolede bakamulya anjuka.* = He returned to look for more money because everything he had brought they had taken from him at cards.
  • become happy in taking revenge, *Bantu bamumunzi bakamulya coolwe Mutinta.* = The people of the village were happy to have time to punish Mutinta.
  • make oneself a slave to, *Mucembele ndalilya kuli nduwe.* = Old woman I make myself your slave.
  • benefit from someones ability, *Mainza wakali kulya masuku atalaa mutwe wamweenzinyina.* = Mainza was benefiting from the work of his friend.
  • yawn = -*lya mwao*, -*lya mwau*, -*lya mwayi*
kiss passionately, *Bakatalika kulyana cilakalaka.* = They began to kiss passionatey. Also: -*lyana nkwela*. (2.-*lyanide*, 4.-*lyanina*, 5.-*lyaninalyo*, 6.-*lyanisya*, 7.-*lyana-lyana*, 8.-*lyana*)

walk on toes, rt. -*lyata*, e..g. *Wakatalikide kweenda mumudima cakusobelela kalyasya tunwe mpela nkaambo akali bwina eno taakaabwene.* = He began to walk in the dark carefully and on tip-toes because the hole could not be seen.

step on, Bamulyata kalede ansi akaambo kakuti tiibamubwene. = They stepped on him when he lay on the ground because they did not see him. (1.-lyatwa, 2.-lyatide, 3.-lyatya, 4.-lyatila, 5.-lyatilalyo, 6.-lyatisya, 7.-lyata-lyata, 8.-lyatana)
  • attack, Bakatulyata Basitukumba nibakazikubba nombe zyesu. = The Balozi attacked us when they came to steal our cattle.
step on repeatedly, Nalangilila bbola inga kwadibuka ansi nkwati walyata-lyata. As he watches the football he raises the dust by stamping repeatedly on the ground.
step on one another, Basikube kunyina nibalyatana. = Vultures never step on one another.

step on someone or something, Bakamulyatauka kalede ansi kutali kusobana. They trampled on him terribly while he was lying down. (1.-lyataukwa, 2.-lyataukide, 3.-lyataukizya, 4.-lyataukila, 5.-lyataukilalyo, 6.-lyataukisya, 7.-lyatauka-lyatauka, 8.-lyataukana)

remove your foot from, change position of one's feet, KociIyatuka cikuni eci, njanda kucitola kunanda. Remove your foot from this log. I want to take it home. (1.-lyatukwa, 2.-lyatukide, 3.-lyatusya, 4.-lyatukila, 5.-lyatukilalyo, 6.-lyatukisya, 7.-lyatukalyatuka, 8.-lyatukana)

rain heavily, Yakalyobola mvwula cifwumofwumo coonse kusikila acilungulungu. It rained heavily the whole morning until noon. Also: -cobola, -buuluka. (1.-lyobolwa, 2.-lyobwede, 3.-lyobozya, 4.-lyobolela, 5.-lyobolelalyo, 6.-lyobolesya, 7.-lyobola-lyobola)

rest oneself, rt. -okezya, Wamana kubeleka, weelede kulyookezya. = When you have finished working you ought to rest yourself. (1.-lyookezyegwa, 2.-lyookezyede, 3.-lyookezyezya, 4.-lyookezyela, 5.lyookezyelalyo, 6.-lyookezyesya, 7.-lyookezya-lyookezya.)

hold, clasp, put between, Komaka sizi lyamulilo alumano. = Hold the ember with the thongs. Eeli bbuku ndalimaka munkwa. = I held this book under my armpit. (1.-makwa, 2.-makide, 3.-makizya, 4.-makila, 5.-makilalyo, 6.-makisya, 7.-maka-maka, 8.-makana)

walk slowly with pain, Baya bantu balaa zinowe balamamaila kweenda. Those people who have corns walk painfully. (1.-mamailwa, 2.-mamailide, 3.-mamaizya, 4.-mamailila, 5.-mamaililalyo, 6.-mamailisya, 7.-mamaila-mamaila) Also: -swaswaila.

pull vigorously, Basankwa bakamamanyana kukwelana. = The boys pulled vigorously in the tug-ofwar. (1.-mamanyanwa, 2.-mamanyanide, 3.-mamanyizya, 4.-mamanyanina, 5.-mamanyaninalyo, 6.-mamanyanisya, 7.-mamanyana-mamanyana, 8.-mamanyaninana) Also: -duunyana.
handle with care, Mwaalumi wakalijisi mayi manji mumutiba walo cakamupa kuyabumamelela kweenda. The man had many eggs in a dish and this made him handle them with care as he walked.

shake in delight, Walo tanaakabona kuti mwaalumi wakwe wasika, wakali kwiide kubala buyo lugwalo, kwamamuka matwi, lumwemwe mbwee. = She herself did not notice that her husband had arrived, she was just reading the letter, her ears moved in joy showing a broad smile. (1.-mamukwa, 2.-mamukide, 3.-mamuzya, 4.-mamukila, 5.-mamukilalyo, 6.-mamukisya, 7.-mamuka-mamuka)

open the mouth, *Komamuna mulomo uwambaule.* = Open your mouth and speak. *Muyuni wakamamuna mulomo akulosezya nweenwe mumeenda.* = The bird opened its mouth causing the finger-ring to fall into the water. *Buzuba bwatatu kumazuba muIwazi wakamamuna mulomo akutalika kukanana.* On the evening of the third day the patient opened her mouth and began to talk. Also: -bbatula, -mwendula mulomo (1.-mamunwa, 2.-mamwide, 3.-татиnya, 4.-mamunina, 5.-mamuninanlyo, 6.-mamunisya, 7.-mamuna-mamuna, 8.-mamunana)
  • *`cimamuna mulomo'*i.e. the first money given to parents of bride before marriage negotiations begin.

end, finish, *Sena mwamana kale kubeleka mulimo uulya?* = Have you already finished that work? *Lwiiyo Iwesu Iwamana sunu.* = Our learning has finished today. (1.-manwa, 2.-manide, 3.-manya, 4.-manina, 5.-maninalyo, 6.-manisya, 7.-mana-mana, 8.-manana.)
  • hold with thongs, *Bakali kumana makala amulilo alumano.* = They were holding the burning charcoal with the thongs. Also: -maka.

cluster together, as fruit, *Insaansa zizyede kabotu, zilamandana.* The grapes of vines which have produced well, grow in bunches. Also: -sumbatana. (1.-mandanwa, 2.-mandanide, 3.-mandanya, 4.-mandanina, 5.-mandaninalyo, 6.-mandanisya, 7.-mandana-mandana)

hold on to, as with two hands, hold down, tuck in, *Nindawa mumusamu, ndazikulimanga amutabi.* = When I fell from the tree, I clung to a branch. *Basicikolo bakamanga masyaati aabo kutegwa aleke kupepela.* = The pupils tucked in their shirts so that they would not blow about. (1.-mangwa, 2.-mangide, 3.-manzya, 4.-mangila, 5.-mangilalyo, 6.-mangisya, 7.-manga-manga, 8.-mangana)
  • insert between, *Kamumanga kapepa kasyoonto akati kamapeeji abbuku.* = Insert the bit of paper between the pages of the book. Also: -manika.

produce, as a mealie-cob, *Mapopwe amanika bana.* = The maize is producing cobs. (1.-manikwa, 2.-manikide, 3.manisya, 4.-manikila, 5.-manikilalyo, 6.-manikisya, 7.manika-manika, 8.-manikana)
  • place between, *Komanika mali akati kamabbuku kutegwa bana bataaboni.* = Place the money between the books so that the children do not see it. Also: -manga.

be squeezed, rt. -ma nika, *Ndamanikila, ndabula mbwekkala kabotu.* = I am squashed, I have not enough space to sit properly. *Kulaca, lilabbila ncejana nkumanikila, nkufwidilila.* = From morning to night all I experience is being squeezed and suffocated. *Nsaku ezyo nozyakasinizya kukomena, mapopwe akamanikila akutakomena kabotu.* = When those weeds began to grow strongly, the maize was choked and did not do well. (1.-manikilwa, 2.-manikide, 3.-manikizya, 4.-manikila, 5.-manikilalyo, 6.-manikisya. 7.-maikila-manikila, 8.-manikilana)
catch, *Basilikani bakali afwaafwi aboobo bakafwambaana kumumanikizya mubbi.* = The police were near and so were quick to arrest him.

finish completely, rt. manizya, *Komaninizya kulimina kutegwa utacibooli alimwi.* = Completely finish weeding so that you do not have to come again. *Kamucimaninizya cibwantu munongo.* = Finish off the sweet beer in the pot. (1.-manizyigwa, 2.-manizyizye, 4.-maninizyizya, 5.-maninizyizyalyo, 6.-maninizyisya, 7.-maninizya-maninizya, 8.-maninizyanya)

complete, finish, Kamumanizya kukukula tombe kutegwa kusalale. = Finish sweeping up that dirt to make the place clean. *Bana baumanizya musozya mucibiya.* = The children have finished off the samp in the pot. *Bina Simweete mbabeelede kuti bamanizye milala.* = The mother of Simweete ought to be the one who finishes the funeral rituals. (1.-manizyigwa, 2.-manizyide, 3.-manizyizya, 4.-manizyila, 5.-manizyilalyo, 6.-manizyisya, 7.-manizya-manizya, 8.-manizyanya)

snatch, *Mubwa waimanka nyama niyaloka ansi.* = The dog snatched the meat when it fell on the ground. (1.-mankwa, 2.-mankide, 3.-mankizya, 4.-mankila, 5.-mankilalyo, 6.-mankisya, 7.-manka-manka, 8.-mankana) Also: -kwaba.

snap, *Nketani yamansuka nitwali kukwela cisamu cilemu.* = The chain snapped when we were pulling a heavy log.
  • work hard without reward, *Bamakaintu bakali kumansuka kupwaya mabwe pesi kunyina ncibakapegwa.* = The women were working hard crushing stones but were not given any payment.

be slow in giving, give in bits, *Mutinta ulamansyamansya kupa cakulya.* = Mutinta gives food in bits. (1.-mansyigwa-mansyigwa, 2.-mansyide-mansyide, mansyizya, 4.-mansyila-mansyila, 3.-mansyizya5.-mansyilalyo-mansyilalyo, 6.-mansyisyamansyisya, 7.-mansya-mansya, 8.-mansyanya-mansyanya) Also: -nonzya-nonzya.

make short jumps as a frog, *Kweenda umantauka buya mbuli cula usotoka.* = When walking he jumps with short steps like a frog. *Utani kwiile kumantauka kwaamba.* = Don't be jumping from one topic to another. *Mutinta wakamvwa buyo kumantauka kwambeba zyakali kusokonya.* = Mutinta just heard the jumping about of the rats which were making noise. (1.-mantaukwa, 2.-mantaukide, 3.-mantauzya, 4.-mantaukila, 5.-mantaukilalyo, 6.-mantaukisya, 7.-mantauka-mantauka, 8.-mantaukana) Also: -butuuka.
  • move frequently from one place to another, e.g *Milimo takkalikili mpaayaka, ngwakumantauka ciindi coonse.* = Milimo does not settle where he builds, he is fond of moving from one place to another all the time.
be weary after long exertion, *Bakali kumanuka kubeleka pesi kunyina ncibakajana.* = They were weary from working but they found nothing.

be ill after long exertion, *Kuti kobeleka kapati inga wamanukilwa.* = If you work hard you will be ill. *Mwana wiile kuswa bulowa akaambo kakumanukilwa.* = The child is just spitting blood because of over-exertion. *Ndakatiimanukilwe kulila nookaangwa.* = I was about to become ill because I cried too much when you were arrested. (2.-manukide, 3.-manukizya, 4.-manukilila, 5.-manukililalyo, 6.-manukilisya, 7.-manukilwa-manukilwa, 8.-manukizyanya)
  • over-excite, *Koleka kudekaanya mwana, ulamanukilwa.* = Stop tickling the child, it will become over-excited.

take out a thing which was mixed up with others, *Kamumanuna munsu kumape.* = Take out the pollen from the honey combs. (1.-manunwa, 2.-manwide, 3.-manuzya, 4.-manwida, 5.-manwidalyo, 6.-manunisya, 7.-manuna-manuna, 8.-manunana)
  • open, Komumanuna mulomo mwana kutegwa ndimunywisye musamu. = Open the child's mouth so that I make it drink the medicine. Also: -bbatula.

cause to end, rt. -mana. Beembela baamanya basune mapopwe. = The herders have caused the oxen to finish off the maize. (1.-manyizyigwa, 2.-manyizyide, 4.-manyizyizya, 5.-manyizyizyalyo, 6.-manyizyisya, 7.-manya-manya, 8.-manyizyanya)

knock hard, (tribal custom of the past) Mudaala naakali kubanga musimbi, wakali _kumanyuna_ buyo. = When the old man was knocking out the teeth of the girl, he hit hard. cf. -banga. Kusya nyika njumu _nkumanyuna_. = To dig hard earth is to strike hard. Also: -ganyuna. (1.-manyunwa, 2.-manywide, 3.-manyuzya, 4.-manywida, 5.-manywidalyo, 6.-manyunisya 7.-manyuna-manyuna, 8.-manyunana)

report, Kuti wabbidwa nombe, uleelede kuya kumaņala kumasilikani. If your cattle are stolen, you ought to go and report it to the police. (1.-marnalwa, 2.-manalide, 3.-maņazya, 4.-marnalila, 5.-marnalilalyo, 6.-manalisya, 7.-manala-manala, 8.-maņalana)
put in a claim to the authorities against someone, sue = Ndakamumanalila. I put in a claim against him. Also: -ceta, -tetela

plaster, Kamumata bulongo ananda iijikila kutegwa ileke kulibonya kumatauka. Plaster the kitchen with dagga so that it stops falling off. Bacembele bamata kabbule abulongo busubila. The old woman is plastering the groundnut bin with red clay. (1-matwa, 2.-matide, 3.-matya, 4-.matila, 5.-matilalyo, 6.-matisya, 7.-mata-mata, 8.-matana.)
  • strike, Inga mbubakapompela, nkaanga sulwe kakamumata suntwe kasako kaandelo. As soon as they appeared, the hare hit the hyena with a stick across the shoulders.
  • run fast, Mubbi naakabona bamuyandaula, wakamata kuya musyokwe kuya kuyuba. When the thief saw those who were searching for him, he fled into the bush to hide. Also: -lunduka.

fall off, as plaster, rt. -mata, Bulongo mbutwakamatide ananda ijikila bwakamatauka. The clay with which we plastered the kitchen has fallen off. (1.-mataukwa, 2.-mataukide, 3.-matauzya, 4.-mataukila, 5.-mataukilalyo, 6.-matukisya, 7.-matauka-matauka) Also: -gomooka, -bbabuka.
be disconnected when speaking, Kwaambaula koonse walikwiide kumatausya. = All his conversation was disconnected.

detach plaster, rip off, rt. mata, Bali kubumatula buya bulongo obu bana aba. These children were just taking off the plaster. Cimboko ncaakali kumuumya ncicakamumatula. The sjambok which he was beating him with, is what ripped off his skin. (1.-matulwa, 2.-matukide, 3.-matuzya, 4.-matwida, 5.-matwidalyo, 6.-matulisya, 7.-matulamatula, 8.-matulana)
plaster with, Bulongo bumwi mbubotu kumatya maanda. = Some clay is good for plastering houses. (1.-matisigwa, 2.-matide, 4.-matila, 5.-matilalyo, 6.-matisya, 7.-matya-matya, 8.-matana)
replaster, take out plaster, Bali kumatulula mpocatakamatidwe kabotu. They were replastering where it had not been plastered properly. Kamu

bulongo busiya tubikke butuba. = Take out the black plaster and put white plaster. (1.-matululwa, 2.-matuIwide, 3.-matuluzya, 4.-matulwida, 5.-matulwidalyo, 6.-matululisya, 7.-matulula-matulula, 8.-matululana)

swagger, swing one's body when walking, Muntu uneneede umbokaila buya kweenda. A fat person just swings the body when walking. (1.-mbokailwa, 2.-mbokailide, 3.-mbokaizya, 4.-mbokailila, 5.-mbokaililalyo, 6.-mbokailisya, 7.-mbokaila-mbokaila) Also: -wizauka.

fail to emerge, sink for good, Insangu zyakkabbicci zyakambombomena. The seeds of the cabbage never germinated. Mapopwe taakamena, akaile kumbombomena. = The maize never germinated, it failed to emerge. Musambazi naakali kusola kuzabuka mulonga wa Kafwuwe, cikwepe cakadenuka, nkabela mootokala wakwe wakambombomena. When the trader was crossing the Kafuwe river, the pontoon capsized, thereupon his vehicle sank down. Also: -bbaamina. (1.-mbombomenwa, 2.-mbombomede, 3.-mbombomezya, 4.-mbombomenena, 5.-mbombomenenalyo, 6.-mbombomesya, 7.-mbombomena-mbombomena)
roll down as tears, Misozi yambulumuka kapati. = The tears flowed freely. Also: -kulumbuka, -lakatika
make thick, Wakacimbumbunganya cibiya naakabikka bulongo bunji. She made the pot very thick when she put more clay on it. Also: -fwumfwumenye, -tuntumenye.

humble oneself Wakali kulimbumbusika nkaambo nkuumakwe. = He was acting in a humble way because he was at the in-laws. (1.-mbumbusikwa, 2.-mbumbusikide, 3.-mbumbusizya, 4.-mbumbusikila. 5.-mbumbusikilalyo, 6.-mbumbusikisya, 7.-mbumbusika-mbumusika) Also: (kuli)-bbubbunyika.

throw down, Wakalimbwanka mizinga ansi. = He threw himself down with a crash to the ground. (1.-mbwankwa, 2.-mbwankide, 3.-mbwankizya, 4.-mbwankila, 5.-mbwankilalyo, 6.-mbwankisya, 7.-mbwanka-mbwanka, 8.-mbwankana) Also: -denketa.

fall off, as fruit from a tree, in large numbers, Masuku abizwa alambwela ansi. When the masuku fruits are ripe, they fall to the ground in large numbers. (1.-mbwelwa, 2.-mbwelede, 7.-mbwelambwela) Also: -lembweteka, kulumbuka.

coming out, as tears without crying loudly, sobbing, Misozi yambwelemuka nindabona mulavwu wandiyoosya kapati. = Tears dropped when I saw the lion who terrified me. (1.-mbwelemukwa, 2.-mbwelemukide, 3.- mbwelemusya, 4.-mbwelemukila, 5.-mbwelemukilalyo, 6.-mbwelemukisya, 7.-mbwelemuka-mbwelemuka)
stroll along, Kavwili munsuti isiya wakali kuyabumbwendaila kweenda amukaintu wakwe Nabulongo kabotu-kabotu. Kavwili in a black suit was strolling along slowly with his wife Nabulongo.

run about naked, Zyana zilambwimbwilika amantanda anze. = The children are running around naked. (1.-mbwimbwilikwa, 2.-mbwimbwilikide, 3.-mbwimbwilisya, 4.-mbwimbwilikila, 5.-mbwimbwilikilalyo, 6.-mbwimbwilikisya, 7.-mbwimbwilika-mbwimbwilika)
move quickly, e.g Bambwindingana kweenda. They moved quickly.

eat, finish food quickly, Nibakafwa nzala banyina bakakamedaula mbabo keele kamwana. = When the mother became hungry she finished off the child's bit of porridge herself. Mbwaakazwida biyo mweenzu, awalo mukaintu nkukwela keele kakwe muntebe, nkukamedaula. = As soon as the visitor departed, the woman pulled her bit of porridge from underneath and quickly ate it. (1.-medaulwa, 2.-medaulide, 3.-medauzya, 4.-medaulila, 5.-medaulilayo, 6.-medaulisya, 7.-medaula-medaula, 8.-medaulana)

smile, as to entice or show off, Kasimbi kaya kacikuyanda, tonookakabwene mu Nsondo nikakali kumeka? = That girl still loves you, did you not see her on Sunday how she was smiling to attract you. (1.-mekwa, 2.-mekede, 3.-mekezya, 4.-mekela, 5.-mekelalyo, 6.-mekesya, 7.-meka-meka, 8.-mekelana.)

flash continually as lightning, Imvwula yalikumekaula busiku boonse. = The lightning was flashing the whole night. (1.-mekaulwa, 2.-mekaulide, 3.-mekauzya, 4.-mekawida, 5.-mekawidalyo, 6.-mekaulisya, 7.-mekaula-mekaula, 8.-mekaulana)
  • sob with fear, Sicibende naakamvwa lyakunyoolwa wakamekaula, misozi yakaiba-iba. = When Sicibende heard about having his hair cut he cried with fear, the tears flowed.
show signs of love to, Mutinta umekela Juunza. = Mutinta shows signs of love to Juunza. (1.-mekwa, 2.-mekede, 3.-mekezya, 4.-mekela, 5.-mekelalyo, 6.-mekesya, 7.-mekela-mekela, 8.-mekelana)
report, sue, Bacembele bakamumema mulumi wabo kunkuta. = The old woman sued her husband. (1.-memwa, 2.-memede, 3.-memya, 4.-memema, 5.-mememalyo, 6.-memesya, 7.-mema-mema, 8.-memenana) Also: -zekela.

show facial expression of pain or disgust or revulsion, Ino Mutinta wabaa nzi nkomemenyana? = Mutinta what is wrong with you that you look disgusted like that? Banyina bakamemenyana kumeso kutondezya kusesemwa akaambo kamamina ngobakabona. = The mother screwed up her face in disgust to show revulsion about the nose mucous which she saw. (1.-memenyanwa, 2.-memenyene, 3.-memenyezya, 4.-memenyanina, 5.-memenyaninalyo, 6.-memenyanisya, 7.-memenyana-memenyana,)

germinate, Mapopwe akamena mumbewu. = The maize seeds germinated in the garden. (1.-menwa, 2.-menede, 3.-menezya, 4.-menena, 5.-menenalyo, 6.-menesya, 7.-menamena.)
  • shoot out as new feathers, Tukuku twamena mapepe. = The chicks have started growing feathers.
  • swallow, Inswi yamena kalobo, ilacegwa. = When a fish swallows a hook, it is caught. Anzyina kaka taanguna mena mate. First of all swallow your spittle. i.e. slow down, go easy; -mena buumbulu /gulyu or -mena budangala or -tangala = swallow without chewing
  • swallow a stone, Balozi bayeeya kuti bakamena bbwe ncobajaya beenzinyina. Witches think that they swaIlowed a stone that is why they bewitch their friends. (i.e. they think they will never die)
  • swallow the spirit, Tiicakatola ciindi kumana bupaapa boonse bwakumena muzimo. It did not take long to complete all the traditions of 'swallowing the spirit'.
  • become dangerous, Cisi casanduka, camena meja alimwi cazungaana mumbazu zyoonse zyabuumi. = The country has changed, it has become dangerous, it is shaken in all aspects of life.
inherit a spirit, Ooyu muzimo ngwenkanana waawa, ndakamenekwa ciindi taata Chikwaangala naakatusiya. This spirit I am talking about here, I inherited the time my father Chikwaangala died.
desire, Babbi balazimenena nombe zineneede. = Thieves covet fat cattle. Also: -nyomenena. (1.-menenwa, 8.-menenana)

mutual inheriting of two or more individuals of the same clan of the spirit of one who has died, Oku kumenenana muzimo kwakali kucita kuti muzimo wasikufwa utakababweedi. = This inheriting of the spirit was done so that the (otherwise uncared for) spirit of the dead person would not return to them (to bring trouble). Kumenenana muzimo tookwakali kumenenanwa buyo, cakali camumikowa. This mutual inheriting of the spirit was not just a matter of merely inheriting, it was based on close relationships within the clan concerned.

be desired, rt. -menena, Impongo zimenenwa abantu banji, zilabbigwa. = Goats which are desired by many people, are stolen. Also: -nyomenenwa.
  • have one's spirit inherited, Oyo watakali kujisi mikowa taakali kumenenwa muzimo. = That one who had no relatives had no one to inherit his/her spirit.

cause to germinate, rt. mena, Meenda ngaamenesya nsangu. Water is what makes the seed grow. Imvwula ntaanzi imenesya mapopwe. The first rains make the maize sprout. (proverb) (1.-menesyegwa, 2.-menede, 3.-menesya, 4.-menena, 5.-menenalyo, 6.-menesya, 7.-menesya-menesya)
shine, Lukanda Iwakwe Iwakali kumenkesa ulati mooye wakacizwa akuvwundikwa. = Her skin was shining, you would say like a girl just coming out from initiation.

make bright, Mafwuta waanana kapati, aile kumumenkesya kumeso. When you smear plenty of oil on the face, it makes it shine brightly. (1.-menkesyegwa, 2.-menkesyede, 4.-menkesyela, 5.-menkesyelalyo, 6.-menkesyesya, 7.-menkesya-menkesya, 8.-menkesyanya)

become angry, Bantu boonse bakaitidwe kumakani aya bakali kwiide kulimfwula mumpemo nkobakati bafwundilila muzyamba. All the people who were called to this meeting were very furious about it, breathing heavily.

be very cold, Ndamfwunduka mpeyo mebo. I am penetrated with the cold. Also: -fwunduka. (1.-mfwundukwa, 2.-mfwundukide, 3.-mfwundusya, 4.-mfwundukila, 5.-mfwundukilalyo, 6.-mfwundukisya, 7.-mfwunduka-mfwunduka)
sit quietly in a bent position, Ngonguwe ulya danki umfwuntyumene waalya. = He is that weasel who sits quietly hunched up over there.

crowd over, Tunyenyene tulamilila buleke bukamina mukupa. = The black ants were crowding on top of the milking can. (1.-mililwa, 2.-mililide, 3.-milizya, 4.-mililila, 5.-milililalyo, 6.-mulilisya, 7.-milila-milila) Also: -bumbilila
  • groan, sob, be in labour pains, Musimbi naakali kutumbuka wakali kumilila ciindi cilamfwu. When the girl was giving birth she was in labour pains for a long time. Also: -tongela, - miningana.

ooze, trickle, Meenda alamimita mucikala. The water is trickling into the well. Mubili oonse wakali kumimita bulowa akaambo kabususuli amansenya. = The whole body was oozing blood because of the midges and mosquitoes. (1.-mimitwa, 2.-mimitide, 3.-mimitizya, 4.-mimitila, 5.-mimitilalyo, 6.-mimitilisya, 7.-mimita-mimita) Also: -fwininika, -zinza, -swininika.
blow nose, Komina mamina, watusesemya. = Remove the mucous from your nose, you are disgusting us. (1.-minwa, 2.-minide, 3.-minizya, 4.-minina, 5.-mininalyo, 6.-minisya, 7.-mina-mina)

writhe in severe pain, Muntu uciswa mwida ulaminingana kapati ceetezya. A person with stomach pains is pitiable as s/he writhes in agony. Mukaintu wakwe wakali kuminingana nkaambo ciindi cakutumbuka cakasika. = His wife was in labour because the time to give birth had arrived. Musankwa wali kuminingana naali kusola kubweza saka lyamapopwe. = The boy was struggling painfully when he was trying to lift a sack of maize. (1.-mininganwa, 2.-miningenye, 3.-mininganya, 4.-mininganina, 5.-mininganinalyo, 6.-mininganisya, 7.-miningana-miningana) Also: -myongosana, -culumba.
  • meander, Inzoka ilaminingana kweenda. A snake meanders as it moves.
be in a state of continuous torture, rt. -miningana, Ooyu muzoka naakaumwa wakaliminingene mpalede. = This snake when it was beaten was writhing where it lies.

collect water gradually which trickles into hole made in sand, Baama baminuna meenda mumusenga. = Mother is collecting the water which gathers in the sand. (1.-minunwa, 2.-minwide, 3.-minuzya, 4.-minwida, 5.-minwidalyo, 6.-minunisya, 7.-minunaminuna)
  • damage, Komujata kabotu mwana ulamuminuna. Hold the child carefully you will damage it. cf. -minyuna.

take out, strain off, Kwaaminununa meenda mumusozya avwulisya. = Strain off the water from the samp, it is too much. Kominununa bunyenyene buzwe mucibwantu. = Strain off the black ants from the sweet-beer. (1.-minununwa, 2.-minunwide, 3.-minunuzya, 4.-minunwida, 5.-minunwidalyo, 6.-minunisya 7.-minununa-minununa)

be exhausted, feel frustrated, Ndaminwa kujatilila malele. = I am weary holding the ladder. (1.-minizyigwa, 2.-minidwe, 3.-minya, 4.-mininwa, 5.mininwalyo, 6.-minisyigwa, 7.-minwa-minwa, 8.-minizyanya)

lie heavily on, go beyond one's control, Cilaminya basune, cikuni eeci cakomenesya. This log is oversize, it will exhaust the oxen. Mulimo wakulemba ulaminya. Writing makes one weary. Nkondo niyakaminya, sibbuku wakaita basilikani. When the fight got out of hand, the headman called the police. Imilimo yandiminya njetavwoleli mali. = Jobs for which I am not paid are a burden to me. (1.-minyizyigwa, 2.-munyide) Also: -limba, -oneka bubi.

damage, Mukuli mulemu nguwandiminyuna musana. = The heavy load damaged my back. Also: -minuna. (1.-minyunwa, 2.-minywide, 3.-minyuzya, 4.-minyunina, 5.-minyuninalyo, 6.-minyunisya, 7.-minyuna-minyuna, 8.-minyunana)

broadcast seed, Kominza nsangu zyamuliwa tukalye mainza. = Sow vegetable seeds so that we eat in the rainy season. (1.-minzigwa, 2.-minzide, 3.-minzizya, 4.-minzila, 5.-minzilalyo, 6.-minzisya, 7.-minza-minza.) Also: -syanga, -minzya.

broadcast seed, Ino bakaminzya cisyu nzi mumibundu eeyi? = What type of vegetable seed did they plant in these beds. Also: -syanga, -byala. (1.-minzyigwa, 2.-minzyide, 3.-minzyisya. 4.-minzyila, 5.-minzyilalyo, 6.-minzisya, 7.-minzya-minzya, 8.-minzyanya)

impregnate, make conceive, rt. -mita, Wakamumisya musyoonto wangu, mmwana aba Kapika. = The one who impregnated my young sister is the son of Kapika. Cheelo nguwakamisya Julia = Cheelo is the one who made Julia pregnant. Also: -mitisya, minsya. (1.-misyigwa, 2.-misyide, 3.-misya, 4.-misyizya, 5.-misyizyalyo, 6.-misyisya, 7.-misya-misya, 8.-misyanya)
conceive, Julia wakamita naakali mubbuku lyafwuka. = Julia conceived when she was in Grade 9. (1.-mitwa, 2.-mitide, 3.-misya, 4.-mitila, 5.-mitilalyo, 6.-mitisya 7.-mita-mita, 8.-misyanya.)

be in a state of pregnancy, Mwana wa Kapaso ulimitide. = The daughter of Kapaso is pregnant.
  • have great desire to see, Muntu wakandibbida basune bangu ndimumitide kapati. = I have a great desire to see the person who stole my oxen.
conceive at, Ino wakamitila kuli musimbi uulya? = Where did that girl conceive? Malina wakaakumitila ku Ndola. = Malina conceived at Ndola.
cause to conceive Webo nduwe wakamumitisya Mutinta. = It was you who made Mutinta pregnant. Nguni wakamitisya Kasyimbi? = Who impregnated Kasyimbi? Also: -misya.

wag the tail, Inombe zilamiza-miza micila nozicela. = The cattle are shaking their tails when grazing. 1.-mizwa-mizwa, 2.-mizide-mizide, 3.-mizisya-mizisya, 4.-mizila-mizila, 5.-mizilalyo-mzilalyo, 6.-mizisya-mizisya, 7.-mizamiza-mizamiza)

scatter seeds as in a field, Twali kumizya nyabo mumuunda kutegwa kukabe mbolezi. = We were scattering bean seeds in the field to increase the fertility. (1.-mizyigwa, 2.-mizyide, 3.-mizyisya, 4.-mizyizya, 5.-mizyizyalyo, 6.-mizyisyisya, 7.-mizya-mizya, 8.-mizyanya) Also: -minzya.

lower the face in joy, Mutinta takuli kumonga-monga akuseka-seka kukondwa. = Mutinta did she not lower her face and smile in happiness. (1.-mongwa, 2.-mongede, 3.-mongezya, 4.-mongela, 5.-mongelalyo, 6.-mongesya, 7.-monga-monga, 8.-mongelana)

pull out, as hair from head, Mulozi wakamojola masusu aamwana. = The witch pulled out the child's hair. Also: -jwa, -monsa. (1.-mojolwa, 2.-mojolede, 3.-mojozya, 4.-mojwela, 5.-mojwelalyo, 6.-mojwesya, 7.-mojola-mojola, 8.-mojolana)
lance, as a boil, Cicisa cakamonkoka. = The wound opened up. (1.-monkokwa, 2.-monkokede, 3.-monkozya, 4.-monkokela, 5.-monkokelalyo, 6.-monkokesya, 7.-monkoka-monkoka, 8.-monkokana)

make hole in cloth or skin in many places, Cisani ncaakaula cakamonkooka. = The garment which she bought had many holes. (1.-monkookwa, 2.-monkookede, 3.-monkoozya, 4.-monkookela, 5.-monkookelalyo, 6.-monkookesya, 7.-monkooka-konkooka) Also: -sinauka, -sunauka, -donkooka.

pluck out as feathers from bird, Basimbi bamonsa nkuku yajayigwa. = The girls are plucking the feathers of the slaughtered hen. Tumonsa sulwe. = We are removing the fur from the rabbit. (1.-monswa, 2.-monswede, 3.-monsya, 4.-monsela, 5.-monselalyo, 6.-monsesya, 7.-monsa-monsa, 8.-monsana) Also: -jwa.

moult, Yamonsauka nkuku njibajaya kwiinda mukwiilumya babwa. = The feathers came out of the hen which was killed by being bitten by the dogs. Impongo ziciswa cinkwankwa zilamonsauka boya. = Goats which suffer from the mange lose their hair. (1.-monsaukwa, 2.-monsaukide, 3.-monsauzya, 4.-monsaukila 5.-monsaukilalyo, 6.-monsaukisya, 7.-monsauka-monsauka) Also: -jundauka.

make to fall out, as hair, rt. -monsa, Malwazi amwi amonsaula masusu. = Some diseases make the hair fall out. (1.-monsaulwa, 2.-monsawide, 3.-monsauzya, 4.-monsaulila, 5.-monsaulila-lyo, 6.-monsaulisya, 7.-monsaula-monsaula, 8.-monsaulana)

peel off, Mungu wabola ulamonzoka. = When a pumpkin rots the skin comes off. Cikanda camwana camonzoka naatilwa meenda apya. = The child's skin came off when hot water was poured on it. Also: -bonzoka, -monkoka. (1.-monzokwa, 2.-monzokede, 3.-monzozya, 4.-monzokela, 5.-monzokelalyo, 6.-monzokesya, 7.-monzoka-monzoka)
peel off Also: -mozoka
peel off, as the skin, be scalded, Cikanda camwana wakapya cakamozoka = The skin of the child who was burnt peeled off. Also: -bambauka, -yabuka

quieten down, Munene wakalabalika citaambiki. Nabulongo wakalema kuswiilizya akumozyoozya kulabalika ooku. = The old man was raving in an unspeakable way. Nabulongo was tired listening and trying to quieten him down. Also: -umbulizya.

be deformed, be out of shape, Cigabba ncobakali kusambalila mapopwe cakampoonkana. = The tin in which they were selling maize was out of shape. (1.-mpoonkanwa, 2.-mpoonkene, 3.-mpoonkezya, 4.-mpoonkanina, 5.-mpoonkaninalyo, 6.-mpoonkanisya, 7.-mpoonkana-mpoonkana, 8.-mpoonkanizyanya) Also: -zeenyana, -poonkana.
beat, Nobakamana kumumpwekaula boobu, bakamujaya. = When they had finished beating him like that, they killed him.
stand still, Tokubwene sena kuti Nabulongo wacaala mpwekemanee, waide kupompoloka. = Did you not see that Nabulongo was left standing still, she was just without words.

be late, Wamuka kusika ncotakwe kwaatambula mali aako. = You have come late that is why you will not receive your money. (1.-mukwa, 2.-mukide, 3.-musya, 4.-mukila, 5.-mukilalyo, 6.-mukisya, 7.-muka-muka, 8.-musyanya.)
be late at or for, rt. -muka, Ino webo wamukila nzi, wali kutyani kumunzi? = Now you, what delayed you, what were you doing at home.

close mouth, Komuma mulomo nolya. = Close your mouth when you are eating. Wamumuma Mainza kumulomo. = He shut Mainza's mouth. (1.-mumwa, 2.-mumide, 3.-mumya, 4.-mumila, 5.-mumilalyo, 6.-mumisya, 7.-muma-muma, 8.-mumana)
laugh with mouth closed, giggle, Bakalikumikizya kuseka kutegwa batakumvwi bantu. = They were laughing eith closed mouths so that the people would not hear them.

munch, Mucembele wakali kumumunya buyo mai akaambo kakubula menyo aakulisya zintu ziyumu. = The old lady was just munching the eggs because she had no teeth for eating hard things. Basimbi balamumunya ivwu noba-sobana, pele meno abo alatuba buu. = Girls munch soil when they play, yet their teeth are pure white. (1.-mumunyigwa, 2.-mumunyide, 3.-mumunyizya, 4.-mumunyina, 5.-mumunyinalyo, 6.-mumunyisya, 7.-mumunya-mumunya) Also: -nyeela

light, shine, Akaambo kamudima wakali mupati, twakali kumunika biya kuti tubone nkotuya. Because the darkness was great, we used a light so that we could see where we were going. (1.-munikwa, 2.-munikide, 3.-munisya, 4.-munikila, 5.-munikilalyo, 6.-munikisya, 7.-munika-munika, 8.-munikana) =

give light to, Kondimunikila kandikubwene nkweunka. = Give some light for me so that I see where I am going. (1.-munikilwa, 2.-munikilide, 3.-munikilizya, 4.-munikilila, 5.-munikilalyo, 6.-munikilisya, 7.-munikila-munikila, 8.-munikilana)

delay, rt. muka, Bacembele batumunsya kuya kucikolo = The old lady delayed us going to school. (1.-munsyigwa, 2.-munsyide, 3.-munsya, 4.-munsyizya, 5.-munsyizyalyo, 6.-munsyisya, 7.-munsya-munsya, 8.-munsyanya) Also: -ccelesya, -musya.

be broken off, as rope, Camuntuka citolopo nitwakali kutambisya musune. = The leather strap broke when we were training the ox. Lwamuntuka lutambo lwangu. = My belt broke. (1.-muntukwa, 2.-muntukide, 3.-muntuzya, 4.-muntukila, 5.-muntukilalyo, 6.-muntukisya, 7.-muntuka-muntuka)

break off, as rope, Musune ulamuntula looye naangwa. = The ox snaps the rope when it is being tied. Inombe yalumuntula looye nindali kuyanda kukama. = The cow snapped the rope when I was about to milk it. (1.-muntulwa, 2.-muntwide, 3.-muntuzya, 4.-muntwida, 5.-muntwidalyo, 6.-muntulisya, 7.-muntula-muntula, 8.-muntulana) Also: -kosola, -zutula.

delay, cause to be late, rt. muka, Candimusya nkusanzya akusamika bana. What delayed me was washing and dressing the children. (1.-musyigwa, 2.-musyide, 3.-musya, 4.-musyizya, 5.-musyizyalyo, 6.-musyisya, 7.-musya-musya 8.-musyanya) Also: -ccelesya, -munsya.

understand, hear, sense, Sena wamvwa bayi ncibali kupandulula? = Have you understood what the teacher was explaining? (1.-mvwugwa, 2.-mvwide, 3.-mvwinsya, 4.-mvwida, 5.-mvwidalyo, 6.-mvwisya, 7.-mvwamvwa, 8.-mvwana.) =
  • agree to the divination of the diviner, as by casting bones or by listening to a hoe-handle, divine, Mwana naakaciswa bacembele bakaunka kumunanga kukumumvwa. = When the child was sick the old woman went to consult the diviner about it.

agree with one another, Baya bantu balamvwana cakwiindilila. Those people understand one another extremely well. Twamvwana kuti tuunke ku Monze. We have agreed to go to Monze. (1.-mvwanwa, 2.-mvwanide, 3.-mvwanisya, 4.-mvwanina, 5.-mvwaninalyo, 6.-mvwanisya, 7.-mvwanamvwana)

be in a crouched position, as in hiding, Mubbi wakamvwantama kuyuba basilikani. = The thief crouched down hiding from the police. (1.-mvwantamwa, 2.-mvwanteme, 3.-mvwantamya, 4.-mvwantamina, 5.-mvwantaminalyo, 6.-mvwantamisya, 7.-mvwantama-mvwantama, 8.-mvwantaminana) =
be in a hiding position, Wakabona muntu mupati uli- _mvwantamene_ mumatete manji. = He saw a big man hiding among many reeds.

hear from, rt. -mvwa, _Swebo twaakumvwida_ kwa Mpande kuti wafwa mwana. = We ourselves heard at Mpande's village that the child is dead. _Ndakumvwida_ ku Chilolo nooli kwiimba. = I heard you at Chilolo when you were singing. (1.mvwugwa, 2.-mvwide, 3.-mvwisya, 4.-mvwida, 5.-mvwidalyo, 6.-mvwisya, 7.-mvwa-mvwa, 8.-mvwana)
be in state of feeling or understanding, rt. -mvwa _Tamulimvwide_ zuba buya mbolyuumpa? = Are you not feeling the burning sun? _Tondimvwide ncengamba?_ = Don't you understand what I am saying?
be heard, rt. -mvwa, _Imebo ndamvwigwa abana bangu._ = I am understood by my children. Also: -mvwugwa, -teelelwa.

be sensed, _Cilamvwika_ kuti eci cabikkwa munyo. = It tastes that this has been salted.
  • be understandable, rt. -mvwa _Eeci cibalo cilamvwika._ = This topic (or chapter) is easily understood. _Majwi aaya taamvwiki._ = These words are not understandable.

make understand, understand fully, _Ndasyoma kuti mwamvwisya zintu nzindalikwaamba zyoonse._ = I hope you have fully understood all that I have been saying. _Ndamvwisya ncoamba._ = I perfectly understand what you say.

be understood, be intelligible, Musyobo wakali kukanana _mwami ulamvwugwa_ kubantu banji. = The language the chief was speaking was understood by many people. (2.-mvwide, 3.-mvwisya, 4.-mvwida, 5.-mvwidalyo, 6.-mvwinsya, 7.-mvwugwa, 8.-mvwana)

be stirred up, Inombe nozinjila muzyiba, maanzi alamvwundauka. = When the cattle enter the pond, the water is stirred up. (1.-mvwundaukwa, 2.-mvwundaukide, 3.-mvwundauzya, 4.-mvwundaukila, 5.-mvwundaukilalyo, 6.-mvwundaukisya, 7.-mvwundauka-mvwundauka, 8.-mvwundaukana) Also: -kondooka.
  • be nauseated, Kumoyo kwali kumvwundauka nitwamana kunywa bukoko busaside. = I felt like vomiting after drinking sour beer.

make a sudden move away from, Kachila wakaide kumvwundumuka mbuli kuti wabona cintu ciyoosya kapati. = Suddenly Kachila moved away quickly as if he had seen something terrible. (1.-mvwundumukwa, 2.-mvwundumukide, 3.-mvwundumusya, 4.-mvwundumukila, 5.-mvwundumukilalyo,6.-mwundumukisya, 7.-mvwundumuka-mvwundumuka,8.-vwundumukana)

bring peace, Ndakabamvwunya amajwi mabotu basankwa bakatiilwane jilo. = I brought peace with good words to the boys who almost fought yesterday. (1-mvwunwa, 2.-mvwunidwe, 3.-mvwunya, 4.-mvwunina, 5.-mvwuninalyo, 6.-mvwunisya, 7.-mvwunya-mvwunya, 8.-mvwunana) Also: -mvwanya
pluck, as a bird, Nitwakamana kumwa nkuku twakaitendaula akwiijika. = When we had finished plucking the chicken we cut it and cooked it. Also: -jwa, -monsa

be dispersed, rt. -mwaya, Bamwaika kale bantu boonse kudilwe. = All the people have already dispersed from the funeral. Also: -mwayuka, -zangauka. (1.-mwaikwa, 2.-mwaikide, 3.-mwaisya, 4.-mwaikila, 5.-mwaikilalyo, 6.-mwaikisya, 7.-mwaika-mwaika, 8.-mwaikana)

scatter, Bakwale bamwaikizyanya kuzwa mumuunda nibabona babwa. = The partridges scattered away from the field when they saw the dogs. Bamakaintu bakamwaikizyanya nibakabona muzovwu. = The women scattered when they saw an elephant. (1.-mwaikizyigwa, 2.-mwaikizyenye, 3.-mwaikizyanisya, 4.-mwaikizyanyizyigwa, 5.-mwaikizyanizyigwalyo, 7.-mwaikizyanya-mwaikizyanya) Also: -bbamukizyanya.
waste, rt. -mwaya, Ubamwaila buyo ciindi calo. You are just wasting their time.

be scattered over with, rt. -mwaya Izuba tiilyalikubala kabotu nkaambo julu lyoonse lwakamwailidwe makumbi aamvwula. = The sun was not shining well because the sky was always scattered with rain-clouds.

scatter in confusion, Nibanyongana bantu baile kumwamwauka. = When the people were agitated they scattered in confusion. (1.-mwamwaukwa, 2.-mwamwaukide, 3.-mwamwauzya, 4.-mwamwaukila, 5.-mwamwaukilalyo, 6.-mwamwaukisya)

kick for joy, as cattle do, be aroused, Kuti nombe zyakkomana zilamwangauka. = When cattle are happy they kick for joy. Boombe babutu balamwangauka mucibanda. = The calves are kicking for joy in the plain. Kuti ngoma yabukali yalila bantu balamwangauka. = If the war drum sounds the people are aroused. (1.-mwangaukwa, 2.-mwangaukide, 3.-mwangausya, 4.-mwangaukila, 5.-mwangaukilalyo, 6.-mwangaukisya, 7.-mwangauka-mwangauka, 8.-mwangausyanya) Also: -mwanyauka, -tambala, -mwansauka, -mwantuka.
kick high, Bazyana eeci nceciindi nobakali kumwanga ukisya kabati babonwe. = That is the time when the dancers were really kicking high thinking that they would be noticed.

throw into mouth, Tacili cibotu kumwankila buya nolya. = It is not good to just throw the food into your mouth when eating. Ndakaamwankila meenda nindakali kweembela. = I was just throwing water into my mouth when I was herding. Also: -kabwila. (1.-mwankilwa, 2.-mwankilide, 3.-mwankizya, 4.-mwankilila, 5.-mwankililalyo, 6.-mwankilisya, 7.-mwankila-mwankila, 8.-mwankizyanya)

suddenly jump up, Boonse bakamwankuka antoomwe kulanga bantu bapilingana. = They all jumped up together to look at the people who were agitated. (1.-mwankukwa, 2.-mwankukide, 3.-mwankuzya, 4.-mwankukila, 5.-mwankukilalyo, 6.-mwankukisya, 7.-mwankukamwankuka, 8,-mwankusyanya)
kick for joy as cattle do, Also: mwangauka
pain severely, Mutwe wali kumwanta. = I had a severe headache. Also: -wanta, -paanta. (1.-mwantwa, 2.-mwantide, 3.-mwantya, 4.-mwantila, 5.-mwantilalyo, 6.-mwantisya, 7.-mwanta-mwanta)

jump about, Nsozi zinji zyali kumwantauka mumbewu. = Many locusts were hopping about in the garden.(1.-mwantaukwa, 2.-mwantaukide, 3.-mwantausya, 4.-mwantaukila, 5.-mwantaukilalyo, 6.-mwantaukisya, 7.-mwantauka-mwantauka, 8.-mwantaukana) Also: -mwentauka.
dance while kicking high, Mooye wakamwantuka cakukondwa. = The girl danced energetically with joy.

kick about, Umwi musole wakaloka antobolo yakwe, ibbiza nilyakamwanyauka. One soldier fell off with his gun when the horse kicked about. (1.-mwanyaukwa, 2.-mwanyaukide, 3.-mwanyausya, 4.-mwanyaukila, 5.-mwanyaukilalyo, 6.-mwanyaukisya, 7.-mwanyauka-mwanyauka, 8.-mwanyausyanya) Also: -mwangauka.

disperse, spread out, *Ndaamwaya mapopwe ansi nindavwukula cisuwo kuzwa kumusyoonto wangu.* = I scattered the maize on the ground when I grabbed the basket from my young sister. *Kamumwaya nsangu zyacisyu acuulu.* = Scatter the vegetable seed on the anthill. (1.-mwayigwa, 2.-mwayide, 3.-mwayizya, 4.-mwayila, 5.-mwayilalyo, 6.-mwayisya, 7.-mwaya-mwaya, 8.-mwayana.) Also: -tataula, -sowaila, -sowa-sowa.
  • spread news, *Inanda yasikapepele ku Chikuni ilamwaya makani manji.* = The radio-station at Chikuni communicates a lot of information.

scatter, *Nkuku zyaamwayaula mapopwe mpaayanikidwe nizyali kuyanga-yanga.* = The hens, when they were scratching, scattered the maize where it was left out to dry. (1.-mwayaulwa, 2.-mwayawide, 3.-mwayauzya, 4.-mwayaulila,/-mwayawida, 5.-mwayaulilalyo, /mwayawidalyo 6.-mwayaulisya, 7.-mwayaula-mwayaula, 8. -mwayaulana)
  • demolish, *Inanda bakaimwayaula naakafwa ulaayo.* = They demolished the house when the owner died. Also: -winyauna, -oloola, -tataula.

be scattered, *Bakamwayuka basicikolo musilikani naakalizya ntobolo.* The pupils scattered when the policeman fired the gun. Also: -mwaika. (1.-mwayukizyigwa, 2.-mwayukide, 3.-mwayukizya, 4.-mwayukila, 5.-mwayukilalyo, 6.-mwayukisya, 7.-mwayuka, -mwayuka, 8.-mwayukana)

shine, *Masenke mapya abalwa zuba alamweka kapati.* = The new iron sheets glisten when the sun shines. *Izuba lilamweka ampulungwido.* = The sun is shining in the window. (1.-mwekezyegwa, 2.-mwekede, 3.-mwesya, 4.-mwekela, 5.-mwekelalyo, 6.-mwekesya, 7.-mweka-mweka, 8.-mwekesyanya)
shine, dazzle, as with variety of colour *Nyenyezi zilamwekamweka masiku.* The stars shine at night.
flashing of lightning, Ilamwekaula mvwula. The lightning is flashing.

smile, *Musimbi ulamwemweta naabona musankwa wakwe.* = The girl smiles when she sees her boyfriend. (1.-mwemwetwa, 2.-mwemwetede, 3.-mwemwetya, 4.-mwemwetela, 5.-mwemwetelalyo, 6.-mwemwetesya, 7.-mwemweta-mwemweta, 8.-mwetelana)
smile at, rt.-mwemweta, *Musankwa wakali kumwemwetela musimbi wakwe.* = The boy was smiling at his girlfriend.

open the mouth, *Mwendula mulomo unywe musamu.* = Open your mouth to drink the medicine. (1.-mwendulwa, 2.-mwendwide, 3.-mwenduzya, 4.-mwendwida, 5.-mwendwidalyo, 6.-mwendulisya, 7.-mwendula-mwndula, 8.-mwendulana) Also: -mamuna.

be bright in appearance, *Mukakatambo naakamita wakali kumwenguka-mwenguka kumeso.* = The wife of Katambo had a shining face when she was pregnant. *Twakatalika Iweendo Iwesu nokwakamwenguka kujwe.* = We began our journey when it was bright in the east. *Mpoona mapenzi aa Mutinta akamana akumeso kwakwe kwakamwenguka.* = Thereupon the sufferings of Mu tinta ended and her eyes brightened up. (1.-mwenguzigwa, 2.-mwengukide, 3.-mwenguzya, 4.-mwengukila, 5.-mwengukilalyo, 6.-mwengukisya, 7.mwenguka-mwenguka, 8.-mwengusyanya)
be of light complexion, Ooyu Hatubotu wakali mulombe muuba-uba, wampanza, mulamfwu *umwengukide* kaniini buyo. = This Hatubotu was a slim fellow, with a bald patch, tall and of light complexion.

jump about, Kokkalikila buya kuleka kumwentauka. = Just sit quietly and stop jumping about. (1.-mwentaukwa, 2.-mwentaukide, 3.-mwentausya, 4.-mwentaukila, 5.mwentaukilalyo, 6.-mwentaukisya, 7.-mwentauka-mwentauka 8.-mwentaukana) Also: -mwantauka, -sotooka.

hit hard, Bakali kusya bakali *kumwenyuna* nyika njumu. = The diggers were hitting hard earth. (1.-mwenyunwa, 2.-mwenywide, 3.-mwenyuzya, 4.-mwenyunina, 5.-mwenyuninalyo, 6.-mwenyunisya, 7.-mwenyuna-mwenyuna, 8.-mwenyunana) Also: -manyuna.
  • cut or extract partially, *Mwana watiigelwe watija mbubamumwenyuna.* = The child who was about to have it's hair cut, ran away when they had just cut a bit.
  • extract two teeth of a Mutonga traditionally. Also: -manyuna.
smile, *Musimbi wangu wali kumweta.* = My girl was smiling. (1.mwetwa, 2.-mwetede, 3.-mwetezya, 4.-mwetela, 5.-mwetelalyo, 6.-mwetesya, 7.-mweta-mweta, 8.-mwetelana) Also: -mwemweta.
smile continually, *Muleli wacisi wamweta-mweta naajana* bantu banji. = The head of state was beaming when he found many people. Also: -seka-seka.

show light continually, Mootokala wabamasilikani wakatalika kukwemba akumwetaula mpoulaa julu kucenjezya simootokala wakali kumbele kuti aime. = The police car began to use its siren and to shine its overhead light warning the driver who was in front to stop. (1.-mwetaulwa, 2.-mwetaulide, 3.-mwetauzya, 4.-mwetaulila, 5.-mwetaulilalyo, 6.-mwetaulisya, 7.-mwetaula-mwetaula, 8.-mwetaulana)

ooze, percolate, Mumbazu mumwi kuli tuntolo twiide kumwimwita meenda akurņaima lyoonse. = In some parts there are springs which are trickling with water and glistening always. (1.-mwimwitwa, 2.-mwimwitide, 3.-mwimwitizya, 4.-mwimwitila, 5.-mwimwitilalyo, 6.-mwimwitisya, 7.-mwimwita-mwimwita)

focus the eyes, Bana bakali kumwinikizya ampulungwido yananda kutegwa babone bantu bakali anze. = The children were focusing their eyes at the window of the house so that they could see the people outside. (1.-mwinikizyigwa, 2.-mwinikizyide, 3.-mwinikizyisya, 4.-mwinikizyila, 5.-mwainikizyilalyo, 6.-mwinikizyisya, 7.-mwinikizya-mwinikizya, 8.-mwinikizyanya) Also: -dinikizya, -fwinikizya.

tell stories, Bamana kulalila, bapati bamyagula zyaano kubana. = When they have finished the evening meal, the elders tell stories to the children. Also: -ana. (-myagula can have negative meaning of telling idle or lying tales, mampya and mambyaambya) (1.-myagulwa, 2.-myagulide, 3.-myaguzya, 4.-myagulila, 5.-myagulilalyo, 6.-myagulisya, 7.-myagula-myagula, 8.-myagulana)

be badly cooked, *Eeyi nsima tiiyabizwa, ilamyala.* = This nsima is not ready, it's badly cooked. (1.-myalazigwa, 2.-myalide, 3.-myalizya, 4.-myalila, 5.-myalilalyo, 6.-myalisya, 7.-myala-myala) Also: -kondekana.
  • dart out, *Mulaka wanzoka ula-myala.* = The tongue of a snake darts out.
flare, dart out repeatedly, as fire or snake's tongue, *Inzoka ijisi mulaka umyala-myala.* = The snake has a tongue which darts in and out. Also: -myaliika

blaze, *Imvwula ilamyalauka kulaba.* = The rain-storm blazes in the flashing of the lightning. (1.-myalaukwa, 2.-myalaukide, 3.-myalauzya, 4.-myalaukila, 5.-myalaukilalyo, 6.-myalaukisya, 7.-myalauka-myalauka)
lie, *Ulamyalika mulomo wakwe.* = She is a liar.

lick, *Kaaze umyankuta kana kakwe.* = The cat is licking it's kitten. *Naakali kukanana wakali kumyankuta kumilomo yakayumide nkaambo kanyota.* = When he was talking he was licking his lips which were dry because of the thirst. (1.-myankutwa, 2.-myankutide, 3-myankutya, 4.-myankutila, 5.-myankutilalyo, 6.-myakutisya, 7.-myankuta-myankuta, 8.-myankutana)

sip, e.g *Kkala buyo ayebo, musaama, simalabali wiide kulabalika anga walikufwuma kubumyenta.* = Friend, just sit down, you who talk nonsense as if you have been out early to sip beer. (1.-myentwa, 2.-myentide, 3.-myentya, 4.-myentela, 5.-myentelalyo, 6.-myentesya, 7.-myenta-myenta, 8.-myentana) Also: -myonta.

have stomach pain, *Mwida mwakali kumyonga nindakamana kulya nswi ibolede.* = My stomach was paining when I ate the rotten fish. *Kumyonga kulya ncinono kwiinda kumyonga nzala.* = It is sweeter to have stomach pains from eating than to have stomach pains from hunger. (1.-myongwa, 2.-myongede, 3.-myonzya, 4.-myongela, 5.-myongelalyo, 6.-myongesya, 7.-myonga-myonga, 8.-myonzyanya)

roll about in pain, wriggle, *Ndali kumyongosana mwida nimwali kucisa.* = I was rolling about in pain when my stomach was sore. Also: -nyongosana, -yongosana, -miningana, -vwunyungula. (1.-myongosanwa, 2.-myongosene, 3.-myonosanya, 4.-myongosanina, 5.-myongosaninalyo, 6.-myongosanisya, 7.-myongosana-myongosana)

have stomach pains, *Kumyongwa kulya, ncinono kwiinda kumyongwa nzala.* = To have stomach pains from eating is better than having stomach pains from hunger. *Ime inga ndakamuyumwide buya oyu mwana mubula bwangu, nywebo nobasankwa tamumyongwi bula pe.* = I carried this boy in my womb, you men do not have labour pains.

kiss, *Mweenzuma ndakamumyonta caluyando naakaunka.* = I kissed my friend with love when she went away. *Wakamumyonta mukaintu wakwe asaya akumulomba kuti amulekelele.* = He kissed his wife on the cheek and asked her to forgive him. (1.-myontwa, 2.-myontede, 3.-myontya, 4.-myontela, 5.-myontelalyo, 6.-myontesya, 7.-myonta-myonta, 8.-myontana)
cause to pain stomach, rt. -myonga, *Bana bandimyonzya bula.* = Babies cause my stomach pains.

stand or sit lightly, impermanently, *Mweembezi wakainaamana bbiza kaya kukunywisya nombe.* = The herdsman sat lightly on top of the horse when he was taking the cattle to drink. (1.-naamanwa, 2.-naamene, 3.-naamika, 4.-naamanina, 5.-naamaninalyo, 6.-naamanisya, 7.-naamana-naamana, 8.-naamanana) Also: -nangamana.
  • stand on one leg. Also: -konya.

sit or stand in a precarious or unstable position, *Ndakajana basankwa balinaamene atalaa zisamu zyakali mucikkocci.* I found the boys sitting in an akward position on the logs which were in the scotch-cart.

keep head upright, *Mwana naakali mucisanza wakanaamika mutwe kutegwa abone bantu bakali kuboola.* When the child was in the maize granary she lifted up her head to see who was coming. Also: -naanika, nongomeka.
walk lightly so that you don't sink in the mud, *Kamunaanana kweenda kutegwa mutabbili mumankanda.* = Walk lightly so that you don't sink into the mud.

keep head erect, *Konaanika mutwe ubone ciboola.* = Keep your head erect so that you see what is coming. Also: -naamika, -nongomeka. (1.-naanikwa, 2.-naanikide, 3.-naanikisya, 4.-naanikila, 5.-naanikilalyo, 6.-naanikisya, 7.-naanika-naanika, 8.-naanikana)

instruct, explain, show how to do, *Kamundinaaninzya kwiimba.* Teach me how to sing. *Izina eli likunaaninzya nzi?* = What does this name teach you? *Kondinaanizya naa cicitwa buti.* Teach me how this is done. *Komиnaanizya mbokutantwa namu-tendele.* = Teach her how to ride a bicycle.

-naanizyigwa, 2.-naanizyide,/ zyizye, 3.-naanizyisya, 4.-naanizyila/naanzyizya, 5.-naanizyilalyo/-naanizyizyalyo, 6.-naanizyisya, 7.-naanizya-naanizya, 8.-naanizyanya) Also: -simwina.
  • give a sign, *Wakamunaanizya mbokweendwa mudolopo lya Lusaka.* He gave directions as to how he should move about in Lusaka. Also: -lubukizya

become wet, be soaked, *Mutinta wanaba naawugwa mvwula.* = Mutinta got drenched when the rain fell on her. (1.-nabwa, 2.-nabide, 3.-nabya, 4.-nabila, 5.-nabilalyo, 6.-nabisya, 7.-naba-naba, 8.-nabizyanya) Also: -nama

walk on something narrow, as rats along a rope, *Imbeba zilanabalika atala abwaanda kazitawi.* = Rats can move along the top of a wall without falling off. Also: -nanalika. (1.-nabalikwa, 2.-nabalikide, 3.-nabalizya, 4.-nabalikila, 5.-nabalikilalyo, 6.-nabalikisya, 7.-nabalika-nabalika)

whip, *Wakamunabba-nabba yamuconyansimba.* He whipped him with a whip made from the muconyansimba tree. (1.-nabbwa, 2.-nabbide, 3.-nabbya, 4.-nabbila, 5.-nabbilalyo, 6.-nabbisya, 7.-nabba-nabba, 8.-nabbana)

raise up, *Kamunabula kaluli, tubanze ndongwe.* Raise up the little roof so that we extract goundnuts. (1.-nabulwa, 2.-nabwide, 3.-nabuzya, 4.-nabulila, 5.-nabulilalyo, 6.-nabulilsya, 7.-nabula-nabula, 8.-nabulana) Also: -vwununa, -tankula.

become wet or soaked with rain, *Wanama akaambo kamvwula ya muwa.* He was wet because the rain fell on him. (1.-namizyigwa, 2.-namide, 3.-namya, 4.-namina, 5.-naminalyo, 6.-namisya, 7.-nama-nama, 8.-namizyanya)

lose weight after illness, *Joojo wakaile kunama-nama akaambo kakuciswa ciindi cilamfwu.* = Joojo has lost weight because he was sick for a long time.
  • become wet, *Twasoka twanamanama kale katuyanda kusika kumunzi.* = When we were about to reach home we were already damp. *Nindakakasansaila meenda kabwa, kakanama-nama.* = When I sprinkled the dog with water, it became wet.

stick or glue on, as a stamp, *Konamatika cipepa kubwaanda.* = Stick the paper on the wall. (1.-namatikwa, 2.-namatikide, 3.-namatizya, 4.-namatikila, 5.-namatikilalyo, 6.-namatikisya, 7.-namatika-namatika, 8.-namatikilana)
  • accuse, *Ncibi kunamatika muntu mukaambo nkatazyi.* = It is bad to accuse someone of a crime of which he is innocent.

adhere, be glued, *Canamatila cipepa ncindabikka kubwaanda.* = The paper has stuck which I put on the wall. *Ndanamatila mumaanza akaambo kamatobo ngindalikulya.* = My hands are sticky because of the matobo fruits I have been eating. (1.-namatilwa, 2.-namatilide, 3.-namatilizya, 4.-namatilila, 5.-namatililalyo, 6.-namatilisya, 7.-namatila-namatila, 8.-namatilana) Also: -lamatila,-kakatila

unstick, *Kamunamatula cipepa cakanamatika bayi ijilo.* = Unstick the paper which the teacher stuck yesterday. (1.-namatulwa, 2.-namatwide, 3.-namatuzya, 4.-namatwida, 5.-namatwidalyo, 6.-namatulisya, 7.-namatula-namatula, 8.-namatulana) Also: -babatula, -bbabatula, -bbabbanuna.
spread a little, *Kamunambaika mafwuta acinkwa kutegwa* *unonenwe.* = Spread a little butter on the bread so that it becomes tasty. Also: -lambaika

drag the feet, *Aaka kasimbi kanambaila buya kweenda nkaambo kakalicisidwe kapati.* = This girl is just dragging her feet because she was very ill. (1.-nambailwa, 2.-nambailide, 3.-nambaizya, 4.-nambailila, 5.-nambaililalyo, 6.-nambailisya 7.-nambaila-nambaila) Also: -tombaila, -nombaila.

be well ground or kneaded, *Nojika nsima weelede kubona kuti yanambana.* = When you cook the nsima you should see that it is without lumps. (1.nambanizyigwa, 2.-nambene, 3.-nambanya, 4.-nambanina, 5.-nambaninalyo, 6.-nambanisya, 7.-nambana-nambana)

become uncoiled, become loose and come out, like cotton, *Bunweba bwanambunuka.* = The cotton became loose and came out. (1.-nambununwa, 2.-nambunukide, 3.-nambunusya, 4.-nambunukila, 5.-nambunikilalyo, 6.-nambunukisya, 7.-nambunuka-nambunuka, 8.-nambununana) Also: -lambuluka,-zambuluka
  • be sticky as glue, *Bunzuka buteteete bulanambunuka.* = Soft wax is sticky. Also: -lelemuka.
be saturated, rt. -nama, *Kwakasika suntwe masiku wakanamide mume.* = There arrived a hyena at night which was soaked by the dew. (1.-namizyigwa)

clean mouth, pick one's teeth, *Munene ulalinamvwula, walya nyama yamafwuta.* = The old man cleans his mouth, he was eating fatty meat. (1.-namvwulwa, 2.-namvwulide, 3.-namvwuzya, 4.-namvwida, 5.-namvwidalyo, 6.-namvwulisya, 7.-namvwulanamvwula) Also: kulitongola

moisten, make wet, rt. nama, Wamunamya meenda mweenzinyoko. = You have soaked your friend with water. Mwana wabunamya bulo naasuba masiku. = The child wet the bed when it urinated at night. (1.-namizyigwa) Also: -nabya
  • shower insults on someone, Munene wakamunamya matusi mwanaakwe. = The old man showered insults on his son.
