anoint, smear, Kuyandika kuti wamana kusamba, wanana mafwuta. = It is necessary that after washing, you oil yourself. Bana kabanana mafwuta basumbule. Let the children smear themselves with oil so that they shine. (1.-nanwa, 2.-nanide, 3.-nanizya-nanya, 4.-nanina, 5.-naninalyo, 6.-nanisya, 7.-nana-nana, 8.-nanikana)

walk on tip-toe, go noiselessly, Konanaila buya kweenda kutegwa batakumvwi. Walk quietly so that they do not hear you. Uusobelela tuyuni unanaila buya kweenda. He who stalks birds walks on tip-toe. (1.-nanailwa, 2.-nanailide, 3.-nanaizya, 4.-nanailila, 5.-nanaililalyo, 6.-nanailisya, 7.-nanailananaila)

walk on edge of, or on top of, or along narrow object Imbeba zyalikunanalika atalaa bwaanda. = The rats were walking on top of the wall. Malundu naanyenaanzya, njakwaananalika. No matter how terrifying the mountains, I will walk across them. Also: -nabalika (1.-nanalikwa, 2.-nanalikide, 3.-nanalikizya, 4.-nanalikila, 5.-nanalikilalyo, 6.-nanalikisya, 7.-nanalika-nanalika, 8.-nanalikana)

hold loosely, Konanama kujata mwana kutegwa utamucisi acicisa cili akwaanza. Hold the child gently so that you do not hurt the sore on his hand, Joojo ulananama kujata nkaambo cilanunka ncajisi. = Joojo is holding it lightly because what he is holding is stinking. Konanama kujata mutunta ubolede kutegwa utakubisyi meenda azwa mumubili wakwe. = Hold the rotten corpse carefully so that the water which exudes from the body does not stain you. (1.-nanamwa, 2.-nanamide, 3.-nanamya, 4.-nanamina, 5.-nanaminalyo, 6.-nanamisya, 7.-nanama-nanama, 8.-nanaminana)

board, mount, Nkubotu buyo akoonene buyo kucitisyini cacitima kutegwa mbocitiisikile buyo ciya kumusanza acinanamane kuya kwabo. = It would be good if he slept at the trainstation so that as soon as the one arrived going south he could get on it and go home.

walk with a rolling gait like a baboon, Twajana basokwe balananamba mumugwagwa ciindi cacifwumo-fwumo. We found the monkeys swaggering along the road in the early morning. (1.-nanambwa, 2.-nanambide, 3.-nanambanya, 4.-nanambanina, 5.-nanambaninalyo, 6.-nanambanisya, 7.-nanamba-nanamba) Also: -nyokomba.
  • walking proudly, Bavwuule baile kunanamba mumugwagwa. The prostitutes just walk proudly along the road.

set a trap, Касиmbika wakakananamika kabotu kakole kakwe. Kacumbika erected his trap well. (1.-nanamikwa, 2.-nanamikide, 3.-nanamizya, 4.-nanamikila, 5.-nanamikilalyo, 6.-nanamikisya, 7.-nanamika-nanamika, 8.-nanamikana)
  • put on carefully, Konanamika kubikka cinkwa atalaa mayi atafwi. = Put the bread on the eggs carefully so that they do not break.

force, make an effort despite difficulties, *Wali kulinana- muna kweenda nacisidwe.* = She made an effort to walk even though she was sick. (1.-nanamunwa, 2.-nanamwide, 3.-nanamuzya, 4.-nanamunina, 5.-nana- muninalyo, 6.-nanamunisya, 7.-nanamuna- nanamuna, 8.-nanamunana)
  • lift carefully, *Komunanamuna mu- Iwazi ayotele zuba.* = Lift the patient carefully to warm himself in the sun. *Konanamuna kabotu cisuwo cijisi mayi.* = Lift the basket of eggs carefully.

rise slowly and carefully, *Konanamuka kubuka kutegwa mwa- na atasinsimuki.* = Rise carefully so as not to awaken the child. (1.-nanamukwa, 2.-nanamukide, 3.-nanamukizya 4.-nanamukila, 5.-nanamukilalyo, 6.-nanamukisya, 7.-nanamuka-nanamuka, 8.-nanamukizyanya)

snatch by force, (Ila) *Mulimi bakamunanga nombe ibabbi bakajisi ntobolo.* = The armed thieves snatched cattle from the farmer. (1.-nangwa, 2.-nangide, 3.-nangizya, 4.-nangila, 5.-nangilalyo, 6.-nangisya, 7.-nanga-nanga, 8.-nangana) Also: -nyanga.

walk with care, *Muntu ooyu unangaila buya kweenda unakuti ulaa mandoombe.* = This person walks along as if he had stilts. *Basimbi basama mabbusu malamfwu tusindi banangaila kweenda.* = Girls who wear high-heeled shoes walk gingerly. (1.-nangailwa, 2.-nangailide, 3.-nanga- izya, 4.-nangailila, 5.-nangaililalyo, 6.-nangailisya, 7.-nangaila-nangaila, 8.-nangailana)

walk very lightly, *Ka- uka kanangalika buya kweenda.* = An insect walks very lightly. (1.-nangalikwa, 2.-nangalikide, 3.-nanga- lisya, 4.-nangalikila, 5.-nangalikilalyo, 6.-nangalikisya, 7.-nangalika-nangalika, 8.-nangalikana) Also: -nanalika.

sit upright, *Konanga- ma, musilisi uyanda kukupima.* = Sit up straight, the doctor wants to examine you. (1.-nangamwa, 2.-nangamide, 3.-nangamya, 4.-nangamina, 5.-nangaminalyo, 6.-nangamisya, 7.-nangama-nangama, 8.-nangamana)

raise oneself up, rt. - nangama, *Konangamana acuuno usondele cili mubutala.* = Get up on the stool and peep into the maize-bin to see what is there. (1.-nangamanwa, 2.-nangamanide, 3.-nangamika, 4.-nangamanina, 5.-nangamaninalyo, 6.-nangamanisya, 7.-nangamana-nangamana, 8.-nangamaninana)
  • be in an unsteady position, *Cimbayambaya cakazwide masaka a mapopwe basankwa bobile bakananga- mana atala.* = Two boys were sitting unsteadily on the lorry which was filled with sacks of maize.
raised, exalted, *Ntunga tazikonzyi kutanta amalo ananga- mene.* = Maggots cannot climb onto raised beds.
raise on supports, *Kamunangamika kaluli kabutala kata- vwavwabali.* = Raise the roof of the maize bin so that it is not low.
be sitting in an upright position, rt. -nangama, *Twajana mu- Iwazi ulinangeme abulo.* = We found the patient sitting upright on the bed.

anoint, smear, rub with oil, fat or orchre, *Komunanika mafwuta muntu ooyu kutegwa asumbule.* = Anoint this person with oil so that s/he shines. *Kamumunanika mukula mooye.* = Smear the initiate with ochre. (1.-nanikwa, 2.-nanikide, 3.-nanikizya, 4.-nanikila, 5.-nanikilalyo, 6.-nanikisya, 7.-nanikananika, 8.-nanikana)

become dirty, as with oil or mud, Canankana cisani mumankandya. My dress has become dirty in the mud. (1.-nankanwa, 2.-nankenye, 3.-nankanya, 4.-nankanina, 5.-nankaninalyo, 6.-nankanisya, 7.-nankananankana, 8.-nankanizyanya)
  • lose weight, Kuzwa nindakali kuciswa mutwe, mubili wangu wakanankana. Since the time I had a headache, I have lost weight. Also: -koka.
make wet or dirty, Nguni wacinankanya cisani eeci? = Who dirtied this cloth? Langa, wamunankanya mankanda mwana. = Look, he has soiled the child with mud.
be in a dirty condition, rt. nankana, Ndinankene mumaanza, ndali kujata buci. = I have sticky hands, I was holding honey

be fine, like flour well ground, or well stirred nsima, Baneene nibamana kutwa, busu bulananta. = When my grandmother finishes pounding, the flour is ground finely. (used as noun: Oobu busu mbunante. This meal is finely ground.) Also: -nambana, -nantikana, -seta. (1.-nantwa, 2.-nantide, 3.-nantizya, 4.-nantila, 5.-nantilalyo, 6.-nantisya, 7.-nanta-nanta, 8.-nantana)

walk lightly, Unantaila buya kweenda nkaambo ulaliyanda. = She walks lightly because of being conceited. Also: nantayila, -nangaila, kulinanamuna. (1.-nantailwa, 2.-nantailide, 3.-nantaizya, 4.-nantailila, 5.-nantaililalyo, 6.-nantailisya, 7.-nantaila-nantaila)

make fine, as flour, Noseba busu weelede kubona kuti bwanantana. When you sift the flour, see to it that it becomes fine. (1.-nantanwa, 2.-nantanide, 3.-nantanya, 4.-nantanina, 5.-nantaninalyo, 6.-nantanisya, 7.-nantana-nantana)
make the meal fine, Ooyu mukaintu ulicizyi kunantanya busu. = This woman knows how to make the meal fine.

be agile, hurry up, Konantauka kweenda, kwasiya. = Walk quickly, it is getting dark. Wakeenda kwaciindi pele nokakaba kaindi kanantauka wakatalika kukatala. He walked for a time but after a while as he moved quickly, he began to tire. Also: -nyansauka. (1.-nantaukwa, 2.-nantaukide, 3.-nantaukizya, 4.-nantaukila, 5.-nantaukilalyo, 6.-nantaukisya, 7.-nantauka-nantauka, 8.-nantaukana)

be ground fine, Bwanantikana busu kugaigwa cakuti tokonzyi kwaamba kuti busebululwe alimwi. = The mealie-meal is ground so fine that you could not say that it should be sieved again. (1.-nantikanwa, 2.-nantikanide, 3.-nantikanya, 4.-nantikanina, 5.-nantikaninalyo, 6.-nantikanisya, 7.-nantikananantikana)

tie securely Konantila kwaanga kutegwa mubwa ataloboki. = Tie the dog securely so that it does not escape. Kamunantila mbalo zijate. = Tie the poles so that they hold. (1.-nantilwa, 2.-nantikide, 3.-nantizya, 4.-nantilila, 5.-nantililalyo, 6.-nantilisya, 7.-nantilanantila, 8.-nantilana)

grind fine, rt.-nanta, Kamunantisya busu kutegwa bumwi tuzyoobujisye kacese. = Grind the meal well so that we can use some of it to cook milk porridge.
  • tie firmly, Konantisya buya kwaanga cijate kabotu. Tie it firmly so that it holds fast.

move quickly, Lwalo lubilo, Chakatazya wakali kuuluka biyo. Wakali kunga wiide kunantuka ikwakali nkokweenda, nguulya mbojene nkambizi. = As for speed Chakatazya was just flying. He was just hurtling along when he was moving, there he goes like a whirlwind. (1.-nantukwa, 2.-nantukide, 3.-nantusya, 4.-nantukila, 5.-nantukilalyo, 6.-nantukisya, 7.-nantuka-nantuka, 8.-nantukana)

take up quickly, Naakalyata sizi lyamulilo lipya, wakafwambaana kunantula kuulu. = When he stepped on the burning ember, he quickly lifted up his foot. (1.-nantulwa, 2.-nantwide, 3.-nantuzya, 4.-nantwida, 5.-nantwidalyo, 6.-nantulisya, 7.-nantulanantula, 8.-nantulana)
  • take off quickly, Konantula buya kujula nkaambo kumukobezyo cilapya. = Take it off the fire quickly because the handle is hot.
  • learn quickly, Chikuwa inga twacinantula, pesi kukanana Chikuwa teesyi kuba amaano pe. = Yes we pick up English quickly, but to speak English does not mean you become wise.
  • toss as a buffalo, Munyati wakamunantula muvwimi naakatiimuyase sumo. The buffalo tossed the hunter when he was about to pierce it with a spear. Also: -fwisula, -bbikula

be swollen or dilated, Ndakajana nombe yandaamana mumugwagwa. I found the cow swollen on the road. Kuti mada aņombe andaamana kozyiba kuti zyakkuta. If the cows stomachs look swollen, know that they have eaten enough. Also: -daamana. (1.-ndaamanwa, 2.-ndaamenye, 3.-ndaamizya, 4.-ndaamanina, 5.-ndaamaninalyo, 6.-ndaamanisya, 7.-ndaamana-ndaamana, 8.-ndaamaninana)

parade, Bamasilikani bakandandama mumilongo yobilo. = The policemen paraded in two lines. (1.-ndandamikwa, 2.-ndandamenye /ndandeme, 3.-ndandamya, 4.-ndandamina, 5.-ndandaminalyo, 6.-ndandamisya, 7.-ndandama, 8.-ndandaminana)

be formed into, rt. ndandama, Nkamu yabili yakaima yandandamikwa munsi-munsi amulundu. = The second group stood and was formed into a line beside the hill. (1.-ndandamikwa, 2.-ndandeme, 3.-ndandamika, 4.-ndandamikilwa, 5.-ndandamikilwalyo, 6.-ndandamisya, 8.-ndandaminana)
be torn, Cisani camwana candeluka. = The child's dress is torn. (1.-ndelukwa, 2.-ndelukide, 3.-ndeluzya. 4.-ndelukila, 5.-ndelukilalyo, 6.-ndelukisya, 7.-ndeluka-ndeluka) Also: -Iwenduka.
tear, Choongo wacindelula cisani camweenzinyina nibali kusobana. = Choongo tore the garment of his friend when they were playing. Also: -delula, -yaula, -zaula, -zapula
tear in different places Also: -yayaula, -zazaula, -zapaula

tremble, Mutinta ulandendema nakanana, kubee kuli ngwayoowa. Mutinta is trembling as she speaks, it seems there is someone who she fears. Munene wakatalika kundendema kukanana. The old man began to tremble as he talked. Also: -dedema. (1.-ndendemwa, 2.-ndendemede, 3.-ndendemya, 4.-ndendemena, 5.-ndendemenalyo, 6.-ndendemesya, 7.-ndendema-ndendema)

be torn, Cakandeuka cibbudula cakwe nibakali kusobana bbola jilo. His shorts were torn when they were playing football yesterday. (2.-ndeukide, 3.-ndeuzya, 4.-ndeukila, 5.-ndeukilalyo, 6.-ndeukisya, 7.-ndeukandeuka) Also: -deluka.
be in a torn state, Cisani ncaakaula jilo cakalindeukide. = The cloth which he bought yesterday was torn.

sound as thunder, thunder loudly, Imvwula ilandindima kuzuma. = The rain is producing heavy thunder. Leka kundindima. = Stop snoring. Bakamvwa gotokala lindindima kukalundu kategwa Kabbilabalamfwu. = They heard a vehicle rumbling on the hill called Kabbilabalamfwu. Also: -didima. (2.-ndindimide, 3.-ndindimya, 4.-ndindimina, 5.-ndindiminalyo, 6.-ndindimisya, 7.-ndindima-ndindima)
growl, Kacele kalandoloma mubwina. = A wild cat is growling in the burrow. (1.-ndolomwa, 2.-ndolomede, 3.-ndolomya, 4.-ndolomena, 5.-ndolomenalyo, 6.-ndolomesya, 7.-ndoloma-ndoloma, 8.-ndolomenana)

sink completely, Bwato mbubakatantide bwakandondobela muli Kaliba. = The boat which they had boarded sank completely in Kariba. Bamwi bakacaalizya kuti babonesye nkobundondobela kubbila ansi mumeenda. = Some waited to see how it became completely submerged in the water. (1.-ndondobelwa, 2.-ndondobelede, 3.-ndondobezya, 4.-ndondobelela, 5.-ndondobelelalyo, 6.-ndondobelesya, 7.-ndondobela-ndondobela 8.-ndondobelezyanya)

hiss, resound, Nindatila meenda mumpoto yali kujikila nsima, makololo andondoma. = When I poured water into the pot which was used to cook nsima, the crust inside hissed. Mucele ulandondoma mubwina kuti babwa kabasola kunjila. The wild-cat hisses if the dogs try to enter the burrow. Muyuni udidima kujulu, wandondoma a bukali sunu. = The bird is making a lot of noise aloft, today it is hissing with rage. 1.-ndondomwa, 2.-ndondomede, 3.-ndondomya, 4.-ndondomena, 5.-ndondomenalyo, 6.-ndondomesya. 7.-ndondoma-ndondoma, 8.-ndondomenana)

sit in a proud fashion, Bana nobakazyila kumuswaangano bakandondomana azyuuno zyabapati. = When the children returned from the meeting, they sat proudly on the chairs of the elders. (1.-ndondomanwa, 2.-ndondomene, 3.-ndondomanya, 4.-ndondomanina, 5.-ndondomaninalyo, 6.-ndondomanisya, 7.-ndondomana-ndondomana, 8.-ndondomaninana)

sink down into mire, disappear into mud or water, Inombe yakandondomena muntimba. = The cow got stuck in the mud. cf. -mbombomena. (1.-ndondomenwa, 2.-ndondomene, 3.-ndondomezya, 4.-ndondomenanina, 5.-ndondomenaninalyo, 6.-ndondomenanisya, 7.-ndondomena-ndondomena, 8.-ndondomenanizyanya)

sit majestically, Naakapegwa cuuno cipati wakandoomana kukkala camapuwo. = When he was promoted he proudly sat majestically. (1.-ndoomanwa, 2.-ndoomenye, 3.-ndoomanya, 4.-ndoomanina, 5.-ndoomaninalyo, 6.-ndoomanisya, 7.-ndoomana-ndoomana)
seated majestically, Nkujana ngooyu ulindoomene acuuno kutyoka buyo mpesulo. = He was sitting in a diginified way on the chair busily writing.

submerge in water or mud, Ntale yakamundyondyomezya mumaanzi. = The crocodile pulled him under the water. (1.-ndyondyomezyegwa, 2.-ndyondyomezyede, 4.-ndyondyomezyezya, 5.-ndyo ndyomezyezyalyo, 6.-ndyondyomezyeya, 7.-ndyondyomezya-ndyondyomezya, 8.- ndyondyomezyanya)

act slowly, *Ulaneelela kubeleka.* = She is slow in working. *Ulaneelela akukankama kucita zintu.* = She is slow and shivers in doing things. *Naluntaambwe mmunyama uneelela kweenda.* = The chameleon is a creature which walks slowly. Also: -kokobela (1.-neelelwa, 2.-neelede, 3.-neelezya, 4.-neelelela, 5.-neelelelalyo, 6.-neelelesya, 7.-neelela-neelela, 8.-neelezyanya)

sit lightly, *Kamuneemana kukkala nkaambo cuuno tacili ciyumu.* = Sit lightly because the chair is not strong. (1.-neemanwa, 2.-neemenye, 3.-neemanya, 4.-neemanina, 5.-neemaninalyo, 6.-neemanisya, 7.-neemananeemana, 8.-neemaninana) Also: -nenemana, -naamana, -nyonyomana.
  • be pierced, *Uciti ndeye syaanza, ndeelyo lini lyamasa-masa lyamuneemana.* = As the lion tried to swerve away to dodge the spear, it pierced him right in the kidneys.
be seated lightly, *Musilikani ulineemene atalaa bbiza.* = The policeman is seated lightly on the horse.
pierce, *Musune mukali lyakamunema sumo.* = The spear pierced the angry ox. (1.-nemwa, 2.-nemede, 3.-nemya, 4.-nemena, 5.-nemenalyo, 6.-nemesya, 7.-nema-nema, 8.-nemana)

be pliable, vibrate, oscillate, *Kasamu aka kalanemanema.* = This stick is pliable.
  • stick fast, *Muvwimi naakayasa munyati, sumo tiilyakanema-nema pe.* = When the hunter speared the buffalo, the spear did not stick fast.

move softly, *Musimbi muvwuule ulanemauka kuzyana akati kabasankwa.* = A profligate girl dances sensually among men. *Mudaala wakasamide nzyeete ilaa mupepe unemauka.* = The old man wore a hat with a feather which moved gently up and down. (1.-nemaukwa, 2.-nemaukide, 3.-nemausya, 4.-nemaukila, 5.-nemaukilalyo, 6.-nemaukisya, 7.-nemauka-nemauka, 8.-nemaukana)

cut small trees, *Ndazyila kukunembuula tusamu-samu.* = I have come from cutting small trees. (1.-nembuulwa, 2.-nembwiide, 3.-nembuuzya, 4.-nembwiida, 5.-nembwiidalyo, 6.-nembuulisya, 7.-nembuula-nembuula, 8.-nembuulana)
  • cut so as to insert medicine as treatment, *Bamunembuula kumucingilila kuti zyeelo kazitamuboni.* = They cut him to protect him so that the spirits would not see him. *Musilisi wakandinembuula nsimbo zipati.* = The healer cut me with big incisions. Also: -yasaula, -nembaula.

work hard, *Walikunemuka kusya zisamu nkozili kumiyanda akuzwisya kutegwa kusalale.* = He was working hard in cutting trees at the roots and clearing them away. *Twali kunemuka kususa zitina zyacikolo.* = We were working hard in carrying bricks for the school. (1.-nemukwa, 2.-nemukide, 3.-nemusya, 4.-nemukila, 5.-nemukilalyo, 6.-nemukisya, 7.-nemuka-nemuka, 8.-nemukana)
be fat, be obese, *Mukaintu wakwe wakalineneele kapati.* = His wife was very fat. (3.-neneesya, 4.-neneelela, 5.-neneelelalyo, 6.-neneesya, 7.-neneele-neneele)

hold up by one corner or edges, *Konenegela kujata, kalayauka kapepa.* = Hold the edges of the paper, it will be torn. Also: -nenekela. (1.-nenegelwa, 2.-nenegede, 3.-nenegezya, 4.-nenegelela, 5.-nenegelelalyo, 6.-nenegelesya, 7.-nenegela-nenegela, 8.-nenegelana)
  • do something carefully, Nitwakasika kumilundu milamfwu, twakali kunenegela kweenda. When we reached the high mountains, we proceeded very carefully.

flower with small pods as pumpkins do, Ilungu lokwesu Iwakaneneka kale. Our pumpkin runners have started to flower with small pods already. (1.-nenekwa, 2.-nenekede, 3.-nenezya, 4.-nenekela, 5.-nenekelalyo, 6.-nenekesya, 7.-neneka-neneka, 8.-nenekana)
  • hold at edges Koneneka kujata kuleka kujatila limwi akati. = Hold at the edges, not tightly in the middle.
hold up carefully, Konenekela kujata cisamu kutegwa citatyoki. = Be careful the way you lift up that wood so that it does not break. Also: -nenegela.

hold an object right at the edges, Kamunenema mutuswi twamasaka. Hold the edges of the sack. (1.-nenemwa, 2.-nenemede, 3.-nenemezya, 4.-nenemanina, 5.-nenemaninalyo, 6.-nenemanisya, 7.-nenema-nenema, 8.-nenemaninana)

do carefully, Konenemana kukkala nkaambo cuuno cilityokede. = Sit carefully because the stool is broken. (1.-nenemanwa, 2.-nenemene, 3.-nenemeka, 4.-nenemanina, 5.-nenemaninalyo, 6.-nenema-nisya, 7.-nenemananenemana, 8.-nenemaninana) Also: -nonomana, -neemana, -naamana.

hold carefully, hold up by a part, Konenemeka kujata mwana, ulakubisya nkaambo ulaambukide. = Hold the child carefully, it will soil you as it has defecated. Konenemeka kujata mayi. = Hold the eggs carefully.

become stout, fat, Ooyu mwana wakaneneya sunu akaambo kakulya kabotu. = This child has become fat today because of eating properly. Bantu balya zinji balaneneya kapati. = People who eat many things get very fat. (1.nenesyegwa, 2.-nenede, 3.-nenesya, 4.-neneela, 5.-neneelalyo, 6.-nenesya, 7.-neneya-neneya) Also: -cila.

cut, gash, lance, Camunenga cikwa camunsale naali kuyupa kuti alye. The skin of the sugar-cane cut him when he was peeling it to eat. Ndazwa bulowa, yandinenga mbeli. = I am bleeding, the blade cut me. (1.-nengwa, 2.-nengede, 3.-nenzya, 4.-nengela, 5.-nengelalyo, 6.-nengesya, 7.-nenga-nenga, 8.-nengana)

slash, Bona bwizu mbobwandinengaula kumaulu. = Look at how the grass has slashed my legs. (1.-nengaulwa, 2.-nengawide, 3.-nengauzya, 4.-nengawida, 5.-nengawidalyo, 6.-nengaulisya, 7.-nengaula-nengaula, 8.-nengaulana)

become thin (between two thicker ends), Kooze kanengetela kayanda kukosoka. The rope is thin between the ends, it will break. Kachesa naali kugonka musamu, niwanengetela, waambila bana kuti basosoloke. = When Kachesa was cutting a tree, when it became thin, he told the children to move away. (1.-nengetezyegwa, 2.-nengetede, 3.-nengetezya, 4.-nengetelila, 5.-nengetelilalyo, 6.-nengetesya, 7.-nengetelanengetela, 8.-nengetezyanya)
be thin, about to break, Eeyi nketani ilinengetede, iya kukosoka yaakubelesegwa. This chain is thin, it will break when it is used.

make thin, Konengetezya cikuni ucityole kabotu. = Chip the wood until thin and you will easily break it. Mutinta lutambo ndwalidina Iwamunengetezya cibuno. = The way Mutinta has tied her belt has made her waist thinner. Nkaanga Nacintu nkokaanga kanengetezya kakome ulati nguloma. = Young Nacintu the way she has tied herself her waist has become thin like a mason wasp.

cut cloth or meat into strips, Konengulula kanyama uyoke. = Cut off a piece of meat and roast it. (1.-nengululwa, 2.-nengulwide, 3.-nenguluzya, 4.-nengulwida, 5.-nengulwidalyo, 6.-nengululisya, 7.-nengulula-nengulula, 8.-nengululana) Also: -tendulula.
  • cut edges, Kamunengulula tupepa kutegwa tweelane. = Cut the edges of the papers so that they become even.

cut part, snip, prune, Kamunentula matu akkabbicci tukavwele munswi. Cut off some cabbage leaves so that we mix it with the fish. Kamиnentula nsyuukwa zyacisyu cikomene kabotu. Cut the young shoots of the vegetable so that it grows well. (1.-nentulwa, 2.-nentwide, 3.-nentuzya, 4.-nentwida, 5.-nentwidalyo, 6.-nentulilsya, 7.-nentula-nentula, 8.-nentulana) Also: -kokola
  • take a little, as liquid, Konentula tubwantu tusyoonto, upe mwana ulila. = Take a little sweet-beer and give it to the child who is crying. Also: -nenuna.
pour a little for, rt. -nentula, Nobasimbi, kamundinentwida meenda masyoonto, ndafwa nyota. = Girls, get me a little water I am thirsty.

take a drop, as water from a bucket, take part of, Kamunenuna tukoko tulabile. = Get a little drop of beer so that we taste it. Wakalijisi K120,000. Wakaile kunenuna kasyoonto kugusya ka K10,000 kabo nkobakali kuyanda. = He had K120,000. He just removed a little, taking out their K10,000 which they wanted. Also: -nentula, -bebula. (1.-nenunwa, 2.-nenwide, 3.-nenuzya, 4.-nemwida, 5.-nenwidalyo, 6.-nenunisya, 7.-nenuna-nenuna, 8.-nenunana)

be parched, droop, wilt, Cisyu caneta nkulyabala zuba. = The vegetables have withered because the sun has shone. Cisyu caneta akaambo kakutaciida kapati. = The vegetables withered because they were not watered much. (1.-netezyegwa, 2.-netede, 3.-netya, 4.-netela, 5.-netelalyo, 6.-netesya, 7.-neta-neta) Also: -lembuka

be parched, become weak or faint and then revive, then faint again, rt.neta, Mwana walikwiile kunetauka kacisidwe kapati. The child has just been fainting, it is extremely ill. Balunduka bakali kunetauka izuba nilyakabala kapati. The runners were fainting when the sun shone fiercely. (1.-netaukwa, 2.-netaukide, 3.-netauzya, 4.-netaukila, 5.-netaukilalyo, 6.-netaukisya, 7.-netauka-netauka)

faint, Nindamuuma nyindi yamalinga, wanetuka. When I struck him a blow on the collar-bone, he fainted. Boonse bakawida ansi akunetuka. = All fell to the ground and fainted. Also: -yuminina. (1.-netusyigwa, 2.-netukide, 3.-netuzya, 4.-netukila, 5.-netukilalyo, 6.-netukisya, 7.-netuka-netuka, 8.-netusyanya)

make to faint, stun, anaesthetize, Musilisi usaanguna kumunetula mulwazi ngwayanda kupandula. = The doctor first anaesthetizes the patient whom he wants to operate on. Chimeko yakali kuyanda kumunetula nzala. = The hunger was making Chimeko nearly faint. (1.-netulwa, 2.-netwide, 3.-netuzya, 4.-netwida, 5.-netwidalyo, 6.-netulisya, 7.-netula-netula, 8.-netulana) Also: -wizula, -fwa cizilo.

wilt, fall to pieces, faint repeatedly, Mulwazi wiile kunetuuka ziindi zinji. = The patient is just fainting many times. (1.-netuuzyigwa, 2.-netuu kide, 3.-netuusya, 4.-netuukila, 5.-netuukilalyo, 6.-netuukisya, 7.-netuukanetuuka, 8.-netuusyanya)

lie back, Basicikolo bakakolwa lubanje, bakangandama acibuye. = The schoolboys who were under the influence of dagga, lay stretched out on their backs on the ground. (1.-ngandamwa, 2.-ndandeme, 3.-ngandamya, 4.-ngandamanina, 5.-ngandamaninalyo, 6.-ngandamisya, 7.-ngandama-ndandama) Also: -gandama, -gadama, -salama.

shine, Musinsi ngwaakasamide mmulamfwu wa Nakonde uungelema-ngelema kahempe kamadansi. = The skirt which she wore was the long Nakonde material which was shiny, the blouse was laced. (2.-ngeleme, 3.-ngelemya, 4.-ngelemanina, 5.-ngelemaninalyo, 6.-ngelemesya, 7.-ngelema-ngelema)

rush down, Ncinga noingenyuka amungenyu, ilabalika kapati. = When the bicycle rushes down the slope, it travels very fast. (1.-ngenyukwa,2.-ngenyukide, 3.-ngenyusya, 4.-ngenyukila, 5.-ngenyukilalyo, 6.ngenyukisya, 7.-ngenyuka-ngenyuka, 8.-ngenyuzyanya)
  • die suddenly, Chiinya wakaile kungenyuka kakunyina akuciswa pe. = Chiinya died suddenly without previously being ill at all. Also: -anguka.
reverberate Also: -zwiima

walk slowly, Suntwe wakatalika kungombaila kweenda naakakkuta. = The hyena began to walk slowly when it was full. (1.-ngombaila, 2.-ngombailide, 3.-ngombaizya, 4.-ngombailila, 5.-ngombaililalyo, 6.-ngombailisya, 7.-ngombaila-ngombaila)

be unsteady, Bantu bakali kutandaanya sikoswe bakali kwiide kungombana akaambo kanzala. = People who were chasing the rat were running unsteadily because of the hunger. (1.-ngombanwa, 2.-ngombanide, 3.-ngombanya, 4.-ngombanina, 5.-ngombaninalyo, 6.-ngombanisya, 7.-ngombana-ngombana)

toll or ring as a cow bell, Mulangu wajombe ulangondoma mumulundu. = The bell of the cow is ringing on the hill. (1.-ngondomezyegwa, 2.-ngondomede, 3.-ngondomya, 4.-ngondomena, 5.-ngondomenalyo, 6.-ngondomesya, 7.-ngondomangondoma, 8.-ngondomezyanya.)

kill in large numbers, Muvwimi wabangondoola banyama mbatakonzyi kubweza. = The hunter killed many animals which he was unable to carry. 1.-gondoolwa,2.ngondoode, 3.ngondoozya 4.-ngondoolela, /-ngondweeda 5.-ngondoolelalyo, /-ngondweedalyo 6.-ngondoolesya, 7.-ngondoola-ngondoola, 8.-ngondoolana)
  • eat everything without leaving anything, Mweenzu waingondoola nsima yoonse njaapedwe. = The visitor has eaten all the nsima which he was given.

blaze, as bush on fire, Igundu lyakangunduma amulilo uuyoosya. = The bush blazed with a terrifying fire. (1.-ngundumizyigwa, 2.-ngundumide, 3.-ngundumya, 4.-ngundumina, 5.-ngunduminalyo, 6.-ngundumisya, 7.-ngunduma-ngunduma, 8.-ngundumizyanya)
  • make a roaring noise, Citima cilangunduma nocitanta mulundu. = The train thunders when it climbs a hill.

drink excessively, as beer, Kunywa bukoko kwakali kukasigwa mumunzi wa Haamilimo, pesi walo sibbuku mwini wakali kulingunga. = Drinking beer was forbidden in the village of Haamilimo, but the headman himself was gulping it down. (2.-ngungide, 4.-ngungila, 5.-ngungilalyo, 6.-ngungisya, 7.-ngunga-ngunga)

drink without pausing, Mbwaakasikila wakangungumuna bukoko boonse nkaambo wakalaa nyota. = As soon as he arrived he gulped down all the beer because he was thirsty. (1.-ngungumunwa, 2.-ngungumwide, 3.-ngungumuzya, 4.-ngungumunina, /-ngungumwida, 5.-ngungumwidalyo, 6.-ngungumunisya, 7.-ngungumunangungumuna) Also: -ngungumwina.

gulp down, Mudyaka wakangungumwina cibwantu coonse cakali mukagumbuli mukaindi kasyoonto. Mudyaka gulped down all the sweet-beer which was in the container in a short time. Also: -kukumwina, -ngungumuna.

pass on information, *Ndakabanguntawida-nguntawida* bacembele caano cangu. = I related my story to the old woman. (1.-nguntawidwa, 2.-nguntawide, 3.-nguntawizya, 4.-nguntawidila, 5.-nguntawidilalyo, 6.-nguntawidisya, 7.-nguntawida-nguntawida 8.-ngintawidana) Also: -guntawida
be wide, *Inanda njaakayaka tiiyakeelede kungwa-* *ngwamana pe.* = The house which he built ought not to have been so wide.

extend, Tacigwasyi kungwangwamuna muunda ngotakonzyi kulimina. It does not help to extend a field which you cannot finish weeding. (1.-ngwangwamunwa, 2.-ngwangwamwide, 3.-ngwangwamuzya, 4.-gwangwamwida, .ngwangwamwidalyo, 6.-ngwangwamunisya, 7.-gwangwamuna) Also: -kwankwamuna.

vibrate as a bell, Mulangu ulangweema niilunduka nombe yuujisi. The bell vibrates when the cow which has it runs. (1.-ngweemezyegwa, 2.-ngweemede, 3.-ngweemya, 4.-ngweemena, 5.-ngweemenalyo, 6.-ngweemesya, 7.-ngweema-ngweema, 8.-ngweemezyanya)

rattle, *Inola yama-* *bbanti ilangwelema akusabila kapati* *noyeenda munzila yamabwe.* = The ironwheeled waggon rattles very noisely when it goes over a stony road. (1.-ngwelemezyegwa, 2.-ngwelemede, 3.-ngwelemede, 4.-ngwelemya, 5.-ngwelemena, 6.-ngwelemenalyo, 7.-ngwelema-ngwelema, 8.-ngwelemezyanya)

run down, *Bulowa bwali* *kungwenga acicisa andigonka keembe.* = The blood was running down from the wound where the axe cut me. Kuti wanana mafwuta manji, alangwenga nilyabala zuba. If you smear yourself with too much oil, it will run down when the sun shines. Nkasaalo yali kungwenga mubili onse naalikutijaana. = The sweat was running down all over the body when he was running. Wakalibonena misozi nkuyakali kungwenga kumeso akwe. = He saw for himself the tears which were running down from her eyes. Ciya cipwaza wakacilonzezya mucivwulumuto kuti maanzi oonse angwenge, ciyume. = He transferred this cheese into a leafy container so that all the water would run out and it would become hard. (1.-ngwengezyegwa, 2.-ngwengede, 3.-ngwengezya, 4.-ngwengela, 5.-ngwengelalyo, 6.-ngwengesya, 7.-ngwenga-ngwenga) Also: -sensela.
begin to brighten, *Kwakangwengwemuka kujwe.* = It began to become bright in the east.
be bright, *Mbukwakangwengwemukide kale kujwe,* wakanyamuka. = As it was already bright in the east, he got up.

defecate, *Bana baniini balania abulo ziindi zinji.* = Little children defecate on the bed frequently. (1.-nigwa, 2.-nide, 3.-nisya, 4.-nina, 5.-ninalyo, 6.-nisya, 7.-nia-nia, 8.-nisyanya)
  • lay an egg, *Inkuku jilo yakania.* = A hen laid an egg yesterday.
  • bring problems, *Uso azikulubona lugwalo, uzikuti ndime ndinia tukatazya.* = If your father sees the letter, he will say it is me who is bringing problems.
  • scribble, *Mpesele yakatalika kunia buluba.* = The pencil started to scribble

bend with pain, *Mudaala wakalikuniabala kweenda nkaambo musana wakwe wakali kucisa.* = The old man was bent with pain as he walked because his back-bone was hurting. (1.-niabalwa, 2.-niabalide, 3.-niabalizya, 4.-niabalila, 5.-niabalilalyo, 6.-niabalisya, 7.-niabala-niabala) Also: -nialala.

beat severely, *Mwana wakaumwa cakuti wakalema kukomba walo Mutinta taleki kuniabbaula mwana limwi nkujana walisubila.* = The child was beaten to the extent that it stopped pleading and Mutinta did not stop hammering the child until it wet itself. (1.-niabbaulwa, 2.-niabbawide, 3.-niabbauzya, 4.-niabbawida 5.-niabbawidalyo, 6.-niabbaulisya, 7.-niabbaula-niabbaula, 8.-niabbaulana)

walk uneasily, as when having a backache, *Muntu uciswa musana unialala buya kweenda.* = When one has a backache s/he walks uneasily. (1.-nialalwa, 2.-nialide, /-nialete, 3.-nialazya, 4.-nialalila, 5.-nialalilalyo, 6.-nialalisya, 7.-nialala-nialala, 8.-nialalizyanya) Also: -niabala, -dyaabala.

dishonour, mock, Wali *kuniangula badaala balemene*. = He was mocking the lame old man. (1.-niangula, 2.-niangwide, 3.-nianguzya, 4.-niangwida, 5.-niangwidalyo, 6.-niangulisya, 7.-niangula-niangula, 8.-niangulana)
be excreted, rt. *-nia*, Maziu *anigwa cifwumofwumo alanunka kapati*. = The faeces which were excreted in the morning stink horribly.

soak, *Kanika-nika mimena yamweesyo*. = Let her quickly soak the maize for the *mweesyo* funeral ceremony. Also: *-nyika-nyika*, (*-nika bugeza* = brew beer) (1.-nikwa-nikwa, 2.-nikidenikide, 3.-nikizya-nikizya, 4.-nikilila-nikilila, 6.-nikisya-nikisya, 7.-nika-nika, 8.-nikizyanya)

sink to the bottom, *Muzeli wakanikila mulwizi*. = A fisherman drowned in the lake. (1.-nikilwa, 2.-nikilide, 3.-nikizya, 4.-nikilila, 5.-nikililalyo, 6.-nikilisya, 7.-nikila-nikila, 8.-nikizyanya) Also: *-nyikila*.

wriggle, shake the shoulders horizontally, *Nzoka niyaumwa kasako amusana yalikunikinya*. = When the snake was struck by a stick on the back it was wriggling. (1.-nikinyizyigwa, 2.-nikinyide, 3.-nikinyizya, 4.-nikinyizyizya, 5.-nikinyizyizyalyo, 6.-nikinyisya, 7.-nikinya-nikinya, 8.-nikinyizyanya) Also: *-nininya, -ninina, -miningana*.

defecate on or into, rt. *-nia* ;
  • destroy what has been good for you, *Wakazyiba kuti ino wanina atekela naakamvwa myoota yabamasilikani nkoikwemba munsi lyakwe*. = He knew that he had brought trouble on himself when he heard the police-cars with their sirens turned on behind him. *Mwania sunu mwaanina atekela*. = I am telling you today that you are in big trouble for what you have done.

shake, Wakali kunininya makkuko kukaka kutwa. = She shook the shoulders (showing displeasure) refusing to pound. (1.-nininyigwa, 2.-nininyide, 3.-nininyizya, 4.-nininyina, 5.-nininyinalyo, 6.-nininyisya, 7.-nininya-nininya) Also: -pungunya (shake head), -tikinyas, -nikinya.

shake Mucila wampongo ucita kuti mpongo niilumwa mbuwo walo wiide kuninina biyo, taukonzyi akuuma mbuwo pe. The tail of the goat reacts when it is bitten by a biting insect it just shakes, it cannot strike the insect. (1.-nininwa, 2.-nininide, 3.-nininya, 4.-nininina, 5.-ninininalyo, 6.-nininisya, 7.-ninina-ninina, 8.-ninizyanya) Also: -nikinya, -nininya
liso look with contempt, Zyoonse ezi zyakali kucitika, kuli Nabulongo zyakalanzizye kunio liso. = As far as Nabulongo was concerned all that had happened was looked upon with contempt.

rub on, smear, Banamunji mumwezi wa Kkunkumuna-masamu tabakkomani nkaambo tacibagwasyi kuliniobba mafwuta nkaambo kakasuko. = In the month of July, people are not happy because it does not help them to smear themselves with oil because of the dust. (1.-niobbwa, 2.-niobbede, 3.-niobbya, 4.-niobbela, 5.-niobbelalyo, 6.-niobbesya, 7.-niobba-niobba, 8.-niobbekana)

fill one with hatred or anger, Bumwi buzuba cikaintu ciya nicakali kukkala munanda yamulumi wangu ndakamvwa candiniokola. One day when that bitch stayed in my husband's house I felt that it filled me with hatred. Oyu mukaintu limwi awalo cakamuniokola cakwiile kwiitwa-itwa akwaambauzigwa. = Finally this woman was filled with anger at been called all the time and been proposed to. (1.-niokolwa, 2.-niokolede, 3.-niokozya, 4.-niokolela, 5.-niokolelalyo, 6.-niokolesya, 7.-niokola-niokola, 8.-niokolana)

enter arrogantly, Mukaintu wakakwatwa munsi, wakali kuliniomba buyo kunjila munanda njaatakabelekela. The wife who was married later was just proudly entering the house that she had not worked for. (1.-niombwa, 2.-niombede, 3.-niombya, 4.-niombela, 5.-niombelalyo, 6.-niombesya, 7.-niomba-niomba, 8.-niombezyanya)

walk swinging from side to side, Wakali kuniombaila mbuli pombo. He was walking with a swagger like a baboon. (1.-niombailwa, 2.-niombailide, 3.-niombaizya, 4.-niombailila, 5.-niombailila-lyo, 6.-niombailisya, 7.-niombaila-niombaila)

soak quickly and withdraw at once, rinse, Kocinjavwika buyo aasyoonto cisani cako, wamana ucizwisye. = Dip and soak your cloth for a while, when you do that withdraw it from the water. (1.njavwikwa, 2.-njavwikide, 3.-njavwikizya, 4.-njavwikila, 5.-njavwikilalyo, 6.-njavwikisya 7.-njavwika-njavwika, 8.-njavwikana) Also: -ccavwika.

be crystal clear, Meenda aya mmabotu kunywa, aile kunjelema. = This water is good to drink, it is crystal clear. Meso amooye naazwa munanda alanjelema. The eyes of the young girl when she comes out of the inititation house are crystal clear. (1.-njelemezyegwa, 2.-njelemede, 3.-njelemya, 4.-njelemena, 5.-njelemenalyo, 6.-njelemesya, 7.-njelema-njelema) Also: -naima, -balangala.

shake, rattle, Ali kunjenjema masenke nikwainda kambizyi. = The corrugated sheets were rattling when the whirlwind passed by. (1.-njenjemezyegwa, 2.-njenjemede, 3.-njenjemya, 4.-njenjemena, 5.-njenjemenalyo, 6.-njenjemesya, 7.-njenjema-njenjema, 8.-njenjemezyanya) Also: -jejema, -njejema

enter, Nitwakamana kwiizya twakanjila murnanda. = When we had finished chatting we entered the house. (1.-njilwa, 2.-njide, 3.-njizya, 4.-njizyizya,/-njilila, 5.-njizyizyalyo/-njililalyo, 6.-njizyisya, /-njilisya, 7.-njila-njila, 8.-njilana.)
  • squeeze or clean out an abcess, Ncibi kunjila mwana waciswa bukoto, weelede kutolwa kucibbadela. = It is bad to clean a child's sore throat with a finger, s/he should be taken to the hospital.
  • interrupt, Mainza wakamunjila mukanwa simizyaakwe. = Mainza interrupted his uncle.

enter repeatedly, Bamuka mufwu bakalilamba twe, bakalikuzuza, bakali kunjilauka munanda. = The widow smeared herself with ash, running up and down, and entering the house repeatedly. Ooyu munene wakazinjilauka zintoolo kuyaabuulaula. = This old man was going in and out of stores buying things. (1.-njilaukwa, 2.-njilaukide, 3.-njilausya, 4.-njilaukila, 5.-njilaukilalyo, 6.-njilaukisya, 7.-njilauka-njilauka, 8.-njilaukana)

enter into a girl's house in parents absence with illicit sexual intentions, Cimwi ciindi basankwa bakali kunjilila basimbi bapati nibakali kuunka mumadilwe. = Sometimes boys used to have sexual relations with girls when their parents were attending funerals. (1.-njililwa, 2.-njililide, 3.-njilizya, 4.-njililila, 5.-njilililalyo, 6.-njililisya, 7.-njilila-njilila, 8.-njililana)
  • enter through, Mubbi wakanjilila ampulungwido naakabba mali. = The thief entered by the window when he stole the money.
be remarried, Bina Malambo baakaka kunjililwa munanda mulumi wabo naakafwa. = The mother of Malambo refused to remarry after her husband died.
be entered (by a spirit) swayigwa, be visited (by a spirit)s, -jatwa, be possessed (by a spirit.)
cause to enter, insert, rt. -njila, Kamunjizya nombe muciba yasika mvwula. = Bring the cattle into the kraal, the rain has come.

get stuck, as car, Moota wanjomba mukalonga. = The vehicle got stuck in the stream. (1.-njombezyegwa, 2.-njombede, 3.-njombya, 4.-njombela, 5.-njombelalyo, 6.-njombesya, 7.-njombanjomba, 8.-njombezyanya) Also: -patila, -dakamina.

peck, Nkuku ilakonzya kunjomona mwana muliso. = A hen can peck a child in the eye. 1.-njomonwa, 2.-njomwede, 3.-njomozya, 4.-njomweda, 5.-njomwedalyo, 6.-njomonesya, 7.-njomona- njomona, 8.-njomonana) Also: -jomona, -goma, -gobola.

defecate continually, Mwana ulanjonjomona. = The child has diarrhoea. (1.-njonjomonwa, 2.-njonjomwede, 3.-njonjomozya, 4.-njonjomweda, 5.-njonjomwedalyo, 6.-njonjomonesya, 7.-njonjomona-njonjomona, 8.-njonjomozyanya)

snore, Boonse beenzinyina bakali kwiide kunkonona koona. = All their friends were just snoring. (1.-nkononwa, 2.-nkononede, 3.-nkonozya, 4.-nkononena, 5.-nkononenalyo, 6.-nkononesya, 7.-nkonona-nkonona)

become fertile, Meenda amumulonga alaa bwizu a matu naayuminina, inga bulongo bulanokela. = When river water containing leaves and grass dries up, it makes the soil fertile. (1.-nokelwa, 2.-nokelede, 3.-nokezya, 4.-nokelela, 5.-nokelelalyo, 6.-nokelesya, 7.-nokela-nokela)

be fertile, rt. -nokela, Bakajana cisi cibotu citandabede, cilaa mulonga uutayuminini. Bakajana bulongo bunokelede. = They found good flat land, it had a river which did not dry up. They found fertile soil.

take a little from, as sugar from a bag, *Konokola* munyo musyoonto mujanza. = Take a little salt in the hand. *Wakanokola* twe acikko akulilamba kukankolyonkolyo kakwe. = He took some ash from the fireplace and smeared himself on the back of the head. (1.-nokolwa, 2.-nokolede, 3.-nokozya, 4.-nokolela, 5.-nokolelalyo, 6.-nokolesya, 7.-nokola-nokola, 8.-nokolana)
  • bleed, Naakaumwa ampemo amupika, Michelo wakatalika kunokola. = When Michelo was beaten on the nose with a pot, he began to bleed.

pick things up one by one, Bana bakali *kunokoola* ndongwe yomwe-yomwe. = The children were uprooting groundnuts one by one. (1.-nokoolwa, 2.-nokoolede, 3.-nokoozya, 4.-nokoolela, 5.-nokoolelalyo, 6.-nokoolesya, 7.-nokoola-nokoola, 8.-nokoolana)
  • take a little, as oil, *Konokoola* tufwuta ulinanike kumeso. = Take a little oil and smear it on your face.
go very slowly, Uyaabunombaila kweenda kuya kucibbadela nkaambo ulicisidwe kapati. = He was walking along very slowly to the hospital because he was extremely ill. Musimbi

buya kweenda mmutolo. = The girl who just walks slowly is a lazy one. (1.-nombailwa, 2.-nombailide, 3.-nombaizya, 4.-nombailila, 5.-nomabililalyo, 6.-nombailisya, 7.-nombaila-nombaila) Also: -tombaila.

prune, Balimi balanomboola buluba kuti buzyale. = Farmers prune the top leaves of cotton plants to make them flower well. (1.-nomboolwa, 2.-nombweede, 3.-nomboozya, 4.-nombweeda, 5.-nombweedalyo, 6.-nomboolesya, 7.-nomboola-nomboola, 8.-nomboolana)

pick out, select, Kamunomona muntu ngomuyanda awa. = Pick out the person you want here. (1.-nomonwa, 2.-nomwede, 3.-nomonzya, 4.-nomweda, 5.-nomwedalyo, 6.-nomonesya, 7.-nomona-nomona, 8.-nomonana) Also: -sala, -domoona.

be tasty, Mundyoli ulanona. Stew is tasty. Nyama ilanona. = Meat is tasty. (1.-nonwa, 2.-nonede, 3.-nonzya, 4.-nonena, 5.-nonelalyo, 6.-nonensya, 7.-nona-nona, 8.-nonzyanya)
  • sharpen by grinding, whet or grind an axe, Nobwakaca wakafwuma kunona keembe kakwe. When it was dawn he went to sharpen his axe. Njanda kunona tubulo a kaleba. = I want to sharpen the arrows and the small axe. Also: -kwenga.

loiter, linger, Babbi balanonelela mumugwagwa kuyandaula nzila yakubba. = The thieves linger on the road looking for a way to steal. (1.-nonelelwa, 2.-nonelede, 3.-nonelezya, 4.-nonelelela, 5.-nonelelelalyo, 6.-nonelesya, 7.-nonelela-nonelela, 8.-nonelelana) Also: -ima-ima, -kokobela.
  • make tasty, rt. -nona, Makowa anonelela munswi ziyumu. = Cucumbers are tasty with dried fish.
be pleased, Tanaakavwula mazuba Michelo wakanonezegwa nkabela wakamukwata Mainza. = Not many days passed of Michelo being pleased, thereupon he married Mainza.

delight, please, rt. -nona, Nobacembele, twaambo tuya ntumwakali kundikananina twakandinonezya. = Old woman, those topics about which you were talking to me delighted me. (1.-nonezyegwa, 2.-nonezyede, 4.-nonezyela, 5.-nonezyelalyo, 6.-nonezyesya, 7.-nonezya-nonezya, 8.-nonezyanya)

mock, ridicule, reject, Bamunonga akaambo kakuti taakasamide kabotu. = They mocked him because he was not dressed well. Bamunonga kuti wiile kubee ncikkeyi kukakokola. = They mocked him as if his elbow was a peg of a yoke. Tulamulomba buti mucembele ooyu ngutwakali kusampaula, kunonga akusulaika? = How can we ask something from this old woman whom we were ridiculing, mocking and hating? Mubali woonse ulaangulukide kunonga mizeezo njabona kuti naa yayungizigwa inga wasumpula bubotu bwabbuku eli. = Each reader is free to reject the ideas which he sees or to add what will improve the value of this book. (1.-nongwa, 2.-nongede, 3.-nongezya, 4.-nongela, 5.-nongelalyo, 6.-nongezya, 7.-nonga-nonga, 8.-nongana) Also: -sanka, -nongoola, -sapula, sampaula.

be ridiculed, be an object of ridicule because of a defect, Ooyu musankwa ulanongeka nkaambo matwi akwe mmapati biya. = This boy is ridiculed because his ears are very big. Ooyu musimbi ulanongeka nkaambo kabubumbe bwakwe bubi. = This girl is ridiculed because of her poor figure. Kunyina mpaakali kunongeka mwanaa musimbi. = There was no way in which the girl could be found to be imperfect. (1.-nongekwa, 2.-nongekede, 3.-nongezya, 4.-nongekela, 5.-nongekelalyo, 6.-nongekesya, 7.-nongeka-nongeka, 8.-nongekana)

raise up, Muvwimi ulanongomana kuti abone aali munyama. = The hunter raises his head to see where the animal is. Mebo musana wangu ulacisa nselimvwi kabotu kunongomana acuuno. = I have a backache, I do not feel well enough to sit up straight on a chair. Nzoka yakanongomana niyakabona muntu. = The snake raised its head when it saw a person. Njelede kunongomana mbone koonse-koonse, utanongomani ngufwulwe. = I ought to raise my head to see everywhere, it is only the tortoise who does not raise its head. (1.-nongomanwa, 2.-nongomene, 3.-nongo-meka, 4.-nongomanina, 5.-nongomaninalyo, 6.-nongomanisya, 7.-nognomana-nongomana, 8.-nongomaninana) Also: -londomana, -lonzola, songomana.
keep head erect, rt.nongomana, Konongomeka mutwe ubone muyuni. = Raise your head to see the bird. Nzoka yakali kunongomeka mutwe. = The snake had it's head erect.
have head raised, rt. nongomana, Wakaya kukubona wisizyala. Wakamujana ulinongomene kulanga kunzila. = He went to see his father-in-law, he found him alert looking towards the road.

critisize in many ways, rt. nonga, Musololi bakamunongoola bantu bakwe muzibi nzyaakali kucita. = The leader was critisized in many ways by his people because of the evil things which he was doing. (1.-nongoolwa, 2.-nongoolede, 3.-nongoozya, 4.-nongweeda, 5.-nongweedalyo, 6.-nongoolesya, 7.-nongoola-nongoola, 8.-nongoolana)

cause to suck, Kamukanonkelezya kapongo kazyalwa ino. = Help the new born goat to suck. (1.-nonkelezyegwa, 2.-nonkelezyede, 4.-nonkelezyezya, 5.-nonkelezyezyalyo, 6.-nonkelezyesya, 7.-nonkelezyanonkelezya, 8.-nonkelezyanya) Also: -nyonkelezya.

pluck out, as plants, *Kocinonkola cisyu citantaane.* = Thin out the vegetables so that they are spaced out. *Kamuzinonkola nzengene zilumide mubwa.* = Take out the ticks which have bitten the dog. (1.-nonkolwa, 2.-nonkwede, 3.-nonkozya, 4.-nonkweda, 5.-nonkwedalyo, 6.-nonkolesya, 7.-nonkola-nonkola, 8.-nonkolana) Also: -jwa.

cause to be pulled out, Nzengene zyamabala-mabala tazijugwi biya nkaambo inga yanonkolezya cikanda camubwa. Coloured ticks are not to be plucked out because they may pull out the skin of the dog. (1.-nonkolezyegwa, 2.-nonkolezyede, 3.-nonkozya, 4.-nonkolezyela, 5.-nonkolezyelalyo, 6.-nonkolezyesya, 7.-nonkolezya-nonkolezya, 8.-nonkolezyanya)

pull out from among vegetables, Bana kamunonkoola bwizu bumenede mucisyungwa. Children pull out the grass growing among the vegetables. (1.-nonkoolwa, 2.-nonkweede, 3.-nonkoozya, 4.-nonkweeda, 5.-nonkweedalyo, 6.-nonkoolesya, 7.-nonkoola-nonkoola, 8.-nonkoolana)

sit for a while, Bakasoka kunonomana atuuno kutegwa baswe ciya. They first of all rested on stools for a while to catch their breath. Amunjile mumunzi mutaangune munonomanenonomane. = Enter the village and first rest for a while. *Kononomana kukkala,* cuuno cijisi manyonyoonyo. Be cautious as you sit as the stool is rough. Mulwazi wakacikonzya *kunonomana kukkala.* The patient was able to sit up. (1.-nonomanwa, 2.-nonomene, 3.-nonomeka, 4.-nonomanina, 5.-nonomaninalyo, 6.-nonomanisya, 7.-nonomana-nonomana, 8.-nonomaninana) Also: -nyonyomana, -nyanyamana.

develop, grow, *Kufwumbwa kasune katalika kunonomoka, walo Chibbwalu nkukasambala.* = Whenever a little ox began to grow, Chibbwalu would sell it. *Tupopwe twakasyangwa twakanonomoka kale.* The liitle maize which was planted is already growing.(1.-nonomokwa, 2.-nonomokede, 3.-nonomosya, 4.-nonomokela, 5.-nonomokelalyo, 6.-nonomokesya, 7.-nonomoka-nonomoka)

act in a proud manner, *Bakali kunga baya nkobaya, Mudyaka walo wiide kulinonoola akakoli ambele.* = It happened that wherever they went, Mudyaka was just strutting along in front with a walking stick. (1.-nonoolwa, 2.-nonoolede, 3.-nonoozya, 4.-nonoozyezya, 5.-nonoozyezyalyo, 6.-nonoolesya, 7.-nonoola-nonoola)

act slowly, *Nabwiinga ulanonosya kulya nkaambo ulaa nsoni.* = A bride eats slowly because she is shy. (1.-nonosyegwa, 2.-nonosyede, 3.nonosyezya, 4.-nonosyela, 5.-nonosyelalyo, 6.-nonosyesya, 7.-nonosya-nonosya) Also: -nozya-nozya.

feed baby with bottle, *Mwana mucaala bamunonselezya mukupa wacikuwa.* They feed the orphaned child by bottle-milk. (1.-nonselezyegwa, 2.-nonselezyede, 4.-nonselezyela, 5.-nonselezyelalyo, 6.-nonselezyesya, 7.-nonselezyanonselezya, 8.-nonselezyanya) Also: -nyonkelezya.

stumble against, trip over, *Walinontola naali kuya kuli bakaapa masiku.* S/he triped when she was going to her grandmother at night. Munene walinontola akuwa ansi. = The old man stumbled and fell to the ground. (1.-nontolwa, 2.-nontwede, 3.-nontozya, 4.-nontweda, 5.-nontwedalyo, 6.-nontolesya, 7.-nontola-nontola, 8.-nontolana) Also: -umpula, -fwumpula.
cause to fall, scandalize, rt. -nontola, Mupati utalilemeki unontozya bacili bana. An elder who does not respect himself is a scandal to children.

sit on a high stool, Ncibi kunonzomana kukkala ciindi cakulanga bbola nkaambo ulasinkila bamwi. = It is bad to sit in a high place when watching football because you block others. Kunonzomana kukkala acuuno antoomwe a bapati cakali kutondwa. = To sit on a chair in the elders presence was taboo. (1.-nonzomana, 2.-nonzomene, 3.-nonzomanya, 4.-nonzomanina, 5.-nonzomaninalyo, 6.-nonzomanisya, 7.-nonzomana-nonzomana, 8.-nonzomaninana) -nonzomene Wakali mukaintu wakapemo kano kanonzomene. = She was a woman with a small protruding nose.

make tasty, rt. -nona, Ncinzi ncomwabikka mucisyu cacinonzya boobu? = What have you put in the relish to make it sweet like this? (1.-nonzyegwa, 2.-nonzyede, 4.-nonzyela, 5.-nonzyelalyo, 6.nonzyesya, 7.-nonzya-nonzya, 8.nonzyanya)

eat slowly with pleasure, Ulanonzya-nonzya caali kutegwa tunyomenenwe. She is eating slowly so that the others will be envious.
  • give bit by bit, Kamunonzyanonzya kumupa cakulya mwana kutegwa ata-tingwi. Give the child the food slowly so that it does not choke him. Also: -nozya-nozya, -nonosya, -mansyamansya.

forage, Mubwa mutumbu wakali kunona-nona cakulya mumunzi. = The bitch was searching for food in the village. Bantu basondokede balanona-nona muzingungulu. = Mad people forage in rubbish bins. (1.-nona-nona, 2.-nonwede-nonwede, 4.-nonela-nonela, 5.-nornelalyo-nonelalyo, 6.-nonesya-nonesya, 7.-nonanonanonanona) Also: -fwulunga.

pretend to be good, act in a polite way, Ulalinozya-nozya mukwaamba kakuli nguulubizizye. = He was talking in a polite way, while he was the one who was at fault. Also: -lomeeka, (rt. -loma) (1.-nozyegwa-nozyegwa, 2.-nozyedenozyede, 4.-nozyeda-nozyeda, 5.-nozyedalyo-nozyedalyo, 6.-nozyesyanozyesya, 7.-nozyesyanya-nozyesyanya)

smell something, Mubwa oonse ulanufwizya mukondo wabanyama. Every dog can sniff out the track of animals. (1.-nufwizyigwa, 2.-nufwizyide, 3.-nufwizya, 4.-nufwizyizya, 5.-nufwizyizyalyo, 6.-nufwizyisyisya, 7.-nufwizya-nufwizya, 8.-nifwizyanya) Also: -numfwida, -numfwizya.

raise head up, Kamunuka ino mwaminwa nkaambo mwalimina kwakaindi. Lift up your head now you are tired because you have been weeding for a long time. Notuyamba mumulonga tulanuka mutwe. When we swim in the river we raise the head. (1.-nukwa, 2.-nukide, 3.-nukizya, 4.-nukila, 5.-nukilalyo, 6.-nukisya, 7.-nuka-nuka, 8.-nukilana) Also: -gwalala.

pluck, Kamunumfwaula matu aacisyu tukajike. Pluck the leaves of the vegetables so that we cook. (1.-numfwaulwa, 2.-numfwawide, 3.-numfwawizya, 4.-numfwaulila, 5.-numfwaulilalyo, 6.-numfwaulisya, 7.-numfwaula-numfwaula, 8.-numfwaulana) Also: -kuntaula, -cela.

track by scent, as a dog does, sniff, smell, *Mubwa unumfwida mwainda simalelo wakwe.* = A dog tracks where his master has passed. *Basankwa bakatandila nkiinga zingi kayuni nkaakali kunumfwida Munziwabunjaka.* = The boys were chasing the small quail, a bird which was being sniffed out by the dog called Munziwabunjaka. *Nobakamunumfwida bakamvwa kuti wakali kununka bukoko alimwi wakalikoledwe.* = When they smelt him they knew that he was stinking with beer and that he was drunk. (1.-numfwidwa, 2.-numfwide, 3.-numfwizya, 4.-numfwida, 5.-numfwidalyo, 6.-numfwidisya, 7.-numfwida -numfwida, 8.-numfwidana) Also: -fwufwuzya, -fwumfwula.

tract by scent, as a dog does, *Mubwa unumfwizya mukondo wakwale.* = The dog is sniffing out the track of the partridge. (1.-numfwizyigwa, 2.-numfwizyide, 3.-numfwizyizya, 4.-numfwizyizya, 5.-numfwizyizyalyo, 6.-numfwizyisya, 7.-numfwizya-numfwizya, 8.-numfwizyanya)

sniff, *Syuumbwa wakamunumfwuzya sulwe.* = The lion smelt the hare. (1.-numfwulwa, 2.-numfwulide, 3.-numfwuzya, 4.-numfwulila, 5.-numfwulilalyo, 6.-numfwulisya, 7.-numfwula-numfwula, 8.-numfwulana) Also: -fwumfwula, -numfwaula, -nunkuzya.
  • pluck, *Kamunumfwula matu acisyu nkajike.* = Pluck the leaves of the veg-etable plants so that I cook. Also: -numfwaula, -kuntaula.

save, *Ndakamucenjezya akumununa Mweemba muntenda yaku-bbukilwa.* = I warned and saved Mweemba from the danger of adultery. (1.-nunwa, 2.-nunide, 3.-nunuzya,/-nunya 4.-nunwida, 5.-nunwidalyo, 6.-nunisya, 7.-nuna-nuna, 8.-nunana.)
  • take out what was drowned in water, *Bakamununa mubwa wakanyikide mucikala.* = They took out the dog which drowned in the well. *Naakanuna syiko, wakajana nswi zinji.* = When he took out the fish trap, he found many fish.

join, as a chain, *Konunganya nketani yakosoka.* = Join the chain which is broken. (1.-nunganyizyigwa, 2.-nunganyide, 3.-nungizya, 4.nunganyizyizya 5.-nunganyizyizyalyo, 6.-nunganyisya, 7.-nunganya-nunganya)

add to, *Kamunungilila kooye kutegwa kalampe.* = Join the two pieces of string to lengthen it. *Kaindi basimbi bakali kuyasaulwa nsimbo ezi mumasaya ankumo. Eelyo nkujana kwakaba kulicenkaula akusoleka kulinunqilila bubotu.* = In the past the girls were pierced with these tatoos on the cheeks and forehead. So we find there came self-admiration and the attempt to add to one's beauty. (1.-nungililwa, 2.-nungililide 3.-nungilizya, 4.-nungilizyizya, 5.-nungi-lizyizyalyo, 6.-nungililisya, 7.-nungilila-nungilila, 8.-nungililana) Also: -lungilila

be smelling, be stinking, *Kwakafwida mubwa kulanunka nsu.* = There is an awful smell from the place where the dog died. (1.-nunkilwa, 2.-nunkide, 3.-nunsya, 4.-nunkila, 5.-nunkilalyo, 6.-nunkisya, 7.-nunka-nunka, 8.-nunkana)

be fragrant, smell nicely, *Kujikwa cinona, kununkilila kabotu.* = Where nice food is cooked there is a nice aroma. *Bamakaintu balayanda kunana mafwuta anunkilila.* = Women like to smear themselves with perfume. (1.-nunkilidwe, 2.-nunkilide, 3.-nunkilizya, 4.-nunkililila, 5.-nukilililalyo, 6.-nunkili-lisya, 7.-nunkilila-nunkilila, 8.-nunkililana)

prefer one kind of food, *Ndanunkilwa kulya mango.* = I have a strong desire for mangoes. *Bamatumbu bamwi bamita, balanunkilwa kulya mayi.* = When some women are pregnant, they have a stong desire to eat eggs.

smell, *Ndali kununkizya ciwo canyama iijikwa munzila nindali kweenda.* = I was smelling the scent of meat being cooked on the way when I was going along. *Mubwa uyaabununkizya mukondo wakwale.* = The dog goes along while sniffing the scent of the partridge. *Wakatalika kweenda kutozya kooko nkwaakanunkizya munyama.* = He began to move to that place where he had smelt an animal. (1.-nunkizyigwa, 2.-nunkizyide, 3.-nunkizya, 4.-nunkizyizya, 5.-nunkizyizyalyo, 6.-nunkizyisya, 7.-nunkizyanunkizya, 8.-nunkizyanya)

be fed up of one another, *Jesi wakati, "Sena uyanda kuti tuzikununkulukanwe andime?" Me ndati, "Kunyina notuya kununkulukanwa anduwe pe, nkaambo mebo ndakuyanda mpoceela."* = Jesi said, "Do you want us to become bored with one another?" I said, "We will never get tired of one another, because I love you so much." (1.-nunkulukwa, 2.-nunkulukide, 3.-nunkuluzya, 4.-nunkulukila, 5.-nunkulukilalyo, 6.-nunkulukisya, 7.-nunkulukanwa-nunkulukanwa, 8.-nunkulukanwa)

be cured from being alergic to the smell of meat, *Lino ulanunkulukwa akuzimbuluka mbowabbukwa mitukuta.* = Now you are cured from being alergic to the smell of meat and from the swelling which made you sweat.
disinfect, *Kobikka musamu wakununkuluzya munanda.* = Put disinfectant in the house.

cause to lose appetite, *Cisyu comwe kucilya kwamazuba* *manji cilanunkuzya.* = To eat the same type of relish for many days makes one loose one's appetite. (1.-nunkuzyigwa, 2.-nunkuzyide, 4.-nunkuzyizya, 5.-nunkuzyizyalyo, 6.-nunkuzyisya, 7.-nunkuzya-nunkuzya, 8.-nunkuzyanya) Also: -kambusya.
  • sense by smelling, *Banyama bamwi balakonzya kununkuzya kabotu kwiinda bantu.* = Some animals are more sensitive in smelling than humans.

dislike, *Haasyipa watununkwida kulya.* = We are sick and tired of eating the relish haasyipa. (1.-nunkwidwa, 2.-nunkwidide, 3.-nunkwizya, 4.-nunkwidila, 5.-nunkwidilalyo, 6.-nunkwidisya, 7.-nunkwida -nunkwida, 8.-nunkwidana) Also: -kambula.

pluck a handful *Konunsaula boya bwamubwa nkobuli kumucila.* = Pluck out hairs from the dog's tail. (1.-nunsaulwa, 2.-nunsawide, 3.-nunsauzya, 4.-nunsawida, 5.-nunsawidalyo, 6.-nunsaulisya, 7.-nunsaula-nunsaula, 8.-nunsaulana)
cause one to smell, Watununsizya. He has brought us something which smells.

be cut, as a rope, *Looye Iwaangidwe mubwa mweenzu Iwanunsuka.* = The rope that was tied to the new dog has been cut. (2.-nunsukide, 3.-nunsuzya, 4.-nunsukila, 5.-nunsukilalyo, 6.-nunsukisya, 7.-nunsuka-nunsuka) Also: -zutuka, -kosoka.

cut, as a rope, *Kamununsula looye, lumwi twaanzye mpongo.* = Break the rope in two so that we tie the goat with one part. (1.-nunsulwa, 2.-nunswide, 3.-nunsuzya, 4.-nunswida, 5.-nunswidalyo, 6.-nunsulisya, 7.-nunsulanunsula, 8.-nunsulana)

dissect, *Kamununsuula looye lube muzibeela zyotatwe.* = Dissect the rope into three pieces. (1.-nunsuulwa, 2.-nunsuulide, 3.-nunsuuzya, 4.-nunswiida, 5.-nunswiidalyo, 6.-nunsuulisya, 7.-nunsuula-nunsuula, 8.-nunsuulana)

cause to smell, rt. -nunka, *Kamumutapula cingulungungwa ulacinunsya ceele.* = Remove the stinking insect, it will cause the porridge to smell. (1.-nunsyigwa, 2.-nunsyide, 3.-nunsya, 4.-nunsyila, 5.-nunsyilalyo, 6.-nunsyisyisya, 7.-nunsya-nunsya, 8.-nunsyanya)
sniff out, *Kujana nanda mazubaano nkutaanguna kununsya-nunsya.* = To find a home nowadays you have first to search carefully around.

save, *Haambayi nguwakatunununa kunzala.* = Haambayi is the one who saved us from hunger. (1.-nununwa, 2.-nunwide, 3.-nununzya, 4.-nunwida, 5.-nunwidalyo, 6.-nununinsya, 7.-nununa-nununa, 8.-nununana.) Also: -fwutula.
be freed as a slave, *Mulembwe wakabapa maamba obile, elyo oyu mukaintu wakanununwa bakamutoleela kumunzi.* = Mulembwe gave them two hoes, thereupon this woman was freed, they took her along home.

save with, *Weelede kujana cintu cakulinunuzya.* = You ought to find something with which to save yourself. *Bakabamba bulilu alimwi bakabweza amaamba akuyaabununuzya bantu mbobakali kuya bujana.* = They prepared food for the journey and took hoes, going along saving the people whom they could find.
raise the head, *Wakanusya mutwe.* = She raised the head.

peer, look over something *Bakaunka abalo kukalonga, bacinuunuka, babona nguulya waazanganya biyo kutenda nyama.* = They also went to the river and looked over, they saw him there just busy in cutting up the meat. *Mutinta wakanuunuka kusondela malundu* ayo akali kwaambwa. = Mutinta looked over to catch a glimpse of those hills that had been talked about. (1.-nuunukwa, 2.-nuunukide, 3.-nuunusya, 4.-nuunukila, 5.-nuunukilalyo, 6.-nuunukisya, 7.-nuunuka-nuunuka, 8.-nuunukana)

approach stealthily, *Ulanwabila kweenda mbuli muntu uyanda kubba.* = He approaches stealthily like a person who wants to steal. (1.-nwabilwa, 2.-nwabilide, 3.-nwabilizya, 4.-nwabilila, 5.-nwabililalyo, 6.-nwabilisya, 7.-nwabilanwabila, 8.-nwabilana) Also: -sobelela, -bela-bela.
  • walk as a giraffe or long-legged creature, *Twabona jule kanwabila kweenda kukosola mumugwagwa.* = We saw a secretary bird strutting across the road.

take some, *Konwengula matu aluungu undiletele.* = Take some leaves of the pumpkin and bring them to me. (1.-nwengulwa, 2.-nwengulide, 3.-nwenguzya, 4.-nwen-gwida, 5.-nwengwidalyo, 6.-nwengulisya, 7.-nwengula-nwengula, 8.-nwengulana)

cut off, as leaves, *Kamunwentuula buyo matuvwu aalo.* = Just cut off the leaves only. *Kapongo kanwentuula mapopwe.* = The goat has stripped the leaves off the maize. (1.-nwentuulwa, 2.-nwentwiide, 3.-nwentuuzya, 4.-nwentwiida, 5.-nwentwiidalyo, 6.-nwentuulisya, 7.-nwentuula-nwentuula, 8.-nwentuulana)

tear lengthways, as paper or cloth, *Tatuyandi kunwenzula mabbuku aacikolo.* = We do not want to tear school books. *Mutumbu naakaalilwa kutumbuka, bakanwenzula kasani kamulumaakwe.* = When the mother failed to give birth, they tore off a piece of cloth from the husband. (A traditional belief practiced to hasten delivery) (1.-nwenzulwa, 2.-nwenzwide, 3.-nwenzuzya, 4.-nwenzwida, 5.-nwenwidalyo, 6.-nwenzulisya, 7.-nwenzula-nwenzula, 8.-nwenzulana)
defecate, (more polite = *kuya ansengwe*)
scramble for, Nkuku zya- katalika kunyaala nsima. = The chickens started scrambling for the nsima. (1.-nyaalwa, 2.-nyaalide, 3.-nyaalizya, 4.-nyaalila, 5.-nyaalilalyo, 6.-nyaalisya, 7.-nyaala-nyaala)

scramble for, Basibukoko banyaana nongo zyabukoko. = The beer drinkers are scrambling for the pots of beer. Kumazuba basimpongo balazitola mpongo kukunyaana nunga amunye- ngele. = In the evening the goatherds take the goats to go and scramble for different types of grass. Baumpe bala- zinyaana nombe. = The wild dogs chasing after the cattle. (1.-nyaanwa, 2.-nyaanide, 3.-nyaanizya, 4.-nyaanina, 5.-nyaani- nalyo, 6.-nyaanisya, 7.-nyaana-nyaana) Also: -bbukana, -bbuka, -bbukula.

deprive, rt. -nyaana, Bandinyaanizya kulya aboobo nsiinda- kkuta. = They deprived me of food and so my appetite is not satisfied. Bantu bamwi tabakwe nsoni kunyaanizya bana baniini cakulya. = Some people have no shame in depriving little children of food. Muka- intu uulaa nanda wakalibilika kuti ulaba- nyaanizya cakulya cabo mweenzu. = The woman was worried that the visitor would deprive them of their food. (1.-nyaanizigwa, 2.-nyaanizyide, 4.-nyaanizyizya, 5.-nyaanizyizyalyo, 6.-nyaanizyisya, 7.-nyaanizya-nyaanizya, 8.-nyaanizyanya)

be revolted, be nauseated, Nindakabona mubwa ubolede ndaka- *nyailwa*, tiindakakonzya kulya. = When I saw the rotting dog I felt revulsion, I could not eat. Ndakanyailwa kulya nkaa- mbo bataata bakandaambila zivwunda- usya kumoyo. = I was unable to eat be cause my father said to me things which upset my heart. (2.-nyailide, 3.-nyaizya, 4.-nyaililwa, 5.-nyaililwalyo, 6.-nyailizyisya, 7.-nyailwa- nyailwa, 8.-nyailizyanya)
  • snatch from, rt. -nyaya, Ino *wakanyailwa* nzi mpongo kakuli nzizyako? = Why did he deprive you of the goats which were yours?
  • be terrified, Akaambo kamusalo ngutwakajisi wabasyuumbwa, ndaka- *nyailwa* nindakabona citewo mumudima, ndakali kuti ngonguwe. = Because of the conversation which we had about the lions, I became afraid when I saw a shrub in the dark, I thought it was one of them. Munene naakabona kuti oku kulangwa akujatwa-jatwa takuli kwamumulawo, wa- *kanyailwa* limwi wakatalika kusosoloka. = When the old man saw that this exam- ination and searching was not according to the law, he became terrified and began to move away.

forfeit, be deprived, rt. - nyaya, *Wakanyaigwa* lubono loonse naakaalilwa kulunga mulandu wakwe wakubbukilwa. = All his wealth was taken away from him when he failed to pay the fine for adultery. *Ndakanyaigwa* ncinda- keelede kujana. = I was deprived of what I was supposed to get. (2.-nyaide, 3.-nyazyizya, 4.-nyangila, 5.-nyangilalyo, 6.-nyangisya, 7.-nyaigwa-nyaigwa, 8.-nyangana) Also: -nyanzigwa, -nyangwa.

act wih energy, Musa- nkwa, konyakaula kubeleka. = Boy, work with energy. (1.-nyakaulwa, 2.-nyaka- wide, 3.-nyakauzya, 4.-nyakaulila,-nyaka- wida, 5.-nyakawidalyo, 6.-nyaka-ulisya, 7.-nyakaula-nyakaula, 8.-nyakaulana.) Also: -nyangauka.
be well-built, Malita wakali musimbi munkutwe mubili wakwe *wakalinyakeme*. = Malita was hard- working girl, she had a sturdy body. Also: -nakeme, -nangeme, -nugile.

lift one leg more than the other, as when one foot is sore, Mazubaaya ndalikunyakila biya kweenda. = These days I have been limping as I walk. Also: -dyabila (1.-nyakilwa, 2.-nyakilide, 3.-nyakizya, 4.-nyakwida, 5.-nyakwidalyo, 6.-nyakilisya, 7.-nyakila-nyakila, 8.-nyakilana

shake head, Akaambo kamakani ngindamvwa ausisya, ndali kwiide kunyakinya mutwe. = Because of the sad news that I heard, I was just shaking the head. (1.-nyakizyigwa, 2.-nyakinyide, 3.-nyakizya, 4.-nyakizyizya, 5.-nyakizyizyalyo, 6.-nyakinyisya, 7.-nyakinya-nyakinya, 8.-nyakinyizyanya) Also: -pungunya, -zungaanya, -uma mutwe, -tikaanya mutwe.

lift as a big stone on one side, Kamulinyakula bbwe elyo kumbali libwezegwe kabotu. = Lift that stone on one side so as to lift it properly. Oyu musankwa lyaamulimba saka nkaambo taakalinyakula kabotu pe. = The sack fell on this boy because he did not lift it properly. (1.-nyakulwa, 2.-nyakwide, 3.-nyakuzya, 4.-nyakwida, 5.-nyakwidalyo, 6.-nyakulisya, 7.-nyakula-nyakula, 8.-nyakulana)

pierce lightly, Musilisi nayanda kugusya bulowa, unyamika buyo acikanda camuntu = When the doctor is taking blood he just pierces lightly the skin of a person. (1.-nyamukwa, 2.-nyamikide, 3.-nyamisya, 4.-nyamikila, 5.-nyamikilalyo, 6.-nyamikisya, 7.-nyamika-nyamika, 8.-nyamikana)

get up quickly from a sitting position, take off, Amwaange matambo, tuyanda kunyampuka. Faster you safety belt, we are about to take off. Musimbi wakanyampuka akuya kucikko camucembele anze. The girl got up and went to the fireplace of the old woman outside. (1.-nyampukwa, 2.-nyampukide, 3.-nyampusya, 4.-nyampukila, 5.-nyampukilalyo, 6.-nyampukisya, 7.-nyampuka-nyampuka, 8.-nyampukana) Also: -nyamuka.

take up a load, lift up, Kamunyampula ibbwe elyo nyotatwe. = The three of you take up that stone. Kabakugwasya kunyampula coola eeci. = Let them help you lift that luggage. (1.-nyampulwa, 2.-nyampwide, 3.-nyampuzya, 4.-nyampwida 5.-nyampwidalyo, 6.-nyampulisya, 7.-nyampula-nyampula, 8.-nyampulana)
carry, Nondo zyakaambila bantu boonse ncozinyampwida nanda zyazyo. = The tortoises told all the people why they carry their houses.

rise up in a body, Nowakamana muswaangano wamusololi, bantu bakanyamukila antoomwe akwiimba ciimbo cacisi. When the meeting of the leader was finished, all the people rose up in a group and sang the national anthem. (1.-nyamukilwa, 2.-nyamukide, 3.-nyamukizya, 4.-nyamukilila, 5.-nyamukililalyo, 6.-nyamukisya, 7.-nyamukilanyamukila, 8.-nyamukilana) Also: -nyandukila amwi.

stand up from sitting position, move from a stationary position, Kamunyamuka, basika bayi tubaanzye kutondezya bulemu. = Rise, the teacher has arrived let us greet him to show respect. Konyamuka uunke kukubeleka. Rise so that you go to work. Citima cakanyamuka. = The train started off. (1.-nyamukwa, 2.-nyamukide, 3.-nyamusya, 4.-nyamukila, 5.-nyamukilalyo, 6.-nyamukisya, 7.-nyamuka-nyamuka, 8.-nyamusyanya) Also: -nyampuka, -nyumuka, -yumuka.
take, Aumwi muntu wakanyamula coola cakwe. Each man took his luggage. (1.-nyamulwa, 2.-nyamwide, 3.-nyamuzya, 4.-nyamwida, 5.-nyamwidalyo, 6.-nyamulisya, 7.-nyamula-nyamula, 8.-nyamulana)

lift up in order to carry, Ino nibamunyamuna kuzwa abulo aalya bamutola kuli? Where did they take him after lifting him out of that bed? Konyamuna nkuni utole kuli banyoko. Lift the firewood and take it to your mother. Also: -nyumpula. (1.-nyamunwa, 2.-nyamwide, 3.-nyamuzya, 4.-nyamwida, 5.-nyamwidalyo, 6.-nyamunisya 7.-nyamuna-nyamuna, 8.-nyamunana)
  • lift up the nose (idiom) Taku buzu-ba nobuba bomwe nitwakalalide manya-muna mpemo. There was not a single day when we had boiled maize-grains as our evening meal.

fade or shrivel, as a leaf or flower, Maluba alanyana muzuba. The flowers wither in the sun. Ooyu musimbi wakajisi lukanda lubotu naakacili mwana, pesi sunu lukanda Iwakwe Iwakanyana. This girl had beautiful skin when she was young, but today her skin has withered. Mucelo wanaluntaambwe ulakonzya kumupenzya muntu kwamyaka minji kayabunyana limwi nayakufwa. The chameleon charm can make a person suffer for years withering up until he finally dies. Also: -pusama, -neta, -bunda-bunda, -zimana. (1.-nyanizyigwa, 2.-nyanide, 3.-nyania, 4.-nyanina, 5.-nyaninalyo, 6.-nyanisya, 7.-nyana-nyana, 8.-nyanizyanya)
  • be ashamed, Musankwa wakanya-na naakajanwa ulabba. The boy was ashamed when he was caught stealing. Also: -gunwa, -usa.

be wrinkled, become dried up. Mapopwe anyana-nyana muzuba. The maize has shrivelled up in the sun. Nguzu zyakweenda zyakaceya-ceya awalo mubili wakwe wakanyana-nyana. His strength to walk began to lessen and also his body began to dry up.
  • be ashamed, Wakaile kunyana-nyana akaambo kakuti bakamujata bulozi. He was ashamed because they caught him for witchcraft.

= go in a body, go all at once, Bantu bakanyandukila amwi kuya kubona ntenda yakacitika. The people all went in a body together to see the accident which had occured. (1.-nyandukwa, 2.-nyandukide, 3.-nyandusya, 5.-nyandukilalyo, 6.-nyandukisya, 7.-nyandukila-nyandukila, 8.-nyandukilana) Also: -nyamukila, -katamuka.

be surprised, Ndaka-nyandwa kubona muntu kalya moongo-Iwa. I was surprised to see someone eating a millipede. Ndilanyandwa kubona bantu batapi mali kubabelesi. I am surprised to see people who do not give workers money. Also: -yabwa, -lamwa. (1.-nyandisyigwa, 2.-nyandidwe, 3.-nyandizya/-nyandya, 4.-nyandilwa, 5.-nyandilwalyo, 6.-nyandisya, 7.-nyandwa-nyandwa, 8,-nyandizyanya.)
cause surprise, Meenda abila kakunyina mulilo alanyandya. For water to boil without fire is surprising.

deprive, extort, carry away by force, snatch, Silunya unyanga zintu zyabantu. A cruel person takes the property of people. Limwi mbwaakawida buyo cakaala kuyumuka, nkabela bantu bamwi bakaunka kumunyanga mali ngaa-kajisi. As soon as he fell he failed to get up, then some people went to snatch the money which he had. Also: -puka. (1.-nyangwa, 2.-nyangide, 3.-nyangizya, 4.-nyangila, 5.-nyangilalyo, 6.-nyangisya, 7.-nyanga-nyanga, 8.-nyangana)

be fast, hurry, Konyangaala kweenda ukateke meenda. = Hurry up so that you draw water. (1.-nyangaalwa, 2.-nyangaalide, 3.-nyangaazya, 4.-nyangaalila, 5.-nyangaalilalyo, 6.-nyangaalisya, 7.-nyangaala-nyangaala, 8.-nyangaazyanya)
move quickly, Kujaya nzoka nkunyangaana. To kill a snake you need to move quickly.

be agile, Kamunyangauka kweenda kutegwa ciindi citamusiyi. Be brisk so that you are not left behind by time. Konyangauka utani kulisukati abee ufwide mpeyo. Be lively and don't be putting your arms around yourself as if you were feeling the cold. (1.-nyangaukwa, 2.-nyangaukide, 3.-nyangausya, 4.-nyangaukila, 5.-nyangaukilalyo, 6.-nyangaukisya, 7.-nyangauka-nyangauka, 8.nyankaukizyanya) Also: -nyakaula - ezemuka.

be deprived, Mwana naakabwezela mali mumugwagwa wakanyangwa abeenzinyina. = When the child picked up the money on the road, he was deprived of it by his friends. (2.-nyangidwe, 4.-nyangila, 5.-nyangilalyo, 6.-nyangisyigwa, 7.-nyangwanyangwa) Also: -nyaigwa.

be withered, be wizened, shrivel, rt. -nyana, Kuulu kwakwe kumwi kwakalinyanide. One of his legs was withered. (1.-nyanizyigwa, 3.-nyania, 4.-nyanina, 5.-nyaninalyo, 6.-nyanisya 7.-nyana-nyana, 8.-nyanizyanya) Also: -puutila.

rise quickly, Naakaamba ncaakaboolede kwaamba, boonse bakaile kunyansamuka antoomwe cakunyandwa. When she said what she came to say, all rose up together with surprise. Bantu banji bakaile kunya nsamuka lyakalila syuumbwa. = Many people quickly rose up together when the lion roared. (1.-nyansamukwa, 2.-nyansamukide, 3.-nyansamusya, 4.-nyansamukila, 5.-nyansamukilalyo, 6.-nyansamukisya, 7.-nysansamuka-nyansamuka, 8.-nyansamusyanya)

be acitve, be agile, Konyansauka kweenda kutegwa ufwambe kujoka. Move fast so that you come back quickly. (1.-nyansaukwa, 2.-nyansaukide, 3.-nyansauzya, 4.-nyansaukila, 5.-nyansaukilalyo, 6.-nyansaukisya, 7.-nyansauka-nyansauka, 8.-nyansaukizyanya) Also: -nantauka, -nyangauka, -ezemuka.

belittle, under-rate, regard as of little value, rt. nyansya, Ndaunyansilizya mulimo oyo, aboobo ndaumana ndimunya sunu. = This work is nothing to me, and so I will finish it on the same day. Bamwi bantu balanyansilizya zilengwa zyamisyobo yabamwi. = Some people do not value the customs of other tribes. (1.-nyansilizyigwa, 2.-nyansilizyide, 3.-nyansilizyizya, 4.-nyansilizyila, 5.-nyansilizyizyalyo, 6.-nyansilizyisya, 7.-nyansilizyanyansilizya, 8.-nyansilizyanya)
  • despise, rt. -nyansya, Ncibi kukanyansilizya kana aka nkaambo nkafwiifwi. It is bad to despise this child because it is short.

be quick to do something, Wakalinyansula kunyamuka. = He moved quickly to get up. (1.-nyansulwa, 2.-nyansulide, 3.-nyansuzya, 4.-nyansululila, 5.-nyansulilalyo, 6.-nyansukisya, 7.-nyansula-nyasnsula, 8.-nyasulizyanya)

despise, hold in contempt, show disrespect, Ooyu mwana tajisi mulemyo, ulanyansya bapati. = This child has no respect, s/he despises the elders. Mulandu wakwiinyansya nkuta okuno ulailungila K100,000. = For the offence of contempt of the court here you are fined K100,000. (1.-nyansigwa, 2.-nyansyide, 3.-nyansizya, 4.-nyansyila, 5.-nyansilalyo, 6.-nyansyisya, 7.-nyansya-nyansya, 8.-nyansyanya)

go to extremes, overdo, Mazuba akainda wakali kubba zintu zisyoonto, pesi aano mazuba wanyanya. = In past days he used to steal small things, but these days he has gone to extremes. Wakali kulanga doono kaka limwi mweenzu ulalaya, walo mweenzu wanyanya mbwaakkala. = She was looking hoping that perhaps the visitor might say good bye, but the visitor persisted in sitting on. Ndakanyanya kubalisya mootokala. = I kept driving the car at high speed. (2.-nyanyide, 4.-nyanyila, 5.-nyanyilayo, 6.-nyanyisya, 7.-nyanya-nyanya)

be lively, active, agile, Konyanyaala kweenda nkaambo mulangu wacikolo ulaafwiifwi kulila. = Walk fast because the school-bell is about to ring. Tanyanyaali. Mubili oonse wakayuma nta kubee ncisamu. = He did not move about. His whole body became stiff like a tree. (1.-nyanyaalwa, 2.-nyanyaalide, 3.-nyanyaazya, 4.-nyanyaalila, 5.-nyanyaalilalyo, 6.-nyanyaalisya, 7.-nyannaala-nyanyaala, 8.-nyanyaazyanya) Also: -ezemuka, -nantauka, -nyangauka.
increase in pain, Mutwe wakali kucisa asyoonto, pesi naakazumanana kubeleka wakanyanyaanka. = Her head was paining a little, but when she continued working the pain increased.
shake, Nyemu kuti zyaluba, taziyandiki kunyanyaansya. = If groundnuts are flowering, they should not be shaken. Also: -nyanyaazya

move slightly, as in fear, Nywebo nobantu muli bakandu. Nkaambo nzi ncomunyanyalika boobu? = You people are cowards. Why are you shifting about nervously like this? (1.-nyanyalikwa, 2.-nyanyalikide, 3.-nyanyalisya, 4.-nyanyalikila, 5.-nyanyalikilalyo, 6.-nyanyalikisya, 7.-nyanyalika-nyanyalika, 8.-nyanyalikizyanya)

step or sit lightly, Konyanyamana buya kukkala nkaambo inga koya kucityola cuuno. = Sit lightly or you will break the stool. (1.-nyanyamanwa, 2.-nyanyamene, 3.-nyanyamizya, 4.-nyanyamanina, 5.-nyanyaminalyo, 6.-nyanyamanisya, 7.-nyanyamana-nyanyamana, 8.-nyanyamaninana) Also: -nonomana, -nyonyomana.

stand erect, Wakamvwa masusu akwe nkwaanyanyamuka. He found his hair standing on end. (1.-nyanyamukwa, 2.-nyanyamukide, 3.-nyanyamusya, 4.-nyanyamukila, 5.-nyanyamukilalyo, 6.-nyanyamukisya, 7.-nyanyamuka-nyanyamuka, 8.-nyanyamukana)
  • rise a little, rt. -nyamuka, Konyanyamuka ndigusye cisani ncokkede acuuno. = Rise up gently so that I remove the cloth from the chair on which you are seated. Naakabuka abulo wakamvwa masusu nkwaanyanyamuka alimwi moyo wakwe wakatalika kuduntaana cakufwambaana. = When he got up from the bed he felt his hair standing on end and again his heart began to beat quickly.

cause to stand up, Wakalila namalwa buzuba obu ceetezya, cinyanyamuna masusu aamuntu nabani. = The friction drum sounded on this day in a moving way which would raise the hair on one's head no matter who.
make stand up, Ootu twaambo tunyanyamusya masusu. = These matters make your hair stand up.

shrink, Matete alanyanyana muzuba. = The reeds are withering in the sun. Also: -nyana-nyana. (1.-nyanyanizigwa, 2.-nyanyanide, 3.-nyanyanizya, 4.-nyanyanina, 5.-nyanyaninalyo, 6.-nyanyanisya, 7.-nyanyana-nyanyana)
shake, Wakamvwa muzuzumina mukali iwakali kunyanyasya nyika yoonse. = He heard a terrible sound which was shaking the whole earth.

be deprived, forfeit, Wakanyanzigwa mapayi a zisani kubabbi. = He was deprived of blankets and clothes by the robbers. (2.-nyanzyide, 3.-nyanzizya, 4.-nyanzila, 5.-nyanzilalyo, 6.-nyanzisya, 7.-nyanzigwa-nyanzigwa, 8.-nyanzyanya) Also: -nyangwa, -nyaigwa, nyanga.

take without right another's property, overpower, rt. -nyanga, Babbi bakanyanzya masuku, bantu banji kaboona. = The thieves took the masuku fruit when many people were asleep. Mmulandu mupati kunyanzya muntu cintu cakwe. = It is a serious crime to deprive a person of what s/he owns. Also: -nyanzaula, -nyanga, -nyea (1.-nyanzigwa, 2.-nyanzide, 3.-nyanzizya. 4.-nyanzyizya, 5.-nyanzyizyalyo, 6.-nyanzyisya, 7.-nyanzya-nyanzya, 8.-nyanzyanya)

deprive of many things, Bakamunyanzyaula nkaambo wakabula nguzu. = They deprived him of many things because he had no strength. (1.-nyanzyaulwa, 2.-nyazyawide, 3.-nyanzyawizya, 4.-nyanzyawida, 5.-nyanzyawidalyo, 6.-nyanzyaulisya, 7.-nyanzyaula-nyanzyaula, 8.-nyanzyaulana)
be quick, Nyawanyawa bakwesu kamufwambaana. = Be quick, my brothers, hurry up.

milling about, Kufwumbwa nkoolanga cabantu cakali kunyawinta buyo. = Wherever you looked the people were just milling about. Langa banyama bamusyokwe mbobanyawinta. = Look at the animals in the bush how they move around in great numbers. (2.-nyawintide, 3.-nyawintya, 4.-nyawintila, 5.-nyawintilalyo, 6.-nyawintisya, 7.-nyawinta-nyawinta, 8.-nyawintizyanya) Also: -nyawita.
move around together, Bantu bakali kunyawintizyanya mbuli basimunyewu banjililwa meenda mubwina. = The people were milling around like ants whose burrow had been flooded by water.

moving about in great numbers, Tuuka twiile kunyawita mubwaanda. = The insects are just swarming about the wall. Kufwumbwa nkoolanga cabantu cakali kunyawita buyo. = Wherever you look the people were milling around. (2.-nyawitide, 3.-nyawitya, 4.-nyawitikila, 5.-nyawitikilalyo, 6.-nyawitisya, 7.-nyawita-nyawita, 8.-nyawitizyanya) Also: -mimila, -bumbilila, -nyawinta.

moving around all about, rt. -nyawita, Bamoomba bali kujanwa kabanyawitika mboluli lubuwa loonse mafwumofwumo. = The turkey buzzards were found moving around all over the whole courtyard in the morning. (1.-nyawitikwa, 2.-nyawitikide, 3.-nyawitizya, 4.-nyawitikila, 5.-nyawitikilalyo, 6.-nyawitikisya, 7.-nyawitika-nyawitika, 8.-nyawitikizyanya)

take away from, deprive, Komunyaya cisani eeci tacimweelede. = Take this cloth from him, it does not fit him. Mubbi wakanyaya nkoli sikulindila akumuuma. = *The thief took the stick from the guard and beat him.* Tacili cibotu bana kunywa bukoko, bulanyaya maanu anguzu. = *It is not good for children to drink beer, it takes away intelligence and energy.* Kunyina muntu weelede kukunyaya bwami. = *No person should take away your authority.* (1.-nyaigwa, 2.-nyayide, 3.-nyayizya, 4.-nyayila, 5.-nyayilalyo, 6.-nyaisya, 7.-nyaya-nyaya, 8.-nyayana) Also: -nyanga.

take from one's own, rt. nyaya, Ino ndakanyayilwa nzi mali ngindakabwezela? = *Now why was I deprived of the money which I had picked up?* (2.-nyayilidwe, 3.-nyayizyigwa, 4.-nyayililwa, 5.-nyayililwalyo, 6.-nyayilisyigwa, 7.-nyayilwa-nyayilwa)

overpower, Musankwa mubi wakanyea mwana mali. = *A bad boy overpowered the child taking the money.* (1.-nyeyegwa, 2.-nyeyede, 3.-nyeyezya, 4.-nyeyela, 5.-nyeyelalyo, 6.-nyeyesya, 7.-nyea-nyea, 8.-nyeyana) Also: -nyaya, -nyanga.

chew, Ncibotu kunyeela kabotu cakulya kutegwa kacigayigwa kabotu mwida. = *It is good to chew food well so that it is digested well in the stomach.* Naakamvwa kunona kwabuci walo wakali kwiide kulongela buyo mukanwa kakunyina akunyeela. = *When she tasted the sweetness of the honey she just kept it in her mouth without chewing.* (1.-nyeelwa, 2.-nyeelede, 3.-nyeezya, 4.-nyeelela, 5.-nyeelelalyo, 6.-nyeelesya, 7.-nyeela-nyeela, 8.-nyeelana)
cause to be chewed up, rt. -nyeela, Kamunyeelesya matobo alamutinga. = *Chew up the matobo fruit, they will stick in your throat.* Also: -tafwuna.

walk away secretly, Mucembele wakanyeemuka kuya mu syokwe kuya kusya musamu. = *The old woman moved secretly going to the bush to dig medicine.* (1.-nyeemukwa, 2.-nyeemukide, 3.-nyeemukizya, 4.-nyeemukila, 5.-nyeemukilalyo, 6.-nyeemukisya, 7.-nyeemuka-nyeemuka) Also: -nyweemuka.

tantalize, Ncibi kunyeemuzya umwi cintu ncotakwe kumupa. = *It is bad to tantalize another with what you do not intend to give.* Mukaintu mubi unyeemuzya bana ndongwe nzyatakwe kubapa. = *A bad woman tantalizes children with groundnuts which she will not give them.* (1.-nyeemuzyigwa, 2.-nyeemuzyizye, 3.-nyeemuzyisya, 4.-nyeemuzyizya, 5.-nyeemuzyizyalyo, 6.-nyeemuzyisya, 7.-nyeemuzya-nyeemuzya, 8.-nyeemuzyanya) Also: -nyemuuzya, -sombezya, -jeemuzya.
