jumping about, Moyo wangu wakali kuvwilima akoontoka mbuli syokwe lyamukasena katajugwi bwizu. = My heart was blazing and jumping about like a bush-fire in a valley where the grass has not been cut. (1.-ontokwa, 2.-ontokede, 3.-ontosya, 4.-ontokela, 5.-ontokelalyo, 6.-ontokesya, 7.-ontoka-ontoka, 8.-ontokana)

be suddenly aroused, Mulwazi wakatalika kuontomoka naakanjilwa zeelo. The patient was suddenly aroused when possessed by evil spirits. (1.-ontomokwa, 2.-ontomokede, 3.-ontomosya, 4.-ontomokela, 5.-ontomokelalyo, 6.-ontomokesya, 7.-ontomoka-ontomoka, 8.-ontomokana) Also: -ponzomoka, -sontomoka.
  • get worked up, become emotional, Walo kubala inga woontomoka buya ku bee kuli camuluma. = When reading he reads intensely as if something has bitten him. Wakayeeya kuti naatakoontomoka, zyoonse eezi nizyatakali kucitika. = He realized that if he hadn't got worked up, all these things would not have happened.

be driven to do something, Wakatalika kulikombya kati ccita naa wanjidwe musangu nzi waamoontomona kuyandwa kumudaala. She began to plead saying that perhaps she had been entered by a spirit which drove her to be loved by an old man. (1.-ontomonwa, 2.-ontomwede, 3.-ontomozya, 4.-ontomweda, 5.-ontomwedalyo, 6.-ontomonesya, 7.-ontomona-ontomona, 8.-ontomonana)

be wrinkled, Cisani cangu cakaide kuonyana nicakaligwa ngulube. = My dress became wrinkled when it was eaten by a pig. Also: -kokonyana, -vwungana. (1.-onyanwa, 2.-onyanide, 3.-onyanizya, 4.-onyanina, 5.-onyaninalyo, 6.-onyanisya, 7.-onyana-onyana)

throw up at, as a stick at fruit, Katoonza matobo tulye. = Lets throw sticks at the matobo fruit so that we eat. Bayakukoonza masuku musyokwe bana. = The children are going to throw sticks at the masuku fruit in the bush. (1.-onzwa, 2.-onzede, 3.-onzezya, 4.-onzela, 5.-onzelalyo, 6.-onzesya, 7.-onza-onza, 8.-onzana)
  • get wealthy by force, Lubono Iwakoonza taluli kabotu. = Wealth acquired unlawfully is not good.

call someone in a highpitched voice, Bacembele bakali koonzolola bana kuti bapiluke kunanda. = The old lady was calling the children to return to the house. (1.-onzololwa, 2.-onzolwede, 3.-onzolozya, 4.-onzolweda, 5.-onzolwedalyo, 6.-onzololesya, 7.-onzolola-onzolola, 8.-onzololana)

call in a high-pitched voice, speak aloud, e.g Koonzomoka kwiita kutegwa bamvwe baboole. = Call them with a loud voice so that they hear and come here. (1.-onzomokwa, 2.-onzomokede, 3.-onzomosya, 4.-onzomokela, 5.-onzomokelalyo, 6.-onzomokesya, 7.-onzomoka-onzomoka, 8.-onzomokelana)
  • embark on an unfortunate course of action, Ndakaonzomoka kubweza Iweendo ndwindatakalibambide. Ndaakunjila muntenda. I was unfortunate to undertake a journey which I was not prepared for. I got involved in an accident, Also: -unzumuka. *-onzomokela* call by the wrong name, rt. -onzomoka, Wakaile kundoonzomokela kundiita. She called me by a wrong name.
  • cause someone to be in trouble, Wakaile kumoonzomokela mwana waakkede buyo kabotu kuli banyina, wamutola ku Lusaka nkwaakaakuguntwa mootokala akutyoka kuulu. = He just brought problems to the child who was staying happily with his mother by taking him to Lusaka where he was hit by a car and broke his leg.

tie, Koyoopa looye nombe eyo kutegwa ikamwe. = Tie that cow with a rope so that it is milked. Wakamoopa kuulu kulaa cilonda musune. = He tied the leg of the ox which had a sore. (1.-opwa, 2.-opede, 3.-opya, 4.-opela, 5.-opelalyo, 6.-opesya, 7.-opa-oра, 8.-opana)

tie up, Wakoopola mutwe wamangoye akukwela matwi. He tied up the cat by the head and pulled it's ears. (1.-opolwa, 2.-opolede, 3.-opolezya, 4.-opolela, 5.-opolelalyo, 6.-opolesya, 7.-opola-opola, 8.-opolana)

dress the hair, plait hair into braids, Musimbi wakali koosa masusu amwanookwabo. = The girl was plaiting her sister's hair. (1.-oswa, 2.-osede, 3.-osya/osezya, 4.-osela, 5.-oselalyo, 6.-osesya, 7.-osoosa, 8.-osana.) Also: -luka, -pesa.
  • twist fibre, spin, Basankwa baya kukoosa mikkwilo musyokwe yakuccaizya nombe. = Those boys are going to twist fibres for whips with which to drive the cattle in the bush. Muteyi woosa tukole. = The trapper is twisting fibres for traps. Bamwi bakaunkide kuya kusya loozi Iwamubombo Iwakoosa toozi twakubambya maaya. = Some went to dig fibres of the mubombo tree to weave fibres for making the maaya skirts.

plait one anothers hair, rt. -osa, Boosana masusu basimbi. = The girls are plaiting each other's hair. (1.-osanwa, 2.-osanide, 3.-osamizya, 4.-osanina, 5.-osaninalyo, 6.-osanisya, 7.-osana-osana, 8.-osana)

replait, rt. -osa, Tiibamoosa kabotu aboobo masusu baawosolola. They did not plait the hair properly and so they had to undo it. Koosolola mukkwilo wazambuluka. = Replait the whip, it has become unwound. (1.-osolowa, 2.-osolwede, 3.-osolozya, 4.-osololela, 5.-osololelalyo, 6.-osololesya, 7.-osolola-osolola, 8.-osololana)
be plaited, Masusu aamukaintu ooyu akali malamfwu amana kaalyoosede mbuli boya bwanombe nkobuli kumucila. The hair of that woman was long and she had plaited it like the hair of a cow's tail.

kneel down to rest as a cow, Musune wootobala nkaambo wakatala kulima. The ox has knelt down because it is tired of ploughing. (1.-otobalwa, 2.-otobede, 3.-otobezya/ka, 4.-otobalila, 5.-otobalilalyo, 6.-otobalisya, 7.-otobala-otobala, 8.-otobekana)
  • become tame, submit, Mulimi wakazumanana limwi kumamanino musune wakootobala wanjila mufwolo. = The farmer persevered until finally the ox became tame and followed the line of the plough. Also: -tamba.
  • cool temper, subdue agitation, Muleelede kwiisunga myoyo yanu, iwotobale, itontole. You ought to control your feelings, so that your hearts become cool and peaceful. Bakamujata kusikila limwi wootobala. They held him until he became subdued.
tame, Syuumbwa ngobayoowa twakamootobeka. = We tamed the lion which they fear. (1.-otobekwa, 2.-otobekede, 3.-otobezya, 4.-otobekela, 5.-otobekelalyo, 6.-otobekesya, 7.-otobeka-otobeka, 8.-otobekana)

become quiet, Muntu wanjidwe zeelo waile kuotomana nizyazwa. A person who had been possessed by evil spirits just became quiet when they came out. Also: -otobala, -tontomana, -kkalikila. (1.-otomanwa, 2.-otomonye, 3.-otomanya, 4.-otomanina, 5.-otomaninalyo, 6.-otomanisya, 7.-otomana-otomana, 8.-otomanizyanya)

pull or bring down, Kamuovwola mutabi wancenje kutegwa bafwiifwi bacele abalo. Pull down a branch of the mucenje tree so that those who are short can also gather the fruit. Also: -obola. (1.-ovwolwa, 2.-ovwede, 3.-ovwozya, 4.-ovweda, 5.-ovwedalyo, 6.-ovwolesya. 7.-ovwola-ovwola, 8.-ovwolana)

be bend down, as a branch, Masamu manji akaovwomana akaambo kaguwo pati lyakali kubbubbula jilo. = Many trees were bent down because of yesterday's strong wind. (1.-ovwomanizyigwa, 2.-ovwomenye, 3.-ovwomezya/ka, 4.-ovwomanina, 5.-ovwomaninalyo, 6.-ovwomanisya, 7.-ovwomana-ovwomana, 8.-ovwomanizyanya)

cause to bend, Naakatanta mumusamu wakauovwomeka mutabi nkaambo wakali mulemu. = When he climbed the tree he made the branch bend because he was heavy. (1.-ovwomekwa, 2.-ovwomekede, 3.-ovwomezya, 4.-ovwomekela, 5.-ovwomekelalyo, 6.-ovwomekesya, 7.-ovwomeka-ovwomeka, 8.-ovwomekana)

remove scum, Koovwulula maccovwu aayo azwe kumeso. = Remove that mucous so that it comes out of your eyes. (1.-ovwululwa, 2.-ovwulide, 3.-ovwuluzya, 4.-ovwulwida, 5.-ovwulidalyo, 6.-ovwululisya, 7.-ovwulula-ovwulula, 8.-ovwululana)

get food from boiling pot before it is ready, Koowa cisyu acikko cilatondwa. = It is taboo to remove relish from the fireplace before it is ready. Kuti kamuli mwabinda, kamuowa musozya nuutaningabizwa. If you are rushing, take the samp from the fire even before it is ready. Miyanda mulombe, nkuta yakujanina mulandu wakuti wakatalika koowa musozya waba Mookola wataningabizwa. = Young man Miyanda, the court finds you guilty of beginning to take the samp of Mr. Mookola before it was cooked. (metaphorical use concerning man found guilty of making a school-girl pregnant, the daughter of Mr. Mookola.) (1.-owegwa, 2.-owede, 3.-owezya 4.-owela, 5.-owelalyo, 6.-owesya, 7.-owaowa, 8.-owana)
  • help oneself to vomit by using fingers, Mulwazi wali kulyoowa kumoyo nikwavwundauka. The patient was sticking his fingers down his throat when he was nauseated.

cool down, rt. -ola, Kamoozeka mukwilili tuvwele bukoko. = Cool down the sweet-beer so that we mix it with beer. (1.-ozekwa, 2.-ozekede, 3.-ozesya, 4.-ozekela, 5.-ozekelalyo, 6.-ozekesya, 7.-ozeka-ozeka, 8.-ozekana) Also: -ozya.
  • take away energy, rt. -ola, Syuumbwa bakamutanda baumpe limwi baakumoozeka. The wild dogs chased the lion until they exhausted him.

doze, Bana bakoozela kabataningalya nkaambo nsima yakamuka kujikwa. Children dozed before supper because the nsima was late in being cooked. Tanaakali kuyanda koona pele tiilyakalampa wakatalika koozela. = He did not want to sleep but before long he began to doze. (1.-ozelwa, 2.-ozelede, 3.-ozezya, 4.-ozelela, 5.-ozelelalyo, 6.-ozelesya, 7.-ozela-ozela) Also: -uvwila.

draw out, as fibres, Twajana bamakaintu baozolola lutende Iwakulusya zisuwo. We found the women pulling the stems of the lutende plant for making baskets. (1.-ozololwa, 2.-ozolwede, 3.-ozolozya, 4.-ozolweda, 5.-ozolwedalyo, 6.-ozololesya, 7.-ozololaozolola, 8.-ozololana) Also: -obolola

pull down, Kamuozomona lungu Iwakazyalila mujulu. = Pull down the pumpkin runners which have produced pumpkins up there. (1.-ozomonwa, 2.-ozomwede, 3.-ozomozya, 4.-ozomonena, 5.-ozomonenalyo, 6.-ozomonesya, 7.-ozomona-ozomona, 8.-ozomonana)

cause to cool down, rt. -ola, Koozya meenda akunywa atontole. = Cool down the drinking water so that it becomes cold. (1.-ozyegwa, 2.-ozyede, 3.-ozyesya, 4.-ozyekela, 5.-ozyekelalyo, 6.-ozyesya, 7.-ozya-ozya, 8.-ozyekana) Also: -ozeka.

give, Bazyali balapa zintu zibotu kubana babo. Parents give good things to their children. Bana bafwa nzala, kamubapa cakulya. The children are hungry, give them food. Ndilyona ndyopa ndelikulya. The very one to whom you give, is the one who devours you. (1.-pegwa, 2.-pede, 3-pesya, 4.-peda, 5.-pedalyo, 6.-pesya, 7.-paapa, 8.-pana.)

suffer severe headache, Sunu masiku mutwe wangu wali kupaanta cakuti ndatalika kuzwa misozi. Last night my head was so painful that I was shedding tears. (1.-paantwa, 2.-paantide, 3.-paantya, 4.-paantila, 5.-paantilalyo, 6.-paantisya, 7.-paanta-paanta)
  • dig hard soil, Bantu bakaindi bakali kupaanta nyika noiyuma kutegwa mvwula yaboola bulongo bukafwambaane kuteta. The people of long ago were digging the earth when it was hard so that when the rain came the soil would become soft quickly.

extend sideways, Mababa aanziba itula alapaanyana. The wings of a dove which still lays eggs spread sideways as it flies. (1.-paanyanwa, 2.-paanyene, 3.-рааnyika, 4.-paanyina, 5.-paanyinalyo, 6.-paanyanisya, 7.-paanyana-paanyana)

be disrespectful, refuse in anger, Umwi musankwa naakali kubetekwa munkuta, wakali kwiile kupabauka kukanana. A certain man when he was being tried in court was just answering disrespectfully. (1.-pabausyigwa, 2.-pabaukide, 3.-pabausya, 4.-pabaukila, 5.-pabaukilalyo, 6.- pabaukisya, 7.-pabauka-pabauka, 8.-pabaukana)
  • resist, struggle against, nombe nsomona ilapabauka noikamwa. A cow which has given birth to its first calf tries to free itself when being milked. Also: -papauka, pazaya, -kangauka.

peel, cut up, slice as potatoe, Kamupabula magwili tubikke munyama. Peel the potatoes so that we put them in the meat. Also: -yupa, -fwalula, fwapula, -tenda. (1.-pabulwa, 2.-pabwide, 3.-pabuzya, 4.-pabwida, 5.-pabwidalyo, 6.-pabulisya, 7.-pabula-pabula, 8.-pabulana)

overflow, Niyakawa kapati mvwula milonga yakapaikila. When a lot of rain fell the rivers overflowed. (1.-paikilwa, 2.-paikide, 3.-pakizya, 4.-paikilila, 5.-paikililalyo, 6.-paikisya, 7.-paikila-paikila, 8.-paikilana)

sacrifice to the spirits Bamadaala bakaindi bakali kupaila mizimo yabo ciindi cacifwumofwumo. The old men of long ago used to offer sacrifice to their ancestral spirits in the morning. (1.-pailwa, 2.-pailide, 3.-paizya, 4.-pailila, 5.-paililalyo, 6.-pailisya, 7.-paila-paila, 8.-paililana.) Also: -piila, -payila.

offer libation to the spirits of the dead, Bukoko bantu babubelesya kupailila mizimo yabantu bakafwa. People use beer to offer to the spirits of people who have died.
  • pray for, Bakamupailila basicikombelo naakayanda kufwa. The churchgoers prayed for him when he was about to die. Mupaizi upailila mulwazi. The priest is praying for the patient.

be filled up, Mapopwe apaka mucizali. The maize has filled up in the maize-bin. Nomulimina kamulangisya mapopwe akapaka mpakatwa kamuzizwisya. When you weed look carefully at the maize whose stem has developed shoots so that you remove them. (1.-pakwa, 2.-pakide, 3.-pakizya, 4.-pakilila, 5.-pakililalyo, 6.-pakilisya, 7.-paka-paka)
  • erect, (using pieces of wood without branches) *Basankwa bapaka ciba cajombe.* = The boys are erecting a cattle-kraal.

prepare to go far, *Basilweendo bakapakaanya kutalika lweendo lulamfwu.* = The travellers prepared themselves for the long journey. (1.-*pakaanyizigwa*, 2.-*pakeenye*, 3.-*pakaanyizya*, 4.-*pakaanyina*, 5.-*pakaanyinalyo*, 6.-*pakaanyisya*, 7.-*pakaanya-pakaanya*, 8.-*pakaanyizyanya*)

load on a vehicle, *Babelezi bapakaika nkuni mucimbaya-mbaya.* = The workers are loading fire-wood on to the lorry. Also: -*pataika*. (1.-*pakaikwa*, 2.-*pakaikide*, 3.-*pakaizya*, 4.-*pakaikila*, 5.-*pakaikilalyo*, 6.-*pakaikisya*, 7.-*pakaika-pakaika*, 8.-*pakaikana*)

be boastful, *Mutinta wapakala nkaambo wabona umuvwuna.* = Mutinta is boasting because she has seen someone to defend her. *Ncibi kupakala mboomanina kusilikwa, munanga inga wanyema.* = It is bad to be boasting when you have been treated, it can make the witchdoctor angry. Also: -*twanga* (1.-*pakalwa*, 2.-*pakede*, 3.-*pakazya*, 4.-*pakalila*, 5.-*pakalilalyo*, 6.-*pakalisya*, 7.-*pakala-pakala*, 8.-*pakazyanya*)

do many things at the same time hurriedly, *Bacembele bakapakalisya kubikka zigwetegwete munanda niyakasika mvwula.* = The old lady hurried to put all her belongings into the house when the rain came. *Ncepakalisya bobuya njanda kutola mwana kucibbadela.* = I am busy like this because I want to take the child to hospital. (1.-*pakalisyigwa*, 2.-*pakalisyide*, 4.-*pakalisyizya*, 5.-*pakalisyizyalyo*, 6.-*pakalisyisya*, 7.-*pakalisya-pakalisya*, 8.-*pakalisyanya*)

be alert, *Kamupakamana koona, cimwi ciindi babbi balaboola* V - 404 *asunu masiku.* = Be alert when sleeping, perhaps the thieves will come again tonight. *Ncibotu kupakamana kuti kakuli ntenda iilangilwa.* = It is good to be alert when you expect danger. (1.-*pakamanwa*, 2.-*pakamenye*, 3.-*pakamika*, 4.-*pakamanina*, 5.-*pakaminalyo*, 6.-*pakamanisya*, 7.-*pakamana-pakamana*, 8.-*pakamaninana*)
be in an alert state, *Munene wakoonya kumaulu, kumutwe kapakamene.* = The old man was asleep at the feet, at the head he was alert.

push oneself forward, to put yourself in a position in which you are not supposed to be, *Musimbi uulipakamisa basankwa tabamuyandi.* = A girl who pushes herself forward is not liked by boys. (1.-*pakamiswa*, 2.-*pakamiside*, 3.-*pakamisya*, 4.-*pakamisila*, 5.-*pakamisilalyo*, 6.-*pakamisisya*, 7.-*pakamisa*)
  • be ambitious, *Kulipakamisa kuti kwaindilila nkubi.* = Ambition for oneself is bad if it becomes extreme.

extract, *Mudaala Chooka wakali kupakamuna tombwe mulutete.* = The old man Chooka was extracting tobacco from the reed. *Nobakamana kulya bakasyaala buyo kulisyoba milomo akulipakamuna tunyama-nyama twaapatide mumeno.* = When they had finished eating they just remained wiping their lips and removing pieces of meat from their teeth. (1.-*pakamunwa*, 2.-*pakamwide*, 3.-*pakamuzya*, 4.-*pakamwida*, 5.-*pakamwidalyo*, 6.-*pakamunisya*, 7.-*pakamuna-pakamuna*, 8.-*pakamuninana*) Also: -*pakununa*.

remove what is carried under the armpit, *Basimbi bakapakanuna tubbeeke twabo nibakasika amunzi.* = The girls removed their bags which they had being carrying under their armpits when they arrived home. (1.-pakanunwa, 2.-pakanwide, 3.-pakanuzya, 4.-pakanwida, 5.-pakanwidalyo, 6.-pakanunisya, 7.-pakanuna-pakanuna, 8.-pakanuninana) Also: -pakatula.
be overloaded, Ndabona nkotabooli kuzikundaanzya, ani pele walipakasizye. I noticed that you did not come to greet me, but the reason was that you were working too hard.

be overloaded with work, be very busy, *Ndapakasya* milimo yandivwulila mebo. I am overloaded with jobs which are too many for me. Ijilo ndakapakasya, tiindakajana ciindi cakuya kucikolo. = I was very busy yesterday, I did not find time to go to school. Ecino ciindi camwaka balimi boonse ncobeelede kupakasya kapati. This is the time of the year when the farmers ought to be very busy. (1.-pakasyigwa, 2.-pakasyide, 4.-pakasyila, 5.-pakasyilalyo, 6.-pakasyisya, 7.-pakasya-pakasya, 8.-pakasyanya) Also: -jata bubi.
  • cause to be busy, Mulimo wakutwa busu nguwakandipakasya. = The work of pounding caused me to be busy.

carry or hang under the arm, Nobauma kalyaba lyankolola, ngoma inga bazipakata balombwana. = When the boys beat out the kalyaba rhythm at an initiation ceremony they hand the drums under their arms. (1.-pakatwa, 2.-pakatide/pakete, 3.-pakatya, 4.-pakatila, 5.-pakatilalyo, 6.-pakatisya, 7.-pakata-pakata, 8.-pakatana)
  • form, as a mealie cob, Mapopwe angu akapakata kabotu mwaka uno. = My maize was filling out well this year.

remove, Katupakatula mpakatwa kumapopwe. = Let us remove the young shoots between the leaves of the maize. (1.-pakatulwa, 2.-pakatwide, 3.-pakatuzya, 4.-pakatwida, 5.-pakatwidalyo, 6.-pakatulisya, 7.-pakatulapakatula, 8.-pakatulana)
cause to boast, rt. -pakala, Cakamupakazya nkutajana mapenzi. = The reason why he boasts is because he has not experienced problems.

carry under arm, rt. -pakata, Ndabona musimbi upakete kabbeeke. = I saw a girl carrying a bag under her arm. (1.-pakatwa, 2.-pakete, 3.-pakatwa, 4.-pakatila, 5.-pakatilalyo, 6.-pakatisya, 7.-pakete-pakete, 8.-pakatana)

load a gun, Kopakila ntobolo ambweni syuumbwa tulamujana asunu. Load the gun we may find a lion even today. (1.-pakilwa, 2.-pakide, 3.-pakizya, 4.-pakilila, 5.-pakililalyo, 6.-pakilisya, 7.-pakila-pakila, 8.-pakililana) Also: - tatila.
  • make a cigarette, Kopakila musanga watombwe ndiyanda kufweba. = Pack a cigarette, I want to smoke.

make hole in the seat, as in wood when making a traditional stool, Nomubamba cimbwalakasa mweelede kucipakula cisamu kusaanguna. = When making a traditional stool you first make the hole. Bataata bapakula cilayi. = Father is carving out a hole in the wood for a sledge. Also: -pokola. (1.-pakulwa, 2.-pakwide, 3.-pakuzya, 4.-pakwida, 5.-pakwidalyo, 6.-pakulisya, 7.-pakula-pakula, 8.-pakulana)

remove, Katupakununa mpakatwa zyamapopwe kumuunda. = Let us go and remove the shoots from the maize stalks. Kopakununa tombwe ngobapangide mumusanga bataata nkaambo ngobapangide ulalula. = Remove the tobacco from the cigarette which my father has made because what he has packed is bitter. Also: -pakamuna. (1.-pakununwa, 2.-pakunwide, 3.-pakunuzya, 4.-pakunwida, 5.-pakunwidalyo, 6.-pakununisya, 7.-pakununa-pakununa, 8.-pakununana)

take out food from cooking pot to plate, rt. -pakula, Kamundipakwida nsima ndye. = Dish out some food for me so that I eat. (1.-pakulwa, 2.-pakwide, 3.-pakuzya, 4.-pakwida, 5.-pakwidalyo, 6.-pakulisya, 7.-pakulapakula, 8.-pakwidana) Also: -apula, -apwida.

paw the ground as a bull, Basankwa bajana mucende ulaboba akupala akaulu. = The boys found the bull roaring and pawing the ground at an anthill. (1.-palwa, 2.-palide, 3.-palizya, 4.-palila, 5.-palilalyo, 6.-palisya, 7.-palapala, 8.-palilana)
  • shave as wood or feathers, scrub, scrape as skin or pot, Mucembele upala zibiya murnanda. = The old woman is scraping pots in the house. Intale yakati, "Kamundipala mapapa amusana." = The crocodile said, "Scrape the scales on my back." Bina Mutinta balapala maamba aabaama acikamu. = The mother of Mutinta is removing the dandruff from my mother with a comb. Wakakapala kayuni mapepe onse, kwaacaala buyo cikanda cisalala anyama mbotu mukati. = She scraped off all the feathers of the bird, there remained the pure skin and the good meat inside.

fork, as a road, Migwagwa yakapalalana munsaa mulundu. = The roads forked near the hill. (1.-palalanwa, 2.-palalanide, 3.-palalanya, 4.-palalanina, 5.-palalaninalyo, 6.-palalanisya, 7.-palalana-palalana) Also: -andana, -pambukana.
go bad, Mabisi apalamuka. The sour milk has become bad. (2.-palamukide, 3.-palamusya, 4.-palamukila, 5.-palamukilalyo, 6.-palamukisya, 7.-palamuka-palamuka) Also: -sakamuna, -syakamuka.

become aggressive, Moonde wakatalika kupalangana kuti alwane naakabona wakamubbida. Moonde began to become aggressive when he saw the one who stole from him. (1.-palanganwa, 2.-palangenye, 3.-palanganya, 4.-palanganina, 5.-palangninalyo, 6.-palanganisya, 7.-palangana-palangana, 8.-palanganizyigwa) Also: -zazangana.
  • struggle, Mwana ulapalangana nayaswa nyeleti. The child struggles when being injected.

disorganize, confuse, Ino nguni wali kupalanganya mabbuku ngindakabambide kabotu? = Now who was upsetting the books which I had set in good order? Haacoozi wazipalanganya zintu. = Haacoozi has confused things.

pawing the ground in readiness to fight, Ooyu mucende upala-pala kuti alwane. = This bull is pawing the ground eager to fight.
  • scrape off, Musilisi wakakapalapala kabale kakali muliso lyabacembele. = The doctor scraped off the cataract which was in the old woman's eye.

act angrily, Walo wiide kupalauka mbuli mbwakonzya. = He acts angrily in readiness for a fight. (1.-palaukwa, 2.-palaukide, 3.-palauzya, 4.-palaukila, 5.-palaukilalyo, 6.-palaukisya, 7.-palauka-palauka, 8.-palausyanya)

struggle to rise, as one lifting a heavy load, Wakapalaya kusola kucinyamuna cibulo, pesi cakaala. = He struggled to lift the iron, but he failed. Inombe ilapalaya niifwa. A Cow struggles to rise when dying. Also: -pazaya, -gwalaya. (1.-palayigwa, 2.-palayide, 3.-palayizya, 4.-palayila, 5.-palayilalyo, 6.-palayisya, 7.-palaya-palaya, 8.-palayilana)
fork, as roads, Ndajana muntu ufwide apalanina nzila. = I found a dead person where the roads fork. Also: -andanina nzila

peel by scraping, cut thin slices, Kamupalula mungu mutubeela-beela. Cut the pumpkin into pieces. (1.-palulwa, 2.-palwide, 3.-paluzya 4.-palwida, 5.-palwidalyo, 6.-palulisya, 7.-palula-palula, 8.-palulana)
  • circumcise, Tacili cilengwa ca Batonga kupalulwa pe. It is not the custom of the Batonga to be circumcised.
be circumcised, Batonga tiibakali kupalulwa kuzwa lili. = The Batonga were never circumcised.

tie intricately, (as a calabash in order to carry it), Kamupamba cibbudu alooye luyumu kutegwa citakaloki batanta ncinga. Tie the luggage with a strong cord so that it doesn't fall off when he gets up on the bicycle. Also: -zambaila. (1.-pambwa, 2.-pambide, 3.-pambya, 4.-pambila, 5.-pambilalyo, 6.-pambisya, 7.-pamba-pamba, 8.-pambana)
  • paint an earthen pot with stripes, decorate, Wamana kubumba cibiya, weelede kucipamba mbuli myeengwe yacibize. After making a clay pot, you should paint it with stripes like that of a zebra's. Also: -cekaula.

decorate with stripes, Bataata bapambaila butala apambe liniini. = My father decorated the maize bin with a small stripe. (1.-pambailwa, 2.-pambailide, 3.-pambaizya, 4.-pambailila, 5.-pambaililalyo, 6.-pambailisya, 7.-pambaila-pambaila, 8.-pambailana)

swerve, Ijamba lilapambalika, nkaambo mulomo wakamana. = The plough swerves because the head is blunt. (1.-pambalikwa, 2.-pambalikide, 3.-pambalisya, 4.-pambalikila, 5.-pambalilkilalyo, 6.-pambalikisya, 7.-pambalikapambalika, 8.-pambalikana)

spread out as pumpkin leaves, Milibo yanyabo yakapambana kale. The bean runners have already spread out. (1.-pambanwa, 2.-pambene, 3.-pambanya, 4.-pambanina, 5.-pambaninalyo, 6.-pambanisya, 7.-pambanapambana, 8.-pambana)
be intricate, Mazila anombe alipambene. Cattle paths are complex.

go aside, evade, part company, Mukwaale ulapambuka kuzyeenzinyina. = Mukwaale parts company with the other cattle. Mainza wakaamba kuti, "Ndilakupambuka nkaambo watalika kutobela basibukoko." = Mainza spoke saying, "I will part company with you since you have started going along with beer-drinkers." Bantu bakalikuyanda kumupambuka mucembele akumusiya mu-tongo. The people wanted to isolate the old woman and leave her in the deserted village. Bana beelede kuyiisigwa kabotu kutegwa batabi nobapambukana. = Children out to be taught well so that they do not be going off on their own. (1.-pambukwa, 2.-pambukide, 3.-pambusya, 4.-pambukila, 5.-pambu-kilalyo, 6.-pambukisya, 7.-pambuka-pambuka, 8.-pambukana) Also: -zanduka, -pampuka.

parted company, rt. pambuka, Bantu aaba bakaliyanzene, mazuba ano bakapambukana. = These people who were friendly have parted company nowadays. Bazovwu bakapambuana nibakasika amanzaanino aanzila. = The elephants separated when they came to a crossroads. (1.-pambukwa, 2.-pambukide, 3.-pambusya, 4.-pambukila, 5.-pambukilalyo, 6.-pambukisya, 7.-pambuka-pambuka, 8.-pambukana)
go aside towards, rt. pambuka, Aabo ibakapambukila kujwe bakaakwiitwa kuti mba Soli. = Those who diverted eastwards were called the Basoli.

shave round leaving the hair in the middle, trim, Mazubaano basankwa bamwi bayanda kupambulwa kugelwa. Nowadays some boys want to be shaved around the sides of the head, leaving hair on top. Also: -tengula, -lazika. (1.-pambulwa, 2.-pambwide, 3.-pambuzya, 4.-pambwida, 5.-pambwidalyo, 6.-pambulisya, 7.-pambula-pambula, 8.-pambulana)
  • make a diversion on the road, Bakabamba kambi kagwagwa kapambula kuya ku Chikuni. They made another road to make a diversion going to Chikuni. Also: -pampula.
  • separate as oxen from herd, Kamupambula boombe kumanyina. = Separate the calves from the cows. Also: -zandula.

unwind as strings round a cake of tobacco, unravel, Kamupambulana cilundu catombwe bafwebe bakaapa. = Unwind the cake of tobacco for my grandmother to smoke. (1.-pambulanwa, 2.-pambulanide, 3.-pambulanya, 4.-pambulanina, 5.-pambulaninalyo, 6.-pambulanisya, 7.-pambulana-pambulana, 8.-pambulana) Also: -zambulula, -pambulula, -ambununa.

separate, Katupambuuka ano mpozyaandaana nzila. = Let us separate here where the roads divide. (1.-pambuukwa, 2.-pambuukide, 3.-pambuuzya, 4.-pambuukila, 5.-pambuukilalyo, 6.-pambuukisya, 7.-pambuuka-pambuuka, 8.-pambuukana)

divide into small portions, Musimbi ulayanika mombola (nseke). Nozivwula, ulazipambuula kuti azibelesye. = The girl dries the seeds. When there are sufficient, she divides them into portions so that she can use them. (1.-pambuulwa, 2.-pambwiide, 3.-pambuuzya, 4.-pambwiida, 5.-pambwiidalyo, 6.-pambuulisya, 7.-pambuula-pambuula, 8.-pambuulana)

become white or grey when drying, Ciindi camainza kuti walanga kucimpati ali meja anombe ulati ntusamu tupampe. In the rainy season if you look in the kraal, the horns of cattle are as white as white sticks. (1.-pampwa, 2.-pampide, 3.-pampya, 4.-pampila, 5.-pampilalyo, 6.-pampisya, 7.-pampa-pampa, 8.-pampana)

be unsteady in action or speech, feel giddy, Muntu wakolwa bukoko ulapampalika. A drunk person moves unsteadily. (1.-pampalikwa, 2.-pampalikide, 3.-pampalisya, 4.-pampalikila, 5.-pampalikilalyo, 6.-pampalikisya, 7.-pampalika-pampalika) Also: -tenteleka, -bbabbalika, -dadalika.

raise the head with eyes looking upwards, Kopampamana ubone ndeke. Look up to see the aeroplane. (1.-pampamana, 2.-pampamene, 3.-pampamanya, 4.-pampamanina, 5.-pampaminalyo, 6.-pampamanisya, 7.-pampamana-pampamana, 8.-pampamaninana) Also: -lungumana.
stick out, Meno a mucembele alipampamene. = The teeth of the old woman are jutting out.

drink without stopping, Mulwazi wakapampamuna kagumbuli kacibwantu katalekezyi. The patient emptied the container of sweet-beer without stopping. (1.-pampamunwa, 2.-pampamwide, 3.-pampamuzya, 4.-pampamwida, 5.-pampamwidalyo, 6.-pampamunisya, 7.-pampamunapampamuna)

nibble at groundnuts, Mbeba zilapampana ndongwe. = The rats are nibbling the groundnuts. (1.-pampanwa, 2.-pampene, 3.-pampanya, 4.-pampamanina, 5.-pampaтаninalyo, 6.-pampanisya, 7.-pampanapampana, 8.-pampana)
  • quarrel, Banabukwetene balapampana munanda. = The married couple are quarreling in the house. Kupampana amakwe taciboti pe. = To quarrel with inlaws is not good at all. Also: -zwangana.

open out as shell, cotton ball, large mushroom, blossom, Akaambo kamvwula bowa bulapampanuka cakukomena kapati. = Because of the rain the mushrooms are opening out and growing quickly. Buluba bwakapampanuka mumuunda. The cotton balls are opening out in the field. (1.-pampanukwa, 2.-pampanukide, 3.-pampanuzya, 4.-pampanukila, 5.-pampanukilalyo, 6.-pampanukisya, 7.pampanuka-pampanuka)
  • recover consciousness, Mwana walinetukide lino wapampanuka. = The child had fainted but now it has recovered. Also: -pampanyuka, -pempenuka.

open, open out, Kopampanuna cipego cako, ubone cili mukati. Open up your gift to see what is inside. (1.-pampanunwa, 2.-pampanwide, 3.-pampanuzya, 4.-pampanwida, 5.-pampanwidalyo, 6.-pampanunisya, 7.-pampanuna-pampanuna, 8.-pampanunana)
use short cut, Kanjikanji kwakali kunga nkwiide kupampanya musyokwe. Very often the short cut through the bush was used.
recover consiousness, Also: -pempenuka, -pampanuka

smash, crush, Baama bapampaula myungu yakujika. crushes the pumpkins for cooking. (1.-pampaulwa, 2.-pampawide, 3.-pampauzya, 4.-pampawida, 5.-pampawidalyo, 6.-pampaulisya, 7.-pampaula-pampaula, 8.-pampaulana)

cut for, Kwakali kunga buzuba mwinakwe atamupampawida tulyo pele ninkondo aboola kuzwa a Nsangwa. It happened that on a day when his wife did not cut food stuffs there was a fight when he came from Nsangwa.

eat or drink without stopping, Ooyu wakapampikizya kagumbuli koonse kacibwantu. = This one has drunk the whole container of sweet beer without stopping. (1.-pampakizyigwa, 2.-pampikizyide, 4.-pampikizyizya, 5.-pampikizyizyalyo, 6.-pampikizyisya, 7.-pampikizyapampikizya, 8.pampikizyanya) Also: -ngungumuna, -pampamuna.

become prudent, careful, Kuti wasika mudolopo uleelede kupampuka. When you arrive at a town you ought to be prudent. (1.pampukwa, 2.-pamukide, 3.-pampusya, 4.-pampukila, 5.-pampukilalyo, 6.-pampukisya, 7.-pampuka-pampuka, 8.-pampusyanya) Also: -panuka.
  • cut off, Atumupampuke munanga ooyu anjina yakwe. Let us cut this diviner off and his louse.

separate, Banabukwetene tabeelede kupampukana nobajana makatazyo. = Married people should not separate when they find difficulties. (1.-pampukanwa, 2.-pampukene, 3.-pampukanya, 4.-pampukanina, 5.-pampukaninalyo, 6.-pampukanisya, 7.-pampukana-pampukana, 8.-pampukana) Also: -andaanya.

cut short, e.g Nitwakali kuya ku Gwembe twakainda kazila kapampula. When we were going to Gwembe we took a short-cut. Mother (1.-pampulwa, 2.-pampwide, 3.-pampuzya, 4.-pampwida, 5.-pampwidalyo, 6.-pampulisya, 7.-pampula-pampula, 8.-pampulana) Also: -dabula, -kosola.
  • dish out, Nakooma wakapampula zyakulya nzyaakajikilide bana bakwe. = Nakooma shared out the food which she had cooked for her children.

cut in pieces, crush, Baama bapampuula myungu yakujikila. Mother is cutting a pumpkin into pieces for cooking. (1.-pampuulwa, 2.-pampwiide, 3.-pampuuzya, 4.-pampwiida, 5.-pampwiidalyo, 6.-pampuulisya, 7.-pampuula-pampuula, 8.-pampuulana) Also: -pampaula, -papaula.
be alert, Kamupanama nomweenda, mutani kulangi ansi. = Walk alertly, don't be looking down. (1.-panamwa, 2.-paneme, 3.-panamya, 4.-panamina, 5.-panaminalyo, 6.-panamisya, 7.-panama-panama)

plough a new field, Mulimi wakapanda muunda mupati. = The farmer has ploughed a big new field. Muunda oyu ucili wainoino ncokuli zifwumpu nkaambo waali kuupanda taakali kugonkesya pe. = This field is only recently made that is why there are stumps because the one who was opening it did not cut them enough. (1.-pandwa, 2.-pandide, 3.-pandizya, /pandya, 4.-pandila, 5.-pandilalyo, 6.-pandisya, 7.-panda-panda.)
  • branch out, Musamu ooyu wakapanda mpanda zinji kapati. = This tree has branched out into many branches. Also: -sanda.
  • use someone or something to make the medicine of witchcraft effective, Mulozi naakapanda musamu wakapandya mwanaangu. = The witch killed my child to make his witchcraft medicine effective.

be cracked in many places, Cibuye cananda capandauka nkaa mbo samende taakavwelenye kabotu amusenga. The floor of the house has cracked because the cement was not well mixed with sand. Waakumana kulya ukakafwuse kabiya mujulu kutegwa kakapandauke kaakuwa ansi. When you have finished eating, throw the little pot up into the air so that it is smashed when it falls to the ground. Also: -panduuka. (1.-pandaukwa, 2.-pandaukide, 3.-pandauzya, 4.-pandaukila, 5.-pandaukilalyo, 6.-pandaukisya, 7.-pandauka-pandauka)

break into pieces, split, Musankwa upandaula nkuni. = The boy is cutting firewood. Bacipandaula cikuni kuti basikke kabotu mulilo uyake. = They split the log so that they could insert it properly into the fire for it to light. (1.-pandaulwa, 2.-pandawide, 3.-pandauzya, 4.-pandawida, 5.-pandawidalyo, 6.-pandaulisya, 7.-pandaula-pandaula, 8.-pandaulana) cf. -bbaluula, -kwamaula, -kwamauna.
  • shine with intense heat, Kulapya zuba nolipandaula kubala. It becomes hot when the sun shines furiously.

split open, Cimbwali cikwikkide kabotu cilapandausya kapati. = Sweet-potatoes that have propagated well split the mounds open. (1.-pandausyigwa, 2.-pandausyide, 3.-pandauzya, 4.-pandausyizya, 5.-pandasyizyalyo, 6.-pandausyisya, 7.-pandausya-pandausya)

burst open, be cracked, Matobo akapanduka pele taaningabizwa. = The matobo fruit is cracked, but it is not yet ripe. (2.-pandukide, 3.-pandusya, 4.-pandukila, 5.-pandukilalyo, 6.-pandukisya, 7.-panduka-panduka) Also: -nyenuka.

open, cleave, Kamupandula nswi eezyo, mwamana muziyanike. Open those fish, when finished put them out to dry in the sun. Chinene upandula kwale kutegwa ayanikwe. = Chinene is opening up the partridge to hang it up to dry. Musilisi naakapandula mulwazi, wakajana kuti bulwazi bwaindilila kukomena. = When the surgeon operated on the patient, he found that the disease had spread. (1.-pandulwa, 2.-pandulide/pandwide 3.-pandulizya/-panduzya, 4.-pandwida, 5.-pandwidalyo, 6.-pandulisya, 7.-pandula-pandula, 8.-pandulana)

cross over from one stage of growth to a maturer state. Kukubuka cakali nceciimo camamanino camusankwa kuti apanduluke, abe mulombwana mupati. The adolescent stage was the last stage before a male became an adult, and a mature man. (2.-pandulukide, 3.-panduluzya, 4.-pandulukila, 5.-pandulukilalyo, 6.-pandulukisya, 7.-panduluka-panduluka)
renew a field, Kopandulula mumuunda mootakapanda kabotu mwakali. = Renew the field which you did not open properly last year. (1.-pandululwa, 2.-pandulwide, 3.-panduluzya, 4.-pandulwida /
5.-pandulwidalyo/

6.-pandululisya, 7.-pandulula-pandulula, 8.-pandulwidana.)
  • explain, Kopandulula caano mbuli mbucakacitika. Tell the story as it happened. Musilisi upandulula bukwabilizi bwamalwazi. = The doctor is explaining the prevention of diseases. Also: -sansulula, -londolola, -lungululas, -pandulwida explain to, Kondipandulwida kutegwa ndicimvwe ncoamba. = Explain to me so that I understand what you are saying. Also: -lungulwida

crack, Izibiya zinji zyakapanduuka nizyakabalwa zuba. = Many earthen pots were cracked when the sun shone. (2.-panduukide, 3.-panduuzya, 4.-panduukila, 5.-panduukilalyo, 6.-panduukisya, 7.-panduuka-panduuka) Als-pandauka, -andaula.
move alertly, rt. -panama, Uleenda ulipaneme. She walks alertly. Also: -anza.

compose a song, Haamucemba ulicizyi kupanga ziimbo. = Haamucemba knows how to compose songs. (1.-pangwa, 2.-pangide, 3.-pangizya,/-panzya, 4.-pangila, 5.-pangilalyo, 6.-pangisya, 7.-panga-panga.)
  • make, Bantu bamwi balicizyi kupanga mali amaze. Some people know how to make counterfeit money. Mucila ulya nceelezyo biyo, nkaambo kunyina ancuupanga. = That tail is just a symbol because there is nothing you can make with it. Also: -pakila, -sangila.
  • make yourself out to be what you are not, Ulalipanga mbuli kuti mmwami. = He presents himself as if he were a chief.

carry many items, Bavwimi bakapangaika masumo kabaya musyokwe. Hunters carried spears on their shoulders as they went hunting. Eci ciyobwedo camasumo cakali kutegwa 'lupango' nkaambo kakupangaika masumo. This container of spears was called a lupango because of holding spears. (1.-pangaikwa, 2.-pangaikide, 3.-pangaizya, 4.-pangaikila, 5.-pangaikilalyo, 6.-pangaikisya 7.-pangaika-pangaika) Also: -pataika.

do some activity for which one is either too old or too dignified to perform, Banyina mukaintu nkubona mbaaba abalo kulapangalika. = The wife's mother (though dignified) was among those serving. (1.-pangalikwa, 2.-pangalikide, 3.-pangalizya, 4.-pangalikila, 5.-pangalikilalyo 6.-pangalikisya, 7.-pangalika-pangalika)

agree to a plan, Bakapangana kuti kunyina nobaya kusiyana mubuumi bwabo. = They made a pact that they would never leave each other in their life. Ijilo twakapangana kuya ku Monze abeenzuma. = Yesterday I agreed with my friends to go to Monze. (1.-panganwa, 2.-pangenye, 3.-panganya, 4.-panganina, 5.-panganinalyo, 6.-panganisya, 7.-pangana-pangana, 8.-pangana)
  • agree to become friends, Mainza a Chimuka wakapangana _bulongwe_. = Mainza and Chimuka made a pact of friendship.
plan with someone, Mainza wakapanganya musimbi wakwe kuti batizyanye. Mainza planned with his girl-friend that they would elope together.

be rude, Chisowa wali kwiile kupangauka naali kubetekwa kwa sibbuku. = Chisowa was just rude when he was being tried at the headman's village. (1.-pangaukwa, 2.-pangaukide, 3.-pangauzya, 4.-pangaukila, 5.-pangaukilalyo, 6.-pangaukisya, 7.-pangaukapangauka, 8.-pangaukilana)

be free, Niyakamana nkondo twakapangazya. = When the war was finished we were free. Wapangazya mbundakukomenzya. = When I had assisted you to grow up you now do whatever you want. (1.-pangazyigwa, 2.-pangazyide, 3.-pangazya, 4.-pangazyila, 5.-pangazyilalyo, 6.-pangazyisya, 7.-pangazya, 8.-pangazyanya)

cross one's legs, Mwana tayelede kupangika maulu nakkede abapati. A child should not cross its legs when sitting with elders. Also: -pyanya maulu (1.-pangikwa, 2.-pangikide, 3.-pangizya, 4.-pangikila, 5.-pangikilalyo, 6.-pangikisya, 7.-pangika-pangika, 8.-pangikana)
  • interlace roof timber, Kopangika masomo mumbalo zyaciluli. = Interweave the roof poles with the laths.
be cross-legged, Komwaambila muntu ooyo uupangikide maulu anyamuke. = Tell that one with the legs crossed to stand up.

be invented, be imagined, Nokuba kuti masena ali mubbuku oomu ngabwini, mazina abantu oonse ngakulipangila buyo. = Even though the places in this book are real, all the names of people are just imaginary. Nkubeja, ulipangila buyo, teesyi nguwali kulemba. = It is a lie, you are only making it up, it was not he who wrote it. (1.-pangilwa, 2.-pangide, 3.-pangizya, 4.-pangila, 5.-pangilalyo, 6.-pangisya, 7.-pangilapangila, 8.-pangilana) Also: -lengelezya.
  • make, Kondigwasya kupangila musanga, mebo munwe ulacisa. = Help me to make a cigarette, I have a sore finger. Zilengwa zimwi nzyotulipangila, zilatufwubaazya tobeni. = Some traditions which we make for ourselves, make fools of us ourselves.

be made of, Bana baluba kuti bazyali babo balaa bulowa mbobapangisigwa, ninyama yomwe ambabo. = Children forget that their parents have the blood from which they are made, they are on blood with them.

lift one leg in the air, Kopangula mweendo kutegwa unjile kabotu mucimbayambaya. = Lift your leg so that you enter easily into the vehicle. (1.-pangulwa, 2.-pangwide, 3.-panguzya, 4.-pangwida, 5.-pangwidalyo, 6.-pangulisya, 7.-pangula-pangula, 8.-pangulana)

be rude, Ndatiimwiite Mutinta, wiile kupanguuka. = I tried to call Mutinta, she was just rude. (1.-panguukwa, 2.-panguukide, 3.-panguuzya, 4.-panguukila, 5.-panguukilalyo, 6.-panguukisya, 7.-panguuka-panguuka, 8.-panguukilana) Also: -pangauka, -kangauka.

become wise, be awakened, Wakapanuka nkaambo wakatalika kuswiilila malailile kuzwa kubapati balaa luzyibo. = S/he became wise because s/he started to listen to the instructions of the elders who have knowledge. (1.-panukwa, 2.-panukide, 3.-panusya, 4.-panukila, 5.-panukilalyo, 6.-panukisya, 7.-panuka-panuka, 8.-panukilana) Also: -pampuka, -anuka, -pampuka.
  • become knowledgeable (for good or evil), Wakapanuka sunu akaambo kabeenzinyina bamuyiisya kucita zibi. = She became learned in evil ways because of her friends who teach her bad things. Wakapanuka sunu nkaambo wakaleka kulisenda kubuzya mpatamvwi. = She has become learned today because she no longer is ashamed to ask what she does not understand. Tuleelede kupanuka notweenda mumigwagwa. = We should be alert when we travel on the roads.
  • be open and clear, Kujulu kwakalipanukide cini-cini, kwaanyina akakumbi nokaceya buti. = The sky was really open and clear, there was not a cloud no matter how small.

educate, make knowledgeable, Kukkala mumapenzi cilapanuna. = To live with problems teaches one. Bamupanuna mbeenzinyina mbasobana limwi. = What makes him understand life are his friends wih whom he plays. (1.-panunwa, 2.-panwide, 3.-panuzya/sya, 4.-panwida, 5.-panwidalyo, 6.-panunisya, 7.-panuna-panuna, 8.-panunana)
make knowledgeable, rt. panuka, Buumi bwamudolopo bwakapanusya mwana. = City life has taught the child.
make one another wise, Amukabe aandiswe notuya kulikanazya nzila zyakupanusyanya. = Be with us when we discuss a way of making each other wise.

be sharp to the taste, Micelo imwi ilalweela, imwi ilapanyuka, imwi ilalula. = Some fruits are sweet, some are sharp, some are bitter. (1.-panyukwa, 2.-panyukide, 3.-panusya, 4.-panyukila, 5.-panyukilalyo, 6.-panyukisya, 7.-panyuka-panyuka) Also: -syakamuka, -sakamuka.

taste flat or stale, Bukoko obu bwakapapa. = This beer is flat. (1.-papwa, 2.-papide, 3.-papya, 4.-papila, 5.-papilalyo, 6.-papisya, 7.-papa-papa, 8.-papilana)
  • rebel, Ooyu musimbi wapapa, taciteeleli bazyali. = This girl is rebelling, she does not listen to her parents.

become rebellious, rt.-papa, Basicikolo bapapala, tabacitobeli milawo pe. = The pupils are rebellious, they do not follow the rules. (1.-papalwa, 2.-papalete, 3.-papazya, 4.-papalila, 5.-papalilalyo, 6.-papalisya, 7.-papalapapala, 8.-papalana) Also: -zanga.

become flat, Mufwuzi wali kuumpa cibulo akucuuma kusikila limwi capapalala. = The blacksmith was heating the iron and beating it until it became flat. Also: -zanzabala, -sasabala, yanzabala. (1.-papalalwa, 2.-papalete, 3.-papalazya, 4.-papalalila, 5.-papalalilalyo, 6.-papalalisya, 7.-papalala-papalala)
  • disagree, Malilwe tafwambaani kuzumina caamba beenzinyina, lyoonse ulapapalala. = Malilwe is not quick to agree with what his friends say, he always argues in contradiction. Also: -papanyana.
be flattened, rt. -papalala, Bamwi bakali kumwiita kuti ngu Mupapali nkaambo kagutwe nkulyakapapalete. Some called him Mupapali because of the big head which was flattened.

flatten, Kamutupapalika buya kutubamba tumbuwa, notutiikaulwe kubantu. = Make the buns flat when you are making them, that is when they will be bought by people. (1.-papalikwa, 2.-papalikide, 3.-papalisya, 4.-papalikila, 5.-papalikilalyo, 6.-papalikisya, 7.-papalika-papalika, 8.-papalikana)
  • stagger as drunk, Muntu wakolwa bukoko ulapapalika. A person who is drunk with beer staggers. Also: -pampalika, -tantalika.
  • make various efforts to do something, be ineffective or indecisive, Wali kupapalika kubamba ncinga pesi camwaalila. = He was trying to mend the bicycle but he failed. Kuti kopapalika ulawa alubayi mpamunya awa. = If you are unwilling to cooperate you will fall down with a slap right here.

try hard to do something difficult, rt. -papalika, Wakatalika kupapalisya kulijalula bbokesi. = He tried hard to open the box. Antela bakatalike kuyeeya kuti antela ndakamumisya aboobo ndipapalisya kusisa da kuti likalibonye ndaakumukwata. = Perhaps they will start to think that maybe I have made her pregnant and so I am trying hard to hide the pregnancy so that it is seen when I have married her. Mulumaakwe Malita wakaluujisi kupapalisya kupasulula Malita kuti amuleke kusina mweenzinyina. = Malita's husband had a hard time trying to get Malita to take her hands of her fellow wife and stop throttling her. (1.-papalisyigwa, 2.-papalisyide, 4.-papalisyila, 5.-papalisyilalyo, 6.-papalisyisya. 7.-papalisya-papalisya, 8.-papalisyanya)

flap wings, Muyuni waumwa ntobolo ulapapama mucizyiba. = The bird which was shot by a gun is flapping its wings in the pond. (1.-papamwa, 2.-papamide, 3.-papamya, 4.-papamina, 5.-papaminalyo, 6.-papamisya, 7.-papama-papama) Also: -babama.

gnaw as rat, Imbeba zipapamuna ndongwe mukabbule. = The rats are gnawing the groundnuts in the granary. (1.-papamunwa, 2.-papamunide, 3.-papamuzya, 4.-papamunina, 5.-papamuninalyo, 6.-papamunisya, 7.-papamuna-papamuna, 8.-papamunana) Also: -lentenya, -cecetula.

insist, become adamant, Ulapapanyana kukazya kaambo nkobwene. = You are adamant in denying the crime of which you know you have done. Mukaintu wakwe cakamucima kapati kubona nkwapapanyana kukaka kaambo kakakosokede kale. It greatly displeased his wife to see how he persisted in refusing to accept the verdict which had already been given. (1.-papanyanwa, 2.-papanyene, 3.-papanyika, 4.-papanyanina, 5.-papanyaninalyo, 6.-papanyanisya, 7.-papanyana-papanyana, 8.-papanyaninana) Also: -kakanyana.

persist Kuti muntu kapapasya buya kukaka, cimwi ciindi ulikabwene kaambo. = When a person persists in denying his guilt, sometimes s/he knows that s/he has done it. (2.-papasyide, 4.-papasyila, 5.-papasyilalyo, 6.-papasyisya, 7.-papasya-papasya, 8.-papasyanya)
sip, Mutumbu ulapapata tukeza notukasaala. = The woman sips beer when it is warm. (1.-papatwa, 2.-papatide, 3.-papatya, 4.-papatila, 5.-papatilalyo, 6.-papatisya, 7.-papatapapata) Also: - vwipa.

be difficult, nombe eyi ilapapauka kukamwa. = This cow is difficult to milk. (1.-papaukwa, 2.-papaukide, 3.-papauzya, 4.-papaukila, 5.-papaukilalyo, 6.-papaukisya, 7.-papaukapapauka) Also: -pabauka.
  • be split as wood, Capapauka cisamu nicaandwa mvwula. = The tree was split when it was struck by lightning. Also: -kwamauka.

splinter as wood, take apart, Basankwa bakafwambaana kupapaula nkuni akukunka mulilo. = The boys were quick to split the firewood and light the fire. Nobacipapaula cijazyo, nkujana babbi baloboka kale. = When they broke down the door, they found the thieves had already fled. Kufwumbwa kuti wausiya mootokala awo mpuwafwida, bwaca ulajana babbi baupapaula. = Whenever you leave a car where it has broken down, you will find by dawn the thieves have stripped it. Muntu tokonzyi kumunjila mukaango kamuntu umbi umupapaule kutegwa uzyibe ncayeeya. = You cannot enter into the heart of another person and take it apart so that you know what s/he thinks. (1.-papaulwa, 2.-papawide, 3.-papauzya, 4.-papawida, 5.-papawidalyo, 6.-papaulisya, 7.-papaula-papaula, 8.-papaulana) Also: -uula, -kwamuna, -fwapuula.
be rebellious, rt. -papa, Bana basunu balipapide, tabayandi kuteelela caamba bapati. The children of today are rebellious, they do not listen to what is said by the elders.

be split, Kasamu nkaalyatide kapapuka ncaalokela ansi. = A branch which she stepped on broke off, that is why she fell to the ground. (2.-papukide, 4.-papukila, 5.-papukilalyo, 6.-papukisya, 7.-papuka-papuka) Also: -kwamuka.

split, remove shell/bark, Kamupapula makwa amusamu ulya, tupe mwana uuciswa. Remove the bark of that tree so that we give it to the sick child. Kopapula buyo pulanga lyomwe. = Just split one plank. (1.-papulwa, 2.-papwide, 3.-papuzya, 4.-papwida, 5.-papwidalyo, 6.-papulisya, 7.-papulapapula, 8.-papulana)

become detached, Makwa anzoka alapapuluka kuti yalikwama. = The skin of a snake is detached when it sloughs. Makwa acisamu apapuluka. The bark of the tree has become detached. (1.-papulukwa, 2.-papulukide, 3.-papulukizya, 4.-papulukila, 5.-papulukilalyo, 6.-papulukisya 7.-papuluka-papuluka) Also: -kwakwamuka

strip off dry bark, e.g Kamupapuula makwa akayuma tusumisye zibiya. Strip off the dry bark so that we fire the clay pots. (1.-papuulwa, 2.-papwiide, 3.-papuuzya, 4.-papwiida, 5.-papwiidalyo, 6.-papuulisya, 7.-papuulapapuula, 8.-papuulana) Also: -papaula.

make sour, rt. -papa, Eeyi nongo ilafwambaana kupapya cibwantu nkaambo yaba yakaindi. = This clay pot is quick to make the cibwantu sour because it is old. Capapya bukoko obu mbumena bubi mbubabikka. What made this beer sour is the fermented mealie-meal which they put in it.

begin to crack as a stick, Capasa cisamu ncomutantide aboobo mweelede kucenjela nkaambo inga kaciya kumucisa cawa. The tree which you have climbed has begun to crack and so you ought to be careful because it will hurt you when it falls. (1.-paswa, 2.-paside, 3.-pasizya, 4.-pasila, 5.-pasilalyo, 6.-pasisya, 7.-pasapasa, 8.-pasizyanya Also: -tonga.
  • pass an examination, (ety. Eng.) Uuno mwaka banji bana bakapasa mumusunko wa Giledi 10. = This year many children passed the exam for Grade 10.

fly about as sparks, Cisisi eci cilapasauka, taciyaki kabotu. = This ember is just sending out sparks, it does not light well. Wakali kuliyoteka amulilo kumwi kasosela nkuni zyamwaani zyakali kupasauka nsasi. = He was warming himself at the fire while pushing in firewood from the mwaani tree which was throwing out sparks. (1.-pasaukwa, 2.-pasaukide, 3.-pasaukizya, 4.-pasaukila, 5.-pasaukilalyo, 6.-pasaukisya, 7.-pasauka-pasauka)

do or speak directly or quickly (without beating about the bush), Kopasaula kwaambaula, utasowi ciindi. Hurry up and speak directly, do not waste time. (1.-pasaulwa, 2.-pasawide, 3.-pasauzya, 4.-pasawida, 5.-pasawidalyo, 6.-pasaulisya, 7.-pasaulapasaula, 8.-pasaulana)
  • open up, Kamupasaula zibbudu eezyo. = Open up that luggage.

rise as the sun, rt. -pasula, Mbolyakapasuda biyo, citumwa cakanyamuka alimwi. = At the time when the sun rises, the charm became active again. (1.-pasudwa, 2.-paswide, 3.-pasuzya, 4.-paswida, 5.-paswidalyo, 7.-pasudapasuda)

ooze out, as blood from ulcer, Mpaalumwa nzoka kwapasuka bulowa. Blood is oozing from the spot where the snake bit. Nibamuuma ampemo kwapasuka bulowa. = When they struck him on the nose blood oozed out. (1.-pasukwa, 2.-pasukide, 3.-pasusya, 4.-pasukila, 5.-pasukilalyo, 6.-pasukisya, 7.-pasuka-pasuka, 8.-pasusyanya)

rise as sun, Izuba lyapasula kale, katufwambaana, tuya kumuka kucikolo. = The sun is rising already, let us hurry, we will be late for school. Mbubona mbobona zuba kalipasula, kalibala, kalibbila, moyo wangu ulapasuka, ulabalilwa, ulabbila. = Just as you see the sun rising, shining and setting, so my heart rises, shines and sets. (1.-pasulwa, 2.-paswide, 3.-pasusya, 4.-paswida, 5.-paswidalyo, 6.-pasulisya. 7.-pasula-pasula)
  • open a way through, Babelesi bakapasula mugwagwa mucisaka. = The workers opened up a road through the forest.
  • open up, Kamupasula zibbudu eezyo, tubone cili mukati. Open that luggage so that we see what is inside. Also: -pasaula.
  • let blood, Bantu baswa nsinga bapasula bulowa bwamulusinga. = People who treat nerve-pain by cupping, cut the affected vein to let out blood.
  • give judgement, Kopasula kufwambaana, kaambo aaka kakosoka kale. = Give judgement quickly on this case, it has been already resolved.

free from hinderance, Wakali kuya bupasuluka mumamwa. = He was going along freeing himself from the thorns. Naakapasuluka mumizeezo, wakaintamuka mutwe. When he was free about what he was thinking, he raised his head.

untie, disengage, solve a problem or riddle, Sena bakapasulula kale kaambo kakunkuta? = Have they already resolved the court case? Bacembele bakali acamba mukupasulula twaambo tukatazya. The old woman was brave in solving difficult problems. Kamupasulula mubwa wapatila mucisilazya. = Release the dog who is stuck in the trap. Ino kuti samu lipati lyakulimba inga ulakonzya kulipasulula? = If a big tree falls on you, will you be able to extricate yourself? (1.-pasululwa, 2.-pasulwide, 3.-pasuluzya, 4.-pasulwida, 5.-pasulwidalyo, 6.-pasululisya, (7.-pasulula-pasulula, 8.-pasululana) Also: -pasununa, -andula.

resolve, Mukutazyiba antela muya mazuba ciya kupasunuka, cikalibonye antangalala ncoyeeya. = Without knowing perhaps in the passing of the days it will be resolved, it will be seen openly what you think. (1.-pasunukwa, 2.-pasunukide, 3.-pasunukizya, 4.-pasunukila 5.-pasunukilalyo, 6.-pasunukisya, 7.-pasunuka-pasunuka, 8.-pasunukana)

untie, resolve, Cakatazya kupasununa kaambo aaka nkaambo tabaambi masimpe boonse. = It is difficult to resolve that case because all are not telling the truth. Basibbuku bakapasununa kaambo kakaalide. = The headman has resolved a case which was difficult to solve. Nsezyi kuti ciya kupasunuka buti, kuyeeya buyo ulati nimpasununa balozi zili mumizeezo yangu. = I don't know how it will be resolved, in my thinking it seems to be a very difficult problem. Also: -pasulula. (1.-pasununwa, 2.-pasunwide, 3.-pasunuzya, 4.-pasunwida, 5.-pasunwidalyo, 6.-pasununisya, 7.-pasununa-pasununa, 8.-pasununana)
have ones grip released, Mukaintu naakasola kusina mulumi wakwe, wakapasununwa biya amwanaakwe. = When the wife tried to choke her husband, her child made her release him.

be risen, as the sun, rt. pasula, Mpolipaswida zuba ulajana bamana kale milimo minji. = As the sun rises you find they have already finished many jobs. (1.-pasulwa, 2.-paswide, 3.-pasuzya, 4.-paswida, 5.-paswidalyo, 6.-pasulisya, 7.-paswida-paswida, 8.-paswidana)

give each other lame excuses to delay agreement, Kaindi kusela lyakalibbosya moyo alimwi kwakali kupasyanya. = Long ago marriage negotiations demanded much patience as there were a lot of lengthy discussions hindering agreement. (1.-pasyanyigwa, 2.-pasyanyide, 3.-pasyanyizya, 4.-pasyanyina, 5.-pasyanyinalyo, 6.-pasyanyisya, 7.-pasyanya-pasyanya, 8.-pasyanyinana)

pack more, Ndakatuma basankwa kupataika zisamu aciba canombe. = I sent the boys to insert more wood along the cattle-krall. (1.-pataikwa, 2.-pataikide, 3.-pataikizya, 4.-pataikila, 5.-pataikilalyo, 6.-pataikisya, 7.-pataika-pataika, 8.-patikilana) Also: -pakaika.

protect oneself from extremes of heat, cold, wind, danger, etc., Bakali kupatama munsi amilundu. = They were hiding near the hills. (1.-patamwa, 2.-pateme, 3.-patamya, 4.-patamina, 5.-pataminalyo, 6.-patamisya, 7.-patamapatama)
be held or stick fast, Ino kapatamina kuli kapepa nkaajisi mwana? = Where is the paper stuck which the child had?
rise in a hurry from sleep, Babwa nibakakuwa, toonse twakapatamuka. = When the dogs barked, we all arose quickly.

rouse from sleep or unconsciousness, startle, Yandipatamuna mvwula yazuma. = The thunder has suddenly caused me to arise. (1.-patamunwa, 2.-patamwide, 3.-patamunya, 4.-patamwida, 5.-patamwidalyo, 6.-patamunisya, 7.-patamuna-patamuna, 8.-patamunana) Also: -bbatamuna.

be confused, be in dis- order, Ooyu muntu wasondoka nca- _patangana_. = This person is mad, that is why he is confused. (1.-patangana, 2.-patangenye, 3.-patanganya, 4.-patanganina, 5.-patanganinalyo, 6.-patanganisya, 7.-patangana-patangana, 8.-patanganizyinya) Also: -palangana.

remove, take out, extricate, e.g Ndakafwambaana kucipatanuna cisani cakapatide mumamvwa. = I was quick to take out the cloth which was stuck in the thorns. (1.-patanunwa, 2.-patanwide, 3.-patauzya, 4.-patanunina or -patanwida, 5.-patanuninalyo or -patanwidalyo, 6.-patanunisya, 7.-patanuna-patanuna, 8.-patanunana) Also: -patununa.
take shelter, rt. -patama, Ndakaile kwiisiya nombe mucoonde muyakapateme. = I left the cow in a clump of trees where it was sheltering.

insert, Bamaama bakali kupatika moono wakuzezya nswi. = My mother was inserting wooden rings in the fishing basket. Syaanza wakajwa boya angala yakwe akubupatika acijazyo ca- suntwe. = The lion plucked a hair from his mane and inserted it in the door of the hyena. (1.-patikwa, 2.-patikide, 3.-patizya, 4.-patikila, 5.-patikilalyo, 6.-patikisya, 7.-patika-patika, 8.-patikilana)

squeeze onself in, Nokuba kuti moota ulizwide, ndalipati- kizya kutegwa ndifwambaane kuya kusika kucibbadela kubona balwazi. = Even though the car is full, I will squeeze my- self in so that I quickly go to the hospital to see the patient. Also: -bbatikizya, -syanikizya. (1.-patikizyigwa, 2.-patikizyizye, 4.-patikizyizya, 5.-patikizyizyalyo, 6.-patikizyisya, 7.-patikizya-patikizya, 8.-patikizyanya)

be caught, as in mud or in thorn bush, Cimbayambaya capatila muma nkandya. = The vehicle is stuck in the mud. Koombe kapatila muntimba. = The calf is stuck in the mud. (1.-patilwa, 2.-patide, 3.-patizya, 4.-patilila, 5.-patili- lalyo, 6.-patilisya, 7.-patila-patila, 8.-patizyanya)

break out, Inkondo ya basitukumba yakapatuka nibakali kutu- bbida nombe. = The Lozi war broke out when they were stealing cattle from us. (1.-patukwa, 2.-patukide, 3.-patusya, 4.- patukila, 5.-patukilalyo, 6.-patukisya, 7.-patuka-patuka, 8.-patukana)
  • separate, Mutinta wabapatuka beenzinyina mbaakali kweenda limwi kuya kucikolo. = Mutinta has gone aside from her friends with whom she was going to school. Also: -zanduka, -pambuka.

disengage, Basankwa baunka kuya kusola kucipatulula cimbaya- mbaya capatide. = The boys have gone to try and disengage the vehicle which was stuck. Kokapatulula koombe kapatila. = Release the calf which is stuck. (1.-patululwa, 2.-patulwide, 3.-patuluzya, 4.-patulwida, 5.-patulwidalyo, 6.-patululisya, 7.-patulula-patulula, 8.-patululana) Also: -pasulula.

become free, Muma- mvwa mwaakapatide wakapatunuka no- lyakabbila zuba. = When the sun sank that is when he became free from the thorns which had caught him. (1.-patunukwa, 2.-patunukide, 3.-patunukizya, 4.-patunukila 5.-patunkilalyo, 6.-patunukisya, 7.-patunuka-patunuka, 8.-patunukana)

unstick, disengage, Ndapatila, kamundipatununa. = I am stuck, release me. Bakafwambaana kuka- patununa koombe kakapatide nkaambo bakali banji. = They quickly pulled the calf out where it was stuck because they were many. (1.-patununwa, 2.-patunwide, 3.-patunuzya, 4.-patunwida, 5.-patunwidalyo, 6.-patununisya, 7.-patununapatununa, 8.-patununana)
  • resolve a case, Naasika mubetesi kaambo kali kayumu wakapatununa. = When the magistrate arrived he solved the case which was difficult.

stir boiling porridge by stiring or lifting it up and down, with a ladle, Mukaintu wakali kupaula nsima yakali kuunka kutegwa itooke. = The woman was stirring the nsima which was overflowing over so that it could settle down. (1.-paulwa, 2.-paulide, 3.-pauzya, 4.-pawida, 5.-pawidalyo, 6.-paulisya, 7.-paula-paula) Also: -omba-omba, -pepaula.
  • penetrate, as through a thick forest, Musefwu wakakakilwa kupaula lusaka, wakapatila. = The eland failed to penetrate the forest, it got stuck. Timba wakalupaula, wakasika acibuwa ncobakabbejelene. = The antelope passed through the forest, it reached the plain which they had agreed upon.
open as furrows to drain garden, rt. -paula, Mulimi wambewu wakali kupawida meenda. = The gardener was opening trenches to drain off the water. Also: -polola, -polweda, -zula.

purge, Mwana waciswa mwida, walikwiide kupaya masiku oonse. = The child has a sick stomach and had diarrhoea all night. (1.-payizigwa, 2.-payide, 3.-payizya, 4.-payila, 5.-payilalyo, 6.-payisya, 7.-paya-paya) Also: -soomona.
  • overflow as a river which has burst its banks, Mulonga wakapaya wakatola mapopwe oonse akalimidwe mumbali anguwe. = The river that overflowed swept away all the maize which was grown along it. Also: -polola.

offer sacrifice to, Bacipayila mizimo, bakambilila mvwula mumalende alimwi balakumba Iwiindi tobilo amwaka. = They still offer sacrifice to the ancestors, they clap for rain at the rainshrine and again they brew beer twice a year for the traditional agricultural festivals. Also: -paila. (1.-payilwa, 2.-payilide, 3.-payizya, 4.-payilila, 5.-payililalyo, 6.-payilisya, 7.-payila-payila, 8.-payililana)

be split, as a forked support, Cisamu cacisanza capayuka nkaambo calemenwa mapopwe. = The pole of the granary split because of the weight of the maize. (1.-payukwa, 2.-payukide, 3.-payusya, 4.-payukila, 5.-payukilalyo, 6.-payukisya, 7.-payuka-payuka, 8.-payukana) Also: -paula.

speak straight, Kopazaula kukanana bantu bamvwe. = Speak straight so that the people understand. (1.-pazaulwa, 2.-pazawide, 3.-pazauzya, 4.-pazawida, 5.-pazawidalyo, 6.-pazaulisya, 7.-pazaula-pazaula, 8-pazaulana) Also: -pasaula.
  • Bantu balapazaula syaambololo ngubajaya. The people are cutting up the kudu they killed.

struggle, Wakasola kupazaya kuti azwe mwaakaangidwe, cakaala. He tried to struggle and come out from where he was tied, but he failed. Namusya ulapazaya pele kooye kalimujisi. = The duiker is struggling but the snare holds it fast. (1.-pazayizyigwa, 2.-pazayide, 3.-pazayizya, 4.-pazayila, 5.-pazayilalyo, 6.-pazayisya, 7.pazayapazaya, 8.-pazayilana) Also: -palaya.

lean over to one side, Musa, kopeama, njanda kusondela ampulungwido. My friend, lean over, I want to peep through the window. (1.-peamwa, 2.-peamide, 3.-peamya, 4.-peamina, 5.-peaminalyo, 6.-peamisya, 7.-peama-peama,
Also: -seama.

give for or to, rt. -pa, Notusobana bbola tuleelede kupeda beenzuma nkaambo nkokusobana kabotu. = When we play football we ought to pass the ball to our friends because that is how to play well. Joojo nguwakandipeda lugwalo kumusimbi wangu. = It was Joojo who gave a letter to my girl-friend for me. (1.-pegwa, 2.-pede, 3.-pesya, 4.-peda, 5.-pedalyo, 6.-pesya, 7.-peda-peda, 8.-pana)
given something for someone, Mwana wakapedelezedwe nswi zyabanyinakulu. = The child was given fishes for his grandmother. (2.-pedelezede)

hand over to, send on, forward, rt. -pa, Kamumupedelezya Nchimunya nzindamutuma. Hand over to Nchimunya the things which I sent her to bring. Mutinta wakandipedelezya mali ookwa Jolezya. = Mutinta handed over to me the money belonging to Jolezya. (1.-pedelezyegwa, 2.-pedelezyede, 4.-pedelezyezya, 5.-pedelezyezyalyo, 7.-pedelezya-pedelezya, 8.-pedelezyanya)

have hope for, plan for, Ulipeekezya kuyooba sicuuno wabakubusi nateeleli. She hopes to become chairperson of youth even though she is unsuitable. Ndali kulipeekezya kumusimbi ooyo pele wandikaka. = I had had hoped for that girl but she refused me. Basimbi bakamuyandisya akulipeekezya ati ateni ulasyaba umwi akati kabo akwate. = The girls all loved him very much and hoped that perhaps he would make arrangements to marry one of them. Wakatalika kumupeekezya kuti kubota wamulowa. = He began to plan that it would be good if he bewitched him. Also: -leelezya, -bikka-bikka. (1.-peekezyegwa, 2.-peekezyede, 3.-peekezyesya, 4.-peekezyezya, 5.-peekezyezyalyo, 6.-peekezyesya, 7.-peekezya-peekezya, 8.-peekezyanya)

lick oneself, Koleka kulipeela milomo. = Stop licking your lips. (1.-peelwa, 2.-peelede, 3.-peezya, 4.-peelela, 5.-peelelalyo, 6.-peelesya, 7.-peela-peela, 8.-peelelana)
  • sweep, Kofwambaana kupeela munanda. Be quick to sweep in the house. Also: -kukula, -pyaanga.
argue with, Sibbuku a mwinaakwe bakapeelukana ceebelwa. = The headman and his wife were arguing which was noticed publicly.

be concluded, as funeral, Dilwe nilyakayanda kupeelwa, bamausyi abamwi buyo bapati bakakkala lubeta Iwakuti basole kubungika lubono Iwamufwu loonse. When the funeral ceremonies were about to be concluded, the father's clan, and just a few other elders, set in session to try and gather up all of the dead person's possessions. (7.-peela-peela)

be carried aloft, Kapepe komwe kalapeepuka mujulu. feather is carried aloft into the air. Twakapeepuka kwakkumi lyamawoola notuziOne kukkala kucibanza cipati candeke ku Lusaka. We were carried aloft in the air for ten hours until we landed on the big runaway at Lusaka airport. (1.-peepukwa, 2.-peepukide, 3.-реериkizya, 4.-peepu-kila, 5.-peepukilalyo, 6.-peepukisya, 7.-peepuka-peepuka)

make fly up in the air, Bana bakali kupeepula tupepa mulubuwa Iwabbola. = The children were flying aloft their little kites in the football field. (1.-peepulwa, 2.-peepwide, 3.-peepuzya, 4.-peepwida, 5.-peepwidalyo, 6.-peepulisya, 7.-peepula-peepula, 8.-peepulana)

be given, rt. -pa, Ndakapegwa nkuku kuli baneene mvwiki yaka mana. = I was given a hen from my grandmother last week. Ino wakapegwa nzi kumulimo ngookabeleka? = What were you given for the work you did? (2.-pegedwe, 3.-pesyegwa, 4.-pegelwa, 5.-pegelwalyo, 6.-pegesyegwa, 7.-pegwapegwa)
wave, as grass, sway, as a reed, Mapopwe alapeka kumuunda. = The maize is swaying in the field. (1.-pekwa, 2.-pekede, 3.-pekemya, 4.-pekemela, 5.-pekemelalyo, 6.-pekemesya, 7.-pekapeka)
glisten in movement, Makweelele alapekema. The maize leaves are glistening as they move. (2.-pekemede, 3.-pekemya, 4.-pekemena, 5.-pekemenalyo, 6.-pekemesya, 7.-pekema-pekema) Also: -beka-beka

have hope in acquiring something, Musankwa uulya ulalipekezya kuli ndime, kakuli mebo ndakamwaambila kuti nsemuyandi. That boy desires to have me, but I told him that I do not love him. Ncibi kulipekezya mpotayelede. = It is bad to desire what you ought not to have. (1.-pekezyegwa, 2.-pekezyede, 3.-pekezyesya, 4.-pekezyezya, 5.-pelezyezyalyo, 6.-pekekezyesya, 7.-pekezya-pekezya, 8.-pekezyanya) Also: -peekezya.

spell, pronounce, Kopela mabala alembedwe waawa. = Spell the words which are written here. Kunyina mulaka umwiinda kumakosi, yoonse buyo walo ulaluma-luma mubuteete, nociba Chikalanga, Chisubiya antela Chinyengo, walo nkuswenswemuna akupela. = No langauage passed him by, he easily grasped each one whether it was Chikalanga, Chisubiya or Chinyengo, he could speak fluently and spell. (1.-pelwa, 2.-pelede, 3.-pelezya, 4.-pelela, 5.-pelelalyo,6.-pelesya, 7.-pela-pela, 8.-pelelana)

move round, hover, Kasulwe kapeleemba kutija. = The hare dodges about as it flees. Basikube bapeleemba babona nombe yadenkete. = The vultures are hovering about as they see a diseased cow. Bantu nobazyana budima ulababona nkobapeleemba. = When people dance the Budima you will see them how they move about. (1.-peleembwa, 2.-peleembede, 3.-peleembya, 4.-peleembela, 5.-peleembelalyo, 6.-peleembesya, 7.-peleemba-peleemba, 8.-peleembezyanya) Also: -zunga.

speak with cunning, Wakazwidilila mumakani akupeleenga twaambo. He came through the discussion through his cunning talk. (1.-peleengelwa, 2.-peleengede, 3.-peleengezya, 4.-peleengela 5.-peleengelalyo, 6.-peleengesya, 7.-peleenga-peleenga, 8.-peleengana)
spell for, rt. -pela, Kondipelela mabala kutegwa ndaalembe kabotu. Spell the words for me so that I write them correctly.

be blown away, Mapepe aankuku apeluluka amuwo. The feathers of the hen have been blown away by the wind. Also: -peuluka,-peepuka, -ululuka, -uuka. (1.-pelulukizyigwa, 2.-pelulukide, 3.-pelulukizya, 4.-pelulukila, 5.-pelulukilalyo, 6.-pelulukisya, 7.-peluluka-peluluka)

wipe nose, Kamumupemba mamina mwana. Wipe the mucous from the child's nose. (1.-pembwa, 2.-pembede, 3.-pembya, 4.-pembela, 5.-pembelalyo, 6.-pembesya, 7.-pemba-pemba, 8.-pembana) Also: . -sinda, -mina.

fumigate, Munanga wakamupembelela mukaintu akumuvwupuula ajingo. The witchdoctor fumi gated the woman and sprinkled her with the tail of a gnu. (1.-pembelelwa, 2.-pembelede, 3.-pembelezya, 4.-pembelelela, 5.-pembelelelalyo, 6.-pembelelesya, 7.-pembelela-pembelela, 8.-pembelelana)
  • venerate, Lyoonse twakali kupembelela mizimo mibotu = We were always venerating the good spirits. Also: -tembelela mizimo

recover consciousness, revive after a fit, Wakalinetukide uuciswa, kumane wakapempenuka. = The one who was sick fainted, then regained consiousness. (1.-pempenukwa, 2.-pempenukide, 3.-pempenuzya, 4.-pempenukila, 5.-pempenukilalyo, 6.-pempenukisya, 7-pempenuka-pempenuka)

wander about, meander, Mulonga wa Kafwuwe ulapenauka mumilundu minji. The Kafue river meanders through many hills. Mubbi wakapenauka mubantu wazitola zintu nzyakajisi mwana. = The thief moved in and out among the people taking the things which the child had. Wakazyila ku Bulozi kazyaabupenauka mumagonde aasiya mbii. = She came from Lozi land wandering about through dark forests. (1.-penaukwa, 2.-penaukide, 3.-penaukizya, 4.-penaukila, 5.-penaukilalyo, 6.-penaukisya, 7.-penaukapenauka, 8.-penaukizyanya) Also: -petauka, -petuuka.

withdraw from good conduct, mutiny, disobey, rebel, leave a husband, Walipenda kubba muntu wakomenede kale kabotu. The one who had already grown old with good behaviour changed to become a thief. Walipenda kutandimvwa. He rebelled and resolved not to listen to me. Musune ooyu sunu walipenda kuluma watakali kuluma. = The ox which never attacked has changed its behaviour and now it bites. Nkobali bantu balipenda banga baunka amilyango yabantu masiku balazemba, beezya lufwu, kumwi balasinganya. There are people who have changed their behaviour for the worse, they go dancing up and down at people's doors at night, invoking death, while cursing the owners. (2.-pendede, 3.-pendya, 4.-pendela, 5.-pendelalyo, 6.-pendesya, 7.-pendapenda, 8.-pendezyanya)

suffer, Wakapenga nibakafwa bakali kumubbadelela kuya kucikolo. = He suffered when the one paying for him at school died. Mwaka uuno bantu bapenga akaambo kanzala. This year the people have suffered because of hunger. (1.-pengwa, 2.-pengede, 3.-penzya, 4.-pengela, 5.-pengelalyo, 6.-pengesya, 7.-penga-penga, 8.-penzyanya.)

be troubled in heart, Ndapengana kapati akaambo kakuciswa ooku. I am troubled in heart because of this sickness. (1.-penganwa, 2.-penganide, 3.-penganya, 4.-penganina, 5.-penganinalyo, 6.-penganisya, 7.-pengana-pengana, 8.-penganizyanya)

suffering for someone, rt. penga, Coonse ncepengela, mpengela nduwe. Everything I suffer, I suffer for you. (1.-pengelwa, 2.-penge-lede, 3.-pengelezya, 4.-pengelela, 5.-pengelelalyo, 6.-pengelesya, 7.-pengela-pengela, 8.-pengelana) =

going about suffering, rt. penga, Inzala yakono ninkali alimwi yuusisya nsoni bantu mbobapengauka akusola kuyandaula twakulya. The famine of this year is severe and it brings shame the way people have to go about suffering, trying to search for a little food. (1.-pengaukwa, 2.-pengaikide, 3.-pengauzya, 4.-pengaukila, 5.-pengaukilalyo, 6.-pengaukisya, 7.-pengauka-pengauka, 8.-pengaukilana)

be opened, Coonde cakapenuka sunu akaambo kabantu baindainda mujungusi aancico. = The thicket is opened widely today because of the people who pass under it. Kamuvwumba mulembo oyo wapenuka. = Close that cloth which has opened up. (2.-penukide, 3.-penukizya, 4.-penukila, 5.-penukilalyo, 6.-penukisya, 7.-penukapenuka)

open a bit, as curtain or door, Kamupenuna mulede mooye, ndiyanda kumubona. = Open a bit where the initiate is lying, I want to see her. Kamupenuna cijazyo unjile mumuni. = Open the door a bit for the light to enter. (1.-penunwa, 2.-penwide, 3.-penuzya, 4.-penwida, 5.-penwidalyo, 6.-penunisya, 7.-penuna-penuna)

cause to suffer, rt. -penga, Kuti kolelwa buya, bamwi balela balapenzya kapati. = If you are being kept, some of those who keep you make you suffer a lot. Basimalelo batavwozyi mali manji bapenzya babelesi babo. = Employers who do not give enough money make their workers suffer. (1.-penzyegwa, 2.-penzyede, 4.-penzyezya, 5. penzyezyalyo, 6.-penzyesya, 7.-penzya-penzya, 8.penzyanya) Also: -tundulula, -pukula, -subula.

ask for something politely, Ndapepa mali aakuuzya cakulya, ndafwa nzala. = I am asking (politely) for money to buy food, I am hungry. (1.-pepwa, 2.-pepede, 3.-pepya, 4.-pepela, 5.-pepelalyo, 6.-pepesya, 7.-pepa-pepa, 8.-pepana)

lift up by spoonfuls to cool, Batumbu bapepaula ceele camwana kutegwa cifwambaane koola. = The mother was lifting the porridge of the child with spoonfuls up and down so that it would quickly cool. (1.-pepaulwa, 2.-pepawide, 3.-pepauzya, 4.-pepawida, 5.-pepawidalyo, 6.-pepaulisya, 7.-pepaula-pepaula, 8.-pepaulana) Also: -paula.
  • scatter, turn papers over, Muwo ulapepaula mapepa. = The wind scatters the papers. Also: -vwunaula, -vwunuula
  • skim off, Kamupepaula mafwuta mumabisi. = Skim the cream off the milk. Also: -ibulula, -bataula.

cover partly or lightly, or on one side, Kolipepeka kabaki aaka, ilakujaya mpeyo. = Cover yourself with this blouse, the cold will kill you. (kulipepeka = to cover or wrap oneself up against the cold.) 1.-pepekwa, 2.-pepekede, 3.-pepekezya, 4.-pepekela, 5.-pepekelalyo, 6.-pepekesya, 7.-pepeka-pepeka, 8.-pepekana)

be blown by wind, Ndembela inga ilapepela mujulu muwo noubbubbula kapati. = When the wind blows the flag is blown about above. Matu aamisamu alapepela kuti kwainda kambizyi. = The leaves of the trees are blown about when a whirlwind passes. (2.-pepelede, 3.-pepezya, 4.-pepelela, 5.-pepelelalyo, 6.-pepelelesya, 7.-pepelapepela, 8.-pepelezyanya)
  • tuck cloth between legs as when sitting = kulipepela, also kubingila

cause to be blown about, Wakabona Mainza uzya bupepelusya cibaki mutalaa mulonga uzya kumunzi. = He saw Mainza coming with his shirt been blown about at the other side of the river going to the village.

file the teeth, Bantu bapepenyeka meno mba Chokwe. = The people who file their teeth are the Ba Chokwe. (1.-pepenyekwa, 2.-pepenyekede, 3.-pepenyezya, 4.-pepenyekela, 5.-pepenyekelalyo, 6.-pepenyekesya, 7.-pepenyeka-pepenyeka, 8.-pepenyekana)
  • show teeth, bare teeth, Kasilili

menyo nokakonga babwa. = The mongoose bares its teeth when it frightens the dogs. Also: *-sinyuna*.
  • turn aside from path, as to avoid trouble, *Wakalalupepenyeka waka-* *gama kulwizi mane wakaakuluzubuka*. = He deviated and headed for the lake until he finally crossed it.

blow away, as wind does, push aside bushes with a stick when looking for something, Muwo niwaka*bbubbula wakapepula matuvwu akali* *munzila oonse*. = When the wind blew, it blew away all the leaves on the path. *Mukulaba kwaliso ciluli cananda caka-* *pepulwa akambizyi*. In the blink of an eye the roof of the house was blown away by a whirlind. (1.-pepulwa, 2.-pepwide, 3.-pepuzya, 4.-pepwida, 5.-pepwidalyo, 6.-pepulisya, 7.-pepula-pepula, 8.-pepulana)
  • carry away, as an addiction, *Kuyandisisya mali kwapepula bakubusi* *banji munyika*. = The lust for money has taken away many young people in the world.

push aside bushes when looking for something, *Kamupepuula* *muzitewo nomuyandaula kasulwe*. = Push aside the bushes when you are looking for a hare. (1.-pepuulwa, 2.-pepwiide, 3.-pepuuzya, 4.-pepwiida, 5.-pepwiidalyo, 6.-pepuulisya, 7.-pepuula-pepuula, 8.-pepuulana) Also: - *vwuntaula*.

plait hair into braids, twist fibres, spin, *Mainza upesa masusu aamwee-* *nzinyina*. Mainza is plaiting her friend's hair. *Aka kooze kakapeswa abuzingo bwa-* *kazwa kunze ansingo yamwana musa-* *nkwa abwakazwa akasolo kamusimbi* *mubotu*. This trap was weaved from the sinews which came from a boy's neck and from the hip of a beautiful girl. (1.-peswa, 2.-pesede, 3.-pesya, 4.-pesela, 5.-peselalyo, 6.-peselesya, 7.-pesa-pesa, 8.-pesana) Also: -osa, -lukas, -pesulula untwist, rt. -pesa, *Waa-* *pesulula masusu ngaapesede kabotu*. = She unplaited the hair which she had plaited nicely. (1.-pesululwa, 2.-pesuIwide, 3.-pesuluzya, 4.-pesulwida, 5.-pesulwidalyo, 6.-pesulululisya, 7.-pesulula-pesulula, 8.-pesululana) Also: -zambununa, -zambulula.

slope, *Ndapesyama* *kukkala, tandikkede kabotu*. = I am sitting on a slope, I am not sitting properly. (1.-pesyamwa, 2.-pesyeme, 3.-pesyamika, 4.-pesyamina, 5.-pesyaminalyo, 6.-pesyamisya, 7.-pesyama-pesyama, 8.-pesyamizyanya) Also: -cengama, -sendama.
  • be out of the topic, *Aayo makani* *apesyama*. = That matter is out of topic.
  • change as a language, *Lulaka Iwa-* *katalika kupesyama*. The language began to change.

distort the truth, rt. pesyama, *Moomba naali kwaambila* *mwami wakapesyamika kaambo*. Moomba distorted the truth when he was talking to the chief. (1.-pesyamikwa, 4.-pesyamikila, 5.-pesyamikilalyo, 6.-pesyamikisya, 7.-pesyamikapesyamika, 8.-pesyamikana) =
be out of topic, rt. -pesyama, *Makani akali kwaamba munene* *akalipesyeme*. The matter which the old man was talking about was out of the topic.

fold, double, *Musimbi* *upeta mali ngaapegwa*. The girl is folding up the money she has been given. (1.-petwa, 2.-petede, 3.-petya, 4.-petela, 5.-petelalyo, 6.-petesya, 7.-peta-peta, 8.-petelana)
  • bend the legs, *Kolipeta buya* *kukkala notutiikkale kabotu.* = Bend your legs and then we will sit properly. Also: -vwunga, -gonya.
  • bend the neck, *Mukombwe wakapeta mukosi mubbaba, alimwi wakapetununa mukosi wakwe mubbaba.* = The cock bent his neck under his wing, then again he stretched his neck out from under his wing.
  • memorize, *Kaindi twakali kupeta* *buya kwiiya ziiyo zyamanombolo.* = Long ago we used to just learn off by heart the mathematical tables. Also: -fwunda.

fold into folds, *Wakaupeta-peta mulembo ziindi zinji limwi waboneka kuceya.* = She folded the cloth many times until it seemed small enough. *Kamupeta-peta mapayi tweende, nkule* *nkotuya.* = Quickly fold up the blankets and let us go, as it is far to where we are going.

become upset, *Moyo wa-* *kwe wakapetama naakatukilwa kapati.* = His heart was upset when he was insulted a lot. (1.-petamwa, 2.-peteme, 3.-petamya, 4.-petamina, 5.-petaminalyo, 6.-petamisya, 7.-petama-petama, 8.-petamizyanya)
be inclined towards, *Muntu mubbi ulaa moyo upetamina bubbi* *lyoonse.* = A thief has a heart which is always bent on stealing.

go in a careless way, wander about carelessly, *Kana kaya* *inga kaya bupetauka muminzi yabantu* *takakwe ansoni.* = That child just goes about carelessly among villages of people without shame. (1.-petaukwa, 2.-petaukide, 3.-petaukizya, 4.-petaukila, 5.petaukilalyo, 6.-petaukisya, 7.-petauka-petauka, 8.-petausyanya)
  • meander, *Tumwi tuzila tulapetauka* *muzyoonde.* = Some paths meander through the thickets. Also: -penauka.

speak low, whisper, *Kopetekezya buya kwaamba, balakumvwa* *bantu.* = Just speak softly, otherwise people will hear you. Bakaleka koonse akukanana nokuba kupetekezya akaambo kakuyoowa. They completely stopped talking and even whispering because of fear. (1.-petekezyegwa, 2.-petekezyede, 3.-petekezyezya, 4.-petekezyela, 5.-petekezyelalyo, 6.-petekezyesya, 7.-petekezya-petekezya, 8.-petekezyanya.)
disposed to, rt.-petama, *Muntu mubbi ulaa moyo upeteme.* = A thief has a heart directed to evil. (1.-petemwe, 3.-petamya, 4.-petamina, 5.-petaminalyo, 6.-petamisya, 7.-peteme-peteme)
crumple, *Cibulo nica-*
When the iron was heated by the fire it crumpled
crumpled, *Inombe ilaa*
The cow has a crumpled horn.
go around, just in one turn, *Waakupetuka buyo kunze aamu-*
When you go around behind that hill you will have arrived at where you are going. (1.-petukwa, 2.-petukide, 3.-petusya, 4.-petukila, 5.-petukilalyo, 6.-petukisya, 7.-petuka-petuka, 8.-petukana)
be curved, as the mouth of a pot with a neck, rt. -petuka. *Mu-*

The mouth of this pot is curved. Also: -aleme
  • have gone around, rt. -petuka, *Ndaupetukide kale mulundu naandikonga* *syaanza.* = I had already gone around the hill when the lion startled me.

unfold, as sleeves, *Koci-* *petula cibaki mumaboko kutegwa ci-* lampe. = Unfold the sleeves so that they become longer. (1.-petulwa, 2.-petwide, 3.-petuzya, 4.-petwida, 5.-petwidalyo, 6.-petulisya, 7.-petula-petula, 8.-petulilana) Also: -petulula.

become unfolded, Capetuluka cibaki mumaboko. = The shirt sleeves became unfolded. Also: -pimpuluka.
  • meander, Koya bupetuluka mutukondo twabanyama, uyakusika. = Go winding along the tracks of the animals, you will get there. (2.-petulukide, 3.-petulukizya, 4.-petulukila, 5.-petulukilalyo, 6.-petulukisya 7.-petuluka-petuluka) Also: -petauka.

unfold as a cloth, Kocipetulula cibaki civwumbe maboko nkaambo kuli mpeyo. = Pull down the sleeves of your shirt because it is cold. Kopetulula mpetu yakakomenensya. = Unfold the hem which is too big. (1.-petululwa, 2.-petulwide, 3.-petuluzya, 4.-petulwida, 5.-petulwidalyo, 6.-petululisya, 7.-petulula-petulula, 8.-petululana) Also: -petula.
