sift again and again, Bayaki baseba-seba musenga wakuyasya. = The builders are sifting the sand for building. (1.-sebwa-sebwa, 2.-sebedesebede, 3.-sebya-sebya, 4.-sebela-sebela, 5.-sebela-sebelayo, 6.-sebesya-sebesya, 7.-sebaseba-sebaseba, 8.-sebelanasebelana)

dance without lifting legs, Bamakaintu basebeleka buya kuzyana ciyayaale = The women are dancing the ciyayaale without lifting their legs. Nobazyana bamwantuka, bavwuuluka, basebeleka, basotoka kujulu. = When they dance they kick in the air, they turn around they dance without lifting legs, they jump. (1.-sebelekwa, 2.-sebelekede, 3.-sebelezya, 4.-sebelekela, 5.-sebelekelalyo, 6.-sebelekesya, 7.-sebeleka-sebeleka, 8.-sebelezyanya)

work, (ety. foreign) Kusebenza tamweelede kulengaana. = You should not be half-hearted when you work. Mapande usebenza ku Monze. = Mapande works at Monze. (1.-sebenzwa, 2.-sebenzede, 3.-sebenzya, 4.-sebenzela, 5.-sebenzelalyo, 6.-sebenzesya, 7.-sebenza-sebenza, 8.-sebenzelana) Also: -beleka.

sift with, rt. seba, Bakaintu balikusebya buntele apukumuna. = The wife was sifting the groundnuts with a wide-holed sieve. (1.-sebwa/-sebezyegwa, 2.-sebede, 3.-sebya, 4.-sebela, 5.-sebelalyo, 6.-sebesya, 7.-sebya-sebya, 8.-sebelana)

sprawl, Chifwala wasedebala kukkala nkaambo walya kapati. = Chifwala sprawls out as he sits because he has eaten a lot. (1.-sedebalwa, 2.-sedebete, 3.-sedebalizya, 4.-sedebalila, 5.-sedebalilalyo, 6.-sedebalisya, 7.-sedebala-sedebala, 8.-sedebalilana) Also: -sedema.

sprawl, Muntu ulaa cuute kumatako ulasedema kukkala. = The person with the abcess on a buttock sprawls as he sits. (1.-sedemwa, 2.-sedeme, 3.-sedemya, 4.-sedemina, 5.-sedeminalyo, 6.-sedemisya, 7.-sedema-sedema, 8.-sedeminana) Also: -sedebala.

move from being seated, Wakaseduka acuuno wakkala ansi. = He moved from the chair and sat on the ground. Kachila wakaseduka kauno nkaakakkede akupa Choopa. = Kachila moved from the chair where he was sitting and gave it to Choopa. (1.-sedukwa, 2.-sedukide, 3.-sedusya, 4.-sedukila, 5.-sedukilalyo, 6.-sedukisya, 7.-seduka-seduka, 8.-sedusyanya)

remove, Nobakasedula bbwe lyakali kunsi amootokala, mootokala wakamudimba kukuulu. = When they removed the stone from under the car, the car fell upon his leg. (1.-sedulwa, 2.-sedwide, 3.-seduzya, 4.-sedwida, 5.-sedwidalyo, 6.-sedulisya, 7.-sedula-sedula, 8.-sedulana)

play, amuse oneself, Kamwale ulaliseenya alikke munanda. = The initiate is playing alone in the house. Basimbi balaliseenya mumulonga. = The girls are playing in the river. (1.-seenyezyegwa, 2.-seenyezyede, 3.-seenyezya, 4.-seenyezyezya, 5.-seenyezyezyalyo, 6.-seenyezyesya, 7.-seenya-seenya, 8.-seenyezyanya)

strain through a sieve, Kamusefwa buntele tutwide cisyu. = Sift the pounded groundnuts so that we use it for relish. (1.-sefwegwa, 2.-sefwede, 3.-sefwezya, 4.-sefwela, 5.-sefwelalyo, 6.-sefwesya, 7.-sefwa-sefwa, 8.-sefwana) Also: -seba.

rest head on, Kamumupa kauno munene uyanda kusegela. = Give the stool to the old man who wants to rest his head on it. Also: -tulika. (kulitulika) (1.-segelwa, 2.-segelede, 3.-segelezya, 4.-segelela, 5.-segelelalyo, 6.-segelesya, 7.-segela-segela, 8.-segelana)

laugh, Bana balikuseka bacembele bakankama. The children were laughing at the old woman who was trembling. Bana bakali kuseka magwegweegwe. The children were laughing loudly. (1.-sekwa, 2.-sekede, 3.-sesya/ sekezya, 4.-sekela, 5.-sekelalyo, 6.-sekesya, 7.-seka-seka, 8.-sekana.)
laugh at, Pesi Mwami wakalibasekede bantu aaba munanda yabo, tiibakajisi amwana naba omwe wakuzyala. The Lord had laughed at them in their marriage, they did not produce a single child.

enjoy, celebrate, Twakasekelela nitwakamvwa kuti bataata bakaula namutendele. We rejoiced when we heard that father had bought a bicycle. Bantu basekelela mwaka waceyo mulwiindi. People are celebrating a year of plenty at the Iwiindi festival. Wakalisekelela akulikambila naakabona basimbi mbobazyana. He was delighted and clapped his hands when he saw how the girls danced. (1.-sekelelwa, 2.-seke-lede, 3.-sekelezya, 4.-sekelelela, 5.-sekelelelalyo, 6.-sekelelesya, 7.-sekelela-sekelela, 8.-sekelelana)

be friable, i.e. easily crumbled, Bwizu bwaciluli bwakasekenuka nkaambo bwakaligwa mumoma. = The grass for the roof crumbled easily as it was eaten by ants. (1.-sekenukwa, 2.-sekenukide, 3.-sekenuzya, 4.-sekenukila, 5.-sekenukilalyo, 6.-sekenukisya, 7.-sekenuka-sekenuka) Also: -senkenuka.

insert, Kamusekka keembe mumwiini kajate. = Insert the axe-head in the handle so that it sticks. Kamusekka sumo mulusako. Insert the spear-head into the shaft. Wakalusekka Iwija mulutebe Iwakwe. He inserted the horn in his big bag. (1.-sekkwa, 2.-sekkede, 3.-sekkezya, 4.-sekkela, 5.-sekkelalyo, 6.-sekkesya, 7.-sekka-sekka, 8.-sekkana.) Also: -syomeka, -kwikka.

dismantle Idilwe lyamana, kamusekkaula kalo tweende. = The funeral is over, dismantle the little bed so that we go. (1.-sekkaulwa, 2.-sekkawide, 3.-sekkauzya, 4.-sekkawida, 5.-sekkawidalyo, 6.-sekkaulisya, 7.-sekkaula-sekkaula, 8.-sekkaulana)

be stuffed with, Wakasola kuti azubuke acisuwo cakwe cisekkeledwe maila atulyo tumwi. = She tried to cross with her basket stuffed with millet and other foods. Ibbaasi liya kuboola lilisekkeledwe. = The bus will come loaded. (1.-sekkelelwa, 2.-sekkelede, 3.-sekkelezya, 4.-sekkelelelwa, 5.-sekkelelelwalyo, 7.-sekkeledwe)

stuff, add more, rt. -sekka, e.g Ciluli cakasekenuka, kamusekkelela bwizu. The roof has crumbled, stuff more grass into it. (1.-sekkelelwa, 2.-sekkelede, 3.-sekkelezya, 4.-sekkelelela, 5.-sekkelelelalyo, 6.-sekkelelesya, 7.-sekkelela-sekkelela, 8.-sekkelelana) Also: -songelela.

make marriage negotiations, bring marriage security, Basela musimbi kwa Moomba. They are making marriage arrangements concerning a girl at Moomba. Bazyali bamusankwa bakali kupenga kuduunkana kuya kukusela musimbi ngubakasala kuti mwanaabo akwate. The parents of the boy were suffering in going frequently to negotiate marriage to the home of the girl who they had chosen for their son to marry. (1.-selwa, 2.-selede, 3.-selezya, 4.-selela, 5.-selelalyo, 6.-selesya, 7.-sela-sela, 8.-selana) Also: -eba.
  • feel effects of illness Ndicimvwide buya cilasela cicisa. I still feel the pain of the wound.
  • land as a boat, reach the shore, Bwato bwasela. The boat has landed.

be concave, Cibuno camukaintu ooyu cakaile kuselebala. = The waist of this woman is just concave. (1.-selebalwa, 2.-selebete, 3.-selebeka, 4.-selebalila, 5.-selebalilalyo, 6.-selebalisya, 7.-selebala-selebala)

slope, rt. selebala, Kamuselebalya cito kaziinda kabotu zilayi. = Slope the drift so that the sledges can pass through easily. (1.-selebalizyigwa, 2.-selebalizyide, 3.-selebalizya, 4.-selebalilzyila, 5.-selebalizyilalyo, 6.-selebalizyisya, 7.-selebalya-selebalya) Also: -selebeka, -selebatya.

be leaning to one side, Taakakkede kabotu wakaliselebede. S/he was not sitting properly, s/he was leaning to one side. (1.-selebalwa, 2.-selebede, 3.-selebeka, 4.-selebalila, 5.-selebalilalyo, 6.-selebalisya, 7.-selebede-selebede, 8.-selebalizyanya)

incline, Kociselebeka cibiya eeco, citabi aanindi ndamfwu. = Curve that earthen dish, let it not have a deep cavity. (1.-selebekwa, 2.-selebekede, 3.-selebesya, 4.-selebekela, 5.-selebekelalyo, 6.-selebekesya, 7.-selebeka-selebeka)

come out, as reeds from a bundle, Lutete Iwakaselebuka kuzwa mumuleye. = The reed came out of the bundle. (1.-selebukwa, 2.-selebukide, 3.-selebusya, 4.-selebukila, 5.-selebukilalyo, 6.-selebukisya, 7.-selebuka-selebuka) Also: -selemuka.

come down, come ashore, Ndamubona wali kuselela kunkunamwa. I saw him going down the slope. Also: -gunukila. (1.-selezyegwa, 2.-selelede, 3.-selezya, 4.-selelela, 5.-selelelalyo, 6.-selelesya, 7.-selela-selela, 8.-selezyanya)
  • negotiate marriage for, rt. -sela, Bausyi tabalibambide kuselela mwanaabo uucili sicikolo. The father is not prepared to negotiate marriage for his son who is still a school-boy. Also: -ebela

go down a steep incline, Kana kaseleleka kuya kumungenyu kakayoowede. The child goes down the slope while fearing. (1.-selelekwa, 2.-selelekede, 3.-selelezya, 4.-selelekela, 5.-selelekelalyo, 6.selelekesya, 7.-seleleka-seleleka, 8.-selelesyanya)

fall, as part of a load, come out as reed from bundle, slip down, Bana basobana cakuselemuka acuulu. = The children are playing slipping down the anthill. (1.-selemukwa, 2.-selemukide, 3.-selemuzya, 4.-selemukila, 5.-selemukilalyo, 6.-selemukisya, 7.-selemukaselemuka, 8.-selemukizyanya)
slip down, rt. -selekuka, Mapopwe aselemukila kucibaka comwe mubutala. = The maize has slipped down into one place in the maize bin. Also: -culukila, -tyumpukila.

help one to marry, by giving part of the lobola, Baacisya mbabakandiselesya. My uncle is the one who helped me to marry by giving me an installment for the bride-wealth. Haajwakasako wakaselesya mujwaakwe lubono lusyoonto biyo. = Haajwakasako added very little bride-wealth to help in the marriage of his nephew. (1.-selesyegwa, 2.-selezyede, 3.-selesyezya, 4.-selesyela, 5.-selesyelalyo, 6.-selesyesya, 7.-selesyaselesya, 8.-selesyanya)

dismount, come down from, Bana baseluka mumusamu nibamana kulya masuku. = The children climbed down from the tree when they had finished eating masuku fruit. (1-selukwa, 2.-selukide, 3.-selukizya/-selusya, 4.-selukila, 5.-selukilalyo, 6.-selukisya, 7.-seluka-seluka, 8.-selusyanya.)
vomit, Waselula mwana. = The baby is vomitting. (1.-selulwa, 2.-selwide, 3.-seluzya, 4.-selwida, 5.-selwidalyo, 6.-selulisya, 7.-selula-selula, 8.-selwidana)

cause to dismount, rt. -seluka, Kamumugwasya kuselusya saka lyabusu. Help her to take down a bag of mealie-meal. (1.-selusyigwa, 2.-selu syide, 3.-selusya, 4.-selusyizya, 5.-selusyizyalyo, 6.-selusyisya, 7.-selusyaselusya, 8.-selusyanya)
cause to dismount at, Uyanda kuti tukuselusyile kuli? = At what place do you want us to drop you?

add to, Kosembelela nsuwa. Add water to the sour milk gourd. Aaya mabisi balaasembelela. They add water to the sour milk. Also: -vwela (1.-sembelelwa, 2.-sembelede, 3.-sembelezya, 4.-sembeleda, 5.-sembedalyo, 6.-sembelelesya, 7.-sembelela-sembelela, 8.-sembelelana)
dilute, adulterate, mix, Kosembelezya mukupa mumabisi alula. Dilute the bitter sour milk with fresh milk. Also: - vwelenganya.

search going backwards and forwards between different places, Ndasempenkana kapati kuyandaula basune. = I went back and forth searching for the oxen. Also: -empenkana, -endengana. (1.-sempenkanwa, 2.-sempenkenye, 3.-sempenkanya, 4.-sempenkanina, 5.-sempenkaninalyo, 6.-sempenkanisya, 7.-sempenkana-sempenkana, 8.-sempenkaninana)

carry, Nibakamana kuyaka mavwuka, bakatalika kusempula lubono Iwabo kulubikka mukati. When they had finished building a temporary shelter, they began to transport their belongings and put them inside. (When used as a noun: Mumazuba acibbalo bantu bakali kubweza mikuli ya Bamabbunu bakali kwiitwa kuti basimusempula. In the days of colonial forced labour the people who were carrying loads for the Boers were called 'carriers'.) (1.-sempulwa, 2.-sempwide, 3.-sempuzya, 4.-sempwida, 5.-sempwidalyo, 6.-sempulisya, 7.-sempula-sempula, 8.-sempwidana) Also: -yumuna, -susa.

speak mockingly, Kokanana kabotu, koleka kusempuzya buya. Speak properly, stop just mocking. Ncibi kusempuzya muntu mucete, ulakunyemena. = It is bad to mock a poor person, s/he can become angry with you. (1.-sempuzyigwa, 2.-sempuzyide, 3.-sempuzyisya, 4.-sempuzyizya, 5.-sempuzyizyalyo, 6.-sempuzyisya, 7.-sempuzya-sempuzya, 8.-sempuzyanya)
  • falsely attribute to someone, Umwi munene wakandisempuzya kuti ndijisi mali manji mubbanga, kakuli kunyina ncejisi pe. A certain old man made a false statement about me saying that I had a lot of money in the bank while I have nothing.

cut meat/fibre into strips, Kamugwasyanya kusenda loozi kutegwa tuvwumbe kabotu kaluli. = Help one another to cut the fibre into small strips so that we thatch the roof of the goats hut. (1.-sendwa, 2.-sendede, 3.-sendya, 4.-sendela, 5.-sendelalyo, 6.-sendesya, 7.-senda-senda, 8.-sendana) Also: -sama.
  • sharpen, as teeth, whittle down to a point, Mucende uulisenda inga meja, abosya kapati. = A bull who sharpens its own horns, makes them very sharp.
  • propose to, Kaumba usenda musimbi, walo ulakaka. Kaumba has proposed to a girl, but she rejects him.
  • be ashamed or embarrassed or shy, Konga kolisenda kutukila beenzinyoko munsi abapati. = You ought to be ashamed for insulting your friends before the elders. Oyu mulombwana wakalisenda kuti ambe kuti yandiluma nzuki. = The boy was ashamed to say that he had been stung by bees. Musimbi wakatalika kulisenda akaambo kakulangisigwa. The girl became shy because of being stared at. =

be slanting sideways, slope, Eeci ciluli cananda cilisendeme = This roof of a house is sloping. (i.e. is not upright as it should be) (1.-sendamwa, 2.-sendamide, 3.-sendamika, 4.-sendamina, 5.-sendaminalyo, 6.-sendamisya, 7.-sendama-sendama, 8.-sendaminana) Also: -cengama, -pesyama, -kunama.
  • become dishonest, Ooyu mwana wakasendama. This child became dishonest.

have a habit of dishonesty, Bantu basendamika kwaambaula ziindi zinji balabeja. = People who are habitually dishonest in speaking very often tell lies. Also: -zendamika, -cengamika (1.-sendamikwa, 2.-sendmikide, 3.-sendamika, 4.-sendamikila, 5.-sendamikilalyo, 6.-sendamikisya, 7.-sendamika-sendamika, 8.-sendamikana)

slope, lean to one side, Igande lyakasola kwiisendeka nongo, kuti linywe tweenda twakali atako. = The bull-frog tried to lean the clay pot on its side so as to drink the water which was at the bottom. Also: -cengamika, -zendamika. (1.-sendekwa, 2.-sendekede, 3.-sendekezya, 4.-sendekela, 5.-sendekelalyo, 6.-sendekesya 7.-sendeka-sendeka, 8.-sendekelana)
  • be easily cut into small strips, rt. senda, Loozi lulamfwu lulasendeka. = It is easy to cut long fibres into small strips. Also: -tendeka.

propose love to, rt. -senda, Mweenzinyoko nguukusendela musimbi. It is your friend who is proposing love to the girl for you. (1.-sendelwa, 2.-sendelede, 3.-sendelezya, 4.-sendelela, 5.-sendelelalyo, 6.-sendelelesya, 7.-sendela-sendela, 8.-sendelana)

speak in an indirect way, allude, insinuate, hint, Ooyu muntu kwaamba usendelezya buya, taambi ciga *minina.* = This one speaks by insinuating, he doesn't talk straight. Kanene wali kusendelezya buya kwaamba kaambo. = Kanene was talking about the matter indirectly. Mucembele wakali kwaana akulabika akusendelezya. = The old woman was telling stories and riddles and speaking with hidden meanings. (1.-sendelezyegwa, 2.-sendelezyede, 3.-sendelezyesya, 4.-sendelezyezya, 5.-sendelezyezyalyo, 6.-sendelezyesya, 7.-sendelezya-sendelezya, 8.-sendelezyanya) Also: -zendekezya.

turn around to, Naakabona kuti kaba kaindi cakulya kacitanaboola, wakasendulukila kulanga kwaali kaanda. = When he saw that after a while the food had not yet come, he turned around to look towards the kitchen. (1.-sendulukilwa, 2.-sendulukide, 3.-sendulukizya, 4.-sendulukila, 5.-sendulukilalyo, 6.-sendulukisya, 7.-sendulukila-sendulukila, 8.-sendulukilana) Also: -cengulukila

drink beer, Bamadaala baya kukusenga bukoko. = The old men are going to drink beer. Katusenga mungani. Wakatambula Choopa akulibuwa kumulomo katananywa. = Let us drink, friend. Choopa received the beer and wiped his mouth before he drank. (1.-sengwa, 2.-sengede, 3.-sengezya, 4.-sengela, 5.-sengelalyo, 6.-sengesya, 7.-senga-senga, 8.-sengelana)

sit down to eat and drink, in a group, Bamane kusamba Chipwetenge a Dyabbula bakasengela buyo kulya antoomwe abamwi. = When Chipwetenge and Dyabbula had finished washing they just sat down with the others to eat. Wakali munywi mupati alimwi wakali muntu unga oko nkwaayakusengela akoona nkumunya obo buzuba. = He was a great boozer and was a person who wherever he sat down to drink he would sleep there that day. (1.-sengelwa, 2.-sengelede, 3.-sengezya, 4.-sengelela, 5.-sengelelalyo, 6.-sengelesya, 7.-sengela-sengela, 8.-sengelana)

persuade one with no appetite to eat, Musilisi usengelezya mulwazi kulya ceele. = The doctor is persuading a patient to eat porridge. (1.-sengelezyegwa, 2.-sengelezyede, 3.-sengelezya, 4.-sengelezyezya, 5.-sengelezyezyalyo, 6.-sengelezyesya, 7.-sengelezya-sengelezya, 8.-sengelezyanya) Also: -songelezya, -kombelezya.

have food put out, Ciindi cacikasaalizi kwakasengezegwa nsima. = At about 8.00 hrs. the food was put out. (1.-sengezegwa, 2.-sengezede, 3.-sengezesya, 4.-sengezezya, 5.-sengezezyalyo, 6.-sengezesya, 7.-sengezegwa-sengezegwa)

put out, as food on table, Kamusengezya cakulya tulye. = Put out the food so that we can eat. Kaindi bamakaintu bakali kujika muzibaka zyaandeene akutolela bamalumi babo kugo-belo akuya kusengezya cakulya. = Long ago the women were cooking the food in different homes and taking it to their husbands at the men's meeting place and putting it out for them to eat. (1.-sengezyegwa, 2.-sengezyede, 3.-sengezyesya, 4.-sengezyezya, 5.-sengezyezyalyo, 6.-sengezyesya, 7.-sengezya-sengezya, 8.-sengezyanya) Also: -engezya.
be cured, Bakali kuti nkubotu anzyina myoyo yabo yasenguka. = They said that it would be good if first of all their hearts were healed.

apply medicine, Musilisi ooyu ulicizyi kusengula. = This healer knows how to treat a patient. Mukaintu wakafwuyuka musana asunu ucili ku cibbadela kusengulwa. = The woman sprained her back and even today she is still in the hospital receiving medicine. (1.-sengulwa, 2.-sengwide, 3.-senguzya, 4.-sengwida, 5.-sengwidalyo, 6.-sengulisya, 7.-sengula-sengula, 8.-sengulana) Also: -ponya, -silika.
  • make out of metal (melt and mould pig iron), Eeyi mpoto yakasengulwa buya. This pot is made out of metal.

shell, Ndali kusenkemuna mapopwe. = I was shelling maize. Also: -buulula, -bumbulula, -umbulula. (1.-senkemunwa, 2.-senkemwide, 3.-senke-muzya, 4.-senkemwida, 5.-senke-mwidalyo, 6.-senkemunisya, 7.-senkemuna-senkemuna, 8.-senkemwidana)
  • take a handful, Mubbi wakazisenkemuna ndongwe acilwi. = A thief took a handful of groundnuts from the heap. Also: -sankamuna.

employ, introduce, bring in, Wakavwiila sibbuku kumwi kasenkula tubala tubyaabi kutondezya kucimwa kwakali mucamba cakwe. = The headman answered while using strong language to show the displeasure that was in his heart.

issue as water from below, percolate, ooze, come forth as water from soil, Meenda alasensa mucikala. = The water is oozing into the well. Also: -mimita, -bwibwa, -zwizya, -zuza (1.-senswa, 2.-sensede, 3.-sensezya, 4.-sensela, 5.-senselalyo, 6.-sensesya, 7.-sensa-sensa)
  • soak, Kamusensa masembe, tukumbe cibwantu kumazuba. = Soak the grounded meal, let us brew cibwantu in the evening.
  • dance (in a certain style) Bamadaala bamwi bakauma miyuwa mipati akusensa. = The old men were shaking big rattles and dancing.
  • exchange, Bataata bajaya musune wakusensa mapopwe. My father has slaughtered an ox whose meat he wants to exchange for maize.
drizzle, Imvwula ilasensa-sensa. = The rain is drizzling.

help an invalid to walk, Basankwa basenseenzya mweenzinyina walicisa mubbola. The boys are helping the friend to walk who hurt himself at football. Banyamuna mwana bayaabusenseenzya Mutinta kuya kumunzi. = They carried the child while going along helping Mutinta to go to village. (1.-senseenzyegwa, 2.-senseenzyede, 3.-senseenzyesya, 4.-senseenzyezya, 5.-sensenzyezyalyo, 6.-senseenzyesya, 7.-senseenzya-senseenzya, 8.-senseezyanya)
help one another to walk, Toonse twakaseka kumwi katusenseezyanya kuya mulubuwa. = We all laughed while helping one another along to the courtyard.

pour down, Nkasaalo yakasensela nindakali kutijaana. = The sweat was pouring down when I was running. (1.-senselwa, 2.-senselede, 3.-sensezya, 4.-senselela, 5.-senselelalyo, 6.-senselesya, 7.-sensela-sensela, 8.-sensezyanya) Also: -ngwenga.

be worn out by friction, Insimbi yajamba yamana kusenseluka. The iron part of the plough is worn out by friction. (1.-senselukwa, 2.-senselukide, 3.-senseluzya, 4.-senselukila, 5.-senselukilalyo, 6.-senselukisya, 7.-senseluka-senseluka, 8.-senselusyanya) Also: -sensuluka.

be beaten, as a blade, be reforged, Keembe kangu kakasensemuka nikakamana kufwulwa ku mufwuzi. = My axe blade was reforged when it was worked on by the blacksmith. (1.-sensemukwa, 2.-sensemukide, 3.-sensemuzya, 4.-sensemukila, 5.-sensemukilalyo, 6.-sensemukisya, 7.-sensemukasensemuka, 8.-sensemukana)
  • be renewed, Twakasensemuka nitwakamana muswaangano. = We were renewed after the seminar.

reforge, sharpen by beating, e.g Kokasensemuna keembe. = Reforge the axe blade. Also: -fwululula. (1.-sensemunwa, 2.-sensemwide, 3.-sensemuzya, 4.-sensemwida, 5.-sensemwidalyo, 6.-sensemunisya, 7.-sensemuna-sensemuna, 8.-sensemunana)
  • sharpen mentally, Mwiiyi umwi wakali kumugwasilizya kumusensemuna kutegwa katayeeyi mapenzi aakuba mucaala. = One teacher was helping him by making him advance mentally so that he would not be thinking about the problems of being an orphan.

be worn down by friction, Insimbi yajamba yamana kusensuluka. = The blade of the plough is worn out by friction. (1.-sensulukwa, 2.-sensulukide, 3.-sensuluzya, 4.-sensulukila, 5.-sensulukilalyo, 6.-sensulukisya, 7.-sensuluka-sensuluka) Also: -senseluka.

investigate, Kuli kaambo nkasepa musilikani. = There is a crime which the policeman is investigating. Musilikani ucisepa kaambo kakacitika mwakali. = The policeman is still investigating the crime which occured last year. uusepa mulandu = the plaintiff (party who brings suit into court of law.) (1.-sepwa, 2.-sepede, 3.-sepya, 4.-sepela, 5.-sepelalyo, 6.-sepesya, 7.-sepa-sepa, 8.-sepana)
interrogate, Musilikani wamunkuta usepa-sepa kaambo kamwaange. = The prosecutor is questioning the detainee.

seek information from, Kanene kakabalailila basankwa kuti mboyakusikila buyo bakasepelele mukaintu wakwe Kajuba. = The old man advised the men that as soon as they arrived they should question the wife of Kajuba. (1.-sepelelwa, 2.-sepelede, 3.-sepelelezya, 4.-sepelelela, 5.-sepelelelalyo, 6.-sepelelesya, 7.-sepelela-sepelela, 8.-sepelelana)

demand money for a crime, Waya kukusesa mali aakwe kuli Mainza = He went to claim payment of the money which Mainza owed him. Mubetesi wali kusesa Nchimunya calunya. = The magistrate was demanding payment from Nchimunya in a rough and threatening way. (1.-seswa, 2.-sesede, 3.-sesezya, 4.-sesela, 5.-seselalyo, 6.-sesesya, 7.-sesa-sesa, 8.-sesana.)
  • judge, Bataata baya kukusesa mulandu kwa Haampongo. = My father is going to judge the case at Haampongo. Bamwi bantu balayanda kusesa beenzinyina banyina cibi. = Some people like to judge others who are innocent.

be disgusted, Mebo ndilasesema cintu cibolede. = I feel revulsion for a thing that is rotting. (1.-sesemwa, 2.-sesemede, 3.-sesemya, 4.-sesemena, 5.-sesemenalyo, 6.-sesemesya, 7.-sesema-sesema, 8.-sesemezyanya)
feel revulsion, Mebo ndasesemwa muntu unga ulalya amana tavwumbi mulomo. = I am disgusted by someone eating and then not covering his/her mouth.
cause disgust, Kujula mulomo kotafwuna cisesemya banji. = Opening your mouth while chewing disgusts many. Cinkoolwa camuntu cilasesemya. = Human phlegm is disgusting.

cause to laugh, entertain by amusing, rt. -seka, Ndakabasesya akaambo kamanyeena. = I entertained them with amusing antics. Ooyu muntu ulasesya naambaula. = This one is amusing when speaking. (1.-sekwa, 2.-sekede, 3.-sesya, 4.-sekela, 5.-sekelalyo, 6.-sekesya, 7.-sesya-sesya, 8.-sekana)

grind finely, digest, Cigayo cina Mundale cilaseta. = Mundale's mill grinds the meal finely. Itandali lyamuyuni mupati lilafwambaana kuseta cakulya. = The gizzard of a big bird quickly digests food. Also: -nantisya, -lamuna (1.-setwa, 2.-setede, 3.-setya, 4.-setela, 5.-setelalyo, 6.-setesya, 7.-seta-seta, 8.-setezyanya)
  • weave, plait, Basimbi bakaindi bakali kuseta nsambo zyakusama mumaboko. = The girls of long ago were plaiting grass bracelets for wearing on their arms.
jump out, Bamwi bakafwambaana kwaasetauka malo abo. = Some quickly jumped out of their beds.

be honourable, upright, Kuti bantu boonse basetekana inga cisi cabota. = If all people were honourable the country would be wonderful. Musimbi wakali mubotu kapati, wakajisi masusu mabotu akwizima kumutwe akusetekana kusiya mbuli boya bwamwanaa cibawe. = The girl was very beautiful, she had lovely hair shining on her head and jet black like the hair of an otter. (1.-setekanwa, 2.-setekene, 3.-setekanya, 4.-setekanina, 5.-setekaninalyo, 6.-setekanisya, 7.-setekana-setekana, 8.-setekanizyanya) Also: -loma.
do thoroughly, Kosetekanya mulimo. = Do the job perfectly. Also: -sindinkanya, -sindinganya.

be of honourable character, rt. -setekana, Ooyu muntu mubuumi ulisetekene. = This person in life is honourable. Milimo yako ilisetekene, njabulondo, busongo amaanu. = Your activities are honourable, they show neatness, intelligence and wisdom.
come from behind, Wakausetuka mulyango kati banjile kabotu beenzu. He came from behind the door telling the visitors to enter.
after twelve hours, Izuba ciindi eci lyakasetukide kale acilungulungu. The sun at this time had already reached midday.

friable, be easily crumbled, Eeli bbwe lilaseuluka ndalicumba. = This stone crumbles easily when I scrub myself. Babelesi bajana musenga uuseuluka. The workers found the sand easy to crumble. (1.-seulukwa, 2.-seulukide, 3.-seuluzya, 4.-seulukila, 5.-seulukilalyo, 6.-seulukisya, 7.-seuluka-seuluka) Also: -bumbuluka.

sit while leaning against something, Ndakaseyama kukkala kandiyeeme kucisamu. = I sat while leaning against a tree. Chuumangoma wakavwipa tii, naakamana wakaseyama acuuno akuswa ciya. = Chuumangoma sipped the tea, when he finished he leaned back on the chair and rested. Twakalikkede acuuno ciseyamwa. We were sitting on a sofa. Wakali kwiide kuseyeme acibalu kayotela zuba. She was just sitting against the wind-fence been warmed by the sun. (1.-seyamwa, 2.-seyamide, 3.-seyamya, 4.-seyamina, 5.-seyaminalyo, 6.-seyamisya, 7.-seyama-seyama, 8.-seyamizyanya) Also: -seama.

whistle, Wakasiba ludweba kuti cisobano cimane. She blew the whistle to end the game. Kosiba mulosi babwa baboole tukavwime. = Whistle for the dogs to come and we go hunting. Basimpongo balasiba tunyeele twabo twameja abalubondwe. The goat herds are blowing their little trumpets of impala horns. (1.-sibwa, 2.-sibide, 3.-sibya, 4.-sibila, 5.-sibilalyo, 6.-sibisya, 7.-sibasiba, 8.-sibilana)

put pot on fire to cook something, Kamusibika zitende kazibila notubeleka. Put the pumpkins on to boil while we are working. Amusibike musozya tulye sikati. Put the samp on the fire so that we eat at midday. (1.-sibikwa, 2.-sibikide, 3.-sibikizya,/sibisya, 4.-sibikila, 5.-sibikilalyo, 6.-sibikisya, 7.-sibika-sibika, 8.-sibikana.) Also: -yambika.
  • show signs of rain, Mutayumuki nkaambo mvwula yasibika kale kujwe. = Do not set out because the rain is threatening in the east. Imvwula yakasibika cinyenaazya kulubazu Iwakunyika. = The rain showed frightening signs of falling to the north of the area. Also: -kkazyika.
be placed on fire, Asike kumunzi aawo wakajana kuti balaa munzi basibikide cibiya acikko. = When he arrived at the village he found that the owner of the village had placed the pot on the fire.

whistle for, rt. -siba, Chigwele naakali kusibila nsolo, taakalibona dola. When Chigwele was whistling for the honey-bird, he did not see the bee-hive. Muvwimi wakabweza buta atulembe amane wakasibilia mubwa wakwe Kaluumwaya. = The hunter took his bow and arrows and when then whistled for his dog Kaluumwaya. (1.-sibilwa, 2.-sibilide, 3.-sibizya, 4.-sibilila, 5.-sibililalyo, 6.-sibilisya, 7.-sibila-sibila, 8.-sibilana)

urge, set dog to chase, stir up a quarrel, Bana nibakabona kanamusya, bakakasibilizya babwa. = When the children saw a duiker, they urged the dogs to chase it. Also: -gubaizya, siilizyas, -soozya, -saalizya, -sweezya, -usilizya. (1.-sibilizyigwa, 2.-sibilizyide, 3.-sibilizya, 4.-sibilizyizya, 5.-sibilizyizyalyo, 6.-sibilizyisya, 7.-sibilizya-sibilizya, 8.-sibilizyanya)

be busy doing something, Mbundakasikila kunanda ndakatalika kusibingana kulibambila Iweendo. = As soon as I arrived at the house I began to set about preparing for the journey. (1.-sibinganwa, 2.-sibingene, 3.-sibinganya, 4.-sibinganina, 5.-sibinganinalyo, 6.-sibinganisya, 7.-sibinganasibingana, 8.-sibinganinana)
  • have troubled or darkened face, Ndakabona wasibingana kumeso mbuli kuti kuli wali kuzima syokwe. = I saw he had a darkened face like one who had been putting out a bush-fire.

give correct information, correct, "Teesyi bamayi balubizya, pele mmuncini wiitwa kuti kkompyuta,". = It was not the teacher who erred, but it is the machine called 'computer'. (1.-sibulwa, 2.-sibwide, 3.-sibuzya, 4.-sibwida, 5.-sibwidalyo, 6.-sibulisya, 7.-sibula-sibula, 8.-sibulana)

dig a narrow hole, rt. -sya, Kamusidila zilindi zyazisanda zyacisanza. = Dig the holes for the poles for a platform for drying maize. (1.-sidilwa, 2.-sidilide, 3.-sidizya, 4.-sidilila, 5.-sidililalyo, 6.-sidilisya, 7.-sidila-sidila, 8.-sidilana) Also: -syidila.

be dug, rt. -sya, Munsi amulonga kwakasigwa mugoti wameenda. = Beside the river a borehole has been dug. (1.-sigwa, 2.-side, 3.-sisya, 4.-sidila, 5.-sidilalyo, 6.-sisyisya, 7.-sigwa-sigwa, 8.-sidilana)

be dark, rt. siya, Ciindi naakasika mu Lusaka Mutinta kwakalisiide, elyo wakoona acitisyini. = At the time when Mutinta arrived at Lusaka it was night-time, therefore she slept at the station. Mbukwakasiide kale, wakatalika kulyoolola nkaambo lino atwalo tulo twakali kuya bumusobelela. = As it was already dark he began to yawn as now sleep was stalking him. (1.-siilidwe, 2.-siide, 3.-siizya, 4.-siilila, 5.siililalyo, 6.-siisya, 7.-siide-siide, 8.-siizyanya)
be left, rt. siya, Taakacili kuyanda limbi kusiigwa alikke. = She did not want to be left alone again.

leave something with/for someone, rt. -siya, Kamumusiila lugwalo mwana uzoobapa bapati. Leave the letter with a child so that s/he gives it to the elders. Kamumusiila ceele mwana. = Leave porridge for the child. Mwanaangu, ndakusiila nanda mbotu njeeyi mebo ndapiluka kumunzi. My child, I leave you this good house, I am returning to the village. Bakulukulu bakatusiila tumwi tulengwa. = Our ancestors of the past left us certain traditions. (1.-siilwa, 2.-siilide, 3.-siilizya, 4.-siilila, 5.-siililalyo, 6.-siilizya, 7.-siila-siila, 8.-siilana)

set dogs on, Bamusiilizya buya babwa ncibamulumina. = They set the dogs on him that is why he was bitten. Basankwa basiilizya namusya mugundu. = The boys are setting the dogs after a duiker in the forest. Also: -sibilizya,-sabilizya. (1.-siilizyigwa, 2.-siilizyide, 3.-siilizya, 4.-siilizyizya, 5.-siilizyizyalyo, 6.-siilizyisya, 7.-siilizya-siilizya, 8.-siilizyanya)

hiss, Nkuni zitete zilasiima, tazifwambaani kuyaka. = Wet firewood hisses, it is not quick to catch fire. (1.-siimwa, 2.-siimide, 3.-siimya,/siimizya, 4.-siimina, 5.-siiminalyo, 6.-siimisya, 7.-siima-siima, 8.-siimizyanya) Also: -syiima.
  • prophesy, Kaindi bakali kusiima ciyakucitika. = Long ago they used to prophesy about things which will happen. Also: -sinsima.
  • slow to accept, Nibali kumwiita bapati, wakali kwiile kusiima. = When the eleders called him, he was slow to respond.

be very dark, rt. -siya, Sunu kwasiisya nkaambo mwezi uli mumakumbi. Tonight it is very dark because the moon is in the clouds. Nsekonzyi kubala munanda mulasiisya. = I cannot read in the house because it is too dark. (1.-siisyigwa, 2.-siisyide, 3.-siizya, 4.-siilila, 5.-siililalyo, 6.-siisya, 7.-siisyasiisya)

arrive, Sena beenzu basika kale? = Have the visitors already arrived? Musankwa wasika kale kuzwa ku Chikuni. = The boy has already arrived coming from Chikuni. (1.-sikwa, 2.-sikide, 3.-sikizya/-sisya, 4.-sikila, 5.-sikilalyo, 6.-sikisya, 7.-sika-sika, 8.-sikana.)
  • be choked, Camusika cibwantu nkaambo wali kufwamvwaanya kunywa. = The sweet-beer choked her because she was drinking it quickly.

have bodily contact with another, Kuti oyu musimbi wazumina kukkala biyo munanda kakunyina kuswaana naakusikana amubili, inga cabota. = If this woman agreed to stay in the house without having sexual or bodily contact with one another, it would be good. (1.-sikanwa, 2.-sikenye, 3.-sikanya, 4.-sikanina, 5.-sikaninalyo, 6.-sikanisya, 7.-sikana-sikana, 8.-sikana)
do immediately, Mbwaamvwida biyo bantu baimba, wasikila kutuma muntu kuti abalesye. = When he heard the people singing, he immediately sent someone to stop them.

rub, Ncibi kulisikisa kuti watoogwa musenga nkaambo inga ulaba atucisa mumeso. It is bad to rub your eyes when blinded with sand because you can develop little cuts in the eye. (1.-sikiswa, 2.-sikiside, 3.-sikisizya, 4.-sikisila, 5.-sikisilalyo, 6.-sikisisya, 7.-sikisa-sikisa, 8.-sikisana) Also: -pikisa.

insert, Kamusikka nkuni kutegwa zifwambaane kubizwa zitende. = Stick some firewood in the fire so that the pumpkins are cooked quickly. (1.-sikkwa, 2.-sikkide, 3.-sikkizya, 4.-sikkila, 5.-sikkilalyo, 6.-sikkisya, 7.-sikka-sikka, 8.-sikkana or -sikkilana)

punish brutally, Si-nkondonyina wakamusikompala akumukonkobezya. = His enemy punished him brutally and left him permamently powerless. Also: sinantila (1.-sikompalwa, 2.-sikompelede, 3.-sikompalya, 4.-sikompalila, 5.-sikompalilalyo, 6.-sikompalisya, 7.-sikompala-sikompala, 8.-sikompalana)

make harmless, make a charm inactive, Tuyanda musamu wakusikulula kayanda nkookatupa. = We want medicine to take away the power of the root which you gave us. (1.-sikululwa, 2.-sikulwide, 3.-sikuluzya, 4.-sikulwida, 5.-sikulwidalyo, 6.-sikululisya, 7.-sikulula-sikulula, 8.-sikululana)

grind, crush, Ndajana bacembele basila tombwe. = I found the old woman grinding snuff. Basimbi bakali kusila mukula. = The girls were crushing red ochre. (1.-silwa, 2.-silide, 3.-silizya, 4.-silila, 5.-sililalyo, 6.-silisya, 7.-sila-sila, 8.-silana or -sililana)
  • perish, die, Bantu boonse bakasila. = All the people perished.

apply protective charms, Kuli bamwi bapati bakakusilaika yebo ncoocikonzya kusika. = There are some elders who used protective charms so that you were able to reach here. Munanga a Chikupu bakatolana musyokwe kutegwa Chikupu akasilaikwe. The witch-doctor and Chikupu took themselves off into the bush so that Chikupu would get protective medicine. (1.-silaikwa, 2-silaikide, 3.-silaizya, 4.-silaikila, 5.-silaikilalyo, 6.-silaikisya, 7.-silaika-silaika, 8.-silaikana)

cure, heal, Bantu bakaindi bakalicizyi kusilika malwazi amwi akubelesya misamu yamusyokwe. = The people of the past knew how to heal certain diseases by using medicines from the bush. (1.-silikwa, 2.-silikide, 3.-silisya, 4.-silikila, 5.-silikilalyo, 6.-silikisya, 7.-silika-silika, 8.-silikana) Also: -ponya, -sengula.

become hard, as pumpkins when ripening, Eeyi myungu yakasima inga twaicela sunu. = These pumpkins have become ripe, we can gather them today. (1.-simizyigwa, 2.-simide, 3.-simya, 4.-simina, 5.-siminalyo, 6.-simisya, 7.-sima-sima, 8.-simizyanya) Also: -kola.
  • become mature, Ooyu musankwa wasima mazubaano ulakonzya kukwata. = This boy who has matured these days is able to marry.

carve as designs on pot, Bacembele bakafwambaana kusimba cibiya nicakacili citete. = The old woman was quick to draw designs on the pot when it was still soft. (1.-simbwa, 2.-simbide, 3.-simbya, 4.-simbila, 5.-simbilalyo, 6.-simbisya, 7.-simba-simba, 8.-simbana or -simbilana)
  • cup or make cuts to draw blood, Munanga wakabasimba nsimbo ankumo bantu bakajatwa bulozi. = The witch-doctor made cuts on the forehead of people caught in witchcraft.
  • print, Eeli bbuku bakalisimba mbaku Lusaka. = This book was printed by people in Lusaka.
  • make a mark, Ivwili lyancinga yangu lyakaleka kusimba nkaambo busimbo bwakamana. = My bicycle has stopped making tracks because the tyre-threads have worn out. Also: -timba.

be filled in, Cilindi ncotwakasya jilo cakasimbila. = The hole which we dug yesterday has been filled in. Cikala ncotuteka meenda cakasimbila. = The well where we draw water has been filled in. Milonga yakali kuleta nswi yakaleka, yakasimbila, inswi zyakaleka kwiinda muli njiyo. = The rivers which used to bring fish have stopped, they have been filled in, the fish have stopped passing through them. Mulonga wa Magoye wakasimbila amvwula yakawa kumamanino. = The river Magoye has become shallow due to the sand from the inflowing water of the last rains. Also: -vwikkila (1.-simbilwa, 2.-simbide, 3.-simbizya, 4.-simbilila, 5.-simbililalyo, 6.-simbilisya, 7.-simbila-simbila, 8.-sambilana)
  • bribe to keep quiet, Babbi bakasimbila musilikani kutegwa atabajati. = The thieves bribed the policeman so that he would not arrest them. Also: -sinka mulomo.

look with a rebellious eye, Ooyu mwana kufwumbwa ndamutuma inga ulasimbula citondezya kutayanda. Whenever I send this child for something he looks at me with a rebellious eye showing that he does not want to be sent. Mucende uyanda kulwana ulasimbula. The bull who is about to fight looks with a rebellious eye. (1.-simbulwa, 2.-simbwide, 3.-simbuzya, 4.-simbwida, 5.-simbwidalyo, 6.-simbulisya, 7.-simbula-simbula, 8.-simbwidana) Also: -syimbula.

be printed, Eeli bbuku lyakasimbwa ku Lusaka. = This book was printed at Lusaka. Kusimbwa kwabbuku eeli kwakacitwa ku Lusaka. = The printing of this book was done in Lusaka. (1.-simbwa, 2.-simbide, 3.-simbya, 4.-simbila, 5.-simbilalyo, 6.-simbisya, 7.-simbwa-simbwa, 8.-simbana or

cup or suck blood with, rt, simba, Meja acitwa misuku yakusimbya balwazi. = The horns were made into cupping horns for drawing blood from sick people. (1.-simbwa, 2.-simbide, 3.-simbya, 4.-simbila, 5.-simbilalyo, 6.-simbisya, 7.-simbya-simbya, 8.-simbana, |-simbilana)

• press upon, Mudaala inga ulasiminina kuciligankizyo cakwe. = The old man is leaning heavily on his walking stick. (1.-simininwa, 2.-siminide, 3.-siminizya, 4.-simininina, 5.-siminininalyo, 6.-siminisya, 7.-siminina-siminina, 8.-simininana)
  • hold on to, Nokkede mumootokala weelede kulisiminina. = When you sit in a vehicle you should hold on. Nabulwe naakatiisole kuzwa wasiminina mala kubula bwamusankwa. = When the iguana tried to get away he held on with its claws to the stomach of the man.
  • hold oneself, Wakalisiminina kusiba mukwele, inyeele isaanguna nyimbo. = He was holding himself (by the ear) when he was blowing the mukwele flute, the first flute to start the song. cf. -jatilila.
  • depend on, Ndali kulisiminina kuli baacisya bakafwa. = I had depended on my uncle who had died. Mazubaano bana balisiminina ali usyi kuti baiye cikolo. = Children depend upon their father for their education nowadays.

promise, Kosimisya naa ulandipa juunza. = Promise that you will give it to me tomorrow. Also: -sinizya Mubelesi wakasimisya cisyomezyo cakwe. = The worker kept his promise. (1.-simizyigwa, 2.-simide, 3.-simya, 4.-simina, 5.-siminalyo, 6.-simisya, 7.-sima-sima, 8.-simizyanya)

finish, end up, Naakamana kwaana caano wakaambila bana kuti, "Caano casimpa." = When she had finished telling the story she said to the children, "The story has ended." (1.-simpwa, 2.-simpide, 3.-simpizya, 4.-simpila, 5.-simpilalyo, 6.-simpisya, 7.-simpa-simpa, 8.-simpana) Also: -gola.
  • plant, as trees, Bamwi bantu nobagonka misamu balafwambaana *kusimpa* imwi. = Some people when they cut down trees are quick to replant others. *Kamu-* *simpa cimbwali.* = Plant the cuttings of sweet potatoes. Also: -jimpika, -jinka
  • transplant, as plants, Kamucisimpa cisyango ncimwasimpula sunu. = Transplant the plant which you uprooted today. Kamusimpa cisyu kumbewu. = Transplant the seedlings in the garden.
  • insert in soft ground, Twaka-fwambaana *kusimpa* zisamu akubikka luwaile kutegwa nombe zitalyi cisyu. = We quickly inserted the poles and put the wire so that the cattle would not eat the vegetables.

scratch the ground with your finger-nail, Lubono olu nolupegwa, walo Nabulonga *wakasimpide* cala ansi. = When the payment was given, Nabulonga scratched the ground with the nail of her finger. (i.e This is a sign showing resistance to what is happening)
be inserted, rt. -simpa, Atalaa bwaanda obo mpobumanina, kwa

bukayekaye bwamabbodela akafwa. On top of that wall where it was completed, there was inserted pieces of broken bottles. Wakakkala mucimvwule calwaanga *lwakasimpidwe* mulubuwa. = He sat in the shade of a spirit gate which had been planted in the courtyard. (1.-simpwa, 2.-simpidwe, 3.-simpizyigwa, 4.-simpidwa, 5.-simpidwalyo, 6.-simpisyigwa, 7.-simpidwe-simpidwe, 8.-simpidanwa)

look direct into, Musankwa *wakasimpika* meso aakwe amusimbi ooyu. = The boy directed his eyes to this girl. (1.-simpikwa, 2.-simpikide, 3.-simpikizya, 4.-simpikila, 5.-simpikilalyo, 6.-simpikisya, 7.-simpika-simpika, 8.-simpikana)
  • do immediately, Mbwaakamubonena suntwe, *wakasimpikila* kutija. = As soon as she saw the hyena, she ran away immediately. *Ndakasimpikila* kumuzyiba munene. I was quick to recognize the old man. Mbwaakatantila abulo, wa
koona. As soon as he climbed into bed, he fell fast asleep at once.
be prepared, Kwaka
kale mabulo-mabulo aazibwantu. The drums of sweet beer were already prepared. Also: -sibikidwe
pay extra attention, Mbwaakalulyatila buyo lubuwa, beenzu

kwaamba kuti walileta silumambanyina. As soon as he stepped out on to the yard, the visitors immediately realized that he had brought himself an enemy.
  • recognize at first sight, Ndakamu*simpikila*. I recognized him immediately.
finish up, rt. -simpa, Caano mpocisimpila awo. = This is where the story finishes up. (1.-simpilwa, 2.-simpide, 3.-simpya, 4.-simpila, 5.-simpilalyo, 6.-simpisya, 7.-simpila-simpila, 8.-simpilana)

transplant by using something, Basimambewu *basimpizya* tusamu cisyu. = The gardeners use sticks when transplanting seedlings. Also: -simpya. (1.-simpwa, 2.-simpide, 3.-simpizya, 4.-simpila, 5.-simpilalyo, 6.-simpisya, 7.-simpizya-simpizya, 8.-simpizyanya)

uproot, Kamucisimpula cisamu eci amiyanda, tiicakkala kabotu aawa. = Uproot this tree with the roots, it does not fit well there. (1.-simpulwa, 2.-simpwide, 3.-simpuzya, 4.-simpwida, 5.-simpwidalyo, 6.-simpulisya, 7.-simpulasimpula, 8. -simpwidana)

transplant, Katusimpulula cisyu cilaindilila kukomena. = Let us transplant the vegetable, it is growing too big. (1.-simpululwa, 2.-simpulwide, 3.-simpuluzya, 4.-simpulwida, 5.-simpulwidalyo, 6.-simpululisya, 7.-simpulula-simpulula, 8.-simpulwidana)

plant with, Nomusimpulula kkabbici, kamusimpuzizya jamba kutegwa miyanda itazutauki. = When you are transplanting the cabbage, you should use a hoe so that the roots are not cut up. (1.-simpuzizyigwa, 2.-simpuzizyide, 3.-simpuzizya, 4.-simpuzizyizya, 5.-simpuzizyizyalyo, 6.-simpuzizyisya, 7.-simpuzizya-simpuzizya, 8.-simpuzizyanya)

transplant with a tool, Ncibotu kusimpya jamba nkaambo talizutauli miyanda. = It is good to use a hoe because it does not cut the roots. Also: -simpizya. (1.-simpwa, 2.-simpide, 3.-simpya, 4.-simpila, 5.-simpilalyo, 6.-simpisya, 7.-simpya-simpya, 8.-simpizyanya)
  • be true, Ncibotu kusimpya kaambo nomubandika abapati. = It is good to give a true account when talking to the elders.

return to parents home (of wife from husband), Bamuka Kavwili bakasimuka jilo nibakalwana amulumi wabo. = The wife of Kavwili returned to her parents home yesterday when she fought with her husband. (1.-simuka, 2.-simukide, 3.-simusya, 4.-simukila, 5.-simukilalyo, 6.-simukisya, 7.-simuka-simuka, 8.-simusyanya)

return for the last time of the bride to her parents before living permanently with her husband, Joni nibakalwana amukaintu wakwe, waka fwambaana kuya kukumusimuna. = When John fought with his wife, he quickly went to bring her back. (1.-simunwa, 2.-simwide, 3.-simusya, 4.-simwida, 5.-simwidalyo, 6.-simunisya, 7.-simuna-simuna, 8.-simunana)
  • reveal oneself, apologize, confess, Kolisimuna kubantu mbookacitila kaambo. = Apologize to the people you have offended.

narrate, announce, demonstrate, Ndakamusimwina kaambo munene jilo. = I narrated the story to the old man yesterday. Also: -syimwina, -ambila. (1.-simwinwa, 2.-simwinide, 3.-simwizya, 4.-simwinina, 5.-simwininalyo, 6.-simwinisya, 7.-simwina-simwina, 8.-simwinana)

make strong, rt. -sima, Bana balayanda kulya tuteteete/tuubauba kusimya mibili kufwambaana. = Children like eating soft things to make their bodies strong. (1.-simizyigwa, 2.-simide, 3.-simya, 4.-simina, 5.-siminalyo, 6.-simisya, 7.-simya-simya, 8.-simizyanya)

throttle, choke, Kabalwana bakazikumujata amoyo akumusina limwi wawa ansi. = As they were fighting they caught him by the throat and throttled him until he fell down. Sena uyanda kusina mwana? = Do you want to choke the child? Insima yajilo ilasina amoyo. = Left over nsima chokes the throat. (1.-sinwa, 2.-sinide, 3.-sinizya, 4.-sinina, 5.-sininalyo, 6.-sinisya, 7.-sina-sina, 8.-sinana)
  • commit suicide, Wakalyaanga lutambo munsingo akulisina. = He tied a rope around his neck and hung himself. Amunzi oonse aide kubija, kuti nsekkede lyoonse ndaide kulisina. = At the village everything is bad, if I stay here all the time I will just hang myself.
  • squeeze, as juice, *Kamusina mafwuleenke kutegwa tujane musinza wakusanina mwana.* = Squeeze the oranges so that we get the juice to feed the baby. Also: -tyanka, -kanya.

put on an inquisitive look, *Munene wakali munanda wakasinama ampulungwido kuti abone cakali kumweka.* = The old man who was inside the house looked inquisitively through the window to see what was shining. (1.-sinamwa, 2.-sinamide, 3.-sinamya, 4.-sinamina, 5.-sinaminalyo, 6.-sinamisya, 7.-sinama-sinama, 8.-sinaminana)
  • be crowded, as children sleeping together, *Bana bakasinama, bulo bwakaceya.* The children were crowded sleeping together, the bed was too small. Also: -syankana.
  • look downwards, *Mubwa ulasinama kulanga mubwina mwanjila sulwe.* = The dog looked down inquisitively into the hole where the rabbit had entered.

scrutinize, examine carefully, e.g *Kosinamina buya ulaibona njina mumazakala oomo.* = Look carefully into those rags and you will see the louse. (1.-sinaminwa, 2.-sinaminide, 3.-sinaminzya, 4.-sinaminina, 5.-sinamininalyo, 6.-sinaminisya, 7.-sinamina-sinamina, 8.-sinaminana)
wear out, *Cisani cangu sunu cakasinauka.* My cloth is worn out. (1.-sinaukwa, 2.-sinaukide, 3.-sinauzya, 4.-sinaukila, 5.-sinaukilalyo, 6.-sinaukisya, 7.-sinauka-sinauka) Also: -sunauka, -monkooka.

wipe, *Koisinda misozi, kwiina aufwide kuno pe.* Wipe your tears there is no one who has died here. *Komusinda mamina mwana.* = Wipe the mucous from the child. Uleelede kubasinda bana maambukwa akubasansamuna bulongo. = You are supposed to wipe off the excrement of the children and clean off the soil. Also: -pemba. (1.-sindwa, 2.-sindide, 3.-sindya, /-sindizya, 4.-sindila, 5.-sindilalyo, 6.-sindisya, 7.-sinda-sinda, 8.-sindana)
  • till new land for planting, *Tuya kukusinda bulimo bwakusyanga nyemu.* = We are going to till new land where we are going to plant groundnuts.

compact, stuff mouth with food, stamp down, *Kamuzisindaila zisamu nzimwasimpa kutegwa zijate.* = Stamp down the poles you have put in the ground so that they hold fast. *Bamakaintu basindaila busu munongo.* = The women are pressing the mealie-meal down into the earthen pot. (1.-sindailwa, 2.-sindailide, 3.-sindaizya, 4.-sindailila, 5.-sindaililalyo, 6.-sindailisya, 7.-sindaila-sindaila, 8.-sindailana)
  • stamp down the soil on a filled in grave after burying the dead, *Basidilwe balasindaila cuumbwe nazikkwa munene.* = The mourners are stamping down the grave when the old man is being buried.

adhere, *Busu bwasindamina atako lyancili.* = The mealiemeal has adhered to the bottom of the mortar. (1.-sindamizyigwa, 2.-sindamide, 3.-sindamizya. 4.-sindaminina, 5.-sindamininalyo, 6.-sindaminisya, 7.-sindaminasindamina, 8.-sindamizyanya)
  • be beaten into the ground, *Bulimo bwasyangwa bwasindamina nibwaugwa mvwula mpati.* The plot which was planted was beaten down when there was a fall of heavy rain.
  • look carefully or intently, *Kuti wamusindamina kumulanga inga wabona kuti ulisowekede mumizeezo.* = If you look carefully at her you will see that she is lost in thoughts.
emphasize, *Mainza wakaambisya cakusindamizya mbojene* muntu wakakoledwe. = Mainza shouted like a drunkard to emphasize the point.

pound, using sharp or pointed end of the pestle to reach the base of the mortar, *Kamusindamuna* kutegwa mapopwe ali kunsi atugwe. = Pound using the sharp end of the pestle so that the maize which is underneath is also pounded. (1.-sindamunwa, 2.-sindamwide, 3.-sindamunzya, 4.-sindamwida, 5.-sindamwidalyo, 6.-sindamunisya, 7.-sindamuna-sindamuna, 8.-sindamwidana)

impel, move, push, squeeze, Mmusune wakamusindika kucisamu Joojo ncaakafwa. = It is an ox which pushed Joojo against a tree which caused him to die. Also: -syanikizya, -syaanikizya (1.-sindwa, 2.-sindide, 3.-sindizya, 4.-sindikila, 5.-sindikilalyo, 6.-sindikisya, 7.-sindika-sindika)
  • be easily ploughed, rt. -sinda, Bulongo buubauba bulasindika. = A soft soil is easily ploughed.

accompany, escort, Ndali kusindikila mweenzuma wali kuya kumunzi wakwe. = I was escorting my friend who was going to his home. Wakamusindikila mane kuya kusikila kugolela lubuwa. = He escorted him reaching up to where the courtyard ended. (1.-sindikilwa, 2.-sindikilide, 3.-sindikizya, 4.-sindikilila, 5.-sindikililalyo, 6.-sindikilizya, 7.-sindikila-sindika, 8.-sindikilana.) Also: -yumba-yumba.
escort, Beenzu usindikizya Juunza uya ku Lusaka. = Beenzu is escorting Juunza who is going to Lusaka.

plough for, rt. -sinda, Ndisindila bataata muunda. = I am ploughing the field for my father. (1.-sindilwa, 2.-sindilide, 3.-sindizyizya, 4.-sindilila, 5.-sindililalyo, 6.-sindililisya, 7.-sindila-sindila, 8.-sindilana)
  • stamp, as a floor, harden it, fill in, Kamusindila cilindi ciya cakasya mweenzinyoko, umbi ulalicisa. Fill in that hole which your friend dug, someone may hurt himself. Also: -simbila, -vwukkila, -sindaila.

do well, *Kamusindi-* nganya kulemba magwalo kutegwa bamacembele abalo kabacikonzya kubala. = Write the letters properly so that the old woman also may be able to read. Kosindinganya kwaamba tumvwe. = Tell us clearly so that we understand. Wakacili mwana muniini cakuti inga tako kucikonzya kusindinganya kwaamba cakacitika. She was still a young child and so she was not able to clearly explain what had happened. (1.-sindinganyizyigwa, 2.-sindingenye, 3.-sindinganya, 4.-sindinganyizyizya, 5.-sindinganyizyizyalyo, 6.-sindinganyizyisya, 7.-sindinganya-sindinganya, 8.-sindinganyizyanya)
do well Also: -setekanya, -sindinganya.

use to clean, rt. -sinda, *Komusindizya* cinkonti mwana, waambuka. = Clean the child with a shelled mealie cob, it has defecated. Amundipe kasani kakulisindizya mitukuta. = Give me a cloth so that I wipe the sweat off myself. (1.-sindizyigwa, 2.-sindizyizye, 3.-sindizya, 4.-sindizyizya, 5.-sindizyizyalyo, 6.-sindizyisya, 7.-sindizya-sindizya, 8.-sindizyanya)
  • plough with, Moono wakali kusindizya talakita mumuunda wakwe. = Moono was using a tractor to plough his field.

wipe, rub off, clean out pot with finger, rt. -sinda, *Kamusindula* makololo aali mucibiya. Clean out the leavings from the pot. *Kosindula* misozi yako. Wipe away your tears, Komusindula mamina mwana. = Clean the mucous from the child. (1.-sindulwa, 2.-sindulide, 3. -sinduzya, 4.-sindwida, 5.-sindwidalyo, 6.-sindulusya, 7.-sindula-sindula, 8.-sindulana)

curse, Bapati bamusinga kufwa mwana. = The elders cursed the child so that it would die. Langa, muntu ngooli kusinga wafwa ncobeni. = Look, the person whom you were cursing really died. Mulicizyi kuti kusinga muntu mu Chitonga cilatondwa, mbuli kuti muntu wamwa-ambila kuti, "Abota waandwa lulabo wafwa." = You know that to curse a person in Chitonga is taboo, like if a person said to you, "It would be good if you were struck by lightning and died." (1.-singwa, 2.-singide, 3.-singizya, 4.-singila, 5.-singilalyo, 6.-singisya, 7.-singa-singa, 8.-singana)

call down a curse on, Bacembele bakaitukila akwiisinganya nzoka. = The old woman insulted and cursed the snake. (1.-singanyizyigwa, 2.-singenye, 3.-singanya, 4.-singanyizyizya, 5.-singanyizyizyalyo, 6.-singanisya, 7.-singanya-singanya, 8.-singanyizyanya)

prepare to rain heavily, Imvwula *yasingula* bubi sunu. = The rain is ready to fall heavily today. (1.-singulwa, 2.-singwide, 3.-singuzya, 4.-singwida, 5.-singwidalyo, 6.-singulisya, 7.-singula-singula, 8.-singwidana)

be removed, Bwaanda bwacijikila *bwakasinguluka*. = The coating on the wall of the kitchen was removed. (1.-singulukwa, 2.-singulukide, 3.-singulukizya, singulukila, 5.-singulukilalyo, 6.-singulukisya, 7.-singuluka-singuluka)
  • fade as paint, Mulambo wakazilidwe ananda *wakasinguluka*. = The paint with which the house was painted has faded.

daub a hut with last coat, white-wash, smear a plastered hut, repair damaged parts, Bacembele ba singulula kabbule. = The old woman is plastering the groundnut bin. Bwaanda bwakacizwa ono-ono *kusingululwa*. = The wall had just now been plastered. (1.-singululwa, 2.-singulwide, 3.-singuluzya, 4.-singulwida, 5.-singulwidalyo, 6.-singululisya, 7.-singulula-singulula, 8.-singulwidana)
  • transfer to another person the inherited name of a dead person from the one to whom it was initially given because of mismanagement of the inherited wealth. Bakazuminana kuti *simulyazina*, anyangwe, *izina lisingululwe* akupegwa kuli umbi. = They agreed among themselves that the inheritor of the name of the deceased should be deprived, the name transferred and given to another.

be hanged, rt. *-sina*, Mumukowa wesu kunyina *wakalisinide*. = In our clan no one has hanged him/her self. (1.-sinwa, 2.-sinide, 3.-sinizya/-sinia, 4.-sinina, 5.-sininalyo, 6.-sinisya, 7.-sinasina, 8.-sinana)

force, Bakamusinikizya kuti abape makki bajule a kubba. = They forced her to give them the key so that they could enter and steal. (1.-sinikizyigwa, 2.-sinikizyide, 3.-sinikisyizya, 4.-sinikizyila, 5.-sinikizyilalyo, 6.-sinikizyisya, 7.-sinikizya-sinikizya. 8.-sinikizyanya.)

squeeze the breast to bring out milk, Muvwanda afwa, banyina balasinina mukupa mucuumbwe. = When a baby dies the mother squeezes milk into the grave. *-sinina mwana* = squeeze the breast to bring out milk for the baby. (1.-sininwa, 2.-sinide, 3.-sinizya, 4.-sinina, 5.-sininalyo, 6.-sinisya, 7.-sinina-sinina, 8.-sininana)

tell the truth, affirm, be serious in what you do or say, be sincere, Wakasinizya kwaamba naakabetekwa amubetesi mupati. = He told the truth when he was tried by a senior magistrate. Nopa bukamboni, weelede kwaamba cakusinizya. = When you give witness, you should tell the truth. Ndakalisinizya aboobo tiindakali kuyoowa pe. = I was really telling the truth and so I was not afraid. Ulalisinizya. = He is very sincere. Mukaintu wakabona kuti oyu munene wakalisinizyide kumakani akwe. = The woman saw that this old man was serious about what he had said. Also: -simizya. (1.-sinizyigwa, 2.-sinizyide, 3.-sinizyisya, 4.-sinizyizya, 5.-sinizyizyalyo, 6.-sinizyisya, 7.-sinizya-sinizya, 8.-sinizyanya)
  • choke to death with, rt. -sina, Basaanyina amooye basinizya maanza mpongo. = The age-mates of the initiate choke the goats to death using hands. Insaku ezyo nozyakasinizya kukomena, mapopwe akamanikila akutapona kabotu. = When those weeds proliferate, the maize is choked and does not do well.

block, close, plug, Kamusinka mutupulo-pulo meenda ataindi. = Close all the little holes so that the water does not enter. Kamusinka bwina atazwi sulwe. = Block the hole so that the rabbit does not get out. (1.-sinkwa, 2.-sinkide, 3.-sinkizya, 4.-sinkila, 5.-sinkilalyo, 6.-sinkisya, 7.-sinka-sinka, 8.-sinkana /-sinkilana)
  • bribe to keep one's mouth closed, Mubetesi wankuta wakapegwa cisinka mulomo. = The magistrate of the court was given a bribe.
  • bring problems, Taakayanda kukazyanya nkaambo wakali kuti nkulisinka ankumo. = He did not argue because he knew it would only bring problems.
kwaamba, pause in speech
kwaamba, speak again after pause

squeeze together, Kamusinkana kukkala nomutiiyele mucimbaya mbaya. = Squeeze together when you are sitting so that you all fit into the vehicle. Mapopwe akasinkana kapati mumuunda oomu. = The maize is over-crowded in this field. (1.-sinkanwa, 2.-sinkene, 3.-sinkanya, 4.-sinkanina, 5.-sinkaninalyo, 6.-sinkanisya, 7.-sinkana-sinkana, 8.-sinkana) Also: -sisinkanas, -sinkila obstruct, Mwatusinkila, kamuzwa kumbele, aswebo tulange bbola. = You are obstructing us, move away from front so that we also see the football. Bavwimi bamusinkila sulwe mubwina. The hunters blocked the rabbit in the hole. Mulonga wakamusinkila. The river blocked him. (1.-sinkilwa, 2.-sinkide, 3.-sinkizya, 4.-sinkilila, 5.-sinkililalyo, 6.-sinkilisya, 7.-sinkila-sinkila, 8.-sinkilana)
choose to marry, rt. -sinkilila, Musankwa undisinkilide ulaboola mwezi uuboola. The man who has chosen to marry me is coming next month.

look forward to having a wife, give presents with hope of marrying later, Mwana wa Haambuto bakamusinkilila kale. = They have already given the daughter of Haambuto presents in the hope of future marriage. Cheelo wakasinkilila kuli Mutinta kuti akakwate. = Cheelo gave presents to Mutinta in the hope of marrying her. Also: -bindika. (1.-sinkililwa, 2.-sinkilide, 3.-sinkilizya, 4.-sinkililila, 5.-sinkilililalyo, 6.-sinkililisya. 7.-sinkilila-sinkilila, 8.-sinkililana)
  • block, Bantu balayaka zibalu ciindi camupeyo kusinkilila luwo. = In the cold season people make wind-breaks for protection against the wind. Koya ukasinkilile boombe. Go and block the calves (from going to the cows).

be stoutly built, be energetic, Icilombwana cimwi cisinkimene alimwi icamampuba cakaima akutalika kulibanda. = One stoutly built man with fat cheeks stood up calling out all his names. (1.-sinkimanwa, 2.-sinkimene, 3.-sinkimanya, 4.-sinkimanina, 5.-sinkimaninalyo, 6.-sinkimanisya, 7.-sinkimaninalyo, 8.-sinkimanizyanya)

stress, emphasize, Bataata nibakalikulaya bana bakali kusinkimika kubasosya muntenda zyabuIwazi bwasikalileke. = When father was instructing the children he was stressing that they should be protected from the danger of the disease of AIDS. (1.-sinkimikwa, 2.-sinkimikide, 3.-sinkimisya, 4.-sinkimikila, 5.-sinkimikilalyo, 6.-sinkimikisya, 7.-sinkimika-sinkimika, 8.-sinkimikizyanya)

be crowded, Bakasinkizyanya bana ciindi nibakali kulangilila banamacaaca. = The children crowded in when they were showing the film. (1.-sinkanwa, 2.-sinkizyenye, 3.-sinkizyanya, 4.-sinkizyanyinina, 5.-sinkizyanyininalyo, 6.-sinkizyanyisyisya, 7.-sinkizyanya-sinkizyanya, 8.-sinkizyanya)

be opened, Cisinsyo cabbodela casinkuka. = The stopper of the bottle was opened. Ibbodela lijisi mukupa lyasinkuka. = The bottle of milk is opened. (1.-sinkukwa, 2.-sinkukide, 3.-sinkuzya, 4.-sinkukila, 5.-sinkukilalyo, 6.-sinkukisya, 7.-sinkuka-sinkuka)
  • come to one's senses, e.g Sicinguni wakasinkuka naakaleta mulandu. = The stubborn person came to his senses when he brought upon himself a criminal offence.

open, unblock, unplug, release, Kosinkula awo kutegwa muya kuuyinda kuya mucaanda campongo. = Open there so that fresh air can enter the goat's shelter. Munene wasinkula kwaamba. = The old man opened his mouth again to speak. Also: -fwogola. (1.-sinkulwa, 2.-sinkwide, 3.-sinkuzya, 4.-sinkwida, 5.-sinkwidalyo, 6.-sinkulisya, 7.-sinkula-sinkula, 8.-sinkulana)
  • pay attention, open the ears, Bana beelede kusinkula matwi akuswiilila mwiiyi napandulula. = The children ought to open their ears and listen to what the teacher is saying. Also: -teelela.

be cured from barrenness, Wakasinkululwa luzyalo Iwakwe. = She was cured from barrenness. Ooyu muntu wakasinkululwa buya kumunanga. = This person was cured from her barrenness by the witchdoctor. (2.-sinkulwide, 3.-sinkuluzya, 4.-sinkuIwida, 5.-sinkulwidalyo, 6.-sinkulu-lisya, 7.-sinkululwa-sinkululwa, 8.-sinkululana) Also: -bbikwa.

rebuke, scold, Wakandisinsa ali cakulya ati nkaambo tiindakalima. = She scolded me as regards food saying that I had not ploughed. Tacili cibotu kusinsa bana nobalya cakulya canu nkaambo bana balakonzya kukoola. = It is not good to complain to your children about the food you give them because they can vomit. (i.e. Parents have an obligation to feed their childen. If they complain about the children eating their food as if they have done something wrong it is considered to be taboo or cikoolo.) (1.-sinswa, 2.-sinside, 3.-sinsya, 4.-sinsila, 5.-sinsilalyo, 6.-sinsisya, 7.-sinsa-sinsa, 8.-sinsana)
  • explain, Bantu bazyila kukusonda basinsa makani ngubaleta. People who have come from the diviner are explaining the diviner's findings. Ino, Sauzendi, kosinsa kaambo kako buleya bumvwe. = Now, Sauzendi, explain your problem so that the group understands.
  • instruct children, Bakali kunga banene amikwasyi yabo nkwiizya azikko nkabela bakali kusinsila bana babo twaambo twakaindi. = The elders and their families used to chat at the fireplaces and so the elders were instructing their children through traditional maxims.
upbraid one another, Malilwe a Chimuka bakali kusinsana cakulya ciindi cacifwumofwumo. = Malilwe and Chimuka were ubraiding one another on account of the food in the morning.
cause to upbraid one another, Doombe nguwakasinsanya bantu baya. = It is Doombe who caused those people to upbraid one another. Also: -yunga kusinganya.

give instruction to, Bapati bakali kusinsila bana babo twaambo twakaindi; abalo bana abo bakomena, nkusinsila bana babo. = The elders used to instruct their child in sayings of the past and their children when they grew up would instruct their children.

prophesy, Haambayi wakasinsima zyakali kunga ziyoocitika kumazuba azyakumpela. = Haambayi prophesied about what would happen in the future. Bacembele bakaisinsima nzala iili kono. = The old woman prophesied the hunger of this year. (1.-sinsimwa, 2.-sinsimide, 3.-sinsimya, 4.-sinsimina, 5.-sinsiminalyo, 6.-sinsimisya, 7.-sinsima-sinsima) Also: -vwuvwuta, -siima.

be fat, obese, Mukonka ulya kabotu mazubaano mukosi wakwe ncowakasinsimana. = Mukonka eats well these days that is why his neck is fat. (1.-sinsimanwa, 2.-sinsimenye, 3.-sinsimika, 4.-sinsimanina, 5.-sinsimaninalyo, 6.-sinsimanisya, 7.-sinsimanasinsimana, 8.-sinsimanizyanya)
be in a state of fatness, Uulya musimbi ulineneede, mukosi wakwe ulisinsimene. = That girl is fat, her neck is fat.

give strict advice, reprimand, Mwana utalomenye bakamu sinsimika kumwaambila naakajaya nkuku yamuntu. = They reprimanded the naughty child when s/he killed someone's chicken. Walikukazya ono bamusinsimika naajatwa kabba. = She used to deny her guilt, but they have reprimanded her when she was caught stealing. (1.-sinsimikwa, 2.-sinsimikide, 3.-sinsimikisya, 4.-sinsimikila, 5.-sinsimikilalyo, 6.-sinsimikisya, 7.-sinsimika-sinsimika, 8.sinsimikana)
  • speak the truth, Mutani kutantaanyi kwaamba kaambo, kamusinsimika kutegwa babetesi bamvwe kabotu. = Do not beat about the bush, speak the truth clearly so that the judge understands clearly.

wake up, Ndasinsimuka lyanjila bataata munanda. = I awoke when my father entered the house. Kosinsimuka, woona kaindi. = Wake up, you have been asleep for a long time. (1.-sinsimukwa, 2.-sinsimukide, 3.-sinsimusya, 4.-sinsimukila, 5.-sinsimukilalyo, 6.-sinsimukisya, 7.-sinsimuka-sinsimuka, 8.-sinsimunana)
  • revive after a fit, Mulwazi wasinsimuka. = The patient has revived. Also: -zinzimuka.
  • realize, wake up to the fact, Ndali kukanana kumuntu ngwendakalubide zina, naawunka ndazoosinsimuka akuyeeya zina lyakwe. = I was talking to a person whose name I had forgotten, when he went I became alert and recalled his name.

cause to awaken, Komusinsimuna mwana lyamubala zuba. = Waken the child, the sun is shining. Nambuta uvwubide mubwa usinsimuna tunyama tucenjezu. = Nambuta is keeping a dog which arouses clever animals. Bandisinsimuna bana nibali kusabila. = The children wakened me when they were making noise. (1.-sinsimunwa, 2.-sinsimwide, 3.-sinsimuna, 4.-sinsimwida, 5.-sinsimwidalyo, 6.-sinsimunisya, 7.-sinsimuna-sinsimuna, 8.-sinsimunana)
  • be wise after a problem, Mmapenzi aakamusinsimuna kuti atalike kuvwuba ngulube. It is problems that made him wise enough to start keeping pigs.

snatch, Mubwa wakasinsula cituli canyama akucitijisya. = The dog snatched the piece of meat and ran away with it. (1.-sinsulwa, 2.-sinswide, 3.-sinsuzya, 4.-sinswida, 5.-sinswidalyo, 6.-sinsulisya, 7.-sinsula-sinsula, 8.-sinswidana)

close, Bantu bakali mumunzi nokuba kuti bakalimvwide kuti kuli utikula, bakalisinsya-sinsya matwi, bakali kuyeeye kuti nceelo. = People who were in the village even though they heard there was someone who was hiccuping, they closed their ears deliberately, they thought it was an evil spirit. (1.-sinkwa, 2.-sinsyide, 3.-sinsya, 4.-sinsyila, 5.-sinsyilalyo, 6.-sinsyisya, 7.-sinsya-sinsya, 8.-sinsyanya)

moan, groan, Musankwa wakasinta kwiindilila mumapenzaakwe. The boy groaned more than ever in his sufferings. Ntunga nizyakamunjila mumubili, wakasunzuuka akusinta abulo bwakwe. When the maggots invaded his body, he rolled and groaned on his bed. (1.-sintwa, 2.-sintide, 3.-sintizya, 4.-sintila, 5.-sintilalyo, 6.-sintisya, 7.-sinta-sinta, 8.-sintana,/-sintanyizyanya)
  • exchange, Moonga uyanda kusinta musune ampwizyi. = Moonga wants to exchange an ox for a heifer. Sikuteka meenda wakapiluka kumunzi katacebuki nokuba kusinta kankuli kukayumwina kukuboko kumbi. = The drawer of water returned to the village without looking around or changing the calabash to carry it on the other arm.

look down repeatedly in cunning or in shyness, Ulajana mwanakukanana, kulanga ngwakubba biya kulasintaamwa-sintaamwa mbuli kabwa kayanda kubba mayi. You find that as you are talking, he looks about repeatedly looking indirectly, like a dog which is about to steal eggs. (1.-sintaamwa, 2.-sintaamide, 3.-sintaamya, 4.-sintaamina, 5.-sintaaminalyo 6.-sintaamisya, 7.-sintaamwa-sintaamwa, 8.-sintaaminana)

stoop, bend down, Kosintama kutegwa batakuboni kubusyu. = Bend down so that they do not see your face. Kulimina mapopwe mmulimo muyumu nkaambo kusintamwa buya. = Weeding maize is a hard job because of having to bend down. (1.-sintamwa, 2.-sintamide, 3.-sintaamyasintamizya, 4.-sitamina, 5.-sintaminalyo, 6.-sintaminsya, 7.-sintama-sintama, 8.-sintamikana.) Also: -kotama, -sitama, -fwuuntilas, -ongomana, -gogomana, -kunkumanas, -suntama, -vwundama.

make to stoop down, rt. sintama, Kamumusintamika mwana nkaambo kaba kaindi kalungumene. = Bend the head of the child down because it has been looking up for a long time. (1.-sintamikwa, 2.-sintamikide, 3.-sintamika, 4.-sintamikila, 5.-sintamikilalyo, 6.-sintamisya, 7.-sintamika-sintamika, 8.-sintimikana)

straighten up from bending position, Kamusintamuka ino nkaambo kaba kaindi kamusinteme. = Straighten up now because you have been bending down for a long time. (1.-sintamukwa, 2.-sintamukide, 3.-sintamusya, 4.-sintamukila, 5.-sintamukilalyo, 6.-sintamukisya, 7.-sintamuka-sintamuka, 8.-sintamusyanya /-sintamunana) Also: -ongomoka.

barter, exchange, Katusintana ndongwe mebo ndijisi mapopwe. = Let me exchange my maize for your groundnuts. (1.-sintanwa, 2.-sintide, 3.-sintizya, 4.-sintila, 5.-sintilalyo, 6.-sintisya, 7.-sintana-sintana, 8.-sintana)

cause to exchange, rt. sinta. Eci cakali nceciyanza, taakali kuzumizigwa kucebauka nokuba kusintausya kankuli. This was the custom, one was not allowed to look around or exchange (the gourd from one arm to the other.) (1.-sintwa, 2.-sintide, 3.-sintausya, 4.-sintila, 5.-sintilalyo, 6.-sintisya, 7.-sintausya-sintausya, 8.-sintana)

cry out, Bacembele bakasintimuka nibakamvwa lufwu Iwamuzyukulu wabo. The old woman cried out when she heard about the death of her grandchild. Also: -kankamuka. (1.-sintimukwa, 2.-sintimukide, 3.-sintimusya, 4.-sintimukila, 5.-sintimukilalyo, 6.-sintimukisya, 7.-sintimuka-sintimuka, 8.-sintimukana)
  • stand upright, Munyati naakasintimuka, wakandibona. When the buffalo stood upright, it saw me.

catch fish with the hands, Bamakaintu bali kusinyaanga nswi mumulonga = The women were catching fish with their hands in the river. (1.-sinyaangwa, 2.-sinyaangide, 3.-sinyaangizya, 4.-sinyaangila, 5.-sinyaangilalyo, 6.-sinyaangisya, 7.-sinyaanga-sinyaanga, 8.-sinyaangilana) Also: -jatila.
be disfigured, Mudaala mbwaakasinyekede kapati, mwana wakwe kunyina anaakafwambaana kumuzyiba. = The old man was so badly disfigured that his son was unable to quickly recognize him. Also: -sinyikide
be deprived of something, Twakasinyekelwa swe. We have been deprived. Also: -sinyikilwa

expend, use up, Nguzu nozisinyika buti, bantu tiibakali kuzibikkila maanu, fwumbwa kuti batebula notuceya. = No matter how much energy one used up, people did not mind as long as they harvested even a little. (2.-sinyikide, 3.-sinyizya, 4.-sinyikila, 5.-sinyikilalyo, 6.-sinyikisya, 7.-sinyika-sinyika, 8.-sinyizyanya)

be serious, be determined, Atusinyukile cesu, nobana. = Children let us be serious about what is ours. (1.-sinyukwa, 2.-sinyukide, 3.-sinyusya, 4.-sinyukila, 5.-sinyukilalyo, 6.-sinyukisya, 7.-sinyuka-sinyuka, 8.-sinyukana)
be serious, Wakazyiba kuti mujwa wakwe wakalisinyukide. = He knew that his nephew was serious.

show teeth, e.g Mangoye wakasinyuna menyo naakabona mubwa. = The cat bared its teeth when it saw the dog. Also: -sipula menyo, -pepenyeka. (1.-sinyunwa, 2.-sinywide, 3.-sinyuzya, 4.-sinywida, 5.-sinywidalyo, 6.-sinyunisya, 7.-sinyuna-sinyuna, 8.-sinywidana)

suck in, sniff as snuff, Ndali kusipa tubwantu tunamala. = I was sucking up the sweet-beer. Ntunga zyakali kuba-luma akubasipa malowa abo. = The maggots were biting and sucking their blood. (1.-sipwa, 2.-sipide, 3.-sipya/sipizya, 4.-sipida, 5.-sipidalyo, 6.-sipisya, 7.-sipa-sipa, 8.-sipilana) Also: -vwipa,-pwita.
become old as clothes, Zikobela zyangu zyasipala. My clothes have become old. (1.-sipalwa, 2.-sipele, 3.-sipazya, 4.-sipalila, 5.-sipalilalyo, 6.-sipalisya, 7.-sipala-sipala) Also: -jujuka, -bbuluka.

sipula show teeth, Kosipula menyo tubone naa alasalala. = Show your teeth so that we see whether they are clean. (1.-sipulwa, 2.-sipwide, 3.-sipuzya, 4.-sipwida, 5.-sipwidalyo, 6.-sipulisya, 7.-sipula-sipula, 8.-sipulana) Also: -syipula, -syitula, -sinyuna.
hide, Kamusisa mali aanu nkaambo babbi balaafwaafwi. = Hide your money because thieves are nearby. (1.-siswa, 2.-siside, 3.-sisizya, 4.-sisila, 5.-sisilalyo, 6.-sisisya, 7.-sisa-sisa, 8.-sisana.)

do something in private or in a hidden way, Basicikolo basisikizya buya kunywa bukoko. The pupils drink beer in secret. Tanaakali kusisikizya kuseka pe, nkugwagwamuna biya kuseka walo. He was not hiding the laughter, he just laughed uncontrollably. Ncecimwi cinga capa bantu kuti bafwambaane kukwatana kutegwa basisikizye da. = That is one of the things which might make people marry quickly so that they hide a pregnancy. Also: -yubilizya. (1.-sisikizyigwa, 2.-sisikizyide, 3.-sisikizyisya, 4.-sisikizyizya, 5.-sisikizyizyalyo, 6.-sisikizyisya 7.-sisikizya-sisikizya, 8.-sisikizyanya)

confine to a narrow space, Mwasisinkana, tamukwe kuzyana kabotu. You are too crowded, you will not dance properly. Mucitima bantu balasisinkana kukkala. In the train people are crowded as they sit. Also: -sinkana. (1.-sisinkanwa, 2.-sisinkenye, 3.-sisinkanya, 4.-sisinkanina, 5.-sisinkaninalyo, 6.-sisinkanisya, 7.-sisinkana-sisinkana, 8.-sisinkanizyanya)

put close together, Bantu balasisinkanya bwizu nobavwumba nanda. People pack the grass tightly together when they are thatching. Mwakacisisinkanya cisyu, tacikakomeni kabotu. You planted the vegetables too closely together, they will not grow well.

reveal, . Mali ngaakasiside kunsi abulo wakaasisulula naakaumwa abasilikani. He revealed the money which he had hidden under the bed when he was beaten by the policeman. Also: -sisununa. (1.-sisululwa, 2.-sisulwide, 3.-sisuluzya, 4.-sisulwida, 5.-sisulwidalyo, 6.-sisululisya, 7.-sisulula-sisulula, 8.-sisulwidana)

take without permission, Kuli wasisumuna mali angu. = There is someone who took my money without permission. (1.-sisumunwa, 2.-sisumwide, 3.-sisumuzya, 4.-sisumwida, 5.-sisumwidalyo, 6.-sisumunisya, 7.-sisumuna-sisumuna, 8.-sisumwidana) Also: -fwulumuna

uncover what is hidden, Wakaleya mucisaka akusisununa Iwija mpaakalusiside. He went aside into a thicket and uncovered the horn where he had hidden it.(1.-sisununwa, 2.-sisunwide, 3.-sisunuzya, 4.-sisunwida, 5.-sisunwidalyo, 6.-sisununisya, 7.-sisununa-sisununa, 8.-sisununana) Also: -yubutaunas, -sisulula, -yubununa, -yutula.

dig deeply, rt. -sya, Kamusisya buya zilindi kutegwa zitakawi zisamu. Dig the holes deeply so that the poles do not fall. (1.-sisyigwa, 2.-sisyide, 3.-sisya, 4.-sisyila, 5.-sisyilalyo, 6.-sisyisya, 7. sisya-sisya, 8.-sisyilana)
  • cause to arrive, rt. -sika, Ndakaisisya mpongo kuli baneene. = I brought the goat to my grandmother's.
  • give beast to someone to look after it for you, Basyaanene bakasisya nombe zyobilo kumuzyukulu wabo. = My grandfather gave two beasts to his grandchild to look after for him.
leave to one's care, rt. -sisya, Muleya wakasyisyile nombe kuli ndime. Muleya left a cow with me to take care of.

protect, Bantu bayoowa kuloogwa, balalya misamu yakulisita. = People who fear to be bewitched, take medicine to protect themselves. (1.-sitwa, 2.-sitide, 3.-sitizya, 4.-sitila, 5.-sitilalyo, 6.-sitisya, 7.-sita-sita, 8.-sitana)
  • obstruct, as someone from warming himself/herself, Mwana ulaa luta ulayanda kusita beenzinyina nobayota. = A child who is naughty likes to obstruct others when they are warming themselves.

protect by using charms, Munanga wakasitaika munzi ooyu. = The witchdoctor protected this village with charms. (1.-sitaikwa, 2.-sitaikide, 3.-sitai-zya, 4.-sitaikila, 5.-sitaikilalyo, 6.-sitai-kisya, 7.-sitaika-sitaika, 8.-sitaikana)

look downwards, bow head, Kositama bulokele ansi bulowa. = Bow your head so that the blood falls on the ground. Also: -sintama. (1.-sitamwa, 2.-siteme, 3.-sitamika, 4.-sitamina, 5.-sitaminalyo, 6.-sitamisya, 7.-sitama-sitama, 8.-sitaminana)

be honourable, Kuti ko-yanda kusitikana, weelede kumvwa malailile. = If you want to be upright, you have to follow advice. Ooyu musankwa taakali kulilemeka kaindi, mazubaano wasitikana. = This boy was not behaving well in the past, but nowadays he is well-mannered. (1.-sitikanwa, 2.-sitikene, 3.-sitikanya, 4.-sitikanina, 5.-sitikaninalyo, 6.-sitikanisya, 7.-sitikana-sitikana, 8.-sitikanizyanya) Also: -kkalikana.
be of honourable character, Kazyalanzubo wakali muntu usitikide. = Kazyalanzubo was an honourable person.

become dignified, peaceful, Sunu mbubaakulaya wakasitikila. = Since they advised you, you have become well-behaved. Kubeteka mulandu wabulale nkusitikila buya. = When you are trying a case concerning adultery you need to be very dignified. Kuti musimbi waba najempa ucili mwana, kozyiba kuti musimbi oyo takacileki cilengwa cakwe naya kukwatwa, alimwi nanda yakwe tiikasitikili. = If a girl becomes a prostitute when she is young, know that that girl will not leave the habit when she is married, and again her home will never be at peace. Kuzwa kumapilingano aamazuba masyoonto aaya ainda, zintu ziyakusitikila alimwi ku Gwembe. = After the disturbances of the last few days, things will be settled again at Gwembe.

protect from wind, Kuti katuyanda kulisitikizya luwo, tweelede kuyaka cibalu. = If we want to protect ourselves from the wind, we ought to build a wind-break. (1.-sitikizyigwa, 2.-sitikizyide, 3.-sitikizya, 4.-sitikizyizya, 5.-sitikizyizyalyo, 6.-sitikizyi-sya, 7.-sitikizya-sitikizya, 8.-sitikizyanya)
  • calm down, rt. -sitikila, Kamumusitikizya kumwaambila, ambweni ulamvwa. = Speak to quieten him down, perhaps he will understand.
  • do perfectly, Baimbi aaba balasitikizya kwiimba. = These singers are singing perfectly.

protect, Kusitila muwo nkuyaka cibalu. = To get protection from the wind means building a wind-break. (1.-sitilwa, 2.-sitilide, 3.-sitizya, 4.-sitilila, 5.-sitililalyo, 6.-sitilisya, 7.-sitila-sitila, 8.-sitilana)

protect from, rt. -sita, Bantu bakaindi bakali kubelesya misamu kulisitilila. = The people of long ago were using medicines to protect themselves from witchcraft. (1.-sitililwa, 2.-sitilide, 3.-sitilizya, 4.-sitililila, 5.-sitilililalyo, 6.-sitililisya, 7.-sitilila-sitilila, 8.-sitililana)
be protected, Ndayanda kuti lubono lwenu loonse lukasitililwe. = I want all your property to be protected.

protect from, Wakaunka ulisamine kabotu-kabotu amagilazi kumeso alya asiya-siya akulisitilizya zuba kutegwa batamuzyibi. = He went well dressed with those dark glasses for protecting oneself from the sun so that they would not know him. (1.-sitilizyigwa, 2.-sitilizyide, 3.-sitilizyisya, 4.-sitilizyizya, 5.-sitilizyizyalyo, 6.-sitilizyisya, 7.-sitilizyasitilizya, 8.-sitilizyanya)

show teeth, open mouth, Kositula tubone menyo aako. Open your mouth so that we see your teeth. *Kasilili kalasitula menyo nokakonga babwa.* A mongoose bares its teeth when it frightens the dogs. Also: *-sipula menyo, -syitula.* (1.-situlwa, 2.-sitwie, 3.-situzya, 4.-sitwida, 5.-sitwidalyo, 6.-situlisya, 7.-situla-situla, 8.-sitwidana)

leave behind, *Kamumusiya buyo oyu, mulamujana.* Just leave this one behind you, will find him. *Kamumusiya mwana, uyakumukatazya.* Leave the child behind, s/he will be bothering you. (1.-siyigwa, 2.-siyide, 3.-siyizya, 4.-siyila, 5.-siyilalyo, 6.-siyisya, 7.-siyasiya, 8.-siyana.)
  • be black, *Makumbi alasiya mbi, mvwula iyanda kuboola.* The clouds are black, the rain is about to come.
  • have feelings of anger or depression, *Moyo wakwe wakali kusiya.* His heart was dark.

part from one another, *Twasiyana mumizeezo, buyo-buyo eezi zintu nizyaakweenda kabotu.* In ideas we disagreed, otherwise these things would have gone well.
  • be different, *Inkanga mmuyuni uukozya nkuku pesi mutwe ulisiyene awankuku.* The guinea fowl is a bird which is similar to a hen but the head is different from that of the hen's.
  • be dark in expression, i.e. unhappy, *Basicikolo basiyana kumeso nibazundwa.* The pupils had dark faces when they were defeated. *Bakasiyana kumeso nobakabona kuti waumwa ngubakali kutembaula.* They were very unhappy when they saw the one beaten whom they had been praising. Also: *-sutana.*
  • compete, *Basicikolo balasiyana mumizundano yakulunduka.* The pupils are competing in track races.

be dejected, downcast, *Walikusiya-siya kumeso citondezya kuti nkutaciyanda ncibali kumwaambila.* He was dejected showing signs of disliking what they were telling him.
  • become dark, *Basikukwela musimbi basika nikwasiya-siya.* The ones who were to take the girl away for marriage arrived when it was getting dark.

insult, *Mwana ngwaali kusoba wamuuma.* The young boy whom he was insulting has beaten him. (1.-sobwa, 2.-sobede, 3.-sobezya, 4.-sobela, 5.-sobelalyo, 6.-sobesya, 7.-soba-soba, 8.-sobana) Also: *-nyansya.*
  • tease, as one would playfully provoke a child, *Ndakali kumusoba mwana, mpoona wakatalika kulila.* I was teasing the child, thereupon he began to cry. Also: -soka.

approach stealthily, *Mubbi wakali kusobaila naakali kuya kukubba nkuku.* The thief approached stealthily when he was going to steal the hens. *Kusobelela kayuni nkusobaila kweenda.* To stalk a bird means to approach stealthily. (1.-sobailwa, 2.-sobailide, 3.-sobaizya, 4.-sobailila, 5.-sobaililalyo, 6.-sobailisya, 7.-sobaila-sobaila, 8.-sobaililana)

play, *Bana, kamusobana kabotu, mutacisani.* Children play carefully, do not hurt one another. *Kacumbika ulasobana ntindituzembe, tuzonde, bulambe abasimpongo bamwi.* Kacumbika is playing the games, ntindituzembe, tig-tag and buzonde with his fellow goatherds. (*ntindi* is a wheel shaped-tuber which grows out of the lyombo plant; tuzembe or tuzonde are the sticks which are thrown as spears to pierce the ntindi.)
