Bana balasobana gogoogo, neene atandabaale. = Children play games for example gogoogo, neene and tandabaale. (1.-sobanwa, 2.-sobanide, 3.-sobanizya, 4.-sobanina, 5.-sobaninalyo, 6.-sobanisya, 7.-sobana-sobana, 8.-sobanizyanya.)

play with, Bana basobanya mulilo. = The children are playing with fire. Utani kubalekeli kusobanya nyoolo, tufwulo, myuumba, tuleba, masumo a maamba. Do not allow the children play with blades, sharp instruments, spears, axes and hoes. (1.-sobanwa, 2.-sobanide, 3.-sobanya, 4.-sobanina, 5.-sobaninalyo, 6.-sobanisya, 7.-sobana-sobana, 8-sobanizyanya)
  • cause to play, Bamayi basobanya bana bacikolo. = The teachers are making the pupils play at school.

stalk, approach stealthily, Noole usobelela mbeba-nsana. = A wild cat is creeping up on the rat. (1.-sobelelwa, 2.-sobelelede, 3.-sobelezya, 4.sobelelela, 5.-sobelelelalyo, 6.-sobelelesya, 7.-sobelela-sobelela, 8.-sobelelana) Also: -bela-bela, -nwabila.

be untidy, Nywebo bana mwasofwaala amulibambe-bambe. = You children are untidy, tidy yourselves. Amundigele basa ndasofwaala mumutwe. Friend, cut my hair, my head is untidy.
  • dirty, Zisani zyangu zyasofwaala, ziyandika kusanzya. My clothes are dirty, they need to be washed. (1.-sofwaazyigwa, 2.-sofweede, 3.-sofwaazya, 4.-sofwaalila, 5.-sofwaalilalyo, 6.-sofwaalisya 7.-sofwaala-sofwaala, 8.-sofwaazyanya)
make unclean, soil, Inanda yangu tiicili cilawo camuntu, buIwazi bwandisofwaazya. My house is no longer a home for a person, disease has made me unclean.
be in a dirty state, Mugwagwa ngwayenda nuusofweede, ulanjila mumugwagwa mupati. When the road he is travelling on is in a dirty state, he enters the main road.

beat off the mealies, Kosogola myaangala yamaila tujike musozya. Beat off the husks of sorghum so that we cook samp. (1.-sogolwa, 2.-sogwede, 3.-sogozya, 4.-sogweda, 5.-sogwedalyo, 6.-sogolesya, 7.-sogola-sogola, 8.-sogweedana) Also: -sokola.

be first to, Kosoka kuya kucikolo kotanaya kukusobana. = Go to school first before you go playing. Muntu uli kumbele nguusoka kubona zili kumbele. The one who is in front is first to see the things ahead. (1.-sokwa, 2.-sokede, 3.-sosya, 4.-sokela, 5.-sokelalyo, 6.-sokesya, 7.-soka-soka, 8.-sokana)
  • provoke, Wakandisoka caali. = He provoked me deliberately. Ndakasokwa, wakandidyunga munwe muliso. = I was provoked, he stook a finger in my eye.

beat off mealies, shell, Bamatumbu basokola nyabo muncili. = The mothers are pounding off the husks of the beans in the mortar. Also: -sogola. (1.-sokolwa, 2.-sokwede, 3.-sokozya, 4.-sokweda, 5.-sokwedalyo, 6.-sokolesya, 7.-sokola-sokola, 8.-sokwedana)
  • make noise as train when moving, Citima casokola caide kumusiya akati kasyaka. = When the train began to move it just left him in the bush.

disturb the fire, Ucita kuti batiisosele walo nkusokoma mucikko limwi baakuzingwa buya bajika. Whenever they tried to cook he poked the fire continually until they had no way of cooking. (1.-sokomwa, 2.-sokomede, 3.-sokomya, 4.-sokomena, 5.-sokomenalyo, 6.-sokomesya, 7.-sokoma-sokoma, 8.-sokomezyanya)

come into view, move from bush into the open. Inzoka yakasokomoka kuzwa mubwizu. = The snake appeared coming out of the grass. (1.-sokomokwa, 2.-sokomokede, 3.-sokomozya, 4.-sokomokela, 5.-sokomokelalyo, 6.-sokomokesya, 7.-sokomokasokomoka, 8.-sokomokelana)
appear from, Ino kayi mwasokomokela kuli mbuli ino acifwumo-fwumo, ansi acitontola? = Now where have you appeared from at this time in the morning when it is still cold on the ground?

take out a little, Kosokomona tunyabo twakasiside bacembele kutegwa mwaabane nyobilo. = Bring out a few beans which the old woman has hidden so that both of you can share them. Kosokomona tombwe. = Take a little tobacco. Munanga wakatalika kusokomona zibelesyo zyakwe kuzwa munkomo yamucele. = The witchdoctor began to take out his instruments of divining from the animal-skinned pouch. (1.-sokomonwa, 2.-sokomwede, 3.-sokomozya, 4.-sokomweda 5.-sokomwedalyo, 6.-sokomonesya, 7.-sokomona-sokomona, 8.-sokomwedana)

make a rustling sound, Kuli cisokonya mumbali anzila eeyi. = There is something rustling beside this path. Imbeba ilasokonya mucitewo. = The rat is rustling in the bush. Also: -sokosa, -cokonya, -fwoota. (1.-sokonyezyegwa, 2.-sokonyede, 3.-sokonyezya, 4.-sokonyezyezya, 5.-sokonyezyezyalyo, 6.-sokonyesya, 7.-sokonya-sokonya, 8.-sokonyezyanya)

strip off sheathes of mealies, Kamusokonyona makweelele aamapopwe kutegwa kucaale mikuba yalo. = Strip off the sheathes of mealies so that only the empty cobs remain. (1.-sokonyonwa, 2.-sokonyede, 3.-sokonyozya, 4.-sokonyweda, 5.-sokonywedalyo, 6.-sokonyenesya, 7.-sokonyonasokonyona, 8.-sokonywedana)

make a rustling sound, Kuli cisokosa musyokwe oomu. = There is something rustling in the bush here. Wakali kuzimvwa mbeba kazisokosa mbuli nombe zili mulukuba. = He heard the rats rustling like cattle in a field of empty maize stalks. (1.-sokoswa, 2.-sokosede, 3.-sokosya, 4.-sokosyezya, 5.-sokosyezyalyo, 6.-sokosesya, 7.-sokosa-sokosa, 8.-sokosezyanya) Also: -sokonya.

husk for someone, Ndalomba mundisokwede nyabo = I am asking you to beat off the husks of the beans for me. (1.-sokolwa, 2.-sokwede, 3.-sokozya, 4.-sokweda, 5.-sokwedalyo, 6.-sokolesya, 7.-sokwede-sokwede, 8.-sokwedana)

try, attempt, Kamunga kamusola kulimya mpwizyi. = You might try to plough with the heifer. Basankwa baunka kukusola basune batatambide. = The boys have gone to try out the untamed oxen. (1.-solwa, 2.-solede, 3.-solezya/-sozya, 4.solela, 5.-solelalyo, 6.-solesya, 7.-solasola, 8.-solana) Also: -tambisya.

go first, Kamusolola, ndaboola munsi. = Go first, I will follow. Kosolola kumbele oozyi nzila. = Take the lead, you who know the way. (1.-sololwa, 2.-sololede/-solwede, 3.-solezya, 4.-solela, 5.solelalyo, 6.-solesya, 7.-sola-sola, 8.-solwedana.) Also: solozya, -solweda.

lead, be in front, rt. -solola, Kobasololela bana baya kumulonga nkaambo tabakuzyi. = Lead the children going to the river because they do not know the way. Wakakomena kababwene bantu mbobakatazya kusololela. = He grew up seeing how difficult the people were to lead them. (1.-sololelwa, 2.-sololede, 3.-sololezya, 4.-sololelela, 5.-sololelelalyo, 6.-sololelesya, 7.-sololelasololela, 8.-sololelana)
produce fruit, Mwezi wa Kavwumbakaniini micelo minji niisolosya. = The month of October is when many trees begin to produce fruits.

be led by, Kamwale usolozya haakamwale kuya anze. = The inititate is led by her assistant when going outside. Ncibi kusolozya bulozi mubuumi bwako. It is bad to put witchcraft as the priority in your life. (1.-solozyegwa, 2.-solozyede, 3.-solozya, 4.-solozyezya, 5.-solozyezyalyo, 6.-solozyesya, 7.-solozya-solozya, 8.-solozyanya)

lead, Usyi nguwakasolweda basankwa kuya kukusya cuumbwe. = The father is the one who led the boys to dig the grave. (1.-solwedwa, 2.-solwede, 3.-solwedezya, 4.-solwedela, 5.-solwedelalyo, 6.-solwedesya, 7.-solweda-solweda, 8.-solwedana)
lead, e.g Mwiiyi wakamupa Mainza mulimo wakusolwedela beenzinyina. The teacher gave Mainza the task of leading his class-mates.

offer first fruits to the spirits (by putting them on the chests and backs of the children and in the ritual calabashes), Muumwezi wa Mulumi nobasoma mapopwe bantu. It is in the month of February that the people offer the first maize to the ancestors. (1.-somwa, 2.-somede, 3.-somya, 4.-somena, 5.-somenalyo, 6.-somesya, 7.-soma-soma, 8.-somezyanya)
  • eat the last mealies of the season, Mazuba ainda twali kusoma. = In these past days we have been eating the last mealies of the season.
  • insert, as poles in roof, Bataata bakamanizya jilo kusoma masomo kuciluli cabutala. My father finished yesterday inserting poles in the roof of the granary. Also: -sekka.

groan in pain, Mulwazi wakali kusomba masiku oonse. = The patient was moaning the whole night. (1.-sombwa, 2.-sombede, 3.-sombezya, 3.-sombya, 4.-sombela, 5.-sombelalyo, 6.-sombesya, 7.-somba-somba, 8.-sombana.)
  • offer food to visitor, Kamubasomba cakulya beenzu bataunki anzala. = Offer the visitors food so that they don't go hungry. Kamumusomba tubwantu mweenzu. = Offer the visitor sweet beer.

persuade to accept, Basilisi basombeezya mulwazi kuti alye cakulya nocicikasaala. The nurse persuaded the patient to eat the food when it was still warm. Also: -kombelezya. (1.-sombeezyegwa, 2.-sombeezyede, 3.-sombeezyesya, 4.-sombeezyezya, 5.-sombeezyezyalyo, 6.-sombeezyesya, 7.-sombeezya-sombeezya, 8.-sombeezyanya)

offer along with, Mwasomba cakulya kumwana, kamusombelezya akubapati. When you offer food to the child, you should also offer it to the elders. (1.-sombelezyegwa, 2.-sombelezyede, 3.-sombelezyesya, 4.-sombelezyezya, 5.-sombelezyezyalyo. 6.-sombelezyesya, 7.-sombelezyasombelezya, 8.-sombelezyanya)

tantalize, tease by showing a thing to a person without intending to give it, Ncibi kumusombezya cintu ncayandisya kapati muntu. = It is bad to tantalize a person with something which you have no intention of giving him/her. (1.-sombezyegwa, 2.-sombezyede, 3.-sombezya, 4.-sombezyezya, 5.-sombezyezyalyo, 6.-sombezyesya, 7.-sombezya-sombezya, 8.-sombezyanya) Also: -nyomenezya, -nyeemuzya.

drop down, Kayuni kakasomboka kuzwa aciluli cananda nikakaumwa malekani. = The little bird dropped from the roof of the house when it was struck by a catapult. (1.-sombokwa, 2.-sombokede, 3.-sombozya, 4.-sombokela, 5.-sombokelalyo, 6.-sombokesya, 7.-somboka-somboka, 8.-sombosyanya)

fall down, Nindakakauma kayuni amalekani kakasombokela muzyiba. When I hit a bird with a stone from a catapult, it fell into a pool. Nondo wakaigunkula ciyoosya, waakuwida mbuli waalya, akalo kankobela kakasombokela mbuli kooko. The tortoise hit hard against something, he fell in one place while the hand-piano was thrown over in another place. Also: -tapuka.
insert, Kamusomeka zimbi zisamu muciluli. = Insert some poles into the roof. (1.-somekwa, 2.-somekede, 3.-somesya, 4.-somekela, 5.-somekelalyo, 6.-somekesya, 7.-someka-someka, 8.-somekana)

insert between, at a certain place, Kamusomena sumo mulusako lupati. Insert the spear-head into a big shaft. (1.-somenwa, 2.-somenede, 3.-somesya, 4.-somenena, 5.-somenenalyo, 6.-somenesya, 7.-somena-somena, 8.-somenana) Also: -sekka.

add more, Kajuba walifwumide kusomenena kaluli kacaanda campongo. = Kajuba was up early to add more grass to the roof of the goat shelter. Nkobali banga mvwula niyatanga, nkokubona kuti nanda ileelede kuvwumbululwa antela kusomenenwa. There are some people when the rain begins to fall, it is only then that they see that the house ought to be rethatched or more grass added to it. Also: -songelela.

come out, as poles from a roof, Casomoka cisamu kuzwa aciluli. = A pole came out of the roof. Isumo lyasomoka kale lyakasomekwa jilo. = The spear-head came out which was inserted yesterday. Ivwili nilyakasomoka, mootokala wakavwuntamuka. = When the wheel came off, the car overturned. Isumo lyakasomoka kulusako lyakacaalila mumusune nkaambo lyakali lyamala. = The spear-head came out of the shaft and remained in the ox, because it was barbed. Also: -fwumuka, -fwubbuka. (2.-somokede, 3.-somosya, 4.-somokela, 5.-somokelalyo, 6.-somokesya, 7.-somoka-somoka, 8.-somokezyanya)

give birth to first child, Mukaintu wasomona wazyala mwana musimbi. The woman has given birth for the first time to a baby girl. Mwana wakusomona wafwa kale. = The firstborn child has already died. (1.-somonwa, 2.-somwede, 3.-somozya, 4.-somonena, 5.-somonenalyo, 6.-somonesya, 7.-somona-somona, 8.-somonezyanya)
  • pull with a jerk, Wakamusomona kanimba, nkabela Mwiinga wakaba cisamu. He pulled out a little (magic) feather, thereupon Mwiinga became a tree. Bakasomona kuulu kwabo, bakabikka ali nguwe. She pulled off her leg and put it on hers. (story where mother gives her leg to her lame daughter.) Kamusomona mpikili yomwe kucaale zyobile. Take out one nail so that there remains two. Also: -vwukula
  • strip down, Mukuya kwamazuba, mwaya bweendeenda ancinga limwi zibulo zyaatalika kufwa. Wakatalika kusomona comwe-comwe akuzyuuzya susu omwe. In the passing of days he was going about on a bicycle until the parts began to wear out. He began to strip the bicycle down and sell each part for six pence.

fall off, as feathers, or grass from roof, *Mapepe aankuku aile kusomooka.* = The feathers of the chicken are just falling off. *Mapepe aankuku alasomooka mumeenda apya.* = The feathers of a chicken come off with hot water. *Bwizu bwakasomooka aciluli caranda.* = The grass fell off the roof of the house. (1.-somookwa, 2.-somookede, 3.-somoozya, 4.-somookela, 5.-somoo-kelalyo, 6.-somookesya, 7.-somoona-somoona)
  • move away from, *Bakatalika ku-somooka omwe-omwe.* = Each one began to move away.

watch, survey as from a high position, *Kamusompa basinkondo mubone nkobaletezya.* = Look out from on high and see from which direction the enemies are coming. Also: -songolola. (1.-sompwa, 2.-sompede, 3.-sompya, 4.-sompela, 5.-sompelalyo, 6.-sompesya, 7.-sompa-sompa, 8.-sompana)

survey, *Wakali kuya bulanga kumbele akuya busompaila.* = He was going looking straight ahead and surveying. *Bakaintu bakanyandwa bakatalika kuzwa mumaanda kulanga aku-sompaila kucimpati.* = The women were amazed and began to come out of their houses to look and survey (what had happened in) the kraal. (1.-sompailwa, 2.-sompailide, 3.-sompaizya, 4.-sompai-lila, 5.-sompaililalyo, 6.-sompailisya, 7.-sompaila-sompaila, 8.-sompaililana)

dandle, move a child up and down in a playful way, *Kosomp-aula mwana aleke kulila.* = Rock the child up and down so that it stops crying. *Ooyu mwana ulayoowa kusompaulwa.* = This child fears to be rocked up and down. Also: -sumpaula. (1.-sompaulwa, 2.-sompawide, 3.-sompauzya, 4.-sompaulila, 5.-sompaulilalyo, 6.-sompaulisya, 7.-sompaula-sompaula, 8.-sompaulana)

look out, rt. -sompa, *Mukasamu kalendemene mwenjakuso-mpela mabanda.* = From a tall tree I will look out over the plains. (1.-sompelwa, 2.-sompede, 3.-sompya, 4.-sompela, 5.-sompelalyo, 6.-sompesya, 6.-sompela-sompela, 7.-sompana)

bring confusion, *Mukaintu, kuti ukabone naa umwi wabo katalika kusompenkana kusola kunyo-nganya nanda yako alimwi ukaule nguwe saimoni ciindi ciboola.* = Woman, if you find that one of them starts to bring confusion trying to disturb your home, sue her to court the next time. (1.-sompenkanwa, 2.-sompenkene, 3.-sompenkezya, 4.-sompenkanina. 5.-sompenkaninalyo, 6.-sompekaisya, 7.-sompenkana-sompenkana, 8.-sompenkanizyanya)

stretch the neck in order to see, *Akaambo kakufwiimpa ndali ku-sompezya mutwe kulanga basibwiinga.* = Because of being of short size I was stretching my neck to see the bride. (1.-sompwa, 2.-sompede, 3.-sompya, 4.-sompela, 5.-sompelalyo, 6.-sompezye-sya, 7.-sompezya-sompezya, 8.-sompezyanya)

reach for by stretching out an, arm, *Kosompokela ugusye mayi mucisekwe.* Stretch out your arm to take the eggs from the nest. Also: -zobokela. (1.-sompokelwa, 2.-sompokelede, 3.-sompokezya, 4.-sompokelela, 5.-sompokelelalyo, 6.-sompokelesya, 7.-sompokela-sompokela, 8.-sompokelana)

snatch, *Wamusompola conco mwana, ncalila.* She snatched a spoon from the child, that is why it is crying. *Mubbi wakamusompola mucem-* bele mali. = The thief snatched the money from the old woman. (1.-sompolwa, 2.-sompwede, 3.-sompozya, 4.-sompweda, 5.-sompwedalyo, 6.-sompolesya, 7.-sompola-sompola, 8.-sompolana)

communicate with, Ndalikkede mucoonde kuyeeya akutelaika kapati majwi ngoondisomweeda cifwumofwumo. = I was just sitting in a thicket thinking and reflecting deeply on the words which you talked to me about this morning.

cause to eat the first mealies of the season, rt. -soma, Ndakabasomya bana bangu mumwezi wa Mulumi. I made my children eat the first mealies in February. (1.-somwa, 2.-somede, 3.-somya, 4.-somena, 5.-somenalyo, 6.-somesya, 7.-somya-somya, 8.-somezyanya)

divine, consult occult powers, Baya kukusonda kuti bamvwe cajaya mwana. They have gone to consult the witchdoctor to know what has killed the child. Bapati bakaya kukusonda lufwu Iwanjila mumukowa. The elders have gone to find out the cause why death has afflicted the clan. (1.-sondwa, 2.-sondede, 3.-sonzya, 4.-sondela, 5.-sondelalyo, 6.-sondesya, 7.-sonda-sonda, 8.-sondana)

peep, Kamuleka kusondela ampulungwido. = Stop peeping through the window. Also: -yuna, -yunina. (1.-sondelwa, 2.-sondede, 3.-sondezya, 4.-sondelela, 5.-sondelelalyo, 6.-sondelesya, 7.-sondela-sondela, 8.-sondelana)
  • examine, Kamukasondela kabotu kaambo aka nkaambo nkayumu kukosola. = Examine this case properly because it is difficult to solve.

become mad, Mutinta wakasondoka. = Mutinta has gone mad. (1.-sondokwa, 2.-sondokede, 3.-sondosya, /-sondokezya, 4.-sondokela, 5.-sondokelalyo, 6.-sondokesya, 7.-sondoka-sondoka, 8.-sondosyanya.) Also: -gauka, -cinkuka.
  • become rabid, Mubwa wangu wakasondoka nsondo yakamana. = My dog became rabid last week.
make mad, Ooyu mwana tanaakumana mwaka wakazaya. Eeci cakabasondola banyina. This child did not last for a year, it died. This made the mother go mad.
cause to become mad, Wakamusondozya musamu. = The medicine caused him to go mad.

eat food with shyness as a bride newly-wed, Imusimbi wakwatwa ino, ulasonga kulya. A newly-wed bride feels shy when eating. Also: -syonga. (1.-songwa, 2.-songede, 3.-songezya, 4.-songela, 5.-songelalyo, 6.-songesya, 7.-songa-songa, 8.-songelana)
  • lower eyes modestly, Bamwi basimbi kuti babona basankwa babo balasonga-songa. Some girls lower their eyes modestly when they see their boyfriends. Also: -syongooma,-ongoonga.
  • add when already full, Kamusonga mapopwe mubutala. Add some more maize to the maize bin even though it is full. Also: -sekkelela.

add more and more, rt. songa, Kamusongelela mapopwe mucikkocci. Pile on more maize on the scotch-cart. Also: -sekkelela, -somenena. (1.-songelelwa, 2.-songelede, 3.-songelezya, 4.-songelelela, 5.-songelelelalyo, 6.-songelelesya, 7.-songelela-songelela, 8.-songelelana)

persuade, incite, Baama bakandisongelezya kunywa cibwantu nindakacisidwe. My mother persuaded me to drink sweet-beer when I was sick. (1.-songelezyegwa, 2.-songelezyede, 3.-songelezyezya, 4.-songelezyezya, 5.-songelezyezyalyo, 6.-songelezyesya, 7.-songelezya-songelezya, 8.-songelezyanya) Also: -sengelezya.

extract, free from, deliver Kondisongola bumvwa. = Extract a thorn from me. Wakasongola muntu wakapengede. = He freed a person who had been suffering. Also: -bangula. (1.-songolwa, 2.-songwede, 3.-songozya, 4.-songweda, 5.-songwedalyo, 6.-songolesya, 7.-songola-songola, 8.-songolana)
  • impart wisdom, Koya ukabasinsile kaambo bamadaala, ndiza balo balakusongola maanu. = Go and relate the affair to the old men perhaps they also may give you advice. Ino twamwiita nyoonse kuti tusole kubasongola bantu aaba, kucita kuti tunjaka tumane. = Now we have called you all so that you advise these people so that the troubles end. Ncicandipa kuboola kokuno kutegwa undisonqole. That is why I came here so that you would help me solve the problem. Also: -anuka
  • develop, as breasts, Basimbi balijisi ziimo naa misela imwi mipati: kuli ciimo cakusongola nkolo. Girls have many stages in life: there is the stage when the breasts develop. Also: -sonsa
free from, Kugwasyanya lyoonse nkusongolana mapenzi. = To help one another always is to deliver one another from sufferings.

look out, survey from a high position, Ndakasongolola kuti mbone cakali kucitika kumbo aamunzi. = I surveyed from a high position to see what was happening west of the village. Koleka kusongolola balakubona. = Stop looking out, they will see you. Also: -sompa (1.-songololwa, 2.-songolwede, 3.-songolozya, 4.-songolweda, 5.-songolwedalyo, 6.-songololesya, 7.-songolola-songolola, 8.-songololana)
be given wisdom, Nduwe sibbuku, bantu boonse balanga kuli nduwe kusongolwa maanu. = You are the headman, all the people look to you to be given wisdom.

be ready to act, Mubwa ulasongomana kuti avwampile kasulwe. = The dog stands ready to pounce on the rabbit. Inonzi zyoonse bakoonya kumaulu, kumitwe balisongomene. = The sleepiness only allowed their feet to sleep, in the heads they were ready to act. Also: -nongomana. (1.-songomanwa, 2.-songomanide, 3.-songomanizya, 4.-songomanina, 5.-songomaninalyo, 6.-songomanisya, 7.-songomana-songomana, 8.-songomaninana)

be wise, Kuti muntu wasongwaala uvwuna bantu banji. = If a person is wise s/he can save many. (1.-songwaalwa, 2.-songwaalide, 3.-songwaazya, 4.-songwaalila, 5.-songwaalilalyo, 6.-songwaalisya, 7.-songwaala-songwaala, 8.-songwaalilana)
  • eagerness to speak before one's turn, butambo kusongwaala.
be instructed about, Basimbi bamwi basunu tabayandi kusongwaalila zilengwa zyakaindi. = Girls of to-day are not anxious to be informed about past customs.

be first to start (in a game called kulambana or in fighting.) Tweelede kusonkola kutegwa musobano utalike. We ought be first to start so that the game may begin. (1.-sonkolwa, 2.-sonkwede, 3.-sonkozya, 4.-sonkweda, 5.-sonkwedalyo, 6.-sonkolesya, 7.-sonkola-sonkola, 8.-sonkolana)

come in great numbers, Bantu bakasonkomoka kuya kunkolola. The people came in great numbers to the initiation ceremony. (1.-sonkomokwa, 2.-sonkomokede, 3.-sonkomozya, 4.-sonkomokela, 5.-sonkomokelalyo, 6.-sonkomokesya, 7.-sonkomoka-sonkomoka, 8.-sonkomozyanya) Also: -soomoka.

pick, *Kamusonkomona ndongwe zinji tuyoke.* = Pick plenty of groundnuts so that we roast them. (1.-sonkomonwa, 2.-sonkomwede, 3.-sonkomozya, 4.-sonkomweda. 5.-sonkomwedalyo, 6.-sonkomonesya, 7.-sonkomona-sonkomona. 8.-sonkomwedana) Also: -sankamuna, -sokomona.

eat only a little of a thing, *Nabwiinga usonkoola buya kulya nacili mweenzu.* = The bride only eats a little when she is still new in a place. *Mutinta wasonkoola asyoonto kulya kukkomanisya buyo bamulela.* = Mutinta ate just a little bit just to make happy the one who looked after her. Also: -tomona, -tomoona. (1.-sonkoolwa, 2.-sonkweede, 3.-sonkoozya, 4.-sonkweeda, 5.-sonkweedalyo, 6.-sonkoolesya, 7.-sonkoola-sonkoola, 8.-sonkoolana)

go ahead, *Kosonona, swebo tunakuccilila munsi.* = Go ahead we will follow behind. *Munyenzi nguusonona kumbele nomweenda.* = The local person is the one to go ahead when you are walking. (1.-sononwa, 2.-sonwede, 3.-sonozya, 4.-sonweda, 5.-sonwedalyo, 6.-sononesya, 7.-sonona-sonona, 8.-sonwedana) Also: -solola, -tonona.

germinate, *Mapopwe akasonsa kabotu mumbewu.* = The maize germinated well in the garden. (1.-sonswa, 2.-sonsede, 3.-sonsenzya, 4.-sonsela, 5.-sonselalyo, 6.-sonsesya, 7.-sonsa-sonsa, 8.-sonsezyanya)
  • shoot out as new feathers, *Twana twatuyuni twakasonsa kale mapepe.* = Those young birds have already produced feathers.
  • heap up more and more on a basket, *Kamusonsa mapopwe mucisuwo kutegwa amanine.* = Heap up more maize in the basket so that it finishes. Also: -songa, -sekkelela, -syonka.
  • be formed as breasts, or appear as teeth, *Mutinta wakafwa, nkolo kazitanasonsa.* = Mutinta died before her breasts were formed. *Menyo amwana muvwanda akatalika kale kusonsa.* = The teeth of the baby already started to appear. Also: -songola
  • tassel, *Mapopwe taaningatalika kusonsa ngalaala.* = The maize has not yet produced the tassel. Also: -langala.
  • light up, *Nsasi zyakamwayikizyanya mubwizu koonse akusonsa syokwe koonse-koonse.* = The sparks scattered throughout the grass and lit up the bush everywhere.

strip, clean, remove, *Kamusonsola mpakatwa zyamapopwe mu-muunda.* = Remove the (unwanted) shoots from the maize in the field. (1.-sonsolwa, 2.-sonswede, 3.-sonsozya, 4.-sonsweda, 5.-sonswedalyo, 6.-sonsolesya, 7.-sonsola-sonsola, 8.-sonsolana) Also: -sonzola, -kwezyaula.
clean, as to thresh, *Babelesi basonsolozya maila muceme.* = The workers are threshing sorghum. Also: -sonzola.

peck, as a fowl at a piece of meat, or fish at bait, *Nsolo iyanda kusonsonya bana banzuki bajanwa mumana.* = The honey bird likes to eat the larvae in the honey combs. Also: -vwindika. (1.-sonsonyegwa, 2.-sonsonyede, 3.-sonsonyezya, 4.-sonsonyela, 5.-sonsonyelalyo, 6.-sonsonyesya, 7.-sonsomya-sonsonya, 8.-sonsonyana)
  • cleanse beak by rubbing, Kayuni kakali kulisonsonya. = The little bird was rubbing its beak to clean it.
  • scratch, as with head or beak, Nkuku yali kulisonsonya amulomo. = The chicken was scratching itself with its beak.

take a small amount from, Kosontola mundyoli mujanza tujike. = Take a small amount of mashed and dried pumpkin leaves in your hand so that we cook. Also: -zubula. (1.-sontolwa, 2.-sontwede, 3.-sontozya, 4.-sontweda, 5.-sontwedalyo, 6.-sontolesya, 7.-sontola-sontola, 8.-sontolana)
  • bring illness by witchcraft, Antela balozi balandisontola, nceciswa-ciswa mazuba ano. = Perhaps it is the witches who are bringing the illness through witchcraft, that is why I am always sick nowadays. Also: -sunka, -yunga.
  • persuade to do something, Nsecizyi cakandisontola kuti ngume mwana muniini. = I don't know what caused me to slap the little child. Also: -sontomona.

call in a high-pitched voice, Koleka kusontomoka buya kwiita. = Don't call in a high-pitched voice. *"Taali makani ngotwaboolela kwaambaula," wakasontomoka.* = "This is not the matter about which we came to discuss," he vigourously protested. (1.-sontomokwa, 2.-sontomokede 3.-sontomozya, 4.-sontomokela, 5.-sontomokelalyo, 6.-sontomokesya, 8.-sontomokelana)
  • jump up suddenly, as when hit with a bullet, Niyakamuuma ntobolo, wakasontomoka kuwa ansi mpoona wakafwa. = When he was hit by a bullet, he jumped up suddenly and fell to the ground thereupon he died. Nindakamvwa bantu nkobalila, ndakaide kusontomoka kuzwa acuuno mpindakakkede. = When I heard the people mourning, I just jumped up out of the chair where I was seated.
  • mistake as one word for another or one person for another, Chinene wakasontomoka kwiita zina litayandi banyina. = Chinene used a wrong name when addressing somebody which his mother did not like.
call by a wrong name, Munene wandisontomokela azina limbi. = The old man called me by a wrong name.

force one to do something dangerous, Nsezyi cakandisontomona kuunka kucuumbwe ciindi camasiku. = I don't know what urged me to go to the graveyard at night-time. Ncinzi candisontomona kuti mboole? = What persuaded me to come? (1.-sontomonwa, 2.-sontomwede, 3.-sontomozya, 4.-sontomweda, 5.-sontomwedalyo, 6.-sontomonesya, 7.-sontomona-sontomona, 8.-sontomonana) cf. -untumuna.

pluck, pull, strip as a stick of branches, extract, as seed from cotton, Kamusonzola muncile kutegwa mutende kabotu. Strip the unwanted growths from the pumpkin stems so that you cut it up properly. (1.-sonzolwa, 2.-sonzwede, 3.-sonzozya, 4.-sonzweda, 5.-sonzwedalyo, 6.-sonzolesya, 7.-sonzola-sonzola, 8.-sonzolana) Also: -sonsola, -pumbula.

be thrown away, rt. -sowa, Ciya cisani cakasoogwa buya nkaambo cakafwa. That cloth has just been thrown away because it is finished. Ijamba eeli lyakasoogwa. This hoe has been thrown away. (2.-sowede, 3.-sowezya, 4.-sowela, 5.-sowelalyo, 6.-sowesya, 7.-soogwa-soogwa, 8.-sowana)
hiss so as to chase away fowl, guard as a field against birds, Kamu

bayuni mumaila, balaamana. = Chase those birds away from the millet, they will finish it. Ngazi iyakilwa akati kamuunda kutegwa ijwi nosoola kalisika koonse-koonse. = The platform was built in the middle of the field so that the voice when crying out to scare them would reach everywhere. (1.-soolwa, 2.-soolede, 3.-soozya, 4.-soolela, 5.-soolelalyo, 6.-soolesya, 7.-soola-soola, 8.-soolana) Also: -yamina.

become slim, Wasima, wasooloka, omusaama. = You have become mature, you have become thin, my age-mate. (1.-soolokwa, 2.-soolokede, 3.-soolosya, 4.-soolokela, 5.-soolokelalyo, 6.-soolokesya, 7.-sooloka-sooloka, 8.-soolosyanya)
be sincere and clear, Wakakanana ajwi *lisoolokede*. = He spoke with a sincere, clear voice. Wakajana mali aya munzila *itasoolokede*. = You acquired this money in a dishonest way.

lengthen, Kamucuumpa cibulo eci ndiyanda *kucisoolola*. = Heat this piece of iron, I want to lengthen it. (1.-soololwa, 2.-soolwede, 3.-soolozya, 4.-soolweda, 5.-soolwedalyo, 6.-soololesya, 7.-soolola-soolola, 8.-soololana)

approach in mass, fall as heavy rain, Katufwambaana kubinga nombe nkaambo mvwula *yasoomoka*. = Hurry up in driving the cattle because the rain is coming in a downpour. (1.-soomokwa, 2.-soomokede, 3.-soomokezya, 4.-soomokela 5.-soomokelalyo, 6.-soomokesya, 7.-soomoka-soomoka, 8.-soomokelana) Also: -pwatamuna
  • rush in a group, Bana boonse mumunzi bakasoomoka kuti bakacinge bausyi. = All the children in the village rushed to meet their father.

rush in a group to, Bantu banji *bakasoomokela* kunkolola kwakali nyama nji. = Many people rushed to the initiation ceremony where there was plenty of meat. Also: -bbuumuka.
  • fall as heavy rain, Imvwula *yakasoomoka* jilo. = The rain fell heavily yesterday. Also: -cobola, -buuluka, lyobola.

have diarrhoea, Mwana wangu *ulasoomona* akuluka. = My child has diarrhoea and is vomiting. Mudaala wakafwa *kusoomona*. = The old man died from diarrhoea. (1.-soomonwa, 2.-soomwede, 3.-soomozya, 4.-soomweda, 5.-soomwedalyo, 6.-soomonesya, 7.-soomona-soomona, 8.-soomwedana) Also: -pulumba.
cause to purge, Camusoomozya mbukoko bubi mbwaakanywa. = What made him purge was the bad beer which he drank. Inyama iibolede *ilasoomozya*. = Rotten meat causes diarrhoea.

come out from hidden position, Syuumbwa *wakasoonoka* kuzwa waawo mpaakagalamene kusintamina Mutinta. = The lion came out from where he had been hiding with chest thrust out, looking down on Mutinta. (1.-soonokwa, 2.-soonokede, 3.-soonokezya, 4.-soonokela, 5.-soonokelalyo, 6.-soonokesya, 7.-soonoka-soonoka, 8.-soonokezyanya)

cause to throw away, abort, rt. -sowa. Buvwuule *busoosya* mukaintu ulaa da. = Prostitution causes a pregnant woman to abort. (1.-soogwa, 2.-sowede, 3.-soosya, 4.-sowela, 5.-sowelalyo, 6.-sowesya, 7.-soosya-soosya, 8.-sowana)

cause an abortion, rt. -sowa, Bulwazi *bwamusoozya* Mweene. = The disease caused Mweene to abort.
  • cheer up one when depressed, comfort, console, *Twali kusoozya Nchimunya wakafwidwa.* = We were comforting Nchimunya whose wife passed away. Also: -umbulizya, -umba-umba.
  • set dogs on, e.g *Ndamusoozya babwa muyuni ubba mayi.* = I set the dogs on the big bird which was stealing the eggs. Also: -saalizya, -sibilizya.
  • scare away with, chase with, *Ijilo ndakabusoozya mukkwilo buyuni bwakali kulya maila.* = I scared the birds away which were eating sorghum with a whip yesterday.

shove firewood into the fire, *Kamusosela, cibizwe cakulya.* = Stoke the fire so that the food is cooked. *Nokuba kuti limwi cakulya cakabizwa pesi bakacileka biyo acikko cilatokoma kabotukabotu, alimwi akusosela kaniini-niini.* Even though the food was finally cooked, they left it on the fireplace simmering nicely, again stoked only a little. (1.-soselwa, 2.-soselede, 3.-soselezya, / sosezya, 4.-soselela, 5-soselelalyo, 6.-soselesya, 7.-sosela-sosela, 8.-soselana.)
  • plant or leak information secretly, *Kuli muntu wakali kusosela makani kumbali, ncaatakafwambaana kumana.* = Someone was giving information secretly about the matter, that is why it took time to resolve it.

move away as people from one place, *Bana basankwa bakasosoleka munsaa mulilo.* = The men moved away from the fire. (1.-sosolekwa, 2.-sosolekede, 3.-sosolekede, 4.-sosolekela, 5.-sosolekelalyo, 6.-soslekesya, 7.-sosoleka-sosoleka, 8.-sosolesyanya)

get out of the way, withdraw, *Kososoloka awa ndakulyata ndawa.* = Move away from this place, I will crush you when I fall. *Mwana kasoso-* *loka amulilo.* = Make the child move away from the fire. (1.-sosolokwa, 2.-sosolokede, 3.-sosolosya, 4.-sosolo-kela, 5.-sosolokelalyo, 6.-sosolokesya, 7.-sosoloka-sosoloka, 8.-sosolokana) Also: -sabuka.

move a thing or person out of the way, *Kamusosolola cisani eeci balacilyata.* = Move this cloth away, they will step on it. *Kobasosolola bana kumbali amulilo, alimwi akumbali atuuka mbuli manyeu, nsundila, abusilibwi.* = You should move the children away from the fire and from black ants and red ants. (1.-sosololwa, 2.-sosolwede, 3.-sosolozya, 4.-sosolweda, 5.-sosolwedalyo, 6.-sosololesya, 7.-sosolola-sosolola, 8.-sosololana)
  • pull out as sticks from fire, *Kamusosolola nkuni kutegwa mulilo uceye.* = Take firewood out of the fire so that the fire lessens. Also: -sosonona.
move something away from, *Komusosolosya mwana munsaa nombe ilaluma.* = Move the child away from near the cow, it bites. Also: -sosolola.

remove sticks from fire, *Kamusosonona nkuni ilasyilila nsima.* = Remove the sticks from the fire the nsima will be burnt. (1.-sosononwa, 2.-sosonwede, 3.-sosonozya, 4.-sosonweda, 5.-sosonwedalyo, 6.-sosononesya, 7.-sosonona-sosonona, 8.-sosonwedana) Also: -sosolola

walk with slow steps, *Nindali kukulindila ndali kusoswanya.* = When I was waiting for you I was walking with slow steps. *Muntu utazyi kabotu nkwaya ulasoswanya.* A person who is not sure of the way, walks with slow steps. (1.-soswanyizyigwa, 2.-soswanyide, 3.-soswanyizya, 4.-soswanyida, 5.-soswanyidalyo, 6.-soswanyiisya, 7.-soswanya-soswanya) Also: -sobaila, -ima-ima.

begin work, rt. -soka, Nobayaka nanda, basosya kubikka mabwe mululindi. = When they build a house they start first by putting the stones in the foundation. Also: -saanguna. (1.-sosyegwa, 2.-sosyede, 3.-sosyezya, 4.-sosyela, 5.-sosyelalyo, 6.-sosyesya, 7.-sosya-sosya, 8.-sosyanya)
  • protect by scaring off the danger, Kamubasosya babwa beenzu, mutani kubasoozyi. = Withdraw the dogs from the visitors, do not be setting the dogs on them. Leza Nalubomba, obuno buzuba lufwu Iwandisikila, pesi kuti koyanda ulalusosya kuli ndime. = Merciful God, this day death has visited me, but if you wish you can drive it away from me.

jump repeatedly, Niyatalika mvwula, bana balasotauka anze. = When the rain begins, children jump up and down outside. (1.-sotaukwa, 2.-sotaukide, 3.-sotausya, 4.-sotaukila, 5.-sotaukilalyo, 6.-sotaukisya, 7.-sotauka-sotauka, 8.-sotaukana)
  • be elusive in speech, Munsanje taambi masimpe, ulasotauka kwaamba. = Munsanje does not speak the truth, he avoids the issue when speaking.

jump, Kosotoka kutegwa utanjili mumeenda. = Just jump, so that you don't go into the water. Impongo yasotoka mulubaya. = The goat jumped over the fence. (1.-sotokwa, 2.-sotokede, 3.-sotokezya/-sotosya, 4.-sotokela, 5.-sotokelalyo, 6.-sotokesya, 7.-sotokasotoka, 8.-sotokana.)
jump at, rt. -sotoka, Cisasa wasotokela nombe akwiiluma. = The puff-adder jumped at the cow and bit her.

jump repeatedly, Bana bakali kunyandwa kulangilizya nkuku lyoonse nkoisotooka kakunyina mutwe. = The children were surprised to watch the chicken continually jumping about without a head. Katiiti kasotooka buya kweenda. = The robin jumps along as it moves. (1.-sotookwa, 2.-sotookede, 3.-sotoosya, 4.-sotookela, 5.-sotookelalyo, 6.-sotookesya, 7.-sotooka-sotooka, 8.-sotookana) Also: -butuuka, -mantauka.

throw away, Kamucisowa cinamunyo eeco, tacinoni. = Throw away that melon, it is not tasty. (1.-soogwa, 2.-sowede, 3.-sowezya, 4.-sowela, 5.-sowwelalyo, 6.-sowesya, 7.-sowa-sowa, 8.-sowana.)
  • miscarry, Muka Michelo wakasowa. = The wife of Michelo had a miscarriage. Also: -pulumuna.
  • find out the source of witchcraft, Bakazuminana kuti bamwi baunke kuтиnanga kusowa cinkuli. = They agreed that some should go to the witchdoctor to `throw the gourd.' i.e. find out who was the bewitcher.

forsake, renounce, rt. sowa, Bataata bakakaka kundivwuna mulandu, bakaile kundisowelezya. = My father refused to save me from the case, he just forsook me. Wakasowelezya kwaamba munene. The old man gave up talking. (1.-sowelezyegwa, 2.-sowelezyede, 3.-sowelezyesya, 4.-sowelezyezya, 5.-sowelezyezyalyo, 6.-sowelezyesya, 7.-sowelezya-sowelezya, 8.-sowelezyanya)
  • cast upon, rt. sowa, Kaniini bakamusowelezya zeelo. = They cast the evil spirits upon Kaniini. Also: -lekelezya.

make one waste or throw away, rt. -sowa, Ndakusowezya mungwimba wako kuboola kokuno. = I have made you waste your fuel in coming here. (1.-sowezyegwa, 2.-sowezyede, 3.-sowezyezya, 4.-sowezyela, 5.-sowezyelalyo, 6.-sowezyesya, 7.-sowezya-sowezya, 8.-sowezyanya)

try on as a coat, *Kosozya* leeli jansi antela lilakweelela. = Try on this jacket, perhaps it fits you. (1.-sozyegwa, 2.-sozyede, 3.-sozyesya, 4.-sozyezya, 5.-sozyezyalyo, 6.-sozyesya, 7.-sozya-sozya, 8.-sozyanya)
  • persist in doing something, *Kamu-sozya buyo limwi mulacikonzya kusotoka alya.* = Keep trying until you are able to jump that height.

urinate, Mwana uyanda ku-suba, mumutole anze. = The child wants to urinate, take him outside. Wakajana munene ulasuba kunze ananda. = He found an old man urinating behind the house. *Bantu basuba mumeenda anyu-gwa mbayamba.* = People who urinate in the drinking water are careless. (1.-subwa, 2.-subide, 3.-subya, 4.-subila, 5.-subilalyo, 6.-subisya, 7.-suba-suba, 8.-subilana)

be red, Kaamba baka-umpa mumulilo kumane kasubila pyu. = They burnt the little hoe in the fire until it was red hot.
  • urinate on, Umwi mubwa wakalisubila nobakali kulwana. = One dog wetted itself when they were fighting.

make red, Sunu ulaci-bona cakasubizya mwanaa kwale kumeso. = Today you will see what reddened the eyes of the partridge. (i.e. You will feel the effects of anger.) *Twakasika zuba nilyakasubizya.* = We arrived when the sun was red. i.e. as the sun was sinking. (1.-subizyigwa, 2.-subizyide, 3.-subizya, 4.-subizyizya, 5.-subizyizyalyo, 6.-subizyisya, 7.-subizya-subizya, 8.-subizyanya)

repent, Sunu nseciyandi kubba, ndakasubuka, bakanduuma kapati basilikani. = Nowadays I no longer want to steal, I have repented, the police beat me a lot. *Wakasubuka kweenda kusika ku* Monze. = She was exhausted walking to Monze. Also: -empela. (1.-subukwa, 2.-subukide, 3.-subuzya, 4.-subukila, 5.-subukilalyo, 6.-subukisya, 7.-subuka-subuka, 8.-subusyanya)

punish, *Bakamusubula bamasilikani naakabbide nombe.* = The police punished him when he stole the cattle. (1.-subulwa, 2.-subwide, 3.-subuzya, 4.-subwida, 5.-subwidalyo, 6.-subulisya, 7.-subula-subula, 8.-subulana) Also: -syoba, -empya.

strip off skin, *Impongo yangu bakaisubulula babbi.* = The thieves stripped the skin off my goat. (1.-subululwa, 2.-subulwide, 3.-subulwi-zya, 4.-subulwida, 5.-subulwidalyo, 6.-subululisya, 7.-subulula-subulula, 8.-subululana) Also: -fwunda.

make cuts to release blood, rt. -swa, *Mwana naakaciswa kapati mutwe, banyina bakamutola kumunanga. Mpoona mwana wakasugwa.* = When the child had a severe headache the mother took the girl to the witchdoctor. There-upon cuts were made on the child to release the blood. (1.-sugwa, 2.-swide, 3.-suwizya, 4.-swida, 5.-swidalyo, 6.-suwisya, 7.-sugwa-sugwa, 8.-swana)

soften as a hide, dress a skin, *Ndakajana bataata basuka cisalu carjombe.* = I found my father softening the skin of a cow. (by oiling and twisting it.) *Kamusuka ntambo kutegwa tubambe zitolopu.* = Soften the straps so that we make reins. Also: -teteesya. (1.-sukwa, 2.-sukide, 3.-sukizya, 4.-sukila, 5.-sukilalyo, 6.-sukisya, 7.-suka-suka, 8.-sukana)
  • churn, *Kamusuka nsuwa kutegwa tujane mafwuta.* = Shake the calabash so that we get butter.
  • clean one's mouth, *Ndalisuka mukanwa nindamana kulya.* = I cleaned my mouth when I had finished eating. Also: -kulisukulula, -kulisukusula, -kulijukajuka
  • drop umbilical cord, Kuli mulawo wakuti mukaintu nasuka lukombo-kombo Iwamwana uleelede kulangisya kuti Iwawa taluwidi abbumbu nkaambo inga mwana ooyo takazyali aakukomena. = There is a belief which says that when the umbilical cord is being separated between child and mother, the mother ought to look carefully so that the umbilical cord does not fall on the lower part of her body, if it does the child may grow to become barren.
  • pinch in punishment, Watalika kundisuka matwi. = He began to twist my ears.
  • send up (as smoke) Eeyi nanda yakali kusuka busi kuzwa kumatalikilo. = This home was sending up smoke from its beginning. (the house was always prosperous). Mainza uzwa munanda isuka busi aboobo uleelede kuba mukwe wangu. Mainza comes from a well-off family and so he should become my inlaw. Kunsi amajwaakwe kwakali twaambo tusuka busi. Beneath his words were powerful meanings.

be extreme in action, Munene wasukama kuuma mwana muniini. The old man beat the small child severely. (1.-sukamwa, 2.-sukamide, 3.-sukamya, 4.-sukamina, 5.-sukaminalyo, 6.-sukamisya, 7.-sukama-sukama, 8.-sukaminana)
  • concentrate on, desire to, Nitwakasika, twakasukama kwiimba. When we arrived, we put our full attention on singing.

set one's heart on getting or doing something, Ncibi kusukamina zintu zikutola mumilandu. = It is bad to desire things which lead you into crime. Wakamusukamina kumulanga ca bukali. He kept looking at him in anger. Bakasukamina kuti bakoonene kumunzi wa Sikulizeeza. They were determined to sleep at Sikulizeeza's village. Also: -sungama.
shake together, Wakatambikizya kuboko kwalulyo kuti basukane mumaanza amweenzu. He stretched out his right arm so that he could shake hands with his visitor.

sit sadly with head resting on arm, tuck head under arm, Kuti muntu wafwidwa ulalisukata. = When a person's partner in marriage dies s/he sadly holds her/his head with the hands. Cileetezya kubona mbwalisukata mwana wafwidwa bausyi. It is pitiable to see how sad the child is when its father dies. (1.-sukatwa, 2.-sukatide, 3.-sukatya, 4.-sukatila, 5.-sukatilalyo, 6.-sukatisya, 7.-sukata-sukata, 8.-sukatilana)

be seated in a pensive mood, Nabulongo wakalisukatide buyo kusaya kumwi kalanga mulumaakwe kumeso. Nabulongo was seated while holding her cheek lost in thought while looking at the face of her husband.
retain as in an embrace, Komusukatila mwana kutegwa atafwi mpeyo. Keep hugging the child so that it does not feel the cold. Also: -fwukatila, -fwumbatila.

bleed someone, cup, Bausyi bakamusukaula nobakabona kuti mutwe tauleki kucisa. The father bled him when he saw that the head did not stop paining. (1.-sukaulwa, 2.-sukawide, 3.-sukauzya, 4.-sukaulila, 5.-sukaulilalyo, 6.-sukaulisya, 7.-sukaula-sukaula, 8.-sukaulana)
  • shake, Mutinta usukaula kabwa kutegwa kakacilya. Mutinta is shaking the puppy so that it eats more. Bausukaula mukupa kuti uvwelengane. = They shook the milk to mix it.

be in a sad state, with head resting on arm, sit while pondering, rt. sukata, *Ndakakkede, kandilisukete mbuli mucaala.* = I was sitting with head resting on arm in a sad state like an orphan. *Wakatungumana kalisukete.* = He bowed down while pondering sadly. (1.-sukatwa, 2.-sukete, 3.-sukatizya, 4.-sukatila, 5.-sukatilalyo, 6.-sukatisya, 7.-sukete-sukete, 8.-sukatilana)

soften what is hard, *Kaindi musankwa wakali kulangilwa kuti asamike musimbi wakwe zintu zibotu, mbuli kumusukila kasalu kampongo, kumuulila bulungu, kumujanina mbaanyina zyakutungililizya mubulungu.* Long ago the boy was watched to see if he dressed his wife with beautiful things like softening the hide of a goat, buying beads for her, finding cowry shells for her for threading into the beads. (1.-sukwa, 2.-sukide, 3.-sukizya, 4.-sukila, 5.-sukilalyo, 6.-sukisya, 7.-sukila-sukila, 8.-sukilana)

cause to inhale fumes of traditional medicine, *Ciindi Chitebenta naakali kumusukizya mucelo wakali kuti, "Nomizimo yataata anywebo nomizimo yabaama amumulekelele Chibbwalu mwana wanu."* = During the time when Chitebenta was causing him to inhale the fumes of the medicine he said, "You, the spirits of my father, and you, the spirits of my mother, forgive Chibbwalu your child." (1.-sukizyigwa, 2.-sukizyide, 3.-sukizyisya, 4.-sukizyizya, 5.-sukizyizyalyo, 6.-sukizyisya, 7.-sukizya-sukizya, 8.-sukizyanya)

slip down, as baby off mother's back, *Wasukuka mwana niyazapuka ngubo.* = The baby fell down when the shawl was ripped. Also: -syupuka (1.-sukukwa, 2.-sukukide, 3.-sukuzya, 4.-sukukila, 5.-sukukilalyo, 6.-sukukisya, 7.-sukuka-sukuka, 8.-sukukana)
  • be extremely tired, *Ndakasukuka kulimina muunda wakajisi syokwe linji.* = I was extremely tired weeding the field which had a lot of weeds. Also: -sukuluka, -cukuka.
  • uneasy feeling in stomach, have upset stomach, *Kuti mwida mwasukuka, weelede kufwambaana kuunka kucimbuzi.* = When you feel a stomach upset, you will have to go to the toilet quickly. Also: -sukuuka.

rub continuously, *Kosukula cisani eeco mumeenda a nsipa.* = Rub that cloth in soapy water continually. (1.-sukulwa, 2.-sukwida, 3.-sukuzya, 4.-sukwida, 5.-sukwidalyo, 6.-sukulisya, 7.-sukula-sukula, 8.-sukulana) Also: -sukulula, -cuka-cuka.

give up doing wrong, *Intolongo njiyakapa kuti Jansi atalike kusukuluka mukulwana kwakwe.* = It is imprisonment that has made Jansi give up the bad habit of fighting. Also: -subuka. (1.-sukulukwa, 2.-sukululide, 3.-sukuluzya, 4.-sukulukila, 5.-sukulukilalyo, 6.-sukulukisya, 7.-sikuluka-sukuluka, 8.-sukulukana)
  • move residence, decamp, *Nindakazyila ku Bukuwa, ndakajana basazima bakasukuluka.* = When I came from abroad, I found all my relatives had moved away from their home. Also: -pola.
  • become very tired, *Ndasukuluka, ndaleka kubeleka.* = I have become very tired, I have stopped working.

shake, *Kolisukulula mukanwa batakumvwi ncoolikunywa.* = Wash your mouth out so that they will not sense what you have been drinking. (1.-sukululwa, 2.-sukulwide, 3.-sukuluzya, 4.-sukulwida, 5.-sukulwidalyo, 6.-sukululisya, 7.-sukulula-sukulula, 8.-sukuluzyanya)
  • rinse, *Kosukulula zisani zyasalala uziyanike.* = Rinse the clean clothes and put them in the sun to dry. *Koonse kulisukulula cakabaalila, bakali kuti nkumana* bunono buli mukanwa. = He avoided any rinsing of the mouth saying that it finished the nice taste in the mouth. *Kulisukulula* = to wash out the mouth.
rinse with, Kosukuluzya zyakusama mumeenda akasaala. = Rinse the clothes with warm water.

push a person down, push over, propel, *Bakamusukuma* kusikila waakuwida mucilindi. They pushed him over until he fell into a hole. Kuli ntenda kusukuma muntu mumulonga. = It is dangerous to push a person into the river. (1.-sukumwa, 2.-sukumide, 3.-sukumya, 4.-sukumina, 5.-sukuminalyo, 6.-sukumisya, 7.-sukuma-sukuma, 8.-sukumana) Also: -tonta, -tonka.

empty all at once, invert a pot to empty, *Bakaisukumana* nsuwa bana, tatujisi amukupa wakulya. = The children completely emptied the calabash of milk and so we don't have any milk to eat. (1.-sukumanwa, 2.-sukumanide, 3.-sukumanizya, 4.-sukumanina, 5.-sukumaninalyo, 6.-sukumanisya, 7.-sukumana-sukumana, 8.-sukumanizyanya) Also: -sukumuna.
  • knock one another about, rt. -sukuma Kamubakasya kusukumana bana. = Stop the children from pushing one another about.

push off, as a boat, Babusukumina mumeenda bwato. = They pushed the boat off into the water. (1.-sukuminwa, 3.-sukumizya, 4.-sukumizyizya, 5.-sukumizyizyalyo, 6.-sukumizyisya, 7.-sukumina-sukumina, 8.-sukumizyanya)

empty out, remove from a mould, as in brick-making, shake out food from pot, pour out contents of pot at one go, Cisaka kocisukumuna. = Empty out the sack. Kamusukumuna mabisi munsuwa. = Empty out the sour milk from the gourd. (1.-sukumunwa, 2.-sukumwide, 3.-sukumuzya, 4.-sukumwida, 5.-sukumwidalyo, 6.-sukumunisya, 7.-sukumuna-sukumuna, 8.-sukumwidana) Also: -fwunta, -sukumana.
empty out contents, rt. sukumuna, Bakajana nswi zilatipita mulusabwi, elyo bakazisukumwida anze. = They found the fish jumping about in the net, thereupon they emptied them out.

test, Saatani nguwakamusukusya ncaakatalika kubba. = It was Satan who tempted him that is why he began to steal. (1.-sukusyigwa, 2.-sukusyide, 3.-sukusyizya, 4.-sukusyila, 5.-sukusyilalyo, 6.-sukusyisya, 7.-sukusyasukusya, 8.-sukusyanya) Also: -sunka.

rest chin on hand, hold head with hands in tiredness or sorrow., Munene walisukuta. The old man is sadly resting his chin on his hand. (1.-sukutwa, 2.-sukutide, 3.-sukutya, 4.-sukutila, 5.-sukutilalyo, 6.-sukutisya, 7.-sukuta-sukuta, 8.-sukutilana) Also: -sukata.

have prolonged stomach upset, Mwida lyangu mulasukuuka. = My stomach has been continually upset. (1.-sukuukwa, 2.-sukuukide, 3.-sukuuzya, 4.-sukuukila, 5.-sukuukilalyo, 6.-sukuukisya, 7.-sukuuka-sukuuka) Also: -sukuka.

rinse with, Kamusukuzya meenda akasaala zisani zisalale. Rinse the clothes with warm water to make them clean. (1.-sukuzyigwa, 2.-sukuzyide, 3.-sukuzya, 4.-sukuzyizya, 5.-sukuzyizyalyo, 6.-sukuzyisya, 7.-sukuzya-sukuzya, 8.-sukuzyanya) Also: -sukuluzya.

emit wind from anus, Tacili cibotu kusula akati kabantu. = It is not polite to release wind from the bowels among people. Also: -pinya (1.-sulwa, 2.-sulide, 3.-suzya, 4.-sulila, 5.-sulilalyo, 6.-sulisya, 7.-sula-sula, 8.-sulana or -sulilana)
  • hate, Bakamusula akaambo kakubbukilwa. = They hated him because of adultery. Bantu basula beenzinyina tabajisi luyando. = People who hate their friends have no love.

feel hatred towards, rt. -sula, Bamwi balasulaika nobacitilwa zibotu. = Some people show hatred even when good things are done for them. *Kusulaika bantu ciletela mapenzi.* = To show hatred towards people brings trouble. (1.-sulaikwa, 2.-sulaikide, 3.-sulaisya, 4.-sulaikila, 5.-sulaikilalyo, 6.-sulaikisya, 7.-sulaika-sulaika, 8.-sulaikana)

stoop to drink water, bend low, slope, Bulo bwangu bwakasulama ncetaoni kabotu. = My bed is sloping that is why I do not sleep well. Cibiya casulama kukkala toocibikka kabotu. = The clay pot is sloping, you did not place it properly. (1.-sulamwa, 2.-sulamide, 3.-sulamya, 4.-sulamina, 5.-sulaminalyo, 6.-sulamisya, 7.-sulama-sulama, 8.-sulamikana)
  • become fixed, Izeelo zyasulama. = The evil spirits cannot come out.
  • be with head downwards and feet upwards, look downwards, Musankwa naakamana kulisina mutwe wakasulama. = When the boy had hung himself, his head was looking down.

invert, bend downwards, hang downwards, Kocisulamika cibulo kutegwa meenda anjila azwe. = Invert the bucket so that the water which has entered comes out. Kamusulamika nkuku njimwakosola mukosi kutegwa buzwe bulowa. = Hang the chicken upside down whose neck you have cut so that the blood comes out. (1.-sulamikwa, 2.-sulamikide, 3.-sulamikizya, 4.-sulamikila, 5.-sulamikilalyo, 6.-sulamikisya 7.-sulamika-sulamika, 8.-sulamikana)
slope towards, rt. -sulama, Akaambo kamagwalo Chimuka moyo wakwe lino wakatalika kusulamina kumunzi. = Because of the letters Chimuka's heart began now to turn towards home.

hate one another, rt. -sula, Baya bantu bakasulana, tabaceendi antoomwe. = Those people hate one another, therefore they don't accompany one another. Kuti bantu basulana, tabaanzyanyi. = If people hate one another, they do not greet each other. (1.-sulwa, 2.-sulide, 3.-sulanya, 4.-sulanina, 5.-sulaninalyo, 6.-sulanisya, 7.-sulana-sulana, 8.-sulana)

be detestable, rt. -sula, Muntu utukila ulasulika. = A person who insults becomes detestable. (1.-sulikwa, 2.-sulikide, 3.-sulizya, 4.-sulikila, 5.-sulikilalyo, 6.-sulikisya, 7.-sulika-sulika, 8.-sulikana)

have hidden agenda, (idiomatic) Mebo nseyandi kusulila mwida, ndiyanda kumwaambila nceyeeya mumoyo wangu. = For myself I do not wish to hide it, I want to say what I think in my heart. (1.-sulilwa, 2.-sulide, 3.-suzya, 4.-sulila, 5.-sulilalyo, 6.-sulisya, 7.-sulilasulila, 8.-sulilana)
be disgusted, Bantu boonse bakanyema akusulukwa kapati. = All the people were angry and very disgusted.

be hateful to, Mebo cilandisulula ncobayanda kundifwubaazya lyoonse. = I detest the way they always make a fool of me. Cilandisulula kubeleka mucimbuzi. = It is repugnant for me to work in a toilet. Nzinini zilamusulula noziwida mumukupa wakwe. = The flies disgust him when they fall into his milk. Me buya me, acijwanyina-cijwanyina cilandisulula. = As for me, this horrid jokingrelationship disgusts me. (1.-sululwa, 2.-sulwide, 3.-suluzya, 4.-sulwida, 5.-sulwidalyo, 6.-sululisya, 7.-sulula-sulula, 8.-sululana)

be filled with resenment, *Ndakasululwa mwana naakajaya cibiya cijikila musozya.* = I was filled with resentment when the child broke the clay pot. *Namalelo wakasululwa, mulumi wakwe naakamunyanzya mpande.* = The first wife was full of hatred when her husband snatched the *mpande* shell from her.

make enemies of one another, *Bakasuluzyanya akwaandaana.* = They made enemies of one another and separated. (1.-suluzyigwa, 2.-suluzyide, 3.-suluzya, 4.-suluzyizya, 5.-suluzyizyalyo, 6.-suluzyisya, 7.-suluzyanya-suluzyanya, 8.-suluzyanya)

sew, knit, *Bacembele nindakabapa cisani bakafwambaana kusuma.* = When I gave the old lady a cloth she quickly sewed it. *Kondipa nyeleti, ndiyanda kusuma cisani.* = Give me a needle, I want to sew a cloth. (1.-sumwa, 2.-sumide, 3.-sumya, 4.-sumina, 5.-suminalyo, 6.-suminsya, 7.-suma-suma, 8.-suminana)
  • join as bricks in a kiln, *Chigabba wakatalika jilo kusuma ondo yazitina.* = Chigabba began yesterday to set up a kiln of bricks.
  • sue, *Usyi musimbi waunka kukusuma mulandu wakumita kwamwanaakwe.* = The father of the girl has gone to take legal action concerning the pregnancy of his daughter.
  • announce bans of marriage in church, *Kuti bantu bayanda kukwatana mucikombelo, mufwundisi weelede kusuma makani munsondo zyotatwe.* = If people wish to marry in church, the priest should read the bans for three Sundays.

cohere, *Mabbuku naakapya mulilo akasumatana.* = When the books were burnt in the fire they stuck together. (1.-sumatanwa, 2.-sumetene, 3.-sumatanya, 4.-sumatanina, 5.-sumataninalyo, 6.-sumatanisya, 7.-sumatana-sumatana)

stick as bricks in a kiln, rt. *-suma*, *Kuzyuumpa kapati zitina inga mwazisumatizya.* = If you overbake bricks you will make them fuse together. (1.-sumatizyigwa, 2.-sumatizyizye, 3.-sumatizya, 4.-sumatizyizya, 5.-sumatizyizyalyo, 6.-sumatizyisya, 7-sumatizya-sumatizya, 8.-sumatizyanya)

cohere, cluster together, *Ndakabona bana bamaanga bakasumbatana mitwe.* = I saw the twins with their heads joined together. (1.-sumbatanwa, 2.-sumbatide, 3.-sumbatizya, 4.-sumbatanina, 5.-sumbataninalyo, 6.-sumbatanisya, 7.-sumbatana-sumbatana) Also: -mandana.
be connected in speech, *Makani akwe alisumbatene.* = His speech is logical.

be cleansed and made beautiful, *Munzi wasumbuka nibamusalazya mukamufwu.* = The village was cleansed when they purified the widow. (1.-sumbukwa, 2.-sumbukide, 3.-sumbuzya, 4.-sumbukila, 5.-sumbukilalyo, 6.-sumbukisya, 7.-sumbuka-sumbuka, 8.-sumbuzyanya)

be clean, be neat, be smooth, be honourable, *Kuti konana mafwuta ulasumbula.* = If you smear yourself with cream you become smooth. *Kamwiinda munzila isumbula mutayaswi mamvwa.* = Pass along the clean path so that you are not pierced with thorns. *Bapati sunu mbebali mbele kuyiisya bana nzila zyabumpelenge zitasumbuli abuniini pe.* = Today it is the elders who are in the lead teaching the children the ways of treachery which have no honesty. (1.-sumbulwa, 2.-sumbwide, 3.-sumbuzya, 4.-sumbwida, 5.-sumbwidalyo, 6.-sumbulisya, 7.-sumbula-sumbula, 8.-sumbuzyanya)
  • be clear, Kunyina kaambo kasumbula awa nkoamba kutondezya kuti toli nduwe wakabba pe. = There is nothing clear in what you have said to show that it was not you who stole. Also: -sumbungana.
  • cleanse ritually, Munanga naakamana kukupaula, munzi wakasumbula. = After the witchdoctor had finished cleansing, the villlage was ritually purified. Munanga wakaitwa kusumbuzya munzi. = The witchdoctor was called to purify the village.
  • be restored to health, Mutinta wakali kulya kabotu akusamba abuzuba, mpoona wakasumbula alimwi. = Mutinta was eating well and washing every day, and so she recovered again.

resume work, Babelesi basumbuluka kale kuya kumulimo. = The workers have already gone to resume their work. (1.-sumbulukwa, 2.-sumbulukide, 3.-sumbulusya, 4.-sumbulukila, 5.-sumbulukilalyo, 6.-sumbulukisya, 7.-sumbuluka-sumbuluka, 8.-sumbulukana)

be clear, Naakali kubetekwa kuli sibbuku, kunyina kaambo kakasumbungana nkaakaamba. = When he was judged by the headman there was no clear reasoning in what he said. (1.-sumbunganwa, 2.-sumbunganide, 3.-sumbunganya, 4.-sumbunganina, 5.-sumbunganinalyo, 6.-sumbunganisya, 7.-sumbungana-sumbungana, 8.-sumbunganizyanya)

be honourable, Cilainda kubota kukwata musimbi uulaa ciimo cisumbungene. = It is much better to marry a girl who has an honourable character. Ndaambile kaambo kasumbu ngene kakapa kuti ukwate muntu ulaa da lyamuntu. = Give me a just reason which caused you to marry a woman who was pregnant by another man.
  • be round and smooth, Kabwe kakukwiizya tombwe kalisumbungene. = The stone that is used to grind tobacco into snuff is round and smooth. Inombe yako ilisumbungenye, ilineneede. = Your cow is smooth and fat. Also: -kwizingene, (rt. -kwiizingana,) umbusene, (rt. -umbusana.)

smoothen as a path, clean, clear, Baisumbuzya nzila bainda-inda awa. = They have cleared the path by continually passing along it. Joojo waisumbuzya nzila iiya kumusimbi wakwe. = Joojo was wearing the path away by continually visiting his girl friend. Mafwuta amunsazi alasumbuzya. = The oil from the oil pot smoothens the skin. (1.-sumbuzyigwa, 2.-sumbuzyizye, 3.-sumbuzya, 4.-sumbuzyizya, 5.-sumbuzyizyalyo, 6.-sumbuzyisya, 7.-sumbuzya-sumbuzya, 8.-sumbuzyanya)
  • be famous, be honoured, Kukwata cisumbuzya munzi wamuntu. = Marriage brings honour to one's home.

be in a clean, smooth condition, rt. -sumbula, Inzila ilisumbwide. = The path is in a smooth state. (1.-sumbulwa, 2.-sumbwide, 3.-sumbuzya, 4.-sumbwida, 5.-sumbwidalyo, 6.-sumbulisya, 7.-sumbwide-sumbwide, 8.-sumbuzyanya)

be stuck together, rt. sumatana, Mabbanana aya alisumetene. = These bananas are stuck together. Also: -sumbetene. (1.-sumatanwa, 2.-sumetene, 3.-sumatanya, 4.-sumatanina, 5.-sumataninalyo, 6.-sumatanisya, 7.-sumetene-sumetene)

harden a clay pot by fire, Baama basumika zibiya. My mother is baking clay pots. Inyika yesu tiikonzyi kutupa kukondwa kutamani, pesi ilakonzya kutusumika mbuli mulilo mbuli mbuusumika zibiya. = Our world does not give us eternal happiness, but it can make us mature as a fire matures clay pots. (1.-sumikwa, 2.-sumikide, 3.-sumisya, 4.-sumikila, 5.-sumikilalyo, 6.-sumikisya, 7.-sumika-sumika, 8.-sumikana)

be baked well, as bricks, Zitina zyeelede kusumikwa kutegwa nanda yayakwa kaili njumu. = Bricks ought to be burnt well so that the house which is built is strong.
  • be easily sewn, Mulembo wabuluba ulasumikwa kwiinda wandeketela. = Cotton material is more easily sewn than that of silk.
  • (idiomatic) be strengthened in Christian sacrament of Confirmation, Mwaka uuno ngwakusaanguna kubona bapati basumikwa musakalamente lya Ciyumyo. = This is the first year we have seen the elders being confirmed.
ask for something, Unyina mwaka nouba omwe nguwaka*suminide*. = There was not a single year when you begged.

mend by sewing, Ndisuminina cisani cakazauka aluwayile. = I am mending the cloth which was torn on barbed wire. (1.-sumininwa, 2.-suminide, 3.-suminizya, 4.-sumininina, 5.-suminininalyo, 6.-suminisya, 7.-sumininasuminina, 8.-sumininana)
  • join together as parts of broken calabash by stitching, Bataata balicizyi kusuminina nsuwa ilaa Iwaanzi kwiinda mukubelesya malala. = My father knows how to mend a cracked calabash by using palm leaves.
bore holes as weevil, Bamusunse basumpa mapopwe. = The weevils have destroyed the maize. (1.-sumpwa, 2.-sumpide, 3.-sumpya, 4.-sumpila, 5.-sumpilalyo, 6.-sumpisya, 7.-sumpa-sumpa, 8.-sumpizyanya)

shake up and down as cart on road, jolt, Mwana wiile kusumpauka kusyule. The child is shaking up and down on the back. Mwana ulasumpauka amubili wabanyina. The baby is being jolted up and down on the mother's body. (1.-sumpaukwa, 2.-sumpaukide, 3.-sumpaukizya, 4.-sumpaukila, 5.-sumpaukilalyo, 6.-sumapukisya, 7.-sumpauka-sumpauka, 8.-sumpausyanya) Also: -gunauka.

dandle, dance a child up and down, Mwana wakakwiila nindakali kumusumpaula. The child was squealing when I danced her up and down. Also: -sompaula. (1.-sumpaulwa, 2.-sumpawide, 3.-sumpausya, 4.-supawida, 5.-sumpawidalyo, 6.-sumpaulisya, 7.-sumpaula-sumpaula, 8.-sumpaulana)

given a higher position, promote, Mweete bakamusumpika mwezi wakamana. They promoted Mweete last month. Also: -sumpula (1.-sumpikwa, 2.-sumpikide, 3.-sumpizya, 4.-sumpikila, 5.-sumpikilalyo, 6.-sumpikisya, 7.-sumpika-sumpika, 8.-sumpikana)
  • be attacked by weevils, as crops, rt. sumpa, Mapopwe atakobeledwe alasumpika abamusunse. = Untreated maize-grain is easily attacked by weevils.

prosper, Aaba basumpuka nkaambo kakumvwana muli cabo cabo. These have prospered because there is cooperation among themselves. Ndakasumpuka mumulimo muciindi cisyoonto nkaambo ndakali kubeleka kabotu. I caused myself to be promoted at work within a short time because I was working hard. (1.-sumpukwa, 2.-sumpukide, 3.-sumpuzya, 4.-sumpukila, 5.-sumpukilalyo, 6.-sumpukisya, 7.-sumpuka-sumpuka, 8.-sumpusyanya) Also: -sumpika.

exalt, lift up, rise to a higher level, Kubeleka canguzu kupa kulisumpula mucisi. To work hard brings development to the country. Wakali kuyandisya kusumpula mulaka wakwe wa Chitonga. He desired very much to promote his mother-tongue of Chitonga. Sumpula buluke bwako = Pull up your trousers. (1.-sumpulwa, 2.-sumpwide, 3.-sumpusya, 4.-sumpwida, 5.-sumpwidalyo, 6.-sumpulisya, 7.-sumpula-sumpula, 8.-sumpulana)
  • be proud, Ooyu musankwa naakajana mali manji wakatalika kulisumpula. = When this boy found riches he became proud.

shake continually, Mwana ulasumpuuka amubili wabanyina. = The child is shaking up and down on the mother's body. (1.-sumpuukwa, 2.-sumpuukide, 3.-sumpuukizya, 4.-sumpuukila, 5.-sumpuukilalyo, 6.-sumpuukisya, 7.-sumpuuka-sumpuuka, sumpuusyanya) Also: -sumpauka.
raise up, Twali kusola kusumpuzya meenda. = We were trying to raise the water.

be improved, rt. -sumpula, Lubono loonse ndwalisumpwida nduIwangu kusanganya amukaintu. All the wealth with which he is proud of, together with his wife, is mine. (1.-sumpwidwa, 2.-sumpwide, 3.-sumpwidizya, 4.-sumpwida, 5.-sumpwidalyo, 6.-sumpulisya, 7.-sumpwida-sumpwida, 8.-sumpwidana)

extend, postpone, Mucado tuukabi nsondo ino, bakausumpya uyakuba nsondo iiboola. The wedding will not take place this week but they have postponed until next week. Imuzeezo wankuta tauli wakugwasya bantu kunikubba nokuba kusumpya ci lengwa eci. The aim of the court is not to assist people who are stealing, nor to encourage this custom. (1.-sumpizyigwa, 2.-sumpizyide, 3.-sumpya, 4.-sumpizyizya, 5.-sumpizyizyalyo, 6.-sumpizyisya, 7.-sumpya-sumpya, 8.-sumpizyanya)
  • add to, support, promote, Mizeezo yakujana mali manji tiisumpuli, kunze lyakusumpya malwazi, munyono abumpelenge. Plans to find plenty of money does not bring progress, apart from promoting disease, envy and deceit.
  • transfer, Chimwanga wakasumpya nombe zyakwe kuzwa kwa Malambo kuzitola ku Kalomo. Chimwanga transferred his cattle from Malambo village to Kalomo. Imfwulumende njeeyo lino yatiiti muntu oyo imusyome akumusumpya kuti akaiye kumasi ambi. There is the government who now trusts a person and transfers him so that he learns in another country.

debate, Basicikolo basumuka musalo mubotu. The pupils are debating an interesting topic. (1.-sumukwa, 2.-sumukide, 3.-sumusya, 4.-sumukila, 5.-sumukilalyo, 6.-sumukisya, 7.-sumuka-sumuka, 8.-sumusyanya)

be unstitched, be torn where it was stitched, Cakasumunuka cibaki. The shirt has become unstitched. (1.-sumunukwa, 2.-sumunukide, 3.-sumunuzya, 4.-sumunukila, 5.-sumunukilalyo, 6.-sumunukisya, 7.-sumunukasumunuka) Also: -zambuluka, -tambuluka, -lambuluka.

re-sew, Cisani ceelede kusumununwa. The cloth needs to be resewed. Ndisumununa cisani cakasumidwe kale. I am resewing the cloth which was already sewn. Also: -zambulula. (1.-sumununwa, 2.-sumunwide, 3.-sumunuzya, 4.-sumunwida, 5.-sumunwidalyo, 6.-sumunisya, 7.-sumununa-sumununa, 8.-sumununana)

break off a piece of something with fingers, Kosuna nsima nsyoonto undipe ndye. = Break off a small piece of nsima and give it to me to eat. Bana baniini basuna tukusu tuniini. = Little children break off little pieces of nsima. Suna bulongo, tubumbe nombe. = Break off some clay so that we mould a cow. (1.-sunwa, 2.-sunide, 3.-sunizya, 4.-sunina, 5.-suninalyo, 6.-sunisya, 7.-suna-suna, 8.-suninana) Also: -yambula.

wear out, crumble, e.g Bwaanda bwananda bwakasunauka nkaambo bwaba bwakaindi. = The wall of the house has crumbled because it is old. (1.-sunaukwa, 2.-sunaukide, 3.-sunauzya, 4.-sunaukila, 5.-sunaukilalyo, 6.-sunaukisya, 7.-sunauka-sunauka, 8.-sunaukana) Also: -komooka, -sinauka.

try, Muntu usunda kubeleka milimo imwi, ulakonzya kulumbuIwa. The one who tries various jobs, can be rewarded. (1.-sundwa, 2.-sundide, 3.-sundya/-sundizya, 4.-sundila, 5.-sundilalyo, 6.-sundisya, 7.-sunda-sunda, 8.-sundilana)
  • be a nuisance, Ooyu mwana tamvwi, ulasunda. This child does not obey, s/he is a nuisance. Muntu usunda ngwakulanga buyo. = A person with difficult behaviour should be just looked at. Also: -puta.
  • be in throes of parturition, Mukaintu ulaa da wakatola ciindi kusunda naya atumbuke. The pregnant women took time in labour-pains before she gave birth. Also: -mimila
  • play about sexually, Kufwumbwa mpaasunda, wakasiya mwana. Wherever he played about he left a child.
Also: -jinsilana

push one another playfully, Bantu bali kusundana balwaninalyo. = The people who were pushing one another playfully ended up fighting one another. (1.-sundanwa, 2.-sundanide, 3.-sundanizya, 4.-sundanina, 5.-sundaninalyo, 6.-sundanisya 7.-sundana-sundana, 8.-sundana)

be in the throes of death, Mufwu wasundauka ciindi cilamfwu katanafwa. The dead person was in the throes of death for a long time before he died. (1.-sundaukwa, 2.-sundaukide, 3.-sundausya, 4.-sundaukila, 5.-sundaukilalyo, 6.-sundaukisya, 7.-sundauka-sundauka, 8.-sundaukilana)
  • make many efforts to execute a plan, rt. -sunda, Bamaama bakali kusundauka munzila zinji kutegwa bajane mali akupa basicikolo. = My mother was trying in many ways to find money to give to the school-children.

provoke one in many ways, Nobakamana kumusundaukila, bakamujaya. After provoking him in many ways, they killed him.
  • try in many ways, Muntu naakali kuciswa kaindi, kuti bulwazi bwalemenena, wakali kusundaukilwa nzila zinji zyakuti apone. = When a person was sick in the past, if the disease became serious, they would try for him many ways so that he would be cured.

plant charms to destroy, Musankwa ooyu bakamusundila beenzinyina ncatazyali. His friends planted charms that is why this man is impotent. Bandisundila mbantu bokwesu bayanda kuti ndafwa bakakkomanine mpawo. The ones who plant charms are my relatives who want me to die so that they can be happy. (1.-sundilwa, 2.-sindilide, 3.-sundilizya, 4.-sundilizyizya, 5.-sundilizyizyalyo, 6.-sundilisya, 7.-sundila-sundila, 8.-sundilana)
  • be a nuisance to, rt. -sunda, Aaba bana basundila bantu bapati. = These children are a nuisance to the elders.

go off, start a journey, leave, Wakasunduka naakamvwa kuti taciko ncaakali kuyanda. = He had started the journey when he heard that what he wanted wasn't there. Naatakajana cintu wakaile kusunduka. = When he didn't find anything he just went off. Umwi musimbi wakamuyandisya musankwa cakuti naakasunduka wakamuccilila. = One girl loved the boy so much that when he went away, she followed him. Wakaide kusunduka kakunyina ngwaakalailide. = He just went off without saying good-bye to anyone. (1.-sundukwa, 2.-sundukide, 3.-sundusya, 4.-sundukila, 5.-sundukilalyo, 6.-sundukisya, 7.-sunduka-sunduka, 8.-sundukilana)

take off, start on a journey, Mbolyakasundukila bbaasi, aswebo twakakwenkweleka kujoka. = As soon as the bus started off we also began to return. (1.-sundukilwa, 2.-sundukilide, 3.-sundukilizya, 4.-sundukilila, 5.-sundukilalyo, 6.-sundukilisya, 7.-sundukilasundukila, 8.-sundukilana)

tie, Kamubasunga babwa batalumi bantu beenda munzila. = Tie the dogs so that they don't bite people who are passing along the path. Kamwiisunga looye nombe eyo, ilaluma muntu. = Tie that cow with a rope, it will attack someone. (1.-sungwa, 2.-sungide, 3.-sunzya, 4.-sungila, 5.-sungilalyo, 6.-sungisya, 7.-sunga-sunga, 8.-sungana) Also: -anga
  • take care of, Ooyu mukaintu tabasungi kabotu bana bakwe. = This woman does not look after her children properly. Also: -bamba.
  • yoke, Bana basankwa balafwambaana kucizyiba kusunga basune. = Young boys are quick to know how to yoke oxen. Also: -bopa, -vwoleka.

desire, Moyo wangu wasungama kuya ku Lusaka. = I greatly desire to go to Lusaka. Also: -sukamina. (1.-sungamwa, 2.-sungeme, 3.-sungamya, 4.-sungamina, 5.-sungaminalyo, 6.-sungamisya, 7.-sungama-sungama, 8.-sungaminana)
  • sleep on back (head to one side), Mwana wasungama koona. = The child is leaning on the back of the mother while sleeping.

make the head lean on, Komusungamika mwana aone kabotu. Make the child lean it's head on the mother's back so that it sleeps well. (1.-sungamikwa, 2.-sungamikide, 3.-sungamisya, 4.-sungamikila, 5.-sungamikilalyo, 6.-sungamikisya, 7.-sungamikasungamika, 8.-sungamikana)

sit with head in hands, Ino ulisungata nzi? = Why are you sitting with your head in hands? Also: -sukata. (1.-sungatwa, 2.-sungatide, 3.-sungatizya, 4.-sungatila, 5.-sungatilalyo, 6.-sungatisya, 7.-sungata-sungata, 8.-sungatana)

be set on, be determined, rt. -sungama, Moyo wakwe waalisungeme kusika mu Bulawayo. = His heart was set on reaching Bulawayo. (1.-sungamwa, 2.-sungeme, 3.-sungamya, 4.-sungamina, 5.-sungaminalyo, 6.- sungamisya, 7.-sungeme-sungeme, 8.-sungaminana)

yoke for someone, rt. sunga, Kamundisungila basune, nkwele zisamu. = Yoke the oxen for me so that I drag the trees. (1.-sungilwa, 2.-sungide, 3.-sungizya, 4.-sungila, 5.-sungilalyo, 6.-sungisya, 7.-sungilasungila, 8.-sugilana)
  • care for, Ba Cheepa mbabakandisungila mwana naakali kwiiya. = It is Cheepa who cared for my child when she was learning.

tie up and go off, *Ndaisungilila ngulube kucisamu kuti nsube.* = I tied the pig to the tree so that I could urinate. *Babbi bakasungilila mpongo mucoonde.* = The thieves tied up the goats in a thicket. (1.-*sungililwa*, 2.-*sungilidwe*, 3.-*sungilizya*, 4.-*sungililila*, 5.-*sungilililalyo*, 6.-*sungililisya*, 7.-*sungilila-sungilila*, 8.-*sungililana*)
  • tie, as for purpose of killing, *Wakalisungilila mucisamu naakalijaya.* = She hung herself from a tree when she committed suicide. Also: -*sina*.

try to force to do something, incite, instigate, *Wakandisungilizya kuti nkwate pesi cakaala.* = He tried to force me to marry, but he failed. *Mugutu nguwakatusungilizya kulwana.* = It was Mugutu who forced us to fight. *Mupati kuti tazyi bubotu bwalwiiyo, tasungilizyi bana bakwe kuti baye kucikolo.* = If an adult does not know the benefit of education, he will not insist on his children going to school. Also: -*yunga*. (1.-*sungilizyigwa*, 2.-*sungilizyide*, 3.-*sungilizya*, 4.-*sungilizyizya*, 5.-*sungilizyizyalyo*, 6.-*sungilizyisya*, 7.-*sungilizyasungilizya*, 8.-*sungilizyanya*)
  • tie up along with, *Bana basungilizya koombe acisamu caangidwe banyina.* = The children tied up the calf to the tree along with the mother where she was tied.

free, let loose, *Bamusungula mwanaabo kuti akwatwe.* = They allowed their daughter to be married. (1.-*sungulwa*, 2.-*sungwide*, 3.-*sunguzya*, 4.-*sungwida*, 5.-*sungwidalyo*, 6.-*sungulisya*, 7.-*sungula-sungula*, 8.-*sungulana*)
  • volunteer, *Ndalisungula kweenda endikke.* = I volunteered to go on my own.
melt, dissolve, *Nyama yatalika kusunguluka naakaigusya mu caanda* = The meat began to become soft when he took it out of the ice.

untie, *Koisungulula ngulube ino.* = Untie the pig now. *Musankwa usungulula kwale wacegwa.* = The boy is releasing the partridge which was trapped. Also: -*sungununa, -angununa*. (1.-*sungululwa*, 2.-*sungulwide*, 3.-*sunguluzya*, 4.-*sungulwida*, 5.-*sungulwidalyo*, 6.-*sungululisya*, 7.-*sungulula-sungulula*, 8.-*sungululana*)
  • remove poison from plant to make it edible by washing, boiling etc. *Bakaindi bakali kuzisungulula ntungulu kutegwa zitabakoli.* = Long ago people were able to reduce the amount of poison in the *ntungulu* tubers so that they would not damage their health. (centre is extracted and ash is added to water in which the tuber is then boiled.)

be released as a girl from parental authority when she is taken by bridegroom, *Wakasungulwa musimbi abausyi.* = The girl was handed over for marriage by her father. (1.-*sungulwa*, 2.-*sungwide*, 3.-*sunguzya*, 4.-*sungwida*, 5.-*sungwidalyo*, 6.-*sungulisya*, 7.-*sungulwa-sungulwa*, 8.-*sungulana*)
  • be sacrificed, be handed over unwillingly, *Musune omwe akati kababili wakasungulwa kuti aulisye akaambo kanzala.* = One of the two oxen was reluctantly handed over for sale because of the famine.

release from hook or trap, *Masowe wandisungulwida mondo yacegwa mukalobo.* = Masowe took off the barbel fish for me which was caught on the hook. (1.-sungululwa, 2.-sungulwida, 3.-sunguluzya, 4.-sungu-Iwida, 5.-sungulwidalyo, 6.-sungululisya, 7.-sungulwida-sungulwida, 8.-sungulwidana)
  • neutralize, reduce power, Мисетbele usungulwida bana haamuvwamba kuti balye. The old woman is removing the poison of the haamuvwamba plant so that the children can eat.

unbind, Baisungununa nombe bataata. My father released the cow. Kamumusungununa mubwa atande kanyama. Untie the dog so that it chases the little animal. (1.-sungununwa, 2.-sungunwide, 3.-sungu-nuzya, 4.-sungunwida, 5.-sungunwidalyo, 6.-sungununisya, 7.-sungununa-sungununa, 8.-sungununana) Also: -sungulula.

release, Ndakaisunguzya nombe yangu kuti baitole. = I released my cow so that they could take it. (1.-sungulwa, 2.-sungwide, 3.-sunguzya, 4.-singwida, 5.-sungwidalyo, 6.-sungulisya, 7.-sungula-sungula, 8.-sungulana)

be zealous, be willing, Kamunga kamusungwaala kucita zintu nozinoolondoloka. You ought to do things with determination, that is when they will be done perfectly. Kuti wasungwaala kale inga mulimo wakonzeka. = If you are already determined then the job is possible. Balombe bakali kusungwaala kuzumanana kukkala kumigodi kusikila bajana ncobakeendelede. The men were determined to persevere living at the mines until they found what they went there for. (1.-sungwaalwa, 2.-sungwaalide, 3.-sungwaazya, 4.-sungwaalila, 5.-sungwaalilalyo, 6.-sungwaalisya, 7.sungwaala-sungwaala, 8.-sungwaalizyanya, | -sungwaalilana)

break off a piece for someone, rt. -suna, Wakali kunga aumana mukusu waboola kuli banyina alimwi kuti bamusunine. = When he had finished a piece of nsima he used to come to his mother again for her to break off a piece for him. (1.-suninwa, 2.-sunide, 3.-sunizya, 4.-sunina, 5.-suninalyo, 6.-sunisya, 7.-sunina-sunina, 8.-suninana)

test, give examinations, Bamayi basunka bana mucikolo. = The teachers are examining the pupils in the school. (1.-sunkwa, 2.-sunkide, 3.-sunkizya, 4.-sunkila, 5.-sunkilalyo, 6.-sunkisya, 7.-sunka-sunka, 8.-sunkana)
  • tempt, Babwa bangu nibajaya nkuku, ndasunkwa kuti ndibajaye. = When my dogs killed the chicken I was tempted to kill them. Also: - tepaula.
  • bewitch with, cause sickness by bewitching, Kuciswa kwamunene ooyu kulibonya buya kuti kuli bamusunka. = The sickness of this old man is seen beyond doubt as due to the fact that people are bewitching him.

walk away with quick steps, Kufwumbwa buyo kuti bamupa eco ncayelede kupegwa, ndilyona inga weenda, wasunkaila. = Whenever they give him what he ought to be given, he goes off at once with quick steps. Wasunkaila acisuwo cakwe amutwe weenda. = She walked off quickly with a basket on her head. (1.-sunkailwa, 2.-sunkailide, 3.-sunkaizya, 4.-sunkailila, 5.-sunkaililalyo, 6.-sunkailisya, 7.-sunkaila-sunkaila, 8.-sunkaililana)

be too/very high, Kaluli kacaanda cangulube kakasunkumana. The roof of the pig sty is too high. Wakatanta atala akalundu mpokakasunkumene kuti asompe kabotu. = She climbed on to the top of a hill which was high enough for her to look out easily. Also: -sankama, -tankama. (1.-sunkumanwa, 2.-sunkumene, 3.-sunku-mika, 4.-sunkumanina, 5.-sunkumaninalyo, 6.-sunkumanisya, 7.-sunkumana-sunkumana, 8.-sunkumaninana)

fall as fine rain, Imvwula yatalika kaindi kusunkumuka. = The rain has started long ago to drizzle. (1.-sunkumukwa, 2.-sunkumukide, 3.-sunkumusya, 4.-sunkumukila, 5.-sunkumukilalyo, 6.-sunkumukisya, 7.-sunkumuka-sunkumuka) Also: -sunsumuka, -sunsumuna, -lundalunda, -fwanta-fwanta.

cause lameness, rt. sunkuta, Cimusunkusya ninombe yakamuumide mulazyi. = What made him lame was the cow which kicked him. (1.-sunkutwa, 2.-sunkutide, 3.-sunkutya, 4.-sunkutila, 5.-sunkutilalyo, 6.-sunkutisya, 7.-sunkusya-sunkusya)

limp, Ulasunkuta nkaambo kacicisa kukweendo. = He is limping because of the sore on his leg. Also: -bbampa, -dyabila, -dyabatila. (1.-sunkutwa, 2.-sunkutide, 3.-sunkusya, 4.-sunkutila, 5.-sunkutilalyo, 6.-sunkutisya, 7.-sunkuta-sunkuta)
  • speak ineffectively, Ooyu sibbuku tacizyi kubeteka, wiide kwaamba twaambo tusunkuta. = This headman does not know how to try cases, he just utters empty words.

dip in relish, Kamusunsa kabotu, cisyu ncisyoonto. = Dip into relish carefully as it is scarce. Kosuna nsima wamana usunse mucisyu. = Break off a piece of nsima and then dip it in the relish. (1.-sunswa, 2.-sunside, 3.-sunsya, 4.-sunsila, 5.-sunsilalyo, 6.-sunsisya, 7.-sunsa-sunsa, 8.-sunsilana) Also: -jompeka, -bwenga.

drizzle, rt. -sunsa, (1.-sunsiilwa, 2.-sunsiilide, 3.-sunsiizya, 4.-sunsiilila, 5.-sunsiililalyo, 6.-sunsiilisya, 7.-sunsiila-sunsiila, 8.-sunsiilana) Also: -sunkumuka, -sunsumuka.
  • devour quickly, Mubwa usunsiila cituli canyama ncaabba. = The dog is gulping down a piece of meat which it stole.
  • pull up, Kosunsiila buluke butaloki. = Pull up the trousers so that they do not drop. Kosunsiila mwana ataloki ansi. = Pull up the child (on your back) so that it does not fall to the ground.

be appetizing, Inyama ilasunsika nkaambo ilanona. = Meat is appetizing because it is tasty. (1.-sunsikwa, 2.-sunsikide, 3.-sunsikizya, 4.-sunsikila, 5.-sunsikilalyo, 6.-sunsikisya, 7.-sunsika-sunsika, 8.-sunsikana)
  • accompany, Wakamusunsika afwiifwi amunzi wakwe. = He accompanied him close to his village. Also: -sindikila.

draw up, raise up, take a higher position, Kosunsila buluke, bulaloka. = Pull up your trousers, they will drop. Komusunsila nsima mwana mucisyu. = Dip the nsima in the relish for the child. Also: -sunsiila. (1.-sunsilwa, 2.-sunsilide, 3.-sunsizya, 4.-sunswida, 5.-sunswidalyo, 6.-sunsilisya, 7.-sunsila-sunsila, 8.-sunsilana)

squat, sit on haunches, Kusunsumana ciindi cilamfwu cilaminya. = To squat for a long time is tiring. Sunsumana nokanana abapati. = Squat when you talk to the elders. (1.-sunsumanwa, 2.-sunsumene, 3.-sunsumanya, 4.-sunsumanina, 5.-sunsumaninalyo, 6.-susumanisya, 7.-sunsumana-sunsumana, 8.-sunsumaninana) Also: -tuntumana.

be in a squatting position, Bapati mbabakakkede azyuuno, bana boonse abaabo ibakali kale kuyanda kukwata bakasunsumene buyo. = The elders were the ones who were seated on stools, all the children and those who already wanted to marry, squatted on their haunches.

fall as fine rain, Utazwi anze, ilasunsumuka mvwula. = Do not go outside, it is drizzling. (1.-sunsumukwa, 2.-sunsumukide, 3.-sunsumusya, 4.-sunsumukila, 5.-sunsumukilalyo, 6.-sunsumukisya, 7.-sunsumuka-sunsumuka) Also: -sunkumuka, -sunsiila, -fwantafwanta.

fall as fine rain, Yakali kusunsumuna nitwakali kuya ku Monze. It was drizzling when we were going to Monze. Imwula yakacili kuujisi kusunsumuna. The fine rain just continued to fall. Also: -sunsiila, -sunkumukas, -lunda-lunda, -fwanta-fwanta. (1.-sunsumunwa, 2.-sunsumwide, 3.-sunsumunzya, 4.-sunsumwida, 5.-sunsumwidalyo, 6.-sunsumunisya, 7.-sunsumuna-sunsumuna)

dip with, Nitwakali kulya ndakali kusunsya lumwensyi nkaambo kululyo ndakalaa cicisa. = When we were eating I was dipping in the relish with the left hand because my right hand had a sore. (1.-sunswa, 2.-sunside, 3.-sunsya, 4.-sunsila, 5.-sunsilalyo, 6.-sunsisya, 7.-sunsya-sunsya, 8.-sunsilana)
