rise as smoke, Nindainda kunamaumbwe kwali kusunta busi. = When I passed the graveyard there was smoke rising. Koleta mulilo nguulya ulasunta kutanda okuya. Go and bring fire which is over there from that smoking log. Komusunsila nsima mwana mucisyu. = Dip the nsima in the relish for the child. (1.-suntwa, 2.-suntide, 3.-suntya, 4.-suntila, 5.-suntilalyo, 6.-suntisya, 7.-sunta-sunta, 8.-suntilana)
  • beat small drum, Notuuma kalyaba inga uumwi ngwakusunta. = When we are drumming the kalyaba dance, one plays the small drum. Bamwi baalilwa koonse akuuma ngoma nokuba kusunta. = Some are completely unable to beat a drum or even to beat in the simplest way.
  • give a blow, Basankwa bobilo bakasuntana mafwaindi kwaciindi cilamfwu. Two boys exchanged blows with one another for a long time.
  • sleep heavily, Sunu ndiyanda kusunta nonzi nkaambo ndakatala. Today I want to go fast asleep because I am tired. Izona masiku eliya kwatontola, bantu boonse baakusunta nonzi, tukabasobelele. Tomorrow night at the time when it is cold, when all the people will be fast asleep, we will creep up on them.

crouch, Kosuntama usanzye kabotu mwana. = Bend down so that you wash the child properly. (1.-suntamwa, 2.-suntamide, 3.-suntamya, 4.-suntamina, 5.-suntaminalyo, 6.-suntamisya, 7.-suntama-suntama, 8.-suntaminana) Also: -sintama.

hit with fists repeatedly, Lyoombe wakamusuntaula mafwaindi mweenzinyina. Lyoombe struck his friend with his fists repeatedly. (1.-suntaulwa, 2.-suntawide, 3.-suntauzya, 4.-suntawida, 5.-suntawidalyo, 6.-suntaulisya, 7.-suntaula-suntaula, 8.-suntaulana)
  • cool as porridge, Kamusuntaula ceele coole. = Blow on the porridge so that it cools down. Baama basuntaula kakondo kuti koole. = Mother was blowing on the porridge to cool it down.

explain vigorously, Wakasuntawida, pele bakali kuuzya. = He explained to them vehemently, but they were silent. (1.-suntaulwa, 2.-suntawida, 3.-suntauzya, 4.-suntawida, 5.-suntawidalyo, 6.-suntaulisya, 7.-suntawidasuntawida, 8.-suntawidana)

burn to produce smoke, Bamuka Bimbe nibakaciswa kapati, bamwi bantu bakali kuletelezya aziyanda-yanda zyamisamu yakunywa, yakusuntizya ali mwi ayakuyasaula. = When the wife of Bimbe was sick some people brought along the roots of medicine to drink, to produce smoke for inhaling and for putting on cuts. (1.-suntizyigwa, 2.-suntizyizye, 3.-suntizya, 4.-suntizyizya, 5.-suntizyizyalyo, 6.-suntizyisya, 7.-suntizya-suntizya, 8.-suntizyanya)

die suddenly, faint, have an epileptic fit, Muntu ooyu uciswa bulwazi bwakusuntuka. = This person is suffering from fits. Ooyu mwana ulasuntuka zimwi ziindi. = This child faints at times. Wakamvwa mbuli kuti bulwazi bwakwe bwakusuntuka ciyanda kumujokelela. = He felt that the illness of epilepsy was about to return to him. (1.-suntukwa, 2.-suntukide, 3.-suntusya, 4.-suntukila, 5.-suntukilalyo, 6.-suntukisya, 7.-suntuka-suntuka, 8.-suntusyanya)
  • fall into a deep sleep, Nindapiluka kuzwa ku Lusaka ndasuntuka biya koona nkaambo ndalikatede. = When I returned from Lusaka I just fell fast asleep because I was tired. Also: -onenena
be fast asleep, rt. -suntuka, Munanda wakajana Jolezya usuntukide buya koona. At home he found Jolezya just fast asleep.
collapse, lose consciousness, pass out, rt. -suntuka, Wakalumwa nzuki, mpoona buyo wakanetuka akusuntukila ansi. She was stung by bees, thereupon she fainted and collapsed on the ground.

knock down, Mulwazi camusuntula kale cisuntu. = The patient's epilepsy has already knocked him down. Ndubayi lwakamusuntula. = It was a slap which knocked him flat. (1.-suntulwa, 2.-suntwide, 3.-suntusya, 4.-suntwida, 5.-suntwidalyo, 6.-suntulisya, 7.-suntula-suntula, 8.-suntulana)
  • kill many cattle at funeral of rich man, Bamwi bantu ambweni balayeeya kuti eyi nyama nciitegwa 'masuntu' nkaambo bantu balaisuntula akwiitola muminzi yabo. Perhaps that is why many peole call this meat 'masuntu' because people take it to their homes.
  • make sleep, Eeci cakali ciindi calulelema, liya nyenze nozikwiila cakusuntula mwana. It was the time of growth when the cicadas are buzzing to put a child asleep.
  • to stumble against, kulisuntula Also: kulinontola, kuligunkula, kulifwumpula.

smoke heavily, rt. -sunta, Busi bwasuntuluka mumulundu. = The smoke is rising heavily from the hill. 1.-suntulukwa, 2.-suntulukide, 3.-suntulukizya, 4.-suntulukila, 5.-suntulukilalyo, 6.-suntulukisya, 7.-suntuluka-suntuluka)

emit smoke, Nobakasika akati kamuunda bakajana mulwi wamagwilinti ngooyu ulilundene kumbali kusuntumuka busi. When they reached the middle of the field they found a heap of wild fruits there beside where smoke was coming from.

ask for alms, beg, ask for a bit of tobacco, Bacembele baya kukusunza tombwe. The old woman has gone to ask for tobacco. Nobantu bangu, kamuya kukusunza zilyo. = My people, go and ask for food. Nyeleti, naakali sicamba naakasunza maanu kümunene Ntaimo antela asunu nibacili kabotu abanakwe. = Nyeleti, if he had been fearless, would have asked for the wisdom of the old man Ntaimo and perhaps today he and his family would have been prosperous. (1.-sunzwa, 2.-sunzide, 3.-sunzizya, 4.-sunzila, 5.-sunzilalyo, 6.-sunzisya, 7.-sunza-sunza, 8.-sunzana)
  • be proud of, Kuzyala nkulisunza mabote amilimo. = To give birth is to be proud of the good activities done. Also: -linga, -lomba.

ask for something from someone, rt. -sunza, Bumwi buzuba wakatumidwe kumunzi kwa Kalyabulongo kuya kusunzila banyinakulu tombwe. = One day he was sent to the village of Kalyabulongo to ask for tobacco for his grandmother.

unpack things from a container, Bakalanga moonse mumakkabati amumabbokesi, bakasunzulusya mabbuku amapepa oonse, pele taakwe nibakaijana pe. They looked everywhere in cupboards and in boxes, they unpacked all the books and papers, but they never found it. (1.-sunzulusyigwa, 2.-sunzulusyizye, 3.-sunzulusyizya, 4.-sunzulusyizya, 5.-sunsulusyizyalyo, 6.-sunzulusyisya, 7.-sunzulusya-sunzulusya, 8.-sunzulusyanya)

go by mistake, Wakasunzumuka mudaala kuunka kunkolola masiku bakaakumuuma. = The old man went by mistake at night to the initiation ceremony where they beat him. (1.-sunzumukwa, 2.-sunzumukide, 3.-sunzumukizya, 4.-sunzumukila, 5.-sunsumukilalyo, 6.-sunzumukisya, 7.-sunzumuka-sunzumuka, 8.-sunzumukilana) Also: -sunkwa.

roll about, Ntunga zyakamunjila mumubili akumusipa. Wakasunzuuka akusinta abulo bwakwe. = The maggots had invaded his/her body and were sucking her/his blood. S/he was rolling about and groaning on his/her bed. (1.-sunzuukwa, 2.-sunzuukide, 3.-sunzuukizya, 4.-sunzuukila, 5.-sunzuukilalyo, 6.-sunzuukisya, 7.-sunzuuka-sunzuuka, 8.-sunzuusyanya) Also: -alabana..

slip down, be easily digested, Kulya kwabana kweelede kusupuka, alimwi kweelede kujikwa kabotu. = The food for children should be easily digested and cooked properly. Inziba njindajisi yandisupuka nindali kuzibauka. = The dove which I held slipped away from me when I was looking round about. (1.-supukwa, 2.-supukide, 3.-supukizya, 4.-supukila, 5.-supukilalyo, 6.-supukisya, 7.-supuka-supuka) Also: -syupuka.

husk, Wakanjila mucimumbwa akugwisya nzembwe yakutwa akutalika kusupula. She entered the maize-bin and took out millet and started removing the husks. Wakajana mukaintu wakwe wakali kusupula nzembwe munsi angazi. = He found his wife husking millet beside the look-out platform. (1.-supulwa, 2.-supwide, 3.-supuzya, 4.-supwida, 5.-supwidalyo, 6.-supulisya, 7.-supula-supula, 8.-supulana/-supwidana)
  • slip out, Ingulube yasupula mpuyaangidwe. = The pig slipped out from where it was tied. Also: -syupula.

carry away little by little, haul continuously, Basankwa baya kukususa zitina zyananda. The boys are going to draw bricks for the house. Cilayi twakacisiya kumuunda jilo nkaambo cikkeyi cakatyoka nitwakali kususa mapopwe. We left the sledge in the field yesterday because the peg broke when we were bringing in the maize. (1.-suswa or susigwa, 2.-suside, 3.-susizya/-susya, 4.-susila, 5.-susilalyo, 6.-susisya, 7.-susa-susa, 8.-susana.)

carry to, Kuti suntwe wazyalila afwiifwi amunzi, bana bampongo ambelele arņombe ulabamana kubasusila bana bakwe. If a hyena is born near a village it finishes off the young of goats and sheep in carrying them off to her young. Also: -sempula, -yumuna.

eat early, take breakfast, Twamana kususula. = We have finished having breakfast. Nobwakaca balaa muunda bakaunka kuya kulingula akweeta zyuungu zyakususula. = When it was dawn the owner of the field went to inspect and bring pumpkins for breakfast. (1.-susulwa, 2.-suswide, 3.-susuzya, 4.-suswida, 5.-suswidalyo, 6.-susulisya. 7.-susula-susula, 8.-susulana)
  • eat at midday, Bakafwuma kukubeleka kumyuunda lyoonse. Bakaya kumunzi kukususula zilyo akalanga bwaaseme akukotoka aalundindiwana. = They always went to work in the fileds early in the morning. They went for lunch at noon and ended work at dusk. Ciindi cabutebuzi nceciindi tuyuni notususula akulalila mumigwagwa yoonse. = The time of harvest is the time when the birds have their morning and evening meal on all the roads.

direct one's energies to, Bana bangu baakukomena bayoondifwutatila akususunkana bamukowa wabo. = When my children grow up they will turn away from me and direct their energies towards their own clan. (1.-susunkanwa, 2.-susunkene, 3.-susunkanya, 4.-susunkanina, 5.-susunkaninalyo, 6.-susunkanisya, 7.-susunkanasusunkana, 8.-susunkaninana)

contract oneself, or itself as the skin, Cikanda casusunyana mpeyo. The skin contracts with the cold. (1.-susunyanwa, 2.-susunyene, 3.-susunyika, 4.-susunyanina, 5.-susunyaninalyo, 6.-susunyanisya, 7.-susunyana-susunyana, 8.-susunyanizyanya) Also: -kokonyana.
be contracted, rt. -susunyana, Cikanda cakwe nciyumu nta, cilisusunyene kwiinda cikanda cacipembele. Its skin is very hard, it is more contracted than the skin of a rhino.

eat breakfast, Bakasika bantu alya mpobasuswida. = They arrived at the time when people eat breakfast. (1.-susulwa, 2.-suswide, 3.-susuzya, 4.-suswida, 5.-suswidalyo, 6.-susulisya, 7.-suswida-suswida, 8.-susulana)

rebel, turn aside, Malailile aakwe mwami nsyindakaasusya pe. = I did not turn away from the directives of the chief. (1.-suswa, 2.-suside, 3.-susya, 4.-susila, 5.-susilalyo, 6.-susisya, 7.-susya-susya, 8.-susana)
  • use to carry, rt. susa, Ino muyakususya nzi mapopwe anu kuti muleke cilayi? How will you transport your maize if you leave the sledge.

wait for a while, Ndisuta buyo kuti bajoke nkubali kuya. = I am just waiting a little until they return from where they were going. Ndacili kusuta mweenzu kuti asike. I was still waiting for the visitor to arrive. Ndakasuta-suta kumana kwansondo yoonse. = I waited for the whole week. (1.-sutwa, 2.-sutide, 3.-sutya, 4.-sutila, 5.-sutilalyo, 6.-sutisya, 7.-suta-suta, 8.-sutilana)
  • tan as a skin, Cikanda cangu casuta nkaambo kazuba lipya kapati. = My skin has become darker because of the sun which is burning fiercely.

have a dark face, rt. -suta, Mwami wasutana kumeso naabona beenzu. = The chief's face darkened when he saw the strangers. Musimbi wakatalika kunga kufwumbwa buyo akabona kadaala nkusutana kunyema kumeso. = The girl began to show a dark angry face any time she saw the little old man. Also: -siyana (1.-sutanwa, 2.-sutene, 3.-sutanizya, 4.-sutanina, 5.-sutaninalyo, 6.-sutanisya, 7.-sutana-sutana, 8.-sutanizyanya)

be bleached, Lukanda Iwakwe Iwakalisutene, Iwakali kutuba bu, Iwakalipandaukide kapati akaambo kampeyo. Her skin was bleached. It was very white, it was very cracked because of the cold.
  • be dark, scowl, Tanaakajisi ciindi cakuseka-seka abantu, lyoonse wakali kunga ulisutene mbuli kuti camucima. = He had no time to smile with people, he always wore a scowl as if there was something annoying hims, -suula be given meat of an animal not killed by you, Ndakasuula kakololo omwe nkaambo walo wakajaide bone mweenzuma. = I was given one big rat because my friend had killed four. Ndasuula sulwe wajaya umbi. = I was given a rabbit which was killed by another. (1.-suulwa, 2.-swiide, 3.-suuzya, 4.-swiida, 5.-swiidalyo, 6.-suulisya, 7.-suula-suula, 8.-suuzyanya) Also: -uula.
  • undress, Komusuula cisani mwana nkaambo cabija tombe. = Take the dress off the child because it has become dirty. Also: -samununa, -tubula, -tukula.

go back the same direction you came from, Kunyina wajanika amunzi, mpoona ndaile kusuuluka. = I found nobody at the village whereupon I just went back. Lyakamana mvwula wakasuuluka akuunka kwakwe. = After the rains, he left and went to his home. (1.-suulukwa, 2.-suulukide, 3.-suuluzya, 4.-suulukila, 5.-suulukilalyo, 6.-suulukisya, 7.-suuluka-suuluka, 8.-suuluzyanya) Also: -sunduka.

swoop down as a hawk, Kainga kasuuma kuya kukujata kakuku. = The falcon swooped down to snatch the chick. (1.-suumwa, 2.-suumide, 3.-suumuzya, 4.-suumina, 5.-suuminalyo, 6.-suumisya, 7.-suuma-suuma, 8.-suumukilana) Also: -fwuumuka.

stand motionless, Muntu wakali kuyanda kubba mapopwe wakasuumana mujungusi aacizali. = The person who wanted to steal the maize stood motionless under the maize granary. (1.-suumanwa, 2.-suumene, 3.-suumika, 4.-suumanina, 5.-suumaninalyo, 6.-suumanisya, 7.-suumana-suumana, 8.-suumaninana)

stand to attention, Basikalumamba nibakasika kunanda yamusololi wabo, bakauma suluti akusuumbana aumwi aawo mpaakabede. When the soldiers arrived at the house of their leader, they saluted and each stood to attention on the spot where he was. (1.-suumbanwa, 2.-suumbene, 3.-suumbika, 4.-suumbanina, 5.-suumbaninalyo, 6.-suumbanisya, 7.suumbana-suumbana, 8.-suumbanizyanya)

hold oneself tightly, Ngwee nkucityanka cinkwa capapalala, amana nkucibikka munkwa walisuumbika kuya kunanda. = Ngwee squeezed the bread flat, when finished she put it under her arm and held herself tightly going to the house.

be conically shaped, Ciluli cananda yangu tacisweki nkaambo cilisuumene. = The roof of my house does not leak because it is conical. (1.-suumanwa, 2.-suumene, 3.-suumika, 4.-suumanina, 5.-suumaninalyo, 6.-suumanisya, 7.-suumene-suumene, 8.-suumaninana)
burn as medicine, Wakasuumuka musamu cakuti koonse kaanda kakaide kuzulila busi gwiti. = He burnt the medicine so that the whole hut was just full of smoke.

drink, Sicibende katanaya mumpongo, wakanjila mwabo kuti asuumwine bbwatu. Before Sicibende went to the goats, he entered the home and drank sweet-beer. (1.-sumwinwa, 2.-suumwide, 3.-suumwizya, 4.-suumwinina, 5.-suumwininalyo, 6.-suumwinisya, 7.-suumwina-suumwina, 8.-suumwizyanya)
stand still, Mainza wakabona muntu usuunyene kaimwi jili kunze lyakwe. = Mainza saw a person stading quite still and upright behind him.

select as young bull for breeding, *Kamusuwa kacende kaneneede komwe.* Select a small fat bull for breeding. *Ooyu moombe mutamuzibi, ngwenjanda kusuwa mucende.* = Do not castrate this calf. I have selected it as a bull. (1.-suugwa, 2.-suwide, 3.-suwizya, 4.-suwila, 5.-suwilalyo, 6.-suwisya, 7.-suwa-suwa, 8.-suwana)
has grown, *Nguni usuwide kalezu ukkala munsi lyamunzi wa Hatubotu?* = Who has grown a beard who lives near the village of Hatubotu?

begin to prepare beer, *Sena banyoko basuza kale bukoko?* = Has your mother already begun to brew beer? (1.-suzwa, 2.-suzide, 3.-sunzya, 4.-suzida, 5.-suzidalyo, 6.-suzisya, 7.-suza-suza, 8.-suzilana) Also: -unza.

spit, *Mwana wiile kuswa bulowa akaambo kakumanukilwa mucamba.* The child is just spitting blood be-cause of pains in the chest. *Beene uswa mate nkaambo kumoyo kulavwundauka.* Beene is spitting saliva because of being nauseated. Also: -bulula. (1.-sugwa, 2.-swide, 3.-swisya, 4.-swidila, 5.-swidilalyo, 6.-swidisya, 7.-swa-swa, 8.-swidana)
  • make cuts on a sick person to draw blood, *Bakaapa bakalicizyi kuswa nsinga mumutwe.* My grandmother knew how to draw blood out from a vein in the head (to relieve pain).
  • catch one's breath, take a brief rest, *Bakakkala, bakaswa ciya.* They sat, they took a break.
  • (A custom of the joking relationship) *Kuli cilengwa cicitwa mubujwanyina. Ncakuswidilanina zintu. Kuti mwayaana amujwanyoko, atwaambe ujisi sumo, ulakonzya kuliswida amana walitola lyaba lyakwe.* There is a custom connected with the clan joking relationship. It is spitting on things. If you meet you nephew, supposing you have a spear. He can spit on it and if this is done he can take it, it becomes his.

gush out, *Nicakamuuma cibulo, bulowa bwakaswaamuka kwaciindi cilamfwu nkabela wakatalika kunetauka.* When he was struck by the iron bar, the blood gushed out for a long time, thereupon he started fainting continuously. (1.-swaamukwa, 2.-swaamukide, 3.-swaamusya, 4.-swaamukila, 5.-swaamukilalyo, 6.-swaamukisya, 7.-swaamuka-swaamuka, 8.swaamuzyanya)

touch one another, join, meet, *Twakabaswaana bayi munzila.* = We met the teacher on the way. *Twakaswaana mumugelo a Mutinta.* = I met Mutinta in a contour ridge. (1.-swaanwa, 2.-sweene, 3.-swaanya, 4.-swaanina, 5.-swaaninalyo, 6.-swaanisya, 7.-swaana-swaana, 8.-swaana)
  • sleep with, have sexual intercourse, *Mubetesi wakabuzya musankwa kuti, "Ino wakaswaana ziindi zyongaye amwana wasibbuku."* = The judge asked him, "How many times did you sleep with the daughter of the headman. *Wakali kuyandisya kweendela musyokwe kutegwa kataswaani abantu.* = He liked very much to go off into the bush so that he would not meet people. Also: -yaana.

encounter, meet, *Sena mwaswaangana anguwe?* = Did you meet him/her? (1.-swaaanganwa, 2.-swaangene, 3.-swaanganya, 4.-swaanganina, 5.-swaanganinalyo, 6.-swaanganisya, 7.-swaangana-swaangana, 8.-swaangana)
have slept with, *Taku nindakaswaanyide musankwa mbundakabeda muntu.* = I had never slept with a man since I became a human being.

move quietly in short jumps, Imbeba ilaswaba-swaba mubwizu. = The rat is moving quietly in short jumps among in the grass. (1.-swabwa, 2.-swabide, 3.-swabanya, 4.-swabila, 5.-swabilalyo, 6.-swabisya, 7.-swabaswaba, 8.-swabilana)

go noiselessly, Ulaswabaila kweenda mbuli mubbi. = He/she moves as silent as a thief. Kweenda katuli kuya kuswabaila mbuli syuumbwa uuyanda kuweza. = In moving let us go noiselessly like a lion which wishes to hunt. (1.-swabailwa, 2.-swabailide, 3.-swabaizya, 4.-swabailila, 5.-swabaililalyo, 6.-swabailisya, 7.-swabaila-swabaila, 8.-swabaililana) Also: -sobelela, -fwaba.

file, Kamuswaila keembe ako kabosye. File that axe to sharpen it. (1.-swailwa, 2.-swailide, 3.-swaizya, 4.-swailila, 5.-swaililalyo, 6.-swailisya, 7.-swaila-swaila, 8.-swaililana)
  • arrive at, Ino mwanyamuka kweenda, muyakuswaila kwani? = You are setting off, whom do you intend to visit? Also: -sikila, (rt. -sika)
gush out, also -swaamuka. (1.-swamukwa, 2.-swamukide, 3.-swamuzya, 4.-swamukila, 5.-swamukilalyo, 6.-swamukisya, 7.-swamuka-swamuka, 8.-swamuzyanya)

maul, Ngusyuumbwa wakandiswapula akuboko, ncokuli cibata cipati. It is a lion which mauled my arm, that is why there is a big scar. (1.-swapulwa, 2.-swapwide, 3.-swapuzya, 4.-swapwida, 5.-swapwidalyo, 6.-swapulisya, 7.-swapula-swapula, 8.-swapulana) Also: -kwamba.

go stealthily, Bamwi bantu, batayoowi zitondwa, bakatalika kuswaswabila kuunka kuzyiba zyamalende balikke ciindi cacifwumofwumo. = Some people, who do not respect what is taboo, began to stealthily go to the rain-shrine pool alone in the morning. Naakali koona kucitisyini, babbi bakaswaswabila kubweza kaputumende kakwe. When he was sleeping at the station, the thieves quietly came and took his bag.

walk with slow steps, Mwana naapya wali kuswaswaila kweenda. When the child was burnt s/he was walking slowly. (1.-swswailwa, 2.-swaswailide, 3.-swaswaizya, 4.-swaswailila, 5.-swaswaililalyo, 6.-swaswailisya, 7.-swaswaila-swaswaila, 8.-swaswaililana) Also: -mamaila, -soswanya, gobailas, -tombaila

have enough of anything that you longed for, Ndajisi cinunki camabisi ino nindaabona ndaanywida limwi cakuti ndaswaula. I have a longing for sour milk and when I have access to it I drink it so much that I don't need any more of it. Ncoucitilwa mweesyo nkuti bantu baswaule, baleke kuyeeya yooyo sikuzaya. That is why the mweesyo (final funeral ritual) is performed so that the mourning of the people may be fulfilled, that they may stop thinking about that one who has died. (1.-swaulwa, 2.-swawide, 3.-swauzya, 4.-swaulila, 5.-swaulilalyo, 6.-swaulisya, 7.-swaula-swaula, 8.-swaulana) Also: -kkuta

visit, Basimbi bayakukuswaya bakaapanyina sunu boonse. = All the girls are going to visit their grandmother today. Bantu balonda kuswaya batambulwa kabotu. People who come to visit are received well. (1-swayigwa, 2.-swayide, 3.-swayizya, 4.-swayila, 5.-swayilalyo, 6.-swayisya, 7.-swaya-swaya, 8.-swayana.)
move to a place stealthily, Muwezi wakaswebeleka cakufwambaana kuya kulubazu kwaali kukuwila babwa. = The hunter moved stealthily with speed to the place where the dogs were barking. Also: -sobelela

guard field for someone against birds, rt. -soola, Kondisweeda bayuni kumuunda ooko. = Scare away the birds for me from that field over there. Also: -yaminina (1.-soolwa, 2.-sweede, 3.-sweezya, 4.-sweeda, 5.-sweedalyo, 6.-soolesya, 7.-sweeda-sweeda, 8.-sweedana)

be lost, get lost, Bana mbindakatumide bakaakusweeka. = The children whom I sent got lost. Impongo yangu yakasweeka. = My goat got lost. (1-sweekwa, 2-sweekede, 3.-sweesya/ sweekezya, 4.-sweekela, 5.-sweekelalyo, 6.-sweekesya, 7.-sweeka-sweeka, 8.-sweekana.)
be in a lost state, rt. sweeka, Wakalisweekede mumizeezo yakwe. = She was lost in her thoughts.

slip away quietly, Nobakaleka kumujata mubbi, wakasweemuka. = When they ceased holding the thief, he slipped away. Musimbi wakaide kusweemuka akalombwana kambi. = The girl just slipped away with another boy. (1.-sweemukwa, 2.-sweemukide, 3.-sweemusya, 4.-sweemukila, 5.-sweemukilalyo, 6.-sweemukisya, 7.-sweemuka-sweemuka, 8.-sweemukana)
move away unnoticed, Nzoka yakasweemukila mucoonde caali munsi-munsi. = The snake moved away quietly into a thicket which was nearby.

set the dogs on, Kamusweezya babwa bajate nkuku. = Set the dogs to catch the chicken. (1.-sweezyegwa, 2.-sweezyede, 3.-sweezya, 4.-sweezyezya, 5.-sweezyezyalyo, 6.-sweezyesya, 7.-sweezya-sweezya, 8.-sweezyanya) Also: -saalizya, -sibilizya.

leak, Cilonda eeci cisweka bulowa. = This wound is dripping blood. Ciluli cangu cilasweka. = My roof is leaking. (1.-swekwa, 2.-swekede, 3.-swesya, 4.-swekela, 5.-swekelalyo, 6.-swekesya, 7.-sweka-sweka, 8.-swekelana)

be left helpless, Muntu nafwa, mukaintu a bana bakwe tabakwe kuya kujana kantu nokaceya, bayakuswekuluka buyo mbube lubono olo loonse bayakulutola bajwa bamufwu. = When a man dies, his wife and children will never find a thing no matter how small, they will be left just helpless because all the wealth will be taken by the nephews of the deceased. (1.-swekulukwa, 2.-swekulukide, 3.-swekulukizya, 4.-swekulukila, 5.-swekulukilalyo, 6.-swekulukisya, 7.-swekuluka-swekuluka, 8.-swekulukizyanya)

taper, be narrow, Mubili wakwe sunu wakaswempeka. = Her body today is thin. (-swempekede = be slender) (1.-swempekwa, 2.-swempekede, 3.-swempesya, 4.-swempekela, 5.-swempekelalyo, 6.-swempekesya, 7.-swempekaswempeka, 8.-swempesyanya)
become thin, (1.-swempukwa, 2.-swempukide, 3.-swempusya, 4.-swempukila, 5.-swempukilalyo, 6.-swempukisya. 7.-swempuka-swempuka, 8.-swempusyanya) Also: -swempeka.

come near, Kamuswena kuno nomutiimvwe nceyanda kwaamba. = Come close, so that you can hear what I want to say. Nobantu, kamuswena munsi tulye nsima. = You people come near so that we eat nsima. (1.-swenwa, 2.-swenede, 3.-swenya/-swenezya, 4.-swenena, 5.-swenenalyo, 6.-swenesya, 7.-swena-swena, 8.-swenana)

approach stealthily, _Kociswenenena munsi uyase kabotu._ = Approach nearer so that you pierce properly. (1.-swenenenwa, 2.-swenenede, 3.-swenenezya, 4.-swenenena, 5.-swenenenalyo, 6.-swenenesya, 7.-swenenena-swenenena, 8.-swenenenana)
explain clearly, _Wakaswenswemuna kwaambila bana bakwe._ = He explained clearly talking to his children.

stand in fear, shiver, _Swebo twaile kuswentemana mumatewo._ = We just stood shivering in the shrubs. (1.-swentemanwa, 2.-swentemenye, 3.-swentemanya, 4.-swentemanina, 5.-swentemaninalyo, 6.-swentemanisya, 7.-swentemanaswentemana, 8.-swentemaninana)
be without worry, _Amukkale kumunzi nkomuya kulyoonena tulo tuswentemukide akwiinininzya kapati._ = Stay in the village there where you can sleep well without fear and enjoy it.

cause to come closer together, _Kobaswenya-swenya bana batatantaani._ = Bring the childen closer to each other so that they do not wander afar. (1.-swenyegwa-swenyegwa, 2.-swenyede-swenyede, 3.-swenyezyaswenyezya, 4.-swenyezyezya, 5.-swenyezyezyalyo, 6.-swenyesya-swenyesya, 7.-swenyaswenya-swenyaswenya, 8.-swenyizyanya) Also: -zwenia-zwenia

shift residence to a place nearby, go aside, _Musambazi wakasika ananda mbwaakaswenzuka buyo._ = The trader arrived at the nraeby house to where he had moved. (1.-swenzukwa, 2.-swenzukide, 3.-swenzusya, 4.-swenzukila, 5.-swenzukilalyo 6.-swenzukisya, 7.-swenzuka-swenzuka, 8.-swenzusyanya) Also: -longa, -pola.
move off with, rt. swenzuka, _Mweenzu bakamutanda akumwaambila kuswenzuzya zintu zyakwe zyoonse._ = They expelled the stranger and told him to take away all his belongings. (1.-swenzuzigwa)

become dried out, _Mukaintu wakakotela kwiindilila. Mubili wakwe wakaswibbala akulangika bucembele._ = The woman has become increasingly thin. Her body has dried up and she looks towards old age. _Mimena yangu tainaswibbala._ = My yeast has not yet dried out. (1.-swibbalwa, 2.-swibbene, 3.-swibbazya, 4.-swibbalila, 5.-swibbalilalyo, 6.-swibbalisya, 7.-swibbalaswibbala, 8.-swibbazyanya)

spit upon, rt. -swa, _Wandiswida mate mwana ooyu._ = This child has spat upon me. _Koleka kuswida mate munsi aacakulya._ = Stop spitting near food. _Kuti mwayaana amujwanyoko, atwaambe ujisi sumo, ulakonzya kuliswida amana walitola lyaba lyakwe._ = If you meet your joking-relative, let us say you have a spear, he can spit on it and then take it and it becomes his own. (1.-swidwa, 2.-swidide, 3.-swidizya, 4.-swidila, 5.-swidilalyo, 6.-swidisya, 7.-swida-swida, 8.-swidana.)
drizzle, _Imvwula yatalika kale kuswida-swida._ = The rain has already begun drizzling.

not to be free, to be restricted, (idiomatic use) _Aabe ananda yomwe-yomwe amunzi wa Haamilimo tiikwali kuswidwa mate, Haamilimo wakalijisi tulawo-lawo tunji._ = Even at each and every house in the village of Haamilimo no one was allowed to do what-ever one liked, Haamilimo had many rules.

listen, pay attention, _Kamuswiilila malailile aabayi._ = Listen to the instructions of the teacher. Bana kabaswiilila bapati. = Let the children listen to the elders. (1.-swiililwa, 2.-swiilide, 3.-swiilizya, 4.-swiililila, 5.-swiilili-lalyo, 6.-swiililisya, 7.-swiilila-swiilila, 8.-swiililana)
  • taste, Kociswiilila cisyu naa munyo walimvwinsya. = Taste the relish and find out if there is enough salt. Also: -labila.
  • sense, feel, Ndajana mulwazi waliswiilila kabotu sunu. = I found that the patient was feeling better today.
  • rest oneself, Naakali kuyanda kutumbuka mukaintu oyo wakakkala mukavwuna akuliswiilila. When that woman was about to give birth, she sat under a bush to rest herself.

test whether something is hot or cold, rt. -swiilila, Swiilizya naa cibwantu catontola. Taste to see whether the sweet beer is cold enough. Kuzwa ciindi naakaalika wakacileka kuswiilizya nkuyalilila. From the time he took a second wife he stopped listening to where the drums were beating. (i.e. he stopped moving about as he had been doing) (1.-swiilizyigwa, 2.-swiilizyide, 3.-swiilizya, 4.-swiilizyizya, 5.-swiilizyizyalyo, 6.-swiililisya, 7.-swiilizya-swiilizya, 8.-swiililana)
  • listen intently, rt. -swiilila, Kamuswiilizya nakanana nkaambo kumamanino ulamubuzya mibuzyo. Listen carefully as he is talking because he will ask you questions at the end. Kuzwa ciindi nakaalika wakacileka kuswiilizya nkuyalilila. = From the time he got the second wife, he stopped listening intently to where the drums were beating. (i.e. He stopped moving about, as he had been doing.)
  • be witness for somebody, Atweende limwi kunkuta, mukandiswiilizye kaambo kangu. = Accompany me to court, be witness at my trial.

drink from under curds, as with a reed Ndajana bamadaala ba swiimuna tukoko ntubakasiide jilo. = I found the old men drinking a little beer which they left over yesterday. (1.-swiimunwa, 2.-swiimwide, 3.-swiimuzya, 4.-swiimwida, 5.-swiimwidalyo, 6.-swiimunisya, 7.-swiimuna-swiimuna, 8.-swiimuzyanya)

suck up, Wakali kuswiinta buci alubu ndwaakasekka munongo. = He sucked up the honey through a reed which he had inserted in a pot. (1.-swiintwa, 2.-swiintide, 3.-swiintya, 4.-swiintila, 5.-swiintilalyo, 6.-swiintisya, 7.-swiinta-swiinta, 8.-swiintilana)
-swa, take a break, Omu mugonde zigwebenga muzyakali kuswila ciya. There in the forest is where the thieves would take a break.

arouse, Nobakagumana matansyi, Mainza wakamvwa mbuli kuti mubili waswima nkaambo janza lyamusimbi lyakali liteteete. When they caught each other by the hand, Mainza felt his body aroused because the hand of the girl was soft. (1.-swimwa, 2.-swimide, 3.-swimya, 4.-swimina, 5.-swiminalyo, 6.-swimisya, 7.-swima-swima, 8.-swimizyanya)

flow out, Mucembele naakatambula makani aalufwu Iwamuzyukulu wakwe, misozi yakaswininika kapati. = When the old woman received the message about the death of her grandchild, the tears flowed down abundantly. (1.-swininikwa, 2.-swinikide, 3.-swininizya, 4.-swinikila, 5.-swinikilalyo, 6.-swininikisya, 7.-swininika-swininika, 8.-swinikizyanya) Also: -lakatika.

slip away, Mukubaa coolwe musankwa wakafwambaana kuswipukila anze a kutija. Luckily enough the boy slipped away outside and fled. (1.-swipukilwa, 2.-swipukide, 3.-swipukizya, 4.-swipukila, 5.-swipukilalyo, 6.-swipukisya, 7.-swipukila-swipukila, 8.-swipukilana)

move about, as poison, Naakasika akati-kati kamusinzo wakateelela cintu citi 'go' kumaulu, wamvwa kwaswiswima amwiindi. Wakati, "Maawe! Yandiluma nzoka!" = When he reached the middle of the journey he felt something with the sound 'go' at his feet, he sensed a movement at the calf of his leg. He said, "A snake has bitten me!" (1.-swiswimwa, 2.-swiswimide, 3.-swiswimya, 4.-swiswimina, 5.-swiswiminalyo, 6.-swiswimisya, 7.-swiswima-swiswima, 8.-swiswimizyanya)

dig, Kamusya zilindi tusyange mapopwe. Dig the holes so that we can plant the maize. Bazyali ba Mainza bakatalika kuvwuntauzya akusya mukwasyi wamusimbi oyu wa Mainza mbowakabede. The parents of Mainza began to investigate and dig up information as regards the family of the girl of Mainza as to what she was like. (1.-syigwa, 2.-syide, 3.-syisya, 4.-syila/-syida, 5.-syilalyo/syidalyo, 6.-syisya, 7.-syaasya, 8.-syana)

stay behind, Webo kosyaala awa tulakujana twazwa ku Monze. = Remain here, we will find you when we return from Monze. Moonga wakasyaala ku Namwala nibakaboola bamwi. Moonga remained at Namwala when the others came. = (1.-syaalwa, 2.-syeede/-syaalide, 3.-syaazya, 4.-syaalila, 5.-syaalilalyo, 6.-syaalisya, 7.-syaala-syaala, 8.-syaazyanya) Also: -caala.

press against, squeeze, force, Nindakatanta citima bantu bakandisyaanikizya. When I boarded the train the people pressed against me. Munwe wamusankwa wakasyaanikizigwa kulubalo nibakali kubamba ciluli. Cakacisa kapati, pesi taakoonzomoka kuti, "Mwandisyaanikizya" antela "Mwandiyakilizya taata", nkaambo nkuumakwe. = The finger of a boy was caught (in the rods) when they were making a roof. It pained very much but he did not cry out saying, "You have squashed me" or "You have built me into the roof," because it was at his in-laws. (1.-syaanikizigwa, 2.-syaanikizyizye, 3.-syaanikizya, 4.-syaanikizyizya, 5.-syaanikizyizyalyo, 6.-syaanikizyisya, 7.-syaanikizya-syaanikizya, 8.-syaanikizyanya) Also: -sindika.

cluster together, have but a narrow space, Twasyaankana kukkala muno, kaanda kaceya. = We are in clustered together in here, the house is too small. (1.-syaankanwa, 2.-syaankene, 3.-syaankanya, 4.-syaankanina, 5.-syaankaninalyo, 6.-syaankanisya, 7.-syaankana-syaankana)
cause to crowd together Mwazisyaankanya nombe, tazikwe kwiimikila kabotu. You have overloaded the cattle together, they cannot stand properly.
be packed together tightly, nombe zilisyaankene muciba. = The cattle are over-crowded in the kraal.

keep back, Imwi ngulube wakaisyaazya munene. = The old man kept one pig back. (1.-syaazyigwa, 2.-syaazide, 3.-syaazya, 4.-syaazyizya, 5.-syaazyizyalyo, 6.-syaazyisya, 7.-syaazya-syaazya, 8.-syaazyanya)
  • remain, rt. -syaala, Bataata bakafwa kale, sunu ndasyaazya bamaama. = My father is already dead, the one I am left behind with is my mother. Kukoka cakaindilila kapati cakuti wakasyaazya mabambo alo. The thiness rapidly increased so that just the ribs remained. Bazyali bamusankwa bakasyaazya kulindila kukwaba nkoli kuzwa kubazyali bamusimbi ngwaakatizya mwanaabo. = The parents of the boy remained and waited for a fight from the parents of the girl with whom their son had eloped with illegally.
  • go away leaving things behind, *Twakabasyaazya bana, bazyali nibaka-unka kudolopo.* = It is we who made the children stay behind, when the parents went to town.

make a love-pact between a girl and boy, *Ooyu musimbi ndaka-musyaba mwakali.* = I made a love-pact with this girl last year. *Nseyandi kusyaba musimbi pe.* = I don't wish to make a love-pact with a girl. (1.-syabwa, 2.-syabide, 3.-syabya, 4.-syabila, 5.-syabilalyo, 6.-syabisya, 7.-syaba-syaba, 8.-syabana)
  • set a plough for ploughing, *Kosyaba jamba tubone mbwiitetede nyika.* = Set the plough so that we see how wet the ground is.

be acidic to the taste, *Mango makwange alasyakamuka.* = Raw mangoes are acidic. *Bana bamusiikka balasyakamuka.* = The fruits of the musiikka tree are acidic. (1.-syakamukwa, 2.-syakamukide, 3.-syakamusya, 4.-syakamukila, 5.-syakamukilalyo, 6.-syakamukisya, 7.-syakamuka-syakamuka, 8.-syakamusyanya)

break into small pieces, like nshima, *Bacembele basyamauna-syamauna nsima yajilo kuti ijikululwe.* = The old woman is breaking the nsima of the previous day into small pieces so as to re-cook it. (1.-syamaunwa, 2.-syamawide, 3.-syamauzya, 4.-syamawida, 5.-syamawidalyo, 6.-syamaunisya, 7.-syamauna-syamauna, 8.-syamaunana)

pinch, *Kuli candisyamba masiku nindali koona.* = Something pinched me last night when I was sleeping. *Musimbi wamusyamba mwana ncalila.* = The girl pinched the child, that is why it is crying. Also: -syuna cimoni. (1.-syambwa, 2.-syambide, 3.-syambya, 4.-syambila, 5.-syambilalyo, 6.-syambisya, 7.-syamba-syamba, 8.-syambana)
  • examine oneself, *Nindakamana kubetekwa, ndakalisyamba kala.* When I had finished being tried, I examined myself.

give a sign of assistance, *Nokwakainda ciindi munene oyu kaci-papanyana, basazinyina bakamusyambila.* When time passed with the old man insisting, his relatives they signaled that they would help him.

be immoveable, *Mweenzu wasyaminina, tayandi kupiluka kwabo.* The visitor does not want to move, he does not wish to go back to his home. (1.-syamininwa, 2.-syaminide, 3.-syaminizya, 4.-syamininina, 5.-syamininalyo, 6.-syamininisya, 7.-syaminina-syaminina, 8.-syamininana)

squeeze, *Wakasya-mikizya mutwe wakwe mukati.* = He squeezed his head inside. (1.-syamikizyigwa, 2.-syamikizyide, 3.-syamikizya, 4.-syamikizyizya, 5.-syamikizyizyalyo, 6.-syamikizyisya, 7.-syamikizya-syamikizya, 8.-syamikizyanya)

break off a piece of nshima, *Kosyamuna kasima kasoonto umupe mwana uulila.* = Break off a little piece of nshima and gie it to the child who is crying. (1.-syamunwa, 2.-syamwide, 3.-syamuzya, 4.-syamwida, 5.-syamwidalyo, 6.-syamunisya, 7.-syamuna-syamuna, 8.-syamwidana)

tell, *Bantu bakandi-syamwida kaambo aako nindakasika.* = The people told me that matter when I arrived. *Muloongo wandisyamwida kaambo kamaseseke.* = Muloongo told me a secret matter.
  • give a portion, *Kondisyamwida kabeela katombwe kuzwa kucilundu cipati.* = Give me a little piece of tobacco from the big cake. Aswebo tunakumusyamwida mukaintu wako cisela camali ngovwola kutegwa kaligwasya. = And we will give your wife a portion of the money you earn so that she can help herself.

hesitate, be immovable, Musankwa wasyamya taayanda kuunka kwaya bamwi. = The boy hesitated he did not want to go where others had gone. (1.-syamizyigwa, 2.-syamide, 3.-syamya, 4.-syamina, 5.-syaminalyo, 6.-syamisya, 7.-syamya-syamya, 8.-syamizyanya) Also: -syaminina, -zyamya.

plant seeds, sow in holes, Kamusyanga mapopwe, ciindi caunka. = Plant the maize, the time has gone. Sena wasyanga cisyu mumbewu? = Did you plant the vegetables in the garden? (1.-syangwa, 2.-syangide, 3.-syangizya/syanzya, 4.-syangila, 5.-syangilalyo, 6.-syangisya, 7.-syanga-syanga, 8.-syangilana.)

make a person promise to keep a secret, charge one not to betray, Ndamusyangila kuti atakaambi kaambo kamaseseke. I charged him not to talk about the secret. Bakamusyangila kuti atakaambili muntu. They insisted that he should not tell anyone. (1.-syangilwa, 2.-syangilide, 3.-syangizya, 4.-syangila, 5.-syangilalyo, 6.-syangilisya, 7.-syangila-syangila, 8.-syangilana)
  • influence, advise, warn, pressurize, Moobe bakamusyangila kuti atande mukaintu. = They persuaded Moobe to chase his wife away. Bakamusyangila musankwa kuti ataindi nzila yakali basinkondonyina. = They warned the boy not to pass along the road where his enemies were. Bacizyi bakwe bakali kumusyangilila-syangilila kabati, "Mbaanzi bantu aaba mbomugwasya boobu? Waluba sena nzyobakatucitila lyakafwa taata? His sister was trying to dissuade him saying, "Who are these people whom you are helping? Have you forgotten what they did to us when our father died? Also: -pila maanu, -cenjezya.
  • plant for, Bataata baunka kukusyangila bacembele ndongwe. = My father has gone to plant ground nuts for the old woman.

emulate one another to get the boss's favour, Twasyangilana cakwaamba kutegwa mupati wamilimo ayeeye kuti tuliluzi. = We have spoken in favour of one another so that the foreman thinks we are right. Tabayandi kusyangilana twaambo tutaluzi. They do not want to flatter one another with false statements.

have someone plant for you, Mukaintu naakali kuciswa waka-syangililwa biya ndongwe zyakwe. = When the woman was sick she was helped in planting her groundnuts. Also: -lebeledwa.
  • be instructed as what to do or say, Basankwa bakali koona musyokwe kutija cibbalo. Ibana munsi basyangililwa kuti, "Asika mukuwa mwaambe kuti bapati bakaya kumbo kucila. The men were sleeping in the bush to escape the forced labour. The childen who remained behind were instructed thus, "When the white man comes tell him that the elders have gone west to the hunting-grounds." (1.-syangililwa, 2.-syangilidwe, 4.-syangilililwa, 5.-syangilililwalyo)

resow, Banyoko basyangulula nyabo zyatakazwa. = Your mother is resowing the beans which did not germinate. (1.-syangululwa, 2.-syangulwide, 3.-syanguluzya, 4.-syangulwida, 5.-syangulwidalyo, 6.-syangululisya, 7.-syangulula-syangulula, 8.-syangulwidana) Also: -gankulula.

squeeze, Wakasyanikizya ciindi cisyoonto kuti andaambile kaambo kamwi. = He squeezed in some time to tell me something. Kamwiinda kabotu, mwamusyanikizya mwana. = Pass along properly, you are squeezing the child. Also: -syaanikizya, -sindikas, -bbatikizya, -patikizya. (1.-syanikizyigwa, 2.-syanikizyizye, 3.-syanikizyisya, 4.-syanikizyizya, 5.-syanikizyizyalyo, 6.-syanikizyisya, 7.-syanikizya-syanikizya, 8.-syanikizyanya)

be fearless, stand without moving, Mudaala naakabona nkamu yabantu yakajisi masumo wakasyankamana. = When the old man saw the crowd of people with spears he remained fearless. (1.-syankamanwa, 2.-syankamene, 3.-syankamanya, 4.-syankamanina, 5.-syankamaninalyo, 6.-syankamanisya, 7.-syankamana-syankamana, 8.-syakamaninana)

crowd together, Bana bacikolo tabeelede kusyankana ciindi cakulemba. School-children should not crowd together when they are writing. (1.-syankanwa, 2.-syankene, 3.syankanya, 4.-syankanina, 5.-syankaninalyo, 6.-syankanisya, 7.-syankana-syankana, 8.-syankanizyanya) Also: -sinama.
tighten, reduce, Zisobano eezi bazisyankanya ncozyataloma. = They have shortened the plays that is why they are not good.
crush, Mootokala uyanda kundisyanta. The vehicle wants to crush me. (1.-syantwa, 2.-syantide, 3.-syantya, 4.-syantila, 5.-syantilalyo, 6.-syantisya, 7.-syanta-syanta, 8.-syantana)
be crushed in a trap, Mubende wasyantwa diba. = A rodent has been caught in a trap.

be agile, Kamusyapalika kweenda, izuba lyabbila. = Be brisk in walking, it is getting dark. (1.-syapalikwa, 2.-syapalikide, 3.-syapalisya, 4.-syapalikila 5.-syapalikilalyo, 6.-syapalikisya, 7.-syapalika-syapalika, 8.-syapalikizyanya)

be reluctant in doing, Mudaala wakatiisyasyale-syasyale kujalula bbokesi. The old man was slow in opening the box. Bamfwulumende bakabelesya nguzu kulonzya Batonga bakali kusyasyala. The government used force to move the Batonga who were reluctant to move. Also: -zyazyatila (1.-syasyalwa, 2.-syasyele, 3.-syasyalizya, 4.-syasyalila, 5.-syasyalilalyo, 6.-syasyalisya, 7.-syasyala-syasyala, 8.-syasyalilana)

feel weak with pain, Mubili ulasyasyamuna antela njanda kubaa bulwazi bwatuntumaanzi. = My body is feeling weak, perhaps I am about to get malaria. (1.-syasyamunwa, 2.-syasyamwide, 3.-syasyamuzya, 4.-syasyamwida, 5.-syasyamwidalyo, 6.-syasyamunisya, 7.-syasyamunasyasyamuna, 8.-syasyamwidana)

whisper to, Kosyasyamwina kwaambaula batakumvwi bantu. Whisper so that people don't hear you. (1.-syasyamwinwa, 2.-syasyamwide, 3.-syasyamwizya, 4.-syasyamwida, 5.-syasyamwidalyo, 6.-syasyamunisya, 7.-syasyamwina-syasyamwina, 8.-syasyamwidana)

run fast, Suntwe wakalusyataula lubilo ndwatanatijaanide. = The hyena ran faster than he had ever run before. (1.-syataulwa, 2.-syatawide, 3.-syatauzya, 4.-syatawida, 5.-syatawidalyo, 6.-syataulisya, 7.-syataula-syatula)
Also: -syangila. (1.-syaulwa, 2.-syauzya, 3.-syauzya 4.-syaulila, 5.-syaulilalyo, 6.-syaulisya, 7.-syaula-syaula, 8.-syaulana)

speak with hoarse voice, hiss, Takanani kabotu, jwi lyakwe lilasyeema. She does not speak well, she has a hoarse voice. Muntu ulaa jwi lisyee ma tamvwugwi kabotu. = A person with a hoarse voice is not heard easily. Mangoye wakali kusyeema naakabona mubwa. = The cat was hissing when it saw the dog. (1.-syeemwa, 2.-syeemede, 3.-syeemya, 4.-syeemena, 5.-syeemenalyo, 6.-syeemesya, 7.-syeema-syeema, 8.-syeemenana)

make to slope, bend, Koolola mulomo wajamba wasyelebala. = Straighten the blade of the plough which is bent inwards. (1.-syelebalwa, 2.-syelebede, 3.-syelebeka, 4.-syelebalila, 5.-syelebalilalyo, 6.-syelebalisya, 7.-syelebala-syelebala, 8.-syelebalilana)
what is concave, rt. -syelebala, Musimbi oyu ulisyelebede kucibuno. = The waist of this girl is concave.

graze, bruise, Nindali kusya lulindi kwananda, jamba lyandisyepula acituta. When I was digging the foundation of the house, the hoe grazed my foot. (1.-syepulwa, 2.-syepwide, 3.-syepuzya, 4.-syepwida, 5.-syepwidalyo, 6.-syepulisya, 7.-syepula-syepula, 8.-syepulana) Also: -yepula, -epula.

be occupied in doing, Baama basyibingana kujikila beenzu. = Mother is busy cooking for the visitors. Nkaambo kakuti banyina Chaalama bakacili kusyibingana, tiibakali kuyanda kufwambaana kwaanjila makani aaya. Because the mother of Chaalama was busily occupied with other things, she did not wish to quickly become involved in such matters. (1.-syibinganwa, 2.-syibingene, 3.-syibinganya, 4.-syibinganina, 5.-syibinganinalyo, 6.-syibinganisya, 7.-syibingana-syibingana, 8.-syibinganinana)
  • become dark as the sky when rain threatens to fall, Inga kuya kusondela anze, wajana kujulu kwasyibingana. = When he peeped outside he found the sky was black with rain-clouds.

dig for, rt. sya, Umwi mulombwana wakajaya mubwa wakwe. Ooyu mubwa wakamusyida cuumbwe cakuti amuzikke. One man killed his dog. He dug a grave for this dog so that he would bury it. (1.-syidwa, 2.-syide, 3.-syisya, 4.-syida, 5.-syidalyo, 6.-syisya, 7.-syida-syida, 8.-syidana)

dig out for, rt. -sya, Kuti twasyidila zisamu zyamalo, ntunga zilakakilwa kututantila akutusipila malowa eesu. If we dig out small poles for our beds, the maggots cannot reach us and suck our blood. (1.-syidilwa, 2.-syidilide, 3.-syidizya, 4.-syidila, 5.-syidilalyo, 6.-syidilisya, 7.-syidila-syidila, 8.-syidilana) Also: -sidila.

breathe deeply, Kuyoya wiile kusyiima akaambo kakufwundilila. = She breathes deeply because of asthmatic attacks. (1.-syiimwa, 2.-syiimide, 3.-syiimya, 4.-syiimina, 5.-syiiminalyo, 6.-syiimisya, 7.-syiima-syiima, 8.-syiiminana)
  • act with vigour, Ooyu muntu wasyiima buya kuuma kana kaniini. = This one severely beat a small child.
  • exhale Nabulongo wakuntumana, wamwanguka, watambala, wasyiima, walibanda akulidundaizya. = Nabulongo stood up with legs apart, she danced with joy, she exhaled, she gave herself praise names, she was very proud of herself.

sprain oneself, Sibbola wasyikuka gondo naawa. The footballer sprained his knee when he fell. Also: -fwuyuka. (1.-syikukwa, 2.-syikukide, 3.-syikusya, 4.-syikukila, 5.-syikukilalyo, 6.-syikukisya, 7.-syikuka-syikuka, 8.-syikulana)

get burnt and stick to the bottom of a pot, Musozya wasyilila nciwatanona. The samp has got burnt sticking to the bottom of the pot, that is why it is not nice. (1.-syilizyigwa, 2.-syilide, 3.-syilizya, 4.-syililila, 5.-syilililalyo, 6.-syililisya, 7.-syilila-syilila, 8.-syilizyanya)

move quickly, hurry along, Nabwiinga wakatalika kusyililika kuya kubana koomusimbi, abalo bakali kusyililika kuza kukuswaangana anabwiinga. The bridegroom started to move quickly towards the in-laws and they also moved quickly to meet the bridegroom. (1.-syililikwa, 2.-syililikide, 3.-syililizya, 4.-syililikila, 5.-syililikilalyo, 6.-syililikisya, 7.-syililika-syililika, 8.-syililikana |
syililikanina)

show sign of unhappiness, disagreement, unwillingness, Musimbi walikusyilimbuka naali kukanana abanyina. The daughter showed an unhappy face when she was talking with her mother. Bana, kamufwambaana kuyumuka, mutani kwiide kusyilimbuka. Children get up quickly, dont show a disagreeable face.
  • show resistance, Citima nocisika kutulundu ku Ndola, cilasyilimbuka, cileenda buniini. = When the train reaches the hills of Ndola it shows the strain, it moves slowly. Nopakila, nofwulidila buti yalo mfwuko yakwe yiide kuunduluka ilasyilimbuka ilazima, busi tiibuleti pe. = No matter how you packed it or blew on it his pipe would just smoke a little and fail to ignite and go out, it did not produce any smoke. (1.-syilimbukwa, 2.-syilimbukide, 3.-syilimbuzya, 4.-syilimbukila, 5.-syilimbukilalyo, 6.-syilimbukisya, 7.-syilimbukasyilimbuka, 8.-syilimbusyanya) Also: -syomboloka.

give a person an unfriendly look, Andilanga wiile kusyimbula kubusyu kube kuli ncindamucita cipati. = When she looks at me she looks with an unfriendly look as if I did something serious to her. Kwa Kagelo takuswaigwi inga wiide kusyimbula. One could not visit Kagelo's home because he always gives an unfriendly look. Mucende ulasyimbula nalibambila kulwana mweenzinyina. = A bull looks with hostility when he is about to fight with another bull. (1.-syimbulwa, 2.-syimbwide, 3.-syimbuzya, 4.-syimbwida, 5.-syimbwidalyo, 6.-syimbulisya, 7.-syimbula-syimbula, 8.-syimbwidana)

(Ila) narrate, announce, demonstrate, Kamundisyimwina makanaaza. = Tell me about this matter. (1.-syimwinwa,2.-syimwine, 3.-syimwizya, 4.-syimwinina, 5.-syimwininalyo, 6.-syimwinisya, 7.-syimwina-syimwina, 3.-syimwinana) Also: -simwina, -Iwiida.

squint, Ooyu sicikolo ulasyinama kubala mubbuku. = This school-boy squints when reading a book. (1.-syinamwa, 2.-syinamide, 3.-syinamya, 4.-syinamina, 5.-syinaminalyo, 6.-syinamisya, 7.-syinama-syinama, 8.-syinaminana) Also: -sinama

be busy using a charm, Twakajana munanga ulasyindauka kusilika mulwazi. = We found the witchdoctor busy using charms to heal the patient. (1.-syindaukwa, 2.-syindaukide, 3.-syindauzya, 4.-syindaukila, 5.-syindaukilalyo, 6.-syindaukisya, 7.-syindaukasyindauka, 8.-syindaukana) Also: -indauka.

smear, Murnanda iijikila muyandika kusyingulula. = The kitchen needs to be smeared. Basimbi balaa nkutwe mbabayanda kusyingulula maandaabo. Industrious girls like to polish their houses. (1.-syingululwa, 2.-singulwide, 3.-syinguluzya, 4.-syingulwida, 5.-syingulwidalyo, 7.-syingulula-syingulula, 8.-syingululana)
waste, Mwana mutaka wakaunka mudolopo kuya kusyinya lubono lunji. The prodigal went to the city to waste much wealth. Also: -sinya,-nyonyoona.
waste, rt. -syinya, Lubono Iwakasyinyikila mukuvwuula. = The wealth was wasted in immoral conduct.

bare teeth, Mangoye naakabona mubwa wakasyipula menyo. = When the cat saw the dog, it bared its teeth. (1.-syipulwa, 2.-syipide, 3.-syipuzya, 4.-syipwida, 5.-syipwidalyo, 6.-syipulisya, 7.-syipula-syipula, 8.-syipwidana) Also: -syitula menyo.
try to do something, Namalelo wakali kusyisyilisya kuteya musamu kutegwa mukazinyina alekwe kumulumi. The first wife was trying to plant charms so that the second wife would be sent away.
prophesy, Mukamwini munzi nguutyungilila bantu kuti kabasyisyima. The owner of the village is the one who encouraged the people to prophesy.
be seated, Mutinta a banyina bakasyite mucimvwule cakali akati kamunzi. = Mutinta and her mother were seated in the shade which was in the middle of the village. (1.-syitwe, 2.-syite)

show teeth in an aggressive fashion, bare teeth, Kuti mubwa wanyema, ulafwambaana kusyitula menyo. If a dog is angry, it quickly bares its teeth. Also: -nyenuna menyo. (1.-syitulwa, 2.-syitwide, 3.-syituzya, 4.-syitwida, 5.-syitwidalyo, 6.-syitulisya, 7.-syitula-syitula, 8.-syitwidana)

rub, Wali kulisyoba maulu. She was rubbing her legs. Kuti umuke kulitondezya kuti ulamuyanda musimbi oyu ncobeni, utakanyandwi waakuteelela kuti kuli kale umbi umusyoba nkolo. If you are slow in showing that you truly love this girl, do not be surprised when you hear that there is another who is fondling her breasts. (1.-syobwa, 2.-syobede, 3.-syobya, 4.-syobela, 5.-syobelalyo, 6.-syobesya, 7.-syoba-syoba, 8.-syobana)
  • rub on the forehead or nose seeking reward or good luck, Sena kuti ndakuzabusya mutala amulonga, ulakonzya kuyakundipa mpasela yakulisyoba ankumo? If I help you cross the river can you give me something extra for to rub on the forehead? Naakkoyo naakali kuyuba basimalungu, wakali kulisyoba ampemo kutegwa batamuboni. When Naakkoyo was hiding from the slave-traders, she was rubbing herself on the forehead so that she would not be seen.
  • crush, Bacembele basyoba tombwe wamumpemo. The old woman is crushing tobacco for snuff.
  • afflict, Nzala anyota zyakabasyoba mwida. Hunger and thirst afflicted them. Also: -subula.

crush, Bakandisyobaula moonono woonse. They smashed the whole bridge of my nose. Atweendesye inga limwi kaya kutweenzya akutusyobaula myeebo. Let us go quickly or he might catch up on us and smash our jaws.

wipe spear or rifle, polish knives with oil or fat, Wakasyobola nyeele zyakwe amafwuta ambono. He polished his musical horns with castor oil. Mudaala wakalisyobola mumaanza kulinanika mafwuta ankuku. The old man was rubbing his hands, oiling them with chicken-fat. Wakalisyobola kumulomo mpoonya wakoona. He wiped his mouth thereupon he fell asleep. Wakalisyobola mabboli kumeso. He wiped the dried mucous from his eyes. Ndilisyobole kumeso, ndicilangisye kapati cakuli-domenena. Let me wipe my eyes so that I kook at it carefully and satisfy myself. (1.-syobolwa, 2.-syobwede, 3.-syobozya, 4.-syobweda, 5.-syobwedalyo, 6.-syobolesya, 7.-syobola-syobola, 8.-syobolana) Also: -syoobola, -pukuta. Also: -buzisya.

crush as green maize, Bamuka Chiimbwe bakasyoboonta mароpwe matete nkaambo mulumaabo wakanyina menyo. = The wife of Chiimbwe was crushing green maize because her husband had no teeth. (1.-syoboontwa, 2.-syoboontede, 3.-syoboontezya, 4.-syoboontela, 5.-syoboontelalyo, 6.-syoboontesya, 7.-syoboonta-syoboonta, 8.-syoboontana) Also: -kanta-kanta.

crush for someone, as fresh maize grains before roasting, Mukaintu wakwe wakali kumusyoboontela mapopwe matete akwaabikka mukkweelele kuti ayokwe. = His wife used to crush fresh maize grains for him and put them in a sheath of a maize-cob to roast them. (1.-syoboontelwa, 2.-syoboontede)

be stepped upon or pressed upon, Kapongo kakabbanyuka akumusyodola amwiindi Sicibende. = The goat jumped and stepped on Sicibende's leg. (1.-syodolwa, 2.-syodwede, 3.-syodozya, 4.-syodweda, 5.-syodwedalyo, 6.-syodolesya, 7.-syodola-syodola, 8.-syodolana)

be bruised, Muzibelo wakalizimbide akaambo kakusyodaulwa minimba. She has swollen thighs because of the pinches with which she has been bruised. (2.-syodawidwe, 3.-syodauzyigwa, 4.-syodawidwa, 5.-syodawidwalyo, 7.-syodaulwa-syodaulwa)

break or sprain a limb, Ndasyokoka kuboko. I have sprained my arm. (1.-syokokwa, 2.-syokokede, 3.-syokosya, 4.-syokokela, 5.-syokokelalyo, 6.-syokokesya, 7.-syokoka-syokoka, 8.-syokolana) Also: -fwuyuka, -tyoka -pizuka.
inquire, investigate, Koya ukazumanane kusyokola kaambo aaka kwa Mwanza. Go and continue investigating on this matter in the Mwanza area.

insult one by showing a look of contempt and making a derisive sound with the tongue, Ndakazikumusyola nkaambo ndakalinyemede. I insulted him by using a derisive sound of the tongue because I was annoyed. Koleka kundisyola musyolo. Stop hissing at me in contempt. Bacembele bakaunka bayabutongooka akusyola akubaamba buunyu basiisi ba Mubita. = The old lady went off complaining and hissing and accusing the lady-teacher Mubita of being mean. (1.-syolwa, 2.-syolede, 3.-syolezya, 4.-syolela, 5.-syolelalyo, 6.-syolesya, 7.-syola-syola, 8.-syolana)
complain, Wakasyolauka naakamvwa kuti mwanaakwe wakakaka kuunka kucikolo. He complained when he heard that his child had refused to go to school.

answer in an insolent tone, become angry, Taciluzi kusyoleka kubazyali bako. = It is not right to answer your parents in an angry tone. Batalika kusyoleka: "Buka, omwana wamu Zambezi." He began in an angry voice, "Get up, child of the Zambezi." (1.-syolekwa, 2.-syolekede, 3.-syolezya, 4.-syolekela, 5.-syolekelalyo, 6.-syolekesya, 7.-syoleka-syoleka, 8.-syolekana)

be flat-buttocked, as elephant, Uulya wakaile kusyolobala kumatako naakamana kuciswa. = That one became flat-buttocked after having been sick. (1.-syolobalwa, 2.-syolobete, 3.-syolobeka, 4.-syolobalila, 5.-syolobalilayo, 6.-syolobalisya, 7.-syolobalasyolobala, 8.-syolobalilana) Also: -syelebala, -syotobala, -syondobalas, -cotobala.

hiss in pain without words, Mulwazi wakasyoloma naakafwundilizigwa mupayi. The patient was groaning when he was receiving the 'steaming treatment' under the blanket. (1.-syolomwa, 2.-syolomede, 3.-syolomya, 4.-syolomena, 5.-syolomenalyo, 6.-syolomesya, 7.-syoloma-syoloma, 8.-syolomenana)

toss in pain, Mulwazi wacimvwa kusyolomba masiku oonse. = The patient was tired tossing in pain all night. Kumunzi mweenzinyina wakali kusyolomba nkocakali kuwanta kucisa. = At the village his friend was tossing when the pain began to throb. Also: -tongela, -bbulungana. (1.-syolombwa, 2.-syolombede, 3.-syolombya, 4.-syolombela, 5.-syolombelalyo, 6.-syolombesya, 7.-syolomba-syolomba, 8.-syolombanizyanya)
make sound of contempt with mouth, rt. -syola, Mulozi tayelede kusyolomwana musyolo. = A witch should not make the sound of contempt with the tongue.

show displeasure, be unwilling, grumble, Bana babi balasyolooka nobatumwa. Bad children grumble when they are being sent for something. Also: -syimbula, -nyonooka. (1.-syolookwa, 2.-syolookede, 3.-syoloozya, 4.-syolookela, 5.-syolookelalyo, 6.-syolookesya, 7.-syolooka-syolooka, 8.-syolookana)
chide, reprimand, Banyina balaa lubweko basyolookela bana babo. A mother who is of a quarrelsome disposition chides her children. Also: -bwentela.

trust, depend on, Mebo ndasyoma kuti ncimwamutuma uyakucileta. I have hope that he will bring the thing for which you sent him. Tuleelede kusyoma muli Leza. = We should trust in God. (1.-syomwa, 2.-syomede, 3.-syomya, /-syomenzya, 4.-syomena, 5.-syomenalyo, 6.-syomesya, 7.-syomasyoma, 8.-syomana.)

refuse to pay attention when called, Tofwambaani kuboola, wiile kusyomboloka. = You do not hurry in coming, you just pay no attention. (1.-syombolokwa, 2.-syombolokede, 3.-syombolozya, 4.-syombolokela, 5.-syombolokelalyo, 6.-syombolokesya, 7.-syomboloka-syombaloka, 8.-syombolokana) Also: -syilimbuka.

be trustworthy, rt. syoma, Ulacileta cimbwali nkaambo ulasyomeka. She will bring the sweet potatoes because she is trustworthy. Bantu basyomeka balacita ncibasyomezya. Trustworthy people do what they promise to do. (1.-syomekwa, 2.-syomekede, 3.-syomezya, 4.-syomekela, 5.-syomekelalyo, 6.-syomekesya, 7.-syomeka-syomeka, 8.-syomekana)
  • insert, Bataata basyomeka keembe mumwiini. My father is inserting the axe-blade in the handle. Wamana kusama, wakasyomeka kansanga kabwizu mumutwe kati nkacoolwe. = When he had finished dressing, he inserted a blade of grass in his head saying it was for luck. Also: -sekka, -kwikka.
  • repair, Mufwuzi usyomeka cibulo cameenda. = The blacksmith is repairing the pail used for drawing water.
be inserted, Ankomo yajekete kwaasyomekedwe kapepa kankamu yamabbelekela amwi. = In the pocket of his jacket was inserted a card of the workers union.

promise, Wakandisyomezya kuti uyakucileta cisani cangu, kumane tacileti. = He promised to bring my cloth, but he did not bring it. Kosyomezya kuti uyakuboola juunza. = Promise that you will come tomorrow. (1.-syomezyegwa, 2.-syomezyede, 3.-syomezyesya, 4.-syomezyezya, 5.-syomezyezyalyo, 6.-syomezyesya, 7.-syomezya-syomezya, 8.-syomezyanya)

lose trust in, Myoyo yesu toonse tuleelede twiibikke mulusyomo lomwe Iwakuyanda mvwula kutali kusyomonona pe. = We ought to put our hearts in the one aim of seeking rain and not lose hope. (1.-syomononwa, 2.-syomonwede, 3.-syomonozya, 4.-syomonweda, 5.-syomonwedalyo, 6.-syomononesya, 7.-syomononasyomonona, 8.-syomononana)

become narrower, Noluka cisuwo taceelede kusyompola kumatako. When you weave a basket it should not be narrower at the base. (1.-syompolwa, 2.-syompwede, 3.-syompozya, 4.-syompweda 5.-syompwedalyo, 6.-syompolesya, 7.-syompola-syompola, 8.-syompozyanya)

be narrow at the base in shape, Eeci cibiya tiicakabumbwa kabotu, cakasyompoka. This pot was not moulded well, it is too narrow at the base. (1.-syompokwa, 2.-syompokede, 3.-syompokezya, 4.-syompokela, 5.-syompokelalyo, 6.-syompokesya, 7.-syompoka-syompoka, 8.-syompokezyanya) Also: -syopoka.

bruise, crush, Citima cakabasyonda bana nocakainda. = The train crushed the children when it passed. Nindali kugagaila mpikili, ndalisyonda amunwe. When I was hammering a nail, I bruised myself on the finger. (1.-syondwa, 2.-syondele, 3.-syondya, 4.-syondela, 5.-syondelalyo, 6.-syondesya, 7.-syonda-syonda, 8.-syondana)

squeeze together, Bantu bakali kusyondana mucitima. = The people were crowded together in the train. (1.-syondanwa, 2.-syondene, 3.-syondanya, 4.-syondanina, 5.-syondaninalyo, 6.-syondanisya, 7.-syondana-syondana, 8.-syondana)
crush, Kamusyonda-syonda musamu wamulwazi. = Crush the medicine of the patient. Also: -umpula

beat to pulp, crush, Zitende bazisyondaula nibazilyata anola. = They crushed the pumpkins when they passed over them with a waggon. Baalumi basyondaula mabwe limwi Iwaba lusu. = The men crushed the stones until they became powder. (1.-syondaulwa, 2.-syondawide, 3.-syondauzya, 4.-syondawida, 5.-syondawidalyo, 6.-syondaulisya, 7.-syondaula-syondaula, 8.-syondaulana)

push through, Ndakali kulisyondelezya mubantu banji kutegwa ndibone muleli wacisi. = I was pushing through the crowd so that I would see the president. (1.-syondelezyegwa, 2.-syondelezyede, 3.-syondelezya, 4.-syondelezyezya, 5.-syondelezyezyalyo, 6.-syondelezyesya, 7.-syondelezya-syondelezya, 8.-syondelezyanya) Also: -ondelezya.

have flat buttocks, Ooyu musimbi wakalineneede kaindi, sunu wakasyondobala. This girl was fat long ago but today she is flat-buttocked. (1.-syondobalwa, 2.-syondobele, 3.-syondobazya, 4.-syondobalila, 5.-syondobalilalyo, 6.-syondobalisya, 7.syondobala-syondobala, 8.-syondobalilana) Also: -syolobala, -syelebala, -syotobala.

mulomo swell the lips in derision, Nakantu wakasyondola mulomo naakabona mukazinyina nkwasamide kabotu. Nakantu swelled her lips in displeasure when she saw her co-wife dressed nicely. Also: -lepula mulomo, -syundula mulomo.

be in an angry mood, Wabaa nzi ncotaseki abantunyoko? Sena inga kosyondomana anga uli sikutulwanya? = What is wrong with you that you do not laugh with other human beings? Are you in an angry mood so that you want to fight with us? (1.-syondomanwa, 2.-syondomene 3.-syondomanya, 4.-syondomanina, 5.-syodomaninalyo, 6.-syondomanisya, 7.-syondomana-syondomana, 8.-syondomaninana)

crush by beating, Muzovwu wakamusyondoola muvwimi wakajisi ntobolo. = The elephant crushed the hunter who had a gun. (1.-syondoolwa, 2.-syondweede, 3.-syondoozya, 4.-syondweeda, 5.-syondweedalyo, 6.-syondoolesya, 7.-syondoola-syondoola, 8.-syondoolana) Also: -pondoola, -syondoonda.

crush, Mapopwe baasyondoonda acilayi. The maize was crushed by the sledge. Munyati wamusyondoonda weembela nombe. = A buffalo crushed the cattle herder. Umwi mucembele wakaisyondoonda ngoma yakwe naakajana unyina tombwe mukati. = One old woman crushed her snuff box when she found there was no tobacco in it. Also: -pondoola, -syondaula.

propose marriage, Moomba wakali kusyonga musimbi kuti akakwate. Moomba was trying to persuade the girl to marry him. Tacili cibotu kusyonga mwana muniini. It is not good to entice a young child sexually. (1.-syongwa, 2.-syongede, 3.-syongezya, 4.-syongela, 5.-syongelalyo, 6.-syongelesya, 7.-syonga-syonga, 8.-syongelana) Also: -ambauzya.

lower eyes shyly, Musimbi naakabona musankwa wakwe wakali kusyongooma. When the girl saw her boyfriend she lowered her eyes in shyness. Also: -sintaama, -ongoonga (1.-syongoomwa, 2.-syongoomede, 3.-syongoomya, 4.-syongoomena, 5.-syongoomenalyo, 6.-syongoomesya, 7.-syongooma-syongooma, 8.-syongoomenana)

push into narrow hole, Kamusyonka cisani aawo mapopwe atanikwiindi. = Squeeze the cloth into the hole so that the maize-grains do not pass through it. Bajayi babasyonka zisani kumulomo bana. The murderers stuffed clothes into the mouths of the children. (1.-syonkwa, 2.-syonkede, 3.-syonkezya 4.-syonkela, 5.-syonkelalyo, 6.-syonkesya, 7.-syonka-syonka, 8.-syonkana)

push with, rt. -syonka, Kosyonsya kasamu nzoka mubwina. = Push the snake into the hole with a stick. (1.-syonsyegwa, 2.-syonsyede, 3.-syonsyezya, 4.-syonsyela, 5.-syonsyelalyo, 6.-syonsyesya 7.-syonsya-syonsya, 8.-syonsyana)

seriously reprimand, Bali kusyonsyonezya musimbi wakabba mayi. = They were reprimanding the girl who stole the eggs. Kamusyonsyonezya mukaintu wakasimuka kumulumi. = Reprimand the woman who ran away from her husband. (1.-syonsyonezyegwa, 2.-syonsyonezyede, 3.-syonsyonezya, 4.syonsyonezyezya, 5.-syonsyonezyezyalyo, 6.-syonsyonezyesya, 7.-syonsyonezyasyonsyonezya, 8.-syonsyonezyanya) Also: -sinkimika.

rub with oil, e.g Mainza wakatalika kusamba akulisyoobola. = Mainza began to wash and oil himself. (1.-syoobolwa, 2.-syoobolede, 3.-syoobozya, 4.-syoobolela, 5.-syoobolelalyo, 6.-syoobolesya, 7.-syoobola-syoobola, 8.-syoobolana)

take revenge by beating, Musankwa mubi wabasyoolezya bana mbaajana munzila nkaambo bakamuseka. The evil boy beat the children he found on the way because they laughed at him. (1.-syoolezyegwa, 2.-syoolezyede, 3.-syoolezya, 4.-syoolezyezya, 5.-syoolezyezyalyo, 6.-syoolezyesya, 7.-syoolezya-syoolezya, 8.-syoolezyanya)

simmer, hiss, Insima yabizwa ilasyooma. = When the well cooked nsima is ready, it simmers. Meenda ali acikko atalika kusyooma. = The water on the fire has begun to simmer. (1.-syoomwa, 2.-syoomede, 3.-syoomya, 4.-syoomena, 5.-syoomenalyo, 6.-syoomesya, 7.-syooma-syooma) Also: -cooma, siima, -fwufwuma.

be narrow at one end, Cibiya ncaakabumba jilo cakasyopoka kutako. = The pot which she moulded yesterday became narrow at the bottom. Also: -syompoka. (1.-syopokwa, 2.-syopokede, 3.-syoposya, 4.-syopokela. 5.-syopokelalyo, 6.-syopokesya, 7.-syopoka-syopoka)
be narrow in shape, Mutwe wakwe wakali mulamfwu, usyopokede alimwi kaujisi mpanza. = His head was long, oval-shaped and he was bald. Also: -syompoka.
smoulder, Zikuni zitete taziyaki kabotu, ziide kusyosyoma. = Wet logs do not burn well, they just smoluder.
have flat buttocks, (1.-syotobalwa, 2.-syotobele, 3.-syotobezya, 4.-syotobalila, 5.-syotobalilalyo, 6.-syotobalisya, 7.-syotobala-syotobala, 8.-syotobalilana) Also: -syolobala.
be smooth, Basimbi nibali kutwa musozya, wafwambaana kusyubuka. = When the girls were pounding the samp it quickly became smooth. Also: -sumbula

use blunt end of pestel when pounding, Baama basyubula musozya muncili. = Mother is pounding the maize grains mixed with water in the mortar. Mu Mujibelo baleelede kusyubula, elyo mu Musumbuluko bakatwe. = On Saturday they should remove the husks by stamping and then on Monday they should pound it to flour. (1.-syubulwa, 2.-syubwide, 3.-syubuzya, 4.-syubwida, 5.-syubwidalyo, 6.-syubulisya, 7.-syubula-syubula, 8.-syubwidana)

strip leaves from branches, Ndajana cisyu cakamana kumbewu, ndaile kusyukuntula matu masyoonto biyo. When I found that the vegetables were finished in the garden, I just plucked a few leaves. (1.-syukuntulwa, 2.-syukuntwide, 3.-syukuntuzya, 4.-syukuntwida, 5.-syukuntwidalyo, 6.-syukuntulisya, 7.-syukuntula-syukuntula, 8.-syukuntwidana) Also: -syukutula.

move with scraping noise, Ndamvwa muntu walikusyukuta masiku. = I heard someone moving at night. Bana bacikolo tabeelede kusyukuta bayi nobapandulula ciiyo. = Pupils should not be moving their feet when the teacher is explaining the lesson. Twamvwa uzyana naali kusyukuta anze. = We heard the dancing witch scraping his feet outside. Mudaala, koleka kusyukuta noenda. = Old man, stop scraping your feet on the ground when you walk. (1.-syukutwa, 2.-syukutide, 3.-syukutya, 4.-syukutila, 5.-syukutilalyo, 6.-syukutisya, 7.-syukuta-syukuta, 8.-syukutilana)
  • scrape off with teeth, Bana baasyukuta mapopwe oonse. = The children are scraping off all the maize with their teeth. Also: -syuta.

strip branches of leaves, Balimi basyukutula mapopwe aacili matete. = The farmers are stripping the maize which is still fresh. (1.-syukutulwa, 2.-syukutwide, 3.-syukutuzya, 4.-syukutwida, 5.-syukutwidalyo, 6.-syukutisya, 7.-syukutula-syukutula, 8.-syukutwidana) Also: -syukuntula.

screw up your face in a repulsive way, Amulange muntu usyulungana mbuli wamvwa cinunka. = Look at the one who is screwing up his face as if he had smelt something stinking. Inombe nozitilimuka, mucende ulatanta akalundu. Ulalangisya mumbali, ulasyulungana, ulasinta cabukali. = When the cows tremble, the bull climbs a hill. He looks intently to the side, he screws up his face, he bellows in anger. (1.-syulunganwa, 2.-syulungene, 3.-syulunganya, 4.-syuluganina, 5.-syulunganinalyo, 6.-syulunganisya, 7.-syulungana-syulungana 8.-syulunganizyanya)
have faced twisted, Muvwimi wakamujana Mutinta ananda yakwe kasyulungene akunyema kapati. = The hunter found Mutinta at her house with her face distorted with a great anger. Also: -syuulungana.

become ugly, Sena mukaintu taasyulusigwa abubaya bwakwe akulya zilyo zitajikwi kabotu? = Has the woman not become ugly because of her carelessness and not eating well-prepared food. (2.-syulusyide, 3.-syulusya, 4.-syulusyizya, 5.-syulusyizyalyo, 6.-syulusyisya, 7.-syulusigwa-syulusigwa, 8.-syulusyanya) Also: -fwulusigwa.

lose health, Nzintu zinji zisyulusya bantu mbuli bulwazi bwasikalileke. There are many things which cause people to lose their health like AIDS. (1.-syulusigwa, 2.-syulusyide, 3.-syulusya, 4.-syulusyizya, 5.-syulusyizyalyo, 6.-syulusyisya, 7.-syulusya-syulusya, 8.-syulusyanya) Also: -fwulusya.

pinch, Bacembele bakamusyuna cimoni mwana. The old woman gave the child a pinch. Also: -syamba. (1.-syunwa, 2.-syunide, 3.-syunizya, 4.-syunina, 5.-syuninalyo, 6.-syunisya, 7.-syuna-syuna, 8.-syunana)

be annoyed, Bamuka Chimuka bakali kusyundauka nibabona mukazinyina. Mrs. Chimuka was annoyed when she saw her co-wife. (1.-syundaukwa, 2.-syundaukide, 3.-syundauzya, 4.-syundaukila, 5.-syundaukilalyo, 6.-syundaukisya, 7.-syundaukasyundauka, 8.-syundaukana) Also: -fwulauka.

stick as sweet-potatoes into embers, cover potatoes with embers, Kocisyundila cimbwali mulufwuse omu njanda kulya cabizwa. Stick these potatoes in the ashes, I want to eat what is cooked. Kamusyundila cimbwali mulufwuse lupya. = Stick the sweet potatoe in hot ashes. Nkooko kotambula bulungu oobu, usyundile mumasusu aako. = Here is this bead, you can stick it in your hair. Bantu bamwi mbabi kuminwe, ibanga kufwumbwa kantu nokaceya buti nkubba akusyundila mumasookesi. Some people use their fingers in a bad way, in that however small a thing may be, it is stolen and stuck in their socks. (1.-syundilwa, 2.-syundilide, 3.-syundizya, 4.-syundilila, 5.-syundililalyo, 6.-syundilisya, 7.-syundila-syundila, 8.-syundilana)
show stubbourness, Nabulongo taakali kusyunduluka mbuli bamakaintu bamwi pe. Nabulongo was not stubbourn like some women.

protrude the lips, pout, Sikabuko ulasyundumana nokunyina mbwaaba. A moody person pouts even though nothing has happened. Sicibende wakasyundumana naakabona kuti beenzinyina bakali kumuseka akaambo kakukululwa. Sicibende pouted when he saw his friends who were laughing at him because of been shaven.
  • Kosyundumana kubeleka notiifwambaane kumanizya mulimo. Work hard so that you quickly finish the work. (1.-syundumanwa, 2.-syundumene, 3.-syundumanya, 4.-syundumanina, 5.-syundumaninalyo, 6.-syundumanisya, 7.-syundumana-syundumana, 8.-syundumaninana) Also: -syuulala, -lundumana mulomo.
hide, suppress, Baindilila akusyungula kuti kufwumbwa ncajisi nkokuti ncakubba. They were further hiding the fact that what he had was got by theft. =

suck, Bana basyunta mango aabizwide. The children are sucking ripe mangoes. Also: -syuunta. (1.-syuntwa, 2.-syuntide, 3.-syuntya, 4.-syuntila, 5.-syuntilalyo, 6.-syuntisya. 7.-syunta-syunta, 8.-syuntana)
be difficult, (ety. Chilapalapa) Candisyupa. = It is difficult for me. (1.-syupwa, 2.-syupide, 3.-syupya, 4.-syupila, 5.-syupilalyo, 6.-syupisya, 7.-syupa-syupa, 8.-syupana)

be difficult, Wakasyupeka kapati kujana akoona akulya mumazuba aya ali atatu. = It became very difficult to find a place to sleep and to eat for three days. (1.-syupekwa, 2.-syupikide, 4.-syupekela, 5.-syupekelalyo, 6.-syupekesya, 7.-syupeka-syupeka, 8.-syupekana)

come out of one's grip, slip from one's grasp, Yandisyupuka nswi njindajatide kale. The fish which I had already caught slipped out of my grasp. Mwana wandisyupuka nkaambo ndananide mafwuta mumaanza. = The child slipped because my hands were smeared with oil. (1.-syupukwa, 2.-syupukide, 3.-syupusya, 4.-syupukila, 5.-syupukilalyo, 6.-syupukisya, 7.-syupuka-supuka, 8.-syupukana) Also: -supula, -pusyuka.

escape as animal from trap, Kanamusya kalicedwe kumane kasyu pula. The duiker which was trapped eventually escaped. (1.-syupulwa, 2.-supwide, 3.-syupuzya, 4.-syupwida, 5.-syupwidalyo, 6.-syupulisya, 7.-syupula-syupula, 8.-syupulana) Also: -supula.

descend with difficulty, Ndakamuswaangana naselela cilundu uza busyusyuka, uyumwide cileye cankuni. = I met her when she came down the slope, coming with difficulty carrying a bundle of firewood. Kaindi bana bakali kunyonka bakali kukomena cini-cini cakuti kumubbala kusyule nkusyusyuka! = In the past the sucking children were really growing big so that if you carried one on the back you would be staggering. (1.-syusyukwa, 2.-syusyukide, 3.-syusyusya, 4.-syusyukila, 5.-syusyukilalyo, 6.-syusyukisya, 7.-syusyuka-syusyuka, 8.-syusyusyanya)

eat a bone clean, gnaw, Wasyuta nyama kuzwa kucifwuwa. = He is eating the meat off the bone. Bana basyuta mango aatabizwide. The children are eating unripe mangoes. (1.-syutwa, 2.-syutide, 3.-syutya, 4.-syutila, 5.-syutilalyo, 6.-syutisya, 7.-syuta-syuta, 8.-syutana) Also: -kunya, -kukuta.
come out clearly, Naaka-fwotolwa cifwanikiso cakasyutuka. = When he was photographed his picture came out clearly.

be built up as from a sickness, Bataata sunu basyuuka nkaambo bakapona. My father is building up his energy because he has recovered nowadays. (1.-syuukwa, 2.-syuukide, 3.-syuuzya, 4.-syuukila, 5.-syuukilalyo, 6.-syuukisya, 7.-syuuka-syuuka, 8.-syuusyanya)
  • sprout leaves, bud, Zisamu nzitwakasimpa zyakasyuuka. = The trees which we planted have sprouted. Cakali ciindi camweto, lusamu-samu kalusyuuka. = It was the cold season when the trees were budding.

sprout leaves, *Cakali ciindi cacilimo mumwezi wa Itwi, zisamu mbuli myuumba azimwi zisamu zyamusyokwe mpozisyuukila matuvwu.* = It was the dry season in the month of August when the trees like *myuumba* and others of the bush begin to sprout leaves.

wipe, as table, *Kamu-syuula atebule kusalale.* = Wipe the table so that it is clean. Also: -*pukuta*. (1.-*syuulwa*, 2.-*syuulide*, 3.-*syuuzya*, 4.-*syuwida*, 5.-*syuwidalyo*, 6.-*syuulisya*, 7.-*syuula-syuula*, 8.-*syuulana*)

protrude lips, *Ncinzi cakucima osyuulala?* = What has annoyed that you? Also: -*syundumana*. (1.-*syuulalwa*, 2.-*syuulalide*, 3.-*syuulazya*, 4.-*syuulalila*, 5.-*syuulalilayo*, 6.-*syuulalisya*, 7.-*syuulala-syuulala*, 8.-*syuulalilana*)

be very agitated with anger, *Wakasyuulungana abukali.* = He was extremely agitated with anger. (1.-*syuulunganwa*, 2.-*syuulungene*, 3.-*syuulunganya*, 4.-*syuulunganina*, 5.-*syuulunganinalyo*, 6.-*syuulunganisya*, 7.-*syuulungana-syuulungana*, 8.-*syuulunganinana*) Also: -*syulungana*.

suck up, as a bee, (-*unga buluba*) or mosquitoe, *Mansenya asyuunta bulowa bwabantu.* = Mosquitoes suck up the blood of people. Also: -*syunta*. (1.-*syuuntwa*, 2.-*syuuntide*, 3.-*syuuntizya*, 4.-*syuuntila*, 5.-*syuuntilalyo*, 6.-*syuuntisya*, 7.-*syuunta-syuunta*, 8.-*syuuntana*)
cause to be sucked up, *Ivwuba ndyakusyuuntizya meenda kunsi.* = The rubber suction-pad is for sucking up water from beneath.

protrude the lips, *Mebo nsemuyandi muntu wiile kusyuutata kakunyina wamusoka.* = I do not like a person who just pouts when s/he is not provoked. (1.-*syuutatwa*, 2.-*syuutatide*, 3.-*syuutatya*, 4.-*syuutatila*, 5.-*syuutatilalyo*, 6.-*syuutatisya*, 7.-*syuutata-syuutata*, 8.-*syuutatilana*) Also: -*syuulala*.

step over, go across a field or forest, *Kamutaaluka cisamu eci citamunontoli.* = Step over that log so that you do not trip. *Cilatondwa kutaaluka mukwasi.* = It is taboo to step over (the legs of) an in-law. (1.-*taalukwa*, 2.-*taalukide*, 3.-*taalusya*, 4.-*taalukila*, 5.-*taalukilalyo*, 6.-*taalukisya*, 7.-*taaluka-taaluka*, 8.-*taalukana*)

help to step over, *Ncibi kutaalusya mwana atalaa cakulya.* = It is bad to help a child to step over food. + shoot over, *Wakauma bbola akubataalusya bantu.* = He struck the ball and it shot over the people.

make room between legs, *Kotaamana kwiima kutegwa njinde muntebe mwako.* = Stretch your legs apart so that I pass underneath you. *Kotaamana maulu kapune kabwa.* = Hold your legs apart so that the puppy passes through. (1.-*taamanwa*, 2.-*taamanide*, 3.-*taamanya*, 4.-*taamanina*, 5.-*taamaninalyo*, 6.-*taamanisya*, 7.-*taamana-taamana*, 8.-*taamaninana*) Also: -*tazamana*.
step, *Kotaamuka ntaamu yomwe buyo.* = Take just one step. (1.-*taamukwa*, 2.-*taamukide*, 3.-*taamusya*, 4.-*taamukila*, 5.-*taamukilalyo*, 6.-*taamukisya*, 7.-*taamuka-taamuka*, 8.-*taamukilana*)

reach a point, *Wakanjila muzyiba akutaana munsingo.* = He entered the pond and reached up to his neck. *Munene wakalikuya ku Chisekese. Wakaindilila waakutaana ku Monze.* = The old man who was going to Chisekese, passed through to reach Monze. *Kaindi bantu tiibakali kutaana minzi iili kule-kule kuya kunywa bukoko mbuli mbobacita bantu sunu.* = In the past the people were not reaching far away villages to drink beer as people do now-a-days. (1.-taanwa, 2.-teenye,/-teene, 3.-taanya, 4.-taanina, 5.-taaninalyo, 6.-taanisya, 7.-taana-taana, 8.-taanizyanya)

be first, Moonze *nguwakataanguna kukambilwa mvwula.* = Moonze was the first to be possessed by rain-spirits. *Ndataanguna kusika kumuswaangano.* = I was first to reach the meeting. (1.-taangunwa, 2.-taangunide, 3.-taangunya, 4.-taangunina, 5.-taanguninalyo, 6.-taangunisya, 7.-taanguna-taanguna, 8.-taanguninana)
  • provoke, Cheelo *nguwataanguna mweenzinyina ncobalwana.* = It is Cheelo who provoked his friend, that is why they fought. Also: -soka, -talika.
anticipate, be in forefront, Wanditaangunina kusika kucikombelo. = He was first to arrive at the church before me. Also: -beelela.
cause to reach, rt. -taana, Mubuzyo ooyu ulatutaanya kule, atuuleke. = This question will take us too far, let us put it aside.

be barely seen, Mwana muvwanda wakatalika kuseka-seka kwataanyana twino tobile twakunsi twakali kutalika kumena. = The infant began to smile barely revealing two little lower teeth which were beginning to grow. (1.-taanyanwa, 2.-taanyene, 3.-taanyizya, 4.-taanyanina, 5.-taanyaninalyo, 6.-taanyanisya, 7.-taanyana-taanyana, 8.-tanyizyanya)

wander about, Kwakanyina muntu buyo unga walitaatila kulinjila gonde eeli nkaambo balala abaumpe mubakali kujanwa. = There was no person who was willing to wander about in that forest because black mamba snakes and wild dogs were present.

prop up, Kamuutaba mupika utatiki acikko aawo. = Prop up the pot so that it does not spill over the fire-place there. Kamutaba ciluli acisamu campanda. Prop up the roof with a forked pole. (1.-tabwa, 2.-tabide, 3.-tabya, 4.-tabila, 5.-tabilalyo, 6.-tabisya, 7.-taba-taba, 8.-tabana.)
  • rest on a piece of wood, Bamadaala bakaindi nibakali koona bakalikuyanda kulitaba akauno kumutwe. = Old men of the past when sleeping liked to rest their heads on a little stool of wood.
  • answer, Naakali kubuzigwa mibuzzyo kunkuta, wakaalilwa kutaba. = When he was asked questions in the court, he was not able to answer. Also: -seama

shake arms, Basankwa bakali kuyooma akutabaika akuseka. = The boys were chatting and shaking arms and laughing. (1.-tabaikwa, 2.-tabaikide, 3.-tabaikizya, 4.-tabaikila, 5.-tabaikilalyo, 6.-tabaikisya, 7.-tabaika-tabaika, 8.-tabaikilana)
  • build a fence with branches, Basankwa batabaika ciba. = The boys are building a kraal with branches.

be agile, Tombela ulatabalika atalaa ciluli. = A lizard moves quickly on the roof. Basokwe balatabalika mumisamu. = Monkeys are active in the trees. (1.-tabalikwa, 2.-tabalikide, 3.-tabalikizya, 4.-tabalikila, 5.-tabalikilalyo, 6.-tabalikisya, 7.-tabalika-tabalika, 8.-tabalikilana) Also: -nanalika.

move from place to place, Wali kutabanta oku akooku kuyandaula cakulya. = He was moving here and there searching for food. Wakalundukila bbola akutalika kutabanta ooku akooku kutandila bbola. = He ran after the ball, moving here and there chasing it. (1.-tabantwa, 2.-tabantide, 3.-tabantya, 4.-tabantila, 5.-tabantilalyo, 6.-tabantisya, 7.-tabanta-tabanta, 8.-tabantilana)

moving about restlessly, Ino utabauka nzi ncotakkalikili? = Why are you moving about restlessly that you cannot settle down? Meso aamunene akali kutabauka mbuli kaceta kabba mapopwe. = The eyes of the old man were moving about restlessly like a monkey stealing maize. (1.-tabaukwa, 2.-tabaukide, 3.-tabaukizya, 4.-tabaukila, 5.-tabaukilalyo, 6.-tabaukisya, 7.-tabauka-tabauka, 8.-tabaukilana)

move away from, Wakafwambaana kutabaula bana kutegwa batasiki munsi amulilo. He was quick to move the children away so that they woud not go near the fire. (1.-tabaulwa, 2.-tabawide, 3.-tabauzya, 4.-tabawida, 5.-tabawidalyo, 6.-tabaulisya, 7.-tabaula-tabaula, 8.-tabaulana) Also: -sosolosya, -tantamuna.

be moved away from, Mubwa ulatabaulwa nayanda kulya cakulya cabana. = The dog is removed when it wants to eat the children's food. Also: -tabululwa.
  • infamous, Muntu uulya nguutabaulwa. = That man has a bad reputation.
