ward off, Twalema kutabauzya mubwa kuti atalumi mweenzu. = We are weary of warding off the dog from biting the stranger. Abuzuba wakali kutabauzya suntwe mbuli muntu uyamina tuyuni mumuunda. = Every day he was driving it off the hyena like a person scaring away the birds.

be supported, rt. -taba, Kwakatabidwe kasamu kasyoonto kuti ciluli kacitankukide. = A small stick was supporting the roof so that it would be propped up. (1.-tabidwe, 2.-tabide, 3.-tabya, 4.-tabila, 5.-tabilalyo, 6.-tabisya, 7.-tabidwe-tabidwe, 8.-tabana)

protect, defend, Muzimo ngundakaulikwa ulanditabilila mubuumi bwangu. = The spirit after which I was named protects me during my life. Bantu banji bakamutabilila kuti ataumwi. = Many people protected him so that he would not be beaten. (1.-tabililwa, 2.-tabilide, 3.-tabilizya, 4.-tabilila, 5.-tabililalyo, 6.-tabilisya, 7.-tabilila-tabilila, 8.-tabilana.)

be infectious, spread, Bulwazi bwameso bulatabukila. = The eye-disease is infectious. Mpuwo yamisamu akusonda kwakwe kwakatabukila muminzi yaafwaafwi. = The reputation of his medicines and divining spread to the nearby villages. (1.-tabukilwa, 2.-tabukide, 3.-tabukizya, 4.-tabukilila, 5.-tabukililalyo, 6.-tabukisya, 7.-tabukilatabukila, 8.-tabukilana)
  • stretch out arm to reach something, Kotabukila undipe cisani cilaa mulenga. Stretch out your arm and give me the cloth which is on the hanger.
be infected, Ndakatabukilwa bulwazi bwantomba. = I was infected with smallpox. Also: -tambukila, -yambukila.

prevent from, Naatakamutabula naakamucisa. = If he had not checked him he would have hurt her. (1.-tabulwa, 2.-tabwide, 3.-tabuzya, 4.-tabwida, 5.-tabwidalyo, 6.-tabulisya, 7.-tabula-tabula, 8.-tabulana)
  • respond, Mwaanguzi naakaangula Iwiimbo, baimbi bakafwambaana kumutabula. When the leader started the song, the singers quickly responded. "Inzya balaamba bapati kuti munyati tabonesyi, alimwi kuti wawa ansi inga wakwiinda buyo." Mbwaakamutabula mweenzinyina. "Yes, the elders say that the buffalo has bad sight, and if you fall to the ground he will just pass you by." That is how his friend responded.

remove, Kamutabulula luubilili amulyango warnanda. Remove the cobweb from the entrance to the house. Kaindi musaanyina sikutwala wakalijisi nguzu zyakutabulula balombwana bambi kumukaintu ooyo. = In the past the age-mate of the bridegroom had the powers to remove other men from that wife of the bridegroom. (1.-tabululwa, 2.-tabulwide, 3.-tabuluzya, 4.-tabulwida, 5.-tabulwidalyo, 6.-tabululisya, 7.-tabulula-tabulula, 8.-tabululana)
be removed, Naataka
mubwa, naakamuluma mwana. = If the dog had not been removed, it would have bitten the child. Also: -tabaulwa, -tabuuzigwa.
remove with, Bali ku
cisamu kugusya luubilili. = They were using a stick to remove the cobwebs.

be moved aside, Mubwa *ulatabuuzigwa* nayanda kulya. = The dog is moved aside when it wants to eat. (2.-tabuuzide, 3.-tabuuzizya, 4.-tabuzyizya, 5.-tabuzyizyalyo, 6.-tabuuzyisya, 7.-tabuuzigwa-tabuuzigwa, 8.-tabuuzyanya) Also: -tabaulwa.

prop with, rt. -taba, Kamuyandaula cisamu cakutabya ciluli. = Look for a stick to prop up the roof. (1.-tabwa, 2.-tabide, 3.-tabya, 4.-tabila, 5.-tabilalyo, 6.-tabisya, 7.-tabya-tabya, 8.-tabana) Also: -nyeela.
chew, masticate, Ko

kabotu, utani kulyi mbuli ngulube. Chew properly, don't eat like a pig. *Kotafwuna* kabotu cakulya kotanamena. Chew the food properly before you swallow. (1.-tafwunwa, 2.-tafwunide, 3.-tafwunya, 4.-tafwunina, 5.-tafuninalyo, 6.-tafwuninsya, 7.-tafwuna-tafwuna, )

give presents to a musician or singer, Bakanditaila akaambo kakuuma kabotu ngoma. = They gave me presents for drumming well. Ndakataila mwiimbi wakaimba kabotu. = I gave a present to the singer who sang well. (1.-tailwa, 2.-tailide, 3.-taizya, 4.-tailila, 5.-taililalyo, 6.-tailisya, 7.-taila-taila, 8.-tailana) Also: -tayila, -taila

deserve presents, rt. -taila, Muntu uma ngoma kabotu ulatailika. = The one who drums well deserves presents. (1.-tailikwa, 2.-tailikide, 3.-tailikizya, 4.-tailikizyizya, 5.-tailikizyizyalyo, 6.-tailikizyisya, 7.-tailika-tailika)

shine, reflect light, Nyenyezi zilataima. The stars shine. Muzenge ulataima mumudima. = A firebrand shines in the darkness. (1.-taimwa, 2.-taimide, 3.-taimya, 4.-taimina, 5.-taiminalyo, 6.-taimisya, 7.-taima-taima, 8.-taimizyanya) Also: -mweka-mweka, -naima.

pass from one food to another when there is a choice, Bantu bakali kwiile kutakaanya zyakulya. = The people were just passing from one choice of food to another. (1.-takaanyizigwa, 2.-takaanyide, 3.-taakanyizya, 4.-takaanyizyizya, 5.-takaanyizyizyalyo, 6.-takaanyisya, 7.-takaanya-takaanya, 8.-takaanyizyanya)

take plenty, leaving what you are unable to eat or carry away, Inombe mbuzyakamanina kulitakala kulya mapopwe, zyakaunka. When the cattle had finished eating as much maize as they could, they went off. (1.-takalwa, 2.-takalide, 3.-takazya, 4.-takalila, 5.-takalilalyo, 6.-takalisya, 7.-takala-takala, 8.-takalizyanya)
start to vomit, Waka

kuluka mbwaakamvwa kununka kwanswi. As soon as he smelt the fish, he started vomiting. Also: -kakamuka. (1.-takamukwa, 2.-takamukide, 3.-takamuzya, 4.-takamukila, 5.-takamukilalyo, 6.-takamukisya, 7.-takamuka-takamuka, 8.-takamukizyanya)

try with all one's strength, Wakali kulitakamuna kwiita pesi ku nyina wakavwiila. = He was calling with all his strength but no one was answering. Mulwazi wali kulitakamuna kuti aluke. = The patient was trying with all her strength to vomit. (1.-takamunwa, 2.-takamwide, 3.-takamuzya, 4.-takamwida, 5.-takamwidalyo, 6.-takamunisya, 7.-takamuna-takamuna, 8.-takmunana) Also: -tukumuna.

over-flow, Mapopwe atakanika mubutala. = The maize is overflowing in the maize bin. Bana batakanika mumazila. = The children are flowing over on the streets (street-kids). (1.-takanikwa, 2.-takanikide, 3.-takanizya, 4.-takanikila, 5.-takanikilalyo, 6.-takanikisya, 7.-takanika-takanika, 8.-takanizyanya)
  • be wasted, Lubono Iwakwe Iwaide kutakanika. His wealth was just wasted.

talk nonsense, Wali kwiile kutakaizya kwaambaula ncibanyema bamwi. = Some people became angry because he was just talking rubbish. (1.-takaizyigwa, 2.-takaizyide, 3.-takaizyisya, 4.-takaizyizya, 5.-takaizyizyalyo, 6.-takaizyisya, 7.-takaizya-takaizya, 8.-takaizyanya)

waste, Wiide kulutakanisya lubono, ulalumana kupa batuba. = You are just wasting your wealth, you are finishing it off on strangers. (1.-takanisyigwa, 2.-takanisyide, 3.-takanisyizya, 4.-takanizyizya, 5.-takanizyizyalyo, 6.-takanisyisya, 7.-takanisya-takanisya, 8.-takanisyanya)

turn one's back, reject property, Wakatakata kubweza lubono mu-buzuba bwakukona. = She refused to take the wealth on the day of inheritance. (1.-takatwa, 2.-takatide, 3.-takatizya, 4.-takatila, 5.-takatilalyo, 6.-takatisya, 7.-takata-takata, 8.-takatilana)
turn one's back on someone, Muzimo wa Syaatontola wakamusiya, wakamutakatila. The spirit of Syaatontola left him, it turned away from him.

make disorder, as hen on a nest, Inkuku itakuula mayi acifwuko. = The hen is moving the eggs about in the nest. (1.-takuulwa, 2.-takwiide, 3.-takuuzya, 4.-takwiida, 5.-takwiidalyo, 6.-takuulisya, 7.-takuula-takuula, 8.-takuulana) Also: -takaula, -tataula.
be infested with, Awo mpaakakkede kwakali kutakwinya mvwunyu. = There where he was sleeping he was infested with maggots.

pass one's power of comprehension, be wonderful, Cilatala kubona izuba mboleenda. = It is wonderful to see how the sun moves. (1.-talwa, 2.-talide, 3.-tazya, 4.-talila, 5.-talila, 6.-talilalyo, 7.-tala-tala, 8.-talizyanya) Also: -nyandya, -kankamanisya

be elastic, Malekani ngaakaula jilo alatalamuka. = The catapult which he bought yesterday is stretchable. Also: -ladamuka, -landamuka. (1.-talamukwa, 2.-talamukide, 3.-talamuzya, 4.-talamukila, 5.-talamukilalyo, 6.-talamukisya, 7.-talamuka-talamuka, 8.-talamukilana)

stretch a catapult, stretch out a camp bed, Amusole kutalamuna malekani tubone mbwaabota. = Try to stretch the catapult to see how good it is. (1.-talamunwa, 2.-talamwide, 3.-talamunya, 4.-talamwida, 5.-talamwidalyo, 6.-talamunisya, 7.-talamuna-talamuna, 8.-talamunana)

move about, as eyes, Ndabona meso aamulwazi atalangana naasika musilisi. I saw the eyes of the patient moving nervously when the doctor arrived. (1.-talanganwa, 2.-talangene, 3.-talanganya, 4.-talanganina, 5.-talanganinalyo, 6.-talanganisya, 7.-talanganatalangana, 8.-talanganinana)
have wandering eyes, *Nitwamubona twajana meso akwe alitalangene.* = When we saw him we found that his eyes were shifting about.

begin, *Kamutalika kulima mvwula mbuyatanga.* = Since the rain has begun you should start to plough. (1-talikwa, 2.-talikide, 3.-talisya, 4.-talikila, 5.-talikilalyo, 6.-talikisya, 7.-talika-talika, 8.-talikana.)
  • provoke, *Wanditalika.* = You have provoked me. Also: -soka.

taste food before giving to visitor, *Kamumutalikila kulya mweenzu.* = Taste the food for the visitor. Also: -labilila.
  • begin from, originate, rt. -talika, *Mulonga utalikila mumulundu.* = The river has its source in the hills.
cause to start, rt. -talika, Also: -talisya.

start up, initiate, found, rt. talika, *Nguni wakatalisya cikolo ca Kasaka?* = Who started the school at Kasaka? (1.-talisyigwa, 2.-talisyide, 3.-talisya, 4.-talisyizya, 5.-talisyizyalyo, 6.-talisyisya, 7.-talisya-talisya, 8.-talisyanya)

wonder, rt. -tala, *Eelyo ndatalwa kubona mukuwa utacizyi Chingisi!* = I was amazed to see a whiteman who did not speak English. *Naakabona cintu ncatanabwene kuzwa naakazyalwa, wakatalwa.* = When he saw a thing which he had never seen since he was born, he was astounded. (2.-talide, 3.-tazya, 4.-talila, 5.-talilalyo, 6.-talisya, 7.-talwa-talwa) Also: -nyandwa.

accuse of a crime, *Bakamutama buyo kubba mali ani tali nguwe.* = They accused him of stealing the money but he was not the one. (1.-tamwa, 2.-tamide, 3.-tamikizya, 4.-tamina, 5.-taminalyo, 6.-tamikisya, 7.-tama-tama, 8.-tamana.) Also: -tamikizya, -gala, -ganda.
  • confess to a crime, *Bamasilikani bakamuuma mbayi zinji mane limwi watama.* = The police slapped him many times until he confessed.
accuse one another, rt. tama, *Bakatamana boonse.* = They both condemned one another. *Basicikolo bakatamana kujaya gilazi.* = The pupils accused one another of breaking the glass.

wander about in speech, *Wali kwiile kutamauka naali kukanana.* = She was just wandering about in speech. *Kowamba cintu comwe, kuleka kutamauka.* = Stay on the one topic, don't be wandering. *Natamauka boobu mudaala kumwi wakateene kumbo amunzi kalijisi maanza atala amutwe akoomoka kulila.* = While he was disoriented in this way the old man reached the west of the village with his hands on his head crying loudly. (1.-tamaukwa, 2.-tamaukide, 3.-tamauzya, 4.-tamaukila, 5.-tamaukilalyo, 6.-tamaukisya, 7.-tamauka-tamauka, 8.-tamaukana)
  • complain, protest, *Meenda naatontola basimbi tabakwe nobakati, "Hiya", nokuba kutamauka nkaambo kwakali kutondwa.* = Even when the water was cold the girls could not say, "Hiya" (to express their reaction to the cold) nor could they grumble because it was taboo to do so. *Munyimbo ezyo nzyobakali kuya bwiimba bakali kulitembaula, bakali kucapa mulombe cimwi ciindi akutamauka.* = In those songs which they went along singing and praising themselves, they would sometimes ridicule a boy and complain.
accuse one another, *Bakali kwiile kutamaukana nobakali kubetekwa.* = When they were being tried, they were just accusing one another. Also: -tamana, -tamikizyanya.
offer excuses, *Wali-kulitamaukila kuti alekelelwe.* = She was excusing herself so that she might be forgiven. Also: -ombookela, -lilauka.
make excuses, *Lyoonse cibi cilatamausya.* Evil always makes one to look for excuses.

invite, call to public function, assemble for a feast, *Ijilo ndakatamba bantu bandiyakila nanda.* = Yesterday I invited people to build a house for me. (1.-*tambwa*, 2.-*tambide*, 3.-*tambya*, 4.-*tambila*, 5.-*tambilalyo*, 6.-*tambisya*, 7.-*tamba-tamba*, 8.-*tambana*.)
  • be tamed as an ox, be overcome, *Musune ngwindakaula jilo wakatamba kale.* = The ox which I bought yesterday is already tamed. *Basankwa bakali kuIwana kwaciindi, pele cino ciindi boonse batamba.* = The boys have been fighting for a long time, now they are all overcome. *Imbooma yakatyanka mbelele, imbelele yakatamba.* The boa-constrictor squeezed the sheep, the sheep was overcome. Also: -otobala.

wave as with hand, *Sincinko ulatambaika nayenda munzila.* = The mad one waves the hand as he goes along the path. Also: -yanaika, -tambiika. (1.-*tambaikwa*, 2.-*tambaikide*, 3.-*tambaizya*, 4.-*tambaikila*, 5.-*tambaikilalyo*, 6.-*tambaikisya*, 7.-*tambaika-tambaika*, 8.-*tambaikana*)
  • spread out as runners, *Bakatalika kulimina luungu, nkujana mumazuba masyoonto biyo Iwatalika kutambaika.* = They began to weed the pumpkins to find that in a few days the runners began to spread. Also: -yanda.

kick for joy like cattle, *Bakatambala lyankolola bantu kutondezya kukondwa.* The people danced for joy at the initiation ceremony. *Bantu balatambala lilila ngoma yabukali.* = The people jump about with excitement when the war-drum sounds. Also: -mwangauka, -mwanyauka. (1.-*tambalwa*, 2.-*tambalide*, 3.-*tambazya*, 4.-*tambalila*, 5.-*tambalilalyo*, 6.-*tambalisya*, 7.-*tambala-tambala*, 8.-*tambalilana*)

hold up/out the hand, *Nomuyanda kubuzya, kamusaanguna kutambika janza.* = When you want to ask a question, first of all put up your hand. *Mukaintu wasowa tayelede kutambika cintu kumuntu.* A woman who has had a miscarriage is not supposed to hand a person anything. *Bakamutambika mwana-akwe mukaintu.* = They handed over the child to the woman. *Bakazwa ambede, bakafwugama, bamane nkupwita, nkutambika Milambo.* She came out with a wooden bowl, she knelt, then she sipped and handed it to Milambo. (1.-*tambikwa*, 2.-*tambikide*, 3.-*tambisya*, 4.-*tambikila*, 5.-*tambikilalyo*, 6.-*tambikisya*, 7.-*tambika-tambika*, 8.-*tambikana*)

offer for someone else, *Mebo ndabatambikila bataata nkaambo tabako.* I have offered something for my father because he is not present. *Musa konditambikila mali kumakwaangu.* = My friend give the money to my in-laws for me. (*tambikilwa*, 2.-*tambikilide*, 3.-*tambikilizya*, 4.-*tambikilila*, 5.-*tambikililalyo*, 6.-*tambikilisya*, 7.-*tambikila-tambikila*, 8.-*tambikilana*)

pass on a thing to someone, *Konditambikizya muungo oyo ndijike.* Pass me that cooking stick so that I cook. *Basankwa batambikizya bwizu kumudaala uuvwumba nanda.* = The boys are passing on grass to the old man for thatching. *Mwana mulombe wisi nayaka nanda, alakwe ulayaka. Ulajatila mbalo akutambikizya loozi.* = When the father of a young boy is building a house, the boy builds with him. He catches the roofing sticks and passes the fibres through. (1.-tambikizyigwa, 2.-tambikizyide, 3.-tambikizya, 4.-tambikizyizya, 5.-tambikizyizyalyo, 7.-tambikizyatambikizya, 8.-tambikizyanya)
  • pass on a message from a distance, Wakatambikizya kumusankwa ChooIwe wakali kutalaa mulonga kuti akaambile munene Haaluma kuti Chingwindi wazimina. = He passed on the message to the boy Choolwe who was across the river that he should tell the old man Haaluma that Chigwindi had died.

tame, Basankwa batambisya basune mbobaya kulimya kono. = The boys are taming the oxen they are going to plough with this year. (1.-tambisyigwa, 2.-tambisyide, 3.-tambisya, 4.-tambisyizya, 5.-tambisyizyalyo, 6.-tambisyisya, 7.-tambisyatambisya, 8.-tambisyanya) Also: -bombya, -fwundisya.

call out to, salute from a distance, Kamumutambizya muntu ooyo ajoke. = Call out to that man so that he returns. Wakakwiila cakuyoowa akutambizya. She screamed in fear and cried out for help. (1.-tambizyigwa, 2.-tambizyide, 3.-tambizya, 4.-tambizyizya, 5.-tambizyizyalyo, 6.-tambizyisya, 7.-tambizya-tambizya, 8.-tambizyanya)

reach up to obtain something, *Kotambukila* mutiba ooyo uuli akasanza. Stretch for that dish which is on the shelf. (1.-tambukilwa, 2.-tambukilide, 3.-tambukizya, 4.-tambukilila, 5.-tambukilalyo, 6.-tambukilisya, 7.-tambukila-tambukila, 8.-tambukilana)
  • be infectious, Bulwazi bwakakweekwe bulatambukila. = Tuberculosis is infectious. Also: -yambukila, -tabukila.
receive, *Kotambula* cipego cazwa kumulongwe wako. Receive the gift which comes from your friend.

ndamweetela cakulya sunu. = Receive the food I have brought you today. (1.-tambulwa, 2.-tambwide, 3.-tambuzya, 4.-tambulila,/-tambwida, 5.-tambulilalyo, /-tambwidalyo, 6.-tambulisya, 7.-tambula-tambula, 8.-tambulana)

become unstitched, Catambuluka cisani ncobasumide bamaama. The cloth which my mother had sewn has become unstitched. (1.-tambulukwa, 2.-tambulukide, 3.-tambuluzya, 4.-tambulukila 5.-tambulukilalyo, 6.-tambulukisya, 7.-tambuluka-tambuluka, 8.-tambulukana) Also: -sumunuka, -zambunuka,-sambuluka.

subdue, protect, shield, Ngamakuwa akatalika kutambya nyika kuti itontwede limwi. = It was the whites who subdued the land so that it became completely peaceful. *Bakatambya* meso abo babona vwutu wavwutuka munzi. = They shielded their eyes when they saw the blaze which was engulfing the village. (1.-tambizyigwa, 2.-tambide, 3.-tambya, 4.-tambizyizya, 5.-tambizyizyalyo, 6.-tambizyisya, 7.-tambya-tambya, 8.-tambizyanya)

slander, *Banditamikizya* kuti ndakabbunukilwa. = They slandered me saying that I had been caught in adultery. *Ooyu mudaala wamutamikizya kubba mali mwanaangu.* = This old man has falsely accused my child of stealing money. *Aumwi utamikizya umwi kuti wakamubona ucita zilengwa zyabulozi.* Each one was accusing the other that he had seen him doing the works of witchcraft. Also: -bejelezya, -lambaika. (1-tamikizigwa, 2.-tamikizyide, 3-tamikizyizya, 4.-tamikizyila, 5.-tamikizyilalyo, 6-tamikizyisya, 7.-tamikizya-tamikizya, 8.-tamikizyanya.)

throw blame on another, rt. - tama, *Basankwa batamina basimbi kubba mayi.* = The boys are blaming the girls for stealing the eggs. cf. -tamikizya. (1.-taminwa, 2.-taminide, 3.-tamizya, 4.-taminina, 5.-tamininalyo, 6.-taminisya. 7.-tamina-tamina, 8.-taminizyanya)

throw blame on one another, *Basicikolo bakali kutaminana nibakatiiumwe kubayi babo.* = The pupils were accusing one another when their teacher was about to cane them. (1.-taminanwa, 2.-taminanide, 3.-taminizyanya, 4.-taminaninana, 5.-taminaninalyo, 6.-taminanisya, 7.-taminana-taminana, 8.-taminana)

assume as the possession of a particular totem, appropriate, claim as one's own property, *Wakali kuyanda buyo kutaminina zintu zyabantu zitali zyakwe.* = He just wanted to claim other peoples belongings. *Wacitaminina cisani citali cakwe mwana.* = The child claimed ownership of the cloth which is not his/hers. *Masowe nguwataminina nzuki zyangu.* = It is Masowe who appropriated my bees. (1.-tamininwa, 2.-taminide, 3.-tamininizya, 4.-tamininina, 5.-taminininalyo, 6.-tamininisya, 7.-taminina-taminina, 8.-tamininana) Also: -laminina.

throw the blame on another, *Tandiciyandi kunditaminzya makani ngetabwene.* = I don't want the blame to be thrown on me of what I am innocent. *Mukaintu wanditaminzya makani aatako.* = The woman blamed me about something which does not exist. Also: -tamikizya. (1.-taminzyigwa, 2.-taminzyide, 3.-taminzyisya, 4.-taminzyizya, 5.-taminzyizyalyo, 6.-taminzyisya, 7.-taminzya-taminzya, 8.-taminzyanya)

excuse oneself, justify one's actions, give apology, *Bina Simweete* V - 564 *bakasola kulitamizya kwaamba kuti, "Kumunzi kwacaala buyo bana baniini, njakujana munene walumwa suntwe."* = The mother of Simweete tried to exempt herself saying, "At the village there remained only small children, I will find the old man has been attacked by a hyena." (1.-tamizyigwa, 2.-tamizyide, 3.-tamizyizya, 4.-tamizyizya, 5.-tamizyizyalyo, 6.-tamizyisya, 7.-tamizya-tamizya, 8.-tamizyanya)

accuse each other, *Basankwa balikutamizyanya kunyona nombe ncizyalya mapopwe aabantu.* = The boys were accusing one another saying that it was the others turn to bring back the cattle that is why they ate the people's maize. *Bakatamizyanya kumubbala mucembele akumutansika acilundu.* = They were arguing with one another about carrying the old woman and lifting her up the hill. Also: -balizyanya.

hurry in picking up things, *Nindakajana masuku manji aawide ansi, ndakatampana kwaabwezelela ni-kwatakaningasika bantu banji.* = When I found plenty of masuku fruit had fallen on the ground, I hurriedly picked them up before many people arrived. (1.-tampanwa, 2.-tampanide, 3.-tampazya, 4.-tampanina, 5.-tampaninalyo, 6.-tampanisya, 7.-tampana-tampana, 8.-tampaninana)
rouse suddenly, as a sleeping person, *Imvwula niyakazuma, yakamutampazya Munene naakaonede nonzi zyakukolwa.* = When it thundered, it suddenly aroused Munene from a drunken sleep. Also: -sinsimuna.

stop raining, *Imvula niyakatamuka, bantu bakali kumuswaangano bakeenda kabotu.* = When the thunder ceased, the people who were at the meeting were able to go. (1.-tamukwa, 2.-tamukide, 3.-tamusya, 4.-tamukila, 5.-tamukilalyo, 6.-tamukisya, 7.-tamuka-tamuka) Also: -timuka, -amuka.

change statements over the same issue, *Kutamuuka kwaamba inga walimbwa mulandu.* = Changing statements again and again makes one guilty. (1.-tamuukwa, 2.-tamuukide, 3.-tamuusya, 4.-tamuukila, 5.-tamuukilalyo, 6.-tamuukisya, 7.-tamuuka-tamuuka, 8.-tamuukana) Also: -tamauka.

make room between one's legs, *Kapongo nokanyonsya kalatananana.* = When the goat suckles its young, it puts its legs apart to give room for sucking. (1.-tanananwa, 2.-tanananide, 3.-tananazya, 4.-tanananina, 5.-tanananinalyo, 6.-tanananisya, 7.-tananana-tananana, 8.-tananinana) Also: -tazamana.

drive away, *Kamuzitanda nombe zitanjili mumuunda.* Drive the cattle away so that they do not enter the field. *Kotanda nkuku, zilabutila buntele.* = Drive the chickens away, they will spill the groundnut mash. (1.-tandwa, 2.-tandide, 3.-tandya, 4.-tandila, 5.-tandilalyo, 6.-tandisya, 7.-tanda-tanda, 8.-tandana)
  • copulate as cattle Also: -limbana

chase, *Baalumi batandaanya munyama mupati.* = The men are chasing a big animal. *Bamutandaanya naali kutija kajisi azintu nzyaabba.* = They chased him when he was running away holding the things which he stole. (1.-tandaanyizyigwa, 2.-tandaanyizyide, 3.-tandaanyizya, 4.-tandaanyizyizya, 5.-tandaanyizyizyalyo, 6.-tandaanyizyisya, 7.-tandaanya-tandaanya, 8.-tandaanyizyanya)

lie stretched like a corpse, stretch out oneself, body and legs, *Bamakaintu nobalyookezya balatandabala.* When the women rest they stretch themselves out. *Bakambila mvwula batandabala buya nobakamba.* = Those who clap for rain, stretch their legs out as they clap. (1.-tandabalwa, 2.-tandabete, 3.-tandabazya, 4.-tandabalila, 5.-tandabalilalyo, 6.-tandabalisya, 7.-tandabala-tandabala, 8.-tandabalilana)
  • spread out as pumpkin runners, *Lungu talunatalika kutandabala.* = The pumpkin runners have not yet begun to spread. Also: -yanda.
  • be cleared up, *Kaambo kakwe takanatandabala, asunu ulabetekwa.* = Her case is not yet cleared up, it is still being tried. Also: -lulama.

be stretched out, *Basike munzila, umwi mukaintu wakali kumbele wakajana kazoka kalitandabede munzila.* = When they arrived at the path, one woman who was in front found a snake stretched out in the path. (1.-tandabalwa, 2.-tandabede, 3.-tandabazya, 4.-tandabalila, 5.-tandabalila-lyo, 6.-tandabalisya, 7.-tandabede-tandabede, 8.-tandabilana)

stretch out, *Kamulutandabika lukalo tubone mboluli lulamfwu.* = Stretch out the rope so that we see how long it is. *Kotandabika kuboko kwalulyo.* = Stretch out your right arm. (1.-tandabikwa, 2.-tandabikide, 3.-tandabisya, 4.-tandabikila, 5.-tandabikilalyo, 6.-tandabikisya, 7.-tandabikatandabika, 8.-tandabikana)

stretch, *Langa mwana uliligonyede, kamumutandabula kutegwa aone kabotu.* = Look the child is curled up, stretch him out so that he sleeps well. (1.-tandabulwa, 2.-tandabwide, 3.-tandabuzya, 4.-tandabwida, 5.-tandabwidalyo, 6.-tandabulisya, 7.-tandabula-tandabula, 8.-tandabulana)

drive off, rt. -tanda, *Langa ngulube zyanjila mumbewu, amufwambaane kuzitandauzya.* = Look the pigs have entered the garden, be quick to chase them away. (1.-tandauzyigwa, 2.-tandauzyizye, 3.-tandauzyisya, 4.-tandauzyizya, 5.-tandauzyizyalyo, 6.-tandauzyisya, 7.-tandauzya-tandauzya. 8.-tandauzyanya)

run after, *Twali kutandila muntu usondokede wabba mwana.* = We were chasing the mad one who stole a child. (1.-tandilwa, 2.-tandilide, 3.-tandizya, 4.-tandilila, 5.-tandililalyo, 6.-tandilisya, 7.-tandila-tandila, 8.-tandilana)

drive away, *Mbobakabona kuti wabbuka, bakamutandilizya kacili kulaale kuti atanjili mumunzi.* = As soon as they saw him appearing, when he was still far away they drove him off so that he would not enter the village. *Ndaya kukutandilizya bakwale kumuunda.* = I am going to chase away the partridges in the field as well. Also: -yamina. (1.-tandilizyigwa, 2.-tandilizyizye, 3.-tandilizyisya, 4.-tandilizyizya, 5.-tandilizyizyalyo, 6.-tandilizyisya, 7.-tandilizya-tandilizya, 8.-tandilizyanya
  • do something extra as to what you had mainly planned to do, *Ndaunka kuya kulanga mbwaakazwa mapopwe, ndiyakutandilizya abakwale.* = When I go to see whether the maize has germinated, while I will also chase the partridges.

dismiss, get rid of, *Cilakatazya kutanduuzya babbi bavwula.* = It is difficult to continually get rid of thieves when they are too many. (1.-tanduuzyigwa, 2.-taanduuzyizye, 3.-tanduuzyisya, 4.-tanduuzyizya, 5.-tanduuzyizyalyo, 6.-tanduuzyisya, 7.-tanduuzya-tanduuzya, 8.-tanduuzyanya) Also: -tandauzya.

fall as the first rain, *Imvwula yakatanga mu Vwumbi-pati.* = The first rain fell in November. *Ncibotu kuba muntu utaanguna kulima imvwula ndilyona niyatanga.* = It is good to be the first person to plough as soon as the rain falls. (1.-tangwa, 2.-tangide, 3.-tanzya, 4.-tangila, 5.-tangilalyo, 6.-tangisya, 7.-tanga-tanga, 8.-tangana)
  • have sexual intercourse, *Uyanda kutanga bamukabantu.* = He wants to sleep with people's wives.

be in state of joy, *Bakatangala boonse cakuti akulya koonse bakakuluba.* = They were so happy that they even forgot to eat. (1.-tangalwa, 2.-tangede, 3.-tangazya, 4.-tangalila, 5.-tangalilalyo, 6.-tangalisya, 7.-tangalatangala, 8.-tangalilana)

form a friendship, *Bamakaintu mbabatangana bulongwe.* = The women are the ones who form friendships. *Bakatangana zyabulongwe Mutinta a Nchimunya.* = Mutinta and Nchimunya made a bond of friendship. (1.-tanganwa, 2.-tanganide, 3.-tanganya, 4.-tanganina, 5.-tanganinalyo, 6.-tanganisya, 7.-tangana-tangana, 8.-tangana)
complete work with many, *Mulimo kuutanganina ulauba-uba.* = When work is done by many it is easy. Also: -zinganina.

be choosy in picking food to eat, *Musimbi wakatalika akutangaula cakulya, wakatalika kunga kufwumbwa ncaatiilye nkuluka a kuyandisisya kulya delele naa lunkomba.* = The girl began to be choosy as regards food, she began to vomit when she was about to eat food she did not like and desired okra very much. (1.-tangaulwa, 2.-tangaulide, 3.-tangauzya, 4.-tangaulila, 5.-tangaulilalyo, 6.-tangaulisya, 7.-tangaula-tangaula, 8.-tangaulana)

make rejoice, rt. -tangala, *Babatangazya kubapa cakulya cinji bana.* = They made the children happy by giving them a lot of food. *Ijwi lyakwe lyakali kutangazya baswiilili kapati.* = His voice used to thrill the listeners. (1.-tangalwa, 2.-tangede, 3.-tangazya, 4.-tangalila, 5.-tangalilalyo, 6.-tangalisya, 7.-tangala-tangala, 8.-tangalilana)

form a friendship, Mwiinga wakatangene bulongwe a Mwiila. = Mwiinga formed frienship with Mwiila. (1.-tangenwe, 2.-tangene, 3.-tangazya, 4.-tanganina, 5.-tanganinalyo, 6.-tanganisya, 7.-tangene-tangene, 8.-tangana)
begin to fall, as rain, Eeci cakacitika ciindi cakumwaka alya eeni mpoitangila mvwula. This happened in the dry season just when the rains began to fall.

go slowly, Mukaintu ulaa da utanka buya kweenda. = A woman who is pregnant walks slowly. (1.-tankwa, 2.-tankide, 3.-tankizya, 4.-tankila, 5.-tankilalyo, 6.-tankisya, 7.-tanka-tanka)
  • walk with legs apart and with difficulty, Muntu uciswa cuute muntebe utanka buya kweenda. = A person who has an abcess underneath walks with difficulty.

walk slowly, Kweenda walo utankaila buya kubee ulaciswa. = In walking he walks slowly as if he was sick. Sunu Masowe utankaila buyo kweenda nkwaaneneya. = Masowe walks slowly today as she is so fat. Tobene buyo mbwentankaila kweenda, ulati nkapongo kalaa da. = Do you not see how slowly I walk, you would say it is a pregnant little goat. (1.-tankailwa, 2.-tankailide, 3.-tankaizya, 4.-tankailila, 5.-tankaililalyo, 6.-tankailisya, 7.-tankaila-tankaila, 8.-tankailana)

be unsteady, Ciluli tiicakkala kabotu, catankama. = The roof does not sit properly, it is unsteady. (1.-tankamwa, 2.-tankeme, 3.-tankamya, 4.-tankamina, 5.-tankaminalyo, 6.-tankamisya, 7.-tankama-tankama, 8.-tankamikana)

be in an unsteady position, Ciluli catankamana. = The roof is not sitting properly. (1.-tankamanwa, 2.-tankamanide, 3.-tankamanya, 4.-tankamanina, 5.-tankamaninalyo, 6.-tankamanisya, 7.-tankamana-tankamana, 8.-tankamaninana)
  • stand up with legs slightly apart, Wakaide kutankamana kwiima, bbola nolyakamwiinda muntebe. = He just stood with his legs apart when the ball passed through them. Also: -tazamana.
  • move outside in an angry way, Wakababbongawida, ucimana nguulya waakutankamana anze. = She spoke aggressively to them, then she stormed outside.

show disrespect Ncibi kutankamanina bapati nobakkede. = It is bad to stand disrespectfully near the elders when they are seated. Bazyali bamazubaano baciindilizya, bacitankamanina kubee takucikwe milawo yacisi. The parents of today go too far in their demands, they have no respect as if there were no laws in the country. Also: -tankamina.

place over, Kamukatankamika kaluli abutala. = Go and put the roof over the granary. (1.-tankamikwa, 2.-tankamikide, 3.-tankamikizya, 4.-tankamikila, 5.-tankamikilalyo, 6.-tankamikisya, 7.-tankamika-tankamika, 8.-tankamikana)

stand among the elders disrespectfully, behave in proud manner, Mwana utankamina bapati takalomi. = The child who stands without respect among the elders will not behave well. (1.-tankaminwa, 2.-tankaminide, 3.-tankaminizya, 4.-tankaminina. 5.-tankamininalyo, 6.-tankaminisya. 7.-tankamina-tankamina, 8.-tankaminana)

be wasteful or thoughtless in what one does, Basikale bakali kunga nociceya ncaajana kumulimo oyo ulabikkilila tusyoonto-syoonto, ulati, 'Mu longa uvwula bunkumwi-nkumwi'. Tiibakali kutankaula kubeleka. = The people of long ago gradually saved, putting aside whatever they earned no matter how little, saying that, "A river grows big through many tributaries". They were not wasteful as they worked. (1.-tankaulwa, 2.-tankaulide, 3.-tankauzya, 4.-tankaulila, 5.-tankaulilalyo, 6.-tankaulisya, 7.-tankaula-tankaula, 8.-tankaulana)

be propped up, rt.-tankula, Kwakatabidwe kasamu kasyoonto kuti ciluli kacitankukide mpoona awo mpaakali kwiinda kuya mukati. A small stick was proping up the roof so that it would be supported right there where he was passing going inside. Also: -tabidwe. (1.-tankukidwe, 2.-tankukide, 3.-tankuzyizye, 4.-tankuzyizya, 5.-tankuzyizyalyo, 6.-tankulisya 7.-tankula-tankula, 8.-tankulana)

jack up, prop up the roof of the grain bin so as to allow one to go inside, Kamucitankula ciluli tubikke mapopwe mubutala. Lift up the roof (by using a pole) so that we can put maize in the granary. Kamutankula kaluli kakabbule tugusye ndongwe. = Lift up the cover of the groundnut-bin so that we take out the groundnuts. Kamutankula mootokala tubikke vwili. = Jack up the car so that we put on the wheel. Kamutankula maulu anu. = Lift up your legs. (1.-tankulwa, 2.-tankwide, 3.-tankuzya, 4.-tankwida, 5.-tankwidalyo, 6.-tankulisya, 7.-tankula-tankula, 8.-tankulana) Also: -nabula.

hoist, help to mount, rt. tanta, Banalumi batansika ciluli cacikolo. The men are putting up the roof of the school. Kamumutansika mwana mujulu oomo mwalilila. = Help the child to get up to the place it is crying for. Citima nicakasika, ndakabatansika bana. = When the train arrived I helped the children to get up on to it. Bataata bakandipa mali akutansika citima. Father gave me the fare to board the train. (1.-tansikwa, 2.-tansikide, 3.-tansisya, 4.-tansikila, 5.-tansikilalyo, 6.-tansikisya, 7.-tansika-tansika, 8.-tansikana) Also: -tantika.

mount, Tanta ncinga yako tweende ku Kasaka. = Mount your bike and let us go to Kasaka. (1.-tantwa, 2.-tantide, 3.-tantizya or -tantya, 4.-tantila, 5.-tantilalyo, 6.-tantisya, 7.-tanta-tanta, 8.-tantana.)
  • accuse falsely of witchcraft, Wakanditanta bulozi. He falsely accused me of witchcraft.

be apart, set apart, be spaced, Kacitantaana cisyu nocitiikakomene kabotu. = Space the vegetables if they are to grow well. Mapopwe akatantaana kuzwa. The maize is germinating at a slow pace. Kamutantaana kwiima nomutiizyane kabotu. = Stand a distance apart so that you can dance well. (1.-tantaanwa, 2.-tanteenye, 3.-tantaanya, 4.-tantaanina, 5.-tantaaninalyo, 6.-tantaanisya, 7.-tantaana-tantaana, 8.-tantaana) Also: -tataana.

sow seed well apart, Kamutantaanya kusyanga maila. = Sow the millet seeds well apart.
  • be unclear, incoherent, Naakajatwa abasilikani wakatalika kutantaanya kwa-amba nkaambo wakaliyoowede. When he was caught by the police he was disconnected in speech because he was afraid. Wakatantaanya kwaamba akaambo kabukali bwakamuzundide. = He was incoherent in speaking because of the anger which had overcome him.

walk quickly and noiselessly like a spider, Kotapula kauka kamutantalika amubili mwana. = Shake off the insect which is crawling on the child's body. Siluubilili tasabili natantalika mubwaanda. = A spider makes no noise when it moves on the wall. (1.-tantalikwa, 2.-tantalikide, 3.-tantalisya, 4.-tantalikila, 5.-tantalilkilalyo, 6.-tantalikisya, 7.-tantalika-tantalika, 8.-tantalikana)
  • walk on a raised and narrow object, as on a wall, Muyaki wakali kutantalika abwaanda naakali kugagaila ciluli. = The builder was walking on the wall when he was nailing on the roof. Also: -nanalika.
  • walk along something, Wanditantalika moongolwa akuulu. = The millipede is walking along my leg. Simantungwizya wakamutantalika akuboko mwana. = The spider moved along the child's arm.
  • stagger as a drunken man, Basibukoko bakatantalika kweenda nobakolwa. = Those who drink stagger when they are drunk. Also: -pampalika, -tenteleka, -bbabbalika.

move aside, Tantamuka! Ulakucisa musamu wawa. = Stand aside, the tree will hurt you when it falls. Kabatantamuka bantu tuzyane kabotu. = Let the people move aside so that we dance properly. Inanda niyakapya, bantu boonse bakatantamuka nkaambo muwo wakali munji. = When the house caught fire, all the people scattered because there was a strong wind. Beenzuma banditantamuka, balongwe bangu ninziniini abukata. My companions have moved away, my friends are flies and loneliness. (1.-tantamukwa, 2.-tantamukide, 3.-tantamuzya, 4.-tantamukila, 5.-tantamukilalyo, 6.-tantamukisya, 7.-tantamuka-tantamuka, 8.-tantamukana)
  • swell as stomach, Ida lyakwe lyakatantamuka naakafwa. His stomach swelled when he died. Also: -fwutumuka.
be at a distance from, Zibondo zyambelele zilitantamukide amaanda abantu. = The enclosures of the sheep are removed a distance from the houses of the people.

leave a passage between, take out of the way, Kamubatantamuna bana munsi aanzila. Take the children away from the path. Musilikani utantamuna bantu acisobano. = The policeman is moving people to make room for the concert. (1.-tantamunwa, 2.-tantamwide, 3.-tantamuzya, 4.-tantamwida, 5.-tantamwidalyo, 6.-tantamunisya, 7.-tantamuna-tantamuna, 8.-tantamunana) Also: -sosolosya.

take a high position, help to mount, rt. -tanta, Batantika nombe mucitolokesi. They are making the cattle get up on to the wagon. Ndali kutantika mwana mucitima. = I was helping the child to get on the train. cf. -tansika. (1.-tantikwa, 2.-tantikide, 3.-tantisya, 4.-tantikila, 5.-tatikilalyo, 6.-tantikisya, 7.-tantika-tantika, 8.-tantikana)
bounce, as a ball, Ibbola lilatanuka kuti lyapompwa kabotu. = The ball bounces if it is well pumped Also: -dundubuka.

open, as an ox along stomach, Nibakamana kufwunda nombe, bakaitanuna akugusya zyamukati. = When they had skined the cow, they opened it and took out the insides. (1.-tanunwa, 2.-tanwide, 3.-tanuzya, 4.-tanwida, 5.-tanwidalyo, 6.-tanunisya, 7.-tanuna-tanuna, 8.-tanunana) Also: -fwundula.
help to board, rt. -tanta, Bamasilikani bakamupa cipepa cakuti akatansye kuya kwakwe kumunzi. = The police gave him a paper to help him get on a bus to go to his home.

jump about, *Inswi zyatapata kuzwa mumeenda.* = The fish are jumping out of the water. *Kumazuba balanuna tunseenga, balajana nswi zilatapata mukati.* = In the evening they take the fish traps out of the water, they find the fish jumping about inside. *Mukaintu wakali kutapata akoompolola.* = The woman was jumping about and shouting. (1.-tapatwa, 2.-tapatide, 3.-tapatya, 4.-tapatila, 5.-tapatilalyo, 6.-tapatisya, 7-tapata-tapata, 8-tapatizyanya) Also: -tipita.

jump about after, *Kangoye kakatapatila nzoka.* = The kitten was jumping about after the snake.
  • reprimand, scold, *Munene wakabatapatila bana nibakasowa mpongo.* = The old man gave out to the children when they lost the goat. *Bakamutapatila kabati wakatalika kuzanga.* = They scolded him saying he had begun to rebel. *Kutapatilwa lyoonse-lyoonse ncibi, aboobo kuzwa sunu uliyake, ube nduwe.* = It is bad to be always reprimanded, and so from today improve, be yourself. (1.-tapatilwa, 2.-tapatilide, 3.-tapatizya, 4.-tapatilila, 5.-tapatililalyo, 6.-tapatilisya, 7.-tapatila-tapatila, 8.-tapatilana)

jump out as sparks or slosh out as water from bucket or maize from tin, *Meenda alatapauka kuzwa munongo.* = The water is slopping out of the pot. *Nsasi zyakatapauka akumwaikizyanya mubwizu boonse.* = The sparks shot out and spread throughout all the grass. *Bantu bakatalika kutapauka kutandwa kumulimo wabo.* = People began to be thrown out in droves from their work. (1.-tapaukwa, 2.-tapaukide 3.-tapaukizya, 4.-tapaukila, 5.-tapaukilalyo, 6.-tapaukisya, 7.-tapauka-tapauka)

throw out from a container, *Kamutapaula bunyenyene mu cibwa V - 570 ntu. = Remove the insects off the sweet beer. (1.-tapaulwa, 2.-tapawide, 3.-tapauzya, 4.-tapawida, 5.-tapawidalyo, 6.-tapaulisya, 7.-tapaula-tapaula, 8.-tapaulana)

be struck off, be thrown off, *Ndakatapuka mootokala niwakauma ncinga njindakatantide.* = I was thrown off when the motorcar struck the bicycle which I was riding. *Inswi yatapuka kuzwa mumoono.* = A fish jumped out of the fish-basket. Also: -somboka. (1.-tapukwa, 2.-tapukide, 3.-tapukizya, 4.-tapukila, 5.-tapukilalyo, 6.-tapukisya. 7.-tapuka-tapuka, 8.-tapukizyanya)
  • rush, *Mbuwalilila mulangu, mwiiyi wamana kuyiisya ciiyo eeco, watapuka ulaya uya kumbi kukkilasi kuyooisya.* = As soon as the bell rang, the teacher having finished one lesson, would rush off to teach in another class.

be struck off, bounce off, rush out, spread, rt. -tapuka, *Mbwaafwusa ibbwe lyakwe kuuma kayuni mpoona lyatapukila kwakali nzuki akumwaikizyanya.* = As he threw his stone to hit the little bird, it bounced off to where the bees were and scattered them. *Bana baniini mbabakasaanguna kutapukila anze.* = The children were the first to rush out.

shake off or brush off, move out of the way, *Kotapula cuuka eeco cakukkala amutwe.* = Brush off that insect which is sitting on the head. *Kotapula moongolwa ooyo utatantaliki mwana.* = Brush off that millipede so that it does not move along on the child. *Nibakali kuyaabweenda, kasamu kakaitapula nsangwa ya Nakaala.* = As they were walking along, a branch knocked the basket off Nakaala's head. *Mebo ndakakkala munsi lyakwe ndakamukumbata akuboko kumwi, nkujana tanditapuli akunditapula pe.* = I sat down beside her and put my arm around her, to find that she did not shake me off at all. Also: -sansa. (1.-tapulwa, 2.-tapwide, 3.-tapuzya, 4.-tapwida, 5.-twapwidalyo, 6.-tapulisya, 7.-tapula-tapula, 8.-tapulana)
  • extract a lot of honey from a hive, Cakatola ciindi cilamfwu kutapula buci nkaambo bwakali bunji. It took a long time to extract the honey because there was so much of it.

extract a lot of honey, Bantu batapununa buci kuzwa mucikooko. = People extracted a lot of honey from the traditional bee hive. (1.-tapununwa, 2.-tapunwide, 3.-tapunuzya, 4.-tapunwida, 5.-tapunwidalyo, 6.-tapununisya, 7.-tapununa-tapununa, 8.-tapununana)

be thrown off from, Bunyenyene bwakali atalaa mabbuku bwakatapuuka muwo niwakabbubbula. = When the wind blew, the ants which were on top of the books were thrown off. (1.-tapuukwa, 2.-tapuukide, 3.-tapuukizya, 4.-tapuukila, 5.-tapuukilalyo, 6.-tapuukisya, 7.-tapuuka-tapuuka, 8.-tapuukizyanya) Also: -lapuuka.

be far away from one another, Batonga balatataana kukkala. = The Batonga live in scattered villages. (1.-tataanwa, 2.-tateene, 3.-tataanya, 4.-tataanina, 5.-tataaninalyo, 6.-tataanisya, 7.-tataana-tataana, 8.-tataana) Also: -tantaana.

walk unsteadily, be as if about to fall, Mumujatilile mulwazi ooyo ucitatalika buya kweenda. Help that patient as he is still walking unsteadily. Bamwi bantu nobatakoledwe balatatalika kweenda. Some people walk unsteadily even though they are not drunk. Also: -tenteleka, -dadalika. (1.-tatalikwa, 2.-tatalikide, 3.-tatalikizya. 4.-tatalikila, 5.-tatalikilalyo, 6.-tatalikisya. 7.-tatalika-tatalika)

cry very much, Mubwa wali kutatama kukuwa sunu. The dog was barking a lot last night. (1.-tatamwa, 2.-tatamide, 3.-tatamya, 4.-tatamina, 5.-tataminalyo, 6.-tatamisya, 7.-tatama-tatama, 8.-tataminana)
  • speak with a high prolonged tone, Bamwi kuti banyema balatatama kukanana. Some people when angry speak in a high sustained voice.

have a marriage blessed in church, Twakatatanisigwa jilo kucikombelo ku Chikuni. = We were married yesterday in the church in Chikuni. (2.-tatanisidwe, 3.-tatanisya, 4.-tatanisiIwa, 5.-tatanisilwalyo) -tatanisya Fwala Nchete nguwakatatanisya Cheelo a Mutinta nibakakwatana. Fr. Nchete was the one who conducted the marriage ceremony of Cheelo and Mutinta when they were married.

protrude, Nsinga mu maboko zyakaide kutatanyene. = The veins in the arms were protruding. (1.-tatanyanwa, 2.-tatanyene, 3.-tatanyika, 4.-tatanyanina, 5.-tatanyaninalyo, 6.-tatanyanisya, 6.-tatanyana-tatanyana, 7.-tatanyaninana)

be wasted, scattered, Indongwe zyatatauka akaambo kankuku. = The groundnuts were scattered because of the hens.
  • get excited, get worked up Boonse balikutatauka baumuna. = All those who were getting excited became quiet. Wakali kufwumbwa atalika kutatauka mukaintu, walo nkunyamuka nkuya bweendeenda kutegwa aboola ajane waumuna. Whenever his wife used to get worked up, he got up and went off walking so that when he came back he would find that she had calmed down. (1.-tataukwa, 2.-tataukide, 3.-tatausya, 4.-tataukila, 5.-tataukilalyo, 6.-tataukisya, 7.-tatauka-tatauka, 8.-tataukilana)

scatter, waste, Nguni watataula mabbukaangu? = Who scattered my books? Wakabatataula bantu naakabatukila = He scattered the people when he insulted them. (1.-tataulwa, 2.-tatawide, 3.-tatauzya, 4.-tatawida, 5.-tatawidalyo, 6.-tataulisya, 7.-tataula-tataula, 8.-tataulana) Also: -takuula, -takaula, -vwinyana.

howl, Masiku kwali bazyana, babwa batataya kukuwa. = Last night there were people who were dancing, the dogs were howling. (1.-tatayigwa, 2.-tatayide, 3.-tatayizya, 4.-tatayila, 5.-tatayilalyo, 6.-tatayilisya, 7.-tataya-tataya, 8.-tatayana) Also: -tatama

charge or load a gun, Kotatila ntobolo tukajaye syaambololo. = Load the gun so that we kill a kudu. (1.-tatilwa, 2.-tatilide, 3.-tatizya, 4.-tatilila, 5.-tatililalyo, 6.-tatilisya, 7.-tatila-tatila, 8.-tatilana) Also: -pakila.

destroy, Ndakulekelela, utakaindululi kabili nkaambo kabili kaya kutatula cisyabo cesu. = I forgive you, do not do it again because the second time it will destroy our engagement. (1.-tatulwa, 2.-tatwide, 3.-tatuzya, 4.-tatwida, 5.-tatwi-dalyo, 6.-tatulisya, 7.-tatula-tatula, 8.-tatulana)

get excited, Malimba naakakolwa bukoko, wakatalika kutatuuka. When Malimba was drunk with. beer, he started getting excited. Also: -tatauka. (1.-tatuukwa, 2.-tatuukide, 3.-tatuukizya, 4.-tatuukila, 5.-tatuukilalyo, 6.-tatuukisya, 7.-tatuuka-tatuuka, 8.-tatuukilana)
  • be scattered, Indongwe zyatatuuka akaambo kankuku. = The groundnuts were scattered because of the hens. Also: -tatauka.

scatter, Inkuku zitatuula mapopwe, kamuzyuuma. = The hens are scattering the maize, chase them away. (1.-tatuulwa, 2.-tatwiide, 3.-tatuuzya. 4.-tatwiida, 5.-tatwiidalyo, 6.-tatuulisya, 7.-tatuula-tatuula, 8.-tatuulana) Also: -tataula.

enslave oneself to, put oneself under another's control, Sunu kulitaya kwakamana. Today the custom of 'kulitaya' has ended. Ndalitaya, baya badaala ndabaita zina litali lyabo. = I have enslaved myself, I have called that old man by a name which is not his. (1.-tayigwa, 2.-tayide, 3.-tayizya, 4.-tayila, 5.-tayilalyo, 6.-tayilisya, 7.-taya-taya, 8.-tayilana)

reward with money for some achievement, Bakanditayila mali nindakazunda mumuzundano. = They gave me a reward when I won the competition. Kamumutayila mwana wainda kwiimba. Give a reward to the child who surpassed others in singing. (1.-tayilwa, 2.-tayide, 3.-tayizya, 4.-tayilila, 5.-tayililalyo, 6.-tayilisya, 7.-tayila-tayila, 8.-tayilana)
Also: -tazama Also: -taila.

put the legs apart, Koleka kutazama kukkala wabaasya bamwi. = Stop spreading your legs apart as you sit, you have taken the place of others. Kotazama litakuumi bbola. Spread your legs so that the ball does not strike you. (1.-tazamwa, 2.-tazamide, 3.-tazamya, 4.-tazamina, 5.-tazaminalyo, 6.-tazamisya, 7.-tazama-tazama, 8.-tazaminana)

stand with legs wide apart, Koleka kutazamana kutegwa kataindi kasulwe. Don't stand with your legs apart for the rabbit to run through. Also: -kwazama. (1.-tazamanwa, 2.-tazamene, 3.-tazamanya, 4.-tazamanina, 5.-tazamaninalyo, 6.-tazamanisya, 7.-tazamana-tazamana, 8.-tazamaninana)

stand with legs apart, Komutazamina mwana kutegwa ainde muntebe natija mubwa. Would you stand with legs apart for the child to pass through since it is being chased by the dog. (1.-tazaminwa, 2.-tazamene, 3.-tazamika, 4.-tazaminina, 5.-tazamininalyo, 6.-tazaminisya, 7.-tazamina-tazamina, 8.-tazaminana)

be stretched out, Kaatazamuka maulu kutegwa ulyoolole. = Put out your legs so that you can stretch. (1.-tazamukwa, 2.-tazamukide, 3.-tazamukizya, 4.-tazamukila, 5.-tazamukilalyo, 6.-tazamukisya, 7.-tazamuka-tazamuka, 8.-tazamukana)

stretch out, Bazubi batazamuna lusabwi kujata nswi. = The fishermen stretched out their fishing nets so as to catch fish. (1.-tazamunwa, 2.-tazamwide, 3.-tazamuzya, 4.-tazamwida, 5.-tazamwidalyo, 6.-tazamunisya, 7.-tazamuna-tazamuna, 8.-tazamunana)

stretch as wire of fence, Bantu batazanuna luwaile Iwamuunda. = The people are stretching out the wire for the field. (1.-tazanunwa, 2.-tazanwide, 3.-tazanuzya, 4.-tazanwida, 5.-tazanwidalyo, 6.-tazanunisya, 7.-tazanuna-tazanuna, 8.-tazanwidana)

undo a knot, take apart, Balutazaula loozi ndubaangizide cifwuko cankuku. They undid the knot with which they had tied the crate of hens. Basilikani batazaula caanda camubbi. = The police dismantled the house of the thief. cf. -tazulula, -angununa. (1.-tazaulwa, 2.-tazawide, 3.-tazauzya, 4.-tazawida, 5.-tazawidalyo, 6.-tazaulisya, 7.-tazaula-tazaula, 8.-tazalana)

undo a belt, remove a prop, Kamucitazula caanda cankuku. = Remove the hen house. Ndali kutazula looye Iwaangide mubwa wangu. = I was undoing the rope which had held my dog. Also: -angununa, -angulula, -kopoola (1.-tazulwa, 2.-tazwide, 3.-tazuzya, 4.-tazwida, 5.-tazwidalyo, 6.-tazulisya, 7.-tazula-tazula, 8.-tazulana)
  • speak angrily, Bunji bwabalombwana bakali kusika kudilwe bakali kutazula, bakaintu boonse bakali kulila. = Most of the men who arrived at the funeral were speaking angrily, all the women were crying.
undo a knot, rt. -tazula (1.-tazululwa, 2.-tazulwide, 3.-tazuluzya, 4.-tazulwida, 5.-tazulwidalyo, 6.-tazululisya, 7.-tazulula-tazulula, 8.-tazululana)

be mysterious, be beyond one's power to understand, rt. -tala, Eeci cacitika sunu cilatazya kapati. = The thing which happened today is a mystery. Akaliko mazyiba akali kutazya. Ngamalende ngutwakali kukambila akali azitazya. = There were pools of water which were mysterious. These were the rain-shrines where we prayed for rain which had their wonders. (1.-tazyigwa, 2.-tazyizye, 4.-tazyizya, 5.-tazyizyalyo, 6.-tazyisya, 7.-tazya-tazya, 8.-tazyanya)
have sex with, Bapati bamwi balateba bana basimbi. = Some elders have sex with young girls. (1.-tebwa, 2.-tebede, 3.-tebya, 4.-tebela, 5.-tebelalyo, 6.-tebesya, 7.-teba-teba, 8.-tebana)
become loose or weak, Inkanka yacilayi ilateba-teba. = The peg of the seldge is loose. Also: -gwebagweba,-kweba-kweba,-koba-koba,-tebela.
gather firewood, Baya kukutebba nkuni musyokwe basimbi boonse. All the girls went to gather firewood in the bush. (1.-tebbwa, 2.-tebbede, 3.-tebbya or
4.-tebbela, 5.-tebbelalyo, 6.-tebbesya, 7.-tebba-tebba, 8.-tebbelana.) Also: -tepa.
be in a lose state, Looye Iwakaangidwe kukuulu Iwakalitebede. = The rope which was tied to the leg was lose.

hang down loosely as chain or rope, Kamutebeka kwaanga mubwa. Tie the dog loosely. Ncibotu kutebeka buyo kwaanga mpongo munsingo. It is good to tie the goat around the neck just loosely. Also: -koba-koba. (1.-tebekwa, 2.-tebekede, 3.-tebekezya, 4.-tebekela, 5.-tebekelalyo, 6.-tebekesya, 7.-tebeka-tebeka, 8.-tebekana)
  • walk side by side, Musankwa uulya utebeka musimbi ngwayanda kukwata. = That boy is walking side by side with the girl he intends to marry.
walk side by side, Moonga amusimbi wakwe bakali kutebekana mumugwagwa. Moonga and his girl friend were walking side by side on the road.
be put losely, Looye Iwakalitebekedwe kumeja a musune. = The rope was put losely around the horns of the ox.

become loose, Zyoonse nkazi nzyobakajisi zyakaide kuba zyabuyo, zyatebela. All the stubbourness which they had just became nothing, it slipped away. Cisani mocili mucibuno cakatebela. = The cloth which is around the waist became loose. Nketani yabasune yatebela. = The chain of the ox is loose. Lwatebela looye nobasankwa tamukoosyanga kabotu. = The cord is loose, boys, you will not plant well. Nobakasobana ciindi cilamfwu bakatebela, nkabela bakanwisigwa magoolo obile. = When they were playing for a long time, they became slack and so two goals were scored against them. (1.-tebezyegwa, 2.-tebede, 3.-tebezya, 4.-tebelela, 5.-tebelelalyo, 6.-tebelesya, 7.-tebela-tebela, 8.-tebezyanya) Also: -tebuluka.

rush to search for something, Bamasilikani bakatebenkana kuya mubakasiide muntu wakali muzumi. = The police rushed to where they had left the man who was alive. (1.-tebenkanwa, 2.-tebenkene, 3.-tebenkanya, 4.-tebenkanina, 5.-tebenkaninalyo, 6.-tebenkanisya, 7.-tebenkana-tebenkana, 8.-tebenkaninana)

make loose, rt. tebeka, Kotebezya lutambo ndolyaangide mucibuno kutegwa ulye kabotu. Loosen the belt around your waist so that you can eat well. Wakatebezya bulukwe mbwaakasamide. He loosened the trousers he was wearing. (1.-tebezyegwa, 2.-tebezyede, 3.-tebezya, 4.-tebezyezya, 5.-tebezyezyalyo, 6.-tebezyesya, 7.-tebezya-tebezya, 8.-tebezyanya) Also: -kobezya, -tebesya.

run out of supplies. Zilyo zyakwe nozyakatebuka, wakasola kujana zilyo zimbi. = When his food was finished he tried to find other food. (1.-tebukwa, 2.-tebukide, 3.-tebukizya, 4.-tebukila, 5.-tebukilalyo, 6.-tebukisya, 7.-tebukatebuka, 8.-tebukana)

harvest, Swebo kuno twatalika kale kutebula. = We here have already begun to harvest. Bantu batebula mumwezi wa Kaanda-kaniini. = People harvest during the month of May. (1.-tebulwa, 2.-tebwide or -tebude, 3.-tebuzya, 4.-tebulila/-tebwida, 5.-tebulilalyo/-tebwidalyo, 6.-tebulisya, 7.-tebula-tebula, 8.-tebulana) Also: -limuna.

become loose or slack, Looye Iwaangidwe nombe Iwatebuluka. The rope which held the cow has become loose. (1.-tebulukwa, 2.-tebulukide, 3.-tebuluzya, 4.-tebulukila, 5.-tebulukilalyo, 6.-tebulukisya, 7.-tebuluka-tebuluka, 8.-tebulukana) Also: -tebela, -tebunuka.
  • disappear by dwindling away as a stream, abate, Basicikolo balanduka nikatebuluka kalonga. = The pupils crossed when the stream abated. Also: -yosa

go dancing with special steps in the open, Bamakaintu bakatebuntuka kuzyana ngoma niyakalila kabotu. = The women went dancing in the open space when the drum sounded well. (1.-tebuntukwa, 2.-tebuntukide, 3.-tebuntuzya, 4.-tebuntukila, 5.-tebuntukilalyo, 6.-tebuntukisya, 7.-tebuntuka-tebuntuka, 8.-tebuntukaninana)

become quite slack, ease off, Sunu bulwazi bwangu bwatebunuka asyoonto. = Today my illness has eased off a little. (1.-tebunukwa, 2.-tebunukide, 3.-tebunuzya, 4.-tebunukila, 5.-tebunukilalyo, 6.-tebunukisya, 7.-tebunuka-tebunuka, 8.-tebunukizyanya)

loosen, Komutebununa musune, citolopo cilamusina. = Loosen the ox, the straps are choking it. Also: -tebezya, -fwasununa, -fwefwenunas, -vwevwenuna. (1.-tebununwa, 2.-tebunwide, 3.-tebunuzya, 4.-tebunwida, 5.-tebunwidalyo, 6.-tebununisya, 7.-tebununa-tebununa, 8.-tebununana)

set traps, rt. -teya, Tuyakukuyunza mputwateede tooye. = We are going to inspect the traps which we set. (1.-teegwa, 2.-teede, 3.-teezya, 4.-teela, 5.-teelalyo, 6.-teesya, 7.-teedeteede, 8.-teyana)
  • load, as gun, Mulumi wakaindilila kumulyango kwakali kuteedwe ntobola. = The man went over to the door where the gun was loaded.

be set to trap, rt. -teya, Musamu ngwaakateegwa wakaulyata. = He stepped on the medicine which was set to trap him. Bantu bamwi bakali kufwa kwiinda mukuteegwa musamu wabu lozi. = Some people were dying by being caught by the medicine of witchcraft.

collect with, Munyama uyoosya wakalungumana kujulu kuteekezya meenda amulomo wakwe mupati ngwaakakwankwamuna kulakama ukoya ciluli cananda casalamikwa. = The terrifying beast looked up to collect the rainwater with it's huge mouth which it had opened widely like an inverted roof of a house. (1.-teekezyegwa, 2.-teekezyede, 3.-teekezyesya, 4.-teekezyezya, 5.-teelezyezyalyo, 6.-teekezyesya, 7.-teekezya-teekezya, 8.-teekezyanya)

lay poison, rt. -teya, Ncaciswa Haamoomba, bakamuteela musamu mubukoko. = The reason why Haamoomba is sick is that they put poison in his beer. (1.-teelwa, 2.-teede, 3.-teezya, 4.-teela, 5.-teelalyo, 6.-teesya, 7.-teela-teela, 8.-teelana) Also: -bebekela.

catch as in a container, Koteelekezya mulewu mukupa kuulokela mumo nekama. = Catch the milk with the container so that it drops into it when I am milking. Beenzuma bateelekezya meenda amvwula. = My friends are catching rain-water. Wakafwambaana kuya kupompi akuya kuteelekezya meenda mucingomo. = He went to the pump to collect water in a container.

understand, listen, hear, obey, Koteelela nesola kukwaambila. = Listen when I try to tell you. Bana beelede kuteelela bapati. Children should obey the elders. (1.-teelelwa, 2.-teelede, 3.-teelezya, 4.-teeleda, 5.-teeledalyo, 6.-teelelesya, 7.-teelela-teelela, 8.-teelelana)
  • smell, Kociteelela cisyu naa cinunkila kabotu. = Smell the relish to see if it has a nice aroma..
be heard, be obeyed, rt. teelela, Bazyali boonse balayanda ku teelelwa abana babo. = All parents desire to be obeyed by their children.

listen, rt. -teelela, Nditeelezya bantu *balimvwinsya kulila kujwe ooku.* = I am listening to the people who can be heard weeping to the east. (1.-teelezyegwa, 2.-teelezyede, 3.-teelezyesya, 4.-teelezyezya, 5.-teelezyezyalyo, 6.-teelezyesya, 7.-teelezya-teelezya, 8.-teelezyanya)
  • bring together, as animals, Ndakaita basankwa botatwe kuti bandigwasye kuteelezya basune nindakali kuyanda kusunga. = I called three boys to assist me in bringing the oxen together when I wanted to span them.

run along, *Bakaintu bakali kuteema-teema kuzyana.* = The women were running along to dance. (1.-teemwa, 2.-teemede, 3.-teemya, 4.-teemena, 5.-teemenalyo, 6.-teemesya, 7.-teema-teema, 8.-teemezyanya)
  • glide, *Ndabona bayuni kabateema atalaa makumbi.* = I saw birds gliding above the clouds.
have reached, rt. -taana, *Jolezya wakateene kule.* = Jolezya had reached a far place. (1.-taanwa, 2.-teene, 3.-taanya, 4.-taanina, 5.-taaninalyo, 6.-taanisya, 7.-teene-teene, 8.-taanizyanya)

surround, *Basilikani bakamuteenkana mubbi wakabula mbwatija.* = The police surrounded the thief who had nowhere to escape. Also: -oba. (1.-teenkanwa, 2.-teenkene, 3.-teenkanya, 4.-teenkanina, 5.-teenkaninalyo, 6.-teenkanisya, 7.-teenkana-teenkana, 8.-teenkaninana)
take up the position of surrounding, *Baalumi bakadukwide mulilo, zilyo bakaliziteenkene.* = The men had turned their backs to the fire and surrounded the food.

trap with, rt. -teya, *Imbiya nzeziteezya nswa.* = Clay pots are used to trap edible ants. Kuti koyanda kujata banyama bapati mukuteya, koteezya luwaile. = If you want to catch big animals by trapping them, you should use wire to trap them. *Banditeezya cibbayi kutegwa ndeke kuzyala.* = They trapped me with charms so that I become impotent. (1.-teegwa, 2.-teede, 3.-teezya, 4.-teela, 5.-teelalyo, 6.-teesya, 7.-teezya-teezya, 8.-teezyanya)

tickle to cause laughter, *Mwana wakaseka banyina nibakamuteguwa.* = The child laughed when it's mother tickled it. (1.-tegunigwa, 2.-teguwide, 3.-teguwizya, 4.-teguwila, 5.-teguwilalyo 6.-teguwisya, 7.-teguwateguwa, 8.-teguwana) Also: -tekenya, -tegunya, -dekaanya.

tickle, cause to shake with laughter, *Bacita kunditegunya buya kuti nseke.* = They tickled me so that I would laugh. (1.-tegunyigwa, 2.-tegunyide, 3.-tegunyizya, 4.-tegunwida, 5.-tegunwidalyo, 6.-tegunyisya, 7.-tegunya-tegunya, 8.-tegunyana) Also: -dekeenya.

submit to a person, *Wakalibombya akulitegwaanya kuli nguwe.* = He humbled himself and submitted to her. (1.-tegwaanyigwa, 2.-tegwaanyide, 3.-tegwaanya, 4.-tegwaanyina, 5.-tegwaanyinalyo, 6.-tegwaanyisya, 7.tegwaanya-tegwaanya, 8.-tegwaanyizyanya)

draw water, *Basimbi a baama bayakukuteka meenda.* = The girls and my mother have gone to draw water. (1.-tekwa, 2.-tekede, 3.-tekezya or tesya, 4-tekela, 5.-tekelalyo, 6.-tekesya, 7.-tekateka, 8.-tekelana.)
draw water for someone, rt. teka, *Basimbi bakaunka kumulonga kuya kumutekela meenda mucembele.* = The girls went to the river going to draw water for the old woman.

shake from side to side, *Bwato bwali kutekaana mudamu.* = The boat was shaking up and down on the dam. (1.-tekaanizyigwa, 2.-tekeene, 3.-tekaanya, 4.-tekaanina, 5.-tekaaninalyo, 6.-tekaanisya, 7.-tekaana-tekaana, 8.-tekaanizyanya)
tickle, *Tacili cibotu kutekaanya muntu uciswa.* = It is not good to tickle someone who is sick. Also: -nyiminya, -dekeenya, -dekaanya.
spread legs so as to hold something between them, Musankwa wamaboko mapati aminwe mipati ai

kuyuuma ngoma, basimbi inga bazyana kapati. The boy with big arms and fingers stretches out his legs to hold the drum between them so that he can really beat it, thereupon the girls dance vigourously. (1.-tekamaninwa, 2.-tekemene, 3.-tekemeka, 4.-tekamanina, 5.-tekamaninalyo, 6.-tekamanisya, 7.tekamanina-tekamanina, 8.-tekamaninana)

draw water for, rt. -teka, Basimbi batekelela mali. The girls are drawing water for money. (1.-tekelewa, 2.-tekelede, 3.-tekelezya, 4.-tekelelela, 5.-tekelelelalyo, 6.-tekelelesya, 7.-tekelela-tekelela, 8.-tekelelana)

legs bend outwards, suffer from rickets, *Kutekemana maulu inga toyendi kabotu.* = If you are bow-legged you do not walk well. *Maulu akwe akatekemana naakacili mwana.* His legs became bent when he was still a child. (1.-tekemanwa, 2.-tekemene, 3.-tekemanina, 5.-tekemaninalyo, 6.-tekemanisya, 7.-tekemana-tekemana, 8.-tekemaninana)

be bow-legged, *Ulaa mapuwo kana yebo otekemeka maulu* *kubee bakama nombe nsomona.* = You young fellow, you are proud who are bowlegged as if you are milking a cow which has had her first calf. (1.-tekemekwa, 2.-tekemekede, 3.-tekemeka, 4.-tekemekela, 5.-tekemekelalyo, 6.-tekemekesya, 7.-tekemeka-tekemeka, 8.-tekemekana)

make laugh by tickling, *Nseyandi unditekena mebo ndilaa bunyeele.* I don't like someone tickling me so that I laugh, I am sensitive. Also: -tekenya. (1.-tekenyegwa, 2.-tekenyede, 3.-tekenyezya, 4.-tekenyezyezya, 5.-tekenyezyezyalyo, 6.-tekenyesya, 7.-tekena-tekena, 8.-tekenyezyanya)

tickle, *Nseyandi uunditekenya pe.* I don't like someone tickling me. *Nziniini zilaboola kukkala kumpemo yangu kutalika kuitekenya.* = Flies come to sit on my nose and begin to tickle it. Also: -tegunya, teguwa, -dekaanya. (1.-tekenyegwa, 2.-tekenyede, 3.-tekenya, 4.-tekenyezyezya, 5.-tekenyezyezyalyo, 6.-tekenyesya, 7.-tekenya-tekenya, 8.-tekenyana)
  • cause laughter, *Wasika mulombe unoneezya akankobela kakwe, Iwiimbo Iwakwe lulatekenya.* The boy who is sweet on his hand-piano has arrived, his songs are entertaining.

dangle, as horns, shake loosely, *Musune wabataata ujisi meja ateketa.* My father's ox has loose horns. (1.-teketwa, 2.-teketede, 3.-teketezya, 4.-teketela, 5.-teketelalyo, 6.-teketesya, 7.-teketa-teketa, 8.-teketezyanya)

pay attention to, *Muntu ulaa kumulomo ngonguyooyo uunga wati wakanana buti, kunyina muntu unga wamuteketela.* A person who speaks too much, he is the one that no matter how he speaks no one will pay attention to him. (1.-teketelwa, 2.-teketede, 3.-teketezya, 4.-teketelela, 5.-teketelalyo, 6.-teketelesya, 7.-teketela-teketela, 8.-teketelana)
draw as water from a bucket, Kofwambaana kutekula meenda masyoonto umutile a mutwe mwana wapya zuba. Quickly draw a little water to pour on the head of the child who is feeling hot. Also: -tekaula.

draw by repeated movements, rt. teka, Nolyakabbila zuba, baama bakatekuula cibwantu kutila munongo ziniini-niini. = When the sun sank, my mother was repeatedly drawing the sweet-beer pouring it into smaller pots. Mbwaakasikila buyo mukati kuti atekuule busu, kasamu kakajisi ciluli kakatyoka. = As soon as she went inside to collect the flour, the pole which held the roof collapsed. (1.-tekuulwa, 2.-tekwiide, 3.-tekuuzya, 4.-tekwiida, 5.-tekwiidalyo, 6.-tekuulisya, 7.-tekuula-tekuula, 8.-tekwiidana)

pay tax, Ndakatela buyo mwaka omwe. I paid tax only for one year. Baya kukutela mali aacipeku-peku ncotulangilila. = They are going to pay a tax for watching T.V.. (1.-telwa, 2.-telede, 3.-tezya, 4.-telela, 5.-telelalyo, 6.-telesya, 7.-tela-tela, 8.-telelana)

plan to do, Baama batelaika kuya kunkolola. My mother has planned to go to the initiation ceremony. Ndakageme kutelaika lufwu akupaila ku Mwami. I turned my attention to prepare for death and pray to the Lord. (1.-telaikwa, 2.-telaikide, 3.-telaisya, 4.-telaikila, 5.-telaikilalyo, 6.-telaikisya, 7.-telaika-telaika, 8.-telaikana)

cause to plan, Naakabweela Iwabili sikusela wakali kulitelaisya mwini kati, "Cibota ndaajana makani ba ndibambila." = When the marriage negotiator came back a second time, he was making plans to himself saying, " It will be good if I find that they have settled the marriage plans for me.

gather, rt. -telekela, Buzuba bumwi gande lyakajana nongo yakatelekede tweenda muciteyo. = One day a frog found a clay pot which had gathered a little water under a shrub. Nindakasika ku Monze ndakajana meenda alitelekede mumigwagwa. = When I reached Monze I found that the water had gathered on the roads.

gather as water, Imvwula niyawa, mazyiba alatelekela. = When the rain falls the pools fill up with water. Mumeso akwe muzikutelekela misozi yakweetela. In her eyes pitiful tears will gather. (1.-telekelwa, 2.-telekede, 3.-telekezya, 4.-telekezyezya, 5.-telekezyezyalyo, 6.-telekezyesya, 7.-telekedetelekede, 8.-telekezyanya)
gather as water into a container or hole, Telekezya meenda kaanjila mucigumbuli. = Collect the water so that it flows into the container.

be slippery, Kacumbika ulayala katobo kamwana warjombe katelemuka. Kacumbika spreads out the dried skin of a calf which is slippery. (1.-telemukwa, 2.-telemukide, 3.-telemusya, 4.-telemukila, 5.-telemukilalyo, 6.-telemukisya. 7.-telemuka-telemuka) Also: -tezemuka.

cut down, lop off, cut as grass or maize, Kamufwambaana kutema mapopwe. Cut the maize quickly. Bacembele batema mabu aazisuwo. = The old lady is cutting reeds for baskets. (1.-temwa, 2.-temede, 3.-temya, 4.-temena, 5.-temenalyo, 6.-temesya, 7.-tema-tema, 8.-temenana)

cut down in great quantities, rt. -tema, Mumoma wakatemauna mapopwe izuba nilyakazumanana kubala. = The white ants cut down a lot of maize when the sun continued to shine. (1.-temaunwa, 2.-temawide, 3.-temauzya, 4.-temawida, 5.-temawidalyo, 6.-temaunisya, 7.-temauna-temauna, 8.-temaunana)

carry together, carry with others, Wakaba wakutemba buya Mutinta nkaambo kakuciswa kapati. = It became a matter of people carrying Mutinta because she was so sick. Kamutemba cikuni cipati tucisikke. = Carry the big log so that we put it on the fire. Ndabona basankwa bobilo batemba ncindalikuyeeya kuti musunta wabwizu ani nguzenimutendu. I saw two boys carrying what I thought was a bundle of grass, instead of that it was a big fish. (1.-tembwa, 2.-tembede, 3.-tembya, 4.-tembela, 5-tembelalyo, 6.-tembesya, 7.-temba-temba, 8. tembana)
  • depend on, Kunyina anentemba baacisya pe kuti njakukona lubono. = I have never depended on my uncle saying I would inherit his wealth.

praise by giving traditional titles, Bakamutembaula mwami mumazina anguli. = They praised the chief through traditional names. Ndabayanda bacembele banditembaula. = I like the old woman who calls me by traditional names. (1.-tembaulwa, 2.-tembawida, 3.-tembauzya, 4.-tembawida, 5.-tembawidalyo, 6.-tembaulisya, 7.-tembaulatembaula, 8.-tembaulana)
cause to praise, Zina lyakuti 'O Munamwaaba' ndizina ndyatembauzya Naakkoyo nabandika amuntu umwi. The name Munamwaaba is the name by which Naakkoyo honours the person with whom she is conversing.

many carrying something together, rt. -temba, Twabona bamuleta kale balimutembede agwezyo bantu musanu mubatatu. = We saw eight people already carrying him on their shoulders. (1.-tembwa, 2.-tembede, 3.-tembya, 4.-tembela, 5.-tembelalyo, 6.-tembesya, 7.-tembede-tembede, 8.-tembelana)

carry along, rt. temba, Wakalota bantu mbaaba balamulila, ulifwide, balamutembeezya kutola kucuumbwe. He dreamed of people, there they are weeping for him, he is dead, they are carrying him along taking him to the grave. (1.-tembeezyegwa, 2.-tembeezyede, 3.-tembeezya, 4.-tembeezyezya, 5.-tembeezyezyalyo, 6.-tembeezyesya, 7.-tembeezya, 8.-tembeezyanya)

• praise, bless, Ncibotu kutembelela mwiimbi mubotu. = It is good to praise a good singer. Tulaitembelela mizimo mibotu nkaambo ilatwiiminina. We venerate the good spirits because they intercede for us. Also: -pembelela. (1.-tembelelwa, 2.-tembelede, 3.-tembelezya, 4.-tembelelela, 5.-tembelelelalyo, 6.-tembelelesya, 7.-tembelela-tembelela, 8.-tembelelana)
  • use an instrument to accompany a song, Balombwana bakatalika kufwala zintu zitembelela nyimbo zili mbuli ngoma, tulumbu a kankobela. = Men began to carve instruments to accompany songs like drums, one-stringed musical bows and hand-pianos.

praise, Kutembula mwami ncilengwa mu Butonga. Praising the chief is a custom in Tongaland. Kutembula bana nkubakulwaizya kucita ziluzi. = Praising children is encouraging them to do good. (1.-tembulwa, 2.-tembwide, 3.-tembuzya, 4.-tembwida, 5.-tembwidalyo, 6.-tembulisya, 7.-tembula-tembula, 8.-tembulana) Also: -tembaula.
be praised, Mwana ulatembulwa kumukowa wawisi. = A person is praised by (invoking) the father's clan.

praise, Bamacembele balayanda kutembuula bana. = Old women like praising children. Also: -tembaula (1.-tembuulwa, 2.-tembwiide, 3.-tembuuzya, 4.-tembwiida, 5.-tembwiidalyo, 6.-tembuulisya, 7.-tembuula-tembuula, 8.-tembuulana)

be carried, rt. temba, Kweenda koonse wakali kutembwa buya bulede abulo. = All his movement consisted in being carried lying on a bed. (2.-tembede, 3.-tembya, 4.-tembela, 5.-tembelalyo, 6.-tembesya, 7.-tembwa-tembwa, 8.-tembelana)

be cut, Basingoma mutanga lyangoma ya Syaanasulwe bakatemedwe nsimbo zyamusamu wakutayaswa masumo uutegwa musendazyiila. = The drummers of Syaanasulwe's group were cut with incisions for the medicine which protects them from being speared called musendazyiila. (1.-temedwe, 2.-temede, 3.-temya, 4.-temenwa, 5.-temenwalyo, 6.-temesye-gwa, 7.-temedwe-temedwe, 8.-temenanwa)

dry fish or meat on fire, Basulusi batemeka nswi zinji kapati. = Traders dry great amounts of fish. cf. -sanzika, -yanika. (1.-temekwa, 2.-temekede, 3.-temesya, 4.-temekela, 5.-temekelalyo, 6.-temekesya, 7.-temeka-temeka, 8.-temekana)
  • easy to be cut, rt. -tema, Eeyi minsale ilatemeka nkaambo mpyungu nzilamfwu. = These sugar-canes are easy to cut because the sections are long.

cut off, rt. -temuna, Ni-bakakaka kuya kulitemena miluso, ndakaunka kuyootema ndemwini yamwiingili. = When they refused to cut canes for themselves, I went to cut one myself from the mwiingili tree. (1.-temenwa, 2.-temenede, 3.-temenzya, 4.-temenena, 5.-temenenalyo, 6.-temenesya, 7.-temena-temena, 8.-temenana)

cut for, Webo koya ukanditemene muluso, njanda kumukandaula. You, go and cut a cane for me, I want to beat you. (1.-temenwe, 2.-temene, 3.-temenezya, 4.-temenena, 5.-temenenalyo, 6.-temenesya, 7.-temene-temene, 8.-temenenana)

cut for someone, rt. temuna, Nibwakaca ndakaunka kuya kubatemenena mapopwe bamaama. = When it was dawn I went to cut maize for my mother. (1.-temenenwa, 2.-temenenede, 3.-temenenezya, 4.-temenenena, 5.-temenenenalyo, 6.-temenenesya, 7.-temenena-temenena, 8.-temenenana)

be long and wavy, be pliable due to length, Kasamu kakalobo kalampisya ncokatempa-tempa. = The fishing rod is too long that is why it bends up and down. (1.-tempezyegwa-tempezyegwa, 2.-tempede-tempede, 3.-tempya-tempya, 4.-tempela-tempela, 5.-tempelalyo-tempelalyo, 6.-tempesya-tempesya, 7.-tempatempa-tempatempa, 8.-tempezyanya-tempezyanya
  • move from side to side, Muntu wakatala wiile kutempa-tempa. A tired person walks from side to side.

become loose, Mwida mulatempauka nkaambo ndalya cakulya cibi. = I have an upset stomach because I ate bad food. (1.-tempaukwa, 2.-tempaukide, 3.-tempausya, 4.tempaukila, 5.-tempaukilalyo, 6.-tempaukisya, 7.-tempauka-tempauka, 8.-tempausyanya)

cause to loosen, Bukoko mbwindanywa cifwumofwumo bwanditempaula mwida. The beer which I drank in the morning has loosened my bowels. (1.-tempaulwa, 2.-tempawide, 3.-tempauzya, 4.-tempawida, 5.-tempawidalyo, 6.-tempaulisya, 7.-tempaula-tempaula, 8.-tempaulana)
  • tempt, Bantu bamwi balayanda kutempaula beenzinyina kutegwa banjile muntenda. = Some people like to tempt their friends so that they get into trouble. Also: -tepaula, -sunka.

be weak, Mulwazi wali kwiile kutempeteka. = The body of the patient is weak.
  • be springy or pliable, wobble as a spear when thrown, Kasako nkaakandipa kakali kwiile kutempeteka. = The stick which she gave me was pliable. Boombe basune ubabone nkobatempeteka. = Look at the male calves how lively they are. Also: -tempa-tempa, -nema-nema. (1.-temepetekwa, 2.-tempetekede, 3.-tempetesya, 4.-tempetekela, 5.-tempetekelalyo, 6.tempetekesya, 7.-tempeteka-tempeteka, 8.-tempetekelana)

be filled with fear, Mwana wakatempuka naakajaya cibiya camusozya. The child was filled with fear when it broke the pot of samp. Sicibende wakatempuka akukankamana naakabona zyoonse zyakali munanda yamusondi. = Sicibende was full of fear and amazed when he saw all the things which were in the house of the diviner. Also: -yoowa, -ba acintebwe. (1.-tempukwa, 2.-tempukide, 3.-tempusya, 4.-tempukila, 5.-tempukilalyo, 6.-tempukisya, 7.-tempuka-tempuka, 8.-tempusyanya)
be terrified, Ndatempukwa nindabona mulavwu. = I was terrified when I saw the lion.

make one fear, Kupwaya nongo cilatempula. = To smash an earthen pot makes one afraid of being punished. (1.-tempulwa, 2.-tempwide, 3.-tempuzya, 4.-tempwida, 5.-tempwidalyo, 6.-tempulisya, 7.-tempula-tempula, 8.-tempulana)
  • receive abundantly, Masowe wakalutempula lubono Iwabausyi nibakafwa. Masowe got the abundance of his father's wealth when he died. Also: -timpula,-dimpula,-kunga,-fwoonkola.

cut off, as branch after branch, Musankwa utemuuna zisamu mumuunda. The boy is cutting off the branches one by one in the field. (1.-temuunwa, 2.-temwiide, 3.-temuuzya, 4.-temwiida, 5.-temwiidalyo, 6.-temuunisya, 7.-temuuna-temuuna, 8.-temuunana) Also: -temauna.

cut down grain stalk after stalk, Bazyali batenauna tusamu twabuluba. The parents are cutting down the stalks of cotton. (1.-tenaunwa, 2.-tenawide, 3.-tenauzya, 4.-tenawida, 5.-tenawidalyo, 6.-tenaunisya, 7.-tenauna-tenauna, 8.-tenaunana)

cut up, Baama batenda nyama. = Mother is cutting up the meat.
  • be sharp as teeth, Meno aasyuumbwa alatenda. = A lion's teeth are sharp. (1.-tendwa, 2.-tendede, 3.-tendya, /-tenzya, -tendezya, 4.-tendela, 5.-tendelalyo, 6.-tendesya, 7.-tenda-tenda, 8.-tendana.)
  • -tenda mpala = circumcise (Baluvale tradition)

cut up bit by bit, Baitendaula nyama kabotu-kabotu. = They cut up the meat bit by bit. Kamutendaula loozi Iwakuvwumbya nanda. = Cut the fibres for thatching the house. (1.-tendaulwa, 2.-tendawide, 3.-tendauzya, 4.-tendawida, 5.-tendawidalyo, 6.-tendaulisya, 7.-tendaula-tendaula, 8.-tendaulana) Also: -bendaula, -benduula.

cut up into little pieces, Wakatendebula banyama abayuni bakwe. He cut up his animals and birds into little pieces. (1.-tendebulwa, 2.-tendebwida, 3.-tendebuzya, 4.-tendebwida, 5.-tendebwidalyo, 6.-tendebulisya, 7.-tendebula-tendebula, 8.-tendebulana)

be easily cut up, rt. -tenda, Nyama njaakaula jilo yakali kutendeka. The meat which he bought yesterday was easily cut. (1.-tendekwa, 2.-tendekede, 3. -tendekezya, 4.-tendekela, 5.-tendekelalyo, 6.-tendekesya, 7.-tendeka-tendeka, 8.-tendekana) Also: -sendeka.

become loose, Loozi Iwaangidwe nombe iikamwa Iwatendela. = The rope tying the cow being milked became loose. (1.-tendelwa, 2.-tendede, 3.-tendezya, 4.-tendelela, 5.-tendelelalyo, 6.-tendelesya, 7.-tendela-tendela, 8.-tendelana)
  • pay attention, Ndiyanda kumulaya, aboobo cibe kuli umwi aumwi kunditendela kutwi kwakwe. = I want to advise you and so it is up to each one to open his ear to me. Also: -tebela.
  • cut up for somebody, Kamunditendela kanyama kasyoonto ndikayoke. = Cut me a small piece of meat so that I roast it.

roll along, Namutendele ncaitwa boobu ulatendeleka kapati mumingwenyu. = A bicycle rolls down slopes that is why it is called namutendele. Mavwili acitima alatendeleka atalaa njanji. The wheels of a train run on rails. (1.-tendelekwa, 2.-tendelekede, 3.-tendelesya, 4.-tendelekela, 5.-tendelekelalyo, 6.-tendelekesya, 7.-tendelekatendeleka, 8.-tendelesyanya) Also: -pumbulika.
roll along to, Mutinta cakaziye wakayaamuna namutendele akutendelekela kooko kwakali kukkala munanga. Mutinta secretly took up the bicycle and cycled over there to where the witchdoctor lived.
wheel along as a barrow, Bana balayanda kutendelesya zingengema. Children like rolling the rims of a wheel along. Kamutendelesya mabbulo aayo azwe aawo. Roll those drums away from there.

cause to collapse, Kunyukaula mulwazi inga wamutendula. = You make the patient collapse if you shake him. (1.-tendulwa, 2.-tendwide, 3.-tenduzya, 4.-tendwida, 5.-tendwidalyo, 6.-tendulisya, 7.-tendula-tendula, 8.-tendulana)

cut out as strips of meat, Kamutendulula nyama ibe mitendu tuyanike. Cut up the meat so that it becomes strips that we can hang up to dry. Bana batendulula malekani. = The children are cutting up strips of rubber for a catapult. (1.-tedululwa, 2.-tedulwide, 3.-tenduluzya, 4.-tendulwida, 5.-tendulwidalyo, 6.-tendululisya, 7.-tendulula-tendulula, 8.-tendulwidana) Also: -bendulula.

be dissatisfied, be resentful, complain of bad pay or insufficient food, Watenga kale mbwali ngu Nselyikaniini. He is already complaining that he is unsatisfied, that is why he is called N'selyikaniini'. Mubelesi uubeleka mulimo muyumu ulatenga avwola mali masyoonto. The worker who does a difficult job complains when he earns little money. Luunga wakatenga wakaba amunyono nkaambo lyoonse wakali kujaya tunyama tuniini. = Luunga was dissatisfied and full of envy because he was always killing small animals. Ncibi kutenga nyama yamusefwu, inga wabaa cikoto. = It is bad to complain about the meat of an eland, you may develop a swelling. Toyelede kutenga pe, uyakubaa cibbozu munsingo kayi mali taatengwa. = You should not complain, you will develop a lump in your neck because money is not to be complained about. (1.-tengwa, 2.-tengede, 3.-tengezya, 4.-tengela, 5.-tengelalyo, 6.-tengesya, 7.-tenga-tenga, 8.-tengana)

be unsteady as a table, Tebule lilatengaana, talikkede kabotu. = The table is unsteady, it is not sitting properly. Cuuno eeci cilatengaana, taayelenye maulu. = This chair is unsteady, the legs are not of the same length. (1.-tengaanwa, 2.-tengeene, 3.-tengaanya, 4.-tengaanina, 5.-tengaaninalyo, 6.-tengaanisya, 7.-tengaana-tengaana, 8.-tengaanizyanya) Also: -tenguuna, gunauka, -zungaana, -teketa.

be unsteady, Cuuno cilatengauna. = The chair is unsteady. (1.-tengaunwa, 2.-tengaunide, 3.-tengaunya, 4.-tengaunina, 5.-tengauninalyo, 6.-tengaunisya, 7.-tengauna-tengauna, 8.-tengaunizyanya) Also: -tengaana.

argue the point, Bantu aaba bacitengauzyanya, tabanazuminana pe. = These people are still arguing with one another, they have not yet agreed. (1.-tengauzyigwa, 2.-tengauzyide, 3.-tengauzyisya, 4.-tengauzyizya, 5.-tengauzyizyalyo, 6.-tengauzyisya, 7.-tengauzyanyatengauzyanya, 8.-tengaunzyanya) Also: -kazyanya.

balance on the head without holding with hands, Bamacembele balicizyi kutengelezya nongo zyameenda amutwe. = The old women know how to balance an earthen pot of water on the head. (1.-tengelezyegwa, 2.-tengelezyede, 3.-tengelezyesya, 4.-tengelezyezya, 5.-tengelezyezyalyo, 6. -tengelezyesya, 7. -tengelezyatengelezya, 8.-tengelezyanya) Also: -tengenezya, -tengenezyeka, -tengezela.

possess ability though young or sick or handicapped, Ooyu mwana tatengelwa mumubili, nkaambo ulakonzya kucita ncito yabapati. = This child's ability is not restricted, because he is able to do the work of adults.

carry on head without holding, Bamacembele bakaindi bakalicizyi kutengenezya nongo zyameenda. The old women of long ago knew how to carry pots of water on their heads without holding on to them. Wakababona banyina balaza balikke kumbo anongo yakutekela meenda amutwe balatengenezya. He saw his mother coming alone from the west with a pot for drawing water balancing it on her head. (1.-tengenezyegwa, 2.-tengenezyede, 3.-tengenezyesya, 4.-tengenezyezya, 5.-tengenezyezyalyo, 6.-tengenezyesya, 7.-tengenezya-tengenezya, 8.-tengenezyanya) Also: -dengenezya.

be easily balanced on head, e.g Nongo njindayumwide sunu ilatengenezyeka. The pot which I was carrying today is easily balanced. (1.-tengenezyekwa, 2.-tengenezyede, 3.-tengenezyesya, 4.-tengenezyezya, 5.-tengenezyezyalyo, 6.-tengenezyesya, 7.-tengenezyeka-tengenezyeka, 8.-tengenezyanya) Also: -tengelezya.

carry on head without holding, Bamuka Choombe bakatengezela nongo yacibwantu kutola kunkolola. = The wife of Choombe is carrying a pot of sweet beer on her head with out holding it, taking it to the initiation ceremony. (1.-tengezelwa, 2.-tengezede, 3.-tengezezya, 4.-tengezelela, 5.-tengezelelalyo, 6.-tenge-zelesya, 7.-tengezela-tengezela, 8.tenge-zelana) Also: -tengelezya, -tengenezya.

move about, Katiba kalatenguka mucibulo cameenda. = The small dish is moving about in the bucket of water.(1.-tengukwa, 2.-tengukila, 3.-tenguzya, 4.-tengukila, 5.-tengukilalyo, 6.-tengulisya, 7.-tenguka-tenguka, 8.-tenguzyanya) Also: -tenguna.
shave round leaving hair in the middle, Mukamufwu bakamu

dilwe kalitanamana. = They shaved the widow before the end of the funeral. (1.-tengulwa, 2.-tengwide, 3.-tenguzya, 4.-tengwida, 5.-tengwidalyo, 6.-tegulisya, 7.-tengula-tengula, 8.-tengulana)
  • show disrespect, Bantu baunyu batengula bacete baboola kulinga. = Stingy people show disrespect to poor people who come to ask for food.
