be unsteady, be rickety, Ciluli cananda cilatenguna alimwi cilalangilwa kuwa fwumbwa ciindi. = The roof of the house is unsteady and looks as if it could fall any time. (1.-tengunwa, 2.-tengunide, 3.-tenguzya, 4.-tengunina, 5.-tenguninalyo, 6.-tengunisya, 7.-tenguna-tenguna, 8.-tengunizyanya) Also: -tengauna, -zungaanas, -yuuna, -dengunuka.
  • shake with laughter, Mutinta wakatenguna kapati naakamvwa kaambo kasesya. = Mutinta shook with laughter when she heard a funny story.
  • feel unsteady or dizzy, Cheelo wakali kutenguna nkaambo taakoona kwamazuba otatwe. = Cheelo felt unsteady because he had not slept for three nights.
  • be loose as a planted pole, Ooyu musemu wananda ulatenguna. = This pole of the house is unsteady.
moving while balancing, Kagumbuli kalatenguuna mudamu. = The container is floating in the dam. Also: -tengauna, -ibauka.

be complained about, Inyama yamusefwu taitengwi inga wabaa cikoto. A small piece of eland meat is not to be complained about because if you do you will develop a swelling. Cipego ncomwatambula nociceya tacitengwi. = You do not complain about a gift which you receive no matter how small it may be. *Tengwa mubili, busungu buli mucamba.* Though insignifiant in body, he has ability to achieve great things. (1.-tengwa, 2.-tengede, 3.-tengezya, 4.-tengela, 5.-tengelalyo, 6.-tengesya, 7.-tengwa-tengwa, 8.-tengana)

tremble, Waile kutenkaana nibamubikka akati kababbi. = He was trembling when they put him among thieves. Kogagaila nkanka yacilayi ileke kutenkaana. Hammer the peg of the sledge so that it stops shaking. (1.-tenkaanwa, 2.-tenkeene, 3.-tenkaanya, 4.-tenkaanina, 5.-tenkaaninalyo, 6.-tenkaanisya, 7.-tenkaana-tenkaana, 8.-tenkaanizyanya) Also: -bimba.

warn of the danger of fire, Komutensya mwana kutegwa ayoowe mulilo. Warn the child so that it fears the fire. (The words "Teente, teente! " are said by a mother to her child to instruct it that the fire is dangerous.) (1.-tensyegwa, 2.-tensyede, 3.-tensya, 4.-tensyezya, 5.-tensyezyalyo, 6.-tensyesya, 7.-tensya-tensya, 8.-tensyanya)

set on fire, Tamweelede kutenta bwizu, nombe zilafwa nzala. = You should not burn the grass, the cattle will go hungry. (1.-tentwa, 2.-tentede, 3.-tentya, 4.-tentela, 5.-tentelalyo, 6.-tentesya, 7.-tenta-tenta, 8.-tentana) Also: -umpa.

be unsteady, stagger, Watenteleka naakolwa akuwa. = He was unsteady when he was drunk and fell. Milimo wakayumuka katenteleka-tenteleka cakukatala. = Milimo stood up staggering about with the tiredness. Twakajana mulwazi ulatenteleka mumugwagwa. = We found the patient staggering along the road. (1.-tentelekwa, 2.-tentelekede, 3.-tentelesya, 4.-tentelekela, 5.-tentelekelalyo, 6.-tentelekesya, 7.-tenteleka-tenteleka, 8.-tentelesyanya) Also: -dadalika, -tatalika, -zeelekas, -cenceleka, -pampalika.

burn anew, rt. -tenta, Kamucitentulula cibiya tiicabizwa. = Reburn that pot, it is not properly baked. (1.-tentululwa, 2.-tentulwide, 3.-tentuluzya, 4.-tentulwida, 5.-tentulwidalyo, 6.-tentululisya, 7.-tentulula-tentulula, 8.-tentululana)

complain continually, Mainza lyoonse utentuuka kuti basimpongo balamutola kumpongo. = Mainza is always complaining that the goatherds take him to herd the goats. (1.-tentuukwa, 2. -tentuukide, 3. -tentuusya, 4.-tentuukila, 5.-tentuukilalyo, 6.-tentuukisya, 7.-tentuuka-tentuuka, 8.-tentuukana) Also: -tongooka.

cut down stalks, Bamancenya batenuna mapopwe mumuunda. = The white ants are cutting down the maize stalks in the field. (1.-tenunwa, 2.-tenwide, 3.-tenuzya, 4.-tenwida, 5.-tenwidalyo, 6.-tenunisya, 7.-tenuna-tenuna, 8.-tenunana)

gather firewood, Bacembele baunka kukutepa nkuni. = The old woman has gone to collect firewood. (1.-tepwa, 2.-tepede, 3.-tepya, 4.-tepela, 5.-tepelalyo, 6.-tepesya, 7.-tepa-tepa, 8.-tepelana) Also: -tebba.

tempt, Maunga wakatepaula mweenzinyina kuti abbe nkuku yamuntu. Maunga tempted his friend to steal someone's chicken. Bantu banji munyika ulabatepaula Saatani kucita zintu zibi. Many people in the world are tempted by Satan to do evil things. (1.-tepaulwa, 2.-tepawide, 3.-tepauzya, 4.-tepawida, 5.-tepawidalyo, 6.-tepaulisya, 7.-tepaula-tepaula, 8.-tepaulana) Also: -tempaula, -sunka.

tuck cloth between one's legs when sitting down, Kuti bamakaintu basama maluke taciyandiki kulitepela. = Women who put on long trousers do not have to tuck their clothing between their legs. (1.-tepelwa, 2.-tepelede, 3.-tepezya, 4.-tepelela, 5.-tepelelalyo, 6.-tepelesya, 7.-tepela-tepela, 8.-tepelana) Also: -bbindila.

cause to fall down, Mapopwe amana kutesauka nkaambo bamacenya bakaalya kunsi. = The maize has all fallen down because the white ants ate the stalks underneath. (1.-tesaukwa, 2.-tesaulide, 3.-tesausya, 4.-tesaukila, 5.-tesaukilalyo, 6.-tesaukisya, 7.-tesauka-tesauka, 8.-tesausyanya)
  • come down, go down, cross over as sun at midday, Mweenzu wangu wakasika izuba kalitaningatesauka. = My visitor came before sunset. Also: -tesuuka.

fall down, Musimbi natumbuka, nkolo zyakwe zilatesuka. = When a girl gives birth, the breasts fall. Ncimunya wakatesuka naakatezemuka mumankanda. = Nchimunya fell down when he slipped in the mud. (1.-tesukwa, 2.-tesukide, 3.-tesuzya, 4.-tesukila, 5.-tesukilalyo, 6.-tesukisya, 7.-tesuka-tesuka, 8.-tesusyanya)
  • decline as sun, Izuba lyatesuka kale. = The sun has already declined. Also: -tesuuка.

pull down, Kamukatesula kasamu nkatantide kutegwa ceta aloke ansi. = Pull down that tree which the monkey is climbing so that he falls off. (1.-tesulwa, 2.-teswide, 3.-tesuzya, 4.-teswida, 5.-teswidalyo, 6.-tesulisya, 7.-tesula-tesula, 8.-tesulana) Also: -denuna, -gwenuna.

dance with closed knees, Basimbi balatesuuka kuzyana. = The girls are dancing with closed knees. Also: -tisyauka. (1.-tesuukwa, 2.-tesuukide, 3.-tesuukizya, 4.-tesuukila, 5.-tesuukilalyo, 6.-tesuukisya, 7.-tesuuka-tesuuka, 8.-tesuukilana)
  • decline or cross over as sun at midday, Also: - tesuka.

draw with, rt. -teka, Nomuteka meenda mumugodi kamutesya zigumbuli ziyumu. = When you draw water from the well you should use strong containers. (1.-tesyegwa, 2.-tesyele, 3.-tesya, 4.-tesyezya, 5.-tesyezyalyo, 6.-tesyesya, 7.-tesya-tesya, 8.-tesyanya)
  • humble oneself, Kuti wabisya, uleelede *kulitesya* kuli ngoobisizya. = If you commit an offence, you should humble yourself before the one you have offended. Sikusela ngusikukumbila, alimwi uleelede *kulitesya* kuli balaa mwana. = The one who seeks a girl in marriage is one who is requesting, again he should humble himself before those who own the child.
  • quench one's thirst, Mudaala naakakatala wakali kuyanda *kulitesya* amoyo. = When the old man was tired he wanted to quench his thirst. Ndati ndikalitesye amoyo kayi nkosya njeeyi yatiindijaye. = I said let me quench my thirst because this lack of water is about to kill me.
  • make wet, rt. -teta, Imvwula ya
cisani cangu. = The rain has soaked my cloth. Habusiwa nguupa meenda ate

akubombya nyika. = God is the one who gives water which wets and softens the earth.
  • not have enough, Bakaintu balikujika nsima *batesya* nkaambo bwaceya busu. = The woman who has cooked the nsima had not enough because the mealie-meal was insufficient.

be pliable, be flexibile, Chintibule naakali kuzyana wakali ku*tesyauka*. When Chintibule was dancing he was flexible. Also: -dizyauka. (1.-tesyaukwa, 2.-tesyaukide, 3.-tesyausya, 4.-tesyaukila, 5.-tesyaukilalyo, 6.-tesyaukisya, 7.-tesyauka-tesyauka, 8.-tesyausyanya)

become wet, become soft, Cateta cisani ncoobikka mumeenda. = The cloth is wet which you put in the water. Mwana wateta naawugwa mvwula. = The child got wet when the rain fell on it. Moyo wausyi Banji *wakateta* naakabona micito mibotu iili boobu. = The heart of Banji's father softened when he saw such good acitivities. (1.-tesyegwa, 2.-tetede, 3.-tetya, 4.-tetela, 5.-tetelalyo, 6.-tetesya, 7.-tetateta, 8.-tesyanya) Also: -nama,-lopa, -naba
sit with legs stretched out in front, Bakaintu balaa da mbaba

buya kukkala. = Women who are pregnant are the ones who stretch out their legs when they are sitting. Ciindi camainza inga kunyina muntu utetebele biyo kukkala. = During the rainy season no person just sits with legs stretched out. Also: -tandabala. (1.-tetebalwa, 2.-tetebete, 3.-tetebeka, 4.-tetebalila, 5.-tetebalilalyo, 6.-tetebalisya, 7.-tetebala-tetebala, 8.-tetebalilana)
make soft, Ndali kute

kasalu kampongo kutegwa kateteete kubbazya mwana. = I was making the hide of the goat soft so that it would be soft enough for carrying the baby. Also: -suka. (1.-teteesyegwa, 2.-teteesyede, 3.-teteesya, 4.-teteesyezya, 5.-teteesyezyalyo, 6.-teteetesya, 7.-teteesya-teteesya, 8.-teteesyanya)

become soft or weak. Mango akabizwa alateteeta. = Ripe mangoes soften. Mubili oonse *wakateteeta* naakakolwa kachasu. = The whole body became weak when he became drunk with kachasu. Kumvwa mause bacembele *bakateteeta*. = Hearing the sad news the old woman became weak. Also: -leluka (1.-teteetwa, 2.-teteetede, 3.-teteetya, 4.-teteetela, 5.-teteetelalyo, 6.-teteetesya, 7.-teteeta-teteeta, 8.-teteetelana)

make soft, rt. -teta, Basankwa *bakabutetya* bulongo nkaambo bakatila meenda manji. = The boys made the clay soft because they poured much water. (1.-tesyegwa, 2.-tesyede,/-tetede, 3.-tetya, 4.-tetela, 5.-tetelalyo, 6.-tetesya, 7.-tetya-tetya, 8.-tesyanya)

decline as the sun, Ndilatalika kweenda izuba lyateuka. = I will start to go when the sun sinks. (1.-teukwa, 2.-teukide, 3.-teusya, 4.-teukila, 5.-teukilalyo, 6.-teukisya, 7.-teuka-teuka, 8.-teukana) Also: -tesuka.

set a trap, Tukaunke kukuteya bakakololo juunza. = Let us go and trap rodents tomorrow. Nguni uteya tuyuni mukalonga? = Who is trapping the little birds in the river? (1.-teyegwa, 2.-teyede, 3.-teyezya, 4.-teyela, 5.-teyelalyo, 6.-teyesya, 7.-teya-teya, 8.-teyana)
  • trap with charms, poison, Musankwa umwi *bakamuteya* musamu kutegwa aleke kuzyala. One boy was harmed with charms so that he became impotent. Chilwalo *bakamuteya* musamu ncaakafwambaana kufwa. = They poisoned Chilwalo that is why he quickly died.
  • raise arms in shape of horns of cattle, Wakali kunga *waateya* maanza ulati meja abasune bakwe. = He was lifting up his arms to resemble the horns of his oxen.
prick up, "Amuteelele, mbuli kuti ndatiimvwe uti 'hodi' kunze oku, antela kuli mweenzu." Boonse baka

matwi. "Listen, as if I hear someone saying 'hodi' outside there, perhaps it is a visitor. All pricked up their ears. (1.-teyekwa, 2.-teyekede, 3.-teyekezya, 4.-teyekela, 5.-teyekelalyo, 6.-teyekesya, 7.-teyeka-teyeka, 8.-teyekana)

be slippery, Nyanzabili zilatezemuka kuti wazilyata. = The green scum is slippery if you step on it. Nibakasika amulonga musune wakakaka kulanduka kuya kutala nkaambo acito kwakali bbwe litezemuka kapati. = When they reached the river, the ox refused to cross over to the other side because at the bridge (drift) there was a very slippery stone. (1.-tezemukwa, 2.-tezemukide, 3.-tezemusya, 4.-tezemu-kila, 5.-tezemukilalyo, 6.-tezemukisya, 7.-tezemuka-tezemuka, 8.-tezemusyanya.)
  • slip, Muloongo walicisa kapati *naatezemuka*, wawida abbwe. Muloongo hurt himself when he slipped, he fell on to a stone. Naakalyata abbwe, musune

akuwida muzyiba pati. = When the ox stepped on the stone, it slipped and fell into a big pool.
  • make a slip of the tongue, Mulaka wangu *watezemuka* nitwali kukanana, ndaamba kaambo kanyemya bantu. = I made a slip of the tongue when I was speaking, I said something which angered the people.

make pay tax, rt. -tela, Naa ulayanda kuti bantu banji bacikonzye kutela, kotezya ciindi nobatebula mapopwe. = If you want people to be able to pay tax, you should tax them when they harvest their maize. (1.-tezyegwa, 2.-tezyede, 3.-tezyesya, 4.-tezyezya, 5.-tezyezyalyo, 6.-tezyesya, 7.-tezya-tezya, 8.-tezyanya)
say, think, Mebo ndali kuti waunka kale. For myself I thought that you had already gone. Wakati, "Ukaboole juunza nkakupe mali." = He said, "Come tomorrow and I will give you the money." (2.-tede)
interrupt, Dyabbula wakamutiba mweenzinyina. = Dyabbula interrupted his friend. (1.-tibwa, 2.-tibide, 3.-tibya, 4.-tibila, 5.-tibilalyo, 6.-tibisya, 7.-tiba-tiba, 8.-tibana)

cover ground closely, as wellgrowing pumpkin runners, Lungu lokwesu lulatibaika akali ciba. = The runners of our pumpkin plants have covered the ground closely where there was a cattle kraal. (1.-tibaikwa, 2.-tibaikide, 3.-tibaikizya, 4.-tibaikila, 5.-tibaikilalyo, 6.-tibaikisya, 7.-tibaika-tibaika, 8.-tibaikana) Also: -vwunaika.

move in disorder or confusion, Bana bacikolo bakaile kutibana nibakali kufwoolwa. The school children were just moving in disorder when they were marching. (i.e. they were not marching in straight lines) Ntobolo niyakalila, bantu bakali adilwe bakatibana. = When the gun was fired, the people who were at the funeral scattered in confusion. Also: -dibana. (1.-tibanwa, 2.-tibanide, 3.-tibanya, 4.-tibanina, 5.-tibaninalyo, 6.-tibanisya, 7.-tibana-tibana, 8.-tibanizyanya)
mix different kinds, Basikweembela batibanya nombe a mpongo musyokwe. = The herders have mixed cattle and goats in the bush. Also: -sanganya, -vwelenganya.

be ground into powder, Mapopwe aatugwa abasimbi bayumu, alatibuka kapati. = Maize which is pounded by strong girls, turns into powder very well. (1.-tibukwa, 2.-tibukide, 3.-tibukizya, 4.-tibukila, 5.-tibukilalyo, 6.-tibukisya, 7.-tibuka-tibuka, 8.-tibukana) Also: -dibuka.

strike heavily with a club, Mubbi bamutibuula azikoli. = They beat the thief severely with clubs. cf. -dibaula. (1.-tibuulwa, 2.-tibwiide, 3.-tibuuzya, 4.-tibwiida, 5.-tibwiidalyo, 6.-tibuulisya, 7.-tibuula-tibuula, 8.-tibuulana)

break, as stick or leg, Bakaindi bakali kutifwula maulu kabatanamuzikka mufwu. = Long ago they used to break the legs before they buried the dead.
  • curtsy, Bamakaintu bakatifwula magondo nibakali kwaanzya mwami. = The women curtisied when they were greeting the chief. (1.-tifwulwa, 2.-tifwulide, 3.-tifwuzya, 4.-tifwulila, 5.-tifwulilalyo, 6.-tifwulisya, 7.-tifwula-tifwula, 8.-tifwulana) Also: -fwunyula, -fwunyuna

walk unsteadily with shaking knees, Kakuku kagonkelwa kaile kutifwuuka. = The chicken which has become weak with hunger is walking unsteadily. Mapopwe akatifwuuka naakabalwa zuba kwaciindi cilamfwu. = The maize-stalks drooped when the maize was exposed to the sun for a long time. (1.-tifwuukwa, 2.-tifwuukide, 3.-tifwuukizya, 4.-tifwuukila, 5.-tifwuukilalyo, 6.-tifwuukisya, 7.-tifwuuka-tifwuuka) Also: - tisyauka.

bend knees, curtesy, Naakasika mwami, bamakaintu bakatifwuula magondo aabo kuti bamwaanzye. = When the chief arrived the women made a curtsy in greeting him. (1.-tifwuulwa, 2.-tifwuulide, 3.-tifwuuzya, 4.-tifwulila, 5.-tifwuulilalyo, 6.-tifwuulisya, 7.-tifwuula-tifwuula, 8.-tifwuulana)

spoil a child, e.g Ooyu mwana banyina mbabamutiimika ncakaka kutumwa. = It is the mother who spoils this child, that is why he refuses to be sent on an errand. Kuli cintu comwe cabisya kapati bantu, cibatiimika, mmakuwa. = There is one thing which ruined the people, which spoiled them, it is the white people. Nkobali biya bapatima balaa bunjaka, mbambabo mbabatiimika bana. = There are indeed my co-adults who are trouble-makers, they are the ones who have spoiled the children. (1.-tiimikwa, 2.-tiimikide, 3.-tiimika, 4.-tiimikila, 5.-tiimikilalyo, 6.-tiimikisya, 7.-tiimika-tiimika, 8.-tiimikana)
  • bend or press down, Cisamu bacitiimika nibacaanga loozi. = They bent the pole down when they tied it with fibres. Also: -diimika.

run away, Kamutija, balamuluma babwa. = Run away, the dogs will bite you. Muntu wajaya muntu ulatija abona masilikani. = The one who murdered a man runs away when he sees policemen. (1.-tijigwa, 2.-tijide, 3.-tizya/tijizya, 4.-tijila, 5.-tijilalyo, 6.-tijisya, 7.-tija-tija, 8.-tijana) Also: -ccija.

run quickly, Kotijaana, ufwambaane kusika balakuyanda. Hurry, be quick to reach there where they want you. (1.-tijaanwa, 2.-tijaanide, 3.-tijaanizya or tijaanya, 4.-tijaanina, 5.-tijaaninalyo, 6.-tijaanisya, 7.-tijaanatijaana, 8.-tijaaninana.) =

run away from one another, Basincinko balatijana tabayandi kubonana bobilo. The insane are running away from one another as they do not want to see one another. (1.-tijigwa, 2.-tijide, 3.-tizya, 4.-tijila, 5.-tijilalyo, 6.-tijisya, 7.-tijana-tijana, 8.-tijana)
be able to run from, Lufwu talutijiki. One cannot run from death. (1.-tijikwa, 2.-tijikide, 3.-tijikizya, 4.-tijikila, 5.-tijikilalyo, 6.-tijikisya, 7.-tijika-tijika, 8.-tijikana)

cause to run, Mucende nguwakatijisya mwana. It was the bull which made the child run. (1.-tijisyigwa, 2.-tijisyide, 3.-tijisyizya, 4.-tijisyizya, 5.-tijisyizyalyo, 6.-tijisyisya, 7.-tijisyatijisya, 8.-tijisyanya)

be spilt, capsize, spill over, Cibwantu catika cibiya naaciguntuzya mwana. The sweet-beer spilled over when the child knocked against the pot. Ceele catika ncitwatiilye. The porridge spilled which we were about to eat. Sena kuti meenda atika inga ulaayola? = If water is spilt can it be gathered up? (1.-tikwa, 2.-tikide, 3.-tikizya, 4.-tikila, 5.-tikilalyo, 6.-tikisya, 7.-tika-tika, 8.-tikana)
  • shake the head, Banyina nibakabona mwana mbwaakalicisa tiibakalila pe, bakatika buyo mutwe. = When the mother saw how the child had hurt itself she did not cry, she only shook her head. Also: -puka mutwe.

shake, rt. tika, Musankwa uujata bbola nilyakamwiinda muntebe, wakaile kutikaanya mutwe. = When the ball passed between the goalkeepers legs, he just shook his head. Jakopo wakanyema, wakatikaanya Jolezya wakati, "Buka cana we!" = Jakopo was angry and shook Jolezya saying, "Get up, you useless child!" Also: -nyakinya. (1.-tikaanyizyigwa, 2.-tikaanyide, 3.-tikaanya, 4.-tikaanyizyizya, 5.-tikaanyizyizyalyo, 6.-tikkanyisya, 7.-tikaanya-tikaanya, 8.-tikaanyizyanya)

be poured out, Meenda atikila ansi. The water is spilt onto the ground. (1.-tikilwa, 2.-tikilide, 3.-tikizya, 4.-tikila, 5.-tikilalyo, 6.-tikisya, 7.-tikilatikila, 8.-tikilana)
  • be angry, *Mucamba moyo watikila kale.* = My heart in my chest is already poured out. i.e. I am already very sad.

cause internal injury, *Bamutikimizya mwana ngubali kuuma.* = They bruised the child whom they were beating. (1.-tikimizyigwa, 2.-tikimizyide, 3.-tikimizya, 4.-tikimizyizya, 5.-tikimizyizyalyo, 6.-tikimizyisya, 7.-tikimizya-tikimizya, 8.-tikimizyanya) Also: -dikimizya, -tikizya.

shake as head, blanket, cloth etc, *Kamutikimuna mapayi aayo kazwe kasuko.* Shake out the dust from those blankets. (1.-tikimunwa, 2.-tikimwide, 3.-tikimuzya, 4.-tikimwida, 5.-tikimwidalyo, 6.-tikimunisya, 7.-tikimuna-tikimuna, 8.-tikimunana) Also: -dikimuna.

shake the head in refusal, *Wakatikinya buyo mutwe kutondezya kuti tayandi.* = He just shook his head to show that he did not like it. *Mupati tayelede kutikinya mutwe nakaka.* = An elder ought not shake the head when refusing. (1.-tikinyigwa, 2.-tikinyide, 3.-tikinya, 4.-tikinyina, 5.-tikinyinalyo, 6.-tikinyisya, 7.-tikinya-tikinya, 8.-tikinyanizyanya) Also: -nikinya, -nininya -zungaanya

shake the shoulders/head horizontally, *Muntu weetezegwa utikita mutwe.* = When a person feels pity s/he shakes the head from side to side. (1.-tikitwa, 2.-tikitide, 3.-tikitya, 4.-tikitila, 5.-tikitilalyo, 6.-tikitisya, 7.-tikitila-tikitila, 8.-tikitilana)

bruise, *Wamutikizya bulowa naamuuma mfwaindi aliso.* = He bruised him when he hit him with a fist on the eye. Also: -tikimizya. (1.-tikizyigwa, 2.-tikizyide, 3.-tikizya, 4.-tikizyizya, 5.-tikizyizyalyo, 6.-tikizyisya, 7.-tikizya-tikizya, 8.-tikizyanya)

hiccup, belch, sound as butter churning, *Kulesya muntu utikula nkumukonga.* = To stop one hiccuping is to frighten him/her. *Bantu bakali mumunzi nokuba kuti bakalimvwide kuti kuli utikula, bakalisinsya-sinsya matwi. Bakali kuyeeya kuti nceelo. Intiku yakali kuzwida nkukona kulubazu kwakali cuumbwe.* = The people who were in the village even thought they heard someone belching, they pretended not to hear. They were thinking it was a spirit. The belching was coming on the same side where there was a grave. (Belching can be a human reaction to involvement in the spirit world.) (1.-tikulwa, 2.-tikwide, 3.-tikuzya, 4.-tikwida, 5.-tikwidalyo, 6.-tikulisya, 7.-tikula-tikula, 8.-tikuzyanya)

pour, *Kamutila musika ooyu, waba wakaindi.* = Pour out this soda, it has expired. *Bana bautila mukupa muciba.* = The children poured out the milk in the kraal. (1-tilwa, 2.-tilide, 3.-tizya, 4.-tilila, 5.tililalyo, 6.-tilisya, 7.-tila-tila, 8.-tilana.) Also: -tya, -kununa.
  • urinate, *Ciindi cankondo bakandu tiibakali kuya kule nibakali kutila meenda.* = During the time of war, cowards were not going far when they were urinating. Also: -suba.

water as a garden, *Kamuya kumbewu akutilaila cisyu.* = Go into the garden and water the vegetables. (1.-tilailwa, 2.-tilailide, 3.-tilaizya, 4.-tilailila, 5.-tilaililalyo, 6.-tilailisya, 7.-tilaila-tilaila, 8.-tilailana) Also: -ida.

irrigate, pour water on, rt. -tila, *Basankwa baya kukutilila kumbewu.* = The boys are going to water the garden. (1.-tililwa, 2.-tililide, 3.-tilizya, 4.-tililila, 5.-tilililalyo, 6.-tililisya, 7.-tilila-tilila, 8.-tililana)
  • pour out for, *Kamunditilila cibwantu mukagumbuli akanywe mwana.* = Pour out the sweet-beer for me so that the child can drink.
  • offer libation to the spirits, Basyaanene bakali kucikonzya kutilila bukoko ciindi cacifwumofwumo kulubazu Iwalulyo Iwamulyango. = My grandfather used to pour out beer in the morning at the right side of the door. Also: -piila.
  • blame someone else, Naakali kubetekwa abasimabbuku, wakatilila makani kumujwa wakwe. When he was being tried by the headmen, he put the blame on his nephew.

shake with fear, Mwana watilimuka naakongwa. = The child shook with fear when it was frightened. Ndakatilimuka jilo masiku nindakalota bakafwa. = I shook with fear last night when I dreamed of the dead. (1.-tilimukwa, 2.-tilimukide, 3.-tilimusya, 4.-tilimukila, 5.-tilimukilalyo, 6.-tilimukisya, 7.-tilimukatilimuka, 8.-tilimusyanya)

shake, tremble, Tatwaambiki twaambo oto, nobana, tutilimuna mubili woonse. All those reports, my children, cannot be expressed, they make the whole body tremble. (1.-tilimunwa, 2.-tilimwide, 3.-tilimusya, 4.-tilimwida, 5.-tilimwidalyo, 6.-tilimunisya, 7.-tilimunatilimuna, 8.-tilimunana)

cause to tremble, rt. tilimuka, Anditilimusya makani aamba mwana ooyu sunu. = The message this child said today has made me tremble. Ndamvwa makani aatilimusya mubili. = I have heard news which causes my body to shake.
pour water on, Unditilizye mumaanza. May you pour water on my hands.

by leaving footprints, fingermarks, paw marks, Bavwimi bali kutobela mwali kutimba banyama. = The hunters were following the pawprints of the animals. cf. -simba. (1.-timbwa, 2.-timbide, 3.-timbya, 4.-timbila, 5.-timbilalyo, 6.-timbisya, 7.-timba-timba, 8.-timbana)
  • beat, Mubbi nobakamutimba abbwe kusyule, cakamwaalila kutija. = When they struck the thief with a stone on the back, he was unabe to flee.
  • growl, bellow, Syuumbwa wakabbuulala, wakalanga kujulu akutalika kutimba. The lion raised his head, he looked upwards and began to growl. Mucende waindizya kutimba mbuli kuti wakalimumvwide simalelo wakwe mbwaakali kumutembaula. The ox increased the bellowing as if he had heard his master as he was praising him. Also: -vwuluma

chop, Munkondo eyi bakali kwiide kupwasyula twana, tumwi bakali kututimbula mikosi. In this war they were just smashing little children, some they were cutting their necks. Cisamu cakajisi mitabi minji. Wakatalika kutimbula mitabi. The tree had many branches. He began to chop off the branches. (1.-timbulwa, 2.-timbwide, 3.-timbuzya, 4.-timbwida, 5.-timbwidalyo, 6.-timbulisya, 7.-timbula-timbula, 8.-timbulana)

overcharge, Bamwi bantu nobasambala zintu, balatimpula. = Some people overcharge when selling things. Also: -fwoonkola (1.-timpulwa, 2.-timpwide, 3.-timpuzya, 4.-timpwida, 5.-timpwidalyo, 6.-timpulisya, 7.-timpula-timpula, 8.-timpwidana)
  • ladle out as porridge, Kotimpula ceele ubikke oomu tulye. Ladle out the porridge and put it in here so that we eat. Bana batimpula ceele camabisi. = The children have ladled out the sour-milk porridge. Also: -kombola.

cease raining or thundering Imvwula yatimuka. The rain has stopped. (1.-timukwa, 2.-timukide, 3.-timusya, 4.-timukila, 5.-timukilalyo, 6.-timukisya, 7.-timuka-timuka, 8.-timusyanya) Also: -amuka, -tamuka.

take out a portion, Kamutimuna ceele cimwi, mubape bana. = Take out some porridge, so that you may give it to the children. (1.-timunwa, 2.-timunide, 3.-timuzya, 4.-timunina, 5.-timuninalyo, 6.-timunisya, 7.-timuna-timuna, 8.-timunana) Also: -zandula.

roll on the surface of the water, Inswi zyakolwa ntimba zilatimuuka mumayuwe. The fish which have been choked by the mud are moving along on the top of the waves. (1.-timuukwa, 2.-timuukide, 3.-timuusya, 4.-timuukila, 5.-timuukilalyo, 6.-timuukisya, 7.-timuuka-timuuka, 8.-timuusyanya) Also: -ibauka.

shut one eye in taking aim, Nkutina liso nodubula kanyama. = You should shut one eye when you are firing at an animal. Also: -sina lisyo, -tyanka liso. (1.-tinwa, 2.-tinide, 3.-tinya, 4.-tinina, 5.-tininalyo, 6.-tinisya, 7.-tina-tina, 8.-tininana)

make a triple cord, replait, Musankwa utindika mukkwilo wakwaanzya nombe nakama. The boy is making a triple-stranded rope for tying the cows as he milks. Also: -osolola (1.-tindikwa, 2.-tindikide, 3.-tindisya, 4.-tindikila, 5.-tindikilalyo, 6.-tindikisya, 7.-tindika-tindika, 8.-tindikana)
  • dress with more than one garment, Watindika kusama zisani akaambo kampeyo. = S/he has dressed with many clothes because of the cold.

stick in throat, Canditinga cimbwali, ncindali kwiile kuboba kukanana. The sweet-potatoe stuck in my throat that is why I am unable to speak properly. Mwana kamutinga kafwuwa kanswi. A little bone has stuck in the child's throat. (1.-tingwa, 2.-tingide, 3.-tinzya, 4.-tingila, 5.-tingilalyo, 6.-tingisya, 7.-tinga-tinga, 8.-tingana) Also: -inga.
  • throw one down on the ground, Kachabe nguwakatinga mweenzinyina. = It was Kachabe who threw his friend down. Kaceya katinga uso. Ninonzi. (a riddle) It is a small thing that throws your father down. It is sleep. Cimwi ciindi tucita kuti notuyanda kujatana kamando, nkuliswida mate mumaboko akwaamba kuti, "Oku kwaandipa taata, oku kwaandipa baama, kuti unditinge na kuti ulaa nguzu musa." = Sometimes we do like this that when we want to wrestle, you spit on your arms saying. "Father gave me this one, mother gave me this one, if you throw me my friend, it can be said you are strong."

be mixed with, Nywebo nobana basunu mwati milimo yamumunzi ilisofweede nkaambo njakutingaana abulongo. You children of today say that the works of the village are dirty because they are mixed with the soil. (1.-tingaanwa, 2.-tingaanide, 3.-tingaanya, 4.-tingaanina, 5.-tingaaninalyo, 6.-tingaanisya, 7.-tingaana-tingaana, 8.-tingaana)
  • wrestle, Chimuka a Kachabe bakali kutingaana kubwana. Chimuka and Kachabe were wrestling when they were young. Chitebenta wakalicizyi kuuma nyindi akutingaana kamando. = Chitebenta knew how to box and wrestle. Also: -tingana.

bend from hips, Kotingama ubweze mutiba oyo, utacaali. = Bend down and pick up that plate, it should not remain there. Kotingama ubbale mwana. = Bend down and put the baby on your back. Also: -dingama, -ongomana, -bongola. (1.-tingamwa, 2.-tingamide, 3.-tingamya, 4.-tingamina, 5.-tingaminalyo, 6.-tingamisya, 7.-tingama-tingama, 8.-tingaminana)
  • be filled with emotion, fear, pity, Inga walanga Munacilende, moyo waile kutingama. = When he saw the hill of Nacilende, his heart shook with emotion.

overturn, Kamucitingamuna cuuno eeco nkaambo cilityokede. = Overturn that stool, because it is broken. Kamulitingamuna dolomu lizwe acilayi. = Turn the metal drum on its side to take it off the sledge. (1.-tingamunwa, 2.-tingamwide, 3.-tingamuzya, 4.-tingamwida, 5.-tingamwidalyo, 6.-tingamunisya, 7.-tingamuna-tingamuna, 8.-tingamunana) Also: -dingamuna, - bbindamuna.

wrestle, Kutingana kamando kuyandika bantu bazyandamene ncobeni. Sturdy people are needed for wrestling. Basankwa balatingana muciba. = The boys are wrestling in the kraal. (1.-tinganwa, 2.-tinganide, 3.-tinganya, 4.-tinganina, 5.-tinganinalyo, 6-tinganisya, 7.-tingana-tingana, 8.-tingana) Also: -tingaana, -pulana, -gagalisyanya.

strike, Munzila ndawa akulitinka akasolo. When I fell on the way I banged myself on the hip. (1.-tinkwa, 2.-tinkide, 3.-tinkizya, 4.-tinkila, 5.-tinkilalyo, 6.-tinkisya, 7.-tinka-tinka, 8.-tinkana) Also: -gunta.
  • sound as a drum, Sunu tiindaona kabotu nkaambo ngoma yali kutinka masiku onse. I did not sleep well last night because the drum was beating all through the night.

mix as people, Kuti basankwa batobelana kuzyalwa botatwe, nkabela kumane kwazyalwa musimbi, oyu musimbi ulaulikwa kuti Mutinta nkaambo watinta basankwa. Kutinta nkokuti kucimbula. If in birth three boys follow one another, then a girl is born, this girl is called Mutinta because she has mixed the line of boys. (1.-tintwa, 2.-tintide, 3.-tintya, 4.-tintila, 5.-tintilalyo, 6.-tintisya, 7.-tinta-tinta, 8.-tintana)
  • mix cattle of different breeds, Kutinta nombe inga luzubo Iwakomena. = To mix cattle of different breeds improves the stock.

become mixed, Naakali kutungila bulungu, kwakali kutintana mumitenta. When she was putting the beads on the strings, she was mixing the colours.
  • meet when coming from opposite sides, Bantu aaba batintana munzila. = These people met as they came from opposite directions.
hybridize, Kamutintanya bacende luzubo lukomene-komene. = You need to change the breed of bulls so that the herd grows.
be mixed of breed, rt. -tinta, Mubwa ooyu ulitintene. = This dog is a mongrel.

be half submerged/half full, Inombe ntaanzi Kaluwa, niyatintimana, nceciindi nciitalika kunywa. = When the first cow Kaluwa is half-submerged in the water, that is when she starts to drink. Kamutila meenda kusikila cibiya citintimane. Fill the pot with water until it is half-full. (1.-tintimanwa, 2.-tintimenye, 3.-tintimanya, 4.-tintimanina, 5.-tintimaninalyo, 6.-tintimanisya, 7.-tintimana-tintimana, 8.-tintimaninana)

go half way into, Nokwakainda myaka yosanwe kuzwa ciindi nobakatalika kulima myuunda yabo, kwakajanika kuti Kaumba wakautintimene buya muunda wamweenzinyina kuulima. = When five years had passed from the time when they started their fields, it was found that Kaumba had gone half-way into the field of his friend in ploughing
be in a half submerged state, rt. -tintimana, Wakajana mootokala wakwe *utintimenyi* mumeenda avwelene amankanda. = He found his vehicle half-submerged in water mixed with mud.

strike, Mudaala wakamutintimuna nkoli mubbi. = The old man struck the thief with a club. (1.-tintimunwa, 2.-tintimwide, 3.-tintimuzya, 4.-tintimwida, 5.-tintimwidalyo, 6.-tintimunisya, 7.-tintimuna-tintimuna, 8.-tintimunana)

jump about as fish in water, Twajana tuswi tunji tulatipita muzyiba nkaambo meenda aceya. = We found many little fish jumping about in the water because the water was not much. (1.-tipitwa, 2.-tipitide, 3.-tipitya, 4.-tipitila, 5.-tipitilalyo, 6.-tipitisya, 7.-tipita-tipita,8.-tipitizyanya) Also: -gunta.

bend at knees, Basimbi nibakali kuzyana bakali kutisyauka mumagondo. = When the girls were dancing they were bending at the knees. (1.-tisyaukwa, 2.-tisyaukide, 3.-tisyausya, 4.-tisyaukila, 5.-tisyaukilalyo, 6.-tisyaukisya, 7.-tisyauka-tisyauka, 8.-tisyaukilana)
  • dance with joined knees, Bamwi bantu balicizyi kutisyauka. = Some people know how to dance with joined knees. Also: -tesuuka.
  • be limp or weak, Mubili wangu ulatisyauka nkaambo ndakalicisidwe nsondo yoonse. = My body is weak because I have been sick all week. Also: -tifwuuka.

grow nicely, Nkujana kumweelede maingankwa, *kutitima* boya mumikono yakwe nabuntu. = We found a gentle man whose armpit hair suited him and whose hair on his arms grew nicely. (1.-titimwa, 2.-titimide, 3.-titimya, 4.-titimina, 5.-titiminalyo, 6.-titimisya, 7.-titima-titima)

gather plenty, pay highly, Ciko eeci ncomubona ncobatitimuna mazubaaano, weelede kuzyiba kuti kaindi kwakanyina. = The lobola marriage payment which you see today is paid at a high cost, you ought to know that there was no such practice in the past. (1.-titimunwa, 2.-titimwide, 3.-titimuzya, 4.-titimwida, 5.-titimwidalyo, 6.-titimunisya, 7.-titimuna-titimuna, 8.-titimunana)

run away, Katufwambaana kutebula *kutizizya* nombe. = We should hurry up harvesting so as to escape the cattle (i.e. from the danger of the maize being eaten by the cattle.) (1.-tizizyigwa, 2.-tizizyizye, 3.-tizyisya, 4.-tizizyizya, 5.-tizizyizyalyo, 6.-tizizyisya, 7.-tizizyatizyizya, 8.-tizizyanya)

abduct a woman without following the traditional marriage procedures, Wakamutizya buya, taakakwela buya. = He just took her, he did not pull her. (i.e. follow the traditional custom). Mweemba wakakaka kutizya musimbi. = Mweemba refused to take the girl illegally for marriage. (1.-tizyigwa, 2.-tizyide, 3.-tizyisya, 4.-tizyizya, 5.-tizyizyalyo, 6.-tizyisya, 7.-tizya-tizya, 8.-tizyanya)

soak, by putting into a liquid, soften, Kamutoba mapopwe ngomuyanda kusyanga. Soften the maize which you want to plant. Miyanda yamunomba weelede kwiitoba mumeenda alya nkujisya ceele ncalya muminsyi. = You ought to soak the roots of the munomba tree in that water and use the same water to cook the porridge for the pregnant woman to eat. (1.-tobwa, 2.-tobede, 3.-tobya, 4.-tobela, 5.-tobelalyo, 6.-tobesya, 7.-toba-toba, 8.-tobana) Also: -nyika, -nika, -cavwika, -tobeka.

steep in liquid, soften, rt. toba, Naakasika kuzwa kukusonda, wakatobeka matu aamusampizya mukalonga. = When he came from divining, he softened the *musampizya* leaves in a stream. (1.-tobekwa, 2.-tobekede, 3.-tobezya, 4.-tobekela, 5.-tobekelalyo, 6.-tobekesya, 7.-tobeka-tobeka, 8.-tobekana)
follow, Kamutobela ncobacita bapati. = Follow what the elders do. (1.-tobelwa, 2.-tobelede, 3.-tobezya, 4.-tobelela, 5.-tobelelalyo, 6.-tobelesya, 7.-tobela-tobela, 8.-tobelana) Also: -ccilila

follow up, rt. -tobela, Nobwakaca alimwi bakamwaikizyanya bantu kulangaula akutobezya mukondo wanombe zyakalobokede masiku. = When it was dawn again the people scattered searching and following up the trail of the cattle who had escaped during the night. (1.-tobezyegwa, 2.-tobezyede, 3.-tobezya, 4.-tobezyezya, 5.-tobezyezyalyo, 6.-tobezyesya, 7.-tobezya-tobezya, 8.-tobezyanya)

lose power, Banyina batoboka nibabona mwana wabo kabba. = When the mother saw her child stealing, she became weak. Boonse basimisamu bayanda kuti misamu yabo itatoboki, balafwusa mali mumulonga. Oku kuwaala mali mumeenda amulonga wa Zambezi kulacitwa kutegwa cizimba citatoboki. All the users of charms, who do not want their charms to lose power, throw money in the river. This throwing of money in the Zambezi river is done so that the spirit they invoke does not become powerless. Sicibende wakafwa kubandauka zintu zinji-zinji limwi wakatoboka. Sicibende used all his energy in naming many things (trying to answer a riddle) until finally he gave up. Bamwi balwazi bakali kufwa nkaambo kakulitoboka nobakabona mikowa yabo iilila kabatanaakufwa. Many sick people died because of themselves giving up when they saw relatives crying before they died. (1.-tobokwa, 2.-tobokede, 3.-tobokezya, 4.-tobokela, 5-tobokelalyo, 6.-tobokesya. 7.-toboka-toboka, 8.-tobozyanya)
  • submit oneself, *Ndatoboka nindabona bandiingilila kumbele.* = I surrendered when I saw them gathered in front of me. Also: -bomba

graze without penetrating, *Ndaitobola nziba abbwe lyamalekani.* = I grazed the dove with a stone from a catapult. *Ndamutobola sulwe nkaambo sumo lyangu talibosyi.* I hit the hare without piercing it because my spear was not sharp. *Menyo aababwa amutobola.* = The teeth of dogs grazed him. (Bantu Bansaka kumukowa ncobatembulwa kuti, 'Bana cibwa camazakala kuluma cilatobola'.) Also: -dunta, -duntubula (1.-tobolwa, 2.tobwede, 3.-tobozya, 4.-tobweda, 5.-tobwedalyo, 6.-tobolesya, 7.-tobola-tobola, 8.-tobolana)

be renowned, Mazuba ayo mbibakali *kutobolwa* buya mubuvwubi. In those days they were the ones who were renowned for being rich.
  • realize to one's surprise, Naakamana kupwaya cibulo, wakaile kutobolwa mbuli kuti taasyi nguwe wacuuma. When he had finished splitting the iron bar, he felt as if he was not the one who had smashed it.

avoid telling the truth, Sicibende wakasoleka kumubuzya-buzya munanga, pele murŋanga wakatobosya. = Sicibende tried his best to question the witch-doctor, but the witchdoctor avoided telling the truth. (1.-tobosyegwa, 2.-tobosyede, 3.-tobosyezya, 4.-tobosyezya, 5.-tobosyezyalyo, 6.-tobosyesya, 7.-tobosya-tobosya, 8.-tobosyanya) =

cause to soak, rt. -toba, Kamutobya ameenda akasaala, mapopwe aamimena. = Soak the maize for yeast in warm water. (1.-tobwa, 2.-tobede, 3.-tobya, 4.-tobela, 5.-tobelalyo, 6.-tobesya, 7.-tobya-tobya, 8.-tobana)

clean the teeth, Kolitogonona tunyama twacaalila mumenyo. = Clean yourself of the pieces of meat which remain in your teeth. Also: -dokonona. (1.-togononwa, 2.-togonwede, 3.-togonozya, (4.-togonweda, 5.-togonwedalyo, 6.-togononesya, 7.-togonona-togonona, 8.-togononana)

act lazily, Ndatogwala kuya ku Chisekesi nilyabala zuba. = When the sun was shining I was sluggish in going to Chisekesi. Also: -tokwaala,- tolwaala, -lengaana. (1.-togwalwa, 2.-togwede, 3.-togwazya, 4.-togwalila, 5.-togwalilalyo, 6.-togwalisya, 7.-togwala-togwala, 8.-togwazyanya)

rake a fire, Kotokolola masizi amulilo ubikke mumbaula. = Rake out the embers from the fire so that you put them in the brazier. Also: -yokolola. (1.-tokololwa, 2.-tokolwede, 3.-tokolozya, 4.-tokolweda, 5.-tokolwedalyo, 6.-tokololesya, 7.-tokolola-tokolola, 8.-tokolwedana)

simmer, Mulilo waceya a-cikko, cibiya citokoma buyo. = There is little fire at the fireplace, the pot is only simmering. Nokuba kuti limwi cakulya cakabizwa pesi bakacileka biyo acikko cilatokoma kabotu-kabotu. = Even though the food was finally cooked but she left it simmering nicely on the fire. (1.-tokomwa, 2.-tokomede, 3.-tokomya, 4.-tokomena, 5.-tokomenalyo, 6.-tokomesya, 7.-tokoma-tokoma, 8.-tokomezyanya)

swarm over, Mvwunyu zyakali kutokonya munyama ibolede. = The maggots were swarming over the rotten meat. (1.tokonyezyegwa, 2.-tokonyede, 3.-tokonyezya, 4.-tokonyena, 5.-tokonyenalyo, 6.-tokonyesya, 7.-tokonya-tokonya, 8.-tokonyezyanya) Also: -bumbilila, -milila.

be reluctant, lose hope, Ndatokwaala kulemba lugwalo kumuntu utasanduli. = I am reluctant to write a letter to a person who does not reply. Also: -tolwaala. (1.-tokwaalwa, 2.-tokweede, 3.-tokwaazya, 4.-tokwaalila, 5.-tokwaalilalyo, 6.-tokwaalisya, 7.-tokwaala-tokwaala, 8.-tokwaazyanya)
take, Kamutola bana ku cipimo. = Take the children to the under-five clinic. (1.-tolwa, 2.-tolede, 3.-tolezya, 4.-tolela, 5.-tolelalyo, 6.-tolesya, 7.-tola-tola, 8.-tolana)

take up, Cakatutolela ciindi cilamfwu kumanizya mulimo. = It took us a lot of time to finish the work. + (idiom) Zuba lyakamubala, ayalo nyota yakalitolela. = The sun was shining on him and the thirst was taking its toll.

take along with, rt. -tola. Mweene, komutolelezya mwana kuci- kolo. = Mweene, go along with the child to school. (1.-tolelezyegwa, 2.-tolelezyede, 3.-tolelezya, 4.-tolelezyezya, 5.-tolelezyezyalyo, 6.-tolelezyesya, 7.-tolelezya-tolelezya, 8.-tolelezyanya)
interpret, explain, Batutolokela zyoonse nzyaakali kwaamba. = He explained to us all that he had been saying. Also: -pandulula

lose hope, Balimi batolwaala nkwiitawi mvwula. = The farmers lose hope because it does not rain. (1.-tolwaazyigwa, 2.-tolweede, 3.-tolwaazya, 4.-tolwaalila, 5.-tolwaalilalyo, 6.-tolwaalisya, 7.-tolwaala-tolwaala, 8.-tolwaazyanya) Also: - togwala.

taste, Sena bantu bakaatoma kale mapopwe aamuliide? = Have the people already tasted the maize from their watered gardens? Also: -soma. (1.-tomwa, 2.-tomede, 3.-tomya, 4.-tomena, 5.-tomenalyo, 6.-tomesya, 7.-toma-toma, 8.-tomezyanya)
  • be firm, Kamutoma nomutiibazunde beenzinyoko. Be strong so that you defeat your friends.

touch, as with one finger, Komutomba munwe ooyo andilange. = Touch that one with the finger so that she looks at me. Also: -domba, -tompa. (1.-tombwa, 2.-tombede, 3.-tombya, 4.-tombela, 5.-tombelalyo, 6.-tombesya, 7.-tomba-tomba, 8.-tombana)
  • take fat out of container, Kamutomba tufwuta tuniini ndibombeke mumilomo. Take out a little vaseline so that I soften my lips.

totter as a child learning to walk, walk slowly, tarry, Koleka kutombaila buya kweenda, tatukasiki kufwambaana. = Stop walking slowly, we will not reach there quickly. Muntu uciswa ulatombaila kweenda. A sick person walks slowly. Also: -nambaila, -nombaila. (1.-tombailwa, 2.-tombailide, 3.-tombaizya, 4.-tombailila, 5.-tombaililalyo, 6.-tombailisya, 7.-tombaila-tombaila, 8.-tombaizyanya)

bear a child prematurely, Mukaintu wangu wakatombela. = My wife gave birth prematurely. Also: -belula (1.-tombelwa, 2.-tombelede, 3.-tombezya, 4.-tombelela, 5.-tombelelalyo, 6.-tombelesya, 7.-tombela-tombela, 8.-tombezyanya)

make one purge severely, Taciyandiki kutombola muntu kuti zuba kalibala kapati. It is not right to purge a person if the sun is shining fiercely. (1.-tombolwa, 2.-tombwede, 3.-tombozya, 4.-tombweda, 5.-tombwedalyo, 6.-tombolesya, 7.-tombolatombola, 8.-tombolana)
  • protect with charms, Mucembele mmupati. Ulatombola kana. Amutumbu ulamutombola. Banakazi abasimbi balamulemeka. The old woman is aged. She protects the baby with medicine and also the suckling mother. Women and girls respect her.

take medicine to be purged, Kutombolwa nkulya musamu waceele uusoomonzya kutegwa mwida lyamulwazi musalalile limwi. = KutomboIwa means to eat medicine in porridge which causes one to purge so that the stomach of the patient is completely clean.
  • give medicine to parents to have children, Mudenda a Mutinta bakamuka kubaa mwana aboobo bakabatombola. Mudenda and Mutinta were slow in having a child so they gave them medicine to enable them to produce.

fall as raindrops far apart, Imwula yatalika kutombooka. = The rain has started spattering. (1.-tombookwa, 2.-tombookede, 3.-tombookezya, 4.-tombookela, 5.-tombookelalyo, 6.-toombookesya, 7.-tombooka-tombooka, 8.-tombookezyanya) Also: -londa-londa

rain a few drops, Ilatomboola mvwula sunu. It is raining a few drops today. (1.-tomboolwa, 2.-tombweede, 3.-tomboozya, 4.-tombweeda, 5.-tombweedalyo, 6.-tomboolesya, 7.-tomboola-tomboola, 8.-tomboozyanya)
fall down upon, Anditombweeda mabuula. = Big scattered rain-drops fell on me.

be retarded in growing, Kubula bwizu bubotu cipa kuti inombe kazitomena. = The lack of good grass has led to the retarded growth of the cattle. (1.-tomenwa, 2.-tomwede, 3.-tomezya, 4.-tomweda, 5.-tomwedalyo, 6.-tomenesya, 7.-tomena-tomena, 8.-tomezyanya) Also: -kangila, -dobela.

be stiff with cold, Amukalete munsi amulilo koombe katomenwa muciba. = Bring the calf near the fire which is becoming stiff with the cold in the kraal. Also: -tontwedwa.
  • become powerless, Mwana ngubakafwambaana kulesya wakatomenwa, takakomeni kabotu pe. = The child that they weaned too soon has become permanently powerless, it will not grow well at all.
eat a little, (1.-tomonwa, 2.-tomwede, 3.-tomozya, 4.-tomweda, 5.-tomwedalyo, 6.-tomonesya, 7.-tomona-tomona, 8.-tomezyanya) Also: -tomoona, -sonkoola.
eat only a little of a thing, Sunu mulwazi wacikonzya kutomoona. = Today the patient is able to eat a little. Also: -sonkoola.

dip the extremity of a thing into a liquid, as the tip of a finger, Kotompa munwe wako mumeenda, ulosezye muvwanda, wamwa nyota. = Dip the tip of your finger in water and drop it into the baby's mouth, it is feeling thirsty. Kotompa munwe wako mubuci umvwe mbobubede. = Dip the tip of your finger in the honey to taste how it is. (1.-tompwa, 2.-tompede, 3.-tompya, 4.-tompela, 5.-tompelalyo, 6.-tompesya, 7-tompa-tompa, 8.-tompelana) Also: -tomba.
  • break out, as a disease, Kuti buIwazi buyambukila bwatompa, buvwulizya munzi onse. = If an infectious disease breaks out, it spreads throughout the whole village.
  • dip into, Kobweza kasanga akutompa mumafwuta, undipe ndinanike akacisa. = Take a stalk of grass and dip it in the vaseline, then give it to me so that I smear it on the wound. Also: -domba.

be forbidden, be taboo, Cilatonda kugonka zisamu kumalende. = It is forbidden to cut trees at the rainshrines. Cilatonda kuyanda mukamuntu. = It is taboo to love another man's wife. Cilatonda kuyandana amucizyi. = It is wrong to make love to your sister. Also: -tondwa.

gesticulate wildly, Nakanana ooyu, ulayanda kutondaika kapati. = When this one is speaking he likes to gesticulate wildly. Utani kutondaika minwe kubapati. = Don't wave your fingers at the elders. (1.-tondaikwa, 2.-tondaikide, 3.-tondaikizya, 4.-tondai-kila, 5.-tondaikilalyo, 6.-tondaikisya, 7.-tondaika-tondaika, 8.-tondaikana)

point at, Komutondeka ndimubone ngowamba. = Point at the one you are talking about so that I see him. Kamutondeka munsi kuletezya kambizyi, kutegwa keelebe. = Point with a pounding stick to where the whirlwind is coming from, so that it passes by. (1.-tondekwa, 2.-tondekede, 3.-tondesya, 4.-tondekela, 5.-tondekelalyo, 6.-tondekesya, 7.-tondeka-tondeka, 8.-tondekana)

show, Ndamutondezya kunanda yabantu mbaali kubuzya. = I showed her the house of the people she was inquiring about. Mwami utondezya muntu wapola nyika yakulima. = The chief is showing land for ploughing to the one who had moved residence. (1.-tondezyegwa, 2.-tondezyede, 3.-tondezyesya, 4.-tondezyezya, 5.-tondezyezyalyo, 6.-tondezyesya, 7.-tondezya-tondezya, 8.-tondezyanya)

pull tightly, stretch, Kolutondomona looye luyume kutegwa tugagaile nkanka. = Pull the rope tightly so that we fix the pegs. (1.-tondomonwa, 2.-tondomwede, 3.-tondomozya, 4.-tondomweda, 5.-tondomwedalyo, 6.-tondomonesya, 7.-tondomona-tondomona, 8.-tondomonana) Also: -landamuna, -lozomona.

be taboo, be prohibited as a religious or natural offence, Cilatondwa kuvwuula mumalende. = Promiscuity is taboo at the rainshrine. Cilatondwa kusyaba banyoko. = It is taboo to have a love-affair with your mother. (1.-tondwa, 2.-tondede, 3.-tondya, 4.-tondela, 5.-tondelalyo, 6.-tondesya, 7.-tonda-tonda, 8.-tondelana)
cause to do what is taboo, Kubula luzyibo lwacibaka cilatondya nomuba mumalende. = Lack of knowledge of the area causes one to do what is taboo even in rainshrines.

hurt someone on sore spot, e.g Ncindali kulila nkaambo wanditoneka acilonda. = You have hurt me on the wound that is why I have been crying. (1.-tonekwa, 2.-tonekede, 3.-tonesya, 4.-tonekela, 5.-tonekelalyo, 6.-tonekesya, 7.-toneka-toneka, 8.-tonekana)

make noise of bones rubbing together, Nayenda ulatonga mumagondo. = When he walks his knees make a noise. (1.-tongwa, 2.-tongede, 3.-tonzya, 4.-tongela, 5.-tongelalyo, 6.-tongesya, 7.-tonga-tonga, 8.-tozyanya)
  • crack, as the knuckles, creak as a tree before falling, Mupati wangu utonga minwe kumaanza. = My elder brother cracks the knuckles. Kamusosoloka musamu ulamulimba nkaambo watalika kale kutonga. = Move away the tree is about to fall because it has begun to creak. Also: -pasa.
  • sound as friction drum, Namalwa ulatonga, awalo mwaandu ulavwuluma, ooku kulila bukwabi-kwabi. = The friction drum is sounding and also the big pot drum is vibrating and the stick-on-pestle rhythm is being tapped out. (Note. The Batonga of the southern bank of the Zambezi in Zimbabwe claim that tonga means to judge well or to be reasonable in judging court cases.)

moan, as when sick, Bantu nobaciswa kapati inga balatongela. = When people are very sick they moan. Jolezya wakalyoombokela Jolezya kumwi katongela. = Jolezya went over the problem in his mind as he moaned. (1.-tongelwa, 2.-tongelede, 3.-tongezya. 4.-tongelela, 5.-tongelelalyo, 6.-tongelesya, 7.-tongela-tongela, 8.-tongelana |
Also: -milila, -nyinyita, sinta.

pick out from, Inkobo zilayandisya kutongola nzengene kunombe. = Cattle-egrets are very fond of picking ticks from cattle. Bamakaintu babelesya zipeni kutongola mapopwe matete. = Women use a knife to extract the fresh maize seeds. Naakamana kulya nyama wakatalika kulitongola mumenyo. = When he had finished eating meat he began to pick his teeth. (1.-tongolwa, 2.-tongwede, 3.-tongozya, 4.-tongweda, 5.-tongwedalyo, 6.-tongolesya, 7.-tongola-tongola, 8.-tongolana)
  • speak directly and openly, Twaambo otu twantongola matwi. = These statements are made directly. Also: -gama.

make representation of a difficulty, lodge a complaint, Balatongooka ati nkaambo nsesiki kumunzi kubona bamukwasyi. = They complain because I do not visit the village to see the family. Batolo balatongooka bapegwa mulimo. = Lazy people complain when they are given work. Also: -nyontooka, (inner grumbling), nunuta, embauka. (1.-tongookwa, 2.-tongookede, 3.-tongoozya, 4.-tongookela, 5.-tongookelalyo, 6.-tongookesya, 7.-tongooka-tongooka, 8.-tongookana)

push, Ndakamutonka akumuumputya kubwaanda. = I pushed him and smashed him up against the wall. Wakaunka koo Mutinta ulati utonkwa kambizyi musyule. = He went off to Mutinta's, you could say he was pushed behind by a whirlwind. Also: -sukuma, -kuba, -tonta. (1.-tonkwa, 2.-tonkede, 3.-tonsya, 4.-tonkela, 5.-tonkelalyo, 6.-tonkesya, 7.-tonka-tonka, 8.-tonkana)
  • push as when giving birth, Mukaintu utumbuka ulatonka kutegwa mwana azwe. = A woman giving birth pushes so that the child comes out. Also: -kana.
oppress, Kubule utonkaika mweenzinyina, nokuba kumunyonokela kucintu cakwe. = Let no one oppress his friend, or be envious of what his friend possesses.
push against one another, Ncibi kutonkana mumootokala inga mwalicisa. It is bad to push against each other in a vehicle, you might hurt yourself.

be slow, Twajana muIwazi ulalitonkazya kweenda. = We found the patient walking slowly. Also: -tonkezya. (1.-tonkazyegwa, 2.-tonkazyede, 3.-tonkazyesya, 4.-tonkazyezya, 5.-tonkazyezyalyo, 6.-tonkazyesya, 7.-tonkazya-tonkazya, 8.-tonkazyanya)

force, Ndinakuyabulitonkezya necisidwe kapati kuya kucibbadela. Being sick I will force myself to go to the hospital. (1.-tonkezyegwa, 2.-tonkezyede, 3.-tonkezyesya, 4.-tonkezyezya, 5.-tonkezyezyalyo, 6.-tonkezyesya, 7.-tonkezya-tonkezya, 8.-tonkezyanya)
  • push with, Kamwiitonkezya cisamu nzoka. Push the snake with a stick.

extract, as seed from cotton, Bamakaintu batonkola nseke zya-buluba mumuunda. The women are extracting cotton-seeds in the field. (1.-tonkolwa, 2.-tonkwede, 3.-tonkozya, 4.-tonkweda, 5.-tonkwedalyo, 6.-tonkolesya, 7.-tonkola-tonkola, 8.-tonkwedana)

be clear or straightforward, Makani aako aleelede kutonkomana nobetekwa munkuta. Your case should be straightforward when you are tried in court. Kunyina twaambo tutonkomene tupa kuti Chimeko azulwe. = There is no clear evidence which shows that Chimeko should be convicted. (1.-tonkomanwa, 2.-tonkomene, 3.-tonkomeka, 4.-tonkomanina, 5.-tonkomaninalyo, 6.-tonkomanisya, 7.-tonkomanatonkomana, 8.-tonkomaninana)

make oneself understood, Bamacembele nobabetekwa cilabaalila kutonkomeka twaambo. = When the old ladies are being tried it is too difficult for them to make clear statements.
  • raise up, Syuumbwa wakatalika kulizakamuna kwapepela mwaala wangala watonkomeka mucila wakwe. The lion started shaking himself, his long mane blowing in the wind and raising up his tail. "Nobantu mebo wandiluma sibbende oyu ukkede waawa." Kkabicci wakatonkomeka munwe kutondezya mpaakali kulumwa. = People, this rat who is sitting there has bitten me." Kkabicci raised his finger showing where he had been bitten.

go ahead, Moonga nguwakatonona kuli basicikolo nobakali kuya kumulonga. Moonga was the one who was leading the pupils when they were going to the river. (1.-tononwa, 2.-tonwede, 3.-tonozya, 4.-tonweda, 5.-tonwedalyo, 6.-tononesya, 7-tononatonona, 8.-tonenana) Also: -sonona,-solola.

push with, rt. -tonta, Nitwakamana kwiijaya nzoka, twakali kutonsya zisamu kwiitola mubwina. = When we had finished killing the snake we were pushing it with sticks taking it to a hole. (1.-tonkwa, 2.-tonkede, 3.-tonsya, 4.-tonkela, 5.-tonkelalyo, 6.-tonkesya, 7.-tonsya-tonsya, 8.-tonkana)

push, Kamutonta cikuni eeco cinjile mukati uyake mulilo. = Push that log so that it goes in and lights up the fire. (1.-tontwa, 2.-tontede, 3.-tontya, 4.-tontela, 5.-tontelalyo, 6.-tontesya, 7.-tonta-tonta, 8.-tontana) Also: -tonka, -sosela.
  • push away, Komutonta ooyo ulakutukila. = Push that one away he is insulting you.

push around, Bamasilikani balikutonteeka mubbi wabba mpongo. The police have been pushing around the thief who stole goats. Boonse bakatalika kumutonteeka akumwaambila kuti afwambaane nkaambo wabaccelezya bayanda kupiluka kumunzi. = They all began to push her telling her that she should hurry up because she was delaying them, they wanted to return home. (1.-tonteekwa, 2.-tonteekede, 3.-tonteekezya, 4.-tonteekela, 5.-tonteekelalyo, 6.-tonteekesya, 7.-yonteeka-tonteeka, 8.-tonteekana)
push with, e.g Cizoka ciya ndacitontezya cisako ncindalikuumya. = I pushed that snake with the stick with which I had beaten it. Also: -tonsya.

cool with cold water, Naakamvwa kumyonga mwida, wakaya mumbali azyiba kulitontobozya cileke kumyonga. = When he felt his stomach upset he went near the pool and began to cool himself so that the stomach pain might ease off. Mainza wakakanana kusola kutontobozya mulombwana uulya. = Mainza spoke trying to cool down that man. (1.-tontobozyegwa, 2.-tontobozyede, 3.-tontobozyesya, 4.-tontobozyezya, 5.-tontobozyezyalyo, 6.-tontobozyesya, 7.ptontobozya-tontobozya, 8.-tontobozyanya)
be cold, Kwaacili kusiya mbii alimwi kaalitontode. It was still dark and it was cold. Also: -tontwede

cool down, Kwatalika kutontola mazuba ano. = It has begun to cool down these days. (1.-tontolwa, 2.-tontolede,/-tontwede, 3.-tontozya, 4.-tontolela,/-tontweda, 5.-tontolelalyo, /-tontwedalyo 6.-tontolesya, 7.-tontola-tontola, 8.-tontozyanya.)
  • be quiet, be at peace, be lonely, Sunu kumunzi wesu kwakatontola nkaambo mazwanga akamana. = It is quiet at our village today because the quarreling has ended.

subside as anger or pain, Wakatontomana sunu nkaambo wakomena. = He has become less aggressive today because he has become mature. Inkondo yatontomana umwi naakomwa. = War ceased when one was beaten. (1.-tontomanwa, 2.-tontomene, 3.-tontomeka, 4.-tontomanina, 5.-tontomaninalyo, 6.-tontomanisya 7.-tontomana-tontomana, 8.-tontomezyanya)

become quiet, Moyo wangu watontomena nibamujata wabba payi lyangu. = My heart became quiet when they caught the one who stole my blanket. Imvwula niyakatalika kuwa, luwo Iwakatontomena. = When the rain began to fall, the wind died down.

quieten, assuage, calm, make cool, Kocitontozya cileke kupya eeco cibulo. = Cool down that bucket so that it is no longer hot. Sibbuku nguwatontozya lumamba. = It was the headman who brought peace in the quarrel. (1.-tontozyegwa, 2.-tontozyede, 3.-tontozya, 4.-tontozyezya, 5.-tontozyezyalyo, 6.-tontozyesya, 7.-tontozyatontozya, 8.-tontozyanya) Also: -ombosya.

be left alone, be lonely, rt. -tontola, Ndatontwedwa nkwaa-wunka mukaintu wangu. = I am lonely since my wife left me. (1.-tontwedwa, 2.-tontwedwe, 3.-tontwezya, 4.-tontwedela, 5.-tontwedelalyo, 6.-tontwedesya, 7.-tontweda-tontweda, 8.-tontwezyanya)
  • become cool/cold, Ndatontwedwa nindasamba meenda atontola. = I became cool when I washed with cold water. Wisi wakatontwedwa mumafwuwa. = The father became cold in the bones. Mwana watontwedwa mpeyo. = The baby was suffering from the cold. Makuwa akali makali kapati. Ngamakuwa aakatalika kutambya nyika kuti itontwede limwi. The white people were very aggresive. It was the whites who began to tame the land so that it became peaceful.

precede, rt. tonona, Ndali kutonweda basune nitwali kuya kucigayo. I was going ahead of the oxen when we were going to the mill. (1.-tonwedwa, 2.-tonwede, 3.-tonwezya, 4.-tonwedela, 5.-tonwedelalyo, 6.-tonwedesya, 7.-tonweda-tonweda, 8.-tonwedana)

crack, rt. tonga, Muwo niwavwula, watonzya ciluli cananda. = When the wind became strong, it cracked the roof of the house. (1.-tonzyegwa, 2.-tonzyede, 3.-tonzyesya, 4.-tonzyezya, 5.-tonzyezyalyo, 6.-tonzyesya, 7.-tonzyatonzya, 8.-tonzyanya)

be blinded, Mwana ulalila nkaambo watooqwa mpilibili mumeso, = The child is crying because it was blinded by pepper in the eyes. (1.-toogwa, 2.-towede, 3.-towezya, 4.-towela, 5.-towelalyo, 6.-towesya, 7.-toogwa-toogwa, 8.-towana)

subside, Mulonga watooka ino ambweni inga twalanduka. = The river has subsided, perhaps we can cross now. Idamu lyakatooka kale, nkaambo nombe zyavwulisya zinywa. = The dam has already gone down, because the cattle drinking are so many. (1.-tookwa, 2.-tookede, 3.-toosya, 4.-tookela, 5.-tookelalyo, 6.-tookesya, 7.-tooka-tooka, 8.-toosyanya) Also: -yosa

be silent, deep in thought, Naakabbukilwa wakatoomana kuyeeya ncaacita. When he was caught in adultery he reflected silently on what he had done. (1.-toomanwa, 2.-toomene, 3.-toomeka, 4.-toomanina, 5.-toomaninalyo, 6.-toomanisya, 7.-toomanatoomana, 8.-toomaninana, or -toomanizyanya)

be silent, Wakalitoomene kunembo lyabalombwana bakaluzyi ncobeni Lusaka. He kept silent in front of the men who really knew Lusaka. (1.-toomekwa, 2.-toomene, 3.-toomeka, 4.-toomanina, 5.-toomaninalyo, 6.-toomanisya, 7.-toomene-toomene, 8.-toomaninana)

cause to lessen quantity, rt. tooka, Mpongo zyakaitoosya nongo yakazwide meenda. = The goats reduced the amount of water in the filled earthen pot. (1.-tookwa,/toosyegwa, 2.-tookede, 3.-toosya, 4.-tookela, 5.-tookelalyo, 6.-tookesya, 7.-toosya-toosya, 8.-toosyanya) Also: -laula.

complain, Mucaangu Haanampakila kusola kwiima kutabapa mali, batalika kumutopa. Poor Haanampakila trying to refuse to give them money, they begin to complain against him. (1.-topwa, 2.-topede, 3.-topya, 4.-topela, 5.-topelalyo, 6.-topesya, 7.-topa-topa, 8.-topana)

complain against, Basazinyina bakali kumutopela. Bakati, "Wiide kulutakanisya lubono ulalumana kupa batuba." His relatives were complaining about him. They said, "You are just dishing out the inherited wealth and you are finishing it off by giving it to strangers."

-topa, defame, report evil things about, Wanditopezya amulimo mmweenzuma nkaambo cuuno ncejisi ulaciyanda awalo. The one who said evil things about me is my friend because he also wants the position which I hold at work. (3.-topezya)
  • make unclean, Mankanda atopezya zisani. = The mud has dirtied the clothes.

wade, as in mud, Mweenzu wasoweka wali kutopola mumankanda. The visitor who was lost was wading through the mud. Also: -tyopola, -dyoboola. (1.-topolwa, 2.-topwede, 3.-topozya, 4.-topweda, 5.-topwedalyo, 6.-topolesya, 7.-topola-topola, 8.-topozyanya)

talk endlessly, Bayi bakali kutopota ciindi cilamfwu limwi bana bacikolo bakatalika kuumfwula. = The teacher dragged on in speaking for a long time so that the children began to doze. (Syaadomo litopota = a chatterbox) (1.-topotwa, 2.-topotede, 3.-topotya, 4.-topotela, 5.-topotelalyo, 6.-topotesya, 7.-topota-topota, 8.-topotelana) Also: -popota.

dazzle, radiate, Nindakasika mudolopo masiku, mimuni minji yakali kutowa. When I arrived in the city at night many lights were glittering. (1.-toogwa, 2.-towede, 3.-towezya, 4.-towela, 5.-towelalyo, 6.-towesya,.. 7.-towa-towa, 8.-towana)
  • have a painful object in the eye, make one temporarily blind, bother one, Kuli canditowa muliso. = There is something bothering me in the eye. Mwana wamu-towa mbala. The sap from the mbala tree was stinging the child's eye. Eco ncosisikizya nolilampa ciyakupwasyuka pele kozyi kuti ciya kukutowa. = That which you are hiding will come out eventually but know that it will bother you. Also: -toogwa, -towegwa.
reflect light, glow as red hot iron, Izuba lilatowa-towa. = The sun is glowing.
Also: -toogwa.

cough repeatedly, Ncibi kuuma kana nkobwene mazuba oonse kaide kutoyola kukola. = It is bad to beat the little child who has a continuous cough all these days. (1.-toyolwa, 2.-toyolede, 3.-toyozya, 4.-toyolela, 5.-toyoyelalyo, 6.-toyolesya, 7.-toyolatoyola, 8.-toyozyanya)

be lanced, be cut open, Cuute cakatozoka jilo. = The abcess was lanced yesterday. Also: -pozyoka. (1.-tozokwa, 2.-tozokede, 3.-tozokezya, 4.-tozokela, 5.-tozokelalyo, 6.-tozokesya, 7.-tozoka-tozoka, 8.-tozokezyanya)
  • be weak or be enfeebled. = Ndatozoka nindamana kubeleka mulimo muyumu. = I was tired when I finished doing a hard job.

lance, Komutozola cuute mweenzinyoko. Lance the abcess of your friend. Also: -pozyola. (1.-tozolwa, 2.-tozwede, 3.-tozosya, 4.-tozweda, 5.-tozwedalyo, 6.-tozolesya, 7.-tozola-tozola, 8.-tozolana)
  • make weak, enfeeble

take direction, direct towards, Bazitozya kuli nombe bana aba sunu? = To where have the children taken the cattle today? Musa, atuloboke, tuzwe mumunzi akati kamasiku, tutozye kujwe. = My friend, let us run away, let us leave the village at night, let us head eastwards. (1.-tozyegwa, 2.-tozyede, 3.-tozyesya, 4.-tozyela,/tozyezya, 5.-tozyelalyo, /-tozyezyalyo, 6.-tozyesya, 7.-tozyatozya, 8.-tozyanya)

be white, Ooyu ulatuba ku meso mbuli kuti walambwa twe. This one is white in the face as if he has been smeared with ash. (1.-tubizyigwa, 2.-tubide, 3.-tubya, 4.-tubila, 5.-tubilalyo, 6.-tubisya, 7.-tubatuba, 8.-tubizyanya)

clear as a field, rub a thing clean, Baama batubula zisani zyabataata. My mother is cleaning my father's clothes. (1.-tubulwa, 2.-tubwide, 3.-tubuzya, 4.-tubwida, 5.-tubwidalyo, 6.-tubulisya, 7.-tubula-tubula, 8.-tubulana)
  • take off, *Kotubula* cisani eeco nkaambo cabija. Take off that dress because it is dirty. Also: samununa.

fade, Citeenge eci catubuluka kufwambaana akuzwa musyobo nkaambo kakucapwa-capwa. This chiteenge material has quickly faded and Isot colour from being washed frequently. Mutayaniki cisani muzuba ciindi cilamfwu nkaambo inga *catubuluka*. Do not hang out a cloth to dry in the sun for a long time because it will fade. (1.-tubulukwa, 2.-tubulukide, 3.-tubulukizya, 4.-tubulukila, 5.-tubulukilalyo, 6.-tubulukisya, 7.-tubuluka-tubuluka, 8.-tubulukizyanya)
  • become white, Bamaama baide

mbuli muntu wanjilwa zyeelo. My mother is just completely white like a person possessed by evil spirits. Meso aakwe akatalika *kutubuluka*. Her eyes became white. Milomo yayuma nta, ya*tubuluka*. The lips have dried up, they have become white. Also: -jujuka.
be haggard, look unwell and exhausted, Bakapiluka kumunzi kabatubulukide a kukoka akaambo kakutundululwa. They returned to the village looking haggard and thin because of being tortured.
crack open, Bana baka
tunyemu akutalika kukwanga. The children opened the groundnuts and began to fry them.

be pounded, rt. -twa, Mundyoli *watugwa* kale, kwacaala buyo kujika. The groundnut mash has been pounded already, what remains is just to cook it. Wakomena uyakuba mulombwana *utugwa* muncili. When you grow up you will be a man who was pounded in a mortar. i.e. You will be a fine strong man. (2.-twide, 3.-twisya, 4.-twida, 5.-twidalyo 6.-twisya, 7.-tugwa-tugwa, 8.-twidana, /-twana) Also: - twigwa.

use abusive language, Ooyu ulaciyanda *kutukana* bapati. This one likes to use abusive language to the elders. (1.-tukanwa, 2.-tukanide, 3.-tukanya, 4.-tukanina, 5.-tukaninalyo, 6.-tukanisya, 7.-tukana-tukana, 8.-tukanana) Also: -tukila.
use abusive language, Wa

munene cijazya bweemya. It is shameful the way he used abusive language to the old man. (1.-tukilwa, 2.-tukilide, 3.-tukizya, 4.-tukilila, 5.-tukililalyo, 6.-tukilisya, 7.-tukila-tukila, 8.-tukilana) Also: -tukana, -bumina.

load, as a person putting on head, Kamubatukka cileye cankuni bacembele. Help the old lady to put the bundle of firewood on her head. Sunu ndacikonzya kulitukka nkuni ndemwini. Today I am myself able to load the firewood on my head. (1.-tukkwa, 2.-tukkide, 3.-tukkizya, 4.-tukkila, 5.-tukkilalyo, 6.-tukkisya, 7.-tukka-tukka, 8.-tukkana.)

be able to sleep, Musankwa tatukopeki akutukopeka tulo pe, bulaca nkulizya kalumbu muganda yakwe. = The boy is quite unable to sleep, until the dawn he plays the onestringed musical-bow in his house. (1.-tukopekwa, 2.-tukopekede, 3.-tukopekezya, 4.-tukopekela, 5.-tukopekelalyo, 6.-tukopekesya, 7.-tukopeka-tukopeka, 8.-tukopekana)

reshape a crumbled tin, Basambazi mumusyika tabayandi kutukula zipimyo zipoonkene nkaambo bayanda kucenga baula. = The sellers in the market do not want to reshape crumbled tins because they want to exploit the customers. (1.-tukulwa, 2.-tukwide, 3.-tukuzya, 4.-tukwida, 5.-tukwidalyo, 6.-tukulisya, 7.-tukula-tukula, 8.-tukulana)
  • undress, Izuba lyabala babelesi *balatukula zisani*. = When the sun shines the workers take off their clothes. Also: -samununa.

throw at, rt. -tukulula, *Watukulwida mabwe canguzu kuuma sicinsuungwe*. = She threw stones vigourously at the rabid dog. Also: -fwukutila
  • strip off, *Nindakamutukila kapati wakanyema mpoona wakanditukulwida zisani*. = When I abused her verbally she became angry and stripped off her clothes before me. Also: -samunwida. (1.-tukulwidwa, 2.-tukulwide, 3.-tukulwizya, 4.-tukulwida, 5.-tukulwidalyo, 6.-tukulwidisya, 7.-tukulwida-tukulwida, 8.-tukulwidana)

stretch, as a bag by filling it, be convex, Ida lyakwe lyatukumana akaambo kakukkuta kapati. = His stomach is extended because of eating to full capacity. Banyina bakali kumupa nsima yakucita kada kakwe kuti kakomene akutukumana anga nkankuli. = His mother began to give him nsima so that his little tummy would grow and extend like a calabash. (1.-tukumanwa, 2.-tukumene, 3.-tukumanya, 4.-tukumanina, 5.-tukumaninalyo, 6.-tukumanisya, 7.-tukumana-tukumana, 8.-tukumanina)
  • be boastful, Chingumbe ulatukumana nkaambo wasama kabotu. = Chingumbe is boastful because he is well dressed. Also: -dukumana.

make one boast, *Wamutukumika mboomuulila buluke bupya*. = You made him boastful because of the new trousers you bought for him. (1.-tukumikwa, 2.-tukumikide, 3.-tukumikizya, 4.-tukumikila, 5.-tukumikilalyo, 6.-tukumikisya, 7.-tukumika-tukumika, 8.-tukumikana
  • brag, *Haamaamba ulalitukumika kubee ulivwubide ani kuti mmucete buyo mbuli bamwi*. = Haamaamba boasts as if he were rich, but it is not so, he is a poor person like others. Also: -tukumuna.

feel cold, *Ndatukuminwa nkaambo mvwula yandiwa kapati*. = I feel cold because the rain has soaked me for a long time. Also: -dukuminwa (2.-tukumide, 3.-tukumizya, 4.-tukuminina, 5.-tukumininalyo, 6.-tukuminisya, 7.tukuminwa-tukuminwa, 8.-tukumizyanya)

swell, as soaked grain, *Mapopwe ngitwakanyika bumena akatukumuka citondezya kuti ayanda kumena*. = The maize grains which we soaked have swollen which shows that they are about to germinate. *Igondo lyatukumuka kuzimba*. = The knee has swollen up. *Ityubbu yatukumuka lilaafwi kubbosyoka*. = The tube has swelled up and is about to burst. *Meso aide kutukumuka akaambo kakufwundilila kunyema, mbuli musune wadinwa citolopo*. = The eyes were just bulging because of choking anger, like an ox being strangled by the reins. (1.-tukumukwa, 2.-tukumukide, 3.-tukumukizya, 4.-tukumukila, 5.-tukumukilalyo, 6.-tukumukisya, 7.-tukumuka-tukumuka, 8.-tukumusyanya) Also: -fwutumuka.

inflate, Bantu bamwi inga balatukumuna mada kubee `ntuvwumbula-balimi.' = Some people inflate their stomachs like underground frogs. (tukumunwa, 2.-tukumwide, 3.-tukumuzya, 4.-tukumwida, 5.-tukumwidalyo, 6.-tukumunisya, 7.-tukumunatukumuna, 8.-tukumunana)
  • brag, show off, Wakasola kulitukumuna naakanjila munkamu yabavwubi. = He tried to show off when he joined the rich group. Also: -tukumika.
  • make an effort to vomit, Walikusola kulitukumuna kuti aluke pesi cakaka. = He tried to force himself to vomit but failed. Also: -takamuna.

be indignant, Bantu banji balatukutila nobatapegwi mali ngobabelekela. Many people become indignant when they do not get the money they work for. (1.-tukutilwa, 2.-tukutilide, 3.-tukutizya, 4.-tukutilila, 5.-tukutililalyo, 6.-tukutilisya, 7.-tukutila-tukutila, 8.-tukutilana) tukwa to be insulted, Bayakusula ikwa, kutukwa alimwi akuya kusinganizigwa abuleya boonse. They will be despised, insulted and cursed by all the crowd.

put down a load, Buumba wakatula mukuli wakwe. = Buumba put down his load. (1.-tulwa, 2.-tulide, 3-tulizya,/-tuzya 4.-tulila, 5.-tulilalyo, 6.-tulisya, 7.-tula-tula, 8.-tulana)
  • relieve a person of load, Kamunditula mebo ndalemenwa. = Take this load off me I am weary. Wakayeeya kuti nkubotu aye kumupati wakwe kutegwa akatule moyo. = He thought it would be good to go to his elder brother to unload his worries.
  • make a present to chief, Badaala batula citulo campongo kumwami. = The V - 606 old man is taking the goat-offering to the chief.
  • make an offering of a blue jay to one's father as a sign of filial homage, or some other such gift, Cuuno ncindakataanguna kufwala, ndakacitula kuli bataata. = The stool which I first carved I gave as a present to my father.
  • lay eggs, Inkuku yatula kale. = The hen has already laid eggs.

pierce here and there, Bantu bamutulaula meso musune wangu. = People pierced the eyes of my ox. Uyanda kututulaula masumo. = You want to pierce us with spears. (1.-tulaulwa, 2.-tulaulide, 3.-tulauzya, 4.-tulaulila, 5.-tulaulilalyo, 6.-tulaulisya, 7.-tulaulatulaula, 8.-tulaulana) Also: -donkoola, -bbwaluulas, -tulidwa be stored at, rt. -tula, Nyama niyakabizwa yakatulidwa musiya akulungwa munyo akukopwa amuungo. = When the meat was cooked it was stored in a hidden place and salted and stirred with a wooden spoon. (2.-tulide, 3.-tulizya, 4.-tulila, 5.-tulilalyo, 6.-tulisya, 7.-tulidwa-tulidwa, 8.-tulana)

rest the head on when lying down, Bacembele balitulika acitulizyo. = The old woman rested her head on a head-rest. (1.-tulikwa, 2.-tulikide, 3.-tulisya, 4.-tulikila, 5.-tulikilalyo, 6.-tulikisya, 7.-tulika-tulika, 8.-tulikana)
  • load or afflict, rt. -tula, Banditulika mukuli ngwetakonzyi kubweza. = They have loaded me with a burden which I cannot carry.

pierce here and there, Kamutuloola cigabba cakwiidizya. Pierce the tin can here and there for watering. (1.-tuloolwa, 2.-tuloolede, 3.-tuloozya, 4.-tuloolela, 5.-tuloolelalyo, 6.-tuloolesya 7.-tuloola-tuloola, 8.-tuloolana). Also: -tulaula, -tulula.

have a miscarriage, Mukubula coolwe musimbi wakatulubanya, nkokuti ida lyakazwa mazuba kaataningasika akutumbuka. = Unfortunately the girl had a miscarriage, that is to say, the foetus came out before the days arrived to give birth. (1.-tulubizyigwa, 2.-tulubizyide, 3.-tulubanya, 4.-tulubizyizya, 5.-tululizyizyalyo, 6.-tulubizyisya, 7.-tulubanya-tulubanya, 8.-tulubizyanya)
  • prepare for school, go to pre-school, Kuli zikolo zyabana bataningakwiiya, balo omu inga nkwiile kutulubanya kwiiya. = There are schools specially for children who have not yet reached the schoolgoing-age in which they just prepare with games etc. to learn.

burst as a dam, abate as a swelling when pierced, Idamu lyesu lyatuluka. Our dam has burst. Cuute catuluka kale. The abcess has already burst. Also: -anduka. (1.-tulukwa, 2.-tulukide, 3.-tulukizya, 4.-tulukila, 5.-tulukilalyo, 6.-tulukisya, 7.-tuluka-tuluka, 8.-tulukizyanya)
  • become emaciated, Mubili wa Jolezya watuluka akaambo kabulwazi bwasikalileke. = Jolezya has become emaciated because of AIDS. Also: -fwuluka.

open an ulcer, pierce, drill a hole, Kamutulula cuute kutegwa busina buzwe. Lance the abcess so that the pus comes out. Kotulula majoko kutegwa tubikke zikkeyi ziyumu. = Drill holes in the yoke. Mubezi utulula miini yatweembe tokwesu. The carpenter is making holes in the handles of our axes. Noyakamana kulwana nkondo eeyi, kwakajanika kuti Muunta bakamutulula nguma zyotatwe mumutwe. = When the battle that was fought was over it was found that they had opened three wounds in Muunta's head. Also: -donkola. (1.-tululwa, 2.-tulwide, 3.-tuluzya, 4.-tulwida, 5.-tulwidalyo, 6.-tululisya, 7.-tulula-tulula, 8.-tululana)

be shocked, Kambone watulumana buyo naamvwa kaambo. = Kambone was just shocked when he heard the news. (1.-tulumanwa, 2.-tulumene, 3.-tulumanya, 4.-tulumanina, 5.-tulumaninalyo, 6.-tulumanisya, 7.-tulumana-tulumana, 8.-tulumanizyanya) Also: -tungumana.

cause shock, Kaambo kayoosya kalatulumika. Frightening news gives one a shock. (kubaa ntulu = to receive a shock) Also: -konga (1.-tulumikwa, 2.-tulumikide, 3.-tulumika, 4.-tulumikila, 5.-tulumikilalyo, 6.-tulumikisya, 7.-tulumika-tulumika, 8.-tulumikana)

pierce with, rt. -tulula, Naakalikutulula miini yatweembe, wakali kutuluzya tubulo tupya. When he was making holes for the axe handles, he pierced them by using hot irons. (1.-tululwa, 2.-tulwide, 3.-tuluzya, 4.-tulwida, 5.-tulwidalyo, 6.-tululisya, 7.-tuluzya-tuluzya, 8.-tululana)

make an opening or hole, pierce, rt. -tulula, Kotulwida meenda mutusamu. Make an opening for the water to flow around the young trees. Kakole utulwida Machila miini yamaamba. = Kakole is making holes in the hoehandles for Machila. Also: -polweda, -donkola.

send, Kamufwambaana kutuma mwana akazyibye banyina kuti kuli beenzu kunanda. = Send the child quickly to inform the mother that there are visitors at home. (1.-tumwa, 2.-tumide, 3.-tuminzya or tumya, 4.-tumina, 5.-tuminalyo, 6.-tumisya, 7.-tuma-tuma, 8.-tumana)

raise dust, Twakaandaana, mebo ndakakkwela namutendele wangu awalo kwakatumba kasuko kunsi aa mavwiili kuya ku Mazabuka. = We separated, I rode my bicycle along while he raised the dust under the wheels going to Mazabuka. (1.-tumbizigwa, 2.-tumbide, 3.-tumbya, 4.-tumbila, 5.-tumbilalyo, 6.-tumbisya, 7.-tumba-tumba, 8.-tumbizyanya

carry a heavy weight, *Batumbaasya mutunta wamuntu.* = They are carrying the corpse. (1.-tumbaasyigwa, 2.-tumbaasyide, 3.-tumbaasya, 4.-tumbaasyizya, 5.-tumbasyizyalyo, 6.-tumbasyisya, 7.-tumbaasya-tumbaasya, 8.-tumbaasyanya) Also: -tumbaizya.

carry a heavy weight, test the weight of a thing on the hands, *Bantu batumbaizya mutunta kutola kunamaumbwe.* = The people are carrying the corpse to the graveyard. Also: -dumbaizya, -tumbaasya. -tumbatila. (1.-tumbaizyigwa, 2.-tumbaizyide, 3.-tumbaizya, 4.-tumbaizyizya, 5.-tumbaizyizyalyo, 6.-tumbaizyisya, 7.-tumbaizyatumbaizya, 8.-tumbaizyanya)

place firmly, hold tightly, *Mutumbu wakanjila munanda akugwisya ciputu akucitumbamika mumaanza amweenzu.* = A mother entered the house and took the parcel and placed it firmly in the hands of the visitor. *Mulombe wakayumuna kabotu ciputu akucitumbamika kabotu mumaanza awisi.* = The young man carried the parcel carefully and placed it firmly in the hands of his father. Also: -tumbika, -tumbatika. (1.-tumbamikwa, 2.-tumbamikide, 3.-tumbamikizya, 4.-tumbamikila, 5.-tumbamikilalyo, 6.-tumbamikisya, 7.-tumbamika-tumbamika, 8.-tumbamikana)

cause to hold carefully, *Banyina bakamutumbatika mayi mwana aabo kutegwa atapwayiki.* = The mother caused her child to hold the eggs carefully so that they would not be broken. (1.-tumbatikwa, 2.-tumbatikide, 3.-tumbatikizya, 4.-tumbatikila, 5.-tumbatikilalyo, 6.-tumbatikisya, 7.-tumbatikatumbatika, 8.-tumbatikana)

hold carefully and firmly, *Kotumbata kabotu mungu ooyo utaloki.* = Hold that pumpkin carefully so that it does not drop. (1.-tumbatwa, 2.-tumbete, 3.-tumbatya, 4.-tumbatila, 5.-tumbatilalyo tumbatisya, 7.-tumbata-tumbata, 8.-tumbatana)

hold carefully with both hands, clasp, rt.-tumbata, *Kotumbatila buya kujata amaanza obile cibiya kutegwa citafwi.* = Hold the clay pot carefully with both hands so that it does not break. *Kamutumbatila mayi aaya atafwi.* = Carry the eggs carefully so that they do not break. (1.-tumbatilwa, 2.-tumbatide, 3.-tumbatizya, 4.-tumbatikila, 5.-tumbatikilalyo, 6.-tumbatilisya, 7.-tumbatilatumbatila, 8.-tumbatilana) Also: -fwumbatila.

open fist when it contains something, *Twajana mali mumaanza a mwana naatumbatula.* = We found money in the child's hands when he opened them. Also: -fwumbatula, -vwungulula. (1.-tumbatulwa, 2.-tumbatwide, 3.-tumbatuzya, 4.-tumbatwida, 5.-tumbatwidalyo, 6.-tumbatulisya, 7.-tumbatula-tumbatula, 8.-tumbatulana)
be holding carefully, *Juunza utumbete mungu.* = Juunza is holding a pumpkin carefully.

hand over to, *Mwana naakafwa, banyina bakamutumbika kuli bakaapa.* = When the child died, the mother handed it over to the grandmother. (1.-tumbikwa, 2.-tumbikide, 3.-tumbikizya, 4.-tumbikila, 5.-tumbikilalyo, 6.-tumbikisya, 7.-tumbika-tumbika, 8.-tumbikana)

give birth, be delivered of a child, *Bakaintu bangu bakatumbuka jilo.* = My wife gave birth yesterday. (1.-tumbukwa, 2.-tumbukide, 3.-tumbusya, 4.-tumbukila, 5.-tumbukilalyo, 6.-tumbukisya, 7.-tumbuka-tumbuka, 8.-tumbusyanya.) Also: -yoboloka, -angunuka.
  • yield grains, as in growing sorghum, *Muceme ookwesu watalika kale kutumbuka.* = Our sorghum has already started yielding grain. Also: -langazya.

come into view, as a snake out of a hole, *Inzoka yatumbunuka kuzwa mubwina.* = A snake appeared coming out of a hole. (1.-tumbunukwa, 2.-tumbunukide, 3.-tumbunukizya, 4.-tumbunukila, 5.-tumbunukilalyo, 6.-tumbunukisya, 7.-tumbunuka-tumbunuka, 8.-tumbunukizyanya) Also: -tupuluka, -longomoka.

assist in giving birth, *Zina lyaakalo ndizina mwana ndyaulikwa amucembele wakwe wakamutumbusya.* = The name known as 'lyaakald is the name of the child given to it by the elder woman who is midwife at its birth. (1.-tumbusyigwa, 2.-tumbusyide, 3.-tumbusya, 4.-tumbusyizya, 5.-tumbusyizyalyo, 6.-tumbusyisya, 7.-tumbusya-tumbusya, 8.-tumbusyanya)

swagger, walk with pride, *Nceciindi balombwana nobatumbwaila kweenda amangowani aabo kumitwe kusola kutondezya buvwubi mbobajisi.* = That is the time when the men parade with their hats on their heads showing the wealth that they have.

blister, swell as abcess or corpse, *Muntu utazyibide kugonka zisamu, ulafwambaana kutumpa mumaanza.* = The hands of a person who is not used to cutting trees will quickly blister. *Mebo ndatumpa mumaanza akaambo* kakusya ansi canguzu. My hands have blistered because of digging the ground energetically. (1.-tumpizigwa,2.-tumpide, 3.-tumpya, 4.-tumpila, 5.-tumpilalyo, 6.-tumpisya, 7.-tumpa-tumpa, 8.-tumpizyanya)

drop something into, *Watumpukizya bbwe mutekwa meenda.* = S/he dropped a stone at the place where water is drawn. *Mwana wacitumpukizya cigabba mumugoti.* The child dropped the tin into the well. (1.-tumpukizyigwa, 2.-tumpukizyide, 3.-tumpukizya, 4.-tumpukizyizya, 5.-tumpukizyizyalyo, 6.-tumpukizyisya, 7.-tumpukizyatumpukizya, 8.-tumpukizyanya) Also: -nyikizya, -dyumpukizya.

be full size, as grain, *Mapopwe esu akatumpulata mumwezi wa Muyoba.* Our maize-grain reached full size in the month of March. Also: -bizwa. (1.-tumpulatwa, 2.-tumpulete, 3.-tumpulatya, 4.-tumpulatila, 5.-tumpulatilalyo, 6.-tumpulatisya, 7.-tumpulata-tumpulata)

fall with a splash, Bakatumpwikila mumeenda. They fell with a splash into the water. (1.-tumpwikilwa, 2.-tumpwikilide, 3.-tumpwikizya, 4.-tumpwikilila, 5.-tumpwikililalyo, 6.-tumpwikilisya, 7.-tumpikila-tumpwikila, 8.-tumpwikizyanya) Also: -dumpukila.

cause to be sent, rt. -tuma, *Bakatumya milomo kubana bokwabo akuli basimukowanyina bapati kuti baboole kuzyokusekelela simakuwa kucipulo nobanyina milimo.* = They sent a messenger to their relatives and elders of the clan that they should come to ritually celebrate the return of their son from working with the whites, if they had no work. (1.-tumwa, 2.-tumide, 3.-tumya, 4.-tumina, 5.-tuminalyo, 6.-tumisya, 7.-tumya-tumya, 8.-tumana)

fit badly, look strange or out of order, Uulya mukaintu ngwakwete ulamutuna. = That woman he married does not suit him. Tokonzyi kukwiila nopenga kumakwe pe, cilatuna. You cannot scream when you are in pain at your in-laws, it is out of place. (1.-tunwa, 2.-tunide, 3.-tunya, 4.-tunina, 5.-tuninalyo, 6.-tunisya, 7.-tuna-tuna, 8.-tunana)

stare, Kuti mangoye katunama mubwina, inga kuli cilimo. = If a cat fixes its attention on a hole, it means there is something there. (-tunama pwi! = stare unflinchingly) (1.-tunamwa, 2.-tuneme, 3.-tunamya, 4.-tunamina, 5.-tunaminalyo, 6.-tunamisya, 7.-tunama-tunama, 8.-tunaminana) Also: -dunama
