Nseli muntu biyo, njide kuunguta, maanu onse akaunka. = I am no longer a human being, I am just in a daze, all wisdom has gone. Also: -zilaika. (1.-ungutwa, 2.-ungutide, 3.-ungutya, 4.-ungutila, 5.-ungutilalyo, 6.-ungutisya, 7.-unguta-unguta, 8.-ungutizyanya)

deceive, cheat, Ooyu nasambala ulaunina, taciti bweelede. = This one cheats when he trades, he does not do what is correct. Munanga wakaunina bantu banji kutegwa ajane mali. = The witchdoctor deceived many people so that he could get much money. (1.-uninwa, 2.-uninide, 3.-unizya, 4.-uninina, 5.-unininalyo, 6.-uninisya, 7.-unina-unina, 8.-uninana) Also: -cenga, -guba, -bejela.
go away, Basicikolo bakaunka jilo kucikolo. = The pupils went yesterday to the school. Also: . -inka. (1.-unkwa,2.-unkide, 3.-unkizya, 4.-unkila 5.-unkilalyo, 6.-unkisya, 7.-unka-unka, 8.-unkilana)

drown, disappear, Waunkila mwana mumeenda. = The child drowned in the water. Aalya balila mwana wakaunkila mumulonga. = Over there they are mourning the child who drowned in the river. (1.-unkilwa, 2.-unkilide, 3.-unkilizya, 4.-unkilila, 5.-unkililalyo, 6.-ukilisya, 7.-unkila-unkila, 8.-unkilizyanya)
  • go for, Ino waunkila nzi ku Monze? = What have you gone to Monze for?

be taken away by wind or current, rt. -unka, Caunkilila mumuwo cisani cako. = Your cloth was taken off by the wind. (1.-unkililwa, 2.-unkilide, 3.-unkilizya, 4.-unkililila, 5.-unkilililalyo, 6.-unkililisya, 7.-unkilila-unkilila, 8.-unkililana)
  • go along with, Mwana wakaunkilila kuli banyina. = The child went along with its mother.

cause to go away, be taken off, rt. -unka, Batumbu nibakalikusamba bakaunkizya zisani zyabo mumulonga. = When the mother was washing she let the clothes to be taken away by the water. Also: -unsya, -insya. (1.-unkizyigwa, 2.-unkizyide, 3.-unkizya, 4.-unkizyizya, 5.-unkizyizyalyo, 6.-unkizyisya, 7.-unkizya-unkizya, 8.-unkizyanya)

be removed as from nest, rt. -unka, Bana banziba bakaunsigwa kale. = The young of the dove had already been taken away. (1.-unsigwa, 2.-unside, 3.-unsizya, 4.-unsizyizya, 5.-unsizyizyalyo, 6.-unsizyisya, 7.-unsigwaunsigwa, 8.-unsizyanya)

cut off for someone, Kondiunswida katendu kanyama nkayoke. = Cut off a piece of meat for me so that I roast it. Also: -kosweda, -dunswida. (1.-unswidwa, 2.-unswide, 3.-unswizya, 4.-unswidila, 5.-unswidilalyo, 6.-unswidisya, 7.-unswida-unswida, 8.-unswidana)

cause to go, rt. -unka, Ndajana nziba yangu yakabaunsya bana. = I found that my dove had taken her young away. (1.-unsyigwa, 2.-unsyide, 3.-unsya, 4.-unsyizya, 5.-unsyizyalyo, 6.-unsyisya, 7.-unsya-unsya, 8.-unsyanya)

smoke, Cisani capya cuunta busi. = The burnt cloth is smoking. Mumulundu kuunta busi. = Smoke is rising from the hill. Also: -unda, -sunta. (1.-untwa, 2.-untide, 3.-untya, 4.-untila, 5.-untilalyo, 6.-untisya, 7.-unta-unta, 8.-untizyanya)

pour out, as smoke, Nobakazibona nsonje zyaziluli zyabana Bimbe, bakapwaya kankuli nkobakajana kumusondi. Bakabona kwauntuluka busi. Muciindi cisyoonto buyo malundu oonse kulubazu Iwakumunzi ooyu kwakazula sikunku munji koonse-koonse. = When they saw the peaks of the roofs of Chief Bimbe's people they broke the gourd which they had found at the diviner. They saw smoke pouring out. In just a short time all the hills in the area of this village were filled with a great mist everywhere. (1.-untulukwa, 2.-untulukide, 3.-untulusya 4.-untulukila, 5.-untulukilalyo, 6.-untulukisya, 7.-untuluka-untuluka. 8.-untulukizyanya)

be discharged, explode, Nsasi zyamusyokwe zilauntumuka akulunduka julu lyoonse, zilatapauka akumwaikizyanya mubwizu moonse. = Sparks from the bush are discharged and run up into the sky, they are thrown off and spread through all the grass. (1.-untumukwa, 2.-untumukide, 3.-untumukizya, 4.-untumukila, 5.-untumukilalyo, 6.-untumukisya, 7.-untumuka-untumuka, 8.-untumukilana)

drive one to do, Kalilo naakasika ku Lusaka wakaakunjila muntenda. Tatuzyi cakamuuntumuna kubweza Iweendo olu. Kalilo had an accident when he reached Lusaka. We do not known what drove him to make this journey. Also: -sontomona. (1.-untumunwa, 2.-untumwide, 3.-untumuzya, 4.-untumwida, 5.-untumwidalyo, 6.-untumunisya, 7.-untumuna-untumuna, 8.-untumunana)

rise upwards like smoke, Bakamvwa nkwalila, abusi bwakali kuuntunta. They became aware of the mourning and the smoke was rising upwards. (1.-untuntwa, 2.-untuntide, 3.-untuzya, 4.-untwida, 5.-untwidalyo, 6.-untuntisya, 7.-untunta-untunta, 8.-untuntizyanya)

cause to smoke, Bavwimi mbabauntuzya busi mumulundu nobayandaula banyama. Hunters are the ones who cause the smoke to rise in the hills when they are looking for animals.
  • ignore, Cilombwana caide kuuntuzya buyo nobatukila. The young man paid no attention when they insulted him. Sibbuku wakali kuuntuzya buyo kubee taakali kumubona. The headman just ignored the incident as if he had not seen him.

be stingy, be mean, Bamwi bantu balaunya zintu zyabo. = Some people are stingy with their goods. Kuunya takuli kubotu mumunzi pe. = Meanness is not good in village life. (1.-unyigwa, 2.-unyide, 3.-unyizya, 4.-unyina, 5.-unyinalyo, 6.-unyisya, 7.-unya-unya, 8.-unyana)

prepare for a ritual rain celebration = *-unza Iwiindi* (In the past preparation consisted in grinding meal and malt and fetching wood to cook the beer, but doing no other heavy work on that day.) (1.-unzwa, 2.-unzide, 3.-unzisya, 4.-unzila, 5.-unzilalyo, 6.-unzisya, 7.-unza-unza, 8.-unzilana)
  • prepare beer, *Bamacembele bakamuka kuunza mweesyo wamunene.* = The old women were late in preparing the funeral-beer for the old man.

desire to have, *Waile kuunzuka naabona bowa mbwayandisya kapati.* A spontaneous desire rose in him when he saw the mushrooms which he likes so much. Also: -nyomenenwa (1.-unzukwa, 2.-unzukide, 3.-unzukizya, 4.-unzukila, 5.-unzukilalyo, 6.-unzukisya, 7.-unzuka-unzuka, 8.-unzukana)

become involved in a problem, *Balaunzumuka nobaunka muzibaka mobajatwa malale.* = They put themselves in danger when they go to places where they are caught committting adultery. *Kwakaba kuunzumuka kumulela mwana ooyu.* = It became a problem to look after this child. (1.-unzumukwa, 2.-unzumukide, 3.-unzumusya, 4.-unzumukila, 5.-unzumukilalyo, 6.-unzumukisya, 7.-unzumuka-unzumuka, 8.-unzumukilana)

get someone involved in a problem, *Kachabe wakamuunzumukila Mainza kumwiita kukunywa bukoko, amane wakakolwa akutalika kutukila bantu.* Kachabe got Mainza involved in a problem by calling him to drink beer, after which he became drunk and started insulting people. (1.-unzumukilwa, 2.-unzumukilide, 3.-unzumukisya, 4.-unzumukilila, 5. -unzumukililalyo, 6.-unzumukilisya, 7.-unzumukilaunzumukila, 8.-unzumukilana)

tempt, drive to do, *Ndajana kuti ndanjila muntenda. Nsecizyi canduunzumuna kuti ndiboole kokuno.* = I find myself in a dangerous situation. I do not know what drove me to come here. (1.-unzumunwa, 2.-unzumwide, 3.-unzumuzya, 4.-unzumwida, 5.-unzumwidalyo, 6.-unzumunisya, 7.-unzumunaunzumuna, 8.-unzumukilana)

get started, begin to brew beer for, *Mweesyo wakaunzwa zoona.* = The funeral-beer began to be prepared the day before yesterday. (1.-unzwa, 2.-unzide, 3.-unzizya, 4.-unzila, 5.-unzilalyo, 6.-unzisya, 7.-unzwa-unzwa, 8.-unzilana)

pretend to be sincere, betray by false signs of love, *Ulanduupaika ameso kuti ulandiyanda, kakuli tandiyandi.* He pretends with the eyes that he loves me, while he does not. *Komusiya buyo muntu oyu, ukuupaika buyo.* = Just leave this person, he is just deceiving you. (1.-upaikwa, 2.-upaikide, 3.-upaizya, 4.-upaikila, 5.-upakilalyo, 6.-upaikisya, 7.-upaika-upaika, 8.-upaikana) Also: -ukaula.

cleanse ritually, *Bukoko bwakuupaula lubuwa Iwamwami ndwaakasaanguna kulyata mweenzu bwakaunzwa.* The beer for cleansing the chief's courtyard where the visitor first trod began to be brewed. (1.-upaulwa, 2.-upawide, 3.-upauzya, 4.-upawida, 5.-upawidalyo, 6.-upaulisya, 7.-upaulaupaula, 8.-upaulana)

be insincere, *Eeci cakabacima bina Mutinta balo batakali kuyanda kuupa-upa ameso nekuba kusulila mwida kucintu ncobatayandi.* = This caused revulsion to the mother of Mutinta who did not like deception nor hiding something which she has in mind which displeases her. (1.-upwa-upwa, 2.-upideupide, 3.-upauzya-upauzya, 4.-upawida upawida, 5.-upaida-upaidalyo, 6.-upailisyaupailisya, 7.-upa-upa, 8.-upana-upana)
  • wag the tail, Mubwa ulaupa-upa mucila kuli umulela. = A dog wags its tail for the one who looks after it.
  • curry favour, Bamwi bantu balalyuupa-upa kubami kutegwa bapegwe cibotu. = Some people curry favour with the rich so that they may be given things.

be unkempt, Bana nibalikundijata amutwe bakandiupunganya masusu. = When the children were catching me by the head they upset my hair. (1.-upunganyizyigwa, 2.-upunganyide, 3.-upunganya, 4.-upunganyizyizya, 5.-upunganyizyizyalyo, 6.-upunganyizyisya 7.-upunganya-upunganya, 8.-upunganyizyanya) Also: -ulunganya, -pupunganyas, -vwulunganya.
move about lustfully, Basimbi bavwuule baupuuka mumadolopo kuyandaula basankwa. Lustful girls roam around the towns looking for men.

Ijilo musimbi upuukide wakajatwa kucibbadela abulwazi bwa sikalileke. = Yesterday a loose-living girl was detained at the hospital with AIDS. (1.-upuukwa, 2.-upuukide, 3.-upuuzya, 4.-upuukila, 5.-upuukilalyo, 6.-upuukisya, 7.-upuuka-upuuka, 8.-upuusyanya)

be ashamed or sorry, Ndausa kumvwa kuti mwakafwidwa. = I am sorry to hear that you lost one of your family. Nabwiinga wakausa kapati naakapwaya nongo. = The bride was ashamed when she broke the earthen pot. (1.-uswa, 2.-uside, 3.-usisya, 4.-usila, 5.-usilalyo, 6.-usisya, 7.-usa-usa, 8.-usilana) Also: -nyana, -gunwa.
  • wither as plants, Maluba angu ausa akaambo kazuba lipya. My flowers have withered because of the burning sun.
feel shame, Wakausausa naakazyiba kuti ncaakali kucita ncibi. = She was ashamed when she realized what she was doing was bad.
be in sad state, rt. -usa, Bamwi bakaliuside kuteelela makani ali boobu. Some were sad to hear news such as that.

be made to fall, rt. -wa, Munduunda wakausigwa kumweenzinyina nibakali kutingaana. Munduunda was thrown down by his friend when they were wrestling. (1.-usigwa, 2.-usyide, 3.-usya, 4.-usyizya, 5.-usyizyalyo, 6.-usisisya, 7.-usigwa-usigwa, 8.-usyanya) Also: -unsigwa.

set dogs on, Kamuusilizya babwa batande kanyama. Rouse the dogs so that they chase the little animal. (1.-usilizyigwa, 2.-usilizyide, 3.-usilizya, 4.-usilizyizya, 5.-usilizyizyalyo, 6.-usilizyisya, 7.-usilizya-usilizya, 8.-usilizyanya) Also: -sibilizya, -saalizya.

be exceedingly sad, Musankwa akaambo kamapuwo wakalilekelezya kumeja ancinga kutegwa abonwe. Maawe cilausisya cakacitika kumusankwa ooyu simapuwo. = Because of pride the boy let go the handle-bars of the bicycle so that he would be admired. However it is very sad what happened to this proud fellow. Also: -usya.

be stretched out like a corpse, Mulombe wakausubala mbuli wafwa. The boy was stretched out as if he was dead. (1.-usubalwa, 2.-usubele, 3.-usubazya, 4.-usubalila, 5.-usubalilalyo, 6.-usubalisya, 7.-usubala-usubala, 8.-usubalilana) Also: -landabala

stroke, groom, Mukaintu ulausula masusu aamulumi wakwe. = The wife is stroking the hair of her husband. Muntanga wakali kwiide kuusula moombe. = Muntanga was just stroking the calf. (1.-usulwa, 2.-uswide, 3.-usuzya, 4.-uswida, 5.-uswidalyo, 6.-usulisya, 7.-usula-usula, 8.-usulana)

make sorry, condemn, put to shame, rt. -usa, Kwiidisya nkuku kumakwe Mutinta ncicamuusya nsoni kapati. The burning of the chicken at the in-laws is what caused Mutinta much embarrassment. Also: -usisya. (1.-usigwa, 2.-usyide, 3.-usya, 4.-usyila, 5.-usyilalyo, 6.-usyisya, 7.-usya-usya, 8.-usyanya)
  • make fall, pull down, rt. -wa, Munene nguwausya musamu ulya mupati. = It was the old man who made that big tree fall. Ibbwe lyakamuleba akumuusya. = The stone made him trip and fall. Wakakakilwa kuusya nanda. = He failed to make the house collapse. Wakasola kulanduka mulonga uzwide pesi meenda akamuusya ansi, mpoona wakanyikila. = He tried to cross the swollen river, but the water pulled him down, thereupon he drowned.

be blown about, Makweelele awuuka muwo. = The maize leaves are blown about by the wind. Waunka mujembwe kumbo uyaabuwuuka mulembo (a riddle). A buck-goat went to the west while a cloth was blown off. Aslo -peluluka, -peepuka. (1.-uukwa, 2.-uukide, 3.-uukizya, 4.-uukila, 5.-uukilalyo, 6.-uukisya, 7.-uuka-uuka, 8.-uukana)
  • become willing to steal or do anything in time of famine, become vulnerable, Bamakaintu banji bakawuuka lyanzala. Many women became willing to do anything in time of famine.

endanger, rt. -uuka Ndakaliwuukila akukwatwa kuli nduwe opombo licelele. = I unfortunately did myself harm by marrying you, you baboon who harvests for himself. Waakumuukila mweenzinyoko ngooyita, langa ino walicisa. You have endangered your friend whom you called, look now he has hurt himself. (1.-uukilwa, 2.-uukilide, 3.-uukizya, 4.-uukilila, 5.-uukililalyo, 6.-uukilisya, 7.-uukila-uukila, 8.-uukilana)

howl as a dog, Babwa bali kuwuula masiku sunu. The dogs were howling last night. Babwa balawuula babona zyeelo masiku. Dogs howl if they see spirits at night. (1.-uulwa, 2.-uulide, 3.-uuzya, 4.-uulila, 5.-uulilalyo, 6.-uulisya, 7.-uula-uula, 8.-uuzyanya) Also: -wuula, -uulula.
  • have a share of meat of an animal not killed by you, Ndakawuula nyama yamunyama wakajaya Moonde. = I took a share of the meat from the animal which Moonde killed. Also: -suula.
  • blow away, Sunu muwo wali munji kapati mpoona awa waziwuula zisani zyayanikidwe. = Today there was a very strong wind and so it blew away the clothes which were hanging out to dry.
  • indulge in prostitution, Kuwuula mu Zambia kwaleta lufwu kubantu banji. = Indulging in prostitution has brought death to many people in Zambia. Also: -vwuula.

reveal a secret, Batasyomeki bakawuulula maseseke oonse. = The untrustworthy people revealed all the secrets. Also: -zubulula, -yubulula. (1.-uululwa, 2.-uulwide, 3.-uuluzya, 4.-uulwida, 5.-ulwidalyo, 6.-uululisya, 7.-uulula-uulula, 8.-uululana)
  • call from a distance, Twakamwa basimbi kabawuulula kunzaa mulundu. = We heard the girls calling out from behind the hill. cf. - vwoeta.
  • howl as a dog, Mubwa wakali kuwuulula masiku oonse. The dog was howling all night.

roar as a torrent, Ndakatijila munanda niyakatalika kuwuuma mvwula. I ran into the house when the rain started to thunder. Meenda alali mvwisya kuwuuma kumulonga wa Magoye. = The water was heard roaring in the Magoye river. (1.-uumizigwa, 2.-uumide, 3.-uumya, 4.-uumina, 5.-uuminalyo, 6.-uumisya, 7.-uuma-uuma, 8.-uumizyanya) Also: -wuuma.

go in a crowd, Niyakalila ngoma kusekelela kamwale, bantu bakalaa dilwe bakauumuka kuya kunkolola. = When the drum sounded in celebration for the initiated girl, the people at the funeral rushed off in a crowd to the nkolola ceremony. Also: -guumuka. (1.-uumukwa, 2.-uumukide, 3.-uumuzya, 4.-uumukila, 5.-uumukilalyo, 6.-uumukisya, 7.-uumuka-uumuka, 8.-uumukilana)
go off to in a group, Mbubwakaceda bantu bakawuumukila ku Monze. = As soon as it was dawn the people all went off to Monze.

guess, Uso wasya munenga banyoko balalidyonga. (riddle) Kouuzya kalabi aaka ncokaamba. Mbutala. = Your father dug a hole and your mother goes into it repeatedly. Guess what the riddle means. It is a maize-bin. Also: -zumbuuzya

doze, Tacili cibotu ku-uvwila munsi amulilo. = It is not good to doze beside the fire. (1.-uvwilwa, 2.-uvwide, 3.-uvwisya, 4.-uvwilila, 5.-uvwililalyo, 6.-uvwilisya, 7.-uvwila-uvwila) Also: -ozela, -umfwula, -uzila, -fwukula.

lose power, Basimakwebo banji mbuvwuule bubapa kuuwa mumakwebo aabo. = It is prostitution which makes many marketeers lose power in their markets. (1.-ugwa, 2.-uwide, 4.-uwida, 5.-uwidalyo, 6.-uvwisya, 7.-uwa-uwa, 8.-usyanya)
be sold to, rt. -uzya, Bamakaintu banji bakali kukombelezya kuti kubota bauzigwa nyemu. = Many women were hoping that it would be good if they could be sold groundnuts.

nickname, Mumunzi wabazike kwakali muntu umwi ngubakauzika zina lya Muyapula. = In the village of the slaves there was a certain man who was nicknamed Muyapula. (1.-uzikwa, 2.-uzikide, 3.-uzikizya, 4.-uzikila, 5.-uzikilalyo, 6.-uzikisya, 7.-uzika-uzika, 8.-uzikana)

drowse, doze, Bana bali kunkolola balauzila munanda. = The children who were at the initiation ceremony are dozing in the house. Also: -uvwila, -fwukula, -uzyila. (1.-uzilwa, 2.-uzilide, 3.-uzizya, 4.-uzilila, 5.-uzililalyo, 6.-uzilisya, 7.-uzila-uzila, 8.-uzililana)

pretend not to hear, keep silence when addressed, Ooyu mwana inga ulauzya mupati naita. = This child pretends a lot not to hear when he is called. Musankwa ooyu ulauzya, tavwiili nemwaanzya. = This boy pretends not to hear, he does not answer when I greet him. Also: -ulula, -wiika. (1.-uzyigwa, 2.-uzyide, 3.-uzyizya, 4.-uzyila, 5.-uzyilalyo, 6.-uzisya, 7.-uzya-uzya, 8.-uzyanya)
  • sell, rt. -ula, Bamaama bauzya ndongwe mumusyika. = My mother is selling groundnuts in the market. Ciindi nibaali kuleta milandu bantu, naa kulangaula muntu wakuuzya cakulya nkaambo kanzala, tiikwakali kuuzigwa mwana kuzyalwa pe, ccita mujwa. = During the time when people would bring a case, or if they were searching for a person to sell for food because of hunger, a child of the family would not be sold but a nephew or niece. Also: -sambala

be unwilling, be indisposed, Ulauzyema kutugwasya. = She seems to be unwilling to help us. Munene naatugwasya mumulimo pele cino ciindi ulauzyema. = Munene would have helped us in this work, but now he is unwilling. (1.-uzyemwa, 2.-uzyemide, 3.-uzyemya, 4.-uzyemena, 5.-uzyemenalyo, 6.-uzyemesya, 7.-uzyema-uzyema, 8.-uzyeminana) Also: -lengaana.

be sleepy, Mutwanga naakabona kuti Mutinta ulauzyila, wakamwaambila kuti alyookezye kwaciindi ceelede. = When the servant saw that Mutinta was in need of sleep, he told her that she should rest for a suitable time. (1.-uzyilwa, 2.-uzyilide, 3.-uzyisya, 4.-uzyilila, 5.-uzyililalyo, 6.-uzyilisya, 7.-uzyila-uzyila, 8.-uzyililana) Also: -uzila.

shiver from malaria, Mwana wakatalika jilo kuvwaama kusikila ino. The child began yesterday to shiver from malaria until now. (1.-vwaamwa, 2.-vwaamide, 3.-vwaamya, 4.-vwaamina, 5.-vwaaminalyo, 6.-vwaamisya, 7.-vwaama-vwaama, 8.-vwaamizyanya)

unproperly cover oneself, Kapika mmuntu buyo ulindilizya busiku akulivwaamika mutupayi twakwe twamitendu kati akaandabwe abuke. = A criminal is a person who waits for the dark and partially covers himself with a tattered blanket saying that he will awake at midnight.

mix, Kamuvwaanya mabisi amukupa zileme. Mix sour milk with fresh milk to make it thick. (1.-vwaanyizyigwa, 2.-vwaanyide, 3.-vwaanyizya, 4.-vwaanyizyizya, 5.-vwaanyizyizyalyo, 6.-vwaanyisya, 7.-vwaanya-vwaanya, 8.-vwaanyizyanya) Also: - vwelanya, -vwanya.

insert, Bacembele baka-tuma basankwa botatwe kuya kukuvwabaika mamvwa mulukwakwa. = The old lady send three boys to insert thorns in the fence. Also: -obaika. (1.-vwabaikwa, 2.-vwabaikide, 3.-vwabaikizya, 4.-vwabaikila, 5.-wabaikilalyo, 6.-vwabaikisya, 7.-vwabaika-vwabaika, 8.-vwabaikana)

turn back in terror, Twavwabalika kuya kunanda. We ran terrified into the house. (1.-vwabalikwa, 2.-wwabalikide, 3.-vwabalisya, 4.-vwabalikila, 5.-vwabalikilalyo, 6.-vwabalikisya, 7.-vwabalika-vwabalika, 8.-vwabalikanina)

lie flat, Ciyuni nicakatala caile kuvwabama kukkala. = When the poor bird was tired it just lay flat. Mulwazi waile kuvwabama ansi, amumuyalile. The patient is just lying flat on the ground, spread out something for him to lie on. (1.-vwabamwa, 2.-vwabamide, 3.-wwabamya, 4.-vwabamina, 5.-vwabaminalyo, 6.-vwabamisya, 7.-vwabamavwabama, 8.-vwabaminana)
  • flap about, Ndiinga Mudyaka lyakaide kuvwabama mubbudula mupati acibaki cipati cidonkokede andelo. Big Mudyaka was flapping about in oversized shorts and a big shirt which was torn at the shoulder.

rebel against, take a contrary position, Ncibi kuvwabauka kuti bantu kabakulaya. It is bad to resist advice when you are given it. (1.-vwabaukwa, 2.-vwabaukide, 3.-vwabausya, 4.-vwabaukila, 5.-vwabaukilalyo, 6.-vwabaukisya, 7.-wabauka-vwabauka, 8.-vwabaukisya) Also: -vwubauka, -zanga.

throw on top of, Kovwabika mulembo atalaa cisanza. Throw the cloth on top of the shelf. (1.vwabikwa, 2.-vwabikide, 3.-vwabikizya, 4.-vwabikila, 5.-vwabikilalyo, 6.-vwabikisya, 7.-vwabika-vwabika, 8.-vwabikana) Also: -vwabaika, -obaika

(borrowed word) go to visit or converse with, Ndakali kuya kukuvwakacca kubacembele. I was going to visit and chat with an old woman. Wakali kuboolela buyo kuvwakacca. = He just came to visit and chat.

flap wings, Bayuni bamujulu balatalika kuvwakama kuuluka. = The birds of the sky begin to flap their wings as they fly off. (1.-vwakamwa, 2.-wakamide, 3.-vwakamya, 4.-vwakamina, 5.-vwakaminalyo, 6.-vwakamisya, 7.-vwakama-vwakama, 8.-vwakamizyanya)

flap wings, Tongola nauluka ulavwakauka kapati mumababa. = The white-bellied stork flaps its wings a lot when it flies. *Ijuni lilavwakauka kuya kukunywa meenda.* = The big bird is flapping its wings going to drink water. (1.-vwakaukwa, 2.-vwakaukide, 3.-vwakaukizya, 4.-vwakaukila, 5.-wakaukilalyo, 6.-vwakaukisya, 7.-wakauka-vwakauka, 8.-vwakaukilana) Also: -fwampauka.

crouch down on hands and knees, Bana bavwalama mumani kuyuba ndeke yainda mujulu. = The children were crouching in the grass in fear hiding from the aeroplane which passed overhead. (1.-vwalamwa, 2.-vwala-mide, 3.-vwalamya, 4.-vwalamina, 5.-vwalaminalyo, 6.-vwalamisya, 7.-wwalama-vwalama, 8.-vwalaminana)
  • go down on hands and knees, lie face downwards, Basicikolo balavwalama mumusenga nobasobana. = Pupils go on their hands and knees in the sand when playing. Basikalumamba balavwalama an-si nobalwana. = Soldiers crouch on the ground when they fight.
jump out and rush at, Siluwe wakavwalamuka kuzwa mu-coonde. = The leopard jumped out of the thicket and rushed forward.

be energetic, *Ko-vwalauka kweenda, ucili cilombwana.* = Walk briskly, you are still young.
  • be unfriendly, Ncobeni kuvwiila kwakali kwancesu-ncesu kwakuvwalauka. = Truly the way he was answering was very unfriendly and without care.

write in a rough way, scribble, Wakaide kunjila munkomwe akugusya cilembyo nkabela wakavwalaula mabala mapati aakuti, *MUKABOOLE JUUNZA.* = He just put his hand in his pocket and took out a pen, thereupon he wrote with big letters roughly, YOU MAY COME TOMORROW.
exude, come out from, smell, Impeyo yakali kuvwambuka kuzwa kusamende. = The cold was coming out of the cement.

pounce on, catch suddenly, Mubwa wakavwampila naaka-bona kancele mumani. = The dog pounced when it saw a small partridge in the grass. Mubwa wakavwampila kasulwe amvwuta. = The dog pounced on the hare while it was still on its patch. (1.-wampilwa,2.-vwampide, 3.-vwampya or -vwampizya, 4.-vwampilila, 5.-vwampi-lilalyo, 6.-vwampilisya, 7.-vwampila-vwampila, 8.-vwampilana) *vwampila ansi* = swoop down on. Also: -vwapila
  • throw at, Bakandivwampila caali mavwu mumeso. = They deliberately threw soil in my eyes.
burst out, Ooku kuwe-lela kwabamakaintu kwakacita kuti nkamu yoonse ivwamuke kuseka. = This jeering of the women made the whole crowd burst out laughing.

grip, Mubwa wakaluma mwingile, wakamuvwamuna munsingo. = The dog attacked the warthog, he gripped it by the neck. (1.-vwamunwa, 2.-vwa-mwide, 3.-vwamuzya, 4.-vwamwida 5.-wamwidalyo, 6.-vwamunisya, 7.-vwamuna-vwamuna, 8.-vwamunana)

rise up, as an animal, Mwingile naakavwandamuka mukalonga, babwa bakaccija boonse. = When the warthog rose up out of the stream, all the dogs fled. Bakaile kuvwandamuka nobakamuzyiba munyinandumi wabo. = She rose up quickly when she recognized her brother. Also: -bbutumuka. (1.-vwandamukwa, 2.-vwandamukide, 3.-vwandamusya, 4.-vwandamukila, 5.-vwandamukilalyo, 6.-vwandamukisya, 7.-vwandamuka-vwandamuka, 8.-vwandamukilana)

rise up to attack, rt. vwankamuka, Inombe niyakainda munsi aasuntwe, wakaivwandamukila akwiijata. = When the cow past by the hyena, it rose up quickly towards it and caught it. Ntale yakamuvwandamukila yakamujata akumudyondyomenzya mumaanzi. The crocodile rose up and caught him and submerged him in the water. (1.-vwandamukilwa, 2.-vwandamukilide, 3.-vwandamukizya, 4.-vwandamukila, 5.-vwandamukilalyo, 6.-vwanadamukilisya, 7.-vwandamukilavwandamukila, 8.-vwandamukilana)

swish as a tail, Takuyandiki kuti nombe kaziyabuvwandaula micila zitajoki akujoka. = It is not good that cattle should go swishing their tails without being returned. (In marriage if cattle are given away to the girls family and she is too lazy to work, it is a sheer waste as they are not returned.) (1.-vwandaulwa, 2.-vwandawide, 3.-vwandauzya, 4.-vwandawida, 5.-vwandawidalyo, 6.-vwandaulisya, 7.-vwandaula-vwandaula, 8.-vwandaulilana)

dig up with both hands or paws, Ino uvwanka nzi mumapopwe oomo? = What are you digging up in the maize there? Kamuvwanka kusikila zima nine ndongwe. = Dig until you finish the groundnuts. (1.-vwankwa, 2.-vwankide, 3.-vwankizya, 4.-vwankila, 5.-vwankilalyo 6.-vwankisya, 7.-vwanka-vwanka, 8.-vwankana, | -vwankilana)
  • shake basket when winnowing, Bacembele bavwanka musozya ngubali kutwa. The old woman is shaking the basket containing samp which she has been pounding to clean it. Also: - kwaapula

rise up immediately, Bacembele bavwankamuka kuyumuka nibamvwa uuyita. = The old lady rose up immediately when she heard someone calling. Wakazikwiide kuvwankamuka awo mpaakakkede naakabona nzoka. = He just rose up immediately from where he was sitting when he saw a snake. (1.-vwankamukwa, 2.-vwankamukide. 3.-vwankamuzya, 4.-vwankamukila, 5.-vwankamukilalyo, 6.-vwnkamukisya, 7.-vwankamuka-vwankamuka, 8.-vwankamukilana) Also: -vwandamuka.

spring up suddely in fear or to attack, Wakaile kuvwankuka mpaakakkede. = He just sprang up suddenly from where he was sitting. (1.-vwankukwa, 2.-vwankukide, 3.-vwankuzya, 4.-vwankukila, 5.-vwankukilalyo, 6.-vwankukisya, 7.-vwankuka-vwankuka, 8.-vwankukilana)

move secretively, Ngooyu lino ulavwantaama kunze azitewo acitisyini. There he goes moving furtively behind the bushes and the railway station. (1.-vwantaamwa, 2.-vwantaamide, 3.-vwantaamya, 4.-wantaa-mina, 5.-vwantaaminalyo, 6.-vwantaami-sya, 7.-vwantaamavwantaama, 8.-vwantaaminana)

mix different kinds, Bacembele bakavwanya nyabo amapopwe nibakali kusyanga. The old woman mixed beans and maize seeds when planting. Also: -vwaanya, -vwelanya. (1.-wwanyigwa,2.-vwanyide, 3.-vwanyizya 4.-wanyizyizya, 5.-vwanyizyizyalyo, 6.-wanyizyisya, 7.-vwanya-vwanya, 8.-vwanyizyanya)
jerk, Ndakaile ku

naakandijata mumukosi nkaambo tiindakamubwene. = I just jumped in fear when he caught me by the back of the neck because I had not seen him. (1.-vwanyukwa, 2.-vwanyukide, 3.-wanyusya, 4.-vwanyukila, 5.-wanyukilalyo, 6.-vwanyukisya, 7.-wanyuka-vwanyuka, 8.-wanyusyanya)

seize by swooping down on, Bana bavwapila mali ansi. = The children snatched the money from the ground. (1.-vwapilwa, 2.-vwapilide, 3.-wapizya, 4.-vwapilila, 5.-vwapililalyo, 6.-vwapilisya, 7.-vwapila-vwapila, 8.-wapilana) Also: -vwampila.

jump up and down, Munanga wakali kuvwatuka kumwi kazinguluka kaanda. The witchdoctor was jumping up and down while encircling the little house. (1.-wwatukwa, 2.-vwatukide, 3.-vwatuzya, 4.-vwatukila, 5.-vwatukilalyo, 6.-vwatukisya, 7.-vwatuka-vwatuka, 8.-vwatusyanya)
touch here and there in a disorderly way, Bana balikundi

mumutwe, ncaapupungana masusu. The children were touching me all over the head, that is why my hair is ruffled. (1.-wwavwaangwa, 2.-vwavwaangide, 3.-vwavwaangizya, 4.-vwavwaangila, 5.-wavwaangilalyo, 6.-wwavwaangisya, 7.-vwavwaangavwavwaanga, 8.-vwavwaangana)
  • harass, Babbi bakamuvwavwaanga akumuuma, bamane bakamubbida mali. = The thieves harassed and beat him, when they finished they stole his money.

act quickly, Ncibi kuvwavwaanya kulya, inga watingwa. = It is bad to eat quickly, you might choke. Muntu uzyibide kulemba ulavwavwaanya kubala. A person who is used to writing reads quickly. Also: -fwamvwaanya. (1.-wwavwaanyizigwa, 2.-vwavwaanyide, 3.-wavwaanyizya, 4.-vwavwaanyizyizya, 5.-wavwaanyizyizyalyo, 6.-vwavwaanyisya, 7.-vwavwaanya-vwavwaanya, 8.-vwavwaanyizyanya)

be low, as a roof, Kamunangamika kaluli kabutala, nseyandi kavwavwabala. Raise the roof of the granary, I don't want it to be flat. Kwale wavwavwabala ansi nindamuuma malekani. = The partridge lay flat down on the ground, when I struck it with a catapult. (1.-vwavwabalizyigwa, 2.-vwavwabete, 3.-vwavwabazya, 4.-vwavwabalila, 5.-wwavwabalilalyo, 6.-vwavwabalisya, 7.-wwavwabala-vwavwabala, 8.-vwavwabalizyanya)

be in a flat position, rt. wwavwabala, Ciluli eeci cilivwavwabete. This roof is flat. Wakabona kasamu kamucecete kakavwavwabete akoovwoka kabotu-kabotu. = She saw a mucecete tree with spread out foliage bending towards the ground.
do without care, Kusama kwakwe kwaali kwakuvwavwalisya buyo. He was dressed in a careless way.

eat food in a careless or greedy manner, Kuvwavwanga kulya buci inga koya kulidilizya anzuki litiikulume amulaka. If you eat honey carelessly you might eat a bee along with it who might sting you on the tongue. (1.-vwavwangwa, 2.-vwavwangide, 3.-vwavwangizya, 4.-vwavwangila, 5.-wavwangilalyo, 6.-vwavwangisya, 7.-wwavwanga-vwavwanga, 8.-vwavwangizyanya)

be greedy in eating, Balyato balavwavwanganya kulya. = Gluttons eat in a greedy manner. (1.-vwavwanganyizyigwa, 2.-vwavwanganyide, 3.-vwavwanganyizya, 4.-vwavwanganyina, 5.-vwavwanganyinalyo, 6.-vwavwanganyisya, 7.-wwavwanganyavwavwanganya, 8.-vwavwanganyizyanya)

sing in unison, Bavweemuka kwiimba antoomwe baimbi. = The singers sang in unison together. (1.-vweemukwa, 2.-vweemukide, 3.-vweemuzya, 4.-vweemukila, 5.-vweemukilalyo, 6.-vweemukisya, 7.-vweemuka-vweemuka, 8.-vweemukizyanya)
  • express all together, Naakabuzya mubuzyo mwami, bantu boonse bakavweemuka kuseka. = When the chief asked a question, all the people burst out laughing together.

sit with knees apart, Kovweketa buya kukkala, kutali ku-sunsumani ulaminwa. Sit with your knees apart, do not sit on your haunches, you will become tired. Bana baleelede kuvweketa nobalya. Children should sit with their legs apart when eating. Wakaide kusowa zibbusu akuvweketa ansi nayakuswa ciya. = He just threw away his boots and sat on the ground with knees apart as he recovered. (1.-vweketwa, 2.-vweketede, 3.-vweketezya, -vweketya, 4.-wweketela, 5.-vweketelalyo, 6.-vweketesya, 7.-vweketa-vweketa, 8.-vweketelana, | -vweketezyanya) =

mix different kinds, Baama balavwela munkoyo mucibwantu. Mother is mixing munkoyo roots into the porridge (to make sweet-beer). Sena mwabuvwela kale bukoko? Have you already mixed the gruel for the beer? (1.-vwelwa, 2.-vwelede, 3.-vwezya, 4.-vwelela, 5.-vwelelalyo, 6.-vwelesya, 7.-vwela-vwela, 8.-vwelelana) Also: -vwaanya, -vwelanya.

be mixed, merged, Katuvwelana, nobasimbi a nobasankwa, kutegwa twiimbe kabotu. = Let us come together, girls and boys, so that we sing well. Mabisi aalula avwelana amukupa aba cibbobbe. = Sour milk mixed with fresh milk becomes curds. (mungwele = whey)

mix, Ncibotu kuvwelanya mukupa amabisi = It is good to mix milk with sour milk. Also: -vwaanya. (1.-vwelenganyizyigwa, 2.-vwelenye, 3.-vwelanya, 4.-vwelela, 5.-vwelelalyo, 6.-vwelesya, 7.-vwela-vwela, 8.-vwelana)

be stirred up, as dirty water, Meenda alavwelauka mumulonga kuti nombe zyaanjila. = The water is stirred up in the river when the cows enter. (1.-vwelaukizyigwa, 2.-vwelaukide, 3.-vwelauzya, 4.-vwelaukila, 5.-vwelaukilalyo, 6.-vwelaukisya, 7.-vwelauka-vwelauka, 8.-vwelaukizyanya) Also: -vwundauka.

mix, as cattle of different owners, Kamuvwelenganya mapopwe anyabo tusyange. Mix the maize with the beans so that we plant. (1.-vwelenganyizyigwa, 2.-vwelengenye, 3.-vwelenganyizya, 4.-vwelenganyizyizya, 5.-vwelenganyizyizyalyo, 6.-vwelenganyisya, 7.-vwelenganya-vwelenganya, 8.-vwelenganyizyanya)

gather together, Munzi oonse wavweluka akaambo komwe. = The whole village joined together on one matter. (1.-vwelukwa, 2.-vwelukide, 3.-vwelusya, 4.-vwelukila, 5.-vwelukilalyo, 6.-vwelukisya, 7.-vweluka-vweluka, 8.-vwelukizyanya)

sing in unison, Bantu bakali kuvwemuka kwiimba kumwi zilalila nkwasi nibakaunka kumalende kulomba Namakungwe. The people were singing in unison while clapping when they went to the rainshrine asking God to help them. (1.-vwemukwa, 2.-vwemukide, 3.-wwemusya, 4.-vwemukila, 5.-vwemukilalyo, 6.-vwemukisya, 7.-vwemukavwemuka, 8.-vwemukizyanya,/-vwemusyanya) Also: -vwunikila amwi
  • go away, Mainza waile kuvwemuka, talayi akulaya. = Mainza just went away, he did not even say goodbye. Also: -vwelemuka, -fwelemuka.
  • burst out laughing, Bantu boonse bakavwemuka kuseka. = All the people burst out laughing.

look for, Ndali kuvwenta nyeleti munanda limwi ndaile kuleka. = I searched for the needle in the house until finally I just gave up. Ndakavwenta buzuba boonse kakunyina kuzibona nombe. = I looked for the cattle all day without seeing them. Also: -yandaula. (1.-wwentwa, 2.-vwwentede, 3.-vwentya /-vwentezya, 4.-vwentela, 5.-vwentelalyo, 6.-vwentesya, 7.-vwenta-vwenta, 8.-vwentana)

jump when suddenly touched, Ndakavwenyuka mweenzuma naakandiguma kumukosi nsetamubwene. = I jumped when my friend, without me seeing him, touched me on the back of the neck.
  • answer rudely, Moonde talemeki bapati, wiide kuvwenyuka kubavwiila. = Moonde does not respect the elders, she just answers them rudely. Also: -vwinyuka (1.-vwenyukwa, 2.-vwenyukide, 3.-vwenyusya, 4.-vwenyukila, 5.-vwenyukilalyo, 6.-vwenyukisya, 7.-vwenyuka-vwenyuka, 8.-vwenyusyanya)

lose power, Nindakamana kunywa bukoko bulula, mubili wangu wakavwenzauka. = When I finished drinking the strong beer, my body lost power. Also: -benzauka, -benzuka. (1.-vwenzaukwa, 2.-vwenzaukide, 3.-vwenzausya, 4.-vwenzaukila, 5.-wenzaukilalyo, 6.-vwenzaukisya, 7.-vwenzauka, 8.-vwenzausyanya)

be talked about as a rumour, rt. -vwiya, Kwakali kuvwiigwa kuti wakalijisi kanswende. It was rumoured that he had a sexual infection. (1.-vwiigwa, 2.-vwiide, 3.-vwiizya, 4.-vwiila, 5.-vwiilalyo, 6.-vwiisya, 7.-vwiigwa-vwiigwa, 8.-vwiiyana)

answer, answer in chorus, Kamuvwiila balaita bataata. = You answer, my father is calling. Mwana ulavwiila nobaita banyina. The child answers when the mother calls. Chingobe naakaangula ciimbo mucikombelo, boonse bantu bakavwiila. When Chingobe started a hymn in the church, all the people responded. Bakabungana kuvwiila ziimbo kumangolezya lyakalila ngoma. = They gathered to answer to the songs in the evening when the drum sounded. (1.-vwiilwa, 2.-vwiilide, 3.-vwiizya, 4.-vwiilila, 5.-vwiililalyo, 6.-vwiilisya, 7.-vwiila-vwiila, 8.-vwiilana) Also: -vweemuka

echo, Malundu alavwiilila basankwa nobauma mukkwilo. = When the boys crack a whip the hills echo. (1.-vwiililwa, 2.-vwiilide, 3.-vwiililizya, 4.-vwiililila, 5.-vwiilililalyo, 6.-vwiililisya, 7.-vwiilila-vwiilila, 8.-vwiililana)
  • answer for, Sibbuku naakaita mwana, banyina bakaakumuvwiilila. = When the headman summoned the child, the mother answered for it.

raise hands in fighting gesture, Bazivwika mfwaindi nibali kulwana. = They were raising their fists when they were fighting. (1.-vwikwa, 2.-vwikide, 3.-vwikizya, 4.-vwikila, 5.-vwikilalyo, 6.-vwikisya, 7.-vwika-vwika, 8.-vwikilana)

cover, as a blanket, Mufwu bakamuvwikka payi lipya. = They covered the dead person with a new blanket. Also: -vwumba, -vwungaila. (1.-vwikkwa, 2.-vwikkide, 3.-vwikkizya, 4.-vwikkila, 5.-vwikkilalyo, 6.-vwikkisya, 7.-vwikka-vwikka, 8.-vwikkana)

bury, cover up with soil, Kamwaavwikkila magwili aayo ansi kutegwa akamene. = Bury those potatoes in the ground so that they germinate. Kuti yalibonya njina yomwe buyo, njakuvwikkila mumamvwu. = If just one louse is seen, I will cover it up with soil. (1.-vwikkilwa, 2.-vwikkide, 3.-vwikkizya, 4.-vwikkilila, 5.-vwikkililalyo, 6.-vwikkilisya 7.-vwikkila-vwikkila, 8.-vwikkilana) Also: -simbila
  • throw ashes on someone, Kaindi cakali kutondwa kulivwikkila itwe amubili wamuntu. = Long ago it was taboo to throw ashes on someone's body. (It was a sign that you were calling death on them.)
  • fill as a hole with earth, Kamucivwikkila cilindi, kuzikunyikila mpongo. = Fill in the hole, a goat might fall into it.

jump suddenly, Naatiikati adubule awalo syuumbwa wakavwikuka akusotokela munyama oyo. = When he was about to shoot, the lion also sprang and jumped on that animal. (1.-vwikukwa, 2.-vwikukide, 3.-vwikusya, 4.-vwikukila, 5.-vwikukilalyo, 6.-vwikukisya, 7.-vwikuka-vwikuka, 8.-vwikukilana)

throw, Basicikolo nibakazanga bakatalika kuvwililisya mabwe kunanda yamwiiyi mupati. = When the pupils went on strike they began to throw stones at the head teachers house. (1.-vwililisyigwa, 2.-vwililisyizye, 3.-vwililisyizya, 4.-vwililizyizya, 5.-vwililizyizyalyo, 6.-vwilililisya, 7.-vwililisya-vwililisya, 8.-vwililisyanya)

blaze continually, Mulilo ulavwilima kuyaka. The fire is blazing. Moyo wangu wakali kuvwilima akoontoka mbuli syokwe lyamukasena katakajugwa bwizu. My heart was blazing and burning like the bush in a vlei where the grass has not been cut. (1.-vwilimizyigwa, 2.-vwilimide, 3.-vwilimya, 4.-vwilimina, 5.-wiliminalyo, 6.-vwilimisya, 7.-vwilimavwilima, 8.-vwilimizyanya)
turn around quickly, Mizeezo yangu ilavwilimuka mbuli kavwili kamootokala. = My thoughts are spinning around like the wheel of a motorcar.
rush off to, Musaama wavwilimukila kale kuli? My friend, where are you rushing off to? Also: -fwelemuka

cause to blaze continually, rt. -vwilima, Nitwakazyila kumuunda twakajana bana bavwilimya mulilo munsaa butala. When we returned from the field we found the children had set a fire blazing beside the maize granary.
  • revolve, as a wheel, Malumbe wakaivwilimya ncinga naakabona bamasilikani. Malumbe rode the bike off when he saw the police. Also: -wilimya.
iguwo ivwilinganya = a hurricane. Iguwo pati lyakavwilinganya meenda mulwaanje. A great wind stirred up the water in the sea.

hunt, Tuyakukuvwima basulwe kumazuba. = We are going to hunt hares in the evening. Also: -weza, -yala. (1.-vwimwa, 2.-vwimide, 3.-vwimya, 4.-vwimina, 5.-vwiminalyo, 6.-vwimisya, 7.-vwima-vwima, 8.-vwimana)
beat with a stick, Moonga wakavwimbula nombe amusana. = Moonga beat the cow with a stick on the back. Also: -zwipula.

beat severely, Basimpongo bakavwimbuula mwingile amaponda malamfwu. = The goat herds were beating the warthog with long sticks. Also: -kwibbaula, -kwabbaula. (1.-vwimbuulwa, 2.-vwimbwiide, 3.-vwimbuuzya, 4.-vwimbwiida, 5.-wimbwiidalyo, 6.-vwimbuulisya, 7.-vwimbuula-vwimbuula, 8.-vwimbuulana)

thrash with a stick, Munene wamuvwimpula amwiindi weembela. = The old man was beating the herder's leg. (1.-vwimpulwa, 2.-vwimpwide, 3.-vwimpuzya, 4.-vwimpwida, 5.-vwimpwidalyo, 6.-vwimpulisya, 7.-vwipula-vwimpula, 8.-vwimpulana) Also: -zwipula.

roll onseself in the dust, Nakomena, navwuba, kuti kayanda mwanaamuntu weelede kulivwinda ansi kutegwa kalibonya kuti ukomba malelo. = Even if he is adult or rich, if he wants the child of a person, he ought to roll on the ground so that he is seen to ask for a favour. (1.-vwindwa, 2.-vwindide, 3.-vwindizya, 4.-vwindila, 5.-vwindilalyo, 6.-vwindisya, 7.-vwinda-vwinda, 8.-vwindana)

leave to ferment, as tobacco, or ripen, as fruit, Ndakauvwindika namunyo kutegwa abizwe. = I kept a melon to ripen. Baama bavwindika masuku kuti abizwe. = Mother is keeping masuku fruits to ripen. Also: -vwundika. (1.-vwindikwa, 2.-vwindikide, 3.-vwindisya 4.-vwindikila, 5.-vwindikilalyo, 6.-vwindikisya, 7.-vwindika-vwindika. 8.-vwindikana)
  • pick at bait (fish), Inswi yatalika kale kuvwindika. = The fish have already started to nibble at the bait. Also: -sonsonya.
take bait as fish, Inswi niyakatalika kuvwinta, ndakafwambaana kukwisula kalobo. = When the fish began to nibble at the bait, I quickly pulled the hook. Also: vwindika, -sunsa, sonsonya.

break down, Oonse maanda ababbi bakaavwinyauna bamasilikani. = The police broke down all the thieves' houses. (1.-vwinyaunwa, 2.-vwinyaunide, 3.-vwinyauzya, 4.-vwinyaunina, 5.-vwinyauninalyo, 6.-vwinyaunisya, 7.-vwinyauna-vwinyauna, 8.-vwinyaunana) Also: -mwayaula, -oloola, -tataula.

be jerked, Mulavwu wakagonta cijazyo akutonta nanda mpoona suntwe amukwasyi wakwe bakavwinyuka. = The lion shoved the door and pushed the house, thereupon the hyena and his family were jerked about. Also: -vwenyuka, -bbwenyuka. (1.-vwinyukwa, 2.-vwinyukide, 3.-vwinyusya, 4.-vwinyukila, 5.-vwinyikilalyo, 6.-vwinyukisya, 7.-vwinyuka-vwinyuka, 8.-vwinyusyanya)

sip, Kovwipa, mboobu bukoko. = Sip, here is the beer. Bantu bavwipa cibwantu cipya. = The people are just sipping the hot sweet-beer. (1.-vwipwa, 2.-vwipide, 3.-vwipya, 4.-vwipila, 5.-vwipilalyo, 6.-vwipisya, 7.-vwipa-vwipa, 8.-vwipilana) Also: -papata, -pwita.

remove, as earth with hands or feet, Kamuvwitila mubwina mugusye mbeba. = Excavate the hole so that you take out the rat. (1.-vwitilwa, 2.-vwitilide, 3.-vwitizya, 4.-vwitilila, 5.-vwitililalyo, 6.-vwitilisya, 7.-witilavwitila, 8.-vwitilana) Also: -fwumba..

breathe noisely, croak, Bafwundilila kuyoya inga balavwitima. = Asthmatics breathe heavily. Muntu waumwa kapati ulavwitima kuyoya. = The person who is beaten severely breathes heavily. Moonde nibakamudina bakaintu, bana bakamumvwa naakali kuvwitima. = When the wife was strangling Moonde, the children heard him choking. Bamacincizya bakali kuvwitima mbuli namalwa. = The eagle owls were hooting like a friction drum. Wakaliwaala ansi akuvwitima mbuli muntu wanjilwa masabe. = She threw herself on the ground and panted like a person possessed with a masabe spirit: (1.-vwitimwa, 2.-vwitimide, 3.-vwitimya, 4.-vwitimina, 5.-vwitiminalyo, 6.-vwitimisya, 7.-vwitima-vwitima, 8.-witimizyanya)
cause to move, like long hair, rt.-vwitima, Naakacebuka wakabona ndiinga syuumbwa *livwitimya* ngala mucivwuna. = When he looked around he saw a huge lion shaking its long mane under a shrub.
gossip, Bamwi basowa ciindi cabo coonse mukuvwiya. = Some people waste their whole time gossiping.

balaa bunjaka. = People who gossip bring discord. Also: - *vwuya*. (1.-vwiigwa, 2.-vwiide, 3.-vwiizya, 4.-vwiila, 5.-vwiilalyo, 6.-vwiisya, .-vwiyavwiya, 8.-vwiyana)
  • reflect on a matter, discuss in private, Bakamwaambila kuti weelede kulivwiya katanalunga. They told him that he ought to think about it before he paid the fine. (he had been denying his guilt.) Nibakamana kumubuzya nkuta yakaambilwa kuti iyumuke kutegwa babetesi bakalivwiye. When they had finished questioning him the court was told to rise so that the judges could discuss the matter in private.
gossip about, Basimbi *bavwiya-vwiya* makani abasankwa: abalo basankwa *bavwiya-vwiya* makani abasimbi = Girls gossip about boys, and boys also gossip about girls.

clap with hands hollowed, *Bantu balaywobela* kumalende kulomba mwula. People clap with hollowed hands when praying for rain. Kumalende *bavwobela* buya kukamba. = At the rainshrine they clap with hollowed hands. (1.-vwobelwa, 2.-vwobelede, 3.-vwobezya 4.-vwobelela, 5.-vwobelelalyo, 6.-vwobelesya, 7.-vwobela-vwobela, 8.-vwobelelana)

shout with prolonged Ooo! or Yoo! Musankwa waywoeta kwiita mweenzinyina. = The boy with a prolonged shout called his friend. (1.-vwoetwa, 2.-vwoetede, 3.-vwoezya, 4.-vwoetela, 5.-vwoetelalyo, 6.-vwoetesya 7.-vwoeta-vwoeta, 8.-vwoetana) Also: -vwoola, -uulula.

be loose, not taut, Naalikuteya tuyuni, ndajana kuti kooye kakwe kavwokomana. When he was trapping little birds I found that the string was loose. Also: - *vwukumana*. (1.-vwokomanwa, 2.-vwokomene, 3.-vwokomesya, 4.-vwokomanina, 5.-vwokomaninalyo, 6.-vwokomanisya, 7.-vwokomana-vwokomana, 8.-vwokomanizyanya)

earn or be paid wages, Sena wakavwola kale mali mwezi uuno? = Have you already received wages this month? Mubelesi wakavwola mali manji naakabeleka kabotu. = A worker received much money for working well. (1.-vwolwa, 2.-vwolede, 3.-vwozya, 4.-vwolela, 5.-vwolelalyo, 6.-vwolesya, 7.-vwola-vwola, 8.-vwolelana)

yoke oxen, Katuvwoleka tuye kumuunda. = Let us go and yoke the oxen so that we go to the field. Kamuvwoleka basune tususe meenda. = Yoke the oxen so that we draw water. Also: -sunga, -bopa, -popa, -boleka. (1.-vwolekwa, 2.-vwolekede, 3.-vwolesya, 4.-vwolekela, 5.-vwolekelalyo, 6.-vwolekesya, 7.-vwoleka-vwoleka, 8.-vwolekana)

deter, delay, Candivwolopezya kufwambaana kusika, nkuswaigwa beenzu. = What delayed me in coming quickly was the arrival of visitors. (1.-vwolopezyegwa, 2.-vwolopezyede, 3.-vwolopezya, 4.-vwolopezyezya, 5.-vwolopezyezyalyo, 6.-vwolopezyesya, 7.-vwolopezya-vwolopezya, 8.-vwolopezyanya) Also: -ccelesya, -munsya.

(ety. home!) bring back, *Kamuvwomeka basune tukakkulule.* = Bring back the oxen so that we unyoke them. Also: -vwomosya, -vwomona (1.-vwomekwa, 2.-vwomekede, 3.-vwomezya, 4.-vwomekela, 5.-vwomekelalyo, 6.-vwomekesya, 7.-vwomeka-vwomeka, 8.-vwomekana)

bring back, *Kofwambaana kuvwomona basune tukalete cilayi.* = Hurry up and bring back the oxen so that we bring the sleigh. (1.-vwomonwa, 2.-vwomwede, 3.-vwomosya, 4.-vwomweda, 5.-vwomwedalyo, 6.-vwomonesya, 7.-vwomona-vwomona, 8.-vwomonana)

cause to bring back, rt. -vwomona. *Bausyi bakamukalalila naakavwomosya basune akati kamuunda.* = His father was angry with him when he brought back the oxen through the middle of the field. Also: -vwomeka.

be hollow, concave, *Conco ngwaakali kulisya jilo wavwongomana.* = The spoon she was eating with yesterday is concave. (1.-vwongomanwa, 2.-vwongomene, 3.-vwongomeka, 4.-vwongomekela, 5.-vwongomekelalyo, 6.-vwongomanisya, 7.-vwogomana-vwongomana, 8.-vwongomekana) Also: -ongomana.
deep, (adj.) *mutiba uvwongomene* = a soup plate, *mutiba wanindi.*

continue, prolong, *Kuvwoola kubwenta balaciyanda aba.* = This one likes to drag on scolding someone. *Muntu ulavwoola kwiita mudaala.* = The person persists in calling the old man. (1.-woolwa, 2.-vwoolede, 3.-vwoozya, 4.-woolela, 5.-vwoolelalyo, 6.-vwoolesya 7.-woola-vwoola, 8.-vwoolana)

continue without purpose, rt. -vwoola, *Kunyina ancomwaamba, muvwoolozya buyo.* = You are saying nothing, you are just rambling on. (1.-vwoolozyegwa, 2.-vwoolozyede, 3.-vwoolozya, 4.-vwoolozyezya, 5.-vwoolozyezyalyo, 6.-vwoolozyesya, 7.-vwoolozya-vwoolozya, 8.-vwoolozyanya)

gather as many people, *Bakavwoomana kulanga cakali kucitika.* = They were crowding around to see what was happening. (1.-vwoomanwa, 2.-vwoomene, 3.-vwoomeka,/-vwoomanya, 4.-vwoomanina, 5.-vwoomaninalyo, 6.-vwoomanisya, 7.-vwoomana-vwoomana, 8.-vwoomaninana)
assemble, *Kamuvwoomeka basicikolo balye cakulya ciindi caunka.* = Assemble the pupils to eat, the time has gone. *Nguni wavwoomeka bantu sunu?* = Who assembled the people today?

pay out wages, rt. -vwola, *Babelesi kamubavwozya, mwezi wasika kumamanino.* = Pay the workers, the month has come to an end. *Bamayi tabaningabavwozya mali abo.* = They have not paid the teachers their salaries. *Nguwakali mulembi wamatikiti abo akubavwozya cakulya.* = He was the one who signed their cards and gave them out food.

become rich, *Kuvwuba tauli muyanda, inga mbunkutwe bwamuntu.* = To become rich is not (in using) a charm, it is in the hard work of a person. (1.-vwubwa, 2.-vwubide, 3.-vwubya, 4.-vwubila, 5.-vwubilalyo, 6.-vwubisya, 7.-vwuba-vwuba, 8.-vwubana)
  • own, acquire, tame or rear wild animals, *Moomba ulayandisya kuvwuba ngulube.* = Moomba wants very much to keep pigs. *Tobazike twakali nombe zyabaabo bakali kutuvwuba.* = We slaves were the cattle of those who owned us.

hold in mouth, *Kamuvwubata meenda mukanwa mumupiile* bamutole bayanda kumukwata. = Hold the water in your mouth and squirt it out on her so that the one who wants to marry her can take her away. Munyama mupati wakakonga syuumbwa amane wavwubata mwana mukanwa. = The big animal frightened away the lion and then held the child gently in its mouth. Also: -vwundika. (1.-vwubatwa, 2.-vwubete, 3.-vwubatya, 4.-vwubatila, 5.-vwubatilalyo, 6.-vwubatisya, 7.-vwubata-vwubata,8.-vwubatilana)

embrace, e.g Moonde a Chimuka bakavwubatana nobakaswaana jilo nkaambo bakalaandene kwaciindi cilamfwu. = Moonde and Chimuka embraced one another yesterday because they had been separated for a long time. (1.-vwubatanwa, 2.-vwubatene, 3.-vwubatanya, 4.-vwubatanina, 5.-vwubataninalyo, 6.-vwubatanisya, 7.-vwubatana-vwubatana, 8.-vwubatana) Also: -kumbata.

oppose, resist, Sincinko walikuvwubauka nibatiimunyange masumo ngaajisi. = The mad person was resisting when they were about to take away the spears which he had. (1.-vwubaukwa, 2.-vwubaukide, 3.-vwubausya, 4.-vwubaukila, 5.-vwubaukilalyo, 6.-vwubaukisya, 7.-vwubauka-vwubauka, 8.-vwubausyanya) Also: -vwabauka.

hold something lightly or gently with both hands, rt.-vwubata, Wakali kunga ulayabila kalivwubete kumutwe. He used to sing songs alone while gently holding his head with both hands. Ooyu ciwena taakamuluma mwana cakumucisa pe, wakamuvwubete buyo. = This crocodile did not bite the child so as to hurt it, it just held it gently.
be tamed, rt. - vwuba, Banyama bavwubidwe kumunene mbanji. = The tamed animals of the old man are many. Banyama bavwubidwe tabalumi. = Tamed animals do not bite.

soften, Kamuvwubilila nsima meenda apya. The water is hot enough, begin cooking nsima by putting the first amount of mealie-meal. Kamuvwubilila bulongo tuume zitina. = Soften the clay so that we make bricks. (1.-wubililwa,2.-vwubilide, 3.-vwubilizya, 4.-vwubililila, 5.-vwubilililalyo, 6.-vwubililisya, 7.-vwubilila-vwubilila, 8.-vwubililana) Also: -zubilila. =

work busily, Twajana munene ulavwubuka kubeleka mumuunda wakwe. We found the old man working busily in his field. (1.-vwubukwa, 2.-vwubukide, 3.-vwubusya, 4.-vwubukila, 5.-vwubukilalyo, 6.-vwubukisya, 7.-vwubuka-vwubuka, 8.-vwubusyanya)
  • shake off, Chakatazya mbwaakamubonena, wakatijaana, mpaamusana, nkwaakati ndavwubuka munyati Chakatazya wakaakwiide kutapukila mbuli kokuya. As soon as Chakatazya saw it he rushed and jumped on it's back, when the buffalo shook him off, it threw Chakatazya away over there. Munyati ucivwubuka kujwa sumo, ilyabili lyakaango lyaakuyasilizya amoyo ndeelyo lyaakwiide kudukuzya mpalaa gwezyo-gwezyo. When the buffalo tried to shake the spear out, a second one in the chest piercing right into the heart and protruding between the shoulders.

fall into, Wakavwubukila mucilindi. He fell into a hole.
  • bend down, Cibengele mbwaakavwubukila wakamunyonsola ampemo. = The hammer-headed stork bend down and pecked him on the nose.

shake by force, back and forth or up and down, blow to light, Ndalivwukaula kutegwa nkasaalilwe nkaambo kwali kutontola. = I shook myself so that I become warm because it was cold. Wakanyamuka mwami awo mpaakakkede kumwi oku katalekezyi cizo cakwe caku vwukaula mucila. = The chief stood up from where he was sitting while not stopping his habit of shaking the tail. Wakatalika kuvwukaula, nkubona wayaka mulilo. = He began to blow, thereupon the fire was lit. (1.-vwukaulwa, 2.-wukawide, 3.-vwukauzya, 4.-vwukawida, 5.-vwukawidalyo, 6.-vwukaulisya, 7.-wukaula-vwukaula, 8.-vwukaulana)

fill up grave or hole, Bakamuvwukkila mucuumbwe jilo. = They placed him in the grave yesterday. Bakauvwukkila mulindi ngwindakaside. = They filled in the hole which I had dug. (1.-vwukkilwa, 2.-vwukkide, 3.-vwukkizya 4.-vwukkilila, 5.-vwukkililalyo, 6.-vwukkilisya, 7.-vwukkila-vwukkila, 8.-vwukkilana) Also: -vwikkila.

exhume, Muntu wakazikkidwe kale bakamuvwukkula. = They exhumed the person whom they had already buried. (1.-vwukkulwa, 2.-vwukkwide, 3.-vwukkuzya, 4.-vwukkwida, 5.-vwukkwidalyo, 6.-vwukkulisya, 7.-vwukkula-vwukkula, 8.-vwukkulana)

pull with a jerk, snatch from, Komuvwukula nkoli ooyu, natanamucisa mweenzinyina. = Grab the stick from that one, before he hurts his friend. Mubbi wakavwukula kabbeeke kamukaintu akutija. = The thief grabbed the bag of the woman and ran off. Mwana wakavwukula kuboko akufwusa kabwe. = The child stretched back his arm and threw the stone. (1.-vwukulwa, 2.-vwukwide, 3.-vwukuzya, 4.-vwukwida, 5.-vwukwidalyo, 6.-vwukulisya, 7.-vwukula-vwwukula, 8.-vwukulana) Also: -ongomana.

be oversize, Buluke bwavwukumana tiibwandeelela. = The trousers are too big they do not fit me. (1.-vwukumanwa, 2.-vwukumene, 3.-vwukumika, 4.-vwukumikila, 5.-wukumikilalyo, 6.-vwukumikisya, 7.-wukumana-vwukumana, 8.-vwukumikana) Also: -vwokomana.

shake, as blanket or clothes, Kamuvwukumuna mapayi aayo kazwe kasuko. Shake those blankets so that the dust comes out. Wakavwukumuna cibaki cakwe ncaaka-samide akaambo kankasaalo amubili wakwe. = He shook out his shirt which he wore because of the sweat from his body. (1.-vwukumunwa, 2.-vwukumwide, 3.-vwukumuzya, 4.-vwukumwida, 5.-wukumwidalyo, 6.-vwukumunisya, 7.-vwukumuna-vwukumuna, 8.-wukumwidana) also -bbukumuna.
  • flap wings, Jule tafwambaani kuliwukumuna mababa naayanda kuuluka. = The secretary bird does not flap its wings quickly when it is about to fly. Also: -vwakauka.

rustle, stir up, Kamuuvwukuta mulilo uyake. = Stir the fire so that it lights up. Mufwuzi uvwukuta mulilo avwuba. The blacksmith stirs up the fire with the bellows. Wakatalika kulota kuti kwasika basankwa-sankwa bamisela yakwe. Lino mbaaba ubatondezya mbokubambwa zilwanyo akuvwukuta mavwuba. He began to dream that young boys of his own age arrived. Now there they were, he showing them how weapons were made and to stir up the fire with the bellows. (1.-vwukutwa, 2.-vwukutide, 3.-vwukutya, 4.-vwukutila, 5.-vwukutilalyo, 6.-vwukutisya, 7.-vwukuta-vwukuta, 8.-vwukutilana)
  • eat hurriedly, Muntu umvwide nzala uvwukuta buya kulya. = A hungry person eats hurriedly. vwukutila fumigate, use smoke from roots in traditional ritual to drive out evil spirit and sickness, Muntu ngobati 'waumwa luwo', eliya nobakamuvwukutila musamu inga watalika kukanana lulaka lutazyi bantu boonse. = A person who they say is 'beaten by the wind', at that time when they fumigate him with medicine he begins to speak in a language which all the people do not know. (1.-vwukutilwa, 2.-vwukutide, 3.-vwukutizya, 4.-vwukutilila, 5.-vwukutililalyo, 6.-vwukutilisya, 7.-vwukutila-vwukutila, 8.-vwukutilana)

act vigourously, Musimbi muyumu ulavwukuula kusya ndongwe. A strong girl is working vigourously to dig up the groundnuts. Musankwa wakali kuvwukuula musimbi kutegwa amunyange cisako. The boy acted in a forceful manner with the girl so that he could snatch the stick from her. (1.-vwukuulwa, 2.-vwukuwide, 3.-vwukuuzya, 4.-vwukuwida, 5.-vwukuwidalyo, 6.-vwukuulisya, 7.-vwukuula-vwukuula, 8.-vwukuulana)

be plentiful, Bantu bakazikuvwula kumuswaangano. = The people became many at the meeting. Meenda avwula mumulonga. = The water is full in the river. (1.-vwulwa, 2.-vwide, 3.-vwuzya, 4.-vwulila, 5.-vwulilalyo, 6.-vwulisya, 7.-vwula-vwula, 8.-vwuzyanya)
  • win a bet, Ndamuvwula mweenzuma. = I won a bet from my friend

be easily filled, Tulonga twamumilundu tulavwula-vwula mainza. Streams in hilly places easily get filled during the rainy season.
  • be not quite full, Ibbodela lyavwula-vwula asyoonto buyo. = The bottle is only partly filled.

mutter, talk in a low voice or indistinctly, Bantu balavwulukuta kucoonde. = The people are talking in a low voice in the thicket. Naakamana kubuzya mubuzyo oyu, wakalindila kwiingula kuzwa kubuleya, pesi bantu bakali kwiile kukanana kuvwulukuta cabula akulimvwisya ncobayeeya. When he finished asking this question he waited for a response from the crowd, but the people were just muttering among themselves and it was impossible to understand what they were thinking. Also: -bulukusya. (1.-vwulukutwa, 2.-vwulukutide, 3.-vwulukutya, 4.-vwulukutila, 5.-wulukutilalyo, 6.-vwulukutisya, 7.-wlukuta-vwulukuta, 8.-vwulukutilana)

reharvest, glean, Bana bayakukuvwulula mapopwe. = The children are going to reharvest the maize. Basimbi bavwulula mapopwe akuuzya ccuka. The girls are gleaning maize to buy sugar. (1.-vwululwa, 2.-vwulwide, 3.-vwuluzya, 4.-vwulwida, 5.-vwulwidalyo, 6.-vwululisya, 7.-vwulula-vwulula, 8.-vwulwidana)

shut the eyes, sleep lightly, Koona koonse wakaide kuvwululata kwakaindi kasyoonto buyo. In all his sleeping he was just closing his eyes for a short period. Moonde wavwululata buyo acuuno. = Moonde is just sleeping lightly in a chair. Atuvwululate tukombe. = Let us close the eyes so that we pray. (1.-vwululatwa, 2.-vwululete, 3.-vwululazya, 4.-vwululalila, 5.-vwululalilalyo, 6.-vwululalisya, 7.-vwululata-vwululata, 8.-vwululatilana)

nurse into sleep, Nchimunya uvwululatika mwana abulo. = Nchimunya is nursing the child to sleep on the bed. (1.-vwululatika, 2.-vwululatikide, 3.-vwululatikwa, 4.-vwululatikila, 5.-vwululatikilalyo, 6.-vwululatikisya, 7.-vwululatika-vwululatika, 8.-vwululatikana) Also: -butika.

close eyes, Talyi, tooni, tafwebi, talangi, ulivwululete ulalila. = He does not eat, he does not sleep, he does not smoke, he does not look, he closes his eyes weeping. (1.-vwululalwa, 2.-vwululete, 3.-vwululazya, 4.-vwululalila, 5.-vwululalilalyo, 6.-vwululalisya, 7.-vwululete-vwululete, 8.-vwululatilana)

snore, Mudaala naakali koona wakali kwiile *kuvwuluma*. = When the old man was sleeping he was just snoring. (1.-*vwulumwa*, 2.-*vwulumide* 3.-*vwulumya*, 4.-*vwulumina*, 5.-*vwuluminalyo*, 6.-*vwulumisya*, 7.-*vwuluma-vwuluma*, 8.-*vwuluminana*)
  • roar or growl, Kuli *kuvwuluma syuumbwa*. = A lion is roaring somewhere. Kacele kalavwuluma mubwina. = An animal is growling in the hole. Mubwa walikuvwuluma naabona mangoye. = The dog was growling when he saw the cat.

growl at, Syuumbwa *wabavwulumina bacembele*. = The lion was growling at the old woman. (1.-*vwuluminwa*, 2.-*vwuluminide*, 3.-*vwulu-mizya*, 4.-*vwulumina*, 5.-*vwuluminalyo*, 6.-*vwuluminisya*, 7.-*vwulumina-vwulumina*, 8.-*vwuluminana*)

speak fiercely, Ooyu kukanana uvwulumuka buya. = This one in speaking is just very rough. (1.-*vwulumukwa*, 2.-*vwulumukide*, 3.-*vwulumuzya*, 4.-*vwulumukila*, 5.-*vwulumukilalyo*, 6.-*vwulumukisya*, 7.-*wulumuka-vwulumuka*, 8.-*vwulumukilana*)
  • speak out loud, as while asleep, Mulwazi wali kuvwulumuka masiku. = The patient was just speaking aloud during the night.
be spoken to sternly, Balwazi bamwi tababindilwi alimwi tabavwulumukilwi. = Certain patients cannot be rushed or spoken to harshly way.

upset the hair, Mwana nguwandivwulunganya masusu naalikundijatauka a mutwe. = It is the child who upset my hair when he was catching me by the head. Also: -ulunganya, -upunganya, -pupunganya, -palanganya. (1.-*vwulunganyizyigwa*, 2-*vwulungenye*, 3.-*vwulunganya*, 4.-*vwulunganyizyizya*, 5.-*vwulunganyizyizyalyo*, 6.-*vwulunganyisya*, 7.-*vwulunganya-vwulunganya*, 8.-*vwuluganyizyanya*)

look, as into a pot when uncovering it, Sinzala ulaywulungula muzibiya. = The hungry person looked into the pots. Also: -*fwulunga*. (1.-*vwulungulwa*, 2.-*vwulungwide*, 3.-*vwulunguzya*, 4.-*vwulungwida*, 5.-*vwulungwidalyo*, 6.-*vwulungulusya*, 7.-*wulungula-vwulungula*, 8.-*vwulungulana*)

be fierce, Kunyema kwalo oyu muntu wavwulunkana kumeso. = In anger this person showed an infuriated face. (1.-*vwulunkanwa*, 2.-*vwulunkene*, 3.-*vwulunkanya*, 4.-*vwulunkanina*, 5.-*vwulunkaninalyo*, 6.-*vwulunkanisya*, 7.-*vwulunkana-vwulunkana*, 8.-*vwulukaninana*)
show fury, rt.-*vwulunkana*, Nindakazyila kubukoko, ndakajana bakaintu balivwulunkene kumeso. = When I came from the beer, I found the wife showing a furious face.

sleep intermittently, rt. - *vwulula*, Tiindoona sunu, ndavwuluzya buyo. = I did not sleep last night, I just slept intermittently. Langa we tobantu tatunaakuvwuluzya pe, webo waanka kubuka kwategwa bwaca. = Look we people have not slept well, and you start getting up saying it has dawned. (1.-*vwuluzyigwa*, 2.-*vwuluzyizye*, 3.-*vwuluzya*, 4.-*vwuluzyizya*, 5.-*vwuluzyizyalyo*, 6.-*vwuluzyisya*, 7.-*vwuluzya-vwuluzya*, 8.-*vwuluzyanya*)
  • cause to glean, Ndabavwuluzya mumuunda wangu bana nkaambo mapopwe manji akaliceede. = I caused the children to glean in my field because there was much left behind.

lose a case, Malikopo wavwulwa mumulandu wakwe. = Malikopo lost his court-case. Also: -*zulwa*. (1.-vwulwa, 2.-vwulidwe, 3.-vwulizya, 4.-vwulilwa, 5.-vwulilwalyo, 6.-vwulisyigwa, 7.-vwulwa-vwulwa, 8.-vwulana)

control or protect with charms, Bananga bazookuvwuma munzi. = The witchdoctors will protect the village. Muntu wakavwuma munzi wakwe, tabbidwi. = A person who has protected his village is not stolen from. Syaazyanamasiku ulakonzya kuvwuma babwa. = The night-dancer can subdue the dogs. Bakali kuvwuma munzi wabo kukasya banyama bamusyokwe kuti kabatasiki kunyonauna bantu babo alubono lwabo. = They were using charms to protect the village by stopping wild animals from destroying the villagers and their property. (1.-vwumwa, 2.-vwumide, 3.-vwumya, 4.-vwumina, 5.-vwuminalyo, 6.-vwumisya, 7.-vwuma-vwuma, 8.-vwumana)
conceal, Bazyali bavwuma-vwuma kaambo kakacita mwanaabo. = The parents are hiding what their child did.

conceal things in a bundle, cover, wrap up, Nobakasika amuntu ufwide, bakalivwumba kumeso kutegwa bataboni mutumba. = When they arrived where the dead person was, they covered their faces so as not to see the corpse. Kaindi bantu bakali kulivwumba zikutu zyabanyama mbuli bakonze, bananja, basyaambololo a banaluvwi. = Long ago people used to cover themselves in animals skins such as hartebeeste, lechway cob, addax, and reedbuck. (1.-vwumbwa, 2.-vwumbide, 3.-vwumbya, 4.-vwumbila, 5.-vwumbilalyo, 6.-vwumbisya, 7.-vwumba-vwumba, 8.-vwumbana) Also: -vwikka.
  • thatch a roof, Basankwa bavwumba nanda atala. = The boys are thatching the roof at the top. V - 656
  • cover the mouth, Ncibotu kapati kuvwumba mulomo kuti kolya. = It is a very good thing to cover the mouth if you are eating.

strip hut of thatch, Baivwumbaula nanda yabwizu nkaambo bayanda kuvwumbulula. = They are stripping the thatched house because they want to rethatch it. (1.-vwumbaulwa, 2.-vwumbawide, 3.-vwumbauzya, 4.-wumbawida, 5.-vwumbawidalyo, 6.-vwumbaulisya, 7.-vwumbaulavwumbaula, 8.-vwumbaulana)

hoard, bury in a burrow, fill up, e.g Kamuvwumbila nsangu eezyo. = Cover those seeds up. Bamadaala bawumbila cuumbwe cakaboba. = The old men are covering the grave which caved in. (1.-vwumbilwa, 2.-vwumbilide, 3.-wumbizya, 4.-vwumbilila, 5.-vwumbililalyo, 6.-vwumbilisya, 7.-vwumbila-vwumbila, 8.-vwumbilana)

be covered up, Inzoka ilajaigwa, ilavwumbilwa mubwina kutegwa kutabi uubulyata buyoka bwanjiyo aalya mpoyasowelwa. = A snake is killed and covered over in a hole so that no one may tread on it's poison there where it is thrown away.

be uncovered, appear from below, arrive unexpectedly, Nitwali kulima, nzoka yaile kuvwumbuka. = When we were ploughing a snake appeared unexpectedly. Ciwena wakavwumbuka munsaa bantu. = A crocodile suddenly appeared beside the people. Also: -fwumbuka, -bbunuka. (1.-vwumbukwa, 2.-vwumbukide, 3.-vwumbuzya, 4.vwumbukila, 5.-vwumbukilalyo, 6.-vwumbukisya, 7.-vwumbukavwumbuka, 8.-vwumbukilana)
  • be blown off, Nikakainda kambizyi, ciluli campongo cakavwumbuka. = When the whirlwind passed, the roof of the goats shelter was blown off. Also: -eluka.

appear from undercover, rt. -vwumbuka, Swe tobapati tulijisi kaambyo kakuti, '*Nkondo ngukavwumbu*' nkokuti nkondo ilakonzya kukuvwumbukila kuciindi ncotiiyeeyi. = We elders have a proverb which says, '*War emerges suddenly*' which means that war can rise up at a time you do not expect. (1.-vwumbukilwa, 2.-vwumbukide, 3.-vwumbukizya, 4.-vwumbukila, 5.-wumbukilalyo, 6.-vwumbukilisya, 7.-vwumbukila-vwumbukila, 8.-vwumbukilana)

uncover, Mooye wavwumbula mulembo wakwe. = The girl in initiation removed her face-veil. Mimena yaavwundikidwe baivwumbula. = They uncovered the maize grains which were fermented. (1.-vwumbulwa, 2.-vwumbwide, 3.-vwumbuzya, 4.-vwumbwida, 5.-wumbwidalyo, 6.-vwumbulisya, 7.-wumbula-vwumbula, 8.-vwumbulana) Also: -fwundulula.
  • exhume, Mwana wakajaigwa bakamuvwumbula nikwakainda mazuba obile kutegwa mubili upimwe amusilisi. = They exhumed the murdered child after two days so that the state pathologist could examine the body. Also: -vwukkula.
  • disclose a secret, Bantu banji balakaka kuvwumbula maseseke. = Many people refuse to reveal secrets.

renew a field already worked, Bamacembele bakalomba basune nkaambo bayanda kuvwumbulula bulimo bwabo. = The old women asked for oxen to replough their patch. (1.-vwumbululwa, 2.-vwumbulwide, 3.-vwumbuluzya, 4.-vwumbulwida, 5.-vwumbulwidalyo, 6.-vwumbululisya, 7.-vwumbulula-vwumbulula, 8.-wumbululana) Also: -fwunkulula.
  • strip thatch off, unearth, Bapati bavwumbulula cikala cakasimbila. = The elders are unearthing a well which was filled in.

be uncovered, Zitina nzyotwakavwumba jilo, zileelede kuvwumbulwa sunu. The bricks which we covered yesterday, should be uncovered today. (1.-vwumbulwa, 2.-vwumbwide, 3.-vwumbuzya, 4.-vwumbwida, 5.-wumbwidalyo, 6.-vwumbulisya, 7.-wumbulwa-vwumbulwa, 8.-vwumbulana)

admit, (Ila) Ndakavwumina kuti ndime ndakaminsya. = I admitted that I was the one who had caused the pregnancy. Ndakkomana kuti musimbi wandivwumina. I am happy that the girl agreed to my proposal. (1.-vwuminwa, 2.-vwuminide, 3.-vwumizya, 4.-vwuminina, 5.-vwumininalyo, 6.-vwuminisya, 7.-vwumina-vwumina, 8.-vwuminana) Also: -zumina.

rise up against, Mubwa uusondokede bamuvwumpa kumuuma. = They rose up against the mad dog to beat it.(1.-vwumpwa, 2.-vwumpide, 3.-wumpya, 4.-vwumpila, 5.-vwumpilalyo, 6.-vwumpisya, 7.-vwumpa-vwumpa, 8.-vwumpana) Also: -zinga.

snatch, catch suddenly Babwa bakaivwumpila nsima yamwana. = The dogs snatched the nsima of the child. (1.-vwumpilwa, 2.-vwumpide, 3.-vwumpizya, 4.-vwumpilila, 5.-vwumpililalyo, 6.-vwumpilisya, 7.-vwumpila-vwumpila, 8.-vwumpilana)

do without hesitation, so suddenly, Mukaintu wakwe wakavwumuka kwaamba maseseke. = Without hesitation his wife revealed the secrets. (1.-vwumukwa,2.-vwumukide, 3.-vwumukizya, 4.-vwumukila, 5.-vwumukilalyo, 6.-vwumukisya, 7.-vwumuka-vwumuka, 8.-vwumukilana).

do suddenly, Bantu bavwumukila kumujata, nobamvwa kuti nguwakali kubba. = The people suddenly caught him, when they heard that he was the one who was stealing. (1.-vwumukilwa,2.-vwumukide, 3.-vwumukizya, 4.-vwumukilila, 5.-vwumukililalyo, 6.-wumukilisya, 7.-vwumukila-vwumukila, 8.-vwumukilana) Also: -vwuumukila.

protect, save, Ndakamuvwuna nibakali kuyanda kumuuma. = I saved him when they wanted to beat him. (1.-vwunwa, 2.-vwunide, 3.-vwunya, 4.-vwunina, 5.-vwuninalyo, 6.-vwunisya, 7.-vwuna-vwuna, 8.-vwunana)

cover ground closely, as well-grown sweet-potatoes, branch out, Lungu Iwangu Iwavwunaika cinoneezya. My pumpkins covered the ground in a nice way. Also: -tibaika. (1.-vwunaikwa, 2.-vwunaikide, 3.-vwunaisya, 4.-vwunaikila, 5.-vwunaikilalyo, 6.-vwunaikisya, 7.-vwunaika-vwunaika, 8.-vwunaikana)

become crooked, Basankwa balulamika kaluli kakavwunama. The boys straightened the roof which was crooked. (1.-vwunamwa, 2.-vwuneme, 3.-vwunamya, 4.-vwunamina, 5.-vwunaminalyo, 6.-vwunamisya, 7-vwunama-vwunama, 8.-vwunamizyanya)

make weak, Zintu ezi zyakali kuvwunamuna misamu yamuntu yoonse njalide. These things were to make all the medicines weak of the person who ate them. (1.-wunamunwa, 2.-vwunamunide, 3.-vwunamuzya, 4.-vwunamunina, 5.-vwunamuninalyo, 6.-vwunamunisya, 7.-vwunamuna-vwunamuna, 8.-vwunamunana)

protect one another, rt. vwuna, Myaka yanzala bantu banji balavwunana. In years of famine people help one another. (1.-vwunwa, 2.-vwunide 3.-vwunya, 4.-vwunina, 5.-vwuninalyo, 6.-vwunisya, 7.-vwunana-vwunana, 8.-vwunana)
turn papers over, Ndalikuvwunaula mubbuku lipati kuyandaula mpindaalembede makani ako. = I was turning the pages of my big book searching for where I had written your business. Also: -vwunauna.

turn papers over, Basicikolo bakatalika kuvwunauna mabbuku bayi nibakasika. = The pupils started to turn over the pages of the books when the teacher arrived. Also: -vwunaula.
  • change the rhythm of the drum, Musankwa wakali kuuma ngoma wakaivwunauna. = The man who was beating the drum changed the rhythm.

become mouldy, decay, Eeci cinkwa cakavwunda, tacicilikkiki. = This bread has become mouldy, it is no longer edible. Nsilyi nyama yakasasa, yakavwunda. = I do not eat sour meat, it is mouldy. Also: -bunda. (1.-vwundwa, 2.-vwundide, 3.-vwundya, 4.-vwundila, 5.-vwundilalyo, 6.-vwundisya 7.-vwunda-vwunda, 8.-vwundana, I vwundizyanya)
  • dance with trophy in hand, Muvwimi naakajaya syuumbwa, wakakosola mucila, mpoona wakatalika kuvwunda. = When the hunter killed the lion he cut off its tail and danced with it in his hand.
  • mock, as in joking-relationships, Kuvwunda ncilengwa cibelesegwa kapati mubujwanyina. Nkusempuzya. Balacibelesya kapati mumadilwe. = 'Kuvwunda' is a custom in which the traditional joking-relationship is used a lot. It means to ridicule. They use it especially at funerals. Lyakafwa bamaama, mukaintu umwi wakaboola kaangide looye kuka-kuku kaamba kuti niŋombe kuvwunda mubujwanyina. When my mother died, a woman came with a chicken tied to a rope saying it was a cow, to mock accord-ing to the joking-relationship tradition.

make dirty or muddy, Ngulube zyakaavwuundaanya meenda. = The pigs dirtied the water. Also: -kondoola, -fwundanya. (1.-vwundanyizyigwa, 2.-vwundeenye, 3.-vwundaanya, 4.-vwundanyizyizya, 5.-vwundaanyizyizyalyo, 6.-vwuundaanyizyisya, 7.-vwundaanya-vwundaanya, 8.-vwundaanyizyanya)

stoop down to drink direct with mouth, Kovwundama unywe meenda mucikala. = Stoop down and drink the water in the well. (1.-vwundamwa, 2.-vwundeme, 3.-vwundamya, 4.-vwundamina, 5.-vwundaminalyo, 6.-vwundamisya, 7.-vwundama-vwundama, 8.-vwundaminana) Also: -sintama.
  • fall face downwards, Joni wakavwundama nibakamuuma nkoli mumutwe. = Joni fell face downwards when they beat him with a stick on the head. Also: -vwuntama.

turn upside down, lay one down on stomach, lay face down, Kamumuvwundamika mwana, uyanda kuluka. = Lie the child face downwards, it wants to vomit. Also: -vwuntamika. (1.-vwundamikwa, 2.-vwundamikide, 3.-vwundamika, 4.-vwundamikila, 5.vwundamikilalyo, 6.-vwundamikisya, 7.-vwundamika-vwundamika. 8.-vwundamikana)

change position, turn over, Kovwundamuka kutegwa uyoye kabotu. = Turn over so that you can breathe properly. Moota niwakatijaana kapati, wakavwundamuka akujaya bantu botatwe. = When the vehicle was moving at high speed it overturned and killed three people. Cintu ceendela mumulawo ncecintu cisalala alimwi ncecilulama, ncecitavwundamuki kumbele aamazuba. = A thing which comes under the law is clear and again it is just, it is a thing which should not be overturned in future days. cf. -vwuntamuka, -bbindamuka. (1.-vwundamukwa, 2.-vwundamukide, 3.-vwundamusya, 4.-vwundamukila, 5.-vwundamukilalyo, 6.-vwundamukisya, 7.-vwundamuka-vwundamuka, 8.-vwundamukilana)

turn over, turn right side up, Moota watwaalila kuvwundamuna nkaambo twali basyoonto. = We failed to put the car upright because we were few. (1.-vwundamunwa, 2.-vwundamwide, 3.-vwundamuzya, 4.-vwundamwida, 5.-vwundamwidalyo, 6.-vwundamunisya, 7.-vwundamunavwundamuna, 8.-vwundamunana)

be muddy, be turbid, Zisani zyangu zyavwundana mu mankanda. = My clothes have been soiled in the mud. (1.-vwundanwa, 2.-wundanide, 3.-vwundanya, 4.-vwundanina, 5.-vwundaninalyo, 6.-vwundanisya, 7.-vwundana-vwundana, 8.-vwundanizyanya)

make muddy, Mwiingile wakaavwundanya meenda. Nkabela nzovwu yakanywa ayalo meenda akavwundene. = The warthog made the water muddy. However the elephant also drank the muddied water. Also: -vwundaula, -kondoola.

become nauseated, retch, Kumoyo kwangu kulavwundauka. = I have become nauseated. Kwavwundauka kumoyo. = He is retching. (1.-vwundaukwa, 2.-vwundaukide, 3.-vwundausya, 4.-vwundaukila, 5.-vwundaukilalyo, 6.-vwundaukisya, 7.-vwundauka-vwundauka, 8.-vwundausyanya) Also: -vwunduuka.
  • be polluted, as water with mud, Meenda avwundauka bamakaintu nibali kuzela nswi. = The water became muddied when the women were fishing. Also: -kondooka, -vwelauka.

stir water to make it muddy, *Kamuvwundaula meenda tukolwe tutaka.* = Stir up the water so that we choke the fish. (1.-vwundaulwa, 2.-vwundawide, 3.-vwundauzya, 4.-wundawida, 5.-vwundawidalyo, 6.-vwundaulisya, 7.-vwundaula-vwundaula 8.-vwundaulana) Also: -vwundanya, -kondoola.

nauseate, rt.-vwundauka, *Candivwundausya moyo ncakulya catajikwa kabotu.* = What nauseates me is food that is not well cooked. *Malusi avwundausya kumoyo.* = Vomit causes one to be nauseated.
  • be agitated, *Bantu bavwundausya myoyo.* = The people are agitated.

initiate a girl, place her in seclusion, *Ino Mutinta baya kumuvwundika lili?* = When are they going to initiate Mutinta? *Usyi nguuvwundika mwana musimbi wakusaanguna.* = It is the reponsibility of the father to initiate the first daughter. (1.-vwundikwa, 2.-vwundikide, 3.-vwundisya, 4.-vwundikila, 5.-vwundikilalyo, 6.-vwundikisya, 7.-vwundika-vwundika, 8.-vwundikana)
  • store to ripen, *Balimi balubanje baanga misunta yabwizu kuvwundika lubanje.* = Hemp growers tie up grass into bundles where they insert hemp to ripen. *Bamaama bavwundika masuku munongo.* = My mother ripens the masuku fruit in a pot. Also: -vwindika.
  • cover potatoes with embers, *Kamuvwundika cimbwali eeco mutwe lipya kutegwa cabizwa tulye.* = Cover those potatoes in hot ashes so that when they are ready we eat them.
  • cover tobacco with leaves to make it ferment, *Balimi batombwe bakavwundika tombwe kutegwa asubile-subile.* = Tobbaco farmers covered tobacco leaves to ferment them.
  • suppress, keep down, *Kuvwundika twaambo twamanjaka, cileta luumuno.* = To suppress malicious gossip, brings peace.
  • postpone, *Katukavwundika kaambo aka, tuyakukabandika mwezi uuboola.* = Let us postpone this matter, we shall discuss it next month.
  • hold water in mouth, *Mudaala naakayanda kupiilila mwanaakwe, wakavwundika meenda mukanwa.* = When the old man wished to have his daughter married, he held water in the mouth. (in preparation for the ritual handingover.) Also: -vwubata-vwunduka change one's mood or character, become annoyed, *Wakafwambaana kuvwunduka nibakamutukila bakaintu bakwe.* = He quickly changed his mood when his wife insulted him. (1.-vwundukwa, 2.-vwundukide, 3.-vwundusya, 4.-vwundukila, 5.-vwundukilalyo, 6.-vwundukisya, 7.-vwunduka-vwunduka, 8.-vwundukilana)
  • shoot up as child in growth, *Musankwa wakavwunduka muciindi cisyoonto buyo.* = The boy has suddenly grown quickly in a short time.

beat with stick, *Bana bali kuyabuvwundula mume nibali kuya kucikolo.* = The children used to beat the dew from the grass when they were going along to school. *Bavwimi balavwundula muzitewo kuyandaula basulwe.* = The hunters beat the shrubs with sticks searching for hares. Also: -vwuntula. (1.-vwundulwa, 2.-vwundwide, 3.-vwunduzya, 4.-vwundwida, 5.-vwundwidalyo, 6.-vwundulisya, 7.-vwundula-vwundula, 8.-vwundwidana)
  • stir to see if there is anything bad in it, *Katuvwundula cibwantu tubone cili* mukati. = Let us stir the sweet beer so that we see what is inside.
  • show white of eyes, roll eyes, make eyes at, *Musimbi ulavwundula meso kumusankwa ngwayanda.* = The girl makes eyes at the boy she loves. Meso akwe nankolola akali kutuba mbuli mukupa, kuti waavwundula kuli nduwe inga omvwa onse moyo waile kutikila bulowa. = The eyes of the young girl were as white as milk, if she made eyes at you, you would feel as if your whole heart would shed blood.

bend down to take cover, *Musankwa wakavwundulata kunze aacitewo kuyuba syuumbwa.* = The boy took cover behind the shrub to hide from the lion. (1.-vwundulatwa, 2.-wundulete, 3.-wundulatizya, 4.-wundulatila, 5.-vwundulatilalyo, 6.-wundulatisya, 7,-vwundulatavwundulata, 8.-vwundulatilana) Also: -vwuntama.

remove after fermentation, *Bavwundulula mapopwe sunu ngibaavwundikide.* = They have removed the maize today which they had fermented. Also: -fwundulula. (1.-wwundululwa, 2.-vwundulwide, 3.-vwunduluzya, 4.-vwundulwida, 5.-wundulwidalyo, 6.-vwundululisya, 7.-vwundulula-vwundulula, 8.-vwundulwidana)
  • have many clothes for changing, *Musimbi ooyu ujisi zisani zinji zyakuvwundulula.* This girl has many clothes to change from time to time.

have an unpleasant look, *Ino wanyemena nzi ncavwundumana?* = Now what has angered him so that he has such an unpleasant look? (1.-vwundumanwa, 2.-vwundumene, 3.-vwundumika, 4.-vwundumanina, 5.-vwundumaninalyo, 6.-vwundumanisya, 7.-wwundumana-vwundumana, 8.-vwundumaninana)

spring into action suddenly, spring from sleep like a hare, *Naakabuka wakavwundumuka buya mbuli kasulwe.* = When he rose he was like a hare springing up from sleep. *Wakavwundumuka munyati, nguwena wakayasidwe.* = The same buffalo that was wounded, suddenly jumped out. (1.-vwundumukwa, 2.-vwundumukide, 3.-vwundumusya, 4.-vwundumukila, 5.-vwundumukilalyo, 6.-vwundumukisya, 7.-vwundumuka-vwundumuka, 8.-vwundumukilana)
pounce upon, *Syaanza wavwundumukila kanamusya.* = The lion suddenly sprang upon the duiker.

wake up from sleep, *Caande wakoona mumfwukula alimwi naakapiluka kukususula akuvwundunuka aludimadima.* = The frog slept in the hole again when it came back from lunch and woke up when it was getting dark. (1.-vwundunukwa, 2.-vwundunukide, 3.-vwundunusya, 4.-vwundunukila, 5.-vwundunukilalyo, 6.-vwundunukisya, 7.-vwundunuka-vwundunuka, 8.-vwundunusyanya)

stir up something, *Mwiingile wakausa nkaambo nguwaavwundununa munsyundu wakaluma nzowu munsingo.* = The warthog was sorry because he was the one who stirred the water up and then the leech bit the elephant on the neck. (1.-vwundununwa, 2.-vwundunwide, 3.-vwundunuzya, 4.-vwundunwida, 5.-vwundunwidalyo, 6.-vwundununisya, 7.-vwundununavwundununa, 8.-vwundununana)

make dirty as water, *Kamuvwundunya meenda zikolwe nswi.* = Make the water dirty to choke the fish. (1.-vwundunyizyigwa, 2.-vwundunyizyizye, 3.-wundunya, 4.-vwundunyizyizya, 5.-vwundunyizyizyalyo, 6.-vwundunyizyisya, 7.-vwundunya-vwundunya, 8.-vwundunyizyanya) Also: -vwunduula.

be nauseated, Kulavwunduuka kumoyo, njanda kuluka. = I feel nauseated, I want to vomit. (1.-vwunduukwa, 2.-vwunduukide, 3.-vwunduusya, 4.-vwunduukila, 5.-wunduukilalyo, 6.-vwunduukisya, 7.-vwunduuka-vwunduuka, 8.-vwuundukizyanya) Also: -vwundauka.
tuck in, fold, wrap up, curl up, sit with feet drawn inwards, Koli
maulu wakkala kutegwa kotaminwi. = Tuck in your legs when you are sitting so that you do not grow tired.

mapayi tuye kukulila. = Wrap up the blankets, let us go to a funeral. *Chuungabuluba tanaakavwunga* moyo, wakabatambula boonse bakamutandide kumunzi. = Chuungabuluba did not want to take revenge, she received all those who had driven her out of the village. Also: -peta. (1.-vwungwa, 2.-vwngide, 3.-vwungizya, /

4.-vwungila, 5.-vwungilalyo, 6.-vwungisya, 7.-vwunga-vwunga, 8.-vwungilana)
  • clench the fist, *Wakavwunga cituku,/intuku.* = He clenched his fist.
  • form tassels, as maize, *Mapopwe* *atalika kale kuvwunga ngala.* = The maize has already started to tassel. Also: -langala
wrap up, fold in, conceal things in bundle, rt. -vwunga, Kamu

zipego zyanabwiinga mutupepa. = Wrap up the gifts for the bride in pieces of paper. *Mwana bamuvwungaila* *mumi-lembo.* = They wrapped up the child in clothes. (1.-vwungailwa, 2.-vwungailide, 3.-vwungaizya, 4.-vwungailila, 5.-wungaililalyo, 6.-vwungailisya, 7.-vwungaila-vwungaila, 8.-vwungailana)

shrivel up, contract, confine, *Cavwungana cisani mbuli kuti* *tiicaccisigwa.* = The cloth shrivelled up as if it had not been ironed. *Maulu aangu* *avwungana, ndakkala kaindi.* = My legs have contracted, I have been sitting for a long time. *Kamwale wakavwungana ku-* *kkala ciindi cilamfwu murnanda.* = The girl under initiation was confined for a long time in the house. (1.-vwunganwa, 2.-wungene, 3.-vwunganya, 4.-vwunganina, 5.-vwunganinalyo, 6.-vunganisya, 7.-vwungana-vwungana, 8.-vwungana) Also: -kokonyana, -fwinyana, -onyana.
contract into folds, make short, *Moonde wakacivwunganya* *cisani naakakkede acuuno.* = Moonde folded up her dress when she was sitting on the chair. (1.-vwunganyizyigwa...)
