be folded up. rt.-vwunga, *Buluke bwakwe bwakalivwungidwe* *kumagondo.* = His trousers were folded up at the knees.
clench, *Twakali kuci-* *konzya kukona kakwiina akuvwungilana* *mafwaindi mbuli mazuba ano.* = We were able to inherit without clenching fists at one another as is done nowadays.
fold up for, Komu

mapayi mweenzinyoko. = Fold up the blankets for your friend. (1.-vwungililwa, 2.-vwungilide, 3.-vwungililizya, 4.-vwungililila, 5.-vwungilililayo, 6.-vwungililisya, 7.-vwungilila-vwungilila, 8.-vwungililana)

be opened out, *Avwunguluka kale mapayi.* = The blankets are already opened out. (1.-vwungulukwa, 2.-vwungulukide, 3.-vwungulukizya, 4.-vwungulukila, 5.-vwungulukilalyo, 6.-vwungulukisya, 7.-vwunguluka-vwunguluka, 8.-vwungulukana)

unwrap, open a letter, unroll, *Katuvwungulula mapayi tuyale* bulo. = Let us open out the blankets so that we make the bed. Also: -putununa (1.-wungululwa, 2.-wungulwide, 3.-vwunguluzya, 4.-vwungulwida, 5.-wungulwidalyo, 6.-vwungululisya, 7.-wungulula-vwungulula, 8.-vwungululana)

= be gloomy, be stupid, *Ncavwungumana munene nkaambo wakajatwa bulozi.* = The reason which makes the old man dejected is that he was caught practicing witchcraft. (1.-vwungumanwa, 2.-vwungumene, 3.-wungumanya, 4.-vwungumanina, 5.-vwungumaninalyo, 6.-vwungumanisya, 7.-wungumana-vwungumana, 8.-vwungumaninana)

= cover pot with lid, *Kovwunika ampoto aawo kutanjili mpongo.* = Cover the pot so that the goat does not get into it. *Ncibotu kuvwunika cakulya ciindi coonse.* = It is good to cover food always. (1.-vwunikwa, 2.-vwunikide, 3.-vwunisya, 4.-vwunikila, 5.-wunikilalyo, 6.-vwunikisya, 7.-vwunika-vwunika, 8.-vwunikana)
  • close book, *Basicikolo bakavwunika mabbuku aabo akuzwa anze.* = The pupils closed their books and went outside.
  • postpone a mourning, *Dilwe lyasibbuku bakalivwunika kwategwa kunyina mbobakonzya kulila bantu bobilo mumunzi ngumunya.* = They postponed the funeral of the headman saying that there was no way by which they could mourn two people in the same village. *Dilwe lyamwami talyeelede kuvwunikwa.* = The funeral of the chief should not be postponed.

= cover as clouds, *Zuba talicilibonyi, makumbi avwunikila.* = The sun is no longer to be seen, the clouds have covered over. *Mangoye bamuvwunikila mucitala.* = They closed the cat up in the maize bin. (1.-vwunikilwa, 2.-vwunikilide, 3.-vwunikilizya, 4.-vwunikilila, 5.-vwunikililalyo, 6.-vwunikilisya, 7.-vwunikila-vwunikila, 8.-vwunikilana)
  • cover for me, *Mwana wakaka kundivwunikila cakulya.* = The child refused to cover the food for me.
  • clap as at rain-shrine, *Kumalende balavwunikila nobalomba mvwula.* = At the rainshrine they clap with hollowed palms when praying for rain.

= protect against, rt. vwuna, *Akaambo kakuti tiindalubizya, balandivwuninina bantu bamwi balupati-pati.* = As I have not done anything wrong, some of the older ones will protect me. *Banyina bavwuninina mwana wabo.* = The mother protects her child against harm. *Ulamubisya mwana oyu kuti komuvwuninina.* = You will spoil this child if you over-protect her. (1.-vwunininwa, 2.-vwuninide, 3.-vwuninizya, 4.-vwuninina, 5.-vwuninininalyo, 6.-vwunininisya, 7.-vwuninina-vwunininina, 8.-vwunininana)

= dig up, *Bacivwunkula cimbwali kuzwa kunsi.* = They have dug up the sweet-potatoe from underneath. *Bakamuvwunkula muntu wakazikkidwe kale.* = They dug up a person who had already been buried. (1.-vvwunkulwa, 2.-vwunkwide, 3.-vwunkuzya, 4.-vwunkwida, 5.-vwunkwidalyo, 6.-vwunkulisya, 7.-vwunkula-vwunkula, 8.-vwunkulana)

= scoop out, *Bana bavwunkulula ndongwe zyakali kucaala.* = The children are scooping out the ground-nuts which remained. (1.-vwunkululwa, 2.-vwunkulwide, 3.-vwunkuluzya, 4.-vwunkulwida, 5.-vwunkulwidalyo, 6.-vwunkululisya, 7.-vwunkulula-vwunkulula, 8.-vwunkululana) Also: -fwukulula.
= beat as a carpet, (1.vwunkumunwa, 2.-vwunkumwide, 3.-vwunkumuzya, 4.-vwunkumwida, 5.-wunkumwidalyo, 6.-vwunkumunisya, 7.-vwunkumuna-vwunkumuna, 8.-vwunkumunana) Also: -vwukumuna

unearth, dig out, Vwunkununa cintu ncoovwumbila ansi aawa. Unearth the thing you buried there on the ground. Musankwa uvwunkununa cikala cakasimbila. The boy is uncovering a well that was filled in. Muntu wakazikkidwe mazuba obilo bakamuvwunkununa. They exhumed the person who had been burried for two days. (1.-vwunkununwa, 2.-vwunkunwide, 3.-vwunkunuzya, 4.-vwunkunwida, 5.-vwunkunwidalyo, 6.-vwunkununisya, 7.-vwunkununa-vwunkumuna, 8.-vwunkunwidana)

munch, Ingulube ilavwunkunya kulya ciindi coonse. = The pig is munching food all the time. (1.-vwunkunyigwa, 2.-vwunkunyide, 3.-vwunkunyizya, 4.-vwunkunyina, 5.-wunkunyinalyo, 6.-vwunkunyisya, 7.-wunkunya-wunkunya, 8.-vwunkunyana)

dodge, Mainza naakafwusa sumo, Muleya wakalivwunta. = When Mainza threw a spear, Muleya dodged. (1.-vwuntwa, 2.-vwuntide, 3.-vwuntya, 4.-vwuntila, 5.-vwuntilalyo, 6.-wuntisya, 7.-wunta-vwunta, 8.-vwuntilana)

be turned upside down, Cimbayambaya nicakapwaya abbwe munzila cakavwuntama. = When the vehicle hit a stone on the road, it turned upside down. (1.-vwuntamwa, 2.-vwuntamide, 3.-vwuntamya, 4.-vwuntamina, 5.-vwuntaminalyo, 6.-vwuntamisya, 7.-vwuntama-vwuntama, 8.-vwuntaminana)
  • lie on stomach, Wakavwuntama ansi kumane woona. = He lay on his stomach on the ground and finally fell asleep. Also: -vwundama.
  • crouch on ones hands and knees, Bana bavwuntama kuyuba bazyali. = The children are crouching down to hide from the parents. Also: -vwundulata.

turn over face down or upside down, Kamwiivwuntamika mpoto eeyo. Turn that pot upside down. Maliya uvwuntamika zibiya nzyabumba. Maliya turns the pots upside down which she makes. Also: -vwundamika,-dingamika,-gununa, -dingamuna. (1.-vwuntamikwa, 2.-vwuntamikide, 3.-vwuntamikizya, 4.-vwuntamikila, 5.-vwuntamikilalyo, 6.-vwuntamikisya, 7.-vwuntamika-vwuntamika, 8.-vwuntamikana)

prostrate before, Bana bavwuntamina usyi naasika. = The children prostrated before the father when he arrived. (1.-vwuntaminwa, 2.-vwuntamide, 3.-vwuntaminizya, 4.-wuntaminina, 5.-vwuntamininalyo, 6.-vwuntaminisya, 7.-vwuntaminavwuntamina, 8.-vwutaminana)

turn over, Muntu wavwuntamuka kale wavwunteme. = The person who was lying face downwards has already turned over on his back. Mootokala wavwuntamuka niwamana kupwaya acisamu. = The car turned over when it hit a tree. (1.-vwuntamukwa, 2.-vwuntamukide, 3.-vwuntamukizya, 4.-wuntamukila, 5.-vwuntamukilalyo, 6.-wuntamukisya, 7.-vwuntamukavwuntamuka, 8.-vwuntamukana) Also: -sandamuna, -salamuna.

turn against, Bantu bacisi bakaivwuntamukila mfwulumende akaambo kakutasyomeka kwabasololi. The people of the country turned against the government because of the corruption of the leaders. (1.-vwuntamukilwa, 2.-vwuntamukilide, 3.-vwuntamukizya, 4.-wuntamukilila, 5.-vwuntamukililalyo, 6.-vwuntamukilisya, 7.-wuntamukila-vwuntamukila, 8.-vwuntamukilana)
  • change whole situation, Wakaliwubide kumane zyamuvwuntamukila zintu wacetaala. = He was rich but then things changed completely and he was left poor. Mweenzuma wandivwuntamukila ngutwakayanzene. = My friend, with whom I was on such good terms, changed completely towards me.

turn over, Kovwuntamuna cibiya cavwuntamikidwe ubikke cibwantu. = Turn the pot right side up which was turned upside down and put sweet beer in it. (1.-vwuntamunwa, 2.-vwuntamwide, 3.-vwntamunzya, 4.-wuntamwida, 5.-vwutamwidalyo, 6.-vwuntamunisya, 7.-vwuntamunavwuntamuna, 8.-vwuntamunana)

beat a fire out, Balikuvwuntaula aziteyo kusola kuzima mulilo. = They were beating the fire with bushes to put it out. (1.-vwuntaulwa, 2.-vwuntawide, 3.-vwuntauzya, 4.-wuntawida, 5.-vwuntamwidalyo, 6.-vwuntaulisya, 7.-vwuntaula-vwuntaula, 8.-vwuntaulana)
  • search for information, Kakunyina kuvwuntaula tamukwe kwaazyiba maseseke. = Without a search for information you will not know what is hidden.

investigate, rt. -vwuntaula, Bamasilikani bakafwambaana kutalika kuvwuntauzya kaambo kalufwu Iwa Chimuka. = The police quickly began to investigate the case of Chimuka's death. Bazyali ba Mpabuka bakatalika kuvwuntauzya mukwasyi wamusimbi mbowakabede. = The parents of Mpabuka began to investigate to find out what the family of the girl was like. Also: -una-una. (1.-vwuntauzyigwa, 2.-vwuntauzyide, 3.-vwuntauzyizya, 4.-vwuntauzyila, 5.-wuntauzyilalyo, 6.-wuntauzyisya, 7.-wuntauzya-vwuntauzya, 8.-vwuntauzyanya)

pounce on, Syuumbwa uvwuntila nombe ciindi mucende nawona. = The lion pounces on a cow when the bull is asleep. Also: -vwampila. (1.-vwuntwa, 2.-vwuntide, 3.-vwuntya, 4.-vwuntila, 5.-vwuntilalyo, 6.-vwuntisya, 7.-vwuntila-vwuntila, 8.-vwuntilana)

beat with a stick, Bamuvwuntula Nchembele acisako. = They beat Nchembele with a stick. Bavwimi balavwuntula muzitewo. = The hunters are beating the bushes with sticks. (1.-vwuntulwa, 2.-vwuntwide, 3.-vwuntuzya, 4.-vwuntwida, 5.-vwuntwidalyo, 6.-vwuntulisya, 7.-vwuntula-vwuntula, 8.-vwuntulana) Also: -vwundula.

be taken down, as roof by wind, Cakavwunuka ciluli carnanda. = The roof was taken down by the wind. Ciluli cabutala cavwunuka. = The roof of the granary has been taken by the wind. (1.-vwunukwa, 2.-vwunukide, 3.-vwunukizya, 4.-vwunukila, 5.-vwunukilalyo, 6.-vwunukisya, 7.-vwunuka-vwunuka, 8.-vwunukilana)

take the lid off, Kovwununa mupika oyo ndange ciliko mukati. = Take the lid off that pot so that I see what is inside. Kovwununa ngowani yako. = Take off your hat. Also: -nabula. (1.-vwununwa,2.-vwunwide, 3.-vwunuzya 4.-vwunwida, 5.-vwunwidalyo, 6.-vwunuisya, 7.-vwununa-vwununa, 8.-vwununana)
  • reveal a secret, Kuvwununa bulale bwamuntu ncibi. = To reveal the adultery of a person is bad.
  • wag, wriggle, shake, Tanga lyabazovwu lileebeka, alo kuti lyazyikuvwununa matwi, pe cilanoneezya kweebela. = A herd of elephants are admirable, and if they move the ears it is wonderful to watch.
search in detail (1.-wunungulwa, 2.-vwunungwide, 3.-vwununguzya, 4.-vwunungwida, 5.-vwunungwidalyo, 6.-vwunungulisya, 7.-vwunungula-vwunungula, 8.-vwunungwidana)
stuff the mouth with food, Twajana mudaala uvwunyunga nyama ciindi camafwumofwumo. = We found the old man stuffing meat into his mouth in the early morning.

search, Basikalumamba bakanjila munanda yamudaala akuvwunyungula munanda yoonse mboibede. The soldiers entered the house of the old man and searched the whole house. Watalika kuvwunyungula tubbudu twamiyanda kusikila wakajana musamu. = He searched through all the bundles of roots until he found the medicine.
  • twist, Mbuno yakali kulivwunyungulwa. In the mbuno dance the hips are twisted.

turn over pages, Basicikolo bavwunuula mabbuku mucikolo. = The pupils in the school are turning over the pages of books. Also: -vwunauna. (1.-vwunuulwa, 2.-vwunwiide, 3.-vwunuuzya, 4.-vwunwiida, 5.-vwumwiidalyo, 6.-vwunuulisya. 7.-wunuula-vwunuula, 8.-vwunuulana)

open, Nkukuvwunwida ndulumina wabbuku, I will open a very big book for you.
  • justify oneself, *Ndakalivwunya* mulomo kukaambo katako. I vindicated myself from a false accusation.

cram mouth with food, Sinzala uvwunyunga buya kulya mangamwe. A hungry person crams the mouth when eating boiled maize grains. (1.-wwunyungwa, 2.-vwunyungide, 3.-vwunyungizya, 4.-vwunyunganina, 5.-vwunyunganinalyo, 6.-vwunyunganisya, 7.-vwunyunga-vwunyunga, 8.-vwunyunganinana)

search about, *Uvwunyungula nzi muzintu zyangu webo?* = What are you searching for among my things? *Ino uvwunyungula nzi munanda omo?* = What are you searching for there in the house? Also: -fwulunga. (1.-vwunyungulwa, 2.-vwunyungwide, 3.-vwunyunguzya, 4.-vwunyungwida, 5.-vwunyungwidalyo, 6.-vwunyungulisya, 7.-vwunyungula-vwunyungula, 8.-vwunyungulana)

strip off small branches, Baugonka cakuuvwunzaula musamu ulya basankwa aba. These boys have stripped the branches off that tree. (1.-vwunzaulwa, 2.-vwunzawide, 3.-vwunzauzya, 4.-vwunzawida, 5.-vwunzawidalyo, 6.-vwunzaulisya, 7.-vwunzaula-vwunzaula, 8.-vwunzaulana)
  • skin, Baivwunzaula nzoka yafwa kale. They skined the snake which was already dead. Also: -fwunzaula.
drive off as flies, Balikulivwupaula nziniini, ncibali kutambaika-tambaika. They were driving off the flies, that is why they were waving their hands about. (1.-vwupaulwa,

protect with, rt. -vwuna Takukwe ucaala kukuvwola zilwanyo zyakulivwunya nkondo zyamunyika. There is no one left to be given weapons to protect oneself against the battles of the world. *Ndakalivwunya* maulu syuumbwa naakali kunditanda. I saved myself from the lion when it was chasing me by using my legs. (1.-vwunwa, 2.-vwunide, 3.-vwunya, 4.-vwunina, 5.-vwuninalyo, 6.-vwunisya, 7.-vwunya-vwunya, 8.-vwunana) 2.-vwupawide, 3.-vwupauzya, 4.-vwupawida, 5.-wupawidalyo, 6.-vwupaulisya, 7.-vwupaula-vwupaula 8.-vwupaulana) Also: -fwisaula,-vwupuula.
  • wave about, *Ndakavwupaula maanza kwiimika moota.* = I was waving my hands to stop the vehicle. *Mwana ciindi naatumbukwa weelede kulila aboobo kuti talili balavwupaula cisani kumeso kwakwe kutegwa apempenuke kuti kali walinetukide.* = When the child comes out it ought to cry and so if it does not cry they wave a cloth in front of its eyes so that it recovers consciousness if it has fainted.
  • beat a fire out, *-vwupaula,* Also: *-uula, -vwuntaula.*

wag or wave about, *Inombe zivwupuula micila nozicela.* = Cattle shake their tails about when they are grazing. *Munanga wakavwupuula mucila wamunyati (jingo) amutwe wamuIwazi.* = The witchdoctor waved the tail of the buffalo over the head of the patient. Also: *-vwupaula, -fwisaula.* (1.-vwupuulwa, 2.-vwupwiide, 3.-vwupuuzya, 4.-vwupwiida, 5.-wupwiidalyo, 6.-vwupuulisya, 7.-wupuula-vwupuula, 8.-vwupuulana)

spring as a trap, *Tuyuni notubungana kugoma busenga ansi, umwi ulalukwela lukole canguzu, eelyo civwupu cavwupuka civwupula tuyuni tunji akutujaya.* = When the little birds gather to peck at the chaff on the ground, one pulls the string of the trap with force, thereupon the trap is activated and pulls them away with force and kills them.

snatch, *Kayinga kavwupula kana kankuku.* = The falcon snatched the chick. (1.-vwupulwa, 2.-vwupwide, 3.-vwupuzya, 4.-vwupwida, 5.-vwupwidalyo, 6.-vwupulisya, 7.-wupula-vwupula, 8.-vwupulana)
  • slap face, *Bamuvwupula lubayi Iwakunze lomwe.* = He slapped him once with the back of his hand. *Munene wakavwupula mukaintu lubayi.* = The old man slapped his wife in the face.. Also: *-pwaya lubayi.*
  • pass by, *Basankwa balikuya ku Monze, tiibaima ano bavwupula_buyo.* = The boys who were going to Monze, did not stop here but just passed through quickly.

roar, bellow as cattle, *Mucende wabona butanga bumbi ulavwuta nkaambo uyanda kulwana.* = A bull who sees another herd of cattle bellows because it wants to fight. *Sokwe wakavwuta mukalundu.* = The monkey cried out in the hill. (1.-vwutwa, 2.-vwutide, 3.-vwutya, 4.-vwutila, 5.-vwutilalyo, 6.-vwutisya, 7.-vwuta-vwuta, 8.-vwutilana) Also: *-boba.*
  • be alight, *Kouleka kuufwulida mulilo, wavwuta kale.* = Stop blowing on the fire, it is already alight.
  • hide, *Sokwe wakavwuta mukalundu.* = The monkey was hiding in the hill. Also: *-vwunta, -yuba.*
  • play as a child, *Mwana ulavwuta, uladidima mbuli ndeke.* = The child is playing, it is making a heavy sound like an aeroplane.

blaze on and off, *Mulilo wakazumanana kuvwutauka.* = The fire continued blazing on and off. (1.-vwutaukwa, 2.-vwutaukide, 3.-vwutausya, 4.-vwutaukila, 5.-vwutaukilalyo, 6.-vwutaukisya, 7.-vwutauka-vwutauka, 8.-vwutausyanya)

wave as a flag, *Wakavwutausya ndembela kutambula muleli.* = He waved the flag to welcome the leader. (1.-vwutausyigwa, 2.-vwutausyide, 3.-vwutausya, 4.-vwutausyizya, 5.-vwutausyizyalyo, 6.-vwutausyisya, 7.-vwutausya-vwutausya 8.-vwutausyanya) cf. *-wupaula.*
blow on, *Vwutila muya amulilo uyake.* = Blow air on the fire so that it lights up. (1.vwutilwa, 2.-vwutilide, 3.-vwutizya, 4.-vwutilila, 5.-vwutililalyo, 6.-vwutilisya, 7.-vwutila-vwutila,
Also: -fwulida.

blaze, spread as fire, *Wavwutuka mulilo kuyaka cakuti bantu boonse bayoowa kusika munsi.* = The fire was blazing so much that all the people were afraid to draw near. *Mulilo wavwutuka, utauzimi limbi.* = The fire is blazing, do not put it out again. Also: -vwutauka. (1.-wwutukwa, 2.-vwutukide, 3.-vwutukizya, 4.-vwutukila, 5.-vwutukilalyo, 6.-wutukisya, 7.-vwutuka-vwutuka, 8.-vwutukilana)
  • spring up as a disease, *Uuno mwaka avwutuka malwazi manji.* = This year many diseases have sprung up.

ignite, *Kamuvwutula mulilo tufwule keembe.* = Make a blazing fire so that we sharpen the axe-blade. (1.-vwutulwa, 2.-vwutwide, 3.-vwutuzya, 4.-vwutwida, 5.-vwutwidalyo, 6.-wutulisya, 7.-vwutula-vwutula, 8.-vwutwidana) Also: -kutula, -kunka.

froth at the mouth, *Musune walikuvwututa makovwu nkaambo lutambo Iwalimudinide.* = The ox was frothing at the mouth because the rope was choking it. (1.-wututwa, 2.-vwututide, 3.-vwututya, 4.-vwututila, 5.-vwututilalyo, 6.-vwututisya 7.-vwututa-vwututa, 8.-vwututilana)
  • ferment as beer, *Bukoko bwafwuma kuvwututa cicili cifwumo-fwumo.* = The beer fermented early when it was sill in the morning. Also: -fwututa.

be in full blossom, = *Avwuuka masamu, imvwula iyanda kuboola.* = The trees are in full blossom, the rain is about to come. (1.-vwuukwa, 2.-vwuukide, 3.-vwuusya, 4.-vwuukila, 5.-vwuukilalyo, 6.-vwuukisya, 7.-vwuuka-vwuuka, 8.-vwuukizyanya)
be in state of full foliage, *Banyama bakalilede mumasamu aakavwuukide kabotu.* = The animals were lying among the shady trees.
prostitute oneself, *Basimbi a basankwa bakaindi tiibakali kuyanda kuvwuula.* The boys and girls of the past di not want to be promiscuous.

turn around, *Wakavwuuluka buyo Choopa wagama kwaakkede Choonde.* Choopa just turned around and went where Choonde was seated. *Mupovwo wakavwuuluka cabukali.* The bull turned around angrily. *Musankwa naakamana kukanana, musimbi wakaide kumweta-mweta wavwuuluka weenda.* When the boy had finished talking, the girl just smiled and turned and walked away. (1.-vwuulusyigwa, 2.-vwuulukide, 3.-vwuulukizya, 4.-vwuulukila, 5.-vwuulukilalyo, 6.-vwuulukisya, 7.-wuuluka-vwuuluka, 8.-wuulusyanya)

turn around to, rt. -vwuuluka, *Buumba mbwaakavwuulukila buyo kuti azwe mumeenda, ciwena nkumujata akuboko.* = As soon as Buumba turned around to get out of the water, the crocodile caught him by the arm. *Mwami wakavwuulukila kuli Mainza akumutondeka munwe mpaakakkede akutalika kumubwentela.* The chief turned to Mainza where he was sitting and pointing his finger at him and began to scold him.

roar or rumble, *Imvwula ilavwuuma niiboola.* = The rain thunders when it comes. *Citima cakavwuuma mubila.* = The train let out a piercing whistle. Also: -wuuma. (1.-vwuumwa, 2.-vwuumide, 3.-vwuumya 4.-vwuumina, 5.-wuuminalyo, 6.-vwuumisya, 7.-vwuuma-vwuuma, 8.-vwuuminana or -vwuumizyanya)
  • talk about, *Bulandivwuuma buleya boonse.* = The whole crowd is talking about me. (accusing me)

seize instantly, *Basankwa bamuvwuumana musimbi akumutizya.* The boys suddenly grabbed the girl and took her away by force for marriage. Also: -vwumpa, -vwampila. (1.-wuumanwa, 2.-vwuumene, 3.-wuumanizya, 4.-vwuumanina, 5.-wuumaninalyo, 6.-vwuumanisya, 7.-wuumana-vwuumana, 8.-wuumaninana)
rush at, -vwuumikila kujata = seize instantaneously, Basankwa bobilo bakamuvwuumukila musimbi akumujata. = The two boys rushed at the girl and seized her. Also: -vwumana

charge at, rush to do, Pita naakanyema wakavwuumuka kuya kukulwana. When Peter was angry he rushed off to fight. Mukulaba kwaliso Malita wakavwuumuka akumujata Mutinta mwali munsingo. In a blink of the eye Malita charged and caught Mutinta by the throat. (1.-vwuumukwa, 2.-wuumukide, 3.-vwuumukizya, 4.-wuumukila, 5.-vwuumukilalyo, 6.-vwuumukisya, 7.-vwuumukawuumuka, 8.-vwuumukilana)
  • fall from a height, Igabo lyakawuumuka akuwida amutwe wamusankwa wakali kweembela. = The wildapple dropped down from on high and fell on the head of the herder.

rush to, e.g Bavwuumukila kukulanga uciswa kwa Nkandela. = They rushed to see who was sick at Nkandela. Buleya bwakavwuumukila kumuntu wakaamba kabotu. The people rushed to the person who spoke well. Kainga kakavwuumukila kana kankuku. = The hawk swopped down on the chick. Also: -vwumukila.

lie flat without showing head, Mwana wakavwuwwumana mumapayi. The child lay flat in the blankets without showing its head. (1.-wwuwwumanwa, 2.-vwuvwumene, 3.-wwuwwumanya, 4.-wuvwumanina, 5.-wuvwumaninalyo, 6.-vwuvwumanisya, 7.-vuwwwumana-vwuvwumana, 8.-vwwwumaninana)

prophesy, Sicibende wakali kuvwuvwunga. = Sicibende was prophesying. (1.-vwuvwungwa, 2.-vwuvwungide, 3.-vwvwunganya, 4.-vwuvwungila, 5.-vwuvwungilalyo, 6.-wwwwungisya, 7.-vwuvwunga-vwuwwunga, 8.-vwvwunganinana) Also: -sinsima

foretell, Ino banjidwe bavwuvwuta kuti mvwula ili buti kono? = What kind of rain do those who are possessed foretell for this year? (1.-vwuvwutwa, 2.-vwuvwutide, 3.-vwuvwutya, 4.-vwuvwutila, 5.-vwuvwutilalyo, 6.-vwuvwutisya, 7.-vwuvwuta-vwuvwuta, 8.-vwuvwutilana) Also: -sinsima.
answer, Kovwuwa, balaita bapati. Answer, the elders are calling. (1.-vwuugwa, 2.-vwuwide, 3.-vwiizya, 4.-vwuwila, 5.-vwuwilalyo, 6.-vwuwisya, 7.-vwuwa-vwuwa, 8.-vwuwana)

think ill of, whisper. Sibunjaka ulayanda kuvwuya. A troublemaker likes to speak ill about people. (1.-vwuyigwa, 2.-vwuyide, 3.-vwuyizya, 4.-vwuyila, 5.-vwuyilalyo, 6.-vwuyisya, 7.-vwuya-vwuya, 8.-vwuyana) cf. -vwiya.

increase, rt. -vwula, Kovwuzya nsima nkaambo ndaa nzala sunu. Increase the amount of nsima because I am very hungry today. (1.-vwuzyigwa, 2.-vwuzyide, 3.-vwuzyizya, 4.-vwuzyila, 5.-vwuzyilalyo, 6.-vwuzyisya, 7.-vwuzya-vwuzya, 8.-vwuzyanya)

be plentiful, Inkuku kuti zyavwuzyanya zinjililwa malwazi. = If the chickens are plentiful, they are subject to diseases. Bantu basunu bavwuzyanya anga mbaasimunyewu. = The people of today are as plentiful as ants. Cibi cavwuzyanya, canunka nsu! = Evil is rampant, it stinks terribly.

fall, Wawa mwana, kamumubusya. = The child has fallen, lift it up. Masuku awa ansi alikke ngaanona. = Masuku fruits which have fallen down by themselves are sweet. (1.-wisigwa, 2.-wide, 3.-wisya, 4.-wida, 5.-widalyo, 6.-wisya, 7.-wa-wa, 8.-wisyanya)
  • (idiomatic usage) Bana nibakasowa nombe, (nkondo) yakabawa yacilimo munene naakanyema kapati. = When the children lost the cattle, they were showered with very angry words when the old man became very furious.

throw, Nitwali kugubba twali kuliwaala mumeenda. = When we were swimming we were throwing ourselves into the water. kuliwaala muzinga = to cast oneself full length; kuwaala nkakata = to throw dice, Uusonda uwaala nkakata. = The one who divines throws the dice. (1.-waalwa, 2.-waalide, 3.-waazya, 4.-waalila, 5.-waalilalyo, 6-waalisya, 7.-waala-waala, 8.-waalana)
  • put oneself in danger, Akaambo kakukaka kulaigwa, wakaliwaala muntenda. = Because of refusing to be advised, he has put himself in danger.

throw with, rt. -wa Wakabelesya kkwisyo kuwaazya bbwe. = He used a sling to cast a stone.
  • free cattle after harvest, Bantu balaleka kweembela nombe nibamana kutebula, baziwaazya buyo mulukuba. = People stop herding cattle when they finish harvesting, they just let them lose into the fields to feed on maize stalks.

rustle, Nindamvwa ciwakama mumusamu, ndayoowa kapati. = When I heard something rustling in the tree, I feared greatly. (1.-wakamwa, 2.-wakeme, 3.-wakamya, 4.-wakamina, 5.-wakaminalyo, 6.-wakamisya, 7.-wakama-wakama, 8.-wakaminana)
cause to rustle, Mpawo wakamvwa ciwakamya matuvwu mumasamu mukalonga kasiya mbi. Thereupon he heard something causing the leaves in the trees to rustle in the very dark stream.

speak to, Naakapwaya nsuwa, bausyi bakamwaambawida cabukali. = When he broke the gourd, his father spoke to him angrily. (1.-wambawidwa, 2.-wambawide, 3.-wambawizya, 4.-wambawida, 5.-wambawidalyo, 6.-wambailisya, 7.-wambawida-wambawida, 8.-wambawidana) Also: -wambwiida, -ambawida.

talk to, Musilisi uwambwiida balwazi makani aakakweekwe. The doctor is talking to patients on matters concerning tuberculosis. (1.-wambwiidwa, 2.-wambwiide, 3.-wambwiizya, 4.-wambwiida, 5.-wambwiidalyo, 6.-wambwiilisya, 7.-wambwiida-wambwiida, 8.-wambwiidana) Also: -wambawida.

suffer pain acutely, Cifwumu cilawanta mubili onse. = Chicken-pox inflicts pain on the whole body. Tiindali koona kabotu, nkaambo mutwe wakali kuwanta masiku oonse. = I was not sleeping well because my head was paining the whole night. (1.-wantwa, 2.-wantide, 3.-wantya, 4.-wantila, 5.-wantilalyo, 6.-wantisya, 7.-wanta-wanta, 8.-wantizyanya)

be unwilling, hesitate, vacillate, waver, Ulawaya-waya kucita mulimo wakwe. = He is indecisive about doing his work. Wakali kuwaya-waya kumutola mwanaakwe kucibbadela. = He was hesitant about taking his child to the hospital. Also: -lengaana. (1.-wayigwa-wayigwa, 2.-wayide-wayide, 3.-waizya-waizya, 4.-wayila-wayila, 5.-wayilalyo-wayilalyo, 6.-wayilisyawayilisa, 7.-wayawaya-wayawaya, 8.-wayana-wayana)
be dispersed, Munzi wesu wawayuka. Our village is scattered. Also: -mwaika. (1.-wayukwa, 2.-wayukide, 3.-wayukizya, 4.-wayukila, 5.-wayukilalyo, 6.-wayukisya, 7.-wayuka-wayuka, 8.-wayukana)

tease, mock, jeer, cry 'we' in derision, Bakamuweela basicikolo naakasuba abulo. = The school-children jeered him/her when s/he urinated in the bed. Basimbi bakali kuweela basankwa. = The girls were mocking the boys. (1.-weelwa, 2.-weelede, 3.-weezya, 4.-weelela, 5.-weelelalyo, 6.-weelesya, 7.-weela-weela, 8. -weelana) Also: -wela.

cheer, Nitwakasika-sika acikolo, baali kumbele lyesu bakatuweelela cakutukkomanisya. = When we were new-comers at school, those who came before us cheered us to make us happy. (1.-weelelwa, 2.-weelelede, 3.-weelelezya 4.-weelelela, 5.-weelelelalyo, 6.-weelelesya, 7.-weelela-weelela, 8.-weelelana)

faint with hunger, Moyo wangu waweezuka akaambo kanzala. = My heart is fainting with the hunger. (1.-weezukwa, 2.-weezukide, 3.-weezukizya, 4.-weezukila, 5.-weezukilalyo, 6.-weezukisya, 7.-weezuka-weezuka, 8.-weezukizyanya) Also: -wizuka.
be totally drunk, Wakali kukolwa cakuwehema. He was drunk unable to do anything.

mock, cry out 'we' in derision, cry out as woman when pleased, Ino bana bawela ni? = Who are the children mocking? Nobakalamwa boonse kuti ngomuntu wakamana bantu amunzi, bakamuwela. When they were amazed realizing that he was the one who had finished off the people in the village (by witchcraft), they jeered him. Also: -weela. (1.-welwa, 2.-welede, 3.-wezya, 4.-welela 5.-welelalyo, 6.-welesya, 7.-wela-wela, 8.-welana)

urge on, jeer, scoff, Basankwa bawelela basune balwana. = The boys were jeering the oxen fighting. (1.-welelwa, 2.-welelede, 3.-welelezya, 4.-welelela, 5.-welelelalyo, 6.-welelesya, 7.-wela-wela, 8.-welelana)
  • applaud, Naakanywisya bbola Muleya, bantu boonse bakawelela cakukkomana. When Muleya scored a goal, all the people applauded with delight. Ciindi noubala mwezi bana balawelela kusobana anze.

disappear from view, Naakamana kuzyana wakaweleluka biyo kuya kunanda yakwe. When he had finished dancing he just disappeared off to his house. (1.-welelukwa, 2.-welelukide, 3.-welelusya, 4.-welelukila, 5.-welelukilalyo, 6.-welelukisya, 7.-weleluka-weleluka, 8.-welelukizyanya) Also: -beleleka.

slide along, as a snake, Nindaibona nzoka yawelemuka kutija akunjila mubwina. When I saw the snake it slithered away and entered a hole. (1.-welemukwa, 2.-welemukide, 3.-welemusya, 4.-welemukila, 5.-welemukilalyo, 6.-welemukisya, 7.-welemuka-welemuka, 8.-welemukilana) Nibakanyema bataata, ndakawelemuka buyo kweenda kunzaa nanda. = When my father became angry, I just sneaked behind the house. Also: -fwelemuka.

wandering aimlessly, Mutinta wiide kuweluka munjanji. Mutinta is just living a life of prostitution along the line of rail. Mwana, kuti ndijane wiide kuweluka ulacibona cakasubizya kwale kumulomo. Child, if I find that you are doing nothing you will see what = caused the partridge's mouth to redden. (i.e. you will see how angry I can get.) (1.-welukwa, 2.-welukide, 3.-welusya, 4.-welukila, 5.-welukilalyo, 6.-welukisya, 7.-weluka-weluka, 8.-welusyanya)

half-understand, misunderstand, be physically defective in hearing, Mubbaanda tamvwi kabotu, ulawentuzya. Mubbaanda does not hear properly, his hearing is impaired. Kumvwa kwakali kuwentuzya, mpaakazyila zina lya Chingwindi. = The hearing was handicapped, that is how he got the name Chingwindi. Kuti Basoli kabakanana mu Chitonga, nobabulubuzya mumwi inga kowentuzya. = When the Basoli speak in Chitonga, as they talk incoherently you do not fully understand what they are trying to say. (1.-wentuzyigwa, 2.-wentuzyide, 3.-wentuzya, 4.-wentuzyizya, 5.-wentuzyizyalyo, 6.-wentuzyisya, 7.-wentuzyawentuzya, 8.-wentuzyanya)

hunt, Baya kukuweza balombwana musyokwe. = The boys are going to hunt in the bush. Baalumi bakaunka jilo kukuweza. The men went to hunt yesterday. Also: -vwima, -yala. (1.-wezwa, 2.-wezede, 3.-wezezya, 4.-wezela, 5.-wezelalyo, 6.-wezesya, 7.-weza-weza, 8. wezana)

fall upon, rt. -wa, Camuwida cisamu mwana uulya. A tree fell upon that child. Inziba yawida ansi. = The dove fell to the ground. Naakatolwa kunkuta, mulandu wakamuwida amutwe, wakaitilwa mali akulungila nkuta K500,000. = When he was taken to court and was convicted of the crime, the payment of the fine to the court was K500,000. (1.-wisigwa, 2.-wide, 3.-wisya, 4.-wida, 5.-widalyo, 6.-wisya, 7.-wida-wida, 8.-wisyanya)
fallen upon, rt. -wa, Wakawidilidwe vwuma mubulimi. = A coconut had fallen upon him as regards farming. (i.e. he had been very lucky in farming.)

be fallen upon, rt. -wa, Wawidwa vwuma mumwaka wakono nkaambo mvwula ilakosozya kwako. = A coconut has fallen upon you (i.e. you are fortunate) this year because the rain has fallen at your place. Ndawidwa mvwula mumuunda wangu. The rain fell for me in my field. Kalinda wakafwa naakawidwa nanda ciindi camasiku. Kalinda died when the house collapsed on him at night.
be drenched by rain, rt.- wa, Zisani zyakwe zyoonse zyakateta zikoya wawigwa mvwula. = All his clothes were wet as if he had been drenched by the rain.

ignore, Ncibi kuwiika caamba bapati. = It is bad to ignore what the elders say. Kachila wakawiika muzeezo wakuti bakaintu bakwe kuli ncibakamuyeeyela. Kachila did not pay attention to what his wife had reminded him about. Also: -uzya, -unduluzya. -lataila. (1.-wiikwa, 2.-wiikide, 3.-wiikizya, 4.-wiikila, 5.-wiikilalyo, 6.-wiikisya, 7.-wiika-wiika, 8.-wiikana)

ignore continually, Ndali kuwiikizya nindamvwa mwana wali kulila. = I was completely ignoring the child when I heard it crying. Nokuba kuti aya makani Mainza wakalaazyi, wakaawiikizya. = Even though Mainza had this information, he ignored it.

fall on, rt. -wa, Meso akwe mudaala oyu akawila ali Mutinta mwana wa Muchenje. The eyes of this old man fell upon Mutinta, the child of Muchenje. (1.-wilwa, 2.-wilide, 3.-wilizya, 4.-wilila, 5.-wililalyo, 6.-wilisya, 7.-wila-wila, 8.-wilizyanya)
  • take cattle on long journey to good grazing ground, Bana besu bakali kutola _nombe kukuwila_. = Our children were taking cattle to good grazing.

whirl or revolve a wheel quickly, _Wali kuwilimya ncinga nciya-muusya_. = He was propelling the bicycle with speed, that is why it threw him off. (1.-wilimizyigwa, 2.-wilimide, 3.-wilimya, 4.-wilimina, 5.-wiliminalyo, 6.-wilimisya, 7.-wilimya-wilimya, 8.-wilimizyanya) Also: - _vwilimya_.

cause to fall, rt. -wa, _Wamuwisya ansi mwana, Mutinta_. = Mutinta caused the child to fall. _Candi-wisya mumakwebo aangu nkukwata ba-makaintu banji_. = What has made me fall in business is having many wives. (1.-wisigwa, 2.-wide, 3.-wisya, 4.-wida, 5.-widalyo, 6.-wisya, 7.-wisya-wisya, 8.-wisyanya) Also: - _usya_.

hold or swing body in a loose way, be limp, _Beene uwizauka buya kweenda nkaambo waciswa_. = Beene holds herself weakly when she walks because she is sick. (1.-wizaukwa, 2.-wizaukide, 3.-wizausya, 4.-wizaukila, 5.-wizaukilalyo, 6.-wizaukisya, 7.-wizauka-wizauka, 8.-wizausyanya)

be restless in sleep, _Kuku-kasya kuwizila wakavwuzya kwaamba akukazya_. = To prevent him from sleeping he increased the talking and arguing. (1.-wizilwa, 2.-wizilide, 3.-wizizya, 4.-wizilila, 5.-wizililalyo, 6.-wizilisya, 7.-wizila-wizila, 8.-wizizyanya) Also: - _puukizya_.

faint with hunger, _Mwana wawizuka nzala, taalide_. = The child is fainting with hunger, it hasn't eaten. (1.-wizukwa, 2.-wizukide, 3.-wizusya, 4.-wizukila, 5.-wizukilalyo, 6.-wizukisya, 7.-wizuka-wizuka, 8.-wizusyanya) Also: - _weezuka_.

make a loud call, _Ndali kuwoolola kwiita walo tavwiili limwi ndacileka_. = I was calling him loudly, but he did not answer so I finally gave up. _Kamumuwoolola Cheelo aboole_. = Call out to Cheelo to come. (1.-woololwa, 2.-woolwede, 3.-woolozya, 4.-woolweda, 5.-woolwedalyo, 6.-woololesya, 7.-woolola-woolola, 8.-woololana) Also: - _ompolola, -wuulula_.

bark or howl as dogs, _Babwa balikuwuula masiku sunu mbuli kuti babona sicinsuungwe_. = The dogs were howling last night as if they saw a rabid dog. _Mubwa alikke Chikopa ngowakali kuwuula kumuunda, ccita naa ncinzi ncaakali kuwuulila_. = It was only the dog Chikopa alone who was barking in the field, it was not known what he was barking at. Also: - _uula, -uulula_. (1.-wuulwa, 2.-wuulide, 3.-wuuzya, 4.-wuulila, 5.-wuulilalyo, 6.-wuulisya, 7.-wuula-wuula, 8.-wuulilana)

call out, _Beembela bakali kuwuulula kutegwa bazyibe nkobabede beenzinyina_. = The herdboys were calling out so that their friends would know where they were. (1.-wuululwa, 2.-wuulwide, 3.-wuuluzya, 4.-wuulwida, 5.-wuulwidalyo, 6.-wuululisya, 7.-wuulula-wuulula, 8.-wuululana)

roar as a torrent or heavy rain falling, _Tuleelede kufwambaana kwe-enda nkaambo mvwula yatalika kale ku-wuuma_. = We must move quickly because the rain has already started to roar. (1.-wuumwa, 2.-wuumide, 3.-wuumya, 4.-wuumina, 5.-wuuminalyo, 6.-wuumisya, 7.-wuuma-wuuma, 8.-wuumizyanya) Also: - _uuma_.

hurry, rush _Bbola nilyakanywa, bana bakawuumuka kunjila mulubuwa lwabbola_. = When a goal was scored, the children rushed on to the pitch. (1.-wuumukwa, 2.-wuumukide, 3.-wuumuzya, 4.-wuumukila, 5.-wuumukilalyo, 6.-wuumukisya, 7.-wuumuka-wuumuka, 8.-wuumukilana)
rushing to, Nibakamvwa ngoma nkozilila, boonse bakali kunywa bukoko bakawuumukila nkuko. = When they heard the drums sounding, all who were drinking beer rushed there. Also: -vwuumukila.

go, Muya kuli? = Where are you going? Bataata baya kunkolola. = Father is going to the initiation ceremony. (1.-yigwa, 2.-yide, 3.-yezya, 5.-yalyo, 6.-yiisya, 7.-ya-ya, 8.-yana)
  • menstruate, Kuti musimbi wakula uya kumwezi. If a girl matures she menstruates. Also: -yaluka.
  • touch physically, Mebo nseyandi musankwa uyanda kundiya amubili pe. = I do not like a boy who wants physical contact with me.

cause to melt, rt.-yaaya, Izuba lipya lilafwambaana kuyaaizya bunzuka. = The hot sun quickly melts the wax. Also: -yaazya. (1.-yaaizyigwa, 2.-yaaizyide, 3.-yaaizyisya, 4.-yaaizyila, 5.-yaaizyilalyo, 6.-yaaizyisya, 7.-yaaizya-yaaizya, 8.-yaaizyanya)

lean, Ndakaile kuyaama acisamu naakanditonka. = I just leaned against the tree when she pushed me. (1.-yaamwa, 2.-yaamide, 3.-yaamya, 4.-yaamina, 5.-yaaminalyo, 6.-yaamisya, 7.-yaama-yaama, 8.-yaamana)
  • rely on, Ino kuti bamutanda amunzi muyakuyaamina kwani? = If they drive you from home, on whom are you going to depend?

lean a thing against, rt. yaama, Bana bayaamika mapopwe muzilwi. The children are leaning the maize against one another or in heaps. Yaamika ngoma ancili wuume kabotu. = Lean the drum on the mortar so that you play it properly. (1.-yaamikwa, 2.-yaamikide, 3.-yaamika, 4.-yaamikila, 5.-yaamikilalyo, 6.-yaamikisya, 7.-yaamika-yaamika, 8.-yaamikana)
  • adjourn, give up, leave off, Babetesi bakayaamika kaambo, nkaambo kamboni umwi taakaliko. The magistrate adjourned the case, because a certain witness was not present. Bamasiisi bakasola kulitola kububotu bwamusankwa oyu limwi bakayaamika mboobakaleka kunyonka kuli bamanyina. The female teachers tried to take for themselves the beauty of this boy but they gave up as they did being suckled by their mothers.
  • place in a position, Cilakatazya kuyeeya lubazu ndwanga ulayaamikwa nondo, nkaambo takwe boya mbuli banyama antela mapepe mbuli bayuni. = It is difficult to think of a category where you might place the tortoise, because it has neither hair like animals nor feathers like birds.

lean against, rt. -yaama, Nindakatiizabuke mulonga meenda akanditonka mpoona ndaakuyaamina kunkomwe. When I was trying to cross the river the water pushed me and so I leaned against the bank. (1.-yaaminwa, 2.-yaminide, 3.-yaaminizya, 4.-yaaminina, 5.-yaamininalyo, 6.-yaaminisya, 7.-yaamina-yaamina, 8.-yaamininana)
  • go aside, Nitwakabona balwana twakayaamina ambali. When we saw them fighting we went aside.

leave off from leaning, Ndakaciyaamuka cisamu nicakatiityoke. I stopped leaning on the tree when it was about to break. (1.-yaamukwa, 2.-yaamukide, 3.-yaamusya, 4.-yaamukila, 5.-yaamukilalyo, 6.-yaamukisya, 7.-yaamuka-yaamuka, 8.-yaamukana)
  • stop relying on, Beenzuma boonse bandiyaamuka. All my friends stopped depending on me.

take away what was laid against a support, Ndakaiyaamuna ngoma kuncili nkaambo tiiyakali kuumika. = I took the drum away from the mortar because it was not possible to play it. *Basimbi bayaamuna misunta yabwizu.* = The girls are taking away the bundles of grass (which were leaning against one another). *Wakayaamuna namutendele akutendelekela kooko kwakali munanga.* = He took up his bicycle and cycled over to where there was a witchdoctor. (1.-yaamunwa, 2.-yaamwide, 3.-yaamuzya, 4.-yaamwida, 5.-yaamwidalyo, 6.-yaamunisya, 7.-yaamuna-yaamuna, 8.-yaamunana)

be united, gather together, meet, *Makumbi aatuba ayaana asiya.* = The white clouds are meeting the black ones. *Moonde a Mainza bakajatana mumaanza nibakayaana.* = Moonde and Mainza shook hands when they met. *Eyi milonga yobilo ilayaana kujwe amunzi wa Syaajilo. Kumbelembele biyo ilayaanizigwa amulonga mupati watatu utegwa Chijalide.* = These two rivers meet east of the village of Syaajilo. Just further on they are met by the third big river called Chijalide. (1.-yaanwa, 2.-yaanide, 3.-yaamya, 4.-yaanina, 5.-yaaninalyo, 6.-yaanisya. 7.-yaana-yaana, 8.-yaanana)
  • sleep with, *Omusimbi, cilatondwa kuyaana amusankwa kotaneebwa.* = Girl, it is forbidden to sleep with a boy before marriage. Also: -swaana.
sleep together, *Malilwe a Misozi bakayaanana.* Malilwe a Misozi were sleeping together. Also: -yanana,-swaangana.

meet with, *Ndaziyaanya mukalonga nombe ezyo nzyomuyandaula.* = I met with those cattle you are looking for in the river. *Cilengwa cakwiide kukwata kufwumbwa ngwaayaanya, wakacijana kuli?* = Where did you find this custom of marrying anyone you meet with? (1.-yaanyizyigwa, 2.-yeenye, 3.-yaanya, 4.-yaanyizyizya, 5.-yaanyizyizyalyo, 6.-yaanyisya, 7.-yaanya-yaanya, 8.-yaanyizyanya)

play a game with stones, *Ijilo twakajana bana balayaata mumugwagwa.* = Yesterday we found children playing with stones on the road. *Kuyaata acisolo zilabanoneezya bana.* = To play 'African chess' delights the children. (1.-yaatwa, 2.-yaatide, 3.-yaatya, 4.-yaatila, 5.-yaatilalyo, 6.-yaatisya, 7.-yaata-yaata, 8.-yaatilana) Also: -pwa.

be melted, be dissolved, be fused, *Caanda cayaaya nicabikkwa akasaala.* = The ice melted when it was put in a warm place. *Zibiya zitaningasumikwa, zilayaaya zyatilwa meenda.* = Clay pots which have not yet been fired dissolve when water is poured on them. *Bunzuka bulafwambaana kuyaaya muzuba lipya.* Wax quickly melts in the hot sun. (1.-yaazyigwa, 2.-yaayide, 3.-yaaizya, 4.-yaayila, 5.-yaayilalyo, 6.-yaayisya, 7.-yaaya-yaaya, 8.-yaayizyanya) Also: -bomboka.
melt, dissolve, *Kofwambaana kuyaayizya makololo mucaambikwa.* = Quickly dissolve the lumps in the pot. Also: -yumbika, -yaazya.
melt or make watery, rt. yaaya, *Izuba lyabuyaazya bunzuka.* = The sun has melted the wax. Also: -yaaizya.

fade as a cloud, *Makumbi aamvwula ayabaana.* = The rain clouds have faded. *Bana basunu tabayandi kufwumbwa cijatikizya musyobo wabazyali babo, eeci cipa kuti musyobo wesu kauyabuyabaana.* = The childen of today do not want to have anything to do with the culture of their parents, this will cause our tribe to disappear. (1.-yabaanwa, 2.-yabeenye, 3.-yabaanya, 4.-yabaanina, 5.-yabaaninalyo, 6.-yabaani sya, 7.-yabaana-yabaana, 8.-yabaanizyanya)
  • spread out over or cover, Bana baluba kujala pompi, mpoona meenda
cibuye coonse. = The children forgot to tun off the pump, and so the water spread out over the whole floor.

be lost, disappear, Yayabaila nkomeki yangu kunkolola. = My cup was lost at the initiation. Muntu walikuzya waawa waile *kuyabaila*. = The person who was coming here just disappeared. Also: -yangabila. (1.-yabailwa, 2.-yabailide, 3.-yabaizya, 4.-yabailila, 5.-yabaililalyo, 6.-yabailisya, 7.-yabaila-yabaila, 8.-yabaizyanya)
prevent a person from discussing a certain matter, Bakandi

nindakatiikanane makani alufwu Iwamwana. = They stopped me when I was about to talk about the death of the child. Inga ndatiikaayeeye makani aaya, ndaayabaizya. = When I was about to think about that matter, I pushed it aside. (1.-yabaizyigwa, 2.-yabaizyide, 3.-yabaizyisya, 4.-yabaizyizya, 5.-yabaizyizyalyo, 6.-yabaizyisya, 7.-yabaizya-yabaizya, 8.-yabaizyanya)

gush out, as water, Ciyobwedo camafwuta capwaika nkabela mafwuta *ayabana* a cibuye coonse. = The container of oil was smashed and poured out over the whole floor. (1.-yabanwa, 2.-yabanide, /-yabene, 3.-yabanya, 4.-yabanina, 5.-yabaninalyo, 6.-yabanisya, 7.-yabana-yabana, 8.-yabanyizyanya) Also: -yabaana

overflow as river, Mulonga *wayabantila* cibanda coonse. = The river flowed over the whole plain. (1.-yabantilwa, 2.-yabantilide,/-yabantide, 3.-yabantizya, 4.-yabantilila, 5.-yabantililalyo, 6.-yabantilisya, 7.-yabantilayabantila, 8.-yabantililana,/-yabantizyanya) Also: -yabaana.

dream about what will happen the next day, Munanga wakali *kuyabauka* masiku oonse kulota beenzu bajisi makani aabulwazi bwakatantamutwe. = The witchdoctor was dreaming the whole night about visitors who have an inquiry about the disease of a serious headache. (1.-yabaukwa, 2.-yabaukide, 3.-yabausya, 4.-yabaukila, 5.-yabaukilalyo, 6.-yabaukisya, 7.-yabauka-yabauka, 8.-yabausyanya)
be obstructed, Mweenzu

babwa naakatiinjile mulubuwa. = The stranger was blocked by the dogs when he tried to enter the courtyard. (1.-yabwa, 2.-yabide, 3.-yabizya,/-yabya, 4.-yabila, 5.-yabilalyo, 6.-yabisya, 7.-yabwa-yabwa, 8.-yabana)
become worn or damaged by friction, blister, Cituta camudaala

nicasyondwa cilayi. = The foot of the old man was blistered when the sledge went over it. Also: -cubbuka. (1.-yabbukwa, 2.-yabbukide, 3.-yabbusya, /-yabbukizya, 4.-yabbukila, 5.-yabbukilalyo, 6.-yabbukisya, 7.-yabbuka-yabbuka, 8.-yabbukana)
put a cloth over, Kamu

mulembo nabwiinga kamutanamutola kumusankwa wakwe. = Cover the bride with a cloth before she is taken to the bridegroom. (1.-yabikwa, 2.-yabikide, 3.-yabikizya, 4.-yabikila, 5.-yabikilalyo, 6.-yabikisya, 7.-yabika-yabika, 8.-yabikana)
  • place a roof in position, Kamufwambaana *kuyabika* kaluli akatala kandongwe. = Be quick to place the roof of the groundnut bin.

sing as solitary vocalist in kuyabila mode (which may be punctuated by friction drum beat or rattle), Muntu *nayabila* inga kuli ncaamba buya, mbuli kulila adilwe. = When a person sings in the kuyabila mode s/he has some important matter to air, like at a funeral. Mudaala uyabila ŋombe zyakwe. = The old man is singing about his cattle. (1.-yabilwa, 2.-yabilide, 3.-yabizya, 4.-yabilila, 5.-yabililalyo, 6.-yabilisya, 7.-yabila-yabila, 8.-yabililana)
  • talk rubbish, Coonse ncoamba eeco uyabila buyo. = All what you have said is rubbish.

form cream, Mafwuta ayabilila atalaa mabisi. = The cream has formed on top of the sour milk. (1.-yabililwa, 2.-yabililide, 3.-yabililizya, 4.-yabililila, 5.-yabilililalyo, 6.-yabililisya, 7.-yabilila-yabilila, 8.-yabililana)
  • sing in kuyabila style for someone, Bataata mbabakandiyabilila kupobwe lyamusaama. = It was my father who sang for me a kuyabila song at the celebration of my agemate.

talk or sing a lot, Banyina balaamba, walo ulayabilizya, taswiilili. = As the mother talks, he rambles on, he does not listen. Bantu bayabilizya, ncindali kwaamba tiicamvwugwa. = People are trying to divert attention so that what I said would not be understood. (1.-yabilizyigwa, 2.-yabilizyide, 3.-yabilizyisya, 4.yabilizyizya, 5.-yabilizyizyalyo,/yabilizya, 6.-yabilizyisya, 7.-yabilizyayabilizya, 8.-yabilizyanya) Also: yabaizya, -yabiizya.
  • be taken away by wind, Muwo wayabilizya tusani twamwana. = The heavy wind blew away the child's clothing.
be revealed Kaambo kasisidwe kayabuka. = The matter which was hidden has been revealed. (1.-yabukwa, 2.-yabukide, 3.-yabusya, /
4.-yabukila, 5.-yabukilalyo, 6.-yabukisya, 7.-yabuka-yabuka, 7.-yabukizyanya)

open a blister, Musilisi wakayabula twizya kutegwa asilike kabotu. The doctor opened the blister so that he could treat it well. (1.-yabulwa, 2.-yabwide, 3.-yabuzya, 4.-yabwida, 5.-yabwidalyo, 6.-yabulisya, 7.-yabulayabula, 8.-yabulana)
  • reveal, Ncibi kuyabula kaambo kamaseseke. = It is bad to reveal a secret matter.

be peeled off, Makwa amusamu ayabuluka kuzwa kumusamu. = The bark of the tree has been peeled off. Cicisa cayabuluka. = The scab has peeled off from the wound. Also: -yupuluka. (1.-yabulukwa, 2.-yabulukide, 3.-yabulusya, /-yabulukisya 4.-yabulukila, 5.-yabulukilalyo, 6.-yabulukisya, 7.-yabuluka-yabuluka, 8.-yabulukizyanya)

take off, scrape, separate leaves sticking together, Kamuyabulula ndongwe tusonzole. = Take off the groundnuts which are on top so that we shell them. Koyabulula magwala-ngubo. = Scrape off the rough parts of a skin (when it has dried). Also: -yabununa. (1.-yabululwa, 2.-yabulwide, 3.-yabuluzya, 4.-yabulwida, 5.-yabulwidalyo, 6.-yabululisya, 7.-yabulula-yabulula, 8.-yabululana)
  • tease cotton, Kamuyabulula buluba kucimvule nokucitontola. = Tease out the cotton in the shade when it is still cool.

separate, remove, Koyabununa mafwuta ali atala amukupa. Remove the fat which is on the top of the milk. Also: yabulula. (1.-yabununwa, 2.-yabunwide, 3.-yabunuzya, 4.-yabunwida, 5.-yabunwidalyo, 6.-yabununisya, 7.-yabununa-yabununa, 8.-yabununana)..
  • tease as cotton Also: -yabulula

be surprised, Basimbi bakayabwa nibakajana muntu ulaa cinswe munzila. The girls were surprised when they found a naked man on the road. Also: -nyandwa, -lamwa. (1.-yabwa, 2.-yabide, 3.-yabizya,/-yabya 4.-yabila, 5.-yabilalyo, 6.-yabisya, 7.-yabwa-yabwa, 8.-yabana)
  • be obstructed in speech, Ndakali kuyanda kupa kaambo kabotu mumuswaangano pele ndakayabwa abantu banji. = I wanted to make a good contribution in the meeting, but I was obstructed by many people.

sleep lightly, doze, Nindakakatala kubeleka, ndakaide kuyabwa-yabwa kulota kuti ndali kusya bulongo. = When I was tired working I was sleeping lightly, dreaming that I was digging clay. Wakalanga kuli mweenzinyina kumwi oku kuyabwa-yabwa mizeezo. = He looked to his friend while far away in his thoughts.

build, erect a house, Ndiyanda kuyaka nanda yangu ndamana nkwate. I want to build my house and then marry. (1.-yakwa, 2.-yakide, 3.-yasya, 4.-yakila, 5.-yakilalyo, 6.-yakisya, 7.-yaka-yaka, 8.-yakana)
  • be lit, catch fire, Mulilo wamuka kuyaka, ncotwamuka kujika. = The fire was slow in lighting, that is why we are late in cooking. Also: -nyeka.

have burning taste, rt. yaka, Impilibili ilayaka-yaka amulaka. = Chilli burns the tongue. Also: -baka-baka
  • build quickly, rt. -yaka, Kamuyakayaka maanda mvwula noitaningatalika kuwa. Build the houses quickly before the rains begin to fall.

fence, rt. -yaka, Kamuyakila mbewu citaligwi cisyu. = Fence the garden so that the vegetables are not eaten. Kamuyakila lubaya cisyu citaligwi nombe. Build a fence so that the vegetables are not eaten by cattle. (1.-yakilwa, 2.-yakilide, 3.-yakizya, 4.-yakilila, 5.-yakililalyo, 6.-yakilisya, 7.-yakila-yakila, 8.-yakililana)
  • build for, Kamundiyakila cibalu. = Build me a wind-break.

rebuild, repair, rt. -yaka, Bakayakulula buya alimwi nkaambo tiikwakayakidwe kabotu. = They just rebuilt it because it was not properly built.
  • unbuild, Mubbi waluyakulula lubaya kuti abbe cisyu. = The thief took down the fence so that he could steal vegetables. (1.-yakululwa, 2.-yakulwide, 3.-yakuluzya, 4.-yakulwida, 5.-yakulwidalyo, 6.-yakululisya, 7.-yakulula-yakulula, 8.-yakululana)

rebuild with, rt. -yaka, Nomuyakulula lubaya lujisi mamvwa, kamuyakuluzya zisamu kutegwa mutayaswi. When you are repairing a fence which has thorns, built it with poles so that you are not pierced. (ext. see -yakulula)

hunt, Basankwa baunka kukuyala basicipongo musyokwe. = The boys have gone to hunt wild pigs in the bush. Ndakaunka ababwa njaabuyala. = I went with the dogs hunting along the way. Also: - vwima, -weza. (1.-yalwa, 2.-yalide, 3.-yalizya,/-yazya, 4.-yalila, 5.-yalilalyo, 6.-yalisya, 7.-yalayala, 8.-yalilana, /-yalana)
  • lay flat, spread out, Mutinta, koyala bulo. Mutinta, make the bed. Kachila wakajisi bubi mpobakakkede a Choopa kuyala mizeezo mbobakonzya kuti atizigwe Mutinta. Kacila was busy where he was sitting with Choopa laying out plans as to how they could take Mutinta away.
  • claim ownership of land, Ndakkala ansi yakayala Mwami Moonze. = I am living on the land claimed and owned by Chief Monze.
  • boil, Kamubikka nkuni zinji kutegwa meenda afwambaane kuyala. = Put plenty of firewood so that the water is quick to boil.

gesticulate with both hands, Muccumaizi walikuyalaika amaanza. = The preacher was gesticulating with his hands. Also: -tambaika, -yanaika. (1.-yalaikwa, 2.-yalaikide, 3.-yalaisya,/yalaikizya, 4.-yalaikila, 5.-yalaikilalyo, 6.-yalaikisya, 7.-yalaika-yalaika, 8.-yalaikilana, /-yalaikana)

walk or sit abreast, Basilumamba balayalana nobafwoolwa. = The soldiers walk side by side when they are marching. (1.-yalanwa, 2.-yalene, 3.-yalanya, 4.-yalanina, 5.-yalaninalyo, 6.-yalanisya, 7.-yalana-yalana, 8.-yalana)

boil over, overflow, Matimba ayalauka kale muzitalo. = The mixture of fermented and unfermented mealies is already flowing out over the pot. (1.-yalaukwa, 2.-yalaukide, 3.-yalaukizya, 4.-yalaukila, 5.-yalaukilalyo, 6.-yalaukisya, 7.-yalauka-yalauka, 8.-yalaukizyanya)

spread out over, Mulonga ciindi nouzwide nouyalaukila atala, ulabwezelezya zyoonse nzyoukonzya kuyumuna. = A river during the time it is full, when it floods out, it carries along with it everything which it is able to carry. (1.-yalaukilwa, 2-8 same as -yalauka)

speak using many gestures, Mwiiyi mubotu ulayalayika nayiisya. = A good teacher uses many gestures when teaching. (1.-yalayikwa, 2.-yalayikide, 3.-yalayisya,/-yalayikizya, 4.-yalayikila, 5.-yalayikilalyo, 6.-yalayikisya, 7.-yalayikayalayika, 8.-yalayikilana,/yalayikana) Also: -yalaika

stretch out, rt. -yala, Bakakkala ansi bayalide maulu. = They sat on the ground stretching out their legs. (1.-yalwa, 2.-yalide, 3.-yalizya,/yazya, 4.-yalila, 5.-yalilalyo, 6.-yalisya, 7.-yalide-yalide, 8.-yalilana,/-yalana)
be at peace, Nyika iliyalikene. The land is at peace. (1.-yalikanwa, 2.-yalikene, 3.-yalikanya, 4.-yalikanina, 5.-yalikaninalyo, 6.-yalikanisya, 7.-yalikene-yalikene, 8.-yalikana/-yalikaninana)

make beds for, rt. -yala, Kamubayalila malo beenzu balyookezye. = Make the beds for the visitors so that they rest. (1.-yalilwa, 2.-yalilide, 3.-yalizya, 4.-yalilila, 5.-yalililalyo, 6.-yalilisya, 7.-yalila-yalila, 8.-yalilana)

menstruate for the first time, Musimbi wayaluka. = The girl has menstruated. Basimbi bakali kufwambaana kubangwa nkaambo cakali kutondwa kuyaluka uutanabangwa. = The girls used to have their teeth knocked out early because it was taboo to menstruate before having the front teeth removed. Basimbi bakali kutumwa kumacembele kuya kulaigwa. Bakali kulaigwa kuti bazyibe kukomena, kuyaluka, kukula mbocaamba. The girls were sent to the elderly women to be instructed. They were instructed so that they would know what it is to grow up, to menstruate, to know what it is to become a woman. (1.-yalukwa, 2.-yalukide, 3.-yaluzya, / yalusya, 4.-yalukila, 5.-yalukilalyo, 6.-yalukisya, 7.-yaluka-yaluka, 8.-yalwidana, /-yalusyanya)
  • fold up bed, Bulo bwamweenzu bwayaluka nkaambo waunka. = The bed for the visitor has been folded up because s/he has gone.

roll up, clear away, Babelesi bayalula milembo yabaa tombe. = The workers are removing dirty cloths. (1.-yalulwa, 2.-yalwide, 3.-yaluzya, 4.-yalwida, 5.-yalwidalyo, 6.-yalulisya, 7.-yalula-yalula, 8.-yalwidana)

take young birds out of nest, rt. -yalula, Kamuyalwida nkuku yakakonkona jilo. = Take the chick out of the nest which was hatched yesterday. (extensions same as for -yalula)
  • roll up for, Basimbi bayalwida bacembele bulo. = The girls are rolling up the bed for the old woman.

swim, paddle, Bantu balayamba mumulonga. People are swimming in the river.(1.-yambwa, 2.-yambide, 3.-yambya, 4.-yambila, 5.-yambilalyo, 6.-yambisya, 7.-yamba-yamba, 8.-yambilana, /-yambizyanya) Also: -dubbwa, -dubba, samba inkulubalwa, -dwaya, -saya.

treat carelessly, Mutinta bayambaala kubikka busu asika nkuku zyabulya. Mutinta was carelessly putting the mealie-meal where chickens can reach and they have eaten it. Also: -bayaala. (1.-yambaalwa, 2.-yambaalide, 3.-yambaazya, 4.-yambaalila, 5.-yambaalilalyo, 6.-yambaalisya, 7.-yambaala-yambaala, 8.-yambaalilana)

put on fire (pot), Kamuyambika cibiya camusozya acikko. = Put the pot of musozya on the fire. (1.-yambikwa, 2.-yambikide, 3.-yambisya, /-yambikizya, 4.-yambikila, 5.-yambikilalyo, 6.-yambikisya, 7.-yambika-yambika, 8.-yambikilana) Also: -sibika.
  • be able to swim in, rt. -yamba, Buzuba butakwe mayuwe kulayambika mulwaanje. It is easy to swim in the sea on a day when there are no waves.

spread as a disease, be infectious, be contagious, Cilwazi eeci cilayambukila. This disease is infectious. (1.-yambukilwa, 2.-yambukide, 3.-yambukizya, 4.-yambukilila, 5.-yambukililalyo, 6.-yambukilisya, 7-yambukilayambukila, 8.-yambukizyanya)

contract a disease, Ndayambukilwa cisyini nkaambo kakukkala abaciswa. I have contracted a cold from sitting near sick people. Ndayambukilwa bulwazi bwakanswende. I have contracted syphilis. (ext. same as -yambukila)
infect, Ndime ndamuyambukizya bulwazi mukaintu wangu. It is I who infected my wife. Kagele nguwandiyambukizya bulwazi. It is Kagele who infected me with the disease. (ext. same as -yambukila)

mix roots of munkoyo plant with maize porridge, Bacembele bayambula cibwantu. The old woman is mixing munkoyo roots with maize porridge to make cibwantu. (1.-yambulwa, 2.-yambwide, 3.-yambuzya 4.-yambwida, 5.-yambwidalyo, 6.-yambulisya, 7.-yambula-yambula, 8.-yambwidana)
  • contract a disease, Mutinta wakayambula bulwazi bwacivwuule. Mutinta has contracted a sexually transmitted disease.

scare away birds, guard field against birds by making noise, Bana bayamina buyuni. The children are scaring the birds away. Kondiyaminina muunda. Guard the field for me. (1.-yaminwa, 2.-yaminide, 3.-yaminzya, 4.-yaminina, 5.-yamininalyo, 6.-yaminisya, 7.-yamina-yamina, 8.-yaminana) Also: -soola.
  • control, Kuti kotamuyamini_mwanaako, uyakuzanga waakukomena. If you do not control your child, it will rebel when it grows up.

gesticulate, Malala naakali kukanana kumusankwa akwe wakali kwiile kuyanaika maboko nkokuti kuli cakamucima. When Malala was talking to her boyfriend she was waving her arms about showing that there was something which annoyed her. (1.-yanaikwa, 2.-yanaikide, 3.-yanaisya, 4.-yanaikila, 5.-yanaikilalyo, 6.-yanaikisya, 7.-yanaikayanaika, 8.-yanaikilana, / -yanaikizyanya)

join, sleep together, Mukaintu amulumi wakwe bayanana sunu kuzwa mwakali. The wife and husband slept together, the first time since last year. Also: -yaanana. (1.-yananwa, 2.-yananide, 3.-yananizya, /
4.-yananina, 5.-yananinalyo, 6.-yananisya, 7.-yanana-yanana, 8.-yanana)

want, love, wish, need, *Bamwi bantu balayanda kufweba lubanje ciindi cacifwumofwumo.* = *Some people like to smoke marijuana in the morning.* (1.-yandwa, 2.-yandide, 3.-yandya, / yandizya, 4.-yandila, 5.-yandilalyo, 6.-yandisya, 7.-yanda-yanda, 8.-yandana)
  • be about to, to almost, *Uyanda kuba simpulukutwi.* = S/He is about to become deaf. *Munene uciswa uyanda kufwa.* = The sick old man is about to die.
  • spread, *Lungu lwangu talunayanda.* = My pumpkin plants have not yet spread. Also: -tandabala.
  • be selfish, *Ooyu mwana ulaliyanda ncatakavwubi akuvwuba.* = This child is selfish, that is why she will never be rich.

spread out as pumpkin vines, diverge, *Lungu lokwesu lwayandalala mumuunda.* = Our pumpkin vines are spreading over the field. (1.-yandalalwa, 2.-yandalalide, 3.-yandalazya, 4.-yandalalila, 5.-yandalalilalyo, 6.-yandalalisya, 7.-yandalala-yandalala, 8.-yandalalizyanya, / -yandalilana)

search for, *Ndiyandaula wakundiyiisya.* = I am looking for someone to teach me. *Basankwa bayandaula nombe.* = The boys are looking for the cattle. Also: -kapaula, -vwenta, -yanduula. (1.-yandaulwa, 2.-yandawide, 3.-yandauzya, 4.-yandawida, 5.-yandawidalyo, 6.-yandaulisya, 7.-yandaula-yandaula, 8.-yandaulana)

seek on behalf of, rt. yandaula, *Ndalikumuyandawida mulimo wakubeleka.* = I was looking for work for him/her. *Kamundiyandawida mali ngunke ku Monze.* = Look for money for me so that I can go to Monze. (extensions same as for -yandaula)

be necessary, be desireable, *Eeci cisamu cilayandika kapati.* = This tree is sought a lot. *Ijansi lilayandika ciindi camupeyo.* = A coat is necessary during the cold season. (1.-yandikwa, 2.-yandikide, 3.-yandizya, / yandya, 4.-yandikila, 5.-yandikilalyo, 6.-yandikisya, 7.-yandika-yandika, 8.-yandikana)
  • be lovable, *Nomuyandika, atuteelelane.* = Beloved, let us listen to one another.

spread, *Bulwazi bwakayandilila mubili onse nkujana muntu wakajisi mubili mubotu wakaide kukoka.* = The disease spread throughout the whole body so that the one who had a healthy body was found to be just thin.

open a way in high grass, *Kuyandula mani malamfwu kusola kubamba nzila, cilakatazya.* = It is difficult to open a way in the high grass to make a path. (1.-yandulwa, 2.-yandwide, 3.-yanduzya, 4.-yandwida, 5.-yandwidalyo 6.-yandulisya, 7.-yandula-yandula, 8.-yandwidana) Also: -bandula.

keep searching for, *Kamuyanduula mali tuule musune wakulimya.* = Continue to look for money so that we buy an ox for ploughing. (1.-yanduulwa, 2.-yandwiide, 3.-yanduuzya, 4.-yandwiida, 5.-yandwiidalyo, 6.-yanduulisya, 7.-yanduula-yanduula, 8.-yanduulana) Also: -yandaula.

scratch ground as hen, *Nkuku zilayanga nozilya.* = Chickens scratch as they eat. *Nkuku ziyanga mumibundu yacisyu.* = Chickens scratch among the rows of vegetables. (1.-yangwa, 2.-yangide, 3.-yanzya, /

4.-yangila, 5.-yangilalyo, 6.-yangisya, 7.-yanga-yanga, 8.-yangana)
  • dig out as groundnuts, potatoes, *Bamaama bakatalika kale kuyanga ndo-* ngwe. = My mother has already begun to dig groundnuts.
  • spread out mealies with flat of hand, Kamubuyanga bumena kutegwa bu*fwambaane kuyuma.* = Spread out the yeast so that it dries quickly. Also: -azala, -sansala, -yanzala.
  • give evidence against, Mwana wakabayanga banyina nobakatiikazye mulandu alubeta. = When the mother tried to deny the crime at the court, her child gave evidence against her. Nankokwe wakamuyanga zyoonse nzyaakali kucita Ntaimo akakoli mbukakali kubba busu amali mumaanda abantu ciindi camasiku. = Nankokwe gave evidence (to the witchdoctor) about all the things which Ntaimo was doing and how by his magic stick was stealing flour and money in the homes of people at night.

fade as a cloud, disappear, Makumbi amvwula ayangabila. = The rain clouds have faded away. Also: -yabaila. (1.-yangabilwa, 2.-yangabalide, / -yangabide, 3.-yangabizya, 4.-yangabalila,/yangabilila, 5.-yangabalilalyo, / -yangabililalyo, 6.-yangabalisya, / -yangabilisya, 7.-yangabila-yangabila, 8.-yangabalizyanya, /-yangabilizyanya)

pass over, not take seriously, Mukaintu wakali kunga watiisole kumwaambila mulumi makani aamapenzi aakali munanda yabo, walo ciindi coonse wakali kwiile kwaayangabizya mbuli kuti taakwe ncaakabwene. = The wife tried to tell her husband about these troublesome matters of the home, but he always would just pass over them as if he had not seen them. (1.-yangabizyigwa, 2.-yangabizyide, 3.-yangabizya, 4.-yangabizyizya, 5.-yangabizyizyalyo, 6.-yangabizyisya, 7.-yangabizya-yangabizya, 8.-yangabizyanya)

be few, Ino kayi zyayangala buti sunu nombe zinji lyoonse. = How is it that the cattle which are always so many are few today? (1.-yangalwa, 2.-yangede, /-yangazya, 3.-yangazya, 4.-yangalila, 5.-yangalilalyo, 6.-yangalisya, 7.-yangala-yangala, 8.-yangalizyanya, /-yangazyanya)

spread out, Musimbi wakaimvwi biya kusule lya Milimo maanza akwe kayanga-yanga agwezyo lyakwe. The girl stood behind Milimo her hands spread out on his shoulders.
  • scratch about, Nkuku zyabuyangayanga busu mbwindasiide mucisuwo. = The chickens were scratching about in the mealie-meal which I had left in the basket. Also: -kulukuuta

scratch for oneself, as a hen, Kulya koonse kwakali kwakuliyangila mbuli buliyangila mwanaa nkuku utalelwa. = All eating was a matter of looking after oneself as a chick which is not looked after by anyone which has to scratch for itself. Koliyangila, swebo tobazyali taakwe ncotunga twacita pe. Provide for yourself, we the parents can do nothing. Musankwa ooyo wakaba kaliyangile, wakazanga. That boy became independent, he rebelled. (1.-yangwa, 2.-yangide, 3.-yangizya, 4.-yangila, 5.-yangilalyo, 6.-yangisya, 7.-yangila-yangila, 8.-yangilana)

make mad or stupid, be addicted to, Bakamuyangula mwanookwesu balozi. = The witches made my relative go mad. Musimbi oyu bwamuyangula buvwuule. Prostitution has caused this girl to become mad. (1.-yangulwa, 2.-yangwide, 3.-yanguzya, 4.-yangwida, 5.-yangwidalyo, 6.-yangulisya, 7.-yangula-yangula, 8.-yangulana)

dig out nuts etc., with fingers or claws, Inkuku iyanguula buya kulya. = A chicken just scratches to eat. (1.-yanguulwa, 2.-yangwiide, 3.-yanguuzya, 4.-yangwiida, 5.-yangwiidalyo, 6.-yanguulisya, 7.-yanguula-yanguula, 8.-yanguulana or -yanguulilana)

lay or hang out, Kamuyanika zisani zyasanzigwa ino, ziyume = Hang out the clothes to dry which were just washed. (1.-yanikwa, 2.-yanikide, 3.-yanisya, 4.-yanikila, 5.-yanikilalyo, 6.-yanikisya, 7.-yanika-yanika, 8.-yanikilana, -yanikizyanya)

dry something for someone, Ngooyu mubondo wakayuma ngondakakuyanikila. There is the dried barbel fish which I hung up to dry for you. (1.-yanikilwa, 2.-yanikilide, 3.-yanikizyizya 4.-yanikizyila, 5.-yanikizyilalyo, 6.-yanikizyisya, 7.-yanikila-yanikila, 8.-yanikilana)

spread out, e.g Nitwakaugwa mvwula twakayanikizya zisani zyesu amulilo kutegwa zifwambaane kuyuma. = When we were soaked by the rain we spread out our clothes by the fire so that they would quickly dry. (1.-yanikizyigwa, 2.-yanikizyide, 3.-yanikizya, 4.-yanikizyizya 5.-yanikizyizyalyo, 6.-yanikizyisya, 7.-yanikizya-yanikizya, 8.-yanikizyanya)

be spread out, be hung out, Mapopwe aleelede kuyanikwa kaatanatolwa kucigayo. The maize should be spread out to dry before it is taken to the mill. (1.-yanikwa, 2.-yanikide, 3.-yanisya, 4.-yanikila, 5.-yanikilalyo, 6.-yanikisya, 7.-yanikwa-yanikwa, 8.-yanikilana, /yanikizyanya)

put out to dry, Bataata bayanila kkutu lyanombe yakafwa jilo, = Father is putting the skin of the cow out to dry which died yesterday. Also: - yanika. (1.-yanilwa, 2.-yanilide, 3.-yanisya, 4.-yanilila, 5.-yanililalyo, 6.-yanilisya, 7.-yanila-yanila, 8.-yanilana)

bring in from outside, as clothes that have been drying, Ndaziyanuna zisani zyali anze. I have brought in the clothes which were drying outside. Kamuziyanuna zisani. = Bring in the clothes from outside. (1.-yanunwa, 2.-yanwide, 3.-yanuzya, 4.-yanwida, 5.-yanwidalyo, 6.-yanunisya, 7.-yanunayanuna, 8.-yanwidana)

be spread out, Kuti mapopwe ayanikwa ayanzabala kabotu, alafwambaana kuyuma. If the maize which is being dried is well spread, it drys quickly. (1.-yanzabalwa, 2.-yanzabele, 3.-yanzabazya, 4.-yanzabalila, 5.-yanzabalilalyo, 6.-yanzabalisya, 7.-yanzabalayanzabala, 8.-yanzabalilana) Also: -zanzabala, -sasabala, -papalala.
spread, Mufwume ku yanzabika mapopwe kutegwa ayume kufwambaana. Rise quickly to spread out the manzie so that it dries quickly.

spread out to dry, Bana, kamuyanzala mapopwe kutegwa ayume. = Children, spread out the maize to dry. Baama bayanzala ndongwe zitete kutegwa zitavwundi. Mother is spreading out the groundnuts to dry so that they don't go bad. (1.-yanzalwa, 2.-yanzalide,/-yanzede, 3.-yanzazya, 4.-yanzalila, 5.-yanzalilalyo, 6.-yanzalisya,/-yanzazya, 7.-yanzala-yanzala, 8.-yanzalilana)

be friendly, be reconciled, Mutinta a Mweemba bakayanzana = Mutinta and Mweemba became friends. Sunu twakayanzana, kunyina bubi abantu baya. There is nothing wrong with those people, we are friends with them. (1.-yanzanwa, 2.-yanzanide, /-yanzene, 3.-yanzanya, 4.-yanzanina, 5.-yanzaninalyo, 6.-yanzanisya, 7.-yanzana-yanzana, 8.-yanzana)

reconcile, Tunji-tunji wakali kubaumuzya akubayanzanya boonse nobakali kuzwanganina kaambo kakali kunga kalabatola mukulwana. = Very often he was cooling them down and reconciling all when they were arguing about a matter which could lead them to violence. (extensions as for -yanzana)

cease to be friends, *Bantu aba bakayanzulukana nkaambo kabulale.* = These people have ceased to be friends because of adultery. (1.-yanzulukanwa, 2.-yanzulukanide, / yanzulukene, 3.-yanzulukanya, 4.-yanzulukanina, 5.-yanzulukaninalyo, 6.-yaanzulukanisya, 7.-yanzulukanayanzulukana, 8.-yanzulukana)

permit, *Banyina tiibakali kumuyanzya Mutinta kukwatwa kuli Michelo pe.* = The mother was not at all in favour of Mutinta being married to Michelo. (1.-yanzyigwa, 2.-yanzyizye, /yanzide, 3.-yanzya, /-yanzyizya, 4.-yanzyizya, 5.-yanzyizyalyo, 6.-yanzyisya, 7.-yanzya-yanzya, 8.-yanzyanya)
open mouth wide, *Ngooyu uyapaula malomo katukana akuswida mate ansi.* = There he is opening his mouth widely in cursing and spitting on the ground.
have one's mouth opened, *Wakali kwiide kuyapawidwa malomo.* = He was just having his mouth opened.

strip off, *Kamuyapula loozi olo acisamu aawo.* = Strip that fibre from the tree there. *Kamuyapula cilonda cisilikwe.* = Remove the scab so that the sore can be treated. Also: -fwundulula. (1.-yapulwa, 2.-yapwide, 3.-yapuzya, 4.-yapwida, 5.-yapwidalyo, 6.-yapulisya, 7.-yapula-yapula, 8.-yapulana)

wound, pierce, *Kamukayasa sumo kangulube aako nokatiileke kulya cimbwali canu.* = Pierce that piglet with a spear to stop it eating your sweet potatoes. *Makani ngaakandaambila jilo akandiyasa.* = The news which he told me yesterday pierced me. *Naakaambaula kapati, bantu banji bakamuyasa meso.* = When he spoke a lot many people fixed their eyes on him. (1.-yaswa, 2.-yaside, 3.-yasya /-yasizya, 4.-yasila, 5.-yasilalyo, 6.-yasisya, 7.-yasa-yasa, 8.-yasana)
  • shoot up as plant, *Sena akayasa kale mapopwe ngookasyanga?* = Has the maize which you planted germinated.
  • play a running game, *Bana bayasa sitinde mumusena.* = The children are playing the *sitinde* game in the vlei.
  • (idiomatic usage) *Mumunzi muli bunjaka, inga nomukkede nkulindila liyasa cuuno.* = In a village where there are conflicts, as you live in it you are waiting for a spear to strike the stool on which you are seated.

cut up (meat), *Kamuyasaula nyama kutegwa twaabane kabotu.* = Cut up the meat so that we share it out easily. (1.-yasaulwa, 2.-yaswide, /yasawide, 3.-yasauzya, 4.-yasawida, 5.-yasawidalyo, 6.-yasaulisya, 7.-yasaulayasaula, 8.-yasaulana) Also: -gonkoola.
  • pierce here and there with knife or spear, *Twakajana Kanoma bamuyasaula cipeni mubili onse.* = We found that they had pierced Kanoma with a knife all over the body.
  • make cuts on a sick person to bleed him/her or insert medicine, *Bamuyasaula nsimbo kuti babikke musamu.* = They made cuts on him so as to insert medicine.

piercable, rt. -yasa, *Cikutu casulwe cilayasika pesi cacivwubwe taciyasiki.* = The hide of a rabbit can easily be pierced, but the hide of a hippo cannot be pierced. (1.-yasikwa, 2.-yasikide, 3.-yasikizya, 4.-yasikila, 5.-yasikilalyo, 6.-yasikisya, 7.-yasika-yasika, 8.-yasikilana)

fish with spear, *Bayasila nswi atuumba.* = They are piercing the fish with fishing spears. Kamuyasila nswi mucizyiba. = Pierce the fish in the pool. (1.-yasilwa, 2.-yasilide, 3.-yasizya, 4.-yasilila, 5.-yasililalyo, 6.-yasilisya, 7.-yasila-yasila, 8.-yasilana)
kill for, Mwami Cheempa naakafwa wakayasilwa nombe zyosanwe. = When chief Cheempa died they killed five cattle for him. (ext. as for -yasila)

gash meat before roasting, Kamuyasula nyama, isasabale kutegwa iyokwe. = Make cuts in the meat and spread it out so that it can be roasted. (1.-yasulwa, 2.-yasulide, /-yaswide, 3.-yasuzya, 4.-yasulila,/-yaswida 5.-yasulilalyo, / -yaswidalyo, 6.-yasulisya, 7.-yasula-yasula, 8.-yasulana) Also: -sama

feel multiple pain, Mucembele uyaswa-yaswa tusinga mucamba. = The old lady has continuous pains in her chest. (1.-yaswa-yaswa, 2.-yaside-yaside, 3.-yasya-yasya, 4.-yasilayasila, 5.-yasila-yasilalyo, 6.-yasisya-yasisya, 7.-yaswa-yaswa, 8.-yasana-yasana)

cause to build, build with, rt. -yaka, Ndakayasya maanda obilo ku Lusaka. = I had two houses built in Lusaka. Twakayasya mabwe cikombelo cesu. = We built our church with stones. (1.-yasyigwa, 2.-yasyide, 3.-yasya, 4.-yasyizya, 5.-yasyizyalyo, 6.-yasyisya, 7.-yasya-yasya, 8.-yasyanya) or (1.-yakwa, 2.-yakide, 3.-yasya, 4.-yakila, yakilalyo, 6.-yakisya, 7.-yasya-yasya, 8.-yakana)
  • cause to light, set fire to, rt. -yaka, Koyasya mulilo tubone mubwa uulya mayi. = Light the fire so that we see the dog which is eating the eggs. Kwakacili kusiya-siya, Mooba wakayasya lambe. = When it was still dark, Mooba lit the lamp.

be disturbed, be restless, Mwiiyi naakali kukanana ciindi cilamfwu, bana bacikolo bakatalika kuyatauka. = When the teacher was talking for a long time to the pupils they began to be restless. Basiminyono bakayatauka, cakaala kukkalikila nibakamwa makani. = The ones who were envious were disturbed, it was impossible to rest when they heard the news. Also: -cucauka. (1.-yataukwa, 2.-yataukide, 3.-yatausya, 4.-yataukila, 5.-yataukilalyo, 6.-yataukisya, 7.-yatauka-yatuka, 8.-yatausyanya, / yataukilana)

be torn, Cayauka cisani cako. = Your cloth is torn. Mulembo wabacembele wayauka. = The old woman's chitenge is torn. Moyo wakatalika kudunta kapati unakuti camba coonse ciyanda kuyauka. = The heart began to beat quickly so that the whole chest was as if to be about to be torn apart. (1.-yaukwa, 2.-yaukide, 3.-yauzya, 4.-yaukila, 5.-yaukilalyo, 6.-yaikisya, 7.-yauka-yauka, 8.-yaukizyanya,/yauzyanya)

tear, Waciyaula cipepa camaseseke oyu. = This one tore up the paper with the secrets. Uusuma wauyaula kale mulembo. = The one sewing has already torn the cloth. (1.-yaulwa, 2.-yawide, 3.-yauzya, 4.-yawida, 5.-yawidalyo, 6.-yaulisya, 7.-yaula-yaula, 8.-yaulana)
  • speak without respect, Moonde naali kubetekwa walikwiide kuyaula kwaamba limwi babeteka banyema. = When Moonde was being tried he spoke rudely until finally the magistrate became annoyed. Also: -bbodola.

tear a second time after mending, Baciyaulula alimwi cakasumidwe. = They tore again the cloth that had been sewn. Bamakaintu bayaulula tusani kutegwa tusumwe kabotu. = The women are tearing the clothes apart so that they can sew them properly. (1.-yaululwa, 2.-yaulwide, 3.-yauluzya, 4.-yaulwida, 5.-yaulwidalyo, 6.-yaululisya, 7-yaulula-yaulula, 8.-yaulana/-yaulwidana)

crawl as baby, Mwana wakatalika kuyavwula. = The baby has begun to crawl. Sunu kana kalaiya kukkala akuyavwula. = Today the baby is learning to sit and crawl. Also: -kalaba. (1.-yavwulwa, 2.-yavwide, 3.-yavwuzya, 4.-yavwida, 5.-yavwidalyo, 6.-yavwulisya, 7.-yavwula-yavwula, 8.-yavwulilana, /yavwidana)

tear off for someone, rt. yaula, Kamundiyawida nyama ndilye. = Tear off a slice of meat for me so that I eat. Also: -tendela. (1.-yawidwa, /yaulwa, 2.-yawide, 3.-yauzya, 4.-yawida, 5.-yawidalyo, 6.-yaulisya, 7.-yawidayawida, 8.-yaulana, / -yawidana)
  • tear someone's clothes, Bamuyawida cisani nibali kumududa. = They have torn his clothes when they were pulling him.

tear in pieces, Nobakali kulwana mukaintu wakaciyawuula cibbudula camulumi wakwe. = When they were fighting, the wife tore her husband's shorts into pieces. Also: -deluuka, -zapaula. (1.-yawuulwa, 2.-yawiide, 3.-yawuuzya, 4.-yawiida, 5.-yawiidalyo, 6.-yawuulisya, 7.-yawuula-yawuula, 8.-yawuulana, / yawiidana)

feel with fingers, Koyayaanga abulo antela ulaijana nyeleti. = Feel about on the bed, perhaps you will find the needle. Naakamvwa janza limuyayaanga wakabbatamuka = When he felt a hand touching him he woke up. (1.-yayaangwa, 2.-yayaangide, 3.-yayaanzya, 4.-yayaangila, 5.-yayaa-ngilalyo, 6.-yayaangisya, 7.-yayaanga-yayaanga, 8.-yayaangana) Also: -jatauka

feel with fingers, as on the ground, Ndalikuyayanga ansi pele tiindaimvwa nyeleti. I was feeling about on the ground but did not feel the needle. (1.-yayangwa, 2.-yayangide, 3.-yayanzya, 4.-yayangila, 5.-yayangilalyo, 6.-yayangisya, 7.-yayanga-yayanga, 8.-yayangana) Also: ampaampa.

be torn in different places, Cakayayauka cisani ciya moonse. = That cloth is torn everywhere. Cisani cangu cayayauka nitwali kulwana. My shirt was torn everywhere when we were fighting. (1.-yayaukwa, 2.-yayaukide, 3.-yayauzya, /-yayausya, 4.-yayaukila, 5.-yayaukilalyo, 6.-yayaukisya, 7.-yayauka-yayauka, 8.-yayaukizyanya, / yayaukana) Also: -zapauka.

tear in many pieces, Kamuciyayaula cipepa eeci. Tear this paper in many pieces. Musankwa waciyayaula cisani camusimbi. = The boy tore the dress of the girl in different places. (1.-yayaulwa, 2.-yayawide, 3.-yayauzya, 4.-yayawida, 5.-yayawidalyo, 6.-yayaulisya 7.-yayaula-yayaula, 8.-yayawidana) Also: -zazaula, -zapaula.

stammer, speak indistinctly, Ooyu ulayayausya kukanana. = This one stammers in speaking. Muntu kuti wanyema ulayayausya kwaamba. = If a person is angry s/he stammers when speaking. (1.-yayausyigwa, 2.-yayausyide, 3.-yayausya, 4.-yayausyizya, 5.-yayausyizyalyo, 6.-yayaisyisya, 7.-yayausya-yayausya, 8.-yayausyanya)
  • eat without being able to masticate properly, Wakali kuyayausya kutafwuna nkaambo ceele cakali kupya. = He was not able to masticate as he swallowed because the porridge was hot.

cleanse sieve with fire or a brush, Baama bayayila nsefwa kutegwa izwisye kabotu busu. = Mother is. cleaning the sieve so that the flour passes through easily. (1.-yayilwa, 2.-yayilide, 3.-yayizya, 4.-yayilila, 5.-yayililalyo, 6.-yayilisya, 7.-yayila-yayila, 8.-yayilana)

close slightly, Kamuyeeka cijazyo unjile muwo. = Leave the door ajar to let fresh air in. (1.-yeekwa, 2.-yeekede, 3.-yeesya, 4.-yeekela, 5.-yeekelalyo, 6.-yeekesya, 7.-yeeka-yeeka, 8.-yeekelana)
  • breathe, Wakajana zilonda tazilibonyi alimwi mukaintu ulayeeka, mmuumi. He found wounds were not visible and the woman was breathing, she was alive.

remind, rt. -yeeya, Bakandiyeekezya kwiima munzila kuti tulange baciswa mucibbadela. = They reminded me to stop on the way to see the sick in the hospital. Kamundiyeekezya ciimbo, ndaciluba. = Recall the song for me, I have forgotten it. Bantu bakali kuunka kukukweleta mali, pesi mudaala tanaalikuyeekezya muntu kujosya mali. = People were going to borrow money but the old man did not remind a person to return the money. Also: -yeezya. (1.-yeekezyegwa, 2.-yeekezyede, 3.-yeekezya, 4.-yeekezyezya, 5.-yeekezyezyalyo, 6.-yeekezyesya, 7.-yeekezya-yeekezya, 8.-yeekezyanya)

be in a leaning position, rt. yaama, Uliyeeme acisamu. = S/He is leaning against a tree. Bakaindi bakali koona atweembe kumitwe, tuleye twamasumo tuyeeme buyo mbuli waalya. = The people of the past were sleeping with axes beside their heads, a bundle of spears leaning like over there. (1.-yaamwa, 2.-yeeme, 3.-yaamya, 4.-yaamina, 5.-yaaminalyo, 6.-yaamisya, 7.-yeeme-yeeme, 8.-yaamana)

be melted, Zigwedegwede zyesu zyoonse zyakabola akuyeemuka. All our goods rotted and melted. Also: -emuka, -enzemuka, -yaaya. (1.-yeemukwa, 2.-yeemukide, 3.-yeemuzya,/-yeemusya, 4.-yeemukila, 5.-yeemukilalyo, 6.-yeemukisya, 7.-yeemuka-yeemuka, 8.-yeemukizyanya)

mourn (yeye! yeye!), condole, Bamacembele nobalila mumadiwe inga balayeemuna. = Old women sing yeye! yeye! when they weep at a funeral. (1.-yeemunwa, 2.-yeemede, /-yeemwide, 3.-yeemuzya, 4.-yeemwida, 5.-yeemwidalyo, 6.-yeemunisya, 7.-yeemuna-yeemuna, 8.-yeemwidana)
  • sing a little, Ino nguni uyeemuna kwiimba? = Who is singing a little?

be fused, rt. -yaana, Muntu wakalumwa munyengwe kukuulu. Mukubula coolwe muntu bulowa a busaki bwakaliyeenyi kale, tanaasika kali muzumi, wakafwa munzila. The man was bitten on the leg by a viper. Unfortunately the venom fused with the blood, he did not arrive alive, he died on the way. (1.-yaanyizyigwa, / -yaanwa, 2.-yeenye, /
3.-yaanya, 4.-yaanina, 5.-yaaninalyo, 6.-yaanisya, 7.-yeenyi-yeenyi, 8.-yaana)

think intensively, rt. -yeeya, Koyeesya, ulamuyeeya wakupa jamba. Think hard, you will remember who gave the hoe to you. Ndayeesya ino kuti ndakaliko ku Lusaka. I now remember distinctly that I was there in Lusaka. (1.-yeesyegwa, 2.-yeesyede, 3.-yeeyezya, 4.-yeesyezya, 5.-yeesyezyalyo, 6.-yeeyesya, 7.-yeesya-yeesya, 8.-yeeyana, / yeesyanya) Also: -yeeyesya.
  • close partly with something, rt. -yeeka, Koyeesya kasasa amulyango kutegwa nkuku zitanjili munanda. = Close the door partly with the mat so that the chickens do not enter.

think, remember, Konga koyeeya kotanaamba ijwi. = You should think before you say a word. Ino uyeeya nzi ncoumunye? = What are you thinking about that makes you quiet? (1.-yeeyegwa, 2.-yeeyede, 3.-yeeyezya, 4.-yeeyela, 5.-yeeyelalyo, 6.-yeeyesya, 7.-yeeya-yeeya, 8.-yeeyana)
remember, Nkobuli buzuba bwakutaanguna mbweyeeyede. = There is the first day that I rememeber. (ext. same as for -yeeya)

think for someone, rt. yeeya, Kuti muntu wafwidwa wakwe, tuleelede kumuyeeyela zyakucita adilwe lyakwe. If a person loses his beloved, we ought to think for him as to what should be done at his/her funeral. (ext. same as for -yeeya)
  • suspect, Tuyeeyela Mapanza kuti nguwakabba nombe zyokwa Joojo. = We suspect that Mapanza is the one who stole Joojo's cattle.

think hard, concentrate, Kociyeeyesya caano cakakwaambila bacembele. Think hard about the story which the old woman told you. Cizyookugwasya noyeeyesya kapati twaambo otu. = It will belp you if you think hard about these matters. (ext. same as for -yeeya)
remind, Ukafwambaane kundiyeeyezya kaambo kakali kubetekwa. = Remind me quickly about the matter which was being tried at court. Also: -yeekezya. (ext. same as for -yeeya)

suspect a person, Ndiyeezya Joni kuti nguwapwaya nsuwa. = I suspect that it was John who broke the milk gourd. Also: -yeeyela. (1.-yeezyegwa, 2.-yeezyede, 3.-yeezya, /-yeezyezya, 4.-yeezyela, /-yeezyezya 5.-yeezyelalyo, /-yeezyezyalyo 6.-yeezyesya, 7.-yeezya-yeezya, 8.-yeezyanya)
  • remind, Mweelede kundiyeezya buzuba bwakuunka kumuswaangano nkaambo inga ndiyakuluba. = You ought to remind me of the day for going to the meeting because I may forget.

raise above normal, Kutali mboyelengunya obu kulitondezya kubaa maanu koli tojisi noliba lyomwe iganu. Do not be raising yourself above your level showing that you have wisdom when you don't even have a single drop of it. (1.-yelengunyizyigwa, /-yelengunyigwa 2.-yelengunyide, 3.-yelengunya, /yelengunyizya, 4.-yelengunyizyizya, /yelengunyina, 5.-yelengunyizyizyalyo, /yelengunyinalyo, 6.-yelengunyisya, 7.-yelengunya-yelengunya, 8.-yelengunyana)

draw a line on the ground, Koyenga munyinza wamyuunda. = Draw the boundary between the fields. Muyaki uyenga nanda. = The builder is marking out the house. (1.-yengwa, 2.-yengede, 3.-yengezya, 4.-yengela, 5.-yengelalyo, 6.-yengesya, 7.-yenga-yenga, 8.-yengana, /-yengelana) Also: -enga.
