touch or scrape lightly in passing, graze, Musankwa wamuyepula keembe mweenzinyina. = The boy has grazed his friend with an axe. (1.-yepulwa, 2.-yepwide, 3.-yepuzya, 4.-yepwida, 5.-yepwidalyo, 6.-yepulisya, 7.-yepula-yepula, 8.-yepulana) Also: -syepula, -epula.

be bent, Masipilini aamoota ayeta nkaambo masaka amapopwe akavwula. The springs of the vehicle are bending because the sacks of maize are many. (1.-yetwa, 2.-yetede, 3.-yetya, /yetezya, 4.-yetela, 5.-yetelalyo, 6.-yetesya, 7.-yeta-yeta, 8.-yetelana,/-yetezyanya) Also: -eta. Also: -elana
be equal (Ila)

rt. -ezana, be of equal power, Ooku kulilemeka kwabo takuli kwamuntu uyezene, naa uukkwene. = Her self-respect is not normal, nor is it sufficient. (1.-yezanwa, 2.-yezene, 3.-yezanya, 4.-yezanina, 5.-yezaninalyo, 6.-yezani7.-yezene-yezene, 8.-yezana) sya, Also: -elene

skin, scoop off, Muntu uyibula nswi zyakolwa ntimba. Someone is scooping out the fish which were drugged with the mud. Also: -ibula, (1.-yibulwa, 2.-yibwide, 3.-yibuzya, 4.-yibwida, 5.-yibwidalyo, 6.-yibulisya, 7.-yibula-yibula, 8.-yibulana)

reveal, expose, (1.-yibululwa, 2.-yibulwide, 3.-yibuluzya, 4.-yibulwida, 5.-yibulwidalyo, 6.-yibululisya 7.-yibulula-yibulula, 8.-yibulwidana) Also: -yubulula.
  • skim off, Bataata bayibulula mafwuta mumukupa. = Father is skimming the cream from the milk. Also: -ibulula.

relate, tell, Wakali kuyiila mwanaakwe twaano twazintu zisesya zicitika mudolopo. He was telling his child about amusing things which happened in the city. Also: -iila. (1.-yiilwa, 2.-yiilide, 3.-yiizya, 4.-yiilila, 5.-yiililalyo, 6.-yiilisya, 7.-yiila-yiila, 8.-yiilana)
  • limit oneself, Ciindi nowambaula makani acisi koyiila buyo kulumbaizya mfwulumende, utasampauli. = When you talk politics, limit yourself to praise the government, don't critisize it.
  • end up at, Ndakeelede kusika ku Monze jilo pele ndakayiila buyo ku Gonde, mpoona ndapiluka. I ought to have reached Monze yesterday but I ended up just at Gonde and then I returned.

pile things on top of one another, Mebo sunu ndayilikizya zisani nkaambo kulatontola. = Today I am piling the clothes on top of one another because it is cold. Kamuyilikizya mapayi, kula-tontola. Pile on the blankets, it is cold. (1.-yilikizyigwa, 2.-yilikizyizye, /-yilizyide, 3.-yilikizyizya, /-yilikizya, 4.-yilikizyizya, 5.-yilikizyizyalyo, 6.-yilikizyisya, 7.-yilikizyayilikizya, 8.-yilikizyanya) Also: -ilikizya.

show sign of fear or worry, Naakamvwa makani ayoosya meso akwe akatalika kuyilingana. = When he heard the frightning news, his eyes began to show fear. (1.-yilinganwa, 2.-yilingene, 3.-yilinganya, 4.-yilinganina, 5.-yilinganinalyo, 6.-yilinganisya, 7.-yilingana-yilingana, 8.-yilinganyizyanya)
  • wander about in search of, Bantu bayilingana kuyandaula mapopwe lyanzala. The people are wandering about searching for maize during the time of hunger. Sunu Mudimba wayilingana kuyandaula musamu wamwana waciswa. = Today Mudimba is wandering around searching for medicine for the sick child. Also: -ilinkana, -ilingana.

be twisted and disturbed, rt. -yilingana, Nindakamulanga kumeso wakaliyilingene nkaambo wakaliyoowede. = When I looked at his face he grimaced because he was afraid. Also: -ilingene. (extensions same as -yilingana)

be healed, Cicisa camwana sunu cakayiluka. The wound of the child has healed. (1.-yilukwa, 2.-yilukide, 3.-yilusya, 4.-yilukila, 5.-yilukilalyo, 6.-yilukisya, 7.-yiluka-yiluka, 8.-yilusyanya)
  • be filled up, Niyakawa kapati mvwula meenda akayiluka mumugodi wangu. When the rain fell heavily the water filled up in my well. Also: -iluka.

fill up hollow, as a hole or a well or low-lying land, Kamucibikka bulongo aawo aadiimenye nyika, tuyanda kuyiilula. Put more soil there where the land is sunken, we want to raise it up. (1.-yilulwa, 2.-yilwide, 3.-yilusya, /-yiluzya 4.-yilwida, 5.-yilwidalyo, 6.-yilulisya, 7.-yilula-yilula, 8.-yilulana) Also: -ilula

make stand, erect, make something stop, rt. ima, Koyimika basune. Make the oxen stand. Kamиmuyimika ooyo weenda munzila. = Stop that one who is passing along the path. Also: -imika. (1.-yimikwa, 2.-yimikide, 3.-yimika, 4.-yimikilila, 5.-yimikililalyo, 6.-yimikizya, 7.-yimika-yimika, 8.-yimikana)

pass, Muntu wayinda munzila iigama kujwe. The person has used the path to the east. Also: -inda. (1.-yindwa, 2.-yindide, 3.-yindizya / yindya, /-yinzya, 4.-yindila, 5.-yindilalyo, 6.-yindisya, 7.-yinda-yinda, 8.-yindana)
pass before, Musimbi wayindila musankwa kusika kuno. = The girl is first to reach here before the boy. Also: -indila. (extensions same as -yinda)

increase, Banyina bayindizya mwana kulila nibamuuma! = The mother made the child cry more when she beat him! Also: -indizya. (1.-yindizyigwa, 2.-yindizyide, 3.-yindizya, 4.-yindizyizya, 5.-yindizyizyalyo, 6.-yindizyisya, 7.-yindizya-yindizya, 8.-yindizyanya)

repeat, Kamuyindulula kwiimba ciimbo eeco, ncibotu. = Sing that song again, it is good. Also: -indulula. (1.-yindululwa, 2.-yindulwide, 3.-yinduluzya, 4.-yindulwida, 5.-yindulwidalyo, 6.-yindululisya, 7.-yindulula-yindulula, 8.-yindululana)

be determined, Nibakaalilwa kulima nzembwe, bantu banji bakayingasila kulima mapopwe. When they failed to grow grey millet, the people determined to grow maize. Also: -ingasila. (1.-yingasilwa, 2.-yingasilide, / -yingaside, 3.-yingasizya, 4.-yingasilila, 5.-yingasililalyo, 6.-yingasilisya, 7.-yingasila-yingasila, 8.-yingasilana)

shout, Bakoledwe balayanda kuyoba kapati. Those who are drunk like to shout loudly. Banyama tabayandi mucisi muyoba-yoba bantu. = Animals do not like territory where people make a lot of noise. (1.-yobwa, 2.-yobede, 3.-yobya, 4.-yobela, 5.-yobelalyo, 6.-yobesya, 7.-yoba-yoba, 8.-yobelana)

make noise, talk aloud, wrangle, Kamuleka kuyobeka, kuli uciswa. Stop talking loudly, someone is sick. Bacula balayobeka niyawaawa mvwula. Frogs make noise after the first rains. Nilyakatalika bbola, bantu boonse bakali kuyobeka cakukkomana. = When the football match started, all the people began to roar in delight. (1.-yobekwa, 2.-yobekede, 3.-yobezya, 4.-yobekela, 5.-yobekelalyo, 6.-yobekesya, 7.-yobeka-yobeka, 8.-yobezyanya)

make noise, Munzi oonse gwiti kuyobela: kwaambaula, kuseka, kutembaula, nguluulu a nkwasi. = The whole village resounded with the noise: talking, laughing, praising, ululating and clapping. (1.-yobelwa, 2.-yobelede, 3.-yobezya, 4.-yobelela, 5.-yobelelalyo, 6.-yobelesya, 7.-yobela-yobela, 8.-yobelana)

store up, Koyobola mali aya, ndaajana ndaboola. Keep that money, I will find it when I come. Kamuyobola mapopwe aakulya cilimo. = Keep the maize for eating during the dry season. (1.-yobolwa, 2.-yobwede, 3.-yobozya, 4.-yobweda, 5.-yobwedalyo, 6.-yobolesya, 7.-yobola-yobola, 8.-yobwedana, / -yobolana)
  • bury, Muntu wakafwa jilo, bakamuyobola ndilyona jilo cifwumo-fwumo. = They buried the man who died yesterday on the morning of the same day. Also: -zikkwa.

give birth, Musimbi wakayoboloka jilo mwana musankwa. = The girl gave birth to a baby boy yesterday. Also: -tumbuka, -angunuka. (1.-yobolokwa, 2.-yobolokede, 3.-yobolozya, 4.-yobolokela, 5.-yobolokelalyo, 6.-yobolokesya, 7.-yoboloka-yoboloka, 8.-yobolokana)
  • gather, assemble, come together, Bantu bayoboloka kuzya kulangilila bbola. = The people came together to watch the football match.

gather together, *Koba-yobolola bantu bamunzi boonse tubandike zyalwiindi.* Assemble the people from the whole village so that we talk about the *Iwiindi* festival. *Basankwa mbaba-yobolola nombe.* = The boys are the ones who gather up the cattle. (1.-yobololwa, 2.-yobolwede, 3.-yobolo-zya, 4.-yobolweda, 5.-yobolwedalyo, 6.-yobololesya, 7.-yobolola-yobolola, 8.-yobololana) Also: -*kobolola*.

be collected from grazing before being milked, *nombe zilaa mukupa munji ciindi noziyobosegwa.* = Cattle have much milk when they are collected after grazing. cf. -*obosegwa*. (1.-yobosegwa, 2.-yobosede, 3.-yobosya 4.-yobosezya, 5.-yobosezyalyo, 6.-yobose-sya, 7.-yobosegwa-yobosegwa 8.-yobozyanya)

graze cattle before milking, herd cattle in the morning, bring cattle back after grazing, *Mukupa uvwula li-yobosegwa.* = Milk is plentiful at the time when cattle graze before milking. *Mazuba nobayobosya nombe basankwa, inga mukupa mmunji.* = When the boys bring the cows back after grazing, the milk is plentiful. Also: -*obosya*. (extensions same as for -*yobosegwa*)
keep, *Kuzyala bana basimbi nkuyobozya.* = To give birth to daughters is to keep them for yourself. (If you have daughters they belong to you even though they marry.)

be keeping, rt. -*yobweda*, *Wakatumya mali kumunzi ngaakali kuyobwedela.* = He sent money to home which he had been keeping. (1.-yobwedelwa, 2.-yobwedelede, 3.-yobwedezya, 4.-yobwedelela, 5.-yobwedelelalyo, 6.-yobwedelesya, 7.-yobwedela-yobwedela, 8.-yobwedelelana)

roast, grill, bake bread or potatoes, *Kuyoka nyama ncibotu nkaambo ilafwambaana kubizwa.* = It is good to roast meat, because it gets ready quickly. *Akumana kuyoka nyemu kwakali nkokumana kwadilwe.* = When the groundnuts were roasted that was the end of the funeral. (1.-yokwa, 2.-yokede, 3.-yosya, /-yokezya, 4.-yokela, 5.-yokelalyo, 6.-yokesya, 7.-yoka-yoka, 8.-yokeyzyanya, /-yokelana)

be very thin, *Ooyu uliyokede mubili nkaambo kakuciswa.* = This one is thin in body because s/he is sick. (1.-yokezyegwa, 2.-yokede, 3.-yokezya, 4.-yokelela, 5.-yokelelalyo, 6.-yokelesya, 7.-yokede-yokede, 8.-yokezyanya)

become very thin, become very weak, *Watalika kuyokela mubili ooyu.* = This one has started growing thin. *Ino musa uyokela nzi?* = Now my friend, why have you become thin? (extensions same as for -*yokede*)
  • roast for, *Kamundiyokela nyama ndilisye nsima.* = Roast the meat for me so that I eat *nsima* with it. *Wakandiyokela caali moomba uulula.* = She deliberately roasted a bitter turkey-buzzard for me (i.e. she deliberately brought me severe suffering)

make thin, rt. -*yoka*, *Nzala yakandiyokezya.* = The hunger has made me thin. (1.-yokezyegwa, 2.-yokezyede, 3.-yokezya, 4.-yokezyezya, 5.-yokezyezyalyo, 6.-yokezyesya, 7.-yokezya-yokezya, 8.-yokezyanya)

survive, *Kapapa wakayokoka kubulwazi bwasikalileke.* = Kapapa has survived the disease of AIDS. *Cakali ciindi cakutaanguna kubona muntu wakayokoka kuzwa mubbibi lyamulilo.* = It was the first time to see a person who had survived coming out of a blazing fire. (1.-yokokwa, 2.-yokokede, 3.-yokokezya, /-yokozya, 4.-yokokela, 5.-yokokelalyo, 6.-yokokesya, 7.-yokoka-yokoka, 8.-yokokelana, /-yokokana)

take out of the fire or oven, *Kamuciyokola cimbwali cabizwa.* = Take the sweet-potatoes out of the oven, they are ready. *Kamuyokola ndongwe zilaida.* = Take out the groundnuts, they are burning. (1.-yokolwa, 2.-yokwede, 3.-yokozya, 4.-yokolela, /-yokweda, 5.-yokolelalyo,/-yokwedalyo, 6.-yokolesya, 7.-yokola-yokola, 8.-yokolana)

poke as a fire, transfer fire, *Bacembele bayokolola masizi amulilo.* = The old woman is poking out the embers from the fire. (1.-yokololwa, 2.-yokolwede, 3.-yokolozya, 4.-yokolweda 5.-yokolwedalyo, 6.-yokololesya, 7.-yokolola-yokolola, 8.-yokolwedana) Also: -fwekemuna, -tokolola, -cokoma.
  • re-roast, *Kamwiiyokolola nyama,* *kutegwa ibizwe.* = Roast the meat again so that it is roasted properly.
  • show great anger, *Bayokolola mu-* *lilo kumeso balinyemede kapati.* = They stirred up fire in their faces they were so angry.

carry fire from one place to another, *Choonda ngowakatumwa kukuleta lumano lupati Iwakuyokolozya mulilo kuzwa kunanda yamudaala Chipuluka.* = Choonda was the one who was sent to bring a big thongs to carry the fire from the house of the old man Chipuluka.
pull out fire from one place to another, *Kamundiyokolweda mulilo mubikke mumbaula nkayotele munanda.* = Would you pull out fire and put it in the brazier so that I may warm myself in the house.

move along, *Busena obu mbubi kapati nkaambo ulazijana nzoka nkoziti zyayokoma mumitabi yamasamu.* = This place is very bad because you find the snakes moving along the branches of the trees. (1.-yokomezyegwa, 2.-yokomede, 3.-yokomya, 4.-yokomena, 5.-yokomenalyo, 6.-yokomesya, 7.-yokoma-yokoma, 8.-yokomezyanya)

gather up, gather as into a bag, scoop up spilt salt or meal, take from bag with both hands, *Ncibotu kuyola twe awa kutegwa lubuwa luboneke ka-* *botu.* = It is good to gather up the ash so that the courtyard looks well. *Musimbi uyola mankwisyi ngaali kukukula.* = The girl is gathering up the rubbish which she was sweeping. *Basimbi a basankwa bakali kuyola tombe.* The girls and the boys were gathering up the dirt. *Sena kuti meenda atika, inga ulaayola?* = If water is spilt, can it be gathered up? (1.-yolwa, 2.-yolede, 3.-yozya, 4.-yolela, 5.-yolelalyo, 6.-yolesya, 7.-yola-yola, 8.-yolelana)
  • take away, *Bakaluyola lubono loo-* *nse basimalungu.* = The slave traders took all the wealth. Also: -saala mucisi, -kukula

gather up for, *Sena to-* *yeeyi kuti buzuba bwakuciswa, basazi-* *nyoko beni mbabaya kukusanzya akuku-* *yolela abulo?* = Now do you not think that on the day that you are sick, it is your close relatives themselves who will wash you and clean up for you in bed?

swallow without masticating sufficiently, *Kamulya kabotu kutali kuyonga-yonga.* = Eat properly without gulping down the food.
  • gathering together, *Bakabona mukaintu nguulya uyonga-yonga twana twankuku.* = They saw a woman, there she was gathering the chicks together.

poison over a period of time, *Kunywa kaccasu cilayongola.* = To drink kaccasu poisons gradually. *Ncefwu yakamuyongola mubwa katanafwa.* = The poison worked on the dog for long time before it died. (1.-yongolwa, 2.-yongede, 3.-yongozya, 4.-yongeleda, 5.-yongeledalyo, 6.-yongolesya, 7.-yongola-yongola, 8.-yongolana)

writhe in pain, Musankwa uyongosana waciswa mwida. = The boy who is writhing in agony has a stomach pain. (1.-yongosanwa, 2.-yongosene, 3.-yongosanya, 4.-yongosanina, 5.-yongosaninalyo, 6.-yongosanisya, 7.-tongosana-yongosana, 8.-yongosaninana) Also: -myongosana, -nyongosana.

be feared, rt. -yoowa, Mwami wesu ulayoogwa nkaambo mmukali. Our chief is feared because he is fierce. (1.-yoogwa, 2.-yoowede, 3.-yoosya, 4.-yoowela, 5.-yoowelalyo, 6.-yoowesya, 7.-yoogwa-yoogwa, 8.-yoosyanya)

chat softly, converse, Balayooma amacembelenyina mumusalo. = She was having a chat with her other old women friends. Bamakaintu balayooma mucibalu. = The women are chatting behind the wind-break. Bakayooma twaambo tunjaani. They talked about many matters. (1.-yoomwa, 2.-yoomede, 3.-yoomya, 4.-yoomena, 5.-yoomenalyo, 6.-yoomesya, 7.-yooma-yooma, 8.-yoomezyanya)
  • be choked and made sterile by close planting, Mapopwe angu akayooma nkaambo akasisinkana. My maize was choked because it was planted too close together.
  • rustle, shake, Bakateelela bwizu buyooma mbuli kuti kuli ceenda. = They heard the grass rustling as if something was moving. Bakauma ngoma yabukali akutalika kwiimba anyimbo zyalumamba kwayooma malundu. They beat the drum for battle and began to chant warsongs shaking the hills.
make to rustle like dry leaves, Mubwa kunyina nayoomya nkwakwani naweza. The dog never rustles the leaves when hunting.

cause fear, frighten, rt. yoowa Wandiyoosya. You frightened me. Syaamankwamu ulabayoosya bana. The masked dancer frightens the children. (1.-yoosyegwa, 2.-yoosyede, 3.-yoosya, 4.-yoosyezya, 5.-yoosyezyalyo, 6.-yoosyesya, 7.-yoosya-yoosya, 8.-yoosyanya)

fear, Koleka kuyoowa, ndiyakukusindikila. = Stop fearing, I will accompany you. Ndayoowa mvwula izuma. = I am afraid of the rain which thunders. (1.-yoowegwa, 2.-yoowede, 3.-yoosya, 4.-yoowela, 5.-yoowelalyo, 6.-yoowesya, 7.-yoowa-yoowa, 8.-yoowana)

cause to be thin, Zyandiyopezya mubili me nobana bangu nzinji. = There are many things which make me thin, my children. (1.-yopezyegwa, 2.-yopezyede, 3.-yopezya, 4.-yopezyezya, 5.-yopezyezyalyo, 6.-yopezyesya, 7.-yopezya-yopezya, 8.-yopezyanya)
abate as a river, Mulonga wayosa ino, atuzabuke. The river has subsided, let us cross. (1.-yosesyegwa, 2.-yosede, 3.-yosya, 4.-yosela, 5.-yoselalyo, 6.-yosesya, 7.-yosa-yosa, 8.-yosezyanya)
(1.-yosokwa, 2.-yosokede, 3.-yosozya, 4.-yosokela, 5.-yosokelalyo, 6.-yosokesya, 7.-yosoka-yosoka, 8.-yososyanya)
dry up, Nokuba kuti kalonga kalizwide ino, ciindi cisyoonto kayosoloka. Even though the stream is full now, in a little while it dries up.

warm oneself at fire, Naakali kuyota, wakawa mumulilo. When he was warming himself, he fell into the fire. Beembezi balayota nkaambo balikuugwa. = The herders are warming themselves because they were soaked in the rain.
acisaasa = warm in the morning sun; (*1*.-yotwa, *2*.-yotede, *3*.-yotya, *4*.-yotela, *5*.-yotelalyo, *6*.-yotesya, *7*.-yota-yota, *8*.-yotelana)

warm oneself, *Tuyotela* *zuba ano mpotwiimvwi*. = We are warming ourselves in the sun where we are standing. *Nabulwe uyotela zuba*. = The lizard warms itself in the sun. (*1*.-yotelwa, *2*.-yotelede, *3*.-yotelezya, *4*.-yotelela, *5*.-yotelelalyo, *6*.-yotelesya, *7*.-yotela-yotela, *8*.-yotelana)

help, *Kamundiyovwa ku-* *nyamuna cisaka*. Help me to lift the sack. *Kamundiyovwa kwaanzika ciluli* *cabutala*. = Help me to erect the roof for the maize bin. (*1*.-yovwegwa, *2*.-yovwede *3*.-yovwesya, *4*.-yovweda, *5*.-yovwedalyo *6*.-yovwesya, *7*.-yovwa-yovwa, *8*.-yovwana) Also: -gwasya.

chatter noisily, make a noise, *Tulayowela kukanana twana ootu*. = These children are chattering noisily. *Ba-* *cula balayowela mumulonga*. = The frogs are making a noise in the river. *Simpongo* *wakabamvwa basimbi nobakali kuyowela* *abanyina kusule akalundu*. = The goatherd heard the girls chattering noisily with their mother behind the hill. (*1*.-yowelwa, *2*.-yowelede, *3*.-yowezya, *4*.-yowelela, *5*.-yowelelalyo, *6*.-yowelesya *7*.-yowela-yowela, *8*.-yowezyanya)

be alleviated, *Aano ma-* *zuba bantu banji bayoya nkaambo milimo* *yaceya*. Many people have time to catch their breath these days because there is not much work. (*1*.-yoyegwa, *2*.-yoyede, *3*.-yoyezya, *4*.-yoyela, *5*.-yoyelalyo, *6*.-yoyesya, *7*.-yoya-yoya, *8*.-yoyelana)
  • breathe, *Mulwazi uciyoya taninga-* *fwa pe*. The patient is still breathing, she has not yet died. Also: -tweta, -fwepa.

be capable of breathing well, heave a sigh, rt. -yoya, *Munanda* *muno muli muya mubotu, mulayoyeka*. = In the house here there is good air, one can breathe well. (*1*.-yoyekwa, *2*.-yoye-* kede, *3*.-yoyeka, *4*.-yoyekela, *5*.-yoyeke-* lalyo, *6*.-yoyekesya, *7*.-yoyeka-yoyeka, *8*.-yoyekelana)

breathe on/ through, rt. -yoya, *Ooyu ayoya, uyoyela mumpemo*. = When this one breathes, she breathes through the nose. *Twakapegwa mpemo* *zyakuyoyela muya wabuumi*. = We were given noses for breathing in the air of life. (*1*.-yoyelwa, *2*.-yoyelede, *3*.-yoyezya, *4*.-yoyelela, *5*.-yoyelelalyo, *6*.-yoyelesya, *7*.-yoyela-yoyela, *8*.-yoyelana

come out, as skin having been burnt by fire or put into boiling water, *Cayozoloka cikanda naapya* *mwana*. = The skin peeled off when the child was burnt. (*1*.-yozolokwa, *2*.-yozolokede, *3*.-yozolozya, *4*.-yozolokela *5*.-yozolokelalyo, *6*.-yozolokesya, *7*.-yozoloka-yozoloka, *8*.-yozolokana)

peel off, *Musilisi waci-* *yozolola cicisa, cazwa busina bunji*. = The nurse peeled the scab off the sore and a lot of pus came out. (*1*.-yozololwa, *2*.-yozolwede, *3*.-yozolozya, *4*.-yozolweda, *5*.-yozolwedalyo, *6*.-yozololesya, *7*.-yozolola-yozolola, *8*.-yozololana)

lessen, ease off, *Kaindi* *Malambo wakali kunywa kapati bukoko,* *mazubaano wayozya*. In the past Malambo was drinking heavily, now not so much. *Imvwula yakayozya kuwa*. = The rain eased off. *Zuba nilyakayozya ku-* *umpa, bakaunka*. = When the sun stopped burning, they went. *Haatimba waka-* *yozya kubalisya ncinga kapati*. Haatimba stopped going very fast on the bike. *Koyozya kwaambaula*. = Calm down in the way you are talking. *Kaindi twakali* *bazyi banyama besu alimwi twakali* kubayozya kubajaya. = In the past we knew our animals and were slow to kill them.(1.-yozyegwa, 2.-yozyede, 3.-yozya, 4.-yozyezya, 5.-yozyezyalyo, 6.-yozyesya, 7.-yozya-yozya, 8.-yozyanyas, -yozya-yozya lessen, Kamuyozyayozya kweendesya tobamwi twakatala. = Decrease the speed, some of us are tired. Kamuyozya-yozya kutyanka cuute cilacisa. = Ease off in pressing the abcess, it is painful.

hide, elude, evade, Impongo zilayuba nozibona umpe. The goats hide when they see a wild-dog. Also: -vwunta. (1.-yubwa, 2.-yubide, 3.-yubya, 4.-yubila, 5.-yubilalyo, 6.-yubisya, 7.-yuba-yuba, 8.-yubana)

move with the intention of not been seen, Mulambya bakalikuyubaila lyoonse abeenzinyina. Mulambya was always moving in a furtive way with his friends. Yakamana myaka yobile Michelo kuyubaila a Hikwaabonena. = Two years went by with Michelo being with Hikwaabonena in a concealed way. (1.-yubailwa, 2.-yubailide, 3.-yubaizya, 4.-yubailila, 5.-yubaililalyo, 6.-yubailisya, 7.-yubaila-yubaila, 8.-yubailana, |

peel off, Maambo naawa abbwe cikanda cakwe cayubbuluka. When Maambo fell down on a stone his skin peeled off. Also: -pululuka. (1.-yubbulukwa, 2.-yubbulukide, 3.-yubbuluzya, 4.-yubbulukila, 5.-yubbulukilalyo, 6.-yubbulukisya, 7.-yubbuluka-yubbuluka, 8.-yubbululana)

approach stealthily, Baumpe balayubilila nombe, balaluma zicaalila musule atanga. The wild-dogs approach the cattle stealthily, they attack the ones at the end of the herd. (1.-yubililwa, 2.-yubilide, 3.-yubilizya, 4.-yubililila, 5.-yubilililalyo, 6.-yubililisya, 7.-yubilila-yubilila, 8.-yubililana)

do a thing in secret, rt. yuba. Bana balikuyubilizya kuseka naawa mudaala. The children laughed secretly when the old man fell. Mumpelenge uyubilizya buya kucita zintu. = A treacherous person begins to do things in secret. Also: -sisikizya. (1.-yubilizyigwa, 2.-yubilizyide, 3.-yubilizya, 4.-yubilizyizya, 5.-yubilizyizyalyo, 6.-yubilizyisya, 7.-yubilizya-yubilizya, 8.-yubilizyanya)

be revealed, Wayubuluka nitwamufwusa mabwe. = He showed himself when we threw stones at him. Mubbi wayubuluka nibaunka bamasilikani. The thief appeared when the police had gone. (1.-yubulukwa, 2.-yubulukide, 3.-yubuluzya, 4.-yubulukila, 5.-yubulukilalyo, 6.-yubulukisya, 7.-yubuluka-yubuluka, 8.-yubulusyanya)

reveal, Komuyubulula mubbi, utamusisi. = Reveal the thief, do not hide him. (1.-yubululwa, 2.-yubuIwide, 3.-yubuluzya, 4.-yubulwida, 5.-yubulwidalyo, 6.-yubululisya, 7.-yubulula-yubulula, 8.-yubululana)
  • confess, Waliyubulula kuti nguwakabba mali aamunene. = He confessed that he was the one who stole the money from the old man.
revealed to, Chiyoba nguwakandiyubulwida makani aaya. = It was Chiyoba who revealed this matter to me. (extensions same as -yubulula)

be revealed, appear, Tulayubunuka tuuka tunji mainza. = Many little insects appear during the rains. (1.-yubunukwa, 2.-yubunukide, 3.-yubunukizya, 4.-yubunukila, 5.-yubunukilalyo, 6.-yubunukisya, 7.-yubunuka-yubunuka, 8.-yubunukizyanya)

reveal, Koleka kuyubununa maseseke aabapati. = Stop revealing the secrets of the elders. (1.-yubununwa, 2.-yubunwide, 3.-yubunuzya, 4.-yubunywida, 5.-yubunwidalyo, 6.-yubununisya, 7.-yubununa-yubununa, 8.-yubununana) Also: -sisununa.
be revealed, Mubbi wakayubununwa amukaintu wakwe naakapenzegwa abamasilikani. = The thief was revealed by his wife when she was punished severely by the police. (extensions same as -yubununa)

play the game of hide and seek, try to hide where you find nothing to hide you, Sulwe naakakatala kutandwa babwa, wakayudubala kunze a katewo kaniini. = When the hare grew tired of being chased by the dogs, it hid behind a small bush. Also: -dudubala, -yubana

open, as door, (Ila) Wakayula cijazyo kutegwa Mutinta anjile. = He opened the door so that Mutinta could come in. (1.-yulwa, 2.-yulile, 3.-yulizya, 4.-yulwila, 5.-yulwilalyo, 6.-yulisya, 7.-yula-yula, 8.-yulana or -yulilana) Also: -jula, -jalula.

go back and forth frequently, Ulayululumba kweenda awa ziindi zinji kuya kukasimbi kakwe. = He goes back and forth to his girl friend frequently. Muzoka ulayululumba mubutala. = A big snake moves to and fro within the maize store. Batonga bamwi mbalupola-pola. Mbakuyululumba. = Some Tonga people shift residence frequently. They move from one place to another. (1.-yululumbwa, 2.-yululumbide, 3.-yululumbya, 4.-yululumbanina. 5.-yululumbaninalyo, 6.-yululumbanisya, 7.-yululumba-yululumba, 8.-yululumbanina)

be dry, Mapopwe akayuma kale, taaciyokwi. = The maize has already dried, it cannot be roasted. Cayuma cakusama cangu ndiciyanune. = My cloth is dry let me take it out of the sun.(1.-yumizyigwa, 2.-yumide, 3.-yumya, 4.-yumina, 5.-yuminalyo, 6.-yumisya, 7.-yuma-yuma, 8.-yumizyanya)
  • become hard, be strong, Bantu banji balatyompwa kuti bwayuma buzumi. = Many people become disappointed if life becomes difficult. Kamuyuma kubala mabbuku nomutiikazwidilile mumisunko. = Work hard in reading books that is when you will pass the exams.
  • be parched, Amundipe meenda, ayuma amoyo. = Give me some water, my throat is dry.
  • burst out laughing, Naakakanana mucembele kwakalibonya linyo lyomwe mukanwa nkabela bana bakayuma kuseka. = When the old woman spoke one tooth appeared in her mouth, whereupon the children burst into laughter.

push, Kamuyumba myoono yanu antoomwe kutegwa mujate kabotu nswi. = Push your fishing-baskets together so that you catch the fish. Wakayumba cibbudu camabwe mujungusi lyabulo. = He shoved the bundle of stones under the bed. (1.-yumbwa, 2.-yumbide, 3.-yumbya, 4.-yumbila, 5.-yumbilalyo, 6.yumbisya, 7.yumba-yumba,8.-yumbana)

drive the cattle out and to their grazing grounds, Kamuziyumba-yumba nombe kusika mumacelelo aazyo. = Take out the cattle and leave them to graze in their pastures. Also: -umizya.
  • escort, go part of the way with, Ndali kuyumba-yumba mweenzu mulweendo Iwakwe. = I was escorting a visitor on his journey. Mweenzu wamana kulya ngwakutondezya nzila, wamuyumbayumba nkokuya upiluke. = A visitor when finished eating, as he leaves he should be escorted along part of the way to where he is going and then you can return. Also: -sindikila. yumbika melt, smelt, Nyama iijikidwe yamafwuta kuti yatontola ilaanga, aboobo uyelede kwiiyumbika amulilo kutegwa ayaaye mafwuta. = When the cooked meat full of fat is cold it clots, and so you ought to melt it with fire so that the grease disolves. Also: -yaayizya. (1.-yumbikwa,2.-yumbikide, 3.-yumbikizya, 4.-yumbikila, 5.-yumbikilalyo, 6.-yumbikisya, 7.-yumbika-yumbika, 8.-yumbikana)
  • lean something against oneself, Mutoonta wakayumbika ngoma amubili wakwe. = Mutoonta leaned the drum against his body.
  • be handed over, Mainza naakafwa lubono Iwakwe basimukowa bakaluyumbika kubana bakwe. = When Mainza died his matrilineal relatives handed over his property to his children.

push something in front of someone, Bacembele nibakacimwa, bakamuyumbikila cakulya mudaala, bamane bazwa anze. The old lady when she was anoyed, pushed the food to the old man and when finished she went away. (extensions same as -yumbika)

send someone to another place, transfer, hand over to, Cheelo naakabakatazya banyina, bakamuyumbila kuli simizyaabo. = When Cheelo bothered her mother, she sent her to her uncle. Koiyumbila kuli Kakoli ngoma nguucizyi. = Pass the drum on to Kakoli, he is the one who knows. Amubazandule boombe akubayumbila kunze amulundu. = Separate the calves and make them pass behind the hill. Munene naakabona kuti bamukowa wakwe bazumanana, wakabayumbila masumo aakwe oonse. = When the old man saw that his family members per-sisted, he handed over all his spears. Bakamuyumbila kulubazu kwakali kwaangwa tupongo. They moved him over to the side where the goats were tied. (1.-yumbilwa, 2.-yumbide, 3.-yumbizya, 4.-yumbila, 5.-yumbilalyo, 6.-yumbisya, 7.-tumbila-yumbila, 8.-yumbilana)

be pulled off, be peeled off, Inzoka njindauma bbwe yayumbuka cikanda. The snake which I hit with a stone had its skin pulled off. (1.-yumbukwa, 2.-yumbukide, 3.-yumbusya, 4.-yumbukila, 5.-yumbukilalyo, 6.-yumbukisya, 7.-yumbuka-yumbuka, 8.-yumbukana or yumbuzyanya) Also: -yupuluka.

fish with a grass fish-trap, rt. -yumba, Nobayumbya muyumbyo mubotu balajaya tuswi tunji. = When they fish with a good grass fishing-trap they catch many little fish. (1.-yumbwa, 2.-yumbide, 3.-yumbya, 4.-yumbila, 5.-yumbilalyo, 6.-yumbisya, 7.-yumbyayumbya, 8.-yumbana, or -yumbilana)

be strong for, Ikuti wauyumina mulimo, ulaucita kabotu. = If you can become strong for the work, you can do it better. (1.-yuminwa, 2.-yuminide, 3.-yumya, 4.-yumina, 5.-yuminalyo, 6.-yumisya, 7.-yumina-yumina, 8.-yumizyanya)

collapse with laughter, Baliyuminide ansi kuseka nkwindakalumwa ankwindaliwaala ansi. They fell down laughing because I was bitten and the way I threw myself down. (1.-yuminizyigwa, 2.-yuminide, 3.-yuminizya, 4.-yuminizyizya, 5.-yuminizyizyalyo, 6.-yuminizyisya, 7.-yuminide-yuminide, 8.-yumininzyanya)
  • be in the state of having no water, Sunu bamakaintu baateka kule meenda nkaambo. mugoti uliyuminide. = Today the women draw water from afar because the well has completely dried up.

dry by boiling or heating in the sun, evaporate, Meenda ayuminina mucikala. The water has dried up in the well. Mulonga wakatalika kuyu minina. = The river is beginning to dry up. Nkotuli tulonga tuzyila mumulundu oyu tutayuminini acilimo coonse. = There are streams coming from this mountain which do not dry up throughout the entire dry season. (1.-yuminizyigwa, 2.-yuminide, 3.-yuminizya, 4.-yumininina, 5.-yuminininalyo, 6.-yumininisya, 7.-yuminina-yuminina, 8.-yuminizyanya)
  • burst out laughing, Mudaala naakayumuka kuzyana, bantu banji bakayuminina kuseka. = When the old man stood up to dance, many people burst out laughing.
  • faint, Muntu uciswa kasuntu uyuminina lyakkala mwezi. = A person suffering from fits, faints when the new moon appears as a cresent. Also: -netuka.
  • become thin gradually, Namangala ulayuminina mubili mbwaakatalika mwakali. = Namangala is getting thiner and thiner since last year.
  • fall fast asleep, Nibakaunka bakandisiila cibaka cipati aboobo ndakayuminina koona. = When they went they left me a big space and so I fell fast asleep.
  • fall down, Maanya wakakwamuka kuseka, kumamanino wayuminina ansi. = Maanya roared laughing, finally he fell down on the floor.

dry off water, rt. -yuma, Kamwaayuminizya meenda omu, mwamana mucitwide cisyu. = Dry off all the water, and when finished put the pounded groundnuts into the relish. Izuba liyuminizya meenda muzikala. = The sun is making the water evaporate from the wells. (1.-yuminizyigwa, 2.-yuminide, 3.-yuminizya, 4.-yuminizyizya, 5.-yuminizyizyalyo, 6.-yuminizyisya, 7.-yuminizyayuminizya, 8.-yuminizyanya)

be dried up, Ndeetela meenda ndinywe, ndayuminwa amoyo. = Bring me water so that I drink, my throat is dried up. (1.-yuminwa, 2.-yuminidwe, 3.-yumizya, 4.-yumininwa, 5.-yumininwalyo, 6.-yumisyigwa, 7.-yuminwa-yuminwa, 8.-yuminizyanya)
  • desire to smoke, Ndayuminwa kufweba. = I am dying for a smoke.

carry on head or shoulders, Baama bayumpula cileye cankuni amutwe. = Mother is carrying a bundle of firewood on her head. (1.-yumpulwa, 2.-yumpwide, 3.-yumpuzya, 4.-yumpwida, 5.-yumpwidalyo, 6.-yumpulisya, 7.-yumpula-yumpula, 8.-yumpulana) Also: -yumuna, -nyampula.

be carrying a child, Mukamuntu kuti wamita balamuleka kuti kaiya biyo nayumude. If a man's wife conceives they will allow her to learn even when she is pregnant. (1.-yumudwe, 2.-yumude, 3.-yumunzya, 4.-yumwida, 5.-yumwidalyo, 6.-yumunisya, 7.-yumudeyumude, 8.-yumwidana)

set out on a journey, stand up, Kamuyumuka tweende kwasiya. = Let us arise and go, it is getting dark. (1.-yumukwa, 2.-yumukide, 3.-yumusya, 4.-yumukila, 5.-yumukilalyo, 6.-yumukisya, 7.-yumuka-yumuka, 8.-yumusyanya)
  • die suddenly, Kalonga wakaile kuyumuka, kunyina naakaciswa pe. = Kalonga just died suddenly without getting sick at all. Also: -anguka.

lift a load on to one's head or shoulders, Kamuyumuna cibulo cameenda eeci. Lift this bucket of water on to the head. Bamakaintu mbayumu kuyumuna. Women are strong in carrying water on the head. Also: -nyampula. (1.-yumunwa, 2.-yumwide, 3.-yumunzya, 4.-yumwida, 5.-yumwidalyo, 6.-yumunisya 7.-yumuna-yumuna, 8.-yumunana)

carry for, Mainza wakamuyumunzya coola musimbi. = Mainza carried the girl's luggage for her. (1.-yumuzyigwa, 2.-yumuzyide, 3.-yumuzyisya, 4.-yumuzyizya, 5.-yumuzyizyalyo, 6.-yumuzyisya, 7.-yumuzya-yumuzya, 8.-yumuzyanya)

carry, rt. -yumuna, Boonse biya abanama ndajanide kuti omwe-omwe waliyumwide kabondo antela tutaka. = I found that each of all my young friends was carrying a small barbel or little fishes. Mainza wakazyiba kuti usyi wakalikayumwide. Mainza knew that his father had something on his mind. (1.-yumwidwe, 2.-yumwide, 3.-yumuzya, 4.-yumwida, 5.-yumwidalyo, 6.-yumunisya 7.-yumwide-yumwide, 8.-yumwidana)

recover health, be healed, make strong, rt. -yuma, Kuti babbi basika amunzi wako, ncibotu kuliyumya. = When thieves come to your home, it is good to make yourself strong. Kuti mwanjila mumapenzi uleelede kuliyumya moyo. = When you are in difficulties you have to be strong in heart. (1.-yumizyigwa, 2.-yumide, 3.-yumya, 4.-yumina, 5.-yuminalyo, 6.-yumisya, 7.-yumya-yumya, 8.-yumizyanya)
  • dry, Mbana bakaciyumya cisamu nobakacigonka miyanda. = It was the children who dried up the tree when they cut the roots.
  • dry the grass (idiomatic) Bubotu bwa Mutinta bwakali kuyumya mani. = The beauty of Mutinta was 'drying up the grass'. Bakalijisi luyando luyumu nta Iwakali kuyumya mani. = They had a very strong love for one another which was drying up the grass.
Also: -kolelezya

look into a pot when uncovering it, Kamuyuna mucibiya cili acikko citaidi cisyu. = Be looking into the pot on the fire so that the relish does not burn. Also: -sondela. (1.-yunwa, 2.-yunide, 3.-yunizya, 4.-yunina, 5.-yuninalyo, 6.-yunisya, 7.-yuna-yuna, 8.-yuninana)
  • come into view, Wakayuna anze amufwunko wakwe mujanza. = He emerged with a walking stick in his hand.

become gradually or partially apparent, Mangweengwe aka-talika kuyunamina muli bamwi babo. = Comic actions began to appear among some of them. (1.-yunaminwa, 2.-yunamide, 3.-tunamizya, 4.-yunaminina 5.-yunamininalyo, 6.-yunaminisya, 7.-yunamina-yunamina, 8.-yunaminana)

shear or cut hair in a rough manner, Chinyama bamuyunda kumugela mumutwe akagele. = They cut the hair on Chinyama's head with a scissors. Ooyu tacizyi kugela, waile kumuyunda mwana. = This one does not know how to cut hair, he just cut the child roughly. (1.-yundwa, 2.-yundide, 3.-yundya, 4.-yundila, 5-yundilalyo, 6.-yundisya, 7.-yunda-yunda, 8.-yundana)

incite, Ndakabayunga beenzuma kuti tuume babbi. = I incited my friends that we beat the thieves, Ncibi kuyunga bana kuti kabaumana. = It is bad to incite children to beat one another. Kabayunge bakali, bakawaale = Incite the angry ones, so that they start fighting. (1.-yungwa, 2.-yungide, 3.-yungizya, 4.-yungila, 5.-yungilalyo, 6.-yungisya, 7.-yunga-yunga, 8.-yungana)

add water in cooking pot, Kamuyungilila meenda mumpoto. = Add water in the pot. (1.-yungililwa, 2.-yungilide, 3.-yungilizya, 4.-yungilila, 5.-yungililalyo, 6.-yungililisya, 7.-yungilila-yungilila, 8.-yungililana)
  • exaggerate stories, Sibunjaka ulayanda kuyungilila twaambo kuleka mbotubede bwini. = A trouble-maker exaggerates stories not telling them as they actually are.

increase, Kamuyungizya mapopwe avwule kuya kucigayo. = Add more maize so that it is enough going to the mill. Kocaayungizya mali tatukasiki nkotuya. = Increase the money, we will not reach our destination. (1.-yungizyigwa, 2.-yungizyide, 3.-yungizyisya, 4.-yungizyizya, 5.-yungizyizyalyo, 6.-yungizyisya, 7.-yungizya-yungizya, 8.-yungizyanya)

be attached to, Tatweelede kuyungwa zilyo a zisamo. = We should not be attached to food and clothes. (1.-yungwa, 2.-yungide, 3.-yungizya, 4.-yungila, 5.-yungilalyo, 6.-yungisya, 7.-yungwa-yungwa, 8.-yungana)

glimpse, spy, listen in secret, rt. -yuna, Ndakali kuyunina kunze aananda nobakanana. = I was listening in secret behind the house when they were talking. Sulwe ulayunina mubwina. = The hare is peeping out of the hole. Kamulomya kusinka, ndaibona mbeba ilayunina mubwina. = Block it properly, I have seen a mouse appearing at the hole. Kulwazya koonse bakali kwiide kuyunina. = Tending the sick for them was just peeping in now and then. Also: -sondela. (1.-yuninwa, 2.-yunide, 3.-yunizya, 4.-yuninina, 5.-yunininalyo, 6.-yuninisya, 7.-yunina-yunina, 8.-yuninana)

yunizya check, show oneself briefly, Zyakaakweenda buti zintu kumunzi ooku nkookaakwiile kuyunizya mpemo. = How were things there at the village where you only visited briefly. (1.-yunizyigwa, 2.-yunizyide, 3.-yunizya, 4.-yunizyizya, 5.-yunizyizyalyo, 6.-yunizyisya, 7.-yunizya-yunizya, 8.-yunizyanya)

quake as earth, Nyika yayuntaana akaambo kabukali bwa Mwami Leza. The earth shook because of the anger of the Lord God. (1.-yuntaanwa, 2.-yuntaanide, 3.-yuntaaya, 4.-yuntaanina, 5.-yuntaaninalyo, 6.-yuntaanisya, 7.-yuntaana-yuntaana, 8.-yuntaaninana or -yuntaanizyanya) Also: -zungaana, -yuuntana, -yuntana.

shake as the earth, Ooyu muntu taakakolwa pe; wakali buyo kulyoolola, kuminingana akuyuntana mpoona ansi mpaakakkede. This man was not drunk, he was just stretching, twisting about and shaking there on the ground where he sat. Also: -yuntaana. (1.-yuntanwa, 2.-yuntanide, 3.-yuntanya, 4.-yuntanina, 5.-yuntaninalyo, 6.-yuntanisya, 7.-yuntana-yuntana, 8.-yuntaninana,/-yuntanizyanya)

inspect traps, Tuyakukuyunza mputwateede. = We are going to inspect where we left the traps. (1.-yunzwa, 2.-yunzide, 3.-yunzizya, 4.-yunzila, 5.-yunzilalyo, 6.-yunzisya, 7.-yunza-yunza, 8.-yunzilana) Also: -langila

inspect trap for someone, rt. yunza, Mwanaangu musankwa wakaka kuya kundiyunzila tooye. = My son refused to go and inspect the little traps for me. (1.-yunzilwa, 2.-yunzilide, 3.-yunzilizya, 4.-yunzizyizya, 5.-yunzizyizyalyo, 6.-yunzizyisya, 7.-yunzilayunzila, 8.-yunzilana) Also: -inzila.

swell or rise up quickly, as a blister, Munene wayunzumuka cikoto mpaawumwa bbwe. = The old man was swollen with a lump where he had been hit with a stone. Lyayunzumuka twizya mukwaanza kwangu. = A blister had arisen on my hand. (1.-yunzumukwa, 2.-yunzumukide, 3.-yunzumusya, 4.-yunzumukila, 5.-yunzumukilalyo, 6.-yunzumukisya, 7.-yunzumukayunzumuka, 8.-yunzumusyanya
project abruptly, rt. yunzumuka, Naakaumwa bbwe, nkumo yakwe yakaliyunzumukide. = When he was struck by a stone, his forehead rose in a swelling.

peel, shell, Bana bayupa nyemu, ncobakkede. The children are shelling groundnuts, that is why they are sitting. (1.-yupwa, 2.-yupide, 3.-yupya, 4.-yupila, 5.-yupilalyo, 6.-yupisya, 7.-yupa-yupa, 8.-yupilana, /-yupana) Also: -pabula.
  • bare teeth, Abaya bantu bayupa buyo menyo, pesi tabakkomene. = Those people are showing their teeth, but they are not happy. Also: -sipula menyo
  • change skin, as snake, Nzoka njindabona munzila yatalikide kale kuliyupa. = The snake which I saw on the way had already began to slough its skin. Also: -kwama.

peel off, Cayupuka cikanda naapya. The skin peeled off when he was burnt. Cicisa cayupuka naanditoneka Kazeni. = The wound was opened when Kazeni hurt me. (1.-yupukwa, 2.-yupukide, 3.-yupukizya, 4.-yulukila, 5.-yupukilalyo, 6.-yupukisya, 7.-yupuka-yupuka, 8.-yupukizyanya)

tear skin, Koyupula cicisa cisilikwe kabotu. = Peel the scab off the sore so that it can be treated. (1.-yupulwa, 2.-yupwide, 3.-yupuzya, 4.-yupwida, 5.-yupwidalyo, 6.-yupulisya, 7.-yupula-yupula, 8.-yupulana)

be peeled off, Lukanda Iwayupuluka naatikilwa meenda apya. = The skin was peeled off when hot water was poured on it. Also: -puluka. (1.-yupulukwa, 2.-yupulukide, 3.-yupulukizya, 4.-yupulukila, 5.-yupulukilalyo, 6.-yupulukisya, 7.-yupuluka-yupuluka, 8.-yupulusyanya)

scratch off, remove feathers, Twaiyupulula nkuku ameenda apya. = We plucked the feathers off the chicken with hot water. Baama bayupulula tusamu twamyoono. Mother is removing the bark from the sticks for a fishing-basket. (1.-yupupulwa, 2.-yupulwide, 3.-yupuluzya, 4.-yupulwida, 5.-yupulwidalyo, 6.-yupululisya, 7.-yupulula-yupulula, 8.-yupululana)

sit in shade, take shelter, Basimpongo bakayusa mvwula mucitungu. The goatherds were sheltering from the rain in a shelter. Wakabandika akuyusa anguwe ciindi noyakatalika kuwa mvwula. He talked and sheltered with him when the rain began to fall. (1.-yuswa, 2.-yuside, 3.-yusya, 4.-yusila, 5.-yusilalyo, 6.-yusisya, 7.-yusa-yusa, 8.-yusisyanya)

hide under, rt. -yusa, Banyama babula kwakuyusila zuba. = The animals lack a place to shelter from the sun. (1.-yusilwa, 2.-yusilide, 3.-yusizya, 4.-yusilila, 5.-yusililalyo, 6.-yusilisya, 7.-yusila-yusila, 8.-yusililana)

be on top of something else, Wakaakujana nzuki zitegwa sikaulu zilazwa ansi mumpangala yabbwe pati. Nolikomena boobu lyakayusubele buyo acuulu. He found bees called sikaulu coming out on the ground from a hole in a huge stone. As big as it was, it was perched on top of an ant-hill. (1.-yusubalwa, 2.-yusubele, 3.-yusubazya, 4.-yusubalila, 5.-yusubalilalyo, 6.-yusubalisya, 7.-yusubele-yusubele, 8.-yusubalilana)

start late, Aba basikusonda bakaakulala munzila nkaambo kubweza bakayusuka. These going for divination slept on the way because they had started their journey (to the witchdoctor) late in the day. (1.-yusukwa, 2.-yusukide, 3.-yususya, 4.-yusukila, 5.-yusukilalyo, 6.-yusukisya, 7.-yusukayusuka, 8.-yususyanya) =

start on a journey late in the day, go to fields late in day, resume work in the evening, Balimi bayusukila kale kutegwa bafwambe kumana. The farmers have resumed work in the evening so that they finish quickly. Syabufwuma bulalweza, buyusukila mbobwami. = The one starts quickly is cursed, the one who starts later finds wealth. (1.-yusukilwa, 2.-yusukide, 3.-yusukizya, 4.-yusukila, 5.-yusukilalyo, 6.-yusukilisya, 7.-yusukila-yusukila, 8.-yusukilana)

appear unexpectedly, Waile kuyutuka mpaatakali kuyeeyelwa. = He just appeared when he was not thought of. Civwubwe wayutuka munsaa bwato bwesu. = The hippo appeared suddenly beside our boat. Also: -bbunuka. (1.-yutukwa, 2.-yutukide, 3.-yutukizya, 4.-yutukila, 5.-yutukilalyo, 6.-yutukisya, 7.-yutuka-yutuka, 8.-yutukilana)

be revealed, Zyoonse zyeelede kuyutukilwa antangalala. = Everything should be revealed openly.
  • fall suddenly upon one who is hidden, Bamasilikani bakamuyutukila akumwaanga. = The police pounced on him and arrested him.

reveal, Nguni wakayutula kaambo kamaseseke? = Who divulged the secret matter. Also: -sisununa. (1.-yutulwa, 2.-yutwide, 3.-yutuzya, 4.-yutwida, 5.-yutwidalyo, 6.-yutulisya, 7.-yutula-yutula, 8.-yutulana)

clean by shaking, as removing grit from the grain, Kamuziyuula ndongwe zisalale. = Clean the groundnuts by removing the grit. Kamuyuula masembe aacibwantu. = Clean the half-ground maize for the sweet-beer. (1.-yuulwa, 2.-yuuwide, 3.-yuuzya, 4.-yuuwida, 5.-yuuwidalyo, 6.-yuulisya, 7.-yuula-yuula, 8.-yuulana)

shake, Musamu nowakayuuna amuwo, matu manji akalokela ansi. = When the tree was shaken by the wind, many leaves fell to the ground. Ooyu mmuzumi pele kubee bongo bwayuuna uyandika kutola kucibbadela. = This one is alive, but it seems he is concussed, he needs to be taken to hospital. (1.-yuunwa, 2.-yuunide, 3.-yuunya, 4.-yuunina, 5.-yuuninalyo, 6.-yuunisya, 7.-yuuna-yuuna, 8.-yuunyizyanya)

swing horns, Kwakayuma caanza kwayuunkana meja kazisolwedela kuzyeeta kumunzi. = The head was firm, moving the horns from side to side as it led back the herd to the village. (1.-yuunkanwa, 2.-yuunkene, 3.-yuunkanya, 4.-yuunkanina, 5.-yuunkaninalyo, 6.-yuunkanisya, 7.-yuunkana-yuunkana, 8.-yuunkanizyanya)

mixed up in thought, Bamana kufweba lubanje, nobeenda balombwana aba, bongo bwiile kuyuuntana. = When they had finished smoking cannabis, as these boys walked, their brains were scrambled. (1.-yuuntanwa, 2.-yuuntene, 3.-yuuntanya, 4.-yuuntanina, 5.-yuuntaninalyo, 6.-yuuntanisya, 7.-yuuntana-yuuntana, 8.-yuuntanizyanya)

cause to be seen, Nobakamana kumunanika nakukwatwa bakamuyuunya amulyango kuti bana koomusimbi bamubone. = After anointing the bride-to-be they revealed her at the doorway so that the relatives of the girl could see her. (1.-yuunyizyigwa, 2.-yuunyizyide, 3.-yuunya, 4.-yuunyizyizya, 5.-yuunyizyizyalyo, 6.-yuunyizyisya, 7.-yuunya-yuunya, 8.-yuunyizyanya)
  • cause to tremble, Bukali bwausyi bwakamuyuunya mwanaakwe acuuno mpaakakkede. = The anger of the father caused the child to tremble on the stool where he was seated.

rush to, Bantu bayuwa kuya kucisobano. = The people are all rushing to the concert. (1.-yuwigwa, 2.-yuwide, 3.-yuwizya, 4.-yuwila, 5.-yuwilalyo, 6.-yuwisya, 7.-yuwa-yuwa, 8.-yuwizyanya)
  • scoop out, bale out, Baama bayuwa masembe aacibwantu. = Mother is scooping out the half-ground maize-grains for the sweet-beer. Also: -kupa, -yupa.
  • perspire, also-yupa nkasaalo, -fwa mibe.
come, Koza kuno. = Come here. Koza tulye nsima. = Come so that we eat nsima. (1.-zidwa, 2.-zide, 3.-zizya, 4.-zida, 5.-zidalyo, 6.-zisya, 7.-za-za, 8.-zidana) Also: -zya.
nickname, Mebo ndime Haanzala pele bantu bakandizaalika zina lyakuti ndime Kaliyangile. = Myself I am Haanzala, but people have nicknamed me with the name saying I am Kaliyangile.

nickname, rt. -zaalika, Mutinta nobakamusisya kumunzi wabo, ngobakazaalikizya zina lya Mungayu, bakamwiindilizya kukwatwa kuli Siame. = When they brought Mutinta to their village, which they nicknamed Mungayu, they had her quickly married to Siame. (1.-zaalikizyigwa, 2.-zaalikizyide, 3.-zaalikizya, 4.-zaalikizyizya, 5.-zaalikizyizyalyo, 6.-zaalikizyisya, 7.-zaalikizyazaalikizya, 8.-zaalikizyanya)

be prodigal, dissipate, Ooyu mwana ulazabala mbuli mubaya fwumbwa ncaapegwa. = This child wastes things as a careless person whatever s/he is given. (1.-zabalwa, 2.-zabele, 3.-zabazya, 4.-zabalila, 5.-zabalilalyo, 6.-zabalisya, 7.-zabala-zabala, 8.-zabalilana) Also: -azuula.

run or jump about, Mwana nobamuuma banyina, wali kuzabalika kumwi ulalila. = When the mother beat the child, she was running about while crying. (1.-zabalikwa, 2.-zabalikide, 3.-zabalisya, 4.-zabalikila, 5.-zabalikilalyo, 6.-zabalikisya, 7.-zabalazabala, 8.-zabalisyanya)

be angry, Ndazabana akaambo kamakani ngaandaambila Mutinta. = I am angry because of the news Mutinta told me. (1.-zabanwa, 2.-zabene, 3.-zabanya, 4.-zabanina, 5.-zabaninalyo, 6.-zabanisya, 7.-zabanazabana, 8.-zabaninana)
  • be dishevelled in appearance, Moonde wakali mulondo, lino wakazabana akaambo kakunywa kapati bukoko. = Moonde was a neat person, nowadays he is shabby because of drinking too much beer. Also: -zakala.

enrage, Choombe ulayanda kuzabaunya bantu amajwi mabi. = Choombe likes to upset people with abusive words. (1.-zabaunyizyigwa, 2.-zabaunyide, 3.-zabaunya, 4.-zabaunyizyizya, 5.-zabaunyizyizyalyo, 6.-zabaunyisya, 7.-zabaunya-zabaunya, 8.-zabaunyizyanya)

distribute in portions, Basikwaaba bazabaula nyama muzibiya. = Those sharing the meat are distributing it in portions from the pots. cf. zubaula. (1.-zabaulwa, 2.-zabawide, 3.-zabauzya, 4.-zabawida, 5.-zabawidalyo, 6.-zabaulisya, 7.-zabaula-zabaula, 8.-zabawidana, / -zabaulana)
  • remove, shake off, Ino walumwa nzi nkolizabaula? = What has bitten you that you are shaking it off?

ferry across, rt. -zabuka, Mbangaye bantu mboozabausya sunu? = How many people have you ferried across today? Wali kuzabausya basicikolo basinkilwa mulonga. = He was ferrying the pupils across who were blocked by the river. Also: -zabusya,-zabula. (1.-zabausyigwa, 2.-zabausyide, 3.-zabausya, 4.-zabausyizya, 5.-zabausyizyalyo, 6.-zabausyisya, 7.-zabausya-zabausya, 8.-zabausyanya)

cross over, Bakazabuka mulonga boonse kuya ku Botswana. = They all crossed the river going to Botswana. Wakasika akalonga kalamfwu katazabukwi. = They reached a deep stream which could not be crossed. (1.-zabukwa, 2.-zabukide, 3.-zabusya, 4.-zabukila, 5.-zabukilalyo, 6.-zabukisya, 7.-zabuka-zabuka, 8.-zabusyanya) Also: -landuka.

transport across, Kamubazabula beenzu abwato bupati. = Transport the visitors across in a big boat. (1.-zabulwa, 2.-zabwide, 3.-zabuzya, 4.-zabwida, 5.-zabwidalyo, 6.-zabulisya, 7.-zabula-zabula, 8.-zabulana)
  • mock jokingly, *Bajwanyina balazabulana* ciindi cadilwe. = Cousins mock each other during funerals.
  • pick, take out, *Kamuzabula* nyama mulye anywebo. = Take out the meat so that you also may eat. Also: -zubula.

be torn or worn out, *Eeci cisani cazakala*, kuyandika kuula cipya. = This cloth is worn out, there is need to buy a new one. *Inanda yakazakala*. = The house was dilapidated. *Suma bbuku lyako, lyakazakala*. = Sew your book, it has fallen apart. Musimbi wakaboola mbuli kuti wakalisweekele kuzakala amatombe. = This girl came as if she was lost, worn out and dishevelled with dirt. (1.-zakalwa, 2.-zakele, 3.-zakazya, 4.-zakalila, 5.-zakalilalyo, 6.-zakalisya, 7.-zakala-zakala, 8.-zakazyanya)
be uncared for, Masusu akwe *akalizakalide*. = His hair was unkempt.
shiver, Ncinzi cakupa
akupozomoka akuluba toonse tuswi twako? = What makes you shiver and shout forgetting all your little fish.
shake vigorously, Syuumbwa wakatalika kulizakamuna kwapepela mwaala wangala. = The lion began to shake itself and ruffle the hair of his mane. Naakaumuna Iwakaindi, Mainza

akutalika kukanana. When he was quite for a while, Mainza shook himself and began to speak. (1.-zakamunwa, 2.-zakamwide, 3.-zakamuzya, 4.-zakamwida, 5.-zakamwidalyo, 6.-zakamunisya, 7.-zakamuna-zakamuna, 8.-zakamunana)
  • to be metamorphosed, kulizakamuna, Also: kulifwungula, -sanduka
be in ruins, as a house, or worn out as clothes Also: -zakala

do injury to a person, mutilate, rt.-zakana, *Mutumba wa Chiiba tiiwakalangwa naakali kutolwa kukuzikkwa, nkaambo mootokala wakamuzakanya kapati.* = Chiiba was not body-viewed because the car badly mutilated him.
  • cause to be torn off, *Cakazakanya ciluli nkambizyi kakainda jilo.* = What destroyed the roof was the whirlwind which passed yesterday. Also: -zakazya. (1.-zakanyizyigwa, 2.-zakanyide, 3.-zakanya, 4.-zakanyila, 5.-zakanyilalyo, 6.-zakanyisya, 7.-zakanya-zakanya, 8.-zakanyizyanya)

destroy, wear out, rt. -zakala, *Mulazyi wakacizakazya ciluli cananda.* = It was the termites which caused the roof to be destroyed. *Mudyaka wakali kuyanda kuti amuzakazye mukaintu wakwe kutegwa kubule bamuyanda.* = Mudyaka wanted to wear his wife out so that no one would love her. Also: -zakanya. (1.-zakazyigwa, 2.-zakazyide, 3.-zakazya, 4.-zakazyizya, 5.-zakazyizyalyo, 6.-zakazyisya, 7.-zakazya-zakazya, 8.-zakazyanya)

be dishevelled, rt. -zakala, *Muce wa Michelo wakapompa kaide kuzakede.* = The young brother of Michelo arrived in a dishevelled state. (1.-zakedwe, 2.-zakede, 3.-zakazya, 4.-zakalila, 5.-zakalilalyo, 6.-zakalisya, 7.-zakede-zakede, 8.-zakazyanya)

nickname, rt.-zalikizya, *Bantu bakamuzalikide zina Iya Mbooma nkaambo wakali musankwa uuluma meno* fwumbwa ngubalwana limwi. = The people nicknamed him boa-constrictor because he was a boy who used his teeth to fight with who ever he fought. (1.-zalikizidwe, 2.-zalikizide, 3.-zalikizya, 4.-zalikizyizya, 5.-zalikizyizyalyo, 6.-zalikizyisya, 7.-zalikizide-zalikizide, 8.-zalikizyanya)

nickname, invent, imagine, *Bakandizalikizya* buyo azina eeli, talili lyangu. They just nicknamed me with this name, it is not mine. Mebo aawo mbundakali kulisukata kuteelela kaano aaka, kakali kulimvwinsya mbuli kuti nkakuzalikizya. Myself there as I sat with my head in my hand listening to that account, it sounded as if it was invented. Toonse tulizyi kuti kaambo kakuyiilwa kajisi zimwi izyakuzalikizya. = We all know that a story which is handed on may contain fiction. Kaya buyo ku Mukobeko bakamukosole nsingo nataningajaya bana Haamasumo mbazalikizya bulozi. Let him go to Mukobeko prison where they will hang him by the neck before he kills the family of Haamasumo whom he had falsely portrayed as using witchcraft. (1.-zalikizidwe, 2.-zalikizide, 3.-zalikizya, 4.-zalikizyizya, 5.-zalikizyizyalyo, 6.-zalikizyisya, 7.-zalikizya-zalikizya, 8.-zalikizyanya) Also: -antikizya.

wrap round, climb as plants by tendrils, Eezi nzimbe ziyandika kuzamba kutegwa zinyamukike. These sugar-canes need to be tied so as to be easily carried. Milibo yanyabo ilazamba mumapopwe. The bean-tendrils are growing around the maize stalks. Siluubilili wakazamba luubilili mumitabi. The spider wound the web all around the branches. (1.-zambwa, 2.-zambide, 3.-zambya, 4.-zambila, 5.-zambilalyo, 6.-zambisya, 7.-zamba-zamba, 8.-zambana, /-zambilana)

coil around, bandage, rt.zamba, *Cakazambaila cooye kabwa.* = The cord has coiled around the little dog. *Mutinta yamuzambaila nzoka.* = The snake coiled around Mutinta. Nyika yakasanduka yakaide kubazambaila bantu. = The world has changed it is just coiling around the people. i.e. new ideas confusing the people. Bamwi balizambaila bumpelenge a luciso luyoosya. = Some have wrapped themselves up in deceit and a terrible hatred. *Cisamu cilazambaila cisamu cimbi.* One tree is coiling around another. (1.-zambailwa, 2.-zambailide, 3.-zambaizya, 4.-zambailila, 5.-zambaililalyo, 6.-zambailisya, 7.-zambaila-zambaila, 8.-zambailana)
  • wander in conversation, Wakali kuzambaila buyo mukukanana kwakwe. = He was just wandering in his speaking.
  • involve, entangle, Bakandizambaila kaambo nketabwene. They were just entangling me in a case which I did not know.

wind around each other, rt.zamba, Maulu akwe akali kuzambana naakali kweenda. His legs were twisting around each other when he was walking. (1.-zambanwa, 2.-zambene, 3.-zambanya 4.-zambanina, 5.-zambaninalyo, 6.-zambanisya, 7.-zambana-zambana, 8.-zambana)

hold securely, embrace, rt. -zamba, *Kozambatila acisamu utanyikili.* Hold tightly onto the tree so that you do not drown in the water. (1.-zambatilwa, 2.-zambatide, 3.-zambatizya, 4.-zambatilila, 5.-zambatililalyo, 6.-zambatilisya, 7.-zambatila-zambatila, 8.-zambatilana) Also: -gwambatila.

coil around, rt.-zamba, *Imbooma yakazambilila mubili wambelele oonse.* = The boa-constrictor coiled around the whole body of the sheep. (1.-zambililwa, 2.-zambilide, 3.-zambilizya, 4.-zambilila, 5.-zambililalyo, 6.-zambililisya, 7.-zambilila-zambilila, 8.-zambililana) Also: -zambaila.
shift residence to a considerable distance, Maambo waka

*mwakali*. = Maambo moved away to another place last year. (1.-zambukwa, 2.-zambukide, 3.-zambukizya, 4.-zambukila, 5.-zambukilalyo, 6.-zambukisya, 7.-zambuka-zambuka, 8.-zambukana) Also: -dubbuka
  • be made thin, as milk, Mukupa
*nkaambo* *bana* *bakatila* *meenda*. = The milk was made thin because the children had watered it.

make thin by watering down, Bana *bakauzambula* *mukupa*. = The children have watered down the milk. (1.-zambulwa, 2.-zambwide, 3.-zambuzya 4.-zambwida, 5.-zambwidalyo, 6.-zambulisya, 7.-zambula-zambula, 8.-zambwidana)

part as stitches, Cazambuluka *cisuwo* *caalukidwe*. = The basket which was weaved, came apart. (1.-zambulukwa, 2.-zambulukide, 3.-zambulukizya, 4.-zambulukila, 5.-zambulukilalyo, 6.-zambulukisya, 7.-zambuluka-zambuluka, 8.-zambulukana) Also: -samunuka.
  • unwind oneself *Inzoka* *ya-zambuluka* *amubili* *wamwana*. = The snake unwound itself from the body of the child.
unravel, uncoil, disengage, *Kamukazambulula* *cooye* *kabwa*. = Remove the cord from the little dog.
*luwaile*. = Unravel the wire. Also: -lambulula, -zambununa. (1.-zambululwa, 2.-zambulwide, 3.-zambuluzya, 4.-zambulwida, 5.-zambulwidalyo, 6.-zambululisya, 7.-zambulula-zambulula, 8.-zambululana)
be unraveled, be unwound, *Cazambunuka* *kale* *cooye*. = The cord is already released. *Luwaile*
*kale*. = The wire is already unraveled. Also: -zambuluka. (1.-zambunukwa, 2.-zambunukide, 3.-zambunukizya, 4.-zambunukila, 5.-zambunukilalyo, 6.-zambunukisya, 7.-zambunuka-zambunuka, 8.-zambunukana)
unwind, Musimbi

*kuzambununa* *masusu*. = The girl was unwinding her hair. *Candaalila* *kuzambununa* *luwaile* *nkaambo* *nduyumu*. = It was beyond me to unravel the wire because it was hard. (1.-zambununwa, 2.-zambunwide, 3.-zambunuzya, 4.-zambunwida, 5.-zambunwidalyo, 6.-zambununisya, 7.-zambununazambununa, 8.-zambununana)

be scattered, separated, *Inombe* *zyazandauka* *musyokwe*. = The cattle are scattered about in the bush. *Twakali* *antoomwe*, *ino* *twakazandauka*. = We used to be together, now we are separated. (1.-zandaukwa, 2.-zandaukide, 3.-zandaukizya, 4.-zandaukila, 5.-zandaukilalyo, 6.-zandaukisya, 7.-zandauka-zandauka, 8.-zandaukana)
separate, *Bakazandaula*
*kutegwa* *bwaca* *manyina* *azikukamwe*. = They separated the calves so that in the morning the cows could be milked.
be separated from, leave herd, go aside, *Bamwi* *bantu* *balayanda* *kuzanduka* *mukucita* *milimo*
*bacite* *balikke*. = Some people like to be separate when doing jobs so that they do it alone. *Kapongo* *kazanduka*

*umpe*. = The young goat which goes off on its own is attacked by a wilddog. *Ncibotu* *kuti* *mbubakaswaangana* *alimwi* *antoomwe* *kukabule* *uzanduka* *ccita* *kufwa*. = It is good that as they had come together again there should be no more parting except in death. Also: -pambuka. (1.-zandukwa, 2.-zandukide, 3.-zandukizya, 4.-zandukila, 5-zandukilalyo, 6.-zandukisya, 7.-zanduka-zanduka, 8.-zandukana)
be separated from one another, Banyama bakazandukana niyakalila ntobolo. = The animals were separated from one another when the gun was fired.

separate, sort out, take out, Cifwumofwumo basiņombe balazandula boombe. = In the morning the herd-boys separate the calves (from the cows). Ndazizandula nombe zyangu kuli zyabo. = I separated my cattle from theirs. Wakanjila muciba akuzandula nombe yakwe. = He went into the kraal and took out his cow. Also: -pambula. (1.-zandulwa, 2.-zandwide, 3.-zanduzya, 4.-zandwida, 5.-zandwidalyo, 6.-zandulisya, 7.-zandula-zandula, 8.-zandulana)
  • open furrows for irrigation, Balimi baminsale ku Nakambala bazandula tulonga kuzwa mu Kafwuwe kwiida minsale. = Sugar-cane growers at Nakambala open water-channels from Kafue river to irrigate the sugar-cane.

separate the calves from the cows, Aalya mpobazandwida boombe kumanyina beembezi, imvwula yakatalika kuwa. = At that time when the shepherds separate the calves from the cows, the rain began to fall. (1.-zandwidwa, extensions 2-8 same as zandula)

rebel, Ooyu mwana wazanga, tacindimvwi. = This child rebels, she doesn't obey me. Musankwa ngwelela wakazanga. = The boy who I am fostering has rebelled. Also: -poba. (Walipoba.) (1.-zangizyigwa, 2.-zangide, 3.-zangizya, /-zanzya, 4.-zangila, 5.-zangilalyo, 6.-zangisya, 7.-zanga-zanga, 8.-zangilana)
waste wealth, Bamwi bana basankwa balayandisya kuzanganya lubono. = Some boys like to waste wealth.

disperse, Nicamana cisobano twazangauka. = When the ceremony was over we dispersed. Lubono Iwangu Iwazangauka. = My wealth has been dissipated. (1.-zangaukwa, 2.-zangaukide, 3.-zangaukizya, 4.-zangaukila, 5.-zangaukilalyo, 6.-zangaukisya, 7.-zangauka-zangauka, 8.-zangaukana) Also: -mwaika.

scatter, share out, dissipate, Kamuleka kuzangaula mali nkaambo mwaka uno kuli nzala. = Stop wasting money because this year there is hunger. (1.-zangaulwa, 2.-zangawide, 3.-zangauzya, 4.-zangawida, 5.-zangawidalyo, 6.-zangaulisya, 7.-zangaula-zangaula, 8.-zangaulana)
  • share out the property of a dead person unjustly, Kuzangaula lubono Iwamufwu ncibi. = To share out unjustly the property of the deceased is bad.

rebel against, rt. -zanga, Bamuzangila bantu bakwe mwami. = The people of the chief rebelled against him. Nitwakajana Iwaanguluko tiitwakati bana besu bakatuzangile. = When we found independence, we did not think our children would rebel against us. (1.-zangizyigwa, 2.-zangide, 3.-zangizya, /-zanzya, 4.-zangila, 5.-zangilalyo, 6.-zangisya, 7.-zangila-zangila, 8.-zangilana)

peel, Wakalikkede mukkoce lyananda kuzanununa milibo yalungu. = She was sitting on the verandah of the house removing the hard parts of the runners. Also: -fwanununa. (1.-zanununwa, 2.-zanunwide, 3.-zanununzya, 4.-zanunwida, 5.-zanunwidalyo, 6.-zanununisya, 7.-zanununa-zanununa, 8.-zanunwidana)

attempt to shake off insects when bitten, Bantu bakalumwa nsilibi bakalema kulizanyauna. People who were attacked by red ants were tired of trying to shake them off. Basankwa balo bakali mbuli kuti aumwi kuli cimuluma mubili oonse nkwalizanyauna kuzyana. = As for the boys it was as if each one has been bitten all over the body the way they were shaking themselves as they danced. (1.-zanyaunwa, 2.-zanyawide, 3.-zanyauzya, 4.-zanyawida, 5.-zanyawidalyo, 6.-zanyaunisya, 7.-zanyaunazanyauna, 8.-zanyaunana)

be flattened, Kacula kazanzabala nikalyatwa. The frog was flattened when it was stepped upon. (1.-zanzabalwa, 2.-zanzabele, 3.-zanzabazya, 4.-zanzabalila, 5.-zanzabalilalyo, 6.-zanzabalisya, 7.-zanzabala-zanzabala, 8.-zanzabalilana) Also: -sasabala, -yanzabala, -papalala. (mutiba uzanzabede/uyanzabete = a pan)

sit proudly, Moomusimbi sikukwata wakakkala ansi nkaambo taakali kuzumizigwa kuti azanzamane acuuno. = In the house of the inlaws, the groom used to sit on the floor because he was not allowed to seat himself proudly on a stool. Also: -zonzomana (1.-zanzamanwa, 2.-zanzamene, 3.-zanzamanya, 4.-zanzamanina, 5.-zanzamaninalyo, 6.-zanzamanisya, 7.-zanzamana-zanzamana, 8.-zanzamaninana)

transform, change, 'Kuzanzamika bantu' caamba kuti kucenjezya, mbuli muntu kuti wanywa bukoko ulajana watalika kucenjela kumeso kwiinda mbuli mbwaabede kale. = 'Kuzanzamika bantu'means that you warn them, like a person who drinks beer you find that he begins to take more care than he did in the way he was behaving. Busiikka towakali mucelo uleta buyo mate mukanwa, wakali mucelo uzanzamika bantu, ukubacesezya myoyo akwiiyumya. = Tamarind fruit was not only a fruit which makes one salivate, it was a fruit which transformed people to become aggresive and made them strong. (1.-zanzamikwa, 2.-zanzamikide, 3.-zanzamikizya, 4.-zanzamikila, 5.-zanzamikilalyo, 6.-zanzamikisya, 7.-zanzamika-zanzamika, 8.-zanzamikana)

be torn, Cazapauka cisani cangu. = My cloth is torn. Cisani cangu cazapauka mumamvwa. My cloth has been torn by the thorns. Also: -yayauka. (1.-zapaukwa, 2.-zapaukide, 3.-zapaukizya, 4.-zapaukila, 5.-zapaukilalyo, 6.-zapaukisya, 7.-zapauka-zapauka, 8.-zapaukana)
be in a torn state, Mulembo ngwaakasamide mucembele wakalizapaukide. The cloth with which the old woman was dressed was torn.

tear, Bacizapaula babwa cisani nibali kusobana. The dogs tore up the cloth when they were playing. (1.-zapaulwa, 2.-zapawide, 3.-zapauzya, 4.-zapawida, 5.-zapawidalyo, 6.-zapaulisya, 7.-zapula-zapaula, 8.-zapaulana) Also: -zazaula, -yavwuula, -deluula.

be torn, Cisani kuti cazapuka ciyandika kusumwa. = If the cloth is torn it needs to be sewn. (1.-zapukwa, 2.-zapukide, 3.-zapuzya, 4.-zapukila, 5.-zapukilalyo, 6.-zapukisya, 7.-zapuka-zapuka, 8.-zapukana, /
Also: -deluka, -zauka.
be in a torn state, Kumaulu wakasamide zisapato zizapukide zilibonya tunwe. On his feet he wore tattered shoes with the toes showing.

tear, nombe yazapula cisani camwana. The cow tore the cloth of the child. (1.-zapulwa, 2.-zapwide, 3.-zapuzya, 4.-zapwida, 5.-zapwidalyo, 6.-zapulisya, 7.-zapula-zapula, 8.-*zapulana or -zapwidana*) Also: *-zaula, -delula.*

be torn, *Cazauka cisani nci-ndalibambide kuti nsame.* = The dress which I was prepared to wear was torn. (1.-*zaukwa*, 2.-*zaukide*, 3.-*zaukizya*, 4.-*zaukila*, 5.-*zaukilalyo*, 6.-*zaukisya*, 7.-*zauka-zauka*, 8.-*zauzyanya*) Also: *-deluka, -zauka.*

tear, *Ncibi kuzaula cisani camuntu.* = It is bad to tear a person's cloth. *Kozaula kasani ulyaange acilonda awo.* = Tear up that piece of cloth so that you bind up the wound there. (1.-*zaulwa*, 2.-*zawide*, 3.-*zauzya*, 4.-*zawida*, 5.-*zawidalyo*, 6.-*zaulisya*, 7.-*zaula-zaula*, 8.-*zaulana or -zawidana*) Also: *-delula, -zapula.*

die, be dead, *Munene wakazaya.* = The old man passed away. *Haamwaya wakazaya mumwaka wanzala.* = Haamwaya passed away during the year of hunger. Also: -fwa. (1.-*zayigwe*, 2.-*zayide*, 3.-*zayizya*, 4.-*zayila*, 5.-*zayilalyo*, 6.-*zayisya*, 7.-*zaya-zaya*, 8.-*zayana*)
refuse to yield, *Inombe ilazaza.* = The cow refuses to be milked. (2.-*zazide*, 3.-*zazazya*, 4.-*zazila*, 5.-*zazilalyo*, 6.-*zazisya*, 7.-*zaza-zaza*) Also: *-pazaya, -pabauka, -sansa.*
shake, *Kabwa kakazazama kukuwa cabukandu.* = The puppy shook while barking with fear.

be unkempt, be disordered, *Mwami wesu sunu wakazazangana.* = Nowadays our chief does not keep himself properly. (1.-*zazanganwa*, 2.-*zazangene*, 3.-*zazanganya*, 4.-*zazanganina*, 5.-*zazanganinalyo*, 6.-*zazanganisya*, 7.-*zazangana-zazangana*, 8.-*zazanganinana*, | *-zazanganizyanya*)
  • be aggresive, *Twakatiisole kumujata kuti aleke kulwana, pele wakazazangana.* = We tried to catch him to re strain him from fighting, but he became aggressive. Also: *-palangana*
  • be scattered, *Zyazazangana nyemu akaambo kampongo zyazilya.* = The groundnuts were scattered because the goats were eating them.

be torn open, *Cazazauka cijazyo amulyango.* = The door at the entrance is torn open. (1.-*zazaukwa*, 2.-*zazaukide*, 3.-*zazaukizya* 4.-*zazaukila*, 5.-*zazaukilalyo*, 6.-*zazaukisya* 7.-*zazauka-zazauka*, 8.-*zazaukana*)

tear apart, *Babwa bakazazaula kana kampongo.* = The dogs tore the kid apart. *Wakazazaula kwaamba Mangalita kumwi kalangisya mukaintunyina kumeso cabukali.* = Mangalita spoke viciously while looking directly at her co-wife in the face with anger. Also: *-zapaula.* (1.-*zazaulwa*, 2.-*zazawide*, 3.-*zazauzya*, 4.-*zazawida*, 5.-*zazawidalyo*, 6.-*zazaulisya* 7.-*zasaula-zazaula*, 8.-*zazaulana*)

lean over to one side, *Kozeama, njanda kuwaala bbwe.* = Lean to one side, I want to throw a stone. (1.-*zeamwa*, 2.-*zeamide*, 3.-*zeamya*, 4.-*zeamina*, 5.-*zeaminalyo*, 6.-*zeamisya*, 7.-*zeama-zeama*, 8.-*zeaminana*)

put out of place, *Kamuleka kuzeanya maulu nomweenda.* = Stop swinging your legs abnormally when you are walking. *Imfwaindi yamuzeanya meebo.* = The blows dislocated his jaws. (1.-*zeanyizyigwa*, 2.-*zeanyide*, 3.-*zeanya*, 4.-*zeanyizyizya*, 5.-*zeanyizyizyalyo*, 6.-*zeanyizyisya*, 7.-*zeanya-zeanya*, 8.-*zeanyizyanya*)

trot with short quick strides, *Mubbi ulazeba-zeba kumbele aancinga yamusilikani.* = A thief is trotting in front of the bicycle of the policeman. (1.-*zebwa-zebwa*, 2.-*zebede-zebede*, 3.-*zebya-zebya*, 4.-*zebela-zebela*, 5.-*zebela-zebelalyo*, 6.-*zebesya-zebesya* 7.-zebazeba-zebazeba, 8.-zebezyanyazebezyanya) Also: -cunka-cunka, -nzeba-nzeba, -cuuntila.

stagger as drunk, Muntu ukolwa ulazeeleka. = The drunk person is staggering. Wakatalika kuzeeleka, wakali kuyanda kuwa. = He began to totter, he was about to fall. Also: -tenteleka. (1.-zeelekwa, 2.-zeelekede, 3.-zeelesya, 4.-zeelekela, 5.-zeelekelalyo, 6.- zeelekesya 7.-zeeleka-zeeleka, 8.-zeelekaninana)

the ritual of singing and dancing which takes place the morning after the first night of cohabitation of bride and bridegroom. Sunu bwiinga bulazeema. = To-day the marriage ceremony is completed. (1.-zeemwa, 2.-zeemede, 3.-zeemya, 4.-zeemena, 5.-zeemenalyo, 6.-zeemesya, 7.-zeema-zeema, 8.-zeemezyanya)
  • walk slowly, Uulya muntu kweenda tafwambaani uile kuzeema. = That person does not walk quickly she just walks slowly.
  • move as brain in a void, Makani aakusowa mwanaakwe amubuzya mizeezo, bongo bwakanka kuzeema buyo ulati ncinkuli cinyina ncocijisi mukati. = The matter of throwing the baby away drained off her thoughts, her mind was just moving emptily like a calabash which has nothing inside.
  • move without pedalling, Niyakasika amungwenyu ncinga, yakazeema. = When the bicycle reached the downward slope, it free-wheeled.
be dishonest, Muntu uzeeme taambilwi kaambo. A dishonest person is not told an important matter. (Ila) (extensions same as for -zeema)

stagger, Nookali kweenda boobo wakali kwiide kuzeenteka kubee mwana wabaa cizunguboombe. = As you were walking like that you were staggering like a child who was dizzy. Also: -tenteleka. (1.-zeentekwa, 2.-zeentekede, 3.-zeentesya, 4.-zeentekela, 5.-zeentekelalyo, 6.-zeentekesya, 7.-zeenteka-zeenteka, 8.-zeentekelana)

be deformed, be put out of shape, Mweebo wakwe wazeenyana naawumwa. = His jaw was dislocated when he was beaten. Cazeenyana cimbayabaya nicaumputana acimwi. = The car was put out of shape when it collided with another one. (1.-zeenyanwa, 2.-zeenyene, 3.-zeenyeka, 4.-zeenyanina, 5.-zeenyaninalyo, 6.-zeenyanisya 7.-zeenyanazeenyana, 8.-zeenyanizyanya) Also: -mpoonkana-mpoonkana, -zeanya

try a case, Waya kukuzeka kunkuta. = He went to be tried at the court. Kuzeka mulandu walufwu cilayoosya. It is fearful to try a murder case. (1.-zekwa, 2.-zekede, 3.-zesya, 4.-zekela, 5.-zekelalyo, 6.-zekesya, 7.-zeka-zeka, 8.-zekelana)
  • be tried in court, Boonse bakali kuboola kuswaya akuzeka bakali kuboola kulanga gutwe lyasyuumbwa awo mpamunya mpolyakaasamikwa. = All those who were coming to visit and those who were coming to be tried in court were coming to look at the big head of the lion just there with its mouth opened.

expand (chest), Musobani wakamando ulazekama acamba cipati. The wrestler expanded his big chest. (1.-zekamwa, 2.-zekene, 3.-zekamya, 4.-zekamina, 5-zekaminalyo,6.-zekamisya. 7.-zekama-zekama, 8.-zekamina)

make a line or drawing, decorate, Baneene bakali kuzekaula cibiya jilo. My grandmother was decorating an earthen pot yesterday. (1.-zekaulwa, 2.-zekawide, 3.-zekauzya, 4.-zekawida, 5.-zekawidalyo, 6.-zekaulisya 7.-zekaula-zekaula, 8.-zekaulana) Also: cekaula, -nyekaula, -nyenyemba,

sue, rt. -zeka, Ino nguni ngozekela mukaambo aaka? = Who are you sueing for this crime? Moono nguwazekela Keempe. = It is Moono who sued Keempe. (1.-zekelwa, 2.-zekede, 3.-zekezya, 4.-zekela, 5.-zekelalyo, 6.-zekesya, 7.-zekela-zekela, 8.-zekelana)

palpitating with fear, Moyo wangu ulazekema nkaambo ndayoowa kapati. = My heart is palpitating because of fear. Also: -nzekema. (1.-zekemwa, 2.-zekemede, 3.-zekemya, 4.-zekemena, 5.-zekemenalyo, 6.-zekemesya, 7.-zekema-zekema, 8.-zekemanina)

be questioned, Tanaakacikondwa cakuzekezekwa boobu. = She was not happy to be interrogated like this. Kunyina makani akazekwa nkaambo Maanya wakalikuciswa. Naakayumya wakazekezekwa. = Nothing was tried because Maanya was sick. When he was better he was questioned. (1.-zekezekwa, 2.-zekezede, 3.-zekezesya, 4.-zekezyezya, 5.-zekezyezyalyo, 6.-zekezesyesya, 7.-zekezekwa-zekezekwa, 8.-zekezezyanya) Also: -zekezegwa, -zeekezegwa.

fish, Bamakaintu bazela nswi mumulonga. = The women are fishing in the river. Also: -zuba. (1.-zelwa, 2.-zelede, 3.-zezya, 4.-zelela, 5.-zelelalyo, 6.-zelesya, 7.-zela-zela, 8.-zelana)
  • vanish like a ghost, Kuli cazela kumbele lyangu ndayoowa. = There is something which has vanished in front of me, I am afraid. Also: -zeta, -zyamas, -zwela, zimina, -pwimbilika, -pwilipwidwas, -zelauka.
  • dribble with a football, Muleya ulainda kuzela nasobana bbola. = Muleya surpasses all others in dribbling the ball. Also: -nyunya.

vanish, shift about, be evasive, Wiile kuzelauka, tayandi kundipa mali. = He is just being evasive, he does not want to give me the money. Mwana wandizelauka, tayandi kuti tuye limwi. = The child is avoiding me, he does not want us to go together. (1.-zelaukwa, 2.-zelaukide, 3.-zelausya, 4.-zelaukila, 5.-zelaukilalyo, 6.-zelaukisya 7.-zelauka-zelauka, 8.-zelaukana)

colour, paint, Musankwa ooyu ulicizyi kuzeleemba zifwanikiso. = This boy knows how to paint pictures. Also: -cekaula, -zelemba. (1.zeleembwa, 2.-zeleembede, 3.-zeleembya, 4.-zeleembela, 5.-zeleembelalyo, 6.-zeleembesya, 7.-zeleemba-zeleemba, 8.-zeleembaninana)
  • move about continuously in a circular manner, Kuti tumembya twatalika kuzeleemba, kozyiba kuti mainza alaafwaafwi. = If sparrows start flying about in a circle, know that the rainy season is near at hand.

disappear, Naakamana kusya masyabe mucembele wakazeleluka, tiitwakamubona nkwaakatozya. = When the old lady had finished digging the masyabe root she disappeared, we did not see where she went. (1.-zelelukwa, 2.-zelelukide, 3.-zelelusya, 4.-zelelukila, 5.-zelelukilalyo, 6.-zelelukisya, 7.-zeleluka
8.-zelelukana) Also: -beleleka, - zeluluka.

colour, paint, (1.-zelembwa, 2.-zelembede, 3.-zelembya, 4.-zelembela, 5.-zelembelalyo, 6.-zelembesya, 7.-zelemba-zelemba, 8.-zelembelana) Also: -zila, -zilulula, zeleembas, -zelembedert.-zelemba, Basimbi bakali zelembede zibika-zibika. = The girls had gone around (the wall) painting figures. Also: -zeleemba.

sneak away, Mbwaakababonena basilikani wakazelembuka. = As soon as he saw the police he slipped away. (1.-zelembuka, 2.-zelembukide, 3.-zelembusya, 4.-zelembukila, 5.-zelembukilalyo, 6.-zelembukisya, 7.-zelembuka-zelembuka, 8.-zelembuzyanya
sneak away, Inombe yazelembukila mumuunda wamapopwe. = The cow has sneaked away into the maize field. Also: -zwelembuka.

wander about, loaf about, Wiile kuzelengana akaambo kakubula kwakukkala. He was just wandering about as he had no place to live. (1.-zeleganwa, 2.-zelengene, 3.-zelenganya, 4.-zelenganina, 5.-zelenga-ninalyo, 6.-zelenganisya, 7.-zelengana-zelengana, 8.-zelenganinana)
  • palpitate, Moyo wangu ulazelengana. My heart is pounding. Also: -duntauka.

give an evasive answer, Wiile kuzelenganya mukwaambaula kwakwe, talimvwisyi kabotu. = He is giving an evasive answer, he is not really understood. (1.-zelenganyizyigwa, 2.-zelenganyizyide, 3.-zelenganya, 4.-zelenganyizyizya, 5.-zelenganyizyizyalyo 6.-zelenganisya, 7.-zelenganya-zelenganya 8.-zelenganyizyanya)

flit past, Tiindamubona kabotu, wazeluka buyo. I did not see him properly, he just flashed past. (1.-zelukwa, 2.-zelukide, 3.-zelusya, 4.-zelukila, 5.-zelukilalyo, 6.-zelukisya, 7.-zeluka-zeluka, 8.-zelukana) Also: -zetuka, -zeta.

vanish, Inzoka yazeluluka akuzimina mumani. = The snake vanished and was lost in the grass. Tiindamubona nkwaaya, waile kuzeluluka. = I did not see where he went, he just vanished. (1.-zelulukwa, 2.-zelulukide, 3.-zelulusya, 4.-zelulukila, 5.-zelulukilalyo, 6.-zelulukisya, 7.-zeluluka-zeluluka, 8.-zelulukana) Also: -beleleka, -beluluka.

take away secretly, Basankwa bamuzelulusya musimbi akumutizya. The boys have taken the girl away secretely and illegally. (1.-zelulusyigwa, 2.-zelulusyide, 3.-zelulusya, 4.-zeluluzyizya, 5.-zeluluzyizyalyo, 6.-zelulusyisya, 7.-zelulusya-zelulusya, 8.-zelulusyanya)

run or walk to and fro when mourning, Bantu inga balazemba adilwe. = People run up and down when mourning at a funeral. Munene Haaluuma wakazemba ciindi cilamfwu kumwi kayabila. The old man Haaluuma was ritually walking up and down for a long time as he sang alone. (1.-zembwa, 2.-zembede, 3.-zembya, 4.-zembela, 5.-zembelalyo, 6.-zembesya, 7.-zembazemba, 8.-zembelana)
  • go from one place to another, Moonde talimi, uzemba buyo muminzi yabantu. Moonde does not plough, he just goes from one place to another in other people's homes.

be constipated, eat to excess, have swollen stomach, Kuti walya kapati inga wazembelwa. = If you overeat, you will have stomach problems. Mwana wazembelwa wania abulo masiku. = The child who was constipated defecated on the bed during the night. (1.-zembelwa, 2.-zembezyedwe, 3.-zembizya, 4.-zembelelwa, 5.-zembelelwalyo, 6.-zembesyegwa, 7.-zembelwa-zembelwa, 8.-zembezyanya) Also: -zimbilwa.

bend, Keembe wakazendamika naali kugonka cisamu ciyumu. = He bent the axe when he was cutting a hard tree. Musololi utalomenye ulicizyi kuzendamika mulawo. = A corrupt leader knows how to bend the law. (1.-zendamikwa, 2.-zendamikide, 3.-zendamika, 4.-zendamikila, 5.-zendamikilalyo, 6.-zendamikisya, 7.-zendamika-zendamika, 8.-zendamikana)

refer indirectly to, Uzendekezya buya kwaamba, taambi cigaminina pe. = He is just talking in a hidden way, he is not speaking directly. Uzendelezya nzi? Kocigama buya ncowamba. What are you hinting at? Just speak openly. Ooyu muntu uzendekezya ndime, ncaambaula eeci. = This person is referring to me, that is why he says this. Also: -sendekezya, -sendelezya. (1.-zendekezyegwa, 2.-zendekezyede, 3.-zendekezya, 4.-zendekezyezya, 5.-zendekezyezyalyo, 6.-zendekezyezya, 7.-zendekezya-zendekezya, 8.-zendekezyanya)

address a third party about someone instead of speaking directly to him/her, speak to one so that another does not hear, Kozendelezya buya kwaamba kutegwa atamvwi uulya. = Speak in a hidden way so that that one does not understand. (1.-zendelezyegwa, 2.-zendelezyede, 3.-zendelezya, 4.-zendelezyezya, 5.-zendelezyezyalyo, 6.-zendelezyesya, 7.-zendelezyazendelezya, 8.-zendelezyanya)

cook in water, heat cream or butter, melt butter to purify it, Bataata bazenga mafwuta amunsuwa. = Father is melting the fat from the gourd. (1.-zengwa, 2.-zengede, 3.-zengezya, 4.-zengela, 5.-zengelalyo, 6.-zengesya, 7.-zenga-zenga, 8.-zengelana)

wobble, shake as half-full bucket of water on head, Nongo ilazenguna nkaambo tiizwide meenda. = The pot is wobbling on the head because it is not full of water. (1.-zengunwa, 2.-zengunide, 3.-zengunya, 4.-zengunina, 5.-zenguninalyo, 6.-zengunisya, 7.-zenguna-zenguna, 8.-zengunizyanya)

move from place to place, Atulyookezye buyo twafwa kuzenta. = Let us just rest, we are weary from running from place to place. Wakali kwiile kuzenta kukapula zintu zyakuula. = He was just moving from place to place looking for things to buy. (1.-zentwa, 2.-zentede, 3.-zentezya, 4.-zentela, 5.-zentelalyo, 6.-zentesya, 7.-zenta-zenta, 8.-zentezyanya)

be slapped, Kabatananyamuka aumwi wakali kupupululwa wakali kuzentulwa lubayi lomwe Iwakusaya. = Before they got up each one who had been purified was given one slap on the cheek to bring him to his senses.

beat violently, Ndamuzenzema lubayi musankwa mubi kumeso. I gave the bad boy a sharp slap on the face. Also: -anzamuna. (1.-zenzemwa, 2.-zenzemide, 3.-zenzemya, 4.-zenzemwida, 5.-zenzemwidalyo, 6.-zenzemunisya, 7.-zenzema-zenzema, 8.-zenzemunana)
  • quake as the heart in agony, Moyo ulazenzema nkaambo kanzala. = My heart is shaking violently because of the hunger. Also: -zezema.

disappear from view, Tatumubwene nkwaaya, wazeta buyo. = We do not know where he has gone, he just disappeared. Also: -zela, -zeluka. -zetuka (1.-zetwa, 2.-zetede, 3.-zetya, 4.-zetela, 5.-zetelalyo, 6.-zetesya, 7.-zeta-zeta, 8.-zetezyanya)

disappear, rt.-zeta, Mainza wakazetuka kunze ananda kutegwa bamasilikani batamuboni. = Mainza disappeared behind the house so that the police would not see him. (1.-zetukwa, 2.-zetukide, 3.-zetusya, 4.-zetukila, 5.-zetukilalyo, 6.-zetukisya, 7.-zetukazetuka, 8.-zetukana) Also: -zeluka.

disappear into, Mbwaakazetukila biyo kuya musyokwe musankwa, walo musimbi wakatalika kugubingana-gubingana kujika. As soon as the boy disappeared into the bush, the girl began to busy herself in cooking. Mpoonya nkuzetukila kuzyuli nkubakali koona. = Thereupon he disappeared into the bedroom where they were sleeping. (eztensions are same as for -zetuka)

tremble or beat violenlty as heart, Moyo wiile kuzezema, ndafwa nzala. = The heart is just trembling, I am dying from the hunger. Also: -zenzema. (1.-zezemwa, 2.-zezemede, 3.-zezemya, 4.-zezemena, 5.-zezemenalyo, 6.-zezemesya, 7.-zezema, 8.-zezemesyanya)

leave for a while, Mwiiyi wakazezembuka kuya kunanda yakwe. The teacher left for a while to go to his house. (1.-zezembukwa, 2.-zezembukide, 3.-zezembusya, 4.-zezembukila, 5.-zezembukilalyo, 6.-zezembukisya, 7.-zezembuka-zezembuka, 8.-zezembukana)

feel giddy, Mubili ulazezemuka, ndikankama nzala. = I am feeling giddy, I am trembling with hunger. (1.-zezemukwa, 2.-zezemukide, 3.-zezemusya, 4.-zezemukila, 5.-zezemukilalyo, 6.-zezemukisya, 7.-zezemuka, 8.-zezemukilana)

fish with, rt. -zela, Bantu baliiyanda myuumba yakuzezya nswi. = People need fishing-spears to fish with. (1.-zelwa, 2.-zelede, 3.-zezya, 4.-zelela, 5.-zelelalyo, 6.-zelesya, 7.-zela-zela, /zezya-zezya, 8.-zelana)

know, be acquainted with, Kuziba kwiimba ncintu cibotu. = Knowing how to sing is a good thing. Also: -zyiba. (1.-zibwa, 2.-zibide, 3.-zibya, 4.-zibila, 5.-zibilalyo, 6.-zibisya, 7.-ziba-ziba, 8.-zibana)
