  • pluck flowers of tobacco plant, prune, Kamubuziba buluba kutegwa bukomene kabotu. = Prune the cotton plants so that they grow well.
  • be castrated, Mucende wangulube uyandika kuziba. = The boar needs to be castrated. Moombe ooyu tayandiki kuziba, asuugwe. = The calf does not need to be castrated so that it becomes a bull.

be wiped out, fade, Mubala wacisani cangu wakazibaana. = The colour of my dress has faded. (1.-zibaanizyigwa, 2.-zibeene, 3.-zibaanya, 4.-zibaanina, 5.-zibaaninalyo, 6.-zibaanisya 7.-zibaana-zibaana, 8.-zibaazyanya) Also: -zimaana.

wipe out, Chinyama wakacizibaanya cikwelete camweenzinyina. = Chinyama wiped out the debt of his friend. Also: -zibanganya, -zimaana. (1.-zibaanyizyigwa, 2.-zibaanyizyide, 3.-zibaanya, 4.-zibaanyizyizya, 5.-zibaanyizyizyalyo, 6.-zibaanyisyisya, 7.-zibaanya-zibaanya, 8.-zibaanyizyanya)

know one another, Mbotwakaswaanina buyo, twakafwambaana kuzibana. = As soon as we met, we came to know one another well. Also: -zyibana. (1.-zibanwa, 2.-zibene, 3.-zibanya, 4.-zibanina, 5.-zibaninalyo, 6.-zibanisya, 7.-zibana-zibana, 8.-zibana)

dismiss, ignore, Mubetesi naakamvwa bukamboni wakauzibanganya mulandu. = When the judge heard the evidence he dismissed the case. (1.-zibanganyizyigwa, 2.-zibanganyizyide, 3.-zibanganya, 4.-zibanganyizyizya, 5.-zibanganyizyizyalyo, 6.-zibanganyisyisya 7.-zibanganya-zibanganya, 8.-zibanganyizyanya) Also: -zibinganya.

look all around, Langa ulya mbwazibauka kubee tazyi kwakugama. = Look at that one how he looks about, it seems he does not know where to go. Inziba ilazibauka mumusamu. = The dove is looking around in the tree. (1.-zibaukwa, 2.-zibaukide, 3.-zibausya, 4.-zibaukila, 5.-zibaukilalyo, 6.-zibaukisya 7.-zibauka-zibauka, 8.-zibaukana, / zibaukilana) Also: -cebauka.

know one another, rt. -ziba, Twakalizibene nkaambo twakali kwiiya limwi cikolo. = We knew one another because we were learning together at school. (1.-zibanwa, 2.-zibene, 3.-zibanya, 4.-zibanina, 5.-zibaninalyo, 6.-zibanisya, 7.-zibene-zibene, 8.-zibana)

be accustomed to, Wakazibila kweenda amaulu sunu. = He has got used to walking on foot today. Sunu bantu bakazibila kunjila cikombelo. = Today people have become accustomed to going to church. (1.-zibilwa, 2.-zibilide, 3.-zibizya, 4.-zibilila, 5.-zibililalyo, 6.-zibilisya, 7.-zibila-zibila, 8.-zibilana) Also: -zyibila.

cast aside, Ziimbo zyoonse zya Batonga antoomwe azizyano zyabo ziyabuzibingana abamwi bantu. = All the songs of the Batonga together with their dances are being cast aside by some people. Also: -zibanganya

be wiped out, Naakabona kuti ono makanze akwe asimpa akuzibinganyizigwa, wakatija. When he saw that his plans had come to ☑ an end and were wiped out, he fled.

glance, quick movement to look at something, Kozibuka ubone uuli kusule lyako. Take a quick look to see who is behind you. (1.-zibukwa, 2.-zibukide, 3.-zibusya, 4.-zibukila, 5.-zibu-kilalyo, 6.-zibukisya, 7.-zibukazibuka, 8.-zibukilana) Also: -ceba.

cause to know, Ndakabazibya kuti mweenzu wakasika. = I informed them that the visitor had arrived. (1.-zibwa, 2.-zibide, 3.-zibya, 4.-zibila, 5.-zibilalyo, 6.-zibisya, 7.-zibya-zibya, 8.-zibana) Also: -zyibya.

  • be foolish, Ooyu muntu ulaziima. = This person is foolish. Syaambololo ubee ulaziima. A kudu looks foolish.

bury, Kuzikka muntu ncintu cilemu kapati. = To bury a person is a very important thing. Basicikombelo bakazikka Mukristo wabo. The church members buried their Christian. (1.-zikkwa, 2.-zikkide, 3.-zikkizya, 4.-zikkila, 5.-zikkilalyo, 6.-zikkisya, 7.-zikka-zikka, 8.-zikkana)
be buried, Choombe uyakuzikkwa mu Mujibelo uboola. Choombe will be buried next Saturday. Also: yobolwa. (extensions same as -zikka)

transplant, Twaunka kukuzikkila cisyu kumbewu. We are going to transplant the vegetables in the garden. (1.-zikkilwa, 2.-zikkilide, 3.-zikkizya, 4.-zikkilila, 5.-zikkililalyo, 6.-zikkilisya, 7.-zikkila-zikkila, 8.-zikkilana) Also: -simpa, -simpula.

come from, Ndazila kwa Chipembele kudilwe. I have come from a funeral at Chipembele. Also: -zyila, -zwa. (1.-zilwa, 2.-zilide, 3.-zizya, 4.-zilila, 5.-zililalyo, 6.-zilisya, 7.-zila-zila, 8.-zilana)

do something with care and attention, Ndali kuzilikizya kulanga bana ncobacita. I was carefully watching what the children were doing. (1.-zilikizyigwa, 2.-zilikizyide, 3.-zilikizya, 4.-zilikizyizya, 5.-zilikizyizyalyo, 6.-zilikizyisya, 7.-zilikizya-zilikizya, 8.-zilikizyanya)
look down, Wazilimana wagankaika kuyeeya. He looked down and was confused in thinking.

try to conceal, Musimbi wakavwiila cakulizimausya-zimausya. The girl answered trying to conceal her problem. (extensions same as -zimauka)

conceal one's identity, Kuzimauzya mweenzu inga wabetekwa. = By concealing your visitor you may have to face being charged. Also: -sisa. (1.-zimauzyigwa, 2.-zimauzyide, 3.-zimauzya, 4.-zimauzyizya, 5.-zimauzyizyalyo, 6.-zimauzyisya, 7.-zimauzya-zimauzya, 8.-zimauzyanya)

(1.-zimbilwa, 2.-zimbidwe, 3.-zimbizya, 4.-zimbililwa, 5.-zimbililwalyo, 6.-zimbilisyigwa, 7.-zimbilwa-zimbilwa, 8.-zibilizyanya) Also: -zembelwa.

(1.-zimbulukwa, 2.-zimbulukide, 3.-zimbulusya, 4.-zimbulukila, 5.-zimbulukilalyo, 6.-zimbulukisya, 7.-zimbulukazimbuluka, 8.-zimbulukana)

(1.-zimbululwa, 2.-zimbulwide, 3.-zimbulula, 4.-zimbulwida, 5.-zimbulwidalyo, 6.-zimbululisya, 7.-zimbulula-zimbulula, 8.-zimbululana)

die *Bataata bakazimina mu 1961.* My father died in 1961. (1.-ziminwa, 2.-zimide, 3.-zimizya, 4.-ziminina, 5.-zimininalyo, 6.-ziminisya, 7.-zimina-zimina, 8.-zimizyanya)

be lost, *Bakakkala muzyuuno kabazibauka koonse-koonse mbuli bantu baziminide.* They sat on stools, looking around everywhere like people who were lost. (1.-ziminidwe, 2.-ziminide, 3.-ziminizya, 4.-ziminina, 5.-zimininalyo, 6.-ziminisya, 7.-ziminide-ziminide, 8.-zimizyanya)

be lost, *Moonde wakazimininwa nombe nsondo yakamana.* Moonde lost the cattle last week. *Dyabula, ndazimininwa kuti cini-cini ncoyeeya ncinzi.* Dyabula, I am lost as to what you really think. (1.-zimininwa, 2.-zimininidwe, 3.-zimininizya, 4.-zimininizyizya, 5.-zimininizyizyalyo, 6.-zimininizyisya, 7.-zimininwa-zimininwa, 8.-zimininana)

rub off, *Izina lyangu baliziminganya acuuno cangu.* They rubbed my name of my stool. (1.-ziminganyizyigwa, 2.-ziminganyizyide, 3.-ziminganya, 4.-ziminganyizyizya, 5.-ziminganyizyizyalyo, 6.-ziminganyizyisya, 7.-ziminganya-ziminganya, 8.-ziminganyizyanya) Also: -zimaazya, -mwaya.

dilute, Minsale yazimuna bukoko bwatukolede. = Raw sugar-cane has diluted the beer which made us drunk. (1.-zimunwa, 2.-zimwide, 3.-zimuzya, 4.-zimwida, 5.-zimwidalyo, 6.-zimunisya, 7.-zimuna-zimuna, 8.-zimunana)

put out as fire, rt. -zima, Meenda alabeleka kuzimya mulilo. = Water is used to extinguish fire. = Meenda ngaazimya mulilo. = Water is what extinguishes fire. (1.-zimwa, 2.-zimide, 3.-zimya, 4.-zimina, 5.-ziminalyo, 6.-zimisya, 7.-zimya-zimya, 8.-zimana)

be reserved in speech, hide what you want to say, Kaambo kakwe wakakazinda nkaambo bantu bakali banji. = He hid his problem because there were many people. (1.-zindwa, 2.-zindide, 3.-zindya, 4.-zindila, 5.-zindilalyo, 6.-zindisya, 7.-zinda-zinda, 8.-zindana) Also: -sisa

break off (as branch of a tree), Cibulo cancinga yangu cazinduka nindawa ansi. = A part of my bicycle broke when I fell down. Insimbi yajamba yazinduka. = The bolt of the plough is broken. (1.-zingwa, 2.-zingide, 3.-zingizya, 4.-zingila, 5.-zingilalyo, 6.-zingisya, 7.-zinga-zinga, 8.-zingilana) Also: -oba.

fight as a group against one, Bacikonzya kumujaya munyati nkaambo bamuzinganina. = They were able to kill the buffalo because they fought against him as a group. (1.-zinganinwa,2.-zinganide, 3.-zinganizya 4.-zinganinina, 5.-zinganininalyo, 6.-zinganisya, 7.-zinganina-zinganina, 8.-zinganinana) Also: *-tanganina*
have curly hair, rt. -zingana, Masusu angu alizingene. = My hair is curly. (1.-zinganwa, 2.-zingene, 3.-zinganya, 4.-zinganina, 5.-zinganinalyo, 6.-zinganisya, 7.-zingene-zingene, 8.-zinganinana)

be in a confused state, rt. zinga, Ncindabuzizya kayi ndizingidwe, ndiziminidwe. The reason why I inquire is that I am confused, I am lost. (1.-zingidwe, 2.-zingide, 3.-zingizya, 4.-zingila, 5.-zingilalyo, 6.-zingisya, 7.-zingidwe-zingidwe, 8.-zingana)

surround with, rt. -zinguluka, Masiku luba bakali kulu-zingulusya zikko zyamulilo. At night they were surrounding the kraal with fires. (1.-zingulusyigwa, 2.-zingulusyide, 3.-zingulusya, 4.-zingulusyizya, 5.-zingulusyizyalyo, 6.-zingulusyisya, 7.-zingulusya-zingulusya, 8.-zingulusyanya)

be encircled, Basimbi bakazingwa ninga kumaulu akumaboko. = The girls' arms and legs were encircled with bangles. (1.-zingwa, 2.-zingide, 3.-zingizya, 4.-zingila, 5.-zingilalyo, 6.-zingisya, 7.-zingwa-zingwa, 8.-zingana)

hurl away, as into the bush, Wakaakuzinta cibaki cibotu musyokwe. = He went and hurled a good shirt into the bush. (1.-zintwa, 2.-zintide, 3.-zintya, 4.-zintila, 5.-zintilalyo, 6.-zintisya, 7.-zinta-zinta, 8.-zintana)

Cakalikundiziya lyoonse ndati antela ndili ngomwa. = It was grinding away in me all the time that I might be impotent. (1.-ziyigwa, 2.-ziyide, 3.-ziyizya, 4.-ziyila, 5.-ziyilalyo, 6.-ziyisya, 7.-ziya-ziya, 8.-ziyana)
  • hide from, Musimbi wakaile biyo kumweta-mweta kumwi ameso kalibonya kuti kuli kaambo kapati kakali kumuziya. = The girl was just smiling while in her eyes it could be seen that there was a serious matter which she was hiding from him.

dispute, protest, Wakali kuziza-ziza kuti wakalimitide. = She was protesting the fact that she was pregnant. (1.-zizwa-zizwa, 2.-zizide-zizide, 3.-zizyazizya, 4.-zizila-zizila, 5.-zizilalyo-zizilalyo, 6.-zizisya-zizisya, 7.-zizaziza-zizaziza, 8.-zizana-zizana) Also: -kazya-kazya.
refrain, control oneself, Wakali kusola kulizizikizya kuti atalangisyi. = He was trying to control himself so as not to stare.

refrain from doing something, control oneself, Walikulizizya buyo pele calikucisa. She was controlling herself, but it was painfull. Ncibotu kulizizya kucita zibi. It is good to refrain from doing bad things. (1.-zizyigwa, 2.-zizyide, 3.-zizyisya, 4.-zizyila, 5.-zizyilalyo, 6.-zizyisya, 7.-zizya-zizya, 8.-zizyanya)

stretch oneself on toes, try to reach, Bana bazobobela matobo mujulu. = The children are stretching on their toes to reach the matobo fruit. (1.-zobobelwa, 2.-zobobelede, 3.-zobobezya, 4.-zobobelela, 5.-zobobelelalyo, 6.-zobobelesya, 7.-zobobela-zobobela, 8.-zobobelana) Also: -zobokela, -sumpukila.

reach up or out for something, Kozobokela, nkuni zili mujulu. = Stand on your toes, the firewood is high up. Mweenzu naakaobokela kusunsa, wakacitila cibiya canyama. = When the visitor was stretching out to dip in the gravy, he upset the pot of meat. Also: -sompokela, -obokela. (1.-zobokelwa, 2.-zobokelede, 3.-zobokezya, 4.-zobokelela, 5.-zobokelelalyo, 6.-zobokelesya, 7.-zobokela-zobokela, 8.-zobokelelana)

snap, e.g Koleta kasamu kalamfwu ndizobole matobo. = Bring a long stick so that I snap off the wild fruit. (1.-zobolwa, 2.-zobolede, 3.-zobozya, 4.-zobweda, 5.-zobwedalyo, 6.-zobolesya 7.-zobola-zobola, 8.-zobolana) Also: -zomona.
  • preserve, (Ila) Kuzobola maseseke ncibotu kwiinda kumwaya. = It is better to keep a secret than to spread it. Also: -yobola.
hoe a long narrow stretch, Tacili cibotu kuzolobola muunda mulamfwu nkaambo kunyina babelesi. = It is not good to hoe a long stretch of land as there are no workers.

peck, Inkuku zizomona nsima mumutiba. = The hens are pecking at the nsima in the dish. Also: -goma. (1.-zomonwa, 2.-zomwede, 3.-zomozya, 4.-zomweda, 5.-zomwedalyo, 6.-zomonesya, 7.-zomona-zomona, 8.-zomonana)
stand with surprise, Ino yawe, uzompomanina nzi ncoima boobu? = Now why are you standing still like that with surprise? Cf. -zumpumana

hate Uleke kundinyansya akundizonda. = Stop despising and hating me. Wakamuzonda mbuli buzondene bantu anzoka. He hated him just as people hate snakes. Also: -sulaika. (1.-zondwa, 2.-zondede, 3.-zondya, 4.-zondela, 5.-zondelalyo, 6.-zondesya, 7.-zonda-zonda, 8.-zondana)
be filled with hatred, Bantu bamwi bakalimuzondede munene nkaambo wakalivwubide kapati. = Some people hated the old man because he was so rich. (extensions same as for -zonda)
hate, rt. zonda, Ncinzi ncindakakucitila ncondizondela boobu? = What have I done to you that you hate me like this?

pinch, Bamuzonyona cimoni bacembele mooye. = The old woman gave the girl a pinch. Imbeba yandizonyona kutusindi. = The rat pinched me on the ankles. Also: -syamba, -syuta. (1.-zonyonwa, 2.-zonywede, 3.-zonyozya, 4.-zonyweda, 5.-zonywedalyo, 6.-zonyonesya, 7.-zonyona-zonyona, 8.-zonyonana)

sit erect, Mudaala wazonzomana acuuno. = The old man was sitting upright on the stool. (1.-zonzomanwa, 2.-zonzomene, 3.-zonzomanya, 4.-zonzomanina. 5.-zonzomaninalyo, 6.-zonzomanisya, 7.-zonzomana-zonzomana, 8.-zonzomaninana) Also: -nonzomana, -dondomanas, -londomana, -ndondomana, -lonzola.
stretch, Bantu bakali kuzoomona tusingo kutegwa babone musololi. = People were stretching their necks to see the leader. cf. -lozomona
cause fear, (Ila) Munyama ulazoosya musyokwe. = The animal causes fear in the bush. Also: -yoosya.

catch fish with net or basket, Balazuba atuzamba. = They are fishing with nets. (1.-zubwa, 2.-zubide, 3.-zubya, 4.-zubila, 5.-zubilalyo, 6.-zubisya, 7.-zuba-zuba, 8.-zubana) Also: -zela. (mumba =a fishing spear), kalobo, (hook and line) kalobio (hook), lujalilo (reed and sorgum-stalk fence used with traps and usually valved), lukome, small mud walls, mpuo, piled stones and timber stakes, mungwala, a cone-shaped valved fishing basket. Other types of basket are, isyiko, nsopo, izubo. Mucundulusio is a roll of grass which is pushed forward to confine the fish to a smaller section of the river. A net is called lusabwi, or kanyandi.)

share in portions, Bamacembele nibakali kwaaba nyama bakali kuzubaula kupa bana baniini. = When the old women were dividing out the meat they put it into portions to give it to the children. Also: -zabaula. (1.-zubaulwa, 2.-zubawide, 3.-zubauzya, 4.-zubawida, 5.-zubawidalyo, 6.-zubaulisya 7.-zubaula-zubaula, 8.-zubaulana)

mix a little meal with warm water to start the process of making nsima, Aciindi cakulubundu-bundu, aalya mpobazubilida nsima bamakaintu, mweenzu wakasika. = As evening falls, at that time when the women begin to prepare to cook nsima, a visitor arrived. (1.-zubilidwa, 2.-zubilide, 3.-zubilizya, 4.-zubilida, 5.-zubilidalyo. 6.-zubililisya, 7.-zubilida-zubilida, 8.-zubililana)

soften, Mukaintu najika nsima uleelede kuzubilila kutegwa nsima itabi amakoto. = When a woman is cooking nsima she first of all adds a portion of meal in warm water to avoid producing lumps. Also: -vwubilila.
2.-zubililide, 3.-zubilizya, 4.-zubililila, 5.-zubilililalyo, 6.-zubililisya, 7.-zubilila-zubilila, 8.-zubililana)

cross over, Bazubuka kuya kutala. They have crossed over. Inombe zizubuka mulonga. = The cattle are crossing the river. Also: -zabuka. (1.-zubukwa, 2.-zubukide, 3.-zubusya, 4.-zubukila, 5.-zubukilalyo, 6.-zubukisya, 7.-zubuka-zubuka, 8.-zubusyanya)

take out, Kozubula nyama mumpoto omo. Take the meat out of that pot. Ooyu ngomulumbe ngwaatakazubula kaambo nokaceya. = This was a message from which he did not take out any meaning no matter how small. (1.-zubulwa, 2.-zubwide, 3.-zubuzya, 4.-zubwida, 5.-zubwidalyo, 6.-zubulisya. 7.-zubula-zubula, 8.-zubulana)
  • transfer, ferry across, Mutala a Zambezi zitima zilazubula mandunduli malemu ajanika kumigodi. = Trains transport heavy things from the mines over the Zambezi. Mainza wabula ankazubula. = Mainza did not take over anything. Also: -landula, -zabusya, -landusya.
explain, rt.-zubulula, Undizubulude cibi ncindakakucitila. Explain to me what evil I have done to you.

explain a riddle or problem, reveal, Kozubulula kalabiko kako aka. = Explain this riddle of yours. Kondizubulula cibi ncondakakucitila. = Explain to me the evil I have done to you. Ncibi kuzubulula makani apa mapenzi. = It is bad to reveal matters that bring sufferings. Wakakonkomona akulizubulula kumukaintu musyoonto kutegwa amujulide. = He knocked and identified himself to the younger wife so that she would let him in. (1.-zubululwa, 2.-zubulude, 3.-zubu-luzya, 4.-zubuluda, 5.-zubuludalyo, 6.-zubululisya, 7.-zubulula-zubulula, 8.-zubululana) Also: -yubulula, -labulula,

cause to cross over, rt. -zubula, Baila bazubusya nombe kuya kukuwila. = The Baila people bring their cattle across for good grazing pastures. (1.-zubukwa, 2.-zubukide, 3.-zubusya, 4.-zubukila, 5.-zubukilalyo, 6.-zubukisya, 7.-zubusya-zubusya, 8.-zubusyanya)

take out of container, Awa abutala mpampawo Mukansondo mpaakazubwida mfwuli yankuku akwiipatika mumbalo yabutala kutegwa aijane ajoka. = Right there at the maize-bin is where Mukansondo took the gizzard of the chicken out of the dish and stuffed it under a roof stick so that she would find it when she returned. (1.-zubulwa, 2.-zubwide, 3.-zubuzya, 4.-zubwida, 5.-zubwidalyo, 6.-zubulisya, 7.-zubwidazubwida, 8.-zubwidana)

reveal, rt. -zubulula, Ba Chiiba bakabazubwilila bakaintu babo boonse mbubakacizyi cisyabo cabo a Mudolo kuzwa kumatalikilo. = Chiiba revealed to his wife how he knew all about her love-affair with Mudolo from the beginning. (1.-zubwililwa, 2.-zubwilide, 3.-zubwilizya, 4.-zubwilida, 5.-zubwilidalyo 6.-zubwililisya, 7.-zubwilila-zubwilila, 8.-zubwililana)

fish with net, Bazubi banjibanji bazubya mazamba mapati mu Zambezi. = Many fishermen fish with big nets in the Zambezi. Basimpongo bazubya tuzamba, basimbi bazubya mazubo (myoono/masyiko). = The goatherds are fishing with nets, the girls are fishing with fishing-baskets. (1.-zubizyigwa, 2.-zubide, 3.-zubya, 4.-zubila, 5.-zubilalyo, 6.-zubisya, 7.-zubya-zubya, 8.-zubilana)

be beaten into powder or meal, Basimbi balikutwa kusikila limwi azugila mapopwe. The girls were pounding until the maize was changed into mealie-meal. (1.-zugizyigwa, 2.-zugide, 3.-zugizya, 4.-zugilila, 5.-zugililalyo, 6.-zugilisya, 7.-zugila-zugila, 8.-zugizyanya) Also: -zukila.

be filled, rt. -zula, Haanampakila kumvwa zeezi tanaakazugwa amoyo pe. When Haanampakila heard these things his heart was not filled. (with anger). (1.-zugwa, 2.-zwide, 3.-zwisya, 4.-zwida, 5.-zwidalyo, 6.-zwisyisya, 7.-zugwa-zugwa, 8.-zwisyanya)

guess, theorize, Kuyandaula kwagama nombe nkuzukaula. = In searching for cattle as to the direction which they have taken, one has to guess. (1.-zukaulwa, 2.-zukawide, 3.-zukauzya, 4.-zukawida, 5.-zukawidalyo, 6.-zukaulisya, 7.-zukaula-zukaula, 8.-zukauzyanya)

guess, Ndali kuzukauzya buya, tiindacizyi cakwaamba. = I was just guessing, I did not know what to say. (1.-zukauzyigwa, 2.-zukauzyizye, 3.-zukauzya, 4.-zukauzyizya, 5.-zukauzyizyalyo, 6.-zukauzyisya, 7.-zukauzyazukauzya, 8.-zukauzyanya)

mix, become soft, be brought by pounding to the stage desired, Musozya ngutwalikutwa wafwambaana kuzukila. The samp which we were pounding was quickly pounded enough. (1.-zukizyigwa, 2.-zukide, 3.-zukizya, 4.-zukilila, 5.-zukililalyo, 6.-zukilisya, 7.-zukila-zukila, 8.-zukizyanya) Also: -zugila.

conjecture, forecast, guess a riddle correctly, augur, Kozukula, nguni wakuuma? = Who do you imagine has beaten you? Zukula naa baboola lili baama. Guess when mother is coming. Also: -zukaula, -zumbula. (1.-zukulwa, 2.-zukwide, 3.-zukuzya, 4.-zukwida, 5.-zukwidalyo, 6.-zukulisya, 7.-zukula-zukula, 8.-zukulana)

guess, Bamwi bananga tababoni cintu akaniini buyo, akusonda kwalo nkwazuku-zuku; nkwakuzukuzya biyo.. Some witchdoctors do not see even a little, and the diving is just guessing. (1.-zukuzyigwa-zukuzyigwa, 2.-zukwide-zukwide, 3.-zukuzya-zukuzya, 4.-zukwida-zukwida, 5.-zukwida-zukwidalyo, 6.-zukuzyisya-zukuzyisya, 7.-zukuzukuzukuzuku, 8.-zukuzyanya-zukuzyanya.

be full, be enough, Cazula meenda cibulo. The bucket is full of water. Wakajana mulonga wazula akaambo kamvwula yakawa kapati. = He found the river was full because of the heavy rain which had fallen. (1.-zulwa, 2.-zwide, 3.-zuzya, 4.-zulila, 5.-zulilalyo, 6.-zulisya, 7.-zula-zula, 8.-zuzyanya)
  • verify, check, Ndazula mali, taazulide. = I have checked the money, it is short.
  • win a case, Mweemba wakazula Moonga mulubeta. = Mweemba won the case against Moonga in court.

be complete, be all present, rt. -zula, Sena twazulila kale toonse? = Are we all already present? Inombe zyazulila kale. = The cattle are already all here. Bumboni bwakazulila. = The evidence was complete. 1.-zulizyigwa, 2.-zulide, 3.-zulizya, 4.-zulizyizya, 5.-zulizyizyalyo, 6.-zulilisya, 7.-zulila-zulila, 8.-zulilana)
  • help oneself, Cakali kweetezya kuti omubona mulwazi mpaakali kuzulila kuya kukaanda kakulivwunina. = It was sad if you saw the patient trying to help himself going to the toilet.

come from, Mujisi myaka yongaye yakuzyalwa alimwi muzulilwa kuli? How old are you and where do you come from? (1.-zulilwa, 2.-zulidwe, 3.-zulizya, 4.-zulililwa, 5.-zulililwalyo, 6.-zulilisyigwa, 7.-zulilwa-zulilwa, 8.-zulilana)

go first, go ahead, Munene nguwazulula kuya ku Namwala. = The old man was the first to go to Namwala. (1.-zululwa, 2.-zulwide, 3.-zuluzya, 4.-zulwida, 5.-zulwidalyo, 6.-zululisya, 7.-zulula, 8.-zululana) Also: -solola,-tonona.

stagger as one drunk, Boonse bakatalika kuzuluma mbuli citaka cakolwa ntimba. All began to wobble like a small fish choked with mud. Kweenda kwakwe wakali kwiide kuzuluma nkaambo tunambi twakalikkwene mumutwe. In walking he was just staggering because the beers had flooded his head. (1.-zulumwa, 2.-zulumide, 3.-zulumya, 4.-zulumina, 5.-zuluminalyo, 6.-zulumisya, 7.-zuluma-zuluma, 8.-zulumizyanya) Also: zulumuka.

look with surprise, Ino uzulumana nzi? = Why do you look with surprise? Nindakasiba kalosi, syaambololo wakazulumana, mpoona ndakamudubula. = When I whistled, the kudu loooked up in surprise, whereupon I shot it. (1.-zulumanwa, 2.-zulumene, 3.-zulumanya, 4.-zulumanina, 5.-zulumaninalyo, 6.-zulumanisya, 7.-zulumana-zulumana, 8.-zulumaninana) Also: -empemana.

wander around, Uusondokede inga wiile kuzulumuka mu syokwe. The one who is mad is just wandering around the bush. (1.-zulumukwa, 2.-zulumukide, 3.-zulumu-sya, 4.-zulumukila, 5.-zulumukilalyo, 6.-zulumukisya, 7.-zulumuka-zulumuka, 8.-zulumukilana)
  • be restless, Mwana naakali kuciswa ntuntumaanzi wakali kuzulumuka masiku onse. When the child was suffering from malaria it was moving about restlessly all through the night.

walk about in a lost fashion, Kabwa kangu kali kuzulungana mutanga lyabantu. = My puppy was lost in a crowd of people. (1.-zulunganwa, 2.-zulungene, 3.-zulunganya, 4.-zulunganina, 5.-zulunganina lyo, 6.-zulunganisya, 7.-zulunganazulungana, 8.-zulunganinana)
  • be disheartened, Moyo wangu wazulungana. = I am disheartened.

be convicted, be found guilty, lose a case, Mainza wakaakuzulwa kaambo nikakabandikwa. = Mainza was convicted when the matter was discussed. Mundiya wazulwa mulandu mupati. = Mundiya was guilty of a great crime. (1.-zulwa, 2.-zulide, 3.-zuzya, 4.-zulila, 5.-zulilalyo, 6.-zulisya, 7.-zulwa-zulwa, 8.-zulana) Also: -vwulwa.

welcome, Musimbi wakamukwata Syaanasulwe. Wakazulwidwa abanyinakulu Syaanasulwe. = The hare married the girl. She was welcomed by the hare's grandmother. (1.-zulwidwa, 2.-zulwide, 3.-zulwizya, 4.-zulwida, 5.-zulwidalyo, 6.-zulwisya, 7.-zulwida-zulwida, 8.-zulwidana)

thunder, Imvwula ilazuma kunyika. = The rain is producing thunder in the north. Imvwula iizuma taiwi. = The rain that thunders, does not fall. (1.-zumwa, 2.-zumide, 3.-zumya, 4.-zumina, 5.-zuminalyo, 6.-zumisya, 7.-zuma-zuma, 8.-zumizyanya)

persist, be resolute, Kaambo kamana kale pesi ulazumanana. = The matter is finished, but she persists. Kamuzumanana kubelekela Leza. = Persevere in working for God. (1.-zumananwa, 2.-zumenene, 3.-zumananika, 4.-zumananina, 5.-zumananinalyo, 6.-zumananisya, 7.-zumanana-zumanana, 8.-zumananinana)

be in a state of persistance, Bakasola kumujata akumukombelezya kuti acileke kutwa, pesi nokuba boobo walo Muzya wakalizumanede kutwa akwiimba. They tried to catch her and persuade her to stop pounding, but even so she, Muzya, was fixed on pounding and singing. (extensions same as -zumanana)

cause people to quarrel, Uzumanika bantu kuti balwane. = He agitates people so that they fight. Koleka kuzumanika bana kulwana. = Never stir up children to fight. Also: -yunga. (1.-zumanikwa, 2.-zumanikide, 3.-zumananika, 4.-zumananina, 5.-zumanmaninalyo, 6.-zumanaisya, 7.-zumanika-zumanika, 8.-zumananinana)
quarrel with one another, Nobakacili kuzumanikana boobo, bantu bamwi bakasika. = When they were still arguing with one another, some peple arrived.

sway, swing, Bana balazumbaana mumusamu. = The children are swinging in a tree. Tee ncicaanga mumukowa wesu kunyina wakalisinide, nikwakali kunga bajana buyo nkwe-zumbaana mucisamu. = In our clan no one ever committed suicide, if it wasn't for that they would find me hanging on a tree. (1.-zumbaanwa, 2.-zumbeene, 3.-zumbaanya, 4.-zumbaanina, 5.-zumbaaninalyo, 6.-zumbaanisya, 7.-zumbaana-zumbaana, 8.-zumbaanizyanya) Also: -lenga-lenga
cause to swing, Beene uzumbaanya bana. Beene swings the children. Wazumbaanya maboko. = She swung her arms..

take a risk, guess, speculate, wonder, Basinjuka bazumbauzya buya kujana mali. = Cardplayers just gamble to find money. Nindali kuula moombe ndalikuzumbauzya buyo. = When I was buying the calf I was just taking a risk. Kunyina nkuta iicizyi kubeteka twaambo iinga yapa muntu mulandu kwiinda mukuzumbauzya. = There is no court which allows itself to judge cases by convicting a person through circumstantial evidence. Kakunyina aku zumbauzya, kana aako kakanjila mumeenda. = Without doubt that child went into the water. Mwana wakaide kul-zumina pesi mumoyo kaide kuzumbauzya banyina ncobatakali kuyandila kuti bantu bazyibe cakajaya Mainza. = The child just agreed but in her heart she wondered why her mother did not want people to know what had killed Mainza. Umuleke buyo kazumbauzya cisubulo ncayakupegwa. = Just leave him alone to guess what punishment he is going to be given. (1.-zumbauzyigwa, 2.-zumbauzyide, 3.-zumbauzya, 4.-zumbauzyizya, 5.-zumbauzyizyalyo, 6.-zumbauzyisya, 7.-zumbauzya-zumbauzya, 8.-zumbauzyanya) Also: -zumbula.

track by scent, as dog, Ooyu mubwa ulafwambaana kuzumbula. This dog is quick to pick up the scent. Also: -numfwida, -fwufwuzya bwema. (1.-zumbulwa, 2.-zumbwide, 3.-zumbuzya 4.-zumbwida, 5.-zumbwidalyo, 6.-zumbulisya, 7.-zumbula-zumbula, 8.-zumbulana)
  • guess, Tiindakacizyi cakali kucitika, ndakali kuzumbula biya. = I did not know what was happening, I was just guessing. Also: -zumbauzya.

speculate, guess, imagine Ooyu tali masimpe, uzumbuuzya buyo. This one is not speaking the truth, he is just guessing. (1.-zumbuuzyigwa, 2.-zumbuuzyide, 3.-zumbuuzya, 4.-zumbuuzyizya, 5.-zumbuuzyizyalyo, 6.-zumbuuzyisya, 7.-zumbuuzya-zumbuuzya, 8.-zumbuuzyanya) Also: -zumbula.

persist, rt. -zumanana, Mukaintu oyu wakalizumenene kuzyala nkaambo kunyina mukaintu unga waikkalilila nanda itabonwi bana. This woman continued to give birth because no woman can stay in a home where children are not seen. (1.-zumananwa, 2.-zumenene, 3.-zumananika, 4.-zumananina, 5.-zumananinalyo, 6.-zumananisya, 7.-zumenene-zumenene, 8.-zumananinana)

agree, consent, believe, Ndazumina kuti ube mulumi wangu. = I agree that you should become my husband. Ndakazumina kuunka kunkuta. = I agreed to go to court. (1.-zuminwa, 2.-zuminide, 3.-zuminzya, 4.-zuminina, 5.-zumininalyo, 6.-zuminisya 7.-zumina-zumina, 8.-zuminana)
  • thunder, rt. -zuma, Sena yalo mvwula nkulaba! Yiide kuzumina amutwe. = How fearfully the rain produced lightning! It was just thundering on top of your head.
agree to, rt. -zumina, Ndakamukakila, tiindakamuzuminina pe. = I opposed him, I did not agree to him.

be permitted, Wakazumiziqwa kubweza ncinga. = He was allowed to take the bicycle. (1.-zumizigwa, 2. zumizyide, 3.-zumizya, 4.-zumizyizya, 5.-zumizyizyalyo, 6.-zumizyisya, 7.-zumizigwa-zumizigwa, 8.-zumizyanya)
permit, rt. -zumina, Bakamuzumizya kuunka kuti akapumune. = They allowed him to go and rest.

conquer, Mumuzundano wakwiimba bakazunda basicikolo besu. = Our pupils won in the singing competition. (1.-zundwa, 2.-zundide, 3.-zundya, 4.-zundila, 5.-zundilalyo, 6.-zundisya, 7.-zunda-zunda, 8.-zundana.) Also: -koma, -jombola.

compete, rt.-zunda, Kamuzundana tubone batiizunde. = Compete so that we see who wins. Aaba bantu bazundana kulwana. = These people are having a boxing contest. Also: -beelezyana. (for extensions see zunda)

treat as inferior, Naakali kubetekwa Mangunje wakalikumuzundikizya mubetesi nkaambo wakacili mwana. When Mangunje was being tried he regarded the judge as inferior because he (the judge) was still young. Uyakuba mukozyanyo kubantu banji cicitika kuti mwana wazundikizya bazyali bakwe akucita zintu mbuli mbwayanda mwini. You will be an example to many people of what happens when a child treats her parents as inferior and does whatever she wants herself. (1.-zundikizigwa, 2.-zundikizyide, 3.-zundikizya, 4.-zundikizyizya, 5.-zundikizyizyalyo, 6.-zundikizyisya, 7.-zundikizya-zundikizya, 8.-zundikizyanya)

be swinging, Muntu walisina ulazunga mucisamu. = The person who committed suicide is swinging from a tree. Also: -leleenga. (1.-zungwa, 2.-zungide, 3.-zungizya, 4.-zungila, 5.-zungilalyo, 6.-zungisya, 7.-zunga-zunga, 8.-zungilana, | -zungizyanya)
  • shake the tail, Musune wangu naalikucela, mucila wali kuzunga kutanda mbuwo. My ox when grazing was shaking his tail to drive off the flies.
  • travel about with, Kacumbika uzunga a Nambuta mazuba oonse. = Kacumbika is travelling about with Nambuta always. Musimbi wakayanda kujoka nkaambo kwategwa tiicaali kuboneka kabotu kuti mweenzu ankata yakwe amutwe watalika kuzunga abasankwa. The girl wanted to return because it did not look well if a visitor with her headpad on her head (i.e. just recently arrived) would be moving about with men. Cheelo ulaba sibonenwisyiko; uutalibonyi mpokkalikila, unakwiide kuzunga kuyandaula basimbi, nokuba kuti wakwata kale. = Cheelo becomes a roamer; it is not known where he stays, he is just travelling about looking for girls, although he is already married.

be shaky, Aaya malele alazungaana, kocenjela. This ladder is shaky, be careful. Bwizu bulazungaana akaambo kamuwo. = The grass is shaking because of the wind. Oyu mwana Mainza wakandityompya alimwi wandisampula kumunzi, zina lyangu lyazungaana. = This child Mainza has disappointed me and has disgraced me at home, my reputation has been shaken. Also: -yuntaana, -yuntana. (1.-zungaanwa, 2.-zungeene, 3.-zungaanya, 4.-zungaanina, 5.-zungaaninalyo, 6.-zungaanisya, 7.-zungaana-zungaana, 8.-zungaanizyanya)

cause to shake, rt.-zungaana, Twaambo twako ntupati twauzungaanya moyo wangu. = Your statements are vast, they shake my heart. Naakkoyo kuti kakanana twaambo twankondo, lyoonse uvwula kuzungaanya mu-twe wakwe. If Naakkoyo talked about the war, she always had the habit of shaking her head. Ibbwe nilyakamuuma amulomo, lyakazungaanya menyo akwe. When the stone struck him on the mouth, it loosened his teeth. Also: -nyakinya, -tikinya. (extensions see zungaana)

walk about without any purpose, Ooyu ulaciyanda kuzungazunga kweenda lyoonse. = This one likes to walk about all the time. Mazubaano bantu bazunga-zunga buyo, kunyina ncobacita. These days people who just walk about, do nothing.

spy, as a bird of prey, Kainga kazungila bana bankuku. = The hawk is looking out for the chickens. (1.-zungilwa, 2.-zungilide, 3.-zungizya, 4.-zungila, 5.-zungilalyo, 6.-zungisya, 7.-zungila-zungila, 8.-zungilana)
  • be impending dangerously, Aano mazuba Kachabe talilemeki, ulangika kuti kuli cimuzungila. = These days Kachabe is not behaving well, it seems something bad is about to happen to him.

have bad feeling against each other, Chiimba a Chingobe bala*zungilana*, ndimasimpe kuti bumwi buzuba bayakulwana. = There are feelings of animosity between Chiimba and Chingobe, I am very sure that one day they will fight. Also: -fwundililana. (extensions see -*zungila*)

be crooked, be winding, as a road, Ooyu mugwagwa ula*zunguluka*. = This road winds. (1.-zungulukwa, 2.-zungulukide, 3.-zungulusya, 4.-zungulukila, 5.-zungulukilalyo, 6.-zungulukisya, 7.-zunguluka-zunguluka, 8.-zungulukana) Also: -zinguluka.

be loose, *Cilazunguna cibulo eeci*. = This bucket is swaying. (1.-zungunwa, 2.-zungunide, 3.-zungunya, 4.-zungunina, 5.-zunguninalyo, 6.-zungunisya, 7.-zunguna-zunguna, 8.-zungunizyanya) Also: -zungaana.

be loose, Cisamu cilazunguuna, tacinasindailwa. = This pole is loose, the ground around it has not been stamped down. Also: -zungaana. (1.-zunguunwa, 2.-zunguunide, 3.-zunguunya, 4.-zunguunina, 5.-zuguuninalyo, 6.-zunguunisya, 7.-zunguunazunguuna, 8.-zunguunizyanya)

throb, *Cilazunta* mukati cilonda eeci. = The wound is throbbing inside. Maulu buyo aacizunta. It is just the legs that are still paining. Also: -zwinta (1.-zuntwa, 2.-zuntide, 3.-zuntya, 4.-zuntila, 5.-zuntilalyo, 6.-zuntisya, 7.-zunta-zunta, 8.-zuntilana)

stand motionless, Musune naatyola cikkeyi, *wazuntumana*. = When the ox broke the yoke-pin, it stood motionless. (1.-zuntumanwa, 2.-zuntumene, 3.-zuntumanya, 4.-zuntumanina, 5.-zuntumaninalyo, 6.-zuntumanisya, 7.-zuntumana-zuntumana, 8.-zuntumaninana)
stand motionless like a soldier on guard.

undress, Sincinko wazunununa zikobela zyoonse. = The mad person took off all his clothes. (1.-zunununwa, 2.-zununwide, 3.-zununuzya, 4.-zununwida, 5.-zununwidalyo, 6.-zununisya, 7.-zunununa-zunununa, 8.-zunununana) Also: -samununa, -suula.
gesticulate for a fight, Wakali kuzunza kayanda kulwana. = He was squaring up for a fight. Also: *vwika*

agitate, Ncibi kapati kuzunzanya bana kuti balwane. = It is very bad to arouse children to fight. (1.-zunzanyizyigwa, 2.-zunzanyide, 3.-zunzanya, 4.-zunzanyizyizya, 5.-zunzanyi-zyizyalyo, 6.-zunzanyisya, 7.-zunzanya-zunzanya, 8.-zunzanyizyanya) Also: -yunga.

become aggressive, Munyati ulazunzuka aumwa ntobolo. = The buffalo becomes agressive when hit by a gun. Also: *nyema*, -kalala. (1.-zunzukwa, 2.-zunzukide, 3.-zunzusya, 4-zunzukila, 5.-zunzukilalyo, 6.-zunzukisya, 7.-zunzuka-zunzuka, 8.-zunzukilana)

shake, Kozunzya cisamu masuku aloke. = Shake the tree so that the masuku fruits fall down. Wakali mukwe utazunzya maleya. He was a person who did not fear crowds. Also: -yuunya. (1.-zunzyigwa, 2.-zunzyide, 3.-zunzya, 4.-zunzyizya, 5.-zunzyizyalyo, 6.-zunzyisya 7.-zunzya-zunzya, 8.-zunzyanya)

erect head, stand alert, Wazupumana mbuli kuti kuli ncaamvwa ciboola. = He stood alert as if he heard something coming. Muntu wazupumana munsi lyangu. = The man stood alert beside me. Naakkoyo naakali kuyanda kuloboka, simalungu wakazuntumana munsi acitewo mpaakayubide akuzupumana zupupuu. = When Naakkoyo was escaping, the trader stood motionless beside the bush where she was hiding and was very alert. (1.-zupumanwa, 2.-zupumene, 3.-zupumanya, 4.-zupumanina, 5.-zupumaninalyo, 6.-zupumanisya, 7.-zupumana-zupumana, 8.-zupumaninana)

stand still, Bausyi oyu mwana bakazwa mucintoolo nkujana mwanaabo mbwaali kuzupumuna a mafwuleenke mumaanza. The father of the child came out of the store only to find his child standing still with the oranges in his hands.

run, Kozusa ufwambaane kujoka. Run so that you are quick to return. Nanzele ulazusa mucibanda. = The oribi is running in the plain. (1.-zuswa, 2.-zuside, 3.-zusisya, 4.-zusila, 5.-zusilalyo, 6.-zusisya, 7.-zusa-zusa, 8.-zusilana) Also: -zuza, -tijaana, -balika, -lunduka.
be torn off, Ciluso cakali kukamba amubili kacizutauka kuuma mukaintu wakwe. The whip sounded and was torn in pieces on the body of his wife.

tear off, Kozutaula nyama eeyo. = Tear off that meat. Syuumbwa uzutaula kanamusya. = The lion is tearing the duiker apart. Also: -zapaula. (1.-zutaulwa, 2.-zutawide, 3.-zutauzya, 4.-zutawida, 5.-zutawidalyo, 6.-zutaulisya, 7.-zutaula-zutaula, 8.-zutaulana)

be cut, Cazutuka cooye caanzya ngulube. The string has been cut which tied the pig. (1.-zutukwa, 2.-zutukide, 3.-zutukizya, 4.-zutukila, 5.-zutukilalyo, 6.-zutukisya, 7.-zutuka-zutuka, 8.-zutukizyanya)

cut, break, tear with teeth, Kocizutula calampisya cooye eco. = Cut that string it is too long. Kozutula lutende Iwacisuwo. Cut the stems of the lutende plant for making a basket. Wakazinguluka kunzaa nanda kumwi uyabuzutula nyama. He went around the back of the house while tearing at the meat. (1.-zutulwa, 2.-zutwide, 3.-zutuzya, 4.-zutwida, 5.-zutwidalyo, 6.-zutulisya, 7.-zutula-zutula, 8.-zutulana)

take off clothes, Bana balazuula zisani. The children are taking off their clothes. Also: -samununa, -suula. (1.-zuulwa, 2.-zuwide, 3.-zuuzya, 4.-zuwida, 5.-zuwidalyo, 6.-zuulisya, 7.-zuulazuula, 8.-zuulana)
  • become mature, Musankwa wazuula inga lyalemalema jwi. = When a boy matures his voice becomes heavy. Bantu beelede kweenda amyoyo izuulele amutukondo twakwa Leza. = People ought to walk with mature hearts in the paths of God. Also: -kula.

suspend oneself from or hang, Mbubakaswaanina amulyango, musimbi nkusotokela musankwa nkulizuumbwa munsingo. Immediately she saw him at the door, the girl jumped towards the man and hung on his neck. (1.-zuumbwa, 2.-zuumbide, 3.-zuumbya, 4 zuumbila, 5.-zuumbilalyo, 6.-zuumbisya 7.-zuumbwa-zuumbwa, 8.-zuumbana)

be shaken, as by the wind, Twabona buyo mutendu wanyama walikuzuumuka amulenga. = We just saw a strip of meat swinging on the line. (1.-zuumukwa, 2.-zuumukide, 3.-zuumusya, 4.-zuumukila, 5.-zuumukilalyo, 6.-zuumukisya 7.-zuumuka-zuumuka, 8.-zuumukilana)
  • move quickly towards, Naakazuumuka kuti andijate, ndakamuzela. = When he moved quickly to catch me, I slipped away from him.

undress, *Komuzuununa* *zisani zikasaala mwana nkaambo lyabala zuba.* = Take off the warm clothes from the child as the sun is shining. (1.-zuununwa, 2.-zuunwide, 3.-zuunuzya, 4.-zuunwida, 5.-zuunwidalyo, 6.-zuununisya, 7.-zuununa-zuununa, 8.-zuununana) Also: -samununa, -zuula, -suula.

be strong, work hard, work earnestly with dedication, *Kozuunyana kubeleka mulimo oyu kutegwa uumane.* = Be strong in doing this work so that you finish it. *Basankwa bakazuunyana kutambisya, nkasaalo bbu!* = The boys were struggling hard to tame the oxen, with the sweat dropping! *Kuliimya nimbaakani yabukombi buzuunyene kuli Leza.* = Self-control is a sign of prayerful life that is earnestly dedicated to God. (1.-zuunyanwa, 2.-zuunyene, 3.-zuunyika, 4.-zuunyanina, 5.-zuunyaninalyo, 6.-zuunyanisya, 7.-zuunyana-zuunyana, 8.-zuunyaninana)

push over (wrestling), *Kuusya muntu mukamando nkuzuwa.* = To throw a man in wrestling is to push him over. (1.-zuugwa, 2.-zuwide, 3.-zuwizya, 4.-zuwila, 5.-zuwilalyo, 6.-ziwisya, 7.-zuwa-zuwa, 8.-zuwana) Also: -zyuula
  • stir vigourously twisting the contents, *Musimbi munkutwe mukujika ulazuwa mukupwaya makoto aansima.* = An energetic girl when cooking stirs vigourously to break the lumps of nsima. *Nibakalikuzyana bakali mbuli bantu ba-zuwa mangolomu.* = When they were dancing they were jumping about like people who had taken the medicine of vitality.

ooze out, leak, *Inanda yokwesu ilazuza.* = Our house is leaking. (1.-zuzilwa, 2.-zuzide, 3.-zuzizya, 4.-zuzila, 5.-zuzilalyo, 6.-zuzisya, 7.-zuza-zuza, 8.-zuzilana) Also: -sweka, -zwizya.
  • run, *Nobakali kuyabweenda, umwi mukaintu, ccita naa waakongwa nzi, wakatalika kuzuza.* = When they were going along, one woman, I don't know what frightened her, began to run. Also: -lunduka.

rush, *Bakaintu bamwi bakali kuzuzaana kumwi bayabuuma nsakalala.* = Some women were rushing about while they were beating rattles. (1.-zuzaanwa, 2.-zuzaanide, 3.-zuzaanya, 4.-zuzaanina, 5.-zuzaaninalyo, 6.-zuzaanisya, 7.-zuzaana-zuzaana, 8.-zuzaaninana)
rush to, *Ndali kuzuzaanina kukuteka meenda akujisya.* = I was rushing to draw water for cooking.

tremble, *Wakayoowa naakabona munene nkwazuzanya akwaazamuka akuyeeya kuti antela munene mmulozi nokuba kubaa kalwalo kamaafwa.* = He feared when he saw the old man trembling and opening his mouth wide thinking that he might be a witch or was suffering from epilepsy.
fulfill, *Ciloto cako cazuzika.* = Your dream is fulfilled. (1.-zuzikwa, 2.-zuzikide, 3.-zuzikizya, 4.-zuzukila, 5.-zuzikilalyo, 6.-zuzikisya, 7.-zuzika-zuzika, 8.-zuzikana)

fulfill, rt. -zuzika, *Wakaile kuboola kumuswaangano wamunzi kuzuzikizya mulawo wasibbuku.* = He was just coming to the village meeting to fulfill the law of the headman. *Kamuzuzikizya zisyomezyo nzyomubamba.* = Fulfill the promises which you make.

be convulsed, shake, *Waciswa ncazuzuma ooyu.* = He is sick that is why he is shaking. *Mwana uzuzuma mpeyo.* = The child is shaking with the cold. (1.-zuzumwa, 2.-zuzumide, 3.-zuzumya, 4.-zuzumina, 5.-zuzuminalyo, 6.-zuzumisya, 7.-zuzuma-zuzuma, 8.-zuzuminana)

pretend, Mutinta wakatalika kulizuzumbuzya, kucita mbuli muntu unyina luyando kuli Mubekwabekwa, pesi kuti wamulanga cini-cini abusyu ulajana kuti mukati mwini mumoyo wakwe Iwakaliko luyando. = Mutinta began to pretend, acting as if she had no love for Mubekwabekwa, but if you looked directly into her face you would find that within her heart there was love. (1.-zuzumbuzyigwa, 2.-zuzumbuzyide, 3.-zuzumbuzya, 4.-zuzumbuzyizya, 5.-zuzumbuzyizyalyo, 6.-zuzumbuzyisya, 7.-zuzumbuzya-zuzumbuzya, 8.-zuzumbuzyanya)

fill, Kamucizuzya meenda cibulo eeco. = Fill that bucket with water. (1.-zuzyigwa, 2.-zuzyide, 3.-zuzya, 4.-zuzyizya, 5.-zuzyizyalyo, 6.-zuzyisya, 7.-zuzya-zuzya, 8.-zuzyanya) Also: -vwuzya.
  • leak, nanda ilazuzya. = The house is leaking. Also: -sweka.

come out, Kamuzwa munzila bainde bapati. = Move out of the way so that the elders can pass. Bulowa bwazwa mumpemo. = Blood is coming out of the nose. Moyo wakamuzwa. The heart left him. i.e. He was devastated. (1.-zwisyigwa, 2.-zwide, 3.-zwisya, 4.-zwida, 5.-zwidalyo, 6.-zwisya, 7.-zwazwa, 8.-zwisyanya) -zwa busonga | -zwa mumena = sprout as grain.

pull off (coat), Kozwaalula cibaki cabija malowa. Pull off the coat which is soiled with blood. (1.-zwaalulwa, 2.-zwaalwide, 3.-zwaaluzya 4.-zwaalwida, 5.-zwaalwidalyo, 6.-zwaalulisya, 7.-zwaalula-zwaalula, 8.-zwaalulana) Also: -samununa.

dress, Kozwaata cizwaato citajisi tombe. = Put on a garment which is not dirty. Also: -sama, -vwakila, -sakila. (1.-zwaatwa, 2.-zwaatide, 3.-zwaatya, 4.-zwaatila, 5.-zwaatilalyo, 6.-zwaatisya, 7.-zwaata-zwaata, 8.-zwaatisyanya)

dress up in, Koleka kuzwatiika zizwaato zinji kuti kakupya. = If it is hot, stop wearing many clothes. (1.-zwatiikwa, 2.-zwatiikide, 3.-zwaatiikizya, 4.-zwatiikila, 5.-zwatiikilalyo, 6.-zwatiikisya, 7.-zwatiika-zwatiika, 8.-zwatiikana) Also: -ilikizya.

rebel against, Basankwa bakazwaluka akusiya sibbuku. = The men rebelled against the headman and left him. Also: -zanga. (1.-zwalukwa, 2.-zwalukide, 3.-zwalukizya 4.-zwalukila, 5.-zwalukilalyo, 6.-zwalukisya 7.-zwaluka-zwaluka, 8.-zwalukana)

hug, hold securely, Kaseseko kazwambatila acisamu. = The bat is clinging to the tree. Also: -gwambatila, -zambatila. (1.-zwambatilwa, 2.-zwambatide, 3.-zwambatizya, 4.-zwambatilila, 5.-zwambatililalyo, 6.-zwambatilisya, 7.-zwambatilazwambatila, 8.-zwambatilana)

quarrel, Kuzwangana abantu taciyandiki. It is not desireable to quarrel with people. (1.-zwanganwa, 2.-zwangene, 3.-zwanganya, 4.-zwanganina, 5.-zwanganinalyo, 6.-zwanganisya, 7.-zwangana-zwangana, 8.-zwangana)

clothe oneself nicely, Wazwata cibaki cisalala. You have donned a clean shirt. Also: -zwaata, -sama. (1.-zwatwa, 2.-zwatide, 3.-zwatya, 4.-zwatila, 5.-zwatilalyo, 6.-zwatisya, 7.-zwata-zwata, 8.-zwatisyanya)

dress, Kamumuzwatika mwana tweende. Dress the child so that we go. cf. -zwatiika, -samika. (1.-zwatikwa, 2.-zwatikide, 3.-zwatisya, 4.-zwatikila, 5.-zwatikilalyo, 6.-zwatikisya, 7.-zwatika-zwatika, 8.-zwatikana)

pour out, Nguni muntu akati kesu uyandisya kubona mwanaakwe kuzwazwatika malowa. = What person among us wants to see his child with blood gushing out. (1.-zwazwatikwa, 2.-zwazwatikide, 3.-zwazwatisya, 4.-zwazwatikila, 5.-zwazwatikilalyo, 6.-zwazwatikisya, 7.-zwazwatika-zwazwatika, 8.-zwazwatisyanya) Also: -mwamwatika

pass by quickly, Kayuni kazikuzwela buyo, tiikalibonya kabotu. = The bird just passed by quickly, it was not clearly seen. Eyi njemizeezo yakali muli Chimuka ciindi coonse ncaakaimvwi mukkota lyacitima kalanga misamu izwelazwela kuya munsi. = These were the thoughts which were in Chimuka all the time as he stood in the corridor of the train looking at the trees passing by quickly. (1.-zwelwa, 2.-zwelede, 3.-zwezya, 4.-zwelela, 5.-zwelelalyo, 6.-zwelesya, 7.-zwela-zwela, 8.-zwelana)

sneak away, Mulala wakazwelembuka kunze aņanda. = Mulala sneaked away behind the house. (1.-zwelembukwa, 2.-zwelembukide, 3.-zwelembukizya, 4.-zwelembukila, 5.-zwelembukilalyo, 6.-zwelembukisya, 7.-zwelembuka-zwelembuka, 8.-zwelembukana) Also: -zelembuka

put on wrong track, Bandizwelenganya buya, nciyandizimina nzila mbotu. = They put me on the wrong track, that is why I lost the good path. Also: -zelenganya. (1.-zwelenganyizyigwa, 2.-zwelenganyide, 3.-zwelenganya, 4.-zwelenganina, 5.-zwelenganinalyo, 6.-zwelenganisya, 7.-zwelenganya-zwelenganya, 8.-zwelenganyizyanya)

vanish into grass, Bakwale bazweluluka musyokwe. = The partridges vanished into the bush. (1.-zwelulukwa, 2.-zwelulukide, 3.-zwelulusya, 4.-zwelulukila, 5.-zwelulukilalyo, 6.-zwelulukisya, 7.-zweluluka-zweluluka, 8.-zwelulukana)

sneaking away, Bazyali bakalimuzyi kuti wakali mwana wakali kuzwenga akuyanda kusobana kapati, bakanyandwa kuti wakabatama. = The parents knew that he was a child who would slip away and wanted to play a lot, but they were surprised when he quietened down. (1.-zwengwa, 2.-zwengede, 3.-zwengezya, 4.-zwengela, 5.-zwengelalyo, 6.-zwengesya, 7.-zwenga-zwenga, 8.-zwengana)

cause to come close, Komuzwenia-zwenia kokuno mwana. = Bring the child close. (1.-zwenesyegwazwenesyegwa, 2.-zwengede-zwengede, 3.-zwenia-zwenia, 4.-zwengela-zwengela, 5.-zwengela-zwengelalyo, 6.-zweniesyazweniesya, 7.-zwenia-zwenia, 8.-zweniana-zweniana) Also: -swenya-swenya

glimpse, Ndamuzwezya kucisobano kuya. = I had a glimpse of her at the play. Ndamuzwezya awa, walikuya kumbo. = I caught sight of him there, he was going westwards. (1.-zwezyegwa, 2.-zwezyede, 3.-zwezya, 4.-zwezyezya, 5.-zwezyezyalyo, 6.-zwezyesya, 7.-zwezya-zwezya, 8.-zwezyanya)

escape from, Wandizwida muntu ngwindalondede kusesa. = The person from whom I came to claim money had sneaked away before I arrived. Bana nibali kusya mbeba yafwambaana kubazwida. = When the children were digging for a rodent, it quickly escaped them. (1.-zwidwa, 2.-zwide, 3.-zwisya, 4.-zwida, 5.-zwidalyo, 6.-zwisya, 7.-zwida-zwida, 8.-zwidana)

start on a journey, rt. -zwa, Kuya ku Choma ndakazwide nkuku nizyakalila. = I set out going to Choma when the chickens were cackling. (extensions same as -zwida)
  • be filled, rt. -zula, Nongo njibakapwaya yakazwide meenda. = The pot that they broke was full of water.
  • come out of, rt. -zwa Ndazwide anze kwakaindi kasyoonto. = I came out for a moment.

prosper or advance in work, pass exam, rt. -zwa, *Ndakazwidilila* mumulimo wangu wakuyiisya bana. = I succeeded in my work of teaching children. *Uli kulumwensyi nguuzwidilila kuuma ngoma, walo uuma zyotatwe ciindi comwe.* = The one on the left is the one who surpasses all in beating the drum, he can also beat three drums at the same time. (1.-zwidililwa, 2.-zwidilide, 3.-zwidilizya, 4.-zwidilila, 5.-zwidililalyo, 6.-zwidililisya, 7.-zwidilila-zwidilila, 8.-zwidilizyanya)

tingle, reverberate as the sound of a bell in the ears, *Cilazwiima* mumagondo omu. = It makes you tingle here at the knees. *Mumazwi mulazwiima, ndabaa cintebwe.* = My knees are tingling, I experience a weakness. (1.-zwiimwa, 2.-zwiimide, 3.-zwiimya, 4.-zwiimina, 5.-zwiiminalyo, 6.-zwiimisya, 7.-zwiima-zwiima, 8.-zwiimizyanya)

throb, *Mutwe wangu wali kuzwinta masiku oonse.* = My head was throbbing all night long. Also: -zunta. (1.-zwintwa, 2.-zwintide, 3.-zwintya, 4.-zwintila, 5.-zwintilalyo, 6.-zwintisya, 7.-zwinta-zwinta, 8.-zwintizyanya)

beat continuously, *Baama bazwipaula mwana wakaka kutwa buntele.* = Mother is beating the child again and again who has refused to pound groundnuts. Also: -kwipaula. 3.-zwipauzya (1.-zwipaulwa,2.-zwipawide, 4.-zwipawida, 5.-zwipawidalyo, 6.-zwipaulisya, 7.-zwipaula-zwipaula, 8.-zwipaulana)
be shocked, Bina Haanampakila abana babo bakaide ku

nibakamvwa majwi aabantu balila. = The mother of Haanampakila and her children were shocked when they heard the voices of the people crying. (1.-zwipimanwa, 2.-zwipimene, 3.-zwipimanya, 4.-zwipimanina, 5.-zwipimaninalyo, 6.-zwipimanisya, 7.-zwipimana-zwipimana, 8.-zwipimaninana)

hit once severely, Suntwe uciti anyone nkaanga sulwe kakamuzwipula keembe kampobe. = As the hyena tried to turn, the hare hit him with the axe on the side of the head. Also: -zwipula. (1.-zwipulwa, 2.-zwipwide, 3.-zwipuzya, 4.-zwipwida, 5.-zwipwidalyo, 6.-zwipulisya 7.-zwipula-zwipula, 8.-zwipulana)
remove, take out, rt. -zwa, *Kamuzwisya* anze balange mbozibede zisani bantu. = Take the clothes outside for the people to see how they are.

nombe mumuunda. = Take the cattle out of the field. (1.-zwisyigwa, 2.-zwisyide, 3.-zwisyizya, 4.-zwisyizya, 5.-zwisyizyalyo, 6.-zwisyisya, 7.-zwisya-zwisya, 8.-zwisyanya)
  • abort, *Ndizyi mbocinyonganya* mubili wamusimbi *kuzwisya da.* = I know how aborting a fetus can disturb the body of a woman.

leak, ooze out, Eeci cibulo citekela meenda *cilazwizya.* = This bucket for drawing water is leaking. Caanda campongo *cilazwizya.* = The goats shelter is leaking. Also: -sweka. (1.-zwizyigwa, 2.-zwizyide, 3.-zwizyizya, 4.-zwizyila, 5.-zwizylalyo, 6.-zwizyisya 7.-zwizya-zwizya, 8.-zwizyizyanya
come, Kozya kuno ndiyanda kukutuma. Come here I want to send you on an errand. Also: -za. (1.-zyigwa, 2.-zyide, 3.-zyizya, 4.-zyila, 5.-zyilalyo, 6.-zyisya, 7.-zya-zya, 8.-zyizyana)

beget, give birth, Batumbu bangu bakazyala mwana musankwa jilo. My wife gave birth to a baby boy yesterday. Also: -tumbuka. (1.-zyalwa, 2.-zyede, 3.-zyazya, 4.-zyalila, 5.-zyalilalyo, 6.-zyalisya, 7.-zyala-zyala, 8.-zyalana)
  • give birth (of an animal), Impongo yesu yazyala bana bobilo. = Our goat has given birth to two kids.
  • bear fruit, Uno mwaka mango taakazyala kabotu. This year the mangoes did not bear much fruit.

complain in an indignant manner. "Wandiswida amwiindi yebo Syaacigabba!" mbwaakazyalamuka Sicibende. = "Syaacigabba, you have spit on the calf of my leg!" That is how Sicibende complained indignantly. (1.-zyalamukwa, 2.-zyalamukide, 3.-zyalamusya, 4.-zyalamukila, 5.-zyalamukilalyo, 6.-zyalamukisya, 7.-zyalamuka-zyalamuka 8.-zyalamukilana)

nickname a person, Wandizyalikizya zina litali lyangu. = He gave me a name which was not mine. (1.-zyalikizyigwa, 2.-zyalikizyide, 3.-zyalikizya, 4.-zyalikizyizya, 5.-zyalikizyizyalyos, -zyalikizyisya, 7.-zyalikizya-zyalikizya, 8.-zyalikizyanya) zalikizya. Also:
give birth to, Ndazyalila amwiindi. = I am lucky. (idomatic) (1.-zyalilwa, 2.-zyalilide, 3.-zyalizya, 4.-zyalila, 5.-zyalilalyo, 6.-zyalilisya, 7.-zyalila-zyalila, 8.-zyalilana)

be reborn, Nikwali kuzyalululwa anyika nindazyalululwa kuti ndijokele kubwana. If there were re birth in the world I would have been reborn so that I return to childhood. Mubukristo kupapatiswa nkuzyalululwa mu Muya Uusalala. In Christianity, to be baptized is to be reborn in the Holy Spirit. (1.-zyalululwa, 2.-zyalulwidwe, 3.-zyaluluzya, 4.-zyalulwida, 5.-zyalulwidalyo, 6.-zyalulusya, 8.-zyalululana) 7.-zyalululwa-zyalululwas, -zyama vanish, perish, Bantu bakazyama musaka. Bakazimina. = The people vanished in the bush. They were lost. (1.-zyamwa, 2.-zyamide, 3.-zyamya, 4.-zyamina, 5.-zyaminalyo, 6.-zyamisya, 7.-zyama-zyama, 8.-zyamizyanya) Also: -yabaana.

resist, stand firm, Nitwakali kutingaana amweenzuma, ndakalicizyi kuzyamya kutegwa atanduusyi. = When I was wrestling with my friend, I knew how to stand firm so that he could not throw me down. (1.-zyamizyigwa, 2.-zyamizyide, 3.-zyamya, 4.-zyamina, 5.-zyaminalyo, 6.-zyaminisya, 7.-zyamyazyamya, 8.-zyamizyanya)

dance, Baama balazyana 'kalyaba'. My mother dances the kalyaba. (1.-zyanwa, 2.-zyanide, 3.-zyanisya, 4.-zyanina, 5.-zyaninalyo, 6.-zyanisya, 7.-zyana-zyana, 8.-zyaninana) (Other types of traditional dances in the past were: mutembwe (at mournings); musimbo (at girls initiation); cipilu, macaaca, musala. Dancing at the back of a drummer was known as kapowamine. A first-class dancer was known as siindwikazyano.) The traditional dances of today are mainly: kalyaba, cinande, ikaambekaambe, kukambilwa, budima, makkwaya, bukonkoolo, indikiti.
  • dance as a witch, Bumwi buzuba ba Muchelemba amunene Meleki bakaunka kucikolo akutalika kuzyana. Boonse bakasamide tufwunga antela tusinsi twa bamakaintu babo. Bakataanguna kuzyanina basiisi Mubita. Nibakasika amulyango bakatalika kumwaya musamu wabusu. = One day Muchelemba and the old man Meleki went to the school to dance. Both were dressed in the skirts of their wives. They first danced for the teacher Mubita. When they arrived at the doorway they began to scatter the flour of witchcraft.

. be sturdy, e.g _Kamuzyandamana_ kubala kucikolo. = Be strong in studying at school. _Kuti wazyandamana inga waukonzya mulimo._ = If you are tough you can do the job. (1.-zyandamanwa, 2.-zyandamene, 3.-zyandamanya, 4.-zyandamanina, 5.-zyandamaninalyo, 6.-zyandamanisya, 7.-zyandamana-zyandamana, 8.-zyandamaninana)
  • stand firmly with legs a little apart or with one leg forward, Nobakali kukwelana, basankwa bakacizyiba kuzyandamana. = When they were playing tugof-war the boys knew how to stand firmly with legs apart. Also: -tankamana.

tremble, shiver, Wakazyangama kujata zintu naakabona musilikani. = He trembled to touch things when he saw the policeman. Muntu wayoowa kapati ulazyangama. = A person who is terrified trembles. (1.-zyangamwa, 2.-zyangeme, 3.-zyangamya, 4.-zyangamina, 5.-zyangaminalyo, 6.-zyangamisya, 7.-zyangama-zyangama, 8.-zyangamizyanya) Also: -kankama, -tuntuma

stick in throat, Mwana kamuzyata kafwuwa kanswi. = A fish bone has choked the child. (1.-zyatwa, 2.-zyatide, 3.-zyatizya, 4.-zyatilila, 5.-zyatililalyo, 6.-zyatisya, 7.-zyata-zyata 8.-zyatizyanya) Also: -tingwa kumoyo.
move quickly, Wakazyatauka kuya kucitisyini. He moved quickly going to the station.

stick to pot, be burnt as food, rt. -zyata, Musozya wazyatila mumpoto. = The samp has stuck to the pot. Mundyoli wazyatila ulanona. = When mundyoli sticks to the pot it is nice. Bamakuwa bamwi bazyatila, tabacijoki kwabo pe. Some white people stick to the place, they do not return to their own lands. (1.-zyatizyigwa, 2.-zyatide, 3.-zyatizya, 4.-zyatilila, 5.-zyatililalyo, 6.-zyatilisya, 7.-zyatila-zyatila, 8.-zyatizyanya)

lift leg off, move, Wazyatuka mpaalyatide musankwa ulya. = That boy lifted his leg up where he had stepped. Kozyatuka kuulu, wamulyata mwana. = Move your leg, you are stepping on the child. Basangu tabayoowi, tabazyatuki. = The ancestral spirits do not fear, they are immovable. (1.-zyatukwa, 2.-zyatukide, 3.-zyatusya, 4.-zyatukila, 5.-zyatukilalyo, 6.-zyatukisya, 7.-zyatukazyatuka, 8.-zyatukana)

push person causing him to lift leg, Bamutonka kusikila wazyatula kuulu kwakwe. They pushed him until he lifted his leg. (1.-zyatulwa, 2.-zyatwide, 3.-zyatuzya, 4.-zyatwida, 5.-zyatwidalyo, 6.-zyatulisya, 7.-zyatula-zyatula, 8.-zyatulana)
  • scoop out, Kamuzyatula makololo mucibiya. = Scrape out the leavings from the pot.

delay, linger, Utabi nozyazyata kuya kwenu nkaambo iya kwenu taisinkidwe mamvwa. Do not delay going to your home because the way home is not blocked with thorns. (1.-zyazyatwa, 2.-zyazyatide, 3.-zyazyatizya, 4.-zyazyatilila, 5.-zyazyatililalyo, 6.-zyazyatilisya, 7.-zyazyata-zyazyata, 8.-zyazyatilana)

resist, become fixed, Wazyazyatila, tayandi kuunka. He resists, he does not want to go. Bamwi Batonga bakatiizyazyatile kulonga. = Some Batonga resisted moving. (1.-zyazyatilwa, 2.-zyazyatide, 3.-zyazyatizya, 4.-zyazyatilila, 5.-zyazyatililalyo, 6.-zyazyatilisya, 7.-zyazyatila-zyazyatila, 8.-zyazyatilana)

have given birth, rt. -zyala, Naakkoyo wakalizyede bana banji. = Naakkoyo had given birth to many children. (1.-zyedwe, 2.-zyede, 3.-zyazya, 4.-zyalila, 5.-zyalilalyo, 6.-zyalisya, 7.-zyede-zyede, 8.-zyalana)

study, examine, Naamba boobo kumwi ulazyeenya-zyeenya akulanga cinzimweemwe cakwe. = When he spoke thus he was studying and looking at his shadow. (1.-zyeenyegwa, 2.-zyeenyene, 3.-zyeenyezya, 4.-zyeenyanina, 5.-zyeenyaninalyo, 6.-zyeenyanisya, 7.-zyeenya-zyeenya, 8.-zyeenyaninana)

drag through, Mucembele naakainda munsi lyangu wakazyeepula mulembo ulaa tombe muli cakulya. When the old lady passed near me she dragged her unclean garment through where the food was. (1.-zyeepulwa, 2.-zyeepwide, 3.-zyeepuzya, 4.-zyeepwida 5.-zeepwidalyo, 6.-zyeepulisya, 7.-zyeepula-zyeepula, 8.-zyeepulana)
drag along, Utali kunga lyoonse kozyeepwida mulembo wako muli cakulya. Don't be always dragging your cloth along through the food. (extensions same as -zyeepula)

shake, Mweenzuma wandibuzya mujwi lizyezyema ategwa, "Ino ndeelede kutyani?" = My friend asked me in a shaking voice, "What should I do?" Also: -dedema. (1.-zyezyemwa, 2.-zyezyemede, 3.-zyezyemya, 4.-zyezyemena, 5.-zyezyemenalyo, 6.-zyezyemesya, 7.-zyezyema-zyezyema, 8.-zyezyemenana)

know, experience, Wakazyiba kuti uyanda kuumwa. He knew that she was about to be beaten. Oomu muzyiba tokonzyi kuzyiba kuti kuli nswi. = In this pool you cannot know if there is fish. Ndakazyiba kuti kupenga caamba nzi? = I experienced what suffering means. (1.-zyibwa, 2.-zyibide, 3.-zyibya, 4.-zyibila, 5.-zyibilalyo, 6.-zyibisya, 7.-zyiba-zyiba, 8.-zyibana) Also: -ziba.

know one another, Baya bantu ambweni bazyibana ncibaima alya. = Perhaps those people have known one another, that is why they are standing there. Kaindi bantu bakali kumuka kuzyibana. Long ago people were slow in getting to know one another.

be accustomed, Ndakuzyibila kuno sunu. = I have grown accustomed to this place today. Ndazyibila sunu kukkala amunzi. = I have got used to living at home today. (1.-zyibilwa, 2.-zyibilide, 3.-zyibya, 4.-zyibilila, 5.-zyibililalyo, 6.-zyibilisya, 7.-zyibila-zyibila, 8.-zyibilana)

be informed, Tiindakazyibizigwa lufwu Iwamuzyukulu wangu. = I was not informed of the death of my grandchild. (1.-zyibizigwa, 2.-zyibizidwe, 3.-zyibizya, 4.-zyibizyizya, 5.-zyibizyizyalyo 6.-zyibizyisya, 7.-zyibizigwa-zyibizyigwa, 8.-zyibizyanya)
let one another know, Lyoonse bakali kuzyibizyanya zintu mpozyeendela. = They were always letting one another know how things were going. (Extensions same as -zyibizyigwa)

ceremony after marriage by which bridegroom brings bride to her former home and makes formal acquaintance with her family, Wazyibwa sunu ukwete Mutinta naamuleta kwabo kuti bazyoomubone. The one who married Mutinta was brought to her home to become formally acquainted with her family. Twalikukunywa bukoko bwaku*zyibwa*. = We went to drink the ceremonial beer which is drunk after the marriage. (1.-zyibwa, 2.-zyibide, 3.-zyibya, 4.-zyibila, 5.-zyibilalyo, 6.-zyibisya, 7.-zyibwa-zyibwa, 8.-zyibana)
  • be known or recognized, Bamwi bantu tabayandi kwaanzigwa ciindi camasiku nkaambo tabayandi kuzyibwa. = Some people do not want to be greeted at night because they do not want to be known.
  • idiom, 'kumuzyibwa ndaboola' = You will never know when I will come back. (when a person is going to a place where there is danger.)

come from, Mwazyila kuli? = Where have you come from? Bamakuwa bakazyila kule. = White people have come from afar. Also: -zila. (1.-zyilwa, 2.-zyilide, 3.-zyizya, 4.-zyilila, 5.-zyililalyo, 6.-zyilisya, 7.-zyila-zyila, 8.-zyilana)

perplex, frustrated, have no way out of a problem Mudenda ncaatasika amuswaangano, kuli kaambo kamuzyinga. = The reason why Mudenda did not arrive at the meeting is because he was in a dilema. Nokkede koliibide kozyi kuti kamwi kantu kaya kukuzyinga akale. When you live happily know that one little thing will bring you frustration in the future. (1.-zyingwa, 2.-zyingide, 3.-zyingizya, 4.-zyingila, 5.-zyingilalyo, 6.-zyingisya, 7.-zyinga-zyinga, 8.-zyingana)
be puzzled, be overcome with emotion, Wakazyingwa naakamvwa lufwu lwabausyi. = He was devastated when he heard of the death of his father.
be well known, Aka nkalengwa kazyizyilwe mucisi coonse. = This is a little custom which is well known throughout the land.

be curved, as road, Mugwagwa uzyobooka ulampya musinzo nkoya. A winding road lengthens the journey you are making. Also: -zyokooka. (1.-zyobookwa, 2.-zyobookede, 3.-zyoobokezya, 4.-zyobookela. 5.-zyobookelalyo, 6.-zyobookesya, 7.-zyobooka-zyobooka, 8.-zyoboosyanya)

return, Kwaanzya basika kuzwa kumalila nkuti, *'Mwazyoka!'* = When greeting those coming from a funeral you say, "You have returned." Mali abaama ataata ngindatola ncintu buyo, njokubeetela ainda ndaakuzyoka. = The money of my mother and father which I have taken is of no significance, I will bring it back to them later when I return. Ino mwakazyoka lili ku Kabulamwaanda = When did you return from Kabula-mwaanda? Also: -joka. (1.-zyokwa, 2.-zyokede, 3.-zyosya, 4.-zyokela, 5.-zyokelalyo, 6.-zyokesya, 7.-zyoka-zyoka, 8.-zyokelana)
be reconciled, (Ila) Aaba bantu bakasulene, sunu bazyokelana. = These people who hated one another have been reconciled. Also: -jokelana.

turn around a little, look back, Ndakazyokoloka akumwaambila kuti ncaakali kucita cakali cibi. = I turned around and told him that what he was doing was bad. (1.-zyokolokwa, 2.-zyokolokede, 3.-zyokolosya, 4.-zyokolokela, 5.-zyokolokelalyo, 6.-zyokolokesya, 7.-zyokoloka-zyokoloka, 8.-zyokolokana)
  • return, Baama bayakuzyokoloka mwezi uuboola. = Mother is returning next month.

name one by his disgarded name, Mweemba wakautakata muswaangano nibakamuzyokolola azina ndyatayandi. = Mweemba walked out of the meeting when they called him by an old name which he did not like. Also: -antikizya. (1.-zyokololwa, 2.-zyokolwede, 3.-zyokolozya, 4.-zyokolweda, 5. -zyokolwedalyo, 6.-zyokololesya, 7.-zyokolola-zyokolola, 8.-zyokololana)
  • cause to turn around, Kamumuzyokolola, aboole tubambe twaambo. = Make him come back so that he comes and we settle the matter. Kamucizyokolola cisamu nkaambo cilicengeme. = Turn the pole around because it is out of position. Also: -vwuulula.

be winding, Mugwagwa uzyokooka ulamusya. The road which winds delays one. (1.-zyokookwa, 2.-zyokookede, 3.-zyokoozya, 4.-zyokookela, 5.-zyokookelalyo, 6.-zyokookesya, 7.-zyokooka-zyokooka, 8.-zyokookelana)

dance more slowly than usual, Balazyokota kuzyana cinande. = They are dancing the cinande more slowly. (1.-zyokotwa, 2.-zyokotede, 3.-zyokotezya 4.-zyokotela, 5.-zyokotelalyo, 6.-zyokotesya, 7.-zyokota-zyokota, 8.-zyokotelana)

marry a widow, Nguni wakazyola bina Mutinta nobakafwidwa mwaalumi wabo? = Who married the mother of Mutinta when her husband died? (1.-zyolwa, 2.-zyolede, 3.-zyolezya, 4.-zyolela, 5.-zyolelalyo, 6.-zyolesya, 7.-zyola-zyola, 8.-zyolana)
  • return, to hit back, Mucende wakomedwe wazunda naazyola. The bull which was overpowered won when it returned to hit back.
  • return of the spirit to the home after it has wandered afar, Bwakondolwa bukoko mbwakuzyola muzimo, basazinyina mufwu balatalika kupailila muzimo ulya kuti uboole munanda kuzwa kooko nkuwakali kuya bwiingaila. = As soon as the beer for returning the spirit has been brewed, the relatives of the dead person begin to beg that spirit that he returns home from that place where he has been wandering.

investigate, Musilikani ucenjede ulicizyi kuzyolola twaambo. = A wise policeman knows how to investigate crimes. Also: -vwuntauzya. (1.-zyololwa, 2.-zyolwede, 3.-zyolozya, 4.-zyolweda, 5.-zyolwedalyo, 6.-zyololesya 7.-zyolola-zyolola, 8.-zyololana)

give love potion, Bakamuzyondola mulumi, ncazundwa. = She gave the husband a love-potion, that is why he has succumbed. Basimunzyeenu bakazyondolwa. Bakaintu bakwe bakabalisya nciinga nkoma cakasanganizigwa atubyaabi twasuntwe ajongolo. Eeci ncecipa kuti abaya bakaintu baambaula balo basimunzyeenu kabaide kugogomana mbuli jongolo akuba abukandu mbuli suntwe. = Your uncle has been given a love potion by his wife. She has fed him with tortoise mixed with juices of a hyena and a millipede. The result of this is that when his wife speaks he just nods his head like a millipede and becomes cowardly like a hyena. (1.-zyondolwa, 2.-zyondwede, 3.-zyondozya, 4.-zyondweda, 5.-zyondwedalyo, 6.-zyondolesya, 7.-zyondola-zyondola, 8.-zyondolana)

be twisted out of shape, Mootokala wamwiiyi wazyondongana niwapwaya amusamu. = The teacher's car was buckled when he hit a tree. (1.-zyondonganwa, 2.-zyondongene, 3.-zyondonganya, 4.-zyondonganina, 5.-zyondonganinalyo, 6.-zyondonganisya, 7.-zyondongana-zyondongana, 8.-zyondonganizyanya) Also: -gogama.

use something as a love-potion, rt. -zyondola, Wakamuzyondozya musamu uvwelwa moongolwa. = She gave him a love potion which was mixed with a millipede. (1.-zyondolwa, 2.-zyondwede, 3.-zyondozya, 4.-zyon-dweda, 5.-zyondwedalyo, 6.-zyondolesya, 7.-zyondozya-zyondozya, 8.-zyondolana)
  • increase a man's wage in order to make him like his job, *Bakamuzyondozya* mali kutegwa auyandisye mulimo wakwe. = They coaxed him with money so that he would like his work.

spy, ferret out, *Muntu mubi uzyonga twaambo tuleta ntenda mucisi cokwabo.* = A bad person ferrets out matters which bring danger to his country. (1.-zyongwa, 2.-zyongede, 3.-zyongezya, 4.-zyongela, 5.-zyongelalyo 6.-zyongesya, 7.-zyonga-zyonga, 8.-zyongelana)

turn around, *Balima mumuunda balazyoomoka tunji.* = People who plough in a field turn around frequently. (1.-zyoomokwa, 2.-zyoomo-kede, 3.-zyoomosya, 4.-zyoomokela, 5.-zyoomokelalyo, 6.-zyoomokesya, 7.-zyoomoka-zyoomoka, 8.-zyoomokana)

be uprooted, come down by breaking, *Cisamu ncitwali kusya cazyuka amiyanda yoonse.* = The tree that we were digging up was taken out with all its roots. (1.-zyukwa, 2.-zyukide, 3.-zyukizya, 4.-zyukila, 5.-zyukilalyo, 6.-zyukisya, 7.-zyuka-zyuka, 8.-zyukilana)
  • appear as full moon, *Mwezi wakazyuka jilo.* = Yesterday there was a full moon. *Nceciindi mwezi niwakali kuzyuka kujwe.* = This is the time when the full-moon was rising in the east.

pull up, as stick or pole out of ground, rt. *-zyuka,* *Basankwa bazyukula cisamu cipati.* = The boys are pulling out a big pole. (1.-zyukulwa, 2.-zyukwide, 3.-zyukuzya, 4.-zyukwida, 5.-zyukwidalyo, 6.-zyukulisya, 7.-zyukula-zyukula, 8.-zyukulana)

uproot, take down a pole, *Kamucizyula cisamu eeco cibisya lubuwa.* = Pull down that tree which is making the yard dirty. *Micelo yakali kuvwuna bantu muciindi canzala taicibonwi, bakiizyula akwiigonka.* = Fruits which were helping people to survive during famine are no longer seen, they have rooted them up and cut them down. (1.-zyulwa, 2.-zyulide, 3.-zyulizya, 4.-zyulila, 5.-zyulilalyo, 6.-zyulisya, 7.-zyula-zyula, 8.-zyulana)
  • disturb, *Nibakali kukanana antoomwe kunyina muntu wakalikunga ulabazyula.* = When they were talking together no one was able to disturb them. *Bamakaintu kuti banjila kale muzindongwe kusya ndongwe, tabazyuliki.* = If the women have already gone to their groundnut plots to dig groundnuts, they cannot be disturbed. Also: *-kakula, -zyukula, -nyukula.*
  • use charms to control another, *Ino yebo wakacikonzya buti kumuzyula mwaalumi wako?* = How were you able to control your husband with charms?

uproot many trees, *Bazizyulaula zisamu zinji mumuunda.* = They uprooted many trees in the field. *Kamuzyulaula masamu mumapande.* = Uproot the trees in the newly broken field. (1.-zyulaulwa, 2.-zyulawide, 3.-zyulauzya, 4.-zyulawida, 5.-zulawidalyo, 6.-zyulaulisya, 7.-zyulaula-zyulaula, 8.-zyulaulana)
sufficient, *Leta busu buzyulile.* Bring sufficient meal. Also: *-zulila, -elela*

twist neck of fowl, *Kozyulula nsingo yankanga ifwe.* = Wring the guinea-fowl's neck so that it dies. (1.-zyululwa, 2.-zyulwide, 3.-zyuluzya, 4.-zyulwida, 5.-zyulwidalyo, 6.-zyululisya, 7.-zyulula-zyulula, 8.-zyululana) Also: *-zyuulula, -nyona mukosi.*

turn and twist, Ndalikupenga kuzyulumba masiku onse akaambo kamwida mwali kumyonga. = I was in pain all night turning and twisting because of my stomach which was in turmoil. (1.-zyulumbwa, 2.-zyulumbide, 3.-zyulumbya, 4.-zyulumbila, 5.-zyulumbi--lalyo, 6.-zyulumbisya, 7.-zyulumba-zyulumba, 8.-zyulumbilana) Also: -syulumba

be uprooted, rt. -zyula, Musamu wakalisinina Mutinta wakazyulwa miyanda mbubonya buzuba obu akuumpwa. The tree from which Mutinta hung herself was uprooted the same day and burnt. (1.-zyulwa, 2.-zyulide, 3.-zyulizya, 4.-zyulila, 5.-zyulilalyo, 6.-zyulisya, 7.-zyulwa-zyulwa, 8.-zyulana)

pinch, Amulange musimbi oyu, wamuzyundula cimoni mwana! = Look at this girl, she is pinching the child! Also: -syamba. (1.-zyundulwa, 2.-zyundwide, 3.-zyunduzya, 4.-zyundwida, 5.-zyundwidalyo, 6.-zyundulisya, 7.-zyundula-zyundula, 8.-zyundulana)

encircle, Koleka kuzyunguluka nanda limwi ulawa. = Stop going around the house, you will fall. Muyuni ulazyunquluka mujulu. = The bird is going round above. (1.-zyungulukwa, 2.-zyungulukide, 3.-zyungulukizya, 4.-zyungulukila, 5.-zyungulukilalyo, 6.-zyungulukisya, 7.-zyungulukazyunguluka, 8.-zyungulukana) Also: -zinguluka, -zeleemba.

become dizzy, Kumeso kulazyuuka, ndaba azyuungwe. = My eyes are dizzy, I have a weakness. (1.-zyuukwa, 2.-zyuukide, 3.-zyuukizya, 4.-zyuukila, 5.-zyuukilalyo, 6.-zyuukisya, 7.-zyuuka-zyuuka, 8.-zyuukilana

wrestle with, or twist a person so as to throw him down, Mujibelo wakamuzyuula mweenzinyina limwi wa muunsya. Mujibelo wrestled with his friend until he threw him down. (1.-zyuulwa, 2.-zyuwide, 3.-zyuuzya, 4.-zyuuwida, 5.-zyuuwidalyo, 6.-zyuuwisya, 7.-zyuula-zyuula, 8.-zyuulana) Also: -zuwa.

• look behind, Kozyuuluka ubone ukutobela munsi. = Look behind so that you see who is following you. Mukubula coolwe naakati azyuuluke alange munsi mwaakazwida, wakabona nzoka zyosanwe ziliimvwi kumwi kazimulindila acabukali. = Unfortunately when he turned around to look behind from where he had come, he saw five snakes standing erect while waiting for him in anger. Also: -ceba. (1.-zyuulukwa, 2.-zyuulukide, 3.-zyuulukizya, 4.-zyuulukila, 5.-zyuulukilalyo, 6.-zyuulukisya, 7.-zyuuluka-zyuuluka, 8.-zyuulusyanya)
  • turn around, Olu lusengo Iwakali kuzyuuluka lyoonse. This charm was always going around. Intale yakazyuuluka akusamba. The crocodile turned and swam away.

twist neck of fowl, Kozyuulula mukosi wankuku ifwe. Wring the chicken's neck so that it dies. (1.-zyuululwa, 2.-zyuulwide, 3.-zyuuluzya 4.-zyuulwida, 5.-zyuulwidalyo, 6.-zyuululisya, 7.-zyuulula-zyuulula, 8.-zyuululana) Also: -zyulula, -nyona mukosi.

be fully occupied in doing something, Balaizyuzya milimo, ncobatazwidilili muli nzyobacita. = They occupy themselves with a lot of things that is why they do not succeed in what they do. Also: - vwuzya. (1.-zyuzyigwa, 2.-zyuzyide, 3.-zyuzya, 4.-zyuzyizya, 5.-zyuzyizya, 6.-zyuzyizyalyo 7.-zyuzya-zyuzya, 8.-zyuzyanya)
  • fill, rt. -zula, Kamuzyuzya mapopwe mubutala. Fill the maize-bin with maize. Also: -zuzya.
